/// Language-neutral read-only view of learning content.
///
/// Shared read-only content contract used by language-neutral learning services.
/// Concrete language models implement this contract at the language boundary.
abstract interface class LearningContent {
  String get id;
  String get sourceText;
  String get translationText;
  String get exampleText;
  String get exampleTranslationText;
  String get topic;
  String get skill;
  String get grammaticalMarker;
  String get pluralForm;
  List<String> get acceptedForms;
}

extension LocalNormalizedDate on DateTime {
  /// Converts the date's local representation to UTC, retaining the exact
  /// local year, month, and day while setting time to midnight. This allows
  /// DST-safe date comparisons (e.g. difference in days) across midnight boundaries.
  DateTime get toUtcMidnight {
    final local = toLocal();
    return DateTime.utc(local.year, local.month, local.day);
  }

  /// Converts the date's local representation to UTC, retaining the exact
  /// local year, month, day, and time. This allows safe, constant-interval
  /// time comparisons without local DST skips impacting difference calculations.
  DateTime get toUtcNominal {
    final local = toLocal();
    return DateTime.utc(
      local.year,
      local.month,
      local.day,
      local.hour,
      local.minute,
      local.second,
      local.millisecond,
    );
  }
}

/// Immutable metadata for one directed lexical deck.
final class DeckMetadata {
  const DeckMetadata({
    required this.deckId,
    required this.sourceLanguage,
    required this.targetLanguage,
    required this.cefrLevel,
    required this.version,
    required this.totalCards,
  });

  final String deckId;
  final String sourceLanguage;
  final String targetLanguage;
  final String cefrLevel;
  final String version;
  final int totalCards;
}

/// One optional example sentence attached to a vocabulary card.
final class ExampleSentence {
  const ExampleSentence({
    required this.textSource,
    required this.textTarget,
    this.contextNote,
  });

  final String textSource;
  final String textTarget;
  final String? contextNote;
}

/// Directed lexical card produced from one canonical matrix entry.
final class VocabularyCard {
  const VocabularyCard({
    required this.id,
    required this.term,
    required this.transliteration,
    required this.partOfSpeech,
    required this.definitions,
    required this.exampleSentences,
    this.audioMarker,
  });

  final String id;
  final String term;
  final String transliteration;
  final String partOfSpeech;
  final Map<String, String> definitions;
  final List<ExampleSentence> exampleSentences;
  final String? audioMarker;
}

/// Parsed, validated directed deck.
final class ParsedDeck {
  const ParsedDeck({required this.metadata, required this.cards});

  final DeckMetadata metadata;
  final List<VocabularyCard> cards;
}

import 'deck_models.dart';

/// Pure-Dart ingestion boundary for directed lexical decks.
abstract interface class DeckParserContract {
  ParsedDeck parse(
    String jsonText, {
    required String deckId,
    required String sourceLanguage,
    required String targetLanguage,
  });
}


--------------------------------------------------
FILE: lib/core/deck/deck_validation.dart
--------------------------------------------------
enum DeckValidationErrorCode {
  invalidJson,
  invalidRoot,
  missingRequiredField,
  invalidFieldType,
  invalidValue,
  directionMismatch,
  inconsistentMetadata,
}

final class DeckValidationError {
  const DeckValidationError({
    required this.code,
    required this.path,
    required this.message,
  });

  final DeckValidationErrorCode code;
  final String path;
  final String message;

  @override
  String toString() => '$path: $message';
}

/// Typed aggregate validation failure with every provable error from one pass.
final class DeckValidationException implements Exception {
  DeckValidationException(Iterable<DeckValidationError> errors)
      : errors = List<DeckValidationError>.unmodifiable(errors);

  final List<DeckValidationError> errors;

  @override
  String toString() =>
      'DeckValidationException(${errors.map((error) => error.toString()).join('; ')})';
}


--------------------------------------------------
FILE: lib/core/deck/json_deck_parser.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'dart:convert';

import 'deck_models.dart';
import 'deck_parser_contract.dart';
import 'deck_validation.dart';

/// Pure-Dart parser for the canonical language-matrix JSON schema.
///
/// Compatibility target: tools/data_generator/schema.json version 1.0.0.
/// Every accepted entry must match the explicit source -> target direction.
final class JsonDeckParser implements DeckParserContract {
  static const String supportedSchemaVersion = '1.0.0';

  static const Set<String> _cefrLevels = <String>{'A1', 'A2', 'B1', 'B2'};
  static const Set<String> _partsOfSpeech = <String>{
    'noun',
    'verb',
    'adjective',
    'adverb',
    'pronoun',
    'preposition',
    'conjunction',
    'interjection',
    'determiner',
    'numeral',
    'phrase',
    'other',
  };

  static const Set<String> _rootKeys = <String>{'schema_version', 'entries'};
  static const Set<String> _entryKeys = <String>{
    'canonical_key',
    'cefr_level',
    'source_text',
    'target_text',
    'pair_identity',
    'phonetics',
    'part_of_speech',
    'bidirectional_flag',
    'rtl_flag',
    'concept_id',
    'domain',
    'plural_form',
    'source_rtl',
    'target_rtl',
    'example_sentence',
  };
  static const Set<String> _pairKeys = <String>{
    'id',
    'source_language',
    'target_language',
    'source_direction',
    'target_direction',
    'record_id',
    'reverse_record_id',
  };
  static const Set<String> _phoneticKeys = <String>{'source', 'target'};
  static const Set<String> _exampleKeys = <String>{'source', 'target'};
  static const Set<String> _domains = <String>{
    'workplace_healthcare',
    'emergency',
    'bureaucracy_registration',
    'daily_essentials',
  };
  static final RegExp _canonicalKeyPattern = RegExp(
    r'^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]*$',
  );
  static final RegExp _languagePattern = RegExp(
    r'^[a-z]{2,3}(?:-[a-z0-9]{2,8})*$',
  );

  @override
  ParsedDeck parse(
    String jsonText, {
    required String deckId,
    required String sourceLanguage,
    required String targetLanguage,
  }) {
    final errors = <DeckValidationError>[];

    final normalizedDeckId = deckId.trim();
    if (normalizedDeckId.isEmpty) {
      errors.add(
        const DeckValidationError(
          code: DeckValidationErrorCode.invalidValue,
          path: r'$.deckId',
          message: 'deckId must not be empty',
        ),
      );
    }

    final expectedSource = _normalizeLanguage(
      sourceLanguage,
      r'$.sourceLanguage',
      errors,
    );
    final expectedTarget = _normalizeLanguage(
      targetLanguage,
      r'$.targetLanguage',
      errors,
    );

    if (expectedSource != null &&
        expectedTarget != null &&
        expectedSource == expectedTarget) {
      errors.add(
        const DeckValidationError(
          code: DeckValidationErrorCode.directionMismatch,
          path: r'$.pair',
          message: 'source and target languages must differ',
        ),
      );
    }

    Object? decoded;
    try {
      decoded = jsonDecode(jsonText);
    } on FormatException catch (error) {
      throw DeckValidationException(<DeckValidationError>[
        DeckValidationError(
          code: DeckValidationErrorCode.invalidJson,
          path: r'$',
          message: 'invalid JSON: ${error.message}',
        ),
      ]);
    }

    final root = _stringMap(decoded);
    if (root == null) {
      errors.add(
        const DeckValidationError(
          code: DeckValidationErrorCode.invalidRoot,
          path: r'$',
          message: 'dataset root must be an object',
        ),
      );
      throw DeckValidationException(errors);
    }

    _rejectUnexpectedKeys(root, _rootKeys, r'$', errors);

    final version = _requiredString(
      root,
      'schema_version',
      r'$.schema_version',
      errors,
    );
    if (version != null && version != supportedSchemaVersion) {
      errors.add(
        DeckValidationError(
          code: DeckValidationErrorCode.invalidValue,
          path: r'$.schema_version',
          message:
              'expected schema version $supportedSchemaVersion, got $version',
        ),
      );
    }

    final entriesValue = root['entries'];
    if (!root.containsKey('entries')) {
      errors.add(
        const DeckValidationError(
          code: DeckValidationErrorCode.missingRequiredField,
          path: r'$.entries',
          message: 'required property missing',
        ),
      );
    } else if (entriesValue is! List) {
      errors.add(
        const DeckValidationError(
          code: DeckValidationErrorCode.invalidFieldType,
          path: r'$.entries',
          message: 'expected array',
        ),
      );
    } else if (entriesValue.isEmpty) {
      errors.add(
        const DeckValidationError(
          code: DeckValidationErrorCode.invalidValue,
          path: r'$.entries',
          message: 'entries must contain at least one item',
        ),
      );
    }

    if (entriesValue is! List || entriesValue.isEmpty) {
      throw DeckValidationException(errors);
    }

    final cards = <VocabularyCard>[];
    String? deckLevel;

    for (var index = 0; index < entriesValue.length; index++) {
      final itemPath = r'$.entries[' + index.toString() + ']';
      final before = errors.length;
      final entry = _stringMap(entriesValue[index]);

      if (entry == null) {
        errors.add(
          DeckValidationError(
            code: DeckValidationErrorCode.invalidFieldType,
            path: itemPath,
            message: 'entry must be an object',
          ),
        );
        continue;
      }

      _rejectUnexpectedKeys(entry, _entryKeys, itemPath, errors);

      final canonicalKey = _requiredString(
        entry,
        'canonical_key',
        '$itemPath.canonical_key',
        errors,
        nonEmpty: true,
      );
      if (canonicalKey != null &&
          !_canonicalKeyPattern.hasMatch(canonicalKey)) {
        errors.add(
          DeckValidationError(
            code: DeckValidationErrorCode.invalidValue,
            path: '$itemPath.canonical_key',
            message: 'canonical key does not match matrix schema pattern',
          ),
        );
      }

      final cefrLevel = _requiredString(
        entry,
        'cefr_level',
        '$itemPath.cefr_level',
        errors,
        nonEmpty: true,
      );
      if (cefrLevel != null && !_cefrLevels.contains(cefrLevel)) {
        errors.add(
          DeckValidationError(
            code: DeckValidationErrorCode.invalidValue,
            path: '$itemPath.cefr_level',
            message: 'unsupported CEFR level: $cefrLevel',
          ),
        );
      } else if (cefrLevel != null) {
        if (deckLevel == null) {
          deckLevel = cefrLevel;
        } else if (deckLevel != cefrLevel) {
          errors.add(
            DeckValidationError(
              code: DeckValidationErrorCode.inconsistentMetadata,
              path: '$itemPath.cefr_level',
              message: 'all entries in a deck must share one CEFR level',
            ),
          );
        }
      }

      final sourceText = _requiredString(
        entry,
        'source_text',
        '$itemPath.source_text',
        errors,
        nonEmpty: true,
      );
      final targetText = _requiredString(
        entry,
        'target_text',
        '$itemPath.target_text',
        errors,
        nonEmpty: true,
      );

      final partOfSpeech = _requiredString(
        entry,
        'part_of_speech',
        '$itemPath.part_of_speech',
        errors,
        nonEmpty: true,
      );
      if (partOfSpeech != null && !_partsOfSpeech.contains(partOfSpeech)) {
        errors.add(
          DeckValidationError(
            code: DeckValidationErrorCode.invalidValue,
            path: '$itemPath.part_of_speech',
            message: 'unsupported part_of_speech: $partOfSpeech',
          ),
        );
      }

      _requiredBool(
        entry,
        'bidirectional_flag',
        '$itemPath.bidirectional_flag',
        errors,
      );
      _requiredBool(entry, 'rtl_flag', '$itemPath.rtl_flag', errors);

      _validateOptionalEntryFields(entry, itemPath, errors);

      final pair = _requiredMap(
        entry,
        'pair_identity',
        '$itemPath.pair_identity',
        errors,
      );
      final pairData = pair == null
          ? null
          : _validatePair(
              pair,
              '$itemPath.pair_identity',
              expectedSource,
              expectedTarget,
              errors,
            );

      final phonetics = _requiredMap(
        entry,
        'phonetics',
        '$itemPath.phonetics',
        errors,
      );
      String? sourcePhonetics;
      if (phonetics != null) {
        _rejectUnexpectedKeys(
          phonetics,
          _phoneticKeys,
          '$itemPath.phonetics',
          errors,
        );
        sourcePhonetics = _requiredString(
          phonetics,
          'source',
          '$itemPath.phonetics.source',
          errors,
        );
        _requiredString(
          phonetics,
          'target',
          '$itemPath.phonetics.target',
          errors,
        );
      }

      final exampleSentences = <ExampleSentence>[];
      if (entry.containsKey('example_sentence')) {
        final example = _stringMap(entry['example_sentence']);
        if (example == null) {
          errors.add(
            DeckValidationError(
              code: DeckValidationErrorCode.invalidFieldType,
              path: '$itemPath.example_sentence',
              message: 'expected object',
            ),
          );
        } else {
          _rejectUnexpectedKeys(
            example,
            _exampleKeys,
            '$itemPath.example_sentence',
            errors,
          );
          final exampleSource = _requiredString(
            example,
            'source',
            '$itemPath.example_sentence.source',
            errors,
            nonEmpty: true,
          );
          final exampleTarget = _requiredString(
            example,
            'target',
            '$itemPath.example_sentence.target',
            errors,
            nonEmpty: true,
          );
          if (exampleSource != null && exampleTarget != null) {
            exampleSentences.add(
              ExampleSentence(
                textSource: exampleSource,
                textTarget: exampleTarget,
                contextNote: null,
              ),
            );
          }
        }
      }

      if (errors.length == before &&
          canonicalKey != null &&
          sourceText != null &&
          targetText != null &&
          partOfSpeech != null &&
          sourcePhonetics != null &&
          pairData != null) {
        cards.add(
          VocabularyCard(
            id: canonicalKey,
            term: sourceText,
            transliteration: sourcePhonetics,
            partOfSpeech: partOfSpeech,
            definitions: Map<String, String>.unmodifiable(<String, String>{
              pairData.targetLanguage: targetText,
            }),
            exampleSentences: List<ExampleSentence>.unmodifiable(
              exampleSentences,
            ),
            audioMarker: null,
          ),
        );
      }
    }

    if (errors.isNotEmpty) {
      throw DeckValidationException(errors);
    }

    if (version == null ||
        deckLevel == null ||
        expectedSource == null ||
        expectedTarget == null) {
      throw DeckValidationException(<DeckValidationError>[
        const DeckValidationError(
          code: DeckValidationErrorCode.invalidRoot,
          path: r'$',
          message: 'deck metadata could not be derived',
        ),
      ]);
    }

    return ParsedDeck(
      metadata: DeckMetadata(
        deckId: normalizedDeckId,
        sourceLanguage: expectedSource,
        targetLanguage: expectedTarget,
        cefrLevel: deckLevel,
        version: version,
        totalCards: cards.length,
      ),
      cards: List<VocabularyCard>.unmodifiable(cards),
    );
  }

  void _validateOptionalEntryFields(
    Map<String, Object?> entry,
    String path,
    List<DeckValidationError> errors,
  ) {
    if (entry.containsKey('concept_id')) {
      final conceptId = _optionalNonEmptyString(
        entry,
        'concept_id',
        '$path.concept_id',
        errors,
      );
      if (conceptId != null && !_canonicalKeyPattern.hasMatch(conceptId)) {
        errors.add(
          DeckValidationError(
            code: DeckValidationErrorCode.invalidValue,
            path: '$path.concept_id',
            message: 'concept_id does not match matrix schema pattern',
          ),
        );
      }
    }

    if (entry.containsKey('plural_form')) {
      _optionalNonEmptyString(
        entry,
        'plural_form',
        '$path.plural_form',
        errors,
      );
    }

    if (entry.containsKey('domain')) {
      final domain = _optionalNonEmptyString(
        entry,
        'domain',
        '$path.domain',
        errors,
      );
      if (domain != null && !_domains.contains(domain)) {
        errors.add(
          DeckValidationError(
            code: DeckValidationErrorCode.invalidValue,
            path: '$path.domain',
            message: 'unsupported domain: $domain',
          ),
        );
      }
    }

    for (final key in <String>['source_rtl', 'target_rtl']) {
      if (entry.containsKey(key) && entry[key] is! bool) {
        errors.add(
          DeckValidationError(
            code: DeckValidationErrorCode.invalidFieldType,
            path: '$path.$key',
            message: 'expected boolean',
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  _PairData? _validatePair(
    Map<String, Object?> pair,
    String path,
    String? expectedSource,
    String? expectedTarget,
    List<DeckValidationError> errors,
  ) {
    final before = errors.length;
    _rejectUnexpectedKeys(pair, _pairKeys, path, errors);

    final id = _requiredString(pair, 'id', '$path.id', errors, nonEmpty: true);
    final source = _requiredString(
      pair,
      'source_language',
      '$path.source_language',
      errors,
      nonEmpty: true,
    );
    final target = _requiredString(
      pair,
      'target_language',
      '$path.target_language',
      errors,
      nonEmpty: true,
    );
    final sourceDirection = _requiredString(
      pair,
      'source_direction',
      '$path.source_direction',
      errors,
      nonEmpty: true,
    );
    final targetDirection = _requiredString(
      pair,
      'target_direction',
      '$path.target_direction',
      errors,
      nonEmpty: true,
    );

    for (final key in <String>['record_id', 'reverse_record_id']) {
      if (pair.containsKey(key)) {
        _optionalNonEmptyString(pair, key, '$path.$key', errors);
      }
    }

    if (source != null && !_languagePattern.hasMatch(source)) {
      errors.add(
        DeckValidationError(
          code: DeckValidationErrorCode.invalidValue,
          path: '$path.source_language',
          message: 'invalid language code',
        ),
      );
    }
    if (target != null && !_languagePattern.hasMatch(target)) {
      errors.add(
        DeckValidationError(
          code: DeckValidationErrorCode.invalidValue,
          path: '$path.target_language',
          message: 'invalid language code',
        ),
      );
    }

    if (source != null && target != null) {
      if (source == target) {
        errors.add(
          DeckValidationError(
            code: DeckValidationErrorCode.directionMismatch,
            path: path,
            message: 'source and target language must differ',
          ),
        );
      }

      if (expectedSource != null &&
          expectedTarget != null &&
          (source != expectedSource || target != expectedTarget)) {
        errors.add(
          DeckValidationError(
            code: DeckValidationErrorCode.directionMismatch,
            path: path,
            message:
                'expected directed pair $expectedSource->$expectedTarget, got $source->$target',
          ),
        );
      }

      final expectedId = '$source->$target';
      if (id != null && id != expectedId) {
        errors.add(
          DeckValidationError(
            code: DeckValidationErrorCode.invalidValue,
            path: '$path.id',
            message: 'expected directed pair id $expectedId',
          ),
        );
      }
    }

    if (sourceDirection != null &&
        sourceDirection != 'ltr' &&
        sourceDirection != 'rtl') {
      errors.add(
        DeckValidationError(
          code: DeckValidationErrorCode.invalidValue,
          path: '$path.source_direction',
          message: 'direction must be ltr or rtl',
        ),
      );
    }
    if (targetDirection != null &&
        targetDirection != 'ltr' &&
        targetDirection != 'rtl') {
      errors.add(
        DeckValidationError(
          code: DeckValidationErrorCode.invalidValue,
          path: '$path.target_direction',
          message: 'direction must be ltr or rtl',
        ),
      );
    }

    if (errors.length != before || source == null || target == null) {
      return null;
    }
    return _PairData(sourceLanguage: source, targetLanguage: target);
  }

  String? _normalizeLanguage(
    String value,
    String path,
    List<DeckValidationError> errors,
  ) {
    final normalized = value.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!_languagePattern.hasMatch(normalized)) {
      errors.add(
        DeckValidationError(
          code: DeckValidationErrorCode.invalidValue,
          path: path,
          message: 'invalid language code: $value',
        ),
      );
      return null;
    }
    return normalized;
  }

  void _rejectUnexpectedKeys(
    Map<String, Object?> object,
    Set<String> allowed,
    String path,
    List<DeckValidationError> errors,
  ) {
    final unexpected =
        object.keys.where((key) => !allowed.contains(key)).toList()..sort();
    for (final key in unexpected) {
      errors.add(
        DeckValidationError(
          code: DeckValidationErrorCode.invalidValue,
          path: '$path.$key',
          message: 'unexpected property',
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  String? _requiredString(
    Map<String, Object?> object,
    String key,
    String path,
    List<DeckValidationError> errors, {
    bool nonEmpty = false,
  }) {
    if (!object.containsKey(key)) {
      errors.add(
        DeckValidationError(
          code: DeckValidationErrorCode.missingRequiredField,
          path: path,
          message: 'required property missing',
        ),
      );
      return null;
    }
    final value = object[key];
    if (value is! String) {
      errors.add(
        DeckValidationError(
          code: DeckValidationErrorCode.invalidFieldType,
          path: path,
          message: 'expected string',
        ),
      );
      return null;
    }
    if (nonEmpty && value.isEmpty) {
      errors.add(
        DeckValidationError(
          code: DeckValidationErrorCode.invalidValue,
          path: path,
          message: 'string must not be empty',
        ),
      );
      return null;
    }
    return value;
  }

  String? _optionalNonEmptyString(
    Map<String, Object?> object,
    String key,
    String path,
    List<DeckValidationError> errors,
  ) {
    final value = object[key];
    if (value is! String) {
      errors.add(
        DeckValidationError(
          code: DeckValidationErrorCode.invalidFieldType,
          path: path,
          message: 'expected string',
        ),
      );
      return null;
    }
    if (value.isEmpty) {
      errors.add(
        DeckValidationError(
          code: DeckValidationErrorCode.invalidValue,
          path: path,
          message: 'string must not be empty',
        ),
      );
      return null;
    }
    return value;
  }

  bool? _requiredBool(
    Map<String, Object?> object,
    String key,
    String path,
    List<DeckValidationError> errors,
  ) {
    if (!object.containsKey(key)) {
      errors.add(
        DeckValidationError(
          code: DeckValidationErrorCode.missingRequiredField,
          path: path,
          message: 'required property missing',
        ),
      );
      return null;
    }
    final value = object[key];
    if (value is! bool) {
      errors.add(
        DeckValidationError(
          code: DeckValidationErrorCode.invalidFieldType,
          path: path,
          message: 'expected boolean',
        ),
      );
      return null;
    }
    return value;
  }

  Map<String, Object?>? _requiredMap(
    Map<String, Object?> object,
    String key,
    String path,
    List<DeckValidationError> errors,
  ) {
    if (!object.containsKey(key)) {
      errors.add(
        DeckValidationError(
          code: DeckValidationErrorCode.missingRequiredField,
          path: path,
          message: 'required property missing',
        ),
      );
      return null;
    }
    final value = _stringMap(object[key]);
    if (value == null) {
      errors.add(
        DeckValidationError(
          code: DeckValidationErrorCode.invalidFieldType,
          path: path,
          message: 'expected object',
        ),
      );
    }
    return value;
  }

  Map<String, Object?>? _stringMap(Object? value) {
    if (value is! Map) {
      return null;
    }
    final result = <String, Object?>{};
    for (final entry in value.entries) {
      final key = entry.key;
      if (key is! String) {
        return null;
      }
      result[key] = entry.value;
    }
    return result;
  }
}

final class _PairData {
  const _PairData({required this.sourceLanguage, required this.targetLanguage});

  final String sourceLanguage;
  final String targetLanguage;
}

FILE: lib/core/language/app_text_direction.dart

/// Language-neutral text direction used by domain models.
enum AppTextDirection {
  ltr,
  rtl;

  String get jsonValue => name;

  /// Parses an explicit wire value when present, otherwise resolves a safe
  /// fallback from the language code.
  static AppTextDirection fromJson(
    Object? value, {
    required String languageCode,
  }) {
    if (value == null) {
      return forLanguage(languageCode);
    }
    if (value is! String) {
      throw FormatException('text direction must be a string');
    }

    switch (value.trim().toLowerCase()) {
      case 'ltr':
        return AppTextDirection.ltr;
      case 'rtl':
        return AppTextDirection.rtl;
      default:
        throw FormatException('unsupported text direction: $value');
    }
  }

  /// Deterministic compatibility fallback used only when metadata is absent.
  /// Arabic resolves to RTL; every other language defaults to LTR.
  static AppTextDirection forLanguage(String languageCode) {
    final normalized = languageCode.trim().toLowerCase();
    final primaryLanguage = normalized.split(RegExp(r'[-_]')).first;
    return primaryLanguage == 'ar'
        ? AppTextDirection.rtl
        : AppTextDirection.ltr;
  }
}

import 'app_text_direction.dart';

/// Direction-aware configuration for one explicit source -> target pair.
final class LanguageConfiguration {
  const LanguageConfiguration({
    required this.sourceLanguage,
    required this.targetLanguage,
    required this.sourceLanguageDirection,
    required this.targetLanguageDirection,
  });

  final String sourceLanguage;
  final String targetLanguage;
  final AppTextDirection sourceLanguageDirection;
  final AppTextDirection targetLanguageDirection;

  factory LanguageConfiguration.fromJson(Map<String, Object?> json) {
    final pairIdentity = _asStringMap(json['pair_identity']);

    final sourceLanguage = _requiredLanguage(
      _firstValue(json, const ['sourceLanguage', 'source_language']) ??
          pairIdentity?['source_language'],
      'source language',
    );
    final targetLanguage = _requiredLanguage(
      _firstValue(json, const ['targetLanguage', 'target_language']) ??
          pairIdentity?['target_language'],
      'target language',
    );

    final sourceDirection = _firstValue(json, const [
          'sourceLanguageDirection',
          'source_direction',
        ]) ??
        pairIdentity?['source_direction'];
    final targetDirection = _firstValue(json, const [
          'targetLanguageDirection',
          'target_direction',
        ]) ??
        pairIdentity?['target_direction'];

    return LanguageConfiguration(
      sourceLanguage: sourceLanguage,
      targetLanguage: targetLanguage,
      sourceLanguageDirection: AppTextDirection.fromJson(
        sourceDirection,
        languageCode: sourceLanguage,
      ),
      targetLanguageDirection: AppTextDirection.fromJson(
        targetDirection,
        languageCode: targetLanguage,
      ),
    );
  }

  Map<String, Object?> toJson() => <String, Object?>{
        'sourceLanguage': sourceLanguage,
        'targetLanguage': targetLanguage,
        'sourceLanguageDirection': sourceLanguageDirection.jsonValue,
        'targetLanguageDirection': targetLanguageDirection.jsonValue,
      };
}

Object? _firstValue(Map<String, Object?> json, List<String> keys) {
  for (final key in keys) {
    if (json.containsKey(key)) {
      return json[key];
    }
  }
  return null;
}

Map<String, Object?>? _asStringMap(Object? value) {
  if (value == null) return null;
  if (value is! Map) {
    throw FormatException('pair_identity must be an object');
  }

  final result = <String, Object?>{};
  for (final entry in value.entries) {
    if (entry.key is! String) {
      throw FormatException('pair_identity keys must be strings');
    }
    result[entry.key as String] = entry.value;
  }
  return result;
}

String _requiredLanguage(Object? value, String label) {
  if (value is! String || value.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw FormatException('$label must be a non-empty string');
  }
  return value.trim().toLowerCase();
}

import 'content_contract.dart';
import '../models/learner.dart';
import 'memory.dart';
import 'mastery.dart';

class DailyFocus {
  final int attempts;
  final int correct;
  final int due;
  final int goal;
  const DailyFocus({
    required this.attempts,
    required this.correct,
    required this.due,
    this.goal = 10,
  });
  double get progress => (attempts / goal).clamp(0, 1).toDouble();
  double get accuracy => attempts == 0 ? 0 : correct / attempts;
  factory DailyFocus.from(LearnerState s) {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final a = s.attempts
        .where(
          (x) =>
              x.at.year == now.year &&
              x.at.month == now.month &&
              x.at.day == now.day,
        )
        .toList();
    return DailyFocus(
      attempts: a.length,
      correct: a.where((x) => x.correct).length,
      due: s.review.length,
    );
  }
}

class LearningCore {
  static List<T> due<T extends LearningContent>(
    LearnerState s,
    Iterable<T> corpus, {
    required bool Function(T item) isLearnable,
    DateTime? now,
  }) {
    final at = now ?? DateTime.now();
    final dueIds = MemoryQueue.rank(s.meaningReviewCards, now: at, limit: 30);
    final dueItems = <T>[];
    for (final card in dueIds) {
      final item = _byId(corpus, card.itemId);
      if (item != null && isLearnable(item)) {
        dueItems.add(item);
      }
    }
    if (dueItems.isNotEmpty) return dueItems;
    final items = corpus.toList(growable: false);
    final legacy = items
        .where((x) => s.review.contains(x.id) && isLearnable(x))
        .take(20)
        .toList();
    if (legacy.isNotEmpty) return legacy;
    final weak = weakestSkill(s);
    final focused = <T>[];
    final fallback = <T>[];
    for (final item in items) {
      if (s.learned.contains(item.id) || !isLearnable(item)) continue;
      if (item.skill == weak) {
        if (focused.length < 30) focused.add(item);
      } else if (fallback.length < 30) {
        fallback.add(item);
      }
      if (focused.length >= 30 && fallback.length >= 30) break;
    }
    return [...focused, ...fallback].take(30).toList(growable: false);
  }

  static T? _byId<T extends LearningContent>(Iterable<T> corpus, String id) {
    for (final item in corpus) {
      if (item.id == id) return item;
    }
    return null;
  }

  static Map<String, List<Attempt>> _attemptsBySkill(LearnerState s) {
    final buckets = <String, List<Attempt>>{};
    for (final attempt in s.meaningAttempts) {
      (buckets[attempt.skill] ??= <Attempt>[]).add(attempt);
    }
    return buckets;
  }

  static String weakestSkill(LearnerState s) {
    const skills = ['recall', 'listening', 'production', 'transfer'];
    final attemptsBySkill = _attemptsBySkill(s);
    var best = 'recall';
    var value = 2.0;
    for (final skill in skills) {
      final a = attemptsBySkill[skill] ?? const <Attempt>[];
      if (a.length < 2) continue;
      final start = a.length > 12 ? a.length - 12 : 0;
      double weight = 1.0, total = 0, score = 0;
      for (var i = a.length - 1; i >= start; i--) {
        final x = a[i];
        score += (x.correct ? 1 : 0) * weight;
        total += weight;
        weight *= .92;
      }
      final measured = total == 0 ? 0.5 : score / total;
      if (measured < value) {
        value = measured;
        best = skill;
      }
    }
    return best;
  }

  static T? weakestItemForSkill<T extends LearningContent>(
    LearnerState s,
    String skill,
    Iterable<T> corpus, {
    required bool Function(T item) isLearnable,
    DateTime? now,
  }) {
    final attemptsByItem = <String, List<Attempt>>{};
    for (final attempt in s.attempts) {
      (attemptsByItem[attempt.itemId] ??= <Attempt>[]).add(attempt);
    }
    final at = now ?? DateTime.now();
    T? best;
    T? fallback;
    var bestScore = double.infinity;
    final items = corpus.toList(growable: false);
    for (final item in items) {
      if (item.skill != skill || !isLearnable(item)) continue;
      final itemAttempts = attemptsByItem[item.id];
      if (itemAttempts == null || itemAttempts.isEmpty) {
        fallback ??= item;
        continue;
      }
      final evidence = Mastery.forItemRows(
        item.id,
        itemAttempts,
        reviewCard: s.reviewCards[item.id],
        now: at,
      );
      final score = evidence.skillScores.isEmpty
          ? 0.0
          : (evidence.overall * .70 + evidence.retention * .30)
              .clamp(0.0, 1.0)
              .toDouble();
      if (best == null || score < bestScore) {
        best = item;
        bestScore = score;
        if (bestScore <= 0) break;
      }
    }
    return best ?? fallback;
  }

  static Map<String, double> skillScores(LearnerState s) {
    const skills = ['recall', 'listening', 'production', 'transfer'];
    final attemptsBySkill = _attemptsBySkill(s);
    return {
      for (final k in skills)
        k: _score(attemptsBySkill[k] ?? const <Attempt>[]),
    };
  }

  static double _score(List<Attempt> a) {
    if (a.isEmpty) return 0;
    final start = a.length > 20 ? a.length - 20 : 0;
    double w = 1, total = 0, score = 0;
    for (var i = a.length - 1; i >= start; i--) {
      final x = a[i];
      score += (x.correct ? 1 : 0) * w;
      total += w;
      w *= .94;
    }
    return total == 0 ? 0 : _clamp(score / total);
  }

  static double _clamp(double x) => x < 0
      ? 0
      : x > 1
          ? 1
          : x;
  static bool proofMastered(LearnerState s, String id) {
    final a =
        s.meaningAttempts.where((x) => x.itemId == id && x.correct).toList();
    final skills = a.map((x) => x.skill).toSet();
    return skills.containsAll([
          'recall',
          'listening',
          'production',
          'transfer',
        ]) &&
        a.length >= 5 &&
        !s.review.contains(id);
  }
}

class NextAction {
  final String skill, title, reason, cta;
  const NextAction(this.skill, this.title, this.reason, this.cta);
  factory NextAction.from(LearnerState s) {
    if (s.attempts.isEmpty)
      return const NextAction(
        'baseline',
        'اختبار البداية',
        'سنقيس مهاراتك أولًا بدل التخمين.',
        'ابدأ الاختبار',
      );
    if (s.review.isNotEmpty)
      return const NextAction(
        'review',
        'مراجعة ذكية',
        'لديك أخطاء لم تثبت قدرتك على تجاوزها بعد.',
        'ابدأ المراجعة',
      );
    final k = LearningCore.weakestSkill(s);
    const labels = {
      'recall': 'التعرّف',
      'listening': 'الاستماع',
      'production': 'الإنتاج',
      'transfer': 'النقل',
    };
    return NextAction(
      k,
      'درّب ${labels[k]}',
      'هذه أضعف مهارة مقاسة لديك حاليًا.',
      'ابدأ التدريب',
    );
  }
}

class WeeklyReport {
  final int attempts, correct, learned, reviews;
  final double accuracy;
  const WeeklyReport({
    required this.attempts,
    required this.correct,
    required this.learned,
    required this.reviews,
    required this.accuracy,
  });
  factory WeeklyReport.from(LearnerState s) {
    final since = DateTime.now().subtract(const Duration(days: 7));
    final a = s.attempts.where((x) => x.at.isAfter(since)).toList();
    return WeeklyReport(
      attempts: a.length,
      correct: a.where((x) => x.correct).length,
      learned: s.learned.length,
      reviews: s.review.length,
      accuracy: a.isEmpty ? 0 : a.where((x) => x.correct).length / a.length,
    );
  }
}

import '../language/app_text_direction.dart';
import '../language/language_configuration.dart';

/// Lossless domain view over one lexicon-pipeline vocabulary record.
///
/// Existing schema fields are preserved verbatim. Direction metadata is read
/// from the generated camelCase fields first, then pair_identity metadata, and
/// finally the language fallback policy when neither is present.
final class VocabularyEntry {
  VocabularyEntry._({
    required this.canonicalKey,
    required this.sourceText,
    required this.targetText,
    required this.languageConfiguration,
    required Map<String, Object?> rawJson,
    required bool hadSourceDirection,
    required bool hadTargetDirection,
  })  : _rawJson = rawJson,
        _hadSourceDirection = hadSourceDirection,
        _hadTargetDirection = hadTargetDirection;

  final String canonicalKey;
  final String sourceText;
  final String targetText;
  final LanguageConfiguration languageConfiguration;

  final Map<String, Object?> _rawJson;
  final bool _hadSourceDirection;
  final bool _hadTargetDirection;

  AppTextDirection get sourceLanguageDirection =>
      languageConfiguration.sourceLanguageDirection;
  AppTextDirection get targetLanguageDirection =>
      languageConfiguration.targetLanguageDirection;

  factory VocabularyEntry.fromJson(Map<String, Object?> json) {
    final snapshot = _cloneStringMap(json);
    return VocabularyEntry._(
      canonicalKey: _requiredString(snapshot['canonical_key'], 'canonical_key'),
      sourceText: _requiredString(snapshot['source_text'], 'source_text'),
      targetText: _requiredString(snapshot['target_text'], 'target_text'),
      languageConfiguration: LanguageConfiguration.fromJson(snapshot),
      rawJson: snapshot,
      hadSourceDirection: snapshot['sourceLanguageDirection'] is String,
      hadTargetDirection: snapshot['targetLanguageDirection'] is String,
    );
  }

  /// Serializes without changing the input schema shape by default.
  ///
  /// [includeResolvedDirections] can be used by newer writers to materialize
  /// fallback values explicitly while older records remain lossless.
  Map<String, Object?> toJson({bool includeResolvedDirections = false}) {
    final json = _cloneStringMap(_rawJson);
    if (_hadSourceDirection || includeResolvedDirections) {
      json['sourceLanguageDirection'] = sourceLanguageDirection.jsonValue;
    }
    if (_hadTargetDirection || includeResolvedDirections) {
      json['targetLanguageDirection'] = targetLanguageDirection.jsonValue;
    }
    return json;
  }
}

String _requiredString(Object? value, String field) {
  if (value is! String || value.isEmpty) {
    throw FormatException('$field must be a non-empty string');
  }
  return value;
}

Map<String, Object?> _cloneStringMap(Map<String, Object?> source) {
  return <String, Object?>{
    for (final entry in source.entries) entry.key: _cloneJsonValue(entry.value),
  };
}

Object? _cloneJsonValue(Object? value) {
  if (value is Map) {
    final clone = <String, Object?>{};
    for (final entry in value.entries) {
      if (entry.key is! String) {
        throw FormatException('JSON object keys must be strings');
      }
      clone[entry.key as String] = _cloneJsonValue(entry.value);
    }
    return clone;
  }
  if (value is List) {
    return <Object?>[for (final item in value) _cloneJsonValue(item)];
  }
  return value;
}

import 'dart:math' as math;

import '../models/learner.dart';

class MasteryEvidence {
  final Map<String, double> skillScores;
  final double retention;
  final double retrievability;

  /// Confidence reflects how much evidence supports the skill scores.
  /// It is deliberately a heuristic, not a calibrated probability.
  final double confidence;
  const MasteryEvidence(
    this.skillScores,
    this.retention,
    this.retrievability, {
    this.confidence = 0,
  });
  double get overall => skillScores.isEmpty
      ? 0
      : skillScores.values.reduce((a, b) => a + b) / skillScores.length;
  bool get isMastered =>
      skillScores.length >= 4 &&
      overall >= .80 &&
      confidence >= .55 &&
      retention >= .70 &&
      retrievability >= .70;
  int get nextReviewDays {
    if (retrievability <= 0 || skillScores.isEmpty) return 0;
    if (retrievability < .45) return 0;
    if (retrievability < .60) return 1;
    if (retrievability < .75) return 2;
    if (retrievability < .85) return 4;
    return 7;
  }

  String get nextAction {
    if (retrievability < .45) return 'review';
    if (skillScores.isEmpty) return 'learn';
    final weakest =
        skillScores.entries.reduce((a, b) => a.value <= b.value ? a : b).key;
    if ((skillScores[weakest] ?? 0) < .65) return weakest;
    if (retention < .65) return 'review';
    return 'consolidate';
  }
}

class Mastery {
  static MasteryEvidence forItem(
    String itemId,
    List<Attempt> attempts, {
    ReviewCard? reviewCard,
    DateTime? now,
  }) {
    return forItemRows(
      itemId,
      attempts.where((a) => a.itemId == itemId).toList(growable: false),
      reviewCard: reviewCard,
      now: now,
    );
  }

  /// Same mastery calculation when the caller already grouped attempts by item.
  /// This avoids an O(content × attempts) scan in dashboards and batch reports.
  static MasteryEvidence forItemRows(
    String itemId,
    List<Attempt> itemAttempts, {
    ReviewCard? reviewCard,
    DateTime? now,
  }) {
    const skills = ['recall', 'listening', 'production', 'transfer'];
    final scores = <String, double>{};
    final attemptsBySkill = <String, List<Attempt>>{};
    for (final a in itemAttempts) {
      (attemptsBySkill[a.skill] ??= <Attempt>[]).add(a);
    }
    for (final skill in skills) {
      final rows = attemptsBySkill[skill];
      if (rows == null || rows.isEmpty) continue;
      final recent = rows.length > 8 ? rows.sublist(rows.length - 8) : rows;
      var weight = 1.0;
      var total = 0.0;
      var score = 0.0;
      for (final a in recent.reversed) {
        score += (a.correct ? 1 : 0) * weight * (a.hinted ? .85 : 1);
        total += weight;
        weight *= .94;
      }
      const priorWeight = 2.0;
      scores[skill] =
          total == 0 ? 0 : (score + priorWeight * .50) / (total + priorWeight);
    }
    final at = now ?? DateTime.now();
    final retention = _retention(reviewCard);
    final retrievability = _retrievability(reviewCard, at);
    final evidenceCount = itemAttempts.length.clamp(0, 40).toDouble();
    final confidence = evidenceCount <= 0
        ? 0.0
        : (1 - math.exp(-evidenceCount / 8)).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
    return MasteryEvidence(
      scores,
      retention,
      retrievability,
      confidence: confidence,
    );
  }

  static double retentionForCard(ReviewCard? card) => _retention(card);

  static double _retention(ReviewCard? card) {
    if (card == null) return 0;
    final attempts = card.successes + card.failures;
    final observed = attempts <= 0 ? .50 : card.successRate;
    // Small samples are pulled gently toward a neutral prior instead of
    // allowing one or two successes to masquerade as durable retention.
    const priorWeight = 2.0;
    final evidenceWeight = attempts.toDouble();
    final smoothed = ((observed * evidenceWeight) + (.50 * priorWeight)) /
        (evidenceWeight + priorWeight);
    final intervalDurability = (card.intervalDays.clamp(0, 30) / 30).toDouble();
    final stabilityDurability =
        (card.stabilityDays.clamp(0, 30) / 30).toDouble();
    final durability = intervalDurability * .40 + stabilityDurability * .60;
    final lapseRecovery =
        math.exp(-card.lapses.clamp(0, 12) / 4).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
    return (smoothed * .55 + durability * .35 + lapseRecovery * .10)
        .clamp(0.0, 1.0)
        .toDouble();
  }

  static double _retrievability(ReviewCard? card, DateTime now) {
    if (card == null || card.lastReviewedAt == null || card.stabilityDays <= 0)
      return 0;
    final elapsed =
        math.max(0, now.difference(card.lastReviewedAt!).inMinutes) / (60 * 24);
    return math.exp(-elapsed / card.stabilityDays).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
  }
}

import '../models/learner.dart';
import 'srs.dart';

class MemoryQueue {
  static List<ReviewCard> rank(
    Iterable<ReviewCard> cards, {
    DateTime? now,
    int limit = 30,
  }) {
    final at = now ?? DateTime.now();
    final unique = <String, ReviewCard>{for (final c in cards) c.itemId: c};
    final boundedLimit = limit < 1 ? 1 : (limit > 100 ? 100 : limit);
    final scored = <ReviewCard, double>{};
    final top = <ReviewCard>[];
    for (final card in unique.values) {
      if (card.dueAt.isAfter(at)) continue;
      scored[card] = priority(card, at);
      final score = scored[card]!;
      var insertAt = top.length;
      for (var i = 0; i < top.length; i++) {
        final existingScore = scored[top[i]]!;
        if (score > existingScore ||
            (score == existingScore &&
                card.itemId.compareTo(top[i].itemId) < 0)) {
          insertAt = i;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (insertAt < boundedLimit) {
        top.insert(insertAt, card);
        if (top.length > boundedLimit) top.removeLast();
      }
    }
    return top;
  }

  static double priority(ReviewCard card, DateTime now) {
    if (card.dueAt.isAfter(now)) return 0;
    final overdueHours = now.difference(card.dueAt).inMinutes / 60;
    return 100 +
        overdueHours * 2 +
        card.lapses * 14 +
        (card.difficulty - 1) * 20 +
        (card.failures * 2) +
        Srs.reviewPriority(card, now: now) * 45;
  }

  static MemoryReviewReason reason(ReviewCard card, {DateTime? now}) {
    final at = now ?? DateTime.now();
    if (Srs.retrievability(card, now: at) < .45 && card.lastReviewedAt != null)
      return MemoryReviewReason.overdue;
    if (card.lapses > 0 && card.repetitions == 0)
      return MemoryReviewReason.lapse;
    if (card.dueAt.isBefore(at.subtract(const Duration(days: 1))))
      return MemoryReviewReason.overdue;
    if (card.memoryState == MemoryState.mature)
      return MemoryReviewReason.consolidation;
    return MemoryReviewReason.due;
  }
}

enum MemoryReviewReason { overdue, lapse, due, consolidation }

class MemorySnapshot {
  final int total, dueNow, overdue, mature, learning, relearning;
  final double retentionEstimate;
  const MemorySnapshot({
    required this.total,
    required this.dueNow,
    required this.overdue,
    required this.mature,
    required this.learning,
    required this.relearning,
    required this.retentionEstimate,
  });

  factory MemorySnapshot.from(Iterable<ReviewCard> cards, {DateTime? now}) {
    final at = now ?? DateTime.now();
    var total = 0;
    var due = 0;
    var overdue = 0;
    var mature = 0;
    var learning = 0;
    var relearning = 0;
    var retentionSum = 0.0;
    final overdueCutoff = at.subtract(const Duration(days: 1));
    for (final c in cards) {
      total++;
      if (!c.dueAt.isAfter(at)) due++;
      if (c.dueAt.isBefore(overdueCutoff)) overdue++;
      if (c.memoryState == MemoryState.mature) mature++;
      if (c.memoryState == MemoryState.learning ||
          c.memoryState == MemoryState.young) learning++;
      if (c.memoryState == MemoryState.relearning) relearning++;
      final intervalRatio = c.intervalDays / 30;
      final interval =
          intervalRatio < 0 ? 0.0 : (intervalRatio > 1 ? 1.0 : intervalRatio);
      final history = c.successRate;
      final lapsePenalty = (c.lapses * .05) > .35 ? .35 : (c.lapses * .05);
      retentionSum += (history * .65 + interval * .35 - lapsePenalty)
          .clamp(0, 1)
          .toDouble();
    }
    final retention = total == 0 ? 0.0 : retentionSum / total;
    return MemorySnapshot(
      total: total,
      dueNow: due,
      overdue: overdue,
      mature: mature,
      learning: learning,
      relearning: relearning,
      retentionEstimate: retention,
    );
  }
}

/// Small, dependency-free guards for runtime data and async boundaries.
T? safeFirst<T>(List<T>? values) {
  try {
    if (values == null || values.isEmpty) return null;
    return values.first;
  } catch (_) {
    return null;
  }
}

int safeIndex(int index, int length) {
  try {
    if (length <= 0 || index < 0 || index >= length) return -1;
    return index;
  } catch (_) {
    return -1;
  }
}

Future<T?> safeAsync<T>(Future<T> Function() action, {T? fallback}) async {
  try {
    return await action();
  } catch (_) {
    return fallback;
  }
}

FILE: lib/core/srs.dart

import 'dart:math' as math;

import '../models/learner.dart';
import 'date_utils.dart';

class Srs {
  static const schedule = <int>[1, 2, 4, 7, 12, 18, 30];

  static int nextDays({
    required bool correct,
    required bool hinted,
    required int repetitions,
  }) {
    if (!correct) return 0;
    final r = repetitions < 0 ? 0 : (repetitions > 20 ? 20 : repetitions);
    final rawIndex = r - (hinted ? 1 : 0);
    final index = rawIndex < 0
        ? 0
        : (rawIndex >= schedule.length ? schedule.length - 1 : rawIndex);
    return schedule[index];
  }

  static double retrievability(ReviewCard card, {DateTime? now}) {
    final at = now ?? DateTime.now();
    if (card.lastReviewedAt == null || card.stabilityDays <= 0) return 0;
    final elapsed = math.max(
          0,
          at.toUtcNominal
              .difference(card.lastReviewedAt!.toUtcNominal)
              .inMinutes,
        ) /
        (60 * 24);
    return math.exp(-elapsed / card.stabilityDays).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
  }

  static double reviewPriority(ReviewCard card, {DateTime? now}) {
    final at = now ?? DateTime.now();
    final r = retrievability(card, now: at);
    final overdueDays = card.dueAt.isAfter(at)
        ? 0.0
        : at.toUtcNominal.difference(card.dueAt.toUtcNominal).inMinutes /
            (60 * 24);
    final lapsePressure = card.lapses * 0.16 + card.failures * 0.025;
    final difficultyPressure =
        (card.difficulty - 1.0).clamp(0.0, 1.5).toDouble() * 0.08;
    return ((1 - r) * 0.62 +
            overdueDays.clamp(0, 30) / 30 * 0.22 +
            lapsePressure +
            difficultyPressure)
        .clamp(0.0, 2.0)
        .toDouble();
  }

  static ReviewCard update(
    ReviewCard current, {
    required bool correct,
    required bool hinted,
    DateTime? now,
  }) {
    final at = now ?? DateTime.now();
    if (!correct) {
      final stability = (current.stabilityDays <= 0
              ? current.intervalDays.toDouble()
              : current.stabilityDays) *
          .45;
      return current.copyWith(
        repetitions: 0,
        intervalDays: 0,
        lapses: current.lapses + 1,
        failures: current.failures + 1,
        difficulty: _bound(current.difficulty + .12, .5, 2.5),
        stabilityDays: _bound(stability, .25, 3650),
        dueAt: at,
        lastReviewedAt: at,
      );
    }
    final base = current.stabilityDays > 0
        ? current.stabilityDays
        : nextDays(
            correct: true,
            hinted: hinted,
            repetitions: current.repetitions,
          ).toDouble();
    final growth = hinted ? 1.28 : 1.62;
    final difficultyFactor = _bound(
      1.95 - current.difficulty * .22,
      1.35,
      1.85,
    );
    final stability =
        (base * growth * difficultyFactor).clamp(1, 3650).toDouble();
    final scheduled = nextDays(
      correct: true,
      hinted: hinted,
      repetitions: current.repetitions,
    );
    final days = current.repetitions < 2
        ? scheduled
        : _boundInt(stability.round(), 1, 3650);
    return current.copyWith(
      repetitions: current.repetitions + 1,
      intervalDays: days,
      successes: current.successes + 1,
      difficulty: _bound(current.difficulty + (hinted ? .015 : -.025), .5, 2.5),
      stabilityDays: stability,
      dueAt: at.add(Duration(days: days)),
      lastReviewedAt: at,
    );
  }

  static double _bound(double v, double min, double max) =>
      v < min ? min : (v > max ? max : v);
  static int _boundInt(int v, int min, int max) =>
      v < min ? min : (v > max ? max : v);
}

import 'srs_models.dart';

class SrsEngine {
  static const double _minEaseFactor = 1.3;

  SrsItemState calculateNextState(
    SrsItemState currentState,
    Rating rating,
    DateTime reviewTimeUtc,
  ) {
    if (!reviewTimeUtc.isUtc) {
      throw ArgumentError('reviewTimeUtc must be in UTC');
    }

    int nextInterval = currentState.intervalDays;
    int nextRepetitions = currentState.repetitions;
    double nextEaseFactor = currentState.easeFactor;
    CardState nextState = currentState.state;

    switch (rating) {
      case Rating.again:
        nextRepetitions = 0;
        nextInterval = 1;
        nextEaseFactor -= 0.20;
        nextState = CardState.learning;
        break;
      case Rating.hard:
        if (nextRepetitions == 0) {
          nextInterval = 1;
        } else {
          nextInterval = (nextInterval * 1.2).round();
        }
        nextRepetitions++;
        nextEaseFactor -= 0.15;
        nextState = CardState.reviewing;
        break;
      case Rating.good:
        if (nextRepetitions == 0) {
          nextInterval = 1;
        } else if (nextRepetitions == 1) {
          nextInterval = 6;
        } else {
          nextInterval = (nextInterval * nextEaseFactor).round();
        }
        nextRepetitions++;
        nextState = CardState.reviewing;
        break;
      case Rating.easy:
        if (nextRepetitions == 0) {
          nextInterval = 4;
        } else if (nextRepetitions == 1) {
          nextInterval = (6 * 1.3).round();
        } else {
          nextInterval = (nextInterval * nextEaseFactor * 1.3).round();
        }
        nextRepetitions++;
        nextEaseFactor += 0.15;
        nextState = CardState.mastered; // Just mapping it logically
        break;
    }

    if (nextEaseFactor < _minEaseFactor) {
      nextEaseFactor = _minEaseFactor;
    }

    // Ensure interval is at least 1 day for any progression
    if (nextInterval < 1) {
      nextInterval = 1;
    }

    DateTime dueDate = reviewTimeUtc.add(Duration(days: nextInterval));

    return currentState.copyWith(
      intervalDays: nextInterval,
      repetitions: nextRepetitions,
      easeFactor: nextEaseFactor,
      dueDate: dueDate,
      lastReviewedDate: reviewTimeUtc,
      state: nextState,
    );
  }
}

enum Rating { again, hard, good, easy }

class SrsItemState {

  final int repetitions;
  final double easeFactor;
  final DateTime dueDate;
  final DateTime? lastReviewedDate;
  final CardState state;

      dueDate: dueDate ?? this.dueDate,

    );
  }
}

enum ReviewFacetType {
  meaningRecall,
  gender,
  plural,
  caseForm,
  spelling,
  listening,
  pronunciation,
  verbValency,
  prepositionCase,
  separablePrefix,
  auxiliary,
  collocation,
  production,
  unknown;

  String get wireName => switch (this) {
        ReviewFacetType.meaningRecall => 'meaning_recall',
        ReviewFacetType.caseForm => 'case_form',
        ReviewFacetType.verbValency => 'verb_valency',
        ReviewFacetType.prepositionCase => 'preposition_case',
        ReviewFacetType.separablePrefix => 'separable_prefix',
        _ => name,
      };

  static ReviewFacetType fromWire(String? raw) {
    final value = raw?.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (value == null || value.isEmpty) {
      return ReviewFacetType.meaningRecall;
    }
    for (final facet in ReviewFacetType.values) {
      if (facet != ReviewFacetType.unknown && facet.wireName == value) {
        return facet;
      }
    }
    return ReviewFacetType.unknown;
  }
}

final class ReviewFacetKey {
  const ReviewFacetKey({
    required this.conceptId,
    this.facetType = ReviewFacetType.meaningRecall,
    this.variantKey,
  });

  static const String _prefix = '@facet::';

  final String conceptId;
  final ReviewFacetType facetType;
  final String? variantKey;

  String? get normalizedVariantKey => normalizeVariant(variantKey);

  bool get isValid {
    final id = conceptId.trim();
    final variant = normalizedVariantKey;
    return id.isNotEmpty &&
        id.length <= 160 &&
        facetType != ReviewFacetType.unknown &&
        (variant == null || variant.length <= 80);
  }

  bool get isLegacyMeaningKey =>
      facetType == ReviewFacetType.meaningRecall &&
      normalizedVariantKey == null;

  String get storageKey {
    final id = conceptId.trim();
    if (facetType == ReviewFacetType.meaningRecall &&
        normalizedVariantKey == null) {
      return id;
    }
    return '$_prefix'
        '${Uri.encodeComponent(id)}::'
        '${facetType.wireName}::'
        '${Uri.encodeComponent(normalizedVariantKey ?? '')}';
  }

  static ReviewFacetKey fromStorageKey(String raw) {
    final value = raw.trim();
    if (!value.startsWith(_prefix)) {
      return ReviewFacetKey(conceptId: value);
    }

    final payload = value.substring(_prefix.length);
    final parts = payload.split('::');
    if (parts.length != 3) {
      return const ReviewFacetKey(
        conceptId: '',
        facetType: ReviewFacetType.unknown,
      );
    }

    try {
      return ReviewFacetKey(
        conceptId: Uri.decodeComponent(parts[0]),
        facetType: ReviewFacetType.fromWire(parts[1]),
        variantKey: normalizeVariant(Uri.decodeComponent(parts[2])),
      );
    } on FormatException {
      return const ReviewFacetKey(
        conceptId: '',
        facetType: ReviewFacetType.unknown,
      );
    }
  }

  static String? normalizeVariant(String? raw) {
    final value = raw?.trim();
    return value == null || value.isEmpty ? null : value;
  }
}

import '../models/learner.dart';
import 'worker/persistent_cpu_worker.dart';
import 'worker/worker_contract.dart';

abstract interface class SrsScheduler {
  Future<ReviewCard> schedule(
    ReviewCard current, {
    required bool correct,
    required bool hinted,
    DateTime? now,
  });
}

final class SrsScheduleFailure implements Exception {
  const SrsScheduleFailure(this.code);

  final String code;

  @override
  String toString() => 'SrsScheduleFailure($code)';
}

/// Canonical scheduling boundary.
///
/// All schedule calculations are delegated to the one persistent CPU worker.
/// There is deliberately no synchronous/main-isolate algorithm fallback.
final class UnifiedSrsScheduler implements SrsScheduler {
  const UnifiedSrsScheduler({PersistentCpuWorker? worker})
      : _worker = worker;

  final PersistentCpuWorker? _worker;

  @override
  Future<ReviewCard> schedule(
    ReviewCard current, {
    required bool correct,
    required bool hinted,
    DateTime? now,
  }) async {
    if (!current.facetKey.isValid) {
      throw const SrsScheduleFailure('invalid_review_card');
    }

    final worker = _worker ?? PersistentCpuWorker.active;
    if (worker == null || worker.isClosed) {
      throw const SrsScheduleFailure(
        'persistent_cpu_worker_unavailable',
      );
    }

    final at = (now ?? DateTime.now()).toUtc();
    final epoch = worker.currentEpoch;
    final result = await worker.submit<Map<String, Object?>>(
      WorkerJob<Map<String, Object?>>(
        id: 'srs.$epoch.${at.microsecondsSinceEpoch}',
        type: WorkerJobTypes.srsSchedule,
        epoch: epoch,
        payload: <String, Object?>{
          'card': current.toJson(),
          'correct': correct,
          'hinted': hinted,
          'now': at.toIso8601String(),
        },
      ),
    );

    if (result.status != WorkerStatuses.ok ||
        result.payload == null) {
      throw SrsScheduleFailure(
        result.errorCode ?? result.status,
      );
    }

    return ReviewCard.fromJson(
      Map<String, dynamic>.from(result.payload!),
    );
  }

  int xpRewardForReview({
    required bool correct,
    required bool hinted,
  }) {
    if (!correct) return 2;
    return hinted ? 6 : 10;
  }
}

const UnifiedSrsScheduler unifiedSrsScheduler =
    UnifiedSrsScheduler();

import '../language/app_text_direction.dart';
import 'directional_text.dart';

abstract final class BidiBoundary {
  static const String lri = '\u2066';
  static const String rli = '\u2067';
  static const String fsi = '\u2068';
  static const String pdi = '\u2069';

  static String isolate(DirectionalText value) {
    final prefix = switch (value.direction) {
      AppTextDirection.ltr => lri,
      AppTextDirection.rtl => rli,
    };
    return prefix + value.text + pdi;
  }

  static String isolateUnknown(String text) => fsi + text + pdi;

  static String join(
    Iterable<DirectionalText> segments, {
    String separator = '',
  }) =>
      segments.map(isolate).join(separator);
}

final class TaskMemoryRecord {
  const TaskMemoryRecord({
    required this.taskId,
    required this.visits,
    required this.completed,
    required this.bestScore,
    required this.attempts,
  });

  final String taskId;
  final int visits;
  final bool completed;
  final double bestScore;
  final int attempts;

  TaskMemoryRecord recordVisit() => TaskMemoryRecord(
        taskId: taskId,
        visits: (visits + 1).clamp(0, 1000000).toInt(),
        completed: completed,
        bestScore: bestScore,
        attempts: attempts,
      );

  TaskMemoryRecord recordProgress({
    required double score,
    required bool isCompleted,
    required int attemptCount,
  }) =>
      TaskMemoryRecord(
        taskId: taskId,
        visits: visits,
        completed: completed || isCompleted,
        bestScore: score > bestScore ? score : bestScore,
        attempts: (attempts + attemptCount).clamp(0, 1000000).toInt(),
      );

  Map<String, Object?> toJson() => <String, Object?>{
        'taskId': taskId,
        'visits': visits,
        'completed': completed,
        'bestScore': bestScore,
        'attempts': attempts,
      };

  static TaskMemoryRecord? fromJson(Object? value) {
    if (value is! Map) return null;
    final taskId = value['taskId'];
    if (taskId is! String || taskId.trim().isEmpty) return null;
    return TaskMemoryRecord(
      taskId: taskId.trim(),
      visits: _int(value['visits']).clamp(0, 1000000).toInt(),
      completed: value['completed'] == true,
      bestScore: _double(value['bestScore']).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble(),
      attempts: _int(value['attempts']).clamp(0, 1000000).toInt(),
    );
  }
}

final class WeaknessMemoryRecord {
  const WeaknessMemoryRecord({
    required this.weaknessKey,
    required this.taskId,
    required this.weight,
    required this.occurrences,
    required this.lastSeenEpochMs,
  });

  final String weaknessKey;
  final String taskId;
  final int weight;
  final int occurrences;
  final int lastSeenEpochMs;

  WeaknessMemoryRecord add({
    required String nextTaskId,
    required int addedWeight,
    required int seenAtEpochMs,
  }) =>
      WeaknessMemoryRecord(
        weaknessKey: weaknessKey,
        taskId: nextTaskId.trim().isEmpty ? taskId : nextTaskId.trim(),
        weight: (weight + addedWeight).clamp(0, 1000000).toInt(),
        occurrences: (occurrences + 1).clamp(0, 1000000).toInt(),
        lastSeenEpochMs:
            seenAtEpochMs > lastSeenEpochMs ? seenAtEpochMs : lastSeenEpochMs,
      );

  Map<String, Object?> toJson() => <String, Object?>{
        'weaknessKey': weaknessKey,
        'taskId': taskId,
        'weight': weight,
        'occurrences': occurrences,
        'lastSeenEpochMs': lastSeenEpochMs,
      };

  static WeaknessMemoryRecord? fromJson(Object? value) {
    if (value is! Map) return null;
    final weaknessKey = value['weaknessKey'];
    final taskId = value['taskId'];
    if (weaknessKey is! String ||
        weaknessKey.trim().isEmpty ||
        taskId is! String ||
        taskId.trim().isEmpty) {
      return null;
    }
    return WeaknessMemoryRecord(
      weaknessKey: weaknessKey.trim(),
      taskId: taskId.trim(),
      weight: _int(value['weight']).clamp(0, 1000000).toInt(),
      occurrences: _int(value['occurrences']).clamp(0, 1000000).toInt(),
      lastSeenEpochMs: _int(value['lastSeenEpochMs']).clamp(0, 4102444800000).toInt(),
    );
  }
}

final class MemoryReviewPriority {
  const MemoryReviewPriority({
    required this.weaknessKey,
    required this.taskId,
    required this.weight,
    required this.occurrences,
    required this.lastSeenEpochMs,
  });

  final String weaknessKey;
  final String taskId;
  final int weight;
  final int occurrences;
  final int lastSeenEpochMs;
}

final class MemoryAgentSnapshot {
  MemoryAgentSnapshot._({
    required Map<String, TaskMemoryRecord> tasks,
    required Map<String, WeaknessMemoryRecord> weaknesses,
    required this.updatedAtEpochMs,
  })  : tasks = Map<String, TaskMemoryRecord>.unmodifiable(tasks),
        weaknesses =
            Map<String, WeaknessMemoryRecord>.unmodifiable(weaknesses);

  factory MemoryAgentSnapshot.empty() => MemoryAgentSnapshot._(
        tasks: const <String, TaskMemoryRecord>{},
        weaknesses: const <String, WeaknessMemoryRecord>{},
        updatedAtEpochMs: 0,
      );

  static const int schemaVersion = 1;
  static const int maxTaskRecords = 100;
  static const int maxWeaknessRecords = 200;

  final Map<String, TaskMemoryRecord> tasks;
  final Map<String, WeaknessMemoryRecord> weaknesses;
  final int updatedAtEpochMs;

  List<MemoryReviewPriority> get reviewPriorities {
    final ranked = weaknesses.values
        .map(
          (record) => MemoryReviewPriority(
            weaknessKey: record.weaknessKey,
            taskId: record.taskId,
            weight: record.weight,
            occurrences: record.occurrences,
            lastSeenEpochMs: record.lastSeenEpochMs,
          ),
        )
        .toList(growable: false)
      ..sort((a, b) {
        final byWeight = b.weight.compareTo(a.weight);
        if (byWeight != 0) return byWeight;
        final byOccurrences = b.occurrences.compareTo(a.occurrences);
        if (byOccurrences != 0) return byOccurrences;
        final byRecency = b.lastSeenEpochMs.compareTo(a.lastSeenEpochMs);
        if (byRecency != 0) return byRecency;
        return a.weaknessKey.compareTo(b.weaknessKey);
      });
    return List<MemoryReviewPriority>.unmodifiable(ranked);
  }

  MemoryAgentSnapshot recordVisit(
    String rawTaskId, {
    required int occurredAtEpochMs,
  }) {
    final taskId = _validatedId(rawTaskId, 'taskId');
    final nextTasks = <String, TaskMemoryRecord>{...tasks};
    final current = nextTasks[taskId] ??
        TaskMemoryRecord(
          taskId: taskId,
          visits: 0,
          completed: false,
          bestScore: 0,
          attempts: 0,
        );
    nextTasks[taskId] = current.recordVisit();
    return _copy(
      tasks: _boundedTasks(nextTasks),
      weaknesses: weaknesses,
      updatedAtEpochMs: _maxTimestamp(updatedAtEpochMs, occurredAtEpochMs),
    );
  }

  MemoryAgentSnapshot recordProgress({
    required String rawTaskId,
    required double score,
    required bool completed,
    required int attempts,
    required int occurredAtEpochMs,
  }) {
    final taskId = _validatedId(rawTaskId, 'taskId');
    final safeScore = score.clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
    final safeAttempts = attempts.clamp(0, 1000000).toInt();
    final nextTasks = <String, TaskMemoryRecord>{...this.tasks};
    final current = nextTasks[taskId] ??
        TaskMemoryRecord(
          taskId: taskId,
          visits: 0,
          completed: false,
          bestScore: 0,
          attempts: 0,
        );
    nextTasks[taskId] = current.recordProgress(
      score: safeScore,
      isCompleted: completed,
      attemptCount: safeAttempts,
    );
    return _copy(
      tasks: _boundedTasks(nextTasks),
      weaknesses: weaknesses,
      updatedAtEpochMs: _maxTimestamp(updatedAtEpochMs, occurredAtEpochMs),
    );
  }

  MemoryAgentSnapshot recordWeakness({
    required String rawTaskId,
    required String rawWeaknessKey,
    required int weight,
    required int occurredAtEpochMs,
  }) {
    final taskId = _validatedId(rawTaskId, 'taskId');
    final weaknessKey = _validatedId(rawWeaknessKey, 'weaknessKey');
    final safeWeight = weight.clamp(1, 1000).toInt();
    final nextWeaknesses = <String, WeaknessMemoryRecord>{...weaknesses};
    final current = nextWeaknesses[weaknessKey];
    nextWeaknesses[weaknessKey] = current == null
        ? WeaknessMemoryRecord(
            weaknessKey: weaknessKey,
            taskId: taskId,
            weight: safeWeight,
            occurrences: 1,
            lastSeenEpochMs: occurredAtEpochMs,
          )
        : current.add(
            nextTaskId: taskId,
            addedWeight: safeWeight,
            seenAtEpochMs: occurredAtEpochMs,
          );

    return _copy(
      tasks: tasks,
      weaknesses: _boundedWeaknesses(nextWeaknesses),
      updatedAtEpochMs: _maxTimestamp(updatedAtEpochMs, occurredAtEpochMs),
    );
  }

  String encode() => jsonEncode(
        <String, Object?>{
          'schemaVersion': schemaVersion,
          'updatedAtEpochMs': updatedAtEpochMs,
          'tasks': tasks.values.map((record) => record.toJson()).toList(),
          'weaknesses':
              weaknesses.values.map((record) => record.toJson()).toList(),
        },
      );

  static MemoryAgentSnapshot fromDecoded(Object? decoded) {
    if (decoded is! Map ||
        _int(decoded['schemaVersion']) != schemaVersion) {
      return MemoryAgentSnapshot.empty();
    }

    final tasks = <String, TaskMemoryRecord>{};
    final rawTasks = decoded['tasks'];
    if (rawTasks is List) {
      for (final raw in rawTasks.take(maxTaskRecords)) {
        final record = TaskMemoryRecord.fromJson(raw);
        if (record != null) tasks[record.taskId] = record;
      }
    }

    final weaknesses = <String, WeaknessMemoryRecord>{};
    final rawWeaknesses = decoded['weaknesses'];
    if (rawWeaknesses is List) {
      for (final raw in rawWeaknesses.take(maxWeaknessRecords)) {
        final record = WeaknessMemoryRecord.fromJson(raw);
        if (record != null) weaknesses[record.weaknessKey] = record;
      }
    }

    return MemoryAgentSnapshot._(
      tasks: tasks,
      weaknesses: weaknesses,
      updatedAtEpochMs:
          _int(decoded['updatedAtEpochMs'])
              .clamp(0, 4102444800000)
              .toInt(),
    );
  }

  MemoryAgentSnapshot _copy({
    required Map<String, TaskMemoryRecord> tasks,
    required Map<String, WeaknessMemoryRecord> weaknesses,
    required int updatedAtEpochMs,
  }) =>
      MemoryAgentSnapshot._(
        tasks: tasks,
        weaknesses: weaknesses,
        updatedAtEpochMs: updatedAtEpochMs,
      );

  static Map<String, TaskMemoryRecord> _boundedTasks(
    Map<String, TaskMemoryRecord> source,
  ) {
    if (source.length <= maxTaskRecords) return source;
    final keys = source.keys.toList(growable: false)..sort();
    final keep = keys.skip(keys.length - maxTaskRecords).toSet();
    return <String, TaskMemoryRecord>{
      for (final entry in source.entries)
        if (keep.contains(entry.key)) entry.key: entry.value,
    };
  }

  static Map<String, WeaknessMemoryRecord> _boundedWeaknesses(
    Map<String, WeaknessMemoryRecord> source,
  ) {
    if (source.length <= maxWeaknessRecords) return source;
    final ranked = source.values.toList(growable: false)
      ..sort((a, b) {
        final byWeight = b.weight.compareTo(a.weight);
        if (byWeight != 0) return byWeight;
        return b.lastSeenEpochMs.compareTo(a.lastSeenEpochMs);
      });
    return <String, WeaknessMemoryRecord>{
      for (final record in ranked.take(maxWeaknessRecords))
        record.weaknessKey: record,
    };
  }
}

int _int(Object? value) => value is num ? value.toInt() : 0;

double _double(Object? value) => value is num ? value.toDouble() : 0;

int _maxTimestamp(int current, int candidate) =>
    candidate > current ? candidate : current;

String _validatedId(String raw, String field) {
  final value = raw.trim();
  if (value.isEmpty || value.length > 160) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(raw, field, '$field must be 1..160 characters.');
  }
  return value;
}
