import '../localization/locale_provider.dart';
import '../orchestration/orchestration.dart';

final class PolyglotMatrixState {
  PolyglotMatrixState({
    required String sourceLanguageTag,
    required String targetLanguageTag,
    required this.revision,
  })  : sourceLanguageTag =
            AppLocale.parse(sourceLanguageTag).languageTag,
        targetLanguageTag =
            AppLocale.parse(targetLanguageTag).languageTag {
    if (revision < 0) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        revision,
        'revision',
        'must be non-negative',
      );
    }
  }

  factory PolyglotMatrixState.fromEvent(AgentEvent event) {
    if (event.topic != AgentTopics.polyglotMatrixChanged) {
      throw FormatException(
        'Expected ' +
            AgentTopics.polyglotMatrixChanged +
            ', got ' +
            event.topic +
            '.',
      );
    }
    return PolyglotMatrixState(
      sourceLanguageTag: _requiredString(
        event.payload['sourceLanguage'],
        'sourceLanguage',
      ),
      targetLanguageTag: _requiredString(
        event.payload['targetLanguage'],
        'targetLanguage',
      ),
      revision: _nonNegativeInt(event.payload['revision'], 'revision'),
    );
  }

  final String sourceLanguageTag;
  final String targetLanguageTag;
  final int revision;

  String get sourceLanguageCode =>
      AppLocale.parse(sourceLanguageTag).languageCode;

  String get targetLanguageCode =>
      AppLocale.parse(targetLanguageTag).languageCode;

  String get directedPairKey =>
      sourceLanguageTag + '->' + targetLanguageTag;

  bool get isIdentityPair =>
      sourceLanguageTag == targetLanguageTag;

  Map<String, Object?> toEventPayload() => <String, Object?>{
        'sourceLanguage': sourceLanguageTag,
        'targetLanguage': targetLanguageTag,
        'directedPair': directedPairKey,
        'revision': revision,
        'identityPair': isIdentityPair,
      };
}

enum UniversalGrammarCapability {
  konjunktivIi,
  comparativeSuperlative;

  String get wireName => switch (this) {
        UniversalGrammarCapability.konjunktivIi => 'konjunktiv_ii',
        UniversalGrammarCapability.comparativeSuperlative =>
          'comparative_superlative',
      };

  static UniversalGrammarCapability parse(Object? value) {
    final normalized = _requiredString(value, 'capability')
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase();
    return switch (normalized) {
      'konjunktiv_ii' => UniversalGrammarCapability.konjunktivIi,
      'comparative_superlative' =>
        UniversalGrammarCapability.comparativeSuperlative,
      _ => throw FormatException(
          'Unsupported grammar capability: ' + normalized,
        ),
    };
  }
}

final class GrammarAgentResult {
  GrammarAgentResult({
    required this.ok,
    required String capability,
    required String targetLanguageTag,
    required String engineId,
    required List<Map<String, Object?>> items,
    this.errorCode,
    this.message,
  })  : capability = capability.trim(),
        targetLanguageTag =
            AppLocale.parse(targetLanguageTag).languageTag,
        engineId = engineId.trim(),
        items = List<Map<String, Object?>>.unmodifiable(
          items.map(
            (item) => Map<String, Object?>.unmodifiable(item),
          ),
        ) {
    if (this.capability.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('capability must not be empty.');
    }
    if (this.engineId.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('engineId must not be empty.');
    }
  }

  factory GrammarAgentResult.fromEvent(AgentEvent event) {
    if (event.topic != AgentTopics.grammarResponse) {
      throw FormatException(
        'Expected ' +
            AgentTopics.grammarResponse +
            ', got ' +
            event.topic +
            '.',
      );
    }

    final rawItems = event.payload['items'];
    final items = <Map<String, Object?>>[];
    if (rawItems is List) {
      for (final item in rawItems) {
        if (item is! Map) {
          throw const FormatException(
            'Grammar response items must be maps.',
          );
        }
        final converted = <String, Object?>{};
        for (final entry in item.entries) {
          if (entry.key is! String) {
            throw const FormatException(
              'Grammar response item keys must be strings.',
            );
          }
          converted[entry.key as String] = entry.value;
        }
        items.add(converted);
      }
    }

    return GrammarAgentResult(
      ok: event.payload['ok'] == true,
      capability: _requiredString(
        event.payload['capability'],
        'capability',
      ),
      targetLanguageTag: _requiredString(
        event.payload['targetLanguage'],
        'targetLanguage',
      ),
      engineId: _requiredString(
        event.payload['engineId'],
        'engineId',
      ),
      items: items,
      errorCode: _optionalString(event.payload['errorCode']),
      message: _optionalString(event.payload['message']),
    );
  }

  final bool ok;
  final String capability;
  final String targetLanguageTag;
  final String engineId;
  final List<Map<String, Object?>> items;
  final String? errorCode;
  final String? message;
}

final class TtsVoiceRequest {
  TtsVoiceRequest({
    required String text,
    required String targetLanguageTag,
    required double speed,
  })  : text = _validatedSpeechText(text),
        targetLanguageTag =
            AppLocale.parse(targetLanguageTag).languageTag,
        speed = _validatedSpeed(speed);

  factory TtsVoiceRequest.fromEvent(AgentEvent event) {
    if (event.topic != AgentTopics.ttsRequest) {
      throw FormatException(
        'Expected ' +
            AgentTopics.ttsRequest +
            ', got ' +
            event.topic +
            '.',
      );
    }
    final rawSpeed = event.payload['speed'];
    if (rawSpeed is! num) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'TTS speed must be numeric.',
      );
    }
    return TtsVoiceRequest(
      text: _requiredString(event.payload['text'], 'text'),
      targetLanguageTag: _requiredString(
        event.payload['targetLanguage'],
        'targetLanguage',
      ),
      speed: rawSpeed.toDouble(),
    );
  }

  final String text;
  final String targetLanguageTag;
  final double speed;

  Map<String, Object?> toEventPayload() => <String, Object?>{
        'text': text,
        'targetLanguage': targetLanguageTag,
        'speed': speed,
      };
}

final class TtsVoiceDispatch {
  TtsVoiceDispatch({
    required this.accepted,
    required String text,
    required String targetLanguageTag,
    required double speed,
    required String backend,
    this.rejectionReason,
  })  : text = text.trim(),
        targetLanguageTag =
            AppLocale.parse(targetLanguageTag).languageTag,
        speed = speed,
        backend = backend.trim() {
    if (this.backend.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('backend must not be empty.');
    }
  }

  factory TtsVoiceDispatch.fromEvent(AgentEvent event) {
    if (event.topic != AgentTopics.ttsPrepared) {
      throw FormatException(
        'Expected ' +
            AgentTopics.ttsPrepared +
            ', got ' +
            event.topic +
            '.',
      );
    }
    final rawSpeed = event.payload['speed'];
    if (rawSpeed is! num) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Prepared TTS speed must be numeric.',
      );
    }
    return TtsVoiceDispatch(
      accepted: event.payload['accepted'] == true,
      text: _requiredString(event.payload['text'], 'text'),
      targetLanguageTag: _requiredString(
        event.payload['targetLanguage'],
        'targetLanguage',
      ),
      speed: rawSpeed.toDouble(),
      backend: _requiredString(event.payload['backend'], 'backend'),
      rejectionReason:
          _optionalString(event.payload['rejectionReason']),
    );
  }

  final bool accepted;
  final String text;
  final String targetLanguageTag;
  final double speed;
  final String backend;
  final String? rejectionReason;
}

String _validatedSpeechText(String value) {
  final normalized = value.trim();
  if (normalized.isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(
      value,
      'text',
      'TTS text must not be empty.',
    );
  }
  if (normalized.length > 4000) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(
      normalized.length,
      'text.length',
      'TTS text must not exceed 4000 characters.',
    );
  }
  return normalized;
}

double _validatedSpeed(double value) {
  if (!value.isFinite || value < 0.5 || value > 2.0) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(
      value,
      'speed',
      'TTS speed must be between 0.5 and 2.0.',
    );
  }
  return value;
}

String _requiredString(Object? value, String field) {
  if (value is! String || value.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw FormatException(field + ' must be a non-empty string.');
  }
  return value.trim();
}

String? _optionalString(Object? value) {
  if (value == null) return null;
  if (value is! String) {
    throw const FormatException(
      'Optional text values must be strings.',
    );
  }
  final normalized = value.trim();
  return normalized.isEmpty ? null : normalized;
}

int _nonNegativeInt(Object? value, String field) {
  if (value is! num) {
    throw FormatException(field + ' must be numeric.');
  }
  final result = value.toInt();
  if (result < 0) {
    throw FormatException(field + ' must be non-negative.');
  }
  return result;
}

import 'dart:async';

import '../orchestration/orchestration.dart';
import 'polyglot_agent_models.dart';
import 'sys_polyglot_matrix_agent.dart';
import 'sys_tts_voice_agent.dart';
import 'sys_universal_grammar_agent.dart';

Future<void> main() async {
  final bus = AgentEventBus.isolated();
  final kernel = OrchestrationKernel(
    eventBus: bus,
    services: ServiceContainer(),
  );

  final localization = kernel.connect(
    AgentDescriptor(
      id: 'contract.localization',
      role: AgentRole.localization,
      subscriptions: const <String>{AgentTopics.contextUpdated},
    ),
  );
  final polyglotEndpoint = kernel.connect(
    AgentDescriptor(
      id: 'contract.polyglot',
      role: AgentRole.polyglot,
      subscriptions: const <String>{
        AgentTopics.localizationChanged,
      },
      observesTargetedEvents: true,
    ),
  );
  final grammarEndpoint = kernel.connect(
    AgentDescriptor(
      id: 'contract.grammar',
      role: AgentRole.grammar,
      subscriptions: const <String>{
        AgentTopics.polyglotMatrixChanged,
        AgentTopics.grammarRequest,
      },
    ),
  );
  final voiceEndpoint = kernel.connect(
    AgentDescriptor(
      id: 'contract.voice',
      role: AgentRole.voice,
      subscriptions: const <String>{
        AgentTopics.polyglotMatrixChanged,
        AgentTopics.ttsRequest,
      },
    ),
  );
  final systemEndpoint = kernel.connect(
    AgentDescriptor(
      id: 'contract.system',
      role: AgentRole.system,
      subscriptions: const <String>{
        AgentTopics.polyglotMatrixChanged,
        AgentTopics.grammarEngineChanged,
        AgentTopics.grammarResponse,
        AgentTopics.ttsPrepared,
      },
    ),
  );

  final polyglot = SysPolyglotMatrixAgent.start(endpoint: polyglotEndpoint);
  final grammar = SysUniversalGrammarAgent.start(endpoint: grammarEndpoint);
  final voice = SysTtsVoiceAgent.start(endpoint: voiceEndpoint);

  final matrixEvent = Completer<AgentEvent>();
  final engineEvent = Completer<AgentEvent>();
  final matrixSub = systemEndpoint
      .events(AgentTopics.polyglotMatrixChanged)
      .listen((event) {
    if (!matrixEvent.isCompleted) matrixEvent.complete(event);
  });
  final engineSub = systemEndpoint
      .events(AgentTopics.grammarEngineChanged)
      .listen((event) {
    if (!engineEvent.isCompleted) engineEvent.complete(event);
  });

  localization.publish(
    topic: AgentTopics.localizationChanged,
    targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{
      AgentRole.design,
      AgentRole.routing,
    },
    context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty('polyglot-contract-1'),
    payload: const <String, Object?>{
      'revision': 7,
      'userLocale': 'ar-JO',
      'sourceLocale': 'ar',
      'targetLocale': 'de-DE',
      'direction': 'rtl',
      'isRtl': true,
      'loadedLocales': <String>['ar-JO', 'de-DE'],
    },
  );

  final changed = await matrixEvent.future.timeout(
    const Duration(seconds: 1),
  );
  final state = PolyglotMatrixState.fromEvent(changed);
  _expect(state.sourceLanguageTag, 'ar', 'matrix source language');
  _expect(state.targetLanguageTag, 'de-DE', 'matrix target language');
  _expect(state.directedPairKey, 'ar->de-DE', 'directed pair identity');
  _expect(state.revision, 7, 'localization revision carried into matrix');

  final engineChanged = await engineEvent.future.timeout(
    const Duration(seconds: 1),
  );
  _expect(
    engineChanged.payload['engineId'],
    'german.core.v1',
    'German target loads German grammar facade',
  );
  _expect(
    engineChanged.payload['targetLanguage'],
    'de-DE',
    'grammar selection follows matrix target',
  );

  final grammarResponse = Completer<AgentEvent>();
  final grammarSub = systemEndpoint
      .events(AgentTopics.grammarResponse)
      .listen((event) {
    if (!grammarResponse.isCompleted &&
        event.context.correlationId == 'grammar-contract-1') {
      grammarResponse.complete(event);
    }
  });

  systemEndpoint.publish(
    topic: AgentTopics.grammarRequest,
    targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.grammar},
    context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty('grammar-contract-1'),
    payload: const <String, Object?>{
      'capability': 'konjunktiv_ii',
      'seed': 11,
      'count': 2,
    },
  );

  final grammarEvent = await grammarResponse.future.timeout(
    const Duration(seconds: 1),
  );
  final grammarResult = GrammarAgentResult.fromEvent(grammarEvent);
  _expect(grammarResult.ok, true, 'German grammar request succeeds');
  _expect(grammarResult.engineId, 'german.core.v1', 'German engine id');
  _expect(grammarResult.items.length, 2, 'grammar result item count');

  final voiceResponse = Completer<AgentEvent>();
  final voiceSub = systemEndpoint
      .events(AgentTopics.ttsPrepared)
      .listen((event) {
    if (!voiceResponse.isCompleted &&
        event.context.correlationId == 'tts-contract-1') {
      voiceResponse.complete(event);
    }
  });

  systemEndpoint.publish(
    topic: AgentTopics.ttsRequest,
    targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.voice},
    context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty('tts-contract-1'),
    payload: const <String, Object?>{
      'text': 'Guten Morgen',
      'targetLanguage': 'de-DE',
      'speed': 0.85,
    },
  );

  final voiceEvent = await voiceResponse.future.timeout(
    const Duration(seconds: 1),
  );
  final dispatch = TtsVoiceDispatch.fromEvent(voiceEvent);
  _expect(dispatch.accepted, true, 'TTS request is prepared');
  _expect(dispatch.text, 'Guten Morgen', 'TTS text is preserved');
  _expect(dispatch.targetLanguageTag, 'de-DE', 'TTS target language');
  _expect(dispatch.speed, 0.85, 'TTS speed is preserved');
  _expect(
    dispatch.backend,
    'flutter_tts.offline.v1',
    'production Flutter TTS backend is bound',
  );

  await voiceSub.cancel();
  await grammarSub.cancel();
  await engineSub.cancel();
  await matrixSub.cancel();
  await voice.close();
  await grammar.close();
  await polyglot.close();
  await kernel.close();

  _expect(bus.isClosed, true, 'isolated bus closes cleanly');
}

void _expect(Object? actual, Object? expected, String contract) {
  if (actual != expected) {
    throw StateError(
      'Contract failed: $contract. Expected <$expected>, got <$actual>.',
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import '../orchestration/orchestration.dart';
import 'polyglot_agent_models.dart';
import 'sys_tts_voice_agent.dart';

Future<void> main() async {
  final bus = AgentEventBus.isolated();
  final kernel = OrchestrationKernel(
    eventBus: bus,
    services: ServiceContainer(),
  );

  final voiceEndpoint = kernel.connect(
    AgentDescriptor(
      id: 'phase8.contract.voice',
      role: AgentRole.voice,
      subscriptions: const <String>{
        AgentTopics.polyglotMatrixChanged,
        AgentTopics.ttsRequest,
      },
    ),
  );
  final systemEndpoint = kernel.connect(
    AgentDescriptor(
      id: 'phase8.contract.system',
      role: AgentRole.system,
      subscriptions: const <String>{
        AgentTopics.ttsPrepared,
        AgentTopics.ttsCompleted,
        AgentTopics.ttsFailed,
      },
    ),
  );
  final producer = kernel.connect(
    AgentDescriptor(
      id: 'phase8.contract.producer',
      role: AgentRole.task,
      subscriptions: const <String>{AgentTopics.contextUpdated},
    ),
  );

  final backend = _ContractBackend();
  final voice = SysTtsVoiceAgent.start(
    endpoint: voiceEndpoint,
    backend: backend,
  );

  producer.publish(
    topic: AgentTopics.polyglotMatrixChanged,
    targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{
      AgentRole.grammar,
      AgentRole.voice,
      AgentRole.system,
    },
    context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty('phase8-matrix'),
    payload: const <String, Object?>{
      'revision': 1,
      'userLanguage': 'ar',
      'sourceLanguage': 'ar',
      'targetLanguage': 'de-DE',
      'directedPair': 'ar->de-DE',
    },
  );
  await Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);

  final prepared = _next(
    systemEndpoint,
    AgentTopics.ttsPrepared,
    'phase8-tts-ok',
  );
  final completed = _next(
    systemEndpoint,
    AgentTopics.ttsCompleted,
    'phase8-tts-ok',
  );

  producer.publish(
    topic: AgentTopics.ttsRequest,
    targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.voice},
    context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty('phase8-tts-ok'),
    payload: const <String, Object?>{
      'text': 'Guten Morgen',
      'targetLanguage': 'de-DE',
      'speed': 0.85,
    },
  );

  final preparedEvent = await prepared;
  final dispatch = TtsVoiceDispatch.fromEvent(preparedEvent);
  _expect(dispatch.accepted, true, 'request is accepted');
  _expect(dispatch.backend, 'contract.tts', 'backend id is exposed');

  final completedEvent = await completed;
  _expect(
    completedEvent.payload['backend'],
    'contract.tts',
    'completion identifies backend',
  );
  _expect(
    completedEvent.payload['targetLanguage'],
    'de-DE',
    'completion preserves target locale',
  );
  _expect(
    backend.lastRequest?.text,
    'Guten Morgen',
    'backend receives exact text',
  );
  _expect(
    backend.lastRequest?.targetLanguageTag,
    'de-DE',
    'backend receives exact target language',
  );
  _expect(backend.lastRequest?.speed, 0.85, 'backend receives speed');

  backend.nextFailure = 'unsupported_language';
  final failed = _next(
    systemEndpoint,
    AgentTopics.ttsFailed,
    'phase8-tts-fail',
  );
  producer.publish(
    topic: AgentTopics.ttsRequest,
    targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.voice},
    context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty('phase8-tts-fail'),
    payload: const <String, Object?>{
      'text': 'Noch einmal',
      'targetLanguage': 'de-DE',
      'speed': 1.0,
    },
  );

  final failedEvent = await failed;
  _expect(
    failedEvent.payload['reason'],
    'unsupported_language',
    'unsupported language fails cleanly',
  );

  await voice.close();
  _expect(backend.stopCount > 0, true, 'close stops playback');
  _expect(backend.disposed, true, 'close disposes backend');

  await kernel.close();
}

Future<AgentEvent> _next(
  AgentEndpoint endpoint,
  String topic,
  String correlationId,
) =>
    endpoint
        .events(topic)
        .firstWhere(
          (event) => event.context.correlationId == correlationId,
        )
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 1));

final class _ContractBackend implements TtsVoiceBackendPort {
  @override
  String get backendId => 'contract.tts';

  TtsVoiceRequest? lastRequest;
  String? nextFailure;
  int stopCount = 0;
  bool disposed = false;

  @override
  Future<TtsBackendResult> speak(TtsVoiceRequest request) async {
    lastRequest = request;
    final failure = nextFailure;
    nextFailure = null;
    return failure == null
        ? const TtsBackendResult.completed()
        : TtsBackendResult.failed(failure);
  }

  @override
  Future<void> stop() async {
    stopCount += 1;
  }

  @override
  Future<void> dispose() async {
    disposed = true;
  }
}

void _expect(Object? actual, Object? expected, String contract) {
  if (actual != expected) {
    throw StateError(
      'Contract failed: $contract. Expected <$expected>, got <$actual>.',
    );
  }
}

FILE: lib/core/agents/sys_error_recovery_fallback.dart

import 'dart:async';

import '../orchestration/orchestration.dart';

enum RecoveryMode {
  safeSection,
  safeShell,
}

final class RecoveryDirective {
  const RecoveryDirective({
    required this.mode,
    required this.context,
    required this.userMessage,
    required this.occurrenceCount,
    required this.fatal,
  });

  final RecoveryMode mode;
  final String context;
  final String userMessage;
  final int occurrenceCount;
  final bool fatal;

  static RecoveryDirective fromEvent(AgentEvent event) {
    final rawMode = event.payload['mode'];
    final mode = rawMode == RecoveryMode.safeShell.name
        ? RecoveryMode.safeShell
        : RecoveryMode.safeSection;
    return RecoveryDirective(
      mode: mode,
      context: _safeText(
        event.payload['context'],
        fallback: 'application',
        maxLength: 120,
      ),
      userMessage: _safeText(
        event.payload['userMessage'],
        fallback: 'تم نقل التطبيق إلى حالة آمنة.',
        maxLength: 240,
      ),
      occurrenceCount: _int(event.payload['occurrenceCount']).clamp(1, 1000000).toInt(),
      fatal: event.payload['fatal'] == true,
    );
  }
}

final class SysErrorRecoveryFallback {
  SysErrorRecoveryFallback._(this.endpoint) {
    _subscription = endpoint
        .events(AgentTopics.systemError)
        .listen(_handle);
  }

  factory SysErrorRecoveryFallback.start({
    required AgentEndpoint endpoint,
  }) =>
      SysErrorRecoveryFallback._(endpoint);

  static const int escalationThreshold = 3;
  static const int maxTrackedContexts = 64;

  final AgentEndpoint endpoint;
  final Map<String, int> _occurrences = <String, int>{};
  late final StreamSubscription<AgentEvent> _subscription;
  bool _closed = false;

  bool get isClosed => _closed;

  void _handle(AgentEvent event) {
    if (_closed) return;

    final context = _safeText(
      event.payload['context'],
      fallback: 'application',
      maxLength: 120,
    );
    final fatal = event.payload['fatal'] == true;
    final count = (_occurrences[context] ?? 0) + 1;
    _occurrences[context] = count;
    _boundOccurrences();

    final mode = fatal || count >= escalationThreshold
        ? RecoveryMode.safeShell
        : RecoveryMode.safeSection;

    endpoint.publish(
      topic: AgentTopics.systemRecovery,
      targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.system},
      context: event.context,
      payload: <String, Object?>{
        'mode': mode.name,
        'context': context,
        'fatal': fatal,
        'occurrenceCount': count,
        'errorType': _safeText(
          event.payload['errorType'],
          fallback: 'Error',
          maxLength: 100,
        ),
        'userMessage': mode == RecoveryMode.safeShell
            ? 'تم تحويل التطبيق إلى الواجهة الآمنة لحماية الجلسة.'
            : 'تم عزل الجزء المتأثر ويمكن متابعة استخدام التطبيق بأمان.',
      },
    );
  }

  void _boundOccurrences() {
    if (_occurrences.length <= maxTrackedContexts) return;
    final keys = _occurrences.keys.toList(growable: false)..sort();
    final removeCount = _occurrences.length - maxTrackedContexts;
    for (final key in keys.take(removeCount)) {
      _occurrences.remove(key);
    }
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    _closed = true;
    await _subscription.cancel();
  }
}

String _safeText(
  Object? value, {
  required String fallback,
  required int maxLength,
}) {
  final text = value is String ? value.trim() : '';
  if (text.isEmpty) return fallback;
  return text.length <= maxLength ? text : text.substring(0, maxLength);
}

int _int(Object? value) => value is num ? value.toInt() : 1;

FILE: lib/core/agents/sys_memory_agent.dart

import 'dart:async';

import '../orchestration/orchestration.dart';
import '../worker/persistent_cpu_worker.dart';
import '../worker/worker_contract.dart';
import 'memory_models.dart';

final class SysMemoryAgent {
  SysMemoryAgent._({
    required this.endpoint,
    required this.store,
    required MemoryAgentSnapshot initialSnapshot,
  }) : _snapshot = initialSnapshot;

  static Future<SysMemoryAgent> start({
    required AgentEndpoint endpoint,
    required MemoryAgentStore store,
    required PersistentCpuWorker cpuWorker,
  }) async {
    String? encoded;
    try {
      encoded = await store.read();
    } on Object {
      encoded = null;
    }
    var initial = MemoryAgentSnapshot.empty();
    if (encoded != null && encoded.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      final result = await cpuWorker.submit<Object?>(
        WorkerJob<Map<String, Object?>>(
          id: 'memory.hydrate',
          type: WorkerJobTypes.jsonDecode,
          epoch: cpuWorker.currentEpoch,
          payload: <String, Object?>{'encoded': encoded},
        ),
      );
      if (result.status == WorkerStatuses.ok) {
        initial = MemoryAgentSnapshot.fromDecoded(result.payload);
      }
    }
    final agent = SysMemoryAgent._(
      endpoint: endpoint,
      store: store,
      initialSnapshot: initial,
    );
    agent._subscription = endpoint.allEvents.listen(agent._accept);
    return agent;
  }

  final AgentEndpoint endpoint;
  final MemoryAgentStore store;

  late final StreamSubscription<AgentEvent> _subscription;
  MemoryAgentSnapshot _snapshot;
  Future<void> _writeQueue = Future<void>.value();
  bool _closed = false;

  MemoryAgentSnapshot get snapshot => _snapshot;
  bool get isClosed => _closed;

  void _accept(AgentEvent event) {
    if (_closed) return;
    _writeQueue = _writeQueue
        .catchError((_) {})
        .then((_) async {
          try {
            await _apply(event);
          } on Object {
            return;
          }
        });
  }

  Future<void> _apply(AgentEvent event) async {
    final occurredAtEpochMs = _eventTimestamp(event);

    switch (event.topic) {
      case AgentTopics.routeSelected:
        final ok = event.payload['ok'];
        final taskId = event.payload['curriculumTaskId'];
        if (ok == true && taskId is String && taskId.trim().isNotEmpty) {
          _snapshot = _snapshot.recordVisit(
            taskId,
            occurredAtEpochMs: occurredAtEpochMs,
          );
          await _persistAndPublish();
        }
        return;
      case AgentTopics.learningProgress:
        final taskId = event.payload['taskId'];
        if (taskId is! String || taskId.trim().isEmpty) return;
        final score = _number(event.payload['score']).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        final attempts = _integer(event.payload['attempts']).clamp(0, 1000000);
        _snapshot = _snapshot.recordProgress(
          rawTaskId: taskId,
          score: score.toDouble(),
          completed: event.payload['completed'] == true,
          attempts: attempts.toInt(),
          occurredAtEpochMs: occurredAtEpochMs,
        );
        await _persistAndPublish();
        return;
      case AgentTopics.learningMistake:
        final taskId = event.payload['taskId'];
        final weaknessKey = event.payload['weaknessKey'];
        if (taskId is! String ||
            taskId.trim().isEmpty ||
            weaknessKey is! String ||
            weaknessKey.trim().isEmpty) {
          return;
        }
        final weight = _integer(event.payload['weight']).clamp(1, 1000);
        _snapshot = _snapshot.recordWeakness(
          rawTaskId: taskId,
          rawWeaknessKey: weaknessKey,
          weight: weight.toInt(),
          occurredAtEpochMs: occurredAtEpochMs,
        );
        await _persistAndPublish();
        return;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _persistAndPublish() async {
    var persisted = true;
    try {
      await store.write(_snapshot.encode());
    } on Object {
      persisted = false;
    }
    endpoint.publish(
      topic: AgentTopics.memorySnapshot,
      targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.system},
      payload: <String, Object?>{
        'taskCount': _snapshot.tasks.length,
        'weaknessCount': _snapshot.weaknesses.length,
        'updatedAtEpochMs': _snapshot.updatedAtEpochMs,
        'persisted': persisted,
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> flush() => _writeQueue;

  Future<void> close() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    _closed = true;
    await _subscription.cancel();
    await flush();
  }

  static int _eventTimestamp(AgentEvent event) {
    final value = event.payload['occurredAtEpochMs'];
    if (value is num) {
      return value.toInt().clamp(0, 4102444800000).toInt();
    }
    return DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;
  }

  static double _number(Object? value) =>
      value is num ? value.toDouble() : 0;

  static int _integer(Object? value) =>
      value is num ? value.toInt() : 0;
}

FILE: lib/core/agents/sys_polyglot_matrix_agent.dart

import 'dart:async';

import '../orchestration/orchestration.dart';
import 'polyglot_agent_models.dart';

final class SysPolyglotMatrixAgent {
  SysPolyglotMatrixAgent._(this.endpoint) {
    _subscription = endpoint
        .events(AgentTopics.localizationChanged)
        .listen(_accept);
  }

  factory SysPolyglotMatrixAgent.start({
    required AgentEndpoint endpoint,
  }) {
    if (endpoint.descriptor.role != AgentRole.polyglot) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'Polyglot matrix endpoint must use AgentRole.polyglot.',
      );
    }
    if (!endpoint.descriptor.subscribesTo(
      AgentTopics.localizationChanged,
    )) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'Polyglot matrix endpoint must subscribe to ' +
            AgentTopics.localizationChanged +
            '.',
      );
    }
    return SysPolyglotMatrixAgent._(endpoint);
  }

  final AgentEndpoint endpoint;

  late final StreamSubscription<AgentEvent> _subscription;
  PolyglotMatrixState? _state;
  bool _closed = false;

  PolyglotMatrixState? get state => _state;
  bool get isClosed => _closed;

  void _accept(AgentEvent event) {
    if (_closed) return;

    try {
      final next = PolyglotMatrixState(
        sourceLanguageTag: _requiredLocale(
          event.payload['sourceLocale'],
          'sourceLocale',
        ),
        targetLanguageTag: _requiredLocale(
          event.payload['targetLocale'],
          'targetLocale',
        ),
        revision: _requiredRevision(event.payload['revision']),
      );

      final current = _state;
      if (current != null) {
        if (next.revision < current.revision) {
          return;
        }
        if (next.revision == current.revision) {
          if (next.directedPairKey == current.directedPairKey) {
            return;
          }
          _publishConflict(event, current, next);
          return;
        }
      }

      _state = next;
      endpoint.publish(
        topic: AgentTopics.polyglotMatrixChanged,
        targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{
          AgentRole.grammar,
          AgentRole.voice,
          AgentRole.system,
        },
        context: event.context,
        payload: next.toEventPayload(),
      );
    } on Object catch (error) {
      endpoint.publish(
        topic: AgentTopics.systemError,
        targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.recovery},
        context: event.context,
        payload: <String, Object?>{
          'context': 'polyglot.matrix_update',
          'errorType': error.runtimeType.toString(),
          'message': _bounded(error.toString(), 240),
          'fatal': false,
        },
      );
    }
  }

  void _publishConflict(
    AgentEvent event,
    PolyglotMatrixState current,
    PolyglotMatrixState incoming,
  ) {
    endpoint.publish(
      topic: AgentTopics.systemError,
      targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.recovery},
      context: event.context,
      payload: <String, Object?>{
        'context': 'polyglot.matrix_conflict',
        'errorType': 'RevisionConflict',
        'message':
            'Localization revision ' +
            incoming.revision.toString() +
            ' attempted to replace ' +
            current.directedPairKey +
            ' with ' +
            incoming.directedPairKey +
            '.',
        'fatal': false,
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    _closed = true;
    await _subscription.cancel();
  }

  static String _requiredLocale(Object? value, String field) {
    if (value is! String || value.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw FormatException(
        field + ' must be a non-empty language tag.',
      );
    }
    return value.trim();
  }

  static int _requiredRevision(Object? value) {
    if (value is! num) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'localization revision must be numeric.',
      );
    }
    final revision = value.toInt();
    if (revision < 0) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'localization revision must be non-negative.',
      );
    }
    return revision;
  }

  static String _bounded(String value, int maxLength) {
    final normalized = value.trim();
    return normalized.length <= maxLength
        ? normalized
        : normalized.substring(0, maxLength);
  }
}

FILE: lib/core/agents/sys_tts_voice_agent.dart

import 'dart:async';

import '../infrastructure/audio/flutter_tts_audio_engine.dart';
import '../orchestration/orchestration.dart';
import '../../language/language_speech_profile.dart';
import 'polyglot_agent_models.dart';

final class TtsBackendResult {
  const TtsBackendResult.completed()
      : completed = true,
        failureReason = null;

  TtsBackendResult.failed(String reason)
      : completed = false,
        failureReason = _normalizeFailure(reason);

  final bool completed;
  final String? failureReason;

  static String _normalizeFailure(String value) {
    final normalized = value.trim();
    return normalized.isEmpty ? 'playback_failed' : normalized;
  }
}

abstract interface class TtsVoiceBackendPort {
  String get backendId;

  Future<TtsBackendResult> speak(TtsVoiceRequest request);

  Future<void> stop();

  Future<void> dispose();
}

final class FlutterTtsVoiceBackend implements TtsVoiceBackendPort {
  FlutterTtsVoiceBackend({FlutterOfflineTtsEngine? engine})
      : _engine = engine ?? FlutterOfflineTtsEngine();

  final FlutterOfflineTtsEngine _engine;
  bool _closed = false;

  @override
  String get backendId => 'flutter_tts.offline.v1';

  @override
  Future<TtsBackendResult> speak(TtsVoiceRequest request) async {
    if (_closed) return TtsBackendResult.failed('backend_closed');

    final profile = _TargetLanguageSpeechProfile(
      request.targetLanguageTag,
    );
    final rate = (profile.defaultSpeechRate * request.speed)
        .clamp(0.1, 1.0)
        .toDouble();

    try {
      final spoken = await _engine.speak(
        text: request.text,
        profile: profile,
        rate: rate,
      );
      return spoken
          ? const TtsBackendResult.completed()
          : TtsBackendResult.failed('unsupported_language_or_voice');
    } on Object {
      return TtsBackendResult.failed('playback_failed');
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> stop() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    try {
      await _engine.stop();
    } on Object {
      return;
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> dispose() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    _closed = true;
    try {
      await _engine.dispose();
    } on Object {
      return;
    }
  }
}

final class _TargetLanguageSpeechProfile
    implements LanguageSpeechProfile {
  _TargetLanguageSpeechProfile(String languageTag)
      : _languageTag = _normalizeTag(languageTag);

  final String _languageTag;

  @override
  String get languageCode => _languageTag;

  @override
  List<String> get preferredTtsLocales {
    final base = _languageTag.split('-').first;
    return List<String>.unmodifiable(
      <String>{
        _languageTag,
        if (base.isNotEmpty) base,
      },
    );
  }

  @override
  double get defaultSpeechRate => 0.46;

  @override
  String get offlineVoiceUnavailableMessage =>
      'offline_voice_unavailable';

  static String _normalizeTag(String value) =>
      value.trim().replaceAll('_', '-');
}

final class SysTtsVoiceAgent {
  SysTtsVoiceAgent._({
    required this.endpoint,
    required TtsVoiceBackendPort backend,
  }) : _backend = backend {
    _subscription = endpoint.allEvents.listen(_accept);
  }

  factory SysTtsVoiceAgent.start({
    required AgentEndpoint endpoint,
    TtsVoiceBackendPort? backend,
  }) {
    if (endpoint.descriptor.role != AgentRole.voice) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'TTS voice endpoint must use AgentRole.voice.',
      );
    }
    if (!endpoint.descriptor.subscribesTo(
          AgentTopics.polyglotMatrixChanged,
        ) ||
        !endpoint.descriptor.subscribesTo(AgentTopics.ttsRequest)) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'TTS voice endpoint must subscribe to matrix and TTS request topics.',
      );
    }
    return SysTtsVoiceAgent._(
      endpoint: endpoint,
      backend: backend ?? FlutterTtsVoiceBackend(),
    );
  }

  final AgentEndpoint endpoint;
  final TtsVoiceBackendPort _backend;

  late final StreamSubscription<AgentEvent> _subscription;
  PolyglotMatrixState? _matrix;
  Future<void> _speechTail = Future<void>.value();
  int _generation = 0;
  bool _isSpeaking = false;
  bool _closed = false;

  bool get isClosed => _closed;
  PolyglotMatrixState? get matrix => _matrix;
  String get backendId => _backend.backendId;

  void _accept(AgentEvent event) {
    if (_closed) return;

    switch (event.topic) {
      case AgentTopics.polyglotMatrixChanged:
        _handleMatrix(event);
        return;
      case AgentTopics.ttsRequest:
        _handleRequest(event);
        return;
    }
  }

  void _handleMatrix(AgentEvent event) {
    try {
      _matrix = PolyglotMatrixState.fromEvent(event);
    } on Object catch (error) {
      _publishSystemError(
        event: event,
        context: 'tts.matrix_update',
        error: error,
      );
    }
  }

  void _handleRequest(AgentEvent event) {
    try {
      final request = TtsVoiceRequest.fromEvent(event);
      final matrix = _matrix;

      if (matrix == null) {
        _publishDispatch(
          event: event,
          request: request,
          accepted: false,
          rejectionReason: 'matrix_not_ready',
        );
        return;
      }

      if (request.targetLanguageTag != matrix.targetLanguageTag) {
        _publishDispatch(
          event: event,
          request: request,
          accepted: false,
          rejectionReason:
              'target_mismatch:' + matrix.targetLanguageTag,
        );
        return;
      }

      _publishDispatch(
        event: event,
        request: request,
        accepted: true,
      );
      _queuePlayback(event, request);
    } on Object catch (error) {
      _publishSystemError(
        event: event,
        context: 'tts.request',
        error: error,
      );
    }
  }

  void _queuePlayback(
    AgentEvent event,
    TtsVoiceRequest request,
  ) {
    final generation = ++_generation;
    if (_isSpeaking) {
      unawaited(_safeStop());
    }

    _speechTail = _speechTail.then<void>((_) async {
      if (_closed) return;

      if (generation != _generation) {
        _publishFailed(
          event: event,
          request: request,
          reason: 'superseded',
        );
        return;
      }

      _isSpeaking = true;
      late final TtsBackendResult result;
      try {
        result = await _backend.speak(request);
      } finally {
        _isSpeaking = false;
      }

      if (_closed) return;

      if (generation != _generation) {
        _publishFailed(
          event: event,
          request: request,
          reason: 'superseded',
        );
        return;
      }

      if (result.completed) {
        _publishCompleted(event: event, request: request);
      } else {
        _publishFailed(
          event: event,
          request: request,
          reason: result.failureReason ?? 'playback_failed',
        );
      }
    }).catchError((Object error, StackTrace stackTrace) {
      if (_closed) return;
      _isSpeaking = false;
      _publishFailed(
        event: event,
        request: request,
        reason: 'backend_error',
      );
    });
  }

  Future<void> _safeStop() async {
    try {
      await _backend.stop();
    } on Object {
      return;
    }
  }

  void _publishDispatch({
    required AgentEvent event,
    required TtsVoiceRequest request,
    required bool accepted,
    String? rejectionReason,
  }) {
    endpoint.publish(
      topic: AgentTopics.ttsPrepared,
      targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.system},
      context: event.context,
      payload: <String, Object?>{
        'accepted': accepted,
        ...request.toEventPayload(),
        'backend': _backend.backendId,
        'providerReady': accepted,
        if (rejectionReason != null)
          'rejectionReason': rejectionReason,
      },
    );
  }

  void _publishCompleted({
    required AgentEvent event,
    required TtsVoiceRequest request,
  }) {
    endpoint.publish(
      topic: AgentTopics.ttsCompleted,
      targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{
        AgentRole.system,
        AgentRole.task,
      },
      context: event.context,
      payload: <String, Object?>{
        ...request.toEventPayload(),
        'backend': _backend.backendId,
        'completed': true,
      },
    );
  }

  void _publishFailed({
    required AgentEvent event,
    required TtsVoiceRequest request,
    required String reason,
  }) {
    endpoint.publish(
      topic: AgentTopics.ttsFailed,
      targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{
        AgentRole.system,
        AgentRole.task,
      },
      context: event.context,
      payload: <String, Object?>{
        ...request.toEventPayload(),
        'backend': _backend.backendId,
        'completed': false,
        'reason': _bounded(reason, 120),
      },
    );
  }

  void _publishSystemError({
    required AgentEvent event,
    required String context,
    required Object error,
  }) {
    endpoint.publish(
      topic: AgentTopics.systemError,
      targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.recovery},
      context: event.context,
      payload: <String, Object?>{
        'context': context,
        'errorType': error.runtimeType.toString(),
        'message': _bounded(error.toString(), 240),
        'fatal': false,
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    _closed = true;
    ++_generation;
    await _subscription.cancel();
    await _safeStop();
    try {
      await _speechTail;
    } on Object {
      // Playback failures are already contained and surfaced as events.
    }
    await _backend.dispose();
  }

  static String _bounded(String value, int maxLength) {
    final normalized = value.trim();
    return normalized.length <= maxLength
        ? normalized
        : normalized.substring(0, maxLength);
  }
}

FILE: lib/core/agents/sys_universal_grammar_agent.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'dart:async';

import '../grammar_engines/comparative_superlative_engine.dart';
import '../grammar_engines/grammar_engine_models.dart';
import '../grammar_engines/konjunktiv_ii_engine.dart';
import '../localization/locale_provider.dart';
import '../orchestration/orchestration.dart';
import 'polyglot_agent_models.dart';

abstract interface class UniversalGrammarEngineFacade {
  String get engineId;

  Set<UniversalGrammarCapability> get capabilities;

  List<Map<String, Object?>> execute({
    required UniversalGrammarCapability capability,
    required int seed,
    required int count,
  });
}

final class SysUniversalGrammarAgent {
  SysUniversalGrammarAgent._(this.endpoint) {
    _subscription = endpoint.allEvents.listen(_accept);
  }

  factory SysUniversalGrammarAgent.start({
    required AgentEndpoint endpoint,
  }) {
    if (endpoint.descriptor.role != AgentRole.grammar) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'Universal grammar endpoint must use AgentRole.grammar.',
      );
    }
    if (!endpoint.descriptor.subscribesTo(
          AgentTopics.polyglotMatrixChanged,
        ) ||
        !endpoint.descriptor.subscribesTo(AgentTopics.grammarRequest)) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'Universal grammar endpoint must subscribe to matrix and '
        'grammar request topics.',
      );
    }
    return SysUniversalGrammarAgent._(endpoint);
  }

  final AgentEndpoint endpoint;

  late final StreamSubscription<AgentEvent> _subscription;
  UniversalGrammarEngineFacade? _engine;
  PolyglotMatrixState? _matrix;
  bool _closed = false;

  bool get isClosed => _closed;
  String? get activeEngineId => _engine?.engineId;
  PolyglotMatrixState? get matrix => _matrix;

  void _accept(AgentEvent event) {
    if (_closed) return;

    switch (event.topic) {
      case AgentTopics.polyglotMatrixChanged:
        _handleMatrix(event);
        return;
      case AgentTopics.grammarRequest:
        _handleRequest(event);
        return;
    }
  }

  void _handleMatrix(AgentEvent event) {
    try {
      final state = PolyglotMatrixState.fromEvent(event);
      _matrix = state;
      _engine = _engineFor(state.targetLanguageTag);

      final capabilities = _engine?.capabilities
              .map((item) => item.wireName)
              .toList(growable: false) ??
          const <String>[];

      endpoint.publish(
        topic: AgentTopics.grammarEngineChanged,
        targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.system},
        context: event.context,
        payload: <String, Object?>{
          'targetLanguage': state.targetLanguageTag,
          'directedPair': state.directedPairKey,
          'engineId': _engine?.engineId ??
              'unavailable.' + state.targetLanguageCode,
          'available': _engine != null,
          'capabilities': capabilities,
          'matrixRevision': state.revision,
        },
      );
    } on Object catch (error) {
      _publishSystemError(
        event: event,
        context: 'grammar.matrix_update',
        error: error,
      );
    }
  }

  void _handleRequest(AgentEvent event) {
    final rawCapability = event.payload['capability'];
    final capabilityLabel =
        rawCapability is String && rawCapability.trim().isNotEmpty
            ? rawCapability.trim()
            : 'unknown';
    final state = _matrix;
    final engine = _engine;

    if (state == null) {
      _publishFailure(
        event: event,
        capability: capabilityLabel,
        targetLanguage: 'und',
        engineId: 'unavailable',
        errorCode: 'matrix_not_ready',
        message:
            'No polyglot matrix state is available for grammar routing.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (engine == null) {
      _publishFailure(
        event: event,
        capability: capabilityLabel,
        targetLanguage: state.targetLanguageTag,
        engineId: 'unavailable.' + state.targetLanguageCode,
        errorCode: 'engine_unavailable',
        message:
            'No grammar engine is registered for target language ' +
            state.targetLanguageTag +
            '.',
      );
      return;
    }

    try {
      final capability = UniversalGrammarCapability.parse(rawCapability);
      if (!engine.capabilities.contains(capability)) {
        _publishFailure(
          event: event,
          capability: capability.wireName,
          targetLanguage: state.targetLanguageTag,
          engineId: engine.engineId,
          errorCode: 'capability_unavailable',
          message:
              'Grammar capability is not available in the selected engine.',
        );
        return;
      }

      final seed = _boundedInt(
        event.payload['seed'],
        fallback: 0,
        min: -1000000000,
        max: 1000000000,
      );
      final count = _boundedInt(
        event.payload['count'],
        fallback: 6,
        min: 1,
        max: 20,
      );

      final items = engine.execute(
        capability: capability,
        seed: seed,
        count: count,
      );

      endpoint.publish(
        topic: AgentTopics.grammarResponse,
        targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.system},
        context: event.context,
        payload: <String, Object?>{
          'ok': true,
          'capability': capability.wireName,
          'targetLanguage': state.targetLanguageTag,
          'engineId': engine.engineId,
          'items': items,
        },
      );
    } on Object catch (error) {
      _publishFailure(
        event: event,
        capability: capabilityLabel,
        targetLanguage: state.targetLanguageTag,
        engineId: engine.engineId,
        errorCode: 'invalid_request',
        message: _bounded(error.toString(), 240),
      );
    }
  }

  UniversalGrammarEngineFacade? _engineFor(String targetLanguageTag) {
    final languageCode = AppLocale.parse(targetLanguageTag).languageCode;
    return switch (languageCode) {
      'de' => const _GermanGrammarEngineFacade(),
      _ => null,
    };
  }

  void _publishFailure({
    required AgentEvent event,
    required String capability,
    required String targetLanguage,
    required String engineId,
    required String errorCode,
    required String message,
  }) {
    endpoint.publish(
      topic: AgentTopics.grammarResponse,
      targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.system},
      context: event.context,
      payload: <String, Object?>{
        'ok': false,
        'capability': capability,
        'targetLanguage': targetLanguage,
        'engineId': engineId,
        'items': const <Object?>[],
        'errorCode': errorCode,
        'message': message,
      },
    );
  }

  void _publishSystemError({
    required AgentEvent event,
    required String context,
    required Object error,
  }) {
    endpoint.publish(
      topic: AgentTopics.systemError,
      targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.recovery},
      context: event.context,
      payload: <String, Object?>{
        'context': context,
        'errorType': error.runtimeType.toString(),
        'message': _bounded(error.toString(), 240),
        'fatal': false,
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    _closed = true;
    await _subscription.cancel();
  }

  static int _boundedInt(
    Object? value, {
    required int fallback,
    required int min,
    required int max,
  }) {
    if (value == null) return fallback;
    if (value is! num) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Numeric grammar parameters must be numbers.',
      );
    }
    return value.toInt().clamp(min, max).toInt();
  }

  static String _bounded(String value, int maxLength) {
    final normalized = value.trim();
    return normalized.length <= maxLength
        ? normalized
        : normalized.substring(0, maxLength);
  }
}

final class _GermanGrammarEngineFacade
    implements UniversalGrammarEngineFacade {
  const _GermanGrammarEngineFacade();

  static const KonjunktivIiEngine _konjunktiv =
      KonjunktivIiEngine();
  static const ComparativeSuperlativeEngine _comparative =
      ComparativeSuperlativeEngine();

  @override
  String get engineId => 'german.core.v1';

  @override
  Set<UniversalGrammarCapability> get capabilities =>
      const <UniversalGrammarCapability>{
        UniversalGrammarCapability.konjunktivIi,
        UniversalGrammarCapability.comparativeSuperlative,
      };

  @override
  List<Map<String, Object?>> execute({
    required UniversalGrammarCapability capability,
    required int seed,
    required int count,
  }) {
    final items = switch (capability) {
      UniversalGrammarCapability.konjunktivIi =>
        _konjunktiv.generateExamples(seed: seed, count: count),
      UniversalGrammarCapability.comparativeSuperlative =>
        _comparative.generateExamples(seed: seed, count: count),
    };

    return List<Map<String, Object?>>.unmodifiable(
      items.map(_serializeTrainingItem),
    );
  }

  static Map<String, Object?> _serializeTrainingItem(
    GrammarTrainingItem item,
  ) =>
      <String, Object?>{
        'id': item.id,
        'category': item.category,
        'promptAr': item.promptAr,
        'sentenceWithBlank': item.sentenceWithBlank,
        'expectedAnswer': item.expectedAnswer,
        'fullSentence': item.fullSentence,
        'explanationAr': item.explanationAr,
        'acceptedAlternatives':
            List<String>.unmodifiable(item.acceptedAlternatives),
      };
}

import 'dart:async';

import '../orchestration/orchestration.dart';
import '../storage/offline_progress_service.dart';
import '../storage/runtime_local_state_container.dart';
import '../storage/validation_hash_cache.dart';
import '../worker/persistent_cpu_worker.dart';
import '../worker/worker_contract.dart';

import 'polyglot_agent_models.dart';

import 'sys_tts_voice_agent.dart';
import 'sys_universal_grammar_agent.dart';

final class SystemAgentRuntime {
  SystemAgentRuntime._({
    required AgentEventBus eventBus,
    required OrchestrationKernel kernel,
    required AgentEndpoint systemEndpoint,
    required SysMemoryAgent memoryAgent,
    required SysErrorRecoveryFallback recoveryAgent,
    required SysPolyglotMatrixAgent polyglotAgent,
    required SysUniversalGrammarAgent grammarAgent,
    required SysTtsVoiceAgent voiceAgent,
    required RuntimeLocalStateContainer localState,
    required OfflineProgressService progressService,
    required ValidationHashCache validationCache,
    required AgentEventBatchDispatcher batchDispatcher,
    required PersistentCpuWorker cpuWorker,
  })  : _eventBus = eventBus,
        _kernel = kernel,
        _systemEndpoint = systemEndpoint,
        _memoryAgent = memoryAgent,
        _recoveryAgent = recoveryAgent,
        _polyglotAgent = polyglotAgent,
        _grammarAgent = grammarAgent,
        _voiceAgent = voiceAgent,
        _localState = localState,
        _progressService = progressService,
        _validationCache = validationCache,
        _batchDispatcher = batchDispatcher,
        _cpuWorker = cpuWorker;

  static Future<SystemAgentRuntime> start({
    required MemoryAgentStore memoryStore,
  }) async {
    final localState = await RuntimeLocalStateContainer.open(memoryStore);
    final progressService = await OfflineProgressService.open(
      localState.namespace('progress'),
    );
    final validationCache = await ValidationHashCache.open(
      localState.namespace('validation'),
    );

    final eventBus = AgentEventBus();
    final cpuWorker = await PersistentCpuWorker.start(
      initialEpoch: eventBus.pairEpoch,
    );

    try {
      final kernel = OrchestrationKernel(
      eventBus: eventBus,
      services: ServiceContainer(),
    );

    final systemEndpoint = kernel.connect(
      AgentDescriptor(
        id: 'sys.system-bridge',
        role: AgentRole.system,
        subscriptions: const <String>{
          AgentTopics.memorySnapshot,
          AgentTopics.systemRecovery,
          AgentTopics.learningProgress,
          AgentTopics.localizationChangeRequested,
          AgentTopics.polyglotMatrixChanged,
          AgentTopics.grammarEngineChanged,
          AgentTopics.grammarResponse,
          AgentTopics.ttsPrepared,
          AgentTopics.ttsCompleted,
          AgentTopics.ttsFailed,
        },
        observesTargetedEvents: true,
      ),
    );
    final memoryEndpoint = kernel.connect(
      AgentDescriptor(
        id: 'sys.memory-agent',
        role: AgentRole.memory,
        subscriptions: const <String>{
          AgentTopics.routeSelected,
          AgentTopics.learningProgress,
          AgentTopics.learningMistake,
        },
        observesTargetedEvents: true,
      ),
    );
    final recoveryEndpoint = kernel.connect(
      AgentDescriptor(
        id: 'sys.error-recovery-fallback',
        role: AgentRole.recovery,
        subscriptions: const <String>{
          AgentTopics.systemError,
        },
      ),
    );
    final polyglotEndpoint = kernel.connect(
      AgentDescriptor(
        id: 'sys.polyglot-matrix-agent',
        role: AgentRole.polyglot,
        subscriptions: const <String>{
          AgentTopics.localizationChanged,
        },
        observesTargetedEvents: true,
      ),
    );
    final grammarEndpoint = kernel.connect(
      AgentDescriptor(
        id: 'sys.universal-grammar-agent',
        role: AgentRole.grammar,
        subscriptions: const <String>{
          AgentTopics.polyglotMatrixChanged,
          AgentTopics.grammarRequest,
        },
      ),
    );
    final voiceEndpoint = kernel.connect(
      AgentDescriptor(
        id: 'sys.tts-voice-agent',
        role: AgentRole.voice,
        subscriptions: const <String>{
          AgentTopics.polyglotMatrixChanged,
          AgentTopics.ttsRequest,
        },
      ),
    );

    final memoryAgent = await SysMemoryAgent.start(
      endpoint: memoryEndpoint,
      store: localState.namespace('memory'),
      cpuWorker: cpuWorker,
    );
    await progressService.hydrateFromMemory(memoryAgent.snapshot);
    final recoveryAgent = SysErrorRecoveryFallback.start(
      endpoint: recoveryEndpoint,
    );
    final polyglotAgent = SysPolyglotMatrixAgent.start(
      endpoint: polyglotEndpoint,
    );
    final grammarAgent = SysUniversalGrammarAgent.start(
      endpoint: grammarEndpoint,
    );
    final voiceAgent = SysTtsVoiceAgent.start(
      endpoint: voiceEndpoint,
    );
    final batchDispatcher = systemEndpoint.createBatchDispatcher(
      maxBatchSize: 16,
      maxPending: 256,
      flushDelay: const Duration(milliseconds: 2),
    );

    final runtime = SystemAgentRuntime._(
      eventBus: eventBus,
      kernel: kernel,
      systemEndpoint: systemEndpoint,
      memoryAgent: memoryAgent,
      recoveryAgent: recoveryAgent,
      polyglotAgent: polyglotAgent,
      grammarAgent: grammarAgent,
      voiceAgent: voiceAgent,
      localState: localState,
      progressService: progressService,
      validationCache: validationCache,
      batchDispatcher: batchDispatcher,
      cpuWorker: cpuWorker,
    );
    runtime._pairProgressSubscription =
        runtime.polyglotMatrixChanges.listen(runtime._persistActivePair);
    runtime._externalProgressSubscription = systemEndpoint
        .events(AgentTopics.learningProgress)
        .listen(runtime._persistExternalProgress);
    runtime._pairEpochSubscription = systemEndpoint
        .events(AgentTopics.localizationChangeRequested)
        .listen(
          (event) => runtime._cpuWorker.advanceEpoch(
            event.context.pairEpoch,
          ),
        );
      return runtime;
    } on Object {
      await cpuWorker.close();
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  final AgentEventBus _eventBus;
  final OrchestrationKernel _kernel;
  final AgentEndpoint _systemEndpoint;
  final SysMemoryAgent _memoryAgent;
  final SysErrorRecoveryFallback _recoveryAgent;
  final SysPolyglotMatrixAgent _polyglotAgent;
  final SysUniversalGrammarAgent _grammarAgent;
  final SysTtsVoiceAgent _voiceAgent;
  final RuntimeLocalStateContainer _localState;
  final OfflineProgressService _progressService;
  final ValidationHashCache _validationCache;
  final AgentEventBatchDispatcher _batchDispatcher;
  final PersistentCpuWorker _cpuWorker;

  late final StreamSubscription<PolyglotMatrixState>
      _pairProgressSubscription;
  late final StreamSubscription<AgentEvent>
      _externalProgressSubscription;
  late final StreamSubscription<AgentEvent>
      _pairEpochSubscription;

  int _sequence = 0;
  bool _closed = false;

  bool get isClosed => _closed;
  int get publishedEventCount => _eventBus.publishedCount;
  MemoryAgentSnapshot get memorySnapshot => _memoryAgent.snapshot;
  PolyglotMatrixState? get polyglotMatrixState => _polyglotAgent.state;
  String? get activeGrammarEngineId => _grammarAgent.activeEngineId;
  OfflineProgressSnapshot get progressSnapshot => _progressService.snapshot;
  Stream<OfflineProgressSnapshot> get progressChanges =>
      _progressService.changes;
  AgentBatchQueueStats get batchStats => _batchDispatcher.stats;
  int get validationCacheHits => _validationCache.hits;
  int get validationCacheMisses => _validationCache.misses;
  int get validationCacheEntries => _validationCache.entryCount;
  int get pairEpoch => _eventBus.pairEpoch;
  int get workerPendingJobs => _cpuWorker.pendingCount;
  bool get workerClosed => _cpuWorker.isClosed;

  Stream<RecoveryDirective> get recoveryDirectives =>
      _systemEndpoint
          .events(AgentTopics.systemRecovery)
          .map(RecoveryDirective.fromEvent);

  Stream<PolyglotMatrixState> get polyglotMatrixChanges =>
      _systemEndpoint
          .events(AgentTopics.polyglotMatrixChanged)
          .map(PolyglotMatrixState.fromEvent);

  Stream<AgentEvent> get grammarEngineChanges =>
      _systemEndpoint.events(AgentTopics.grammarEngineChanged);

  Stream<GrammarAgentResult> get grammarResponses =>
      _systemEndpoint
          .events(AgentTopics.grammarResponse)
          .map(GrammarAgentResult.fromEvent);

  Stream<TtsVoiceDispatch> get ttsDispatches =>

          .map(TtsVoiceDispatch.fromEvent);

  Stream<AgentEvent> get ttsFailures =>
      _systemEndpoint.events(AgentTopics.ttsFailed);

  void requestLearningPair({
    required String sourceLanguageTag,
    required String targetLanguageTag,
  }) {
    _ensureOpen();
    final source = _requiredLanguageTag(
      sourceLanguageTag,
      'sourceLanguageTag',
    );
    final target = _requiredLanguageTag(
      targetLanguageTag,
      'targetLanguageTag',
    );

    final event = _systemEndpoint.publish(
      topic: AgentTopics.localizationChangeRequested,
      targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.localization},
      context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty(
        _nextCorrelation('language-pair'),
      ),
      payload: <String, Object?>{
        'sourceLocale': source,
        'targetLocale': target,
      },
    );
    _cpuWorker.advanceEpoch(event.context.pairEpoch);
  }

  LanguagePackRepository createLanguagePackRepository({
    required LanguagePackTextLoader loadText,
    String assetRoot = 'assets/lang_data',
  }) {
    _ensureOpen();
    return LanguagePackRepository(
      loadText: loadText,
      assetRoot: assetRoot,
      cpuWorker: _cpuWorker,
    );
  }

  Future<WorkerResult<R>?> dispatchWorkerJob<R>(
    WorkerJob<Object?> job,
  ) async {
    _ensureOpen();
    final result = await _cpuWorker.submit<R>(job);
    if (_closed ||
        result.epoch != pairEpoch ||
        result.status == WorkerStatuses.stale) {
      return null;
    }
    return result;
  }

  Future<WorkerResult<R>?> runCpuJob<R>({
    required String type,
    required Object? payload,
    String? id,
  }) =>
      dispatchWorkerJob<R>(
        WorkerJob<Object?>(
          id: id ?? _nextCorrelation('cpu'),
          type: type,
          epoch: pairEpoch,
          payload: payload,
        ),
      );

  Future<Object?> decodePayload(String encoded) async {
    final result = await runCpuJob<Object>(
      type: WorkerJobTypes.jsonDecode,
      payload: <String, Object?>{'encoded': encoded},
    );
    return _workerPayload(result);
  }

  Future<String?> computeChecksum128({
    required String scopeKey,
    required String content,
    required String validatorVersion,
  }) async {
    final result = await runCpuJob<String>(
      type: WorkerJobTypes.checksum128,
      payload: <String, Object?>{
        'scopeKey': scopeKey,
        'content': content,
        'validatorVersion': validatorVersion,
      },
    );
    return _workerPayload(result);
  }

  Future<String?> computeSha256(String content) async {
    final result = await runCpuJob<String>(
      type: WorkerJobTypes.sha256,
      payload: <String, Object?>{'content': content},
    );
    return _workerPayload(result);
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, Object?>>?> rankFuzzyCandidates({
    required String query,
    required List<Map<String, Object?>> candidates,
    int limit = 20,
  }) async {
    final result = await runCpuJob<Object>(
      type: WorkerJobTypes.fuzzyRank,
      payload: <String, Object?>{
        'query': query,
        'candidates': candidates,
        'limit': limit.clamp(1, 100).toInt(),
      },
    );
    final payload = _workerPayload(result);
    if (payload == null) return null;
    if (payload is! List) {
      throw StateError('CPU worker returned an invalid fuzzy result.');
    }
    return List<Map<String, Object?>>.unmodifiable(
      payload.whereType<Map>().map(
            (row) => Map<String, Object?>.unmodifiable(
              <String, Object?>{
                for (final entry in row.entries)
                  if (entry.key is String)
                    entry.key as String: entry.value,
              },
            ),
          ),
    );
  }

  Future<GrammarAgentResult> requestGrammar({
    required UniversalGrammarCapability capability,
    int seed = 0,
    int count = 6,
  }) async {
    _ensureOpen();
    final boundedCount = count.clamp(1, 20).toInt();
    final correlationId = _nextCorrelation('grammar');
    final matrix = _polyglotAgent.state;
    final sourceLanguage = matrix?.sourceLanguageTag ?? 'und';
    final targetLanguage = matrix?.targetLanguageTag ?? 'und';
    final payload = <String, Object?>{
      'capability': capability.wireName,
      'seed': seed,
      'count': boundedCount,
    };
    final grammarSignature =
        '${capability.wireName}|$seed|$boundedCount|$targetLanguage';
    final validation = await _validationCache.validateOnce(
      scopeKey:
          '${sourceLanguage.toLowerCase()}->'
          '${targetLanguage.toLowerCase()}|grammar|'
          '${capability.wireName}',
      content: grammarSignature,
      validatorVersion: 'runtime.grammar.v1',
      validator: () async {
        final report = const AgentDataIntegrityVerifier().verify(
          <AgentDataRecord>[
            AgentDataRecord(
              recordId: 'validation.$correlationId',
              domain: AgentDataDomain.grammar,
              sourceLanguage: sourceLanguage,
              targetLanguage: targetLanguage,
              canonicalKey: capability.wireName,
              fingerprint: grammarSignature,
            ),
          ],
        );
        return report.isValid;
      },
    );
    if (!validation.validated) {
      throw StateError('Grammar request failed integrity validation.');
    }

    final response = _systemEndpoint
        .events(AgentTopics.grammarResponse)
        .firstWhere(
          (event) => event.context.correlationId == correlationId,
        )
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 2));

    await _batchDispatcher.submit(
      AgentBatchEvent(
        dedupeKey: correlationId,
        topic: AgentTopics.grammarRequest,
        context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty(correlationId),
        targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.grammar},
        payload: payload,
        integrityRecord: AgentDataRecord(
          recordId: correlationId,
          domain: AgentDataDomain.grammar,
          sourceLanguage: sourceLanguage,
          targetLanguage: targetLanguage,
          canonicalKey: 'runtime.$correlationId',
          fingerprint:
              '${capability.wireName}|$seed|$boundedCount|$targetLanguage',
        ),
      ),
    );

    return GrammarAgentResult.fromEvent(await response);
  }

  Future<TtsVoiceDispatch> prepareSpeech({
    required String text,
    required String targetLanguageTag,
    double speed = 1.0,
  }) async {
    _ensureOpen();
    final request = TtsVoiceRequest(
      text: text,
      targetLanguageTag: targetLanguageTag,
      speed: speed,
    );
    final correlationId = _nextCorrelation('tts');
    final response = _systemEndpoint
        .events(AgentTopics.ttsPrepared)
        .firstWhere(
          (event) => event.context.correlationId == correlationId,
        )
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 2));

    _systemEndpoint.publish(
      topic: AgentTopics.ttsRequest,
      targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.voice},
      context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty(correlationId),
      payload: request.toEventPayload(),
    );

    return TtsVoiceDispatch.fromEvent(await response);
  }

  void recordProgress({
    required String taskId,
    required double score,
    required bool completed,
    required int attempts,
    int? points,
    int? occurredAtEpochMs,
  }) {
    _ensureOpen();
    final timestamp =
        occurredAtEpochMs ?? DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;
    final normalizedTaskId = taskId.trim();
    final normalizedScore = score.clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
    final correlationId = _nextCorrelation('progress');

    _submitBackground(
      AgentBatchEvent(
        dedupeKey: correlationId,
        topic: AgentTopics.learningProgress,
        context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty(correlationId),
        targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.memory},
        payload: <String, Object?>{
          'taskId': normalizedTaskId,
          'score': normalizedScore,
          'completed': completed,
          'attempts': attempts.clamp(0, 1000000).toInt(),
          'occurredAtEpochMs': timestamp,
        },
      ),
    );
    _persistBackground(
      _progressService.recordTaskProgress(
        taskId: normalizedTaskId,
        pointsDelta:
            points ?? _defaultProgressPoints(normalizedScore, completed),
        score: normalizedScore,
        completed: completed,
        occurredAtEpochMs: timestamp,
      ),
      context: 'progress.persist',
    );
  }

  void recordMistake({
    required String taskId,
    required String weaknessKey,
    int weight = 1,
    int? occurredAtEpochMs,
  }) {
    _ensureOpen();
    final correlationId = _nextCorrelation('mistake');
    _submitBackground(
      AgentBatchEvent(
        dedupeKey: correlationId,
        topic: AgentTopics.learningMistake,
        context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty(correlationId),
        targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.memory},
        payload: <String, Object?>{
          'taskId': taskId.trim(),
          'weaknessKey': weaknessKey.trim(),
          'weight': weight.clamp(1, 1000).toInt(),
          'occurredAtEpochMs':
              occurredAtEpochMs ?? DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch,
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  void recordRouteVisit({
    required String taskId,
    String featureKey = 'bootstrap',
    int? occurredAtEpochMs,
  }) {
    _ensureOpen();
    final correlationId = _nextCorrelation('route');
    _submitBackground(
      AgentBatchEvent(
        dedupeKey: correlationId,
        topic: AgentTopics.routeSelected,
        context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty(correlationId),
        targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.memory},
        payload: <String, Object?>{
          'ok': true,
          'featureKey': featureKey.trim(),
          'curriculumTaskId': taskId.trim(),
          'occurredAtEpochMs':
              occurredAtEpochMs ?? DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch,
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<RecoveryDirective> reportError({
    required String context,
    required String errorType,
    required String message,
    required bool fatal,
  }) async {
    _ensureOpen();
    final correlationId = _nextCorrelation('error');
    final response = _systemEndpoint
        .events(AgentTopics.systemRecovery)
        .firstWhere(
          (event) => event.context.correlationId == correlationId,
        )
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 2));

    _systemEndpoint.publish(
      topic: AgentTopics.systemError,
      targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.recovery},
      context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty(correlationId),
      payload: <String, Object?>{
        'context': _boundedText(context, 120, 'application'),
        'errorType': _boundedText(errorType, 100, 'Error'),
        'message': _boundedText(
          message,
          240,
          'Unexpected application error',
        ),
        'fatal': fatal,
        'occurredAtEpochMs': DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch,
      },
    );

    return RecoveryDirective.fromEvent(await response);
  }

  Future<ValidationCacheResult> validateContentOnce({
    required String scopeType,
    required String sourceLanguageTag,
    required String targetLanguageTag,
    required String canonicalKey,
    required String content,
    required String validatorVersion,
    required Future<bool> Function() validator,
  }) {
    _ensureOpen();
    final source = _requiredLanguageTag(
      sourceLanguageTag,
      'sourceLanguageTag',
    );
    final target = _requiredLanguageTag(
      targetLanguageTag,
      'targetLanguageTag',
    );
    final scope = '${source.toLowerCase()}->${target.toLowerCase()}'
        '|${scopeType.trim().toLowerCase()}|${canonicalKey.trim()}';
    return _validationCache.validateOnce(
      scopeKey: scope,
      content: content,
      validatorVersion: validatorVersion,
      validator: validator,
    );
  }

  Future<void> flushMemory() async {
    await _batchDispatcher.flush();
    await _memoryAgent.flush();
    await _progressService.flush();
    await _validationCache.flush();
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    _closed = true;
    await _pairProgressSubscription.cancel();
    await _externalProgressSubscription.cancel();
    await _pairEpochSubscription.cancel();
    await _batchDispatcher.close();
    await _memoryAgent.flush();
    await _progressService.flush();
    await _validationCache.flush();
    await _voiceAgent.close();
    await _grammarAgent.close();
    await _polyglotAgent.close();
    await _memoryAgent.close();
    await _recoveryAgent.close();
    await _progressService.close();
    await _validationCache.close();
    await _localState.close();
    await _cpuWorker.close();
    await _kernel.close();
  }

  void _persistExternalProgress(AgentEvent event) {
    final taskId = event.payload['taskId'];
    if (taskId is! String || taskId.trim().isEmpty) return;

    final rawScore = event.payload['score'];
    final score =
        rawScore is num ? rawScore.toDouble().clamp(0.0, 1.0) : 0.0;
    final rawPoints = event.payload['points'];
    final points = rawPoints is num
        ? rawPoints.toInt()
        : _defaultProgressPoints(
            score.toDouble(),
            event.payload['completed'] == true,
          );
    final rawTimestamp = event.payload['occurredAtEpochMs'];
    final timestamp = rawTimestamp is num
        ? rawTimestamp.toInt().clamp(0, 4102444800000).toInt()
        : DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;

    _persistBackground(
      _progressService.recordTaskProgress(
        taskId: taskId,
        pointsDelta: points,
        score: score.toDouble(),
        completed: event.payload['completed'] == true,
        occurredAtEpochMs: timestamp,
      ),
      context: 'progress.external_event',
    );
  }

  void _persistActivePair(PolyglotMatrixState state) {
    _persistBackground(
      _progressService.setActivePair(
        sourceLanguageTag: state.sourceLanguageTag,
        targetLanguageTag: state.targetLanguageTag,
      ),
      context: 'progress.active_pair',
    );
    _persistBackground(
      _validationCache
          .validateOnce(
            scopeKey:
                '${state.sourceLanguageTag.toLowerCase()}->'
                '${state.targetLanguageTag.toLowerCase()}|pair',
            content:
                '${state.sourceLanguageTag}->${state.targetLanguageTag}',
            validatorVersion: 'runtime.pair.v1',
            validator: () async => true,
          )
          .then<void>((result) {
        if (!result.validated) {
          throw StateError('Language pair validation failed.');
        }
      }),
      context: 'validation.active_pair',
    );
  }

  R? _workerPayload<R>(WorkerResult<R>? result) {
    if (result == null) return null;
    if (result.status != WorkerStatuses.ok) {
      throw StateError(
        'CPU worker failed: ${result.errorCode ?? result.status}.',
      );
    }
    return result.payload;
  }

  static int _defaultProgressPoints(
    double score,
    bool completed,
  ) {
    final scorePoints = (score.clamp(0.0, 1.0) * 100).round();
    final completionBonus = completed ? 25 : 0;
    return (scorePoints + completionBonus).clamp(0, 125).toInt();
  }

  void _submitBackground(AgentBatchEvent event) {
    unawaited(
      _batchDispatcher.submit(event).catchError((Object error) {
        if (_closed) return;
        _publishBackgroundFailure(
          context: 'batch.${event.topic}',
          error: error,
        );
      }),
    );
  }

  void _persistBackground(
    Future<void> operation, {
    required String context,
  }) {
    unawaited(
      operation.catchError((Object error) {
        if (_closed) return;
        _publishBackgroundFailure(
          context: context,
          error: error,
        );
      }),
    );
  }

  void _publishBackgroundFailure({
    required String context,
    required Object error,
  }) {
    _systemEndpoint.publish(
      topic: AgentTopics.systemError,
      targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.recovery},
      context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty(
        _nextCorrelation('background-error'),
      ),
      payload: <String, Object?>{
        'context': _boundedText(context, 120, 'runtime.background'),
        'errorType': error.runtimeType.toString(),
        'message': _boundedText(
          error.toString(),
          240,
          'Background runtime operation failed',
        ),
        'fatal': false,
        'occurredAtEpochMs': DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch,
      },
    );
  }

  String _nextCorrelation(String purpose) {
    _sequence += 1;
    return 'sys.' + purpose + '.' + _sequence.toString();
  }

  void _ensureOpen() {
    if (_closed) {
      throw StateError('SystemAgentRuntime is closed.');
    }
  }
}

String _requiredLanguageTag(String value, String field) {
  final normalized = value.trim();
  if (normalized.isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(
      value,
      field,
      'language tag must not be empty',
    );
  }
  return normalized;
}

String _boundedText(
  String value,
  int maxLength,
  String fallback,
) {
  final normalized = value.trim();
  if (normalized.isEmpty) return fallback;
  return normalized.length <= maxLength
      ? normalized
      : normalized.substring(0, maxLength);
}
