import '../orchestration/orchestration.dart';
import 'agents.dart';

Future<void> main() async {
  final store = _MemoryStore();
  final runtime = await SystemAgentRuntime.start(memoryStore: store);

  final producerBus = AgentEventBus();
  final producerKernel = OrchestrationKernel(
    eventBus: producerBus,
    services: ServiceContainer(),
  );
  final producer = producerKernel.connect(
    AgentDescriptor(
      id: 'contract.task-producer',
      role: AgentRole.task,
      subscriptions: const <String>{AgentTopics.contextUpdated},
    ),
  );

  producer.publish(
    topic: AgentTopics.routeSelected,
    context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty('route-1'),
    targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.task},
    payload: const <String, Object?>{
      'ok': true,
      'featureKey': 'life_maintenance',
      'curriculumTaskId': 'task-16',
    },
  );
  producer.publish(
    topic: AgentTopics.learningProgress,
    context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty('progress-1'),
    payload: const <String, Object?>{
      'taskId': 'task-16',
      'score': 0.82,
      'completed': true,
      'attempts': 2,
    },
  );
  producer.publish(
    topic: AgentTopics.learningMistake,
    context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty('mistake-1'),
    payload: const <String, Object?>{
      'taskId': 'task-16',
      'weaknessKey': 'dative-preposition',
      'weight': 2,
    },
  );
  producer.publish(
    topic: AgentTopics.learningMistake,
    context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty('mistake-2'),
    payload: const <String, Object?>{
      'taskId': 'task-16',
      'weaknessKey': 'dative-preposition',
      'weight': 1,
    },
  );

  await runtime.flushMemory();

  final snapshot = runtime.memorySnapshot;
  _expect(snapshot.tasks['task-16']?.visits, 1, 'route visit is tracked');
  _expect(snapshot.tasks['task-16']?.completed, true, 'completion is tracked');
  _expect(snapshot.tasks['task-16']?.bestScore, 0.82, 'best score is retained');
  _expect(
    snapshot.weaknesses['dative-preposition']?.weight,
    3,
    'weakness weight accumulates',
  );
  _expect(store.lastEncoded.isNotEmpty, true, 'memory snapshot is persisted');
  _expect(
    snapshot.reviewPriorities.first.weaknessKey,
    'dative-preposition',
    'weakness appears in review priority',
  );

  final restored = await SystemAgentRuntime.start(memoryStore: store);
  _expect(
    restored.memorySnapshot.tasks['task-16']?.completed,
    true,
    'memory restores across runtime restart',
  );
  await restored.close();

  final directive = await runtime.reportError(
    context: 'phase3.route',
    errorType: 'StateError',
    message: 'route failed',
    fatal: true,
  );
  _expect(
    directive.mode,
    RecoveryMode.safeShell,
    'fatal errors route to safe shell',
  );
  _expect(
    directive.context,
    'phase3.route',
    'recovery preserves error context',
  );

  final firstNonFatal = await runtime.reportError(
    context: 'phase3.cards',
    errorType: 'FormatException',
    message: 'bad card',
    fatal: false,
  );
  _expect(
    firstNonFatal.mode,
    RecoveryMode.safeSection,
    'first non-fatal error isolates the section',
  );

  final secondNonFatal = await runtime.reportError(
    context: 'phase3.cards',
    errorType: 'FormatException',
    message: 'bad card again',
    fatal: false,
  );
  final thirdNonFatal = await runtime.reportError(
    context: 'phase3.cards',
    errorType: 'FormatException',
    message: 'bad card third',
    fatal: false,
  );
  _expect(
    secondNonFatal.mode,
    RecoveryMode.safeSection,
    'second repeated error remains section-safe',
  );
  _expect(
    thirdNonFatal.mode,
    RecoveryMode.safeShell,
    'third repeated error escalates to safe shell',
  );

  await producerKernel.close();
  await runtime.close();

  _expect(runtime.isClosed, true, 'system runtime closes cleanly');
}

final class _MemoryStore implements MemoryAgentStore {
  String lastEncoded = '';

  @override
  Future<String?> read() async =>
      lastEncoded.isEmpty ? null : lastEncoded;

  @override
  Future<void> write(String encoded) async {
    lastEncoded = encoded;
  }
}

void _expect(Object? actual, Object? expected, String contract) {
  if (actual != expected) {
    throw StateError(
      'Contract failed: $contract. Expected <$expected>, got <$actual>.',
    );
  }
}

import '../models/language_catalog_models.dart';
import '../packs/pack_acquisition_router.dart';

final class LanguageCatalog {
  LanguageCatalog({
    required PackAcquisitionRouter packRouter,
    Iterable<LanguageMetadata> languages =
        const <LanguageMetadata>[],
  }) : _packRouter = packRouter {
    registerAll(languages);
  }

  static const int maxLanguages = 100;

  final PackAcquisitionRouter _packRouter;
  final Map<String, LanguageMetadata> _languages =
      <String, LanguageMetadata>{};

  ResolvedLanguagePair? _activePair;
  int _resolutionGeneration = 0;

  int get languageCount => _languages.length;

  int get directedPairCapacity =>
      languageCount * (languageCount - 1);

  int get residentPairCount => _activePair == null ? 0 : 1;

  ResolvedLanguagePair? get activePair => _activePair;

  List<LanguageMetadata> get languages =>
      List<LanguageMetadata>.unmodifiable(_languages.values);

  void register(LanguageMetadata metadata) {
    final id = _normalizeLanguageId(metadata.id);
    final name = metadata.name.trim();
    if (name.isEmpty || name.length > 120) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        metadata.name,
        'metadata.name',
        'must be 1..120 characters',
      );
    }
    if (_languages.containsKey(id)) {
      throw StateError('language_already_registered:$id');
    }
    if (_languages.length >= maxLanguages) {
      throw StateError(
        'language_catalog_capacity_exceeded:$maxLanguages',
      );
    }

    _languages[id] = LanguageMetadata(
      id: id,
      name: name,
      isRtl: metadata.isRtl,
    );
  }

  void registerAll(Iterable<LanguageMetadata> languages) {
    for (final language in languages) {
      register(language);
    }
  }

  LanguageMetadata? find(String languageId) =>
      _languages[_normalizeLanguageId(languageId)];

  LanguageMetadata require(String languageId) {
    final id = _normalizeLanguageId(languageId);
    final language = _languages[id];
    if (language == null) {
      throw StateError('language_not_registered:$id');
    }
    return language;
  }

  Future<ResolvedLanguagePair> resolvePair(
    String sourceId,
    String targetId,
  ) async {
    final sourceKey = _normalizeLanguageId(sourceId);
    final targetKey = _normalizeLanguageId(targetId);
    if (sourceKey == targetKey) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'Source and target language must be different.',
      );
    }

    final source = _languages[sourceKey];
    final target = _languages[targetKey];
    if (source == null) {
      throw StateError('language_not_registered:$sourceKey');
    }
    if (target == null) {
      throw StateError('language_not_registered:$targetKey');
    }

    final generation = ++_resolutionGeneration;
    final request = PackPairRequest(
      sourceLanguageTag: source.id,
      targetLanguageTag: target.id,
    );
    final route = await _packRouter.route(request);
    final resolved = ResolvedLanguagePair(
      source: source,
      target: target,
      pairKey: request.pairKey,
      generation: generation,
      route: route,
    );

    if (generation == _resolutionGeneration) {
      _activePair = resolved;
    }
    return resolved;
  }

  static String _normalizeLanguageId(String raw) {
    final normalized =
        raw.trim().replaceAll('_', '-').toLowerCase();
    if (!RegExp(r'^[a-z]{2,8}(?:-[a-z0-9]{1,8})*$')
        .hasMatch(normalized)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        raw,
        'languageId',
        'must be a valid language tag',
      );
    }
    return normalized;
  }
}

import 'content_card.dart';

enum ContentDisposition {
  canonical,
  quarantine,
}

enum ContentGateReason {
  invalidSemanticId('semantic.invalid_id'),
  semanticNamespaceMismatch('semantic.namespace_mismatch'),
  duplicateSemanticId('semantic.duplicate_id'),
  hiddenDirectionalControl('safety.hidden_directional_control'),
  externalLink('safety.external_link'),
  semanticConfidenceLow('semantic.confidence_low'),
  culturalReviewRequired('cultural.review_required'),
  culturalRiskFlagged('cultural.risk_flagged'),
  reviewRejected('review.rejected');

  const ContentGateReason(this.code);

  final String code;
}

final class ContentGateDecision {
  ContentGateDecision._(
    this.disposition,
    Iterable<ContentGateReason> reasons,
  ) : reasons = List<ContentGateReason>.unmodifiable(reasons);

  factory ContentGateDecision.canonical() =>
      ContentGateDecision._(
        ContentDisposition.canonical,
        const <ContentGateReason>[],
      );

  factory ContentGateDecision.quarantine(
    Iterable<ContentGateReason> reasons,
  ) {
    final unique = <ContentGateReason>{
      ...reasons,
    };
    if (unique.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'A quarantine decision requires at least one reason.',
      );
    }
    return ContentGateDecision._(
      ContentDisposition.quarantine,
      unique,
    );
  }

  final ContentDisposition disposition;
  final List<ContentGateReason> reasons;

  bool get isCanonical =>
      disposition == ContentDisposition.canonical;
}

final class QuarantinedContentCard {
  QuarantinedContentCard({
    required this.card,
    required Iterable<ContentGateReason> reasons,
  }) : reasons = List<ContentGateReason>.unmodifiable(reasons) {
    if (this.reasons.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'Quarantined content requires at least one reason.',
      );
    }
  }

  final PipelineContentCard card;
  final List<ContentGateReason> reasons;

  Map<String, Object?> toAuditJson() => <String, Object?>{
        'cardId': card.id,
        'semanticId': card.semanticId,
        'languageCode': card.languageCode,
        'reasons': reasons
            .map((reason) => reason.code)
            .toList(growable: false),
      };
}

final class ContentPromotionBatch {
  const ContentPromotionBatch.empty()
      : canonical = const <PipelineContentCard>[],
        quarantine = const <QuarantinedContentCard>[];

  ContentPromotionBatch({
    required Iterable<PipelineContentCard> canonical,
    required Iterable<QuarantinedContentCard> quarantine,
  })  : canonical =
            List<PipelineContentCard>.unmodifiable(canonical),
        quarantine =
            List<QuarantinedContentCard>.unmodifiable(quarantine);

  final List<PipelineContentCard> canonical;
  final List<QuarantinedContentCard> quarantine;

  int get canonicalCount => canonical.length;
  int get quarantineCount => quarantine.length;
}

final class CanonicalContentGate {
  const CanonicalContentGate({
    this.minimumSemanticConfidence = 0.80,
  }) : assert(
          minimumSemanticConfidence >= 0 &&
              minimumSemanticConfidence <= 1,
        );

  static const String policyVersion =
      'phase18-canonical-gate-v1';

  final double minimumSemanticConfidence;

  ContentGateDecision review(PipelineContentCard card) {
    final reasons = <ContentGateReason>{};

    final semanticId = card.semanticId.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!RegExp(r'^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,159}$')
        .hasMatch(semanticId)) {
      reasons.add(ContentGateReason.invalidSemanticId);
    }

    final category = card.metadata['category'];
    if (category is String && category.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      final namespace = semanticId.split('.').first;
      final normalizedCategory =
          category.trim().toLowerCase().replaceAll('_', '-');
      if (namespace != normalizedCategory) {
        reasons.add(
          ContentGateReason.semanticNamespaceMismatch,
        );
      }
    }

    for (final value in <String?>[
      card.text,
      card.translation,
      card.example,
    ]) {
      if (value == null) continue;
      if (_containsHiddenDirectionalControl(value)) {
        reasons.add(
          ContentGateReason.hiddenDirectionalControl,
        );
      }
      if (_externalLink.hasMatch(value)) {
        reasons.add(ContentGateReason.externalLink);
      }
    }

    _applySemanticConfidence(card.metadata, reasons);
    _applyCulturalReview(card.metadata, reasons);
    _applyCulturalRisk(card.metadata, reasons);
    _applyReviewStatus(card.metadata, reasons);

    if (reasons.isEmpty) {
      return ContentGateDecision.canonical();
    }
    return ContentGateDecision.quarantine(reasons);
  }

  ContentPromotionBatch classify(
    Iterable<PipelineContentCard> input,
  ) {
    final cards = input.toList(growable: false);
    final reasonBuckets = List<Set<ContentGateReason>>.generate(
      cards.length,
      (_) => <ContentGateReason>{},
      growable: false,
    );
    final semanticIndexes = <String, List<int>>{};

    for (var index = 0; index < cards.length; index += 1) {
      final card = cards[index];
      reasonBuckets[index].addAll(review(card).reasons);
      final key = card.semanticId.trim().toLowerCase();
      semanticIndexes
          .putIfAbsent(key, () => <int>[])
          .add(index);
    }

    for (final indexes in semanticIndexes.values) {
      if (indexes.length < 2) continue;
      for (final index in indexes) {
        reasonBuckets[index].add(
          ContentGateReason.duplicateSemanticId,
        );
      }
    }

    final canonical = <PipelineContentCard>[];
    final quarantine = <QuarantinedContentCard>[];
    for (var index = 0; index < cards.length; index += 1) {
      final reasons = reasonBuckets[index];
      if (reasons.isEmpty) {
        canonical.add(cards[index]);
      } else {
        quarantine.add(
          QuarantinedContentCard(
            card: cards[index],
            reasons: reasons,
          ),
        );
      }
    }

    return ContentPromotionBatch(
      canonical: canonical,
      quarantine: quarantine,
    );
  }

  void _applySemanticConfidence(
    Map<String, Object?> metadata,
    Set<ContentGateReason> reasons,
  ) {
    if (!metadata.containsKey('semanticConfidence')) return;
    final raw = metadata['semanticConfidence'];
    if (raw is! num) {
      reasons.add(ContentGateReason.semanticConfidenceLow);
      return;
    }
    final value = raw.toDouble();
    if (!value.isFinite ||
        value < minimumSemanticConfidence ||
        value > 1) {
      reasons.add(ContentGateReason.semanticConfidenceLow);
    }
  }

  static void _applyCulturalReview(
    Map<String, Object?> metadata,
    Set<ContentGateReason> reasons,
  ) {
    if (!metadata.containsKey('culturalReview')) return;
    final raw = metadata['culturalReview'];
    if (raw is! String) {
      reasons.add(ContentGateReason.culturalReviewRequired);
      return;
    }
    switch (raw.trim().toLowerCase()) {
      case 'not-required':
      case 'approved':
        return;
      case 'required':
      case 'pending':
      case 'needs-review':
      default:
        reasons.add(
          ContentGateReason.culturalReviewRequired,
        );
    }
  }

  static void _applyCulturalRisk(
    Map<String, Object?> metadata,
    Set<ContentGateReason> reasons,
  ) {
    if (!metadata.containsKey('culturalRisk')) return;
    final raw = metadata['culturalRisk'];
    if (raw is! String) {
      reasons.add(ContentGateReason.culturalRiskFlagged);
      return;
    }
    switch (raw.trim().toLowerCase()) {
      case 'none':
      case 'low':
        return;
      case 'medium':
      case 'high':
      default:
        reasons.add(ContentGateReason.culturalRiskFlagged);
    }
  }

  static void _applyReviewStatus(
    Map<String, Object?> metadata,
    Set<ContentGateReason> reasons,
  ) {
    if (!metadata.containsKey('reviewStatus')) return;
    final raw = metadata['reviewStatus'];
    if (raw is! String) {
      reasons.add(ContentGateReason.culturalReviewRequired);
      return;
    }
    switch (raw.trim().toLowerCase()) {
      case 'approved':
      case 'verified':
        return;
      case 'rejected':
        reasons.add(ContentGateReason.reviewRejected);
        return;
      case 'pending':
      case 'needs-review':
      default:
        reasons.add(
          ContentGateReason.culturalReviewRequired,
        );
    }
  }

  static bool _containsHiddenDirectionalControl(
    String value,
  ) {
    for (final rune in value.runes) {
      if ((rune >= 0x202A && rune <= 0x202E) ||
          (rune >= 0x2066 && rune <= 0x2069)) {
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  static final RegExp _externalLink = RegExp(
    r'(?:https?://|www\.)',
    caseSensitive: false,
  );
}

import 'dart:convert';

enum ContentRegister {
  formal,
  neutral,
  informal;

  static ContentRegister parse(Object? raw) {
    switch (raw) {
      case 'formal':
        return ContentRegister.formal;
      case 'neutral':
        return ContentRegister.neutral;
      case 'informal':
        return ContentRegister.informal;
      default:
        throw const FormatException(
          'register must be one of: formal, neutral, informal',
        );
    }
  }
}

final class PipelineContentCard {
  PipelineContentCard({
    required this.id,
    required this.semanticId,
    required this.languageCode,
    required this.text,
    required this.register,
    this.translation,
    this.example,
    this.metadata = const <String, Object?>{},
  }) {
    _validateIdentifier(id, 'id', maxLength: 160);
    _validateIdentifier(
      semanticId,
      'semanticId',
      maxLength: 160,
    );
    _validateLanguageCode(languageCode);
    _validateRequiredUtf8(text, 'text');
    _validateOptionalUtf8(translation, 'translation');
    _validateOptionalUtf8(example, 'example');
  }

  final String id;
  final String semanticId;
  final String languageCode;
  final String text;
  final ContentRegister register;
  final String? translation;
  final String? example;
  final Map<String, Object?> metadata;

  factory PipelineContentCard.fromJson(
    Map<String, Object?> json,
  ) {
    final id = _requiredString(json, 'id');
    final semanticId = _requiredString(json, 'semanticId');
    final languageCode = _requiredString(json, 'languageCode');
    final text = _requiredString(json, 'text');
    final register = ContentRegister.parse(json['register']);
    final translation = _optionalString(json, 'translation');
    final example = _optionalString(json, 'example');
    final rawMetadata = json['metadata'];
    final metadata = rawMetadata == null
        ? const <String, Object?>{}
        : _stringKeyedMap(rawMetadata, 'metadata');

    return PipelineContentCard(
      id: id,
      semanticId: semanticId,
      languageCode: languageCode,
      text: text,
      register: register,
      translation: translation,
      example: example,
      metadata: metadata,
    );
  }

  Map<String, Object?> toJson() => <String, Object?>{
        'id': id,
        'semanticId': semanticId,
        'languageCode': languageCode,
        'text': text,
        'register': register.name,
        if (translation != null) 'translation': translation,
        if (example != null) 'example': example,
        if (metadata.isNotEmpty) 'metadata': metadata,
      };

  static void requireStrictUtf8Bytes(
    List<int> bytes, {
    String field = 'payload',
  }) {
    final decoded = utf8.decode(bytes, allowMalformed: false);
    final roundTrip = utf8.encode(decoded);
    if (roundTrip.length != bytes.length) {
      throw FormatException('$field is not canonical UTF-8');
    }
    for (var index = 0; index < bytes.length; index += 1) {
      if (roundTrip[index] != bytes[index]) {
        throw FormatException('$field is not canonical UTF-8');
      }
    }
  }

  static bool isStrictUtf8String(String value) {
    try {
      final bytes = utf8.encode(value);
      return utf8.decode(bytes, allowMalformed: false) == value;
    } on FormatException {
      return false;
    }
  }

  static String _requiredString(
    Map<String, Object?> json,
    String key,
  ) {
    final value = json[key];
    if (value is! String || value.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw FormatException('$key is required');
    }
    return value;
  }

  static String? _optionalString(
    Map<String, Object?> json,
    String key,
  ) {
    final value = json[key];
    if (value == null) return null;
    if (value is! String) {
      throw FormatException('$key must be a string');
    }
    if (value.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw FormatException('$key must not be empty');
    }
    return value;
  }

  static Map<String, Object?> _stringKeyedMap(
    Object? raw,
    String field,
  ) {
    if (raw is! Map) {
      throw FormatException('$field must be an object');
    }
    final result = <String, Object?>{};
    for (final entry in raw.entries) {
      if (entry.key is! String) {
        throw FormatException('$field keys must be strings');
      }
      result[entry.key as String] = entry.value;
    }
    return Map<String, Object?>.unmodifiable(result);
  }

  static void _validateIdentifier(
    String value,
    String field, {
    required int maxLength,
  }) {
    final normalized = value.trim();
    if (normalized.isEmpty || normalized.length > maxLength) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        value,
        field,
        'must be 1..$maxLength characters',
      );
    }
    if (!isStrictUtf8String(value)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        value,
        field,
        'must round-trip through strict UTF-8',
      );
    }
  }

  static void _validateLanguageCode(String value) {
    final normalized = value.trim().replaceAll('_', '-');
    if (!RegExp(r'^[A-Za-z]{2,8}(?:-[A-Za-z0-9]{1,8})*$')
        .hasMatch(normalized)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        value,
        'languageCode',
        'must be a valid language tag',
      );
    }
  }

  static void _validateRequiredUtf8(
    String value,
    String field,
  ) {
    if (value.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(value, field, 'must not be empty');
    }
    if (!isStrictUtf8String(value)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        value,
        field,
        'must round-trip through strict UTF-8',
      );
    }
  }

  static void _validateOptionalUtf8(
    String? value,
    String field,
  ) {
    if (value == null) return;
    if (value.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(value, field, 'must not be empty');
    }
    if (!isStrictUtf8String(value)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        value,
        field,
        'must round-trip through strict UTF-8',
      );
    }
  }
}

FILE: lib/core/content_pipeline/content_cas_manifest.dart

import 'dart:convert';

import 'content_card.dart';

final class ContentCasEntry {
  const ContentCasEntry({
    required this.source,
    required this.packId,
    required this.languageCode,
    required this.sha256,
    required this.cardCount,
  });

  final String source;
  final String packId;
  final String languageCode;
  final String sha256;
  final int cardCount;
}

final class ContentCasManifest {
  ContentCasManifest._({
    required this.contentEpoch,
    required this.referenceLanguage,
    required this.wave1Languages,
    required this.directedPairs,
    required Map<String, ContentCasEntry> entries,
  }) : _entries = Map<String, ContentCasEntry>.unmodifiable(entries);

  final String contentEpoch;
  final String referenceLanguage;
  final List<String> wave1Languages;
  final List<String> directedPairs;
  final Map<String, ContentCasEntry> _entries;

  factory ContentCasManifest.fromBytes(List<int> bytes) {
    PipelineContentCard.requireStrictUtf8Bytes(
      bytes,
      field: 'content CAS manifest',
    );
    final decoded = utf8.decode(bytes, allowMalformed: false);
    final root = jsonDecode(decoded);
    final json = _stringKeyedMap(root, 'content CAS manifest');

    if (json['schemaVersion'] != 1) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'content CAS schemaVersion must equal 1',
      );
    }
    if (json['algorithm'] != 'sha256') {
      throw const FormatException(
        'content CAS algorithm must be sha256',
      );
    }

    final contentEpoch = _requiredString(json, 'contentEpoch');
    final referenceLanguage = _requiredLanguage(
      json,
      'referenceLanguage',
    );
    final wave1Languages = _requiredStringList(
      json,
      'wave1Languages',
      normalizeLanguage: true,
    );
    if (!wave1Languages.contains(referenceLanguage)) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'reference language must belong to wave1Languages',
      );
    }

    final rawDirectedPairs = _requiredStringList(
      json,
      'directedPairs',
    );
    final directedPairs = <String>[];
    final seenPairs = <String>{};
    for (final pair in rawDirectedPairs) {
      final parts = pair.split('->');
      if (parts.length != 2) {
        throw FormatException('invalid directed pair: $pair');
      }
      final source = _normalizeLanguage(parts[0]);
      final target = _normalizeLanguage(parts[1]);
      if (source.isEmpty || target.isEmpty || source == target) {
        throw FormatException('invalid directed pair: $pair');
      }
      if (!wave1Languages.contains(source) ||
          !wave1Languages.contains(target)) {
        throw FormatException(
          'directed pair uses language outside Wave 1: $pair',
        );
      }
      final normalizedPair = '$source->$target';
      if (!seenPairs.add(normalizedPair)) {
        throw FormatException(
          'duplicate directed pair: $normalizedPair',
        );
      }
      directedPairs.add(normalizedPair);
    }

    final rawEntries = json['entries'];
    if (rawEntries is! List || rawEntries.isEmpty) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'content CAS entries must be non-empty',
      );
    }

    final entries = <String, ContentCasEntry>{};
    for (final rawEntry in rawEntries) {
      final entry = _stringKeyedMap(rawEntry, 'content CAS entry');
      final source = _requiredString(entry, 'path');
      if (!source.startsWith('assets/data/') ||
          source.startsWith('/') ||
          source.contains('..')) {
        throw FormatException(
          'content CAS path is outside assets/data: $source',
        );
      }
      final packId = _requiredString(entry, 'packId');
      final languageCode = _requiredLanguage(
        entry,
        'languageCode',
      );
      final sha256 = _requiredString(entry, 'sha256').toLowerCase();
      if (!RegExp(r'^[0-9a-f]{64}$').hasMatch(sha256)) {
        throw FormatException(
          'invalid SHA-256 for content source: $source',
        );
      }
      final cardCount = entry['cardCount'];
      if (cardCount is! int || cardCount < 1) {
        throw FormatException(
          'cardCount must be positive for content source: $source',
        );
      }
      if (!wave1Languages.contains(languageCode)) {
        throw FormatException(
          'content source uses language outside Wave 1: $source',
        );
      }
      if (entries.containsKey(source)) {
        throw FormatException(
          'duplicate content CAS path: $source',
        );
      }
      entries[source] = ContentCasEntry(
        source: source,
        packId: packId,
        languageCode: languageCode,
        sha256: sha256,
        cardCount: cardCount,
      );
    }

    return ContentCasManifest._(
      contentEpoch: contentEpoch,
      referenceLanguage: referenceLanguage,
      wave1Languages: List<String>.unmodifiable(wave1Languages),
      directedPairs: List<String>.unmodifiable(directedPairs),
      entries: entries,
    );
  }

  int get entryCount => _entries.length;

  ContentCasEntry requireEntry(String source) {
    final entry = _entries[source];
    if (entry == null) {
      throw FormatException(
        'content source is absent from CAS manifest: $source',
      );
    }
    return entry;
  }

  ContentCasEntry verifySource({
    required String source,
    required String packId,
    required String languageCode,
    required String checksum,
    int? cardCount,
  }) {
    final entry = requireEntry(source);
    final normalizedLanguage = _normalizeLanguage(languageCode);
    if (packId.trim() != entry.packId) {
      throw FormatException(
        'content CAS pack id mismatch: $source',
      );
    }
    if (normalizedLanguage != entry.languageCode) {
      throw FormatException(
        'content CAS language mismatch: $source',
      );
    }
    if (checksum.toLowerCase() != entry.sha256) {
      throw FormatException(
        'content CAS checksum mismatch: $source',
      );
    }
    if (cardCount != null && cardCount != entry.cardCount) {
      throw FormatException(
        'content CAS card count mismatch: $source',
      );
    }
    return entry;
  }

  bool supportsDirectedPair(
    String sourceLanguage,
    String targetLanguage,
  ) {
    final source = _normalizeLanguage(sourceLanguage);
    final target = _normalizeLanguage(targetLanguage);
    if (source.isEmpty || target.isEmpty) return false;
    return directedPairs.contains('$source->$target');
  }

  static String _requiredString(
    Map<String, Object?> json,
    String key,
  ) {
    final value = json[key];
    if (value is! String || value.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw FormatException('$key is required');
    }
    return value.trim();
  }

  static String _requiredLanguage(
    Map<String, Object?> json,
    String key,
  ) {
    final normalized = _normalizeLanguage(
      _requiredString(json, key),
    );
    if (normalized.isEmpty) {
      throw FormatException('$key is not a valid language tag');
    }
    return normalized;
  }

  static List<String> _requiredStringList(
    Map<String, Object?> json,
    String key, {
    bool normalizeLanguage = false,
  }) {
    final raw = json[key];
    if (raw is! List || raw.isEmpty) {
      throw FormatException('$key must be a non-empty array');
    }
    final values = <String>[];
    final seen = <String>{};
    for (final item in raw) {
      if (item is! String || item.trim().isEmpty) {
        throw FormatException('$key must contain non-empty strings');
      }
      final value = normalizeLanguage
          ? _normalizeLanguage(item)
          : item.trim();
      if (value.isEmpty || !seen.add(value)) {
        throw FormatException(
          '$key contains an invalid or duplicate value',
        );
      }
      values.add(value);
    }
    return values;
  }

  static String _normalizeLanguage(String value) {
    final normalized =
        value.trim().replaceAll('_', '-').toLowerCase();
    if (!RegExp(r'^[a-z]{2,8}(?:-[a-z0-9]{1,8})*$')
        .hasMatch(normalized)) {
      return '';
    }
    return normalized;
  }

  static Map<String, Object?> _stringKeyedMap(
    Object? raw,
    String field,
  ) {
    if (raw is! Map) {
      throw FormatException('$field must be an object');
    }
    final result = <String, Object?>{};
    for (final entry in raw.entries) {
      if (entry.key is! String) {
        throw FormatException('$field keys must be strings');
      }
      result[entry.key as String] = entry.value;
    }
    return result;
  }
}


--------------------------------------------------
FILE: lib/core/content_pipeline/parallel_content_pipeline.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';

import 'canonical_content_gate.dart';
import 'content_card.dart';
import 'content_cas_manifest.dart';
import 'validation_cache.dart';

typedef LanguagePackGenerator = Future<List<int>> Function(
  LanguagePackRequest request,
);

final class LanguagePackRequest {
  const LanguagePackRequest({
    required this.packId,
    required this.languageCode,
    required this.source,
    this.requireManifestVerification = false,
  });

  final String packId;
  final String languageCode;
  final String source;
  final bool requireManifestVerification;
}

final class LanguagePackAudit {
  const LanguagePackAudit({
    required this.packId,
    required this.languageCode,
    required this.valid,
    required this.packChecksum,
    required this.wholePackCacheHit,
    required this.cardCount,
    required this.validatedCards,
    required this.cachedCards,
    required this.errorCode,
    this.promotion = const ContentPromotionBatch.empty(),
  });

  final String packId;
  final String languageCode;
  final bool valid;
  final String? packChecksum;
  final bool wholePackCacheHit;
  final int cardCount;
  final int validatedCards;
  final int cachedCards;
  final String? errorCode;
  final ContentPromotionBatch promotion;

  Map<String, Object?> toJson() => <String, Object?>{
        'packId': packId,
        'languageCode': languageCode,
        'valid': valid,
        'packChecksum': packChecksum,
        'wholePackCacheHit': wholePackCacheHit,
        'cardCount': cardCount,
        'validatedCards': validatedCards,
        'cachedCards': cachedCards,
        'canonicalCards': promotion.canonicalCount,
        'quarantinedCards': promotion.quarantineCount,
        if (promotion.quarantine.isNotEmpty)
          'quarantine': promotion.quarantine
              .map((entry) => entry.toAuditJson())
              .toList(growable: false),
        'errorCode': errorCode,
      };
}

final class ParallelContentPipeline {
  const ParallelContentPipeline({
    required this.generator,
    required this.cache,
    this.manifest,
    this.canonicalGate = const CanonicalContentGate(),
    this.maxParallel = 4,
  });

  final LanguagePackGenerator generator;
  final ContentValidationCache cache;
  final ContentCasManifest? manifest;
  final CanonicalContentGate canonicalGate;
  final int maxParallel;

  Stream<LanguagePackAudit> run(
    Stream<LanguagePackRequest> requests,
  ) async* {
    if (maxParallel < 1 || maxParallel > 32) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        maxParallel,
        'maxParallel',
        'must be between 1 and 32',
      );
    }

    final batch = <LanguagePackRequest>[];
    await for (final request in requests) {
      batch.add(request);
      if (batch.length < maxParallel) continue;

      final audits = await Future.wait(
        batch.map(_process),
        eagerError: false,
      );
      for (final audit in audits) {
        yield audit;
      }
      batch.clear();
    }

    if (batch.isNotEmpty) {
      final audits = await Future.wait(
        batch.map(_process),
        eagerError: false,
      );
      for (final audit in audits) {
        yield audit;
      }
    }
  }

  Future<LanguagePackAudit> _process(
    LanguagePackRequest request,
  ) async {
    String? packChecksum;
    try {
      final packId = request.packId.trim();
      final languageCode = _normalizeLanguage(
        request.languageCode,
      );
      if (packId.isEmpty || packId.length > 160) {
        throw const FormatException('pack id is invalid');
      }
      if (languageCode.isEmpty) {
        throw const FormatException('language code is invalid');
      }

      final bytes = await generator(request);
      PipelineContentCard.requireStrictUtf8Bytes(
        bytes,
        field: 'language pack',
      );
      packChecksum = await ValidationFingerprint.bytes(bytes);

      ContentCasEntry? manifestEntry;
      if (request.requireManifestVerification) {
        final activeManifest = manifest;
        if (activeManifest == null) {
          throw const FormatException(
            'content CAS manifest is required',
          );
        }
        manifestEntry = activeManifest.verifySource(
          source: request.source,
          packId: packId,
          languageCode: languageCode,
          checksum: packChecksum,
        );
      }

      final packCacheKey = 'pack:$languageCode:$packId';
      final wholePackCacheHit = cache.isValidated(
        key: packCacheKey,
        checksum: packChecksum,
      );

      final decoded = utf8.decode(bytes, allowMalformed: false);
      final root = jsonDecode(decoded);
      _rejectEmptyStrings(root, 'pack root');
      if (root is! Map) {
        throw const FormatException('pack root must be an object');
      }
      final json = _stringKeyedMap(root, 'pack root');
      if (json['schemaVersion'] != 1) {
        throw const FormatException(
          'schemaVersion must equal 1',
        );
      }

      final pack = _stringKeyedMap(json['pack'], 'pack');
      final declaredPackId = pack['id'];
      final declaredLanguage = pack['languageCode'];
      if (declaredPackId is! String ||
          declaredPackId.trim() != packId) {
        throw const FormatException('pack id mismatch');
      }
      if (declaredLanguage is! String ||
          _normalizeLanguage(declaredLanguage) != languageCode) {
        throw const FormatException('pack language mismatch');
      }

      final rawCards = json['cards'];
      if (rawCards is! List || rawCards.isEmpty) {
        throw const FormatException(
          'cards must be a non-empty array',
        );
      }

      if (manifestEntry != null &&
          rawCards.length != manifestEntry.cardCount) {
        throw const FormatException(
          'content CAS card count mismatch',
        );
      }

      var validatedCards = 0;
      var cachedCards = 0;
      final seenCardIds = <String>{};
      final parsedCards = <PipelineContentCard>[];

      for (final rawCard in rawCards) {
        final cardJson = _stringKeyedMap(rawCard, 'card');
        final rawId = cardJson['id'];
        final rawLanguage = cardJson['languageCode'];
        if (rawId is! String || rawId.trim().isEmpty) {
          throw const FormatException('card id is required');
        }
        final cardId = rawId.trim();
        if (!seenCardIds.add(cardId)) {
          throw FormatException(
            'duplicate card id: ' + cardId,
          );
        }
        if (rawLanguage is! String ||
            _normalizeLanguage(rawLanguage) != languageCode) {
          throw FormatException(
            'card language mismatch: ' + cardId,
          );
        }

        final card = PipelineContentCard.fromJson(cardJson);
        if (_normalizeLanguage(card.languageCode) != languageCode) {
          throw FormatException(
            'card language mismatch: ' + cardId,
          );
        }
        parsedCards.add(card);

        final checksum =
            await ValidationFingerprint.jsonValue(cardJson);
        final cardCacheKey =
            'card:$languageCode:$packId:$cardId';
        if (cache.isValidated(
          key: cardCacheKey,
          checksum: checksum,
        )) {
          cachedCards += 1;
        } else {
          cache.remember(
            key: cardCacheKey,
            checksum: checksum,
          );
          validatedCards += 1;
        }
      }

      final promotion = canonicalGate.classify(parsedCards);

      cache.remember(
        key: packCacheKey,
        checksum: packChecksum,
      );

      return LanguagePackAudit(
        packId: packId,
        languageCode: languageCode,
        valid: true,
        packChecksum: packChecksum,
        wholePackCacheHit: wholePackCacheHit,
        cardCount: rawCards.length,
        validatedCards: validatedCards,
        cachedCards: cachedCards,
        errorCode: null,
        promotion: promotion,
      );
    } on FormatException catch (error) {
      return LanguagePackAudit(
        packId: request.packId,
        languageCode: request.languageCode,
        valid: false,
        packChecksum: packChecksum,
        wholePackCacheHit: false,
        cardCount: 0,
        validatedCards: 0,
        cachedCards: 0,
        errorCode: error.message,
      );
    } on ArgumentError catch (error) {
      return LanguagePackAudit(
        packId: request.packId,
        languageCode: request.languageCode,
        valid: false,
        packChecksum: packChecksum,
        wholePackCacheHit: false,
        cardCount: 0,
        validatedCards: 0,
        cachedCards: 0,
        errorCode: error.message?.toString() ?? 'invalid_argument',
      );
    } on Object {
      return LanguagePackAudit(
        packId: request.packId,
        languageCode: request.languageCode,
        valid: false,
        packChecksum: packChecksum,
        wholePackCacheHit: false,
        cardCount: 0,
        validatedCards: 0,
        cachedCards: 0,
        errorCode: 'content_pipeline_failure',
      );
    }
  }

  static void _rejectEmptyStrings(
    Object? value,
    String path,
  ) {
    if (value is String) {
      if (value.trim().isEmpty) {
        throw FormatException('$path must not be empty');
      }
      if (!PipelineContentCard.isStrictUtf8String(value)) {
        throw FormatException(
          '$path must round-trip through strict UTF-8',
        );
      }
      return;
    }
    if (value is List) {
      for (var index = 0; index < value.length; index += 1) {
        _rejectEmptyStrings(value[index], '$path[$index]');
      }
      return;
    }
    if (value is Map) {
      for (final entry in value.entries) {
        if (entry.key is! String) {
          throw FormatException('$path keys must be strings');
        }
        _rejectEmptyStrings(
          entry.value,
          '$path.' + entry.key.toString(),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  static String _normalizeLanguage(String value) {
    final normalized =
        value.trim().replaceAll('_', '-').toLowerCase();
    if (!RegExp(r'^[a-z]{2,8}(?:-[a-z0-9]{1,8})*$')
        .hasMatch(normalized)) {
      return '';
    }
    return normalized;
  }

  static Map<String, Object?> _stringKeyedMap(
    Object? raw,
    String field,
  ) {
    if (raw is! Map) {
      throw FormatException('$field must be an object');
    }
    final result = <String, Object?>{};
    for (final entry in raw.entries) {
      if (entry.key is! String) {
        throw FormatException(
          '$field keys must be strings',
        );
      }
      result[entry.key as String] = entry.value;
    }
    return result;
  }
}

FILE: lib/core/content_pipeline/validation_cache.dart

import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:cryptography/cryptography.dart';

final class ContentValidationCache {
  ContentValidationCache._({
    required this.file,
    required this.validatorVersion,
    required Map<String, String> entries,
  }) : _entries = entries;

  final File file;
  final String validatorVersion;
  final Map<String, String> _entries;

  static Future<ContentValidationCache> open({
    required String path,
    required String validatorVersion,
  }) async {
    final file = File(path);
    if (!await file.exists()) {
      return ContentValidationCache._(
        file: file,
        validatorVersion: validatorVersion,
        entries: <String, String>{},
      );
    }

    try {
      final bytes = await file.readAsBytes();
      final decoded = utf8.decode(bytes, allowMalformed: false);
      final raw = jsonDecode(decoded);
      if (raw is! Map) {
        throw const FormatException('validation cache must be an object');
      }
      final version = raw['validatorVersion'];
      final entryValue = raw['entries'];
      if (version != validatorVersion || entryValue is! Map) {
        return ContentValidationCache._(
          file: file,
          validatorVersion: validatorVersion,
          entries: <String, String>{},
        );
      }

      final entries = <String, String>{};
      for (final entry in entryValue.entries) {
        if (entry.key is String && entry.value is String) {
          entries[entry.key as String] = entry.value as String;
        }
      }
      return ContentValidationCache._(
        file: file,
        validatorVersion: validatorVersion,
        entries: entries,
      );
    } on Object {
      return ContentValidationCache._(
        file: file,
        validatorVersion: validatorVersion,
        entries: <String, String>{},
      );
    }
  }

  bool isValidated({
    required String key,
    required String checksum,
  }) =>
      _entries[key] == checksum;

  void remember({
    required String key,
    required String checksum,
  }) {
    _entries[key] = checksum;
  }

  int get entryCount => _entries.length;

  Future<void> persist() async {
    await file.parent.create(recursive: true);
    final sorted = _entries.entries.toList(growable: false)
      ..sort((a, b) => a.key.compareTo(b.key));
    final payload = <String, Object?>{
      'validatorVersion': validatorVersion,
      'entries': <String, String>{
        for (final entry in sorted) entry.key: entry.value,
      },
    };
    final encoded = utf8.encode(jsonEncode(payload));
    final temp = File(file.path + '.tmp');
    await temp.writeAsBytes(encoded, flush: true);
    if (await file.exists()) {
      await file.delete();
    }
    await temp.rename(file.path);
  }
}

abstract final class ValidationFingerprint {
  static final Sha256 _sha256 = Sha256();

  static Future<String> bytes(List<int> bytes) async {
    final digest = await _sha256.hash(bytes);
    final buffer = StringBuffer();
    for (final byte in digest.bytes) {
      buffer.write(byte.toRadixString(16).padLeft(2, '0'));
    }
    return buffer.toString();
  }

  static Future<String> jsonValue(Object? value) =>
      bytes(utf8.encode(jsonEncode(value)));
}

import '../content_contract.dart';

enum CefrLevel {
  a1,
  a2,
  b1,
  b2,
  c1,
  c2,
}

extension CefrLevelCode on CefrLevel {
  String get code => name.toUpperCase();
}

enum VocabularyPartOfSpeech {
  noun,
  verb,
  adjective,
  adverb,
  phrase,
  preposition,
  conjunction,
  other,
}

enum GermanArticle {
  der,
  die,
  das,
  plural,
  none,
}

extension GermanArticleText on GermanArticle {
  String get text => switch (this) {
        GermanArticle.der => 'der',
        GermanArticle.die => 'die',
        GermanArticle.das => 'das',
        GermanArticle.plural => 'Plural',
        GermanArticle.none => '',
      };
}

enum PerfectAuxiliary {
  haben,
  sein,
}

extension PerfectAuxiliaryText on PerfectAuxiliary {
  String get thirdPerson => switch (this) {
        PerfectAuxiliary.haben => 'hat',
        PerfectAuxiliary.sein => 'ist',
      };
}

final class PronunciationData {
  const PronunciationData({
    this.ipa = '',
    this.stressHint = '',
    this.audioKey = '',
  });

  final String ipa;
  final String stressHint;
  final String audioKey;
}

final class VerbMorphology {
  const VerbMorphology({
    required this.thirdPersonPresent,
    required this.preterite,
    required this.perfectAuxiliary,
    required this.pastParticiple,
    required this.separable,
    this.governedCase = '',
    this.preposition = '',
  });

  final String thirdPersonPresent;
  final String preterite;
  final PerfectAuxiliary perfectAuxiliary;
  final String pastParticiple;
  final bool separable;
  final String governedCase;
  final String preposition;

  String get perfectDisplay =>
      '${perfectAuxiliary.thirdPerson} $pastParticiple';
}

final class VocabularyFlashcardProjection {
  const VocabularyFlashcardProjection({
    required this.id,
    required this.frontText,
    required this.backText,
    required this.frontLanguageCode,
    required this.backLanguageCode,
    required this.article,
    required this.frontSupportingText,
    required this.backSupportingText,
    required this.semanticLabel,
  });

  final String id;
  final String frontText;
  final String backText;
  final String frontLanguageCode;
  final String backLanguageCode;
  final String? article;
  final String? frontSupportingText;
  final String? backSupportingText;
  final String? semanticLabel;

  Map<String, Object?> toMap() => <String, Object?>{
        'id': id,
        'frontText': frontText,
        'backText': backText,
        'frontLanguageCode': frontLanguageCode,
        'backLanguageCode': backLanguageCode,
        'article': article,
        'frontSupportingText': frontSupportingText,
        'backSupportingText': backSupportingText,
        'semanticLabel': semanticLabel,
      };
}

final class AdvancedVocabularyEntry implements LearningContent {
  AdvancedVocabularyEntry({
    required this.id,
    required this.sourceText,
    required this.translationText,
    required this.exampleText,
    required this.exampleTranslationText,
    required this.topic,
    required this.skill,
    required this.level,
    required this.partOfSpeech,
    required this.grammaticalMarker,
    required List<String> acceptedForms,
    this.article = GermanArticle.none,
    this.pluralForm = '',
    this.pronunciation = const PronunciationData(),
    this.verbData,
    Set<String> tags = const <String>{},
    this.sourceLanguageCode = 'de',
    this.targetLanguageCode = 'ar',
  })  : acceptedForms = List<String>.unmodifiable(
          _deduplicateVisible(acceptedForms),
        ),
        tags = Set<String>.unmodifiable(
          tags.map((tag) => tag.trim()).where((tag) => tag.isNotEmpty),
        ) {
    _requireVisible(id, 'id');
    _requireVisible(sourceText, 'sourceText');
    _requireVisible(translationText, 'translationText');
    _requireVisible(exampleText, 'exampleText');
    _requireVisible(exampleTranslationText, 'exampleTranslationText');
    _requireVisible(topic, 'topic');
    _requireVisible(skill, 'skill');
    _requireVisible(sourceLanguageCode, 'sourceLanguageCode');
    _requireVisible(targetLanguageCode, 'targetLanguageCode');

    if (partOfSpeech == VocabularyPartOfSpeech.noun &&
        article == GermanArticle.none) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'German noun entries must define an article or plural marker.',
      );
    }
    if (partOfSpeech == VocabularyPartOfSpeech.verb && verbData == null) {
      throw ArgumentError('Verb entries must define VerbMorphology.');
    }
    if (this.acceptedForms.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('acceptedForms must contain at least one form.');
    }
  }

  @override
  final String id;

  @override
  final String sourceText;

  @override
  final String translationText;

  @override
  final String exampleText;

  @override
  final String exampleTranslationText;

  @override
  final String topic;

  @override
  final String skill;

  final CefrLevel level;
  final VocabularyPartOfSpeech partOfSpeech;
  final GermanArticle article;

  @override
  final String grammaticalMarker;

  @override
  final String pluralForm;

  @override
  final List<String> acceptedForms;

  final PronunciationData pronunciation;
  final VerbMorphology? verbData;
  final Set<String> tags;
  final String sourceLanguageCode;
  final String targetLanguageCode;

  String get articleText => article.text;

  LearningContent toLearningContent() => this;

  VocabularyFlashcardProjection get flashcard {
    final supportingFront = <String>[
      if (pronunciation.ipa.trim().isNotEmpty) pronunciation.ipa.trim(),
      if (partOfSpeech == VocabularyPartOfSpeech.verb && verbData != null)
        verbData!.perfectDisplay,
      if (pluralForm.trim().isNotEmpty) 'Plural: ${pluralForm.trim()}',
    ].join(' • ');

    return VocabularyFlashcardProjection(
      id: id,
      frontText: sourceText,
      backText: translationText,
      frontLanguageCode: sourceLanguageCode,
      backLanguageCode: targetLanguageCode,
      article: article == GermanArticle.none ? null : articleText,
      frontSupportingText:
          supportingFront.isEmpty ? exampleText : supportingFront,
      backSupportingText: exampleTranslationText,
      semanticLabel:
          '${level.code} ${partOfSpeech.name}: $sourceText — $translationText',
    );
  }

  bool accepts(String candidate) {
    final normalized = _normalize(candidate);
    return acceptedForms.any((form) => _normalize(form) == normalized);
  }
}

final class AdvancedVocabularyBank {
  AdvancedVocabularyBank({
    required this.id,
    required List<AdvancedVocabularyEntry> entries,
  }) : entries = List<AdvancedVocabularyEntry>.unmodifiable(entries) {
    _requireVisible(id, 'id');
    if (this.entries.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('Vocabulary bank must contain at least one entry.');
    }
    final ids = <String>{};
    for (final entry in this.entries) {
      if (!ids.add(entry.id)) {
        throw ArgumentError('Duplicate vocabulary entry id: ${entry.id}');
      }
    }
    _byId = <String, AdvancedVocabularyEntry>{
      for (final entry in this.entries) entry.id: entry,
    };
  }

  final String id;
  final List<AdvancedVocabularyEntry> entries;
  late final Map<String, AdvancedVocabularyEntry> _byId;

  AdvancedVocabularyEntry byId(String entryId) {
    final entry = _byId[entryId];
    if (entry == null) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(entryId, 'entryId', 'Unknown vocabulary id.');
    }
    return entry;
  }

  List<LearningContent> get learningContent =>
      List<LearningContent>.unmodifiable(entries);

  List<VocabularyFlashcardProjection> get flashcards =>
      List<VocabularyFlashcardProjection>.unmodifiable(
        entries.map((entry) => entry.flashcard),
      );

  List<AdvancedVocabularyEntry> forLevel(CefrLevel level) =>
      List<AdvancedVocabularyEntry>.unmodifiable(
        entries.where((entry) => entry.level == level),
      );

  List<AdvancedVocabularyEntry> forTopic(String topic) {
    final normalized = topic.trim().toLowerCase();
    return List<AdvancedVocabularyEntry>.unmodifiable(
      entries.where(
        (entry) => entry.topic.trim().toLowerCase() == normalized,
      ),
    );
  }

  List<AdvancedVocabularyEntry> forPartOfSpeech(
    VocabularyPartOfSpeech partOfSpeech,
  ) =>
      List<AdvancedVocabularyEntry>.unmodifiable(
        entries.where((entry) => entry.partOfSpeech == partOfSpeech),
      );
}

List<String> _deduplicateVisible(Iterable<String> values) {
  final seen = <String>{};
  final output = <String>[];
  for (final value in values) {
    final trimmed = value.trim();
    if (trimmed.isEmpty) continue;
    final key = _normalize(trimmed);
    if (seen.add(key)) output.add(trimmed);
  }
  return output;
}

String _normalize(String value) =>
    value.trim().toLowerCase().replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');

void _requireVisible(String value, String field) {
  if (value.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(value, field, '$field must not be empty.');
  }
}

import 'advanced_vocabulary.dart';
import 'canonical_curriculum_50.dart';
import 'curriculum_models.dart';
import 'learning_path_engine.dart';

void main() {
  final tasks = CanonicalCurriculum50.tasks;
  _expect(tasks.length, 50, 'canonical curriculum must contain exactly 50 tasks');
  _expect(
    tasks.map((task) => task.id).toSet().length,
    50,
    'curriculum task ids must be unique',
  );

  final engine = LearningPathEngine(tasks);
  final validation = engine.validateGraph();
  if (!validation.isValid) {
    throw StateError('Curriculum graph invalid: ${validation.errors.join('; ')}');
  }

  var progress = CurriculumProgress.empty();
  final first = engine.recommend(progress, limit: 3);
  _expect(first.first.task.id, 'task-01', 'first curriculum task');
  _expect(
    first.where((item) => item.unlocked).length,
    1,
    'only the first task may be unlocked before prerequisites are met',
  );

  progress = engine.recordOutcome(
    progress,
    const CurriculumTaskOutcome(
      taskId: 'task-01',
      score: 0.62,
      completed: false,
      attempts: 1,
    ),
  );
  _expect(
    engine.nextRequired(progress)?.id,
    'task-01',
    'incomplete task remains current',
  );

  progress = engine.recordOutcome(
    progress,
    const CurriculumTaskOutcome(
      taskId: 'task-01',
      score: 0.88,
      completed: true,
      attempts: 2,
    ),
  );
  _expect(
    engine.nextRequired(progress)?.id,
    'task-02',
    'completing task-01 unlocks task-02',
  );
  _expect(
    engine.progressRatio(progress),
    0.02,
    'one of fifty tasks equals two percent progress',
  );

  for (var number = 2; number <= 10; number++) {
    final id = 'task-${number.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
    progress = engine.recordOutcome(
      progress,
      CurriculumTaskOutcome(
        taskId: id,
        score: 0.9,
        completed: true,
        attempts: 1,
      ),
    );
  }
  _expect(
    engine.nextRequired(progress)?.id,
    'task-11',
    'stage transition must continue to task-11',
  );

  final noun = AdvancedVocabularyEntry(
    id: 'vocab-termin',
    sourceText: 'Termin',
    translationText: 'موعد',
    exampleText: 'Ich habe morgen einen Termin.',
    exampleTranslationText: 'لدي موعد غداً.',
    topic: 'appointments',
    skill: 'vocabulary',
    level: CefrLevel.a1,
    partOfSpeech: VocabularyPartOfSpeech.noun,
    article: GermanArticle.der,
    pluralForm: 'Termine',
    grammaticalMarker: 'der',
    acceptedForms: const <String>['Termin', 'der Termin', 'Termine'],
    pronunciation: const PronunciationData(
      ipa: '/tɛʁˈmiːn/',
      stressHint: 'zweite Silbe',
    ),
    tags: const <String>{'alltag', 'planung'},
  );
  _expect(noun.articleText, 'der', 'noun article');
  _expect(noun.flashcard.frontText, 'Termin', 'flashcard front');
  _expect(noun.flashcard.backText, 'موعد', 'flashcard back');
  _expect(noun.flashcard.article, 'der', 'flashcard article');
  _expect(noun.toLearningContent().id, noun.id, 'LearningContent compatibility');

  final verb = AdvancedVocabularyEntry(
    id: 'vocab-anrufen',
    sourceText: 'anrufen',
    translationText: 'يتصل هاتفياً',
    exampleText: 'Ich rufe dich morgen an.',
    exampleTranslationText: 'سأتصل بك غداً.',
    topic: 'communication',
    skill: 'production',
    level: CefrLevel.a1,
    partOfSpeech: VocabularyPartOfSpeech.verb,
    grammaticalMarker: 'trennbar',
    acceptedForms: const <String>['anrufen', 'ruft an', 'angerufen'],
    verbData: const VerbMorphology(
      thirdPersonPresent: 'ruft an',
      preterite: 'rief an',
      perfectAuxiliary: PerfectAuxiliary.haben,
      pastParticiple: 'angerufen',
      separable: true,
    ),
  );
  _expect(verb.verbData?.separable, true, 'separable verb metadata');
  _expect(
    verb.verbData?.perfectDisplay,
    'hat angerufen',
    'perfect projection',
  );

  final bank = AdvancedVocabularyBank(
    id: 'daily-a1',
    entries: <AdvancedVocabularyEntry>[noun, verb],
  );
  _expect(bank.entries.length, 2, 'vocabulary bank size');
  _expect(bank.byId('vocab-anrufen').sourceText, 'anrufen', 'bank lookup');
  _expect(bank.flashcards.length, 2, 'bank flashcard projections');
}

void _expect(Object? actual, Object? expected, String contract) {
  if (actual != expected) {
    throw StateError(
      'Contract failed: $contract. Expected <$expected>, got <$actual>.',
    );
  }
}

enum CurriculumStage {
  foundation,
  everydayA1,
  a2Bridge,
  functionalB1,
  integration,
}

extension CurriculumStageLabel on CurriculumStage {
  String get code => switch (this) {
        CurriculumStage.foundation => 'foundation',
        CurriculumStage.everydayA1 => 'everyday-a1',
        CurriculumStage.a2Bridge => 'a2-bridge',
        CurriculumStage.functionalB1 => 'functional-b1',
        CurriculumStage.integration => 'integration',
      };
}

enum CurriculumTaskKind {
  orientation,
  vocabulary,
  grammar,
  listening,
  reading,
  writing,
  speaking,
  transfer,
  checkpoint,
}

final class CurriculumTask {
  CurriculumTask({
    required this.id,
    required this.order,
    required this.stage,
    required this.kind,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.skill,
    required this.topic,
    List<String> prerequisiteIds = const <String>[],
    this.targetItemCount = 8,
    this.masteryThreshold = 0.8,
  }) : prerequisiteIds = List<String>.unmodifiable(
          prerequisiteIds.map((id) => id.trim()),
        ) {
    if (id.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(id, 'id', 'Task id must not be empty.');
    }
    if (order < 1 || order > 50) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(order, 'order', 'Task order must be 1..50.');
    }
    if (titleDe.trim().isEmpty || titleAr.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('Task titles must not be empty.');
    }
    if (skill.trim().isEmpty || topic.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('Task skill/topic must not be empty.');
    }
    if (targetItemCount < 1) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        targetItemCount,
        'targetItemCount',
        'Task item count must be positive.',
      );
    }
    if (masteryThreshold <= 0 || masteryThreshold > 1) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        masteryThreshold,
        'masteryThreshold',
        'Mastery threshold must be in (0, 1].',
      );
    }
    if (this.prerequisiteIds.any((value) => value.isEmpty)) {
      throw ArgumentError('Prerequisite ids must not be empty.');
    }
    if (this.prerequisiteIds.toSet().length != this.prerequisiteIds.length) {
      throw ArgumentError('Prerequisite ids must be unique.');
    }
    if (this.prerequisiteIds.contains(id)) {
      throw ArgumentError('A task cannot depend on itself.');
    }
  }

  final String id;
  final int order;
  final CurriculumStage stage;
  final CurriculumTaskKind kind;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String skill;
  final String topic;
  final List<String> prerequisiteIds;
  final int targetItemCount;
  final double masteryThreshold;

  bool get isCheckpoint => kind == CurriculumTaskKind.checkpoint;
}

final class CurriculumTaskOutcome {
  const CurriculumTaskOutcome({
    required this.taskId,
    required this.score,
    required this.completed,
    required this.attempts,
  })  : assert(taskId != ''),
        assert(score >= 0 && score <= 1),
        assert(attempts > 0);

  final String taskId;
  final double score;
  final bool completed;
  final int attempts;
}

final class CurriculumTaskProgress {
  const CurriculumTaskProgress({
    required this.taskId,
    required this.bestScore,
    required this.completed,
    required this.attempts,
  });

  final String taskId;
  final double bestScore;
  final bool completed;
  final int attempts;

  CurriculumTaskProgress merge(CurriculumTaskOutcome outcome) {
    if (outcome.taskId != taskId) {
      throw ArgumentError('Outcome task id does not match progress task id.');
    }
    return CurriculumTaskProgress(
      taskId: taskId,
      bestScore: outcome.score > bestScore ? outcome.score : bestScore,
      completed: completed || outcome.completed,
      attempts: attempts + outcome.attempts,
    );
  }
}

final class CurriculumProgress {
  CurriculumProgress._(Map<String, CurriculumTaskProgress> entries)
      : entries = Map<String, CurriculumTaskProgress>.unmodifiable(entries);

  factory CurriculumProgress.empty() =>
      CurriculumProgress._(<String, CurriculumTaskProgress>{});

  final Map<String, CurriculumTaskProgress> entries;

  CurriculumTaskProgress? forTask(String taskId) => entries[taskId];

  bool isCompleted(String taskId) => entries[taskId]?.completed ?? false;

  int get completedCount =>
      entries.values.where((item) => item.completed).length;

  CurriculumProgress record(CurriculumTaskOutcome outcome) {
    final next = <String, CurriculumTaskProgress>{...entries};
    final current = next[outcome.taskId];
    next[outcome.taskId] = current == null
        ? CurriculumTaskProgress(
            taskId: outcome.taskId,
            bestScore: outcome.score,
            completed: outcome.completed,
            attempts: outcome.attempts,
          )
        : current.merge(outcome);
    return CurriculumProgress._(next);
  }
}

final class CurriculumRecommendation {
  const CurriculumRecommendation({
    required this.task,
    required this.unlocked,
    required this.reason,
    required this.missingPrerequisiteIds,
  });

  final CurriculumTask task;
  final bool unlocked;
  final String reason;
  final List<String> missingPrerequisiteIds;
}

final class CurriculumGraphValidation {
  const CurriculumGraphValidation({
    required this.errors,
  });

  final List<String> errors;

  bool get isValid => errors.isEmpty;
}

import 'curriculum_models.dart';

final class LearningPathEngine {
  LearningPathEngine(List<CurriculumTask> tasks)
      : _tasks = List<CurriculumTask>.unmodifiable(
          [...tasks]..sort((a, b) => a.order.compareTo(b.order)),
        ),
        _byId = <String, CurriculumTask>{
          for (final task in tasks) task.id: task,
        } {
    final validation = validateGraph();
    if (!validation.isValid) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'Invalid curriculum graph: ${validation.errors.join('; ')}',
      );
    }
  }

  final List<CurriculumTask> _tasks;
  final Map<String, CurriculumTask> _byId;

  List<CurriculumTask> get tasks => _tasks;

  CurriculumTask taskById(String taskId) {
    final task = _byId[taskId];
    if (task == null) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(taskId, 'taskId', 'Unknown curriculum task.');
    }
    return task;
  }

  CurriculumGraphValidation validateGraph() {
    final errors = <String>[];
    final ids = <String>{};
    final orders = <int>{};

    for (final task in _tasks) {
      if (!ids.add(task.id)) {
        errors.add('Duplicate task id: ${task.id}');
      }
      if (!orders.add(task.order)) {
        errors.add('Duplicate task order: ${task.order}');
      }
    }

    for (final task in _tasks) {
      for (final prerequisiteId in task.prerequisiteIds) {
        final prerequisite = _byId[prerequisiteId];
        if (prerequisite == null) {
          errors.add(
            '${task.id} references missing prerequisite $prerequisiteId',
          );
          continue;
        }
        if (prerequisite.order >= task.order) {
          errors.add(
            '${task.id} depends on non-earlier prerequisite $prerequisiteId',
          );
        }
      }
    }

    final states = <String, int>{};
    bool visit(String taskId, List<String> stack) {
      final state = states[taskId] ?? 0;
      if (state == 1) {
        errors.add('Cycle detected: ${[...stack, taskId].join(' -> ')}');
        return false;
      }
      if (state == 2) return true;

      states[taskId] = 1;
      final task = _byId[taskId];
      if (task != null) {
        for (final prerequisiteId in task.prerequisiteIds) {
          if (_byId.containsKey(prerequisiteId)) {
            visit(prerequisiteId, <String>[...stack, taskId]);
          }
        }
      }
      states[taskId] = 2;
      return true;
    }

    for (final task in _tasks) {
      visit(task.id, const <String>[]);
    }

    return CurriculumGraphValidation(
      errors: List<String>.unmodifiable(errors.toSet()),
    );
  }

  CurriculumProgress recordOutcome(
    CurriculumProgress progress,
    CurriculumTaskOutcome outcome,
  ) {
    final task = taskById(outcome.taskId);
    if (outcome.score < 0 || outcome.score > 1) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        outcome.score,
        'score',
        'Score must be between 0 and 1.',
      );
    }
    if (outcome.attempts < 1) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        outcome.attempts,
        'attempts',
        'Attempts must be positive.',
      );
    }

    final prerequisitesMet = _prerequisitesMet(task, progress);
    if (!prerequisitesMet && !progress.isCompleted(task.id)) {
      throw StateError(
        'Cannot record ${task.id} before its prerequisites are completed.',
      );
    }

    final normalized = CurriculumTaskOutcome(
      taskId: outcome.taskId,
      score: outcome.score,
      completed: outcome.completed && outcome.score >= task.masteryThreshold,
      attempts: outcome.attempts,
    );
    return progress.record(normalized);
  }

  CurriculumTask? nextRequired(CurriculumProgress progress) {
    for (final task in _tasks) {
      if (progress.isCompleted(task.id)) continue;
      if (_prerequisitesMet(task, progress)) return task;
    }
    return null;
  }

  List<CurriculumTask> unlockedTasks(CurriculumProgress progress) =>
      List<CurriculumTask>.unmodifiable(
        _tasks.where(
          (task) =>
              !progress.isCompleted(task.id) &&
              _prerequisitesMet(task, progress),
        ),
      );

  List<CurriculumRecommendation> recommend(
    CurriculumProgress progress, {
    int limit = 5,
  }) {
    if (limit < 1) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(limit, 'limit', 'Limit must be positive.');
    }

    final firstIncompleteIndex = _tasks.indexWhere(
      (task) => !progress.isCompleted(task.id),
    );
    if (firstIncompleteIndex < 0) {
      return const <CurriculumRecommendation>[];
    }

    final end = (firstIncompleteIndex + limit)
        .clamp(0, _tasks.length)
        .toInt();
    return List<CurriculumRecommendation>.unmodifiable(
      _tasks
          .sublist(firstIncompleteIndex, end)
          .map((task) => _recommendationFor(task, progress)),
    );
  }

  double progressRatio(CurriculumProgress progress) {
    if (_tasks.isEmpty) return 1;
    final completed = _tasks
        .where((task) => progress.isCompleted(task.id))
        .length;
    return completed / _tasks.length;
  }

  CurriculumStage? activeStage(CurriculumProgress progress) =>
      nextRequired(progress)?.stage;

  bool isComplete(CurriculumProgress progress) =>
      _tasks.every((task) => progress.isCompleted(task.id));

  CurriculumRecommendation _recommendationFor(
    CurriculumTask task,
    CurriculumProgress progress,
  ) {
    final missing = <String>[
      for (final prerequisiteId in task.prerequisiteIds)
        if (!progress.isCompleted(prerequisiteId)) prerequisiteId,
    ];
    final unlocked = missing.isEmpty;
    final existing = progress.forTask(task.id);

    final reason = !unlocked
        ? 'بانتظار إكمال: ${missing.join(', ')}'
        : existing != null && !existing.completed
            ? 'إعادة موجّهة بعد ${existing.attempts} محاولة؛ أفضل نتيجة '
                '${(existing.bestScore * 100).round()}%.'
            : task.isCheckpoint
                ? 'نقطة تحقق لقياس نقل المعرفة قبل المرحلة التالية.'
                : 'المهمة التالية المتاحة حسب تسلسل المنهج.';

    return CurriculumRecommendation(
      task: task,
      unlocked: unlocked,
      reason: reason,
      missingPrerequisiteIds: List<String>.unmodifiable(missing),
    );
  }

  bool _prerequisitesMet(
    CurriculumTask task,
    CurriculumProgress progress,
  ) =>
      task.prerequisiteIds.every(progress.isCompleted);
}

import 'curriculum_models.dart';

final class LearningLanguageIdentity {
  LearningLanguageIdentity({
    required String id,
    required String englishName,
    required String nativeName,
    required String script,
  })  : id = _languageId(id),
        englishName = _requiredText(englishName, 'englishName'),
        nativeName = _requiredText(nativeName, 'nativeName'),
        script = _requiredText(script, 'script');

  final String id;
  final String englishName;
  final String nativeName;
  final String script;

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is LearningLanguageIdentity && other.id == id;

  @override
  int get hashCode => id.hashCode;
}

final class DirectedLanguagePair {
  DirectedLanguagePair({
    required this.source,
    required this.target,
  }) {
    if (source.id == target.id) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'Source and target languages must be different.',
      );
    }
  }

  final LearningLanguageIdentity source;
  final LearningLanguageIdentity target;

  String get id => '${source.id}->${target.id}';

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is DirectedLanguagePair &&
      other.source.id == source.id &&
      other.target.id == target.id;

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(source.id, target.id);
}

final class DirectedCurriculumTask {
  const DirectedCurriculumTask({
    required this.pair,
    required this.task,
  });

  final DirectedLanguagePair pair;
  final CurriculumTask task;

  String get pairTaskId => '${pair.id}::${task.id}';
  String get promptLanguageId => pair.source.id;
  String get responseLanguageId => pair.target.id;
}

final class PairAwareCurriculumPlan {
  PairAwareCurriculumPlan._({
    required this.pair,
    required List<DirectedCurriculumTask> tasks,
  }) : tasks = List<DirectedCurriculumTask>.unmodifiable(tasks);

  factory PairAwareCurriculumPlan.build({
    required DirectedLanguagePair pair,
    required List<CurriculumTask> tasks,
  }) {
    if (tasks.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('Curriculum task list must not be empty.');
    }
    return PairAwareCurriculumPlan._(
      pair: pair,
      tasks: <DirectedCurriculumTask>[
        for (final task in tasks)
          DirectedCurriculumTask(pair: pair, task: task),
      ],
    );
  }

  final DirectedLanguagePair pair;
  final List<DirectedCurriculumTask> tasks;

  DirectedCurriculumTask taskByCanonicalId(String taskId) {
    for (final item in tasks) {
      if (item.task.id == taskId) return item;
    }
    throw ArgumentError.value(
      taskId,
      'taskId',
      'Unknown curriculum task for pair ${pair.id}.',
    );
  }
}

final class OmniDirectionalLearningMatrix {
  OmniDirectionalLearningMatrix({
    required Iterable<LearningLanguageIdentity> languages,
  }) : languages = List<LearningLanguageIdentity>.unmodifiable(languages) {
    if (this.languages.length < 2) {
      throw ArgumentError('At least two languages are required.');
    }
    final ids = this.languages.map((item) => item.id).toSet();
    if (ids.length != this.languages.length) {
      throw ArgumentError('Language ids must be unique.');
    }
    _byId = <String, LearningLanguageIdentity>{
      for (final language in this.languages) language.id: language,
    };
  }

  factory OmniDirectionalLearningMatrix.standard20() =>
      OmniDirectionalLearningMatrix(languages: projectLanguageRoster20);

  final List<LearningLanguageIdentity> languages;
  late final Map<String, LearningLanguageIdentity> _byId;

  int get directedPairCount =>
      languages.length * (languages.length - 1);

  LearningLanguageIdentity requireLanguage(String rawId) {
    final id = _languageId(rawId);
    final language = _byId[id];
    if (language == null) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        rawId,
        'languageId',
        'Unknown project language.',
      );
    }
    return language;
  }

  DirectedLanguagePair requirePair(
    String sourceLanguageId,
    String targetLanguageId,
  ) {
    final source = requireLanguage(sourceLanguageId);
    final target = requireLanguage(targetLanguageId);
    return DirectedLanguagePair(source: source, target: target);
  }

  Iterable<DirectedLanguagePair> pairsFrom(String sourceLanguageId) sync* {
    final source = requireLanguage(sourceLanguageId);
    for (final target in languages) {
      if (target.id == source.id) continue;
      yield DirectedLanguagePair(source: source, target: target);
    }
  }

  Iterable<DirectedLanguagePair> get allPairs sync* {
    for (final source in languages) {
      yield* pairsFrom(source.id);
    }
  }
}

      script: 'Kore',
    ),
    LearningLanguageIdentity(
      id: 'fa',
      englishName: 'Persian',
      nativeName: 'فارسی',
      script: 'Arab',
    ),
    LearningLanguageIdentity(
      id: 'ur',
      englishName: 'Urdu',
      nativeName: 'اردو',
      script: 'Arab',
    ),
  ],
);

String _languageId(String raw) {
  final id = raw.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (id.isEmpty ||
      id.length > 16 ||
      !RegExp(r'^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$').hasMatch(id)) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(
      raw,
      'languageId',
      'Language ids must be lowercase BCP-47-like tokens.',
    );
  }
  return id;
}

String _requiredText(String raw, String field) {
  final value = raw.trim();
  if (value.isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(raw, field, 'must not be empty');
  }
  return value;
}

import 'canonical_curriculum_50.dart';
import 'omni_directional_matrix.dart';

void main() {
  final matrix = OmniDirectionalLearningMatrix.standard20();

  _expect(matrix.languages.length, 20, 'exact project roster has 20 identities');
  _expect(matrix.directedPairCount, 380, '20 languages create 380 ordered pairs');

  final arToDe = matrix.requirePair('ar', 'de');
  final deToAr = matrix.requirePair('de', 'ar');

  _expect(arToDe.id, 'ar->de', 'source-target pair identity');
  _expect(deToAr.id, 'de->ar', 'reverse pair identity');
  _expect(arToDe == deToAr, false, 'A→B is not B→A');
  _expect(arToDe.source.id, 'ar', 'source role is explicit');
  _expect(arToDe.target.id, 'de', 'target role is explicit');

  final plan = PairAwareCurriculumPlan.build(
    pair: arToDe,
    tasks: CanonicalCurriculum50.tasks,
  );

  _expect(plan.pair.id, 'ar->de', 'plan keeps directed pair');
  _expect(plan.tasks.length, 50, 'pair plan binds all canonical tasks');
  _expect(
    plan.tasks.first.pairTaskId,
    'ar->de::task-01',
    'pair task id is direction-specific',
  );
  _expect(
    plan.tasks.first.promptLanguageId,
    'ar',
    'lesson prompt language follows SOURCE',
  );
  _expect(
    plan.tasks.first.responseLanguageId,
    'de',
    'lesson response language follows TARGET',
  );

  final reversePlan = PairAwareCurriculumPlan.build(
    pair: deToAr,
    tasks: CanonicalCurriculum50.tasks,
  );
  _expect(
    reversePlan.tasks.first.pairTaskId,
    'de->ar::task-01',
    'reverse curriculum is separately identified',
  );

  var sameLanguageRejected = false;
  try {
    matrix.requirePair('de', 'de');
  } on ArgumentError {
    sameLanguageRejected = true;
  }
  _expect(
    sameLanguageRejected,
    true,
    'same-language learning pair is rejected',
  );

  var unknownLanguageRejected = false;
  try {
    matrix.requirePair('xx', 'de');
  } on ArgumentError {
    unknownLanguageRejected = true;
  }
  _expect(
    unknownLanguageRejected,
    true,
    'unknown language id is rejected',
  );
}

void _expect(Object? actual, Object? expected, String contract) {
  if (actual != expected) {
    throw StateError(
      'Contract failed: $contract. Expected <$expected>, got <$actual>.',
    );
  }
}
