import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'flashcard_3d_models.dart';

final class Flashcard3DAnimationMath {
  const Flashcard3DAnimationMath({
    this.perspective = .0012,
    this.maxDragTiltRadians = .08,
  })  : assert(perspective > 0),
        assert(maxDragTiltRadians >= 0);

  final double perspective;
  final double maxDragTiltRadians;

  double _unit(double value) => value.clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();

  double rotationFor(double progress) => _unit(progress) * math.pi;

  double dragTiltFor(double dragFraction) =>
      dragFraction.clamp(-1.0, 1.0).toDouble() * maxDragTiltRadians;

  Flashcard3DFace visibleFaceFor(double progress) =>
      _unit(progress) <= .5 ? Flashcard3DFace.front : Flashcard3DFace.back;

  Matrix4 matrixFor(
    double progress, {
    double dragFraction = 0,
  }) {
    return Matrix4.identity()
      ..setEntry(3, 2, perspective)
      ..rotateY(rotationFor(progress))
      ..rotateZ(dragTiltFor(dragFraction));
  }
}

final class Flashcard3DRenderer extends StatefulWidget {
  const Flashcard3DRenderer({
    required this.front,
    required this.back,
    required this.isFlipped,
    this.dragFraction = 0,
    this.duration = const Duration(milliseconds: 320),
    this.curve = Curves.easeInOutCubic,
    this.animationMath = const Flashcard3DAnimationMath(),
    super.key,
  });

  final Widget front;
  final Widget back;
  final bool isFlipped;
  final double dragFraction;
  final Duration duration;
  final Curve curve;
  final Flashcard3DAnimationMath animationMath;

  @override
  State<Flashcard3DRenderer> createState() => _Flashcard3DRendererState();
}

final class _Flashcard3DRendererState extends State<Flashcard3DRenderer>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late final AnimationController _controller;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _controller = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      value: widget.isFlipped ? 1 : 0,
      duration: widget.duration,
    );
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant Flashcard3DRenderer oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.duration != widget.duration) {
      _controller.duration = widget.duration;
    }
    if (oldWidget.isFlipped != widget.isFlipped) {
      _controller.animateTo(
        widget.isFlipped ? 1 : 0,
        duration: widget.duration,
        curve: widget.curve,
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: _controller,
      builder: (context, child) {
        final progress = _controller.value;
        final face = widget.animationMath.visibleFaceFor(progress);
        final visibleChild = face == Flashcard3DFace.front
            ? widget.front
            : Transform(
                alignment: Alignment.center,
                transform: Matrix4.identity()..rotateY(math.pi),
                child: widget.back,
              );

        return Transform(
          alignment: Alignment.center,
          transform: widget.animationMath.matrixFor(
            progress,
            dragFraction: widget.dragFraction,
          ),
          child: visibleChild,
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../design_system/app_audio_button.dart';
import '../../../design_system/app_colors.dart';
import '../../../design_system/app_glass_card.dart';

abstract final class Flashcard3DUiTokens {
  static const double outerInset = 16;
  static const double sectionGap = 16;
  static const double cardInset = 22;
  static const double compactGap = 8;
  static const double actionGap = 12;
  static const double maxCardWidth = 520;
}

final class Flashcard3DMasterHub extends StatefulWidget {
  const Flashcard3DMasterHub({
    required this.cards,
    this.initialIndex = 0,
    this.loop = true,
    this.onSwipe,
    this.onCardChanged,
    this.onAudio,
    super.key,
  });

  final List<Flashcard3DData> cards;
  final int initialIndex;
  final bool loop;
  final FlashcardSwipeCallback? onSwipe;
  final FlashcardIndexChanged? onCardChanged;
  final FlashcardAudioCallback? onAudio;

  @override
  State<Flashcard3DMasterHub> createState() => _Flashcard3DMasterHubState();
}

final class _Flashcard3DMasterHubState extends State<Flashcard3DMasterHub> {
  late final FlashcardGestureController _gestureController;
  late int _index;
  bool _isFlipped = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _gestureController = FlashcardGestureController();
    _index = _safeInitialIndex();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant Flashcard3DMasterHub oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (widget.cards.isEmpty) {
      _index = 0;
      _isFlipped = false;
      _gestureController.cancelDrag();
      return;
    }
    if (_index >= widget.cards.length) {
      _index = widget.cards.length - 1;
      _isFlipped = false;
      _gestureController.cancelDrag();
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _gestureController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  int _safeInitialIndex() {
    if (widget.cards.isEmpty) return 0;
    return widget.initialIndex.clamp(0, widget.cards.length - 1).toInt();
  }

  void _toggleFlip() {
    if (widget.cards.isEmpty) return;
    setState(() => _isFlipped = !_isFlipped);
  }

  void _moveBy(int delta) {
    if (widget.cards.isEmpty) return;

    final length = widget.cards.length;
    final raw = _index + delta;
    final next = widget.loop
        ? ((raw % length) + length) % length
        : raw.clamp(0, length - 1).toInt();

    if (next == _index) {
      setState(() => _isFlipped = false);
      return;
    }

    setState(() {
      _index = next;
      _isFlipped = false;
    });
    widget.onCardChanged?.call(widget.cards[_index], _index);
  }

  void _handleSwipe(FlashcardSwipeDirection direction) {
    if (widget.cards.isEmpty) return;
    final activeCard = widget.cards[_index];
    final activeIndex = _index;
    widget.onSwipe?.call(direction, activeCard, activeIndex);

    switch (direction) {
      case FlashcardSwipeDirection.left:
        _moveBy(1);
        break;
      case FlashcardSwipeDirection.right:
        _moveBy(-1);
        break;
      case FlashcardSwipeDirection.up:
      case FlashcardSwipeDirection.down:
        setState(() => _isFlipped = false);
        break;
    }
  }

  Color _articleColor(String? article) => switch (article?.toLowerCase()) {
        'der' => AppColors.articleDer,
        'die' => AppColors.articleDie,
        'das' => AppColors.articleDas,
        'plural' => AppColors.articleOther,
        _ => AppColors.primary,
      };

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface = dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface;
    final border =
        dark ? AppColors.glassBorderDark : AppColors.glassBorderLight;

    if (widget.cards.isEmpty) {
      return Center(
        child: AppGlassCard(
          backgroundColor: surface,
          borderColor: border,
          child: AppDirectionalText(
            'لا توجد بطاقات متاحة حاليًا.',
            languageCode: 'ar',
            style: AppTypography.body,
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    final card = widget.cards[_index];

    return SafeArea(
      child: LayoutBuilder(
        builder: (context, constraints) {
          final availableWidth = constraints.maxWidth.isFinite
              ? constraints.maxWidth
              : Flashcard3DUiTokens.maxCardWidth;
          final cardWidth = (availableWidth -
                  (Flashcard3DUiTokens.outerInset * 2))
              .clamp(240.0, Flashcard3DUiTokens.maxCardWidth)
              .toDouble();
          final cardHeight = (cardWidth * 1.18).clamp(300.0, 560.0).toDouble();
          final viewport = Size(cardWidth, cardHeight);

          return Center(
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(Flashcard3DUiTokens.outerInset),
              child: ConstrainedBox(
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(
                  maxWidth: Flashcard3DUiTokens.maxCardWidth,
                ),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    _DeckHeader(
                      index: _index,
                      total: widget.cards.length,
                      isFlipped: _isFlipped,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: Flashcard3DUiTokens.sectionGap),
                    SizedBox(
                      width: cardWidth,
                      height: cardHeight,
                      child: GestureDetector(
                        key: const ValueKey<String>(
                          'flashcard-gesture-surface',
                        ),
                        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                        onTap: _toggleFlip,
                        onPanStart: (_) => _gestureController.beginDrag(),
                        onPanUpdate: (details) =>
                            _gestureController.updateDrag(details.delta),
                        onPanCancel: _gestureController.cancelDrag,
                        onPanEnd: (_) {
                          final direction =
                              _gestureController.endDrag(viewport);
                          if (direction != null) {
                            _handleSwipe(direction);
                          }
                        },
                        child: Semantics(
                          button: true,
                          label: card.semanticLabel ??
                              'Interactive flashcard ${_index + 1} '
                                  'of ${widget.cards.length}',
                          hint:
                              'Tap to flip. Swipe left or right to navigate.',
                          child: AnimatedBuilder(
                            animation: _gestureController,
                            builder: (context, child) {
                              final offset = _gestureController.dragOffset;
                              final dragFraction =
                                  _gestureController.horizontalFraction(
                                viewport,
                              );

                              return Transform.translate(
                                offset: Offset(
                                  offset.dx * .72,
                                  offset.dy * .36,
                                ),
                                child: AnimatedSwitcher(
                                  duration:
                                      const Duration(milliseconds: 220),
                                  switchInCurve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
                                  switchOutCurve: Curves.easeInCubic,
                                  transitionBuilder: (child, animation) =>
                                      FadeTransition(
                                    opacity: animation,
                                    child: ScaleTransition(
                                      scale: Tween<double>(
                                        begin: .97,
                                        end: 1,
                                      ).animate(animation),
                                      child: child,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  child: Flashcard3DRenderer(
                                    key: ValueKey<String>(card.id),
                                    isFlipped: _isFlipped,
                                    dragFraction: dragFraction,
                                    front: _CardFace(
                                      card: card,
                                      face: Flashcard3DFace.front,
                                      surface: surface,
                                      border: border,
                                      articleColor:
                                          _articleColor(card.article),
                                      onAudio: widget.onAudio,
                                    ),
                                    back: _CardFace(
                                      card: card,
                                      face: Flashcard3DFace.back,
                                      surface: surface,
                                      border: border,
                                      articleColor:
                                          _articleColor(card.article),
                                      onAudio: widget.onAudio,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ),
                              );
                            },
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: Flashcard3DUiTokens.sectionGap),
                    _AccessibleControls(
                      canGoPrevious: widget.loop || _index > 0,
                      canGoNext:
                          widget.loop || _index < widget.cards.length - 1,
                      isFlipped: _isFlipped,
                      onPrevious: () => _moveBy(-1),
                      onFlip: _toggleFlip,
                      onNext: () => _moveBy(1),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: Flashcard3DUiTokens.compactGap),
                    AppDirectionalText(
                      'Tippen: drehen • Links/Rechts: navigieren • '

                      'أعلى/أسفل لإجراء تعليمي',
                      languageCode: 'ar',
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      style: AppTypography.label,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),

final class _CardFace extends StatelessWidget {

    required this.card,
    required this.face,
    required this.surface,
    required this.border,
    required this.articleColor,
    required this.onAudio,

  @override

        isFront ? card.frontSupportingText : card.backSupportingText;

                  const SizedBox(height: Flashcard3DUiTokens.actionGap),
                  AppDirectionalText(
                    supporting,
                    languageCode: languageCode,
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: AppTypography.body,

              end: 0,
              bottom: 0,

                onPressed: () => onAudio!(card, face),
                semanticLabel: isFront
                    ? 'Listen to the front of the flashcard'
                    : 'Listen to the back of the flashcard',
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

enum Flashcard3DFace { front, back }

enum FlashcardSwipeDirection { left, right, up, down }

@immutable
final class Flashcard3DData {
  const Flashcard3DData({
    required this.id,
    required this.frontText,
    required this.backText,
    this.frontLanguageCode = 'de',
    this.backLanguageCode = 'ar',
    this.article,
    this.frontSupportingText,
    this.backSupportingText,
    this.semanticLabel,
  }) : assert(id != '');

  final String id;
  final String frontText;
  final String backText;
  final String frontLanguageCode;
  final String backLanguageCode;
  final String? article;
  final String? frontSupportingText;
  final String? backSupportingText;
  final String? semanticLabel;
}

typedef FlashcardSwipeCallback = void Function(
  FlashcardSwipeDirection direction,
  Flashcard3DData card,
  int index,
);

typedef FlashcardIndexChanged = void Function(
  Flashcard3DData card,
  int index,
);

typedef FlashcardAudioCallback = void Function(
  Flashcard3DData card,
  Flashcard3DFace face,

import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';

import 'flashcard_3d_models.dart';

final class FlashcardGestureController extends ChangeNotifier {
  FlashcardGestureController({
    this.swipeThresholdFraction = .22,
    this.minimumSwipeDistance = 64,
  })  : assert(swipeThresholdFraction > 0 && swipeThresholdFraction <= 1),
        assert(minimumSwipeDistance > 0);

  final double swipeThresholdFraction;
  final double minimumSwipeDistance;

  Offset _dragOffset = Offset.zero;
  bool _dragging = false;

  Offset get dragOffset => _dragOffset;
  bool get isDragging => _dragging;

  void beginDrag() {
    _dragging = true;
    if (_dragOffset != Offset.zero) {
      _dragOffset = Offset.zero;
    }
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void updateDrag(Offset delta) {
    if (!_dragging) beginDrag();
    _dragOffset += delta;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void cancelDrag() {
    final changed = _dragging || _dragOffset != Offset.zero;
    _dragging = false;
    _dragOffset = Offset.zero;
    if (changed) notifyListeners();
  }

  FlashcardSwipeDirection? endDrag(Size viewport) {
    final direction = _classify(viewport);
    _dragging = false;
    _dragOffset = Offset.zero;
    notifyListeners();
    return direction;
  }

  double horizontalFraction(Size viewport) {
    final width = math.max(1.0, viewport.width);
    return (_dragOffset.dx / width).clamp(-1.0, 1.0).toDouble();
  }

  double verticalFraction(Size viewport) {
    final height = math.max(1.0, viewport.height);
    return (_dragOffset.dy / height).clamp(-1.0, 1.0).toDouble();
  }

  FlashcardSwipeDirection? _classify(Size viewport) {
    final dx = _dragOffset.dx;
    final dy = _dragOffset.dy;
    final horizontalThreshold = math.max(
      minimumSwipeDistance,
      viewport.width * swipeThresholdFraction,
    );
    final verticalThreshold = math.max(
      minimumSwipeDistance,
      viewport.height * swipeThresholdFraction,
    );

    if (dx.abs() >= dy.abs() && dx.abs() >= horizontalThreshold) {
      return dx < 0
          ? FlashcardSwipeDirection.left
          : FlashcardSwipeDirection.right;
    }

    if (dy.abs() > dx.abs() && dy.abs() >= verticalThreshold) {
      return dy < 0
          ? FlashcardSwipeDirection.up
          : FlashcardSwipeDirection.down;
    }

    return null;
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'responsive_breakpoints.dart';
import 'screen_sizes_handler.dart';

typedef ResponsiveModuleBuilder = Widget Function(
  BuildContext context,
  ResponsiveWindowClass windowClass,
);

enum ResponsiveRouteTransition { platform, fade, slideHorizontal }

@immutable
final class ResponsiveRouteDefinition {
  const ResponsiveRouteDefinition({
    required this.name,
    required this.builder,
    this.transition = ResponsiveRouteTransition.platform,
    this.allowedWindowClasses = const <ResponsiveWindowClass>{
      ResponsiveWindowClass.compact,
      ResponsiveWindowClass.medium,
      ResponsiveWindowClass.expanded,
      ResponsiveWindowClass.wide,
    },
  });

  final String name;
  final ResponsiveModuleBuilder builder;
  final ResponsiveRouteTransition transition;
  final Set<ResponsiveWindowClass> allowedWindowClasses;

  bool supports(ResponsiveWindowClass windowClass) =>
      allowedWindowClasses.contains(windowClass);
}

final class NavigationRoutingRegistry {
  NavigationRoutingRegistry({
    required Iterable<ResponsiveRouteDefinition> routes,
  }) : _routes = <String, ResponsiveRouteDefinition>{} {
    for (final route in routes) {
      _validateRouteName(route.name);
      if (_routes.containsKey(route.name)) {
        throw StateError('Duplicate responsive route: ${route.name}');
      }
      _routes[route.name] = route;
    }
  }

  final Map<String, ResponsiveRouteDefinition> _routes;

  Iterable<String> get registeredNames => _routes.keys;

  ResponsiveRouteDefinition? resolve(String? name) =>
      name == null ? null : _routes[name];

  bool contains(String name) => _routes.containsKey(name);

  Route<T> buildRoute<T>(
    RouteSettings settings,
    ResponsiveWindowClass windowClass,
  ) {
    final definition = _requireDefinition(settings.name);
    return _createRoute<T>(
      definition: definition,
      settings: settings,
      pageBuilder: (context) => _buildForClass(
        context,
        definition,
        windowClass,
      ),
    );
  }

  Route<dynamic>? buildAdaptiveRoute(RouteSettings settings) {
    final definition = resolve(settings.name);
    if (definition == null) return null;

    return _createRoute<dynamic>(
      definition: definition,
      settings: settings,
      pageBuilder: (context) {
        final snapshot = ResponsiveLayoutScope.of(context);
        return _buildForClass(
          context,
          definition,
          snapshot.windowClass,
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Future<T?> pushNamed<T>(
    BuildContext context,
    String routeName, {
    Object? arguments,
  }) {
    if (!contains(routeName)) {
      throw StateError('Unregistered responsive route: $routeName');
    }
    return Navigator.of(context).pushNamed<T>(
      routeName,
      arguments: arguments,
    );
  }

  ResponsiveRouteDefinition _requireDefinition(String? name) {
    final definition = resolve(name);
    if (definition == null) {
      throw StateError('Unregistered responsive route: ${name ?? '<null>'}');
    }
    return definition;
  }

  Widget _buildForClass(
    BuildContext context,
    ResponsiveRouteDefinition definition,
    ResponsiveWindowClass windowClass,
  ) {
    if (!definition.supports(windowClass)) {
      return ResponsiveRouteUnavailable(
        routeName: definition.name,
        windowClass: windowClass,
      );
    }
    return definition.builder(context, windowClass);
  }

  Route<T> _createRoute<T>({
    required ResponsiveRouteDefinition definition,
    required RouteSettings settings,
    required WidgetBuilder pageBuilder,
  }) =>
      switch (definition.transition) {
        ResponsiveRouteTransition.platform => MaterialPageRoute<T>(
            settings: settings,
            builder: pageBuilder,
          ),
        ResponsiveRouteTransition.fade => PageRouteBuilder<T>(
            settings: settings,
            transitionDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
            reverseTransitionDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 140),
            pageBuilder: (context, animation, secondaryAnimation) =>
                pageBuilder(context),
            transitionsBuilder: (
              context,
              animation,
              secondaryAnimation,
              child,
            ) =>
                FadeTransition(
              opacity: CurvedAnimation(
                parent: animation,
                curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
                reverseCurve: Curves.easeInCubic,
              ),
              child: child,
            ),
          ),
        ResponsiveRouteTransition.slideHorizontal => PageRouteBuilder<T>(
            settings: settings,
            transitionDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 220),
            reverseTransitionDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
            pageBuilder: (context, animation, secondaryAnimation) =>
                pageBuilder(context),
            transitionsBuilder: (
              context,
              animation,
              secondaryAnimation,
              child,
            ) =>
                SlideTransition(
              position: Tween<Offset>(
                begin: const Offset(1, 0),
                end: Offset.zero,
              ).animate(
                CurvedAnimation(
                  parent: animation,
                  curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
                  reverseCurve: Curves.easeInCubic,
                ),
              ),
              child: child,
            ),
          ),
      };

  static void _validateRouteName(String name) {
    if (name.isEmpty || !name.startsWith('/')) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        name,
        'name',
        'Responsive routes must start with "/".',
      );
    }
    if (name.length > 1 && name.endsWith('/')) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        name,
        'name',
        'Responsive routes must not end with "/".',
      );
    }
    if (name.contains('//')) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        name,
        'name',
        'Responsive routes must not contain empty path segments.',
      );
    }
  }
}

final class ResponsiveRouteUnavailable extends StatelessWidget {
  const ResponsiveRouteUnavailable({
    required this.routeName,
    required this.windowClass,
    super.key,
  });

  final String routeName;
  final ResponsiveWindowClass windowClass;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
        body: SafeArea(
          child: Center(
            child: Semantics(
              liveRegion: true,
              label: 'Route unavailable for current layout',
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                child: Text(
                  'The route $routeName is not available for the '
                  '${windowClass.name} layout.',
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

enum ResponsiveWindowClass { compact, medium, expanded, wide }

enum ResponsiveNavigationPresentation {
  bottomBar,
  navigationRail,
  navigationDrawer,
}

@immutable
final class ResponsiveBreakpoints {
  const ResponsiveBreakpoints({
    this.compactMax = 599,
    this.mediumMax = 839,
    this.expandedMax = 1199,
  })  : assert(compactMax >= 0),
        assert(mediumMax > compactMax),
        assert(expandedMax > mediumMax);

  final double compactMax;
  final double mediumMax;
  final double expandedMax;

  ResponsiveWindowClass classify(double width) {
    if (!width.isFinite || width < 0) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        width,
        'width',
        'Responsive width must be finite and non-negative.',
      );
    }
    if (width <= compactMax) return ResponsiveWindowClass.compact;
    if (width <= mediumMax) return ResponsiveWindowClass.medium;
    if (width <= expandedMax) return ResponsiveWindowClass.expanded;
    return ResponsiveWindowClass.wide;
  }

  ResponsiveNavigationPresentation navigationFor(
    ResponsiveWindowClass windowClass,
  ) =>
      switch (windowClass) {
        ResponsiveWindowClass.compact =>
          ResponsiveNavigationPresentation.bottomBar,
        ResponsiveWindowClass.medium =>
          ResponsiveNavigationPresentation.navigationRail,
        ResponsiveWindowClass.expanded =>
          ResponsiveNavigationPresentation.navigationRail,
        ResponsiveWindowClass.wide =>
          ResponsiveNavigationPresentation.navigationDrawer,
      };

  int columnsFor(ResponsiveWindowClass windowClass) => switch (windowClass) {
        ResponsiveWindowClass.compact => 1,
        ResponsiveWindowClass.medium => 2,
        ResponsiveWindowClass.expanded => 3,
        ResponsiveWindowClass.wide => 4,
      };

  double horizontalPaddingFor(ResponsiveWindowClass windowClass) =>
      switch (windowClass) {
        ResponsiveWindowClass.compact => 16,
        ResponsiveWindowClass.medium => 24,
        ResponsiveWindowClass.expanded => 32,
        ResponsiveWindowClass.wide => 40,
      };

  double maxContentWidthFor(ResponsiveWindowClass windowClass) =>
      switch (windowClass) {
        ResponsiveWindowClass.compact => 599,
        ResponsiveWindowClass.medium => 760,
        ResponsiveWindowClass.expanded => 1040,
        ResponsiveWindowClass.wide => 1200,
      };
}

FILE: lib/core/design/responsive_layout_routing/responsive_layout_hub.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'navigation_routing.dart';
import 'screen_sizes_handler.dart';

final class ResponsiveLayoutHub extends StatelessWidget {
  const ResponsiveLayoutHub({
    required this.registry,
    required this.initialRoute,
    this.navigatorKey,
    this.screenSizesHandler = const ScreenSizesHandler(),
    super.key,
  });

  final NavigationRoutingRegistry registry;
  final String initialRoute;
  final GlobalKey<NavigatorState>? navigatorKey;
  final ScreenSizesHandler screenSizesHandler;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (!registry.contains(initialRoute)) {
      throw StateError(
        'ResponsiveLayoutHub initial route is not registered: $initialRoute',
      );
    }

    return LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, constraints) {
        final media = MediaQuery.of(context);
        final snapshot = screenSizesHandler.resolve(constraints, media);

        return ResponsiveLayoutScope(
          snapshot: snapshot,
          child: Navigator(
            key: navigatorKey,
            initialRoute: initialRoute,
            onGenerateInitialRoutes: (navigator, routeName) {
              final route = registry.buildAdaptiveRoute(
                RouteSettings(name: routeName),
              );
              if (route == null) {
                throw StateError(
                  'ResponsiveLayoutHub could not build initial route: '
                  '$routeName',
                );
              }
              return <Route<dynamic>>[route];
            },
            onGenerateRoute: registry.buildAdaptiveRoute,
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';

import 'responsive_breakpoints.dart';

@immutable
final class ScreenSizeSnapshot {
  const ScreenSizeSnapshot({
    required this.width,
    required this.height,
    required this.orientation,
    required this.windowClass,
    required this.navigation,
    required this.columns,
    required this.horizontalPadding,
    required this.contentWidth,
    required this.textScaleFactor,
  });

  final double width;
  final double height;
  final Orientation orientation;
  final ResponsiveWindowClass windowClass;
  final ResponsiveNavigationPresentation navigation;
  final int columns;
  final double horizontalPadding;
  final double contentWidth;
  final double textScaleFactor;

  bool get isLandscape => orientation == Orientation.landscape;

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      identical(this, other) ||
      other is ScreenSizeSnapshot &&
          width == other.width &&
          height == other.height &&
          orientation == other.orientation &&
          windowClass == other.windowClass &&
          navigation == other.navigation &&
          columns == other.columns &&
          horizontalPadding == other.horizontalPadding &&
          contentWidth == other.contentWidth &&
          textScaleFactor == other.textScaleFactor;

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(
        width,
        height,
        orientation,
        windowClass,
        navigation,
        columns,
        horizontalPadding,
        contentWidth,
        textScaleFactor,
      );
}

final class ScreenSizesHandler {
  const ScreenSizesHandler({
    this.breakpoints = const ResponsiveBreakpoints(),
  });

  final ResponsiveBreakpoints breakpoints;

  ScreenSizeSnapshot resolve(
    BoxConstraints constraints,
    MediaQueryData media,
  ) {
    final width = constraints.hasBoundedWidth
        ? math.max(0.0, constraints.maxWidth).toDouble()
        : media.size.width;
    final height = constraints.hasBoundedHeight
        ? math.max(0.0, constraints.maxHeight).toDouble()
        : media.size.height;
    final windowClass = breakpoints.classify(width);
    final padding = breakpoints.horizontalPaddingFor(windowClass);
    final maxContent = breakpoints.maxContentWidthFor(windowClass);
    final availableContent = math.max(0.0, width - (padding * 2)).toDouble();
    final contentWidth = math.min(availableContent, maxContent).toDouble();
    final orientation =
        width >= height ? Orientation.landscape : Orientation.portrait;

    return ScreenSizeSnapshot(
      width: width,
      height: height,
      orientation: orientation,
      windowClass: windowClass,
      navigation: breakpoints.navigationFor(windowClass),
      columns: breakpoints.columnsFor(windowClass),
      horizontalPadding: padding,
      contentWidth: contentWidth,
      textScaleFactor: media.textScaler.scale(14) / 14,
    );
  }
}

final class ResponsiveLayoutScope extends InheritedWidget {
  const ResponsiveLayoutScope({
    required this.snapshot,
    required super.child,
    super.key,
  });

  final ScreenSizeSnapshot snapshot;

  static ScreenSizeSnapshot of(BuildContext context) {
    final scope =
        context.dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType<ResponsiveLayoutScope>();
    assert(
      scope != null,
      'ResponsiveLayoutScope.of() called without ResponsiveLayoutHub.',
    );
    if (scope == null) {
      throw StateError(
        'ResponsiveLayoutScope requires a ResponsiveLayoutHub ancestor.',
      );
    }
    return scope.snapshot;
  }

  static ScreenSizeSnapshot? maybeOf(BuildContext context) =>
      context
          .dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType<ResponsiveLayoutScope>()
          ?.snapshot;

  @override
  bool updateShouldNotify(ResponsiveLayoutScope oldWidget) =>
      snapshot != oldWidget.snapshot;
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'visual_theme_contracts.dart';

class BrightnessModeController extends ChangeNotifier {
  BrightnessModeController({
    VisualThemeMode initialMode = VisualThemeMode.system,
  }) : _mode = initialMode;

  VisualThemeMode _mode;

  VisualThemeMode get mode => _mode;

  ThemeMode get themeMode => switch (_mode) {
        VisualThemeMode.system => ThemeMode.system,
        VisualThemeMode.light => ThemeMode.light,
        VisualThemeMode.dark => ThemeMode.dark,
      };

  Brightness effectiveBrightness(Brightness platformBrightness) =>
      switch (_mode) {
        VisualThemeMode.system => platformBrightness,
        VisualThemeMode.light => Brightness.light,
        VisualThemeMode.dark => Brightness.dark,
      };

  void selectMode(VisualThemeMode next) {
    if (_mode == next) return;
    _mode = next;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void selectThemeMode(ThemeMode next) {
    selectMode(
      switch (next) {
        ThemeMode.system => VisualThemeMode.system,
        ThemeMode.light => VisualThemeMode.light,
        ThemeMode.dark => VisualThemeMode.dark,
      },
    );
  }

  void toggle(Brightness platformBrightness) {
    final effective = effectiveBrightness(platformBrightness);
    selectMode(
      effective == Brightness.dark
          ? VisualThemeMode.light
          : VisualThemeMode.dark,
    );
  }

  void followSystem() => selectMode(VisualThemeMode.system);
}

import '../../features/srs/corpus_sqlite_repository.dart';

final class ExplainerCorpusEntry {
  ExplainerCorpusEntry({
    required this.id,
    required String sourceText,
    required String translationText,
    required String sentence,
    required String sentenceTranslation,
    required String grammaticalMarker,
    required String pluralForm,
  })  : sourceText = sourceText.trim(),
        translationText = translationText.trim(),
        sentence = sentence.trim(),
        sentenceTranslation = sentenceTranslation.trim(),
        grammaticalMarker = grammaticalMarker.trim(),
        pluralForm = pluralForm.trim();

  final String id;
  final String sourceText;
  final String translationText;
  final String sentence;
  final String sentenceTranslation;
  final String grammaticalMarker;
  final String pluralForm;
}

final class ExplainerVerbEvidence {
  ExplainerVerbEvidence({
    required String infinitive,
    required String person,
    required String personTranslation,
    required String form,
    required String past,
    required String pastTranslation,
    required String example,
    required String exampleTranslation,
  })  : infinitive = infinitive.trim(),
        person = person.trim(),
        personTranslation = personTranslation.trim(),
        form = form.trim(),
        past = past.trim(),
        pastTranslation = pastTranslation.trim(),
        example = example.trim(),
        exampleTranslation = exampleTranslation.trim();

  final String infinitive;
  final String person;
  final String personTranslation;
  final String form;
  final String past;
  final String pastTranslation;
  final String example;
  final String exampleTranslation;
}

abstract interface class ExplainerCorpusReader {
  Future<ExplainerCorpusEntry?> fetchById(String contentId);

  Future<List<ExplainerVerbEvidence>> fetchVerbForms(
    String infinitive, {
    int limit = 6,
  });
}

/// Adapter over the already admitted [IndexedSrsCorpusRepository].
///
/// It performs no work in the constructor and therefore adds no startup I/O.
/// Every request is bounded to one content row and at most 12 verb rows.
final class IndexedSrsExplainerCorpusReader
    implements ExplainerCorpusReader {
  const IndexedSrsExplainerCorpusReader(this.repository);

  static const int maxVerbRows = 12;
  static const int maxContentIdLength = 160;
  static const int maxInfinitiveLength = 200;

  final IndexedSrsCorpusRepository repository;

  @override
  Future<ExplainerCorpusEntry?> fetchById(String contentId) async {
    final safeId = contentId.trim();
    if (safeId.isEmpty || safeId.length > maxContentIdLength) {
      return null;
    }

    final rows = await repository.fetchByIds(<String>[safeId]);
    if (rows.isEmpty) return null;

    final item = rows.single;
    return ExplainerCorpusEntry(
      id: item.id,
      sourceText: item.german,
      translationText: item.arabic,
      sentence: item.sentence,
      sentenceTranslation: item.sentenceAr,
      grammaticalMarker: item.article,
      pluralForm: item.plural,
    );
  }

  @override
  Future<List<ExplainerVerbEvidence>> fetchVerbForms(
    String infinitive, {
    int limit = 6,
  }) async {
    final safeInfinitive = infinitive.trim();
    if (safeInfinitive.isEmpty ||
        safeInfinitive.length > maxInfinitiveLength) {
      return const <ExplainerVerbEvidence>[];
    }

    final safeLimit = limit.clamp(1, maxVerbRows).toInt();
    final rows = await repository.fetchVerbRows(
      infinitive: safeInfinitive,
      limit: safeLimit,
    );

    return rows
        .map(
          (row) => ExplainerVerbEvidence(
            infinitive: row.infinitive,
            person: row.person,
            personTranslation: row.personAr,
            form: row.form,
            past: row.past,
            pastTranslation: row.pastArabic,
            example: row.example,
            exampleTranslation: row.exampleAr,
          ),
        )
        .toList(growable: false);
  }
}

final class ExplainerRequest {
  ExplainerRequest({
    this.contentId = '',
    this.reasonCode,
    this.correct,
    this.observedForm,
    this.pronoun,
    Map<String, String> arguments = const <String, String>{},
    this.maxVerbForms = 6,
  }) : arguments = Map<String, String>.unmodifiable(arguments);

  final String contentId;

final class ExplainerFact {

    required this.kind,
    required String value,
    required this.source,
    Iterable<String> evidence = const <String>[],
  })  : value = value.trim(),

final class ExplainerResult {
  ExplainerResult({
    required this.status,
    required this.contentId,
    required String sourceText,
    required String translationText,
    required Iterable<ExplainerFact> facts,
    this.reasonCode,
    String explanationText = '',
    String explanationLanguageCode = '',
  })  : sourceText = sourceText.trim(),
        translationText = translationText.trim(),
        facts = List<ExplainerFact>.unmodifiable(facts),
        explanationText = explanationText.trim(),
        explanationLanguageCode = explanationLanguageCode.trim();

  factory ExplainerResult.notFound(String contentId) => ExplainerResult(
        status: ExplainerStatus.notFound,
        contentId: contentId,
        sourceText: '',
        translationText: '',
        facts: const <ExplainerFact>[],
      );

  final ExplainerStatus status;
  final String contentId;
  final String sourceText;
  final String translationText;
  final List<ExplainerFact> facts;
  final String? reasonCode;
  final String explanationText;
  final String explanationLanguageCode;

  bool get found => status == ExplainerStatus.explained;
}

import '../explain_why/deterministic_explain_why_engine.dart';
import 'explainer_corpus_reader.dart';
import 'explainer_models.dart';

/// Offline-first deterministic explanation service.
///
/// Construction is lazy. Each content-linked explanation performs one indexed
/// content lookup and at most one indexed verb lookup. Verb evidence is capped
/// at [maxVerbFormsPerExplanation], so rule resolution remains bounded O(1).
final class ExplainerService {
  const ExplainerService({
    required ExplainerCorpusReader corpusReader,
    ExplainWhyEngine? explainWhyEngine,
  })  : _corpusReader = corpusReader,
        _explainWhyEngine = explainWhyEngine;

  static const int maxVerbFormsPerExplanation = 12;
  static const int maxContentIdLength = 160;

  final ExplainerCorpusReader _corpusReader;
  final ExplainWhyEngine? _explainWhyEngine;

  Future<ExplainerResult> explainWhy(
    ExplainerRequest request,
  ) async {
    final contentId = request.contentId.trim();
    if (contentId.isEmpty || contentId.length > maxContentIdLength) {
      return ExplainerResult.notFound(contentId);
    }

    final maxVerbForms =
        request.maxVerbForms.clamp(1, maxVerbFormsPerExplanation).toInt();

    final entry = await _corpusReader.fetchById(contentId);
    if (entry == null) {
      return ExplainerResult.notFound(contentId);
    }

    final verbRows = await _corpusReader.fetchVerbForms(
      entry.sourceText,
      limit: maxVerbForms,
    );
    final expectedVerb = _selectExpectedVerbEvidence(
      verbRows,
      pronoun: request.pronoun,
      observedForm: request.observedForm,
    );

    final facts = _factsFor(
      entry,
      verbRows: verbRows,
      selectedVerb: expectedVerb,
    );
    final rule = _resolveRule(
      request,
      entry: entry,
      expectedVerb: expectedVerb,
    );
    final engine = _explainWhyEngine;
    if (engine == null) {
      return ExplainerResult(
        status: ExplainerStatus.explained,
        contentId: entry.id,
        sourceText: entry.sourceText,
        translationText: entry.translationText,
        facts: facts,
        reasonCode: rule.reasonCode,
      );
    }

    final rendered = engine.explain(
      ExplainerRequest(
        contentId: entry.id,
        reasonCode: rule.reasonCode,
        correct: rule.correct,
        observedForm: request.observedForm,
        pronoun: request.pronoun,
        arguments: rule.arguments,
        maxVerbForms: maxVerbForms,
      ),
    );

    return ExplainerResult(
      status: ExplainerStatus.explained,
      contentId: entry.id,
      sourceText: entry.sourceText,
      translationText: entry.translationText,
      facts: facts,
      reasonCode: rendered.reasonCode,
      explanationText: rendered.text,
      explanationLanguageCode: rendered.languageCode,
    );
  }

  List<ExplainerFact> _factsFor(
    ExplainerCorpusEntry entry, {
    required List<ExplainerVerbEvidence> verbRows,
    required ExplainerVerbEvidence? selectedVerb,
  }) {
    final facts = <ExplainerFact>[];

    if (entry.translationText.isNotEmpty) {
      facts.add(
        ExplainerFact(
          kind: ExplainerFactKind.meaning,
          value: entry.translationText,
          source: ExplainerEvidenceSource.indexedSqliteCorpus,
          evidence: <String>[entry.sourceText],
        ),
      );
    }

    if (entry.grammaticalMarker.isNotEmpty) {
      facts.add(
        ExplainerFact(
          kind: ExplainerFactKind.grammaticalMarker,
          value: entry.grammaticalMarker,
          source: ExplainerEvidenceSource.indexedSqliteCorpus,
          evidence: <String>[entry.sourceText],
        ),
      );
    }

    if (entry.pluralForm.isNotEmpty) {
      facts.add(
        ExplainerFact(
          kind: ExplainerFactKind.pluralForm,
          value: entry.pluralForm,
          source: ExplainerEvidenceSource.indexedSqliteCorpus,
          evidence: <String>[entry.sourceText],
        ),
      );
    }

    if (entry.sentence.isNotEmpty || entry.sentenceTranslation.isNotEmpty) {
      facts.add(
        ExplainerFact(
          kind: ExplainerFactKind.usageExample,
          value: entry.sentence,
          source: ExplainerEvidenceSource.indexedSqliteCorpus,
          evidence: <String>[entry.sentenceTranslation],
        ),
      );
    }

    if (verbRows.isNotEmpty) {
      if (selectedVerb != null) {
        facts.add(
          ExplainerFact(
            kind: ExplainerFactKind.verbAgreement,
            value: selectedVerb.form,
            source: ExplainerEvidenceSource.indexedSqliteCorpus,
            evidence: <String>[
              selectedVerb.person,
              selectedVerb.personTranslation,
              selectedVerb.infinitive,
              selectedVerb.example,
              selectedVerb.exampleTranslation,
            ],
          ),
        );
        if (selectedVerb.past.isNotEmpty) {
          facts.add(
            ExplainerFact(
              kind: ExplainerFactKind.pastForm,
              value: selectedVerb.past,
              source: ExplainerEvidenceSource.indexedSqliteCorpus,
              evidence: <String>[
                selectedVerb.pastTranslation,
                selectedVerb.infinitive,
              ],
            ),
          );
        }
      } else {
        facts.add(
          ExplainerFact(
            kind: ExplainerFactKind.verbAgreement,
            value: entry.sourceText,
            source: ExplainerEvidenceSource.indexedSqliteCorpus,
            evidence: verbRows.expand(_verbEvidenceLines),
          ),
        );
      }
    }

    return List<ExplainerFact>.unmodifiable(facts);
  }

  _ExplainerRule _resolveRule(
    ExplainerRequest request, {
    required ExplainerCorpusEntry entry,
    required ExplainerVerbEvidence? expectedVerb,
  }) {
    final corpusArguments = <String, String>{
      'source': entry.sourceText,
      'translation': entry.translationText,
      'marker': entry.grammaticalMarker,
      'plural': entry.pluralForm,
      'sentence': entry.sentence,
      'sentenceTranslation': entry.sentenceTranslation,
    };

    if (expectedVerb != null) {
      corpusArguments.addAll(<String, String>{
        'infinitive': expectedVerb.infinitive,
        'pronoun': expectedVerb.person,
        'expected': expectedVerb.form,
        'observed': request.observedForm?.trim() ?? '',
      });
    }

    final explicitReason = request.reasonCode?.trim();
    if (explicitReason != null && explicitReason.isNotEmpty) {
      return _ExplainerRule(
        reasonCode: explicitReason,
        correct: request.correct ??
            _verbOutcome(
              observedForm: request.observedForm,
              expectedVerb: expectedVerb,
            ) ??
            true,
        arguments: <String, String>{
          ...request.arguments,
          ...corpusArguments,
        },
      );
    }

    if (expectedVerb != null &&
        (request.observedForm?.trim().isNotEmpty ?? false)) {
      return _ExplainerRule(
        reasonCode: 'lexicon.verb.agreement',
        correct: request.correct ??
            _verbOutcome(
              observedForm: request.observedForm,
              expectedVerb: expectedVerb,
            )!,
        arguments: <String, String>{
          ...request.arguments,
          ...corpusArguments,
        },
      );
    }

    if (entry.grammaticalMarker.isNotEmpty) {
      return _ExplainerRule(
        reasonCode: 'lexicon.grammatical_marker',
        correct: request.correct ?? true,
        arguments: <String, String>{
          ...request.arguments,
          ...corpusArguments,
        },
      );
    }

    if (entry.pluralForm.isNotEmpty) {
      return _ExplainerRule(
        reasonCode: 'lexicon.plural_form',
        correct: request.correct ?? true,
        arguments: <String, String>{
          ...request.arguments,
          ...corpusArguments,
        },
      );
    }

    if (entry.sentence.isNotEmpty || entry.sentenceTranslation.isNotEmpty) {
      return _ExplainerRule(
        reasonCode: 'lexicon.usage_example',
        correct: request.correct ?? true,
        arguments: <String, String>{
          ...request.arguments,
          ...corpusArguments,
        },
      );
    }

    return _ExplainerRule(
      reasonCode: 'lexicon.meaning',
      correct: request.correct ?? true,
      arguments: <String, String>{
        ...corpusArguments,
        ...request.arguments,
      },
    );
  }

  ExplainerVerbEvidence? _selectExpectedVerbEvidence(
    List<ExplainerVerbEvidence> rows, {
    String? pronoun,
    String? observedForm,
  }) {
    final safePronoun = pronoun?.trim().toLowerCase() ?? '';
    if (safePronoun.isNotEmpty) {
      for (final row in rows) {
        if (row.person.toLowerCase() == safePronoun) return row;
      }
    }

    final safeForm = observedForm?.trim().toLowerCase() ?? '';
    if (safeForm.isNotEmpty) {
      for (final row in rows) {
        if (row.form.toLowerCase() == safeForm) return row;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  bool? _verbOutcome({
    required String? observedForm,
    required ExplainerVerbEvidence? expectedVerb,
  }) {
    final observed = observedForm?.trim().toLowerCase() ?? '';
    if (observed.isEmpty || expectedVerb == null) return null;
    return observed == expectedVerb.form.toLowerCase();
  }

  Iterable<String> _verbEvidenceLines(ExplainerVerbEvidence row) sync* {
    if (row.person.isNotEmpty) yield row.person;
    if (row.personTranslation.isNotEmpty) yield row.personTranslation;
    if (row.form.isNotEmpty) yield row.form;
    if (row.example.isNotEmpty) yield row.example;
    if (row.exampleTranslation.isNotEmpty) {
      yield row.exampleTranslation;
    }
  }
}

final class _ExplainerRule {
  _ExplainerRule({
    required this.reasonCode,
    required this.correct,
    required Map<String, String> arguments,
  }) : arguments = Map<String, String>.unmodifiable(arguments);

  final String reasonCode;
  final bool correct;
  final Map<String, String> arguments;
}

import 'grammar_engine_models.dart';

final class ComparativeSuperlativeEngine {
  const ComparativeSuperlativeEngine();

  static const Map<String, ({String comparative, String superStem})>
      _irregular = <String, ({String comparative, String superStem})>{
    'gut': (comparative: 'besser', superStem: 'best'),
    'viel': (comparative: 'mehr', superStem: 'meist'),
    'gern': (comparative: 'lieber', superStem: 'liebst'),
    'hoch': (comparative: 'höher', superStem: 'höchst'),
    'nah': (comparative: 'näher', superStem: 'nächst'),
    'groß': (comparative: 'größer', superStem: 'größt'),
    'wenig': (comparative: 'weniger', superStem: 'wenigst'),
  };

  static const Map<String, String> _umlautBases = <String, String>{
    'alt': 'ält',
    'arm': 'ärm',
    'dumm': 'dümm',
    'gesund': 'gesünd',
    'hart': 'härt',
    'kalt': 'kält',
    'krank': 'kränk',
    'kurz': 'kürz',
    'lang': 'läng',
    'jung': 'jüng',
    'klug': 'klüg',
    'scharf': 'schärf',
    'schwach': 'schwäch',
    'stark': 'stärk',
    'warm': 'wärm',
  };

  static const Map<String, String> _contractedComparatives = <String, String>{
    'dunkel': 'dunkler',
    'edel': 'edler',
    'teuer': 'teurer',
    'sauer': 'saurer',
  };

  ComparisonForms formsFor(String adjective) {
    final positive = _normalizeAdjective(adjective);
    final irregular = _irregular[positive];
    if (irregular != null) {
      return ComparisonForms(
        positive: positive,
        comparative: irregular.comparative,
        superlativeStem: irregular.superStem,
        adverbialSuperlative: 'am ${irregular.superStem}en',
        ruleLabelAr: 'صيغة غير منتظمة يجب حفظها كوحدة واحدة.',
      );
    }

    final umlautBase = _umlautBases[positive];
    final comparative = _contractedComparatives[positive] ??
        _regularComparative(positive, umlautBase ?? positive);
    final superBase = umlautBase ?? positive;
    final superStem = '$superBase${_needsEpentheticE(superBase) ? 'est' : 'st'}';

    return ComparisonForms(
      positive: positive,
      comparative: comparative,
      superlativeStem: superStem,
      adverbialSuperlative: 'am ${superStem}en',
      ruleLabelAr: _ruleLabel(
        umlauted: umlautBase != null,
        contracted: _contractedComparatives.containsKey(positive),
        epentheticE: _needsEpentheticE(superBase),
      ),
    );
  }

  String formFor(
    String adjective,
    ComparisonPattern pattern, {
    String attributiveEnding = 'e',
  }) {
    final forms = formsFor(adjective);
    return switch (pattern) {
      ComparisonPattern.equality => forms.positive,
      ComparisonPattern.comparative => forms.comparative,
      ComparisonPattern.superlative =>
        '${forms.superlativeStem}${_validateEnding(attributiveEnding)}',
    };
  }

  String adverbialFormFor(
    String adjective,
    ComparisonPattern pattern,
  ) {
    final forms = formsFor(adjective);
    return switch (pattern) {
      ComparisonPattern.equality => forms.positive,
      ComparisonPattern.comparative => forms.comparative,
      ComparisonPattern.superlative => forms.adverbialSuperlative,
    };
  }

  String connectorFor(ComparisonPattern pattern) => switch (pattern) {
        ComparisonPattern.equality => 'wie',
        ComparisonPattern.comparative => 'als',
        ComparisonPattern.superlative => '',
      };

  bool validateForm({
    required String adjective,
    required ComparisonPattern pattern,
    required String candidate,
    bool adverbial = true,
    String attributiveEnding = 'e',
  }) {
    final expected = adverbial
        ? adverbialFormFor(adjective, pattern)
        : formFor(
            adjective,
            pattern,
            attributiveEnding: attributiveEnding,
          );
    return normalizeGermanInput(candidate) ==
        normalizeGermanInput(expected);
  }

  bool validateConnector({
    required ComparisonPattern pattern,
    required String candidate,
  }) {
    if (pattern == ComparisonPattern.superlative) {
      return candidate.trim().isEmpty;
    }
    return normalizeGermanInput(candidate) ==
        connectorFor(pattern);
  }

  String buildComparisonSentence({
    required String subject,
    required String adjective,
    required String reference,
    required ComparisonPattern pattern,
    String copula = 'ist',
  }) {
    final cleanSubject = _cleanPhrase(subject);
    final cleanReference = _cleanPhrase(reference);
    final cleanCopula = _cleanPhrase(copula);
    if (cleanSubject.isEmpty || cleanCopula.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'subject and copula must contain visible text.',
      );
    }

    if (pattern == ComparisonPattern.superlative) {
      return '$cleanSubject $cleanCopula '
          '${adverbialFormFor(adjective, pattern)}.';
    }

    if (cleanReference.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'reference is required for equality and comparative sentences.',
      );
    }

    final form = adverbialFormFor(adjective, pattern);
    final connector = connectorFor(pattern);
    final intensifier =
        pattern == ComparisonPattern.equality ? 'genauso ' : '';
    return '$cleanSubject $cleanCopula $intensifier$form '
        '$connector $cleanReference.';
  }

  List<GrammarTrainingItem> generateExamples({
    required int seed,
    int count = 6,
    ComparisonPattern? pattern,
  }) {
    if (count <= 0) return const <GrammarTrainingItem>[];
    return List<GrammarTrainingItem>.generate(
      count,
      (index) => generateTrainingItem(
        seed: seed + index * 19,
        pattern: pattern,
      ),
      growable: false,
    );
  }

  GrammarTrainingItem generateTrainingItem({
    required int seed,
    ComparisonPattern? pattern,
  }) {
    final selectedPattern = pattern ??
        ComparisonPattern.values[_index(seed, ComparisonPattern.values.length)];
    const scenarios = <({
      String adjective,
      String subject,
      String reference,
      String prompt,
    })>[
      (
        adjective: 'schnell',
        subject: 'Der Zug',
        reference: 'der Bus',
        prompt: 'قارن سرعة القطار بالحافلة',
      ),
      (
        adjective: 'groß',
        subject: 'Berlin',
        reference: 'Bonn',
        prompt: 'قارن الحجم',
      ),
      (
        adjective: 'teuer',
        subject: 'Dieses Hotel',
        reference: 'die Pension',
        prompt: 'قارن السعر',
      ),
      (
        adjective: 'gut',
        subject: 'Diese Lösung',
        reference: 'die erste Lösung',
        prompt: 'قارن الجودة',
      ),
      (
        adjective: 'kalt',
        subject: 'Der Januar',
        reference: 'der März',
        prompt: 'قارن درجة البرودة',
      ),
      (
        adjective: 'breit',
        subject: 'Diese Straße',
        reference: 'die Nebenstraße',
        prompt: 'قارن العرض',
      ),
      (
        adjective: 'dunkel',
        subject: 'Dieses Zimmer',
        reference: 'der Flur',
        prompt: 'قارن شدة الظلام',
      ),
    ];
    final scenario = scenarios[_index(seed, scenarios.length)];
    final full = buildComparisonSentence(
      subject: scenario.subject,
      adjective: scenario.adjective,
      reference: scenario.reference,
      pattern: selectedPattern,
    );
    final expected = adverbialFormFor(
      scenario.adjective,
      selectedPattern,
    );
    final blank = full.replaceFirst(expected, '___');
    final forms = formsFor(scenario.adjective);
    final alternatives = selectedPattern == ComparisonPattern.equality
        ? <String>[forms.positive]
        : const <String>[];

    return GrammarTrainingItem(
      id: 'cmp_${selectedPattern.name}_${_index(seed, 100000)}',
      category: selectedPattern.labelAr,
      promptAr: scenario.prompt,
      sentenceWithBlank: blank,
      expectedAnswer: expected,
      fullSentence: full,
      explanationAr: _trainingExplanation(
        forms: forms,
        pattern: selectedPattern,
      ),
      acceptedAlternatives: alternatives,
    );
  }

  String _regularComparative(String positive, String transformedBase) {
    if (positive.endsWith('e')) {
      return '${positive}r';
    }
    return '${transformedBase}er';
  }

  bool _needsEpentheticE(String base) {
    const endings = <String>['d', 't', 's', 'ß', 'x', 'z', 'sch'];
    return endings.any(base.endsWith);
  }

  String _validateEnding(String value) {
    final ending = value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const allowed = <String>{'e', 'en', 'em', 'er', 'es'};
    if (!allowed.contains(ending)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        value,
        'attributiveEnding',
        'Expected one of e, en, em, er, es.',
      );
    }
    return ending;
  }

  String _trainingExplanation({
    required ComparisonForms forms,
    required ComparisonPattern pattern,
  }) {
    return switch (pattern) {
      ComparisonPattern.equality =>
        'للمساواة نستخدم genauso/so + الصفة الأساسية + wie. ${forms.ruleLabelAr}',
      ComparisonPattern.comparative =>
        'للمقارنة غير المتساوية نستخدم Komparativ + als: ${forms.comparative} als ... ${forms.ruleLabelAr}',
      ComparisonPattern.superlative =>
        'عند استعمال الصفة خبراً أو ظرفاً نستخدم am + Superlativ + -en: ${forms.adverbialSuperlative}. ${forms.ruleLabelAr}',
    };
  }

  String _ruleLabel({
    required bool umlauted,
    required bool contracted,
    required bool epentheticE,
  }) {
    final notes = <String>[];
    if (umlauted) {
      notes.add('يتغير حرف العلة إلى Umlaut في درجتي المقارنة والتفضيل');
    } else {
      notes.add('تتبع الصفة القاعدة الإنتاجية -er / -(e)st');
    }
    if (contracted) {
      notes.add('تُحذف e داخلية في صيغة المقارنة');
    }
    if (epentheticE) {
      notes.add('تدخل e قبل -st لتسهيل النطق');
    }
    return '${notes.join('؛ ')}.';
  }

  String _normalizeAdjective(String value) {
    final result = value.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (result.isEmpty || result.contains(RegExp(r'\s'))) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        value,
        'adjective',
        'Expected one German adjective token.',
      );
    }
    return result;
  }

  String _cleanPhrase(String value) =>
      value.trim().replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');

  int _index(int seed, int length) {
    final nonNegative = seed < 0 ? -seed : seed;
    return nonNegative % length;
  }
}

enum GermanPerson {
  ich,
  du,
  er,
  sieSingular,
  es,
  wir,
  ihr,
  siePlural,
  sieFormal,
}

extension GermanPersonGrammar on GermanPerson {
  String get pronoun => switch (this) {
        GermanPerson.ich => 'ich',
        GermanPerson.du => 'du',
        GermanPerson.er => 'er',
        GermanPerson.sieSingular => 'sie',
        GermanPerson.es => 'es',
        GermanPerson.wir => 'wir',
        GermanPerson.ihr => 'ihr',
        GermanPerson.siePlural => 'sie',
        GermanPerson.sieFormal => 'Sie',
      };

  String get sentenceSubject => switch (this) {
        GermanPerson.ich => 'Ich',
        GermanPerson.du => 'Du',
        GermanPerson.er => 'Er',
        GermanPerson.sieSingular => 'Sie',
        GermanPerson.es => 'Es',
        GermanPerson.wir => 'Wir',
        GermanPerson.ihr => 'Ihr',
        GermanPerson.siePlural => 'Sie',
        GermanPerson.sieFormal => 'Sie',
      };

  int get paradigmIndex => switch (this) {
        GermanPerson.ich => 0,
        GermanPerson.du => 1,
        GermanPerson.er => 2,
        GermanPerson.sieSingular => 2,
        GermanPerson.es => 2,
        GermanPerson.wir => 3,
        GermanPerson.ihr => 4,
        GermanPerson.siePlural => 5,
        GermanPerson.sieFormal => 5,
      };
}

enum KonjunktivUsage {
  politeRequest,
  wish,
  hypotheticalCondition,
  advice,
}

extension KonjunktivUsageArabic on KonjunktivUsage {
  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        KonjunktivUsage.politeRequest => 'طلب مهذب',
        KonjunktivUsage.wish => 'تمنٍ أو رغبة',
        KonjunktivUsage.hypotheticalCondition => 'شرط افتراضي',
        KonjunktivUsage.advice => 'نصيحة لطيفة',
      };
}

enum KonjunktivConstruction {
  synthetic,
  wuerdeInfinitive,
}

final class KonjunktivForm {
  const KonjunktivForm({
    required this.infinitive,
    required this.person,
    required this.surface,
    required this.construction,
    required this.explanationAr,
  });

  final String infinitive;
  final GermanPerson person;
  final String surface;
  final KonjunktivConstruction construction;
  final String explanationAr;

  bool get usesInfinitiveTail =>
      construction == KonjunktivConstruction.wuerdeInfinitive;
}

enum ComparisonPattern {
  equality,
  comparative,
  superlative,
}

extension ComparisonPatternArabic on ComparisonPattern {
  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        ComparisonPattern.equality => 'مساواة',
        ComparisonPattern.comparative => 'مقارنة',
        ComparisonPattern.superlative => 'تفضيل',
      };
}

final class ComparisonForms {
  const ComparisonForms({
    required this.positive,
    required this.comparative,
    required this.superlativeStem,
    required this.adverbialSuperlative,
    required this.ruleLabelAr,
  });

  final String positive;
  final String comparative;
  final String superlativeStem;
  final String adverbialSuperlative;
  final String ruleLabelAr;
}

final class GrammarTrainingItem {
  const GrammarTrainingItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.category,
    required this.promptAr,
    required this.sentenceWithBlank,
    required this.expectedAnswer,
    required this.fullSentence,
    required this.explanationAr,
    this.acceptedAlternatives = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final String category;
  final String promptAr;
  final String sentenceWithBlank;
  final String expectedAnswer;
  final String fullSentence;
  final String explanationAr;
  final List<String> acceptedAlternatives;

  bool accepts(String candidate) {
    final normalized = normalizeGermanInput(candidate);
    if (normalized == normalizeGermanInput(expectedAnswer)) {
      return true;
    }
    return acceptedAlternatives.any(
      (value) => normalizeGermanInput(value) == normalized,
    );
  }
}

String normalizeGermanInput(String value) {
  var normalized = value.trim().toLowerCase();
  normalized = normalized.replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');
  normalized = normalized.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[.!?]+$'), '');
  return normalized.trim();
}

FILE: lib/core/grammar_engines/grammar_engines_contract.dart

import 'comparative_superlative_engine.dart';
import 'grammar_engine_models.dart';
import 'konjunktiv_ii_engine.dart';
import 'grammar_training_sessions.dart';

void main() {
  final konjunktiv = KonjunktivIiEngine();
  final comparison = ComparativeSuperlativeEngine();

  _expect(
    konjunktiv.conjugate('haben', GermanPerson.ich).surface,
    'hätte',
    'haben/ich must use the preferred synthetic form',
  );
  _expect(
    konjunktiv.conjugate('sein', GermanPerson.du).surface,
    'wärst',
    'sein/du must use the preferred synthetic form',
  );
  _expect(
    konjunktiv.conjugate('bestellen', GermanPerson.ich).surface,
    'würde bestellen',
    'regular lexical verbs must fall back to würde + infinitive',
  );
  _expect(
    konjunktiv.buildPreference(nounPhrase: 'einen Kaffee'),
    'Ich hätte gern einen Kaffee.',
    'haben preference must produce Ich hätte gern',
  );
  _expect(
    konjunktiv.buildWish(
      person: GermanPerson.ich,
      infinitive: 'bleiben',
      complement: 'länger',
    ),
    'Ich würde gern länger bleiben.',
    'regular wish must preserve infinitive-final würde construction',
  );
  _expect(
    konjunktiv.buildPoliteRequest(
      infinitive: 'helfen',
      complement: 'mir',
      formal: true,
      abilityStyle: true,
    ),
    'Könnten Sie mir bitte helfen?',
    'formal ability request must use könnten Sie',
  );
  _expect(
    konjunktiv.buildHypothetical(
      conditionPerson: GermanPerson.ich,
      conditionInfinitive: 'haben',
      conditionComplement: 'mehr Zeit',
      resultPerson: GermanPerson.ich,
      resultInfinitive: 'reisen',
      resultComplement: 'öfter',
    ),
    'Wenn ich mehr Zeit hätte, würde ich öfter reisen.',
    'hypothetical condition must place the condition verb finally',
  );

  final fast = comparison.formsFor('schnell');
  _expect(fast.comparative, 'schneller', 'regular comparative');
  _expect(
    fast.adverbialSuperlative,
    'am schnellsten',
    'regular adverbial superlative',
  );

  final big = comparison.formsFor('groß');
  _expect(big.comparative, 'größer', 'umlaut comparative');
  _expect(big.adverbialSuperlative, 'am größten', 'umlaut superlative');

  final expensive = comparison.formsFor('teuer');
  _expect(expensive.comparative, 'teurer', '-er stem contraction');
  _expect(
    expensive.adverbialSuperlative,
    'am teuersten',
    'superlative keeps the full teuer stem',
  );

  final dark = comparison.formsFor('dunkel');
  _expect(dark.comparative, 'dunkler', '-el comparative contraction');
  _expect(
    dark.adverbialSuperlative,
    'am dunkelsten',
    'superlative keeps the full dunkel stem',
  );

  final good = comparison.formsFor('gut');
  _expect(good.comparative, 'besser', 'irregular comparative');
  _expect(good.adverbialSuperlative, 'am besten', 'irregular superlative');

  final wide = comparison.formsFor('breit');
  _expect(wide.comparative, 'breiter', 'regular -t comparative');
  _expect(
    wide.adverbialSuperlative,
    'am breitesten',
    '-t superlative needs e before -sten',
  );

  _expect(
    comparison.connectorFor(ComparisonPattern.equality),
    'wie',
    'equality comparison connector',
  );
  _expect(
    comparison.connectorFor(ComparisonPattern.comparative),
    'als',
    'comparative connector',
  );
  _expect(
    comparison.buildComparisonSentence(
      subject: 'Der Zug',
      adjective: 'schnell',
      reference: 'der Bus',
      pattern: ComparisonPattern.comparative,
    ),
    'Der Zug ist schneller als der Bus.',
    'comparative sentence generation',
  );

  final konjA = konjunktiv.generateTrainingItem(seed: 7);
  final konjB = konjunktiv.generateTrainingItem(seed: 7);
  _expect(
    konjA.expectedAnswer,
    konjB.expectedAnswer,
    'Konjunktiv training generation must be deterministic for the same seed',
  );

  final compA = comparison.generateTrainingItem(seed: 11);
  final compB = comparison.generateTrainingItem(seed: 11);
  _expect(
    compA.expectedAnswer,
    compB.expectedAnswer,
    'comparison training generation must be deterministic for the same seed',
  );

  if (konjA.expectedAnswer.trim().isEmpty ||
      konjA.explanationAr.trim().isEmpty ||
      compA.expectedAnswer.trim().isEmpty ||
      compA.explanationAr.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw StateError('Generated training items must be complete.');
  }

  final konjSession = KonjunktivTrainingSession(seed: 7);
  final konjAttempt = konjSession.submit(
    konjSession.current.expectedAnswer,
  );
  _expect(
    konjAttempt.correct,
    true,
    'Konjunktiv interactive session must validate the current item',
  );
  final firstKonjId = konjSession.current.id;
  konjSession.next();
  if (konjSession.current.id == firstKonjId || konjSession.answered) {
    throw StateError(
      'Konjunktiv session next() must advance and clear answer state.',
    );
  }

  final comparisonSession = ComparisonTrainingSession(seed: 11);
  final comparisonAttempt = comparisonSession.submit(
    comparisonSession.current.expectedAnswer,
  );
  _expect(
    comparisonAttempt.correct,
    true,
    'comparison interactive session must validate the current item',
  );
  final firstComparisonId = comparisonSession.current.id;
  comparisonSession.next();
  if (comparisonSession.current.id == firstComparisonId ||
      comparisonSession.answered) {
    throw StateError(
      'Comparison session next() must advance and clear answer state.',
    );
  }
}

void _expect(Object? actual, Object? expected, String contract) {
  if (actual != expected) {
    throw StateError(
      'Contract failed: $contract. Expected <$expected>, got <$actual>.',
    );
  }
}
