import 'comparative_superlative_engine.dart';
import 'grammar_engine_models.dart';
import 'konjunktiv_ii_engine.dart';

final class TrainingAttemptResult {
  const TrainingAttemptResult({
    required this.item,
    required this.candidate,
    required this.correct,
    required this.feedbackAr,
  });

  final GrammarTrainingItem item;
  final String candidate;
  final bool correct;
  final String feedbackAr;
}

final class KonjunktivTrainingSession {
  KonjunktivTrainingSession({
    KonjunktivIiEngine engine = const KonjunktivIiEngine(),
    KonjunktivUsage usage = KonjunktivUsage.politeRequest,
    int seed = 1,
  })  : _engine = engine,
        _usage = usage,
        _seed = seed {
    _refresh();
  }

  final KonjunktivIiEngine _engine;
  late GrammarTrainingItem _current;
  KonjunktivUsage _usage;
  int _seed;
  TrainingAttemptResult? _lastAttempt;

  GrammarTrainingItem get current => _current;
  KonjunktivUsage get usage => _usage;
  TrainingAttemptResult? get lastAttempt => _lastAttempt;
  bool get answered => _lastAttempt != null;

  TrainingAttemptResult submit(String candidate) {
    final correct = _current.accepts(candidate);
    final result = TrainingAttemptResult(
      item: _current,
      candidate: candidate.trim(),
      correct: correct,
      feedbackAr: correct
          ? 'إجابة صحيحة. ${_current.explanationAr}'
          : 'الإجابة الصحيحة: ${_current.expectedAnswer}. ${_current.explanationAr}',
    );
    _lastAttempt = result;
    return result;
  }

  GrammarTrainingItem next() {
    _seed += 17;
    _refresh();
    return _current;
  }

  GrammarTrainingItem setUsage(KonjunktivUsage usage) {
    _usage = usage;
    _seed += 7;
    _refresh();
    return _current;
  }

  void _refresh() {
    _current = _engine.generateTrainingItem(
      seed: _seed,
      usage: _usage,
    );
    _lastAttempt = null;
  }
}

final class ComparisonTrainingSession {
  ComparisonTrainingSession({
    ComparativeSuperlativeEngine engine =
        const ComparativeSuperlativeEngine(),
    ComparisonPattern pattern = ComparisonPattern.comparative,
    int seed = 2,
  })  : _engine = engine,
        _pattern = pattern,
        _seed = seed {
    _refresh();
  }

  final ComparativeSuperlativeEngine _engine;
  late GrammarTrainingItem _current;
  ComparisonPattern _pattern;
  int _seed;
  TrainingAttemptResult? _lastAttempt;

  GrammarTrainingItem get current => _current;
  ComparisonPattern get pattern => _pattern;
  TrainingAttemptResult? get lastAttempt => _lastAttempt;
  bool get answered => _lastAttempt != null;

  TrainingAttemptResult submit(String candidate) {
    final correct = _current.accepts(candidate);
    final result = TrainingAttemptResult(
      item: _current,
      candidate: candidate.trim(),
      correct: correct,
      feedbackAr: correct
          ? 'إجابة صحيحة. ${_current.explanationAr}'
          : 'الإجابة الصحيحة: ${_current.expectedAnswer}. ${_current.explanationAr}',
    );
    _lastAttempt = result;
    return result;
  }

  GrammarTrainingItem next() {
    _seed += 19;
    _refresh();
    return _current;
  }

  GrammarTrainingItem setPattern(ComparisonPattern pattern) {
    _pattern = pattern;
    _seed += 5;
    _refresh();
    return _current;
  }

  void _refresh() {
    _current = _engine.generateTrainingItem(
      seed: _seed,
      pattern: _pattern,
    );
    _lastAttempt = null;
  }
}


--------------------------------------------------
FILE: lib/core/grammar_engines/konjunktiv_ii_engine.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'grammar_engine_models.dart';

final class KonjunktivIiEngine {
  const KonjunktivIiEngine();

  static const List<String> _endings = <String>[
    'e', 'est', 'e', 'en', 'et', 'en',
  ];

  static const List<String> _wuerdeForms = <String>[
    'würde', 'würdest', 'würde', 'würden', 'würdet', 'würden',
  ];

  static const Map<String, List<String>> _specialParadigms =
      <String, List<String>>{
    'sein': <String>['wäre', 'wärst', 'wäre', 'wären', 'wärt', 'wären'],
  };

  static const Set<String> _defaultSyntheticVerbs = <String>{
    'sein', 'haben', 'werden', 'können', 'müssen', 'dürfen',
    'sollen', 'wollen', 'mögen', 'wissen', 'brauchen',
  };

  static const Map<String, String> _syntheticStems = <String, String>{
    'sein': 'wär',
    'haben': 'hätt',
    'werden': 'würd',
    'können': 'könnt',
    'müssen': 'müsst',
    'dürfen': 'dürft',
    'sollen': 'sollt',
    'wollen': 'wollt',
    'mögen': 'möcht',
    'wissen': 'wüsst',
    'brauchen': 'bräucht',
    'kommen': 'käm',
    'gehen': 'ging',
    'fahren': 'führ',
    'finden': 'fänd',
    'geben': 'gäb',
    'nehmen': 'nähm',
    'lassen': 'ließ',
    'bleiben': 'blieb',
    'stehen': 'stünd',
    'tun': 'tät',
    'sehen': 'säh',
    'sprechen': 'spräch',
    'helfen': 'hülf',
    'schreiben': 'schrieb',
    'lesen': 'läs',
    'schlafen': 'schlief',
    'tragen': 'trüg',
    'essen': 'äß',
  };

  KonjunktivForm conjugate(
    String infinitive,
    GermanPerson person, {
    bool forceSynthetic = false,
  }) {
    final verb = _normalizeInfinitive(infinitive);
    final special = _specialParadigms[verb];
    final stem = _syntheticStems[verb];
    final useSynthetic = forceSynthetic || _defaultSyntheticVerbs.contains(verb);

    if (useSynthetic && special != null) {
      final surface = special[person.paradigmIndex];
      return KonjunktivForm(
        infinitive: verb,
        person: person,
        surface: surface,
        construction: KonjunktivConstruction.synthetic,
        explanationAr:
            'هذه صيغة Konjunktiv II أصلية شائعة للفعل $verb، وتُستخدم مباشرة دون würde.',
      );
    }

    if (useSynthetic && stem != null) {
      final surface = '${stem}${_endings[person.paradigmIndex]}';
      return KonjunktivForm(
        infinitive: verb,
        person: person,
        surface: surface,
        construction: KonjunktivConstruction.synthetic,
        explanationAr:
            'هذه صيغة Konjunktiv II أصلية شائعة للفعل $verb، لذلك تُفضّل على würde + Infinitiv في الاستعمال الطبيعي.',
      );
    }

    final finiteWuerde = _wuerdeForms[person.paradigmIndex];
    return KonjunktivForm(
      infinitive: verb,
      person: person,
      surface: '$finiteWuerde $verb',
      construction: KonjunktivConstruction.wuerdeInfinitive,
      explanationAr:
          'يُستخدم $finiteWuerde مع المصدر $verb لأن würde + Infinitiv هو البناء العملي الواضح لهذا الفعل.',
    );
  }

  bool validateForm({
    required String infinitive,
    required GermanPerson person,
    required String candidate,
    bool forceSynthetic = false,
  }) {
    final expected = conjugate(
      infinitive,
      person,
      forceSynthetic: forceSynthetic,
    );
    return normalizeGermanInput(candidate) ==
        normalizeGermanInput(expected.surface);
  }

  String buildPreference({
    String nounPhrase = '',
    GermanPerson person = GermanPerson.ich,
    String infinitive = 'haben',
  }) {
    final verb = _normalizeInfinitive(infinitive);
    final complement = _cleanPhrase(nounPhrase);
    final form = conjugate(verb, person);
    final subject = person.sentenceSubject;

    if (form.construction == KonjunktivConstruction.synthetic) {
      return _sentence(
        '$subject ${form.surface} gern'
        '${complement.isEmpty ? '' : ' $complement'}',
      );
    }

    final finite = _wuerdeForms[person.paradigmIndex];
    return _sentence(
      '$subject $finite gern'
      '${complement.isEmpty ? '' : ' $complement'} $verb',
    );
  }

  String buildWish({
    required GermanPerson person,
    required String infinitive,
    required String complement,
    bool withGern = true,
  }) {
    final verb = _normalizeInfinitive(infinitive);
    final cleanComplement = _cleanPhrase(complement);
    final form = conjugate(verb, person);
    final subject = person.sentenceSubject;
    final gern = withGern ? ' gern' : '';

    if (form.construction == KonjunktivConstruction.synthetic) {
      return _sentence(
        '$subject ${form.surface}$gern'
        '${cleanComplement.isEmpty ? '' : ' $cleanComplement'}',
      );
    }

    final finite = _wuerdeForms[person.paradigmIndex];
    return _sentence(
      '$subject $finite$gern'
      '${cleanComplement.isEmpty ? '' : ' $cleanComplement'} $verb',
    );
  }

  String buildPoliteRequest({
    required String infinitive,
    required String complement,
    bool formal = true,
    bool abilityStyle = false,
    bool includeBitte = true,
  }) {
    final verb = _normalizeInfinitive(infinitive);
    final cleanComplement = _cleanPhrase(complement);
    final person = formal ? GermanPerson.sieFormal : GermanPerson.du;
    final subject = person.pronoun;
    final finite = abilityStyle
        ? conjugate('können', person).surface
        : _wuerdeForms[person.paradigmIndex];
    final leading = _capitalize(finite);
    final middle = <String>[
      if (cleanComplement.isNotEmpty) cleanComplement,
      if (includeBitte) 'bitte',
    ].join(' ');

    return '$leading $subject'
        '${middle.isEmpty ? '' : ' $middle'} $verb?';
  }

  String buildHypothetical({
    required GermanPerson conditionPerson,
    required String conditionInfinitive,
    required String conditionComplement,
    required GermanPerson resultPerson,
    required String resultInfinitive,
    required String resultComplement,
  }) {
    final conditionVerb = _normalizeInfinitive(conditionInfinitive);
    final resultVerb = _normalizeInfinitive(resultInfinitive);
    final conditionForm = conjugate(conditionVerb, conditionPerson);
    final resultForm = conjugate(resultVerb, resultPerson);
    final cleanCondition = _cleanPhrase(conditionComplement);
    final conditionTail = _subordinateTail(conditionForm);
    final resultClause = _mainClause(
      form: resultForm,
      complement: _cleanPhrase(resultComplement),
    );

    return 'Wenn ${conditionPerson.pronoun}'
        '${cleanCondition.isEmpty ? '' : ' $cleanCondition'}'
        ' $conditionTail, $resultClause.';
  }

  String buildAdvice({
    required String infinitive,
    required String complement,
    bool formalAddressee = false,
  }) {
    final verb = _normalizeInfinitive(infinitive);
    final cleanComplement = _cleanPhrase(complement);
    final opening = formalAddressee ? 'An Ihrer Stelle' : 'An deiner Stelle';
    return _sentence(
      '$opening würde ich'
      '${cleanComplement.isEmpty ? '' : ' $cleanComplement'} $verb',
    );
  }

  GrammarTrainingItem generateTrainingItem({
    required int seed,
    KonjunktivUsage? usage,
  }) {
    final selectedUsage =
        usage ?? KonjunktivUsage.values[_index(seed, KonjunktivUsage.values.length)];
    return switch (selectedUsage) {
      KonjunktivUsage.politeRequest => _politeRequestItem(seed),
      KonjunktivUsage.wish => _wishItem(seed),
      KonjunktivUsage.hypotheticalCondition => _hypotheticalItem(seed),
      KonjunktivUsage.advice => _adviceItem(seed),
    };
  }

  List<GrammarTrainingItem> generateExamples({
    required int seed,
    int count = 6,
    KonjunktivUsage? usage,
  }) {
    if (count <= 0) return const <GrammarTrainingItem>[];
    return List<GrammarTrainingItem>.generate(
      count,
      (index) => generateTrainingItem(
        seed: seed + index * 17,
        usage: usage,
      ),
      growable: false,
    );
  }

  GrammarTrainingItem _politeRequestItem(int seed) {
    const scenarios = <({String verb, String complement, bool ability, String ar})>[
      (verb: 'bringen', complement: 'mir die Rechnung', ability: false, ar: 'اطلب الفاتورة بلطف'),
      (verb: 'helfen', complement: 'mir', ability: true, ar: 'اطلب المساعدة بصيغة مهذبة'),
      (verb: 'schließen', complement: 'das Fenster', ability: false, ar: 'اطلب إغلاق النافذة بلطف'),
      (verb: 'erklären', complement: 'mir den Weg', ability: true, ar: 'اطلب شرح الطريق بلطف'),
    ];
    final item = scenarios[_index(seed, scenarios.length)];
    final full = buildPoliteRequest(
      infinitive: item.verb,
      complement: item.complement,
      abilityStyle: item.ability,
    );
    final expected = full.split(' ').first;
    final blank = full.replaceFirst(expected, '___');

    return GrammarTrainingItem(
      id: 'k2_request_${_index(seed, 100000)}',
      category: KonjunktivUsage.politeRequest.labelAr,
      promptAr: item.ar,
      sentenceWithBlank: blank,
      expectedAnswer: expected,
      fullSentence: full,
      explanationAr: item.ability
          ? 'في الطلب المهذب مع Sie نستخدم könnten + فاعل + بقية الجملة، ثم يأتي المصدر في النهاية.'
          : 'würden + Sie تخفف مباشرة الطلب، ويبقى الفعل الأساسي في صيغة المصدر في النهاية.',
    );
  }

  GrammarTrainingItem _wishItem(int seed) {
    const scenarios = <({String verb, String complement, String ar})>[
      (verb: 'haben', complement: 'mehr Zeit', ar: 'تمنَّ وقتاً أكثر'),
      (verb: 'sein', complement: 'am Meer', ar: 'تمنَّ أن تكون عند البحر'),
      (verb: 'bleiben', complement: 'länger', ar: 'عبّر عن رغبتك بالبقاء مدة أطول'),
      (verb: 'reisen', complement: 'öfter', ar: 'عبّر عن رغبتك بالسفر أكثر'),
    ];
    final item = scenarios[_index(seed, scenarios.length)];
    final full = buildWish(
      person: GermanPerson.ich,
      infinitive: item.verb,
      complement: item.complement,
    );
    final parts = full.split(' ');
    final expected = parts.length > 1 ? parts[1] : '';
    final blank = full.replaceFirst(expected, '___');

    return GrammarTrainingItem(
      id: 'k2_wish_${_index(seed, 100000)}',
      category: KonjunktivUsage.wish.labelAr,
      promptAr: item.ar,
      sentenceWithBlank: blank,
      expectedAnswer: expected,
      fullSentence: full,
      explanationAr: conjugate(item.verb, GermanPerson.ich).explanationAr,
    );
  }

  GrammarTrainingItem _hypotheticalItem(int seed) {
    const scenarios = <({
      String conditionVerb,
      String conditionComplement,
      String resultVerb,
      String resultComplement,
      String ar,
    })>[
      (
        conditionVerb: 'haben',
        conditionComplement: 'mehr Zeit',
        resultVerb: 'reisen',
        resultComplement: 'öfter',
        ar: 'لو كان لدي وقت أكثر لسافرت أكثر',
      ),
      (
        conditionVerb: 'sein',
        conditionComplement: 'näher',
        resultVerb: 'kommen',
        resultComplement: 'jeden Tag',
        ar: 'لو كنت أقرب لأتيت كل يوم',
      ),
      (
        conditionVerb: 'können',
        conditionComplement: 'früher gehen',
        resultVerb: 'helfen',
        resultComplement: 'dir danach',
        ar: 'لو استطعت المغادرة أبكر لساعدتك بعدها',
      ),
    ];
    final item = scenarios[_index(seed, scenarios.length)];
    final full = buildHypothetical(
      conditionPerson: GermanPerson.ich,
      conditionInfinitive: item.conditionVerb,
      conditionComplement: item.conditionComplement,
      resultPerson: GermanPerson.ich,
      resultInfinitive: item.resultVerb,
      resultComplement: item.resultComplement,
    );
    final condition = conjugate(item.conditionVerb, GermanPerson.ich);
    final expected = condition.construction == KonjunktivConstruction.synthetic
        ? condition.surface
        : _wuerdeForms[GermanPerson.ich.paradigmIndex];
    final blank = full.replaceFirst(expected, '___');

    return GrammarTrainingItem(
      id: 'k2_hyp_${_index(seed, 100000)}',
      category: KonjunktivUsage.hypotheticalCondition.labelAr,
      promptAr: item.ar,
      sentenceWithBlank: blank,
      expectedAnswer: expected,
      fullSentence: full,
      explanationAr:
          'في جملة wenn يذهب الجزء المصرف إلى نهاية الجملة الفرعية؛ وفي الجملة الرئيسية يبقى الفعل المصرف في الموقع الثاني.',
    );
  }

  GrammarTrainingItem _adviceItem(int seed) {
    const scenarios = <({String verb, String complement, String ar})>[
      (verb: 'lernen', complement: 'jeden Tag etwas', ar: 'انصح بالدراسة يومياً'),
      (verb: 'schlafen', complement: 'mehr', ar: 'انصح بالنوم أكثر'),
      (verb: 'sprechen', complement: 'öfter Deutsch', ar: 'انصح بالتحدث بالألمانية أكثر'),
      (verb: 'machen', complement: 'regelmäßig eine Pause', ar: 'انصح بأخذ استراحة بانتظام'),
    ];
    final item = scenarios[_index(seed, scenarios.length)];
    final full = buildAdvice(
      infinitive: item.verb,
      complement: item.complement,
    );
    final blank = full.replaceFirst('würde', '___');

    return GrammarTrainingItem(
      id: 'k2_advice_${_index(seed, 100000)}',
      category: KonjunktivUsage.advice.labelAr,
      promptAr: item.ar,
      sentenceWithBlank: blank,
      expectedAnswer: 'würde',
      fullSentence: full,
      explanationAr:
          'An deiner Stelle + würde ich + Infinitiv صيغة شائعة لتقديم نصيحة دون تحويلها إلى أمر مباشر.',
    );
  }

  String _subordinateTail(KonjunktivForm form) {
    if (form.construction == KonjunktivConstruction.synthetic) {
      return form.surface;
    }
    return '${form.infinitive} ${_wuerdeForms[form.person.paradigmIndex]}';
  }

  String _mainClause({
    required KonjunktivForm form,
    required String complement,
  }) {
    final subject = form.person.pronoun;
    if (form.construction == KonjunktivConstruction.synthetic) {
      return '$subject ${form.surface}'
          '${complement.isEmpty ? '' : ' $complement'}';
    }
    final finite = _wuerdeForms[form.person.paradigmIndex];
    return '$subject $finite'
        '${complement.isEmpty ? '' : ' $complement'} ${form.infinitive}';
  }

  String _normalizeInfinitive(String value) {
    final result = value.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (result.isEmpty || result.contains(RegExp(r'\s'))) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        value,
        'infinitive',
        'Expected one German infinitive token.',
      );
    }
    return result;
  }

  String _cleanPhrase(String value) =>
      value.trim().replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');

  String _sentence(String body) => '${body.trim()}.';

  String _capitalize(String value) =>
      value.isEmpty ? value : '${value[0].toUpperCase()}${value.substring(1)}';


  int _index(int seed, int length) {
    final nonNegative = seed < 0 ? -seed : seed;
    return nonNegative % length;
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

enum AudioServiceState { idle, playing, paused, error }

enum AudioServiceFailureCode {
  invalidRequest,
  playbackFailed,
  pauseFailed,
  stopFailed,
  disposed,
}

final class AudioServiceFailure implements Exception {
  const AudioServiceFailure(this.code);

  final AudioServiceFailureCode code;

  @override
  String toString() => 'AudioServiceFailure($code)';
}

abstract interface class GermanAudioEngine {
  Future<void> speakGerman(String text, {required double rate});
  Future<void> pause();
  Future<void> stop();
  Future<void> dispose();
}

abstract interface class AudioService {
  AudioServiceState get state;
  Stream<AudioServiceState> get states;

  Future<void> speakGerman(String text, {double rate = .46});
  Future<void> pause();
  Future<void> stop();
  Future<void> dispose();
}

final class ManagedAudioService implements AudioService {
  ManagedAudioService(this._engine);

  final GermanAudioEngine _engine;
  final StreamController<AudioServiceState> _states =
      StreamController<AudioServiceState>.broadcast();

  AudioServiceState _state = AudioServiceState.idle;
  int _generation = 0;
  bool _disposed = false;

  @override
  AudioServiceState get state => _state;

  @override
  Stream<AudioServiceState> get states => _states.stream;

  @override
  Future<void> speakGerman(String text, {double rate = .46}) async {
    _ensureActive();
    final normalized = text.trim();
    if (normalized.isEmpty || rate < .1 || rate > 1.0) {
      throw const AudioServiceFailure(AudioServiceFailureCode.invalidRequest);
    }

    final generation = ++_generation;
    _emit(AudioServiceState.playing);
    try {
      await _engine.speakGerman(normalized, rate: rate);
      if (!_disposed &&
          generation == _generation &&
          _state == AudioServiceState.playing) {
        _emit(AudioServiceState.idle);
      }
    } on AudioServiceFailure {
      rethrow;
    } on Object {
      if (!_disposed && generation == _generation) {
        _emit(AudioServiceState.error);
      }
      throw const AudioServiceFailure(
        AudioServiceFailureCode.playbackFailed,
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> pause() async {
    _ensureActive();
    if (_state != AudioServiceState.playing) return;
    ++_generation;
    try {
      await _engine.pause();
      _emit(AudioServiceState.paused);
    } on Object {
      _emit(AudioServiceState.error);
      throw const AudioServiceFailure(AudioServiceFailureCode.pauseFailed);
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> stop() async {
    _ensureActive();
    ++_generation;
    try {
      await _engine.stop();
      _emit(AudioServiceState.idle);
    } on Object {
      _emit(AudioServiceState.error);
      throw const AudioServiceFailure(AudioServiceFailureCode.stopFailed);
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> dispose() async {
    if (_disposed) return;
    _disposed = true;
    ++_generation;
    try {
      await _engine.dispose();
    } finally {
      await _states.close();
    }
  }

  void _emit(AudioServiceState next) {
    if (_disposed || _states.isClosed) return;
    _state = next;
    _states.add(next);
  }

  void _ensureActive() {
    if (_disposed) {
      throw const AudioServiceFailure(AudioServiceFailureCode.disposed);
    }
  }
}

import 'package:flutter_tts/flutter_tts.dart';

import '../../../features/audio/domain/services/offline_tts_engine.dart';
import '../../../language/german/german_speech_profile.dart';
import '../../../language/language_speech_profile.dart';
import 'audio_service.dart';

final class FlutterOfflineTtsEngine
    implements OfflineTtsEngine, GermanAudioEngine {
  FlutterOfflineTtsEngine({FlutterTts? engine})
      : _engine = engine ?? FlutterTts();

  final FlutterTts _engine;
  Map<String, String>? _selectedVoice;
  String? _selectedLanguage;
  bool _closed = false;

  @override
  Future<OfflineTtsAvailability> probe(LanguageSpeechProfile profile) async {
    if (_closed) return OfflineTtsAvailability.unavailable;
    if (_selectedVoice != null && _selectedLanguage == profile.languageCode) {
      return OfflineTtsAvailability.ready;
    }
    try {
      final rawVoices = await _engine.getVoices;
      if (rawVoices is! List) return OfflineTtsAvailability.unavailable;
      final voice = selectOfflineVoice(
        rawVoices,
        profile.preferredTtsLocales,
      );
      if (voice == null) return OfflineTtsAvailability.unavailable;

      final locale = voice['locale'];
      if (locale == null || locale.isEmpty) {
        return OfflineTtsAvailability.unavailable;
      }
      final installed = await _engine.isLanguageInstalled(locale);
      if (installed != true) {
        return OfflineTtsAvailability.unavailable;
      }

      _selectedVoice = voice;
      _selectedLanguage = profile.languageCode;
      return OfflineTtsAvailability.ready;
    } on Object {
      return OfflineTtsAvailability.unavailable;
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<bool> speak({
    required String text,
    required LanguageSpeechProfile profile,
    required double rate,
  }) async {
    if (_closed || text.trim().isEmpty) return false;
    if (await probe(profile) != OfflineTtsAvailability.ready) return false;
    final voice = _selectedVoice;
    if (voice == null) return false;
    try {
      await _engine.stop();
      await _engine.setVoice(voice);
      await _engine.setLanguage(voice['locale']!);
      await _engine.setSpeechRate(rate.clamp(.1, 1.0));
      await _engine.setPitch(1.0);
      await _engine.setVolume(1.0);
      await _engine.awaitSpeakCompletion(true);
      final result = await _engine.speak(text.trim());
      return result == 1 || result == true || result == null;
    } on Object {
      return false;
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> speakGerman(String text, {required double rate}) async {
    final spoken = await speak(
      text: text,
      profile: const GermanSpeechProfile(),
      rate: rate,
    );
    if (!spoken) throw StateError('offline_german_tts_unavailable');
  }

  @override
  Future<void> pause() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    await _engine.pause();
  }

  @override
  Future<void> stop() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    try {
      await _engine.stop();
    } on Object {
      // Platform failures remain inside the infrastructure adapter boundary.
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> shutdown() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    _closed = true;
    try {
      await _engine.stop();
    } on Object {
      // Platform failures remain inside the infrastructure adapter boundary.
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> dispose() => shutdown();

  static Map<String, String>? selectOfflineVoice(
    List<dynamic> voices,
    List<String> preferredLocales,
  ) {
    final preferred = preferredLocales
        .map(_normalizeLocale)
        .where((value) => value.isNotEmpty)
        .toList(growable: false);

    for (final locale in preferred) {
      for (final raw in voices) {
        if (raw is! Map) continue;
        final normalized = <String, String>{
          for (final entry in raw.entries)
            entry.key.toString(): entry.value.toString(),
        };
        final voiceLocale = _normalizeLocale(normalized['locale'] ?? '');
        if (voiceLocale != locale && !voiceLocale.startsWith('$locale-')) {
          continue;
        }
        if (!_isStrictlyOfflineVoice(normalized)) continue;
        final name = normalized['name']?.trim() ?? '';
        if (name.isEmpty) continue;
        return <String, String>{
          'name': name,
          'locale': normalized['locale']!,
        };
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  static bool _isStrictlyOfflineVoice(Map<String, String> voice) {
    const networkKeys = <String>[
      'network_required',
      'networkRequired',
      'requiresNetwork',
    ];
    for (final key in networkKeys) {
      final value = (voice[key] ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (value == 'true' || value == '1' || value == 'yes') {
        return false;
      }
    }

    final features = (voice['features'] ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (features.contains('notinstalled') ||
        features.contains('networktts') ||
        features.contains('network_tts') ||
        features.contains('requiresnetwork')) {
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  static String _normalizeLocale(String value) =>
      value.trim().replaceAll('_', '-').toLowerCase();
}

import 'package:speech_to_text/speech_to_text.dart' as stt;

final class SpeechResult {
  const SpeechResult({
    required this.recognizedWords,
    required this.finalResult,
  });

  final String recognizedWords;
  final bool finalResult;
}

/// Infrastructure adapter that owns the speech_to_text plugin lifecycle.
///
/// A generation token makes late callbacks harmless after stop/dispose while
/// the operation guard prevents overlapping initialize/listen calls.
class SpeechToTextEngine {
  SpeechToTextEngine({this.localeId = 'de_DE', stt.SpeechToText? engine})
      : _engine = engine ?? stt.SpeechToText();

  final String localeId;
  final stt.SpeechToText _engine;
  bool initialized = false;
  bool _disposed = false;
  bool _operationBusy = false;
  int _generation = 0;

  Future<bool> initialize() async {
    if (_disposed || _operationBusy) return false;
    _operationBusy = true;
    try {
      initialized = await _engine.initialize();
      return !_disposed && initialized;
    } on Object {
      initialized = false;
      return false;
    } finally {
      _operationBusy = false;
    }
  }

  Future<bool> listen({
    required void Function(SpeechResult result) onResult,
  }) async {
    if (_disposed || _operationBusy) return false;
    _operationBusy = true;
    final generation = ++_generation;
    try {
      if (!initialized) {
        initialized = await _engine.initialize();
      }
      if (_disposed || !initialized) return false;
      await _engine.listen(
        listenOptions: stt.SpeechListenOptions(localeId: localeId),
        onResult: (result) {
          if (_disposed || generation != _generation) return;
          try {
            onResult(
              SpeechResult(
                recognizedWords: result.recognizedWords,
                finalResult: result.finalResult,
              ),
            );
          } on Object {
            // Consumer callback errors never escape the plugin boundary.
          }
        },
      );
      return !_disposed;
    } on Object {
      initialized = false;
      return false;
    } finally {
      _operationBusy = false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> stop() async {
    if (_disposed) return;
    ++_generation;
    try {
      await _engine.stop();
    } on Object {
      // Device plugin failures remain isolated in infrastructure.
    }
  }

  bool get isListening {
    if (_disposed) return false;
    try {
      return _engine.isListening;
    } on Object {
      return false;
    }
  }

  void dispose() {
    if (_disposed) return;
    _disposed = true;
    ++_generation;
    initialized = false;
    try {
      _engine.stop().catchError((_) {});
    } on Object {
      // Best-effort lifecycle cleanup.
    }
  }
}

FILE: lib/core/infrastructure/storage/local_storage_repository.dart

import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:cryptography/cryptography.dart';

import 'secure_storage_backend.dart';

enum StorageBucket {
  learnerProgress('learner_progress_v1'),
  srsIntervals('srs_intervals_v1'),
  errorBank('error_bank_v1'),
  gamification('gamification_v1'),
  syncPendingMutations('sync_pending_mutations_v1'),
  notificationPreferences('notification_preferences_v1'),
  lexiconUserData('lexicon_user_data_v1');

  const StorageBucket(this.storageKey);

  final String storageKey;
}

enum LocalStorageFailureCode {
  invalidPayload,
  readFailed,
  writeFailed,
  disposed,
}

final class LocalStorageFailure implements Exception {
  const LocalStorageFailure(this.code);

  final LocalStorageFailureCode code;

  @override
  String toString() => 'LocalStorageFailure($code)';
}

abstract interface class LocalStorageRepository {
  Future<void> save(StorageBucket bucket, Map<String, Object?> payload);
  Future<Map<String, Object?>?> load(StorageBucket bucket);
  Future<void> delete(StorageBucket bucket);
  Future<void> dispose();
}

final class ResilientLocalStorageRepository implements LocalStorageRepository {
  ResilientLocalStorageRepository(
    this._backend, {
    HashAlgorithm? hashAlgorithm,
  }) : _hashAlgorithm = hashAlgorithm ?? Sha256();

  final SecureStorageBackend _backend;
  final HashAlgorithm _hashAlgorithm;
  bool _disposed = false;

  @override
  Future<void> save(
    StorageBucket bucket,
    Map<String, Object?> payload,
  ) async {
    _ensureActive();

    late final String encoded;
    try {
      encoded = jsonEncode(payload);
    } on Object {
      throw const LocalStorageFailure(LocalStorageFailureCode.invalidPayload);
    }

    try {
      final digest = await _digest(encoded);
      final previous = await _backend.readRecord(bucket.storageKey);

      String? backupPayload;
      String? backupDigest;
      if (previous != null) {
        if (await _decodeValid(
              previous.primaryPayload,
              previous.primaryDigest,
            ) !=
            null) {
          backupPayload = previous.primaryPayload;
          backupDigest = previous.primaryDigest;
        } else if (previous.backupPayload != null &&
            previous.backupDigest != null &&
            await _decodeValid(
                  previous.backupPayload!,
                  previous.backupDigest!,
                ) !=
                null) {
          backupPayload = previous.backupPayload;
          backupDigest = previous.backupDigest;
        }
      }

      await _backend.writeRecord(
        bucket.storageKey,
        StorageRecord(
          primaryPayload: encoded,
          primaryDigest: digest,
          backupPayload: backupPayload,
          backupDigest: backupDigest,
        ),
      );
    } on LocalStorageFailure {
      rethrow;
    } on Object {
      throw const LocalStorageFailure(LocalStorageFailureCode.writeFailed);
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<Map<String, Object?>?> load(StorageBucket bucket) async {
    _ensureActive();

    StorageRecord? record;
    try {
      record = await _backend.readRecord(bucket.storageKey);
    } on Object {
      throw const LocalStorageFailure(LocalStorageFailureCode.readFailed);
    }
    if (record == null) return null;

    final primary = await _decodeValid(
      record.primaryPayload,
      record.primaryDigest,
    );
    if (primary != null) return primary;

    final backupPayload = record.backupPayload;
    final backupDigest = record.backupDigest;
    if (backupPayload != null && backupDigest != null) {
      final backup = await _decodeValid(backupPayload, backupDigest);
      if (backup != null) {
        try {
          await _backend.writeRecord(
            bucket.storageKey,
            StorageRecord(
              primaryPayload: backupPayload,
              primaryDigest: backupDigest,
              backupPayload: backupPayload,
              backupDigest: backupDigest,
            ),
          );
        } on Object {
          // The recovered in-memory value is still safe to return. A later
          // write can repair the physical row if this best-effort repair fails.
        }
        return backup;
      }
    }

    try {
      await _backend.deleteRecord(bucket.storageKey);
    } on Object {
      // A corrupt row is treated as unavailable even if cleanup is deferred.
    }
    return null;
  }

  @override
  Future<void> delete(StorageBucket bucket) async {
    _ensureActive();
    try {
      await _backend.deleteRecord(bucket.storageKey);
    } on Object {
      throw const LocalStorageFailure(LocalStorageFailureCode.writeFailed);
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> dispose() async {
    if (_disposed) return;
    _disposed = true;
    await _backend.dispose();
  }

  Future<String> _digest(String payload) async {
    final digest = await _hashAlgorithm.hash(utf8.encode(payload));
    return base64UrlEncode(digest.bytes);
  }

  Future<Map<String, Object?>?> _decodeValid(
    String payload,
    String expectedDigest,
  ) async {
    if (await _digest(payload) != expectedDigest) return null;
    try {
      final decoded = jsonDecode(payload);
      if (decoded is! Map) return null;
      return <String, Object?>{
        for (final entry in decoded.entries)
          if (entry.key is String) (entry.key as String): entry.value,
      };
    } on Object {
      return null;
    }
  }

  void _ensureActive() {
    if (_disposed) {
      throw const LocalStorageFailure(LocalStorageFailureCode.disposed);
    }
  }
}

abstract interface class SecureStorageBackend {
  Future<StorageRecord?> readRecord(String key);
  Future<void> writeRecord(String key, StorageRecord record);
  Future<void> deleteRecord(String key);
  Future<void> dispose();
}

final class StorageRecord {
  const StorageRecord({
    required this.primaryPayload,
    required this.primaryDigest,
    this.backupPayload,
    this.backupDigest,
  });

  final String primaryPayload;
  final String primaryDigest;
  final String? backupPayload;
  final String? backupDigest;

  StorageRecord copyWith({
    String? primaryPayload,
    String? primaryDigest,
    String? backupPayload,
    String? backupDigest,
  }) {
    return StorageRecord(
      primaryPayload: primaryPayload ?? this.primaryPayload,
      primaryDigest: primaryDigest ?? this.primaryDigest,
      backupPayload: backupPayload ?? this.backupPayload,
      backupDigest: backupDigest ?? this.backupDigest,
    );
  }
}

final class SecureStorageBackendException implements Exception {
  const SecureStorageBackendException(this.code);

  final String code;

  @override
  String toString() => 'SecureStorageBackendException($code)';
}

import 'package:sqflite_common/sqlite_api.dart';
import 'package:sqflite_sqlcipher/sqflite.dart' as sqlcipher;

import 'secure_storage_backend.dart';

final class SqlCipherStorageBackend implements SecureStorageBackend {
  SqlCipherStorageBackend._(this._database);

  static const String _table = 'local_secure_records';
  final Database _database;
  bool _disposed = false;

  static Future<SqlCipherStorageBackend> open({
    required String path,
    required String passphrase,
  }) async {
    if (passphrase.trim().length < 32) {
      throw const SecureStorageBackendException(
        'secure_storage_passphrase_too_short',
      );
    }

    Database? database;
    try {
      database = await sqlcipher.openDatabase(
        path,
        password: passphrase,
        version: 1,
        singleInstance: true,
        onCreate: (db, _) async {
          await db.execute(
            'CREATE TABLE $_table ('
            'record_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, '
            'primary_payload TEXT NOT NULL, '
            'primary_digest TEXT NOT NULL, '
            'backup_payload TEXT, '
            'backup_digest TEXT, '
            'updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL'
            ')',
          );
        },
      );
      await _assertCipher(database);
      await _assertIntegrity(database);
      return SqlCipherStorageBackend._(database);
    } on SecureStorageBackendException {
      if (database != null) await database.close();
      rethrow;
    } on Object {
      if (database != null) await database.close();
      throw const SecureStorageBackendException('secure_storage_open_failed');
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<StorageRecord?> readRecord(String key) async {
    _ensureActive();
    try {
      final rows = await _database.query(
        _table,
        columns: const <String>[
          'primary_payload',
          'primary_digest',
          'backup_payload',
          'backup_digest',
        ],
        where: 'record_key = ?',
        whereArgs: <Object?>[key],
        limit: 1,
      );
      if (rows.isEmpty) return null;
      final row = rows.first;
      return StorageRecord(
        primaryPayload: row['primary_payload'] as String,
        primaryDigest: row['primary_digest'] as String,
        backupPayload: row['backup_payload'] as String?,
        backupDigest: row['backup_digest'] as String?,
      );
    } on SecureStorageBackendException {
      rethrow;
    } on Object {
      throw const SecureStorageBackendException('secure_storage_read_failed');
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> writeRecord(String key, StorageRecord record) async {
    _ensureActive();
    try {
      await _database.insert(
        _table,
        <String, Object?>{
          'record_key': key,
          'primary_payload': record.primaryPayload,
          'primary_digest': record.primaryDigest,
          'backup_payload': record.backupPayload,
          'backup_digest': record.backupDigest,
          'updated_at': DateTime.now().toUtc().millisecondsSinceEpoch,
        },
        conflictAlgorithm: ConflictAlgorithm.replace,
      );
    } on Object {
      throw const SecureStorageBackendException('secure_storage_write_failed');
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> deleteRecord(String key) async {
    _ensureActive();
    try {
      await _database.delete(
        _table,
        where: 'record_key = ?',
        whereArgs: <Object?>[key],
      );
    } on Object {
      throw const SecureStorageBackendException('secure_storage_delete_failed');
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> dispose() async {
    if (_disposed) return;
    _disposed = true;
    await _database.close();
  }

  static Future<void> _assertCipher(Database database) async {
    final rows = await database.rawQuery('PRAGMA cipher_version');
    if (rows.isEmpty ||
        rows.first.values.isEmpty ||
        rows.first.values.first.toString().trim().isEmpty) {
      throw const SecureStorageBackendException(
        'secure_storage_cipher_unavailable',
      );
    }
  }

  static Future<void> _assertIntegrity(Database database) async {
    final cipherErrors = await database.rawQuery(
      'PRAGMA cipher_integrity_check',
    );
    if (cipherErrors.isNotEmpty) {
      throw const SecureStorageBackendException(
        'secure_storage_cipher_integrity_failed',
      );
    }
    final logical = await database.rawQuery('PRAGMA integrity_check');
    if (logical.isEmpty ||
        logical.first.values.isEmpty ||
        logical.first.values.first.toString().trim().toLowerCase() != 'ok') {
      throw const SecureStorageBackendException(
        'secure_storage_sqlite_integrity_failed',
      );
    }
  }

  void _ensureActive() {
    if (_disposed) {
      throw const SecureStorageBackendException('secure_storage_disposed');
    }
  }
}

import 'unit_test_automation.dart';
import 'workflow_build_fixer.dart';

final class CiCdWorkflowReport {
  const CiCdWorkflowReport({
    required this.workflow,
    required this.tests,
  });

  final WorkflowRepairResult workflow;
  final UnitTestPlan tests;

  bool get isReady => workflow.issuesAfter.isEmpty && !tests.isEmpty;
}

final class CiCdWorkflowHub {
  const CiCdWorkflowHub({
    this.workflowFixer = const WorkflowBuildFixer(),
    this.testAutomation = const UnitTestAutomation(),
  });

  final WorkflowBuildFixer workflowFixer;
  final UnitTestAutomation testAutomation;

  CiCdWorkflowReport prepare({
    required String workflowYaml,
    required List<UnitTestModule> modules,
  }) {
    return CiCdWorkflowReport(
      workflow: workflowFixer.repair(workflowYaml),
      tests: testAutomation.plan(modules),
    );
  }
}

final class UnitTestModule {
  const UnitTestModule({
    required this.id,
    required this.testPath,
  });

  final String id;
  final String testPath;
}

final class UnitTestCommand {
  const UnitTestCommand({
    required this.moduleId,
    required this.testPath,
    required this.command,
  });

  final String moduleId;
  final String testPath;
  final String command;
}

final class UnitTestPlan {
  const UnitTestPlan({
    required this.commands,
    required this.workflowStepsYaml,
  });

  final List<UnitTestCommand> commands;
  final String workflowStepsYaml;

  bool get isEmpty => commands.isEmpty;
}

final class UnitTestAutomation {
  const UnitTestAutomation();

  UnitTestPlan plan(List<UnitTestModule> modules) {
    final seenPaths = <String>{};
    final commands = <UnitTestCommand>[];

    for (final module in modules) {
      final id = module.id.trim();
      final path = module.testPath.trim();

      if (id.isEmpty) {
        throw ArgumentError.value(module.id, 'id', 'Module id cannot be empty.');
      }
      if (!_isSafeTestPath(path)) {
        throw ArgumentError.value(
          module.testPath,
          'testPath',
          'Test path must remain inside test/ and contain safe characters.',
        );
      }
      if (!seenPaths.add(path)) continue;

      commands.add(
        UnitTestCommand(
          moduleId: id,
          testPath: path,
          command: 'flutter test ' + path,
        ),
      );
    }

    final workflowLines = <String>[];
    for (final item in commands) {
      workflowLines
        ..add('- name: Unit tests - ' + item.moduleId)
        ..add('  run: ' + item.command);
    }

    return UnitTestPlan(
      commands: List<UnitTestCommand>.unmodifiable(commands),
      workflowStepsYaml: workflowLines.join('\n'),
    );
  }

  bool _isSafeTestPath(String path) {
    if (!path.startsWith('test/')) return false;
    if (path.contains('..') || path.contains('\n') || path.contains('\r')) {
      return false;
    }
    return RegExp(r'^[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+$').hasMatch(path);
  }
}

FILE: lib/core/infrastructure/sys_ci_cd_workflow_fixer/workflow_build_fixer.dart

enum WorkflowIssueCode {
  missingJobs,
  missingSteps,
  missingCheckout,
  missingFlutterSetup,
  missingPubGet,
  buildBeforeDependencyInstall,
  unpinnedKnownAction,
}

final class WorkflowIssue {
  const WorkflowIssue({
    required this.code,
    required this.message,
    this.line,
  });

  final WorkflowIssueCode code;
  final String message;
  final int? line;
}

final class WorkflowRepairResult {
  const WorkflowRepairResult({
    required this.originalYaml,
    required this.repairedYaml,
    required this.issuesBefore,
    required this.issuesAfter,
    required this.changes,
  });

  final String originalYaml;
  final String repairedYaml;
  final List<WorkflowIssue> issuesBefore;
  final List<WorkflowIssue> issuesAfter;
  final List<String> changes;

  bool get changed => originalYaml != repairedYaml;
}

final class WorkflowBuildFixer {
  const WorkflowBuildFixer();

  static const String checkoutAction =
      'actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262';
  static const String flutterAction =
      'subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2';

  List<WorkflowIssue> inspect(String yaml) {
    final lines = yaml.split('\n');
    final issues = <WorkflowIssue>[];

    final jobsIndex = _indexOfTrimmed(lines, 'jobs:');
    if (jobsIndex < 0) {
      issues.add(
        const WorkflowIssue(
          code: WorkflowIssueCode.missingJobs,
          message: 'Workflow is missing a jobs section.',
        ),
      );
      return List<WorkflowIssue>.unmodifiable(issues);
    }

    final stepsIndex = _indexOfTrimmed(lines, 'steps:');
    if (stepsIndex < 0) {
      issues.add(
        const WorkflowIssue(
          code: WorkflowIssueCode.missingSteps,
          message: 'Workflow is missing a steps section.',
        ),
      );
      return List<WorkflowIssue>.unmodifiable(issues);
    }

    final checkoutIndex = _indexContaining(lines, 'uses: actions/checkout@');
    final flutterIndex =
        _indexContaining(lines, 'uses: subosito/flutter-action@');
    final pubGetIndex = _indexContaining(lines, 'flutter pub get');
    final buildIndex = _indexContaining(lines, 'flutter build ');

    if (checkoutIndex < 0) {
      issues.add(
        const WorkflowIssue(
          code: WorkflowIssueCode.missingCheckout,
          message: 'Flutter jobs must checkout the source before build steps.',
        ),
      );
    }
    if (flutterIndex < 0) {
      issues.add(
        const WorkflowIssue(
          code: WorkflowIssueCode.missingFlutterSetup,
          message: 'Flutter jobs must set up Flutter before running commands.',
        ),
      );
    }
    if (buildIndex >= 0 && pubGetIndex < 0) {
      issues.add(
        const WorkflowIssue(
          code: WorkflowIssueCode.missingPubGet,
          message: 'Flutter build requires dependency installation first.',
        ),
      );
    }
    if (buildIndex >= 0 && pubGetIndex >= 0 && buildIndex < pubGetIndex) {
      issues.add(
        WorkflowIssue(
          code: WorkflowIssueCode.buildBeforeDependencyInstall,
          message: 'flutter pub get must run before flutter build.',
          line: buildIndex + 1,
        ),
      );
    }

    for (var index = 0; index < lines.length; index++) {
      final trimmed = lines[index].trim();
      if (_isFloatingKnownAction(trimmed, 'actions/checkout@') ||
          _isFloatingKnownAction(trimmed, 'subosito/flutter-action@')) {
        issues.add(
          WorkflowIssue(
            code: WorkflowIssueCode.unpinnedKnownAction,
            message: 'Known actions must be pinned to an exact commit SHA.',
            line: index + 1,
          ),
        );
      }
    }

    return List<WorkflowIssue>.unmodifiable(issues);
  }

  WorkflowRepairResult repair(String yaml) {
    final before = inspect(yaml);
    var lines = yaml.split('\n');
    final changes = <String>[];

    lines = lines.map((line) {
      final trimmed = line.trim();
      if (_isFloatingKnownAction(trimmed, 'actions/checkout@')) {
        changes.add('Pinned actions/checkout to the approved SHA.');
        return _replaceActionRef(line, 'actions/checkout@', checkoutAction);
      }
      if (_isFloatingKnownAction(trimmed, 'subosito/flutter-action@')) {
        changes.add('Pinned subosito/flutter-action to the approved SHA.');
        return _replaceActionRef(
          line,
          'subosito/flutter-action@',
          flutterAction,
        );
      }
      return line;
    }).toList();

    final stepsIndex = _indexOfTrimmed(lines, 'steps:');
    if (stepsIndex >= 0) {
      var insertAt = stepsIndex + 1;
      final stepIndent = _leadingWhitespace(lines[stepsIndex]) + '  ';

      if (_indexContaining(lines, 'uses: actions/checkout@') < 0) {
        lines.insert(insertAt, stepIndent + '- uses: ' + checkoutAction);
        insertAt++;
        changes.add('Added source checkout step.');
      }
      if (_indexContaining(lines, 'uses: subosito/flutter-action@') < 0) {
        lines.insert(insertAt, stepIndent + '- uses: ' + flutterAction);
        insertAt++;
        changes.add('Added Flutter setup step.');
      }

      final buildIndex = _indexContaining(lines, 'flutter build ');
      var pubGetIndex = _indexContaining(lines, 'flutter pub get');
      if (buildIndex >= 0 && pubGetIndex < 0) {
        final indent = _leadingWhitespace(lines[buildIndex]);
        lines.insert(
          buildIndex,
          indent + '- run: flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile',
        );
        changes.add('Added dependency installation before build.');
      } else if (buildIndex >= 0 &&
          pubGetIndex >= 0 &&
          buildIndex < pubGetIndex) {
        final pubLine = lines.removeAt(pubGetIndex);
        final newBuildIndex = _indexContaining(lines, 'flutter build ');
        lines.insert(newBuildIndex, pubLine);
        changes.add('Moved dependency installation before build.');
      }
    }

    final repaired = lines.join('\n');
    return WorkflowRepairResult(
      originalYaml: yaml,
      repairedYaml: repaired,
      issuesBefore: before,
      issuesAfter: inspect(repaired),
      changes: List<String>.unmodifiable(changes),
    );
  }

  bool _isFloatingKnownAction(String line, String marker) {
    final markerIndex = line.indexOf(marker);
    if (markerIndex < 0) return false;
    final ref = line.substring(markerIndex + marker.length).split(' ').first;
    return !RegExp(r'^[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$').hasMatch(ref);
  }

  String _replaceActionRef(String line, String marker, String replacement) {
    final markerIndex = line.indexOf(marker);
    if (markerIndex < 0) return line;
    final prefix = line.substring(0, markerIndex);
    final rest = line.substring(markerIndex + marker.length);
    final suffixIndex = rest.indexOf(' ');
    final suffix = suffixIndex < 0 ? '' : rest.substring(suffixIndex);
    return prefix + replacement + suffix;
  }

  int _indexOfTrimmed(List<String> lines, String value) {
    for (var index = 0; index < lines.length; index++) {
      if (lines[index].trim() == value) return index;
    }
    return -1;
  }

  int _indexContaining(List<String> lines, String value) {
    for (var index = 0; index < lines.length; index++) {
      if (lines[index].contains(value)) return index;
    }
    return -1;
  }

  String _leadingWhitespace(String value) {
    final length = value.length - value.trimLeft().length;
    return value.substring(0, length);
  }
}

enum ArchitectureIssueCode {
  duplicateModule,
  unknownDependency,
  forbiddenDependency,
  dependencyCycle,
}

final class ArchitectureModule {
  const ArchitectureModule({
    required this.name,
    required this.layer,
    required this.dependencies,
  });

  final String name;
  final String layer;
  final List<String> dependencies;
}

final class ArchitecturePolicy {
  const ArchitecturePolicy({required this.allowedDependencies});

  final Map<String, Set<String>> allowedDependencies;

  bool allows(String fromLayer, String toLayer) {
    if (fromLayer == toLayer) {
      return allowedDependencies[fromLayer]?.contains(toLayer) ?? false;
    }
    return allowedDependencies[fromLayer]?.contains(toLayer) ?? false;
  }
}

final class ArchitectureIssue {
  const ArchitectureIssue({
    required this.code,
    required this.module,
    this.dependency,
    this.cycle = const <String>[],
  });

  final ArchitectureIssueCode code;
  final String module;
  final String? dependency;
  final List<String> cycle;
}

final class ArchitectureValidationResult {
  const ArchitectureValidationResult(this.issues);

  final List<ArchitectureIssue> issues;

  bool get isValid => issues.isEmpty;
}

final class ArchitectureValidator {
  const ArchitectureValidator();

  ArchitectureValidationResult validate(
    List<ArchitectureModule> modules,
    ArchitecturePolicy policy,
  ) {
    final issues = <ArchitectureIssue>[];
    final byName = <String, ArchitectureModule>{};

    for (final module in modules) {
      if (byName.containsKey(module.name)) {
        issues.add(
          ArchitectureIssue(
            code: ArchitectureIssueCode.duplicateModule,
            module: module.name,
          ),
        );
        continue;
      }
      byName[module.name] = module;
    }

    for (final module in modules) {
      for (final dependencyName in module.dependencies) {
        final dependency = byName[dependencyName];
        if (dependency == null) {
          issues.add(
            ArchitectureIssue(
              code: ArchitectureIssueCode.unknownDependency,
              module: module.name,
              dependency: dependencyName,
            ),
          );
          continue;
        }

        if (!policy.allows(module.layer, dependency.layer)) {
          issues.add(
            ArchitectureIssue(
              code: ArchitectureIssueCode.forbiddenDependency,
              module: module.name,
              dependency: dependency.name,
            ),
          );
        }
      }
    }

    issues.addAll(_findCycles(byName));
    return ArchitectureValidationResult(
      List<ArchitectureIssue>.unmodifiable(issues),
    );
  }

  List<ArchitectureIssue> _findCycles(
    Map<String, ArchitectureModule> modules,
  ) {
    final issues = <ArchitectureIssue>[];
    final state = <String, int>{};
    final stack = <String>[];
    final reported = <String>{};

    void visit(String name) {
      final currentState = state[name] ?? 0;
      if (currentState == 2) return;
      if (currentState == 1) {
        final start = stack.indexOf(name);
        final cycle = <String>[
          ...stack.sublist(start < 0 ? 0 : start),
          name,
        ];
        final signature = cycle.join('>');
        if (reported.add(signature)) {
          issues.add(
            ArchitectureIssue(
              code: ArchitectureIssueCode.dependencyCycle,
              module: name,
              cycle: List<String>.unmodifiable(cycle),
            ),
          );
        }
        return;
      }

      state[name] = 1;
      stack.add(name);
      final module = modules[name];
      if (module != null) {
        for (final dependency in module.dependencies) {
          if (modules.containsKey(dependency)) {
            visit(dependency);
          }
        }
      }
      stack.removeLast();
      state[name] = 2;
    }

    for (final name in modules.keys) {
      visit(name);
    }
    return issues;
  }
}

import 'architecture_validator.dart';

final class CodeReviewReport {

    required this.architecture,
    required this.performance,
  });

      architecture.isValid &&

    this.architectureValidator = const ArchitectureValidator(),
    this.performanceProfiler = const PerformanceProfiler(),

  final PerformanceProfiler performanceProfiler;

      performance: performanceProfiler.profile(
        samples,
        budgetsMicros: budgetsMicros,
      ),
    );
  }

final class PerformanceSample {
  const PerformanceSample({
    required this.operation,
    required this.elapsedMicros,
  });

  final String operation;
  final int elapsedMicros;
}

final class PerformanceProfile {
  const PerformanceProfile({
    required this.operation,
    required this.count,
    required this.totalMicros,
    required this.averageMicros,
    required this.maxMicros,
    required this.p95Micros,
    required this.budgetMicros,
  });

  final String operation;
  final int count;
  final int totalMicros;
  final double averageMicros;
  final int maxMicros;
  final int p95Micros;
  final int? budgetMicros;

  bool get budgetExceeded =>
      budgetMicros != null && p95Micros > budgetMicros!;
}

final class PerformanceProfiler {
  const PerformanceProfiler();

  List<PerformanceProfile> profile(
    List<PerformanceSample> samples, {
    Map<String, int> budgetsMicros = const <String, int>{},
  }) {
    final grouped = <String, List<int>>{};

    for (final sample in samples) {
      if (sample.elapsedMicros < 0) {
        throw ArgumentError.value(
          sample.elapsedMicros,
          'elapsedMicros',
          'Performance timings cannot be negative.',
        );
      }
      grouped.putIfAbsent(sample.operation, () => <int>[])
        ..add(sample.elapsedMicros);
    }

    final operations = grouped.keys.toList()..sort();
    return List<PerformanceProfile>.unmodifiable(
      operations.map((operation) {
        final values = List<int>.from(grouped[operation]!)..sort();
        final total = values.fold<int>(0, (sum, value) => sum + value);
        final rawP95 = (values.length * 0.95).ceil() - 1;
        final p95Index = rawP95 < 0 ? 0 : rawP95;

        return PerformanceProfile(
          operation: operation,
          count: values.length,
          totalMicros: total,
          averageMicros: total / values.length,
          maxMicros: values.last,
          p95Micros: values[p95Index],
          budgetMicros: budgetsMicros[operation],
        );
      }),
    );
  }
}

import 'safe_input_validator.dart';
import 'type_safety_validator.dart';

final class DataHubValidationReport {
  const DataHubValidationReport({
    required this.inputFailure,
    required this.typeFailures,
  });

  final InputFailure? inputFailure;
  final List<DataFailure> typeFailures;

  bool get isValid => inputFailure == null && typeFailures.isEmpty;
}

final class DataModelsHub {
  const DataModelsHub({
    this.inputValidator = const SafeInputValidator(),
    this.typeValidator = const TypeSafetyValidator(),
  });

  final SafeInputValidator inputValidator;
  final TypeSafetyValidator typeValidator;

  DataHubValidationReport validateJson(
    String raw,
    DataSchema schema, {
    int maxBytes = 64 * 1024,
    int maxDepth = 16,
  }) {
    final decoded = inputValidator.decodeJsonObject(
      raw,
      maxBytes: maxBytes,
      maxDepth: maxDepth,
    );

    if (!decoded.isSuccess) {
      return DataHubValidationReport(
        inputFailure: decoded.failure,
        typeFailures: const <DataFailure>[],
      );
    }

    final typeResult = typeValidator.validate(decoded.value!, schema);
    return DataHubValidationReport(
      inputFailure: null,
      typeFailures: typeResult.failures,
    );
  }

  ApiValidationResult validateApiRequest(
    Uri uri, {
    required String method,
    required ApiRequestPolicy policy,
    int bodyBytes = 0,
  }) {
    return inputValidator.validateApiRequest(
      uri,
      method: method,
      policy: policy,
      bodyBytes: bodyBytes,
    );
  }
}

FILE: lib/core/infrastructure/sys_data_layer_validation/safe_input_validator.dart

import 'dart:convert';

enum InputFailureCode {
  invalidJson,
  nonObjectJson,
  payloadTooLarge,
  maxDepthExceeded,
}

final class InputFailure {
  const InputFailure({
    required this.code,
    required this.message,
  });

  final InputFailureCode code;
  final String message;
}

final class JsonObjectResult {
  const JsonObjectResult._({
    this.value,
    this.failure,
  });

  const JsonObjectResult.success(Map<String, Object?> value)
      : this._(value: value);

  const JsonObjectResult.failure(InputFailure failure)
      : this._(failure: failure);

  final Map<String, Object?>? value;
  final InputFailure? failure;

  bool get isSuccess => failure == null;
}

enum ApiFailureCode {
  insecureScheme,
  hostNotAllowed,
  methodNotAllowed,
  payloadTooLarge,
}

final class ApiFailure {
  const ApiFailure({
    required this.code,
    required this.message,
  });

  final ApiFailureCode code;
  final String message;
}

final class ApiValidationResult {
  const ApiValidationResult(this.failures);

  final List<ApiFailure> failures;

  bool get isValid => failures.isEmpty;
}

final class ApiRequestPolicy {
  const ApiRequestPolicy({
    required this.allowedHosts,
    this.allowedMethods = const <String>{'GET'},
    this.maxBodyBytes = 1024 * 1024,
  });

  final Set<String> allowedHosts;
  final Set<String> allowedMethods;
  final int maxBodyBytes;
}

final class SafeInputValidator {
  const SafeInputValidator();

  JsonObjectResult decodeJsonObject(
    String raw, {
    int maxBytes = 64 * 1024,
    int maxDepth = 16,
  }) {
    if (utf8.encode(raw).length > maxBytes) {
      return const JsonObjectResult.failure(
        InputFailure(
          code: InputFailureCode.payloadTooLarge,
          message: 'JSON payload exceeds the configured byte limit.',
        ),
      );
    }

    late final Object? decoded;
    try {
      decoded = jsonDecode(raw);
    } on FormatException {
      return const JsonObjectResult.failure(
        InputFailure(
          code: InputFailureCode.invalidJson,
          message: 'Input is not valid JSON.',
        ),
      );
    }

    if (decoded is! Map<String, Object?>) {
      return const JsonObjectResult.failure(
        InputFailure(
          code: InputFailureCode.nonObjectJson,
          message: 'JSON root must be an object.',
        ),
      );
    }

    if (_depth(decoded) > maxDepth) {
      return const JsonObjectResult.failure(
        InputFailure(
          code: InputFailureCode.maxDepthExceeded,
          message: 'JSON nesting exceeds the configured depth limit.',
        ),
      );
    }

    return JsonObjectResult.success(
      Map<String, Object?>.unmodifiable(decoded),
    );
  }

  ApiValidationResult validateApiRequest(
    Uri uri, {
    required String method,
    required ApiRequestPolicy policy,
    int bodyBytes = 0,
  }) {
    final failures = <ApiFailure>[];
    final normalizedMethod = method.trim().toUpperCase();

    if (uri.scheme.toLowerCase() != 'https') {
      failures.add(
        const ApiFailure(
          code: ApiFailureCode.insecureScheme,
          message: 'Only HTTPS endpoints are allowed.',
        ),
      );
    }

    final normalizedHost = uri.host.toLowerCase();
    final allowedHosts = policy.allowedHosts
        .map((host) => host.toLowerCase())
        .toSet();
    if (!allowedHosts.contains(normalizedHost)) {
      failures.add(
        ApiFailure(
          code: ApiFailureCode.hostNotAllowed,
          message: 'Host "' + normalizedHost + '" is not allowlisted.',
        ),
      );
    }

    final allowedMethods = policy.allowedMethods
        .map((allowed) => allowed.toUpperCase())
        .toSet();
    if (!allowedMethods.contains(normalizedMethod)) {
      failures.add(
        ApiFailure(
          code: ApiFailureCode.methodNotAllowed,
          message: 'HTTP method "' + normalizedMethod + '" is not allowed.',
        ),
      );
    }

    if (bodyBytes < 0 || bodyBytes > policy.maxBodyBytes) {
      failures.add(
        const ApiFailure(
          code: ApiFailureCode.payloadTooLarge,
          message: 'Request body exceeds the configured byte limit.',
        ),
      );
    }

    return ApiValidationResult(
      List<ApiFailure>.unmodifiable(failures),
    );
  }

  int _depth(Object? value) {
    if (value is Map) {
      if (value.isEmpty) return 1;
      var deepest = 0;
      for (final child in value.values) {
        final childDepth = _depth(child);
        if (childDepth > deepest) deepest = childDepth;
      }
      return deepest + 1;
    }
    if (value is List) {
      if (value.isEmpty) return 1;
      var deepest = 0;
      for (final child in value) {
        final childDepth = _depth(child);
        if (childDepth > deepest) deepest = childDepth;
      }
      return deepest + 1;
    }
    return 0;
  }
}

enum DataValueType { string, integer, number, boolean, object, list }

enum DataFailureCode {
  missingRequiredField,
  nullNotAllowed,
  typeMismatch,
  unknownField,
  operationFailed,
}

final class DataField {
  const DataField({
    required this.type,
    this.required = true,
    this.nullable = false,
  });

  final DataValueType type;
  final bool required;
  final bool nullable;
}

final class DataSchema {
  const DataSchema({
    required this.fields,
    this.allowUnknownFields = false,
  });

  final Map<String, DataField> fields;
  final bool allowUnknownFields;
}

final class DataFailure {
  const DataFailure({
    required this.code,
    required this.message,
    this.field,
  });

  final DataFailureCode code;
  final String message;
  final String? field;
}

final class DataValidationResult {
  const DataValidationResult(this.failures);

  final List<DataFailure> failures;

  bool get isValid => failures.isEmpty;
}

final class DataOperationResult<T> {
  const DataOperationResult._({
    this.value,
    this.failure,
  });

  const DataOperationResult.success(T value) : this._(value: value);

  const DataOperationResult.failure(DataFailure failure)
      : this._(failure: failure);

  final T? value;
  final DataFailure? failure;

  bool get isSuccess => failure == null;
}

final class TypeSafetyValidator {
  const TypeSafetyValidator();

  DataValidationResult validate(
    Map<String, Object?> payload,
    DataSchema schema,
  ) {
    final failures = <DataFailure>[];

    for (final entry in schema.fields.entries) {
      final fieldName = entry.key;
      final field = entry.value;
      final hasField = payload.containsKey(fieldName);

      if (!hasField) {
        if (field.required) {
          failures.add(
            DataFailure(
              code: DataFailureCode.missingRequiredField,
              field: fieldName,
              message: 'Required field "' + fieldName + '" is missing.',
            ),
          );
        }
        continue;
      }

      final value = payload[fieldName];
      if (value == null) {
        if (!field.nullable) {
          failures.add(
            DataFailure(
              code: DataFailureCode.nullNotAllowed,
              field: fieldName,
              message: 'Field "' + fieldName + '" does not allow null.',
            ),
          );
        }
        continue;
      }

      if (!_matchesType(value, field.type)) {
        failures.add(
          DataFailure(
            code: DataFailureCode.typeMismatch,
            field: fieldName,
            message: 'Field "' +
                fieldName +
                '" expected ' +
                field.type.name +
                ' but received ' +
                value.runtimeType.toString() +
                '.',
          ),
        );
      }
    }

    if (!schema.allowUnknownFields) {
      for (final key in payload.keys) {
        if (!schema.fields.containsKey(key)) {
          failures.add(
            DataFailure(
              code: DataFailureCode.unknownField,
              field: key,
              message: 'Unknown field "' + key + '" is not allowed.',
            ),
          );
        }
      }
    }

    return DataValidationResult(
      List<DataFailure>.unmodifiable(failures),
    );
  }

  DataOperationResult<T> capture<T>(T Function() operation) {
    try {
      return DataOperationResult<T>.success(operation());
    } on Object catch (error) {
      return DataOperationResult<T>.failure(
        DataFailure(
          code: DataFailureCode.operationFailed,
          message: error.toString(),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  bool _matchesType(Object value, DataValueType type) {
    return switch (type) {
      DataValueType.string => value is String,
      DataValueType.integer => value is int,
      DataValueType.number => value is num,
      DataValueType.boolean => value is bool,
      DataValueType.object => value is Map,
      DataValueType.list => value is List,
    };
  }
}

FILE: lib/core/l10n/dynamic_l10n_engine.dart

import 'dart:async';

import '../localization/locale_provider.dart';
import '../localization/localization_state.dart';
import 'l10n_models.dart';

/// UI-chrome localization runtime.
///
/// Configured fallback is intentionally available only through [uiText] and
/// [resolveUi]. Learning content must use an exact admitted language resource
/// and must never route through this fallback boundary.
final class DynamicL10nEngine {
  DynamicL10nEngine({
    required LocalizationState initialState,
    required String fallbackLanguageTag,
    Iterable<L10nDictionary> dictionaries = const <L10nDictionary>[],
  })  : _state = initialState,
        _fallbackLocale = AppLocale.parse(fallbackLanguageTag) {
    for (final dictionary in dictionaries) {
      final key = dictionary.locale.languageTag;
      if (_dictionaries.containsKey(key)) {
        throw ArgumentError(
          'Duplicate localization dictionary for $key.',
        );
      }
      _dictionaries[key] = dictionary;
    }
  }

  final Map<String, L10nDictionary> _dictionaries =
      <String, L10nDictionary>{};
  final StreamController<L10nEngineChange> _changes =
      StreamController<L10nEngineChange>.broadcast(sync: true);

  LocalizationState _state;
  AppLocale _fallbackLocale;
  int _revision = 0;
  bool _closed = false;

  L10nRuntimeSnapshot get snapshot => L10nRuntimeSnapshot(
        state: _state,
        fallbackLocale: _fallbackLocale,
        revision: _revision,
        loadedLocales: _dictionaries.keys.toSet(),
      );

  Stream<L10nEngineChange> get changes => _changes.stream;

  bool get isClosed => _closed;

  void setUserLanguage(String languageTag) {
    _ensureOpen();
    final next = _state.switchUserLocale(languageTag);
    if (next.userLocale.languageTag == _state.userLocale.languageTag) {
      return;
    }
    final previous = snapshot;
    _state = next;
    _commit(
      reason: L10nChangeReason.userLanguage,
      previous: previous,
    );
  }

  void setLearningPair({
    required String sourceLanguageTag,
    required String targetLanguageTag,
  }) {
    _ensureOpen();
    final next = _state.switchLearningPair(
      sourceLanguageTag: sourceLanguageTag,
      targetLanguageTag: targetLanguageTag,
    );
    if (next.sourceLocale.languageTag == _state.sourceLocale.languageTag &&
        next.targetLocale.languageTag == _state.targetLocale.languageTag) {
      return;
    }
    final previous = snapshot;
    _state = next;
    _commit(
      reason: L10nChangeReason.learningPair,
      previous: previous,
    );
  }

  void setFallbackLanguage(String languageTag) {
    _ensureOpen();
    final next = AppLocale.parse(languageTag);
    if (next.languageTag == _fallbackLocale.languageTag) return;
    final previous = snapshot;
    _fallbackLocale = next;
    _commit(
      reason: L10nChangeReason.fallbackLanguage,
      previous: previous,
    );
  }

  void registerDictionary(
    L10nDictionary dictionary, {
    bool replace = true,
  }) {
    _ensureOpen();
    final localeTag = dictionary.locale.languageTag;
    if (!replace && _dictionaries.containsKey(localeTag)) {
      throw StateError(
        'Localization dictionary already registered for $localeTag.',
      );
    }
    final previous = snapshot;
    _dictionaries[localeTag] = dictionary;
    _commit(
      reason: L10nChangeReason.dictionaryRegistered,
      previous: previous,
      dictionaryLocale: localeTag,
    );
  }

  void registerAll(
    Iterable<L10nDictionary> dictionaries, {
    bool replace = true,
  }) {
    _ensureOpen();
    final incoming = dictionaries.toList(growable: false);
    if (incoming.isEmpty) return;

    final seen = <String>{};
    for (final dictionary in incoming) {
      final localeTag = dictionary.locale.languageTag;
      if (!seen.add(localeTag)) {
        throw ArgumentError(
          'Duplicate localization dictionary in batch for $localeTag.',
        );
      }
      if (!replace && _dictionaries.containsKey(localeTag)) {
        throw StateError(
          'Localization dictionary already registered for $localeTag.',
        );
      }
    }

    final previous = snapshot;
    for (final dictionary in incoming) {
      _dictionaries[dictionary.locale.languageTag] = dictionary;
    }
    _commit(
      reason: L10nChangeReason.dictionaryRegistered,
      previous: previous,
    );
  }

  bool removeDictionary(String languageTag) {
    _ensureOpen();
    final localeTag = AppLocale.parse(languageTag).languageTag;
    if (!_dictionaries.containsKey(localeTag)) return false;
    final previous = snapshot;
    _dictionaries.remove(localeTag);
    _commit(
      reason: L10nChangeReason.dictionaryRemoved,
      previous: previous,
      dictionaryLocale: localeTag,
    );
    return true;
  }

  bool hasDictionary(String languageTag) {
    _ensureOpen();
    final localeTag = AppLocale.parse(languageTag).languageTag;
    return _dictionaries.containsKey(localeTag);
  }

  String uiText(
    String key, {
    Map<String, Object?> arguments = const <String, Object?>{},
  }) =>
      resolveUi(key, arguments: arguments).value;

  UiL10nResolvedText resolveUi(
    String key, {
    Map<String, Object?> arguments = const <String, Object?>{},
  }) {
    _ensureOpen();
    final normalizedKey = key.trim();
    if (normalizedKey.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(key, 'key', 'must not be empty');
    }

    final requested = _state.userLocale;
    for (final localeTag in _lookupOrder(requested, _fallbackLocale)) {
      final dictionary = _dictionaries[localeTag];
      final message = dictionary?.find(normalizedKey);
      if (message == null) continue;
      return UiL10nResolvedText(
        key: normalizedKey,
        value: message.render(arguments: arguments),
        requestedLocale: requested.languageTag,
        resolvedLocale: localeTag,
        usedFallback: localeTag != requested.languageTag,
      );
    }

    return UiL10nResolvedText(
      key: normalizedKey,
      value: normalizedKey,
      requestedLocale: requested.languageTag,
      resolvedLocale: requested.languageTag,
      usedFallback: true,
    );
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    _closed = true;
    await _changes.close();
  }

  void _commit({
    required L10nChangeReason reason,
    required L10nRuntimeSnapshot previous,
    String? dictionaryLocale,
  }) {
    _revision += 1;
    _changes.add(
      L10nEngineChange(
        reason: reason,
        previous: previous,
        current: snapshot,
        dictionaryLocale: dictionaryLocale,
      ),
    );
  }

  void _ensureOpen() {
    if (_closed) {
      throw StateError('DynamicL10nEngine is closed.');
    }
  }

  static List<String> _lookupOrder(
    AppLocale requested,
    AppLocale fallback,
  ) {
    final ordered = <String>[];
    void add(String value) {
      if (!ordered.contains(value)) ordered.add(value);
    }

    for (final value in _localeCandidates(requested)) {
      add(value);
    }
    for (final value in _localeCandidates(fallback)) {
      add(value);
    }
    return List<String>.unmodifiable(ordered);
  }

  static List<String> _localeCandidates(AppLocale locale) {
    final result = <String>[locale.languageTag];
    if (locale.regionCode != null) {
      result.add(locale.languageCode);
    }
    return List<String>.unmodifiable(result);
  }
}

FILE: lib/core/l10n/l10n_bundle_loader.dart

import 'l10n_dictionary_codec.dart';
import 'l10n_models.dart';

typedef L10nTextAssetReader = Future<String> Function(String assetPath);

final class L10nBundleLoader {
  L10nBundleLoader({
    required L10nTextAssetReader readText,
  }) : _readText = readText;

  final L10nTextAssetReader _readText;

  Future<L10nDictionary> load({
    required String assetPath,
    required L10nSourceFormat format,
    String? localeTag,
  }) async {
    final normalizedPath = assetPath.trim();
    if (normalizedPath.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        assetPath,
        'assetPath',
        'must not be empty',
      );
    }

    final encoded = await _readText(normalizedPath);
    if (encoded.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw FormatException(
        'Localization asset "$normalizedPath" is empty.',
      );
    }

    return switch (format) {
      L10nSourceFormat.json => L10nDictionaryCodec.decodeJson(
          encoded,
          localeTag: localeTag,
        ),
      L10nSourceFormat.arb => L10nDictionaryCodec.decodeArb(
          encoded,
          localeTag: localeTag,
        ),
    };
  }

  Future<List<L10nDictionary>> loadAll(
    Iterable<L10nBundleRequest> requests,
  ) async {
    final result = <L10nDictionary>[];
    final seenPaths = <String>{};

    for (final request in requests) {
      final path = request.assetPath.trim();
      if (!seenPaths.add(path)) {
        throw ArgumentError(
          'Duplicate localization asset path: $path.',
        );
      }
      result.add(
        await load(
          assetPath: path,
          format: request.format,
          localeTag: request.localeTag,
        ),
      );
    }

    return List<L10nDictionary>.unmodifiable(result);
  }
}

final class L10nBundleRequest {
  L10nBundleRequest({
    required String assetPath,
    required this.format,
    this.localeTag,
  }) : assetPath = assetPath.trim() {
    if (this.assetPath.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        assetPath,
        'assetPath',
        'must not be empty',
      );
    }
  }

  final String assetPath;
  final L10nSourceFormat format;
  final String? localeTag;
}
