import 'dart:async';

import '../orchestration/orchestration.dart';
import 'l10n.dart';

Future<void> main() async {
  final loader = L10nBundleLoader(
    readText: (assetPath) async {
      if (assetPath == 'assets/l10n/it.json') {
        return '{"locale":"it","strings":{"nav.home":"Home"}}';
      }
      throw StateError('Unexpected localization asset: $assetPath');
    },
  );
  final italian = await loader.load(
    assetPath: 'assets/l10n/it.json',
    format: L10nSourceFormat.json,
  );
  _expect(italian.locale.languageTag, 'it', 'bundle loader locale');
  _expect(italian.require('nav.home').template, 'Home', 'bundle loader content');

  final arabic = L10nDictionaryCodec.decodeArb(
    '''
{
  "@@locale": "ar-JO",
  "nav.home": "الرئيسية",
  "welcome.user": "مرحباً {name}",
  "@welcome.user": {
    "description": "Personalized welcome",
    "placeholders": {
      "name": {"type": "String", "example": "سليم"}
    }
  }
}
''',
  );
  final german = L10nDictionaryCodec.decodeJson(
    '''
{
  "locale": "de-DE",
  "strings": {
    "nav.home": "Start",
    "welcome.user": "Hallo {name}"
  }
}
''',
  );
  final english = L10nDictionaryCodec.decodeJson(
    '''
{
  "locale": "en",
  "strings": {
    "nav.home": "Home",
    "fallback.only": "Fallback value"
  }
}
''',
  );

  _expect(arabic.locale.languageTag, 'ar-JO', 'ARB locale parsing');
  _expect(arabic.messages.length, 2, 'ARB metadata is not a UI message');
  _expect(
    arabic.require('welcome.user').placeholders.contains('name'),
    true,
    'ARB placeholders are modeled',
  );

  final engine = DynamicL10nEngine(
    initialState: LocalizationState.fromLanguageTags(
      userLanguageTag: 'ar-JO',
      sourceLanguageTag: 'ar',
      targetLanguageTag: 'de-DE',
    ),
    fallbackLanguageTag: 'en',
    dictionaries: <L10nDictionary>[arabic, german, english],
  );

  _expect(engine.snapshot.userLocale.languageTag, 'ar-JO', 'initial UI locale');
  _expect(engine.snapshot.isRtl, true, 'Arabic UI resolves RTL');
  _expect(engine.uiText('nav.home'), 'الرئيسية', 'exact locale lookup');
  _expect(
    engine.uiText('welcome.user', arguments: const <String, Object?>{'name': 'سليم'}),
    'مرحباً سليم',
    'placeholder interpolation',
  );
  _expect(
    engine.uiText('fallback.only'),
    'Fallback value',
    'fallback dictionary lookup',
  );
  final uiFallback = engine.resolveUi('fallback.only');
  _expect(uiFallback.usedFallback, true, 'UI fallback is explicit');
  _expect(uiFallback.requestedLocale, 'ar-JO', 'UI fallback request locale');
  _expect(uiFallback.resolvedLocale, 'en', 'UI fallback resolved locale');
  _expect(engine.uiText('missing.key'), 'missing.key', 'missing key fallback');

  final beforePair = engine.snapshot;
  engine.setUserLanguage('de-DE');
  _expect(engine.snapshot.userLocale.languageTag, 'de-DE', 'UI locale switch');
  _expect(engine.snapshot.isRtl, false, 'German UI resolves LTR');
  _expect(
    engine.snapshot.sourceLocale.languageTag,
    beforePair.sourceLocale.languageTag,
    'UI locale does not mutate source language',
  );
  _expect(
    engine.snapshot.targetLocale.languageTag,
    beforePair.targetLocale.languageTag,
    'UI locale does not mutate target language',
  );

  engine.setLearningPair(sourceLanguageTag: 'de-DE', targetLanguageTag: 'ar');
  _expect(engine.snapshot.userLocale.languageTag, 'de-DE', 'pair keeps UI locale');
  _expect(engine.snapshot.sourceLocale.languageTag, 'de-DE', 'source changes');
  _expect(engine.snapshot.targetLocale.languageTag, 'ar', 'target changes');

  var missingPlaceholderRejected = false;
  try {
    arabic.require('welcome.user').render();
  } on FormatException {
    missingPlaceholderRejected = true;
  }
  _expect(
    missingPlaceholderRejected,
    true,
    'missing placeholder arguments are rejected',
  );

  final batchRevision = engine.snapshot.revision;
  engine.registerAll(
    <L10nDictionary>[
      L10nDictionaryCodec.decodeJson(
        '{"locale":"fr","strings":{"nav.home":"Accueil"}}',
      ),
      L10nDictionaryCodec.decodeJson(
        '{"locale":"es","strings":{"nav.home":"Inicio"}}',
      ),
    ],
  );
  _expect(
    engine.snapshot.revision,
    batchRevision + 1,
    'dictionary batch produces one localization revision',
  );
  _expect(
    engine.snapshot.loadedLocales.containsAll(<String>{'fr', 'es'}),
    true,
    'dictionary batch registers every locale',
  );

  final bus = AgentEventBus.isolated();
  final kernel = OrchestrationKernel(
    eventBus: bus,
    services: ServiceContainer(),
  );
  final localizationEndpoint = kernel.connect(
    AgentDescriptor(
      id: 'l10n.runtime',
      role: AgentRole.localization,
      subscriptions: const <String>{
        AgentTopics.localizationChangeRequested,
      },
    ),
  );
  final designEndpoint = kernel.connect(
    AgentDescriptor(
      id: 'l10n.design-observer',
      role: AgentRole.design,
      subscriptions: const <String>{
        AgentTopics.localizationChanged,
      },
    ),
  );
  final routingEndpoint = kernel.connect(
    AgentDescriptor(
      id: 'l10n.routing-observer',
      role: AgentRole.routing,
      subscriptions: const <String>{
        AgentTopics.localizationChanged,
      },
    ),
  );
  final recoveryEndpoint = kernel.connect(
    AgentDescriptor(
      id: 'l10n.recovery-observer',
      role: AgentRole.recovery,
      subscriptions: const <String>{AgentTopics.systemError},
    ),
  );
  final requester = kernel.connect(
    AgentDescriptor(
      id: 'l10n.requester',
      role: AgentRole.task,
      subscriptions: const <String>{AgentTopics.contextUpdated},
    ),
  );

  final bridge = L10nEventBridge(
    engine: engine,
    endpoint: localizationEndpoint,
  );

  final designEvent = Completer<AgentEvent>();
  final routingEvent = Completer<AgentEvent>();
  final designSub = designEndpoint
      .events(AgentTopics.localizationChanged)
      .listen((event) {
    if (!designEvent.isCompleted) designEvent.complete(event);
  });
  final routingSub = routingEndpoint
      .events(AgentTopics.localizationChanged)
      .listen((event) {
    if (!routingEvent.isCompleted) routingEvent.complete(event);
  });

  requester.publish(
    topic: AgentTopics.localizationChangeRequested,
    targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.localization},
    context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty('l10n-change-1'),
    payload: const <String, Object?>{
      'userLocale': 'ar-JO',
    },
  );

  final designChanged = await designEvent.future.timeout(
    const Duration(seconds: 1),
  );
  final routingChanged = await routingEvent.future.timeout(
    const Duration(seconds: 1),
  );

  _expect(
    designChanged.payload['userLocale'],
    'ar-JO',
    'design receives changed UI locale',
  );
  _expect(
    designChanged.payload['direction'],
    'rtl',
    'design receives RTL direction immediately',
  );
  _expect(
    routingChanged.payload['revision'],
    designChanged.payload['revision'],
    'routing and design observe the same localization revision',
  );
  _expect(engine.snapshot.isRtl, true, 'event request mutates central state');

  final recoveryEvent = Completer<AgentEvent>();
  final recoverySub = recoveryEndpoint
      .events(AgentTopics.systemError)
      .listen((event) {
    if (!recoveryEvent.isCompleted) recoveryEvent.complete(event);
  });
  requester.publish(
    topic: AgentTopics.localizationChangeRequested,
    targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.localization},
    context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty('l10n-invalid-1'),
    payload: const <String, Object?>{
      'sourceLocale': 'de-DE',
    },
  );
  final invalidRequest = await recoveryEvent.future.timeout(
    const Duration(seconds: 1),
  );
  _expect(
    invalidRequest.payload['fatal'],
    false,
    'malformed language request fails safe',
  );
  _expect(
    invalidRequest.payload['context'],
    'l10n.change_request',
    'malformed request is identified to recovery',
  );

  await recoverySub.cancel();
  await designSub.cancel();
  await routingSub.cancel();
  await bridge.close();
  await kernel.close();
  await engine.close();

  _expect(bus.isClosed, true, 'isolated localization bus closes');
}

void _expect(Object? actual, Object? expected, String contract) {
  if (actual != expected) {
    throw StateError(
      'Contract failed: $contract. Expected <$expected>, got <$actual>.',
    );
  }
}


--------------------------------------------------
FILE: lib/core/l10n/l10n_dictionary_codec.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'dart:convert';

import '../localization/locale_provider.dart';
import 'l10n_models.dart';

abstract final class L10nDictionaryCodec {
  static L10nDictionary decodeJson(
    String encoded, {
    String? localeTag,
  }) {
    final root = _decodeObject(encoded);
    final resolvedLocale = _resolveLocale(
      explicit: localeTag,
      embedded: root['locale'],
      format: 'JSON',
    );

    final rawStrings = root['strings'];
    final rawMetadata = root['metadata'];
    final messages = rawStrings is Map
        ? _messagesFromMap(
            rawStrings,
            metadata: rawMetadata is Map ? rawMetadata : const <Object?, Object?>{},
            reservedKeys: const <String>{},
          )
        : _messagesFromMap(
            root,
            metadata: rawMetadata is Map ? rawMetadata : const <Object?, Object?>{},
            reservedKeys: const <String>{'locale', 'metadata'},
          );

    return L10nDictionary(
      locale: AppLocale.parse(resolvedLocale),
      sourceFormat: L10nSourceFormat.json,
      messages: messages,
    );
  }

  static L10nDictionary decodeArb(
    String encoded, {
    String? localeTag,
  }) {
    final root = _decodeObject(encoded);
    final resolvedLocale = _resolveLocale(
      explicit: localeTag,
      embedded: root['@@locale'],
      format: 'ARB',
    );

    final metadata = <Object?, Object?>{
      for (final entry in root.entries)
        if (entry.key is String &&
            (entry.key as String).startsWith('@') &&
            !(entry.key as String).startsWith('@@'))
          (entry.key as String).substring(1): entry.value,
    };

    final messages = _messagesFromMap(
      root,
      metadata: metadata,
      reservedKeys: const <String>{},
      skipAtKeys: true,
    );

    return L10nDictionary(
      locale: AppLocale.parse(resolvedLocale),
      sourceFormat: L10nSourceFormat.arb,
      messages: messages,
    );
  }

  static Map<Object?, Object?> _decodeObject(String encoded) {
    if (encoded.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw const FormatException('Localization document must not be empty.');
    }
    late final Object? decoded;
    try {
      decoded = jsonDecode(encoded);
    } on Object {
      throw const FormatException('Localization document is not valid JSON.');
    }
    if (decoded is! Map) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Localization document root must be a JSON object.',
      );
    }
    return Map<Object?, Object?>.from(decoded);
  }

  static String _resolveLocale({
    required String? explicit,
    required Object? embedded,
    required String format,
  }) {
    final explicitValue = explicit?.trim() ?? '';
    final embeddedValue = embedded is String ? embedded.trim() : '';

    if (explicitValue.isNotEmpty &&
        embeddedValue.isNotEmpty &&
        AppLocale.parse(explicitValue).languageTag !=
            AppLocale.parse(embeddedValue).languageTag) {
      throw FormatException(
        '$format locale mismatch: $explicitValue != $embeddedValue.',
      );
    }

    final selected =
        explicitValue.isNotEmpty ? explicitValue : embeddedValue;
    if (selected.isEmpty) {
      throw FormatException('$format localization document has no locale.');
    }
    return selected;
  }

  static Map<String, L10nMessage> _messagesFromMap(
    Map rawMessages, {
    required Map metadata,
    required Set<String> reservedKeys,
    bool skipAtKeys = false,
  }) {
    final messages = <String, L10nMessage>{};

    for (final entry in rawMessages.entries) {
      final rawKey = entry.key;
      if (rawKey is! String) {
        throw const FormatException(
          'Localization message keys must be strings.',
        );
      }

      final key = rawKey.trim();
      if (reservedKeys.contains(key)) continue;
      if (skipAtKeys && key.startsWith('@')) continue;
      if (key.startsWith('@@')) continue;

      final rawValue = entry.value;
      if (rawValue is! String) {
        throw FormatException(
          'Localization message "$key" must be a string.',
        );
      }

      final rawMessageMetadata = metadata[key];
      messages[key] = L10nMessage(
        key: key,
        template: rawValue,
        metadata: _metadata(rawMessageMetadata),
      );
    }

    if (messages.isEmpty) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Localization document contains no UI messages.',
      );
    }
    return messages;
  }

  static L10nMessageMetadata _metadata(Object? raw) {
    if (raw == null) return L10nMessageMetadata();
    if (raw is! Map) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Localization message metadata must be an object.',
      );
    }

    final description = raw['description'];
    if (description != null && description is! String) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Localization metadata description must be a string.',
      );
    }

    final placeholders = <String, L10nPlaceholder>{};
    final rawPlaceholders = raw['placeholders'];
    if (rawPlaceholders != null) {
      if (rawPlaceholders is! Map) {
        throw const FormatException(
          'Localization placeholders metadata must be an object.',
        );
      }

      for (final entry in rawPlaceholders.entries) {
        if (entry.key is! String) {
          throw const FormatException(
            'Localization placeholder names must be strings.',
          );
        }
        final name = (entry.key as String).trim();
        final spec = entry.value;
        if (spec != null && spec is! Map) {
          throw FormatException(
            'Placeholder metadata for "$name" must be an object.',
          );
        }
        final type = spec is Map ? spec['type'] : null;
        final example = spec is Map ? spec['example'] : null;
        if (type != null && type is! String) {
          throw FormatException(
            'Placeholder type for "$name" must be a string.',
          );
        }
        if (example != null &&
            example is! String &&
            example is! num &&
            example is! bool) {
          throw FormatException(
            'Placeholder example for "$name" must be scalar.',
          );
        }
        placeholders[name] = L10nPlaceholder(
          name: name,
          type: type as String?,
          example: example?.toString(),
        );
      }
    }

    return L10nMessageMetadata(
      description: description as String?,
      placeholders: placeholders,
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import '../orchestration/orchestration.dart';
import 'dynamic_l10n_engine.dart';
import 'l10n_models.dart';

final class L10nEventBridge {
  L10nEventBridge({
    required this.engine,
    required this.endpoint,
  }) {
    if (endpoint.descriptor.role != AgentRole.localization) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'L10nEventBridge endpoint must use AgentRole.localization.',
      );
    }
    if (!endpoint.descriptor
        .subscribesTo(AgentTopics.localizationChangeRequested)) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'L10nEventBridge endpoint must subscribe to '
        'localization.change_requested.',
      );
    }

    _engineSubscription = engine.changes.listen(_publishChange);
    _requestSubscription = endpoint
        .events(AgentTopics.localizationChangeRequested)
        .listen(_handleRequest);
  }

  final DynamicL10nEngine engine;
  final AgentEndpoint endpoint;

  late final StreamSubscription<L10nEngineChange> _engineSubscription;
  late final StreamSubscription<AgentEvent> _requestSubscription;
  AgentContextSnapshot? _activeRequestContext;
  bool _closed = false;

  bool get isClosed => _closed;

  void _handleRequest(AgentEvent event) {
    if (_closed) return;
    _activeRequestContext = event.context;
    try {
      final userLocale = _optionalString(event.payload['userLocale']);
      final sourceLocale = _optionalString(event.payload['sourceLocale']);
      final targetLocale = _optionalString(event.payload['targetLocale']);
      final fallbackLocale =
          _optionalString(event.payload['fallbackLocale']);

      if ((sourceLocale == null) != (targetLocale == null)) {
        throw const FormatException(
          'sourceLocale and targetLocale must be supplied together.',
        );
      }

      if (userLocale != null) {
        engine.setUserLanguage(userLocale);
      }
      if (sourceLocale != null && targetLocale != null) {
        engine.setLearningPair(
          sourceLanguageTag: sourceLocale,
          targetLanguageTag: targetLocale,
        );
      }
      if (fallbackLocale != null) {
        engine.setFallbackLanguage(fallbackLocale);
      }
    } on Object catch (error) {
      endpoint.publish(
        topic: AgentTopics.systemError,
        targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.recovery},
        context: event.context,
        payload: <String, Object?>{
          'context': 'l10n.change_request',
          'errorType': error.runtimeType.toString(),
          'message': _bounded(error.toString(), 240),
          'fatal': false,
        },
      );
    } finally {
      _activeRequestContext = null;
    }
  }

  void _publishChange(L10nEngineChange change) {
    if (_closed) return;
    final current = change.current;
    final loadedLocales = current.loadedLocales.toList(growable: false)
      ..sort();

    endpoint.publish(
      topic: AgentTopics.localizationChanged,
      targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{
        AgentRole.design,
        AgentRole.routing,
      },
      context: _activeRequestContext,
      payload: <String, Object?>{
        'reason': change.reason.name,
        'revision': current.revision,
        'userLocale': current.userLocale.languageTag,
        'sourceLocale': current.sourceLocale.languageTag,
        'targetLocale': current.targetLocale.languageTag,
        'fallbackLocale': current.fallbackLocale.languageTag,
        'direction': current.direction,
        'isRtl': current.isRtl,
        'loadedLocales': loadedLocales,
        if (change.dictionaryLocale != null)
          'dictionaryLocale': change.dictionaryLocale,
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    _closed = true;
    await _requestSubscription.cancel();
    await _engineSubscription.cancel();
  }

  static String _bounded(String value, int maxLength) {
    final normalized = value.trim();
    return normalized.length <= maxLength
        ? normalized
        : normalized.substring(0, maxLength);
  }

  static String? _optionalString(Object? value) {
    if (value == null) return null;
    if (value is! String) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Localization request locale values must be strings.',
      );
    }
    final normalized = value.trim();
    if (normalized.isEmpty) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Localization request locale values must not be empty.',
      );
    }
    return normalized;
  }
}

import '../localization/localization_state.dart';
import '../localization/locale_provider.dart';

enum L10nSourceFormat {
  json,
  arb,
}

enum L10nChangeReason {
  userLanguage,
  learningPair,
  fallbackLanguage,
  dictionaryRegistered,
  dictionaryRemoved,
}

final class L10nPlaceholder {
  L10nPlaceholder({
    required String name,
    this.type,
    this.example,
  }) : name = _validatedToken(name, 'placeholder');

  final String name;
  final String? type;
  final String? example;
}

final class L10nMessageMetadata {
  L10nMessageMetadata({
    this.description,
    Map<String, L10nPlaceholder> placeholders =
        const <String, L10nPlaceholder>{},
  }) : placeholders =
            Map<String, L10nPlaceholder>.unmodifiable(placeholders);

  final String? description;
  final Map<String, L10nPlaceholder> placeholders;
}

final class L10nMessage {
  L10nMessage({
    required String key,
    required String template,
    L10nMessageMetadata? metadata,
  })  : key = _validatedMessageKey(key),
        template = template,
        metadata = metadata ?? L10nMessageMetadata() {
    final inferred = _extractPlaceholders(template);
    final unknownMetadata =
        this.metadata.placeholders.keys.where((name) => !inferred.contains(name));
    if (unknownMetadata.isNotEmpty) {
      throw FormatException(
        'Placeholder metadata is not present in template for $key: '
        '${unknownMetadata.join(', ')}',
      );
    }
  }

  final String key;
  final String template;
  final L10nMessageMetadata metadata;

  Set<String> get placeholders =>
      Set<String>.unmodifiable(_extractPlaceholders(template));

  String render({
    Map<String, Object?> arguments = const <String, Object?>{},
  }) {
    var rendered = template;
    for (final name in placeholders) {
      if (!arguments.containsKey(name) || arguments[name] == null) {
        throw FormatException(
          'Missing localization argument "$name" for "$key".',
        );
      }
      rendered = rendered.replaceAll('{$name}', arguments[name].toString());
    }
    return rendered;
  }
}

final class L10nDictionary {
  L10nDictionary({
    required this.locale,
    required this.sourceFormat,
    required Map<String, L10nMessage> messages,
  }) : messages = Map<String, L10nMessage>.unmodifiable(messages) {
    if (this.messages.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('Localization dictionary must not be empty.');
    }
    for (final entry in this.messages.entries) {
      if (entry.key != entry.value.key) {
        throw ArgumentError(
          'Dictionary key ${entry.key} does not match message '
          '${entry.value.key}.',
        );
      }
    }
  }

  final AppLocale locale;
  final L10nSourceFormat sourceFormat;
  final Map<String, L10nMessage> messages;

  bool contains(String key) => messages.containsKey(key.trim());

  L10nMessage? find(String key) => messages[key.trim()];

  L10nMessage require(String key) {
    final message = find(key);
    if (message == null) {
      throw StateError(
        'Missing localization key "$key" in ${locale.languageTag}.',
      );
    }
    return message;
  }
}

/// Resolution metadata for UI chrome. [usedFallback] must never describe
/// learning-content substitution.
final class UiL10nResolvedText {
  const UiL10nResolvedText({
    required this.key,
    required this.value,
    required this.requestedLocale,
    required this.resolvedLocale,
    required this.usedFallback,
  });

  final String key;
  final String value;
  final String requestedLocale;
  final String resolvedLocale;
  final bool usedFallback;
}

final class L10nRuntimeSnapshot {
  L10nRuntimeSnapshot({
    required this.state,
    required this.fallbackLocale,
    required this.revision,
    required Set<String> loadedLocales,
  }) : loadedLocales = Set<String>.unmodifiable(loadedLocales) {
    if (revision < 0) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(revision, 'revision', 'must be non-negative');
    }
  }

  final LocalizationState state;
  final AppLocale fallbackLocale;
  final int revision;
  final Set<String> loadedLocales;

  AppLocale get userLocale => state.userLocale;
  AppLocale get sourceLocale => state.sourceLocale;
  AppLocale get targetLocale => state.targetLocale;
  bool get isRtl => userLocale.isRtl;
  String get direction => userLocale.direction.jsonValue;
}

final class L10nEngineChange {
  const L10nEngineChange({
    required this.reason,
    required this.previous,
    required this.current,
    this.dictionaryLocale,
  });

  final L10nChangeReason reason;
  final L10nRuntimeSnapshot previous;
  final L10nRuntimeSnapshot current;
  final String? dictionaryLocale;
}

String _validatedMessageKey(String raw) {
  final key = raw.trim();
  if (key.isEmpty ||
      key.length > 160 ||
      !RegExp(r'^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*$').hasMatch(key)) {
    throw FormatException('Invalid localization key: "$raw".');
  }
  return key;
}

String _validatedToken(String raw, String field) {
  final value = raw.trim();
  if (value.isEmpty ||
      value.length > 80 ||
      !RegExp(r'^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*$').hasMatch(value)) {
    throw FormatException('Invalid $field token: "$raw".');
  }
  return value;
}

Set<String> _extractPlaceholders(String template) {
  final result = <String>{};
  final pattern = RegExp(r'\{([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*)\}');
  for (final match in pattern.allMatches(template)) {
    final name = match.group(1);
    if (name != null) result.add(name);
  }
  return result;
}

import 'collaboration_models.dart';

final class AgentMessagingSystem {
  final Map<String, List<AgentMessage>> _mailboxes =
      <String, List<AgentMessage>>{};
  final Set<String> _seenIds = <String>{};

  bool send(AgentMessage message) {
    if (!_isValid(message)) return false;
    if (!_seenIds.add(message.id)) return false;

    final mailbox = _mailboxes.putIfAbsent(
      message.recipientId,
      () => <AgentMessage>[],
    );
    mailbox.add(message);
    mailbox.sort((a, b) {
      final byTime = a.createdAt.compareTo(b.createdAt);
      if (byTime != 0) return byTime;
      return a.id.compareTo(b.id);
    });
    return true;
  }

  List<AgentMessage> pendingFor(String recipientId) =>
      List<AgentMessage>.unmodifiable(
        _mailboxes[recipientId] ?? const <AgentMessage>[],
      );

  bool acknowledge({
    required String recipientId,
    required String messageId,
  }) {
    final mailbox = _mailboxes[recipientId];
    if (mailbox == null) return false;
    final index = mailbox.indexWhere((message) => message.id == messageId);
    if (index < 0) return false;
    mailbox.removeAt(index);
    if (mailbox.isEmpty) _mailboxes.remove(recipientId);
    return true;
  }

  int pendingCount(String recipientId) =>
      _mailboxes[recipientId]?.length ?? 0;

  bool hasSeen(String messageId) => _seenIds.contains(messageId);

  static bool _isValid(AgentMessage message) =>
      message.id.trim().isNotEmpty &&
      message.senderId.trim().isNotEmpty &&
      message.recipientId.trim().isNotEmpty &&
      message.topic.trim().isNotEmpty &&
      message.senderId != message.recipientId;
}

import 'agent_messaging_system.dart';
import 'collaboration_models.dart';
import 'conflict_resolution_engine.dart';

final class AiSyncHub {
  AiSyncHub({
    AgentMessagingSystem? messaging,
    ConflictResolutionEngine conflictEngine =
        const ConflictResolutionEngine(),
  })  : messaging = messaging ?? AgentMessagingSystem(),
        _conflictEngine = conflictEngine;

  final AgentMessagingSystem messaging;
  final ConflictResolutionEngine _conflictEngine;

  SyncEvaluation evaluatePair({
    required BranchChangeSet left,
    required BranchChangeSet right,
    required String coordinatorId,
    required int sequence,
  }) {
    final decision = _conflictEngine.resolve(left: left, right: right);
    final messageIds = <String>[];

    for (final changeSet in <BranchChangeSet>[left, right]) {
      final messageId =
          'sync:$sequence:${changeSet.ownerId}:${left.headSha}:${right.headSha}';
      final sent = messaging.send(
        AgentMessage(
          id: messageId,
          senderId: coordinatorId,
          recipientId: changeSet.ownerId,
          topic: 'sync-decision',
          payload: <String, String>{
            'action': decision.action.name,
            'code': decision.code,
            'left_branch': left.branch,
            'right_branch': right.branch,
            'left_head': left.headSha,
            'right_head': right.headSha,
            'conflicting_paths': decision.conflictingPaths.join(','),
          },
          createdAt: DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(
            sequence,
            isUtc: true,
          ),
        ),
      );
      if (sent) messageIds.add(messageId);
    }

    return SyncEvaluation(
      decision: decision,
      messageIds: List<String>.unmodifiable(messageIds),
    );
  }

  bool handoff({
    required String id,
    required String fromAgent,
    required String toAgent,
    required String scope,
    required String headSha,
    required int sequence,
  }) =>
      messaging.send(
        AgentMessage(
          id: id,
          senderId: fromAgent,
          recipientId: toAgent,
          topic: 'handoff',
          payload: <String, String>{
            'scope': scope,
            'head_sha': headSha,
          },
          createdAt: DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(
            sequence,
            isUtc: true,
          ),
        ),
      );
}

FILE: lib/core/language_agents/sys_ai_collaboration_bridge/conflict_resolution_engine.dart

import 'collaboration_models.dart';

final class ConflictResolutionEngine {
  const ConflictResolutionEngine();

  ConflictDecision resolve({
    required BranchChangeSet left,
    required BranchChangeSet right,
  }) {
    if (!_valid(left) || !_valid(right)) {
      return const ConflictDecision(
        action: ConflictAction.manualResolution,
        code: 'invalid_change_set',
        conflictingPaths: <String>[],
      );
    }

    if (left.headSha == right.headSha && left.branch == right.branch) {
      return const ConflictDecision(
        action: ConflictAction.noOp,
        code: 'same_branch_head',
        conflictingPaths: <String>[],
      );
    }

    final leftByPath = <String, BranchMutation>{
      for (final mutation in left.mutations) mutation.path: mutation,
    };
    final rightByPath = <String, BranchMutation>{
      for (final mutation in right.mutations) mutation.path: mutation,
    };

    final overlaps = leftByPath.keys
        .where(rightByPath.containsKey)
        .toList(growable: false)
      ..sort();

    if (overlaps.isEmpty) {
      return const ConflictDecision(
        action: ConflictAction.autoMerge,
        code: 'disjoint_scopes',
        conflictingPaths: <String>[],
      );
    }

    final divergent = <String>[];
    var allIdentical = true;
    for (final path in overlaps) {
      final a = leftByPath[path]!;
      final b = rightByPath[path]!;
      final sameMutation = a.operation == b.operation &&
          a.contentFingerprint == b.contentFingerprint;
      if (!sameMutation) {
        allIdentical = false;
        divergent.add(path);
      }
    }

    if (allIdentical) {
      final leftOnly = leftByPath.keys.where((path) => !rightByPath.containsKey(path));
      final rightOnly =
          rightByPath.keys.where((path) => !leftByPath.containsKey(path));
      if (leftOnly.isEmpty && rightOnly.isEmpty) {
        return ConflictDecision(
          action: ConflictAction.noOp,
          code: 'identical_mutations',
          conflictingPaths: List<String>.unmodifiable(overlaps),
        );
      }
      return const ConflictDecision(
        action: ConflictAction.autoMerge,
        code: 'identical_overlap_with_disjoint_changes',
        conflictingPaths: <String>[],
      );
    }

    if (left.baseSha != right.baseSha) {
      return ConflictDecision(
        action: ConflictAction.rebaseRequired,
        code: 'divergent_base_with_overlap',
        conflictingPaths: List<String>.unmodifiable(divergent),
      );
    }

    return ConflictDecision(
      action: ConflictAction.manualResolution,
      code: left.ownerId == right.ownerId
          ? 'same_owner_divergent_content'
          : 'cross_owner_divergent_content',
      conflictingPaths: List<String>.unmodifiable(divergent),
    );
  }

  static bool _valid(BranchChangeSet set) {
    if (set.branch.trim().isEmpty ||
        set.ownerId.trim().isEmpty ||
        set.baseSha.trim().isEmpty ||
        set.headSha.trim().isEmpty) {
      return false;
    }
    final seen = <String>{};
    for (final mutation in set.mutations) {
      if (mutation.path.trim().isEmpty ||
          mutation.contentFingerprint.trim().isEmpty ||
          !seen.add(mutation.path)) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    return true;
  }
}

import 'bilingual_models.dart';
import 'contextual_validator.dart';
import 'directed_language_mapper.dart';

final class BilingualEngineHub {
  const BilingualEngineHub({
    this.mapper = const DirectedLanguageMapper(),
    this.validator = const ContextualValidator(),
  });

  final DirectedLanguageMapper mapper;
  final ContextualValidator validator;

  BilingualResolution resolve({
    required String sourceLanguageId,
    required String targetLanguageId,
    required String sourceText,
    required LifeContext context,
  }) {
    final phrase = mapper.map(
      sourceLanguageId: sourceLanguageId,
      targetLanguageId: targetLanguageId,
      sourceText: sourceText,
      context: context,
    );

    if (phrase == null) {
      return BilingualResolution.blocked(
        code: 'direct_pair_not_registered',
        sourceLanguageId: sourceLanguageId,
        targetLanguageId: targetLanguageId,
      );
    }

    final validation = validator.validate(
      phrase: phrase,
      requestedContext: context,
    );
    if (!validation.isValid) {
      return BilingualResolution.blocked(
        code: validation.code,
        sourceLanguageId: sourceLanguageId,
        targetLanguageId: targetLanguageId,
      );
    }

    return BilingualResolution.accepted(phrase);
  }

  List<DirectedPhrase> catalog({
    required String sourceLanguageId,
    required String targetLanguageId,
    LifeContext? context,
  }) =>
      mapper.entriesFor(
        sourceLanguageId: sourceLanguageId,
        targetLanguageId: targetLanguageId,
        context: context,
      );
}

    this.semanticSlots = const <String>[],
    this.notes = '',
  });

final class ContextValidationResult {
  const ContextValidationResult({
    required this.isValid,
    required this.code,
    required this.message,
  });

  final bool isValid;
  final String code;
  final String message;

  const ContextValidationResult.valid()
      : isValid = true,
        code = 'valid',
        message = 'context_and_semantics_valid';

  const ContextValidationResult.invalid(this.code, this.message)

    required this.isAccepted,
    required this.code,
    required this.path,
    this.phrase,
  });

    required String code,

import 'bilingual_models.dart';

final class ContextualValidator {
  const ContextualValidator();

  ContextValidationResult validate({
    required DirectedPhrase phrase,
    required LifeContext requestedContext,
  }) {
    if (phrase.sourceLanguageId.trim().isEmpty ||
        phrase.targetLanguageId.trim().isEmpty ||
        phrase.sourceLanguageId == phrase.targetLanguageId) {
      return const ContextValidationResult.invalid(
        'invalid_directed_pair',
        'source and target languages must be distinct and explicit',
      );
    }

    if (phrase.context != requestedContext) {
      return const ContextValidationResult.invalid(
        'context_mismatch',
        'phrase is not approved for the requested life context',
      );
    }

    if (phrase.sourceText.trim().isEmpty || phrase.targetText.trim().isEmpty) {
      return const ContextValidationResult.invalid(
        'empty_phrase',
        'source and target text must both be present',
      );
    }

    final sourceSlots = _slotsIn(phrase.sourceText);
    final targetSlots = _slotsIn(phrase.targetText);
    final declared = phrase.semanticSlots.toSet();

    if (!sourceSlots.containsAll(declared) ||
        !targetSlots.containsAll(declared)) {
      return const ContextValidationResult.invalid(
        'semantic_slot_missing',
        'declared semantic slots must survive source and target',
      );
    }

    if (!declared.containsAll(sourceSlots) ||
        !declared.containsAll(targetSlots)) {
      return const ContextValidationResult.invalid(
        'undeclared_semantic_slot',
        'all placeholders must be declared explicitly',
      );
    }

    if (phrase.register == PhraseRegister.formal &&
        phrase.context == LifeContext.greeting &&
        phrase.targetText.trim().length < 3) {
      return const ContextValidationResult.invalid(
        'formal_register_too_weak',
        'formal greeting output is underspecified',
      );
    }

    return const ContextValidationResult.valid();
  }

  static Set<String> _slotsIn(String text) {
    final matches = RegExp(r'\{([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\}').allMatches(text);
    return <String>{
      for (final match in matches)
        if (match.group(1) != null) match.group(1)!,
    };
  }
}

import 'bilingual_models.dart';

final class DirectedLanguageMapper {
  const DirectedLanguageMapper({this.catalog = _catalog});

  final List<DirectedPhrase> catalog;

  DirectedPhrase? map({
    required String sourceLanguageId,
    required String targetLanguageId,
    required String sourceText,
    required LifeContext context,
  }) {
    final source = _normalize(sourceText);
    for (final phrase in catalog) {
      if (phrase.sourceLanguageId != sourceLanguageId ||
          phrase.targetLanguageId != targetLanguageId ||
          phrase.context != context) {
        continue;
      }
      if (_normalize(phrase.sourceText) == source) return phrase;
    }
    return null;
  }

  List<DirectedPhrase> entriesFor({
    required String sourceLanguageId,
    required String targetLanguageId,
    LifeContext? context,
  }) =>
      List<DirectedPhrase>.unmodifiable(
        catalog.where(
          (phrase) =>
              phrase.sourceLanguageId == sourceLanguageId &&
              phrase.targetLanguageId == targetLanguageId &&
              (context == null || phrase.context == context),
        ),
      );

  static String _normalize(String value) => value
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ')
      .replaceAll('„', '"')
      .replaceAll('“', '"');
}

import '../../../features/audio/domain/entities/audio_playback_result.dart';
import '../../../features/audio/domain/entities/audio_request.dart';
import '../../../features/audio/domain/services/i_audio_runtime.dart';
import 'speech_models.dart';

final class SpeechPracticeAudioPlayer {
  const SpeechPracticeAudioPlayer({required this.runtime});

  final IAudioRuntime runtime;

  Future<AudioPlaybackResult> play(
    SpeechPracticePrompt prompt, {
    double? rate,
  }) {
    if (!prompt.isValid) {
      return Future<AudioPlaybackResult>.value(
        const AudioPlaybackResult.unavailable('speech_practice_prompt_invalid'),
      );
    }

    return runtime.play(
      AudioRequest(
        text: prompt.text,
        languageCode: prompt.languageCode,
        conceptId: prompt.conceptId,
        variant: AudioVariant.pronunciation,
        rate: rate,
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> stop() => runtime.stop();
}

final class SpeechPracticePrompt {
  const SpeechPracticePrompt({
    required this.id,
    required this.text,
    required this.languageCode,
    required this.localeId,
    required this.conceptId,
    this.acceptedForms = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final String text;
  final String languageCode;
  final String localeId;
  final String conceptId;
  final List<String> acceptedForms;

  bool get isValid =>
      id.trim().isNotEmpty &&
      text.trim().isNotEmpty &&
      languageCode.trim().isNotEmpty &&
      localeId.trim().isNotEmpty &&
      conceptId.trim().isNotEmpty;
}

final class SpeechComparison {
  const SpeechComparison({
    required this.recognizedText,
    required this.matchedTarget,
    required this.similarity,
    required this.isExact,
    required this.isAccepted,
    required this.feedbackCode,
  });

  final String recognizedText;
  final String matchedTarget;
  final double similarity;
  final bool isExact;
  final bool isAccepted;
  final String feedbackCode;
}

final class SpeechRecognitionSnapshot {
  const SpeechRecognitionSnapshot({
    required this.text,
    required this.isFinal,
    required this.evaluation,
  });

  final String text;
  final bool isFinal;
  final SpeechComparison evaluation;
}

import '../../../features/audio/domain/entities/audio_playback_result.dart';
import '../../../features/audio/domain/services/i_audio_runtime.dart';
import 'audio_asset_player.dart';
import 'speech_models.dart';
import 'voice_recognition_engine.dart';

final class SpeechPracticeHub {
  SpeechPracticeHub({
    required IAudioRuntime audioRuntime,
    VoiceRecognitionEngine recognitionEngine =
        const VoiceRecognitionEngine(),
  })  : _audioPlayer = SpeechPracticeAudioPlayer(runtime: audioRuntime),
        _recognitionEngine = recognitionEngine;

  final SpeechPracticeAudioPlayer _audioPlayer;
  final VoiceRecognitionEngine _recognitionEngine;

  Future<AudioPlaybackResult> play(
    SpeechPracticePrompt prompt, {
    double? rate,
  }) =>
      _audioPlayer.play(prompt, rate: rate);

  Future<void> stopAudio() => _audioPlayer.stop();

  SpeechComparison evaluateTranscript({
    required SpeechPracticePrompt prompt,
    required String recognizedText,
  }) =>
      _recognitionEngine.compare(
        prompt: prompt,
        recognizedText: recognizedText,
      );

  SpeechRecognitionSession createRecognitionSession(
    SpeechPracticePrompt prompt,
  ) {
    if (!prompt.isValid) {
      throw ArgumentError('speech practice prompt must be complete');
    }
    return _recognitionEngine.createSession(prompt);
  }
}

FILE: lib/core/language_agents/sys_pronunciation_speech_practice/voice_recognition_engine.dart

import '../../infrastructure/audio/speech_to_text_engine.dart';
import 'speech_models.dart';

final class VoiceRecognitionEngine {
  const VoiceRecognitionEngine();

  SpeechComparison compare({
    required SpeechPracticePrompt prompt,
    required String recognizedText,
  }) {
    if (!prompt.isValid) {
      return SpeechComparison(
        recognizedText: recognizedText,
        matchedTarget: prompt.text,
        similarity: 0,
        isExact: false,
        isAccepted: false,
        feedbackCode: 'invalid_prompt',
      );
    }

    final recognized = _normalize(recognizedText);
    final targets = <String>[prompt.text, ...prompt.acceptedForms];

    var bestTarget = prompt.text;
    var bestScore = 0.0;
    var exact = false;

    for (final target in targets) {
      final normalizedTarget = _normalize(target);
      final isExactMatch =
          recognized.isNotEmpty && recognized == normalizedTarget;
      final score = isExactMatch
          ? 1.0
          : _similarity(recognized, normalizedTarget);
      if (score > bestScore || isExactMatch) {
        bestScore = score;
        bestTarget = target;
        exact = isExactMatch;
      }
      if (isExactMatch) break;
    }

    final accepted = exact || bestScore >= 0.84;
    final feedback = exact
        ? 'exact_match'
        : bestScore >= 0.84
            ? 'close_match'
            : bestScore >= 0.62
                ? 'needs_refinement'
                : 'retry_required';

    return SpeechComparison(
      recognizedText: recognizedText.trim(),
      matchedTarget: bestTarget,
      similarity: bestScore.clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble(),
      isExact: exact,
      isAccepted: accepted,
      feedbackCode: feedback,
    );
  }

  SpeechRecognitionSession createSession(SpeechPracticePrompt prompt) =>
      SpeechRecognitionSession(
        prompt: prompt,
        engine: SpeechToTextEngine(localeId: prompt.localeId),
        comparator: this,
      );

  static String _normalize(String value) => value
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replaceAll('ß', 'ss')
      .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[\u064B-\u065F\u0670]'), '')
      .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[.,!?;:،؟“”„()]'), ' ')
      .replaceAll("'", ' ')
      .replaceAll('"', ' ')
      .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ')
      .trim();

  static double _similarity(String left, String right) {
    if (left == right && left.isNotEmpty) return 1;
    if (left.isEmpty || right.isEmpty) return 0;

    final distance = _levenshtein(left, right);
    final longest = left.length > right.length ? left.length : right.length;
    return 1 - (distance / longest);
  }

  static int _levenshtein(String left, String right) {
    var previous = List<int>.generate(right.length + 1, (i) => i);
    for (var i = 1; i <= left.length; i++) {
      final current = List<int>.filled(right.length + 1, 0);
      current[0] = i;
      for (var j = 1; j <= right.length; j++) {
        final substitutionCost =
            left.codeUnitAt(i - 1) == right.codeUnitAt(j - 1) ? 0 : 1;
        final deletion = previous[j] + 1;
        final insertion = current[j - 1] + 1;
        final substitution = previous[j - 1] + substitutionCost;
        current[j] = _min3(deletion, insertion, substitution);
      }
      previous = current;
    }
    return previous[right.length];
  }

  static int _min3(int a, int b, int c) {
    var result = a < b ? a : b;
    if (c < result) result = c;
    return result;
  }
}

final class SpeechRecognitionSession {
  SpeechRecognitionSession({
    required this.prompt,
    required SpeechToTextEngine engine,
    required VoiceRecognitionEngine comparator,
  })  : _engine = engine,
        _comparator = comparator;

  final SpeechPracticePrompt prompt;
  final SpeechToTextEngine _engine;
  final VoiceRecognitionEngine _comparator;

  Future<bool> initialize() => _engine.initialize();

  Future<bool> listen({
    required void Function(SpeechRecognitionSnapshot snapshot) onResult,
  }) =>
      _engine.listen(
        onResult: (result) {
          onResult(
            SpeechRecognitionSnapshot(
              text: result.recognizedWords,
              isFinal: result.finalResult,
              evaluation: _comparator.compare(
                prompt: prompt,
                recognizedText: result.recognizedWords,
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      );

  Future<void> stop() => _engine.stop();

  bool get isListening => _engine.isListening;

  void dispose() => _engine.dispose();
}

FILE: lib/core/localization/german_article_style.dart

/// German noun articles are a German-language concern and must never become a
/// universal gender/article schema for other languages.
enum GermanArticle { der, die, das }

final class GermanArticleStyle {
  final GermanArticle article;
  final String gender;
  final int colorArgb;
  final String colorToken;

  const GermanArticleStyle._({
    required this.article,
    required this.gender,
    required this.colorArgb,
    required this.colorToken,
  });

  static const GermanArticleStyle der = GermanArticleStyle._(
    article: GermanArticle.der,
    gender: 'masculine',
    colorArgb: 0xFF1976D2,
    colorToken: 'germanArticle.der',
  );

  static const GermanArticleStyle die = GermanArticleStyle._(
    article: GermanArticle.die,
    gender: 'feminine',
    colorArgb: 0xFFD32F2F,
    colorToken: 'germanArticle.die',
  );

  static const GermanArticleStyle das = GermanArticleStyle._(
    article: GermanArticle.das,
    gender: 'neuter',
    colorArgb: 0xFF388E3C,
    colorToken: 'germanArticle.das',
  );

  static GermanArticleStyle forGermanNoun({
    required String languageCode,
    required String article,
  }) {
    final language =
        languageCode.trim().toLowerCase().split(RegExp(r'[-_]')).first;
    if (language != 'de') {
      throw ArgumentError('German article styling is only valid for German');
    }
    return switch (article.trim().toLowerCase()) {
      'der' => der,
      'die' => die,
      'das' => das,
      _ => throw FormatException('unsupported German article: $article'),
    };
  }
}

FILE: lib/core/localization/locale_direction_provider.dart

import '../language/app_text_direction.dart';

/// Localization-specific direction resolver.
///
/// This extends the legacy Arabic-only fallback without changing the existing
/// language contract. Direction remains explicit metadata at runtime.
abstract final class LocaleDirectionProvider {
  static const Set<String> rtlLanguageCodes = <String>{
    'ar',
    'fa',
    'he',
    'ur',
    'ps',
  };

  static AppTextDirection resolve(String localeCode) {
    final primary = _primaryLanguage(localeCode);
    return rtlLanguageCodes.contains(primary)
        ? AppTextDirection.rtl
        : AppTextDirection.ltr;
  }

  static String _primaryLanguage(String localeCode) {
    final normalized = localeCode.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (normalized.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(localeCode, 'localeCode', 'must not be empty');
    }
    return normalized.split(RegExp(r'[-_]')).first;
  }
}

FILE: lib/core/localization/locale_provider.dart

import '../language/app_text_direction.dart';
import 'locale_direction_provider.dart';

/// Framework-neutral locale value used by Core.
final class AppLocale {
  final String languageCode;
  final String? regionCode;
  final AppTextDirection direction;

  const AppLocale._({
    required this.languageCode,
    required this.regionCode,
    required this.direction,
  });

  factory AppLocale.parse(String languageTag) {
    final normalized = languageTag.trim();
    if (normalized.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(languageTag, 'languageTag', 'must not be empty');
    }
    final parts = normalized.split(RegExp(r'[-_]'));
    final language = parts.first.toLowerCase();
    final region = parts.length > 1 && parts[1].isNotEmpty
        ? parts[1].toUpperCase()
        : null;
    return AppLocale._(
      languageCode: language,
      regionCode: region,
      direction: LocaleDirectionProvider.resolve(language),
    );
  }

  String get languageTag =>
      regionCode == null ? languageCode : '$languageCode-$regionCode';

  bool get isRtl => direction == AppTextDirection.rtl;
}

/// Read-only contract consumed by application/presentation composition.
abstract interface class LocaleProvider {
  AppLocale get userLocale;
  AppLocale get sourceLocale;
  AppLocale get targetLocale;
}

/// Keeps interface, source, and target language identities separate.
///
/// Equal values are allowed because a user's UI language can legitimately be
/// the target language. The fields remain semantically distinct so no implicit
/// German/English pivot or reverse-pair assumption is introduced.
final class LocalizationState implements LocaleProvider {
  @override
  final AppLocale userLocale;

  @override
  final AppLocale sourceLocale;

  @override
  final AppLocale targetLocale;

  const LocalizationState({
    required this.userLocale,
    required this.sourceLocale,
    required this.targetLocale,
  });

    required String userLanguageTag,
    required String sourceLanguageTag,
    required String targetLanguageTag,

      LocalizationState(
        userLocale: AppLocale.parse(userLanguageTag),
        sourceLocale: AppLocale.parse(sourceLanguageTag),
        targetLocale: AppLocale.parse(targetLanguageTag),
      );

FILE: lib/core/media/cache_manager.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'dart:collection';
import 'dart:typed_data';

/// Memory-only LRU cache for lightweight vocabulary images.
final class CacheManager {
  CacheManager({
    this.maxEntries = 48,
    this.maxBytes = 2 * 1024 * 1024,
  })  : assert(maxEntries > 0),
        assert(maxBytes > 0);

  final int maxEntries;
  final int maxBytes;
  final LinkedHashMap<String, Uint8List> _entries = LinkedHashMap();

  int _currentBytes = 0;

  int get length => _entries.length;
  int get currentBytes => _currentBytes;
  Iterable<String> get keys => List<String>.unmodifiable(_entries.keys);

  Uint8List? get(String key) {
    final value = _entries.remove(key);
    if (value == null) return null;
    _entries[key] = value;
    return value;
  }

  void put(String key, Uint8List bytes) {
    if (key.isEmpty || bytes.isEmpty) return;
    final previous = _entries.remove(key);
    if (previous != null) {
      _currentBytes -= previous.lengthInBytes;
    }

    if (bytes.lengthInBytes > maxBytes) {
      return;
    }

    _entries[key] = bytes;
    _currentBytes += bytes.lengthInBytes;
    _evictToBudget();
  }

  bool contains(String key) => _entries.containsKey(key);

  void remove(String key) {
    final removed = _entries.remove(key);
    if (removed != null) {
      _currentBytes -= removed.lengthInBytes;
    }
  }

  void clear() {
    _entries.clear();
    _currentBytes = 0;
  }

  void _evictToBudget() {
    while (_entries.length > maxEntries || _currentBytes > maxBytes) {
      final oldest = _entries.keys.first;
      final removed = _entries.remove(oldest);
      if (removed != null) {
        _currentBytes -= removed.lengthInBytes;
      }
    }
  }
}

FILE: lib/core/notifications/contextual_notification_permission.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter_local_notifications/flutter_local_notifications.dart';

enum NotificationPermissionStatus {
  notRequired,
  granted,
  denied,
  unavailable,
}

final class NotificationOptInContext {
  const NotificationOptInContext({
    required this.userInitiated,
    required this.remindersEnabled,
    required this.rationalePresented,
    required this.reason,
  });

  final bool userInitiated;
  final bool remindersEnabled;
  final bool rationalePresented;
  final String reason;

  bool get mayPrompt =>
      userInitiated &&
      remindersEnabled &&
      rationalePresented &&
      reason.trim().isNotEmpty;
}

abstract interface class NotificationPermissionGateway {
  Future<NotificationPermissionStatus> status();

  Future<NotificationPermissionStatus> request(
    NotificationOptInContext context,
  );
}

final class ContextualNotificationPermissionGateway
    implements NotificationPermissionGateway {
  ContextualNotificationPermissionGateway({
    FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin? plugin,
  }) : _plugin = plugin ?? FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin();

  final FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin _plugin;

  @override
  Future<NotificationPermissionStatus> status() async {
    if (!_isAndroid) {
      return NotificationPermissionStatus.notRequired;
    }

    final android = _plugin.resolvePlatformSpecificImplementation<
        AndroidFlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin>();
    if (android == null) {
      return NotificationPermissionStatus.unavailable;
    }

    final enabled = await android.areNotificationsEnabled();
    if (enabled == true) {
      return NotificationPermissionStatus.granted;
    }
    return NotificationPermissionStatus.denied;
  }

  @override
  Future<NotificationPermissionStatus> request(
    NotificationOptInContext context,
  ) async {
    final current = await status();
    if (current == NotificationPermissionStatus.granted ||
        current == NotificationPermissionStatus.notRequired) {
      return current;
    }

    if (!context.mayPrompt) {
      return current;
    }

    if (!_isAndroid) {
      return NotificationPermissionStatus.notRequired;
    }

    final android = _plugin.resolvePlatformSpecificImplementation<
        AndroidFlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin>();
    if (android == null) {
      return NotificationPermissionStatus.unavailable;
    }

    final granted = await android.requestNotificationsPermission();
    return granted == true
        ? NotificationPermissionStatus.granted
        : NotificationPermissionStatus.denied;
  }

  bool get _isAndroid =>
      !kIsWeb && defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.android;
}

import 'package:flutter_local_notifications/flutter_local_notifications.dart';
import 'package:timezone/timezone.dart' as tz;

import '../../features/notifications/domain/notification_contracts.dart';
import '../../features/notifications/domain/notification_models.dart';
import '../time/device_time_zone_provider.dart';
import 'contextual_notification_permission.dart';

final class FlexibleNotificationWindow {
  FlexibleNotificationWindow({
    required DateTime preferredLocal,
    this.before = const Duration(minutes: 20),
    this.after = const Duration(minutes: 40),
  }) : preferredLocal = _requireLocal(preferredLocal) {
    if (before.isNegative ||
        after.isNegative ||
        before > const Duration(hours: 2) ||
        after > const Duration(hours: 2)) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'Notification flexibility must remain within a two-hour window.',
      );
    }
  }

  final DateTime preferredLocal;
  final Duration before;
  final Duration after;

  DateTime get earliestLocal => preferredLocal.subtract(before);
  DateTime get latestLocal => preferredLocal.add(after);

  static DateTime _requireLocal(DateTime value) {
    if (value.isUtc) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        value,
        'preferredLocal',
        'must be a local wall-clock value',
      );
    }
    return value;
  }
}

final class InexactNotificationPolicy {
  const InexactNotificationPolicy({
    this.before = const Duration(minutes: 20),
    this.after = const Duration(minutes: 40),
  });

  final Duration before;
  final Duration after;

  FlexibleNotificationWindow windowFor(DateTime preferredLocal) =>
      FlexibleNotificationWindow(
        preferredLocal: preferredLocal,
        before: before,
        after: after,
      );
}

final class InexactLocalNotificationService
    implements NotificationServiceContract {
  factory InexactLocalNotificationService({
    FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin? plugin,
    DeviceTimeZoneProvider? timeZoneProvider,
    NotificationPermissionGateway? permissionGateway,
    InexactNotificationPolicy policy = const InexactNotificationPolicy(),
  }) {
    final resolvedPlugin = plugin ?? FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin();
    return InexactLocalNotificationService._(
      plugin: resolvedPlugin,
      timeZoneProvider:
          timeZoneProvider ?? SystemDeviceTimeZoneProvider(),
      permissionGateway: permissionGateway ??
          ContextualNotificationPermissionGateway(
            plugin: resolvedPlugin,
          ),
      policy: policy,
    );
  }

  InexactLocalNotificationService._({
    required FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin plugin,
    required DeviceTimeZoneProvider timeZoneProvider,
    required NotificationPermissionGateway permissionGateway,
    required InexactNotificationPolicy policy,
  })  : _plugin = plugin,
        _timeZoneProvider = timeZoneProvider,
        _permissionGateway = permissionGateway,
        _policy = policy;

  final FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin _plugin;
  final DeviceTimeZoneProvider _timeZoneProvider;
  final NotificationPermissionGateway _permissionGateway;
  final InexactNotificationPolicy _policy;

  bool _initialized = false;

  Future<NotificationPermissionStatus> permissionStatus() =>
      _permissionGateway.status();

  Future<NotificationPermissionStatus> requestPermission(
    NotificationOptInContext context,
  ) =>
      _permissionGateway.request(context);

  @override
  Future<void> initialize() async {
    if (_initialized) return;

    await _timeZoneProvider.resolve(forceRefresh: true);

    const settings = InitializationSettings(
      android: AndroidInitializationSettings('@mipmap/ic_launcher'),
      iOS: DarwinInitializationSettings(
        requestAlertPermission: false,
        requestBadgePermission: false,
        requestSoundPermission: false,
      ),
      macOS: DarwinInitializationSettings(
        requestAlertPermission: false,
        requestBadgePermission: false,
        requestSoundPermission: false,
      ),
    );
    await _plugin.initialize(settings: settings);
    _initialized = true;
  }

  @override
  Future<void> replaceAll(
    List<ScheduledNotificationItem> items,
  ) async {
    await initialize();

    final permission = await _permissionGateway.status();
    if (permission == NotificationPermissionStatus.denied ||
        permission == NotificationPermissionStatus.unavailable) {
      throw StateError('notification_permission_required');
    }

    await _plugin.cancelAll();
    for (final item in items) {
      await _schedule(item);
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> cancelAll() async {
    await initialize();
    await _plugin.cancelAll();
  }

  Future<void> _schedule(ScheduledNotificationItem item) async {
    final snapshot = await _timeZoneProvider.resolve();
    final preferred = item.scheduledAtLocal.isUtc
        ? await _timeZoneProvider.toLocal(item.scheduledAtLocal)
        : item.scheduledAtLocal;
    final window = _policy.windowFor(preferred);

    final scheduled = tz.TZDateTime(
      snapshot.location,
      window.preferredLocal.year,
      window.preferredLocal.month,
      window.preferredLocal.day,
      window.preferredLocal.hour,
      window.preferredLocal.minute,
      window.preferredLocal.second,
      window.preferredLocal.millisecond,
      window.preferredLocal.microsecond,
    );

    final silent = item.tone == NotificationTone.silent;
    final gentle = item.tone == NotificationTone.gentle;

    final android = AndroidNotificationDetails(
      'adaptive_habit_reminders',
      'Adaptive Habit Reminders',
      channelDescription:
          'Local reminders delivered in battery-friendly flexible windows.',
      importance: gentle ? Importance.defaultImportance : Importance.high,
      priority: gentle ? Priority.defaultPriority : Priority.high,
      playSound: !silent,
    );
    final darwin = DarwinNotificationDetails(
      presentAlert: true,
      presentBadge: false,
      presentSound: !silent,
    );

    await _plugin.zonedSchedule(
      id: item.id,
      title: item.title,
      body: item.body,
      scheduledDate: scheduled,
      notificationDetails: NotificationDetails(
        android: android,
        iOS: darwin,
        macOS: darwin,
      ),
      androidScheduleMode: AndroidScheduleMode.inexact,
      payload: item.payload,
      matchDateTimeComponents:
          item.repeatDaily ? DateTimeComponents.time : null,
    );
  }
}

FILE: lib/core/orchestration/agent_batch_processing.dart

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:collection';

import 'agent_data_integrity.dart';
import 'orchestration_models.dart';

typedef AgentBatchProcessor<T> = Future<void> Function(List<T> items);
typedef AgentBatchDedupeKey<T> = String Function(T item);

final class AgentBatchQueueStats {
  const AgentBatchQueueStats({
    required this.submitted,
    required this.processed,
    required this.failed,
    required this.coalesced,
    required this.batches,
    required this.maxPendingObserved,
  });

  final int submitted;
  final int processed;
  final int failed;
  final int coalesced;
  final int batches;
  final int maxPendingObserved;
}

final class AgentBatchQueue<T> {
  AgentBatchQueue({
    required this.maxBatchSize,
    required this.maxPending,
    required this.flushDelay,
    required this.dedupeKeyOf,
    required this.processBatch,
  }) {
    if (maxBatchSize < 1 || maxBatchSize > 256) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        maxBatchSize,
        'maxBatchSize',
        'must be between 1 and 256',
      );
    }
    if (maxPending < maxBatchSize || maxPending > 10000) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        maxPending,
        'maxPending',
        'must be >= maxBatchSize and <= 10000',
      );
    }
    if (flushDelay.isNegative) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        flushDelay,
        'flushDelay',
        'must not be negative',
      );
    }
  }

  final int maxBatchSize;
  final int maxPending;
  final Duration flushDelay;
  final AgentBatchDedupeKey<T> dedupeKeyOf;
  final AgentBatchProcessor<T> processBatch;

  final LinkedHashMap<String, _PendingBatchItem<T>> _entries =
      LinkedHashMap<String, _PendingBatchItem<T>>();
  final Queue<String> _order = Queue<String>();

  Timer? _flushTimer;
  Completer<void>? _idleCompleter;
  bool _draining = false;
  bool _accepting = true;

  int _submitted = 0;
  int _processed = 0;
  int _failed = 0;
  int _coalesced = 0;
  int _batches = 0;
  int _maxPendingObserved = 0;

  bool get isClosed => !_accepting;
  int get pendingCount => _entries.length;

  AgentBatchQueueStats get stats => AgentBatchQueueStats(
        submitted: _submitted,
        processed: _processed,
        failed: _failed,
        coalesced: _coalesced,
        batches: _batches,
        maxPendingObserved: _maxPendingObserved,
      );

  Future<void> submit(T item) {
    if (!_accepting) {
      return Future<void>.error(
        StateError('AgentBatchQueue is closed.'),
      );
    }

    final key = dedupeKeyOf(item).trim();
    if (key.isEmpty) {
      return Future<void>.error(
        ArgumentError.value(key, 'dedupeKey', 'must not be empty'),
      );
    }

    final existing = _entries[key];
    if (existing != null) {
      _coalesced += 1;
      return existing.completer.future;
    }

    if (_entries.length >= maxPending) {
      return Future<void>.error(
        StateError(
          'AgentBatchQueue capacity exceeded: $maxPending pending items.',
        ),
      );
    }

    final pending = _PendingBatchItem<T>(item);
    _entries[key] = pending;
    _order.addLast(key);
    _submitted += 1;
    if (_entries.length > _maxPendingObserved) {
      _maxPendingObserved = _entries.length;
    }

    if (_order.length >= maxBatchSize || flushDelay == Duration.zero) {
      _startDrain();
    } else {
      _flushTimer ??= Timer(flushDelay, _startDrain);
    }

    return pending.completer.future;
  }

  Future<void> flush() async {
    _flushTimer?.cancel();
    _flushTimer = null;

    if (_order.isEmpty && !_draining) return;

    _startDrain();
    final idle = _idleCompleter;
    if (idle != null) {
      await idle.future;
    }
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    if (!_accepting) {
      await flush();
      return;
    }
    _accepting = false;
    await flush();
  }

  void _startDrain() {
    _flushTimer?.cancel();
    _flushTimer = null;

    if (_draining) return;
    if (_order.isEmpty) {
      _completeIdle();
      return;
    }

    _draining = true;
    _idleCompleter ??= Completer<void>();
    scheduleMicrotask(() async {
      try {
        await _drainLoop();
      } finally {
        _draining = false;
        if (_order.isEmpty) {
          _completeIdle();
        } else {
          _startDrain();
        }
      }
    });
  }

  Future<void> _drainLoop() async {
    while (_order.isNotEmpty) {
      final keys = <String>[];
      while (keys.length < maxBatchSize && _order.isNotEmpty) {
        keys.add(_order.removeFirst());
      }

      final items = <T>[
        for (final key in keys) _entries[key]!.item,
      ];
      _batches += 1;

      try {
        await processBatch(List<T>.unmodifiable(items));
        for (final key in keys) {
          final pending = _entries.remove(key);
          if (pending == null || pending.completer.isCompleted) continue;
          _processed += 1;
          pending.completer.complete();
        }
      } on Object catch (error, stackTrace) {
        for (final key in keys) {
          final pending = _entries.remove(key);
          if (pending == null || pending.completer.isCompleted) continue;
          _failed += 1;
          pending.completer.completeError(error, stackTrace);
        }
      }

      await Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);
    }
  }

  void _completeIdle() {
    final idle = _idleCompleter;
    _idleCompleter = null;
    if (idle != null && !idle.isCompleted) {
      idle.complete();
    }
  }
}

final class _PendingBatchItem<T> {
  _PendingBatchItem(this.item);

  final T item;
  final Completer<void> completer = Completer<void>();
}

final class AgentBatchEvent {
  AgentBatchEvent({
    required String dedupeKey,
    required String topic,
    required AgentContextSnapshot context,
    required Set<AgentRole> targetRoles,
    required Map<String, Object?> payload,
    this.integrityRecord,
  })  : dedupeKey = _requiredToken(dedupeKey, 'dedupeKey'),
        topic = _requiredToken(topic, 'topic').toLowerCase(),
        context = context,
        targetRoles = Set<AgentRole>.unmodifiable(targetRoles),
        payload = Map<String, Object?>.unmodifiable(payload);

  final String dedupeKey;
  final String topic;
  final AgentContextSnapshot context;
  final Set<AgentRole> targetRoles;
  final Map<String, Object?> payload;
  final AgentDataRecord? integrityRecord;

  bool get requiresIntegrity =>
      topic == AgentTopics.grammarRequest ||
      topic == AgentTopics.cardsRequest;

  AgentBatchEvent withContext(AgentContextSnapshot nextContext) =>
      AgentBatchEvent(
        dedupeKey: dedupeKey,
        topic: topic,
        context: nextContext,
        targetRoles: targetRoles,
        payload: payload,
        integrityRecord: integrityRecord,
      );
}

final class AgentBatchIntegrityException implements Exception {
  AgentBatchIntegrityException(this.message);

  final String message;

  @override
  String toString() => 'AgentBatchIntegrityException($message)';
}

void verifyGuardedAgentBatch(List<AgentBatchEvent> events) {
  final guarded = events.where((event) => event.requiresIntegrity).toList();
  if (guarded.isEmpty) return;

  for (final event in guarded) {
    if (event.integrityRecord == null) {
      throw AgentBatchIntegrityException(
        'Integrity metadata is required for ${event.topic}.',
      );
    }
  }

  final report = const AgentDataIntegrityVerifier().verify(
    guarded.map((event) => event.integrityRecord!),
  );
  if (!report.isValid) {
    final codes = report.issues
        .map((issue) => issue.code.name)
        .toSet()
        .join(',');
    throw AgentBatchIntegrityException(
      'Batch rejected by data integrity guard: $codes',
    );
  }
}

final class AgentEventBatchDispatcher {
  AgentEventBatchDispatcher({
    required AgentBatchQueue<AgentBatchEvent> queue,
    int Function()? currentPairEpoch,
  })  : _queue = queue,
        _currentPairEpoch = currentPairEpoch ?? _zeroEpoch;

  final AgentBatchQueue<AgentBatchEvent> _queue;
  final int Function() _currentPairEpoch;
  int _generation = 0;

  AgentBatchQueueStats get stats => _queue.stats;
  int get generation => _generation;

  Future<void> submit(AgentBatchEvent event) {
    _generation += 1;
    final context = event.context.withTemporal(
      pairEpoch: event.context.pairEpoch == 0
          ? _currentPairEpoch()
          : event.context.pairEpoch,
      generation: event.context.generation == 0
          ? _generation
          : event.context.generation,
    );
    return _queue.submit(event.withContext(context));
  }

  Future<void> flush() => _queue.flush();

  Future<void> close() => _queue.close();

  static int _zeroEpoch() => 0;
}

String _requiredToken(String value, String field) {
  final normalized = value.trim();
  if (normalized.isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(value, field, 'must not be empty');
  }
  return normalized;
}

enum AgentDataDomain {
  vocabulary,
  grammar,
}

enum AgentDataIntegrityCode {
  duplicateEntry,
  conflictingEntry,
  crossPairIdCollision,
  recordIdCollision,
  invalidRecord,
}

final class AgentDataRecord {
  const AgentDataRecord({
    required this.recordId,
    required this.domain,
    required this.sourceLanguage,
    required this.targetLanguage,
    required this.canonicalKey,
    required this.fingerprint,
  });

  final String recordId;
  final AgentDataDomain domain;
  final String sourceLanguage;
  final String targetLanguage;
  final String canonicalKey;
  final String fingerprint;

  String get directedPairKey =>
      _language(sourceLanguage) + '->' + _language(targetLanguage);

  String get entryKey =>
      domain.name + '|' + directedPairKey + '|' + canonicalKey.trim();

  AgentDataRecord normalized() => AgentDataRecord(
        recordId: recordId.trim(),
        domain: domain,
        sourceLanguage: _language(sourceLanguage),
        targetLanguage: _language(targetLanguage),
        canonicalKey: canonicalKey.trim(),
        fingerprint: fingerprint.trim(),
      );

  bool get isStructurallyValid =>
      recordId.trim().isNotEmpty &&
      _validLanguage(sourceLanguage) &&
      _validLanguage(targetLanguage) &&
      canonicalKey.trim().isNotEmpty &&
      fingerprint.trim().isNotEmpty;
}

final class AgentDataIntegrityIssue {
  const AgentDataIntegrityIssue({
    required this.code,
    required this.recordId,
    required this.message,
  });

  final AgentDataIntegrityCode code;
  final String recordId;
  final String message;
}

final class AgentDataIntegrityReport {
  AgentDataIntegrityReport({
    required this.checkedRecords,
    required List<AgentDataIntegrityIssue> issues,
  }) : issues = List<AgentDataIntegrityIssue>.unmodifiable(issues);

  final int checkedRecords;
  final List<AgentDataIntegrityIssue> issues;

  bool get isValid => issues.isEmpty;

  bool hasCode(AgentDataIntegrityCode code) =>
      issues.any((issue) => issue.code == code);
}

final class AgentDataIntegrityVerifier {
  const AgentDataIntegrityVerifier();

  AgentDataIntegrityReport verify(Iterable<AgentDataRecord> records) {
    final issues = <AgentDataIntegrityIssue>[];
    final entries = <String, AgentDataRecord>{};
    final ids = <String, AgentDataRecord>{};
    var checked = 0;

    for (final raw in records) {
      checked += 1;
      if (!raw.isStructurallyValid) {
        issues.add(
          AgentDataIntegrityIssue(
            code: AgentDataIntegrityCode.invalidRecord,
            recordId: raw.recordId.trim(),
            message: 'Record contains an empty or invalid identity field.',
          ),
        );
        continue;
      }

      final record = raw.normalized();
      final previousEntry = entries[record.entryKey];
      if (previousEntry != null) {
        final sameContent =
            previousEntry.fingerprint == record.fingerprint;
        issues.add(
          AgentDataIntegrityIssue(
            code: sameContent
                ? AgentDataIntegrityCode.duplicateEntry
                : AgentDataIntegrityCode.conflictingEntry,
            recordId: record.recordId,
            message: sameContent
                ? 'Duplicate ${record.domain.name} entry for '
                    '${record.directedPairKey}:${record.canonicalKey}.'
                : 'Conflicting ${record.domain.name} entry for '
                    '${record.directedPairKey}:${record.canonicalKey}.',
          ),
        );
      } else {
        entries[record.entryKey] = record;
      }

      final previousId = ids[record.recordId];
      if (previousId == null) {
        ids[record.recordId] = record;
        continue;
      }

      if (previousId.directedPairKey != record.directedPairKey) {
        issues.add(
          AgentDataIntegrityIssue(
            code: AgentDataIntegrityCode.crossPairIdCollision,
            recordId: record.recordId,
            message: 'Record id crosses directed language pairs: '
                '${previousId.directedPairKey} vs '
                '${record.directedPairKey}.',
          ),
        );
        continue;
      }

      if (previousId.entryKey != record.entryKey ||
          previousId.fingerprint != record.fingerprint) {
        issues.add(
          AgentDataIntegrityIssue(
            code: AgentDataIntegrityCode.recordIdCollision,
            recordId: record.recordId,
            message: 'Record id maps to conflicting content.',
          ),
        );
      }
    }

    return AgentDataIntegrityReport(
      checkedRecords: checked,
      issues: issues,
    );
  }
}

String _language(String value) =>
    value.trim().replaceAll('_', '-').toLowerCase();

bool _validLanguage(String value) {
  final normalized = _language(value);
  if (normalized.isEmpty || normalized.length > 35) return false;
  return RegExp(
    r'^[a-z]{2,8}(?:-[a-z0-9]{1,8})*$',
    caseSensitive: false,
  ).hasMatch(normalized);
}
