import 'dart:async';

import 'orchestration_models.dart';

final class AgentEventBus {
  AgentEventBus()
      : _transport = _applicationTransport,
        _ownsTransport = false;

  AgentEventBus.isolated()
      : _transport = _EventTransport(),
        _ownsTransport = true;

  static final _EventTransport _applicationTransport = _EventTransport();

  final _EventTransport _transport;
  final bool _ownsTransport;
  int _sequence = 0;
  bool _closed = false;

  int get publishedCount => _sequence;
  int get pairEpoch => _transport.pairEpoch;
  int get droppedStaleCount => _transport.droppedStaleCount;
  bool get isClosed => _closed;
  bool get usesApplicationTransport => !_ownsTransport;

  AgentEvent publish({
    required AgentDescriptor source,
    required String topic,
    required Map<String, Object?> payload,
    required AgentContextSnapshot context,
    Set<AgentRole> targetRoles = const <AgentRole>{},
  }) {
    if (_closed) {
      throw StateError('Cannot publish to a closed AgentEventBus.');
    }

    final normalizedTopic = topic.trim().toLowerCase();
    var stampedContext = context;

    if (normalizedTopic == AgentTopics.localizationChangeRequested) {
      if (context.pairEpoch != 0 && context.pairEpoch != _transport.pairEpoch) {
        return _dropStale(
          source: source,
          topic: normalizedTopic,
          payload: payload,
          context: context,
          targetRoles: targetRoles,
        );
      }
      _transport.pairEpoch += 1;
      stampedContext = context.withTemporal(pairEpoch: _transport.pairEpoch);
    } else {
      final eventEpoch =
          context.pairEpoch == 0 ? _transport.pairEpoch : context.pairEpoch;
      stampedContext = context.withTemporal(pairEpoch: eventEpoch);
      if (eventEpoch != _transport.pairEpoch) {
        return _dropStale(
          source: source,
          topic: normalizedTopic,
          payload: payload,
          context: stampedContext,
          targetRoles: targetRoles,
        );
      }
    }

    final sequence = ++_sequence;
    if (stampedContext.generation == 0) {
      stampedContext = stampedContext.withTemporal(generation: sequence);
    }

    final event = AgentEvent(
      sequence: sequence,
      topic: normalizedTopic,
      sourceAgentId: source.id,
      sourceRole: source.role,
      targetRoles: targetRoles,
      context: stampedContext,
      payload: payload,
    );
    _transport.add(event);
    return event;
  }

  Stream<AgentEvent> eventsFor(
    AgentDescriptor subscriber,
    String topic,
  ) {
    final normalizedTopic = topic.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!subscriber.subscribesTo(normalizedTopic)) {
      return const Stream<AgentEvent>.empty();
    }

    return _transport.stream.where(
      (event) =>
          event.topic == normalizedTopic &&
          event.sourceAgentId != subscriber.id &&
          (event.isAddressedTo(subscriber.role) ||
              subscriber.observesTargetedEvents),
    );
  }

  Stream<AgentEvent> allEventsFor(AgentDescriptor subscriber) =>
      _transport.stream.where(
        (event) =>
            event.sourceAgentId != subscriber.id &&
            subscriber.subscribesTo(event.topic) &&
            (event.isAddressedTo(subscriber.role) ||
                subscriber.observesTargetedEvents),
      );

  Future<void> close() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    _closed = true;
    if (_ownsTransport) {
      await _transport.close();
    }
  }

  AgentEvent _dropStale({
    required AgentDescriptor source,
    required String topic,
    required Map<String, Object?> payload,
    required AgentContextSnapshot context,
    required Set<AgentRole> targetRoles,
  }) {
    _transport.droppedStaleCount += 1;
    final sequence = ++_sequence;
    final stamped = context.generation == 0
        ? context.withTemporal(generation: sequence)
        : context;
    return AgentEvent(
      sequence: sequence,
      topic: topic,
      sourceAgentId: source.id,
      sourceRole: source.role,
      targetRoles: targetRoles,
      context: stamped,
      payload: payload,
    );
  }
}

final class _EventTransport {
  final StreamController<AgentEvent> _controller =
      StreamController<AgentEvent>.broadcast(sync: true);
  int pairEpoch = 0;
  int droppedStaleCount = 0;
  bool _closed = false;

  Stream<AgentEvent> get stream => _controller.stream;

  void add(AgentEvent event) {
    if (_closed) {
      throw StateError('Cannot publish to a closed event transport.');
    }
    _controller.add(event);
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    _closed = true;
    await _controller.close();
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'event_bus.dart';
import 'orchestration_kernel.dart';
import 'orchestration_models.dart';
import 'service_container.dart';

final class HeadlessLocalizationBridge {
  HeadlessLocalizationBridge._({
    required AgentEventBus eventBus,
    required OrchestrationKernel kernel,
    required AgentEndpoint endpoint,
  })  : _eventBus = eventBus,
        _kernel = kernel,
        _endpoint = endpoint {
    _subscription = endpoint
        .events(AgentTopics.localizationChangeRequested)
        .listen(_handleRequest);
  }

  static HeadlessLocalizationBridge start({
    AgentEventBus? eventBus,
  }) {
    final bus = eventBus ?? AgentEventBus();
    final kernel = OrchestrationKernel(
      eventBus: bus,
      services: ServiceContainer(),
    );
    final endpoint = kernel.connect(
      AgentDescriptor(
        id: 'headless.localization-bridge',
        role: AgentRole.localization,
        subscriptions: const <String>{
          AgentTopics.localizationChangeRequested,
        },
        observesTargetedEvents: true,
      ),
    );
    return HeadlessLocalizationBridge._(
      eventBus: bus,
      kernel: kernel,
      endpoint: endpoint,
    );
  }

  final AgentEventBus _eventBus;
  final OrchestrationKernel _kernel;
  final AgentEndpoint _endpoint;

  late final StreamSubscription<AgentEvent> _subscription;
  int _revision = 0;
  bool _closed = false;

  bool get isClosed => _closed;

  void _handleRequest(AgentEvent event) {
    if (_closed) return;

    final source = _language(
      event.payload['sourceLocale'],
      'sourceLocale',
    );
    final target = _language(
      event.payload['targetLocale'],
      'targetLocale',
    );
    if (source == target) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Headless localization source and target must differ.',
      );
    }

    _revision += 1;
    _endpoint.publish(
      topic: AgentTopics.localizationChanged,
      targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{
        AgentRole.polyglot,
        AgentRole.routing,
        AgentRole.cards,
        AgentRole.design,
        AgentRole.task,
      },
      context: event.context,
      payload: <String, Object?>{
        'userLocale': source,
        'sourceLocale': source,
        'targetLocale': target,
        'revision': _revision,
        'direction': _isRtl(source) ? 'rtl' : 'ltr',
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    _closed = true;
    await _subscription.cancel();
    await _kernel.close();
    if (_eventBus.isClosed) return;
  }
}

String _language(Object? value, String field) {
  if (value is! String) {
    throw FormatException('$field must be a language tag.');
  }
  final normalized = value.trim().replaceAll('_', '-').toLowerCase();
  if (!RegExp(r'^[a-z]{2,8}(?:-[a-z0-9]{1,8})*$').hasMatch(normalized)) {
    throw FormatException('$field must be a valid language tag.');
  }
  return normalized;
}

bool _isRtl(String languageTag) {
  final code = languageTag.split('-').first;
  return const <String>{'ar', 'fa', 'ur'}.contains(code);
}

FILE: lib/core/orchestration/language_pack_repository.dart

import '../worker/persistent_cpu_worker.dart';
import '../worker/worker_contract.dart';
import 'polyglot_language_pack.dart';

typedef LanguagePackTextLoader = Future<String> Function(String path);

final class LanguagePackRepository {
  LanguagePackRepository({
    required LanguagePackTextLoader loadText,
    this.assetRoot = 'assets/lang_data',
    PersistentCpuWorker? cpuWorker,
  })  : _loadText = loadText,
        _cpuWorker = cpuWorker;

  final LanguagePackTextLoader _loadText;
  final PersistentCpuWorker? _cpuWorker;
  final String assetRoot;

  PolyglotLanguagePackCatalog? _catalog;
  PolyglotLanguagePack? _activePack;

  String? get activePair => _activePack?.directedPair;
  PolyglotLanguagePack? get activePack => _activePack;
  PolyglotLanguagePackCatalog? get catalog => _catalog;

  Future<PolyglotLanguagePackCatalog> loadCatalog() async {
    final current = _catalog;
    if (current != null) return current;

    final encoded = await _loadText(_pathFor('catalog.json'));
    final worker = _cpuWorker;
    final loaded = worker == null
        ? PolyglotLanguagePackCatalog.parse(encoded)
        : await _loadCatalogWithWorker(worker, encoded);
    _catalog = loaded;
    return loaded;
  }

  Future<PolyglotLanguagePack> loadPair(
    String sourceLanguage,
    String targetLanguage,
  ) async {
    final source = _language(sourceLanguage, 'sourceLanguage');
    final target = _language(targetLanguage, 'targetLanguage');
    if (source == target) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'Source and target language must be different.',
      );
    }

    final pair = '$source->$target';
    final active = _activePack;
    if (active != null && active.directedPair == pair) {
      return active;
    }

    final catalog = await loadCatalog();
    final entry = catalog.requirePair(source, target);
    if (!entry.isLoadable) {
      throw StateError(
        'Language pack $pair is not loadable: '
        '${entry.reason ?? entry.readiness}.',
      );
    }

    final encoded = await _loadText(
      _pathFor(fileNameForPair(source, target)),
    );
    final worker = _cpuWorker;
    final loaded = worker == null
        ? PolyglotLanguagePack.parse(encoded)
        : await _loadPackWithWorker(
            worker,
            encoded,
            source: source,
            target: target,
          );
    if (loaded.directedPair != pair) {
      throw FormatException(
        'Loaded pack pair ${loaded.directedPair} does not match $pair.',
      );
    }
    if (entry.checksum != loaded.checksum) {
      throw FormatException(
        'Catalog checksum does not match loaded pack $pair.',
      );
    }

    _activePack = loaded;
    return loaded;
  }

  Future<PolyglotLanguagePackCatalog> _loadCatalogWithWorker(
    PersistentCpuWorker worker,
    String encoded,
  ) async {
    final decoded = await _decode(
      worker,
      encoded,
      id: 'pack.catalog.decode',
    );
    if (decoded is! Map) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Language pack catalog root must be an object.',
      );
    }

    final root = _stringObjectMap(decoded, 'catalog');
    final languageCount = _intValue(
      root['languageCount'],
      'catalog.languageCount',
    );
    final directedPairCount = _intValue(
      root['directedPairCount'],
      'catalog.directedPairCount',
    );
    final unsigned = Map<String, Object?>.from(root)..remove('checksum');
    final checksum = await _checksumJson(
      worker,
      id: 'pack.catalog.checksum',
      scopeKey: 'polyglot-catalog|$languageCount'
          'x$directedPairCount',
      jsonValue: unsigned,
      validatorVersion: PolyglotLanguagePackCatalog.validatorVersion,
    );

    return PolyglotLanguagePackCatalog.fromDecoded(
      root,
      computedChecksum: checksum,
    );
  }

  Future<PolyglotLanguagePack> _loadPackWithWorker(
    PersistentCpuWorker worker,
    String encoded, {
    required String source,
    required String target,
  }) async {
    final decoded = await _decode(
      worker,
      encoded,
      id: 'pack.$source.$target.decode',
    );
    if (decoded is! Map) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Language pack root must be an object.',
      );
    }

    final root = _stringObjectMap(decoded, 'pack');
    final unsigned = Map<String, Object?>.from(root)..remove('checksum');
    final checksum = await _checksumJson(
      worker,
      id: 'pack.$source.$target.checksum',
      scopeKey: '$source->$target|pack',
      jsonValue: unsigned,
      validatorVersion: PolyglotLanguagePack.validatorVersion,
    );

    return PolyglotLanguagePack.fromDecoded(
      root,
      computedChecksum: checksum,
    );
  }

  Future<Object?> _decode(
    PersistentCpuWorker worker,
    String encoded, {
    required String id,
  }) async {
    final result = await worker.submit<Object?>(
      WorkerJob<Map<String, Object?>>(
        id: id,
        type: WorkerJobTypes.jsonDecode,
        epoch: worker.currentEpoch,
        payload: <String, Object?>{'encoded': encoded},
      ),
    );
    if (result.status == WorkerStatuses.stale) {
      throw StateError(
        'Language pack decode became stale after pair switch.',
      );
    }
    if (result.status != WorkerStatuses.ok) {
      throw StateError(
        'Language pack decode failed: '
        '${result.errorCode ?? result.status}.',
      );
    }
    return result.payload;
  }

  Future<String> _checksumJson(
    PersistentCpuWorker worker, {
    required String id,
    required String scopeKey,
    required Object? jsonValue,
    required String validatorVersion,
  }) async {
    final result = await worker.submit<String>(
      WorkerJob<Map<String, Object?>>(
        id: id,
        type: WorkerJobTypes.checksum128,
        epoch: worker.currentEpoch,
        payload: <String, Object?>{
          'scopeKey': scopeKey,
          'jsonValue': jsonValue,
          'validatorVersion': validatorVersion,
        },
      ),
    );
    if (result.status == WorkerStatuses.stale) {
      throw StateError(
        'Language pack checksum became stale after pair switch.',
      );
    }
    if (result.status != WorkerStatuses.ok || result.payload == null) {
      throw StateError(
        'Language pack checksum failed: '
        '${result.errorCode ?? result.status}.',
      );
    }
    return result.payload!;
  }

  void clear() {
    _activePack = null;
  }

  void clearAll() {
    _activePack = null;
    _catalog = null;
  }

  String _pathFor(String fileName) {
    final root = assetRoot.trim();
    if (root.isEmpty) return fileName;

    final normalizedRoot = root.endsWith('/')
        ? root.substring(0, root.length - 1)
        : root;
    return '$normalizedRoot/$fileName';
  }

  static String fileNameForPair(
    String sourceLanguage,
    String targetLanguage,
  ) {
    final source = _language(sourceLanguage, 'sourceLanguage');
    final target = _language(targetLanguage, 'targetLanguage');
    return '${source.replaceAll('-', '_')}_'
        '${target.replaceAll('-', '_')}.json';
  }
}

Map<String, Object?> _stringObjectMap(
  Object? value,
  String field,
) {
  if (value is! Map) {
    throw FormatException('$field must be an object.');
  }
  final result = <String, Object?>{};
  for (final entry in value.entries) {
    if (entry.key is! String) {
      throw FormatException('$field keys must be strings.');
    }
    result[entry.key as String] = entry.value;
  }
  return result;
}

int _intValue(Object? value, String field) {
  if (value is! num) {
    throw FormatException('$field must be numeric.');
  }
  return value.toInt();
}

String _language(String value, String field) {
  final normalized = value.trim().replaceAll('_', '-').toLowerCase();
  if (!RegExp(r'^[a-z]{2,8}(?:-[a-z0-9]{1,8})*$')
      .hasMatch(normalized)) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(
      value,
      field,
      'must be a valid language tag',
    );
  }
  return normalized;
}

FILE: lib/core/orchestration/localization_role_observers.dart

import 'dart:async';

import 'orchestration_kernel.dart';
import 'orchestration_models.dart';

final class AgentLocalizationState {
  AgentLocalizationState({
    required this.revision,
    required this.userLocale,
    required this.sourceLocale,
    required this.targetLocale,
    required this.fallbackLocale,
    required this.direction,
    required this.isRtl,
    required List<String> loadedLocales,
  }) : loadedLocales = List<String>.unmodifiable(loadedLocales) {
    if (revision < 0) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(revision, 'revision', 'must be non-negative');
    }
    if (direction != 'ltr' && direction != 'rtl') {
      throw FormatException('Unsupported localization direction: $direction');
    }
  }

  final int revision;
  final String userLocale;
  final String sourceLocale;
  final String targetLocale;
  final String fallbackLocale;
  final String direction;
  final bool isRtl;
  final List<String> loadedLocales;

  static AgentLocalizationState fromEvent(AgentEvent event) {
    if (event.topic != AgentTopics.localizationChanged) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        event.topic,
        'event.topic',
        'Expected localization.changed.',
      );
    }
    return AgentLocalizationState(
      revision: _int(event.payload['revision'], 'revision'),
      userLocale: _text(event.payload['userLocale'], 'userLocale'),
      sourceLocale: _text(event.payload['sourceLocale'], 'sourceLocale'),
      targetLocale: _text(event.payload['targetLocale'], 'targetLocale'),
      fallbackLocale:
          _text(event.payload['fallbackLocale'], 'fallbackLocale'),
      direction: _text(event.payload['direction'], 'direction'),
      isRtl: _bool(event.payload['isRtl'], 'isRtl'),
      loadedLocales: _stringList(
        event.payload['loadedLocales'],
        'loadedLocales',
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class LocalizationDesignRoutingObservers {
  LocalizationDesignRoutingObservers._({
    required _LocalizationRoleObserver design,
    required _LocalizationRoleObserver routing,
  })  : _design = design,
        _routing = routing;

  factory LocalizationDesignRoutingObservers.connect(
    OrchestrationKernel kernel,
  ) {
    final designEndpoint = kernel.connect(
      AgentDescriptor(
        id: 'phase6.design-l10n-observer',
        role: AgentRole.design,
        subscriptions: const <String>{
          AgentTopics.localizationChanged,
        },
      ),
    );
    final routingEndpoint = kernel.connect(
      AgentDescriptor(
        id: 'phase6.routing-l10n-observer',
        role: AgentRole.routing,
        subscriptions: const <String>{
          AgentTopics.localizationChanged,
        },
      ),
    );

    return LocalizationDesignRoutingObservers._(
      design: _LocalizationRoleObserver(designEndpoint),
      routing: _LocalizationRoleObserver(routingEndpoint),
    );
  }

  final _LocalizationRoleObserver _design;
  final _LocalizationRoleObserver _routing;

  Stream<AgentLocalizationState> get designChanges => _design.changes;
  Stream<AgentLocalizationState> get routingChanges => _routing.changes;

  AgentLocalizationState? get latestDesign => _design.latest;
  AgentLocalizationState? get latestRouting => _routing.latest;

  Future<void> close() async {
    await _design.close();
    await _routing.close();
  }
}

final class _LocalizationRoleObserver {
  _LocalizationRoleObserver(this.endpoint) {
    if (endpoint.descriptor.role != AgentRole.design &&
        endpoint.descriptor.role != AgentRole.routing) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'Localization observer endpoint must be Design or Routing role.',
      );
    }
    _subscription = endpoint
        .events(AgentTopics.localizationChanged)
        .listen(_accept);
  }

  final AgentEndpoint endpoint;
  final StreamController<AgentLocalizationState> _controller =
      StreamController<AgentLocalizationState>.broadcast(sync: true);

  late final StreamSubscription<AgentEvent> _subscription;
  AgentLocalizationState? _latest;
  bool _closed = false;

  Stream<AgentLocalizationState> get changes => _controller.stream;
  AgentLocalizationState? get latest => _latest;

  void _accept(AgentEvent event) {
    if (_closed) return;
    try {
      final state = AgentLocalizationState.fromEvent(event);
      _latest = state;
      _controller.add(state);
    } on Object {
      return;
    }
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    _closed = true;
    await _subscription.cancel();
    await _controller.close();
  }
}

String _text(Object? value, String field) {
  if (value is! String || value.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw FormatException('$field must be a non-empty string.');
  }
  return value.trim();
}

int _int(Object? value, String field) {
  if (value is! num) {
    throw FormatException('$field must be numeric.');
  }
  return value.toInt();
}

bool _bool(Object? value, String field) {
  if (value is! bool) {
    throw FormatException('$field must be boolean.');
  }
  return value;
}

List<String> _stringList(Object? value, String field) {
  if (value is! List) {
    throw FormatException('$field must be a list.');
  }
  final result = <String>[];
  for (final item in value) {
    if (item is! String || item.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw FormatException('$field must contain non-empty strings.');
    }
    result.add(item.trim());
  }
  return List<String>.unmodifiable(result);
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'event_bus.dart';
import 'localization_role_observers.dart';
import 'orchestration_kernel.dart';
import 'orchestration_models.dart';
import 'service_container.dart';

Future<void> main() async {
  final bus = AgentEventBus.isolated();
  final kernel = OrchestrationKernel(
    eventBus: bus,
    services: ServiceContainer(),
  );
  final observers = LocalizationDesignRoutingObservers.connect(kernel);

  final publisher = kernel.connect(
    AgentDescriptor(
      id: 'phase6.localization-publisher',
      role: AgentRole.localization,
      subscriptions: const <String>{AgentTopics.contextUpdated},
    ),
  );

  final designReady = Completer<AgentLocalizationState>();
  final routingReady = Completer<AgentLocalizationState>();

  final designSub = observers.designChanges.listen((state) {
    if (!designReady.isCompleted) designReady.complete(state);
  });
  final routingSub = observers.routingChanges.listen((state) {
    if (!routingReady.isCompleted) routingReady.complete(state);
  });

  publisher.publish(
    topic: AgentTopics.localizationChanged,
    targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{
      AgentRole.design,
      AgentRole.routing,
    },
    payload: const <String, Object?>{
      'revision': 7,
      'userLocale': 'fa',
      'sourceLocale': 'ar',
      'targetLocale': 'de',
      'fallbackLocale': 'en',
      'direction': 'rtl',
      'isRtl': true,
      'loadedLocales': <String>['ar', 'de', 'en'],
    },
  );

  final design = await designReady.future.timeout(
    const Duration(seconds: 1),
  );
  final routing = await routingReady.future.timeout(
    const Duration(seconds: 1),
  );

  _expect(design.revision, 7, 'design observes localization revision');
  _expect(design.direction, 'rtl', 'design observes RTL direction');
  _expect(routing.sourceLocale, 'ar', 'routing observes SOURCE');
  _expect(routing.targetLocale, 'de', 'routing observes TARGET');
  _expect(
    routing.revision,
    design.revision,
    'design and routing share one localization revision',
  );

  await designSub.cancel();
  await routingSub.cancel();
  await observers.close();
  await kernel.close();

  _expect(bus.isClosed, true, 'isolated observer bus closes');
}

void _expect(Object? actual, Object? expected, String contract) {
  if (actual != expected) {
    throw StateError(
      'Contract failed: $contract. Expected <$expected>, got <$actual>.',
    );
  }
}

import 'event_bus.dart';

import 'orchestration_models.dart';

Future<void> main() async {
  final bus = AgentEventBus.isolated();
  final services = ServiceContainer();
  final kernel = OrchestrationKernel(
    eventBus: bus,
    services: services,
  );

  final curriculumToken = ServiceToken<String>('curriculum-version');
  services.registerSingleton(curriculumToken, 'phase-2');
  _expect(
    services.resolve(curriculumToken),
    'phase-2',
    'typed DI singleton resolution',
  );

  var directReferenceRejected = false;
  try {
    final forbiddenToken =
        ServiceToken<AgentReferenceBoundary>('direct-agent-reference');
    services.registerSingleton(
      forbiddenToken,
      _FakeAgentReference(),
    );
  } on ArgumentError {
    directReferenceRejected = true;
  }
  _expect(
    directReferenceRejected,
    true,
    'DI must reject direct agent references',
  );

  var eventReferenceRejected = false;
  try {
    AgentContextSnapshot(
      correlationId: 'bad-ref',
      values: <String, Object?>{'agent': _FakeAgentReference()},
    );
  } on ArgumentError {
    eventReferenceRejected = true;
  }
  _expect(
    eventReferenceRejected,
    true,
    'event context must reject object references',
  );

  var factoryCalls = 0;
  final counterToken = ServiceToken<int>('counter');
  services.registerFactory(counterToken, () {
    factoryCalls += 1;
    return factoryCalls;
  });
  _expect(services.resolve(counterToken), 1, 'factory first resolution');
  _expect(services.resolve(counterToken), 2, 'factory creates a new value');

  final taskAgent = kernel.connect(
    AgentDescriptor(
      id: 'task-agent',
      role: AgentRole.task,
      subscriptions: <String>{AgentTopics.taskRequest, AgentTopics.routeSelected},
    ),
  );
  final designAgent = kernel.connect(
    AgentDescriptor(
      id: 'design-agent',
      role: AgentRole.design,
      subscriptions: <String>{AgentTopics.designRequest},
    ),
  );
  final routingAgent = kernel.connect(
    AgentDescriptor(
      id: 'routing-agent',
      role: AgentRole.routing,
      subscriptions: <String>{AgentTopics.routeRequest},
    ),
  );
  final cardsAgent = kernel.connect(
    AgentDescriptor(
      id: 'cards-agent',
      role: AgentRole.cards,
      subscriptions: <String>{AgentTopics.cardsRequest},
    ),
  );

  _expect(kernel.connectedAgentCount, 4, 'four isolated agent endpoints');
  _expect(
    identical(taskAgent, designAgent),
    false,
    'agents never share endpoint objects',
  );

  final routingMessage = Completer<AgentEvent>();
  final routingSub = routingAgent.events(AgentTopics.routeRequest).listen((event) {
    if (!routingMessage.isCompleted) routingMessage.complete(event);
  });

  taskAgent.publish(
    topic: AgentTopics.routeRequest,
    payload: const <String, Object?>{'taskId': 'task-17'},
    context: AgentContextSnapshot(
      correlationId: 'corr-17',
      values: <String, Object?>{'learnerLevel': 'A2'},
    ),
  );

  final routed = await routingMessage.future.timeout(
    const Duration(seconds: 1),
  );
  _expect(routed.sourceAgentId, 'task-agent', 'event source identity');
  _expect(routed.topic, AgentTopics.routeRequest, 'event topic');
  _expect(
    routed.context.correlationId,
    'corr-17',
    'context correlation survives the bridge',
  );
  _expect(routed.payload['taskId'], 'task-17', 'payload survives event bus');

  var designSawRoute = false;
  final designSub = designAgent.events(AgentTopics.routeRequest).listen((_) {
    designSawRoute = true;
  });
  taskAgent.publish(
    topic: AgentTopics.routeRequest,
    payload: const <String, Object?>{'taskId': 'task-18'},
  );
  await Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);
  _expect(
    designSawRoute,
    false,
    'unsubscribed agents must not receive unrelated traffic',
  );

  final cardsMessage = Completer<AgentEvent>();
  final cardsSub = cardsAgent.events(AgentTopics.cardsRequest).listen((event) {
    if (!cardsMessage.isCompleted) cardsMessage.complete(event);
  });
  routingAgent.publish(
    topic: AgentTopics.cardsRequest,
    payload: const <String, Object?>{
      'bankId': 'daily-a1',
      'taskId': 'task-18',
    },
    targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.cards},
  );
  final cardEvent = await cardsMessage.future.timeout(
    const Duration(seconds: 1),
  );
  _expect(
    cardEvent.targetRoles.contains(AgentRole.cards),
    true,
    'target-role routing',
  );
  _expect(bus.publishedCount >= 3, true, 'event bus sequence accounting');

  var duplicateRejected = false;
  try {
    kernel.connect(
      AgentDescriptor(
        id: 'task-agent',
        role: AgentRole.task,
        subscriptions: <String>{AgentTopics.taskRequest},
      ),
    );
  } on StateError {
    duplicateRejected = true;
  }
  _expect(duplicateRejected, true, 'duplicate agent ids must be rejected');

  await routingSub.cancel();
  await designSub.cancel();
  await cardsSub.cancel();
  await kernel.close();

  _expect(bus.isClosed, true, 'kernel closes the event bus');
}

void _expect(Object? actual, Object? expected, String contract) {
  if (actual != expected) {
    throw StateError(
      'Contract failed: $contract. Expected <$expected>, got <$actual>.',
    );
  }
}

import 'agent_batch_processing.dart';
import 'event_bus.dart';
import 'orchestration_models.dart';
import 'service_container.dart';

final class AgentEndpoint implements AgentReferenceBoundary {
  AgentEndpoint._({
    required this.descriptor,
    required AgentEventBus eventBus,
    required ServiceContainer services,
  })  : _eventBus = eventBus,
        _services = services;

  final AgentDescriptor descriptor;
  final AgentEventBus _eventBus;
  final ServiceContainer _services;
  bool _active = true;
  int _emittedCount = 0;

  bool get isActive => _active;

  Stream<AgentEvent> events(String topic) {
    _ensureActive();
    return _eventBus.eventsFor(descriptor, topic);
  }

  Stream<AgentEvent> get allEvents {
    _ensureActive();
    return _eventBus.allEventsFor(descriptor);
  }

  AgentEvent publish({
    required String topic,
    required Map<String, Object?> payload,
    AgentContextSnapshot? context,
    Set<AgentRole> targetRoles = const <AgentRole>{},
  }) {
    _ensureActive();
    _emittedCount += 1;
    final snapshot = context ??
        AgentContextSnapshot.empty(
          '${descriptor.id}:event-$_emittedCount',
        );
    return _eventBus.publish(
      source: descriptor,
      topic: topic,
      payload: payload,
      context: snapshot,
      targetRoles: targetRoles,
    );
  }

  AgentEventBatchDispatcher createBatchDispatcher({
    int maxBatchSize = 16,
    int maxPending = 256,
    Duration flushDelay = const Duration(milliseconds: 2),
  }) {
    _ensureActive();
    return AgentEventBatchDispatcher(
      currentPairEpoch: () => _eventBus.pairEpoch,
      queue: AgentBatchQueue<AgentBatchEvent>(
        maxBatchSize: maxBatchSize,
        maxPending: maxPending,
        flushDelay: flushDelay,
        dedupeKeyOf: (event) => event.dedupeKey,
        processBatch: (events) async {
          verifyGuardedAgentBatch(events);
          for (final event in events) {
            publish(
              topic: event.topic,
              payload: event.payload,
              context: event.context,
              targetRoles: event.targetRoles,
            );
          }
          await Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  T resolve<T>(ServiceToken<T> token) {
    _ensureActive();
    return _services.resolve(token);
  }

  void _deactivate() {
    _active = false;
  }

  void _ensureActive() {
    if (!_active) {
      throw StateError('Agent endpoint ${descriptor.id} is inactive.');
    }
  }
}

final class OrchestrationKernel {
  OrchestrationKernel({
    required AgentEventBus eventBus,
    required ServiceContainer services,
  })  : _eventBus = eventBus,
        _services = services;

  final AgentEventBus _eventBus;
  final ServiceContainer _services;
  final Map<String, AgentEndpoint> _endpoints = <String, AgentEndpoint>{};
  bool _closed = false;

  int get connectedAgentCount => _endpoints.length;
  bool get isClosed => _closed;

  AgentEndpoint connect(AgentDescriptor descriptor) {
    if (_closed) {
      throw StateError('Cannot connect agents to a closed kernel.');
    }
    if (_endpoints.containsKey(descriptor.id)) {
      throw StateError('Agent id already connected: ${descriptor.id}.');
    }

    if (!_services.isFrozen) {
      _services.freeze();
    }

    final endpoint = AgentEndpoint._(
      descriptor: descriptor,
      eventBus: _eventBus,
      services: _services,
    );
    _endpoints[descriptor.id] = endpoint;
    return endpoint;
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    _closed = true;
    for (final endpoint in _endpoints.values) {
      endpoint._deactivate();
    }
    _endpoints.clear();
    await _eventBus.close();
  }
}

abstract interface class AgentReferenceBoundary {}

abstract final class AgentTopics {
  static const String taskRequest = 'task.request';
  static const String designRequest = 'design.request';
  static const String routeRequest = 'route.request';
  static const String routeSelected = 'route.selected';
  static const String cardsRequest = 'cards.request';
  static const String contextUpdated = 'context.updated';
  static const String learningProgress = 'learning.progress';
  static const String learningMistake = 'learning.mistake';
  static const String memorySnapshot = 'memory.snapshot';
  static const String systemError = 'system.error';
  static const String systemRecovery = 'system.recovery';
  static const String localizationChangeRequested =
      'localization.change_requested';
  static const String localizationChanged = 'localization.changed';
  static const String polyglotMatrixChanged = 'polyglot.matrix_changed';
  static const String grammarRequest = 'grammar.request';
  static const String grammarEngineChanged = 'grammar.engine_changed';
  static const String grammarResponse = 'grammar.response';
  static const String ttsRequest = 'tts.request';
  static const String ttsPrepared = 'tts.prepared';
  static const String ttsCompleted = 'tts.completed';
  static const String ttsFailed = 'tts.failed';
}

enum AgentRole {
  task,
  design,
  routing,
  cards,
  memory,
  recovery,
  system,
  localization,
  polyglot,
  grammar,
  voice,
}

final class AgentDescriptor {
  AgentDescriptor({
    required String id,
    required this.role,
    required Set<String> subscriptions,
    this.observesTargetedEvents = false,
  })  : id = id.trim(),
        subscriptions = Set<String>.unmodifiable(
          subscriptions.map(_validatedTopic),
        ) {
    if (this.id.isEmpty ||
        !RegExp(r'^[a-z0-9]+(?:[._-][a-z0-9]+)*$').hasMatch(this.id)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        id,
        'id',
        'Agent id must be a lowercase path token.',
      );
    }
    if (this.subscriptions.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'An agent must subscribe to at least one event topic.',
      );
    }
  }

  final String id;
  final AgentRole role;
  final Set<String> subscriptions;
  final bool observesTargetedEvents;

  bool subscribesTo(String topic) => subscriptions.contains(topic);
}

final class AgentContextSnapshot {
  AgentContextSnapshot({
    required String correlationId,
    Map<String, Object?> values = const <String, Object?>{},
    this.pairEpoch = 0,
    this.generation = 0,
  })  : correlationId = correlationId.trim(),
        values = _freezeMap(values) {
    if (this.correlationId.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        correlationId,
        'correlationId',
        'Correlation id must not be empty.',
      );
    }
    if (pairEpoch < 0) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        pairEpoch,
        'pairEpoch',
        'Pair epoch must not be negative.',
      );
    }
    if (generation < 0) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        generation,
        'generation',
        'Generation must not be negative.',
      );
    }
  }

  factory AgentContextSnapshot.empty(
    String correlationId, {
    int pairEpoch = 0,
    int generation = 0,
  }) =>
      AgentContextSnapshot(
        correlationId: correlationId,
        pairEpoch: pairEpoch,
        generation: generation,
      );

  final String correlationId;
  final Map<String, Object?> values;
  final int pairEpoch;
  final int generation;

  AgentContextSnapshot merge(Map<String, Object?> delta) =>
      AgentContextSnapshot(
        correlationId: correlationId,
        values: <String, Object?>{...values, ...delta},
        pairEpoch: pairEpoch,
        generation: generation,
      );

  AgentContextSnapshot withTemporal({
    int? pairEpoch,
    int? generation,
  }) =>
      AgentContextSnapshot(
        correlationId: correlationId,
        values: values,
        pairEpoch: pairEpoch ?? this.pairEpoch,
        generation: generation ?? this.generation,
      );
}

final class AgentEvent {
  AgentEvent({
    required this.sequence,
    required String topic,
    required String sourceAgentId,
    required this.sourceRole,
    required Set<AgentRole> targetRoles,
    required this.context,
    required Map<String, Object?> payload,
  })  : topic = _validatedTopic(topic),
        sourceAgentId = sourceAgentId.trim(),
        targetRoles = Set<AgentRole>.unmodifiable(targetRoles),
        payload = _freezeMap(payload) {
    if (sequence < 1) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(sequence, 'sequence', 'Must be positive.');
    }
    if (this.sourceAgentId.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        sourceAgentId,
        'sourceAgentId',
        'Source agent id must not be empty.',
      );
    }
  }

  final int sequence;
  final String topic;
  final String sourceAgentId;
  final AgentRole sourceRole;
  final Set<AgentRole> targetRoles;
  final AgentContextSnapshot context;
  final Map<String, Object?> payload;

  bool isAddressedTo(AgentRole role) =>
      targetRoles.isEmpty || targetRoles.contains(role);
}

String _validatedTopic(String topic) {
  final normalized = topic.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (normalized.isEmpty ||
      !RegExp(r'^[a-z0-9]+(?:[._-][a-z0-9]+)*$').hasMatch(normalized)) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(
      topic,
      'topic',
      'Event topics must be lowercase dot/dash/underscore paths.',
    );
  }
  return normalized;
}

Map<String, Object?> _freezeMap(Map<String, Object?> source) =>
    Map<String, Object?>.unmodifiable(
      <String, Object?>{
        for (final entry in source.entries)
          entry.key: _freezeValue(entry.value),
      },
    );

Object? _freezeValue(Object? value) {
  if (value == null || value is String || value is num || value is bool) {
    return value;
  }
  if (value is Map) {
    final copy = <String, Object?>{};
    for (final entry in value.entries) {
      if (entry.key is! String) {
        throw ArgumentError('Event/context map keys must be strings.');
      }
      copy[entry.key as String] = _freezeValue(entry.value);
    }
    return Map<String, Object?>.unmodifiable(copy);
  }
  if (value is List) {
    return List<Object?>.unmodifiable(
      value.map<Object?>((item) => _freezeValue(item)),
    );
  }
  throw ArgumentError(
    'Agent event data must use JSON-like scalar/list/map values only; '
    'object references are not allowed.',
  );
}

FILE: lib/core/orchestration/polyglot_language_pack.dart

import 'dart:convert';

import '../storage/validation_hash_cache.dart';

final class PolyglotLanguagePack {
  PolyglotLanguagePack._({
    required this.schemaVersion,
    required this.sourceLanguage,
    required this.targetLanguage,
    required this.readiness,
    required this.curriculumTasks,
    required this.vocabularyPool,
    required this.grammarMatrix,
    required this.checksum,
  });

  static const int currentSchemaVersion = 1;
  static const String checksumAlgorithm = 'validation-checksum-128-v1';
  static const String validatorVersion = 'phase11.pack.v1';

  final int schemaVersion;
  final String sourceLanguage;
  final String targetLanguage;
  final String readiness;
  final List<Map<String, Object?>> curriculumTasks;
  final List<Map<String, Object?>> vocabularyPool;
  final List<Map<String, Object?>> grammarMatrix;
  final String checksum;

  String get directedPair => '$sourceLanguage->$targetLanguage';

  // Headless compatibility path. Runtime loading uses the persistent worker.
  static PolyglotLanguagePack parse(String encoded) =>
      fromDecoded(jsonDecode(encoded));

  static PolyglotLanguagePack fromDecoded(
    Object? raw, {
    String? computedChecksum,
  }) {
    if (raw is! Map) {
      throw const FormatException('Language pack root must be an object.');
    }

    final root = _stringMap(raw, 'root');
    final schemaVersion = _requiredInt(root['schemaVersion'], 'schemaVersion');
    if (schemaVersion != currentSchemaVersion) {
      throw FormatException(
        'Unsupported language pack schema: $schemaVersion.',
      );
    }

    final pair = _stringMap(root['pair'], 'pair');
    final source = _language(pair['sourceLanguage'], 'sourceLanguage');
    final target = _language(pair['targetLanguage'], 'targetLanguage');
    if (source == target) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Language pack source and target must be different.',
      );
    }
    final id = _requiredString(pair['id'], 'pair.id').toLowerCase();
    final expectedPair = '$source->$target';
    if (id != expectedPair) {
      throw FormatException(
        'Language pack pair id mismatch: $id != $expectedPair.',
      );
    }

    final readiness = _requiredString(
      pair['readiness'],
      'pair.readiness',
    ).toLowerCase();
    if (!const <String>{'ready', 'partial'}.contains(readiness)) {
      throw FormatException(
        'Loadable pack readiness must be ready or partial.',
      );
    }

    final checksumMap = _stringMap(root['checksum'], 'checksum');
    final algorithm = _requiredString(
      checksumMap['algorithm'],
      'checksum.algorithm',
    );
    final validator = _requiredString(
      checksumMap['validatorVersion'],
      'checksum.validatorVersion',
    );
    final checksum = _requiredString(
      checksumMap['value'],
      'checksum.value',
    ).toLowerCase();

    if (algorithm != checksumAlgorithm) {
      throw FormatException(
        'Unsupported language pack checksum algorithm: $algorithm.',
      );
    }
    if (validator != validatorVersion) {
      throw FormatException(
        'Unsupported language pack validator version: $validator.',
      );
    }
    if (!_isChecksum(checksum)) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Language pack checksum must be a 128-bit hex token.',
      );
    }

    final unsigned = Map<String, Object?>.from(root)..remove('checksum');
    final expectedChecksum = computedChecksum ??
        ContentChecksum.compute(
          scopeKey: '$expectedPair|pack',
          content: jsonEncode(unsigned),
          validatorVersion: validatorVersion,
        );
    if (expectedChecksum != checksum) {
      throw const FormatException('Language pack checksum mismatch.');
    }

    final tasks = _objectList(root['curriculumTasks'], 'curriculumTasks');
    if (tasks.isEmpty || tasks.length > 50) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Language pack curriculum task count must be 1..50.',
      );
    }
    final taskIds = <String>{};
    for (final task in tasks) {
      final taskId = _requiredString(task['id'], 'curriculumTasks.id');
      if (!_canonicalTaskId(taskId) || !taskIds.add(taskId)) {
        throw FormatException(
          'Invalid or duplicate curriculum task id: $taskId.',
        );
      }
    }

    final vocabulary = _objectList(
      root['vocabularyPool'],
      'vocabularyPool',
    );
    final vocabularyIds = <String>{};
    for (final item in vocabulary) {
      final vocabularyId = _requiredString(
        item['id'],
        'vocabularyPool.id',
      );
      if (!vocabularyIds.add(vocabularyId)) {
        throw FormatException(
          'Duplicate vocabulary id: $vocabularyId.',
        );
      }
      _requiredString(item['source'], 'vocabularyPool.source');
      _requiredString(item['target'], 'vocabularyPool.target');
    }

    final grammar = _objectList(root['grammarMatrix'], 'grammarMatrix');
    final grammarIds = <String>{};
    for (final item in grammar) {
      final grammarId = _requiredString(item['id'], 'grammarMatrix.id');
      if (!grammarIds.add(grammarId)) {
        throw FormatException('Duplicate grammar id: $grammarId.');
      }
      final taskId = _requiredString(
        item['taskId'],
        'grammarMatrix.taskId',
      );
      if (!taskIds.contains(taskId)) {
        throw FormatException(
          'Grammar item references unknown task id: $taskId.',
        );
      }
    }

    for (final task in tasks) {
      final taskId = task['id'] as String;
      for (final ref in _stringList(
        task['vocabularyRefs'],
        'curriculumTasks.vocabularyRefs',
      )) {
        if (!vocabularyIds.contains(ref)) {
          throw FormatException(
            'Task $taskId references unknown vocabulary id: $ref.',
          );
        }
      }
      for (final ref in _stringList(
        task['grammarRefs'],
        'curriculumTasks.grammarRefs',
      )) {
        if (!grammarIds.contains(ref)) {
          throw FormatException(
            'Task $taskId references unknown grammar id: $ref.',
          );
        }
      }
    }

    return PolyglotLanguagePack._(
      schemaVersion: schemaVersion,
      sourceLanguage: source,
      targetLanguage: target,
      readiness: readiness,
      curriculumTasks: List<Map<String, Object?>>.unmodifiable(tasks),
      vocabularyPool: List<Map<String, Object?>>.unmodifiable(vocabulary),
      grammarMatrix: List<Map<String, Object?>>.unmodifiable(grammar),
      checksum: checksum,
    );
  }

  Map<String, Object?> taskById(String taskId) {
    final normalized = taskId.trim();
    for (final task in curriculumTasks) {
      if (task['id'] == normalized) return task;
    }
    throw ArgumentError.value(
      taskId,
      'taskId',
      'Unknown task in active language pack.',
    );
  }

  Map<String, Object?> vocabularyById(String id) {
    final normalized = id.trim();
    for (final item in vocabularyPool) {
      if (item['id'] == normalized) return item;
    }
    throw ArgumentError.value(
      id,
      'id',
      'Unknown vocabulary id in active language pack.',
    );
  }
}

final class LanguagePackCatalogEntry {
  const LanguagePackCatalogEntry({
    required this.id,
    required this.sourceLanguage,
    required this.targetLanguage,
    required this.readiness,
    required this.assetPath,
    required this.checksum,
    required this.vocabularyCount,
    required this.grammarCount,
    required this.reason,
  });

  final String id;
  final String sourceLanguage;
  final String targetLanguage;
  final String readiness;
  final String? assetPath;
  final String? checksum;
  final int vocabularyCount;
  final int grammarCount;
  final String? reason;

  bool get isLoadable =>
      assetPath != null &&
      (readiness == 'ready' || readiness == 'partial');
}

final class PolyglotLanguagePackCatalog {
  PolyglotLanguagePackCatalog._({
    required this.schemaVersion,
    required this.languageCount,
    required this.directedPairCount,
    required this.generatedPairCount,
    required this.entries,
    required this.checksum,
  });

  static const int currentSchemaVersion = 1;
  static const String validatorVersion = 'phase11.catalog.v1';

  final int schemaVersion;
  final int languageCount;
  final int directedPairCount;
  final int generatedPairCount;
  final List<LanguagePackCatalogEntry> entries;
  final String checksum;

  // Headless compatibility path. Runtime loading uses the persistent worker.
  static PolyglotLanguagePackCatalog parse(String encoded) =>
      fromDecoded(jsonDecode(encoded));

  static PolyglotLanguagePackCatalog fromDecoded(
    Object? raw, {
    String? computedChecksum,
  }) {
    if (raw is! Map) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Language pack catalog root must be an object.',
      );
    }

    final root = _stringMap(raw, 'catalog');
    final schemaVersion = _requiredInt(
      root['schemaVersion'],
      'catalog.schemaVersion',
    );
    if (schemaVersion != currentSchemaVersion) {
      throw FormatException(
        'Unsupported language pack catalog schema: $schemaVersion.',
      );
    }

    final languageCount = _requiredInt(
      root['languageCount'],
      'catalog.languageCount',
    );
    final directedPairCount = _requiredInt(
      root['directedPairCount'],
      'catalog.directedPairCount',
    );
    final generatedPairCount = _requiredInt(
      root['generatedPairCount'],
      'catalog.generatedPairCount',
    );
    if (languageCount < 2 ||
        directedPairCount != languageCount * (languageCount - 1) ||
        generatedPairCount < 0 ||
        generatedPairCount > directedPairCount) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Language pack catalog counts are invalid.',
      );
    }

    final checksumMap = _stringMap(
      root['checksum'],
      'catalog.checksum',
    );
    final algorithm = _requiredString(
      checksumMap['algorithm'],
      'catalog.checksum.algorithm',
    );
    final validator = _requiredString(
      checksumMap['validatorVersion'],
      'catalog.checksum.validatorVersion',
    );
    final checksum = _requiredString(
      checksumMap['value'],
      'catalog.checksum.value',
    ).toLowerCase();

    if (algorithm != PolyglotLanguagePack.checksumAlgorithm) {
      throw FormatException(
        'Unsupported catalog checksum algorithm: $algorithm.',
      );
    }
    if (validator != validatorVersion) {
      throw FormatException(
        'Unsupported catalog validator version: $validator.',
      );
    }
    if (!_isChecksum(checksum)) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Catalog checksum must be a 128-bit hex token.',
      );
    }

    final unsigned = Map<String, Object?>.from(root)..remove('checksum');
    final expectedChecksum = computedChecksum ??
        ContentChecksum.compute(
          scopeKey: 'polyglot-catalog|$languageCount'
              'x$directedPairCount',
          content: jsonEncode(unsigned),
          validatorVersion: validatorVersion,
        );
    if (expectedChecksum != checksum) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Language pack catalog checksum mismatch.',
      );
    }

    final rawEntries = _objectList(root['pairs'], 'catalog.pairs');
    if (rawEntries.length != directedPairCount) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Catalog pair entry count does not match directedPairCount.',
      );
    }

    final ids = <String>{};
    final entries = <LanguagePackCatalogEntry>[];
    for (final row in rawEntries) {
      final source = _language(
        row['sourceLanguage'],
        'catalog.pairs.sourceLanguage',
      );
      final target = _language(
        row['targetLanguage'],
        'catalog.pairs.targetLanguage',
      );
      final id = _requiredString(
        row['id'],
        'catalog.pairs.id',
      ).toLowerCase();

      if (source == target || id != '$source->$target' || !ids.add(id)) {
        throw FormatException(
          'Invalid or duplicate catalog pair: $id.',
        );
      }

      final readiness = _requiredString(
        row['readiness'],
        'catalog.pairs.readiness',
      ).toLowerCase();
      if (!const <String>{
        'ready',
        'partial',
        'supported_not_generated',
        'not_ready',
      }.contains(readiness)) {
        throw FormatException(
          'Unsupported catalog readiness value: $readiness.',
        );
      }

      final assetPath = _optionalString(row['assetPath']);
      final entryChecksum = _optionalString(
        row['checksum'],
      )?.toLowerCase();
      if (entryChecksum != null && !_isChecksum(entryChecksum)) {
        throw FormatException(
          'Invalid pack checksum for catalog pair $id.',
        );
      }

      final vocabularyCount = _requiredInt(
        row['vocabularyCount'],
        'catalog.pairs.vocabularyCount',
      );
      final grammarCount = _requiredInt(
        row['grammarCount'],
        'catalog.pairs.grammarCount',
      );
      if (vocabularyCount < 0 || grammarCount < 0) {
        throw FormatException(
          'Catalog pair counts must be non-negative for $id.',
        );
      }

      final loadable =
          readiness == 'ready' || readiness == 'partial';
      if (loadable && (assetPath == null || entryChecksum == null)) {
        throw FormatException(
          'Loadable catalog pair $id must declare assetPath and checksum.',
        );
      }
      if (!loadable && assetPath != null) {
        throw FormatException(
          'Non-loadable catalog pair $id must not declare an assetPath.',
        );
      }

      entries.add(
        LanguagePackCatalogEntry(
          id: id,
          sourceLanguage: source,
          targetLanguage: target,
          readiness: readiness,
          assetPath: assetPath,
          checksum: entryChecksum,
          vocabularyCount: vocabularyCount,
          grammarCount: grammarCount,
          reason: _optionalString(row['reason']),
        ),
      );
    }

    final loadableCount =
        entries.where((entry) => entry.isLoadable).length;
    if (loadableCount != generatedPairCount) {
      throw FormatException(
        'Catalog generatedPairCount $generatedPairCount does not match '
        'loadable entry count $loadableCount.',
      );
    }

    return PolyglotLanguagePackCatalog._(
      schemaVersion: schemaVersion,
      languageCount: languageCount,
      directedPairCount: directedPairCount,
      generatedPairCount: generatedPairCount,
      entries: List<LanguagePackCatalogEntry>.unmodifiable(entries),
      checksum: checksum,
    );
  }

  LanguagePackCatalogEntry requirePair(
    String sourceLanguage,
    String targetLanguage,
  ) {
    final source = _language(sourceLanguage, 'sourceLanguage');
    final target = _language(targetLanguage, 'targetLanguage');
    final id = '$source->$target';
    for (final entry in entries) {
      if (entry.id == id) return entry;
    }
    throw ArgumentError.value(
      id,
      'directedPair',
      'Pair is not present in the language pack catalog.',
    );
  }
}

Map<String, Object?> _stringMap(Object? value, String field) {
  if (value is! Map) {
    throw FormatException('$field must be an object.');
  }
  final result = <String, Object?>{};
  for (final entry in value.entries) {
    if (entry.key is! String) {
      throw FormatException('$field keys must be strings.');
    }
    result[entry.key as String] = entry.value;
  }
  return result;
}

List<Map<String, Object?>> _objectList(Object? value, String field) {
  if (value is! List) {
    throw FormatException('$field must be an array.');
  }
  return List<Map<String, Object?>>.unmodifiable(
    value.map((item) => _stringMap(item, field)),
  );
}

List<String> _stringList(Object? value, String field) {
  if (value is! List) {
    throw FormatException('$field must be an array.');
  }
  return List<String>.unmodifiable(
    value.map((item) => _requiredString(item, field)),
  );
}

String _requiredString(Object? value, String field) {
  if (value is! String || value.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw FormatException('$field must be a non-empty string.');
  }
  return value.trim();
}

int _requiredInt(Object? value, String field) {
  if (value is! num) {
    throw FormatException('$field must be numeric.');
  }
  return value.toInt();
}

String? _optionalString(Object? value) {
  if (value == null) return null;
  if (value is! String) {
    throw const FormatException(
      'Optional catalog text must be a string.',
    );
  }
  final normalized = value.trim();
  return normalized.isEmpty ? null : normalized;
}

String _language(Object? value, String field) {
  final normalized = _requiredString(value, field)
      .replaceAll('_', '-')
      .toLowerCase();
  if (!RegExp(r'^[a-z]{2,8}(?:-[a-z0-9]{1,8})*$')
      .hasMatch(normalized)) {
    throw FormatException('$field is not a valid language tag.');
  }
  return normalized;
}

bool _canonicalTaskId(String value) {
  final match = RegExp(r'^task-(\d{2})$').firstMatch(value);
  if (match == null) return false;
  final number = int.tryParse(match.group(1) ?? '');
  return number != null && number >= 1 && number <= 50;
}

bool _isChecksum(String value) =>
    value.length == 32 &&
    !RegExp(r'[^0-9a-f]').hasMatch(value);

import 'orchestration_models.dart';

final class ServiceToken<T> {
  ServiceToken(String name) : name = name.trim() {
    if (this.name.isEmpty ||
        !RegExp(r'^[a-z0-9]+(?:[._-][a-z0-9]+)*$').hasMatch(this.name)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        name,
        'name',
        'Service token must be a lowercase path token.',
      );
    }
  }

  final String name;

  @override
  String toString() => 'ServiceToken($name)';
}

final class ServiceContainer {
  final Map<String, _ServiceRegistration> _registrations =
      <String, _ServiceRegistration>{};
  bool _frozen = false;

  bool get isFrozen => _frozen;
  int get registrationCount => _registrations.length;

  void registerSingleton<T>(ServiceToken<T> token, T value) {
    _rejectAgentReference(value);
    _register(
      token.name,
      _SingletonRegistration(value),
    );
  }

  void registerFactory<T>(
    ServiceToken<T> token,
    T Function() factory,
  ) {
    _register(
      token.name,
      _FactoryRegistration(() {
        final value = factory();
        _rejectAgentReference(value);
        return value;
      }),
    );
  }

  void registerLazySingleton<T>(
    ServiceToken<T> token,
    T Function() factory,
  ) {
    _register(
      token.name,
      _LazySingletonRegistration(() {
        final value = factory();
        _rejectAgentReference(value);
        return value;
      }),
    );
  }

  T resolve<T>(ServiceToken<T> token) {
    final registration = _registrations[token.name];
    if (registration == null) {
      throw StateError(
        'No service registered for token ${token.name}.',
      );
    }

    final value = registration.resolve();
    if (value is! T) {
      throw StateError(
        'Service token ${token.name} resolved to '
        '${value.runtimeType}, expected requested type.',
      );
    }
    return value;
  }

  bool contains<T>(ServiceToken<T> token) =>
      _registrations.containsKey(token.name);

  void freeze() {
    _frozen = true;
  }

  void _register(
    String name,
    _ServiceRegistration registration,
  ) {
    if (_frozen) {
      throw StateError('ServiceContainer is frozen.');
    }
    if (_registrations.containsKey(name)) {
      throw StateError('Service token already registered: $name.');
    }
    _registrations[name] = registration;
  }
}

abstract interface class _ServiceRegistration {
  Object? resolve();
}

final class _SingletonRegistration implements _ServiceRegistration {
  const _SingletonRegistration(this.value);

  final Object? value;

  @override
  Object? resolve() => value;
}

final class _FactoryRegistration implements _ServiceRegistration {
  const _FactoryRegistration(this.factory);

  final Object? Function() factory;

  @override
  Object? resolve() => factory();
}

final class _LazySingletonRegistration implements _ServiceRegistration {
  _LazySingletonRegistration(this.factory);

  final Object? Function() factory;
  Object? _value;
  bool _initialized = false;

  @override
  Object? resolve() {
    if (!_initialized) {
      _value = factory();
      _initialized = true;
    }
    return _value;
  }
}

void _rejectAgentReference(Object? value) {
  if (value is AgentReferenceBoundary) {
    throw ArgumentError(
      'Direct agent references are forbidden in ServiceContainer. '
      'Use AgentEventBus streams instead.',
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';

import '../../services/pack_checksum.dart';
import '../packs/pack_models.dart';
import 'hybrid_pad_models.dart';

enum HybridPadAdmissionCode {
  shardUnavailable,
  shardManifestHashMismatch,
  shardManifestSchemaMismatch,
  shardManifestSchemaRejected,
  logicalPackSizeMismatch,
  logicalPackHashMismatch,
  logicalPackSchemaMismatch,
  logicalPackSchemaRejected,
  activationReceiptMismatch,
}

final class HybridPadAdmissionException implements Exception {
  const HybridPadAdmissionException(
    this.code,
    this.message,
  );

  final HybridPadAdmissionCode code;
  final String message;

  @override
  String toString() =>
      'HybridPadAdmissionException(${code.name}): $message';
}

abstract interface class PhysicalPadShardReader {
  Future<bool> isInstalled(String assetPackName);

  Future<List<int>> readBytes({
    required String assetPackName,
    required String relativePath,
  });
}

abstract interface class PhysicalShardManifestSchemaVerifier {
  Future<int> verifyAndReadSchemaVersion({
    required PhysicalPadShardDescriptor descriptor,
    required List<int> bytes,
  });
}

final class JsonPhysicalShardManifestSchemaVerifier
    implements PhysicalShardManifestSchemaVerifier {
  const JsonPhysicalShardManifestSchemaVerifier();

  @override
  Future<int> verifyAndReadSchemaVersion({
    required PhysicalPadShardDescriptor descriptor,
    required List<int> bytes,
  }) async {
    final decoded = jsonDecode(
      utf8.decode(bytes, allowMalformed: false),
    );
    if (decoded is! Map) {
      throw const FormatException('PAD shard manifest must be an object.');
    }
    final root = decoded.cast<String, dynamic>();
    _rejectKeys(
      root,
      const <String>{'schemaVersion', 'shard', 'logicalPacks'},
      'PAD shard manifest',
    );
    final schemaVersion = _positiveInt(root, 'schemaVersion');

    final rawShard = root['shard'];
    if (rawShard is! Map) {
      throw const FormatException('PAD shard identity must be an object.');
    }
    final shard = rawShard.cast<String, dynamic>();
    _rejectKeys(
      shard,
      const <String>{'id', 'assetPackName', 'version'},
      'PAD shard identity',
    );
    if (shard['id'] != descriptor.id ||
        shard['assetPackName'] != descriptor.assetPackName ||
        shard['version'] != descriptor.version) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'PAD shard manifest identity does not match its descriptor.',
      );
    }

    final rawLogicalPacks = root['logicalPacks'];
    if (rawLogicalPacks is! List ||
        rawLogicalPacks.length != descriptor.logicalPacks.length) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'PAD shard logical-pack inventory does not match its descriptor.',
      );
    }

    final expected = <String, LogicalPadPackDescriptor>{
      for (final item in descriptor.logicalPacks) item.id: item,
    };
    final seen = <String>{};
    for (final rawItem in rawLogicalPacks) {
      if (rawItem is! Map) {
        throw const FormatException(
          'PAD shard logical-pack entry must be an object.',
        );
      }
      final item = rawItem.cast<String, dynamic>();
      _rejectKeys(
        item,
        const <String>{
          'id',
          'kind',
          'languageCode',
          'version',
          'schemaVersion',
          'sha256',
          'sizeBytes',
          'path',
          'sourceLanguageCode',
          'targetLanguageCode',
        },
        'PAD shard logical-pack entry',
      );
      final id = _requiredString(item, 'id');
      final descriptorItem = expected[id];
      if (descriptorItem == null || !seen.add(id)) {
        throw FormatException(
          'Unexpected or duplicate PAD logical pack: $id',
        );
      }

      if (item['kind'] != descriptorItem.kind.name ||
          item['languageCode'] != descriptorItem.languageCode ||
          item['version'] != descriptorItem.version ||
          item['schemaVersion'] != descriptorItem.schemaVersion ||
          item['sha256'] != descriptorItem.sha256 ||
          item['sizeBytes'] != descriptorItem.sizeBytes ||
          item['path'] != descriptorItem.relativePath ||
          item['sourceLanguageCode'] != descriptorItem.sourceLanguageCode ||
          item['targetLanguageCode'] != descriptorItem.targetLanguageCode) {
        throw FormatException(
          'PAD logical-pack manifest mismatch: $id',
        );
      }
    }

    if (seen.length != expected.length) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'PAD shard manifest is missing logical packs.',
      );
    }
    return schemaVersion;
  }

  static void _rejectKeys(
    Map<String, dynamic> value,
    Set<String> allowed,
    String field,
  ) {
    final unknown = value.keys.where((key) => !allowed.contains(key));
    if (unknown.isNotEmpty) {
      throw FormatException(
        '$field contains unknown keys: ${unknown.join(', ')}',
      );
    }
  }

  static int _positiveInt(
    Map<String, dynamic> value,
    String key,
  ) {
    final raw = value[key];
    if (raw is! int || raw < 1) {
      throw FormatException('$key must be a positive integer.');
    }
    return raw;
  }

  static String _requiredString(
    Map<String, dynamic> value,
    String key,
  ) {
    final raw = value[key];
    if (raw is! String || raw.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw FormatException('$key must be a non-empty string.');
    }
    return raw;
  }
}

abstract interface class LogicalPackSchemaVerifier {
  Future<int> verifyAndReadSchemaVersion({
    required LogicalPadPackDescriptor descriptor,
    required List<int> bytes,
  });
}

final class VerifiedLogicalPackReceipt {
  const VerifiedLogicalPackReceipt._({
    required this.logicalPackId,
    required this.physicalShardId,
    required this.assetPackName,
    required this.version,
    required this.schemaVersion,
    required this.sha256,
    required this.sizeBytes,
    required this.verifiedAt,
  });

  final String logicalPackId;
  final String physicalShardId;
  final String assetPackName;
  final String version;
  final int schemaVersion;
  final String sha256;
  final int sizeBytes;
  final DateTime verifiedAt;
}

final class VerifiedDirectionReceipt {
  VerifiedDirectionReceipt._({
    required this.request,
    required Iterable<VerifiedLogicalPackReceipt> logicalPacks,
    required this.verifiedAt,
  }) : logicalPacks =
            List<VerifiedLogicalPackReceipt>.unmodifiable(logicalPacks);

  final PackPairRequest request;
  final List<VerifiedLogicalPackReceipt> logicalPacks;
  final DateTime verifiedAt;

  String get pairKey => request.pairKey;

  bool coversLogicalPack(String logicalPackId) =>
      logicalPacks.any((receipt) => receipt.logicalPackId == logicalPackId);
}

final class HybridPadAdmissionGate {
  HybridPadAdmissionGate({
    required this.catalog,
    required PhysicalPadShardReader reader,
    required PhysicalShardManifestSchemaVerifier shardManifestSchemaVerifier,
    required LogicalPackSchemaVerifier schemaVerifier,
    DateTime Function()? clock,
  })  : _reader = reader,
        _shardManifestSchemaVerifier = shardManifestSchemaVerifier,
        _schemaVerifier = schemaVerifier,
        _clock = clock ?? DateTime.now;

  final HybridPadCatalog catalog;
  final PhysicalPadShardReader _reader;
  final PhysicalShardManifestSchemaVerifier _shardManifestSchemaVerifier;
  final LogicalPackSchemaVerifier _schemaVerifier;
  final DateTime Function() _clock;

  Future<VerifiedDirectionReceipt> verifyDirection(
    PackPairRequest request,
  ) async {
    final required = catalog.requirementsFor(request);
    final verifiedShardManifests = <String>{};
    final receipts = <VerifiedLogicalPackReceipt>[];

    for (final logicalPack in required) {
      final shard = catalog.shardForLogicalPack(logicalPack.id);
      final installed = await _reader.isInstalled(shard.assetPackName);
      if (!installed) {
        throw HybridPadAdmissionException(
          HybridPadAdmissionCode.shardUnavailable,
          'PAD shard is not installed: ${shard.assetPackName}',
        );
      }

      if (verifiedShardManifests.add(shard.id)) {
        await _verifyShardManifest(shard);
      }
      receipts.add(
        await _verifyLogicalPack(
          shard: shard,
          logicalPack: logicalPack,
        ),
      );
    }

    final now = _clock().toUtc();
    return VerifiedDirectionReceipt._(
      request: request,
      logicalPacks: receipts,
      verifiedAt: now,
    );
  }

  void requireActivationReceipt(
    PackPairRequest request,
    VerifiedDirectionReceipt receipt,
  ) {
    if (request.pairKey != receipt.pairKey) {
      throw const HybridPadAdmissionException(
        HybridPadAdmissionCode.activationReceiptMismatch,
        'Admission receipt does not belong to the requested direction.',
      );
    }
    final required = catalog
        .requirementsFor(request)
        .map((descriptor) => descriptor.id)
        .toSet();
    final verified =
        receipt.logicalPacks.map((item) => item.logicalPackId).toSet();
    if (required.length != verified.length ||
        !required.every(verified.contains)) {
      throw const HybridPadAdmissionException(
        HybridPadAdmissionCode.activationReceiptMismatch,
        'Admission receipt does not cover the exact logical-pack set.',
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _verifyShardManifest(
    PhysicalPadShardDescriptor shard,
  ) async {
    final bytes = await _reader.readBytes(
      assetPackName: shard.assetPackName,
      relativePath: shard.manifestRelativePath,
    );
    final checksum = PackChecksum.sha256Hex(bytes);
    if (checksum.toLowerCase() != shard.manifestSha256) {
      throw HybridPadAdmissionException(
        HybridPadAdmissionCode.shardManifestHashMismatch,
        'Physical PAD shard manifest failed SHA-256 verification: '
        '${shard.id}',
      );
    }

    late final int schemaVersion;
    try {
      schemaVersion =
          await _shardManifestSchemaVerifier.verifyAndReadSchemaVersion(
        descriptor: shard,
        bytes: bytes,
      );
    } on HybridPadAdmissionException {
      rethrow;
    } on Object catch (error) {
      throw HybridPadAdmissionException(
        HybridPadAdmissionCode.shardManifestSchemaRejected,
        'Physical PAD shard manifest schema rejected '
        '${shard.id}: $error',
      );
    }
    if (schemaVersion != shard.schemaVersion) {
      throw HybridPadAdmissionException(
        HybridPadAdmissionCode.shardManifestSchemaMismatch,
        'Physical PAD shard schema version mismatch for '
        '${shard.id}: expected ${shard.schemaVersion}, '
        'got $schemaVersion',
      );
    }
  }

  Future<VerifiedLogicalPackReceipt> _verifyLogicalPack({
    required PhysicalPadShardDescriptor shard,
    required LogicalPadPackDescriptor logicalPack,
  }) async {
    final bytes = await _reader.readBytes(
      assetPackName: shard.assetPackName,
      relativePath: logicalPack.relativePath,
    );

    if (bytes.length != logicalPack.sizeBytes) {
      throw HybridPadAdmissionException(
        HybridPadAdmissionCode.logicalPackSizeMismatch,
        'Logical pack size mismatch: ${logicalPack.id}',
      );
    }

    final checksum = PackChecksum.sha256Hex(bytes);
    if (checksum.toLowerCase() != logicalPack.sha256) {
      throw HybridPadAdmissionException(
        HybridPadAdmissionCode.logicalPackHashMismatch,
        'Logical pack failed SHA-256 verification: ${logicalPack.id}',
      );
    }

    late final int schemaVersion;
    try {
      schemaVersion = await _schemaVerifier.verifyAndReadSchemaVersion(
        descriptor: logicalPack,
        bytes: bytes,
      );
    } on HybridPadAdmissionException {
      rethrow;
    } on Object catch (error) {
      throw HybridPadAdmissionException(
        HybridPadAdmissionCode.logicalPackSchemaRejected,
        'Logical pack schema verification rejected '
        '${logicalPack.id}: $error',
      );
    }

    if (schemaVersion != logicalPack.schemaVersion) {
      throw HybridPadAdmissionException(
        HybridPadAdmissionCode.logicalPackSchemaMismatch,
        'Logical pack schema version mismatch for '
        '${logicalPack.id}: expected ${logicalPack.schemaVersion}, '
        'got $schemaVersion',
      );
    }

    return VerifiedLogicalPackReceipt._(
      logicalPackId: logicalPack.id,
      physicalShardId: shard.id,
      assetPackName: shard.assetPackName,
      version: logicalPack.version,
      schemaVersion: schemaVersion,
      sha256: checksum.toLowerCase(),
      sizeBytes: bytes.length,
      verifiedAt: _clock().toUtc(),
    );
  }
}
