import '../packs/pack_models.dart';

enum LogicalPadPackKind {
  languageCore,
  pairOverlay,
  audio,
}

final class LogicalPadPackDescriptor {
  LogicalPadPackDescriptor({
    required String id,
    required this.kind,
    required String languageCode,
    required String version,
    required this.schemaVersion,
    required String sha256,
    required this.sizeBytes,
    required String relativePath,
    String? sourceLanguageCode,
    String? targetLanguageCode,
  })  : id = _stableToken(id, 'logical pack id'),
        languageCode = _language(languageCode, 'languageCode'),
        version = _version(version),
        sha256 = _sha256(sha256, 'logical pack sha256'),
        relativePath = _safeRelativePath(relativePath),
        sourceLanguageCode = sourceLanguageCode == null
            ? null
            : _language(sourceLanguageCode, 'sourceLanguageCode'),
        targetLanguageCode = targetLanguageCode == null
            ? null
            : _language(targetLanguageCode, 'targetLanguageCode') {
    if (schemaVersion < 1 || schemaVersion > 1 << 20) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        schemaVersion,
        'schemaVersion',
        'must be a positive bounded schema version',
      );
    }
    if (sizeBytes < 1 || sizeBytes > 512 * 1024 * 1024) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        sizeBytes,
        'sizeBytes',
        'must be between 1 byte and 512 MiB',
      );
    }

    final source = this.sourceLanguageCode;
    final target = this.targetLanguageCode;
    if (kind == LogicalPadPackKind.pairOverlay) {
      if (source == null || target == null || source == target) {
        throw ArgumentError(
          'pairOverlay requires distinct source and target languages',
        );
      }
      if (this.languageCode != target) {
        throw ArgumentError(
          'pairOverlay languageCode must match its directed target language',
        );
      }
    } else if (source != null || target != null) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'Only pairOverlay logical packs may declare directed endpoints',
      );
    }
  }

  final String id;
  final LogicalPadPackKind kind;
  final String languageCode;
  final String version;
  final int schemaVersion;
  final String sha256;
  final int sizeBytes;
  final String relativePath;
  final String? sourceLanguageCode;
  final String? targetLanguageCode;

  String? get pairKey {
    final source = sourceLanguageCode;
    final target = targetLanguageCode;
    if (source == null || target == null) return null;
    return '$source->$target';
  }
}

final class PhysicalPadShardDescriptor {
  PhysicalPadShardDescriptor({
    required String id,
    required String assetPackName,
    required String version,
    required this.schemaVersion,
    required String manifestSha256,
    String manifestRelativePath = 'manifest/shard.json',
    required Iterable<LogicalPadPackDescriptor> logicalPacks,
  })  : id = _stableToken(id, 'physical shard id'),
        assetPackName = _assetPackName(assetPackName),
        version = _version(version),
        manifestSha256 = _sha256(
          manifestSha256,
          'physical shard manifest sha256',
        ),
        manifestRelativePath = _safeRelativePath(manifestRelativePath),
        logicalPacks = List<LogicalPadPackDescriptor>.unmodifiable(
          logicalPacks,
        ) {
    if (schemaVersion < 1 || schemaVersion > 1 << 20) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        schemaVersion,
        'schemaVersion',
        'must be a positive bounded schema version',
      );
    }
    if (this.logicalPacks.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('Physical PAD shard must contain logical packs.');
    }

    final ids = <String>{};
    final paths = <String>{manifestRelativePath};
    for (final pack in this.logicalPacks) {
      if (!ids.add(pack.id)) {
        throw ArgumentError('Duplicate logical pack id in shard: ${pack.id}');
      }
      if (!paths.add(pack.relativePath)) {
        throw ArgumentError(
          'Duplicate or reserved logical pack path: ${pack.relativePath}',
        );
      }
    }
  }

  final String id;
  final String assetPackName;
  final String version;
  final int schemaVersion;
  final String manifestSha256;
  final String manifestRelativePath;
  final List<LogicalPadPackDescriptor> logicalPacks;
}

final class HybridPadCatalog {
  HybridPadCatalog(Iterable<PhysicalPadShardDescriptor> shards)
      : shards = List<PhysicalPadShardDescriptor>.unmodifiable(shards) {
    if (this.shards.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('Hybrid PAD catalog cannot be empty.');
    }

    final shardIds = <String>{};
    final assetPackNames = <String>{};
    final languageCoreIds = <String, String>{};
    final logicalIds = <String>{};

    for (final shard in this.shards) {
      if (!shardIds.add(shard.id)) {
        throw ArgumentError('Duplicate physical shard id: ${shard.id}');
      }
      if (!assetPackNames.add(shard.assetPackName)) {
        throw ArgumentError(
          'Duplicate PAD asset pack name: ${shard.assetPackName}',
        );
      }
      for (final pack in shard.logicalPacks) {
        if (!logicalIds.add(pack.id)) {
          throw ArgumentError(
            'Logical pack cannot belong to multiple shards: ${pack.id}',
          );
        }
        _logicalToShard[pack.id] = shard;
        _logicalById[pack.id] = pack;

        if (pack.kind == LogicalPadPackKind.languageCore) {
          final previous = languageCoreIds[pack.languageCode];
          if (previous != null) {
            throw ArgumentError(
              'Multiple languageCore logical packs for '
              '${pack.languageCode}: $previous and ${pack.id}',
            );
          }
          languageCoreIds[pack.languageCode] = pack.id;
          _languageCoreByLanguage[pack.languageCode] = pack;
        } else if (pack.kind == LogicalPadPackKind.pairOverlay) {
          final pairKey = pack.pairKey!;
          if (_overlayByPair.containsKey(pairKey)) {
            throw ArgumentError(
              'Duplicate directed pair overlay for $pairKey',
            );
          }
          _overlayByPair[pairKey] = pack;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  final List<PhysicalPadShardDescriptor> shards;
  final Map<String, PhysicalPadShardDescriptor> _logicalToShard =
      <String, PhysicalPadShardDescriptor>{};
  final Map<String, LogicalPadPackDescriptor> _logicalById =
      <String, LogicalPadPackDescriptor>{};
  final Map<String, LogicalPadPackDescriptor> _languageCoreByLanguage =
      <String, LogicalPadPackDescriptor>{};
  final Map<String, LogicalPadPackDescriptor> _overlayByPair =
      <String, LogicalPadPackDescriptor>{};

  LogicalPadPackDescriptor requireLogicalPack(String id) {
    final normalized = _stableToken(id, 'logical pack id');
    final value = _logicalById[normalized];
    if (value == null) {
      throw StateError('logical_pack_not_registered:$normalized');
    }
    return value;
  }

  PhysicalPadShardDescriptor shardForLogicalPack(String id) {
    final normalized = _stableToken(id, 'logical pack id');
    final value = _logicalToShard[normalized];
    if (value == null) {
      throw StateError('logical_pack_shard_not_registered:$normalized');
    }
    return value;
  }

  LogicalPadPackDescriptor requireLanguageCore(String languageCode) {
    final normalized = _language(languageCode, 'languageCode');
    final value = _languageCoreByLanguage[normalized];
    if (value == null) {
      throw StateError('language_core_not_registered:$normalized');
    }
    return value;
  }

  LogicalPadPackDescriptor? directedOverlay(
    String sourceLanguageCode,
    String targetLanguageCode,
  ) {
    final source = _language(sourceLanguageCode, 'sourceLanguageCode');
    final target = _language(targetLanguageCode, 'targetLanguageCode');
    if (source == target) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'Source and target language must be different.',
      );
    }
    return _overlayByPair['$source->$target'];
  }

  List<LogicalPadPackDescriptor> requirementsFor(
    PackPairRequest request,
  ) {
    final pairKey = request.pairKey;
    final required = <LogicalPadPackDescriptor>[
      requireLanguageCore(request.source),
      requireLanguageCore(request.target),
    ];
    final overlay = _overlayByPair[pairKey];
    if (overlay != null) required.add(overlay);
    return List<LogicalPadPackDescriptor>.unmodifiable(required);
  }
}

String _stableToken(String raw, String field) {
  final value = raw.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!RegExp(r'^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,79}$').hasMatch(value)) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(raw, field, 'must be a stable token');
  }
  return value;
}

String _assetPackName(String raw) {
  final value = raw.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!RegExp(r'^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$').hasMatch(value)) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(
      raw,
      'assetPackName',
      'must be a stable Android asset-pack module token',
    );
  }
  return value;
}

String _language(String raw, String field) {
  final value = raw.trim().replaceAll('_', '-').toLowerCase();
  if (!RegExp(r'^[a-z]{2,8}(?:-[a-z0-9]{1,8})*$').hasMatch(value)) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(raw, field, 'must be a valid language tag');
  }
  return value;
}

String _version(String raw) {
  final value = raw.trim();
  if (value.isEmpty || value.length > 80) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(raw, 'version', 'must be 1..80 characters');
  }
  return value;
}

String _sha256(String raw, String field) {
  final value = raw.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!RegExp(r'^[a-f0-9]{64}$').hasMatch(value)) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(raw, field, 'must be a SHA-256 hex digest');
  }
  return value;
}

String _safeRelativePath(String raw) {
  final value = raw.trim().replaceAll('\\', '/');
  final segments = value.split('/');
  if (value.isEmpty ||
      value.startsWith('/') ||
      value.length > 240 ||
      segments.any(
        (segment) =>
            segment.isEmpty || segment == '.' || segment == '..',
      )) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(
      raw,
      'relativePath',
      'must remain inside the physical PAD shard',
    );
  }
  return value;
}

import 'pack_models.dart';

export 'pack_models.dart';

final class PackAcquisitionRouter {
  PackAcquisitionRouter({
    required LocalPackCatalog storage,
    List<PackAcquisitionProvider> providers =
        const <PackAcquisitionProvider>[],
  })  : _storage = storage,
        _providers = List<PackAcquisitionProvider>.unmodifiable(
          _validateProviders(providers),
        );

  final LocalPackCatalog _storage;
  final List<PackAcquisitionProvider> _providers;

  Future<PackRouteDecision> route(PackPairRequest request) async {
    request.pairKey;
    final local = await _storage.find(request);
    if (local != null) {
      return PackRouteDecision(
        request: request,
        availability: PackAvailabilityStatus.available,
        status: PackAcquisitionStatus.localReady,
        localPack: local,
        providerCandidates: const <String>[],
      );
    }

    return PackRouteDecision(
      request: request,
      availability: PackAvailabilityStatus.missing,
      status: PackAcquisitionStatus.requiresDownload,
      localPack: null,
      providerCandidates: List<String>.unmodifiable(
        _providers.map((provider) => provider.id),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> acquire(PackPairRequest request) async {
    request.pairKey;
    throw StateError(
      'pack_acquisition_disabled_offline_phase14',
    );
  }

  static List<PackAcquisitionProvider> _validateProviders(
    List<PackAcquisitionProvider> providers,
  ) {
    final ids = <String>{};
    for (final provider in providers) {
      final id = provider.id.trim().toLowerCase();
      if (id.isEmpty ||
          id.length > 80 ||
          !RegExp(r'^[a-z0-9]+(?:[._-][a-z0-9]+)*$')
              .hasMatch(id)) {
        throw ArgumentError.value(
          provider.id,
          'provider.id',
          'must be a stable provider token',
        );
      }
      if (!ids.add(id)) {
        throw ArgumentError(
          'Duplicate pack acquisition provider: $id',
        );
      }
    }
    return providers;
  }
}

enum PackAvailabilityStatus {
  available,
  missing,
}

enum PackAcquisitionStatus {
  localReady,
  requiresDownload,
}

final class PackPairRequest {
  const PackPairRequest({
    required this.sourceLanguageTag,
    required this.targetLanguageTag,
  });

  final String sourceLanguageTag;
  final String targetLanguageTag;

  String get source => _language(sourceLanguageTag, 'sourceLanguageTag');
  String get target => _language(targetLanguageTag, 'targetLanguageTag');

  String get pairKey {
    final normalizedSource = source;
    final normalizedTarget = target;
    if (normalizedSource == normalizedTarget) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'Source and target language must be different.',
      );
    }
    return '$normalizedSource->$normalizedTarget';
  }

  String get storageKey =>
      '${source.replaceAll('-', '_')}__${target.replaceAll('-', '_')}';
}

abstract interface class LocalPackReader {
  Future<String> readText(String relativePath);
  Future<List<int>> readBytes(String relativePath);
  Future<List<String>> listAssets();
}

final class LocalPackHandle {
  const LocalPackHandle({
    required this.pairKey,
    required this.rootPath,
    required this.reader,
    required this.hasJsonContent,
    required this.hasSqliteContent,
  });

  final String pairKey;
  final String rootPath;
  final LocalPackReader reader;
  final bool hasJsonContent;
  final bool hasSqliteContent;
}

abstract interface class LocalPackCatalog {
  Future<LocalPackHandle?> find(PackPairRequest request);
}

abstract interface class PackAcquisitionProvider {
  String get id;
  bool get requiresNetwork;

  Future<void> acquire(PackPairRequest request);
}

final class PackRouteDecision {
  const PackRouteDecision({
    required this.request,
    required this.availability,
    required this.status,
    required this.localPack,
    required this.providerCandidates,
  });

  final PackPairRequest request;
  final PackAvailabilityStatus availability;
  final PackAcquisitionStatus status;
  final LocalPackHandle? localPack;
  final List<String> providerCandidates;
}

String _language(String raw, String field) {
  final normalized =
      raw.trim().replaceAll('_', '-').toLowerCase();
  if (!RegExp(r'^[a-z]{2,8}(?:-[a-z0-9]{1,8})*$')
      .hasMatch(normalized)) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(
      raw,
      field,
      'must be a valid language tag',
    );
  }
  return normalized;
}

import '../../models/learner.dart';
import '../models/language_catalog_models.dart';
import '../packs/pack_models.dart';
import '../srs_facets.dart';
import '../srs_scheduler.dart';
import '../storage/local_db/pair_progress_database.dart';
import 'pair_progress_models.dart';
import 'review_transaction_envelope.dart';

final class OfflinePairProgressEngine {
  const OfflinePairProgressEngine(this._store);

  final PairProgressDatabase _store;

  Future<void> recordCard({
    required ResolvedLanguagePair pair,
    required String cardId,
    required bool learned,
    required int level,
    required int achievementDelta,
    required bool correct,
    required DateTime reviewedAt,
  }) async {
    final context = _validatePair(pair);
    final normalizedCardId = _cardId(cardId);
    _validateProgress(level, achievementDelta);

    await _store.recordCard(
      sourceLanguageId: context.source,
      targetLanguageId: context.target,
      cardId: normalizedCardId,
      learned: learned,
      level: level,
      achievementDelta: achievementDelta,
      correct: correct,
      reviewedAt: reviewedAt,
    );
  }

  Future<void> migrateLegacySnapshot({
    required ResolvedLanguagePair pair,
    required Iterable<ReviewCard> reviewCards,
    required Set<String> learnedConceptIds,
    required int achievementPoints,
    int level = 0,
  }) async {
    final context = _validatePair(pair);
    _validateProgress(level, achievementPoints);
    final cards = reviewCards.toList(growable: false);
    if (cards.any((card) => !card.facetKey.isValid)) {
      throw ArgumentError('Invalid legacy review card.');
    }
    await _store.migrateLegacySnapshot(
      sourceLanguageId: context.source,
      targetLanguageId: context.target,
      reviewCards: cards,
      learnedConceptIds: learnedConceptIds,
      achievementPoints: achievementPoints,
      level: level,
    );
  }

  Future<void> importReviewCard({
    required ResolvedLanguagePair pair,
    required ReviewCard reviewCard,
    required bool learned,
    int level = 0,
    int achievementDelta = 0,
  }) async {
    final context = _validatePair(pair);
    _validateProgress(level, achievementDelta);
    if (!reviewCard.facetKey.isValid) {
      throw ArgumentError('Invalid review card.');
    }
    await _store.importReviewCard(
      sourceLanguageId: context.source,
      targetLanguageId: context.target,
      reviewCard: reviewCard,
      learned: learned,
      level: level,
      achievementDelta: achievementDelta,
    );
  }

  Future<void> persistScheduledReview({
    required ResolvedLanguagePair pair,
    required ReviewCard reviewCard,
    required bool learned,
    required int level,
    required int achievementDelta,
    required bool correct,
    required DateTime reviewedAt,
  }) async {
    final context = _validatePair(pair);
    _validateProgress(level, achievementDelta);
    if (!reviewCard.facetKey.isValid) {
      throw ArgumentError('Invalid review card.');
    }
    await _store.recordScheduledReview(
      sourceLanguageId: context.source,
      targetLanguageId: context.target,
      reviewCard: reviewCard,
      learned: learned,
      level: level,
      achievementDelta: achievementDelta,
      correct: correct,
      reviewedAt: reviewedAt,
    );
  }

  Future<ReviewTransactionAcceptance> persistReviewEnvelope({
    required ResolvedLanguagePair pair,
    required ReviewTransactionEnvelope envelope,
    required ReviewCard reviewCard,
    required bool learned,
    required int level,
  }) async {
    final context = _validatePair(pair);
    _validateProgress(level, envelope.requestedXp);
    if (envelope.sourceLanguageId != context.source ||
        envelope.targetLanguageId != context.target) {
      throw StateError('review_envelope_pair_context_mismatch');
    }
    if (!reviewCard.facetKey.isValid ||
        reviewCard.storageKey != envelope.cardId) {
      throw StateError('review_envelope_card_context_mismatch');
    }

    return _store.recordScheduledReviewEnvelope(
      envelope: envelope,
      reviewCard: reviewCard,
      learned: learned,
      level: level,
    );
  }

  Future<ReviewTransactionAcceptance> persistReviewDeliveryEnvelope({
    required ResolvedLanguagePair pair,
    required ReviewTransactionEnvelope envelope,
  }) {
    final context = _validatePair(pair);
    if (envelope.sourceLanguageId != context.source ||
        envelope.targetLanguageId != context.target) {
      throw StateError('review_envelope_pair_context_mismatch');
    }
    return _store.recordReviewDeliveryEnvelope(envelope: envelope);
  }

  Future<ReviewCard> scheduleReview({
    required ResolvedLanguagePair pair,
    required String conceptId,
    ReviewFacetType facetType = ReviewFacetType.meaningRecall,
    String? variantKey,
    required bool correct,
    required bool hinted,
    required int level,
    required int achievementDelta,
    required DateTime reviewedAt,
    SrsScheduler scheduler = unifiedSrsScheduler,
  }) async {
    final context = _validatePair(pair);
    _validateProgress(level, achievementDelta);
    final key = ReviewFacetKey(
      conceptId: conceptId,
      facetType: facetType,
      variantKey: variantKey,
    );
    if (!key.isValid) {
      throw ArgumentError('Invalid review facet key.');
    }

    final current = await _store.loadReviewCard(
          sourceLanguageId: context.source,
          targetLanguageId: context.target,
          cardId: key.storageKey,
        ) ??
        ReviewCard(
          itemId: key.conceptId.trim(),
          facetType: key.facetType,
          variantKey: key.normalizedVariantKey,
          dueAt: reviewedAt,
        );
    final updated = await scheduler.schedule(
      current,
      correct: correct,
      hinted: hinted,
      now: reviewedAt,
    );

    await _store.recordScheduledReview(
      sourceLanguageId: context.source,
      targetLanguageId: context.target,
      reviewCard: updated,
      learned: correct,
      level: level,
      achievementDelta: achievementDelta,
      correct: correct,
      reviewedAt: reviewedAt,
    );
    return updated;
  }

  Future<List<ReviewTransactionJournalEntry>>
      loadPendingReviewTransactions({int limit = 128}) =>
          _store.loadPendingReviewTransactions(limit: limit);

  Future<ReviewTransactionJournalEntry?> loadReviewTransaction(
    String reviewEventId,
  ) =>
      _store.loadReviewTransaction(reviewEventId);

  Future<void> acknowledgeReviewTransaction({
    required String reviewEventId,
    required String payloadHash,
    required ReviewTransactionSink sink,
    DateTime? acknowledgedAt,
  }) =>
      _store.acknowledgeReviewTransaction(
        reviewEventId: reviewEventId,
        payloadHash: payloadHash,
        sink: sink,
        acknowledgedAt: acknowledgedAt,
      );

  Future<ReviewCard?> loadReviewCard(
    ResolvedLanguagePair pair, {
    required String conceptId,
    ReviewFacetType facetType = ReviewFacetType.meaningRecall,
    String? variantKey,
  }) {
    final context = _validatePair(pair);
    final key = ReviewFacetKey(
      conceptId: conceptId,
      facetType: facetType,
      variantKey: variantKey,
    );
    if (!key.isValid) {
      throw ArgumentError('Invalid review facet key.');
    }
    return _store.loadReviewCard(
      sourceLanguageId: context.source,
      targetLanguageId: context.target,
      cardId: key.storageKey,
    );
  }

  Future<void> clearAll() => _store.clearAll();

  Future<void> clearPair(ResolvedLanguagePair pair) {
    final context = _validatePair(pair);
    return _store.clearPair(
      sourceLanguageId: context.source,
      targetLanguageId: context.target,
    );
  }

  Future<PairProgressSnapshot> loadPair(
    ResolvedLanguagePair pair,
  ) {
    final context = _validatePair(pair);
    return _store.loadPair(
      sourceLanguageId: context.source,
      targetLanguageId: context.target,
    );
  }

  Future<PairProgressCard?> loadCard(
    ResolvedLanguagePair pair,
    String cardId,
  ) {
    final context = _validatePair(pair);
    final normalizedCardId = _cardId(cardId);
    return _store.loadCard(
      sourceLanguageId: context.source,
      targetLanguageId: context.target,
      cardId: normalizedCardId,
    );
  }

  _PairContext _validatePair(ResolvedLanguagePair pair) {
    final source = _language(pair.source.id, 'pair.source.id');
    final target = _language(pair.target.id, 'pair.target.id');
    if (source == target) {
      throw ArgumentError('Pair source and target must differ.');
    }

    final request = PackPairRequest(
      sourceLanguageTag: source,
      targetLanguageTag: target,
    );
    if (pair.pairKey != request.pairKey ||
        pair.route.request.pairKey != request.pairKey) {
      throw StateError('resolved_pair_context_mismatch');
    }

    return _PairContext(source: source, target: target);
  }

  static String _cardId(String raw) {
    final normalized = raw.trim();
    if (normalized.isEmpty || normalized.length > 1024) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        raw,
        'cardId',
        'must be 1..1024 characters',
      );
    }
    return normalized;
  }

  static void _validateProgress(
    int level,
    int achievementDelta,
  ) {
    if (level < 0 || level > 100) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(level, 'level', 'must be 0..100');
    }
    if (achievementDelta < 0 || achievementDelta > 100000) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        achievementDelta,
        'achievementDelta',
        'must be 0..100000',
      );
    }
  }

  static String _language(String raw, String field) {
    final normalized =
        raw.trim().replaceAll('_', '-').toLowerCase();
    if (!RegExp(r'^[a-z]{2,8}(?:-[a-z0-9]{1,8})*$')
        .hasMatch(normalized)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        raw,
        field,
        'must be a valid language tag',
      );
    }
    return normalized;
  }

FILE: lib/core/progress/review_transaction_envelope.dart

import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:math';

import 'package:cryptography/cryptography.dart';

import '../srs_facets.dart';

final class ReviewTransactionEnvelope {
  ReviewTransactionEnvelope._({
    required this.reviewEventId,
    required this.sourceLanguageId,
    required this.targetLanguageId,
    required this.conceptId,
    required this.facetType,
    required this.variantKey,
    required this.skill,
    required this.answer,
    required this.correct,
    required this.hinted,
    required this.seconds,
    required this.occurredAtUtc,
    required this.timezoneOffsetMinutes,
    required this.requestedXp,
    required this.compatibilityStreakTarget,
  });

  static const int schemaVersion = 1;
  static const int maxReviewEventIdLength = 160;
  static const int maxAnswerLength = 1000;
  static const int maxSkillLength = 160;
  static const int maxRequestedXp = 100;
  static const int maxCompatibilityStreak = 10000;

  final String reviewEventId;
  final String sourceLanguageId;
  final String targetLanguageId;
  final String conceptId;
  final ReviewFacetType facetType;
  final String? variantKey;
  final String skill;
  final String answer;
  final bool correct;
  final bool hinted;
  final int seconds;
  final DateTime occurredAtUtc;
  final int timezoneOffsetMinutes;
  final int requestedXp;
  final int? compatibilityStreakTarget;

  factory ReviewTransactionEnvelope({
    required String reviewEventId,
    required String sourceLanguageId,
    required String targetLanguageId,
    required String conceptId,
    ReviewFacetType facetType = ReviewFacetType.meaningRecall,
    String? variantKey,
    required String skill,
    required String answer,
    required bool correct,
    required bool hinted,
    required int seconds,
    required DateTime occurredAt,
    required int timezoneOffsetMinutes,
    required int requestedXp,
    int? compatibilityStreakTarget,
  }) {
    final normalizedEventId = reviewEventId.trim();
    if (normalizedEventId.isEmpty ||
        normalizedEventId.length > maxReviewEventIdLength) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        reviewEventId,
        'reviewEventId',
        'must be 1..$maxReviewEventIdLength characters',
      );
    }

    final source = _language(sourceLanguageId, 'sourceLanguageId');
    final target = _language(targetLanguageId, 'targetLanguageId');
    if (source == target) {
      throw ArgumentError('Review source and target languages must differ.');
    }

    final normalizedConceptId = conceptId.trim();
    final facetKey = ReviewFacetKey(
      conceptId: normalizedConceptId,
      facetType: facetType,
      variantKey: variantKey,
    );
    if (!facetKey.isValid) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        conceptId,
        'conceptId',
        'must define a valid review facet key',
      );
    }

    final normalizedSkill = skill.trim();
    if (normalizedSkill.isEmpty || normalizedSkill.length > maxSkillLength) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        skill,
        'skill',
        'must be 1..$maxSkillLength characters',
      );
    }
    if (answer.length > maxAnswerLength) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        answer.length,
        'answer.length',
        'must not exceed $maxAnswerLength characters',
      );
    }
    if (seconds < 0 || seconds > 3600) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(seconds, 'seconds', 'must be 0..3600');
    }
    if (timezoneOffsetMinutes < -840 || timezoneOffsetMinutes > 840) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        timezoneOffsetMinutes,
        'timezoneOffsetMinutes',
        'must be -840..840',
      );
    }
    if (requestedXp < 0 || requestedXp > maxRequestedXp) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        requestedXp,
        'requestedXp',
        'must be 0..$maxRequestedXp',
      );
    }
    final streakTarget = compatibilityStreakTarget;
    if (streakTarget != null &&
        (streakTarget < 0 || streakTarget > maxCompatibilityStreak)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        streakTarget,
        'compatibilityStreakTarget',
        'must be 0..$maxCompatibilityStreak',
      );
    }

    return ReviewTransactionEnvelope._(
      reviewEventId: normalizedEventId,
      sourceLanguageId: source,
      targetLanguageId: target,
      conceptId: normalizedConceptId,
      facetType: facetType,
      variantKey: facetKey.normalizedVariantKey,
      skill: normalizedSkill,
      answer: answer,
      correct: correct,
      hinted: hinted,
      seconds: seconds,
      occurredAtUtc: occurredAt.toUtc(),
      timezoneOffsetMinutes: timezoneOffsetMinutes,
      requestedXp: requestedXp,
      compatibilityStreakTarget: streakTarget,
    );
  }

  factory ReviewTransactionEnvelope.fromJournalRow(
    Map<String, Object?> row,
  ) {
    final version = _requiredInt(row, 'envelope_version');
    if (version != schemaVersion) {
      throw FormatException(
        'Unsupported review envelope version: $version',
      );
    }
    final facet = ReviewFacetType.fromWire(
      _requiredString(row, 'facet_type'),
    );
    if (facet == ReviewFacetType.unknown) {
      throw const FormatException('Invalid review facet type.');
    }

    return ReviewTransactionEnvelope(
      reviewEventId: _requiredString(row, 'review_event_id'),
      sourceLanguageId: _requiredString(row, 'source_language_id'),
      targetLanguageId: _requiredString(row, 'target_language_id'),
      conceptId: _requiredString(row, 'concept_id'),
      facetType: facet,
      variantKey: _optionalString(row['variant_key']),
      skill: _requiredString(row, 'skill'),
      answer: _requiredString(row, 'answer', allowEmpty: true),
      correct: _requiredFlag(row, 'correct'),
      hinted: _requiredFlag(row, 'hinted'),
      seconds: _requiredInt(row, 'seconds'),
      occurredAt: _requiredDateTime(row, 'occurred_at_utc'),
      timezoneOffsetMinutes:
          _requiredInt(row, 'timezone_offset_minutes'),
      requestedXp: _requiredInt(row, 'requested_xp'),
      compatibilityStreakTarget:
          _optionalInt(row['compatibility_streak_target']),
    );
  }

  ReviewFacetKey get facetKey => ReviewFacetKey(
        conceptId: conceptId,
        facetType: facetType,
        variantKey: variantKey,
      );

  String get cardId => facetKey.storageKey;

  Map<String, Object?> canonicalPayload() => <String, Object?>{
        'schemaVersion': schemaVersion,
        'reviewEventId': reviewEventId,
        'sourceLanguageId': sourceLanguageId,
        'targetLanguageId': targetLanguageId,
        'conceptId': conceptId,
        'facetType': facetType.wireName,
        'variantKey': variantKey ?? '',
        'skill': skill,
        'answer': answer,
        'correct': correct,
        'hinted': hinted,
        'seconds': seconds,
        'occurredAtUtc': occurredAtUtc.toIso8601String(),
        'timezoneOffsetMinutes': timezoneOffsetMinutes,
        'requestedXp': requestedXp,
        'compatibilityStreakTarget': compatibilityStreakTarget,
      };

  String canonicalJson() => jsonEncode(canonicalPayload());

  Future<String> computePayloadHash() async {
    final digest = await Sha256().hash(utf8.encode(canonicalJson()));
    final buffer = StringBuffer();
    for (final byte in digest.bytes) {
      buffer.write(byte.toRadixString(16).padLeft(2, '0'));
    }
    return buffer.toString();
  }

  Map<String, Object?> toJournalValues({
    required String payloadHash,
    required DateTime createdAtUtc,
  }) {
    final normalizedHash = _sha256(payloadHash);
    return <String, Object?>{
      'review_event_id': reviewEventId,
      'envelope_version': schemaVersion,
      'source_language_id': sourceLanguageId,
      'target_language_id': targetLanguageId,
      'concept_id': conceptId,
      'card_id': cardId,
      'facet_type': facetType.wireName,
      'variant_key': variantKey ?? '',
      'skill': skill,
      'answer': answer,
      'correct': correct ? 1 : 0,
      'hinted': hinted ? 1 : 0,
      'seconds': seconds,
      'occurred_at_utc': occurredAtUtc.toIso8601String(),
      'timezone_offset_minutes': timezoneOffsetMinutes,
      'requested_xp': requestedXp,
      'compatibility_streak_target': compatibilityStreakTarget,
      'payload_hash': normalizedHash,
      'attempt_applied': 0,
      'gamification_applied': 0,
      'created_at_utc': createdAtUtc.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
      'completed_at_utc': null,
    };
  }

  static String generateReviewEventId({
    required String kind,
    required DateTime occurredAt,
    Random? random,
  }) {
    final normalizedKind = kind.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!RegExp(r'^[a-z0-9_-]{1,24}$').hasMatch(normalizedKind)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        kind,
        'kind',
        'must match [a-z0-9_-] and be 1..24 characters',
      );
    }
    final source = random ?? Random.secure();
    final nonce = List<int>.generate(12, (_) => source.nextInt(256));
    final token = base64Url.encode(nonce).replaceAll('=', '');
    return 'rv1:$normalizedKind:'
        '${occurredAt.toUtc().microsecondsSinceEpoch}:$token';
  }

  static String validatePayloadHash(String value) => _sha256(value);

  static String _language(String raw, String field) {
    final normalized = raw.trim().replaceAll('_', '-').toLowerCase();
    if (!RegExp(r'^[a-z]{2,8}(?:-[a-z0-9]{1,8})*$')
        .hasMatch(normalized)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        raw,
        field,
        'must be a valid language tag',
      );
    }
    return normalized;
  }

  static String _sha256(String raw) {
    final normalized = raw.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!RegExp(r'^[a-f0-9]{64}$').hasMatch(normalized)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(raw, 'payloadHash', 'invalid SHA-256');
    }
    return normalized;
  }

  static String _requiredString(
    Map<String, Object?> row,
    String key, {
    bool allowEmpty = false,
  }) {
    final value = row[key]?.toString() ?? '';
    if ((!allowEmpty && value.trim().isEmpty) || value.length > 4096) {
      throw FormatException('Invalid review journal field: $key');
    }
    return allowEmpty ? value : value.trim();
  }

  static int _requiredInt(Map<String, Object?> row, String key) {
    final raw = row[key];
    final value =
        raw is num ? raw.toInt() : int.tryParse(raw?.toString() ?? '');
    if (value == null) {
      throw FormatException('Invalid review journal integer: $key');
    }
    return value;
  }

  static bool _requiredFlag(Map<String, Object?> row, String key) {
    final value = _requiredInt(row, key);
    if (value != 0 && value != 1) {
      throw FormatException('Invalid review journal flag: $key');
    }
    return value == 1;
  }

  static int? _optionalInt(Object? raw) {
    if (raw == null) return null;
    final value = raw is num ? raw.toInt() : int.tryParse(raw.toString());
    if (value == null) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Invalid review journal optional integer.',
      );
    }
    return value;
  }

  static String? _optionalString(Object? raw) {
    final value = raw?.toString().trim();
    return value == null || value.isEmpty ? null : value;
  }

  static DateTime _requiredDateTime(
    Map<String, Object?> row,
    String key,
  ) {
    final value = DateTime.tryParse(row[key]?.toString() ?? '')?.toUtc();
    if (value == null) {
      throw FormatException('Invalid review journal timestamp: $key');
    }
    return value;
  }
}

enum ReviewTransactionSink {
  attempt,
  gamification,
}

final class ReviewTransactionAcceptance {
  const ReviewTransactionAcceptance({
    required this.reviewEventId,
    required this.payloadHash,
    required this.alreadyAccepted,
  });

  final String reviewEventId;
  final String payloadHash;
  final bool alreadyAccepted;
}

final class ReviewTransactionJournalEntry {
  const ReviewTransactionJournalEntry({
    required this.envelope,
    required this.payloadHash,
    required this.attemptApplied,
    required this.gamificationApplied,
    required this.createdAtUtc,
    required this.completedAtUtc,
  });

  final ReviewTransactionEnvelope envelope;
  final String payloadHash;
  final bool attemptApplied;
  final bool gamificationApplied;
  final DateTime createdAtUtc;
  final DateTime? completedAtUtc;

  bool get isComplete =>
      attemptApplied && gamificationApplied && completedAtUtc != null;

  factory ReviewTransactionJournalEntry.fromRow(
    Map<String, Object?> row,
  ) {
    final envelope = ReviewTransactionEnvelope.fromJournalRow(row);
    final storedCardId = row['card_id']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
    if (storedCardId != envelope.cardId) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Review journal card_id does not match the envelope.',
      );
    }
    final hash = ReviewTransactionEnvelope.validatePayloadHash(
      row['payload_hash']?.toString() ?? '',
    );
    final createdAt =
        DateTime.tryParse(row['created_at_utc']?.toString() ?? '')?.toUtc();
    if (createdAt == null) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Invalid review journal created_at_utc.',
      );
    }
    final rawCompleted = row['completed_at_utc']?.toString() ?? '';
    final completedAt =
        rawCompleted.isEmpty ? null : DateTime.tryParse(rawCompleted)?.toUtc();
    if (rawCompleted.isNotEmpty && completedAt == null) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Invalid review journal completed_at_utc.',
      );
    }

    return ReviewTransactionJournalEntry(
      envelope: envelope,
      payloadHash: hash,
      attemptApplied: _flag(row['attempt_applied'], 'attempt_applied'),
      gamificationApplied:
          _flag(row['gamification_applied'], 'gamification_applied'),
      createdAtUtc: createdAt,
      completedAtUtc: completedAt,
    );
  }

  static bool _flag(Object? raw, String field) {
    final value =
        raw is num ? raw.toInt() : int.tryParse(raw?.toString() ?? '');
    if (value != 0 && value != 1) {
      throw FormatException('Invalid review journal flag: $field');
    }
    return value == 1;
  }
}

final class ReviewTransactionJournalException implements Exception {
  const ReviewTransactionJournalException(this.code);

  final String code;

  @override
  String toString() => 'ReviewTransactionJournalException($code)';
}

import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

import '../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import 'sentence_engine.dart';
import 'sentence_models.dart';
import 'sentence_tts.dart';

abstract final class _SentenceUiTokens {
  static const double sectionGap = 14;
  static const double contentGap = 10;
  static const double tokenGap = 8;
  static const double sheetInset = 18;
}

final class InteractiveSentenceCard extends StatefulWidget {
  const InteractiveSentenceCard({
    required this.sentence,
    required this.engine,
    this.audioController,
    this.onCopied,
    super.key,
  });

  final SentenceEntry sentence;
  final SentenceAnalysisEngine engine;
  final AudioPlaybackController? audioController;
  final ValueChanged<String>? onCopied;

  @override
  State<InteractiveSentenceCard> createState() =>
      _InteractiveSentenceCardState();
}

final class _InteractiveSentenceCardState
    extends State<InteractiveSentenceCard> {
  bool _showTranslation = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    widget.audioController?.addListener(_onAudioStateChanged);
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant InteractiveSentenceCard oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.audioController != widget.audioController) {
      oldWidget.audioController?.removeListener(_onAudioStateChanged);
      widget.audioController?.addListener(_onAudioStateChanged);
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    widget.audioController?.removeListener(_onAudioStateChanged);
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onAudioStateChanged(AudioPlaybackSnapshot _) {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final tokens = widget.engine.analyze(widget.sentence);
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return SafeArea(
      top: false,
      bottom: false,
      left: false,
      right: false,
      child: SingleChildScrollView(
        physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
        child: AppGlassCard(
          glowColor: AppColors.primary,
          borderColor: AppColors.primary,
          backgroundColor:
              isDark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: <Widget>[
              _ActionRow(
                translationVisible: _showTranslation,
                audioController: widget.audioController,
                onToggleTranslation: () {
                  setState(() {
                    _showTranslation = !_showTranslation;
                  });
                },
                onCopy: _copySentence,
                onTogglePlayback: _togglePlayback,
                onShowGrammar: _showGrammarBreakdown,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: _SentenceUiTokens.sectionGap),
              AppDirectionalText(
                widget.sentence.german,
                languageCode: 'de',
                style: AppTypography.title,
              ),
              if (_showTranslation) ...<Widget>[
                const SizedBox(height: _SentenceUiTokens.contentGap),
                AppDirectionalText(
                  widget.sentence.translationAr,
                  languageCode: 'ar',
                  style: AppTypography.body,
                ),
              ],
              const SizedBox(height: _SentenceUiTokens.sectionGap),
              Directionality(
                textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                child: Wrap(
                  spacing: _SentenceUiTokens.tokenGap,
                  runSpacing: _SentenceUiTokens.tokenGap,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    for (final token in tokens) _buildToken(context, token),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildToken(BuildContext context, SentenceToken token) {
    if (token.isPunctuation) {
      return Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
          vertical: _SentenceUiTokens.tokenGap,
        ),
        child: AppDirectionalText(
          token.text,
          languageCode: 'de',
          style: AppTypography.body,
        ),
      );
    }

    final accent = _grammarAccent(token);
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    return ActionChip(
      key: ValueKey<String>('sentence-token-${token.index}'),
      onPressed: () => _showTokenInspector(token),
      side: BorderSide(color: accent),
      backgroundColor: isDark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
      label: AppDirectionalText(
        token.text,
        languageCode: 'de',
        style: token.lexeme == null
            ? AppTypography.body
            : AppTypography.label.copyWith(color: accent),
      ),
    );
  }

  Color _grammarAccent(SentenceToken token) {
    if (token.verb != null) return AppColors.primary;
    if (token.noun != null) {
      return switch (token.noun!.article) {
        GermanArticle.der => AppColors.articleDer,
        GermanArticle.die => AppColors.articleDie,
        GermanArticle.das => AppColors.articleDas,
      };
    }
    return AppColors.secondary;
  }

  Future<void> _copySentence() async {
    await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: widget.sentence.german));
    widget.onCopied?.call(widget.sentence.german);
  }

  Future<void> _togglePlayback() async {
    final controller = widget.audioController;
    if (controller == null || !controller.isAvailable) return;

    if (controller.state == AudioPlaybackState.playing) {
      await controller.stop();
      return;
    }

    await controller.play(widget.sentence.german, languageCode: 'de-DE');
  }

  Future<void> _showTokenInspector(SentenceToken token) =>
      showModalBottomSheet<void>(
        context: context,
        isScrollControlled: true,
        builder: (sheetContext) => Directionality(
          textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
          child: SafeArea(
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(_SentenceUiTokens.sheetInset),
              child: AppGlassCard(
                glowColor: _grammarAccent(token),
                borderColor: _grammarAccent(token),
                child: _TokenInspector(
                  token: token,
                  onClose: () => Navigator.of(sheetContext).pop(),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );

  Future<void> _showGrammarBreakdown() => showModalBottomSheet<void>(
        context: context,
        isScrollControlled: true,
        builder: (sheetContext) => SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(_SentenceUiTokens.sheetInset),
            child: GrammarBreakdownSheet(
              sentence: widget.sentence,
              pattern: widget.engine.detectWordOrderPattern(widget.sentence),
              onClose: () => Navigator.of(sheetContext).pop(),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
}

final class _ActionRow extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ActionRow({
    required this.translationVisible,
    required this.audioController,
    required this.onToggleTranslation,
    required this.onCopy,
    required this.onTogglePlayback,
    required this.onShowGrammar,
  });

  final bool translationVisible;
  final AudioPlaybackController? audioController;
  final VoidCallback onToggleTranslation;
  final Future<void> Function() onCopy;
  final Future<void> Function() onTogglePlayback;
  final Future<void> Function() onShowGrammar;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final controller = audioController;
    final snapshot = controller?.snapshot;
    final audioEnabled = controller?.isAvailable ?? false;

    return Wrap(
      alignment: WrapAlignment.start,
      spacing: _SentenceUiTokens.tokenGap,
      runSpacing: _SentenceUiTokens.tokenGap,
      crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,
      children: <Widget>[
        IconButton(
          key: const ValueKey<String>('sentence-translation-toggle'),
          tooltip:
              translationVisible ? 'إخفاء الترجمة' : 'إظهار الترجمة',
          onPressed: onToggleTranslation,
          icon: Icon(
            translationVisible
                ? Icons.visibility_off_outlined
                : Icons.translate_outlined,
          ),
        ),
        IconButton(
          key: const ValueKey<String>('sentence-copy-button'),
          tooltip: 'نسخ الجملة',
          onPressed: () async => onCopy(),
          icon: const Icon(Icons.copy_outlined),
        ),
        IconButton(
          key: const ValueKey<String>('sentence-tts-button'),
          tooltip: snapshot?.isPlaying == true ? 'إيقاف الصوت' : 'تشغيل الصوت',
          onPressed: audioEnabled ? () async => onTogglePlayback() : null,
          icon: Icon(
            snapshot?.isPlaying == true
                ? Icons.stop_circle_outlined
                : Icons.volume_up_outlined,
          ),
        ),
        TextButton(
          key: const ValueKey<String>('sentence-speed-toggle'),
          onPressed: audioEnabled ? controller!.toggleSpeed : null,
          child: Text(snapshot?.speed.label ?? AudioPlaybackSpeed.normal.label),
        ),
        TextButton.icon(
          key: const ValueKey<String>('sentence-syntax-button'),
          onPressed: () async => onShowGrammar(),
          icon: const Icon(Icons.account_tree_outlined),
          label: AppDirectionalText(
            'تحليل الجملة',

final class _SentenceCardState extends State<SentenceCard> {

    super.initState();
    _syncController();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant SentenceCard oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.ttsHook != widget.ttsHook) _syncController();

    final hook = widget.ttsHook;
    _controller = hook == null ? null : AudioPlaybackController(hook: hook);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => InteractiveSentenceCard(
        sentence: widget.sentence,
        engine: widget.engine,
        audioController: _controller,
        onCopied: widget.onCopied,
      );
}

import 'sentence_models.dart';

final class SentenceAnalysisEngine {
  static final RegExp _tokenPattern = RegExp(
    r"[A-Za-zÄÖÜäöüßẞ]+(?:[-'][A-Za-zÄÖÜäöüßẞ]+)*|[0-9]+|[^\s]",
  );
  static final RegExp _wordPattern = RegExp(
    r"^[A-Za-zÄÖÜäöüßẞ0-9]",
  );
  static final RegExp _subordinateMarkerPattern = RegExp(
    r'\b(weil|dass|wenn|obwohl|damit|während|bevor|nachdem|falls|ob)\b',
    caseSensitive: false,
  );

  List<SentenceToken> analyze(SentenceEntry sentence) {
    final grammarByForm = <String, SentenceLexeme>{};

    for (final lexeme in sentence.lexicon) {
      for (final form in <String>{lexeme.lemma, ...lexeme.forms}) {
        final key = normalizeToken(form);
        if (key.isEmpty) continue;
        grammarByForm.putIfAbsent(key, () => lexeme);
      }
    }

    final result = <SentenceToken>[];
    var index = 0;
    for (final match in _tokenPattern.allMatches(sentence.german)) {
      final text = match.group(0)!;
      final normalized = normalizeToken(text);
      final isPunctuation = !_wordPattern.hasMatch(text);
      result.add(
        SentenceToken(
          index: index++,
          text: text,
          normalized: normalized,
          isPunctuation: isPunctuation,
          lexeme: isPunctuation ? null : grammarByForm[normalized],
        ),
      );
    }

    return List<SentenceToken>.unmodifiable(result);
  }

  SentenceWordOrderPattern detectWordOrderPattern(SentenceEntry sentence) {
    if (sentence.wordOrderPattern != SentenceWordOrderPattern.custom) {
      return sentence.wordOrderPattern;
    }

    if (_subordinateMarkerPattern.hasMatch(sentence.german)) {
      return SentenceWordOrderPattern.subordinateVerbFinal;
    }

    final hasModal = sentence.lexicon.any(
      (lexeme) => lexeme.verb?.isModal ?? false,
    );
    if (hasModal) return SentenceWordOrderPattern.modalBracket;

    final hasVerb = sentence.lexicon.any((lexeme) => lexeme.isVerb);
    if (hasVerb) return SentenceWordOrderPattern.svo;

    return SentenceWordOrderPattern.custom;
  }

  static String normalizeToken(String value) =>
      value.trim().toLowerCase().replaceAll('ẞ', 'ß');
}

final class SentenceFuzzySearchService {
  SentenceFuzzySearchService(Iterable<SentenceEntry> sentences)
      : _sentences = List<SentenceEntry>.unmodifiable(sentences);

  final List<SentenceEntry> _sentences;

  static const Map<String, String> _arabicToLatin = <String, String>{
    'ا': 'a',
    'أ': 'a',
    'إ': 'i',
    'آ': 'a',
    'ب': 'b',
    'ت': 't',
    'ث': 'th',
    'ج': 'j',
    'ح': 'h',
    'خ': 'ch',
    'د': 'd',
    'ذ': 'd',
    'ر': 'r',
    'ز': 'z',
    'س': 's',
    'ش': 'sch',
    'ص': 's',
    'ض': 'd',
    'ط': 't',
    'ظ': 'z',
    'ع': '',
    'غ': 'g',
    'ف': 'f',
    'ق': 'k',
    'ك': 'k',
    'ل': 'l',
    'م': 'm',
    'ن': 'n',
    'ه': 'h',
    'ة': 'a',
    'و': 'u',
    'ؤ': 'u',
    'ي': 'i',
    'ى': 'a',
    'ئ': 'i',
    'ء': '',
    'َ': '',
    'ُ': '',
    'ِ': '',
    'ْ': '',
    'ّ': '',
    'ً': '',
    'ٌ': '',
    'ٍ': '',
  };

  List<SentenceSearchHit> search(
    String query, {
    int limit = 20,
  }) {
    final normalizedQuery = _normalizeSearch(query);
    if (normalizedQuery.isEmpty) return const <SentenceSearchHit>[];

    final cappedLimit = limit.clamp(1, 100).toInt();
    final hits = <SentenceSearchHit>[];

    for (final sentence in _sentences) {
      var bestScore = 0.0;
      for (final candidate in _candidateTexts(sentence)) {
        final normalizedCandidate = _normalizeSearch(candidate);
        if (normalizedCandidate.isEmpty) continue;
        final score = _score(normalizedQuery, normalizedCandidate);
        if (score > bestScore) bestScore = score;
        if (bestScore >= .999) break;
      }

      if (bestScore >= .42) {
        hits.add(SentenceSearchHit(sentence: sentence, score: bestScore));
      }
    }

    hits.sort((left, right) {
      final scoreOrder = right.score.compareTo(left.score);
      if (scoreOrder != 0) return scoreOrder;
      return left.sentence.id.compareTo(right.sentence.id);
    });

    return List<SentenceSearchHit>.unmodifiable(hits.take(cappedLimit));
  }

  static Iterable<String> _candidateTexts(SentenceEntry sentence) sync* {
    yield sentence.german;
    yield sentence.translationAr;
    yield* sentence.phoneticAliases;

    for (final lexeme in sentence.lexicon) {
      yield lexeme.lemma;
      yield* lexeme.forms;
      yield* lexeme.phoneticAliases;
    }
  }

  static double _score(String query, String candidate) {
    if (candidate.isEmpty) return 0;
    if (query == candidate) return 1;
    if (candidate.contains(query)) return .96;

    final queryTokens = query.split(' ');
    final candidateTokens = candidate.split(' ');
    var similarityTotal = 0.0;
    var covered = 0;

    for (final queryToken in queryTokens) {
      var best = 0.0;
      for (final candidateToken in candidateTokens) {
        final similarity = _similarity(queryToken, candidateToken);
        if (similarity > best) best = similarity;
        if (best == 1) break;
      }
      similarityTotal += best;
      if (best >= .72) covered += 1;
    }

    final average = similarityTotal / queryTokens.length;
    final coverage = covered / queryTokens.length;
    final prefixBonus = candidateTokens.isNotEmpty &&
            candidateTokens.first.startsWith(queryTokens.first)
        ? .04
        : 0.0;

    return (average * .78 + coverage * .18 + prefixBonus)
        .clamp(0.0, 1.0)
        .toDouble();
  }

  static double _similarity(String left, String right) {
    if (left == right) return 1;
    if (left.isEmpty || right.isEmpty) return 0;

    final longest = left.length > right.length ? left.length : right.length;
    final distance = _levenshtein(left, right);
    return (1 - (distance / longest)).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
  }

  static int _levenshtein(String left, String right) {
    var previous = List<int>.generate(right.length + 1, (index) => index);

    for (var row = 1; row <= left.length; row++) {
      final current = <int>[row];
      for (var column = 1; column <= right.length; column++) {
        final substitution = previous[column - 1] +
            (left[row - 1] == right[column - 1] ? 0 : 1);
        final insertion = current[column - 1] + 1;
        final deletion = previous[column] + 1;

        var best = substitution;
        if (insertion < best) best = insertion;
        if (deletion < best) best = deletion;
        current.add(best);
      }
      previous = current;
    }

    return previous.last;
  }

  static String _normalizeSearch(String value) {
    var normalized = value.toLowerCase();
    normalized = normalized
        .replaceAll('ä', 'a')
        .replaceAll('ö', 'o')
        .replaceAll('ü', 'u')
        .replaceAll('ß', 'ss');

    final buffer = StringBuffer();
    for (final rune in normalized.runes) {
      final character = String.fromCharCode(rune);
      buffer.write(_arabicToLatin[character] ?? character);
    }

    normalized = buffer.toString().replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-z0-9 ]'), ' ');
    normalized = normalized.replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ').trim();
    return normalized;
  }
}

typedef SentenceTtsSpeakCallback = Future<void> Function(
  String text,
  String languageCode,
);
typedef SentenceTtsRateCallback = Future<void> Function(double speed);
typedef AudioPlaybackStateListener = void Function(
  AudioPlaybackSnapshot snapshot,
);

abstract interface class SentenceTtsHook {
  bool get isOfflineReady;

  Future<void> speak(
    String text, {
    String languageCode = 'de-DE',
    double speed = 1.0,
  });

  Future<void> stop();
}

final class CallbackSentenceTtsHook implements SentenceTtsHook {
  const CallbackSentenceTtsHook({
    required this.offlineReady,
    required this.speakCallback,
    this.rateCallback,
    this.stopCallback,
  });

  final bool offlineReady;
  final SentenceTtsSpeakCallback speakCallback;
  final SentenceTtsRateCallback? rateCallback;
  final Future<void> Function()? stopCallback;

  @override
  bool get isOfflineReady => offlineReady;

  @override
  Future<void> speak(
    String text, {
    String languageCode = 'de-DE',
    double speed = 1.0,
  }) async {
    final onRate = rateCallback;
    if (onRate != null) {
      await onRate(speed);
    }
    await speakCallback(text, languageCode);
  }

  @override
  Future<void> stop() async {
    final callback = stopCallback;
    if (callback != null) {
      await callback();
    }
  }
}

enum AudioPlaybackSpeed {
  normal(1.0, '1.0x'),
  slow(0.75, '0.75x');

  const AudioPlaybackSpeed(this.factor, this.label);

  final double factor;
  final String label;
}

enum AudioPlaybackState {
  idle,
  playing,
  stopped,
  unavailable,
  error;

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        AudioPlaybackState.idle => 'جاهز',
        AudioPlaybackState.playing => 'يتم التشغيل',
        AudioPlaybackState.stopped => 'متوقف',
        AudioPlaybackState.unavailable => 'الصوت غير متاح',
        AudioPlaybackState.error => 'تعذر تشغيل الصوت',
      };
}

final class AudioPlaybackSnapshot {
  const AudioPlaybackSnapshot({
    required this.state,
    required this.speed,
    this.error,
  });

  final AudioPlaybackState state;
  final AudioPlaybackSpeed speed;
  final Object? error;

  bool get isPlaying => state == AudioPlaybackState.playing;
}

final class AudioPlaybackController {
  AudioPlaybackController({
    required this.hook,
    AudioPlaybackSpeed initialSpeed = AudioPlaybackSpeed.normal,
    AudioPlaybackStateListener? onStateChanged,
  }) : _snapshot = AudioPlaybackSnapshot(
          state: hook.isOfflineReady
              ? AudioPlaybackState.idle
              : AudioPlaybackState.unavailable,
          speed: initialSpeed,
        ) {
    if (onStateChanged != null) {
      _listeners.add(onStateChanged);
    }
  }

  final SentenceTtsHook hook;
  final List<AudioPlaybackStateListener> _listeners =
      <AudioPlaybackStateListener>[];
  AudioPlaybackSnapshot _snapshot;

  AudioPlaybackSnapshot get snapshot => _snapshot;
  AudioPlaybackSpeed get speed => _snapshot.speed;
  AudioPlaybackState get state => _snapshot.state;
  bool get isAvailable => hook.isOfflineReady;

  void addListener(AudioPlaybackStateListener listener) {
    if (!_listeners.contains(listener)) {
      _listeners.add(listener);
    }
  }

  void removeListener(AudioPlaybackStateListener listener) {
    _listeners.remove(listener);
  }

  void setSpeed(AudioPlaybackSpeed speed) {
    if (_snapshot.speed == speed) return;
    _emit(state: _snapshot.state, speed: speed);
  }

  void toggleSpeed() {
    setSpeed(
      _snapshot.speed == AudioPlaybackSpeed.normal
          ? AudioPlaybackSpeed.slow
          : AudioPlaybackSpeed.normal,
    );
  }

  Future<bool> play(
    String text, {
    String languageCode = 'de-DE',
  }) async {
    if (!hook.isOfflineReady) {
      _emit(
        state: AudioPlaybackState.unavailable,
        speed: _snapshot.speed,
      );
      return false;
    }

    if (_snapshot.isPlaying) {
      await hook.stop();
    }

    _emit(
      state: AudioPlaybackState.playing,
      speed: _snapshot.speed,
    );

    try {
      await hook.speak(
        text,
        languageCode: languageCode,
        speed: _snapshot.speed.factor,
      );
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      _emit(
        state: AudioPlaybackState.error,
        speed: _snapshot.speed,
        error: error,
      );
      return false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> stop() async {
    if (!hook.isOfflineReady) {
      _emit(
        state: AudioPlaybackState.unavailable,
        speed: _snapshot.speed,
      );
      return;
    }

    try {
      await hook.stop();
      _emit(
        state: AudioPlaybackState.stopped,
        speed: _snapshot.speed,
      );
    } catch (error) {
      _emit(
        state: AudioPlaybackState.error,
        speed: _snapshot.speed,
        error: error,
      );
    }
  }

  void markCompleted() {
    if (!_snapshot.isPlaying) return;
    _emit(
      state: AudioPlaybackState.idle,
      speed: _snapshot.speed,
    );
  }

  void reset() {
    _emit(
      state: hook.isOfflineReady
          ? AudioPlaybackState.idle
          : AudioPlaybackState.unavailable,
      speed: _snapshot.speed,
    );
  }

  void _emit({
    required AudioPlaybackState state,
    required AudioPlaybackSpeed speed,
    Object? error,
  }) {
    _snapshot = AudioPlaybackSnapshot(
      state: state,
      speed: speed,
      error: error,
    );

    for (final listener in List<AudioPlaybackStateListener>.of(_listeners)) {
      listener(_snapshot);
    }
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'local_preferences_store.dart';

final class AdaptiveThemeSettingsController extends ChangeNotifier {
  AdaptiveThemeSettingsController._({
    required LocalPreferencesStore preferences,
    required ThemeMode initialMode,
  })  : _preferences = preferences,
        _mode = initialMode;

  static const String _storageKey = 'settings.theme_mode.v1';

  final LocalPreferencesStore _preferences;
  ThemeMode _mode;

  ThemeMode get mode => _mode;

  static Future<AdaptiveThemeSettingsController> load({
    required LocalPreferencesStore preferences,
  }) async {
    final raw = preferences.getString(_storageKey);
    final mode = ThemeMode.values.firstWhere(
      (value) => value.name == raw,
      orElse: () => ThemeMode.system,
    );
    return AdaptiveThemeSettingsController._(
      preferences: preferences,
      initialMode: mode,
    );
  }

  void setMode(ThemeMode next) {
    if (_mode == next) return;
    _mode = next;
    notifyListeners();
    unawaited(_preferences.setString(_storageKey, next.name));
  }

  void followSystem() => setMode(ThemeMode.system);

  void toggle(Brightness platformBrightness) {
    final effective = switch (_mode) {
      ThemeMode.system => platformBrightness,
      ThemeMode.light => Brightness.light,
      ThemeMode.dark => Brightness.dark,
    };
    setMode(
      effective == Brightness.dark ? ThemeMode.light : ThemeMode.dark,
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'local_preferences_store.dart';

enum SpeechRatePreset {
  half(0.5, '0.5x'),
  threeQuarter(0.75, '0.75x'),
  normal(1.0, '1.0x');

  const SpeechRatePreset(this.multiplier, this.label);

  final double multiplier;
  final String label;

  double resolveEngineRate({
    double normalEngineRate = 0.46,
  }) =>
      (normalEngineRate * multiplier).clamp(0.1, 1.0).toDouble();
}

final class SpeechRateSettingsController extends ChangeNotifier {
  SpeechRateSettingsController._({
    required LocalPreferencesStore preferences,
    required SpeechRatePreset initialPreset,
  })  : _preferences = preferences,
        _preset = initialPreset;

  static const String _storageKey = 'settings.speech_rate.v1';

  final LocalPreferencesStore _preferences;
  SpeechRatePreset _preset;

  SpeechRatePreset get preset => _preset;
  double get speedMultiplier => _preset.multiplier;

  static Future<SpeechRateSettingsController> load({
    required LocalPreferencesStore preferences,
  }) async {
    final raw = preferences.getString(_storageKey);
    final preset = SpeechRatePreset.values.firstWhere(
      (value) => value.name == raw,
      orElse: () => SpeechRatePreset.normal,
    );
    return SpeechRateSettingsController._(
      preferences: preferences,
      initialPreset: preset,
    );
  }

  void setPreset(SpeechRatePreset next) {
    if (_preset == next) return;
    _preset = next;
    notifyListeners();
    unawaited(_preferences.setString(_storageKey, next.name));
  }
}

import '../../features/audio/domain/services/offline_tts_engine.dart';
import '../../language/language_speech_profile.dart';
import '../infrastructure/audio/flutter_tts_audio_engine.dart';
import 'speech_capability_resolver.dart';

final class FlutterLocalSpeechCapabilityProbe
    implements LocalSpeechCapabilityProbe {
  FlutterLocalSpeechCapabilityProbe({
    FlutterOfflineTtsEngine? engine,
  }) : _engine = engine ?? FlutterOfflineTtsEngine();

  final FlutterOfflineTtsEngine _engine;
  bool _closed = false;

  bool get isClosed => _closed;

  @override
  Future<LocalSpeechProbeResult> probe(String languageTag) async {
    if (_closed) {
      return const LocalSpeechProbeResult.unavailable(
        reason: 'local_probe_closed',
      );
    }

    final profile = _ProbeSpeechProfile(languageTag);
    try {
      final availability = await _engine.probe(profile);
      if (availability != OfflineTtsAvailability.ready) {
        return const LocalSpeechProbeResult.unavailable(
          reason: 'offline_voice_not_installed',
        );
      }

      return LocalSpeechProbeResult.ready(
        locale: profile.preferredTtsLocales.first,
      );
    } on Object {
      return const LocalSpeechProbeResult.unavailable(
        reason: 'local_probe_failed',
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    _closed = true;
    await _engine.shutdown();
  }
}

final class _ProbeSpeechProfile implements LanguageSpeechProfile {
  _ProbeSpeechProfile(String languageTag)
      : _languageTag = _normalize(languageTag);

  final String _languageTag;

  @override
  String get languageCode => _languageTag;

  @override
  List<String> get preferredTtsLocales {
    final base = _languageTag.split('-').first;
    return List<String>.unmodifiable(
      <String>{
        _languageTag,
        if (base.isNotEmpty) base,
      },
    );
  }

  @override
  double get defaultSpeechRate => 0.46;

  @override
  String get offlineVoiceUnavailableMessage =>
      'offline_voice_unavailable';

  static String _normalize(String value) =>
      value.trim().replaceAll('_', '-').toLowerCase();
}


--------------------------------------------------
FILE: lib/core/speech/speech_capability_resolver.dart
--------------------------------------------------
enum SpeechOfflineStatus {
  ready,
  unavailable,
}

enum SpeechPairOfflineStatus {
  ready,
  partial,
  unavailable,
}

final class LocalSpeechProbeResult {
  const LocalSpeechProbeResult.ready({
    required String locale,
  })  : available = true,
        locale = locale,
        reason = null;

  const LocalSpeechProbeResult.unavailable({
    required String reason,
  })  : available = false,
        locale = null,
        reason = reason;

  final bool available;
  final String? locale;
  final String? reason;
}

abstract interface class LocalSpeechCapabilityProbe {
  Future<LocalSpeechProbeResult> probe(String languageTag);
}

final class SpeechLanguageCapability {
  const SpeechLanguageCapability({
    required this.languageTag,
    required this.status,
    required this.locale,
    required this.reason,
  });

  final String languageTag;
  final SpeechOfflineStatus status;
  final String? locale;
  final String? reason;
}

final class SpeechPairCapability {
  const SpeechPairCapability({
    required this.source,
    required this.target,
    required this.status,
  });

  final SpeechLanguageCapability source;
  final SpeechLanguageCapability target;
  final SpeechPairOfflineStatus status;

  bool get isFullyOfflineReady =>
      status == SpeechPairOfflineStatus.ready;
}

final class SpeechCapabilityResolver {
  const SpeechCapabilityResolver({
    required LocalSpeechCapabilityProbe probe,
  }) : _probe = probe;

  final LocalSpeechCapabilityProbe _probe;

  Future<SpeechPairCapability> resolvePair({
    required String sourceLanguageTag,
    required String targetLanguageTag,
  }) async {
    final source = _languageTag(
      sourceLanguageTag,
      'sourceLanguageTag',
    );
    final target = _languageTag(
      targetLanguageTag,
      'targetLanguageTag',
    );
    if (source == target) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'Source and target language must be different.',
      );
    }

    final sourceCapability = await _resolveLanguage(source);
    final targetCapability = await _resolveLanguage(target);
    final readyCount = <SpeechLanguageCapability>[
      sourceCapability,
      targetCapability,
    ].where((item) => item.status == SpeechOfflineStatus.ready).length;

    final status = switch (readyCount) {
      2 => SpeechPairOfflineStatus.ready,
      1 => SpeechPairOfflineStatus.partial,
      _ => SpeechPairOfflineStatus.unavailable,
    };

    return SpeechPairCapability(
      source: sourceCapability,
      target: targetCapability,
      status: status,
    );
  }

  Future<SpeechLanguageCapability> _resolveLanguage(
    String languageTag,
  ) async {
    try {
      final result = await _probe.probe(languageTag);
      if (!result.available) {
        return SpeechLanguageCapability(
          languageTag: languageTag,
          status: SpeechOfflineStatus.unavailable,
          locale: null,
          reason: _reason(result.reason, 'voice_not_installed'),
        );
      }

      final locale = result.locale?.trim();
      if (locale == null || locale.isEmpty) {
        return SpeechLanguageCapability(
          languageTag: languageTag,
          status: SpeechOfflineStatus.unavailable,
          locale: null,
          reason: 'offline_locale_missing',
        );
      }

      return SpeechLanguageCapability(
        languageTag: languageTag,
        status: SpeechOfflineStatus.ready,
        locale: locale.replaceAll('_', '-'),
        reason: null,
      );
    } on Object {
      return SpeechLanguageCapability(
        languageTag: languageTag,
        status: SpeechOfflineStatus.unavailable,
        locale: null,
        reason: 'local_probe_failed',
      );
    }
  }

  static String _languageTag(String raw, String field) {
    final normalized =
        raw.trim().replaceAll('_', '-').toLowerCase();
    if (!RegExp(r'^[a-z]{2,8}(?:-[a-z0-9]{1,8})*$')
        .hasMatch(normalized)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        raw,
        field,
        'must be a valid language tag',
      );
    }
    return normalized;
  }

  static String _reason(String? value, String fallback) {
    final normalized = value?.trim() ?? '';
    if (normalized.isEmpty) return fallback;
    return normalized.length <= 120
        ? normalized
        : normalized.substring(0, 120);
  }
}

FILE: lib/core/storage/local_db/pair_progress_database.dart
