part of 'learner_state_database.dart';

const String _attemptsTable = LearnerStateDatabase.attemptsTable;
const String _assessmentTable = LearnerStateDatabase.assessmentTable;
const String _assessmentWeakSkillsTable =
    LearnerStateDatabase.assessmentWeakSkillsTable;
const String _placementTable = LearnerStateDatabase.placementTable;
const String _placementScoresTable =
    LearnerStateDatabase.placementScoresTable;
const String _placementWeakTable =
    LearnerStateDatabase.placementWeakTable;
const String _placementReviewItemsTable =
    LearnerStateDatabase.placementReviewItemsTable;
const String _favoritesTable = LearnerStateDatabase.favoritesTable;

const int _maxAttempts = LearnerStateDatabase.maxAttempts;
const int _maxAssessments = LearnerStateDatabase.maxAssessments;
const int _maxPlacements = LearnerStateDatabase.maxPlacements;
const int _maxFavorites = LearnerStateDatabase.maxFavorites;
const int _maxWeakSkills = LearnerStateDatabase.maxWeakSkills;
const int _maxPlacementReviewItems =
    LearnerStateDatabase.maxPlacementReviewItems;
const int _maxIdentifierLength =
    LearnerStateDatabase.maxIdentifierLength;
const int _maxAnswerLength = LearnerStateDatabase.maxAnswerLength;

bool _attemptRowMatches(
  Map<String, Object?> row,
  Attempt value,
) =>
    _strictIdentifier(row['attempt_id'], field: 'attempt_id') == value.id &&
    _strictIdentifier(row['item_id'], field: 'item_id') == value.itemId &&
    _strictIdentifier(row['skill'], field: 'skill') == value.skill &&
    _strictText(
          row['answer'],
          field: 'answer',
          maxLength: _maxAnswerLength,
          allowEmpty: true,
        ) ==
        value.answer &&
    _strictFlag(row['correct'], field: 'correct') == value.correct &&
    _strictFlag(row['hinted'], field: 'hinted') == value.hinted &&
    _strictInt(
          row['seconds'],
          field: 'seconds',
          min: 0,
          max: 3600,
        ) ==
        value.seconds &&
    _strictDateTime(
          row['occurred_at_utc'],
          field: 'occurred_at_utc',
        ).microsecondsSinceEpoch ==
        value.at.toUtc().microsecondsSinceEpoch &&
    _strictText(
          row['facet_type'],
          field: 'facet_type',
          maxLength: 64,
        ) ==
        value.facetType.wireName &&
    (_optionalBoundedText(
          row['variant_key'],
          field: 'variant_key',
          maxLength: _maxIdentifierLength,
        ) ??
        '') ==
        (ReviewFacetKey.normalizeVariant(value.variantKey) ?? '');

bool _assessmentRowsMatch(
  Map<String, Object?> row,
  List<Map<String, Object?>> weakRows,
  AssessmentHistory value,
) {
  if (_strictIdentifier(row['assessment_id'], field: 'assessment_id') !=
          value.id ||
      _strictDateTime(
            row['occurred_at_utc'],
            field: 'occurred_at_utc',
          ).microsecondsSinceEpoch !=
          value.at.toUtc().microsecondsSinceEpoch ||
      _strictFiniteDouble(
            row['score'],
            field: 'score',
            min: 0,
            max: 100,
          ) !=
          value.score ||
      _strictInt(
            row['answered'],
            field: 'answered',
            min: 0,
            max: 100,
          ) !=
          value.answered ||
      weakRows.length != value.weakSkills.length) {
    return false;
  }
  for (var index = 0; index < weakRows.length; index += 1) {
    final weak = weakRows[index];
    if (_strictInt(
              weak['position'],
              field: 'position',
              min: 0,
              max: _maxWeakSkills - 1,
            ) !=
            index ||
        _strictIdentifier(weak['skill'], field: 'weak_skill') !=
            value.weakSkills[index]) {
      return false;
    }
  }
  return true;
}

bool _placementRowsMatch(
  Map<String, Object?> row,
  List<Map<String, Object?>> scoreRows,
  List<Map<String, Object?>> weakRows,
  List<Map<String, Object?>> reviewRows,
  PlacementDiagnosticRecord value,
) {
  final level = row['curriculum_start_level']?.toString();
  final goal = row['learning_goal']?.toString();
  if (_strictIdentifier(row['placement_id'], field: 'placement_id') !=
          value.id ||
      _strictDateTime(
            row['occurred_at_utc'],
            field: 'occurred_at_utc',
          ).microsecondsSinceEpoch !=
          value.at.toUtc().microsecondsSinceEpoch ||
      _strictInt(row['answered'], field: 'answered', min: 0, max: 20) !=
          value.answered ||
      _strictInt(
            row['scored_answers'],
            field: 'scored_answers',
            min: 0,
            max: 20,
          ) !=
          value.scoredAnswers ||
      _strictFiniteDouble(
            row['score'],
            field: 'score',
            min: 0,
            max: 100,
          ) !=
          value.score ||
      _strictFiniteDouble(
            row['confidence'],
            field: 'confidence',
            min: 0,
            max: 1,
          ) !=
          value.confidence ||
      row['band']?.toString() != value.band.wireName ||
      (level == null || level.isEmpty ? null : level) !=
          value.curriculumStartLevel ||
      _strictInt(
            row['recommended_start_task_order'],
            field: 'recommended_start_task_order',
            min: 1,
            max: 50,
          ) !=
          value.recommendedStartTaskOrder ||
      (goal == null || goal.isEmpty ? null : goal) !=
          value.learningGoal) {
    return false;
  }

  final expectedScores = value.dimensionScores.entries.toList()
    ..sort((a, b) => a.key.wireName.compareTo(b.key.wireName));
  if (scoreRows.length != expectedScores.length ||
      weakRows.length != value.weakDimensions.length ||
      reviewRows.length != value.reviewItemIds.length) {
    return false;
  }
  for (var index = 0; index < scoreRows.length; index += 1) {
    if (scoreRows[index]['dimension']?.toString() !=
            expectedScores[index].key.wireName ||
        _strictFiniteDouble(
              scoreRows[index]['score'],
              field: 'dimension_score',
              min: 0,
              max: 1,
            ) !=
            expectedScores[index].value) {
      return false;
    }
  }
  for (var index = 0; index < weakRows.length; index += 1) {
    if (_strictInt(
              weakRows[index]['position'],
              field: 'position',
              min: 0,
              max: DiagnosticDimension.values.length - 1,
            ) !=
            index ||
        weakRows[index]['dimension']?.toString() !=
            value.weakDimensions[index].wireName) {
      return false;
    }
  }
  for (var index = 0; index < reviewRows.length; index += 1) {
    if (_strictInt(
              reviewRows[index]['position'],
              field: 'position',
              min: 0,
              max: _maxPlacementReviewItems - 1,
            ) !=
            index ||
        _strictIdentifier(
              reviewRows[index]['item_id'],
              field: 'placement_review_item_id',
            ) !=
            value.reviewItemIds[index]) {
      return false;
    }
  }
  return true;
}

Future<List<Attempt>> _readAttempts(DatabaseExecutor db) async {
  final rows = await db.query(
    _attemptsTable,
    orderBy: 'ordinal ASC',
    limit: _maxAttempts + 1,
  );
  if (rows.length > _maxAttempts) {
    throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
      'attempt_row_bound_exceeded',
    );
  }
  final result = <Attempt>[];
  final seenIds = <String>{};
  int? previousOrdinal;
  for (final row in rows) {
    final ordinal = _strictInt(
      row['ordinal'],
      field: 'ordinal',
      min: 0,
      max: 1 << 30,
    );
    if (previousOrdinal != null && ordinal <= previousOrdinal) {
      throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
        'attempt_ordinal_order_invalid',
      );
    }
    previousOrdinal = ordinal;
    final id = _strictIdentifier(row['attempt_id'], field: 'attempt_id');
    if (!seenIds.add(id)) {
      throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
        'duplicate_attempt_id',
      );
    }
    final facet = ReviewFacetType.fromWire(
      _strictText(
        row['facet_type'],
        field: 'facet_type',
        maxLength: 64,
      ),
    );
    if (facet == ReviewFacetType.unknown) {
      throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
        'invalid_attempt_facet_type',
      );
    }
    final variant = _optionalBoundedText(
      row['variant_key'],
      field: 'variant_key',
      maxLength: _maxIdentifierLength,
    );
    result.add(
      Attempt(
        id: id,
        itemId: _strictIdentifier(row['item_id'], field: 'item_id'),
        skill: _strictIdentifier(row['skill'], field: 'skill'),
        answer: _strictText(
          row['answer'],
          field: 'answer',
          maxLength: _maxAnswerLength,
          allowEmpty: true,
        ),
        correct: _strictFlag(row['correct'], field: 'correct'),
        hinted: _strictFlag(row['hinted'], field: 'hinted'),
        seconds: _strictInt(
          row['seconds'],
          field: 'seconds',
          min: 0,
          max: 3600,
        ),
        at: _strictDateTime(
          row['occurred_at_utc'],
          field: 'occurred_at_utc',
        ),
        facetType: facet,
        variantKey: variant,
      ),
    );
  }
  return List<Attempt>.unmodifiable(result);
}

Future<List<AssessmentHistory>> _readAssessments(
  DatabaseExecutor db,
) async {
  final rows = await db.query(
    _assessmentTable,
    orderBy: 'ordinal DESC',
    limit: _maxAssessments + 1,
  );
  if (rows.length > _maxAssessments) {
    throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
      'assessment_row_bound_exceeded',
    );
  }
  final weakRows = await db.query(
    _assessmentWeakSkillsTable,
    orderBy: 'assessment_id ASC, position ASC',
    limit: (_maxAssessments * _maxWeakSkills) + 1,
  );
  if (weakRows.length > _maxAssessments * _maxWeakSkills) {
    throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
      'assessment_weak_skill_bound_exceeded',
    );
  }
  final weakById = <String, List<String>>{};
  for (final row in weakRows) {
    final id = _strictIdentifier(
      row['assessment_id'],
      field: 'assessment_id',
    );
    final position = _strictInt(
      row['position'],
      field: 'position',
      min: 0,
      max: _maxWeakSkills - 1,
    );
    final values = weakById.putIfAbsent(id, () => <String>[]);
    if (position != values.length) {
      throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
        'assessment_weak_skill_order_invalid',
      );
    }
    values.add(
      _strictIdentifier(row['skill'], field: 'weak_skill'),
    );
  }

  final result = <AssessmentHistory>[];
  final seenIds = <String>{};
  int? previousOrdinal;
  for (final row in rows) {
    final ordinal = _strictInt(
      row['ordinal'],
      field: 'ordinal',
      min: 0,
      max: 1 << 30,
    );
    if (previousOrdinal != null && ordinal >= previousOrdinal) {
      throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
        'assessment_ordinal_order_invalid',
      );
    }
    previousOrdinal = ordinal;
    final id = _strictIdentifier(
      row['assessment_id'],
      field: 'assessment_id',
    );
    if (!seenIds.add(id)) {
      throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
        'duplicate_assessment_id',
      );
    }
    result.add(
      AssessmentHistory(
        id: id,
        at: _strictDateTime(
          row['occurred_at_utc'],
          field: 'occurred_at_utc',
        ),
        score: _strictFiniteDouble(
          row['score'],
          field: 'score',
          min: 0,
          max: 100,
        ),
        weakSkills:
            List<String>.unmodifiable(weakById[id] ?? const <String>[]),
        answered: _strictInt(
          row['answered'],
          field: 'answered',
          min: 0,
          max: 100,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
  if (weakById.keys.any((id) => !seenIds.contains(id))) {
    throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
      'orphan_assessment_weak_skill',
    );
  }
  return List<AssessmentHistory>.unmodifiable(result);
}

Future<List<PlacementDiagnosticRecord>> _readPlacements(
  DatabaseExecutor db,
) async {
  final rows = await db.query(
    _placementTable,
    orderBy: 'ordinal DESC',
    limit: _maxPlacements + 1,
  );
  if (rows.length > _maxPlacements) {
    throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
      'placement_row_bound_exceeded',
    );
  }

  final scoreRows = await db.query(
    _placementScoresTable,
    orderBy: 'placement_id ASC, dimension ASC',
    limit: (_maxPlacements * DiagnosticDimension.values.length) + 1,
  );
  if (scoreRows.length >
      _maxPlacements * DiagnosticDimension.values.length) {
    throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
      'placement_score_bound_exceeded',
    );
  }
  final scoresById = <String, Map<DiagnosticDimension, double>>{};
  for (final row in scoreRows) {
    final id = _strictIdentifier(
      row['placement_id'],
      field: 'placement_id',
    );
    final dimension = DiagnosticDimension.fromWire(
      _strictText(
        row['dimension'],
        field: 'dimension',
        maxLength: 32,
      ),
    );
    if (dimension == null) {
      throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
        'invalid_placement_dimension',
      );
    }
    final scores = scoresById.putIfAbsent(
      id,
      () => <DiagnosticDimension, double>{},
    );
    if (scores.containsKey(dimension)) {
      throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
        'duplicate_placement_dimension',
      );
    }
    scores[dimension] = _strictFiniteDouble(
      row['score'],
      field: 'dimension_score',
      min: 0,
      max: 1,
    );
  }

  final weakRows = await db.query(
    _placementWeakTable,
    orderBy: 'placement_id ASC, position ASC',
    limit: (_maxPlacements * DiagnosticDimension.values.length) + 1,
  );
  if (weakRows.length >
      _maxPlacements * DiagnosticDimension.values.length) {
    throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
      'placement_weak_dimension_bound_exceeded',
    );
  }
  final weakById = <String, List<DiagnosticDimension>>{};
  for (final row in weakRows) {
    final id = _strictIdentifier(
      row['placement_id'],
      field: 'placement_id',
    );
    final position = _strictInt(
      row['position'],
      field: 'position',
      min: 0,
      max: DiagnosticDimension.values.length - 1,
    );
    final dimension = DiagnosticDimension.fromWire(
      _strictText(
        row['dimension'],
        field: 'dimension',
        maxLength: 32,
      ),
    );
    if (dimension == null) {
      throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
        'invalid_placement_weak_dimension',
      );
    }
    final values = weakById.putIfAbsent(
      id,
      () => <DiagnosticDimension>[],
    );
    if (position != values.length || values.contains(dimension)) {
      throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
        'placement_weak_dimension_order_invalid',
      );
    }
    values.add(dimension);
  }

  final reviewRows = await db.query(
    _placementReviewItemsTable,
    orderBy: 'placement_id ASC, position ASC',
    limit: (_maxPlacements * _maxPlacementReviewItems) + 1,
  );
  if (reviewRows.length > _maxPlacements * _maxPlacementReviewItems) {
    throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
      'placement_review_item_bound_exceeded',
    );
  }
  final reviewById = <String, List<String>>{};
  for (final row in reviewRows) {
    final id = _strictIdentifier(
      row['placement_id'],
      field: 'placement_id',
    );
    final position = _strictInt(
      row['position'],
      field: 'position',
      min: 0,
      max: _maxPlacementReviewItems - 1,
    );
    final itemId = _strictIdentifier(
      row['item_id'],
      field: 'placement_review_item_id',
    );
    final values = reviewById.putIfAbsent(id, () => <String>[]);
    if (position != values.length || values.contains(itemId)) {
      throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
        'placement_review_item_order_invalid',
      );
    }
    values.add(itemId);
  }

  final result = <PlacementDiagnosticRecord>[];
  final seenIds = <String>{};
  const allowedBands = <String>{
    'foundation',
    'basic',
    'developing',
    'strong',
  };
  const allowedLevels = <String>{'A1', 'A2', 'B1', 'B2'};
  const allowedGoals = <String>{
    'general',
    'dailyLife',
    'work',
    'studyExam',
    'travel',
  };

  int? previousOrdinal;
  for (final row in rows) {
    final ordinal = _strictInt(
      row['ordinal'],
      field: 'ordinal',
      min: 0,
      max: 1 << 30,
    );
    if (previousOrdinal != null && ordinal >= previousOrdinal) {
      throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
        'placement_ordinal_order_invalid',
      );
    }
    previousOrdinal = ordinal;
    final id = _strictIdentifier(
      row['placement_id'],
      field: 'placement_id',
    );
    if (!seenIds.add(id)) {
      throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
        'duplicate_placement_id',
      );
    }
    final bandRaw = _strictText(
      row['band'],
      field: 'band',
      maxLength: 32,
    );
    if (!allowedBands.contains(bandRaw)) {
      throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
        'invalid_placement_band',
      );
    }
    final level = _nullableStrictEnum(
      row['curriculum_start_level'],
      allowed: allowedLevels,
      field: 'curriculum_start_level',
    );
    final goal = _nullableStrictEnum(
      row['learning_goal'],
      allowed: allowedGoals,
      field: 'learning_goal',
    );

    result.add(
      PlacementDiagnosticRecord(
        id: id,
        at: _strictDateTime(
          row['occurred_at_utc'],
          field: 'occurred_at_utc',
        ),
        answered: _strictInt(
          row['answered'],
          field: 'answered',
          min: 0,
          max: 20,
        ),
        scoredAnswers: _strictInt(
          row['scored_answers'],
          field: 'scored_answers',
          min: 0,
          max: 20,
        ),
        score: _strictFiniteDouble(
          row['score'],
          field: 'score',
          min: 0,
          max: 100,
        ),
        confidence: _strictFiniteDouble(
          row['confidence'],
          field: 'confidence',
          min: 0,
          max: 1,
        ),
        band: DiagnosticPlacementBand.values.firstWhere(
          (candidate) => candidate.wireName == bandRaw,
        ),
        dimensionScores:
            Map<DiagnosticDimension, double>.unmodifiable(
          scoresById[id] ?? const <DiagnosticDimension, double>{},
        ),
        weakDimensions:
            List<DiagnosticDimension>.unmodifiable(
          weakById[id] ?? const <DiagnosticDimension>[],
        ),
        reviewItemIds: List<String>.unmodifiable(
          reviewById[id] ?? const <String>[],
        ),
        curriculumStartLevel: level,
        recommendedStartTaskOrder: _strictInt(
          row['recommended_start_task_order'],
          field: 'recommended_start_task_order',
          min: 1,
          max: 50,
        ),
        learningGoal: goal,
      ),
    );
  }

  final known = seenIds;
  if (scoresById.keys.any((id) => !known.contains(id)) ||
      weakById.keys.any((id) => !known.contains(id)) ||
      reviewById.keys.any((id) => !known.contains(id))) {
    throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
      'orphan_placement_child_row',
    );
  }
  return List<PlacementDiagnosticRecord>.unmodifiable(result);
}

Future<Set<String>> _readFavorites(DatabaseExecutor db) async {
  final rows = await db.query(
    _favoritesTable,
    orderBy: 'verb ASC',
    limit: _maxFavorites + 1,
  );
  if (rows.length > _maxFavorites) {
    throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
      'favorite_row_bound_exceeded',
    );
  }
  final result = <String>{};
  for (final row in rows) {
    final verb = _strictIdentifier(row['verb'], field: 'favorite_verb');
    if (!result.add(verb)) {
      throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
        'duplicate_favorite_verb',
      );
    }
  }
  return Set<String>.unmodifiable(result);
}

void _validateSnapshotBounds(LearnerSqliteSnapshot snapshot) {
  if (snapshot.attempts.length > _maxAttempts ||
      snapshot.assessmentHistory.length > _maxAssessments ||
      snapshot.placementHistory.length > _maxPlacements ||
      snapshot.favoriteVerbs.length > _maxFavorites) {
    throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
      'learner_snapshot_bound_exceeded',
    );
  }

  _requireUnique(
    snapshot.attempts.map((value) => value.id),
    'duplicate_attempt_id',
  );
  _requireUnique(
    snapshot.assessmentHistory.map((value) => value.id),
    'duplicate_assessment_id',
  );
  _requireUnique(
    snapshot.placementHistory.map((value) => value.id),
    'duplicate_placement_id',
  );
}

Attempt _validateAttempt(Attempt attempt) {
  _strictIdentifier(attempt.id, field: 'attempt_id');
  _strictIdentifier(attempt.itemId, field: 'item_id');
  _strictIdentifier(attempt.skill, field: 'skill');
  _strictText(
    attempt.answer,
    field: 'answer',
    maxLength: _maxAnswerLength,
    allowEmpty: true,
  );
  if (attempt.seconds < 0 || attempt.seconds > 3600) {
    throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
      'invalid_attempt_seconds',
    );
  }
  if (attempt.facetType == ReviewFacetType.unknown) {
    throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
      'invalid_attempt_facet_type',
    );
  }
  final variant = ReviewFacetKey.normalizeVariant(attempt.variantKey);
  if (variant != null && variant.length > _maxIdentifierLength) {
    throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
      'invalid_attempt_variant',
    );
  }
  _validateUtcDateRange(attempt.at, field: 'attempt_at');
  return attempt;
}

AssessmentHistory _validateAssessment(AssessmentHistory value) {
  _strictIdentifier(value.id, field: 'assessment_id');
  _validateUtcDateRange(value.at, field: 'assessment_at');
  if (!value.score.isFinite || value.score < 0 || value.score > 100) {
    throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
      'invalid_assessment_score',
    );
  }
  if (value.answered < 0 || value.answered > 100 ||
      value.weakSkills.length > _maxWeakSkills) {
    throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
      'invalid_assessment_bounds',
    );
  }
  for (final skill in value.weakSkills) {
    _strictIdentifier(skill, field: 'weak_skill');
  }
  return value;
}

PlacementDiagnosticRecord _validatePlacement(
  PlacementDiagnosticRecord value,
) {
  _strictIdentifier(value.id, field: 'placement_id');
  _validateUtcDateRange(value.at, field: 'placement_at');
  if (value.answered < 0 ||
      value.answered > 20 ||
      value.scoredAnswers < 0 ||
      value.scoredAnswers > 20 ||
      !value.score.isFinite ||
      value.score < 0 ||
      value.score > 100 ||
      !value.confidence.isFinite ||
      value.confidence < 0 ||
      value.confidence > 1 ||
      value.weakDimensions.length > DiagnosticDimension.values.length ||
      value.reviewItemIds.length > _maxPlacementReviewItems ||
      value.recommendedStartTaskOrder < 1 ||
      value.recommendedStartTaskOrder > 50) {
    throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
      'invalid_placement_bounds',
    );
  }
  const allowedLevels = <String>{'A1', 'A2', 'B1', 'B2'};
  const allowedGoals = <String>{
    'general',
    'dailyLife',
    'work',
    'studyExam',
    'travel',
  };
  final level = value.curriculumStartLevel;
  final goal = value.learningGoal;
  if ((level != null && !allowedLevels.contains(level)) ||
      (goal != null && !allowedGoals.contains(goal))) {
    throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
      'invalid_placement_metadata',
    );
  }
  for (final score in value.dimensionScores.values) {
    if (!score.isFinite || score < 0 || score > 1) {
      throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
        'invalid_placement_dimension_score',
      );
    }
  }
  if (value.weakDimensions.toSet().length !=
      value.weakDimensions.length) {
    throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
      'duplicate_placement_weak_dimension',
    );
  }
  _requireUnique(
    value.reviewItemIds,
    'duplicate_placement_review_item',
  );
  return value;
}

String _strictIdentifier(
  Object? raw, {
  required String field,
}) =>
    _strictText(
      raw,
      field: field,
      maxLength: _maxIdentifierLength,
    );

String _strictText(
  Object? raw, {
  required String field,
  required int maxLength,
  bool allowEmpty = false,
}) {
  if (raw is! String) {
    throw LearnerStateDatabaseException('invalid_$field');
  }
  final value = raw.trim();
  if ((!allowEmpty && value.isEmpty) || value.length > maxLength) {
    throw LearnerStateDatabaseException('invalid_$field');
  }
  return allowEmpty ? raw : value;
}

String? _optionalBoundedText(
  Object? raw, {
  required String field,
  required int maxLength,
}) {
  if (raw == null) return null;
  if (raw is! String) {
    throw LearnerStateDatabaseException('invalid_$field');
  }
  final value = raw.trim();
  if (value.isEmpty) return null;
  if (value.length > maxLength) {
    throw LearnerStateDatabaseException('invalid_$field');
  }
  return value;
}

int _strictInt(
  Object? raw, {
  required String field,
  required int min,
  required int max,
}) {
  if (raw is! num || raw.toInt() != raw) {
    throw LearnerStateDatabaseException('invalid_$field');
  }
  final value = raw.toInt();
  if (value < min || value > max) {
    throw LearnerStateDatabaseException('invalid_$field');
  }
  return value;
}

bool _strictFlag(Object? raw, {required String field}) {
  final value = _strictInt(raw, field: field, min: 0, max: 1);
  return value == 1;
}

double _strictFiniteDouble(
  Object? raw, {
  required String field,
  required double min,
  required double max,
}) {
  if (raw is! num) {
    throw LearnerStateDatabaseException('invalid_$field');
  }
  final value = raw.toDouble();
  if (!value.isFinite || value < min || value > max) {
    throw LearnerStateDatabaseException('invalid_$field');
  }
  return value;
}

DateTime _strictDateTime(
  Object? raw, {
  required String field,
}) {
  if (raw is! String) {
    throw LearnerStateDatabaseException('invalid_$field');
  }
  final value = DateTime.tryParse(raw)?.toUtc();
  if (value == null) {
    throw LearnerStateDatabaseException('invalid_$field');
  }
  _validateUtcDateRange(value, field: field);
  return value;
}

void _validateUtcDateRange(
  DateTime value, {
  required String field,
}) {
  final utc = value.toUtc();
  final min = DateTime.utc(2000);
  final max = DateTime.now().toUtc().add(const Duration(days: 1));
  if (utc.isBefore(min) || utc.isAfter(max)) {
    throw LearnerStateDatabaseException('invalid_$field');
  }
}

String? _nullableStrictEnum(
  Object? raw, {
  required Set<String> allowed,
  required String field,
}) {
  if (raw == null) return null;
  if (raw is! String) {
    throw LearnerStateDatabaseException('invalid_$field');
  }
  final value = raw.trim();
  if (value.isEmpty) return null;
  if (!allowed.contains(value)) {
    throw LearnerStateDatabaseException('invalid_$field');
  }
  return value;
}

void _requireUnique(
  Iterable<String> values,
  String code,
) {
  final seen = <String>{};
  for (final raw in values) {
    final value = _strictIdentifier(raw, field: 'identity');
    if (!seen.add(value)) {
      throw LearnerStateDatabaseException(code);
    }
  }
}

part of 'learner_state_database.dart';

enum LearnerSqliteApplyStatus {
  applied,
  alreadyApplied,
}

final class LearnerSqliteApplyResult {
  const LearnerSqliteApplyResult._({
    required this.status,
    required this.revision,
  });

  const LearnerSqliteApplyResult.applied({required int revision})
      : this._(
          status: LearnerSqliteApplyStatus.applied,
          revision: revision,
        );

  const LearnerSqliteApplyResult.alreadyApplied({required int revision})
      : this._(
          status: LearnerSqliteApplyStatus.alreadyApplied,
          revision: revision,
        );

  final LearnerSqliteApplyStatus status;
  final int revision;

  bool get alreadyApplied =>
      status == LearnerSqliteApplyStatus.alreadyApplied;
}

final class LearnerSqliteSnapshot {
  const LearnerSqliteSnapshot({
    required this.attempts,
    required this.assessmentHistory,
    required this.placementHistory,
    required this.favoriteVerbs,
  });

  final List<Attempt> attempts;
  final List<AssessmentHistory> assessmentHistory;
  final List<PlacementDiagnosticRecord> placementHistory;
  final Set<String> favoriteVerbs;
}

final class LearnerMigrationRecord {
  const LearnerMigrationRecord({
    required this.migrationId,
    required this.migrationVersion,
    required this.sourceStorageKey,
    required this.sourcePayloadSha256,
    required this.sourceLegacyFavoritesSha256,
    required this.importedSnapshotSha256,
    required this.attemptCount,
    required this.assessmentCount,
    required this.placementCount,
    required this.favoriteCount,
    required this.completedAtUtc,
    required this.cutoverRevision,
  });

  final String migrationId;
  final int migrationVersion;
  final String sourceStorageKey;
  final String sourcePayloadSha256;
  final String sourceLegacyFavoritesSha256;
  final String importedSnapshotSha256;
  final int attemptCount;
  final int assessmentCount;
  final int placementCount;
  final int favoriteCount;
  final DateTime completedAtUtc;
  final int cutoverRevision;

  Map<String, Object?> toRow() => <String, Object?>{
        'migration_id': migrationId,
        'migration_version': migrationVersion,
        'status': 'verified',
        'source_storage_key': sourceStorageKey,
        'source_payload_sha256': sourcePayloadSha256,
        'source_legacy_favorites_sha256':
            sourceLegacyFavoritesSha256,
        'imported_snapshot_sha256': importedSnapshotSha256,
        'attempt_count': attemptCount,
        'assessment_count': assessmentCount,
        'placement_count': placementCount,
        'favorite_count': favoriteCount,
        'completed_at_utc': completedAtUtc.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
        'cutover_revision': cutoverRevision,
      };

  factory LearnerMigrationRecord.fromRow(Map<String, Object?> row) {
    final status = row['status']?.toString();
    if (status != 'verified') {
      throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
        'invalid_migration_status',
      );
    }
    final completed =
        DateTime.tryParse(row['completed_at_utc']?.toString() ?? '')?.toUtc();
    if (completed == null) {
      throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
        'invalid_migration_completed_at',
      );
    }

    String hash(String field) {
      final value = row[field]?.toString().trim().toLowerCase() ?? '';
      if (!RegExp(r'^[a-f0-9]{64}$').hasMatch(value)) {
        throw LearnerStateDatabaseException('invalid_$field');
      }
      return value;
    }

    int integer(String field, {int max = 1 << 30}) {
      final raw = row[field];
      if (raw is! num || raw.toInt() != raw) {
        throw LearnerStateDatabaseException('invalid_$field');
      }
      final value = raw.toInt();
      if (value < 0 || value > max) {
        throw LearnerStateDatabaseException('invalid_$field');
      }
      return value;
    }

    final id = row['migration_id']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
    final sourceKey = row['source_storage_key']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
    if (id.isEmpty ||
        id.length > LearnerStateDatabase.maxIdentifierLength ||
        sourceKey.isEmpty ||
        sourceKey.length > LearnerStateDatabase.maxIdentifierLength) {
      throw const LearnerStateDatabaseException(
        'invalid_migration_identity',
      );
    }

    return LearnerMigrationRecord(
      migrationId: id,
      migrationVersion: integer('migration_version', max: 1000),
      sourceStorageKey: sourceKey,
      sourcePayloadSha256: hash('source_payload_sha256'),
      sourceLegacyFavoritesSha256:
          hash('source_legacy_favorites_sha256'),
      importedSnapshotSha256: hash('imported_snapshot_sha256'),
      attemptCount: integer(
        'attempt_count',
        max: LearnerStateDatabase.maxAttempts,
      ),
      assessmentCount: integer(
        'assessment_count',
        max: LearnerStateDatabase.maxAssessments,
      ),
      placementCount: integer(
        'placement_count',
        max: LearnerStateDatabase.maxPlacements,
      ),
      favoriteCount: integer(
        'favorite_count',
        max: LearnerStateDatabase.maxFavorites,
      ),
      completedAtUtc: completed,
      cutoverRevision: integer('cutover_revision', max: 1 << 30),
    );
  }
}

final class LearnerStateDatabaseException implements Exception {
  const LearnerStateDatabaseException(this.code);

  final String code;

  @override
  String toString() => 'LearnerStateDatabaseException($code)';
}

import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:path/path.dart' as p;

import '../packs/pack_models.dart';

final class FileSystemModularPackStorage implements LocalPackCatalog {
  FileSystemModularPackStorage({
    required this.rootDirectory,
  });

  static const int maxTextBytes = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
  static const int maxBinaryBytes = 64 * 1024 * 1024;

  final Directory rootDirectory;

  Directory get packsDirectory =>
      Directory(p.join(rootDirectory.path, 'packs'));

  Directory get stagingDirectory =>
      Directory(p.join(rootDirectory.path, '.staging'));

  Future<void> initialize() async {
    await packsDirectory.create(recursive: true);
    await stagingDirectory.create(recursive: true);
  }

  Future<Directory> prepareStaging(PackPairRequest request) async {
    final pairKey = request.pairKey;
    await initialize();
    final stamp = DateTime.now().toUtc().microsecondsSinceEpoch;
    final directory = Directory(
      p.join(
        stagingDirectory.path,
        '${request.storageKey}_$stamp',
      ),
    );
    await directory.create(recursive: true);
    await File(p.join(directory.path, '.pair'))
        .writeAsString(pairKey, flush: true);
    return directory;
  }

  Future<void> commitStaged(
    PackPairRequest request,
    Directory staging,
  ) async {
    final pairKey = request.pairKey;
    await initialize();

    final stagingRoot = p.normalize(stagingDirectory.absolute.path);
    final candidate = p.normalize(staging.absolute.path);
    if (!p.isWithin(stagingRoot, candidate)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        staging.path,
        'staging',
        'must be created under the storage staging root',
      );
    }

    final pairMarker = File(p.join(staging.path, '.pair'));
    if (!await pairMarker.exists()) {
      throw StateError('pack_staging_pair_marker_missing');
    }
    final stagedPair = (await pairMarker.readAsString()).trim();
    if (stagedPair != pairKey) {
      throw StateError('pack_staging_pair_mismatch');
    }

    final jsonContent =
        File(p.join(staging.path, 'content', 'pack.json'));
    final sqliteContent =
        File(p.join(staging.path, 'content', 'content.sqlite'));
    final hasJson = await jsonContent.exists();
    final hasSqlite = await sqliteContent.exists();
    if (!hasJson && !hasSqlite) {
      throw StateError('pack_content_missing');
    }

    final destination = _packDirectory(request);
    if (await destination.exists()) {
      throw StateError('pack_already_installed');
    }

    await File(p.join(staging.path, '.ready'))
        .writeAsString(pairKey, flush: true);
    await staging.rename(destination.path);
  }

  @override
  Future<LocalPackHandle?> find(PackPairRequest request) async {
    final pairKey = request.pairKey;
    final directory = _packDirectory(request);
    if (!await directory.exists()) return null;

    final ready = File(p.join(directory.path, '.ready'));
    if (!await ready.exists()) return null;
    final readyPair = (await ready.readAsString()).trim();
    if (readyPair != pairKey) return null;

    final jsonContent =
        File(p.join(directory.path, 'content', 'pack.json'));
    final sqliteContent =
        File(p.join(directory.path, 'content', 'content.sqlite'));
    final hasJson = await jsonContent.exists();
    final hasSqlite = await sqliteContent.exists();
    if (!hasJson && !hasSqlite) return null;

    return LocalPackHandle(
      pairKey: pairKey,
      rootPath: directory.path,
      reader: _FileSystemLocalPackReader(directory),
      hasJsonContent: hasJson,
      hasSqliteContent: hasSqlite,
    );
  }

  Directory _packDirectory(PackPairRequest request) =>
      Directory(p.join(packsDirectory.path, request.storageKey));
}

final class _FileSystemLocalPackReader implements LocalPackReader {
  const _FileSystemLocalPackReader(this.root);

  final Directory root;

  @override
  Future<String> readText(String relativePath) async {
    final file = _resolveFile(relativePath);
    final length = await file.length();
    if (length > FileSystemModularPackStorage.maxTextBytes) {
      throw StateError('pack_text_payload_too_large');
    }
    final bytes = await file.readAsBytes();
    try {
      return utf8.decode(bytes);
    } on FormatException {
      throw StateError('pack_text_payload_not_utf8');
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<List<int>> readBytes(String relativePath) async {
    final file = _resolveFile(relativePath);
    final length = await file.length();
    if (length > FileSystemModularPackStorage.maxBinaryBytes) {
      throw StateError('pack_binary_payload_too_large');
    }
    return List<int>.unmodifiable(await file.readAsBytes());
  }

  @override
  Future<List<String>> listAssets() async {
    final assets = Directory(p.join(root.path, 'assets'));
    if (!await assets.exists()) {
      return const <String>[];
    }

    final rootPath = p.normalize(root.absolute.path);
    final result = <String>[];
    await for (final entity in assets.list(
      recursive: true,
      followLinks: false,
    )) {
      if (entity is! File) continue;
      final absolute = p.normalize(entity.absolute.path);
      if (!p.isWithin(rootPath, absolute)) continue;
      result.add(
        p.posix.normalize(
          p.relative(absolute, from: rootPath).replaceAll('\\', '/'),
        ),
      );
    }
    result.sort();
    return List<String>.unmodifiable(result);
  }

  File _resolveFile(String relativePath) {
    final safe = _safeRelativePath(relativePath);
    final rootPath = p.normalize(root.absolute.path);
    final resolved = p.normalize(p.join(rootPath, safe));
    if (!p.isWithin(rootPath, resolved)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        relativePath,
        'relativePath',
        'must stay inside the pack root',
      );
    }
    final file = File(resolved);
    if (!file.existsSync()) {
      throw StateError('pack_file_missing');
    }
    return file;
  }

  static String _safeRelativePath(String rawPath) {
    final normalized =
        p.posix.normalize(rawPath.trim().replaceAll('\\', '/'));
    if (normalized.isEmpty ||
        normalized == '.' ||
        normalized == '..' ||
        normalized.startsWith('../') ||
        p.posix.isAbsolute(normalized) ||
        normalized.length > 240) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        rawPath,
        'relativePath',
        'must be a safe relative pack path',
      );
    }
    return p.joinAll(p.posix.split(normalized));
  }
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';

import '../agents/memory_models.dart';

enum TaskMasteryStatus {
  notStarted,
  learning,
  mastered,
}

final class OfflineTaskProgress {
  const OfflineTaskProgress({
    required this.taskId,
    required this.points,
    required this.bestScore,
    required this.completed,
    required this.mastery,
    required this.updatedAtEpochMs,
    this.sourceLanguageId,
    this.targetLanguageId,
  });

  final String taskId;
  final int points;
  final double bestScore;
  final bool completed;
  final TaskMasteryStatus mastery;
  final int updatedAtEpochMs;
  final String? sourceLanguageId;
  final String? targetLanguageId;

  Map<String, Object?> toJson() => <String, Object?>{
        'taskId': taskId,
        if (sourceLanguageId != null)
          'source_language_id': sourceLanguageId,
        if (targetLanguageId != null)
          'target_language_id': targetLanguageId,
        'points': points,
        'bestScore': bestScore,
        'completed': completed,
        'mastery': mastery.name,
        'updatedAtEpochMs': updatedAtEpochMs,
      };

  static OfflineTaskProgress? fromJson(Object? raw) {
    if (raw is! Map) return null;
    final taskId = raw['taskId'] ?? raw['task_id'];
    if (taskId is! String || !_validTaskId(taskId)) return null;

    final points = _asInt(raw['points']).clamp(0, 1000000000).toInt();
    final score =
        _asDouble(raw['bestScore']).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
    final completed = raw['completed'] == true;
    final mastery = completed
        ? TaskMasteryStatus.mastered
        : (points > 0 || score > 0)
            ? TaskMasteryStatus.learning
            : TaskMasteryStatus.notStarted;

    return OfflineTaskProgress(
      taskId: taskId.trim(),
      points: points,
      bestScore: score,
      completed: completed,
      mastery: mastery,
      updatedAtEpochMs:
          _asInt(raw['updatedAtEpochMs']).clamp(0, 4102444800000).toInt(),
      sourceLanguageId: _optionalLanguage(raw['source_language_id']),
      targetLanguageId: _optionalLanguage(raw['target_language_id']),
    );
  }

  OfflineTaskProgress withPair(
    String sourceLanguageId,
    String targetLanguageId,
  ) =>
      OfflineTaskProgress(
        taskId: taskId,
        points: points,
        bestScore: bestScore,
        completed: completed,
        mastery: mastery,
        updatedAtEpochMs: updatedAtEpochMs,
        sourceLanguageId: _language(sourceLanguageId),
        targetLanguageId: _language(targetLanguageId),
      );
}

final class _ScopedTaskProgress {
  _ScopedTaskProgress({
    required this.sourceLanguageId,
    required this.targetLanguageId,
    required OfflineTaskProgress progress,
  }) : progress = progress.withPair(
          sourceLanguageId,
          targetLanguageId,
        );

  final String sourceLanguageId;
  final String targetLanguageId;
  final OfflineTaskProgress progress;

  String get recordKey => _progressRecordKey(
        sourceLanguageId,
        targetLanguageId,
        progress.taskId,
      );

  Map<String, Object?> toJson() => <String, Object?>{
        'source_language_id': sourceLanguageId,
        'target_language_id': targetLanguageId,
        'task_id': progress.taskId,
        'points': progress.points,
        'bestScore': progress.bestScore,
        'completed': progress.completed,
        'mastery': progress.mastery.name,
        'updatedAtEpochMs': progress.updatedAtEpochMs,
      };
}

final class OfflineProgressSnapshot {
  OfflineProgressSnapshot._({
    required this.sourceLanguageTag,
    required this.targetLanguageTag,
    required Map<String, _ScopedTaskProgress> records,
    required this.updatedAtEpochMs,
  }) : _records = Map<String, _ScopedTaskProgress>.unmodifiable(records);

  factory OfflineProgressSnapshot.empty() => OfflineProgressSnapshot._(
        sourceLanguageTag: null,
        targetLanguageTag: null,
        records: const <String, _ScopedTaskProgress>{},
        updatedAtEpochMs: 0,
      );

  static const int schemaVersion = 2;
  static const int legacySchemaVersion = 1;
  static const int maxTasks = 50;
  static const String legacyDefaultSourceLanguageId = 'ar';
  static const String legacyDefaultTargetLanguageId = 'de';

  final String? sourceLanguageTag;
  final String? targetLanguageTag;
  final Map<String, _ScopedTaskProgress> _records;
  final int updatedAtEpochMs;

  bool get hasAnyProgress => _records.isNotEmpty;

  Map<String, OfflineTaskProgress> get tasks {
    final source = sourceLanguageTag;
    final target = targetLanguageTag;
    if (source == null || target == null) {
      return const <String, OfflineTaskProgress>{};
    }
    return tasksForPair(source, target);
  }

  String? get activePair {
    final source = sourceLanguageTag;
    final target = targetLanguageTag;
    if (source == null || target == null) return null;
    return '$source->$target';
  }

  int get completedTasks =>
      tasks.values.where((task) => task.completed).length;

  int get masteredTasks =>
      tasks.values
          .where((task) => task.mastery == TaskMasteryStatus.mastered)
          .length;

  int get totalPoints => tasks.values.fold<int>(
        0,
        (sum, task) => sum + task.points,
      );

  Map<String, OfflineTaskProgress> tasksForPair(
    String sourceLanguageId,
    String targetLanguageId,
  ) {
    final source = _language(sourceLanguageId);
    final target = _language(targetLanguageId);
    if (!_validDirectedPair(source, target)) {
      throw ArgumentError('Invalid directed language pair.');
    }

    final pairKey = _progressPairKey(source, target);
    final result = <String, OfflineTaskProgress>{};
    for (final record in _records.values) {
      if (_progressPairKey(
            record.sourceLanguageId,
            record.targetLanguageId,
          ) !=
          pairKey) {
        continue;
      }
      result[record.progress.taskId] = record.progress;
    }
    return Map<String, OfflineTaskProgress>.unmodifiable(result);
  }

  OfflineProgressSnapshot withActivePair({
    required String sourceLanguageTag,
    required String targetLanguageTag,
    required int occurredAtEpochMs,
  }) {
    final source = _language(sourceLanguageTag);
    final target = _language(targetLanguageTag);
    if (!_validDirectedPair(source, target)) {
      throw ArgumentError('Invalid directed language pair.');
    }
    return OfflineProgressSnapshot._(
      sourceLanguageTag: source,
      targetLanguageTag: target,
      records: _records,
      updatedAtEpochMs:
          _maxTimestamp(updatedAtEpochMs, occurredAtEpochMs),
    );
  }

  OfflineProgressSnapshot recordTask({
    required String taskId,
    required int pointsDelta,
    required double score,
    required bool completed,
    required int occurredAtEpochMs,
  }) {
    final normalizedId = taskId.trim();
    if (!_validTaskId(normalizedId)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        taskId,
        'taskId',
        'must be 1..160 characters',
      );
    }

    final source = sourceLanguageTag ?? legacyDefaultSourceLanguageId;
    final target = targetLanguageTag ?? legacyDefaultTargetLanguageId;
    if (!_validDirectedPair(source, target)) {
      throw StateError('Offline progress requires a valid directed pair.');
    }

    final pairTasks = tasksForPair(source, target);
    if (!pairTasks.containsKey(normalizedId) &&
        pairTasks.length >= maxTasks) {
      throw StateError(
        'Offline progress is limited to 50 canonical tasks per pair.',
      );
    }

    final key = _progressRecordKey(source, target, normalizedId);
    final current = _records[key]?.progress ??
        OfflineTaskProgress(
          taskId: normalizedId,
          points: 0,
          bestScore: 0,
          completed: false,
          mastery: TaskMasteryStatus.notStarted,
          updatedAtEpochMs: 0,
        );

    final nextScore = score.clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
    final bestScore =
        nextScore > current.bestScore ? nextScore : current.bestScore;
    final isCompleted = current.completed || completed;
    final points = (current.points + pointsDelta)
        .clamp(0, 1000000000)
        .toInt();
    final mastery = isCompleted
        ? TaskMasteryStatus.mastered
        : (points > 0 || bestScore > 0)
            ? TaskMasteryStatus.learning
            : TaskMasteryStatus.notStarted;

    final nextRecords = <String, _ScopedTaskProgress>{..._records};
    final progress = OfflineTaskProgress(
      taskId: normalizedId,
      points: points,
      bestScore: bestScore,
      completed: isCompleted,
      mastery: mastery,
      updatedAtEpochMs:
          _maxTimestamp(current.updatedAtEpochMs, occurredAtEpochMs),
    );
    final scoped = _ScopedTaskProgress(
      sourceLanguageId: source,
      targetLanguageId: target,
      progress: progress,
    );
    nextRecords[scoped.recordKey] = scoped;

    return OfflineProgressSnapshot._(
      sourceLanguageTag: sourceLanguageTag ?? source,
      targetLanguageTag: targetLanguageTag ?? target,
      records: nextRecords,
      updatedAtEpochMs:
          _maxTimestamp(updatedAtEpochMs, occurredAtEpochMs),
    );
  }

  String encode() {
    final rows = _records.values.toList(growable: false)
      ..sort((left, right) => left.recordKey.compareTo(right.recordKey));
    return jsonEncode(
      <String, Object?>{
        'schemaVersion': schemaVersion,
        'sourceLanguageTag': sourceLanguageTag,
        'targetLanguageTag': targetLanguageTag,
        'updatedAtEpochMs': updatedAtEpochMs,
        'rows': rows.map((record) => record.toJson()).toList(growable: false),
        'tasks': tasks.values.map((task) => task.toJson()).toList(
              growable: false,
            ),
      },
    );
  }

  static bool requiresMigration(String? encoded) {
    if (encoded == null || encoded.trim().isEmpty) return false;
    try {
      final decoded = jsonDecode(encoded);
      return decoded is Map &&
          _asInt(decoded['schemaVersion']) == legacySchemaVersion;
    } on Object {
      return false;
    }
  }

  static OfflineProgressSnapshot decode(String? encoded) {
    if (encoded == null || encoded.trim().isEmpty) {
      return OfflineProgressSnapshot.empty();
    }

    try {
      final decoded = jsonDecode(encoded);
      if (decoded is! Map) return OfflineProgressSnapshot.empty();
      final version = _asInt(decoded['schemaVersion']);
      if (version == legacySchemaVersion) {
        return _decodeLegacy(decoded);
      }
      if (version != schemaVersion) {
        return OfflineProgressSnapshot.empty();
      }
      return _decodePairScoped(decoded);
    } on Object {
      return OfflineProgressSnapshot.empty();
    }
  }

  static OfflineProgressSnapshot _decodeLegacy(Map<dynamic, dynamic> decoded) {
    final source = _optionalLanguage(decoded['sourceLanguageTag']) ??
        legacyDefaultSourceLanguageId;
    final targetCandidate =
        _optionalLanguage(decoded['targetLanguageTag']) ??
            legacyDefaultTargetLanguageId;
    final target = _sameLanguage(source, targetCandidate)
        ? (_sameLanguage(source, legacyDefaultTargetLanguageId)
            ? legacyDefaultSourceLanguageId
            : legacyDefaultTargetLanguageId)
        : targetCandidate;
    final records = <String, _ScopedTaskProgress>{};
    final rawTasks = decoded['tasks'];
    if (rawTasks is List) {
      for (final raw in rawTasks.take(maxTasks)) {
        final progress = OfflineTaskProgress.fromJson(raw);
        if (progress == null) continue;
        final scoped = _ScopedTaskProgress(
          sourceLanguageId: source,
          targetLanguageId: target,
          progress: progress,
        );
        records[scoped.recordKey] = scoped;
      }
    }

    return OfflineProgressSnapshot._(
      sourceLanguageTag: source,
      targetLanguageTag: target,
      records: records,
      updatedAtEpochMs:
          _asInt(decoded['updatedAtEpochMs'])
              .clamp(0, 4102444800000)
              .toInt(),
    );
  }

  static OfflineProgressSnapshot _decodePairScoped(
    Map<dynamic, dynamic> decoded,
  ) {
    final source = _optionalLanguage(decoded['sourceLanguageTag']);
    final target = _optionalLanguage(decoded['targetLanguageTag']);
    final records = <String, _ScopedTaskProgress>{};

    final rawRows = decoded['rows'];
    if (rawRows is List) {
      for (final raw in rawRows) {
        if (raw is! Map) continue;
        final rowSource = _optionalLanguage(raw['source_language_id']);
        final rowTarget = _optionalLanguage(raw['target_language_id']);
        final progress = OfflineTaskProgress.fromJson(raw);
        if (rowSource == null ||
            rowTarget == null ||
            !_validDirectedPair(rowSource, rowTarget) ||
            progress == null) {
          continue;
        }
        final scoped = _ScopedTaskProgress(
          sourceLanguageId: rowSource,
          targetLanguageId: rowTarget,
          progress: progress,
        );
        records[scoped.recordKey] = scoped;
      }
    }

    if (records.isEmpty) {
      final rawTasks = decoded['tasks'];
      if (rawTasks is List) {
        final fallbackSource =
            source ?? legacyDefaultSourceLanguageId;
        final fallbackTargetCandidate =
            target ?? legacyDefaultTargetLanguageId;
        final fallbackTarget =
            _sameLanguage(fallbackSource, fallbackTargetCandidate)
                ? (_sameLanguage(
                    fallbackSource,
                    legacyDefaultTargetLanguageId,
                  )
                    ? legacyDefaultSourceLanguageId
                    : legacyDefaultTargetLanguageId)
                : fallbackTargetCandidate;

        for (final raw in rawTasks.take(maxTasks)) {
          final progress = OfflineTaskProgress.fromJson(raw);
          if (progress == null) continue;
          final rowSource =
              progress.sourceLanguageId ?? fallbackSource;
          final rowTarget =
              progress.targetLanguageId ?? fallbackTarget;
          if (!_validDirectedPair(rowSource, rowTarget)) continue;
          final scoped = _ScopedTaskProgress(
            sourceLanguageId: rowSource,
            targetLanguageId: rowTarget,
            progress: progress,
          );
          records[scoped.recordKey] = scoped;
        }
      }
    }

    final activeSource =
        source ?? (records.isEmpty ? null : records.values.first.sourceLanguageId);
    final activeTarget =
        target ?? (records.isEmpty ? null : records.values.first.targetLanguageId);

    return OfflineProgressSnapshot._(
      sourceLanguageTag: activeSource,
      targetLanguageTag: activeTarget,
      records: records,
      updatedAtEpochMs:
          _asInt(decoded['updatedAtEpochMs'])
              .clamp(0, 4102444800000)
              .toInt(),
    );
  }
}

final class OfflineProgressService {
  OfflineProgressService._({
    required MemoryAgentStore store,
    required OfflineProgressSnapshot initial,
  })  : _store = store,
        _snapshot = initial;

  final MemoryAgentStore _store;
  final StreamController<OfflineProgressSnapshot> _changes =
      StreamController<OfflineProgressSnapshot>.broadcast();

  OfflineProgressSnapshot _snapshot;
  Future<void> _writeQueue = Future<void>.value();
  bool _closed = false;

  static Future<OfflineProgressService> open(
    MemoryAgentStore store,
  ) async {
    String? encoded;
    try {
      encoded = await store.read();
    } on Object {
      encoded = null;
    }
    final initial = OfflineProgressSnapshot.decode(encoded);
    if (OfflineProgressSnapshot.requiresMigration(encoded)) {
      try {
        await store.write(initial.encode());
      } on Object {
        // Migration remains fail-safe: the original payload is still intact
        // in the physical store and will be retried on the next successful write.
      }
    }
    return OfflineProgressService._(
      store: store,
      initial: initial,
    );
  }

  OfflineProgressSnapshot get snapshot => _snapshot;

  Stream<OfflineProgressSnapshot> get changes => _changes.stream;

  Future<void> setActivePair({
    required String sourceLanguageTag,
    required String targetLanguageTag,
    int? occurredAtEpochMs,
  }) {
    _ensureOpen();
    final source = _language(sourceLanguageTag);
    final target = _language(targetLanguageTag);
    if (!_validDirectedPair(source, target)) {
      return Future<void>.error(
        ArgumentError('Invalid source or target directed language pair.'),
      );
    }

    if (_sameLanguage(_snapshot.sourceLanguageTag, source) &&
        _sameLanguage(_snapshot.targetLanguageTag, target)) {
      return Future<void>.value();
    }

    _snapshot = _snapshot.withActivePair(
      sourceLanguageTag: source,
      targetLanguageTag: target,
      occurredAtEpochMs:
          occurredAtEpochMs ?? DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch,
    );
    return _persistAndEmit();
  }

  Future<void> recordTaskProgress({
    required String taskId,
    required int pointsDelta,
    required double score,
    required bool completed,
    int? occurredAtEpochMs,
  }) {
    _ensureOpen();
    _snapshot = _snapshot.recordTask(
      taskId: taskId,
      pointsDelta: pointsDelta,
      score: score,
      completed: completed,
      occurredAtEpochMs:
          occurredAtEpochMs ?? DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch,
    );
    return _persistAndEmit();
  }

  Future<void> hydrateFromMemory(MemoryAgentSnapshot memory) {
    _ensureOpen();
    if (_snapshot.hasAnyProgress || memory.tasks.isEmpty) {
      return Future<void>.value();
    }

    var next = _snapshot;
    for (final record in memory.tasks.values.take(
      OfflineProgressSnapshot.maxTasks,
    )) {
      next = next.recordTask(
        taskId: record.taskId,
        pointsDelta: _legacyPoints(record),
        score: record.bestScore,
        completed: record.completed,
        occurredAtEpochMs: memory.updatedAtEpochMs,
      );
    }
    _snapshot = next;
    return _persistAndEmit();
  }

  Future<void> flush() => _writeQueue;

  Future<void> close() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    _closed = true;
    await flush().catchError((_) {});
    await _changes.close();
  }

  Future<void> _persistAndEmit() {
    final encoded = _snapshot.encode();
    final emitted = _snapshot;
    _writeQueue = _writeQueue
        .catchError((_) {})
        .then<void>((_) => _store.write(encoded))
        .then<void>((_) {
      if (!_closed && !_changes.isClosed) {
        _changes.add(emitted);
      }
    });
    return _writeQueue;
  }

  void _ensureOpen() {
    if (_closed) {
      throw StateError('OfflineProgressService is closed.');
    }
  }
}

String _language(String value) =>
    value.trim().replaceAll('_', '-');

String? _optionalLanguage(Object? value) {
  if (value is! String) return null;
  final normalized = _language(value);
  return _validLanguage(normalized) ? normalized : null;
}

bool _validLanguage(String value) =>
    RegExp(r'^[A-Za-z]{2,8}(?:-[A-Za-z0-9]{1,8})*$').hasMatch(value);

bool _validDirectedPair(String source, String target) =>
    _validLanguage(source) &&
    _validLanguage(target) &&
    !_sameLanguage(source, target);

bool _sameLanguage(String? left, String? right) {
  if (left == null || right == null) return left == right;
  return left.toLowerCase() == right.toLowerCase();
}

bool _validTaskId(String value) =>
    value.trim().isNotEmpty && value.trim().length <= 160;

String _progressPairKey(String source, String target) =>
    '${_language(source).toLowerCase()}\u0000'
    '${_language(target).toLowerCase()}';

String _progressRecordKey(
  String source,
  String target,
  String taskId,
) =>
    '${_progressPairKey(source, target)}\u0000${taskId.trim()}';

int _legacyPoints(TaskMemoryRecord record) {
  final scorePoints = (record.bestScore * 100).round();
  final completionBonus = record.completed ? 25 : 0;
  return (scorePoints + completionBonus).clamp(0, 125).toInt();
}

int _asInt(Object? value) => value is num ? value.toInt() : 0;

double _asDouble(Object? value) => value is num ? value.toDouble() : 0;

int _maxTimestamp(int current, int candidate) =>
    candidate > current ? candidate : current;

FILE: lib/core/storage/runtime_local_state_container.dart

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';

import '../agents/memory_models.dart';

final class RuntimeLocalStateContainer {
  RuntimeLocalStateContainer._({
    required MemoryAgentStore physicalStore,
    required Map<String, String> namespaces,
  })  : _physicalStore = physicalStore,
        _namespaces = namespaces;

  static const int schemaVersion = 1;
  static const int maxNamespaces = 16;
  static const int maxNamespaceBytes = 1024 * 1024;

  final MemoryAgentStore _physicalStore;
  final Map<String, String> _namespaces;

  Future<void> _writeQueue = Future<void>.value();
  bool _closed = false;

  static Future<RuntimeLocalStateContainer> open(
    MemoryAgentStore physicalStore,
  ) async {
    String? encoded;
    try {
      encoded = await physicalStore.read();
    } on Object {
      encoded = null;
    }

    return RuntimeLocalStateContainer._(
      physicalStore: physicalStore,
      namespaces: _decodeNamespaces(encoded),
    );
  }

  MemoryAgentStore namespace(String rawName) {
    _ensureOpen();
    final name = _validateNamespace(rawName);
    if (!_namespaces.containsKey(name) &&
        _namespaces.length >= maxNamespaces) {
      throw StateError(
        'Runtime local state namespace limit exceeded.',
      );
    }
    return _NamespacedStore(this, name);
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    _closed = true;
    await _writeQueue.catchError((_) {});
  }

  Future<String?> _read(String name) async {
    _ensureOpen();
    return _namespaces[name];
  }

  Future<void> _write(String name, String encoded) {
    _ensureOpen();
    final bytes = utf8.encode(encoded);
    if (bytes.length > maxNamespaceBytes) {
      return Future<void>.error(
        ArgumentError.value(
          bytes.length,
          'encoded.length',
          'namespace payload exceeds $maxNamespaceBytes bytes',
        ),
      );
    }

    _namespaces[name] = encoded;
    _writeQueue = _writeQueue
        .catchError((_) {})
        .then<void>((_) => _physicalStore.write(_encodeContainer()));
    return _writeQueue;
  }

  String _encodeContainer() {
    final orderedKeys = _namespaces.keys.toList(growable: false)..sort();
    return jsonEncode(
      <String, Object?>{
        'containerSchemaVersion': schemaVersion,
        'namespaces': <String, String>{
          for (final key in orderedKeys) key: _namespaces[key]!,
        },
      },
    );
  }

  void _ensureOpen() {
    if (_closed) {
      throw StateError('RuntimeLocalStateContainer is closed.');
    }
  }

  static Map<String, String> _decodeNamespaces(String? encoded) {
    if (encoded == null || encoded.trim().isEmpty) {
      return <String, String>{};
    }

    try {
      final decoded = jsonDecode(encoded);
      if (decoded is! Map) return <String, String>{};

      if (decoded['containerSchemaVersion'] == schemaVersion) {
        final rawNamespaces = decoded['namespaces'];
        if (rawNamespaces is! Map) return <String, String>{};

        final restored = <String, String>{};
        for (final entry in rawNamespaces.entries) {
          if (restored.length >= maxNamespaces) break;
          final key = entry.key;
          final value = entry.value;
          if (key is! String || value is! String) continue;
          final normalized = _tryNamespace(key);
          if (normalized == null) continue;
          if (utf8.encode(value).length > maxNamespaceBytes) continue;
          restored[normalized] = value;
        }
        return restored;
      }

      final looksLikeLegacyMemory =
          decoded['schemaVersion'] is num &&
          decoded['tasks'] is List &&
          decoded['weaknesses'] is List;
      if (looksLikeLegacyMemory) {
        return <String, String>{'memory': encoded};
      }
    } on Object {
      return <String, String>{};
    }

    return <String, String>{};
  }

  static String _validateNamespace(String value) {
    final normalized = _tryNamespace(value);
    if (normalized == null) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        value,
        'namespace',
        'must match [a-z0-9._-] and be 1..64 characters',
      );
    }
    return normalized;
  }

  static String? _tryNamespace(String value) {
    final normalized = value.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (normalized.isEmpty || normalized.length > 64) return null;
    if (!RegExp(r'^[a-z0-9._-]+$').hasMatch(normalized)) return null;
    return normalized;
  }
}

final class _NamespacedStore implements MemoryAgentStore {
  const _NamespacedStore(this._container, this._name);

  final RuntimeLocalStateContainer _container;
  final String _name;

  @override
  Future<String?> read() => _container._read(_name);

  @override
  Future<void> write(String encoded) =>
      _container._write(_name, encoded);
}

import 'dart:convert';

import '../agents/memory_models.dart';

final class ValidationCacheResult {
  const ValidationCacheResult({
    required this.cacheHit,
    required this.validated,
    required this.contentHash,
  });

  final bool cacheHit;
  final bool validated;
  final String contentHash;
}

final class ValidationCacheEntry {
  const ValidationCacheEntry({
    required this.scopeKey,
    required this.contentHash,
    required this.validatorVersion,
    required this.validatedAtEpochMs,
  });

  final String scopeKey;
  final String contentHash;
  final String validatorVersion;
  final int validatedAtEpochMs;

  Map<String, Object?> toJson() => <String, Object?>{
        'scopeKey': scopeKey,
        'contentHash': contentHash,
        'validatorVersion': validatorVersion,
        'validatedAtEpochMs': validatedAtEpochMs,
      };

  static ValidationCacheEntry? fromJson(Object? raw) {
    if (raw is! Map) return null;
    final scopeKey = raw['scopeKey'];
    final contentHash = raw['contentHash'];
    final validatorVersion = raw['validatorVersion'];
    if (scopeKey is! String ||
        !_validToken(scopeKey, 240) ||
        contentHash is! String ||
        !RegExp(r'^[0-9a-f]{32}$').hasMatch(contentHash) ||
        validatorVersion is! String ||
        !_validToken(validatorVersion, 80)) {
      return null;
    }

    return ValidationCacheEntry(
      scopeKey: scopeKey.trim(),
      contentHash: contentHash,
      validatorVersion: validatorVersion.trim(),
      validatedAtEpochMs:
          _asInt(raw['validatedAtEpochMs'])
              .clamp(0, 4102444800000)
              .toInt(),
    );
  }
}

final class ValidationHashCache {
  ValidationHashCache._({
    required MemoryAgentStore store,
    required Map<String, ValidationCacheEntry> entries,
  })  : _store = store,
        _entries = entries;

  static const int schemaVersion = 1;
  static const int maxEntries = 2048;

  final MemoryAgentStore _store;
  final Map<String, ValidationCacheEntry> _entries;
  final Map<String, Future<ValidationCacheResult>> _inflight =
      <String, Future<ValidationCacheResult>>{};

  Future<void> _writeQueue = Future<void>.value();
  bool _closed = false;
  int _hits = 0;
  int _misses = 0;

  static Future<ValidationHashCache> open(
    MemoryAgentStore store,
  ) async {
    String? encoded;
    try {
      encoded = await store.read();
    } on Object {
      encoded = null;
    }

    return ValidationHashCache._(
      store: store,
      entries: _decodeEntries(encoded),
    );
  }

  int get entryCount => _entries.length;
  int get hits => _hits;
  int get misses => _misses;

  bool containsValid({
    required String scopeKey,
    required String content,
    required String validatorVersion,
  }) {
    _ensureOpen();
    final scope = _token(scopeKey, 'scopeKey', 240);
    final version = _token(
      validatorVersion,
      'validatorVersion',
      80,
    );
    final hash = ContentChecksum.compute(
      scopeKey: scope,
      content: content,
      validatorVersion: version,
    );
    final entry = _entries[scope];
    return entry != null &&
        entry.contentHash == hash &&
        entry.validatorVersion == version;
  }

  Future<ValidationCacheResult> validateOnce({
    required String scopeKey,
    required String content,
    required String validatorVersion,
    required Future<bool> Function() validator,
    int? occurredAtEpochMs,
  }) {
    _ensureOpen();
    final scope = _token(scopeKey, 'scopeKey', 240);
    final version = _token(
      validatorVersion,
      'validatorVersion',
      80,
    );
    final hash = ContentChecksum.compute(
      scopeKey: scope,
      content: content,
      validatorVersion: version,
    );
    final existing = _entries[scope];

    if (existing != null &&
        existing.contentHash == hash &&
        existing.validatorVersion == version) {
      _hits += 1;
      return Future<ValidationCacheResult>.value(
        ValidationCacheResult(
          cacheHit: true,
          validated: true,
          contentHash: hash,
        ),
      );
    }

    _misses += 1;
    final inflightKey = '$scope|$version|$hash';
    final running = _inflight[inflightKey];
    if (running != null) return running;

    final future = _runValidation(
      scope: scope,
      contentHash: hash,
      validatorVersion: version,
      validator: validator,
      occurredAtEpochMs:
          occurredAtEpochMs ?? DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch,
    );
    _inflight[inflightKey] = future;
    return future.whenComplete(() => _inflight.remove(inflightKey));
  }

  Future<void> invalidate(String scopeKey) {
    _ensureOpen();
    final scope = _token(scopeKey, 'scopeKey', 240);
    if (_entries.remove(scope) == null) {
      return Future<void>.value();
    }
    return _persist();
  }

  Future<void> flush() => _writeQueue;

  Future<void> close() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    _closed = true;
    final pending = _inflight.values.toList(growable: false);
    if (pending.isNotEmpty) {
      try {
        await Future.wait<ValidationCacheResult>(pending);
      } on Object {
        // Validation failures are contained by their callers.
      }
    }
    try {
      await flush();
    } on Object {
      // Local persistence failures must not crash shutdown.
    }
  }

  Future<ValidationCacheResult> _runValidation({
    required String scope,
    required String contentHash,
    required String validatorVersion,
    required Future<bool> Function() validator,
    required int occurredAtEpochMs,
  }) async {
    final validated = await validator();
    if (!validated || _closed) {
      return ValidationCacheResult(
        cacheHit: false,
        validated: validated,
        contentHash: contentHash,
      );
    }

    _entries[scope] = ValidationCacheEntry(
      scopeKey: scope,
      contentHash: contentHash,
      validatorVersion: validatorVersion,
      validatedAtEpochMs:
          occurredAtEpochMs.clamp(0, 4102444800000).toInt(),
    );
    _trim();
    await _persist();

    return ValidationCacheResult(
      cacheHit: false,
      validated: true,
      contentHash: contentHash,
    );
  }

  Future<void> _persist() {
    final encoded = _encode();
    _writeQueue = _writeQueue
        .catchError((_) {})
        .then<void>((_) => _store.write(encoded));
    return _writeQueue;
  }

  String _encode() {
    final ordered = _entries.values.toList(growable: false)
      ..sort((a, b) => a.scopeKey.compareTo(b.scopeKey));
    return jsonEncode(
      <String, Object?>{
        'schemaVersion': schemaVersion,
        'entries': ordered.map((entry) => entry.toJson()).toList(),
      },
    );
  }

  void _trim() {
    if (_entries.length <= maxEntries) return;
    final ranked = _entries.values.toList(growable: false)
      ..sort(
        (a, b) => b.validatedAtEpochMs.compareTo(
          a.validatedAtEpochMs,
        ),
      );
    final keep = ranked.take(maxEntries).map((entry) => entry.scopeKey).toSet();
    _entries.removeWhere((key, _) => !keep.contains(key));
  }

  void _ensureOpen() {
    if (_closed) {
      throw StateError('ValidationHashCache is closed.');
    }
  }

  static Map<String, ValidationCacheEntry> _decodeEntries(
    String? encoded,
  ) {
    if (encoded == null || encoded.trim().isEmpty) {
      return <String, ValidationCacheEntry>{};
    }

    try {
      final decoded = jsonDecode(encoded);
      if (decoded is! Map ||
          _asInt(decoded['schemaVersion']) != schemaVersion) {
        return <String, ValidationCacheEntry>{};
      }

      final entries = <String, ValidationCacheEntry>{};
      final rawEntries = decoded['entries'];
      if (rawEntries is List) {
        for (final raw in rawEntries.take(maxEntries)) {
          final entry = ValidationCacheEntry.fromJson(raw);
          if (entry != null) entries[entry.scopeKey] = entry;
        }
      }
      return entries;
    } on Object {
      return <String, ValidationCacheEntry>{};
    }
  }
}

abstract final class ContentChecksum {
  static const int _mask32 = 0xffffffff;
  static const int _prime = 16777619;

  static String compute({
    required String scopeKey,
    required String content,
    required String validatorVersion,
  }) {
    final bytes = utf8.encode(
      '${validatorVersion.trim()}\u0000'
      '${scopeKey.trim()}\u0000'
      '${content.trim()}',
    );

    var first = 2166136261;
    var second = 2246822519;
    var third = 3266489917;
    var fourth = 668265263;

    for (final byte in bytes) {
      first = ((first ^ byte) * _prime) & _mask32;
      second =
          ((second ^ ((byte + 0x3d) & 0xff)) * _prime) & _mask32;
      third =
          ((third ^ ((byte + 0x7f) & 0xff)) * _prime) & _mask32;
      fourth =
          ((fourth ^ ((byte + 0xb5) & 0xff)) * _prime) & _mask32;

      second = _rotateLeft32(second, 5);
      third = _rotateLeft32(third, 11);
      fourth = _rotateLeft32(fourth, 17);
    }

    return _hex32(first) +
        _hex32(second) +
        _hex32(third) +
        _hex32(fourth);
  }

  static int _rotateLeft32(int value, int shift) =>
      ((value << shift) | (value >> (32 - shift))) & _mask32;

  static String _hex32(int value) =>
      (value & _mask32).toRadixString(16).padLeft(8, '0');
}

String _token(String value, String field, int maxLength) {
  final normalized = value.trim();
  if (!_validToken(normalized, maxLength)) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(
      value,
      field,
      'must be 1..$maxLength characters',
    );
  }
  return normalized;
}

bool _validToken(String value, int maxLength) =>
    value.trim().isNotEmpty && value.trim().length <= maxLength;

int _asInt(Object? value) => value is num ? value.toInt() : 0;

import 'dart:ui';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class AdaptiveGlassSurface extends StatelessWidget {
  const AdaptiveGlassSurface({
    super.key,
    required this.child,
    this.padding = const EdgeInsets.all(16),
    this.borderRadius = 20,
    this.blurSigma = 8,
  });

  final Widget child;
  final EdgeInsetsGeometry padding;
  final double borderRadius;
  final double blurSigma;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final scheme = theme.colorScheme;
    final highContrast =
        MediaQuery.maybeOf(context)?.highContrast ?? false;
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;

    final fillOpacity = highContrast
        ? (isDark ? 0.92 : 0.96)
        : (isDark ? 0.56 : 0.72);
    final borderOpacity = highContrast ? 1.0 : 0.72;
    final radius = BorderRadius.circular(borderRadius);
    final content = DecoratedBox(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: scheme.surfaceContainerHighest.withValues(
          alpha: fillOpacity,
        ),
        borderRadius: radius,
        border: Border.all(
          color: scheme.outlineVariant.withValues(
            alpha: borderOpacity,
          ),
        ),
      ),
      child: Padding(
        padding: padding,
        child: child,
      ),
    );

    final clipped = highContrast || blurSigma <= 0
        ? ClipRRect(
            borderRadius: radius,
            child: content,
          )
        : ClipRRect(
            borderRadius: radius,
            child: BackdropFilter(
              filter: ImageFilter.blur(
                sigmaX: blurSigma,
                sigmaY: blurSigma,
              ),
              child: content,
            ),
          );

    return RepaintBoundary(child: clipped);
  }
}

abstract final class Phase19AdaptiveTheme {

      dividerColor: scheme.outlineVariant,

          alpha: brightness == Brightness.dark ? 0.52 : 0.72,
        ),
        border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
      ),
    );
  }
}

    required this.palette,
    required this.pulsePeriod,
    required this.feedbackDuration,
    required this.shakeDuration,
    required this.glassBlurSigma,
    required this.reduceMotion,
  });

  final Duration pulsePeriod;
  final Duration feedbackDuration;
  final Duration shakeDuration;
  final double glassBlurSigma;

    final scheme = theme.colorScheme;
    final media = MediaQuery.maybeOf(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final highContrast = media?.highContrast ?? false;
    final reduceMotion = media?.disableAnimations ?? false;

    final core = _blend(
      isDark
          ? const Color(0xFF72E7FF)
          : const Color(0xFF1687B8),
      scheme.primary,
      0.42,
    );
    final success = _blend(
      isDark
          ? const Color(0xFF5DE08D)
          : const Color(0xFF168A50),
      scheme.primary,
      0.16,
    );
    final guidance = _blend(
      isDark
          ? const Color(0xFF77A8FF)
          : const Color(0xFF2F6FD4),
      scheme.secondary,
      0.18,
    );
    final incorrect = _blend(
      isDark
          ? const Color(0xFFFFB45E)
          : const Color(0xFFD96B16),
      scheme.tertiary,
      0.16,
    );

    return SmartOrbThemeTokens(
      palette: SmartOrbPalette(
        core: core,
        success: success,
        guidance: guidance,
        incorrect: incorrect,
        glassHighlight: scheme.surface,
        outline: highContrast
            ? scheme.onSurface
            : scheme.outlineVariant,
      ),
      pulsePeriod: const Duration(milliseconds: 1120),
      feedbackDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 720),
      shakeDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 460),
      glassBlurSigma: highContrast ? 0 : 8,
      reduceMotion: reduceMotion,
    );
  }

  static Color _blend(
    Color semantic,
    Color adaptive,
    double amount,
  ) =>
      Color.lerp(semantic, adaptive, amount)!;
}
