import 'package:timezone/data/latest.dart' as tz_data;
import 'package:timezone/timezone.dart' as tz;

enum DeviceTimeZoneConfidence {
  exactIdentifier,
  equivalentRules,
}

final class DeviceTimeZoneSnapshot {
  const DeviceTimeZoneSnapshot({
    required this.location,
    required this.locationId,
    required this.nativeName,
    required this.currentOffset,
    required this.capturedAtUtc,
    required this.confidence,
  });

  final tz.Location location;
  final String locationId;
  final String nativeName;
  final Duration currentOffset;
  final DateTime capturedAtUtc;
  final DeviceTimeZoneConfidence confidence;

  bool get exactIdentifier =>
      confidence == DeviceTimeZoneConfidence.exactIdentifier;
}

abstract interface class DeviceTimeZoneProvider {
  Future<DeviceTimeZoneSnapshot> resolve({bool forceRefresh = false});

  Future<DateTime> nowLocal();

  Future<DateTime> toLocal(DateTime instant);

  Future<DateTime> nextLocalOccurrence({
    required int minutesSinceMidnight,
    DateTime? fromUtc,
  });
}

final class SystemDeviceTimeZoneProvider implements DeviceTimeZoneProvider {
  SystemDeviceTimeZoneProvider({
    DateTime Function()? localClock,
  }) : _localClock = localClock ?? DateTime.now;

  final DateTime Function() _localClock;

  DeviceTimeZoneSnapshot? _cached;
  String? _cachedFingerprint;
  bool _databaseInitialized = false;

  @override
  Future<DeviceTimeZoneSnapshot> resolve({
    bool forceRefresh = false,
  }) async {
    _initializeDatabase();
    final nativeNow = _nativeLocalNow();
    final fingerprint =
        '${nativeNow.timeZoneName}|${nativeNow.timeZoneOffset.inMinutes}';

    if (!forceRefresh &&
        _cached != null &&
        _cachedFingerprint == fingerprint) {
      return _cached!;
    }

    final nowUtc = nativeNow.toUtc();
    final samples = _sampleInstants(nowUtc);
    final nativeName = nativeNow.timeZoneName.trim();

    tz.Location? selected;
    var confidence = DeviceTimeZoneConfidence.equivalentRules;

    final direct = tz.timeZoneDatabase.locations[nativeName];
    if (direct != null && _matchesNativeRules(direct, samples)) {
      selected = direct;
      confidence = DeviceTimeZoneConfidence.exactIdentifier;
    }

    selected ??= _bestEquivalentLocation(
      samples: samples,
      nativeName: nativeName,
    );

    if (selected == null) {
      throw StateError('device_timezone_unresolvable');
    }

    tz.setLocalLocation(selected);
    final snapshot = DeviceTimeZoneSnapshot(
      location: selected,
      locationId: selected.name,
      nativeName: nativeName,
      currentOffset: nativeNow.timeZoneOffset,
      capturedAtUtc: nowUtc,
      confidence: confidence,
    );
    _cached = snapshot;
    _cachedFingerprint = fingerprint;
    return snapshot;
  }

  @override
  Future<DateTime> nowLocal() async {
    await resolve();
    return _nativeLocalNow();
  }

  @override
  Future<DateTime> toLocal(DateTime instant) async {
    await resolve();
    return instant.toUtc().toLocal();
  }

  @override
  Future<DateTime> nextLocalOccurrence({
    required int minutesSinceMidnight,
    DateTime? fromUtc,
  }) async {
    if (minutesSinceMidnight < 0 || minutesSinceMidnight >= 24 * 60) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        minutesSinceMidnight,
        'minutesSinceMidnight',
        'must be within a local day',
      );
    }
    await resolve();

    final baselineUtc = (fromUtc ?? DateTime.now().toUtc()).toUtc();
    final localNow = baselineUtc.toLocal();
    var candidate = DateTime(
      localNow.year,
      localNow.month,
      localNow.day,
      minutesSinceMidnight ~/ 60,
      minutesSinceMidnight % 60,
    );
    if (!candidate.isAfter(localNow)) {
      candidate = DateTime(
        localNow.year,
        localNow.month,
        localNow.day + 1,
        minutesSinceMidnight ~/ 60,
        minutesSinceMidnight % 60,
      );
    }
    return candidate;
  }

  DateTime _nativeLocalNow() {
    final value = _localClock();
    return value.isUtc ? value.toLocal() : value;
  }

  void _initializeDatabase() {
    if (_databaseInitialized) return;
    tz_data.initializeTimeZones();
    _databaseInitialized = true;
  }

  List<DateTime> _sampleInstants(DateTime nowUtc) {
    const offsets = <Duration>[
      Duration(days: -365),
      Duration(days: -180),
      Duration(days: -90),
      Duration.zero,
      Duration(days: 90),
      Duration(days: 180),
      Duration(days: 365),
    ];
    return offsets
        .map((offset) => nowUtc.add(offset))
        .toList(growable: false);
  }

  tz.Location? _bestEquivalentLocation({
    required List<DateTime> samples,
    required String nativeName,
  }) {
    final candidates = <_LocationCandidate>[];
    for (final entry in tz.timeZoneDatabase.locations.entries) {
      final location = entry.value;
      if (!_matchesNativeRules(location, samples)) continue;

      candidates.add(
        _LocationCandidate(
          location: location,
          nativeNameExact:
              entry.key.toLowerCase() == nativeName.toLowerCase(),
        ),
      );
    }

    if (candidates.isEmpty) return null;
    candidates.sort((a, b) {
      if (a.nativeNameExact != b.nativeNameExact) {
        return a.nativeNameExact ? -1 : 1;
      }
      return a.location.name.compareTo(b.location.name);
    });
    return candidates.first.location;
  }

  bool _matchesNativeRules(
    tz.Location location,
    List<DateTime> samples,
  ) {
    for (final instant in samples) {
      final nativeOffset = instant.toLocal().timeZoneOffset;
      final candidateOffset =
          location.timeZone(instant.millisecondsSinceEpoch).offset;
      if (nativeOffset != candidateOffset) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }
}

final class LocalSrsTimePolicy {
  const LocalSrsTimePolicy(this.timeZoneProvider);

  final DeviceTimeZoneProvider timeZoneProvider;

  Future<DateTime> dueAtUtc({
    required DateTime reviewedAt,
    required int intervalDays,
  }) async {
    if (intervalDays < 0 || intervalDays > 3650) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        intervalDays,
        'intervalDays',
        'must be between 0 and 3650 days',
      );
    }

    await timeZoneProvider.resolve();
    final reviewedLocal = reviewedAt.toUtc().toLocal();
    if (intervalDays == 0) return reviewedAt.toUtc();

    final dueLocal = DateTime(
      reviewedLocal.year,
      reviewedLocal.month,
      reviewedLocal.day + intervalDays,
      reviewedLocal.hour,
      reviewedLocal.minute,
      reviewedLocal.second,
      reviewedLocal.millisecond,
      reviewedLocal.microsecond,
    );
    return dueLocal.toUtc();
  }

  Future<bool> isDue({
    required DateTime dueAt,
    DateTime? nowUtc,
  }) async {
    await timeZoneProvider.resolve();
    final now = (nowUtc ?? DateTime.now().toUtc()).toUtc().toLocal();
    final due = dueAt.toUtc().toLocal();
    return !due.isAfter(now);
  }
}

final class _LocationCandidate {
  const _LocationCandidate({
    required this.location,
    required this.nativeNameExact,
  });

  final tz.Location location;
  final bool nativeNameExact;
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:collection';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:isolate';

import 'package:cryptography/cryptography.dart';

import '../../models/learner.dart';
import '../srs.dart';
import '../storage/validation_hash_cache.dart';
import 'worker_contract.dart';

final class PersistentCpuWorker {
  static const int maxPendingJobs = 256;
  static PersistentCpuWorker? _activeWorker;

  static PersistentCpuWorker? get active {
    final worker = _activeWorker;
    return worker == null ||
            worker.isClosed ||
            !worker._accepting
        ? null
        : worker;
  }

  PersistentCpuWorker._({
    required Isolate isolate,
    required SendPort commandPort,
    required ReceivePort responsePort,
    required ReceivePort exitPort,
    required int initialEpoch,
  })  : _isolate = isolate,
        _commandPort = commandPort,
        _responsePort = responsePort,
        _exitPort = exitPort,
        _currentEpoch = initialEpoch {
    _responseSubscription = _responsePort.listen(_handleResponse);
    _exitSubscription = _exitPort.listen(_handleExit);
  }

  static Future<PersistentCpuWorker> start({
    required int initialEpoch,
  }) async {
    if (initialEpoch < 0) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        initialEpoch,
        'initialEpoch',
        'must not be negative',
      );
    }

    final existing = active;
    if (existing != null) {
      if (initialEpoch > existing.currentEpoch) {
        existing.advanceEpoch(initialEpoch);
      }
      return existing;
    }

    final bootstrap = ReceivePort('phase13b.cpu.bootstrap');
    final responses = ReceivePort('phase13b.cpu.responses');
    final exits = ReceivePort('phase13b.cpu.exits');

    final isolate = await Isolate.spawn<Map<String, Object?>>(
      _cpuWorkerMain,
      <String, Object?>{
        'bootstrapPort': bootstrap.sendPort,
        'responsePort': responses.sendPort,
      },
      debugName: 'salim.cpu-worker',
      errorsAreFatal: true,
      onExit: exits.sendPort,
    );

    final command = await bootstrap.first.timeout(
      const Duration(seconds: 3),
      onTimeout: () {
        isolate.kill(priority: Isolate.immediate);
        bootstrap.close();
        responses.close();
        exits.close();
        throw StateError('CPU worker bootstrap timed out.');
      },
    );
    bootstrap.close();

    if (command is! SendPort) {
      isolate.kill(priority: Isolate.immediate);
      responses.close();
      exits.close();
      throw StateError('CPU worker did not provide a command port.');
    }

    final worker = PersistentCpuWorker._(
      isolate: isolate,
      commandPort: command,
      responsePort: responses,
      exitPort: exits,
      initialEpoch: initialEpoch,
    );
    _activeWorker = worker;
    return worker;
  }

  final Isolate _isolate;
  final SendPort _commandPort;
  final ReceivePort _responsePort;
  final ReceivePort _exitPort;
  final Queue<_QueuedWorkerJob> _pending = Queue<_QueuedWorkerJob>();

  late final StreamSubscription<Object?> _responseSubscription;
  late final StreamSubscription<Object?> _exitSubscription;

  _QueuedWorkerJob? _inFlight;
  int _currentEpoch;
  bool _accepting = true;
  bool _closed = false;
  bool _unexpectedExit = false;
  int _spawnCount = 1;

  Completer<void>? _shutdownCompleter;

  int get currentEpoch => _currentEpoch;
  int get pendingCount => _pending.length;
  int get spawnCount => _spawnCount;
  bool get isClosed => _closed;
  bool get hasInFlightJob => _inFlight != null;

  Future<WorkerResult<R>> submit<R>(WorkerJob<Object?> job) {
    if (!_accepting || _closed) {
      return Future<WorkerResult<R>>.error(
        StateError('PersistentCpuWorker is closed.'),
      );
    }

    _validateJob(job);

    if (_pending.length >= maxPendingJobs) {
      return Future<WorkerResult<R>>.error(
        StateError(
          'CPU worker queue capacity exceeded: $maxPendingJobs.',
        ),
      );
    }

    if (job.epoch != _currentEpoch) {
      return Future<WorkerResult<R>>.value(
        WorkerResult<R>(
          id: job.id,
          epoch: job.epoch,
          status: WorkerStatuses.stale,
          payload: null,
          errorCode: 'stale_epoch',
        ),
      );
    }

    final pending = _QueuedWorkerJob(job);
    _pending.addLast(pending);
    _dispatchNext();

    return pending.completer.future.then<WorkerResult<R>>(
      (result) => WorkerResult<R>(
        id: result.id,
        epoch: result.epoch,
        status: result.status,
        payload: result.payload as R?,
        errorCode: result.errorCode,
      ),
    );
  }

  void advanceEpoch(int nextEpoch) {
    if (_closed) return;
    if (nextEpoch < _currentEpoch) {
      return;
    }
    if (nextEpoch == _currentEpoch) {
      return;
    }

    _currentEpoch = nextEpoch;
    final retained = Queue<_QueuedWorkerJob>();

    while (_pending.isNotEmpty) {
      final queued = _pending.removeFirst();
      if (queued.job.epoch == nextEpoch) {
        retained.addLast(queued);
        continue;
      }
      _complete(
        queued,
        WorkerResult<Object?>(
          id: queued.job.id,
          epoch: queued.job.epoch,
          status: WorkerStatuses.stale,
          payload: null,
          errorCode: 'stale_epoch',
        ),
      );
    }

    _pending.addAll(retained);
    _dispatchNext();
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    _accepting = false;

    while (_pending.isNotEmpty) {
      final queued = _pending.removeFirst();
      _complete(
        queued,
        WorkerResult<Object?>(
          id: queued.job.id,
          epoch: queued.job.epoch,
          status: WorkerStatuses.closed,
          payload: null,
          errorCode: 'worker_closed',
        ),
      );
    }

    final inFlight = _inFlight;
    if (inFlight != null && !inFlight.completer.isCompleted) {
      try {
        await inFlight.completer.future.timeout(
          const Duration(seconds: 3),
        );
      } on TimeoutException {
        _unexpectedExit = true;
        _inFlight = null;
        _complete(
          inFlight,
          WorkerResult<Object?>(
            id: inFlight.job.id,
            epoch: inFlight.job.epoch,
            status: WorkerStatuses.closed,
            payload: null,
            errorCode: 'shutdown_timeout',
          ),
        );
        _isolate.kill(priority: Isolate.immediate);
      } on Object {
        // The shutdown path still proceeds if the in-flight job failed.
      }
    }

    if (!_unexpectedExit) {
      _shutdownCompleter ??= Completer<void>();
      _commandPort.send(const <String, Object?>{'kind': 'shutdown'});
      try {
        await _shutdownCompleter!.future.timeout(
          const Duration(seconds: 3),
        );
      } on TimeoutException {
        _isolate.kill(priority: Isolate.immediate);
      }
    }

    _closed = true;
    await _responseSubscription.cancel();
    await _exitSubscription.cancel();
    _responsePort.close();
    _exitPort.close();
    _isolate.kill(priority: Isolate.immediate);
    if (identical(_activeWorker, this)) {
      _activeWorker = null;
    }
  }

  void _dispatchNext() {
    if (!_accepting || _closed || _inFlight != null) return;

    while (_pending.isNotEmpty) {
      final queued = _pending.removeFirst();
      if (queued.job.epoch != _currentEpoch) {
        _complete(
          queued,
          WorkerResult<Object?>(
            id: queued.job.id,
            epoch: queued.job.epoch,
            status: WorkerStatuses.stale,
            payload: null,
            errorCode: 'stale_epoch',
          ),
        );
        continue;
      }

      _inFlight = queued;
      try {
        _commandPort.send(
          <String, Object?>{
            'kind': 'job',
            'job': _jobToWire(queued.job),
          },
        );
        return;
      } on Object {
        _inFlight = null;
        _complete(
          queued,
          WorkerResult<Object?>(
            id: queued.job.id,
            epoch: queued.job.epoch,
            status: WorkerStatuses.error,
            payload: null,
            errorCode: 'invalid_payload',
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  void _handleResponse(Object? raw) {
    if (_closed || raw is! Map) return;
    final kind = raw['kind'];

    if (kind == 'shutdownAck') {
      final completer = _shutdownCompleter;
      if (completer != null && !completer.isCompleted) {
        completer.complete();
      }
      return;
    }

    if (kind != 'result') return;
    final queued = _inFlight;
    if (queued == null) return;

    var result = _resultFromWire(raw['result'], fallback: queued.job);
    if (result.epoch != _currentEpoch &&
        result.status == WorkerStatuses.ok) {
      result = WorkerResult<Object?>(
        id: result.id,
        epoch: result.epoch,
        status: WorkerStatuses.stale,
        payload: null,
        errorCode: 'stale_epoch',
      );
    }

    _inFlight = null;
    _complete(queued, result);
    _dispatchNext();
  }

  void _handleExit(Object? _) {
    if (_closed) return;
    _unexpectedExit = true;
    _accepting = false;

    final queued = _inFlight;
    _inFlight = null;
    if (queued != null) {
      _complete(
        queued,
        WorkerResult<Object?>(
          id: queued.job.id,
          epoch: queued.job.epoch,
          status: WorkerStatuses.error,
          payload: null,
          errorCode: 'worker_exit',
        ),
      );
    }

    while (_pending.isNotEmpty) {
      final pending = _pending.removeFirst();
      _complete(
        pending,
        WorkerResult<Object?>(
          id: pending.job.id,
          epoch: pending.job.epoch,
          status: WorkerStatuses.error,
          payload: null,
          errorCode: 'worker_exit',
        ),
      );
    }

    final shutdown = _shutdownCompleter;
    if (shutdown != null && !shutdown.isCompleted) {
      shutdown.complete();
    }
  }

  static void _validateJob(WorkerJob<Object?> job) {
    if (job.id.trim().isEmpty || job.id.length > 160) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(job.id, 'job.id', 'must be 1..160 chars');
    }
    if (job.type.trim().isEmpty || job.type.length > 80) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        job.type,
        'job.type',
        'must be 1..80 chars',
      );
    }
    if (job.epoch < 0) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(job.epoch, 'job.epoch', 'must be >= 0');
    }
  }

  static void _complete(
    _QueuedWorkerJob queued,
    WorkerResult<Object?> result,
  ) {
    if (!queued.completer.isCompleted) {
      queued.completer.complete(result);
    }
  }
}

final class _QueuedWorkerJob {
  _QueuedWorkerJob(this.job);

  final WorkerJob<Object?> job;
  final Completer<WorkerResult<Object?>> completer =
      Completer<WorkerResult<Object?>>();
}

Map<String, Object?> _jobToWire(WorkerJob<Object?> job) =>
    <String, Object?>{
      'id': job.id,
      'type': job.type,
      'epoch': job.epoch,
      'payload': job.payload,
    };

WorkerResult<Object?> _resultFromWire(
  Object? raw, {
  required WorkerJob<Object?> fallback,
}) {
  if (raw is! Map) {
    return WorkerResult<Object?>(
      id: fallback.id,
      epoch: fallback.epoch,
      status: WorkerStatuses.error,
      payload: null,
      errorCode: 'invalid_result',
    );
  }

  final id = raw['id'];
  final epoch = raw['epoch'];
  final status = raw['status'];
  final errorCode = raw['errorCode'];

  return WorkerResult<Object?>(
    id: id is String && id.isNotEmpty ? id : fallback.id,
    epoch: epoch is num ? epoch.toInt() : fallback.epoch,
    status: status is String ? status : WorkerStatuses.error,
    payload: raw['payload'],
    errorCode: errorCode is String ? errorCode : null,
  );
}

void _cpuWorkerMain(Map<String, Object?> bootstrap) async {
  final bootstrapValue = bootstrap['bootstrapPort'];
  final responseValue = bootstrap['responsePort'];
  if (bootstrapValue is! SendPort || responseValue is! SendPort) {
    return;
  }
  final bootstrapPort = bootstrapValue;
  final responsePort = responseValue;

  final commands = ReceivePort('phase13b.cpu.commands');
  bootstrapPort.send(commands.sendPort);

  await for (final raw in commands) {
    if (raw is! Map) continue;
    final kind = raw['kind'];

    if (kind == 'shutdown') {
      responsePort.send(const <String, Object?>{'kind': 'shutdownAck'});
      commands.close();
      Isolate.exit();
    }

    if (kind != 'job') continue;
    final job = raw['job'];
    final result = await _executeWireJob(job);
    responsePort.send(
      <String, Object?>{
        'kind': 'result',
        'result': result,
      },
    );
  }
}

Future<Map<String, Object?>> _executeWireJob(Object? raw) async {
  if (raw is! Map) {
    return _errorWire(
      id: 'invalid',
      epoch: 0,
      code: 'invalid_job',
    );
  }

  final idValue = raw['id'];
  final typeValue = raw['type'];
  final epochValue = raw['epoch'];
  final payload = raw['payload'];
  final id = idValue is String ? idValue : 'invalid';
  final type = typeValue is String ? typeValue : '';
  final epoch = epochValue is num ? epochValue.toInt() : 0;

  try {
    switch (type) {
      case WorkerJobTypes.jsonDecode:
        return _okWire(
          id: id,
          epoch: epoch,
          payload: _decodePayload(payload),
        );
      case WorkerJobTypes.checksum128:
        return _okWire(
          id: id,
          epoch: epoch,
          payload: _checksum128(payload),
        );
      case WorkerJobTypes.sha256:
        return _okWire(
          id: id,
          epoch: epoch,
          payload: await _sha256(payload),
        );
      case WorkerJobTypes.fuzzyRank:
        return _okWire(
          id: id,
          epoch: epoch,
          payload: _rankFuzzy(payload),
        );
      case WorkerJobTypes.srsSchedule:
        return _okWire(
          id: id,
          epoch: epoch,
          payload: _scheduleSrs(payload),
        );
      default:
        return _errorWire(
          id: id,
          epoch: epoch,
          code: 'unsupported_job_type',
        );
    }
  } on FormatException {
    return _errorWire(
      id: id,
      epoch: epoch,
      code: 'invalid_payload',
    );
  } on ArgumentError {
    return _errorWire(
      id: id,
      epoch: epoch,
      code: 'invalid_payload',
    );
  } on Object {
    return _errorWire(
      id: id,
      epoch: epoch,
      code: 'worker_exception',
    );
  }
}

Map<String, Object?> _scheduleSrs(Object? payload) {
  final map = _payloadMap(payload);
  final cardValue = map['card'];
  final correct = map['correct'];
  final hinted = map['hinted'];
  final nowValue = map['now'];
  if (cardValue is! Map ||
      correct is! bool ||
      hinted is! bool ||
      nowValue is! String ||
      nowValue.length > 64) {
    throw const FormatException('srs payload is invalid');
  }

  final cardJson = <String, dynamic>{};
  for (final entry in cardValue.entries) {
    if (entry.key is! String) {
      throw const FormatException('srs card keys must be strings');
    }
    cardJson[entry.key as String] = entry.value;
  }

  final current = ReviewCard.fromJson(cardJson);
  final now = DateTime.tryParse(nowValue)?.toUtc();
  if (current.itemId.trim().isEmpty ||
      current.itemId.length > 160 ||
      !current.facetKey.isValid ||
      now == null ||
      now.isBefore(DateTime.utc(2000)) ||
      now.isAfter(DateTime.utc(2100))) {
    throw const FormatException('srs payload is invalid');
  }

  return Map<String, Object?>.from(
    Srs.update(
      current,
      correct: correct,
      hinted: hinted,
      now: now,
    ).toJson(),
  );
}

Object? _decodePayload(Object? payload) {
  final map = _payloadMap(payload);
  final encoded = map['encoded'];
  if (encoded is! String || encoded.length > 16 * 1024 * 1024) {
    throw const FormatException('json payload is invalid');
  }
  return jsonDecode(encoded);
}

String _checksum128(Object? payload) {
  final map = _payloadMap(payload);
  final scopeKey = map['scopeKey'];
  final contentValue = map['content'];
  final jsonValue = map['jsonValue'];
  final validatorVersion = map['validatorVersion'];
  if (scopeKey is! String ||
      validatorVersion is! String ||
      scopeKey.length > 240 ||
      validatorVersion.length > 80) {
    throw const FormatException('checksum payload is invalid');
  }

  final String content;
  if (contentValue is String) {
    content = contentValue;
  } else if (jsonValue != null) {
    content = jsonEncode(jsonValue);
  } else {
    throw const FormatException('checksum payload is invalid');
  }
  if (content.length > 16 * 1024 * 1024) {
    throw const FormatException('checksum payload is invalid');
  }

  return ContentChecksum.compute(
    scopeKey: scopeKey,
    content: content,
    validatorVersion: validatorVersion,
  );
}

Future<String> _sha256(Object? payload) async {
  final map = _payloadMap(payload);
  final content = map['content'];
  if (content is! String || content.length > 16 * 1024 * 1024) {
    throw const FormatException('sha256 payload is invalid');
  }
  final digest = await Sha256().hash(utf8.encode(content));
  final buffer = StringBuffer();
  for (final byte in digest.bytes) {
    buffer.write(byte.toRadixString(16).padLeft(2, '0'));
  }
  return buffer.toString();
}

List<Map<String, Object?>> _rankFuzzy(Object? payload) {
  final map = _payloadMap(payload);
  final queryValue = map['query'];
  final candidatesValue = map['candidates'];
  final limitValue = map['limit'];

  if (queryValue is! String ||
      queryValue.length > 512 ||
      candidatesValue is! List ||
      candidatesValue.length > 5000) {
    throw const FormatException('fuzzy payload is invalid');
  }

  final query = _normalize(queryValue);
  if (query.isEmpty) {
    return const <Map<String, Object?>>[];
  }

  final limit = limitValue is num
      ? limitValue.toInt().clamp(1, 100).toInt()
      : 20;
  final ranked = <_RankedCandidate>[];

  for (var index = 0; index < candidatesValue.length; index += 1) {
    final raw = candidatesValue[index];
    if (raw is! Map) continue;
    final id = raw['id'];
    final text = raw['text'];
    if (id is! String ||
        id.trim().isEmpty ||
        id.length > 160 ||
        text is! String ||
        text.length > 2048) {
      continue;
    }

    final normalized = _normalize(text);
    if (normalized.isEmpty) continue;

    ranked.add(
      _RankedCandidate(
        id: id.trim(),
        text: text,
        score: _fuzzyScore(query, normalized),
        order: index,
      ),
    );
  }

  ranked.sort((left, right) {
    final byScore = right.score.compareTo(left.score);
    if (byScore != 0) return byScore;
    final byOrder = left.order.compareTo(right.order);
    if (byOrder != 0) return byOrder;
    return left.id.compareTo(right.id);
  });

  return List<Map<String, Object?>>.unmodifiable(
    ranked.take(limit).map(
          (item) => <String, Object?>{
            'id': item.id,
            'text': item.text,
            'score': item.score,
          },
        ),
  );
}

Map<Object?, Object?> _payloadMap(Object? payload) {
  if (payload is! Map) {
    throw const FormatException('worker payload must be a map');
  }
  return payload;
}

String _normalize(String value) => value
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');

double _fuzzyScore(String query, String candidate) {
  if (query == candidate) return 1.0;

  final maxLength =
      query.length > candidate.length ? query.length : candidate.length;
  if (maxLength == 0) return 1.0;

  final distance = _levenshtein(query, candidate);
  final editScore = (1.0 - (distance / maxLength)).clamp(0.0, 1.0);

  var containment = 0.0;
  if (candidate.contains(query) || query.contains(candidate)) {
    final shorter =
        query.length < candidate.length ? query.length : candidate.length;
    containment = 0.78 + (0.2 * (shorter / maxLength));
  }

  final tokenScore = _tokenOverlap(query, candidate);
  final combined = <double>[
    editScore.toDouble(),
    containment,
    tokenScore,
  ].reduce((left, right) => left > right ? left : right);

  return double.parse(combined.clamp(0.0, 1.0).toStringAsFixed(6));
}

double _tokenOverlap(String query, String candidate) {
  final queryTokens = query.split(' ').where((value) => value.isNotEmpty).toSet();
  final candidateTokens =
      candidate.split(' ').where((value) => value.isNotEmpty).toSet();
  if (queryTokens.isEmpty || candidateTokens.isEmpty) return 0.0;

  final intersection = queryTokens.intersection(candidateTokens).length;
  final union = queryTokens.union(candidateTokens).length;
  return union == 0 ? 0.0 : intersection / union;
}

int _levenshtein(String left, String right) {
  if (left == right) return 0;
  if (left.isEmpty) return right.length;
  if (right.isEmpty) return left.length;

  var previous = List<int>.generate(right.length + 1, (index) => index);

  for (var i = 1; i <= left.length; i += 1) {
    final current = List<int>.filled(right.length + 1, 0);
    current[0] = i;
    for (var j = 1; j <= right.length; j += 1) {
      final substitutionCost =
          left.codeUnitAt(i - 1) == right.codeUnitAt(j - 1) ? 0 : 1;
      final deletion = previous[j] + 1;
      final insertion = current[j - 1] + 1;
      final substitution = previous[j - 1] + substitutionCost;
      current[j] = _min3(deletion, insertion, substitution);
    }
    previous = current;
  }

  return previous[right.length];
}

int _min3(int a, int b, int c) {
  var result = a < b ? a : b;
  if (c < result) result = c;
  return result;
}

Map<String, Object?> _okWire({
  required String id,
  required int epoch,
  required Object? payload,
}) =>
    <String, Object?>{
      'id': id,
      'epoch': epoch,
      'status': WorkerStatuses.ok,
      'payload': payload,
      'errorCode': null,
    };

Map<String, Object?> _errorWire({
  required String id,
  required int epoch,
  required String code,
}) =>
    <String, Object?>{
      'id': id,
      'epoch': epoch,
      'status': WorkerStatuses.error,
      'payload': null,
      'errorCode': code,
    };

final class _RankedCandidate {
  const _RankedCandidate({
    required this.id,
    required this.text,
    required this.score,
    required this.order,
  });

  final String id;
  final String text;
  final double score;
  final int order;
}

final class WorkerJob<T> {
  const WorkerJob({
    required this.id,
    required this.type,
    required this.epoch,
    required this.payload,
  });

  final String id;
  final String type;
  final int epoch;
  final T payload;
}

final class WorkerResult<R> {
  const WorkerResult({
    required this.id,
    required this.epoch,
    required this.status,
    required this.payload,
    required this.errorCode,
  });

  final String id;
  final int epoch;
  final String status;
  final R? payload;
  final String? errorCode;
}

abstract final class WorkerJobTypes {
  static const String jsonDecode = 'json.decode';
  static const String checksum128 = 'checksum.128';
  static const String sha256 = 'checksum.sha256';
  static const String fuzzyRank = 'fuzzy.rank';
  static const String srsSchedule = 'srs.schedule';
}

abstract final class WorkerStatuses {
  static const String ok = 'ok';
  static const String error = 'error';
  static const String stale = 'stale';
  static const String closed = 'closed';
}

FILE: lib/core/quick_review/quick_review_corpus_reader.dart

import '../../features/srs/corpus_sqlite_repository.dart';
import 'quick_review_models.dart';

abstract interface class QuickReviewCorpusReader {
  Future<List<QuickReviewCorpusItem>> fetchByIds(
    Iterable<String> contentIds,
  );
}

/// Lazy adapter over the admitted indexed SQLite corpus.
///
/// No query runs during construction. Each call is bounded to at most
/// [maxIdsPerQuery] content identifiers.
final class IndexedSrsQuickReviewCorpusReader
    implements QuickReviewCorpusReader {
  const IndexedSrsQuickReviewCorpusReader(this.repository);

  static const int maxIdsPerQuery = 20;
  static const int maxContentIdLength = 160;

  final IndexedSrsCorpusRepository repository;

  @override
  Future<List<QuickReviewCorpusItem>> fetchByIds(
    Iterable<String> contentIds,
  ) async {
    final normalized = <String>[];
    final seen = <String>{};

    for (final rawId in contentIds) {
      if (normalized.length >= maxIdsPerQuery) break;
      final id = rawId.trim();
      if (id.isEmpty ||
          id.length > maxContentIdLength ||
          !seen.add(id)) {
        continue;
      }
      normalized.add(id);
    }

    if (normalized.isEmpty) {
      return const <QuickReviewCorpusItem>[];
    }

    final rows = await repository.fetchByIds(normalized);
    return rows
        .map(
          (item) => QuickReviewCorpusItem(
            id: item.id,
            sourceText: item.german,
            translationText: item.arabic,
            exampleText: item.sentence,
            exampleTranslationText: item.sentenceAr,
            grammaticalMarker: item.article,
            pluralForm: item.plural,
            topic: item.topic,
            skill: item.skill,
            acceptedForms: item.accepted,
          ),
        )
        .toList(growable: false);
  }
}

import '../../models/learner.dart';
import '../memory.dart';

final class QuickReviewCorpusItem {
  const QuickReviewCorpusItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.sourceText,
    required this.translationText,
    required this.exampleText,
    required this.exampleTranslationText,
    required this.grammaticalMarker,
    required this.pluralForm,
    this.topic = '',
    this.skill = 'vocabulary',
    this.acceptedForms = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final String sourceText;
  final String translationText;
  final String exampleText;
  final String exampleTranslationText;
  final String grammaticalMarker;
  final String pluralForm;
  final String topic;
  final String skill;
  final List<String> acceptedForms;
}

final class QuickReviewCard {
  const QuickReviewCard({
    required this.contentId,
    required this.sourceText,
    required this.translationText,
    required this.exampleText,
    required this.exampleTranslationText,
    required this.grammaticalMarker,
    required this.pluralForm,
    this.topic = '',
    this.skill = 'vocabulary',
    this.acceptedForms = const <String>[],
    required this.dueAt,
    required this.memoryState,
    required this.reason,
    required this.intervalDays,
    required this.lapses,
  });

  final String contentId;
  final String sourceText;
  final String translationText;
  final String exampleText;
  final String exampleTranslationText;
  final String grammaticalMarker;
  final String pluralForm;
  final String topic;
  final String skill;
  final List<String> acceptedForms;
  final DateTime dueAt;
  final MemoryState memoryState;
  final MemoryReviewReason reason;
  final int intervalDays;
  final int lapses;
}

final class QuickReviewSession {
  QuickReviewSession({
    required DateTime createdAt,
    required this.limit,
    required Iterable<QuickReviewCard> cards,
  })  : createdAt = createdAt.toUtc(),
        cards = List<QuickReviewCard>.unmodifiable(cards);

  final DateTime createdAt;
  final int limit;
  final List<QuickReviewCard> cards;

  bool get isEmpty => cards.isEmpty;
  int get length => cards.length;
}

FILE: lib/core/quick_review/quick_review_service.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import '../../models/learner.dart';
import '../memory.dart';
import 'quick_review_corpus_reader.dart';
import 'quick_review_models.dart';

/// Builds a small, due-only review working set from SRS state.
///
/// Memory remains O(K), where K is capped at [maxSessionItems]. A session
/// performs zero corpus queries when no card is due and exactly one bounded
/// indexed SQLite query when review work exists.
final class QuickReviewService {
  const QuickReviewService({
    required QuickReviewCorpusReader corpusReader,
  }) : _corpusReader = corpusReader;

  static const int defaultSessionItems = 12;
  static const int maxSessionItems = 20;

  final QuickReviewCorpusReader _corpusReader;

  Future<QuickReviewSession> buildSession({
    required Iterable<ReviewCard> reviewCards,
    DateTime? now,
    int limit = defaultSessionItems,
  }) async {
    final clock = now ?? DateTime.now();
    final safeLimit = limit.clamp(1, maxSessionItems).toInt();

    final ranked = MemoryQueue.rank(
      reviewCards.where((card) => card.facetKey.isLegacyMeaningKey),
      now: clock,
      limit: safeLimit,
    );

    if (ranked.isEmpty) {
      return QuickReviewSession(
        createdAt: clock,
        limit: safeLimit,
        cards: const <QuickReviewCard>[],
      );
    }

    final ids = ranked
        .map((card) => card.itemId.trim())
        .where((id) => id.isNotEmpty)
        .take(safeLimit)
        .toList(growable: false);

    if (ids.isEmpty) {
      return QuickReviewSession(
        createdAt: clock,
        limit: safeLimit,
        cards: const <QuickReviewCard>[],
      );
    }

    final corpusRows = await _corpusReader.fetchByIds(ids);
    final byId = <String, QuickReviewCorpusItem>{
      for (final item in corpusRows) item.id: item,
    };

    final cards = <QuickReviewCard>[];
    for (final review in ranked) {
      if (cards.length >= safeLimit) break;
      final item = byId[review.itemId.trim()];
      if (item == null) continue;

      cards.add(
        QuickReviewCard(
          contentId: item.id,
          sourceText: item.sourceText,
          translationText: item.translationText,
          exampleText: item.exampleText,
          exampleTranslationText: item.exampleTranslationText,
          grammaticalMarker: item.grammaticalMarker,
          pluralForm: item.pluralForm,
          topic: item.topic,
          skill: item.skill,
          acceptedForms: item.acceptedForms,
          dueAt: review.dueAt,
          memoryState: review.memoryState,
          reason: MemoryQueue.reason(review, now: clock),
          intervalDays: review.intervalDays,
          lapses: review.lapses,
        ),
      );
    }

    return QuickReviewSession(
      createdAt: clock,
      limit: safeLimit,
      cards: cards,
    );
  }
}

import '../explainer/explainer_models.dart';
import '../l10n/l10n_models.dart';

final class ExplainWhyResult {
  const ExplainWhyResult({
    required this.reasonCode,
    required this.languageCode,
    required this.text,
  });

  final String reasonCode;
  final String languageCode;
  final String text;
}

abstract interface class ExplainWhyEngine {
  bool supports(String reasonCode);
  ExplainWhyResult explain(ExplainerRequest request);
}

/// Deterministic reason-code renderer over one exact admitted learning-content
/// dictionary. No UI-localization fallback participates in explanation lookup.
/// Runtime reason lookup is O(1) and placeholder rendering is bounded by the
/// selected template.
final class DeterministicExplainWhyEngine implements ExplainWhyEngine {
  DeterministicExplainWhyEngine._({
    required L10nDictionary dictionary,
    required Set<String> reasonCodes,
  })  : _dictionary = dictionary,
        _reasonCodes = Set<String>.unmodifiable(reasonCodes);

  factory DeterministicExplainWhyEngine.fromDictionary({
    required L10nDictionary dictionary,
  }) {
    final reasonCodes = _reasonCodesFromDictionary(dictionary);
    return DeterministicExplainWhyEngine._(
      dictionary: dictionary,
      reasonCodes: reasonCodes,
    );
  }

  final L10nDictionary _dictionary;
  final Set<String> _reasonCodes;

  @override
  bool supports(String reasonCode) {
    try {
      return _reasonCodes.contains(_validatedReasonCode(reasonCode));
    } on FormatException {
      return false;
    }
  }

  @override
  ExplainWhyResult explain(ExplainerRequest request) {
    final rawReasonCode = request.reasonCode;
    if (rawReasonCode == null || rawReasonCode.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw StateError('explain_why_reason_missing');
    }
    final reasonCode = _validatedReasonCode(rawReasonCode);
    if (!_reasonCodes.contains(reasonCode)) {
      throw StateError('explain_why_reason_unsupported:' + reasonCode);
    }

    final correct = request.correct;
    if (correct == null) {
      throw StateError('explain_why_outcome_missing:' + reasonCode);
    }

    final key = _messageKey(reasonCode, correct: correct);
    if (!_dictionary.contains(key)) {
      throw StateError('explain_why_template_missing:' + key);
    }
    final message = _dictionary.require(key);

    return ExplainWhyResult(
      reasonCode: reasonCode,
      languageCode: _dictionary.locale.languageTag,
      text: message.render(arguments: request.arguments),
    );
  }
}

Set<String> _reasonCodesFromDictionary(L10nDictionary dictionary) {
  const prefix = 'explain.';
  const correctSuffix = '.correct';
  const incorrectSuffix = '.incorrect';

  final variants = <String, int>{};
  for (final key in dictionary.messages.keys) {
    if (!key.startsWith(prefix)) continue;

    late final String reasonCode;
    late final int mask;
    if (key.endsWith(correctSuffix)) {
      reasonCode = key.substring(
        prefix.length,
        key.length - correctSuffix.length,
      );
      mask = 1;
    } else if (key.endsWith(incorrectSuffix)) {
      reasonCode = key.substring(
        prefix.length,
        key.length - incorrectSuffix.length,
      );
      mask = 2;
    } else {
      throw FormatException('explain_why_template_key_invalid:' + key);
    }

    final normalized = _validatedReasonCode(reasonCode);
    variants[normalized] = (variants[normalized] ?? 0) | mask;
  }

  if (variants.isEmpty) {
    throw const FormatException('explain_why_catalog_empty');
  }
  for (final entry in variants.entries) {
    if (entry.value != 3) {
      throw FormatException(
        'explain_why_template_pair_incomplete:' + entry.key,
      );
    }
  }
  return variants.keys.toSet();
}

String _messageKey(String reasonCode, {required bool correct}) =>
    'explain.' + reasonCode + '.' + (correct ? 'correct' : 'incorrect');

String _validatedReasonCode(String raw) {
  final value = raw.trim();
  if (value.isEmpty ||
      value.length > 160 ||
      !RegExp(r'^[a-z0-9]+(?:[._-][a-z0-9]+)*$').hasMatch(value)) {
    throw FormatException('explain_why_reason_code_invalid:' + raw);
  }
  return value;
}

import 'package:flutter_tts/flutter_tts.dart';

enum SupportedLanguage {
  german('de-DE', 'الألمانية', '🇩🇪'),
  english('en-US', 'الإنجليزية', '🇬🇧'),
  french('fr-FR', 'الفرنسية', '🇫🇷'),
  spanish('es-ES', 'الإسبانية', '🇪🇸'),
  turkish('tr-TR', 'التركية', '🇹🇷');

  final String localeCode;
  final String titleAr;
  final String flag;
  const SupportedLanguage(this.localeCode, this.titleAr, this.flag);
}

class LanguageHub {
  static final FlutterTts _tts = FlutterTts();

  static Future<void> speakWord(String text, SupportedLanguage lang) async {
    await _tts.setLanguage(lang.localeCode);
    await _tts.setSpeechRate(0.45);
    await _tts.speak(text);
  }
}

FILE: lib/core/universal_search_normalizer.dart
--------------------------------------------------
class UniversalSearchNormalizer {
  /// تسوية النصوص وإزالة العلامات الصوتية والتشكيل لجميع اللغات
  static String normalize(String text) {
    String normalized = text.toLowerCase().trim();

    // إزالة الحركات والتشكيل العربي
    final arabicDiacritics = RegExp(r'[\u064B-\u065F\u0670]');
    normalized = normalized.replaceAll(arabicDiacritics, '');
    normalized = normalized.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[أإآ]'), 'ا');
    normalized = normalized.replaceAll('ة', 'ه');
    normalized = normalized.replaceAll('ى', 'ي');

    // تسوية الحروف اللاتينية والأوروبية الخاصة
    const replacements = {
      'ä': 'a', 'ö': 'o', 'ü': 'u', 'ß': 'ss', // ألماني
      'é': 'e', 'è': 'e', 'ê': 'e', 'ë': 'e', 'ç': 'c', // فرنسي
      'ñ': 'n', 'á': 'a', 'í': 'i', 'ó': 'o', 'ú': 'u', // إسباني
      'ğ': 'g', 'ş': 's', 'ı': 'i', 'İ': 'i'             // تركي
    };

    replacements.forEach((key, val) {
      normalized = normalized.replaceAll(key, val);
    });

    return normalized;
  }

  static bool matches(String source, String query) {
    if (query.trim().isEmpty) return true;
    final cleanSource = normalize(source);
    final cleanQuery = normalize(query);
    return cleanSource.contains(cleanQuery);
  }
}

  ...generatedVerbConjugationsChunk028,
  ...generatedVerbConjugationsChunk029
];

FILE: lib/features/audio/data/android_recorded_audio_player.dart

import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

import '../domain/services/recorded_audio_player.dart';

final class AndroidRecordedAudioPlayer implements RecordedAudioPlayer {
  AndroidRecordedAudioPlayer({MethodChannel? channel})
      : _channel = channel ?? const MethodChannel(_channelName);

  static const String _channelName =
      'com.deutschbilarabi.app/recorded_audio_player';

  final MethodChannel _channel;
  bool _closed = false;

  @override
  Future<bool> playAsset(String assetPath) async {
    if (_closed || !_isSafeAssetPath(assetPath)) return false;
    try {
      return await _channel.invokeMethod<bool>('playAsset', <String, Object>{
            'assetPath': assetPath,
          }) ??
          false;
    } on MissingPluginException {
      return false;
    } on PlatformException {
      return false;
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> stop() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    try {
      await _channel.invokeMethod<void>('stop');
    } on Object {
      // Recorded-audio failure falls back through the unified runtime.
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> shutdown() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    await stop();
    _closed = true;
  }

  static bool _isSafeAssetPath(String value) {
    final path = value.trim().replaceAll('\\', '/');
    if (path.isEmpty ||
        path.startsWith('/') ||
        path.contains('../') ||
        path.contains('/..') ||
        path.contains('//')) {
      return false;
    }
    final lower = path.toLowerCase();
    return const <String>{
      '.aac',
      '.flac',
      '.m4a',
      '.mp3',
      '.ogg',
      '.wav',
    }.any(lower.endsWith);
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/audio/data/audio_manifest_catalog.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'dart:convert';

import '../domain/entities/audio_request.dart';
import '../domain/services/audio_catalog.dart';

final class AudioManifestCatalog implements AudioCatalog {
  AudioManifestCatalog._({
    required this.baseAssetPath,
    required Map<String, Map<AudioVariant, String>> entries,
  }) : _entries = entries;

  factory AudioManifestCatalog.empty({
    String baseAssetPath = 'content/german/audio',
  }) =>
      AudioManifestCatalog._(
        baseAssetPath: baseAssetPath,
        entries: const <String, Map<AudioVariant, String>>{},
      );

  factory AudioManifestCatalog.parse(
    String rawJson, {
    String baseAssetPath = 'content/german/audio',
  }) {
    final decoded = jsonDecode(rawJson);
    if (decoded is! Map<String, dynamic> ||
        decoded['version'] != 1 ||
        decoded['entries'] is! List) {
      throw const FormatException('audio_manifest_invalid');
    }

    final result = <String, Map<AudioVariant, String>>{};
    for (final rawEntry in decoded['entries'] as List<dynamic>) {
      if (rawEntry is! Map) {
        throw const FormatException('audio_manifest_entry_invalid');
      }
      final entry = Map<String, dynamic>.from(rawEntry);
      final id = _requiredToken(entry['contentId']);
      if (result.containsKey(id)) {
        throw const FormatException('audio_manifest_duplicate_content_id');
      }

      final variants = <AudioVariant, String>{};
      _addVariant(variants, AudioVariant.word, entry['word']);
      _addVariant(variants, AudioVariant.sentence, entry['sentence']);
      _addVariant(variants, AudioVariant.pronunciation, entry['pronunciation']);
      result[id] = Map<AudioVariant, String>.unmodifiable(variants);
    }

    return AudioManifestCatalog._(
      baseAssetPath: _safeBase(baseAssetPath),
      entries: Map<String, Map<AudioVariant, String>>.unmodifiable(result),
    );
  }

  final String baseAssetPath;
  final Map<String, Map<AudioVariant, String>> _entries;

  @override
  String? recordedAssetFor({
    required String conceptId,
    required AudioVariant variant,
  }) {
    final variants = _entries[conceptId];
    if (variants == null) return null;
    final relative = variants[variant] ??
        (variant == AudioVariant.pronunciation
            ? variants[AudioVariant.word]
            : null);
    if (relative == null) return null;
    return baseAssetPath + '/' + relative;
  }

  static void _addVariant(
    Map<AudioVariant, String> variants,
    AudioVariant variant,
    Object? raw,
  ) {
    if (raw == null) return;
    final value = _safeRelativeAudioPath(raw);
    variants[variant] = value;
  }

  static String _requiredToken(Object? raw) {
    if (raw is! String) {
      throw const FormatException('audio_manifest_content_id_invalid');
    }
    final value = raw.trim();
    if (value.isEmpty || value.length > 160) {
      throw const FormatException('audio_manifest_content_id_invalid');
    }
    return value;
  }

  static String _safeBase(String raw) {
    final value = raw.trim().replaceAll('\\', '/');
    if (value.isEmpty ||
        value.startsWith('/') ||
        value.contains('../') ||
        value.contains('/..') ||
        value.contains('//')) {
      throw const FormatException('audio_manifest_base_path_invalid');
    }
    return value.endsWith('/') ? value.substring(0, value.length - 1) : value;
  }

  static String _safeRelativeAudioPath(Object? raw) {
    if (raw is! String) {
      throw const FormatException('audio_manifest_path_invalid');
    }
    final value = raw.trim().replaceAll('\\', '/');
    if (value.isEmpty ||
        value.startsWith('/') ||
        value.contains('../') ||
        value.contains('/..') ||
        value.contains('//')) {
      throw const FormatException('audio_manifest_path_invalid');
    }
    final lower = value.toLowerCase();
    const allowed = <String>{'.aac', '.flac', '.m4a', '.mp3', '.ogg', '.wav'};
    if (!allowed.any(lower.endsWith)) {
      throw const FormatException('audio_manifest_extension_invalid');
    }
    return value;
  }
}

class AudioTrack {
  final String id;
  final String assetPath;
  final String languageCode;
  final int durationMs;
  final bool hasLocalFallback;

  const AudioTrack({
    required this.id,
    required this.assetPath,
    required this.languageCode,
    required this.durationMs,
    required this.hasLocalFallback,
  });

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) {
    if (identical(this, other)) return true;

    return other is AudioTrack &&
        other.id == id &&
        other.assetPath == assetPath &&
        other.languageCode == languageCode &&
        other.durationMs == durationMs &&
        other.hasLocalFallback == hasLocalFallback;
  }

  @override
  int get hashCode {
    return id.hashCode ^
        assetPath.hashCode ^
        languageCode.hashCode ^
        durationMs.hashCode ^
        hasLocalFallback.hashCode;
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/audio/domain/resolvers/audio_path_resolver.dart

class AudioPathResolver {
  static const String _baseAssetPath = 'assets/audio';

  /// Resolves the local asset path for a given concept ID and language code.
  ///
  /// Returns null if the conceptId or languageCode is null or empty, allowing
  /// for graceful fallback without application crashes.
  ///
  /// It sanitizes the conceptId to prevent irregular characters or directory
  /// traversal issues.
  String? resolvePath(String? conceptId, String? languageCode) {
    if (conceptId == null || conceptId.trim().isEmpty) return null;
    if (languageCode == null || languageCode.trim().isEmpty) return null;

    final sanitizedConceptId = _sanitize(conceptId);
    if (sanitizedConceptId.isEmpty) return null;

    final sanitizedLanguageCode = _sanitize(languageCode);
    if (sanitizedLanguageCode.isEmpty) return null;

    return '$_baseAssetPath/$sanitizedLanguageCode/$sanitizedConceptId.mp3';
  }

  /// Sanitizes input strings by removing path traversal characters
  /// and potentially harmful irregular characters.
  String _sanitize(String input) {
    // Basic sanitization: allow only alphanumeric characters, dashes, and underscores.
    // Replace anything else with an empty string.
    return input.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]'), '').toLowerCase();
  }
}

--------------------------------------------------
FILE: lib/features/audio/offline_audio_runtime.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'dart:async';

import '../../language/language_speech_profile.dart';
import 'domain/entities/audio_playback_result.dart';
import 'domain/entities/audio_playback_state.dart';
import 'domain/entities/audio_request.dart';
import 'domain/services/audio_catalog.dart';
import 'domain/services/i_audio_runtime.dart';
import 'domain/services/offline_tts_engine.dart';
import 'domain/services/recorded_audio_player.dart';

final class OfflineAudioRuntime implements IAudioRuntime {
  OfflineAudioRuntime({
    required this.speechProfile,
    required this.ttsEngine,
    this.catalog = const EmptyAudioCatalog(),
    this.recordedPlayer = const UnavailableRecordedAudioPlayer(),
    this.speechRateProvider,
  });

  final LanguageSpeechProfile speechProfile;
  final OfflineTtsEngine ttsEngine;
  final AudioCatalog catalog;
  final RecordedAudioPlayer recordedPlayer;
  final double Function()? speechRateProvider;

  final StreamController<AudioPlaybackState> _states =
      StreamController<AudioPlaybackState>.broadcast();
  Future<void> _tail = Future<void>.value();
  int _generation = 0;
  bool _closed = false;

  @override
  Stream<AudioPlaybackState> get playbackStateStream => _states.stream;

  @override
  Future<AudioPlaybackResult> play(AudioRequest request) async {
    if (_closed) {
      return const AudioPlaybackResult.unavailable('audio_runtime_closed');
    }
    if (!request.hasText) {
      return const AudioPlaybackResult.unavailable('audio_text_empty');
    }
    if (!_sameLanguage(request.languageCode, speechProfile.languageCode)) {
      return const AudioPlaybackResult.unavailable(
        'audio_language_profile_mismatch',
      );
    }

    final generation = ++_generation;
    final completer = Completer<AudioPlaybackResult>();
    final next = _tail.then((_) async {
      if (_closed || generation != _generation) {
        completer.complete(
          const AudioPlaybackResult.unavailable('audio_request_superseded'),
        );
        return;
      }
      _emit(AudioPlaybackState.loading);

      final conceptId = request.conceptId?.trim();
      if (conceptId != null && conceptId.isNotEmpty) {
        final asset = catalog.recordedAssetFor(
          conceptId: conceptId,
          variant: request.variant,
        );
        if (asset != null) {
          try {
            _emit(AudioPlaybackState.playing);
            if (await recordedPlayer.playAsset(asset)) {
              _emit(AudioPlaybackState.completed);
              _emit(AudioPlaybackState.idle);
              completer.complete(const AudioPlaybackResult.recorded());
              return;
            }
          } on Object {
            // A broken local asset may fall through to verified offline TTS.
          }
        }
      }

      if (_closed || generation != _generation) {
        _emit(AudioPlaybackState.idle);
        completer.complete(
          const AudioPlaybackResult.unavailable('audio_request_superseded'),
        );
        return;
      }

      final availability = await ttsEngine.probe(speechProfile);
      if (availability != OfflineTtsAvailability.ready) {
        _emit(AudioPlaybackState.error);
        completer.complete(
          const AudioPlaybackResult.unavailable(
            'offline_tts_voice_unavailable',
          ),
        );
        return;
      }

      _emit(AudioPlaybackState.playing);
      final spoken = await ttsEngine.speak(
        text: request.text.trim(),
        profile: speechProfile,
        rate: _resolveSpeechRate(request),
      );
      if (!spoken) {
        _emit(AudioPlaybackState.error);
        completer.complete(
          const AudioPlaybackResult.unavailable(
            'offline_tts_playback_failed',
          ),
        );
        return;
      }
      _emit(AudioPlaybackState.completed);
      _emit(AudioPlaybackState.idle);
      completer.complete(const AudioPlaybackResult.offlineTts());
    }).catchError((Object _) {
      if (!completer.isCompleted) {
        _emit(AudioPlaybackState.error);
        completer.complete(
          const AudioPlaybackResult.unavailable('audio_runtime_failure'),
        );
      }
    });
    _tail = next;
    return completer.future;
  }

  double _resolveSpeechRate(AudioRequest request) {
    try {
      final preferred = request.rate ??
          speechRateProvider?.call() ??
          speechProfile.defaultSpeechRate;
      return preferred.clamp(.1, 1.0).toDouble();
    } on Object {
      return speechProfile.defaultSpeechRate.clamp(.1, 1.0).toDouble();
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> stop() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    ++_generation;
    await Future.wait<void>(<Future<void>>[
      recordedPlayer.stop(),
      ttsEngine.stop(),
    ]);
    _emit(AudioPlaybackState.idle);
  }

  @override
  Future<void> shutdown() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    _closed = true;
    ++_generation;
    try {
      await Future.wait<void>(<Future<void>>[
        recordedPlayer.stop(),
        ttsEngine.stop(),
      ]);
      await _tail;
    } finally {
      await recordedPlayer.shutdown();
      await ttsEngine.shutdown();
      await _states.close();
    }
  }

  void _emit(AudioPlaybackState state) {
    if (!_closed && !_states.isClosed) {
      _states.add(state);
    }
  }

  bool _sameLanguage(String requested, String profile) {
    String base(String value) =>
        value.trim().toLowerCase().split(RegExp('[-_]')).first;
    return base(requested) == base(profile);
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/audio/hybrid_pronunciation_service.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'domain/entities/audio_playback_result.dart';
import 'domain/entities/audio_request.dart';
import 'domain/services/i_audio_runtime.dart';

/// General pronunciation entrypoint for V1.1.
///
/// Source selection remains owned by [IAudioRuntime]: a verified local
/// recording is preferred when the catalog has one; otherwise the runtime may
/// use only its native offline TTS fallback.
final class HybridPronunciationService {
  const HybridPronunciationService({
    required IAudioRuntime audioRuntime,
  }) : _audioRuntime = audioRuntime;

  static const int maxConceptIdLength = 160;
  static const int maxTextLength = 2000;

  final IAudioRuntime _audioRuntime;

  Future<AudioPlaybackResult> play({
    required String conceptId,
    required String text,
    required String languageCode,
    bool slow = false,
  }) {
    final id = conceptId.trim();
    final spoken = text.trim();
    final language = languageCode.trim();
    if (id.isEmpty ||
        id.length > maxConceptIdLength ||
        spoken.isEmpty ||
        spoken.length > maxTextLength ||
        language.isEmpty) {
      return Future<AudioPlaybackResult>.value(
        const AudioPlaybackResult.unavailable(
          'pronunciation_request_invalid',
        ),
      );
    }

    return _audioRuntime.play(
      AudioRequest(
        text: spoken,
        languageCode: language,
        conceptId: id,
        variant: AudioVariant.pronunciation,
        rate: slow ? .34 : .48,
      ),
    );
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/micro_context_stories/micro_context_stories.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/gestures.dart';

import '../../services/user_vocabulary_service.dart';

class MicroContextStory {
  final String title;
  final String storyText;
  final Map<String, String> vocabularyTranslations;

  const MicroContextStory({
    required this.title,
    required this.storyText,
    required this.vocabularyTranslations,
  });
}

class MicroContextStoriesEngine {
  final UserVocabularyService _vocabularyService;

  MicroContextStoriesEngine(this._vocabularyService);

  Future<MicroContextStory?> generateStoryForToday() async {
    final entries = await _vocabularyService.getCustomEntries();
    if (entries.isEmpty) {
      return null;
    }

    final now = DateTime.now();
    final todayStr =
        "${now.year}-${now.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${now.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}";

    // Filter for vocabulary created today
    final todayVocab = entries.where((e) {
      final createdAt = e['created_at'] as String?;
      return createdAt != null && createdAt.startsWith(todayStr);
    }).toList();

    // Fallback to recent 3 if no vocab today
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> selectedVocab = todayVocab.isNotEmpty
        ? todayVocab.take(3).toList()
        : entries.take(3).toList();

    if (selectedVocab.isEmpty) return null;

    final Map<String, String> translations = {};
    for (final v in selectedVocab) {
      translations[v['german_text'] as String] =
          v['arabic_translation'] as String;
    }

    final words = selectedVocab.map((e) => e['german_text'] as String).toList();

    String storyText;
    String title;

    if (words.length == 1) {
      title = "Eine kurze Geschichte über ${words[0]}";
      storyText =
          "Heute habe ich etwas Neues gelernt. Das Wort ist ${words[0]}. Es ist wichtig, ${words[0]} zu verstehen, um besser Deutsch zu sprechen.";
    } else if (words.length == 2) {
      title = "Die Geschichte von ${words[0]} und ${words[1]}";
      storyText =
          "Es war einmal ein Tag, an dem wir über ${words[0]} sprachen. Später lernten wir auch über ${words[1]}. Beide, ${words[0]} und ${words[1]}, sind sehr nützlich.";
    } else {
      title = "Ein Tag mit ${words[0]}, ${words[1]} und ${words[2]}";
      storyText =
          "Am Morgen dachte ich an ${words[0]}. Am Mittag benutzte ich ${words[1]}. Und am Abend war ${words[2]} sehr wichtig für mich. So war mein Tag.";
    }

    return MicroContextStory(
      title: title,
      storyText: storyText,
      vocabularyTranslations: translations,
    );
  }
}

class MicroContextStoriesView extends StatefulWidget {
  final MicroContextStoriesEngine engine;

  const MicroContextStoriesView({super.key, required this.engine});

  @override
  State<MicroContextStoriesView> createState() =>
      _MicroContextStoriesViewState();
}

class _MicroContextStoriesViewState extends State<MicroContextStoriesView> {
  MicroContextStory? _story;
  bool _loading = true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadStory();
  }

  Future<void> _loadStory() async {
    try {
      final story = await widget.engine.generateStoryForToday();
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _story = story;
          _loading = false;
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _loading = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  void _showTranslationDrawer(String germanWord, String arabicTranslation) {
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(20)),
      ),
      builder: (context) {
        return Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24.0),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Text(
                germanWord,
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall?.copyWith(
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary,
                    ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),

                arabicTranslation,
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 24),
              SizedBox(
                width: double.infinity,
                child: ElevatedButton(
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                  child: const Text('إغلاق'),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_loading) {
      return const Scaffold(body: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()));
    }

    if (_story == null) {
      return Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('قصص السياق الصغير')),
        body: const Center(
          child: Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.all(24.0),
            child: Text(
              'لا يوجد مفردات كافية لبناء قصة اليوم. قم بإضافة المزيد من المفردات في قسم المفردات الشخصية.',
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('قصة اليوم')),
      body: SingleChildScrollView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24.0),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text(
              _story!.title,
              style: Theme.of(context)
                  .textTheme
                  .headlineMedium
                  ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 24),
            _buildInteractiveStoryText(context),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildInteractiveStoryText(BuildContext context) {
    // Split text keeping the delimiters using capture group
    final parts = _story!.storyText.split(RegExp(r'(\b)'));

    final List<TextSpan> spans = [];

    for (final part in parts) {
      String? translation;
      bool isVocabulary = false;

      final cleanWord = part.trim();
      if (cleanWord.isNotEmpty) {
        for (final entry in _story!.vocabularyTranslations.entries) {
          if (cleanWord.toLowerCase() == entry.key.toLowerCase()) {
            isVocabulary = true;
            translation = entry.value;
            break;
          }
        }
      }

      if (isVocabulary) {
        spans.add(
          TextSpan(
            text: part,
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyLarge?.copyWith(
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary,
                  decoration: TextDecoration.underline,
                ),
            recognizer: TapGestureRecognizer()
              ..onTap = () => _showTranslationDrawer(cleanWord, translation!),
          ),
        );
      } else {
        spans.add(
          TextSpan(text: part, style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyLarge),
        );
      }
    }

    return RichText(text: TextSpan(children: spans));
  }
}

/// Domain-facing facade. Platform notification plugins stay behind
/// [NotificationServiceContract] implementations in Infrastructure.
final class OfflineNotificationScheduler
    implements NotificationSchedulerFacade {
  OfflineNotificationScheduler(this._service);

  final NotificationServiceContract _service;

  @override
  Future<void> initialize() => _service.initialize();

  @override
  Future<void> replaceSchedule(List<ScheduledNotificationItem> items) {
    return _service.replaceAll(
      List<ScheduledNotificationItem>.unmodifiable(items),
    );
  }

  @override
  Future<void> cancelAll() => _service.cancelAll();
}

abstract interface class NotificationRepository {

abstract interface class NotificationServiceContract {
  Future<void> initialize();
  Future<void> replaceAll(List<ScheduledNotificationItem> items);

enum NotificationTone {
  gentle('gentle'),
  classic('classic'),
  silent('silent');

  const NotificationTone(this.wireName);

  final String wireName;

  static NotificationTone fromWireName(String? value) {
    return NotificationTone.values.firstWhere(
      (tone) => tone.wireName == value,
      orElse: () => NotificationTone.gentle,
    );
  }
}

final class ScheduledNotificationItem {
  const ScheduledNotificationItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.title,
    required this.body,
    required this.scheduledAtLocal,
    required this.tone,
    this.repeatDaily = false,
    this.payload,
  });

  final int id;
  final String title;
  final String body;
  final DateTime scheduledAtLocal;
  final NotificationTone tone;
  final bool repeatDaily;
  final String? payload;
}

final class NotificationPreference {
  const NotificationPreference({
    this.preferredReminderMinutes = 19 * 60,
    this.dailyReminderEnabled = true,
    this.streakAlertEnabled = true,
    this.tone = NotificationTone.gentle,
  }) : assert(preferredReminderMinutes >= 0),
       assert(preferredReminderMinutes < 24 * 60);

  final int preferredReminderMinutes;
  final bool dailyReminderEnabled;
  final bool streakAlertEnabled;
  final NotificationTone tone;

  int get preferredHour => preferredReminderMinutes ~/ 60;
  int get preferredMinute => preferredReminderMinutes % 60;

  NotificationPreference copyWith({
    int? preferredReminderMinutes,
    bool? dailyReminderEnabled,
    bool? streakAlertEnabled,
    NotificationTone? tone,
  }) {
    return NotificationPreference(
      preferredReminderMinutes:
          (preferredReminderMinutes ?? this.preferredReminderMinutes)
              .clamp(0, (24 * 60) - 1)
              .toInt(),
      dailyReminderEnabled:
          dailyReminderEnabled ?? this.dailyReminderEnabled,
      streakAlertEnabled: streakAlertEnabled ?? this.streakAlertEnabled,
      tone: tone ?? this.tone,
    );
  }

  factory NotificationPreference.normalized({
    int? preferredReminderMinutes,
    bool? dailyReminderEnabled,
    bool? streakAlertEnabled,
    NotificationTone? tone,
  }) {
    return NotificationPreference(
      preferredReminderMinutes:
          (preferredReminderMinutes ?? 19 * 60)
              .clamp(0, (24 * 60) - 1)
              .toInt(),
      dailyReminderEnabled: dailyReminderEnabled ?? true,
      streakAlertEnabled: streakAlertEnabled ?? true,
      tone: tone ?? NotificationTone.gentle,
    );
  }
}

import '../domain/notification_contracts.dart';
import '../domain/notification_models.dart';

final class HabitReminderPlan {
  const HabitReminderPlan({
    required this.effectiveReminderMinutes,
    required this.items,
  });

  final int effectiveReminderMinutes;
  final List<ScheduledNotificationItem> items;
}

final class HabitReminderScheduler {
  HabitReminderScheduler(this._scheduler);

  static const int quietStartMinutes = 22 * 60;
  static const int quietEndMinutes = 7 * 60;
  static const int fallbackDaytimeMinutes = 8 * 60;

  final NotificationSchedulerFacade _scheduler;

  Future<HabitReminderPlan> reschedule({
    required NotificationPreference preference,
    required Iterable<DateTime> activityTimesUtc,
    required DateTime nowUtc,
    required int timezoneOffsetMinutes,
    int currentStreak = 0,
  }) async {
    if (!nowUtc.isUtc) {
      throw ArgumentError('nowUtc must be UTC');
    }
    await _scheduler.initialize();
    final safeOffset =
        timezoneOffsetMinutes.clamp(-840, 840).toInt();
    final activities = activityTimesUtc
        .where((value) => value.isUtc)
        .toList(growable: false);

    final effectiveMinutes = _effectiveReminderMinutes(
      preference,
      activities,
      safeOffset,
    );

    final items = <ScheduledNotificationItem>[];
    if (preference.dailyReminderEnabled) {
      items.add(
        ScheduledNotificationItem(
          id: 41001,
          title: 'وقت الألمانية',
          body: 'جلسة قصيرة اليوم تحافظ على تقدمك.',
          scheduledAtLocal: _nextLocalOccurrence(
            nowUtc,
            safeOffset,
            effectiveMinutes,
          ),
          tone: preference.tone,
          repeatDaily: true,
          payload: 'habit_daily',
        ),
      );
    }

    if (preference.streakAlertEnabled && currentStreak > 0) {
      final streakMinutes = _safeStreakMinutes(effectiveMinutes);
      items.add(
        ScheduledNotificationItem(
          id: 41002,
          title: 'حافظ على سلسلتك',
          body: 'سلسلتك الحالية $currentStreak يوم. مراجعة قصيرة تكفي.',
          scheduledAtLocal: _nextLocalOccurrence(
            nowUtc,
            safeOffset,
            streakMinutes,
          ),
          tone: preference.tone,
          repeatDaily: true,
          payload: 'streak_guard',
        ),
      );
    }

    if (items.isEmpty) {
      await _scheduler.cancelAll();
    } else {
      await _scheduler.replaceSchedule(items);
    }

    return HabitReminderPlan(
      effectiveReminderMinutes: effectiveMinutes,
      items: List<ScheduledNotificationItem>.unmodifiable(items),
    );
  }

  int _effectiveReminderMinutes(
    NotificationPreference preference,
    List<DateTime> activitiesUtc,
    int offsetMinutes,
  ) {
    if (activitiesUtc.length < 3) {
      return _avoidQuietHours(preference.preferredReminderMinutes);
    }

    final counts = <int, int>{};
    for (final utc in activitiesUtc) {
      final local = utc.add(Duration(minutes: offsetMinutes));
      final minute = local.hour * 60 + local.minute;
      final bucket = (minute ~/ 30) * 30;
      counts[bucket] = (counts[bucket] ?? 0) + 1;
    }

    final ranked = counts.entries.toList()
      ..sort((a, b) {
        final countOrder = b.value.compareTo(a.value);
        if (countOrder != 0) return countOrder;
        final aDistance =
            _circularDistance(a.key, preference.preferredReminderMinutes);
        final bDistance =
            _circularDistance(b.key, preference.preferredReminderMinutes);
        return aDistance.compareTo(bDistance);
      });

    return _avoidQuietHours(ranked.first.key);
  }

  static int _circularDistance(int a, int b) {
    final distance = (a - b).abs();
    return distance > 12 * 60 ? (24 * 60) - distance : distance;
  }

  static int _avoidQuietHours(int minutes) {
    final normalized = minutes.clamp(0, (24 * 60) - 1).toInt();
    if (normalized >= quietStartMinutes ||
        normalized < quietEndMinutes) {
      return fallbackDaytimeMinutes;
    }
    return normalized;
  }

  static int _safeStreakMinutes(int habitMinutes) {
    final candidate = habitMinutes < 18 * 60
        ? 18 * 60
        : habitMinutes + 90;
    return candidate.clamp(18 * 60, (21 * 60) + 30).toInt();
  }

  static DateTime _nextLocalOccurrence(
    DateTime nowUtc,
    int offsetMinutes,
    int minutesSinceMidnight,
  ) {
    final localNow = nowUtc.add(Duration(minutes: offsetMinutes));
    var scheduled = DateTime(
      localNow.year,
      localNow.month,
      localNow.day,
      minutesSinceMidnight ~/ 60,
      minutesSinceMidnight % 60,
    );
    if (!scheduled.isAfter(localNow)) {
      scheduled = scheduled.add(const Duration(days: 1));
    }
    return scheduled;
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import '../domain/notification_contracts.dart';
import '../domain/notification_models.dart';

final class NotificationSettingsState {
  const NotificationSettingsState({
    required this.preference,
    this.isSaving = false,
  });

  final NotificationPreference preference;
  final bool isSaving;

  NotificationSettingsState copyWith({
    NotificationPreference? preference,
    bool? isSaving,
  }) {
    return NotificationSettingsState(
      preference: preference ?? this.preference,
      isSaving: isSaving ?? this.isSaving,
    );
  }
}

final class NotificationSettingsNotifier {
  NotificationSettingsNotifier(this._repository)
      : _state = const NotificationSettingsState(
          preference: NotificationPreference(),
        );

  final NotificationRepository _repository;
  final StreamController<NotificationSettingsState> _changes =
      StreamController<NotificationSettingsState>.broadcast();

  NotificationSettingsState _state;
  bool _disposed = false;

  NotificationSettingsState get state => _state;
  Stream<NotificationSettingsState> get changes => _changes.stream;

  Future<NotificationSettingsState> initialize() async {
    _ensureActive();
    final preference = await _repository.loadPreference();
    _emit(NotificationSettingsState(preference: preference));
    return _state;
  }

  Future<void> setDailyReminderEnabled(bool enabled) {
    return _persist(
      _state.preference.copyWith(dailyReminderEnabled: enabled),
    );
  }

  Future<void> setStreakAlertEnabled(bool enabled) {
    return _persist(
      _state.preference.copyWith(streakAlertEnabled: enabled),
    );
  }

  Future<void> setReminderMinutes(int minutes) {
    return _persist(
      _state.preference.copyWith(preferredReminderMinutes: minutes),
    );
  }

  Future<void> setTone(NotificationTone tone) {
    return _persist(_state.preference.copyWith(tone: tone));
  }

  Future<void> _persist(NotificationPreference next) async {
    _ensureActive();
    final previous = _state.preference;
    _emit(NotificationSettingsState(
      preference: next,
      isSaving: true,
    ));
    try {
      await _repository.savePreference(next);
      _emit(NotificationSettingsState(preference: next));
    } catch (_) {
      _emit(NotificationSettingsState(preference: previous));
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<void> dispose() async {
    if (_disposed) return;
    _disposed = true;
    await _changes.close();
  }

  void _emit(NotificationSettingsState next) {
    _state = next;
    if (!_changes.isClosed) _changes.add(next);
  }

  void _ensureActive() {
    if (_disposed) {
      throw StateError('NotificationSettingsNotifier is disposed');
    }
  }
}

import '../../../core/infrastructure/storage/local_storage_repository.dart';
import '../domain/notification_contracts.dart';
import '../domain/notification_models.dart';

final class LocalNotificationRepository implements NotificationRepository {
  LocalNotificationRepository(this._storage);

  final LocalStorageRepository _storage;

  @override
  Future<NotificationPreference> loadPreference() async {
    final payload =
        await _storage.load(StorageBucket.notificationPreferences);
    if (payload == null) return const NotificationPreference();

    final rawMinutes = payload['preferred_reminder_minutes'];
    final minutes = rawMinutes is num
        ? rawMinutes.toInt()
        : int.tryParse(rawMinutes?.toString() ?? '');

    return NotificationPreference.normalized(
      preferredReminderMinutes: minutes,
      dailyReminderEnabled: payload['daily_reminder_enabled'] is bool
          ? payload['daily_reminder_enabled'] as bool
          : null,
      streakAlertEnabled: payload['streak_alert_enabled'] is bool
          ? payload['streak_alert_enabled'] as bool
          : null,
      tone: NotificationTone.fromWireName(
        payload['tone']?.toString(),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Future<void> savePreference(NotificationPreference preference) {
    return _storage.save(
      StorageBucket.notificationPreferences,
      <String, Object?>{
        'schema_version': 1,
        'preferred_reminder_minutes':
            preference.preferredReminderMinutes,
        'daily_reminder_enabled': preference.dailyReminderEnabled,
        'streak_alert_enabled': preference.streakAlertEnabled,
        'tone': preference.tone.wireName,
      },
    );
  }
}
