import 'package:sqflite_common/sqlite_api.dart';

import '../../../../services/sqlite_policy.dart';

import '../models/milestone_badge.dart';

class StreakMilestonesEngine {
  static const String _milestonesTable = 'streak_milestones';
  static const String _columnId = 'id';
  static const String _columnTitle = 'title';
  static const String _columnDescription = 'description';
  static const String _columnRequiredDays = 'required_days';
  static const String _columnUnlockedAt = 'unlocked_at';

  static const String _studyDaysTable = 'study_days';
  static const String _columnDate = 'date';

  static final StreakMilestonesEngine instance = StreakMilestonesEngine._init();
  static Database? _database;
  static const AppSqlitePolicy _sqlitePolicy = AppSqlitePolicy();

  StreakMilestonesEngine._init();

  Future<Database> get database async {
    if (_database != null) return _database!;
    _database = await _initDB('streak_tracking.db');
    return _database!;
  }

  Future<Database> _initDB(String filePath) async {
    final path = await _sqlitePolicy.resolvePath(fileName: filePath);
    return _sqlitePolicy.openWritable(
      path: path,
      version: 1,
      onCreate: _createDB,
    );
  }

  Future _createDB(Database db, int version) async {
    await db.execute('''
      CREATE TABLE $_milestonesTable (
        $_columnId TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        $_columnTitle TEXT NOT NULL,
        $_columnDescription TEXT NOT NULL,
        $_columnRequiredDays INTEGER NOT NULL,
        $_columnUnlockedAt TEXT NOT NULL
      )
    ''');

    await db.execute('''
      CREATE TABLE $_studyDaysTable (
        $_columnDate TEXT PRIMARY KEY
      )
    ''');
  }

  String _formatDate(DateTime date) {
    return '${date.year}-${date.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${date.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
  }

  Future<void> logStudyDay(DateTime date) async {
    final db = await database;
    final dateString = _formatDate(date);

    await db.insert(
        _studyDaysTable,
        {
          _columnDate: dateString,
        },
        conflictAlgorithm: ConflictAlgorithm.ignore);

    final streak = await calculateCurrentStreak();
    await checkAndUnlockMilestones(streak);
  }

  Future<int> calculateCurrentStreak() async {
    final db = await database;
    final maps = await db.query(_studyDaysTable, orderBy: '$_columnDate DESC');

    if (maps.isEmpty) return 0;

    int streak = 0;
    DateTime? expectedDate;
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final today = DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day);
    final yesterday = DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day - 1);

    for (final map in maps) {
      final loggedDateStr = map[_columnDate] as String;

      if (streak == 0 && loggedDateStr == _formatDate(today)) {
        streak++;
        expectedDate = yesterday;
      } else if (streak == 0 && loggedDateStr == _formatDate(yesterday)) {
        streak++;
        expectedDate = DateTime(
          yesterday.year,
          yesterday.month,
          yesterday.day - 1,
        );
      } else if (expectedDate != null &&
          loggedDateStr == _formatDate(expectedDate)) {
        streak++;
        expectedDate = DateTime(
          expectedDate.year,
          expectedDate.month,
          expectedDate.day - 1,
        );
      } else {
        break;
      }
    }

    return streak;
  }

  Future<List<MilestoneBadge>> getUnlockedBadges() async {
    final db = await database;
    final maps = await db.query(
      _milestonesTable,
      orderBy: '$_columnRequiredDays ASC',
    );

    return maps
        .map(
          (map) => MilestoneBadge(
            id: map[_columnId] as String,
            title: map[_columnTitle] as String,
            description: map[_columnDescription] as String,
            requiredStreakDays: map[_columnRequiredDays] as int,
            unlockedAt: DateTime.parse(map[_columnUnlockedAt] as String),
          ),
        )
        .toList();
  }

  Future<void> checkAndUnlockMilestones(int currentStreakDays) async {
    final db = await database;

    final milestonesToUnlock = _getAvailableMilestones()
        .where((m) => m.requiredStreakDays <= currentStreakDays)
        .toList();

    await db.transaction((txn) async {
      for (final milestone in milestonesToUnlock) {
        final existing = await txn.query(
          _milestonesTable,
          where: '$_columnId = ?',
          whereArgs: [milestone.id],
        );

        if (existing.isEmpty) {
          await txn.insert(_milestonesTable, {
            _columnId: milestone.id,
            _columnTitle: milestone.title,
            _columnDescription: milestone.description,
            _columnRequiredDays: milestone.requiredStreakDays,
            _columnUnlockedAt: DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
          });
        }
      }
    });
  }

  List<MilestoneBadge> _getAvailableMilestones() {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    return [
      MilestoneBadge(
        id: 'streak_3',
        title: 'البداية الجيدة',
        description: 'دراسة لمدة 3 أيام متتالية',
        requiredStreakDays: 3,
        unlockedAt: now,
      ),
      MilestoneBadge(
        id: 'streak_7',
        title: 'مواظب أسبوعي',
        description: 'دراسة لمدة 7 أيام متتالية',
        requiredStreakDays: 7,
        unlockedAt: now,
      ),
      MilestoneBadge(
        id: 'streak_14',
        title: 'عزيمة حديدية',
        description: 'دراسة لمدة 14 يوم متتالية',
        requiredStreakDays: 14,
        unlockedAt: now,
      ),
      MilestoneBadge(
        id: 'streak_30',
        title: 'بطل الشهر',
        description: 'دراسة لمدة 30 يوم متتالية',
        requiredStreakDays: 30,
        unlockedAt: now,
      ),
    ];
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    if (_database != null) {
      await _database!.close();
      _database = null;
    }
  }
}

import 'package:sqflite_common/sqlite_api.dart';

import '../../../services/database_migration_helper.dart';
import '../../../services/sqlite_policy.dart';

class ReverseQuizDatabase {
  static const String _dbName = 'reverse_quiz.db';
  static const String _flashcardsTable = 'flashcards';
  static const String _attemptsTable = 'quiz_attempts';

  Database? _db;
  final DatabaseFactory? _dbFactory;
  final AppSqlitePolicy _sqlitePolicy;
  final String? _inMemoryPath;

  ReverseQuizDatabase({DatabaseFactory? factory, String? path})
      : _dbFactory = factory,
        _sqlitePolicy = AppSqlitePolicy(factory: factory),
        _inMemoryPath = path;

  Future<Database> get database async {
    if (_db != null) return _db!;
    _db = await _initDB();
    return _db!;
  }

  Future<Database> _initDB() async {
    final path = await _sqlitePolicy.resolvePath(
      fileName: _dbName,
      overridePath: _inMemoryPath,
    );
    return DatabaseMigrationHelper.open(
      path: path,
      version: 1,
      onCreate: _createDB,
      migrationScripts: const <int, List<String>>{},
      factory: _dbFactory,
    );
  }

  Future _createDB(Database db, int version) async {
    await db.execute('''
      CREATE TABLE $_flashcardsTable (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        conceptId TEXT NOT NULL,
        german TEXT NOT NULL,
        arabic TEXT NOT NULL
      )
    ''');

    await db.execute('''
      CREATE TABLE $_attemptsTable (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        cardId TEXT NOT NULL,
        isCorrect INTEGER NOT NULL,
        timestamp INTEGER NOT NULL,
        FOREIGN KEY (cardId) REFERENCES $_flashcardsTable (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
      )
    ''');
  }

  Future<void> insertFlashcards(List<Map<String, dynamic>> cards) async {
    final db = await database;
    await DatabaseMigrationHelper.executeAtomic(db, (txn) async {
      for (final card in cards) {
        await txn.insert(
          _flashcardsTable,
          card,
          conflictAlgorithm: ConflictAlgorithm.replace,
        );
      }
    });
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> getRandomFlashcards(int count) async {
    final db = await database;
    return await db.query(_flashcardsTable, orderBy: 'RANDOM()', limit: count);
  }

  Future<void> recordAttempt(Map<String, dynamic> attempt) async {
    final db = await database;
    await DatabaseMigrationHelper.executeAtomic(db, (txn) async {
      await txn.insert(
        _attemptsTable,
        attempt,
        conflictAlgorithm: ConflictAlgorithm.replace,
      );
    });
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    final db = await database;
    db.close();
    _db = null;
  }
}

class ReverseQuizItem {
  final String id;
  final String conceptId;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;

  const ReverseQuizItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.conceptId,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
  });

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() {
    return {
      'id': id,
      'conceptId': conceptId,
      'german': german,
      'arabic': arabic,
    };
  }

  factory ReverseQuizItem.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    return ReverseQuizItem(
      id: map['id'] as String,
      conceptId: map['conceptId'] as String,
      german: map['german'] as String,
      arabic: map['arabic'] as String,
    );
  }
}

class ReverseQuizAttempt {
  final String id;
  final String cardId;
  final bool isCorrect;
  final DateTime timestamp;

  const ReverseQuizAttempt({
    required this.id,
    required this.cardId,
    required this.isCorrect,
    required this.timestamp,
  });

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() {
    return {
      'id': id,
      'cardId': cardId,
      'isCorrect': isCorrect ? 1 : 0,
      'timestamp': timestamp.millisecondsSinceEpoch,
    };
  }

  factory ReverseQuizAttempt.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    return ReverseQuizAttempt(
      id: map['id'] as String,
      cardId: map['cardId'] as String,
      isCorrect: (map['isCorrect'] as int) == 1,
      timestamp: DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(map['timestamp'] as int),
    );
  }
}

import 'data/database.dart';
import 'domain/models.dart';

class ReverseQuizMode {
  final ReverseQuizDatabase _database;

  ReverseQuizMode(this._database);

  Future<void> initialize(List<ReverseQuizItem> initialCards) async {
    final mappedCards = initialCards.map((card) => card.toMap()).toList();
    await _database.insertFlashcards(mappedCards);
  }

  Future<List<ReverseQuizItem>> fetchQuizItems(int count) async {
    final records = await _database.getRandomFlashcards(count);
    return records.map((record) => ReverseQuizItem.fromMap(record)).toList();
  }

  Future<void> submitAnswer(String cardId, bool isCorrect) async {
    final attempt = ReverseQuizAttempt(
      id: 'attempt_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}',
      cardId: cardId,
      isCorrect: isCorrect,
      timestamp: DateTime.now(),
    );
    await _database.recordAttempt(attempt.toMap());
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    await _database.close();
  }
}

import 'dart:ui';

import 'package:sqflite_common/sqlite_api.dart';

import '../../services/sqlite_policy.dart';

enum GrammaticalClass {
  masculineNoun,
  feminineNoun,
  neuterNoun,
  pluralNoun,
  verb,
  adjective,
  other,
}

class SemanticColorTagging {
  static const Color masculineColor = Color(0xFF2563EB); // Slate Blue
  static const Color feminineColor = Color(0xFFE11D48); // Soft Crimson
  static const Color neuterColor = Color(0xFF0D9488); // Deep Teal
  static const Color pluralColor = Color(0xFF7C3AED); // Muted Violet
  static const Color defaultColor = Color(0xFF64748B); // Slate

  static const String _dbName = 'semantic_color_tags.db';
  static const String _tableName = 'semantic_tags';

  Database? _db;
  final AppSqlitePolicy _sqlitePolicy;
  final String? _inMemoryPath;

  SemanticColorTagging({DatabaseFactory? factory, String? path})
      : _sqlitePolicy = AppSqlitePolicy(factory: factory),
        _inMemoryPath = path;

  Future<Database> get database async {
    if (_db != null) return _db!;
    _db = await _initDB();
    return _db!;
  }

  Future<Database> _initDB() async {
    final path = await _sqlitePolicy.resolvePath(
      fileName: _dbName,
      overridePath: _inMemoryPath,
    );
    return _sqlitePolicy.openWritable(
      path: path,
      version: 1,
      onCreate: _createDB,
    );
  }

  Future _createDB(Database db, int version) async {
    await db.execute('''
      CREATE TABLE $_tableName (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        word TEXT NOT NULL,
        grammaticalClass TEXT NOT NULL,
        colorHex INTEGER NOT NULL
      )
    ''');
  }

  GrammaticalClass determineClass(String article, String word) {
    if (article == 'der') return GrammaticalClass.masculineNoun;
    if (article == 'die') return GrammaticalClass.feminineNoun;
    if (article == 'das') return GrammaticalClass.neuterNoun;

    if (word.isNotEmpty && word.endsWith('en') && word.toLowerCase() == word) {
      return GrammaticalClass.verb;
    }

    return GrammaticalClass.other;
  }

  Color getColorForClass(GrammaticalClass gClass) {
    switch (gClass) {
      case GrammaticalClass.masculineNoun:
        return masculineColor;
      case GrammaticalClass.feminineNoun:
        return feminineColor;
      case GrammaticalClass.neuterNoun:
        return neuterColor;
      case GrammaticalClass.pluralNoun:
        return pluralColor;
      default:
        return defaultColor;
    }
  }

  Future<void> tagAndSaveWord(
    String id,
    String word,
    String article, {
    bool isPlural = false,
  }) async {
    final gClass =
        isPlural ? GrammaticalClass.pluralNoun : determineClass(article, word);
    final color = getColorForClass(gClass);

    final db = await database;
    await db.insert(
        _tableName,
        {
          'id': id,
          'word': word,
          'grammaticalClass': gClass.name,
          'colorHex': color.toARGB32(),
        },
        conflictAlgorithm: ConflictAlgorithm.replace);
  }

  Future<Color> getColorForWord(String id) async {
    final db = await database;
    final maps = await db.query(
      _tableName,
      columns: ['colorHex'],
      where: 'id = ?',
      whereArgs: [id],
    );

    if (maps.isNotEmpty) {
      return Color(maps.first['colorHex'] as int);
    }
    return defaultColor;
  }

  Future<GrammaticalClass> getGrammaticalClassForWord(String id) async {
    final db = await database;
    final maps = await db.query(
      _tableName,
      columns: ['grammaticalClass'],
      where: 'id = ?',
      whereArgs: [id],
    );

    if (maps.isNotEmpty) {
      final className = maps.first['grammaticalClass'] as String;
      return GrammaticalClass.values.firstWhere(
        (e) => e.name == className,
        orElse: () => GrammaticalClass.other,
      );
    }
    return GrammaticalClass.other;
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    if (_db != null) {
      await _db!.close();
      _db = null;
    }
  }
}

class PuzzleItem {
  final String id;
  final String conceptId;
  final String germanSentence;
  final String arabicSentence;

  const PuzzleItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.conceptId,
    required this.germanSentence,
    required this.arabicSentence,
  });

  List<String> get scrambledWords {
    final words = germanSentence
        .split(RegExp(r'\s+'))
        .map((w) => w.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^\wäöüßÄÖÜ]'), ''))
        .where((w) => w.isNotEmpty)
        .toList();
    words.shuffle();
    return words;
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() {
    return {
      'id': id,
      'conceptId': conceptId,
      'germanSentence': germanSentence,
      'arabicSentence': arabicSentence,
    };
  }

  factory PuzzleItem.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    return PuzzleItem(
      id: map['id'] as String,
      conceptId: map['conceptId'] as String,
      germanSentence: map['germanSentence'] as String,
      arabicSentence: map['arabicSentence'] as String,
    );
  }
}

class PuzzleAttempt {
  final String id;
  final String puzzleId;
  final bool isCorrect;
  final DateTime timestamp;
  final int timeTakenMs;

  const PuzzleAttempt({
    required this.id,
    required this.puzzleId,
    required this.isCorrect,
    required this.timestamp,
    required this.timeTakenMs,
  });

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() {
    return {
      'id': id,
      'puzzleId': puzzleId,
      'isCorrect': isCorrect ? 1 : 0,
      'timestamp': timestamp.millisecondsSinceEpoch,
      'timeTakenMs': timeTakenMs,
    };
  }

  factory PuzzleAttempt.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    return PuzzleAttempt(
      id: map['id'] as String,
      puzzleId: map['puzzleId'] as String,
      isCorrect: (map['isCorrect'] as int) == 1,
      timestamp: DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(map['timestamp'] as int),
      timeTakenMs: map['timeTakenMs'] as int,
    );
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/sentence_bridge_puzzle/presentation/sentence_bridge_puzzle.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../domain/models.dart';
import '../data/database.dart';

class SentenceBridgePuzzleWidget extends StatefulWidget {
  final SentenceBridgeDatabase database;

  const SentenceBridgePuzzleWidget({super.key, required this.database});

  @override
  State<SentenceBridgePuzzleWidget> createState() =>
      _SentenceBridgePuzzleWidgetState();
}

class _SentenceBridgePuzzleWidgetState
    extends State<SentenceBridgePuzzleWidget> {
  PuzzleItem? _currentPuzzle;
  List<String> _scrambledWords = [];
  List<String> _assembledWords = [];
  bool _isLoading = true;
  String? _feedbackMessage;
  DateTime? _startTime;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadRandomPuzzle();
  }

  Future<void> _loadRandomPuzzle() async {
    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
      _feedbackMessage = null;
    });

    final puzzles = await widget.database.getRandomPuzzles(1);
    if (puzzles.isNotEmpty) {
      final item = PuzzleItem.fromMap(puzzles.first);
      setState(() {
        _currentPuzzle = item;
        _scrambledWords = item.scrambledWords;
        _assembledWords = [];
        _isLoading = false;
        _startTime = DateTime.now();
      });
    } else {
      setState(() {
        _isLoading = false;
        _feedbackMessage = "No puzzles available.";
      });
    }
  }

  void _onWordTapped(String word, bool isFromAssembled) {
    setState(() {
      if (isFromAssembled) {
        _assembledWords.remove(word);
        _scrambledWords.add(word);
      } else {
        _scrambledWords.remove(word);
        _assembledWords.add(word);
      }
    });
  }

  Future<void> _checkAnswer() async {
    if (_currentPuzzle == null || _startTime == null) return;

    final originalSentence = _currentPuzzle!.germanSentence
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^\wäöüßÄÖÜ\s]'), '')
        .trim();
    final assembledSentence = _assembledWords.join(' ').trim();

    final isCorrect =
        originalSentence.toLowerCase() == assembledSentence.toLowerCase();

    final timeTakenMs = DateTime.now().difference(_startTime!).inMilliseconds;

    final attempt = PuzzleAttempt(
      id: DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch.toString(),
      puzzleId: _currentPuzzle!.id,
      isCorrect: isCorrect,
      timestamp: DateTime.now(),
      timeTakenMs: timeTakenMs,
    );

    await widget.database.recordAttempt(attempt.toMap());

    setState(() {
      if (isCorrect) {
        _feedbackMessage = "Correct!";
      } else {
        _feedbackMessage = "Incorrect. Try again!";
      }
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_isLoading) {
      return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
    }

    if (_currentPuzzle == null) {
      return Center(child: Text(_feedbackMessage ?? "Unknown error"));
    }

    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          Text(
            "Translate this sentence:",
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge,
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
            ),
            child: Text(
              _currentPuzzle!.arabicSentence,
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall,
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 32),
          Container(
            constraints: const BoxConstraints(minHeight: 100),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              border: Border.all(color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.outline),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
            ),
            child: Wrap(
              spacing: 8,
              runSpacing: 8,
              children: _assembledWords
                  .map((word) => _buildWordChip(word, true))
                  .toList(),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 32),
          Wrap(
            spacing: 8,
            runSpacing: 8,
            alignment: WrapAlignment.center,
            children: _scrambledWords
                .map((word) => _buildWordChip(word, false))
                .toList(),
          ),
          const Spacer(),
          if (_feedbackMessage != null) ...[
            Text(
              _feedbackMessage!,
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: TextStyle(
                color:
                    _feedbackMessage == "Correct!" ? Colors.green : Colors.red,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                fontSize: 18,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
          ],
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceEvenly,
            children: [
              ElevatedButton(
                onPressed: _scrambledWords.isEmpty ? _checkAnswer : null,
                child: const Text('Check'),
              ),
              if (_feedbackMessage == "Correct!")
                ElevatedButton(
                  onPressed: _loadRandomPuzzle,
                  child: const Text('Next Puzzle'),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildWordChip(String word, bool isFromAssembled) {
    return ActionChip(
      label: Text(word),
      onPressed: () => _onWordTapped(word, isFromAssembled),
      backgroundColor: isFromAssembled
          ? Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primaryContainer
          : Theme.of(context).colorScheme.secondaryContainer,
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/study_session.dart';
import '../domain/models.dart';
import '../domain/cognitive_overload_shield.dart';

class StudySessionController extends ChangeNotifier {
  final StudySession session;
  final CognitiveOverloadShield shield;

  bool _isPaused = false;
  String? _interventionPrompt;

  StudySessionController({
    required this.session,
    CognitiveOverloadShield? shield,
  }) : shield = shield ?? const CognitiveOverloadShield();

  bool get isPaused => _isPaused;
  String? get interventionPrompt => _interventionPrompt;
  Flashcard? get currentCard {
    if (session.activeQueue.isEmpty ||
        session.currentCardIndex >= session.activeQueue.length) {
      return null;
    }
    return session.activeQueue[session.currentCardIndex];
  }

  void startSession({
    required List<Flashcard> dueCards,
    required List<Flashcard> newCards,
  }) {
    session.startSession(dueCards: dueCards, newCards: newCards);
    _isPaused = false;
    _interventionPrompt = null;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void submitAnswer(Rating rating) {
    if (_isPaused || currentCard == null) return;

    session.submitAnswer(card: currentCard!, rating: rating);

    if (shield.isOverloaded(
      totalAnswers: session.currentCardIndex,
      correctAnswers: session.correctAnswers,
    )) {
      _isPaused = true;
      _interventionPrompt =
          'You seem to be getting tired. Let\'s take a short break to rest your mind and cement what you\'ve learned.';
    }

    notifyListeners();
  }

  void resumeSession() {
    if (!_isPaused) return;

    _isPaused = false;
    _interventionPrompt = null;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

class CognitiveOverloadShield {
  final double thresholdAccuracy;
  final int minimumAnswersBeforeCheck;

  const CognitiveOverloadShield({
    this.thresholdAccuracy = 0.60,
    this.minimumAnswersBeforeCheck = 10,
  });

  bool isOverloaded({required int totalAnswers, required int correctAnswers}) {
    if (totalAnswers < minimumAnswersBeforeCheck) {
      return false;
    }

    final accuracy = correctAnswers / totalAnswers;
    return accuracy < thresholdAccuracy;
  }
}

  final double accuracyPercentage;
  final int timeSpentSeconds;

  const SessionResult({
    required this.totalReviewed,
    required this.accuracyPercentage,
    required this.timeSpentSeconds,

import 'models.dart';

class StudySession {
  final String sessionId;
  final DateTime startTime;
  final int dailyNewCardsQuota;
  final int dailyReviewLimit;

  final List<Flashcard> activeQueue = [];
  final List<Flashcard> completedCards = [];

  int currentCardIndex = 0;
  int _correctAnswers = 0;

  int get correctAnswers => _correctAnswers;

  StudySession({
    required this.sessionId,
    required this.startTime,
    this.dailyNewCardsQuota = 10,
    this.dailyReviewLimit = 50,
  });

  void startSession({
    required List<Flashcard> dueCards,
    required List<Flashcard> newCards,
  }) {
    activeQueue.clear();
    completedCards.clear();
    currentCardIndex = 0;
    _correctAnswers = 0;

    final reviewCardsToTake = dueCards.take(dailyReviewLimit).toList();
    final newCardsToTake = newCards.take(dailyNewCardsQuota).toList();

    activeQueue.addAll(reviewCardsToTake);
    activeQueue.addAll(newCardsToTake);
  }

  Flashcard? submitAnswer({required Flashcard card, required Rating rating}) {
    if (activeQueue.isEmpty || currentCardIndex >= activeQueue.length) {
      return null;
    }

    if (activeQueue[currentCardIndex].id != card.id) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'Submitted card does not match the current card in the queue',
      );
    }

    if (rating == Rating.good || rating == Rating.easy) {
      _correctAnswers++;
      completedCards.add(activeQueue[currentCardIndex]);
    } else {
      // Re-add to the end of the queue for reviewing again
      activeQueue.add(activeQueue[currentCardIndex]);
    }

    currentCardIndex++;

    if (currentCardIndex < activeQueue.length) {
      return activeQueue[currentCardIndex];
    }

    return null; // session finished
  }

  SessionResult calculateSessionResult({DateTime? endTime}) {
    final end = endTime ?? DateTime.now();
    final timeSpentSeconds = end.difference(startTime).inSeconds;

    final totalReviewed = currentCardIndex;
    final accuracyPercentage =
        totalReviewed == 0 ? 0.0 : (_correctAnswers / totalReviewed) * 100.0;

    return SessionResult(
      totalReviewed: totalReviewed,
      accuracyPercentage: accuracyPercentage,
      timeSpentSeconds: timeSpentSeconds,
    );
  }
}

import 'models.dart';

class VocabularySearchService {
  const VocabularySearchService();

  String _normalizeText(String value) {
    return value
        .toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll('ä', 'a')
        .replaceAll('ö', 'o')
        .replaceAll('ü', 'u')
        .replaceAll('ß', 'ss')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[.!?,;:،؛؟]'), '')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ')
        .trim();
  }

  List<Flashcard> search(List<Flashcard> items, String query) {
    if (query.trim().isEmpty) {
      return items;
    }

    final normalizedQuery = _normalizeText(query);

    return items.where((card) {
      final normalizedConceptId = _normalizeText(card.conceptId);
      final normalizedGerman = _normalizeText(card.german);
      final normalizedArabic = _normalizeText(card.arabic);

      return normalizedConceptId.contains(normalizedQuery) ||
          normalizedGerman.contains(normalizedQuery) ||
          normalizedArabic.contains(normalizedQuery);
    }).toList();
  }
}

import 'package:sqflite_common/sqlite_api.dart';

import '../../../services/sqlite_policy.dart';

class VerbMatrixDatabase {
  static const String _dbName = 'verb_matrix.db';
  static const String _attemptsTable = 'verb_attempts';

  Database? _db;
  final AppSqlitePolicy _sqlitePolicy;
  final String? _inMemoryPath;

  VerbMatrixDatabase({DatabaseFactory? factory, String? path})
      : _sqlitePolicy = AppSqlitePolicy(factory: factory),
        _inMemoryPath = path;

  Future<Database> get database async {
    if (_db != null) return _db!;
    _db = await _initDB();
    return _db!;
  }

  Future<Database> _initDB() async {
    final path = await _sqlitePolicy.resolvePath(
      fileName: _dbName,
      overridePath: _inMemoryPath,
    );
    return _sqlitePolicy.openWritable(
      path: path,
      version: 1,
      onCreate: _createDB,
    );
  }

  Future _createDB(Database db, int version) async {
    await db.execute('''
      CREATE TABLE $_attemptsTable (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        infinitive TEXT NOT NULL,
        person TEXT NOT NULL,
        isCorrect INTEGER NOT NULL,
        timestamp INTEGER NOT NULL,
        timeTaken INTEGER NOT NULL
      )
    ''');
  }

  Future<void> recordAttempt(Map<String, dynamic> attempt) async {
    final db = await database;
    await db.insert(
      _attemptsTable,
      attempt,
      conflictAlgorithm: ConflictAlgorithm.replace,
    );
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> getAttempts() async {
    final db = await database;
    return await db.query(_attemptsTable, orderBy: 'timestamp DESC');
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    final db = await database;
    db.close();
    _db = null;
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

@immutable
class VerbChallengeAttempt {
  final String id;
  final String infinitive;
  final String person;
  final bool isCorrect;
  final DateTime timestamp;
  final Duration timeTaken;

  const VerbChallengeAttempt({
    required this.id,
    required this.infinitive,
    required this.person,
    required this.isCorrect,
    required this.timestamp,
    required this.timeTaken,
  });

  VerbChallengeAttempt copyWith({
    String? id,
    String? infinitive,
    String? person,
    bool? isCorrect,
    DateTime? timestamp,
    Duration? timeTaken,
  }) {
    return VerbChallengeAttempt(
      id: id ?? this.id,
      infinitive: infinitive ?? this.infinitive,
      person: person ?? this.person,
      isCorrect: isCorrect ?? this.isCorrect,
      timestamp: timestamp ?? this.timestamp,
      timeTaken: timeTaken ?? this.timeTaken,
    );
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() {
    return {
      'id': id,
      'infinitive': infinitive,
      'person': person,
      'isCorrect': isCorrect ? 1 : 0,
      'timestamp': timestamp.millisecondsSinceEpoch,
      'timeTaken': timeTaken.inMilliseconds,
    };
  }

  factory VerbChallengeAttempt.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    return VerbChallengeAttempt(
      id: map['id'] as String,
      infinitive: map['infinitive'] as String,
      person: map['person'] as String,
      isCorrect: (map['isCorrect'] as int) == 1,
      timestamp: DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(map['timestamp'] as int),
      timeTaken: Duration(milliseconds: map['timeTaken'] as int),
    );
  }

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) {
    if (identical(this, other)) return true;
    return other is VerbChallengeAttempt &&
        other.id == id &&
        other.infinitive == infinitive &&
        other.person == person &&
        other.isCorrect == isCorrect &&
        other.timestamp == timestamp &&
        other.timeTaken == timeTaken;
  }

  @override
  int get hashCode {
    return Object.hash(id, infinitive, person, isCorrect, timestamp, timeTaken);
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/verb_matrix/verb_matrix_challenge.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../models/verb_conjugation.dart';
import '../../services/verb_index.dart';
import 'data/database.dart';
import 'domain/models.dart';

class VerbMatrixChallengePage extends StatefulWidget {
  final VerbIndex verbIndex;
  final VerbMatrixDatabase database;

  const VerbMatrixChallengePage({
    super.key,
    required this.verbIndex,
    required this.database,
  });

  @override
  State<VerbMatrixChallengePage> createState() =>
      _VerbMatrixChallengePageState();
}

class _VerbMatrixChallengePageState extends State<VerbMatrixChallengePage> {
  String? _selectedInfinitive;
  List<VerbConjugation> _currentVerbs = [];
  final Map<String, String?> _userAnswers = {}; // person -> form
  DateTime? _startTime;
  bool _isSubmitted = false;

  final List<String> _pronouns = [
    'ich',
    'du',
    'er/sie/es',
    'wir',
    'ihr',
    'sie/Sie',
  ];

  // A mapping to simplify pronouns from the data model to the UI display
  String _normalizePronoun(String person) {
    if (person == 'ich' ||
        person == 'du' ||
        person == 'wir' ||
        person == 'ihr') {
      return person;
    } else if (person == 'er' || person == 'sie (هي)' || person == 'es') {
      return 'er/sie/es';
    } else if (person == 'sie (هم)' || person == 'Sie') {
      return 'sie/Sie';
    }
    return person; // Fallback
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _startNewRound();
  }

  void _startNewRound() {
    final infinitives = widget.verbIndex.infinitives.toList();
    if (infinitives.isEmpty) return;

    // Pick a random verb for the challenge
    infinitives.shuffle();
    _selectedInfinitive = infinitives.first;
    _currentVerbs = widget.verbIndex.rowsFor(_selectedInfinitive!);
    _userAnswers.clear();
    _isSubmitted = false;
    _startTime = DateTime.now();
    setState(() {});
  }

  Future<void> _submitAnswers() async {
    setState(() {
      _isSubmitted = true;
    });

    final timeTaken = DateTime.now().difference(_startTime!);

    // Record attempts
    for (final verb in _currentVerbs) {
      final normalizedPronoun = _normalizePronoun(verb.person);
      final userAnswer = _userAnswers[normalizedPronoun];

      // Skip if we already recorded for this normalized pronoun in this round
      // to avoid duplicates for er/sie/es

      if (userAnswer != null) {
        final isCorrect = userAnswer == verb.form;
        final attempt = VerbChallengeAttempt(
          id: 'attempt_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}_${verb.person}',
          infinitive: verb.infinitive,
          person: verb.person,
          isCorrect: isCorrect,
          timestamp: DateTime.now(),
          timeTaken: timeTaken,
        );

        await widget.database.recordAttempt(attempt.toMap());
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_selectedInfinitive == null) {
      return const Scaffold(body: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()));
    }

    // Filter out verbs to just get one representative for each pronoun group
    final representativeVerbs = <String, VerbConjugation>{};
    for (final verb in _currentVerbs) {
      representativeVerbs[_normalizePronoun(verb.person)] = verb;
    }

    // Get all possible forms for draggable items, specifically one for each pronoun slot
    final forms = representativeVerbs.values.map((v) => v.form).toList()
      ..shuffle();

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('تحدي تصريف الأفعال'),
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
            onPressed: _startNewRound,
            tooltip: 'تحدي جديد',
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
        child: Column(
          children: [
            Text(
              'صرف الفعل: $_selectedInfinitive',
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall,
              textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
            ),
            if (_currentVerbs.isNotEmpty)
              Text(
                _currentVerbs.first.arabic,
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
              ),
            const SizedBox(height: 24),

            // The Drop Targets (Matrix)
            Expanded(
              child: GridView.count(
                crossAxisCount: 2,
                childAspectRatio: 2.5,
                mainAxisSpacing: 10,
                crossAxisSpacing: 10,
                children: _pronouns.map((pronoun) {
                  final expectedVerb = representativeVerbs[pronoun];
                  final isAnswered = _userAnswers[pronoun] != null;

                  bool? isCorrect;
                  if (_isSubmitted && isAnswered && expectedVerb != null) {
                    isCorrect = _userAnswers[pronoun] == expectedVerb.form;
                  }

                  return DragTarget<String>(
                    onAcceptWithDetails: (details) {
                      if (!_isSubmitted) {
                        setState(() {
                          _userAnswers[pronoun] = details.data;
                        });
                      }
                    },
                    builder: (context, candidateData, rejectedData) {
                      Color bgColor =
                          Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest;
                      if (candidateData.isNotEmpty) {
                        bgColor =
                            Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primaryContainer;
                      } else if (isCorrect == true) {
                        bgColor = const Color(0xFF0D9488)
                            .withValues(alpha: 0.3); // Deep Teal for success
                      } else if (isCorrect == false) {
                        bgColor = const Color(0xFFE11D48)
                            .withValues(alpha: 0.3); // Soft Crimson for error
                      }

                      return Container(
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: bgColor,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                          border: Border.all(
                            color: isCorrect == false
                                ? const Color(0xFFE11D48)
                                : Colors.transparent,
                            width: 2,
                          ),
                        ),
                        child: Row(
                          children: [
                            Container(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                horizontal: 12,
                              ),
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: Theme.of(context)
                                    .colorScheme
                                    .primary
                                    .withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                                borderRadius: const BorderRadius.horizontal(
                                  left: Radius.circular(14),
                                ),
                              ),
                              alignment: Alignment.center,
                              child: Text(
                                pronoun,
                                style: const TextStyle(
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                ),
                                textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                              ),
                            ),
                            Expanded(
                              child: Center(
                                child: Text(
                                  _userAnswers[pronoun] ?? '...',
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 18,
                                    color: isAnswered
                                        ? null
                                        : Theme.of(context).disabledColor,
                                  ),
                                  textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                            if (isCorrect == false && expectedVerb != null)
                              Padding(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 8.0),
                                child: Tooltip(
                                  message: 'الصحيح: ${expectedVerb.form}',
                                  child: const Icon(
                                    Icons.help_outline,
                                    color: Color(0xFFE11D48),
                                    size: 20,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            if (isAnswered && !_isSubmitted)
                              IconButton(
                                icon: const Icon(Icons.close, size: 16),
                                onPressed: () {
                                  setState(() {
                                    _userAnswers.remove(pronoun);
                                  });
                                },
                              ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      );
                    },
                  );
                }).toList(),
              ),
            ),

            // The Draggable Items
            if (!_isSubmitted) ...[
              const Divider(),
              const Text('اسحب التصريف الصحيح إلى الضمير المناسب'),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Wrap(
                spacing: 8,
                runSpacing: 8,
                children: () {
                  // Count remaining occurrences for each form
                  final formCounts = <String, int>{};
                  for (final form in forms) {
                    formCounts[form] = (formCounts[form] ?? 0) + 1;
                  }

                  // Subtract forms that are already placed
                  for (final answer in _userAnswers.values) {
                    if (answer != null && formCounts.containsKey(answer)) {
                      formCounts[answer] = formCounts[answer]! - 1;
                    }
                  }

                  final availableForms = <String>[];
                  for (final entry in formCounts.entries) {
                    for (var i = 0; i < entry.value; i++) {
                      availableForms.add(entry.key);
                    }
                  }

                  availableForms.shuffle();

                  return availableForms.map((form) {
                    return Draggable<String>(
                      data: form,
                      feedback: Material(
                        elevation: 4,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                        child: Container(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 16,
                            vertical: 8,
                          ),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color:
                                Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primaryContainer,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                          ),
                          child: Text(
                            form,
                            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      childWhenDragging: Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: 16,
                          vertical: 8,
                        ),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: Theme.of(context)
                              .colorScheme
                              .surfaceContainerHighest
                              .withValues(alpha: 0.5),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                        ),
                        child: Text(
                          form,
                          style: TextStyle(
                            color: Theme.of(context).disabledColor,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      child: Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: 16,
                          vertical: 8,
                        ),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primaryContainer,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                        ),
                        child: Text(form, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18)),
                      ),
                    );
                  }).toList();
                }(),
              ),
            ],

            const SizedBox(height: 24),

            if (_isSubmitted)
              ElevatedButton.icon(
                onPressed: _startNewRound,
                icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_forward),
                label: const Text('التالي'),
              )
            else
              ElevatedButton(
                onPressed: _userAnswers.length == _pronouns.length
                    ? _submitAnswers
                    : null,
                child: const Text('تحقق من الإجابات'),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import '../../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../../core/srs_facets.dart';
import '../../models/learner.dart';
import 'domain/commute_models.dart';

final class CommuteReviewQueueBuilder<T extends LearningContent> {
  CommuteReviewQueueBuilder(Iterable<T> corpus)
      : _itemsById = <String, T>{
          for (final item in corpus)
            if (item.id.trim().isNotEmpty) item.id.trim(): item,
        };

  final Map<String, T> _itemsById;

  List<CommuteReviewItem<T>> build(
    LearnerState state, {
    DateTime? now,
    int limit = 50,
  }) {
    final clock = now ?? DateTime.now();
    final safeLimit = limit.clamp(1, 100).toInt();
    final cards = state.reviewCards.values
        .where((card) => _supportedFacet(card.facetType))
        .where((card) => !card.dueAt.isAfter(clock))
        .toList(growable: false)
      ..sort((a, b) {
        final due = a.dueAt.compareTo(b.dueAt);
        if (due != 0) return due;
        final id = a.itemId.compareTo(b.itemId);
        if (id != 0) return id;
        return a.facetType.index.compareTo(b.facetType.index);
      });

    final result = <CommuteReviewItem<T>>[];
    for (final card in cards) {
      final item = _itemsById[card.itemId.trim()];
      if (item == null || !_hasCompleteAudioSequence(item)) continue;
      result.add(
        CommuteReviewItem<T>(
          item: item,
          facetType: card.facetType,
          variantKey: card.variantKey,
          dueAt: card.dueAt,
        ),
      );
      if (result.length >= safeLimit) break;
    }
    return List<CommuteReviewItem<T>>.unmodifiable(result);
  }

  static bool _supportedFacet(ReviewFacetType facet) =>
      facet == ReviewFacetType.meaningRecall ||
      facet == ReviewFacetType.listening;

  static bool _hasCompleteAudioSequence(LearningContent item) =>
      item.sourceText.trim().isNotEmpty &&
      item.translationText.trim().isNotEmpty &&
      item.exampleText.trim().isNotEmpty;
}

import '../../../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../../../core/srs_facets.dart';

final class CommuteReviewItem<T extends LearningContent> {
  const CommuteReviewItem({
    required this.item,
    required this.facetType,
    required this.variantKey,
    required this.dueAt,
  });

  final T item;
  final ReviewFacetType facetType;
  final String? variantKey;
  final DateTime dueAt;

  bool get isListening => facetType == ReviewFacetType.listening;
}

enum CommutePlaybackStage {
  targetTerm,
  sourceMeaning,
  targetExample,
  completed,
  cancelled,
}

final class CommutePlaybackReport {
  const CommutePlaybackReport._({
    required this.completed,
    required this.stage,
    this.reason,
  });

  const CommutePlaybackReport.completed()
      : this._(completed: true, stage: CommutePlaybackStage.completed);

  const CommutePlaybackReport.cancelled()
      : this._(
          completed: false,
          stage: CommutePlaybackStage.cancelled,
          reason: 'commute_playback_cancelled',
        );

  const CommutePlaybackReport.failed(CommutePlaybackStage stage, String reason)
      : this._(completed: false, stage: stage, reason: reason);

  final bool completed;
  final CommutePlaybackStage stage;
  final String? reason;

  bool get failed => !completed && stage != CommutePlaybackStage.cancelled;
}

import '../../core/content_contract.dart';

final class HandsFreeCommuteService<T extends LearningContent> {
  HandsFreeCommuteService({
    required this.repository,
    required this.targetAudioRuntime,
    required this.sourceAudioRuntime,
    required this.targetLanguageCode,
    required this.sourceLanguageCode,
    required Iterable<T> corpus,
    this.interSegmentPause = const Duration(milliseconds: 700),
  }) : queueBuilder = CommuteReviewQueueBuilder<T>(corpus);

  final LearnerRepository repository;
  final IAudioRuntime targetAudioRuntime;
  final IAudioRuntime sourceAudioRuntime;
  final String targetLanguageCode;
  final String sourceLanguageCode;
  final Duration interSegmentPause;
  final CommuteReviewQueueBuilder<T> queueBuilder;

  int _generation = 0;
  bool _paused = false;

  List<CommuteReviewItem<T>> pendingQueue({
    LearnerState? state,
    DateTime? now,
    int limit = 50,
  }) =>
      queueBuilder.build(state ?? repository.load(), now: now, limit: limit);

  Future<CommutePlaybackReport> play(CommuteReviewItem<T> review) async {
    final generation = ++_generation;
    _paused = false;

    final term = await _playSegment(
      generation: generation,
      runtime: targetAudioRuntime,
      request: AudioRequest(
        text: review.item.sourceText,
        languageCode: targetLanguageCode,
        conceptId: review.item.id,
        variant: AudioVariant.word,
      ),
      stage: CommutePlaybackStage.targetTerm,
    );
    if (term != null) return term;
    if (!await _betweenSegments(generation)) {
      return const CommutePlaybackReport.cancelled();
    }

    final meaning = await _playSegment(
      generation: generation,
      runtime: sourceAudioRuntime,
      request: AudioRequest(
        text: review.item.translationText,
        languageCode: sourceLanguageCode,
        conceptId: review.item.id,
        variant: AudioVariant.word,
      ),
      stage: CommutePlaybackStage.sourceMeaning,
    );
    if (meaning != null) return meaning;
    if (!await _betweenSegments(generation)) {
      return const CommutePlaybackReport.cancelled();
    }

    final example = await _playSegment(
      generation: generation,
      runtime: targetAudioRuntime,
      request: AudioRequest(
        text: review.item.exampleText,
        languageCode: targetLanguageCode,
        conceptId: review.item.id,
        variant: AudioVariant.sentence,
      ),
      stage: CommutePlaybackStage.targetExample,
    );
    if (example != null) return example;

    return generation == _generation && !_paused
        ? const CommutePlaybackReport.completed()
        : const CommutePlaybackReport.cancelled();
  }

  Future<void> pause() async {
    _paused = true;
    ++_generation;
    await Future.wait<void>(<Future<void>>[
      targetAudioRuntime.stop(),
      sourceAudioRuntime.stop(),
    ]);
  }

  Future<void> recordReview(
    CommuteReviewItem<T> review, {
    required bool known,
    required int seconds,
    DateTime? at,
  }) =>
      repository.recordFacet(
        item: review.item,
        facetType: review.facetType,
        variantKey: review.variantKey,
        answer: known ? 'commute_known' : 'commute_unknown',
        correct: known,
        seconds: seconds.clamp(0, 3600).toInt(),
        hinted: false,
        at: at,
      );

  Future<CommutePlaybackReport?> _playSegment({
    required int generation,
    required IAudioRuntime runtime,
    required AudioRequest request,
    required CommutePlaybackStage stage,
  }) async {
    if (generation != _generation || _paused) {
      return const CommutePlaybackReport.cancelled();
    }
    final result = await runtime.play(request);
    if (generation != _generation || _paused) {
      return const CommutePlaybackReport.cancelled();
    }
    if (!result.played) {
      return CommutePlaybackReport.failed(
        stage,
        result.reason ?? 'audio_runtime_unavailable',
      );
    }
    return null;
  }

  Future<bool> _betweenSegments(int generation) async {
    if (generation != _generation || _paused) return false;
    if (interSegmentPause.inMicroseconds > 0) {
      await Future<void>.delayed(interSegmentPause);
    }
    return generation == _generation && !_paused;
  }
}

final class XpProgress {
  const XpProgress({
    required this.totalXp,
    required this.level,
    required this.levelFloorXp,
    required this.nextLevelXp,
  });

  final int totalXp;
  final int level;
  final int levelFloorXp;
  final int nextLevelXp;

  double get progressToNextLevel {
    final span = nextLevelXp - levelFloorXp;
    if (span <= 0) return 1;
    return ((totalXp - levelFloorXp) / span).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
  }

  factory XpProgress.fromTotalXp(int rawXp) {
    final xp = rawXp.clamp(0, 100000000).toInt();
    final level = (xp ~/ 250) + 1;
    final floor = (level - 1) * 250;
    return XpProgress(
      totalXp: xp,
      level: level,
      levelFloorXp: floor,
      nextLevelXp: level * 250,
    );
  }
}

final class MilestoneBadge {
  const MilestoneBadge({
    required this.id,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.descriptionAr,
    this.xpThreshold,
    this.streakThreshold,
  });

  final String id;
  final String titleAr;
  final String descriptionAr;
  final int? xpThreshold;
  final int? streakThreshold;

  bool isReached(GamificationProfile profile) {
    final xp = xpThreshold;
    if (xp != null && profile.totalXp < xp) return false;
    final streak = streakThreshold;
    if (streak != null && profile.currentStreak < streak) return false;
    return xp != null || streak != null;
  }
}

final class GamificationSnapshot {
  const GamificationSnapshot({
    required this.profile,
    required this.unlocked,
    required this.badges,
  });

  final GamificationProfile profile;
  final List<UnlockedMilestone> unlocked;
  final List<MilestoneBadge> badges;

  Set<String> get unlockedBadgeIds =>
      unlocked.map((item) => item.badgeId).toSet();

  MilestoneBadge? get nextMilestone {
    final unlockedIds = unlockedBadgeIds;
    for (final badge in badges) {
      if (!unlockedIds.contains(badge.id)) return badge;
    }
    return null;
  }

import 'gamification_models.dart';

final class UserStreak {
  const UserStreak({
    required this.currentDays,
    required this.longestDays,
    required this.lastActivityDate,
    bool? freezeAvailable,
    int? streakFreezesAvailable,
  })  : assert(
          streakFreezesAvailable == null || streakFreezesAvailable >= 0,
          'streakFreezesAvailable cannot be negative',
        ),
        streakFreezesAvailable = streakFreezesAvailable ??
            (freezeAvailable == true ? 1 : 0),
        freezeAvailable = freezeAvailable ??
            ((streakFreezesAvailable ?? 0) > 0);

  final int currentDays;
  final int longestDays;
  final DateTime? lastActivityDate;
  final bool freezeAvailable;
  final int streakFreezesAvailable;

  List<bool> get recentSevenDayActivity =>
      recentSevenDayActivityAt(lastActivityDate ?? DateTime.utc(1970));

  List<bool> recentSevenDayActivityAt(DateTime referenceDate) {
    final last = lastActivityDate;
    if (last == null || currentDays <= 0) {
      return List<bool>.unmodifiable(List<bool>.filled(7, false));
    }

    final referenceDay = DateTime.utc(
      referenceDate.year,
      referenceDate.month,
      referenceDate.day,
    );
    final lastDay = DateTime.utc(last.year, last.month, last.day);
    final firstActiveDay = lastDay.subtract(
      Duration(days: currentDays.clamp(1, 10000).toInt() - 1),
    );

    return List<bool>.unmodifiable(
      List<bool>.generate(7, (index) {
        final day = referenceDay.subtract(Duration(days: 6 - index));
        return !day.isBefore(firstActiveDay) && !day.isAfter(lastDay);
      }),
    );
  }

  factory UserStreak.fromProfile(GamificationProfile profile) {
    final day = profile.lastLocalDay;
    return UserStreak(
      currentDays: profile.currentStreak,
      longestDays: profile.longestStreak,
      lastActivityDate: day == null
          ? null
          : DateTime.tryParse('${day}T00:00:00Z')?.toUtc(),
      streakFreezesAvailable: profile.streakFreezeAvailable ? 1 : 0,
    );
  }
}

extension GamificationSnapshotProjection on GamificationSnapshot {
  UserStreak get userStreak => UserStreak.fromProfile(profile);

  UserXpRecord get userXpRecord => UserXpRecord.fromProfile(profile);

  UserProgressLevel get userProgressLevel =>
      UserProgressLevel.fromProfile(profile);

  List<AchievementBadge> get achievementBadges {
    final unlockedById = <String, DateTime>{
      for (final item in unlocked) item.badgeId: item.unlockedAtUtc,
    };
    return List<AchievementBadge>.unmodifiable(
      badges.map(
        (badge) => AchievementBadge(
          id: badge.id,
          name: badge.titleAr,
          description: badge.descriptionAr,
          icon: _iconForBadge(badge.id),
          unlockCondition: _unlockCondition(badge),
          unlockedAt: unlockedById[badge.id],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

String _unlockCondition(MilestoneBadge badge) {
  final conditions = <String>[];
  final xp = badge.xpThreshold;
  if (xp != null) conditions.add('اجمع $xp XP');
  final streak = badge.streakThreshold;
  if (streak != null) conditions.add('حافظ على سلسلة $streak أيام');
  return conditions.isEmpty ? 'أكمل إنجاز التعلم المحدد' : conditions.join(' و ');
}

String _iconForBadge(String id) {
  if (id.startsWith('streak_')) return 'local_fire_department';
  if (id.startsWith('xp_1000')) return 'workspace_premium';
  if (id.startsWith('xp_')) return 'military_tech';
  return 'emoji_events';
}

import 'domain/gamification_models.dart';

final class _StreakResult {
  const _StreakResult(this.value, {this.freezeUsed = false});

  final int value;
  final bool freezeUsed;
}

abstract final class GamificationEngine {
  static const Duration _backwardClockTolerance = Duration(minutes: 5);
  static const Duration _monotonicClockDriftTolerance = Duration(minutes: 10);

  static GamificationTransition apply(
    GamificationProfile current,
    GamificationReviewEvent event, {
    List<MilestoneBadge> badges = GamificationMilestones.defaults,
    Set<String> alreadyUnlocked = const <String>{},
  }) {
    final eventUtc = event.occurredAtUtc.toUtc();
    final safeOffset = event.timezoneOffsetMinutes.clamp(-840, 840).toInt();
    final malformedOffset = safeOffset != event.timezoneOffsetMinutes;
    final backwardClock = current.lastReviewAtUtc != null &&
        eventUtc.isBefore(
          current.lastReviewAtUtc!.toUtc().subtract(_backwardClockTolerance),
        );
    final localDay = _dayKey(eventUtc, safeOffset);
    final localDayRegression = _isDayBefore(localDay, current.lastLocalDay);
    final stamp = event.clockIntegrityStamp;
    final malformedStamp = stamp != null && !stamp.isValid;
    final previousBootCount = current.lastBootCount;
    final previousElapsed = current.lastMonotonicElapsedMilliseconds;
    final bootCountRegression = stamp != null &&
        previousBootCount != null &&
        stamp.bootCount < previousBootCount;
    final sameBoot = stamp != null &&
        previousBootCount != null &&
        previousElapsed != null &&
        stamp.bootCount == previousBootCount;
    final monotonicRegression = sameBoot
        ? stamp.elapsedRealtimeMilliseconds < previousElapsed
        : false;
    final monotonicClockDrift = sameBoot &&
        !monotonicRegression &&
        current.lastReviewAtUtc != null &&
        _hasMonotonicClockDrift(
          previousUtc: current.lastReviewAtUtc!.toUtc(),
          currentUtc: eventUtc,
          previousElapsedMilliseconds: previousElapsed,
          currentElapsedMilliseconds: stamp.elapsedRealtimeMilliseconds,
        );

    if (malformedOffset ||
        malformedStamp ||
        backwardClock ||
        localDayRegression ||
        bootCountRegression ||
        monotonicRegression ||
        monotonicClockDrift) {
      return GamificationTransition(
        profile: GamificationProfile(
          totalXp: current.totalXp,
          currentStreak: current.currentStreak,
          longestStreak: current.longestStreak,
          lastReviewAtUtc: current.lastReviewAtUtc,
          lastLocalDay: current.lastLocalDay,
          lastTimezoneOffsetMinutes: current.lastTimezoneOffsetMinutes,
          lastMonotonicElapsedMilliseconds:
              current.lastMonotonicElapsedMilliseconds,
          lastBootCount: current.lastBootCount,
          clockAnomalyDetected: true,
          streakFreezeAvailable: current.streakFreezeAvailable,
        ),
        awardedXp: 0,
        clockAnomaly: true,
        newlyUnlocked: const <MilestoneBadge>[],
      );
    }

    final streakResult = _nextStreak(
      current.currentStreak,
      current.lastLocalDay,
      localDay,
      useFreeze: event.useStreakFreeze && current.streakFreezeAvailable,
    );
    final awardedXp = event.requestedXp.clamp(0, 100).toInt();
    final nextProfile = GamificationProfile(
      totalXp: (current.totalXp + awardedXp).clamp(0, 100000000).toInt(),
      currentStreak: streakResult.value,
      longestStreak: streakResult.value > current.longestStreak
          ? streakResult.value
          : current.longestStreak,
      lastReviewAtUtc: eventUtc,
      lastLocalDay: localDay,
      lastTimezoneOffsetMinutes: safeOffset,
      lastMonotonicElapsedMilliseconds:
          stamp != null && stamp.isValid
              ? stamp.elapsedRealtimeMilliseconds
              : current.lastMonotonicElapsedMilliseconds,
      lastBootCount:
          stamp != null && stamp.isValid
              ? stamp.bootCount
              : current.lastBootCount,
      clockAnomalyDetected: current.clockAnomalyDetected,
      streakFreezeAvailable:
          current.streakFreezeAvailable && !streakResult.freezeUsed,
    );
    final newlyUnlocked = <MilestoneBadge>[
      for (final badge in badges)
        if (!alreadyUnlocked.contains(badge.id) && badge.isReached(nextProfile))
          badge,
    ];

    return GamificationTransition(
      profile: nextProfile,
      awardedXp: awardedXp,
      clockAnomaly: false,
      newlyUnlocked: List<MilestoneBadge>.unmodifiable(newlyUnlocked),
      streakFreezeUsed: streakResult.freezeUsed,
    );
  }

  static bool _hasMonotonicClockDrift({
    required DateTime previousUtc,
    required DateTime currentUtc,
    required int previousElapsedMilliseconds,
    required int currentElapsedMilliseconds,
  }) {
    final elapsedDelta =
        currentElapsedMilliseconds - previousElapsedMilliseconds;
    if (elapsedDelta < 0) return true;

    final wallDelta =
        currentUtc.difference(previousUtc).inMilliseconds;
    final drift = (wallDelta - elapsedDelta).abs();
    return drift > _monotonicClockDriftTolerance.inMilliseconds;
  }

  static _StreakResult _nextStreak(
    int current,
    String? previousDay,
    String localDay, {
    required bool useFreeze,
  }) {
    if (previousDay == null || previousDay.isEmpty) {
      return const _StreakResult(1);
    }
    if (previousDay == localDay) {
      return _StreakResult(current <= 0 ? 1 : current);
    }

    final previous = _parseDay(previousDay);
    final next = _parseDay(localDay);
    if (previous == null || next == null) {
      return const _StreakResult(1);
    }

    final delta = next.difference(previous).inDays;
    if (delta == 1) {
      return _StreakResult(
        (current <= 0 ? 1 : current + 1).clamp(1, 10000).toInt(),
      );
    }
    if (delta == 2 && useFreeze) {
      return _StreakResult(
        (current <= 0 ? 1 : current + 1).clamp(1, 10000).toInt(),
        freezeUsed: true,
      );
    }
    if (delta <= 0) {
      return _StreakResult(current.clamp(0, 10000).toInt());
    }
    return const _StreakResult(1);
  }

  static bool _isDayBefore(String day, String? reference) {
    if (reference == null || reference.isEmpty) return false;
    final current = _parseDay(day);
    final previous = _parseDay(reference);
    if (current == null || previous == null) return false;
    return current.isBefore(previous);
  }

  static DateTime? _parseDay(String value) =>
      DateTime.tryParse('${value}T00:00:00Z');

  static String _dayKey(DateTime utc, int offsetMinutes) {
    final local = utc.add(Duration(minutes: offsetMinutes));
    final year = local.year.toString().padLeft(4, '0');
    final month = local.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    final day = local.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    return '$year-$month-$day';
  }
}
