      status == GamificationReviewApplyStatus.alreadyApplied;
}

final class GamificationReviewEventException implements Exception {
  const GamificationReviewEventException(this.code);

  final String code;

  @override
  String toString() => 'GamificationReviewEventException($code)';
}

final class SqliteGamificationRepository implements GamificationRepository {
  static const int schemaVersion = 4;
  static const String metaTable = 'gamification_store_meta';
  SqliteGamificationRepository._(
    this._database,
    this._clockIntegritySource,
  );

  final Database _database;
  final GamificationClockIntegritySource _clockIntegritySource;
  bool _closed = false;

  static Future<SqliteGamificationRepository> open(
    String databasePath, {
    GamificationClockIntegritySource clockIntegritySource =
        const UnavailableGamificationClockIntegritySource(),
  }) =>
      SqliteGamificationRepository.openWithFactory(
        sqflite.databaseFactory,
        databasePath,
        clockIntegritySource: clockIntegritySource,
      );

  static Future<SqliteGamificationRepository> openWithFactory(
    DatabaseFactory factory,
    String databasePath, {
    GamificationClockIntegritySource clockIntegritySource =
        const UnavailableGamificationClockIntegritySource(),
  }) async {
    final database = await factory.openDatabase(
      databasePath,
      options: OpenDatabaseOptions(
        version: SqliteGamificationRepository.schemaVersion,
        onConfigure: (db) async {
          await db.execute('PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON');
        },
        onCreate: (db, version) async {
          await db.execute('''
            CREATE TABLE gamification_profile (
              id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
              total_xp INTEGER NOT NULL,
              current_streak INTEGER NOT NULL,
              longest_streak INTEGER NOT NULL,
              last_review_utc TEXT,
              last_local_day TEXT,
              last_timezone_offset_minutes INTEGER,
              last_monotonic_elapsed_ms INTEGER,
              last_boot_count INTEGER,
              clock_anomaly_detected INTEGER NOT NULL,
              streak_freeze_available INTEGER NOT NULL
            )
          ''');
          await db.execute('''
            CREATE TABLE gamification_review_events (
              event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
              facet_type TEXT NOT NULL,
              correct INTEGER NOT NULL,
              hinted INTEGER NOT NULL,
              requested_xp INTEGER NOT NULL,
              awarded_xp INTEGER NOT NULL,
              reviewed_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
              timezone_offset_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
              monotonic_elapsed_ms INTEGER,
              boot_count INTEGER,
              clock_anomaly INTEGER NOT NULL
            )
          ''');
          await db.execute('''
            CREATE TABLE gamification_badges (
              badge_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
              unlocked_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL
            )
          ''');
          await SqliteGamificationRepository._createMeta(db);
          await SqliteGamificationRepository._resetProfile(db);
        },
        onUpgrade: (db, oldVersion, newVersion) async {
          if (oldVersion < 2) {
            await db.execute(
              'ALTER TABLE gamification_profile ADD COLUMN streak_freeze_available INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1',
            );
          }
          if (oldVersion < 3) {
            await db.execute(
              'ALTER TABLE gamification_profile ADD COLUMN last_monotonic_elapsed_ms INTEGER',
            );
            await db.execute(
              'ALTER TABLE gamification_profile ADD COLUMN last_boot_count INTEGER',
            );
            await db.execute(
              'ALTER TABLE gamification_review_events ADD COLUMN monotonic_elapsed_ms INTEGER',
            );
            await db.execute(
              'ALTER TABLE gamification_review_events ADD COLUMN boot_count INTEGER',
            );
          }
          if (oldVersion < 4) {
            await SqliteGamificationRepository._createMeta(db);
            await SqliteGamificationRepository
                ._initializeRevisionForUpgrade(db);
          }
        },
      ),
    );
    return SqliteGamificationRepository._(
      database,
      clockIntegritySource,
    );
  }

  Future<bool> migrateLegacyProfileIfPristine({
    required int totalXp,
    required int currentStreak,
    required DateTime? lastReviewAtUtc,
    required int? timezoneOffsetMinutes,
  }) async {
    if (_closed) return false;

    final safeXp = totalXp.clamp(0, 100000000).toInt();
    final safeStreak = currentStreak.clamp(0, 10000).toInt();
    if (safeXp == 0 && safeStreak == 0) return false;

    final safeReviewAt = lastReviewAtUtc?.toUtc();
    final safeOffset = timezoneOffsetMinutes == null
        ? null
        : timezoneOffsetMinutes.clamp(-840, 840).toInt();
    final localDay = safeReviewAt != null && safeOffset != null
        ? SqliteGamificationRepository._dayKey(
            safeReviewAt,
            safeOffset,
          )
        : null;

    return _database.transaction((txn) async {
      final revision =
          await SqliteGamificationRepository._readRevision(txn);
      if (revision != 0) return false;
      final current =
          await SqliteGamificationRepository._readProfile(txn);
      final events = await txn.query(
        'gamification_review_events',
        columns: const <String>['event_id'],
        limit: 1,
      );
      final badges = await txn.query(
        'gamification_badges',
        columns: const <String>['badge_id'],
        limit: 1,
      );
      final isPristine = current.totalXp == 0 &&
          current.currentStreak == 0 &&
          current.longestStreak == 0 &&
          current.lastReviewAtUtc == null &&
          current.lastLocalDay == null &&
          current.lastMonotonicElapsedMilliseconds == null &&
          current.lastBootCount == null &&
          events.isEmpty &&
          badges.isEmpty;
      if (!isPristine) return false;

      final migrated = GamificationProfile(
        totalXp: safeXp,
        currentStreak: safeStreak,
        longestStreak: safeStreak,
        lastReviewAtUtc: safeReviewAt,
        lastLocalDay: localDay,
        lastTimezoneOffsetMinutes: safeReviewAt == null ? null : safeOffset,
      );
      await txn.update(
        'gamification_profile',
        <String, Object?>{
          'total_xp': migrated.totalXp,
          'current_streak': migrated.currentStreak,
          'longest_streak': migrated.longestStreak,
          'last_review_utc': migrated.lastReviewAtUtc?.toIso8601String(),
          'last_local_day': migrated.lastLocalDay,
          'last_timezone_offset_minutes':
              migrated.lastTimezoneOffsetMinutes,
          'last_monotonic_elapsed_ms': null,
          'last_boot_count': null,
          'clock_anomaly_detected': 0,
          'streak_freeze_available': 1,
        },
        where: 'id = 1',
      );

      final unlockedAt = safeReviewAt ?? DateTime.now().toUtc();
      for (final badge in GamificationMilestones.defaults) {
        if (!badge.isReached(migrated)) continue;
        await txn.insert(
          'gamification_badges',
          <String, Object?>{
            'badge_id': badge.id,
            'unlocked_at_utc': unlockedAt.toIso8601String(),
          },
          conflictAlgorithm: ConflictAlgorithm.ignore,
        );
      }
      await SqliteGamificationRepository._bumpRevision(txn);
      return true;
    });
  }

  @override
  Future<void> recordReview(GamificationReviewEvent event) async {
    if (_closed) return;
    final id = event.reviewId.trim();
    if (id.isEmpty || id.length > 160) return;
    await recordReviewOnce(event);
  }

  Future<GamificationReviewApplyResult> recordReviewOnce(
    GamificationReviewEvent event,
  ) async {
    if (_closed) {
      throw StateError('gamification_repository_closed');
    }

    final id = event.reviewId.trim();
    if (id.isEmpty || id.length > 160) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        event.reviewId,
        'event.reviewId',
        'must be 1..160 characters',
      );
    }

    final expectedPayload = <String, Object?>{
      'facet_type': event.facetType.wireName,
      'correct': event.correct ? 1 : 0,
      'hinted': event.hinted ? 1 : 0,
      'requested_xp': event.requestedXp.clamp(0, 100).toInt(),
      'reviewed_at_utc':
          event.occurredAtUtc.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
      'timezone_offset_minutes':
          event.timezoneOffsetMinutes.clamp(-840, 840).toInt(),
    };

    var clockStamp = event.clockIntegrityStamp;
    if (clockStamp == null) {
      try {
        clockStamp = await _clockIntegritySource.read();
      } on Object {
        clockStamp = null;
      }
    }

    return _database.transaction((txn) async {
      final duplicate = await txn.query(
        'gamification_review_events',
        columns: const <String>[
          'event_id',
          'facet_type',
          'correct',
          'hinted',
          'requested_xp',
          'reviewed_at_utc',
          'timezone_offset_minutes',
        ],
        where: 'event_id = ?',
        whereArgs: <Object?>[id],
        limit: 1,
      );
      if (duplicate.isNotEmpty) {
        if (!SqliteGamificationRepository._matchesImmutableReviewPayload(
          duplicate.first,
          expectedPayload,
        )) {
          throw const GamificationReviewEventException(
            'gamification_event_payload_mismatch',
          );
        }
        return GamificationReviewApplyResult(
          status: GamificationReviewApplyStatus.alreadyApplied,
          reviewEventId: id,
        );
      }

      final current =
          await SqliteGamificationRepository._readProfile(txn);
      final unlocked =
          await SqliteGamificationRepository._readUnlocked(txn);
      final unlockedIds = unlocked.map((item) => item.badgeId).toSet();
      final transition = GamificationEngine.apply(
        current,
        GamificationReviewEvent(
          reviewId: id,
          facetType: event.facetType,
          correct: event.correct,
          hinted: event.hinted,
          requestedXp: event.requestedXp,
          occurredAtUtc: event.occurredAtUtc,
          timezoneOffsetMinutes: event.timezoneOffsetMinutes,
          useStreakFreeze: event.useStreakFreeze,
          clockIntegrityStamp: clockStamp,
        ),
        alreadyUnlocked: unlockedIds,
      );

      await txn.insert(
        'gamification_review_events',
        <String, Object?>{
          'event_id': id,
          ...expectedPayload,
          'awarded_xp': transition.awardedXp,
          'monotonic_elapsed_ms':
              clockStamp?.elapsedRealtimeMilliseconds,
          'boot_count': clockStamp?.bootCount,
          'clock_anomaly': transition.clockAnomaly ? 1 : 0,
        },
        conflictAlgorithm: ConflictAlgorithm.abort,
      );

      final profile = transition.profile;
      await txn.update(
        'gamification_profile',
        <String, Object?>{
          'total_xp': profile.totalXp,
          'current_streak': profile.currentStreak,
          'longest_streak': profile.longestStreak,
          'last_review_utc': profile.lastReviewAtUtc?.toIso8601String(),
          'last_local_day': profile.lastLocalDay,
          'last_timezone_offset_minutes': profile.lastTimezoneOffsetMinutes,
          'last_monotonic_elapsed_ms':
              profile.lastMonotonicElapsedMilliseconds,
          'last_boot_count': profile.lastBootCount,
          'clock_anomaly_detected': profile.clockAnomalyDetected ? 1 : 0,
          'streak_freeze_available': profile.streakFreezeAvailable ? 1 : 0,
        },
        where: 'id = 1',
      );

      for (final badge in transition.newlyUnlocked) {
        await txn.insert(
          'gamification_badges',
          <String, Object?>{
            'badge_id': badge.id,
            'unlocked_at_utc':
                event.occurredAtUtc.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
          },
          conflictAlgorithm: ConflictAlgorithm.ignore,
        );
      }
      await SqliteGamificationRepository._bumpRevision(txn);

      return GamificationReviewApplyResult(
        status: GamificationReviewApplyStatus.applied,
        reviewEventId: id,
      );
    });
  }

  static bool _matchesImmutableReviewPayload(
    Map<String, Object?> stored,
    Map<String, Object?> expected,
  ) {
    for (final key in expected.keys) {
      final expectedValue = expected[key];
      final storedValue = stored[key];
      if (expectedValue is int) {
        final storedInt = storedValue is num
            ? storedValue.toInt()
            : int.tryParse(storedValue?.toString() ?? '');
        if (storedInt != expectedValue) return false;
        continue;
      }
      if (storedValue?.toString() != expectedValue?.toString()) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    return true;
  }

  @override
  Future<void> clearGamification() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    await _database.transaction((txn) async {
      await txn.delete('gamification_review_events');
      await txn.delete('gamification_badges');
      await txn.delete('gamification_profile');
      await SqliteGamificationRepository._resetProfile(txn);
      await txn.update(
        SqliteGamificationRepository.metaTable,
        <String, Object?>{'revision': 0},
        where: 'id = 1',
      );
    });
  }

  Future<int> loadRevision() async {
    if (_closed) {
      throw StateError('gamification_repository_closed');
    }
    return SqliteGamificationRepository._readRevision(_database);
  }

  @override
  Future<GamificationSnapshot> loadSnapshot() async {
    if (_closed) {
      return GamificationSnapshot(
        profile: GamificationProfile(),
        unlocked: <UnlockedMilestone>[],
        badges: GamificationMilestones.defaults,
      );
    }
    final profile =
        await SqliteGamificationRepository._readProfile(_database);
    final unlocked =
        await SqliteGamificationRepository._readUnlocked(_database);
    return GamificationSnapshot(
      profile: profile,
      unlocked: unlocked,
      badges: GamificationMilestones.defaults,
    );
  }

  static Future<void> _createMeta(DatabaseExecutor db) async {
    await db.execute('''
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${SqliteGamificationRepository.metaTable} (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
        schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
        revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision >= 0)
      )
    ''');
    await db.insert(
      SqliteGamificationRepository.metaTable,
      <String, Object?>{
        'id': 1,
        'schema_version': SqliteGamificationRepository.schemaVersion,
        'revision': 0,
      },
      conflictAlgorithm: ConflictAlgorithm.ignore,
    );
  }

  static Future<void> _initializeRevisionForUpgrade(
    DatabaseExecutor db,
  ) async {
    final profile = await SqliteGamificationRepository._readProfile(db);
    final events = await db.query(
      'gamification_review_events',
      columns: const <String>['event_id'],
      limit: 1,
    );
    final badges = await db.query(
      'gamification_badges',
      columns: const <String>['badge_id'],
      limit: 1,
    );
    final mutated = profile.totalXp != 0 ||
        profile.currentStreak != 0 ||
        profile.longestStreak != 0 ||
        profile.lastReviewAtUtc != null ||
        profile.lastLocalDay != null ||
        profile.lastMonotonicElapsedMilliseconds != null ||
        profile.lastBootCount != null ||
        events.isNotEmpty ||
        badges.isNotEmpty;
    await db.update(
      SqliteGamificationRepository.metaTable,
      <String, Object?>{
        'schema_version': SqliteGamificationRepository.schemaVersion,
        'revision': mutated ? 1 : 0,
      },
      where: 'id = 1',
    );
  }

  static Future<int> _readRevision(DatabaseExecutor db) async {
    final rows = await db.query(
      SqliteGamificationRepository.metaTable,
      where: 'id = 1',
      limit: 1,
    );
    if (rows.length != 1) {
      throw const GamificationReviewEventException(
        'gamification_meta_missing',
      );
    }
    final version = rows.single['schema_version'];
    final revision = rows.single['revision'];
    if (version is! num ||
        version.toInt() != SqliteGamificationRepository.schemaVersion ||
        revision is! num ||
        revision.toInt() < 0) {
      throw const GamificationReviewEventException(
        'gamification_meta_invalid',
      );
    }
    return revision.toInt();
  }

  static Future<int> _bumpRevision(DatabaseExecutor db) async {
    final current = await SqliteGamificationRepository._readRevision(db);
    if (current >= (1 << 62)) {
      throw const GamificationReviewEventException(
        'gamification_revision_overflow',
      );
    }
    final next = current + 1;
    await db.update(
      SqliteGamificationRepository.metaTable,
      <String, Object?>{'revision': next},
      where: 'id = 1',
    );
    return next;
  }

  static Future<void> _resetProfile(DatabaseExecutor db) async {
    await db.insert(
        'gamification_profile',
        <String, Object?>{
          'id': 1,
          'total_xp': 0,
          'current_streak': 0,
          'longest_streak': 0,
          'clock_anomaly_detected': 0,
          'streak_freeze_available': 1,
        },
        conflictAlgorithm: ConflictAlgorithm.replace);
  }

  static Future<GamificationProfile> _readProfile(DatabaseExecutor db) async {
    final rows = await db.query(
      'gamification_profile',
      where: 'id = 1',
      limit: 1,
    );
    if (rows.isEmpty) return GamificationProfile();
    final row = rows.first;

    int safeInt(String key, {int max = 100000000}) {
      final value = row[key];
      final parsed = value is num
          ? value.toInt()
          : int.tryParse(value?.toString() ?? '') ?? 0;
      return parsed.clamp(0, max).toInt();
    }

    final rawOffset = row['last_timezone_offset_minutes'];
    final offset =
        rawOffset is num ? rawOffset.toInt().clamp(-840, 840).toInt() : null;

    return GamificationProfile(
      totalXp: safeInt('total_xp'),
      currentStreak: safeInt('current_streak', max: 10000),
      longestStreak: safeInt('longest_streak', max: 10000),
      lastReviewAtUtc: DateTime.tryParse(
        row['last_review_utc']?.toString() ?? '',
      )?.toUtc(),
      lastLocalDay:
          SqliteGamificationRepository._safeDay(row['last_local_day']),
      lastTimezoneOffsetMinutes: offset,
      lastMonotonicElapsedMilliseconds:
          SqliteGamificationRepository._safeNullableNonNegativeInt(
        row['last_monotonic_elapsed_ms'],
      ),
      lastBootCount:
          SqliteGamificationRepository._safeNullableNonNegativeInt(
        row['last_boot_count'],
      ),
      clockAnomalyDetected: row['clock_anomaly_detected'] == 1,
      streakFreezeAvailable: row['streak_freeze_available'] != 0,
    );
  }

  static int? _safeNullableNonNegativeInt(Object? raw) {
    if (raw == null) return null;
    final parsed = raw is num
        ? raw.toInt()
        : int.tryParse(raw.toString());
    if (parsed == null || parsed < 0) return null;
    return parsed;
  }

  static Future<List<UnlockedMilestone>> _readUnlocked(
    DatabaseExecutor db,
  ) async {
    final rows = await db.query(
      'gamification_badges',
      orderBy: 'unlocked_at_utc ASC, badge_id ASC',
      limit: 200,
    );
    final result = <UnlockedMilestone>[];
    for (final row in rows) {
      final id = row['badge_id']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
      final at =
          DateTime.tryParse(row['unlocked_at_utc']?.toString() ?? '')?.toUtc();
      if (id.isEmpty || id.length > 120 || at == null) continue;
      result.add(UnlockedMilestone(badgeId: id, unlockedAtUtc: at));
    }
    return List<UnlockedMilestone>.unmodifiable(result);
  }

  static String _dayKey(DateTime utc, int offsetMinutes) {
    final local = utc.toUtc().add(Duration(minutes: offsetMinutes));
    final year = local.year.toString().padLeft(4, '0');
    final month = local.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    final day = local.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    return '$year-$month-$day';
  }

  static String? _safeDay(Object? raw) {
    final value = raw?.toString().trim() ?? '';
    if (!RegExp(r'^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$').hasMatch(value)) return null;
    return DateTime.tryParse('${value}T00:00:00Z') == null ? null : value;
  }

  @override
  Future<void> close() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    _closed = true;
    await _database.close();
  }
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:math' as math;

import '../../../core/srs_facets.dart';
import '../domain/achievement_models.dart';
import '../domain/gamification_models.dart';
import '../gamification_repository.dart';

enum GamificationUiEventType {
  levelUp,
  badgeUnlocked,
  streakFreezeUsed,
}

final class GamificationUiEvent {
  const GamificationUiEvent({
    required this.type,
    this.badge,
    this.fromLevel,
    this.toLevel,
  });

  final GamificationUiEventType type;
  final AchievementBadge? badge;
  final int? fromLevel;
  final int? toLevel;
}

final class GamificationViewState {
  const GamificationViewState({
    required this.streak,
    required this.progress,
    required this.badges,
    required this.badgeProgress,
  });

  final UserStreak streak;
  final UserXpRecord progress;
  final List<AchievementBadge> badges;
  final Map<String, double> badgeProgress;

  factory GamificationViewState.fromSnapshot(GamificationSnapshot snapshot) {
    final progress = <String, double>{};
    for (final badge in snapshot.badges) {
      progress[badge.id] = _badgeProgress(badge, snapshot.profile);
    }
    return GamificationViewState(
      streak: snapshot.userStreak,
      progress: snapshot.userXpRecord,
      badges: snapshot.achievementBadges,
      badgeProgress: Map<String, double>.unmodifiable(progress),
    );
  }

  static double _badgeProgress(
    MilestoneBadge badge,
    GamificationProfile profile,
  ) {
    final ratios = <double>[];
    final xpThreshold = badge.xpThreshold;
    if (xpThreshold != null && xpThreshold > 0) {
      ratios.add((profile.totalXp / xpThreshold).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble());
    }
    final streakThreshold = badge.streakThreshold;
    if (streakThreshold != null && streakThreshold > 0) {
      ratios.add(
        (profile.currentStreak / streakThreshold)
            .clamp(0.0, 1.0)
            .toDouble(),
      );
    }
    if (ratios.isEmpty) return 0;
    return ratios.reduce(math.min);
  }
}

final class GamificationUpdate {
  const GamificationUpdate({
    required this.state,
    required this.events,
  });

  final GamificationViewState state;
  final List<GamificationUiEvent> events;
}

final class GamificationNotifier {
  GamificationNotifier(this._repository);

  final GamificationRepository _repository;
  final StreamController<GamificationUiEvent> _events =
      StreamController<GamificationUiEvent>.broadcast();

  GamificationSnapshot? _snapshot;
  bool _disposed = false;

  Stream<GamificationUiEvent> get events => _events.stream;

  GamificationViewState? get state {
    final snapshot = _snapshot;
    return snapshot == null ? null : GamificationViewState.fromSnapshot(snapshot);
  }

  Future<GamificationViewState> initialize() async {
    _ensureActive();
    final snapshot = await _repository.loadSnapshot();
    _snapshot = snapshot;
    return GamificationViewState.fromSnapshot(snapshot);
  }

  Future<GamificationUpdate> completeExercise({
    required String activityId,
    required DateTime completedAtUtc,
    required int earnedXp,
    required int timezoneOffsetMinutes,
    bool useStreakFreeze = false,
  }) =>
      completeSession(
        sessionId: activityId,
        completedAtUtc: completedAtUtc,
        earnedXp: earnedXp,
        timezoneOffsetMinutes: timezoneOffsetMinutes,
        useStreakFreeze: useStreakFreeze,
        facetType: ReviewFacetType.meaningRecall,
      );

  Future<GamificationUpdate> completeCardReview({
    required String activityId,
    required DateTime completedAtUtc,
    required int earnedXp,
    required int timezoneOffsetMinutes,
    bool useStreakFreeze = false,
    ReviewFacetType facetType = ReviewFacetType.meaningRecall,
  }) =>
      completeSession(
        sessionId: activityId,
        completedAtUtc: completedAtUtc,
        earnedXp: earnedXp,
        timezoneOffsetMinutes: timezoneOffsetMinutes,
        useStreakFreeze: useStreakFreeze,
        facetType: facetType,
      );

  Future<GamificationUpdate> completeSession({
    required String sessionId,
    required DateTime completedAtUtc,
    required int earnedXp,
    required int timezoneOffsetMinutes,
    bool useStreakFreeze = false,
    ReviewFacetType facetType = ReviewFacetType.meaningRecall,
  }) async {
    _ensureActive();
    final before = _snapshot ?? await _repository.loadSnapshot();
    final beforeView = GamificationViewState.fromSnapshot(before);

    await _repository.recordReview(
      GamificationReviewEvent(
        reviewId: sessionId,
        facetType: facetType,
        correct: true,
        hinted: false,
        requestedXp: earnedXp,
        occurredAtUtc: completedAtUtc.toUtc(),
        timezoneOffsetMinutes: timezoneOffsetMinutes,
        useStreakFreeze: useStreakFreeze,
      ),
    );

    final after = await _repository.loadSnapshot();
    _snapshot = after;
    final afterView = GamificationViewState.fromSnapshot(after);
    final emitted = <GamificationUiEvent>[];

    if (afterView.progress.currentLevel > beforeView.progress.currentLevel) {
      emitted.add(
        GamificationUiEvent(
          type: GamificationUiEventType.levelUp,
          fromLevel: beforeView.progress.currentLevel,
          toLevel: afterView.progress.currentLevel,
        ),
      );
    }

    final beforeUnlocked = <String>{
      for (final badge in beforeView.badges)
        if (badge.isUnlocked) badge.id,
    };
    for (final badge in afterView.badges) {
      if (badge.isUnlocked && !beforeUnlocked.contains(badge.id)) {
        emitted.add(
          GamificationUiEvent(
            type: GamificationUiEventType.badgeUnlocked,
            badge: badge,
          ),
        );
      }
    }

    if (beforeView.streak.freezeAvailable &&
        !afterView.streak.freezeAvailable) {
      emitted.add(
        const GamificationUiEvent(
          type: GamificationUiEventType.streakFreezeUsed,
        ),
      );
    }

    for (final event in emitted) {
      if (!_events.isClosed) _events.add(event);
    }
    return GamificationUpdate(
      state: afterView,
      events: List<GamificationUiEvent>.unmodifiable(emitted),
    );
  }

  Future<void> clear() async {
    _ensureActive();
    await _repository.clearGamification();
    _snapshot = await _repository.loadSnapshot();
  }

  Future<void> dispose() async {
    if (_disposed) return;
    _disposed = true;
    await _repository.close();
    await _events.close();
  }

  void _ensureActive() {
    if (_disposed) {
      throw StateError('GamificationNotifier is disposed');
    }
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

import '../domain/gamification_clock_integrity_source.dart';

final class AndroidGamificationClockIntegritySource
    implements GamificationClockIntegritySource {
  const AndroidGamificationClockIntegritySource({
    MethodChannel channel = const MethodChannel(_channelName),
  }) : _channel = channel;

  static const String _channelName =
      'com.deutschbilarabi.app/gamification_clock_integrity';

  final MethodChannel _channel;

  @override
  Future<GamificationClockIntegrityStamp?> read() async {
    try {
      final raw = await _channel.invokeMapMethod<String, Object?>(
        'readStamp',
      );
      if (raw == null) return null;

      final elapsed = _safeInt(raw['elapsedRealtimeMilliseconds']);
      final bootCount = _safeInt(raw['bootCount']);
      if (elapsed == null || bootCount == null) return null;

      final stamp = GamificationClockIntegrityStamp(
        elapsedRealtimeMilliseconds: elapsed,
        bootCount: bootCount,
      );
      return stamp.isValid ? stamp : null;
    } on MissingPluginException {
      return null;
    } on PlatformException {
      return null;
    }
  }

  static int? _safeInt(Object? raw) {
    if (raw is int) return raw;
    if (raw is num) return raw.toInt();
    return int.tryParse(raw?.toString() ?? '');
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

import '../domain/pronunciation_models.dart';
import '../domain/services/pronunciation_signal_probe.dart';

final class AndroidPronunciationSignalProbe
    implements PronunciationSignalProbe {
  const AndroidPronunciationSignalProbe();

  static const MethodChannel _channel = MethodChannel(
    'com.deutschbilarabi.app/pronunciation_signal',
  );

  @override
  Future<bool> requestPermission() async {
    try {
      return await _channel.invokeMethod<bool>('requestPermission') ?? false;
    } on PlatformException {
      return false;
    } on MissingPluginException {
      return false;
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<PronunciationSignalCapture> capture({
    Duration maxDuration = const Duration(milliseconds: 1600),
  }) async {
    try {
      final map = await _channel.invokeMapMethod<Object?, Object?>(
        'capture',
        <String, Object?>{
          'maxDurationMs': maxDuration.inMilliseconds.clamp(500, 2500),
        },
      );
      if (map == null || map['available'] != true) {
        return PronunciationSignalCapture.unavailable(
          map?['reason']?.toString() ?? 'pronunciation_capture_unavailable',
        );
      }
      return PronunciationSignalCapture.available(
        PronunciationSignalFeatures.fromMap(map),
      );
    } on PlatformException catch (error) {
      return PronunciationSignalCapture.unavailable(
        error.code.isEmpty ? 'pronunciation_capture_failed' : error.code,
      );
    } on MissingPluginException {
      return const PronunciationSignalCapture.unavailable(
        'pronunciation_signal_probe_unavailable',
      );
    }
  }
}

enum PronunciationContrastKind {

  roundedVowel,
  vowelFronting,
  ichAch,
}

final class PronunciationContrast {
  const PronunciationContrast({
    required this.id,
    required this.kind,
    required this.leftToken,
    required this.rightToken,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.coachingAr,
  });

  final String id;
  final PronunciationContrastKind kind;

    required this.item,
    required this.token,
    required this.isLeft,

  final T item;
  final String token;

  const PronunciationTrial({
    required this.contrast,
    required this.target,
    required this.leftItem,
    required this.rightItem,
    required this.round,
  });

  final PronunciationContrast contrast;
  final PronunciationTarget<T> target;
  final T leftItem;
  final T rightItem;
  final int round;

  List<String> get options => <String>[contrast.leftToken, contrast.rightToken];
}

final class PronunciationPerceptionResult {
  const PronunciationPerceptionResult({
    required this.correct,
    required this.expectedToken,
    required this.selectedToken,
    required this.feedbackAr,
  });

  final bool correct;
  final String expectedToken;
  final String selectedToken;
  final String feedbackAr;
}

final class PronunciationSignalFeatures {
  const PronunciationSignalFeatures({
    required this.captureDurationMs,
    required this.voicedDurationMs,
    required this.rms,
    required this.peak,
    required this.zeroCrossingRate,
  });

  final int captureDurationMs;
  final int voicedDurationMs;
  final double rms;
  final double peak;
  final double zeroCrossingRate;

  factory PronunciationSignalFeatures.fromMap(Map<Object?, Object?> map) {
    int asInt(String key) {
      final value = map[key];
      return value is num ? value.toInt() : 0;
    }

    double asDouble(String key) {
      final value = map[key];
      return value is num ? value.toDouble() : 0;
    }

    return PronunciationSignalFeatures(
      captureDurationMs: asInt('captureDurationMs').clamp(0, 5000).toInt(),
      voicedDurationMs: asInt('voicedDurationMs').clamp(0, 5000).toInt(),
      rms: asDouble('rms').clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble(),
      peak: asDouble('peak').clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble(),
      zeroCrossingRate: asDouble('zeroCrossingRate').clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble(),
    );
  }
}

final class PronunciationSignalCapture {
  const PronunciationSignalCapture.available(this.features)
      : available = true,
        reason = null;

  const PronunciationSignalCapture.unavailable(this.reason)
      : available = false,
        features = null;

  final bool available;
  final String? reason;
  final PronunciationSignalFeatures? features;
}

final class PronunciationProductionFeedback {
  const PronunciationProductionFeedback({
    required this.signalAvailable,
    required this.signalUsable,
    required this.timingScore,
    required this.messageAr,
    required this.features,
  });

  final bool signalAvailable;
  final bool signalUsable;
  final double timingScore;
  final String messageAr;
  final PronunciationSignalFeatures? features;

  bool get phonemeAccuracyAvailable => false;
}

final class PronunciationConfusionStat {
  const PronunciationConfusionStat({
    required this.contrastId,
    required this.attempts,
    required this.mistakes,
  });

  final String contrastId;
  final int attempts;
  final int mistakes;

  double get errorRate => attempts == 0 ? 0 : mistakes / attempts;
}

FILE: lib/features/pronunciation/pronunciation_lab_engine.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import '../../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../../core/srs_facets.dart';
import '../../models/learner.dart';
import 'domain/pronunciation_models.dart';

final class PronunciationLabEngine<T extends LearningContent> {
  PronunciationLabEngine(Iterable<T> corpus)
      : _items = List<T>.unmodifiable(corpus);

  final List<T> _items;

  List<PronunciationContrast> availableContrasts(
    Iterable<PronunciationContrast> catalog,
  ) {
    final result = <PronunciationContrast>[];
    for (final contrast in catalog) {
      if (_find(contrast.leftToken) != null &&
          _find(contrast.rightToken) != null) {
        result.add(contrast);
      }
    }
    return List<PronunciationContrast>.unmodifiable(result);
  }

  PronunciationTrial<T>? buildTrial(
    PronunciationContrast contrast, {
    required int round,
  }) {
    final left = _find(contrast.leftToken);
    final right = _find(contrast.rightToken);
    if (left == null || right == null) return null;

    final chooseLeft = (_stableHash(contrast.id) + round.abs()) % 2 == 0;
    final target = chooseLeft
        ? PronunciationTarget<T>(
            item: left,
            token: contrast.leftToken,
            isLeft: true,
          )
        : PronunciationTarget<T>(
            item: right,
            token: contrast.rightToken,
            isLeft: false,
          );

    return PronunciationTrial<T>(
      contrast: contrast,
      target: target,
      leftItem: left,
      rightItem: right,
      round: round,
    );
  }

  PronunciationPerceptionResult scorePerception(
    PronunciationTrial<T> trial,
    String selectedToken,
  ) {
    final selected = _normalize(selectedToken);
    final expected = _normalize(trial.target.token);
    final correct = selected.isNotEmpty && selected == expected;
    return PronunciationPerceptionResult(
      correct: correct,
      expectedToken: trial.target.token,
      selectedToken: selectedToken.trim(),
      feedbackAr: correct
          ? 'تمييز صحيح. انتقل الآن إلى الإنتاج وكرر الصوت المستهدف.'
          : 'التمييز غير صحيح. استمع مرة أخرى ثم ركّز على الفرق المحدد في الإرشاد.',
    );
  }

  List<PronunciationConfusionStat> confusionStats(LearnerState state) {
    final attempts = <String, int>{};
    final mistakes = <String, int>{};

    for (final attempt in state.attempts) {
      if (attempt.facetType != ReviewFacetType.pronunciation) continue;
      final variant = attempt.variantKey?.trim() ?? '';
      if (!variant.startsWith('contrast:') ||
          !variant.endsWith(':perception')) {
        continue;
      }
      final parts = variant.split(':');
      if (parts.length != 3 || parts[1].isEmpty) continue;
      final id = parts[1];
      attempts[id] = (attempts[id] ?? 0) + 1;
      if (!attempt.correct) {
        mistakes[id] = (mistakes[id] ?? 0) + 1;
      }
    }

    final result = <PronunciationConfusionStat>[
      for (final entry in attempts.entries)
        PronunciationConfusionStat(
          contrastId: entry.key,
          attempts: entry.value,
          mistakes: mistakes[entry.key] ?? 0,
        ),
    ]..sort((a, b) {
        final errors = b.mistakes.compareTo(a.mistakes);
        if (errors != 0) return errors;
        return b.attempts.compareTo(a.attempts);
      });
    return List<PronunciationConfusionStat>.unmodifiable(result);
  }

  T? _find(String token) {
    final key = _normalize(token);
    if (key.isEmpty) return null;
    for (final item in _items) {
      if (_normalize(item.sourceText) == key) return item;
    }
    return null;
  }

  static String _normalize(String raw) {
    var value = raw.trim().toLowerCase();
    value = value.replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');
    value = value.replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^(der|die|das)\s+'), '');
    return value.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[.!?]+$'), '').trim();
  }

  static int _stableHash(String value) {
    var hash = 17;
    for (final unit in value.codeUnits) {
      hash = ((hash * 31) + unit) & 0x7fffffff;
    }
    return hash;
  }
}

import '../../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../../core/srs_facets.dart';
import '../../features/audio/domain/entities/audio_playback_result.dart';
import '../../features/audio/domain/services/i_audio_runtime.dart';
import '../../features/audio/hybrid_pronunciation_service.dart';
import '../../models/learner.dart';
import '../../services/repository.dart';
import 'domain/pronunciation_models.dart';
import 'domain/services/pronunciation_signal_probe.dart';
import 'pronunciation_lab_engine.dart';
import 'pronunciation_signal_evaluator.dart';

final class PronunciationLabService<T extends LearningContent> {
  PronunciationLabService({
    required this.repository,
    required this.audioRuntime,
    required this.signalProbe,
    required this.languageCode,
    required Iterable<T> corpus,
  })  : _pronunciationAudio = HybridPronunciationService(
          audioRuntime: audioRuntime,
        ),
        engine = PronunciationLabEngine<T>(corpus);

  final LearnerRepository repository;
  final IAudioRuntime audioRuntime;
  final PronunciationSignalProbe signalProbe;
  final String languageCode;
  final HybridPronunciationService _pronunciationAudio;
  final PronunciationLabEngine<T> engine;

  List<PronunciationContrast> availableContrasts(
    Iterable<PronunciationContrast> catalog,
  ) =>
      engine.availableContrasts(catalog);

  PronunciationTrial<T>? buildTrial(
    PronunciationContrast contrast, {
    required int round,
  }) =>
      engine.buildTrial(contrast, round: round);

  List<PronunciationConfusionStat> confusionStats([LearnerState? state]) =>
      engine.confusionStats(state ?? repository.load());

  Future<AudioPlaybackResult> playTarget(
    PronunciationTrial<T> trial, {
    bool slow = false,
  }) =>
      _pronunciationAudio.play(
        conceptId: trial.target.item.id,
        text: trial.target.token,
        languageCode: languageCode,
        slow: slow,
      );

  Future<PronunciationPerceptionResult> answerPerception(
    PronunciationTrial<T> trial, {
    required String selectedToken,
    required int seconds,
  }) async {
    final result = engine.scorePerception(trial, selectedToken);
    await repository.recordFacet(
      item: trial.target.item,
      facetType: ReviewFacetType.pronunciation,
      variantKey: 'contrast:${trial.contrast.id}:perception',
      answer: selectedToken,
      correct: result.correct,
      seconds: seconds.clamp(0, 3600).toInt(),
      hinted: false,
    );
    return result;
  }

  Future<PronunciationProductionFeedback> captureProduction(
    PronunciationTrial<T> trial,
  ) async {
    if (!await signalProbe.requestPermission()) {
      return PronunciationSignalEvaluator.evaluate(
        capture: const PronunciationSignalCapture.unavailable(
          'microphone_permission_required',
        ),
        targetToken: trial.target.token,
      );
    }

    final capture = await signalProbe.capture(
      maxDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 1700),
    );
    return PronunciationSignalEvaluator.evaluate(
      capture: capture,
      targetToken: trial.target.token,
    );
  }
}

import 'domain/pronunciation_models.dart';

abstract final class PronunciationSignalEvaluator {
  static PronunciationProductionFeedback evaluate({
    required PronunciationSignalCapture capture,
    required String targetToken,
  }) {
    final features = capture.features;
    if (!capture.available || features == null) {
      return PronunciationProductionFeedback(
        signalAvailable: false,
        signalUsable: false,
        timingScore: 0,
        messageAr: _unavailableMessage(capture.reason),
        features: null,
      );
    }

    final expectedMs =
        (280 + targetToken.trim().length * 65).clamp(420, 1500).toInt();
    final observedMs = features.voicedDurationMs;
    final delta = (observedMs - expectedMs).abs();
    final timingScore = (1 - (delta / expectedMs)).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();

    if (features.rms < .012) {
      return PronunciationProductionFeedback(
        signalAvailable: true,
        signalUsable: false,
        timingScore: timingScore,
        messageAr:
            'الصوت منخفض جدًا. قرّب الهاتف قليلًا وارفع صوتك بشكل طبيعي.',
        features: features,
      );
    }
    if (features.peak >= .985) {
      return PronunciationProductionFeedback(
        signalAvailable: true,
        signalUsable: false,
        timingScore: timingScore,
        messageAr:
            'الإشارة مرتفعة جدًا وقد تكون مشوشة. ابتعد قليلًا عن الميكروفون.',
        features: features,
      );
    }
    if (features.voicedDurationMs < 180) {
      return PronunciationProductionFeedback(
        signalAvailable: true,
        signalUsable: false,
        timingScore: timingScore,
        messageAr:
            'المقطع المنطوق قصير جدًا للتحليل. انطق الكلمة كاملة ثم أعد المحاولة.',
        features: features,
      );
    }
    if (features.zeroCrossingRate > .32) {
      return PronunciationProductionFeedback(
        signalAvailable: true,
        signalUsable: false,
        timingScore: timingScore,
        messageAr: 'هناك ضوضاء أو احتكاك مرتفع في التسجيل. جرّب مكانًا أهدأ.',
        features: features,
      );
    }

    final timingMessage = timingScore >= .72
        ? 'توقيت النطق ضمن نطاق تدريبي مناسب.'
        : observedMs < expectedMs
            ? 'النطق أسرع من النطاق التدريبي المتوقع؛ أبطئ قليلًا.'
            : 'النطق أطول من النطاق التدريبي المتوقع؛ حاول قول الكلمة بوحدة واحدة.';

    return PronunciationProductionFeedback(
      signalAvailable: true,
      signalUsable: true,
      timingScore: timingScore,
      messageAr:
          '$timingMessage هذا فحص محلي لجودة الإشارة والتوقيت، وليس درجة دقة للمخارج أو الفونيمات.',
      features: features,
    );
  }

  static String _unavailableMessage(String? reason) => switch (reason) {
        'microphone_permission_required' =>
          'إذن الميكروفون مطلوب. فعّله ثم أعد المحاولة.',
        'pronunciation_capture_busy' =>
          'هناك تسجيل جارٍ بالفعل. أنهه قبل بدء تسجيل جديد.',
        _ => 'فحص الميكروفون المحلي غير متاح على هذا الجهاز حاليًا. '
            'لن نختلق درجة نطق بديلة.',
      };
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/adjective_declension_models.dart';
import '../domain/adjective_declension_repository.dart';

final class AdjectiveDeclensionNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  AdjectiveDeclensionNotifier(this._repository);

  static const Set<String> supportedEndings = <String>{
    '-e',
    '-en',
    '-er',
    '-es',
    '-em',
  };

  final AdjectiveDeclensionRepository _repository;

  List<AdjectiveExerciseItem> _exercises = const <AdjectiveExerciseItem>[];
  DeclensionType? _activeType;
  int _currentIndex = 0;
  String? _selectedEnding;
  bool? _isCorrect;
  bool _showExplanation = false;
  bool _isLoading = false;
  int _selectionGeneration = 0;

  List<AdjectiveExerciseItem> get exercises =>
      List<AdjectiveExerciseItem>.unmodifiable(_exercises);
  DeclensionType? get activeType => _activeType;
  int get currentIndex => _currentIndex;
  String? get selectedEnding => _selectedEnding;
  bool? get isCorrect => _isCorrect;
  bool get showExplanation => _showExplanation;
  bool get isLoading => _isLoading;

  AdjectiveExerciseItem? get currentExercise {
    if (_exercises.isEmpty || _currentIndex >= _exercises.length) return null;
    return _exercises[_currentIndex];
  }

  Future<void> load({DeclensionType? type}) async {
    _isLoading = true;
    _activeType = type;
    _selectionGeneration++;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      final loaded = await _repository.getExercises(type: type);
      _exercises = List<AdjectiveExerciseItem>.unmodifiable(loaded);
      _currentIndex = 0;
      _clearAnswerState();
    } finally {
      _isLoading = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  Future<void> selectEnding(String ending) async {
    final exercise = currentExercise;
    if (exercise == null || _showExplanation) return;

    final normalized = _normalizeEnding(ending);
    if (!supportedEndings.contains(normalized)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        ending,
        'ending',
        'unsupported adjective ending',
      );
    }

    final generation = ++_selectionGeneration;
    _selectedEnding = normalized;
    _isCorrect = null;
    _showExplanation = false;
    notifyListeners();

    final correct = await _repository.checkAnswer(exercise.id, normalized);
    if (generation != _selectionGeneration ||
        currentExercise?.id != exercise.id) {
      return;
    }

    _isCorrect = correct;
    _showExplanation = true;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void nextExercise() {
    if (_exercises.isEmpty || !_showExplanation) return;
    _selectionGeneration++;
    _currentIndex = (_currentIndex + 1) % _exercises.length;
    _clearAnswerState();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> reset() async {
    await load(type: _activeType);
  }

  void _clearAnswerState() {
    _selectedEnding = null;
    _isCorrect = null;
    _showExplanation = false;
  }

  static String _normalizeEnding(String value) {
    final trimmed = value.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (trimmed.isEmpty) return '';
    return trimmed.startsWith('-') ? trimmed : '-$trimmed';
  }
}

import '../domain/adjective_declension_models.dart';
import '../domain/adjective_declension_repository.dart';

final class LocalAdjectiveDeclensionRepository
    implements AdjectiveDeclensionRepository {
  LocalAdjectiveDeclensionRepository() : _exercises = _buildExerciseBank();

  final List<AdjectiveExerciseItem> _exercises;

  @override
  Future<List<AdjectiveExerciseItem>> getExercises({
    DeclensionType? type,
  }) async {
    final selected = type == null
        ? _exercises
        : _exercises
            .where((item) => item.declensionType == type)
            .toList(growable: false);
    return List<AdjectiveExerciseItem>.unmodifiable(selected);
  }

  @override
  Future<bool> checkAnswer(
    String exerciseId,
    String selectedEnding,
  ) async {
    final normalized = _normalizeEnding(selectedEnding);
    for (final item in _exercises) {
      if (item.id == exerciseId) {
        return normalized == item.correctEnding;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  static String _normalizeEnding(String value) {
    final trimmed = value.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (trimmed.isEmpty) return '';
    return trimmed.startsWith('-') ? trimmed : '-$trimmed';
  }

        gender: GrammaticalGender.maskulin,
        explanation:
            'بدون أداة في Dativ للمذكر تحمل الصفة علامة الحالة بالنهاية -em.',
      ),
      const _ExerciseSpec(
        id: 'strong_dat_plural',
        sentence: 'Mit ___ Brötchen beginnt das Frühstück.',
        adjective: 'frisch',
        type: DeclensionType.strong,
        grammaticalCase: GrammaticalCase.dativ,
        gender: GrammaticalGender.plural,
        explanation:
            'بدون أداة في Dativ الجمع تكون نهاية الصفة القوية -en.',
      ),
      const _ExerciseSpec(
        id: 'strong_gen_fem',
        sentence: 'Trotz ___ Kälte gehen wir spazieren.',
        adjective: 'stark',
        type: DeclensionType.strong,
        grammaticalCase: GrammaticalCase.genitiv,
        gender: GrammaticalGender.feminin,
        explanation:
            'بدون أداة في Genitiv للمؤنث تكون نهاية الصفة القوية -er.',
      ),
    ];

    final exercises = specs
        .map(
          (spec) => AdjectiveExerciseItem(
            id: spec.id,
            sentenceWithBlank: spec.sentence,
            baseAdjective: spec.adjective,
            correctEnding: _endingFor(
              spec.type,
              spec.grammaticalCase,
              spec.gender,
            ),
            declensionType: spec.type,
            grammaticalCase: spec.grammaticalCase,
            grammaticalGender: spec.gender,
            explanationAr: spec.explanation,
          ),
        )
        .toList(growable: false);

    final ids = exercises.map((item) => item.id).toSet();
    if (ids.length != exercises.length) {
      throw StateError('adjective exercise bank contains duplicate ids');
    }
    return List<AdjectiveExerciseItem>.unmodifiable(exercises);
  }

  static String _endingFor(
    DeclensionType type,
    GrammaticalCase grammaticalCase,
    GrammaticalGender gender,
  ) {
    return switch (type) {
      DeclensionType.weak => _weakEnding(grammaticalCase, gender),
      DeclensionType.mixed => _mixedEnding(grammaticalCase, gender),
      DeclensionType.strong => _strongEnding(grammaticalCase, gender),
    };
  }

  static String _weakEnding(
    GrammaticalCase grammaticalCase,
    GrammaticalGender gender,
  ) {
    if (grammaticalCase == GrammaticalCase.dativ ||
        grammaticalCase == GrammaticalCase.genitiv) {
      return '-en';
    }
    if (grammaticalCase == GrammaticalCase.akkusativ &&
        gender == GrammaticalGender.maskulin) {
      return '-en';
    }
    if (gender == GrammaticalGender.plural) return '-en';
    return '-e';
  }

  static String _mixedEnding(
    GrammaticalCase grammaticalCase,
    GrammaticalGender gender,
  ) {
    if (grammaticalCase == GrammaticalCase.dativ ||
        grammaticalCase == GrammaticalCase.genitiv) {
      return '-en';
    }
    if (gender == GrammaticalGender.plural) return '-en';
    if (grammaticalCase == GrammaticalCase.akkusativ &&
        gender == GrammaticalGender.maskulin) {
      return '-en';
    }
    return switch (gender) {
      GrammaticalGender.maskulin => '-er',
      GrammaticalGender.feminin => '-e',
      GrammaticalGender.neutral => '-es',
      GrammaticalGender.plural => '-en',
    };
  }

  static String _strongEnding(
    GrammaticalCase grammaticalCase,
    GrammaticalGender gender,
  ) {
    return switch (grammaticalCase) {
      GrammaticalCase.nominativ => switch (gender) {
          GrammaticalGender.maskulin => '-er',
          GrammaticalGender.feminin => '-e',
          GrammaticalGender.neutral => '-es',
          GrammaticalGender.plural => '-e',
        },
      GrammaticalCase.akkusativ => switch (gender) {
          GrammaticalGender.maskulin => '-en',
          GrammaticalGender.feminin => '-e',
          GrammaticalGender.neutral => '-es',
          GrammaticalGender.plural => '-e',
        },
      GrammaticalCase.dativ => switch (gender) {
          GrammaticalGender.maskulin => '-em',
          GrammaticalGender.feminin => '-er',
          GrammaticalGender.neutral => '-em',
          GrammaticalGender.plural => '-en',
        },
      GrammaticalCase.genitiv => switch (gender) {
          GrammaticalGender.maskulin => '-en',
          GrammaticalGender.feminin => '-er',
          GrammaticalGender.neutral => '-en',
          GrammaticalGender.plural => '-er',
        },
    };
  }
}

final class _ExerciseSpec {
  const _ExerciseSpec({
    required this.id,
    required this.sentence,
    required this.adjective,
    required this.type,
    required this.grammaticalCase,
    required this.gender,
    required this.explanation,
  });

  final String id;
  final String sentence;
  final String adjective;
  final DeclensionType type;
  final GrammaticalCase grammaticalCase;
  final GrammaticalGender gender;
  final String explanation;
}

FILE: lib/features/adjective_declension_agent/domain/adjective_declension_models.dart
--------------------------------------------------
enum DeclensionType { weak, strong, mixed }

enum GrammaticalCase { nominativ, akkusativ, dativ, genitiv }

enum GrammaticalGender { maskulin, feminin, neutral, plural }

final class AdjectiveExerciseItem {
  const AdjectiveExerciseItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.sentenceWithBlank,
    required this.baseAdjective,
    required this.correctEnding,
    required this.declensionType,
    required this.grammaticalCase,
    required this.grammaticalGender,
    required this.explanationAr,
  });

  final String id;
  final String sentenceWithBlank;
  final String baseAdjective;
  final String correctEnding;
  final DeclensionType declensionType;
  final GrammaticalCase grammaticalCase;
  final GrammaticalGender grammaticalGender;
  final String explanationAr;

  String get completedAdjective =>
      baseAdjective + correctEnding.substring(1);

  String renderCompletedSentence() =>
      sentenceWithBlank.replaceFirst('___', completedAdjective);
}

import '../application/adjective_declension_notifier.dart';
import '../domain/adjective_declension_models.dart';

final class AdjectiveDeclensionScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const AdjectiveDeclensionScreen({
    required this.notifier,
    super.key,
  });

  final AdjectiveDeclensionNotifier notifier;

  @override
  State<AdjectiveDeclensionScreen> createState() =>
      _AdjectiveDeclensionScreenState();
}

final class _AdjectiveDeclensionScreenState
    extends State<AdjectiveDeclensionScreen> {
  static const List<String> _endingOptions = <String>[
    '-e',
    '-en',
    '-er',
    '-es',
    '-em',
  ];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    if (widget.notifier.currentExercise == null &&
        !widget.notifier.isLoading) {
      unawaited(widget.notifier.load());
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Directionality(
        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
        child: Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(
            title: const Text('نهايات الصفات · Adjektivendungen'),
          ),
          body: ListenableBuilder(
            listenable: widget.notifier,
            builder: (context, _) {
              final notifier = widget.notifier;
              final exercise = notifier.currentExercise;

              if (notifier.isLoading && exercise == null) {
                return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
              }
              if (exercise == null) {
                return _EmptyState(
                  onRetry: () => unawaited(notifier.load()),
                );
              }

              return ListView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 36),
                children: <Widget>[
                  _ProgressHeader(notifier: notifier),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  _ExerciseCard(exercise: exercise),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  _EndingOptions(
                    notifier: notifier,
                    options: _endingOptions,
                  ),
                  if (notifier.showExplanation) ...<Widget>[
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    _ExplanationCard(
                      exercise: exercise,
                      correct: notifier.isCorrect == true,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    FilledButton.icon(
                      onPressed: notifier.nextExercise,
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded),
                      label: const Text('التمرين التالي'),
                    ),
                  ],
                ],
              );
            },
          ),
        ),
      );
}

final class _ProgressHeader extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ProgressHeader({required this.notifier});

  final AdjectiveDeclensionNotifier notifier;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final total = notifier.exercises.length;
    final position = total == 0 ? 0 : notifier.currentIndex + 1;

    return AppGlassCard(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
      borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(90),
      glowColor: AppColors.primary,
      child: Row(
        children: <Widget>[
          const Icon(Icons.school_outlined, color: AppColors.primary),
          const SizedBox(width: 10),
          Expanded(
            child: Text(
              'اختر نهاية الصفة الصحيحة',
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
          ),
          Text(
            '$position / $total',
            textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
            style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
              color: AppColors.primary,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _ExerciseCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ExerciseCard({required this.exercise});

  final AdjectiveExerciseItem exercise;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        borderColor: AppColors.secondary.withAlpha(90),
        glowColor: AppColors.secondary,
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            Wrap(
              spacing: 8,
              runSpacing: 8,
              children: <Widget>[
                _GrammarBadge(
                  label: _declensionLabel(exercise.declensionType),
                  color: AppColors.primary,
                ),
                _GrammarBadge(
                  label: _caseLabel(exercise.grammaticalCase),
                  color: AppColors.secondary,
                ),
                _GrammarBadge(
                  label: _genderLabel(exercise.grammaticalGender),
                  color: AppColors.achievement,
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 20),
            Text(
              exercise.sentenceWithBlank,
              textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall?.copyWith(
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                  ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Text(
              'الصفة: ${exercise.baseAdjective}',
              textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(
                color: AppColors.primary,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );

  static String _declensionLabel(DeclensionType type) => switch (type) {
        DeclensionType.weak => 'ضعيف · weak',
        DeclensionType.mixed => 'مختلط · mixed',
        DeclensionType.strong => 'قوي · strong',
      };

  static String _caseLabel(GrammaticalCase grammaticalCase) =>
      switch (grammaticalCase) {
        GrammaticalCase.nominativ => 'Nominativ',
        GrammaticalCase.akkusativ => 'Akkusativ',
        GrammaticalCase.dativ => 'Dativ',
        GrammaticalCase.genitiv => 'Genitiv',
      };

  static String _genderLabel(GrammaticalGender gender) => switch (gender) {
        GrammaticalGender.maskulin => 'مذكر',
        GrammaticalGender.feminin => 'مؤنث',
        GrammaticalGender.neutral => 'محايد',
        GrammaticalGender.plural => 'جمع',
      };
}

final class _EndingOptions extends StatelessWidget {
  const _EndingOptions({
    required this.notifier,
    required this.options,
  });

  final AdjectiveDeclensionNotifier notifier;
  final List<String> options;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final answered = notifier.showExplanation;
    return AppGlassCard(
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          Text('اختر النهاية', style: AppTypography.title),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Wrap(
            alignment: WrapAlignment.center,
            spacing: 10,
            runSpacing: 10,
            children: <Widget>[
              for (final ending in options)
                _EndingChoiceCard(
                  ending: ending,
                  selected: notifier.selectedEnding == ending,
                  answered: answered,
                  correct: notifier.currentExercise?.correctEnding == ending,
                  onTap: answered
                      ? null
                      : () => unawaited(notifier.selectEnding(ending)),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _EndingChoiceCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _EndingChoiceCard({
    required this.ending,
    required this.selected,
    required this.answered,
    required this.correct,
    required this.onTap,
  });

  final String ending;
  final bool selected;
  final bool answered;
  final bool correct;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final errorColor = Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error;
    final borderColor = answered && correct
        ? AppColors.mastery
        : answered && selected && !correct
            ? errorColor
            : selected
                ? AppColors.primary
                : Theme.of(context).dividerColor;
    final glowColor = selected || (answered && correct) ? borderColor : null;

    return SizedBox(
      width: 92,
      child: AppGlassCard(
        onTap: onTap,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 16),
        borderRadius: 20,
        borderColor: borderColor,
        glowColor: glowColor,
        child: Center(
          child: Text(
            ending,
            textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge?.copyWith(
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                  color: borderColor,
                ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _ExplanationCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ExplanationCard({
    required this.exercise,
    required this.correct,
  });

  final AdjectiveExerciseItem exercise;
  final bool correct;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final errorColor = Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error;
    final color = correct ? AppColors.mastery : errorColor;

    return AppGlassCard(
      borderColor: color.withAlpha(120),
      glowColor: color,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          Row(
            children: <Widget>[
              Icon(
                correct ? Icons.check_circle_outline : Icons.info_outline,
                color: color,
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  correct ? 'إجابة صحيحة' : 'راجع القاعدة',
                  style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(color: color),
                ),
              ),
              Text(
                exercise.correctEnding,
                textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(
                  color: color,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Text(exercise.explanationAr, style: AppTypography.body),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          Text(
            exercise.renderCompletedSentence(),
            textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _GrammarBadge extends StatelessWidget {
  const _GrammarBadge({
    required this.label,
    required this.color,
  });

  final String label;
  final Color color;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => DecoratedBox(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: color.withAlpha(22),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
          border: Border.all(color: color.withAlpha(90)),
        ),
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 5),
          child: Text(
            label,
            style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(color: color),
          ),
        ),
      );
}

final class _EmptyState extends StatelessWidget {
  const _EmptyState({required this.onRetry});

  final VoidCallback onRetry;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Center(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
          child: AppGlassCard(
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: <Widget>[
                const Icon(
                  Icons.menu_book_outlined,
                  color: AppColors.primary,
                  size: 42,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                Text('لا توجد تمارين متاحة.', style: AppTypography.title),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                FilledButton(
                  onPressed: onRetry,
                  child: const Text('إعادة التحميل'),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../data/local_alltagssprache_repository.dart';
import '../domain/alltagssprache_models.dart';

class AlltagsspracheNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  AlltagsspracheNotifier(this.repository) : _items = repository.all();

  final LocalAlltagsspracheRepository repository;

  List<AlltagScenario> _items;
  AlltagTopic? _topic;
  int _currentIndex = 0;
  int? _selectedIndex;
  bool _checked = false;

  List<AlltagScenario> get items => List<AlltagScenario>.unmodifiable(_items);
  AlltagTopic? get topic => _topic;
  int get currentIndex => _currentIndex;
  int? get selectedIndex => _selectedIndex;
  bool get checked => _checked;

  AlltagScenario get current {
    if (_items.isEmpty) {
      throw StateError('No Alltagssprache scenarios are available.');
    }
    return _items[_currentIndex];
  }

  bool? get isCorrect {
    if (!_checked || _selectedIndex == null) return null;
    return repository.isChoiceCorrect(current, _selectedIndex!);
  }

  String get feedbackAr => _checked ? current.feedbackAr : '';

  void filterByTopic(AlltagTopic? topic) {
    _topic = topic;
    _items = topic == null ? repository.all() : repository.byTopic(topic);
    _currentIndex = 0;
    _resetAnswer();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void selectChoice(int index) {
    if (index < 0 || index >= current.optionsDe.length) {
      throw RangeError.range(
        index,
        0,
        current.optionsDe.length - 1,
        'index',
      );
    }
    if (_checked) return;

    _selectedIndex = index;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void checkSelection() {
    if (_selectedIndex == null) {
      throw StateError('Select an answer before checking it.');
    }
    if (_checked) return;

    _checked = true;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void nextScenario() {
    if (_items.isEmpty) return;

    _currentIndex = (_currentIndex + 1) % _items.length;
    _resetAnswer();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void _resetAnswer() {
    _selectedIndex = null;
    _checked = false;
  }
}

      etiquetteAr:
          'استخدمها عندما يكون المعنى واضحًا؛ نبرة الصوت والسياق مهمان لأنها مختصرة.',
      promptAr: 'اعتذر شخص عن تعديل بسيط لا يزعجك. ماذا يمكن أن تقول؟',
      optionsDe: <String>[
        'Passt schon, kein Problem.',
        'Das war unverzeihlich.',
        'Reden Sie nicht mit mir.',
      ],
      correctIndex: 0,
      feedbackAr:
          'Passt schon, kein Problem تطمئن الطرف الآخر بطريقة يومية بسيطة.',
    ),
  ];

  List<AlltagScenario> all() => List<AlltagScenario>.unmodifiable(_items);

  List<AlltagScenario> byTopic(AlltagTopic topic) => List<AlltagScenario>.unmodifiable(
        _items.where((item) => item.topic == topic),
      );

  AlltagScenario? byId(String id) {
    for (final item in _items) {
      if (item.id == id) return item;
    }
    return null;
  }

  bool isChoiceCorrect(AlltagScenario item, int selectedIndex) =>
      selectedIndex == item.correctIndex;
}

enum AlltagTopic {
  neighborhood,
  shopping,
  punctuality,
  politePhrases,
}

extension AlltagTopicLabels on AlltagTopic {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        AlltagTopic.neighborhood => 'Nachbarschaft',
        AlltagTopic.shopping => 'Einkaufen',
        AlltagTopic.punctuality => 'Pünktlichkeit',
        AlltagTopic.politePhrases => 'Höfliche Wendungen',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        AlltagTopic.neighborhood => 'الجيرة وآداب السكن',
        AlltagTopic.shopping => 'التسوق',
        AlltagTopic.punctuality => 'المواعيد',
        AlltagTopic.politePhrases => 'عبارات يومية مهذبة',
      };
}

class AlltagScenario {
  const AlltagScenario({
    required this.id,
    required this.topic,
    required this.phraseDe,
    required this.meaningAr,
    required this.contextDe,
    required this.etiquetteAr,
    required this.promptAr,
    required this.optionsDe,
    required this.correctIndex,
    required this.feedbackAr,
  }) : assert(optionsDe.length >= 2),
       assert(correctIndex >= 0),
       assert(correctIndex < optionsDe.length);

  final String id;
  final AlltagTopic topic;
  final String phraseDe;
  final String meaningAr;
  final String contextDe;
  final String etiquetteAr;
  final String promptAr;
  final List<String> optionsDe;
  final int correctIndex;
  final String feedbackAr;

  String get correctAnswer => optionsDe[correctIndex];
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/learning_preferences.dart';
import '../domain/storage_metrics.dart';

abstract interface class SettingsController implements Listenable {
  LearningPreferences get preferences;
  StorageMetrics get storageMetrics;
  bool get isInitialized;
  bool get isSaving;
  bool get isBusy;
  bool get hasError;
  String? get errorCode;

  Future<void> initialize();
  Future<void> setSpeechRatePreset(SpeechRatePreset preset);
  Future<void> setTextScaleFactor(double value);
  Future<void> setShowAutomaticTranslation(bool value);
  Future<bool> clearCache();
  Future<bool> resetLearningProgress({required bool confirmed});
  void dispose();
}

final class UnavailableSettingsController implements SettingsController {
  const UnavailableSettingsController();

  @override
  LearningPreferences get preferences => const LearningPreferences();

  @override
  StorageMetrics get storageMetrics =>
      const StorageMetrics(localDataBytes: 0);

  @override
  bool get isInitialized => true;

  @override
  bool get isSaving => false;

  @override
  bool get isBusy => false;

  @override
  bool get hasError => false;

  @override
  String? get errorCode => null;

  @override
  Future<void> initialize() async {}

  @override
  Future<void> setSpeechRatePreset(SpeechRatePreset preset) async {}

  @override
  Future<void> setTextScaleFactor(double value) async {}

  @override
  Future<void> setShowAutomaticTranslation(bool value) async {}

  @override
  Future<bool> clearCache() async => false;

  @override
  Future<bool> resetLearningProgress({required bool confirmed}) async => false;

  @override
  void addListener(VoidCallback listener) {}

  @override
  void removeListener(VoidCallback listener) {}

  @override
  void dispose() {}
}

FILE: lib/features/app_settings/application/settings_notifier.dart

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/learning_preferences.dart';
import '../domain/settings_repository.dart';
import '../domain/storage_metrics.dart';
import 'settings_controller.dart';

final class SettingsNotifier extends ChangeNotifier implements SettingsController {
  SettingsNotifier(this._repository, this._progressResetter);

  final SettingsRepository _repository;
  final LearningProgressResetter _progressResetter;

  LearningPreferences _preferences = const LearningPreferences();
  LearningPreferences _persistedPreferences = const LearningPreferences();
  StorageMetrics _storageMetrics =
      const StorageMetrics(localDataBytes: 0);
  bool _initialized = false;
  bool _saving = false;
  bool _busy = false;
  String? _errorCode;
  Future<void> _writeTail = Future<void>.value();
  int _saveGeneration = 0;

  LearningPreferences get preferences => _preferences;
  StorageMetrics get storageMetrics => _storageMetrics;
  bool get isInitialized => _initialized;
  bool get isSaving => _saving;
  bool get isBusy => _busy;
  bool get hasError => _errorCode != null;
  String? get errorCode => _errorCode;

  Future<void> initialize() async {
    if (_initialized) return;
    _busy = true;
    _errorCode = null;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      _preferences = await _repository.loadPreferences();
      _persistedPreferences = _preferences;
      _storageMetrics = await _repository.loadStorageMetrics();
      _initialized = true;
    } on Object {
      _errorCode = 'settings_initialize_failed';
      _initialized = true;
    } finally {
      _busy = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  Future<void> setSpeechRatePreset(SpeechRatePreset preset) {
    return _persist(
      _preferences.copyWith(speechRatePreset: preset),
    );
  }

  Future<void> setTextScaleFactor(double value) {
    return _persist(
      _preferences.copyWith(textScaleFactor: value),
    );
  }

  Future<void> setShowAutomaticTranslation(bool value) {
    return _persist(
      _preferences.copyWith(showAutomaticTranslation: value),
    );
  }

  Future<bool> clearCache() async {
    _busy = true;
    _errorCode = null;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      _storageMetrics = await _repository.clearCache();
      return true;
    } on Object {
      _errorCode = 'settings_cache_clear_failed';
      return false;
    } finally {
      _busy = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  Future<bool> resetLearningProgress({
    required bool confirmed,
  }) async {
    if (!confirmed || _busy) return false;
    _busy = true;
    _errorCode = null;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      final reset = await _progressResetter.resetLearningProgress();
      if (!reset) {
        _errorCode = 'learning_progress_reset_failed';
      }
      return reset;
    } on Object {
      _errorCode = 'learning_progress_reset_failed';
      return false;
    } finally {
      _busy = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _persist(LearningPreferences next) {
    final generation = ++_saveGeneration;
    final completion = Completer<void>();

    _preferences = next;
    _saving = true;
    _errorCode = null;
    notifyListeners();

    _writeTail = _writeTail
        .catchError((Object _) {})
        .then((_) async {
      try {
        await _repository.savePreferences(next);
        _persistedPreferences = next;
        if (generation == _saveGeneration) {
          _storageMetrics = await _repository.loadStorageMetrics();
        }
        completion.complete();
      } catch (error, stackTrace) {
        if (generation == _saveGeneration) {
          _preferences = _persistedPreferences;
          _errorCode = 'settings_save_failed';
        }
        completion.completeError(error, stackTrace);
      } finally {
        if (generation == _saveGeneration) {
          _saving = false;
          notifyListeners();
        }
      }
    });
    return completion.future;
  }
}
