import 'dart:convert';

import '../domain/learning_preferences.dart';
import '../domain/settings_repository.dart';
import '../domain/storage_metrics.dart';

final class LocalSettingsRepository implements SettingsRepository {
  LocalSettingsRepository(
    this._source, {
    DateTime Function()? nowUtc,
  }) : _nowUtc = nowUtc ?? (() => DateTime.now().toUtc());

  static final int _schemaVersion = 1;

  final SettingsLocalDataSource _source;
  final DateTime Function() _nowUtc;

  @override
  Future<LearningPreferences> loadPreferences() async {
    final record = await _readRecord();
    return record.preferences;
  }

  @override
  Future<void> savePreferences(LearningPreferences preferences) async {
    final current = await _readRecord();
    final encoded = _encode(
      preferences: preferences,
      lastCacheClearAt: current.lastCacheClearAt,
    );
    await _source.write(encoded);
  }

  @override
  Future<StorageMetrics> loadStorageMetrics() async {
    final raw = await _source.read();
    if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty) {
      return StorageMetrics(localDataBytes: 0);
    }
    final record = _decode(raw);
    return StorageMetrics(
      localDataBytes: utf8.encode(raw).length,
      lastCacheClearAt: record.lastCacheClearAt,
    );
  }

  @override
  Future<StorageMetrics> clearCache() async {
    final current = await _readRecord();
    final clearedAt = _nowUtc().toUtc();
    final encoded = _encode(
      preferences: current.preferences,
      lastCacheClearAt: clearedAt,
    );
    await _source.write(encoded);
    _source.evictMemoryCache();
    return StorageMetrics(
      localDataBytes: utf8.encode(encoded).length,
      lastCacheClearAt: clearedAt,
    );
  }

  Future<_SettingsRecord> _readRecord() async {
    final raw = await _source.read();
    if (raw == null || raw.trim().isEmpty) {
      return const _SettingsRecord(
        preferences: LearningPreferences(),
      );
    }
    return _decode(raw);
  }

  _SettingsRecord _decode(String raw) {
    try {
      final decoded = jsonDecode(raw);
      if (decoded is! Map) {
        return const _SettingsRecord(
          preferences: LearningPreferences(),
        );
      }
      final map = <String, Object?>{
        for (final entry in decoded.entries)
          if (entry.key is String) entry.key as String: entry.value,
      };
      if (map['schema_version'] != _schemaVersion) {
        return const _SettingsRecord(
          preferences: LearningPreferences(),
        );
      }

      final speech = _asDouble(map['speech_rate']);
      final scale = _asDouble(map['text_scale_factor']);
      final translation = map['show_automatic_translation'];
      final lastClear = _asUtcDate(map['last_cache_clear_at']);

      return _SettingsRecord(
        preferences: LearningPreferences.normalized(
          speechRate: speech,
          textScaleFactor: scale,
          showAutomaticTranslation:
              translation is bool ? translation : null,
        ),
        lastCacheClearAt: lastClear,
      );
    } on Object {
      return const _SettingsRecord(
        preferences: LearningPreferences(),
      );
    }
  }

  String _encode({
    required LearningPreferences preferences,
    required DateTime? lastCacheClearAt,
  }) {
    return jsonEncode(<String, Object?>{
      'schema_version': _schemaVersion,
      'speech_rate': preferences.speechRate,
      'text_scale_factor': preferences.textScaleFactor,
      'show_automatic_translation':
          preferences.showAutomaticTranslation,
      'last_cache_clear_at': lastCacheClearAt?.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
    });
  }

  static double? _asDouble(Object? value) {
    if (value is num) return value.toDouble();
    return double.tryParse(value?.toString() ?? '');
  }

  static DateTime? _asUtcDate(Object? value) {
    final parsed = DateTime.tryParse(value?.toString() ?? '');
    return parsed?.toUtc();
  }
}

final class _SettingsRecord {
  const _SettingsRecord({
    required this.preferences,
    this.lastCacheClearAt,
  });

  final LearningPreferences preferences;
  final DateTime? lastCacheClearAt;
}

FILE: lib/features/app_settings/data/preferences_settings_local_data_source.dart

import '../../../services/preferences_service.dart';
import '../domain/settings_repository.dart';

final class PreferencesSettingsLocalDataSource
    implements SettingsLocalDataSource {
  PreferencesSettingsLocalDataSource(this._preferences);

  static const String storageKey = 'app_learning_preferences_v1';

  final PreferencesService _preferences;
  String? _memoryCache;
  bool _cacheLoaded = false;

  @override
  Future<String?> read() async {
    if (_cacheLoaded) return _memoryCache;
    _memoryCache = _preferences.readText(storageKey);
    _cacheLoaded = true;
    return _memoryCache;
  }

  @override
  Future<void> write(String value) async {
    final stored = await _preferences.writeText(storageKey, value);
    if (!stored) {
      throw StateError('app_settings_write_failed');
    }
    _memoryCache = value;
    _cacheLoaded = true;
  }

  @override
  void evictMemoryCache() {
    _memoryCache = null;
    _cacheLoaded = false;
  }
}

enum SpeechRatePreset {
  slow(0.75),
  normal(1.0);

  const SpeechRatePreset(this.rate);

  final double rate;
}

final class LearningPreferences {
  const LearningPreferences({
    this.speechRatePreset = SpeechRatePreset.normal,
    this.textScaleFactor = 1.0,
    this.showAutomaticTranslation = true,
  }) : assert(textScaleFactor >= minimumTextScale),
       assert(textScaleFactor <= maximumTextScale);

  static const double minimumTextScale = 0.85;
  static const double maximumTextScale = 1.30;
  static const double textScaleStep = 0.05;

  final SpeechRatePreset speechRatePreset;
  final double textScaleFactor;
  final bool showAutomaticTranslation;

  double get speechRate => speechRatePreset.rate;

  factory LearningPreferences.normalized({
    double? speechRate,
    double? textScaleFactor,
    bool? showAutomaticTranslation,
  }) {
    return LearningPreferences(
      speechRatePreset: _normalizeSpeechRate(speechRate),
      textScaleFactor: normalizeTextScale(textScaleFactor ?? 1.0),
      showAutomaticTranslation: showAutomaticTranslation ?? true,
    );
  }

  LearningPreferences copyWith({
    SpeechRatePreset? speechRatePreset,
    double? textScaleFactor,
    bool? showAutomaticTranslation,
  }) {
    return LearningPreferences(
      speechRatePreset: speechRatePreset ?? this.speechRatePreset,
      textScaleFactor: textScaleFactor == null
          ? this.textScaleFactor
          : normalizeTextScale(textScaleFactor),
      showAutomaticTranslation:
          showAutomaticTranslation ?? this.showAutomaticTranslation,
    );
  }

  static double normalizeTextScale(double value) {
    final clamped = value.clamp(minimumTextScale, maximumTextScale).toDouble();
    final steps = ((clamped - minimumTextScale) / textScaleStep).round();
    final snapped = minimumTextScale + (steps * textScaleStep);
    return (snapped * 100).round() / 100.0;
  }

  static SpeechRatePreset _normalizeSpeechRate(double? value) {
    if (value == null) return SpeechRatePreset.normal;
    const midpoint = (0.75 + 1.0) / 2;
    return value <= midpoint
        ? SpeechRatePreset.slow
        : SpeechRatePreset.normal;
  }

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      identical(this, other) ||
      other is LearningPreferences &&
          other.speechRatePreset == speechRatePreset &&
          other.textScaleFactor == textScaleFactor &&
          other.showAutomaticTranslation == showAutomaticTranslation;

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(
        speechRatePreset,
        textScaleFactor,
        showAutomaticTranslation,
      );
}

final class StorageMetrics {
  const StorageMetrics({
    required this.localDataBytes,
    this.lastCacheClearAt,
  }) : assert(localDataBytes >= 0);

  final int localDataBytes;
  final DateTime? lastCacheClearAt;

  double get localDataKilobytes => localDataBytes / 1024.0;

  StorageMetrics copyWith({
    int? localDataBytes,
    DateTime? lastCacheClearAt,
  }) {
    return StorageMetrics(
      localDataBytes: localDataBytes ?? this.localDataBytes,
      lastCacheClearAt: lastCacheClearAt ?? this.lastCacheClearAt,
    );
  }
}

    unawaited(operation.catchError((Object _) {}));

          style: AppTypography.body,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _confirmProgressReset() async {
    final confirmed = await showDialog<bool>(
          context: context,
          builder: (dialogContext) => Directionality(
            textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
            child: AlertDialog(
              title: AppDirectionalText(
                'إعادة ضبط تقدم التعلم؟',
                languageCode: 'ar',
                style: AppTypography.title,
              ),
              content: AppDirectionalText(
                'سيتم حذف XP والمراجعات والمحاولات والمفضلة من هذا الجهاز. '
                'لا يمكن التراجع عن العملية.',
                languageCode: 'ar',
                style: AppTypography.body,
              ),
              actions: <Widget>[
                TextButton(
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, false),
                  child: AppDirectionalText(
                    'إلغاء',
                    languageCode: 'ar',
                    style: AppTypography.label,
                  ),
                ),
                FilledButton(
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, true),
                  child: AppDirectionalText(
                    'إعادة ضبط',
                    languageCode: 'ar',
                    style: AppTypography.label,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ) ??
        false;
    if (!confirmed) return;

    final reset = await widget.notifier.resetLearningProgress(
      confirmed: true,
    );
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (reset) widget.onProgressReset?.call();
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: AppDirectionalText(
          reset
              ? 'تمت إعادة ضبط تقدم التعلم المحلي.'
              : 'تعذر إعادة ضبط تقدم التعلم بالكامل.',
          languageCode: 'ar',
          style: AppTypography.body,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _MetricsCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _MetricsCard({required this.notifier});

  final SettingsController notifier;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final metrics = notifier.storageMetrics;
    final size = metrics.localDataBytes < 1024
        ? '${metrics.localDataBytes} B'
        : '${metrics.localDataKilobytes.toStringAsFixed(1)} KB';
    final clearText = _formatDate(metrics.lastCacheClearAt);
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return AppGlassCard(
      borderColor:
          dark ? AppColors.glassBorderDark : AppColors.glassBorderLight,
      backgroundColor:
          dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
      glowColor: AppColors.primary,
      child: Row(
        children: <Widget>[
          const Icon(Icons.storage_outlined, color: AppColors.primary),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: <Widget>[
                AppDirectionalText(
                  'بيانات الإعدادات المحلية',
                  languageCode: 'ar',
                  style: AppTypography.title,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                AppDirectionalText(
                  'الحجم: $size',
                  languageCode: 'ar',
                  style: AppTypography.body,
                ),
                AppDirectionalText(
                  'آخر تفريغ: $clearText',
                  languageCode: 'ar',
                  style: AppTypography.body,
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  static String _formatDate(DateTime? value) {
    if (value == null) return 'لم يتم التفريغ بعد';
    final local = value.toLocal();
    return '${local.year.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}-'
        '${local.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-'
        '${local.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')} '
        '${local.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:'
        '${local.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/berufssprache_models.dart';

final class BerufsspracheNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  BerufsspracheNotifier({required BerufsspracheRepository repository})
      : _repository = repository;

  final BerufsspracheRepository _repository;

  List<WorkplacePhrase> _phrases = const <WorkplacePhrase>[];
  WorkplaceTopic? _activeTopic;
  int _currentIndex = -1;
  bool _isBusy = false;
  bool _showArabic = true;
  bool? _lastAnswerCorrect;
  String? _feedbackArabic;

  List<WorkplacePhrase> get phrases => _phrases;
  WorkplaceTopic? get activeTopic => _activeTopic;
  bool get isBusy => _isBusy;
  bool get showArabic => _showArabic;
  bool? get lastAnswerCorrect => _lastAnswerCorrect;
  String? get feedbackArabic => _feedbackArabic;

  WorkplacePhrase? get currentPhrase {
    if (_currentIndex < 0 || _currentIndex >= _phrases.length) return null;
    return _phrases[_currentIndex];
  }

  Future<void> load() async {
    if (_isBusy) return;
    _setBusy(true);
    try {
      _phrases = await _repository.getPhrases(topic: _activeTopic);
      _activateFirstOrEmpty();
    } finally {
      _setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> filterByTopic(WorkplaceTopic? topic) async {
    if (_isBusy) return;
    _setBusy(true);
    try {
      _activeTopic = topic;
      _phrases = await _repository.getPhrases(topic: topic);
      _activateFirstOrEmpty();
    } finally {
      _setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  void nextPhrase() {
    if (_phrases.isEmpty) return;
    _currentIndex = (_currentIndex + 1) % _phrases.length;
    _resetAnswerState();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void toggleArabic() {
    _showArabic = !_showArabic;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> checkGerman(String candidate) async {
    final phrase = currentPhrase;
    if (phrase == null) {
      throw StateError('No active Berufssprache phrase.');
    }
    if (candidate.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(candidate, 'candidate', 'must not be empty');
    }

    _setBusy(true);
    try {
      final correct = await _repository.validateGermanPhrase(
        phrase.id,
        candidate,
      );
      _lastAnswerCorrect = correct;
      _feedbackArabic = correct
          ? 'مطابقة صحيحة للصياغة المهنية.'
          : 'راجع الصياغة الألمانية وعلامات الأدب المهني في البطاقة.';
    } finally {
      _setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  void clearAnswer() {
    _resetAnswerState();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void _activateFirstOrEmpty() {
    _currentIndex = _phrases.isEmpty ? -1 : 0;
    _resetAnswerState();
  }

  void _resetAnswerState() {
    _lastAnswerCorrect = null;
    _feedbackArabic = null;
  }

  void _setBusy(bool value) {
    if (_isBusy == value) return;
    _isBusy = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

    ),

      usageArabic: 'etwas ausrichten تعني نقل رسالة لشخص غير متاح.',
    ),
    WorkplacePhrase(

      topic: WorkplaceTopic.formalTelephone,
      register: WorkplaceRegister.formalSie,

          'Vielen Dank für Ihren Anruf. Ich sende Ihnen die Unterlagen noch heute per E-Mail.',
      arabic: 'شكرًا لاتصالكم. سأرسل لكم المستندات اليوم عبر البريد الإلكتروني.',
      usageArabic: 'خاتمة رسمية تحدد الإجراء التالي بوضوح.',
    ),
  ];

  @override
  Future<List<WorkplacePhrase>> getPhrases({WorkplaceTopic? topic}) async {
    final values = topic == null
        ? _phrases
        : _phrases.where((phrase) => phrase.topic == topic).toList();
    return List<WorkplacePhrase>.unmodifiable(values);
  }

  @override
  Future<WorkplacePhrase?> getPhraseById(String id) async {
    final normalizedId = id.trim();
    for (final phrase in _phrases) {
      if (phrase.id == normalizedId) return phrase;
    }
    return null;
  }

  @override
  Future<bool> validateGermanPhrase(String id, String candidate) async {
    final phrase = await getPhraseById(id);
    if (phrase == null) return false;
    return _normalize(candidate) == _normalize(phrase.german);
  }

  static String _normalize(String value) => value
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[.!?,;:]'), '')
      .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');
}

enum WorkplaceTopic {
  meetingMinutes,
  scheduling,
  delegation,

  String get germanLabel => switch (this) {
        WorkplaceTopic.meetingMinutes => 'Protokoll',
        WorkplaceTopic.scheduling => 'Terminabstimmung',
        WorkplaceTopic.delegation => 'Aufgaben delegieren',
        WorkplaceTopic.politeRequests => 'Höflich bitten',
        WorkplaceTopic.formalTelephone => 'Telefon im Büro',
      };

  String get arabicLabel => switch (this) {
        WorkplaceTopic.meetingMinutes => 'كتابة محضر الاجتماع',
        WorkplaceTopic.scheduling => 'تنسيق المواعيد',
        WorkplaceTopic.delegation => 'تفويض المهام',
        WorkplaceTopic.politeRequests => 'الطلب بأدب من الزملاء',
        WorkplaceTopic.formalTelephone => 'الهاتف الرسمي في المكتب',
      };
}

      };
}

final class WorkplacePhrase {
  const WorkplacePhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.topic,
    required this.register,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.usageArabic,
  });

  final String id;
  final WorkplaceTopic topic;
  final WorkplaceRegister register;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String usageArabic;
}

final class ProtocolTask {
  const ProtocolTask({
    required this.task,
    required this.responsible,
    required this.deadline,
  });

  final String task;
  final String responsible;
  final String deadline;
}

final class ProtocolDraft {
  const ProtocolDraft({
    required this.date,
    required this.participants,
    required this.discussionPoints,
    required this.decisions,
    required this.tasks,
  });

  final String date;
  final List<String> participants;
  final List<String> discussionPoints;
  final List<String> decisions;
  final List<ProtocolTask> tasks;

  String renderGerman() {
    if (date.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(date, 'date', 'must not be empty');
    }
    if (participants.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        participants,
        'participants',
        'must contain at least one participant',
      );
    }

    final buffer = StringBuffer()
      ..writeln('Protokoll')
      ..writeln('Datum: ${date.trim()}')
      ..writeln('Teilnehmende: ${participants.map(_clean).join(', ')}')
      ..writeln()
      ..writeln('Besprochene Punkte:');

    _writeBulletSection(buffer, discussionPoints);
    buffer
      ..writeln()
      ..writeln('Beschlüsse:');
    _writeBulletSection(buffer, decisions);
    buffer
      ..writeln()
      ..writeln('Aufgaben:');

    if (tasks.isEmpty) {
      buffer.writeln('- Keine offenen Aufgaben.');
    } else {
      for (final task in tasks) {
        buffer.writeln(
          '- ${_clean(task.task)} | Zuständig: ${_clean(task.responsible)} '
          '| Frist: ${_clean(task.deadline)}',
        );
      }
    }

    return buffer.toString().trimRight();
  }

  static void _writeBulletSection(StringBuffer buffer, List<String> values) {
    if (values.isEmpty) {
      buffer.writeln('- Keine Einträge.');
      return;
    }
    for (final value in values) {
      buffer.writeln('- ${_clean(value)}');
    }
  }

  static String _clean(String value) => value.trim().replaceAll(
        RegExp(r'\s+'),
        ' ',
      );
}

abstract interface class BerufsspracheRepository {
  Future<List<WorkplacePhrase>> getPhrases({WorkplaceTopic? topic});

  Future<WorkplacePhrase?> getPhraseById(String id);

  Future<bool> validateGermanPhrase(String id, String candidate);
}

import 'dart:async';


import '../../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import '../application/berufssprache_notifier.dart';
import '../domain/berufssprache_models.dart';

abstract final class BerufsspracheUiTokens {
  static const double page = 16;
  static const double top = 18;
  static const double bottom = 28;
  static const double gapXs = 6;
  static const double gapSm = 10;
  static const double gapMd = 14;
  static const double icon = 34;
  static const double chipHorizontal = 12;
  static const double chipVertical = 9;
}

final class BerufsspracheScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const BerufsspracheScreen({required this.notifier, super.key});

  final BerufsspracheNotifier notifier;

  @override
  State<BerufsspracheScreen> createState() => _BerufsspracheScreenState();
}

final class _BerufsspracheScreenState extends State<BerufsspracheScreen> {
  final TextEditingController _practiceController = TextEditingController();

  BerufsspracheNotifier get notifier => widget.notifier;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    notifier.addListener(_refresh);
    if (notifier.currentPhrase == null) {
      unawaited(notifier.load());
    }
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant BerufsspracheScreen oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.notifier == notifier) return;
    oldWidget.notifier.removeListener(_refresh);
    notifier.addListener(_refresh);
    _practiceController.clear();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    notifier.removeListener(_refresh);
    _practiceController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _refresh() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  Future<void> _selectTopic(WorkplaceTopic? topic) async {
    _practiceController.clear();
    await notifier.filterByTopic(topic);
  }

  Future<void> _check() async {
    final value = _practiceController.text.trim();
    if (value.isEmpty || notifier.isBusy) return;
    await notifier.checkGerman(value);
  }

  void _next() {
    _practiceController.clear();
    notifier.nextPhrase();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface = dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface;
    final border =
        dark ? AppColors.glassBorderDark : AppColors.glassBorderLight;
    final phrase = notifier.currentPhrase;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              BerufsspracheUiTokens.page,
              BerufsspracheUiTokens.top,
              BerufsspracheUiTokens.page,
              BerufsspracheUiTokens.bottom,
            ),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: <Widget>[
                _HeaderCard(surface: surface, border: border),
                const SizedBox(height: BerufsspracheUiTokens.gapMd),
                _TopicSelector(
                  activeTopic: notifier.activeTopic,
                  enabled: !notifier.isBusy,
                  surface: surface,
                  border: border,
                  onSelected: (topic) => unawaited(_selectTopic(topic)),
                ),
                if (notifier.activeTopic == WorkplaceTopic.meetingMinutes)
                  ...<Widget>[
                    const SizedBox(height: BerufsspracheUiTokens.gapMd),
                    _ProtocolCard(surface: surface, border: border),
                  ],
                const SizedBox(height: BerufsspracheUiTokens.gapMd),
                if (phrase == null)
                  _EmptyCard(
                    busy: notifier.isBusy,
                    surface: surface,
                    border: border,
                    onRetry: () => unawaited(notifier.load()),
                  )
                else ...<Widget>[
                  _PhraseCard(
                    phrase: phrase,
                    showArabic: notifier.showArabic,
                    surface: surface,
                    border: border,
                    onToggleArabic: notifier.toggleArabic,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: BerufsspracheUiTokens.gapMd),
                  _PracticeCard(
                    controller: _practiceController,
                    phrase: phrase,
                    notifier: notifier,
                    surface: surface,
                    border: border,
                    onCheck: () => unawaited(_check()),
                    onClear: () {
                      _practiceController.clear();
                      notifier.clearAnswer();
                    },
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: BerufsspracheUiTokens.gapMd),
                  _NextCard(
                    enabled: !notifier.isBusy,
                    surface: surface,
                    onTap: _next,
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _TopicSelector extends StatelessWidget {

  final bool enabled;

  @override

      ],

  final bool showArabic;

  @override

        backgroundColor: surface,

            AppDirectionalText(
              phrase.german,
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),

            AppDirectionalText(

              languageCode: 'de',

            ),

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/bewerbung_models.dart';
import '../domain/bewerbung_repository.dart';

final class BewerbungNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  BewerbungNotifier({
    required BewerbungRepository repository,
  }) : _repository = repository;

  final BewerbungRepository _repository;

  BewerbungDocumentType _documentType =
      BewerbungDocumentType.lebenslauf;
  CareerTrack _careerTrack = CareerTrack.general;
  List<BewerbungTemplate> _templates =
      const <BewerbungTemplate>[];
  BewerbungTemplate? _selectedTemplate;
  BewerbungProfile _profile = BewerbungProfile.empty;
  BewerbungPreview? _preview;
  List<String> _validationIssues = const <String>[];
  bool _isBusy = false;

  BewerbungDocumentType get documentType => _documentType;
  CareerTrack get careerTrack => _careerTrack;
  List<BewerbungTemplate> get templates => _templates;
  BewerbungTemplate? get selectedTemplate => _selectedTemplate;
  BewerbungProfile get profile => _profile;
  BewerbungPreview? get preview => _preview;
  List<String> get validationIssues => _validationIssues;
  bool get isBusy => _isBusy;

  Future<void> initialize() => _reloadTemplates();

  Future<void> selectDocumentType(
    BewerbungDocumentType value,
  ) async {
    if (_documentType == value && _templates.isNotEmpty) return;
    _documentType = value;
    _preview = null;
    _validationIssues = const <String>[];
    await _reloadTemplates();
  }

  Future<void> selectCareerTrack(CareerTrack value) async {
    if (_careerTrack == value && _templates.isNotEmpty) return;
    _careerTrack = value;
    _preview = null;
    _validationIssues = const <String>[];
    await _reloadTemplates();
  }

  void chooseTemplate(String templateId) {
    BewerbungTemplate? match;
    for (final template in _templates) {
      if (template.id == templateId.trim()) {
        match = template;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (match == null) return;
    if (_selectedTemplate?.id == match.id) return;

    _selectedTemplate = match;
    _preview = null;
    _validationIssues = const <String>[];
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void updateProfile(BewerbungProfile value) {
    _profile = value;
    _preview = null;
    _validationIssues = const <String>[];
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> buildPreview() async {
    if (_isBusy) return;

    _setBusy(true);
    try {
      if (_templates.isEmpty) {
        await _loadTemplatesWithoutBusyToggle();
      }

      final template = _selectedTemplate;
      if (template == null) {
        _preview = null;
        _validationIssues = const <String>[
          'اختر قالبًا قبل إنشاء المعاينة.',
        ];
        return;
      }

      final issues = await _repository.validateProfile(_profile);
      _validationIssues = issues;
      if (issues.isNotEmpty) {
        _preview = null;
        return;
      }

      _preview = await _repository.buildPreview(
        template.id,
        _profile,
      );
    } finally {
      _setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  void reset() {
    _documentType = BewerbungDocumentType.lebenslauf;
    _careerTrack = CareerTrack.general;
    _templates = const <BewerbungTemplate>[];
    _selectedTemplate = null;
    _profile = BewerbungProfile.empty;
    _preview = null;
    _validationIssues = const <String>[];
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> _reloadTemplates() async {
    if (_isBusy) return;

    _setBusy(true);
    try {
      await _loadTemplatesWithoutBusyToggle();
    } finally {
      _setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _loadTemplatesWithoutBusyToggle() async {
    final loaded = await _repository.getTemplates(
      documentType: _documentType,
      careerTrack: _careerTrack,
    );
    _templates = loaded;
    _selectedTemplate = loaded.isEmpty ? null : loaded.first;
    _preview = null;
    _validationIssues = const <String>[];
  }

  void _setBusy(bool value) {
    if (_isBusy == value) return;
    _isBusy = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

  static BewerbungTemplate _template(
    String id,
    BewerbungDocumentType type,
    CareerTrack track,
    String titleDe,
    String guidanceAr,
    List<String> skills,
  ) {
    return BewerbungTemplate(
      id: id,
      documentType: type,
      careerTrack: track,
      titleDe: titleDe,
      guidanceAr: guidanceAr,
      suggestedSkillsDe: skills,
    );
  }

  @override
  Future<List<BewerbungTemplate>> getTemplates({
    BewerbungDocumentType? documentType,
    CareerTrack? careerTrack,
  }) async {
    final result = _templates.where((template) {
      if (documentType != null &&
          template.documentType != documentType) {
        return false;
      }
      if (careerTrack != null &&
          template.careerTrack != careerTrack) {
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    });

    return List<BewerbungTemplate>.unmodifiable(result);
  }

  @override
  Future<List<String>> validateProfile(
    BewerbungProfile profile,
  ) async {
    final issues = <String>[];

    if (profile.fullName.trim().isEmpty) {
      issues.add('أدخل الاسم الكامل كما سيظهر في طلب التوظيف.');
    }
    if (profile.targetRole.trim().isEmpty) {
      issues.add('أدخل اسم الوظيفة المستهدفة.');
    }
    if (profile.email.trim().isEmpty ||
        !profile.email.contains('@')) {
      issues.add('أدخل البريد الإلكتروني المهني بصيغة صحيحة.');
    }
    if (profile.city.trim().isEmpty) {
      issues.add('أدخل المدينة.');
    }
    if (profile.professionalSummary.trim().isEmpty) {
      issues.add('أضف ملخصًا مهنيًا واقعيًا قصيرًا.');
    }
    if (profile.skills.isEmpty) {
      issues.add('أضف مهارة مهنية واحدة على الأقل.');
    }

    return List<String>.unmodifiable(issues);
  }

  @override
  Future<BewerbungPreview> buildPreview(
    String templateId,
    BewerbungProfile profile,
  ) async {
    BewerbungTemplate? template;
    for (final candidate in _templates) {
      if (candidate.id == templateId.trim()) {
        template = candidate;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (template == null) {
      throw StateError('Unknown Bewerbung template: $templateId');
    }

    final issues = await validateProfile(profile);
    if (issues.isNotEmpty) {
      throw StateError(
        'Profile must be valid before preview generation.',
      );
    }

    return switch (template.documentType) {
      BewerbungDocumentType.lebenslauf =>
        _buildLebenslauf(template, profile),
      BewerbungDocumentType.anschreiben =>
        _buildAnschreiben(template, profile),
    };
  }

  BewerbungPreview _buildLebenslauf(
    BewerbungTemplate template,
    BewerbungProfile profile,
  ) {
    final contact = <String>[
      profile.fullName.trim(),
      if (profile.city.trim().isNotEmpty) profile.city.trim(),
      profile.email.trim(),
      if (profile.phone.trim().isNotEmpty) profile.phone.trim(),
    ].join(' · ');

    final blocks = <BewerbungPreviewBlock>[
      BewerbungPreviewBlock(
        headingDe: 'PERSÖNLICHE DATEN',
        bodyDe: contact,
        guidanceAr:
            'اعرض بيانات الاتصال الضرورية فقط وبشكل مهني.',
      ),
      BewerbungPreviewBlock(
        headingDe: 'PROFIL',
        bodyDe: profile.professionalSummary.trim(),
        guidanceAr:
            'ملخص قصير يصف خبرتك الفعلية واتجاهك المهني.',
      ),
      if (profile.experience.isNotEmpty)
        BewerbungPreviewBlock(
          headingDe: 'BERUFSERFAHRUNG',
          bodyDe: _bulletList(profile.experience),
          guidanceAr:
              'اكتب المهام والنتائج الحقيقية دون مبالغة.',
        ),
      if (profile.education.isNotEmpty)
        BewerbungPreviewBlock(
          headingDe: 'AUSBILDUNG',
          bodyDe: _bulletList(profile.education),
          guidanceAr:
              'اذكر المؤهلات التي حصلت عليها بالفعل.',
        ),
      BewerbungPreviewBlock(
        headingDe: 'KENNTNISSE',
        bodyDe: _bulletList(profile.skills),
        guidanceAr:
            'اختر المهارات المرتبطة مباشرة بالوظيفة.',
      ),
      if (profile.languages.isNotEmpty)
        BewerbungPreviewBlock(
          headingDe: 'SPRACHEN',
          bodyDe: _bulletList(profile.languages),
          guidanceAr:
              'اذكر مستوى اللغة كما هو فعلًا.',
        ),
    ];

    return BewerbungPreview(
      documentType: template.documentType,
      templateId: template.id,
      titleDe: 'Tabellarischer Lebenslauf',
      blocks: blocks,
    );
  }

  BewerbungPreview _buildAnschreiben(
    BewerbungTemplate template,
    BewerbungProfile profile,
  ) {
    final role = profile.targetRole.trim();
    final employer = profile.employer.trim();
    final employerPhrase =
        employer.isEmpty ? 'Ihrem Unternehmen' : employer;

    final skills = profile.skills.join(', ');
    final experience = profile.experience.isEmpty
        ? ''
        : 'Besonders relevant ist meine praktische Erfahrung: '
            '${profile.experience.join('; ')}.';

    final body = <String>[
      'Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren,',
      '',
      'hiermit bewerbe ich mich um die Position als $role bei $employerPhrase.',
      profile.professionalSummary.trim(),
      if (experience.isNotEmpty) experience,
      'Zu meinen fachlich relevanten Kenntnissen zählen: $skills.',
      'Gern erläutere ich Ihnen meine Erfahrungen und Motivation in einem persönlichen Gespräch.',
      '',
      'Mit freundlichen Grüßen',
      profile.fullName.trim(),
    ].join('\n');

    return BewerbungPreview(
      documentType: template.documentType,
      templateId: template.id,
      titleDe: 'Anschreiben – $role',
      blocks: <BewerbungPreviewBlock>[
        BewerbungPreviewBlock(
          headingDe: 'ANSCHREIBEN',
          bodyDe: body,
          guidanceAr:
              'راجع النص واحذف أي معلومة لا تستطيع إثباتها. لا تضف شهادات أو سنوات خبرة غير موجودة.',
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  static String _bulletList(List<String> values) {
    return values
        .map((value) => value.trim())
        .where((value) => value.isNotEmpty)
        .map((value) => '• $value')
        .join('\n');
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/bewerbung_builder/domain/bewerbung_models.dart

enum BewerbungDocumentType {
  lebenslauf,
  anschreiben,
}

enum CareerTrack {
  general,
  medicine,
  pharmacy,
  it,
  trades,
}

extension BewerbungDocumentTypeLabel on BewerbungDocumentType {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        BewerbungDocumentType.lebenslauf => 'Tabellarischer Lebenslauf',
        BewerbungDocumentType.anschreiben => 'Anschreiben',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        BewerbungDocumentType.lebenslauf => 'السيرة الذاتية الجدولية',
        BewerbungDocumentType.anschreiben => 'رسالة التقديم',
      };
}

extension CareerTrackLabel on CareerTrack {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        CareerTrack.general => 'Allgemein',
        CareerTrack.medicine => 'Medizin',
        CareerTrack.pharmacy => 'Pharmazie',
        CareerTrack.it => 'IT',
        CareerTrack.trades => 'Handwerk',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        CareerTrack.general => 'عام',
        CareerTrack.medicine => 'الطب',
        CareerTrack.pharmacy => 'الصيدلة',
        CareerTrack.it => 'تقنية المعلومات',
        CareerTrack.trades => 'المهن والحرف',
      };
}

final class BewerbungProfile {
  const BewerbungProfile({
    required this.fullName,
    required this.city,
    required this.email,
    required this.phone,
    required this.targetRole,
    required this.employer,
    required this.professionalSummary,
    required this.education,
    required this.experience,
    required this.skills,
    required this.languages,
  });

  final String fullName;
  final String city;
  final String email;
  final String phone;
  final String targetRole;
  final String employer;
  final String professionalSummary;
  final List<String> education;
  final List<String> experience;
  final List<String> skills;
  final List<String> languages;

  BewerbungProfile copyWith({
    String? fullName,
    String? city,
    String? email,
    String? phone,
    String? targetRole,
    String? employer,
    String? professionalSummary,
    List<String>? education,
    List<String>? experience,
    List<String>? skills,
    List<String>? languages,
  }) {
    return BewerbungProfile(
      fullName: fullName ?? this.fullName,
      city: city ?? this.city,
      email: email ?? this.email,
      phone: phone ?? this.phone,
      targetRole: targetRole ?? this.targetRole,
      employer: employer ?? this.employer,
      professionalSummary:
          professionalSummary ?? this.professionalSummary,
      education: education ?? this.education,
      experience: experience ?? this.experience,
      skills: skills ?? this.skills,
      languages: languages ?? this.languages,
    );
  }

  static const BewerbungProfile empty = BewerbungProfile(
    fullName: '',
    city: '',
    email: '',
    phone: '',
    targetRole: '',
    employer: '',
    professionalSummary: '',
    education: <String>[],
    experience: <String>[],
    skills: <String>[],
    languages: <String>[],
  );
}

final class BewerbungTemplate {
  BewerbungTemplate({
    required this.id,
    required this.documentType,
    required this.careerTrack,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.guidanceAr,
    required List<String> suggestedSkillsDe,
  }) : suggestedSkillsDe =
            List<String>.unmodifiable(suggestedSkillsDe) {
    if (id.trim().isEmpty ||
        titleDe.trim().isEmpty ||
        guidanceAr.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('template fields must not be empty');
    }
  }

  final String id;
  final BewerbungDocumentType documentType;
  final CareerTrack careerTrack;
  final String titleDe;
  final String guidanceAr;
  final List<String> suggestedSkillsDe;
}

final class BewerbungPreviewBlock {
  const BewerbungPreviewBlock({
    required this.headingDe,
    required this.bodyDe,
    required this.guidanceAr,
  });

  final String headingDe;
  final String bodyDe;
  final String guidanceAr;
}

final class BewerbungPreview {
  BewerbungPreview({
    required this.documentType,
    required this.templateId,
    required this.titleDe,
    required List<BewerbungPreviewBlock> blocks,
  }) : blocks = List<BewerbungPreviewBlock>.unmodifiable(blocks);

  final BewerbungDocumentType documentType;
  final String templateId;
  final String titleDe;
  final List<BewerbungPreviewBlock> blocks;
}

class BewerbungBuilderScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const BewerbungBuilderScreen({
    required this.notifier,
    super.key,
  });

  final BewerbungNotifier notifier;

  @override
  State<BewerbungBuilderScreen> createState() =>
      _BewerbungBuilderScreenState();
}

class _BewerbungBuilderScreenState
    extends State<BewerbungBuilderScreen> {
  late final TextEditingController _name;
  late final TextEditingController _city;
  late final TextEditingController _email;
  late final TextEditingController _phone;
  late final TextEditingController _role;
  late final TextEditingController _employer;
  late final TextEditingController _summary;
  late final TextEditingController _education;
  late final TextEditingController _experience;
  late final TextEditingController _skills;
  late final TextEditingController _languages;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final profile = widget.notifier.profile;
    _name = TextEditingController(text: profile.fullName);
    _city = TextEditingController(text: profile.city);
    _email = TextEditingController(text: profile.email);
    _phone = TextEditingController(text: profile.phone);
    _role = TextEditingController(text: profile.targetRole);
    _employer = TextEditingController(text: profile.employer);
    _summary =
        TextEditingController(text: profile.professionalSummary);
    _education = TextEditingController(
      text: profile.education.join('\n'),
    );
    _experience = TextEditingController(
      text: profile.experience.join('\n'),
    );
    _skills = TextEditingController(
      text: profile.skills.join(', '),
    );
    _languages = TextEditingController(
      text: profile.languages.join(', '),
    );
    Future<void>.microtask(widget.notifier.initialize);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _name.dispose();
    _city.dispose();
    _email.dispose();
    _phone.dispose();
    _role.dispose();
    _employer.dispose();
    _summary.dispose();
    _education.dispose();
    _experience.dispose();
    _skills.dispose();
    _languages.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _syncProfile() {
    widget.notifier.updateProfile(
      BewerbungProfile(
        fullName: _name.text.trim(),
        city: _city.text.trim(),
        email: _email.text.trim(),
        phone: _phone.text.trim(),
        targetRole: _role.text.trim(),
        employer: _employer.text.trim(),
        professionalSummary: _summary.text.trim(),
        education: _lines(_education.text),
        experience: _lines(_experience.text),
        skills: _csv(_skills.text),
        languages: _csv(_languages.text),
      ),
    );
  }

  List<String> _lines(String value) => value
      .split('\n')
      .map((item) => item.trim())
      .where((item) => item.isNotEmpty)
      .toList(growable: false);

  List<String> _csv(String value) => value
      .split(',')
      .map((item) => item.trim())
      .where((item) => item.isNotEmpty)
      .toList(growable: false);

  Future<void> _buildPreview() async {
    _syncProfile();
    await widget.notifier.buildPreview();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: widget.notifier,
      builder: (context, _) {
        final notifier = widget.notifier;

        return Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(
            title: Text(
              'Bewerbung Builder',
              textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
          ),
          body: SafeArea(
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  _EthicsCard(),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  _DocumentTypeCard(
                    selected: notifier.documentType,
                    busy: notifier.isBusy,
                    onSelected: notifier.selectDocumentType,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  _CareerTrackCard(
                    selected: notifier.careerTrack,
                    busy: notifier.isBusy,
                    onSelected: notifier.selectCareerTrack,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  _TemplateCard(
                    templates: notifier.templates,
                    selected: notifier.selectedTemplate,
                    busy: notifier.isBusy,
                    onSelected: notifier.chooseTemplate,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  _ProfileForm(
                    name: _name,
                    city: _city,
                    email: _email,
                    phone: _phone,
                    role: _role,
                    employer: _employer,
                    summary: _summary,
                    education: _education,
                    experience: _experience,
                    skills: _skills,
                    languages: _languages,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  FilledButton.icon(
                    onPressed:
                        notifier.isBusy ? null : _buildPreview,
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.preview_outlined),
                    label: Text(
                      'إنشاء المعاينة',
                      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                      style: AppTypography.label,
                    ),
                  ),
                  if (notifier.validationIssues.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    _ValidationCard(
                      issues: notifier.validationIssues,
                    ),
                  ],
                  if (notifier.preview != null) ...<Widget>[
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    _PreviewCard(preview: notifier.preview!),
                  ],
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/buergeramt_dialogs/application/buergeramt_notifier.dart

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/buergeramt_models.dart';
import '../domain/buergeramt_repository.dart';

final class BuergeramtNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  BuergeramtNotifier(this._repository);

  final BuergeramtRepository _repository;

  List<BureaucracyScenario> _situations = const <BureaucracyScenario>[];
  List<BureaucracyDialogueTurn> _dialogue =
      const <BureaucracyDialogueTurn>[];
  BureaucracyScenario? _activeScenario;
  int _currentTurnIndex = 0;
  String? _selectedChoiceId;
  bool? _isCorrect;
  bool _showExplanation = false;
  String _feedbackAr = '';
  bool _isLoading = false;
  int _generation = 0;

  List<BureaucracyScenario> get situations =>
      List<BureaucracyScenario>.unmodifiable(_situations);
  List<BureaucracyDialogueTurn> get dialogue =>
      List<BureaucracyDialogueTurn>.unmodifiable(_dialogue);
  BureaucracyScenario? get activeScenario => _activeScenario;
  int get currentTurnIndex => _currentTurnIndex;
  String? get selectedChoiceId => _selectedChoiceId;
  bool? get isCorrect => _isCorrect;
  bool get showExplanation => _showExplanation;
  String get feedbackAr => _feedbackAr;
  bool get isLoading => _isLoading;

  BureaucracyDialogueTurn? get currentTurn {
    if (_dialogue.isEmpty || _currentTurnIndex >= _dialogue.length) {
      return null;
    }
    return _dialogue[_currentTurnIndex];
  }

  bool get isLastTurn =>
      _dialogue.isNotEmpty && _currentTurnIndex == _dialogue.length - 1;

  Future<void> load() async {
    final generation = ++_generation;
    _isLoading = true;
    notifyListeners();

    try {
      final situations = await _repository.getSituations();
      if (generation != _generation) return;

      _situations = List<BureaucracyScenario>.unmodifiable(situations);
      if (_situations.isEmpty) {
        _activeScenario = null;
        _dialogue = const <BureaucracyDialogueTurn>[];
        _resetTurnState();
        return;
      }

      final first = _situations.first;
      final turns = await _repository.getDialogue(first.id);
      if (generation != _generation) return;

      _activeScenario = first;
      _dialogue = List<BureaucracyDialogueTurn>.unmodifiable(turns);
      _currentTurnIndex = 0;
      _resetAnswerState();
    } finally {
      if (generation == _generation) {
        _isLoading = false;
        notifyListeners();
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> switchSituation(BureaucracySituation type) async {
    final scenario = _findSituation(type);
    if (scenario == null) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(type, 'type', 'situation is not available');
    }

    final generation = ++_generation;
    _isLoading = true;
    _activeScenario = scenario;
    _dialogue = const <BureaucracyDialogueTurn>[];
    _currentTurnIndex = 0;
    _resetAnswerState();
    notifyListeners();

    try {
      final turns = await _repository.getDialogue(scenario.id);
      if (generation != _generation ||
          _activeScenario?.id != scenario.id) {
        return;
      }
      _dialogue = List<BureaucracyDialogueTurn>.unmodifiable(turns);
      _currentTurnIndex = 0;
      _resetAnswerState();
    } finally {
      if (generation == _generation) {
        _isLoading = false;
        notifyListeners();
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> selectResponse(String choiceId) async {
    final scenario = _activeScenario;
    final turn = currentTurn;
    if (scenario == null ||
        turn == null ||
        turn.choices.isEmpty ||
        _showExplanation) {
      return;
    }

    final choice = _findChoice(turn, choiceId);
    if (choice == null) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        choiceId,
        'choiceId',
        'choice is not available for this turn',
      );
    }

    final generation = ++_generation;
    _selectedChoiceId = choice.id;
    _isCorrect = null;
    _showExplanation = false;
    _feedbackAr = '';
    notifyListeners();

    final correct = await _repository.checkChoice(
      scenarioId: scenario.id,
      turnId: turn.id,
      choiceId: choice.id,
    );
    if (generation != _generation ||
        _activeScenario?.id != scenario.id ||
        currentTurn?.id != turn.id ||
        _selectedChoiceId != choice.id) {
      return;
    }

    _isCorrect = correct;
    _feedbackAr = choice.feedbackAr;
    _showExplanation = true;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void nextTurn() {
    final turn = currentTurn;
    if (turn == null || isLastTurn) return;
    if (turn.choices.isNotEmpty && !_showExplanation) return;

    _generation++;
    _currentTurnIndex++;
    _resetAnswerState();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void restartDialogue() {
    if (_dialogue.isEmpty) return;
    _generation++;
    _currentTurnIndex = 0;
    _resetAnswerState();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  BureaucracyScenario? _findSituation(BureaucracySituation type) {
    for (final situation in _situations) {
      if (situation.type == type) return situation;
    }
    return null;
  }

  static DialogueChoice? _findChoice(
    BureaucracyDialogueTurn turn,
    String choiceId,
  ) {
    for (final choice in turn.choices) {
      if (choice.id == choiceId) return choice;
    }
    return null;
  }

  void _resetTurnState() {
    _currentTurnIndex = 0;
    _resetAnswerState();
  }

  void _resetAnswerState() {
    _selectedChoiceId = null;
    _isCorrect = null;
    _showExplanation = false;
    _feedbackAr = '';
  }
}

import '../domain/buergeramt_models.dart';
import '../domain/buergeramt_repository.dart';

final class LocalBuergeramtRepository implements BuergeramtRepository {
  LocalBuergeramtRepository()
      : _situations = _buildSituations(),
        _dialogues = _buildDialogues();

  final List<BureaucracyScenario> _situations;
  final Map<String, List<BureaucracyDialogueTurn>> _dialogues;

  @override
  Future<List<BureaucracyScenario>> getSituations() async =>
      List<BureaucracyScenario>.unmodifiable(_situations);

  @override
  Future<List<BureaucracyDialogueTurn>> getDialogue(String scenarioId) async {
    final turns = _dialogues[scenarioId];
    if (turns == null) return const <BureaucracyDialogueTurn>[];
    return List<BureaucracyDialogueTurn>.unmodifiable(turns);
  }

  @override
  Future<bool> checkChoice({
    required String scenarioId,
    required String turnId,
    required String choiceId,
  }) async {
    final turns = _dialogues[scenarioId];
    if (turns == null) return false;

    for (final turn in turns) {
      if (turn.id != turnId) continue;
      for (final choice in turn.choices) {
        if (choice.id == choiceId) return choice.isCorrect;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

enum BureaucracySituation { buergeramt, bank, anmeldung }

enum DialogueSpeaker { official, learner }

final class OfficialDocumentBadge {
  const OfficialDocumentBadge({
    required this.id,
    required this.labelDe,
    required this.labelAr,
    required this.required,
  });

  final String id;
  final String labelDe;
  final String labelAr;
  final bool required;
}

final class DialogueChoice {
  const DialogueChoice({
    required this.id,
    required this.textDe,
    required this.translationAr,
    required this.feedbackAr,
    required this.isCorrect,
  });

  final String id;
  final String textDe;
  final String translationAr;
  final String feedbackAr;
  final bool isCorrect;
}

final class BureaucracyDialogueTurn {
  const BureaucracyDialogueTurn({
    required this.id,
    required this.speaker,
    required this.textDe,
    required this.translationAr,
    this.choices = const <DialogueChoice>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final DialogueSpeaker speaker;
  final String textDe;
  final String translationAr;
  final List<DialogueChoice> choices;
}

final class BureaucracyScenario {
  const BureaucracyScenario({
    required this.id,
    required this.type,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.goalAr,
    required this.documents,
  });

  final String id;
  final BureaucracySituation type;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String goalAr;
  final List<OfficialDocumentBadge> documents;

  String get typeLabelDe => switch (type) {
        BureaucracySituation.buergeramt => 'Bürgeramt',
        BureaucracySituation.bank => 'Bank',
        BureaucracySituation.anmeldung => 'Anmeldung',
      };
}

abstract interface class BuergeramtRepository {
  Future<List<BureaucracyScenario>> getSituations();

  Future<List<BureaucracyDialogueTurn>> getDialogue(String scenarioId);

  Future<bool> checkChoice({
    required String scenarioId,
    required String turnId,
    required String choiceId,
  });
}

import 'dart:async';


import '../../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import '../application/buergeramt_notifier.dart';
import '../domain/buergeramt_models.dart';

final class BuergeramtHubScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const BuergeramtHubScreen({
    required this.notifier,
    super.key,
  });

  final BuergeramtNotifier notifier;

  @override
  State<BuergeramtHubScreen> createState() => _BuergeramtHubScreenState();
}

final class _BuergeramtHubScreenState extends State<BuergeramtHubScreen> {
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    if (widget.notifier.situations.isEmpty &&
        !widget.notifier.isLoading) {
      unawaited(widget.notifier.load());
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Directionality(
        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
        child: Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(
            title: const Text(
              'المعاملات اليومية · Alltag & Behörden',
              textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
            ),
          ),
          body: SafeArea(
            child: ListenableBuilder(
              listenable: widget.notifier,
              builder: (context, _) {
                final notifier = widget.notifier;

                if (notifier.isLoading && notifier.situations.isEmpty) {
                  return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
                }
                if (notifier.situations.isEmpty) {
                  return _EmptyState(
                    onRetry: () => unawaited(notifier.load()),
                  );
                }

                final scenario = notifier.activeScenario;
                return SingleChildScrollView(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 36),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      _SituationSelector(notifier: notifier),
                      if (scenario != null) ...<Widget>[
                        const SizedBox(height: 14),
                        _ScenarioHeader(scenario: scenario),
                        const SizedBox(height: 14),
                        _DocumentPanel(scenario: scenario),
                      ],
                      const SizedBox(height: 14),
                      _DialoguePanel(notifier: notifier),
                    ],
                  ),
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
}

final class _SituationSelector extends StatelessWidget {
  const _SituationSelector({required this.notifier});

  final BuergeramtNotifier notifier;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        glowColor: AppColors.primary,
        borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(92),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            Text(
              'اختر الموقف',
              textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Wrap(
              spacing: 10,
              runSpacing: 10,
              children: <Widget>[
                for (final situation in notifier.situations)
                  ChoiceChip(
                    label: Text(
                      _situationLabel(situation.type),
                      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                    ),
                    selected:
                        notifier.activeScenario?.type == situation.type,
                    selectedColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(34),
                    side: BorderSide(
                      color: notifier.activeScenario?.type == situation.type
                          ? AppColors.primary
                          : Theme.of(context).dividerColor,
                    ),
                    onSelected: notifier.isLoading
                        ? null
                        : (_) => unawaited(
                              notifier.switchSituation(situation.type),
                            ),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );

  static String _situationLabel(BureaucracySituation type) => switch (type) {
        BureaucracySituation.buergeramt => 'Bürgeramt',
        BureaucracySituation.bank => 'Bank',
        BureaucracySituation.anmeldung => 'Anmeldung',
      };
}

final class _DialoguePanel extends StatelessWidget {
  const _DialoguePanel({required this.notifier});

  final BuergeramtNotifier notifier;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (notifier.isLoading && notifier.dialogue.isEmpty) {
      return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
    }

    final turn = notifier.currentTurn;
    if (turn == null) {
      return AppGlassCard(
        child: Text(
          'لا يوجد حوار لهذا الموقف.',
          textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
          style: AppTypography.body,
        ),
      );
    }

    return AppGlassCard(
      glowColor: AppColors.tertiary,
      borderColor: AppColors.tertiary.withAlpha(80),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          Row(
            children: <Widget>[
              const Icon(
                Icons.forum_outlined,
                color: AppColors.tertiary,
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  'المحادثة · Gespräch',
                  textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                  style: AppTypography.title,
                ),
              ),
              Text(
                (notifier.currentTurnIndex + 1).toString() +
                    ' / ' +
                    notifier.dialogue.length.toString(),
                textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
                  color: AppColors.tertiary,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          for (var index = 0;
              index <= notifier.currentTurnIndex &&
                  index < notifier.dialogue.length;
              index++) ...<Widget>[
            _DialogueBubble(
              turn: notifier.dialogue[index],
              active: index == notifier.currentTurnIndex,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
          ],
          if (turn.choices.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text(
              'اختر ردك',
              textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            for (final choice in turn.choices) ...<Widget>[
              _ChoiceCard(
                choice: choice,
                selected: notifier.selectedChoiceId == choice.id,
                answered: notifier.showExplanation,
                onTap: () => unawaited(
                  notifier.selectResponse(choice.id),
                ),
              ),
              if (choice != turn.choices.last) const SizedBox(height: 9),
            ],
          ],
          if (notifier.showExplanation) ...<Widget>[
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            _FeedbackCard(
              correct: notifier.isCorrect == true,
              feedbackAr: notifier.feedbackAr,
            ),
          ],
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          Wrap(
            spacing: 10,
            runSpacing: 10,
            children: <Widget>[
              FilledButton.icon(
                onPressed: _canAdvance(notifier) ? notifier.nextTurn : null,
                icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded),
                label: const Text(
                  'التالي',
                  textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                ),
              ),
              OutlinedButton.icon(
                onPressed: notifier.restartDialogue,
                icon: const Icon(Icons.restart_alt_rounded),
                label: const Text(
                  'إعادة الحوار',
                  textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  static bool _canAdvance(BuergeramtNotifier notifier) {
    final turn = notifier.currentTurn;
    if (turn == null || notifier.isLastTurn) return false;
    return turn.choices.isEmpty || notifier.showExplanation;
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/clause_connector_models.dart';
import '../domain/clause_connector_repository.dart';

final class ClauseConnectorNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  ClauseConnectorNotifier(
    this._repository, {
    this.typeFilter,
  });

  static const String verbFinalPosition = 'verb-final';
  static const String verbSecondPosition = 'verb-second';
  static const String inversionVerbSecondPosition = 'inversion-verb-second';

  static const List<String> _connectorPool = <String>[
    'weil',
    'denn',
    'obwohl',
    'dass',
    'deshalb',
    'trotzdem',
  ];

  final ClauseConnectorRepository _repository;
  final ConjunctionType? typeFilter;

  List<ConnectorChallengeItem> _challenges =
      const <ConnectorChallengeItem>[];
  ConnectorChallengeItem? _currentChallenge;
  List<String> _options = const <String>[];
  bool? _isCorrect;
  String? _feedbackExplanation;
  int _currentIndex = -1;
  bool _isBusy = false;

  ConnectorChallengeItem? get currentChallenge => _currentChallenge;

  List<String> get options => _options;

  bool? get isCorrect => _isCorrect;

  String? get feedbackExplanation => _feedbackExplanation;

  bool get isBusy => _isBusy;

  Future<void> nextChallenge() async {
    if (_isBusy) return;
    _isBusy = true;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      if (_challenges.isEmpty) {
        _challenges = await _repository.getChallenges(type: typeFilter);
      }
      if (_challenges.isEmpty) {
        _currentChallenge = null;
        _options = const <String>[];
        _isCorrect = null;
        _feedbackExplanation =
            'لا توجد تحديات متاحة لهذا النوع حالياً.';
        return;
      }

      _currentIndex = (_currentIndex + 1) % _challenges.length;
      _currentChallenge = _challenges[_currentIndex];
      _options = _buildConnectorOptions(
        _currentChallenge!.targetConnector,
      );
      _isCorrect = null;
      _feedbackExplanation = null;
    } finally {
      _isBusy = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  Future<void> submitConnector(
    String connector,
    String verbPosition,
  ) async {
    if (_isBusy) return;
    final challenge = _currentChallenge;
    if (challenge == null) return;

    final submittedConnector = connector.trim().toLowerCase();
    final submittedPosition = verbPosition.trim().toLowerCase();
    final expectedPosition = _expectedVerbPosition(challenge.type);
    final connectorCorrect =
        submittedConnector == challenge.targetConnector.toLowerCase();
    final positionCorrect = submittedPosition == expectedPosition;

    _isBusy = true;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      final candidate = challenge.correctCombinedSentence.replaceFirst(
        challenge.targetConnector,
        submittedConnector,
      );
      final repositoryValid = await _repository.validateConnection(
        challenge.id,
        candidate,
      );

      _isCorrect =
          connectorCorrect && positionCorrect && repositoryValid;
      _feedbackExplanation = _buildFeedback(
        challenge: challenge,
        connectorCorrect: connectorCorrect,
        positionCorrect: positionCorrect,
      );
    } finally {
      _isBusy = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  static String expectedVerbPositionFor(ConjunctionType type) =>
      _expectedVerbPosition(type);

  static String _expectedVerbPosition(ConjunctionType type) {
    return switch (type) {
      ConjunctionType.positionZero => verbSecondPosition,
      ConjunctionType.verbKicker => verbFinalPosition,
      ConjunctionType.adverbialConnector =>
        inversionVerbSecondPosition,
    };
  }

  List<String> _buildConnectorOptions(String target) {
    final normalizedTarget = target.trim().toLowerCase();
    final values = <String>[normalizedTarget];
    for (final connector in _connectorPool) {
      if (connector == normalizedTarget) continue;
      values.add(connector);
      if (values.length == 4) break;
    }

    final shift = normalizedTarget.codeUnits.fold<int>(
          0,
          (sum, value) => sum + value,
        ) %
        values.length;
    return List<String>.unmodifiable(
      <String>[
        ...values.skip(shift),
        ...values.take(shift),
      ],
    );
  }

  String _buildFeedback({
    required ConnectorChallengeItem challenge,
    required bool connectorCorrect,
    required bool positionCorrect,
  }) {
    if (connectorCorrect && positionCorrect) {
      return challenge.arabicVerbPositionExplanation;
    }

    if (!connectorCorrect && !positionCorrect) {
      return 'الأداة الصحيحة هي ${challenge.targetConnector}. '
          '${challenge.arabicVerbPositionExplanation}';
    }
    if (!connectorCorrect) {
      return 'اختيار موقع الفعل مناسب، لكن الأداة المستهدفة هنا هي '
          '${challenge.targetConnector}.';
    }
    return challenge.arabicVerbPositionExplanation;
  }
}

import '../domain/clause_connector_models.dart';

final class LocalClauseConnectorRepository
    implements ClauseConnectorRepository {

      id: 'dass_zeit',
      firstSentence: 'Ich weiß.',
      secondSentence: 'Du hast heute Zeit.',
      targetConnector: 'dass',
      correctCombinedSentence:

      type: ConjunctionType.verbKicker,
      arabicVerbPositionExplanation:
          'dass أداة جملة فرعية؛ الفعل المصرف hast يأتي في نهاية الجملة التابعة.',
    ),
    ConnectorChallengeItem(
      id: 'weil_modal',
      firstSentence: 'Ich gehe früh schlafen.',
      secondSentence: 'Ich muss morgen arbeiten.',
      targetConnector: 'weil',
      correctCombinedSentence:
          'Ich gehe früh schlafen, weil ich morgen arbeiten muss.',
      type: ConjunctionType.verbKicker,
      arabicVerbPositionExplanation:
          'مع weil ينتقل الفعل المصرف muss إلى النهاية بعد المصدر arbeiten: arbeiten muss.',
    ),
    ConnectorChallengeItem(
      id: 'denn_modal',
      firstSentence: 'Ich gehe früh schlafen.',
      secondSentence: 'Ich muss morgen arbeiten.',
      targetConnector: 'denn',
      correctCombinedSentence:
          'Ich gehe früh schlafen, denn ich muss morgen arbeiten.',
      type: ConjunctionType.positionZero,
      arabicVerbPositionExplanation:
          'مع denn تبقى الجملة مستقلة نحويًا؛ الفعل muss يبقى في الموضع الثاني، وبعده بقية الجملة.',
    ),
    ConnectorChallengeItem(
      id: 'deshalb_mued',
      firstSentence: 'Ich bin müde.',
      secondSentence: 'Ich gehe früh ins Bett.',
      targetConnector: 'deshalb',
      correctCombinedSentence:
          'Ich bin müde. Deshalb gehe ich früh ins Bett.',
      type: ConjunctionType.adverbialConnector,
      arabicVerbPositionExplanation:
          'deshalb ظرف رابط يحتل الموضع الأول؛ لذلك يأتي الفعل gehe مباشرة بعده في الموضع الثاني ثم الفاعل ich.',
    ),
    ConnectorChallengeItem(
      id: 'trotzdem_regen',
      firstSentence: 'Es regnet stark.',
      secondSentence: 'Wir gehen spazieren.',
      targetConnector: 'trotzdem',
      correctCombinedSentence:
          'Es regnet stark. Trotzdem gehen wir spazieren.',
      type: ConjunctionType.adverbialConnector,
      arabicVerbPositionExplanation:
          'trotzdem ظرف رابط في الموضع الأول؛ الفعل gehen يأتي بعده مباشرة، ثم الفاعل wir.',
    ),
  ];

  @override
  Future<List<ConnectorChallengeItem>> getChallenges({
    ConjunctionType? type,
  }) async {
    final filtered = type == null
        ? _challengeBank
        : _challengeBank.where((item) => item.type == type);
    return List<ConnectorChallengeItem>.unmodifiable(filtered);
  }

  @override
  Future<bool> validateConnection(
    String challengeId,
    String constructedClause,
  ) async {
    final normalizedId = challengeId.trim();
    ConnectorChallengeItem? challenge;
    for (final item in _challengeBank) {
      if (item.id == normalizedId) {
        challenge = item;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (challenge == null) return false;

    return _normalizeClause(constructedClause) ==
        _normalizeClause(challenge.correctCombinedSentence);
  }

  static String _normalizeClause(String value) {
    return value
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s*,\s*'), ', ')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+([;:])\s*'), r'$1 ')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[.!?]+$'), '')
        .trim();
  }
}

enum ConjunctionType {
  positionZero,
  verbKicker,
  adverbialConnector,
}

final class ConnectorChallengeItem {
  const ConnectorChallengeItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.firstSentence,
    required this.secondSentence,
    required this.targetConnector,
    required this.correctCombinedSentence,
    required this.type,
    required this.arabicVerbPositionExplanation,
  })  : assert(id.length > 0),
        assert(firstSentence.length > 0),
        assert(secondSentence.length > 0),
        assert(targetConnector.length > 0),
        assert(correctCombinedSentence.length > 0),
        assert(arabicVerbPositionExplanation.length > 0);

  final String id;
  final String firstSentence;
  final String secondSentence;
  final String targetConnector;
  final String correctCombinedSentence;
  final ConjunctionType type;
  final String arabicVerbPositionExplanation;
}

import 'dart:async';

final class ClauseConnectorScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ClauseConnectorScreen({
    required this.notifier,
    super.key,
  });

  final ClauseConnectorNotifier notifier;

  @override
  State<ClauseConnectorScreen> createState() =>
      _ClauseConnectorScreenState();
}

final class _ClauseConnectorScreenState
    extends State<ClauseConnectorScreen> {
  String? _selectedConnector;
  String? _selectedVerbPosition;

  ClauseConnectorNotifier get notifier => widget.notifier;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    notifier.addListener(_refresh);
    if (notifier.currentChallenge == null) {
      unawaited(notifier.nextChallenge());
    }
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant ClauseConnectorScreen oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.notifier == notifier) return;
    oldWidget.notifier.removeListener(_refresh);
    notifier.addListener(_refresh);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    notifier.removeListener(_refresh);
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _refresh() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  Future<void> _nextChallenge() async {
    setState(() {
      _selectedConnector = null;
      _selectedVerbPosition = null;
    });
    await notifier.nextChallenge();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final challenge = notifier.currentChallenge;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: Text('وكيل أدوات الربط', style: AppTypography.title),
          backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
          elevation: 0,
        ),
        body: SafeArea(
          top: false,
          child: challenge == null
              ? _EmptyOrLoadingState(
                  isBusy: notifier.isBusy,
                  message: notifier.feedbackExplanation,
                  onRetry: () => unawaited(notifier.nextChallenge()),
                )
              : ListView(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 12, 16, 28),
                  children: <Widget>[
                    _ChallengeHeader(
                      challenge: challenge,
                      dark: dark,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    _SentencePairCard(
                      challenge: challenge,
                      dark: dark,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    const _SectionTitle(
                      title: '1. اختر أداة الربط',
                      subtitle:
                          'قارن بين معنى الأداة وتأثيرها على ترتيب الفعل.',
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    _ConnectorOptions(
                      options: notifier.options,
                      selected: _selectedConnector,
                      enabled: !notifier.isBusy,
                      onSelected: (value) {
                        setState(() => _selectedConnector = value);
                      },
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    const _SectionTitle(
                      title: '2. حدّد موقع الفعل',
                      subtitle:
                          'راقب كيف يتغيّر ترتيب الجملة بعد أداة الربط.',
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    _VerbKickerVisualizer(
                      selectedPosition: _selectedVerbPosition,
                      enabled: !notifier.isBusy,
                      onSelected: (value) {
                        setState(() => _selectedVerbPosition = value);
                      },
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    _SubmitCard(
                      enabled: _selectedConnector != null &&
                          _selectedVerbPosition != null &&
                          !notifier.isBusy,
                      onSubmit: () => unawaited(
                        notifier.submitConnector(
                          _selectedConnector!,
                          _selectedVerbPosition!,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (notifier.isCorrect != null) ...<Widget>[
                      const SizedBox(height: 14),
                      _FeedbackCard(
                        correct: notifier.isCorrect!,
                        explanation:
                            notifier.feedbackExplanation ?? '',
                        correctSentence:
                            challenge.correctCombinedSentence,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      AppGlassCard(
                        onTap: notifier.isBusy
                            ? null
                            : () => unawaited(_nextChallenge()),
                        glowColor: AppColors.primary,
                        borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(82),
                        backgroundColor: dark
                            ? AppColors.darkSurface
                            : AppColors.lightSurface,
                        child: Row(

                            const Icon(

                              color: AppColors.primary,
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(width: 8),
                            Text(
                              'التحدي التالي',
                              style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(
                                color: dark
                                    ? AppColors.primaryDark
                                    : AppColors.primary,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ],
                ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _ChallengeHeader extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ChallengeHeader({
    required this.challenge,
    required this.dark,
  });

  final ConnectorChallengeItem challenge;
  final bool dark;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final (label, color) = switch (challenge.type) {
      ConjunctionType.positionZero => (
          'Position 0',
          AppColors.secondary,
