import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/cognitive_load_engine.dart';
import '../domain/cognitive_load_models.dart';
import '../domain/pacing_repository.dart';

final class CognitiveLoadAgentState {
  const CognitiveLoadAgentState({
    this.analysis = CognitiveLoadAnalysis.empty,
    this.samples = 0,
    this.isAnalyzing = false,
  });

  final CognitiveLoadAnalysis analysis;
  final int samples;
  final bool isAnalyzing;

  CognitiveState get cognitiveState => analysis.state;
  double get loadScore => analysis.loadScore;
  double get focusIndex => analysis.focusIndex;
  double get comprehensionPace => analysis.comprehensionPace;
  PacingRecommendation get recommendation => analysis.recommendation;

  CognitiveLoadAgentState copyWith({
    CognitiveLoadAnalysis? analysis,
    int? samples,
    bool? isAnalyzing,
  }) {
    return CognitiveLoadAgentState(
      analysis: analysis ?? this.analysis,
      samples: samples ?? this.samples,
      isAnalyzing: isAnalyzing ?? this.isAnalyzing,
    );
  }
}

final class CognitiveLoadAgentNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  CognitiveLoadAgentNotifier({
    required PacingRepository repository,
    CognitiveLoadEngine engine = const CognitiveLoadEngine(),
    this.analysisWindow = 8,
  })  : _repository = repository,
        _engine = engine {
    if (analysisWindow < 1 || analysisWindow > 32) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        analysisWindow,
        'analysisWindow',
        'must be 1..32',
      );
    }
  }

  final PacingRepository _repository;
  final CognitiveLoadEngine _engine;
  final int analysisWindow;

  CognitiveLoadAgentState _state = const CognitiveLoadAgentState();
  Future<void> _serial = Future<void>.value();

  CognitiveLoadAgentState get state => _state;

  Future<void> hydrate() => _enqueue(_recalculate);

  Future<void> recordInteraction(SessionTelemetry telemetry) {
    return _enqueue(() async {
      _setAnalyzing(true);
      await _repository.record(telemetry);
      await _recalculate();
    });
  }

  Future<void> resetSession() {
    return _enqueue(() async {
      _setAnalyzing(true);
      await _repository.clear();
      _state = const CognitiveLoadAgentState();
      notifyListeners();
    });
  }

  Future<void> settle() => _serial;

  Future<void> _recalculate() async {
    final samples = await _repository.recent(limit: analysisWindow);
    final analysis = _engine.analyze(samples);
    _state = CognitiveLoadAgentState(
      analysis: analysis,
      samples: samples.length,
      isAnalyzing: false,
    );
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> _enqueue(Future<void> Function() operation) {
    final next = _serial.then((_) => operation());
    _serial = next.catchError((_) {
      _setAnalyzing(false);
    });
    return next;
  }

  void _setAnalyzing(bool value) {
    if (_state.isAnalyzing == value) return;
    _state = _state.copyWith(isAnalyzing: value);
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

import '../domain/cognitive_load_models.dart';
import '../domain/pacing_repository.dart';

final class LocalPacingRepository implements PacingRepository {
  LocalPacingRepository({this.capacity = 64}) {
    if (capacity < 1 || capacity > 500) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(capacity, 'capacity', 'must be 1..500');
    }
  }

  final int capacity;
  final List<SessionTelemetry> _items = <SessionTelemetry>[];

  @override
  Future<void> record(SessionTelemetry telemetry) async {
    _items.removeWhere((item) => item.eventId == telemetry.eventId);
    _items.add(telemetry);
    _items.sort((a, b) {
      final time = a.occurredAtUtc.compareTo(b.occurredAtUtc);
      return time != 0 ? time : a.eventId.compareTo(b.eventId);
    });
    if (_items.length > capacity) {
      _items.removeRange(0, _items.length - capacity);
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<List<SessionTelemetry>> recent({required int limit}) async {
    final safeLimit = limit.clamp(0, capacity).toInt();
    if (safeLimit == 0 || _items.isEmpty) {
      return const <SessionTelemetry>[];
    }
    final start = (_items.length - safeLimit).clamp(0, _items.length).toInt();
    return List<SessionTelemetry>.unmodifiable(_items.sublist(start));
  }

  @override
  Future<void> clear() async => _items.clear();
}

FILE: lib/features/cognitive_load_agent/domain/cognitive_load_engine.dart

import 'cognitive_load_models.dart';

final class CognitiveLoadEngine {
  const CognitiveLoadEngine();

  CognitiveLoadAnalysis analyze(Iterable<SessionTelemetry> samples) {
    final items = List<SessionTelemetry>.unmodifiable(samples);
    if (items.isEmpty) return CognitiveLoadAnalysis.empty;

    var responseTotal = 0.0;
    var hesitationTotal = 0.0;
    var errorTotal = 0.0;
    var rawResponseTotal = 0.0;
    var rawHesitationTotal = 0.0;
    var rawErrorTotal = 0.0;

    for (final item in items) {
      rawResponseTotal += item.responseTimeMs;
      rawHesitationTotal += item.hesitationCount;
      rawErrorTotal += item.consecutiveErrors;

      responseTotal += _responseLoad(item.responseTimeMs);
      hesitationTotal += _hesitationLoad(item.hesitationCount);
      errorTotal += _errorLoad(item.consecutiveErrors);
    }

    final count = items.length;
    final responseLoad = responseTotal / count;
    final hesitationLoad = hesitationTotal / count;
    final errorLoad = errorTotal / count;

    final loadScore = (
      responseLoad * .45 +
      hesitationLoad * .25 +
      errorLoad * .30
    ).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();

    final state = _stateFor(loadScore);
    return CognitiveLoadAnalysis(
      state: state,
      loadScore: loadScore,
      focusIndex: (1 - (hesitationLoad * .55 + errorLoad * .45))
          .clamp(0.0, 1.0)
          .toDouble(),
      comprehensionPace: (1 - responseLoad).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble(),
      averageResponseTimeMs: rawResponseTotal / count,
      averageHesitationCount: rawHesitationTotal / count,
      averageConsecutiveErrors: rawErrorTotal / count,
      recommendation: _recommendationFor(state),
    );
  }

  double _responseLoad(int responseTimeMs) {
    if (responseTimeMs <= 2500) return 0;
    return ((responseTimeMs - 2500) / 7500)
        .clamp(0.0, 1.0)
        .toDouble();
  }

  double _hesitationLoad(int hesitationCount) =>
      (hesitationCount / 4).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();

  double _errorLoad(int consecutiveErrors) =>
      (consecutiveErrors / 4).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();

  CognitiveState _stateFor(double score) {
    if (score < .40) return CognitiveState.optimal;
    if (score < .70) return CognitiveState.fatigue;
    return CognitiveState.overwhelmed;
  }

  PacingRecommendation _recommendationFor(CognitiveState state) {
    return switch (state) {
      CognitiveState.optimal => PacingRecommendation.keepPace,
      CognitiveState.fatigue => const PacingRecommendation(
          action: PacingAction.supportiveHint,
          reducePace: true,
          showSupportHint: true,
          suggestShortBreak: false,
          messageAr: 'خفّف الوتيرة قليلًا. سيظهر تلميح داعم للسؤال التالي.',
        ),
      CognitiveState.overwhelmed => const PacingRecommendation(
          action: PacingAction.shortBreak,
          reducePace: true,
          showSupportHint: true,
          suggestShortBreak: true,
          messageAr: 'الإشارات الحالية مرتفعة. خذ وقفة قصيرة ثم أكمل بوتيرة أخف.',
        ),
    };
  }
}

enum CognitiveState { optimal, fatigue, overwhelmed }

enum PacingAction { keepPace, reducePace, supportiveHint, shortBreak }

final class SessionTelemetry {
  SessionTelemetry({
    required this.eventId,
    required DateTime occurredAtUtc,
    required int responseTimeMs,
    required int hesitationCount,
    required int consecutiveErrors,
  })  : occurredAtUtc = occurredAtUtc.toUtc(),
        responseTimeMs = responseTimeMs.clamp(0, 120000).toInt(),
        hesitationCount = hesitationCount.clamp(0, 20).toInt(),
        consecutiveErrors = consecutiveErrors.clamp(0, 20).toInt() {
    if (eventId.trim().isEmpty || eventId.length > 160) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(eventId, 'eventId', 'invalid telemetry id');
    }
  }

  final String eventId;
  final DateTime occurredAtUtc;
  final int responseTimeMs;
  final int hesitationCount;
  final int consecutiveErrors;
}

final class PacingRecommendation {
  const PacingRecommendation({
    required this.action,
    required this.reducePace,
    required this.showSupportHint,
    required this.suggestShortBreak,
    required this.messageAr,
  });

  final PacingAction action;
  final bool reducePace;
  final bool showSupportHint;
  final bool suggestShortBreak;
  final String messageAr;

  static const keepPace = PacingRecommendation(
    action: PacingAction.keepPace,
    reducePace: false,
    showSupportHint: false,
    suggestShortBreak: false,
    messageAr: 'وتيرتك مستقرة. استمر بنفس الإيقاع.',
  );
}

final class CognitiveLoadAnalysis {
  const CognitiveLoadAnalysis({
    required this.state,
    required this.loadScore,
    required this.focusIndex,
    required this.comprehensionPace,
    required this.averageResponseTimeMs,
    required this.averageHesitationCount,
    required this.averageConsecutiveErrors,
    required this.recommendation,
  });

  final CognitiveState state;
  final double loadScore;
  final double focusIndex;
  final double comprehensionPace;
  final double averageResponseTimeMs;
  final double averageHesitationCount;
  final double averageConsecutiveErrors;
  final PacingRecommendation recommendation;

  static const empty = CognitiveLoadAnalysis(
    state: CognitiveState.optimal,
    loadScore: 0,
    focusIndex: 1,
    comprehensionPace: 1,
    averageResponseTimeMs: 0,
    averageHesitationCount: 0,
    averageConsecutiveErrors: 0,
    recommendation: PacingRecommendation.keepPace,
  );
}

            state.samples == 0
                ? 'تظهر المؤشرات بعد بدء التفاعل مع التمارين.'
                : 'محسوبة من آخر ${state.samples} تفاعلات في هذه الجلسة.',
            style: AppTypography.label,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  _FocusVisual _visualFor(CognitiveState value) => switch (value) {
        CognitiveState.optimal => const _FocusVisual(
            label: 'مستقر',
            icon: Icons.center_focus_strong_rounded,
            color: AppColors.mastery,
          ),
        CognitiveState.fatigue => const _FocusVisual(
            label: 'يحتاج تخفيفًا',
            icon: Icons.speed_rounded,
            color: AppColors.secondary,
          ),
        CognitiveState.overwhelmed => const _FocusVisual(
            label: 'وتيرة مرتفعة',
            icon: Icons.hourglass_bottom_rounded,
            color: AppColors.tertiary,
          ),
      };
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../../design_system/app_colors.dart';

class SmartPacingToast extends StatelessWidget {
  const SmartPacingToast({
    required this.recommendation,
    this.onHint,
    this.onBreak,
    super.key,
  });

  final PacingRecommendation recommendation;
  final VoidCallback? onHint;
  final VoidCallback? onBreak;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (recommendation.action == PacingAction.keepPace) {
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    }

    final accent = recommendation.suggestShortBreak
        ? AppColors.tertiary
        : AppColors.secondary;
    final icon = recommendation.suggestShortBreak
        ? Icons.pause_circle_outline_rounded
        : Icons.lightbulb_outline_rounded;

    return Semantics(
      liveRegion: true,
      child: AppGlassCard(
        blur: 20,
        opacity: .14,
        borderColor: accent.withAlpha(84),
        glowColor: accent,
        child: Row(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: <Widget>[
            Icon(icon, color: accent, size: 24),
            const SizedBox(width: 10),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Text(
                    recommendation.suggestShortBreak
                        ? 'اقتراح وتيرة'
                        : 'مساعدة ذكية',
                    style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
                      color: accent,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  Text(
                    recommendation.messageAr,
                    style: AppTypography.body,
                  ),
                  if (recommendation.showSupportHint && onHint != null) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    TextButton.icon(
                      onPressed: onHint,
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.lightbulb_outline_rounded),
                      label: const Text('أظهر تلميحًا'),
                    ),
                  ],
                  if (recommendation.suggestShortBreak &&
                      onBreak != null) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                    OutlinedButton.icon(
                      onPressed: onBreak,
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.timer_outlined),
                      label: const Text('وقفة قصيرة'),
                    ),
                  ],
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/comparative_superlative/application/comparison_notifier.dart

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/comparison_models.dart';
import '../domain/comparison_repository.dart';

final class ComparisonNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  ComparisonNotifier(this._repository);

  final ComparisonRepository _repository;

  List<ComparisonChallengeItem> _challenges =
      const <ComparisonChallengeItem>[];
  int _currentIndex = 0;
  ComparisonDegree _targetDegree = ComparisonDegree.komparativ;
  ComparisonRuleType? _activeRuleType;
  String? _selectedAnswer;
  String? _selectedConnector;
  bool? _isCorrect;
  bool _showExplanation = false;
  bool _isLoading = false;
  int _requestGeneration = 0;

  List<ComparisonChallengeItem> get challenges =>
      List<ComparisonChallengeItem>.unmodifiable(_challenges);
  int get currentIndex => _currentIndex;
  ComparisonDegree get targetDegree => _targetDegree;
  ComparisonRuleType? get activeRuleType => _activeRuleType;
  String? get selectedAnswer => _selectedAnswer;
  String? get selectedConnector => _selectedConnector;
  bool? get isCorrect => _isCorrect;
  bool get showExplanation => _showExplanation;
  bool get isLoading => _isLoading;

  ComparisonChallengeItem? get currentChallenge {
    if (_challenges.isEmpty || _currentIndex >= _challenges.length) return null;
    return _challenges[_currentIndex];
  }

  Future<void> load({ComparisonRuleType? ruleType}) async {
    final generation = ++_requestGeneration;
    _isLoading = true;
    notifyListeners();

    final loaded = await _repository.getChallenges(ruleType: ruleType);
    if (generation != _requestGeneration) return;

    _challenges = List<ComparisonChallengeItem>.unmodifiable(loaded);
    _activeRuleType = ruleType;
    _currentIndex = 0;
    _clearAnswerState();
    _isLoading = false;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setTargetDegree(ComparisonDegree degree) {
    if (_targetDegree == degree) return;
    _requestGeneration++;
    _targetDegree = degree;
    _clearAnswerState();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> checkComparisonAnswer({
    required String form,
    String? connector,
  }) async {
    final challenge = currentChallenge;
    if (challenge == null || _showExplanation) return;

    final normalizedForm = form.trim();
    final normalizedConnector = connector?.trim();
    final generation = ++_requestGeneration;

    _selectedAnswer = normalizedForm;
    _selectedConnector = normalizedConnector;
    _isCorrect = null;
    _showExplanation = false;
    notifyListeners();

    final formCorrect = await _repository.checkForm(
      challenge.id,
      _targetDegree,
      normalizedForm,
    );
    final expectedConnector = challenge.connectorFor(_targetDegree);
    final connectorCorrect = expectedConnector == null
        ? true
        : await _repository.checkConnector(
            challenge.id,
            _targetDegree,
            normalizedConnector ?? '',
          );

    if (generation != _requestGeneration ||
        currentChallenge?.id != challenge.id) {
      return;
    }

    _isCorrect = formCorrect && connectorCorrect;
    _showExplanation = true;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void nextChallenge() {
    if (_challenges.isEmpty) return;
    _requestGeneration++;
    _currentIndex = (_currentIndex + 1) % _challenges.length;
    _clearAnswerState();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> filterByRuleType(ComparisonRuleType? ruleType) async {
    await load(ruleType: ruleType);
  }

  void _clearAnswerState() {
    _selectedAnswer = null;
    _selectedConnector = null;
    _isCorrect = null;
    _showExplanation = false;
  }
}

import '../domain/comparison_models.dart';
import '../domain/comparison_repository.dart';

final class LocalComparisonRepository implements ComparisonRepository {
  LocalComparisonRepository() : _challenges = _buildBank();

  final List<ComparisonChallengeItem> _challenges;

  @override
  Future<List<ComparisonChallengeItem>> getChallenges({
    ComparisonRuleType? ruleType,
  }) async {
    final selected = ruleType == null
        ? _challenges
        : _challenges
            .where((item) => item.ruleType == ruleType)
            .toList(growable: false);
    return List<ComparisonChallengeItem>.unmodifiable(selected);
  }

  @override
  Future<bool> checkForm(
    String challengeId,
    ComparisonDegree degree,
    String answer,
  ) async {
    final challenge = _find(challengeId);
    if (challenge == null) return false;

    final normalized = _normalize(answer);
    if (normalized == _normalize(challenge.answerFor(degree))) return true;

    return degree == ComparisonDegree.superlativ &&
        challenge.attributiveSuperlativ != null &&
        normalized == _normalize(challenge.attributiveSuperlativ!);
  }

  @override
  Future<bool> checkConnector(
    String challengeId,
    ComparisonDegree degree,
    String connector,
  ) async {
    final challenge = _find(challengeId);
    if (challenge == null) return false;

    final expected = challenge.connectorFor(degree);
    if (expected == null) return _normalize(connector).isEmpty;
    return _normalize(connector) == _normalize(expected);
  }

  ComparisonChallengeItem? _find(String id) {
    for (final challenge in _challenges) {
      if (challenge.id == id) return challenge;
    }
    return null;
  }

  static String _normalize(String value) =>
      value.trim().toLowerCase().replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');

FILE: lib/features/comparative_superlative/domain/comparison_models.dart

enum ComparisonDegree { positiv, komparativ, superlativ }

enum ComparisonRuleType { regular, umlautChange, irregular, stemChange }

final class ComparisonChallengeItem {
  const ComparisonChallengeItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.positiv,
    required this.komparativ,
    required this.superlativ,
    required this.ruleType,
    required this.positivSentence,
    required this.komparativSentence,
    required this.superlativSentence,
    required this.positivTranslationAr,
    required this.komparativTranslationAr,
    required this.superlativTranslationAr,
    required this.explanationAr,
    this.equalityConnector = 'wie',
    this.comparativeConnector = 'als',
    this.attributiveSuperlativ,
  });

  final String id;
  final String positiv;
  final String komparativ;
  final String superlativ;
  final String? attributiveSuperlativ;
  final ComparisonRuleType ruleType;
  final String equalityConnector;
  final String comparativeConnector;
  final String positivSentence;
  final String komparativSentence;
  final String superlativSentence;
  final String positivTranslationAr;
  final String komparativTranslationAr;
  final String superlativTranslationAr;
  final String explanationAr;

  String answerFor(ComparisonDegree degree) => switch (degree) {
        ComparisonDegree.positiv => positiv,
        ComparisonDegree.komparativ => komparativ,
        ComparisonDegree.superlativ => superlativ,
      };

  String sentenceFor(ComparisonDegree degree) => switch (degree) {
        ComparisonDegree.positiv => positivSentence,
        ComparisonDegree.komparativ => komparativSentence,
        ComparisonDegree.superlativ => superlativSentence,
      };

  String translationFor(ComparisonDegree degree) => switch (degree) {
        ComparisonDegree.positiv => positivTranslationAr,
        ComparisonDegree.komparativ => komparativTranslationAr,
        ComparisonDegree.superlativ => superlativTranslationAr,
      };

  String? connectorFor(ComparisonDegree degree) => switch (degree) {
        ComparisonDegree.positiv => equalityConnector,
        ComparisonDegree.komparativ => comparativeConnector,
        ComparisonDegree.superlativ => null,
      };
}

import 'comparison_models.dart';

abstract interface class ComparisonRepository {
  Future<List<ComparisonChallengeItem>> getChallenges({
    ComparisonRuleType? ruleType,
  });

  Future<bool> checkForm(
    String challengeId,
    ComparisonDegree degree,
    String answer,
  );

  Future<bool> checkConnector(
    String challengeId,
    ComparisonDegree degree,
    String connector,
  );

import 'dart:async';


import '../../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import '../application/comparison_notifier.dart';
import '../domain/comparison_models.dart';

final class ComparisonScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ComparisonScreen({
    required this.notifier,
    super.key,
  });

  final ComparisonNotifier notifier;

  @override
  State<ComparisonScreen> createState() => _ComparisonScreenState();
}

final class _ComparisonScreenState extends State<ComparisonScreen> {
  final TextEditingController _answerController = TextEditingController();
  String? _connector;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    if (widget.notifier.currentChallenge == null &&
        !widget.notifier.isLoading) {
      unawaited(widget.notifier.load());
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _answerController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _selectDegree(ComparisonDegree degree) {
    widget.notifier.setTargetDegree(degree);
    _answerController.clear();
    setState(() => _connector = null);
  }

  void _nextChallenge() {
    widget.notifier.nextChallenge();
    _answerController.clear();
    setState(() => _connector = null);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Directionality(
        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
        child: Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(
            title: const Text('المقارنة والتفضيل · Steigerung'),
          ),
          body: ListenableBuilder(
            listenable: widget.notifier,
            builder: (context, _) {
              final notifier = widget.notifier;
              final challenge = notifier.currentChallenge;

              if (notifier.isLoading && challenge == null) {
                return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
              }
              if (challenge == null) {
                return _EmptyState(
                  onRetry: () => unawaited(notifier.load()),
                );
              }

              return ListView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 36),
                children: <Widget>[
                  _ProgressCard(notifier: notifier),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  _DegreeScale(
                    selected: notifier.targetDegree,
                    onSelected: _selectDegree,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  _ChallengeCard(
                    challenge: challenge,
                    degree: notifier.targetDegree,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  _AnswerCard(
                    controller: _answerController,
                    degree: notifier.targetDegree,
                    connector: _connector,
                    answered: notifier.showExplanation,
                    onConnectorSelected: (value) {
                      setState(() => _connector = value);
                    },
                    onSubmit: () => unawaited(
                      notifier.checkComparisonAnswer(
                        form: _answerController.text,
                        connector: _connector,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  if (notifier.showExplanation) ...<Widget>[
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    _FeedbackCard(
                      challenge: challenge,
                      degree: notifier.targetDegree,
                      correct: notifier.isCorrect == true,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    FilledButton.icon(
                      onPressed: _nextChallenge,
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded),
                      label: const Text('التحدي التالي'),
                    ),
                  ],
                ],
              );
            },
          ),
        ),
      );
}

                fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurface,
              ),
          children: <InlineSpan>[
            for (final rune in value.runes)
              TextSpan(

                style: _isUmlaut(String.fromCharCode(rune))
                    ? TextStyle(
                        color: color,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                      )
                    : null,
              ),
          ],
        ),
      );

      value == 'ä' ||
      value == 'ö' ||
      value == 'ü' ||
      value == 'Ä' ||
      value == 'Ö' ||
      value == 'Ü';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/conjunctions_models.dart';
import '../domain/conjunctions_repository.dart';

enum VerbPositionVerdict { idle, correct, incorrect }

final class ConjunctionsNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  ConjunctionsNotifier({
    required ConjunctionsRepository repository,
    this.category,
  }) : _repository = repository;

  final ConjunctionsRepository _repository;
  final ConjunctionCategory? category;

  List<ConjunctionDrillItem> _drills = const <ConjunctionDrillItem>[];
  ConjunctionDrillItem? _currentDrill;
  String? _selectedOption;
  int? _selectedVerbPosition;
  VerbPositionVerdict _verbPositionVerdict = VerbPositionVerdict.idle;
  bool? _isCorrect;
  bool _showExplanation = false;
  bool _isBusy = false;
  int _currentIndex = -1;
  int _answeredCount = 0;
  int _correctCount = 0;

  ConjunctionDrillItem? get currentDrill => _currentDrill;
  String? get selectedOption => _selectedOption;
  int? get selectedVerbPosition => _selectedVerbPosition;
  VerbPositionVerdict get verbPositionVerdict => _verbPositionVerdict;
  bool? get isCorrect => _isCorrect;
  bool get showExplanation => _showExplanation;
  bool get isBusy => _isBusy;
  int get answeredCount => _answeredCount;
  int get correctCount => _correctCount;

  double get accuracy =>
      _answeredCount == 0 ? 0 : _correctCount / _answeredCount;

  List<String> get connectorOptions {
    final values = <String>{};
    for (final drill in _drills) {
      values.add(drill.targetConnector);
    }
    return List<String>.unmodifiable(values);
  }

  Future<void> checkAnswer(
    String chosenConnector,
    int chosenVerbPos,
  ) async {
    final drill = _currentDrill;
    if (drill == null) {
      throw StateError('No active conjunction drill.');
    }
    if (_showExplanation) {
      throw StateError('Current drill has already been scored.');
    }

    final normalizedConnector = chosenConnector.trim();
    if (normalizedConnector.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        chosenConnector,
        'chosenConnector',
        'must not be empty',
      );
    }

    _setBusy(true);
    try {
      final correct = await _repository.validateAnswer(
        drill.id,
        normalizedConnector,
        chosenVerbPos,
      );

      _selectedOption = normalizedConnector;
      _selectedVerbPosition = chosenVerbPos;
      _verbPositionVerdict = chosenVerbPos == drill.correctVerbPosition
          ? VerbPositionVerdict.correct
          : VerbPositionVerdict.incorrect;
      _isCorrect = correct;
      _showExplanation = true;
      _answeredCount += 1;
      if (correct) _correctCount += 1;
    } finally {
      _setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> nextDrill() async {
    if (_isBusy) return;

    _setBusy(true);
    try {
      if (_drills.isEmpty) {
        _drills = await _repository.getDrills(category: category);
      }

      if (_drills.isEmpty) {
        _currentDrill = null;
        _selectedOption = null;
        _selectedVerbPosition = null;
        _verbPositionVerdict = VerbPositionVerdict.idle;
        _isCorrect = null;
        _showExplanation = false;
        return;
      }

      _currentIndex = (_currentIndex + 1) % _drills.length;
      _currentDrill = _drills[_currentIndex];
      _selectedOption = null;
      _selectedVerbPosition = null;
      _verbPositionVerdict = VerbPositionVerdict.idle;
      _isCorrect = null;
      _showExplanation = false;
    } finally {
      _setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  void _setBusy(bool value) {
    if (_isBusy == value) return;
    _isBusy = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

import '../../clause_connector_agent/data/local_clause_connector_repository.dart';
import '../../clause_connector_agent/domain/clause_connector_models.dart';

final class LocalConjunctionsRepository implements ConjunctionsRepository {
  LocalConjunctionsRepository({
    ClauseConnectorRepository? canonicalRepository,
  }) : _canonicalRepository =
            canonicalRepository ?? LocalClauseConnectorRepository();

  final ClauseConnectorRepository _canonicalRepository;
  List<ConjunctionDrillItem>? _cachedBank;

  static const List<ConjunctionDrillItem> _arenaSupplements =
      <ConjunctionDrillItem>[

      arabicTranslation: 'أنا متعب، لكنني أواصل الدراسة.',
      verbPositionExplanationAr:
          'aber تأتي في Position 0؛ الجملة بعدها تبقى جملة رئيسية ويظل الفعل lerne في V2.',
    ),
    ConjunctionDrillItem(
      id: 'arena_oder_bus',
      category: ConjunctionCategory.coordinatingADUSO,
      mainClause: 'Wir fahren mit dem Bus.',
      linkedClause: 'Wir gehen zu Fuß.',
      targetConnector: 'oder',
      correctVerbPosition: ConjunctionDrillItem.positionZero,
      arabicTranslation: 'نذهب بالحافلة أو نمشي على الأقدام.',
      verbPositionExplanationAr:
          'oder لا تحتل خانة من الجملة التالية؛ لذلك تبقى الجملة الرئيسية بعدها بترتيب V2.',
    ),
    ConjunctionDrillItem(
      id: 'arena_sondern_tee',
      category: ConjunctionCategory.coordinatingADUSO,
      mainClause: 'Ich trinke keinen Kaffee.',
      linkedClause: 'Ich trinke Tee.',
      targetConnector: 'sondern',
      correctVerbPosition: ConjunctionDrillItem.positionZero,
      arabicTranslation: 'أنا لا أشرب القهوة، بل أشرب الشاي.',
      verbPositionExplanationAr:
          'sondern تستخدم بعد نفي لتصحيح البديل، وهي Position 0؛ الفعل trinke يبقى في V2.',
    ),
    ConjunctionDrillItem(
      id: 'arena_wenn_zeit',
      category: ConjunctionCategory.subordinatingNebensatz,
      mainClause: 'Ich rufe dich an.',
      linkedClause: 'Ich habe Zeit.',
      targetConnector: 'wenn',
      correctVerbPosition: ConjunctionDrillItem.positionEnd,
      arabicTranslation: 'سأتصل بك عندما يكون لدي وقت.',
      verbPositionExplanationAr:
          'wenn تبدأ Nebensatz؛ لذلك ينتقل الفعل المصرف habe إلى نهاية الجملة الفرعية.',
    ),
  ];

  static const Map<String, String> _canonicalTranslations =
      <String, String>{
    'weil_krank': 'أبقى في البيت لأنني مريض.',
    'denn_krank': 'أبقى في البيت لأنني مريض.',
    'obwohl_regen': 'تتمشى ميا رغم أن المطر يهطل بغزارة اليوم.',
    'dass_zeit': 'أعرف أن لديك وقتًا اليوم.',
    'weil_modal': 'أنام مبكرًا لأن عليّ أن أعمل غدًا.',
    'denn_modal': 'أنام مبكرًا لأن عليّ أن أعمل غدًا.',
    'deshalb_mued': 'أنا متعب، لذلك أذهب إلى السرير مبكرًا.',
    'trotzdem_regen': 'المطر يهطل بغزارة، ومع ذلك نذهب للتنزه.',
  };

  @override
  Future<List<ConjunctionDrillItem>> getDrills({
    ConjunctionCategory? category,
  }) async {
    final bank = await _loadBank();
    final filtered = category == null
        ? bank
        : bank.where((item) => item.category == category);
    return List<ConjunctionDrillItem>.unmodifiable(filtered);
  }

  @override
  Future<bool> validateAnswer(
    String drillId,
    String chosenConnector,
    int chosenVerbPosition,
  ) async {
    final normalizedId = drillId.trim();
    final normalizedConnector = chosenConnector.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (normalizedId.isEmpty || normalizedConnector.isEmpty) return false;

    final bank = await _loadBank();
    ConjunctionDrillItem? drill;
    for (final item in bank) {
      if (item.id == normalizedId) {
        drill = item;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (drill == null) return false;

    return normalizedConnector == drill.targetConnector.toLowerCase() &&
        chosenVerbPosition == drill.correctVerbPosition;
  }

  Future<List<ConjunctionDrillItem>> _loadBank() async {
    final cached = _cachedBank;
    if (cached != null) return cached;

    final canonical = await _canonicalRepository.getChallenges();
    final mapped = <ConjunctionDrillItem>[
      for (final item in canonical) _fromCanonical(item),
      ..._arenaSupplements,
    ];

    _cachedBank = List<ConjunctionDrillItem>.unmodifiable(mapped);
    return _cachedBank!;
  }

  static ConjunctionDrillItem _fromCanonical(
    ConnectorChallengeItem item,
  ) {
    return ConjunctionDrillItem(
      id: 'canonical_${item.id}',
      category: _categoryFor(item.type),
      mainClause: item.firstSentence,
      linkedClause: item.secondSentence,
      targetConnector: item.targetConnector,
      correctVerbPosition: _positionFor(item.type),
      arabicTranslation: _canonicalTranslations[item.id] ??
          'تدريب على ربط الجمل باستخدام ${item.targetConnector}.',
      verbPositionExplanationAr:
          item.arabicVerbPositionExplanation,
    );
  }

  static ConjunctionCategory _categoryFor(ConjunctionType type) {
    return switch (type) {
      ConjunctionType.positionZero =>
        ConjunctionCategory.coordinatingADUSO,
      ConjunctionType.verbKicker =>
        ConjunctionCategory.subordinatingNebensatz,
      ConjunctionType.adverbialConnector =>
        ConjunctionCategory.adverbialInversion,
    };
  }

  static int _positionFor(ConjunctionType type) {
    return switch (type) {
      ConjunctionType.positionZero => ConjunctionDrillItem.positionZero,
      ConjunctionType.verbKicker => ConjunctionDrillItem.positionEnd,
      ConjunctionType.adverbialConnector =>
        ConjunctionDrillItem.positionOne,
    };
  }
}

enum ConjunctionCategory {
  coordinatingADUSO,
  subordinatingNebensatz,
  adverbialInversion,
}

final class ConjunctionDrillItem {
  const ConjunctionDrillItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.category,
    required this.mainClause,
    required this.linkedClause,
    required this.targetConnector,
    required this.correctVerbPosition,
    required this.arabicTranslation,
    required this.verbPositionExplanationAr,
  })  : assert(id.length > 0),
        assert(mainClause.length > 0),
        assert(linkedClause.length > 0),
        assert(targetConnector.length > 0),
        assert(
          correctVerbPosition == positionZero ||
              correctVerbPosition == positionOne ||
              correctVerbPosition == positionEnd,
        ),
        assert(arabicTranslation.length > 0),
        assert(verbPositionExplanationAr.length > 0);

  /// Coordinating conjunction occupies Position 0; the clause itself stays V2.
  static const int positionZero = 0;

  /// Adverbial connector occupies the first field and triggers inversion.
  static const int positionOne = 1;

  /// Sentinel for a finite verb placed at the end of a subordinate clause.
  static const int positionEnd = -1;

  final String id;
  final ConjunctionCategory category;
  final String mainClause;
  final String linkedClause;
  final String targetConnector;
  final int correctVerbPosition;
  final String arabicTranslation;
  final String verbPositionExplanationAr;

  static String verbPositionLabel(int position) => switch (position) {
        positionZero => 'Position 0',
        positionOne => 'Position 1',
        positionEnd => 'End',
        _ => 'Unknown',
      };
}

class _ConjunctionsArenaScreenState extends State<ConjunctionsArenaScreen> {
  String? _chosenConnector;
  int? _chosenVerbPosition;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    Future<void>.microtask(widget.notifier.nextDrill);
  }

  Future<void> _submit() async {
    final connector = _chosenConnector;
    final position = _chosenVerbPosition;
    if (connector == null || position == null) return;
    await widget.notifier.checkAnswer(connector, position);
  }

  Future<void> _next() async {
    setState(() {
      _chosenConnector = null;
      _chosenVerbPosition = null;
    });
    await widget.notifier.nextDrill();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: widget.notifier,
      builder: (context, _) {
        final notifier = widget.notifier;
        final drill = notifier.currentDrill;

        return Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(
            title: Text(
              'ساحة أدوات الربط والجمل الجانبية',
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
          ),
          body: Directionality(
            textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
            child: SafeArea(
              child: ListView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                children: <Widget>[
                  _ScoreCard(notifier: notifier),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  if (notifier.isBusy && drill == null)
                    const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
                  else if (drill == null)
                    AppGlassCard(
                      child: Text(
                        'لا توجد تمارين متاحة حاليًا.',
                        style: AppTypography.body,
                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      ),
                    )
                  else ...<Widget>[
                    _ClauseCard(drill: drill),
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    _ConnectorOptions(
                      options: notifier.connectorOptions,
                      selected: _chosenConnector,
                      enabled: !notifier.showExplanation,
                      onSelected: (value) {
                        setState(() => _chosenConnector = value);
                      },
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    _VerbPositionIndicator(
                      selectedPosition: _chosenVerbPosition,
                      expectedPosition: notifier.showExplanation
                          ? drill.correctVerbPosition
                          : null,
                      enabled: !notifier.showExplanation,
                      onSelected: (value) {
                        setState(() => _chosenVerbPosition = value);
                      },
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    if (!notifier.showExplanation)
                      FilledButton.icon(
                        onPressed: notifier.isBusy ||
                                _chosenConnector == null ||
                                _chosenVerbPosition == null
                            ? null
                            : _submit,
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.check_rounded),
                        label: const Text('تحقق من الإجابة'),
                      )
                    else ...<Widget>[

import '../../core/content_pipeline/content_cas_manifest.dart';
import '../../core/content_pipeline/parallel_content_pipeline.dart';

final class Wave1LanguagePackDescriptor {
  const Wave1LanguagePackDescriptor({
    required this.source,
    required this.packId,
    required this.languageCode,
  });

  final String source;
  final String packId;
  final String languageCode;

  LanguagePackRequest toImportRequest() => LanguagePackRequest(
        packId: packId,
        languageCode: languageCode,
        source: source,
        requireManifestVerification: true,
      );
}

final class Wave1DirectedPair {
  const Wave1DirectedPair(
    this.sourceLanguage,
    this.targetLanguage,
  );

  final String sourceLanguage;
  final String targetLanguage;

  String get id => '$sourceLanguage->$targetLanguage';
}

final class Wave1CurriculumCatalog {
  const Wave1CurriculumCatalog(this.manifest);

  static const String manifestPath =
      'assets/data/manifest/checksums.json';
  static const String validatorVersion = 'phase18-wave1-v1';

  static const List<Wave1LanguagePackDescriptor> packs =
      <Wave1LanguagePackDescriptor>[
    Wave1LanguagePackDescriptor(
      source: 'assets/data/wave1/de.json',
      packId: 'wave1-de-core',
      languageCode: 'de',
    ),
    Wave1LanguagePackDescriptor(
      source: 'assets/data/wave1/ar.json',
      packId: 'wave1-ar-core',
      languageCode: 'ar',
    ),
    Wave1LanguagePackDescriptor(
      source: 'assets/data/wave1/en.json',
      packId: 'wave1-en-core',
      languageCode: 'en',
    ),
    Wave1LanguagePackDescriptor(
      source: 'assets/data/wave1/zh-hans.json',
      packId: 'wave1-zh-hans-core',
      languageCode: 'zh-Hans',
    ),
    Wave1LanguagePackDescriptor(
      source: 'assets/data/wave1/ru.json',
      packId: 'wave1-ru-core',
      languageCode: 'ru',
    ),
    Wave1LanguagePackDescriptor(
      source: 'assets/data/wave1/hi.json',
      packId: 'wave1-hi-core',
      languageCode: 'hi',
    ),
  ];

  static const List<Wave1DirectedPair> directedPairs =
      <Wave1DirectedPair>[
    Wave1DirectedPair('de', 'ar'),
    Wave1DirectedPair('ar', 'de'),
    Wave1DirectedPair('en', 'ar'),
    Wave1DirectedPair('ar', 'en'),
    Wave1DirectedPair('zh-Hans', 'ar'),
    Wave1DirectedPair('ar', 'zh-Hans'),
    Wave1DirectedPair('ru', 'ar'),
    Wave1DirectedPair('ar', 'ru'),
    Wave1DirectedPair('hi', 'ar'),
    Wave1DirectedPair('ar', 'hi'),
  ];

  final ContentCasManifest manifest;

  Iterable<LanguagePackRequest> get importRequests sync* {
    _requireManifestCoverage();
    for (final pack in packs) {
      yield pack.toImportRequest();
    }
  }

  bool supportsDirectedPair(
    String sourceLanguage,
    String targetLanguage,
  ) {
    return manifest.supportsDirectedPair(
      sourceLanguage,
      targetLanguage,
    );
  }

  void _requireManifestCoverage() {
    if (manifest.contentEpoch != validatorVersion) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Wave 1 content epoch does not match curriculum validator',
      );
    }
    for (final pack in packs) {
      manifest.verifySource(
        source: pack.source,
        packId: pack.packId,
        languageCode: pack.languageCode,
        checksum: manifest.requireEntry(pack.source).sha256,
      );
    }
    for (final pair in directedPairs) {
      if (!manifest.supportsDirectedPair(
        pair.sourceLanguage,
        pair.targetLanguage,
      )) {
        throw FormatException(
          'Wave 1 manifest is missing directed pair: ' + pair.id,
        );
      }
    }
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../../../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../../../models/learner.dart';
import '../domain/daily_drill_models.dart';
import '../domain/daily_drill_repository.dart';

final class DailyDrillState {
  const DailyDrillState({
    this.status = DailyDrillStatus.idle,
    this.session,
    this.currentIndex = 0,
    this.revealed = false,
    this.correctCount = 0,
    this.totalSeconds = 0,
    this.currentStreak = 0,
    this.sessionXp = 0,
    this.busy = false,
    this.summary,
  });

  final DailyDrillStatus status;
  final DailyDrillSession? session;
  final int currentIndex;
  final bool revealed;
  final int correctCount;
  final int totalSeconds;
  final int currentStreak;
  final int sessionXp;
  final bool busy;
  final DrillResultSummary? summary;

  FlashcardReviewItem? get currentItem {
    final activeSession = session;
    if (status != DailyDrillStatus.active ||
        activeSession == null ||
        currentIndex < 0 ||
        currentIndex >= activeSession.items.length) {
      return null;
    }
    return activeSession.items[currentIndex];
  }

  int get reviewedCount {
    if (status == DailyDrillStatus.completed) {
      return summary?.reviewedCards ?? 0;
    }
    return currentIndex;
  }

  double get liveAccuracy {
    final reviewed = reviewedCount;
    return reviewed == 0 ? 0 : correctCount / reviewed;
  }

  DailyDrillState copyWith({
    DailyDrillStatus? status,
    DailyDrillSession? session,
    int? currentIndex,
    bool? revealed,
    int? correctCount,
    int? totalSeconds,
    int? currentStreak,
    int? sessionXp,
    bool? busy,
    DrillResultSummary? summary,
    bool clearSummary = false,
  }) {
    return DailyDrillState(
      status: status ?? this.status,
      session: session ?? this.session,
      currentIndex: currentIndex ?? this.currentIndex,
      revealed: revealed ?? this.revealed,
      correctCount: correctCount ?? this.correctCount,
      totalSeconds: totalSeconds ?? this.totalSeconds,
      currentStreak: currentStreak ?? this.currentStreak,
      sessionXp: sessionXp ?? this.sessionXp,
      busy: busy ?? this.busy,
      summary: clearSummary ? null : summary ?? this.summary,
    );
  }
}

final class DailyDrillController extends ChangeNotifier {
  DailyDrillController({
    required DailyDrillRepository repository,
    required DailyDrillReviewSink reviewSink,
  })  : _repository = repository,
        _reviewSink = reviewSink;

  final DailyDrillRepository _repository;
  final DailyDrillReviewSink _reviewSink;

  DailyDrillState _state = const DailyDrillState();

  DailyDrillState get state => _state;

  void start({
    required LearnerState learnerState,
    required int currentStreak,
    required Iterable<LearningContent> corpus,
    required DateTime now,
    int limit = 10,
  }) {
    final target = limit.clamp(1, 20).toInt();
    final items = _repository.dueReviews(
      state: learnerState,
      corpus: corpus,
      now: now,
      limit: target,
    );
    final session = DailyDrillSession(
      id: 'daily-${now.toUtc().microsecondsSinceEpoch}',
      startedAt: now,
      items: items,
      targetCount: target,
    );

    if (session.isEmpty) {
      _state = DailyDrillState(
        status: DailyDrillStatus.completed,
        session: session,
        currentStreak: currentStreak,
        summary: DrillResultSummary(
          reviewedCards: 0,
          correctCards: 0,
          totalSeconds: 0,
          currentStreak: currentStreak,
          sessionXp: 0,
        ),
      );
    } else {
      _state = DailyDrillState(
        status: DailyDrillStatus.active,
        session: session,
        currentStreak: currentStreak,
      );
    }
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void reveal() {
    if (_state.status != DailyDrillStatus.active ||
        _state.busy ||
        _state.currentItem == null) {
      return;
    }
    if (_state.revealed) return;
    _state = _state.copyWith(revealed: true);
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> gradeCurrent({
    required bool correct,
    required Duration elapsed,
  }) async {
    if (_state.status != DailyDrillStatus.active ||
        _state.currentItem == null) {
      throw StateError('No active daily drill card.');
    }
    if (!_state.revealed) {
      throw StateError('Reveal the card before grading recall.');
    }
    if (_state.busy) {
      throw StateError('A daily drill review is already being recorded.');
    }

    final current = _state.currentItem!;
    final seconds = elapsed.inSeconds.clamp(1, 3600).toInt();
    _state = _state.copyWith(busy: true);
    notifyListeners();

    try {
      final receipt = await _reviewSink.record(
        item: current.item,
        correct: correct,
        seconds: seconds,
      );
      final nextCorrect = _state.correctCount + (correct ? 1 : 0);
      final nextSeconds = _state.totalSeconds + seconds;
      final activeSession = _state.session!;
      final reviewed = _state.currentIndex + 1;
      final complete = reviewed >= activeSession.items.length;

      if (complete) {
        final summary = DrillResultSummary(
          reviewedCards: reviewed,
          correctCards: nextCorrect,
          totalSeconds: nextSeconds,
          currentStreak: receipt.currentStreak,
          sessionXp: receipt.sessionXp,
        );
        _state = _state.copyWith(
          status: DailyDrillStatus.completed,
          correctCount: nextCorrect,
          totalSeconds: nextSeconds,
          currentStreak: receipt.currentStreak,
          sessionXp: receipt.sessionXp,
          busy: false,
          summary: summary,
        );
      } else {
        _state = _state.copyWith(
          currentIndex: _state.currentIndex + 1,
          revealed: false,
          correctCount: nextCorrect,
          totalSeconds: nextSeconds,
          currentStreak: receipt.currentStreak,
          sessionXp: receipt.sessionXp,
          busy: false,
          clearSummary: true,
        );
      }
      notifyListeners();
    } on Object {
      _state = _state.copyWith(busy: false);
      notifyListeners();
      rethrow;
    }
  }
}


--------------------------------------------------
FILE: lib/features/daily_drill/application/offline_daily_mission_orchestrator.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import '../../../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../../../core/progress/pair_progress_models.dart';
import '../../../core/srs_facets.dart';
import '../../../services/repository.dart';
import '../../session/universal_session_orchestrator.dart';

enum OfflineDailyMissionItemKind {
  dueReview,
  grammar,
  vocabulary,
  reinforcement,
  discovery,
}

final class OfflineDailyMissionItem {
  const OfflineDailyMissionItem({
    required this.item,
    required this.kind,
    required this.facetType,
    this.variantKey,
    this.dueAt,
    this.incorrectCount = 0,
    this.successRate = 0,
  });

  final LearningContent item;
  final OfflineDailyMissionItemKind kind;
  final ReviewFacetType facetType;
  final String? variantKey;
  final DateTime? dueAt;
  final int incorrectCount;
  final double successRate;

  String get reviewKey => ReviewFacetKey(
        conceptId: item.id,
        facetType: facetType,
        variantKey: variantKey,
      ).storageKey;
}

final class OfflineDailyMissionPlan {
  OfflineDailyMissionPlan({
    required this.id,
    required this.pairKey,
    required this.generatedAtUtc,
    required this.dailyTarget,
    required this.completedToday,
    required Iterable<OfflineDailyMissionItem> items,
  }) : items = List<OfflineDailyMissionItem>.unmodifiable(items) {
    if (id.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(id, 'id', 'must not be empty');
    }
    if (pairKey.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(pairKey, 'pairKey', 'must not be empty');
    }
    if (dailyTarget < 1 || dailyTarget > 12) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        dailyTarget,
        'dailyTarget',
        'must be 1..12',
      );
    }
    if (completedToday < 0 || completedToday > dailyTarget) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        completedToday,
        'completedToday',
        'must be within daily target',
      );
    }
    if (this.items.length > remainingTarget) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'mission items cannot exceed the remaining daily target',
      );
    }
  }

  final String id;
  final String pairKey;
  final DateTime generatedAtUtc;
  final int dailyTarget;
  final int completedToday;
  final List<OfflineDailyMissionItem> items;

  int get remainingTarget => dailyTarget - completedToday;
  bool get isCompleted => remainingTarget == 0;
  bool get isEmpty => items.isEmpty;
}

final class OfflineDailyMissionOrchestrator {
  const OfflineDailyMissionOrchestrator({
    required LearnerRepository repository,
    required UniversalSessionOrchestrator sessionOrchestrator,
  })  : _repository = repository,
        _sessionOrchestrator = sessionOrchestrator;

  final LearnerRepository _repository;
  final UniversalSessionOrchestrator _sessionOrchestrator;

  Future<OfflineDailyMissionPlan> build({
    required Iterable<LearningContent> corpus,
    DateTime? now,
    int dailyTarget = 6,
  }) async {
    final safeTarget = dailyTarget.clamp(1, 12).toInt();
    final generatedAtUtc = (now ?? DateTime.now()).toUtc();
    final pairSnapshot = await _repository.loadPairProgress();

    final dayStart = DateTime.utc(
      generatedAtUtc.year,
      generatedAtUtc.month,
      generatedAtUtc.day,
    );
    final dayEnd = dayStart.add(const Duration(days: 1));

    final reviewedToday = <String>{
      for (final card in pairSnapshot.cards)
        if (_isWithinUtcDay(card.lastReviewedAt, dayStart, dayEnd))
          card.cardId,
    };
    final completedToday =
        reviewedToday.length.clamp(0, safeTarget).toInt();
    final remainingTarget = safeTarget - completedToday;

    final contentById = <String, LearningContent>{};
    final corpusInOrder = <LearningContent>[];
    for (final item in corpus) {
      final id = item.id.trim();
      if (id.isEmpty || contentById.containsKey(id)) continue;
      contentById[id] = item;
      corpusInOrder.add(item);
    }

    if (remainingTarget == 0 || contentById.isEmpty) {
      return OfflineDailyMissionPlan(
        id: _missionId(pairSnapshot, dayStart),
        pairKey: pairSnapshot.pairKey,
        generatedAtUtc: generatedAtUtc,
        dailyTarget: safeTarget,
        completedToday: completedToday,
        items: const <OfflineDailyMissionItem>[],
      );
    }

    final candidates = <_MissionCandidate>[];
    final progressedConcepts = <String>{};

    for (final card in pairSnapshot.cards) {
      final review = card.reviewCard;
      if (review == null || !review.facetKey.isValid) continue;
      progressedConcepts.add(review.itemId);

      final item = contentById[review.itemId];
      if (item == null || reviewedToday.contains(card.cardId)) {
        continue;
      }

      final dueAtUtc = review.dueAt.toUtc();
      final isDue = !dueAtUtc.isAfter(generatedAtUtc);
      final weak = card.incorrectCount > card.correctCount ||
          review.failures > review.successes ||
          review.successRate < 0.75;

      if (!isDue && !weak) continue;

      candidates.add(
        _MissionCandidate(
          item: item,
          kind: isDue
              ? OfflineDailyMissionItemKind.dueReview
              : _kindForSkill(item.skill),
          facetType: review.facetType,
          variantKey: review.variantKey,
          dueAt: dueAtUtc,
          incorrectCount: card.incorrectCount,
          successRate: review.successRate,
          priority: isDue ? 0 : 1,
        ),
      );
    }

    candidates.sort(_compareCandidates);

    final selected = <OfflineDailyMissionItem>[];
    final selectedReviewKeys = <String>{};

    void addCandidate(_MissionCandidate candidate) {
      if (selected.length >= remainingTarget) return;
      final key = candidate.reviewKey;
      if (!selectedReviewKeys.add(key)) return;
      selected.add(candidate.toMissionItem());
    }

    for (final candidate in candidates.where((item) => item.priority == 0)) {
      addCandidate(candidate);
      if (selected.length >= remainingTarget) break;
    }

    if (selected.length < remainingTarget) {
      _addPreferredSkill(
        selected: selected,
        selectedReviewKeys: selectedReviewKeys,
        candidates: candidates,
        skill: 'grammar',
        remainingTarget: remainingTarget,
      );
    }
    if (selected.length < remainingTarget) {
      _addPreferredSkill(
        selected: selected,
        selectedReviewKeys: selectedReviewKeys,
        candidates: candidates,
        skill: 'vocabulary',
        remainingTarget: remainingTarget,
      );
    }

    for (final candidate in candidates.where((item) => item.priority != 0)) {
      addCandidate(candidate);
      if (selected.length >= remainingTarget) break;
    }

    if (selected.length < remainingTarget) {
      _addFreshSkill(
        selected: selected,
        selectedReviewKeys: selectedReviewKeys,
        corpus: corpusInOrder,
        progressedConcepts: progressedConcepts,
        skill: 'grammar',
        remainingTarget: remainingTarget,
      );
    }
    if (selected.length < remainingTarget) {
      _addFreshSkill(
        selected: selected,
        selectedReviewKeys: selectedReviewKeys,
        corpus: corpusInOrder,
        progressedConcepts: progressedConcepts,
        skill: 'vocabulary',
        remainingTarget: remainingTarget,
      );
    }

    if (selected.length < remainingTarget) {
      for (final item in corpusInOrder) {
        if (progressedConcepts.contains(item.id)) continue;
        final missionItem = OfflineDailyMissionItem(
          item: item,
          kind: OfflineDailyMissionItemKind.discovery,
          facetType: ReviewFacetType.meaningRecall,
        );
        if (!selectedReviewKeys.add(missionItem.reviewKey)) continue;
        selected.add(missionItem);
        if (selected.length >= remainingTarget) break;
      }
    }

    return OfflineDailyMissionPlan(
      id: _missionId(pairSnapshot, dayStart),
      pairKey: pairSnapshot.pairKey,
      generatedAtUtc: generatedAtUtc,
      dailyTarget: safeTarget,
      completedToday: completedToday,
      items: selected,
    );
  }

  Future<SessionStateSnapshot> record({
    required OfflineDailyMissionItem missionItem,
    required String answer,
    required bool correct,
    required int seconds,
    bool hinted = false,
  }) {
    return _sessionOrchestrator.record(
      SessionReviewInput<LearningContent>(
        item: missionItem.item,
        answer: answer,
        correct: correct,
        seconds: seconds.clamp(1, 3600).toInt(),
        hinted: hinted,
        facetType: missionItem.facetType,
        variantKey: missionItem.variantKey,
        skillOverride: missionItem.item.skill,
      ),
    );
  }

  static void _addPreferredSkill({
    required List<OfflineDailyMissionItem> selected,
    required Set<String> selectedReviewKeys,
    required List<_MissionCandidate> candidates,
    required String skill,
    required int remainingTarget,
  }) {
    final normalizedSkill = skill.trim().toLowerCase();
    final alreadyPresent = selected.any(
      (item) => item.item.skill.trim().toLowerCase() == normalizedSkill,
    );
    if (alreadyPresent) return;

    for (final candidate in candidates) {
      if (candidate.item.skill.trim().toLowerCase() != normalizedSkill) {
        continue;
      }
      if (!selectedReviewKeys.add(candidate.reviewKey)) continue;
      selected.add(candidate.toMissionItem());
      if (selected.length >= remainingTarget) return;
      return;
    }
  }

  static void _addFreshSkill({
    required List<OfflineDailyMissionItem> selected,
    required Set<String> selectedReviewKeys,
    required List<LearningContent> corpus,
    required Set<String> progressedConcepts,
    required String skill,
    required int remainingTarget,
  }) {
    final normalizedSkill = skill.trim().toLowerCase();
    final alreadyPresent = selected.any(
      (item) => item.item.skill.trim().toLowerCase() == normalizedSkill,
    );
    if (alreadyPresent) return;

    for (final item in corpus) {
      if (progressedConcepts.contains(item.id) ||
          item.skill.trim().toLowerCase() != normalizedSkill) {
        continue;
      }

      final missionItem = OfflineDailyMissionItem(
        item: item,
        kind: _kindForSkill(item.skill),
        facetType: ReviewFacetType.meaningRecall,
      );
      if (!selectedReviewKeys.add(missionItem.reviewKey)) continue;
      selected.add(missionItem);
      if (selected.length >= remainingTarget) return;
      return;
    }
  }

  static OfflineDailyMissionItemKind _kindForSkill(String rawSkill) {
    switch (rawSkill.trim().toLowerCase()) {
      case 'grammar':
        return OfflineDailyMissionItemKind.grammar;
      case 'vocabulary':
        return OfflineDailyMissionItemKind.vocabulary;
      default:
        return OfflineDailyMissionItemKind.reinforcement;
    }
  }

  static int _compareCandidates(
    _MissionCandidate a,
    _MissionCandidate b,
  ) {
    final priority = a.priority.compareTo(b.priority);
    if (priority != 0) return priority;

    final dueA = a.dueAt?.microsecondsSinceEpoch ?? 0;
    final dueB = b.dueAt?.microsecondsSinceEpoch ?? 0;
    final due = dueA.compareTo(dueB);
    if (due != 0) return due;

    final incorrect = b.incorrectCount.compareTo(a.incorrectCount);
    if (incorrect != 0) return incorrect;

    final success = a.successRate.compareTo(b.successRate);
    if (success != 0) return success;

    return a.reviewKey.compareTo(b.reviewKey);
  }

  static bool _isWithinUtcDay(
    DateTime value,
    DateTime dayStart,
    DateTime dayEnd,
  ) {
    final utc = value.toUtc();
    return !utc.isBefore(dayStart) && utc.isBefore(dayEnd);
  }

  static String _missionId(
    PairProgressSnapshot snapshot,
    DateTime dayStart,
  ) {
    final date = dayStart.toIso8601String().substring(0, 10);
    return 'daily:${snapshot.pairKey}:$date';
  }
}

final class _MissionCandidate {
  const _MissionCandidate({
    required this.item,
    required this.kind,
    required this.facetType,
    required this.variantKey,
    required this.dueAt,
    required this.incorrectCount,
    required this.successRate,
    required this.priority,
  });

  final LearningContent item;
  final OfflineDailyMissionItemKind kind;
  final ReviewFacetType facetType;
  final String? variantKey;
  final DateTime? dueAt;
  final int incorrectCount;
  final double successRate;
  final int priority;

  String get reviewKey => ReviewFacetKey(
        conceptId: item.id,
        facetType: facetType,
        variantKey: variantKey,
      ).storageKey;

  OfflineDailyMissionItem toMissionItem() {
    return OfflineDailyMissionItem(
      item: item,
      kind: kind,
      facetType: facetType,
      variantKey: variantKey,
      dueAt: dueAt,
      incorrectCount: incorrectCount,
      successRate: successRate,
    );
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/daily_drill/data/srs_daily_drill_repository.dart

import '../../../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../../../core/memory.dart';
import '../../../models/learner.dart';
import '../domain/daily_drill_models.dart';
import '../domain/daily_drill_repository.dart';

final class SrsDailyDrillRepository implements DailyDrillRepository {
  const SrsDailyDrillRepository();

  @override
  List<FlashcardReviewItem> dueReviews({
    required LearnerState state,
    required Iterable<LearningContent> corpus,
    required DateTime now,
    int limit = 10,
  }) {
    final safeLimit = limit.clamp(1, 20).toInt();
    final contentById = <String, LearningContent>{
      for (final item in corpus) item.id: item,
    };

    final ranked = MemoryQueue.rank(
      state.meaningReviewCards,
      now: now,
      limit: safeLimit,
    );

    final result = <FlashcardReviewItem>[];
    for (final card in ranked) {
      final item = contentById[card.itemId];
      if (item == null) continue;
      result.add(
        FlashcardReviewItem(
          item: item,
          dueAt: card.dueAt,
          memoryState: card.memoryState,
          successRate: card.successRate,
          reviewReason: MemoryQueue.reason(card, now: now),
        ),
      );
    }
    return List<FlashcardReviewItem>.unmodifiable(result);
  }
}

import '../../../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../../../core/srs_facets.dart';
import '../../gamification/gamification_repository.dart';
import '../../session/universal_session_orchestrator.dart';
import '../domain/daily_drill_models.dart';
import '../domain/daily_drill_repository.dart';

final class UniversalSessionDrillReviewSink implements DailyDrillReviewSink {
  const UniversalSessionDrillReviewSink({
    required UniversalSessionOrchestrator orchestrator,
    required GamificationRepository gamificationRepository,
  })  : _orchestrator = orchestrator,
        _gamificationRepository = gamificationRepository;

  final UniversalSessionOrchestrator _orchestrator;
  final GamificationRepository _gamificationRepository;

  @override
  Future<DailyDrillReviewReceipt> record({
    required LearningContent item,
    required bool correct,
    required int seconds,
  }) async {
    final snapshot = await _orchestrator.record(
      SessionReviewInput<LearningContent>(
        item: item,
        answer: correct ? 'quick_recall:remembered' : 'quick_recall:missed',
        correct: correct,
        seconds: seconds.clamp(1, 3600).toInt(),
        hinted: false,
        facetType: ReviewFacetType.meaningRecall,
        skillOverride: item.skill,
      ),
    );
    final gamification = await _gamificationRepository.loadSnapshot();
    return DailyDrillReviewReceipt(
      currentStreak: gamification.profile.currentStreak,
      sessionXp: snapshot.sessionXp,
    );
  }
}

import '../../../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../../../core/memory.dart';
import '../../../models/learner.dart';

enum DailyDrillStatus { idle, active, completed }

final class FlashcardReviewItem {
  const FlashcardReviewItem({
    required this.item,
    required this.dueAt,
    required this.memoryState,
    required this.successRate,
    required this.reviewReason,
  });

  final LearningContent item;
  final DateTime dueAt;
  final MemoryState memoryState;
  final double successRate;
  final MemoryReviewReason reviewReason;
}

final class DailyDrillSession {
  DailyDrillSession({
    required this.id,
    required this.startedAt,
    required Iterable<FlashcardReviewItem> items,
    this.targetCount = 10,
  }) : items = List<FlashcardReviewItem>.unmodifiable(items) {
    if (id.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(id, 'id', 'must not be empty');
    }
    if (targetCount < 1 || targetCount > 20) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(targetCount, 'targetCount', 'must be 1..20');
    }
    if (this.items.length > targetCount) {
      throw ArgumentError('items cannot exceed targetCount');
    }
  }

  final String id;
  final DateTime startedAt;
  final List<FlashcardReviewItem> items;
  final int targetCount;

  bool get isEmpty => items.isEmpty;
}

final class DrillResultSummary {
  const DrillResultSummary({
    required this.reviewedCards,
    required this.correctCards,
    required this.totalSeconds,
    required this.currentStreak,
    required this.sessionXp,
  });

  final int reviewedCards;
  final int correctCards;
  final int totalSeconds;
  final int currentStreak;
  final int sessionXp;

  double get accuracy =>
      reviewedCards == 0 ? 0 : correctCards / reviewedCards;

  double get averageSecondsPerCard =>
      reviewedCards == 0 ? 0 : totalSeconds / reviewedCards;
}

final class DailyDrillReviewReceipt {
  const DailyDrillReviewReceipt({
    required this.currentStreak,
    required this.sessionXp,
  });

  final int currentStreak;
  final int sessionXp;
}

FILE: lib/features/daily_drill/presentation/screens/daily_drill_screen.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../../../../design_system/app_colors.dart';
import '../../../../design_system/app_glass_card.dart';
import '../../../../design_system/app_typography.dart';
import '../../../../models/learner.dart';
import '../../application/daily_drill_controller.dart';
import '../../domain/daily_drill_models.dart';
import '../widgets/drill_completion_summary_widget.dart';
import '../widgets/quick_card_flip_widget.dart';

class DailyDrillScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const DailyDrillScreen({
    required this.controller,
    required this.learnerState,
    required this.currentStreak,
    required this.corpus,
    this.limit = 10,
    this.sourceLanguageCode = 'de',
    this.translationLanguageCode = 'ar',
    super.key,
  });

  final DailyDrillController controller;
  final LearnerState learnerState;
  final int currentStreak;
  final List<LearningContent> corpus;
  final int limit;
  final String sourceLanguageCode;
  final String translationLanguageCode;

  @override
  State<DailyDrillScreen> createState() => _DailyDrillScreenState();
}

class _DailyDrillScreenState extends State<DailyDrillScreen> {
  late DateTime _cardStartedAt;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _cardStartedAt = DateTime.now();
    widget.controller.start(
      learnerState: widget.learnerState,
      currentStreak: widget.currentStreak,
      corpus: widget.corpus,
      now: _cardStartedAt,
      limit: widget.limit,
    );
  }

  Future<void> _grade(bool correct) async {
    final elapsed = DateTime.now().difference(_cardStartedAt);
    try {
      await widget.controller.gradeCurrent(
        correct: correct,
        elapsed: elapsed,
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _cardStartedAt = DateTime.now();
      });
    } on Object {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('تعذر حفظ المراجعة الآن. حاول مرة أخرى.'),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: widget.controller,
      builder: (context, _) {
        final state = widget.controller.state;
        return Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(
            title: const Text('المراجعة اليومية السريعة'),
          ),
          body: Directionality(
            textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
            child: SafeArea(
              child: _bodyFor(state),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _bodyFor(DailyDrillState state) {
    if (state.status == DailyDrillStatus.idle) {
      return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
    }

    if (state.status == DailyDrillStatus.completed) {
      final summary = state.summary ??
          const DrillResultSummary(
            reviewedCards: 0,
            correctCards: 0,
            totalSeconds: 0,
            currentStreak: 0,
            sessionXp: 0,
          );
      return ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        children: <Widget>[
          DrillCompletionSummaryWidget(summary: summary),
        ],
      );
    }

    final current = state.currentItem;
    if (current == null) {
      return const Center(child: Text('لا توجد بطاقة مراجعة نشطة.'));
    }
    final session = state.session!;
    final total = session.items.length;

    return ListView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      children: <Widget>[
        _DailyDrillHeader(
          current: state.currentIndex + 1,
          total: total,
          correct: state.correctCount,
          streak: state.currentStreak,
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 14),
        QuickCardFlipWidget(
          review: current,
          revealed: state.revealed,
          onFlip: state.busy ? null : widget.controller.reveal,
          sourceLanguageCode: widget.sourceLanguageCode,
          translationLanguageCode: widget.translationLanguageCode,
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 14),
        if (!state.revealed)
          AppGlassCard(
            borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(72),
            child: Text(
              'حاول تذكّر المعنى أولًا، ثم اقلب البطاقة.',
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: AppTypography.body,
            ),
          )
        else
          _RecallActions(
            busy: state.busy,
            onForgot: () => _grade(false),
            onRemembered: () => _grade(true),
          ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _DailyDrillHeader extends StatelessWidget {
  const _DailyDrillHeader({
    required this.current,
    required this.total,
    required this.correct,
    required this.streak,
  });

  final int current;
  final int total;
  final int correct;
  final int streak;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final progress = total == 0 ? 0.0 : current / total;
    return AppGlassCard(
      borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(72),
      child: Column(
        children: <Widget>[
          Row(
            children: <Widget>[
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  'بطاقة $current من $total',
                  style: AppTypography.label,
                ),
              ),
              Icon(
                Icons.local_fire_department_rounded,
                color: AppColors.streak,
                size: 18,
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 4),
              Text(
                '$streak',
                style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
                  color: AppColors.streak,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 9),
          LinearProgressIndicator(
            value: progress.clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble(),
            minHeight: 7,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
            color: AppColors.primary,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 7),
          Align(
            alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
            child: Text(
              'صحيح حتى الآن: $correct',
              style: AppTypography.label,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _RecallActions extends StatelessWidget {
  const _RecallActions({
    required this.busy,
    required this.onForgot,
    required this.onRemembered,
  });

  final bool busy;
  final VoidCallback onForgot;
  final VoidCallback onRemembered;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AppGlassCard(
      borderColor: AppColors.mastery.withAlpha(70),
      child: Column(

import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../../core/memory.dart';
import '../../../../design_system/app_colors.dart';
import '../../../../design_system/app_glass_card.dart';
import '../../../../design_system/app_typography.dart';
import '../../domain/daily_drill_models.dart';

class QuickCardFlipWidget extends StatelessWidget {
  const QuickCardFlipWidget({
    required this.review,
    required this.revealed,
    required this.onFlip,
    this.sourceLanguageCode = 'de',
    this.translationLanguageCode = 'ar',
    super.key,
  });

  final FlashcardReviewItem review;
  final bool revealed;
  final VoidCallback? onFlip;
  final String sourceLanguageCode;
  final String translationLanguageCode;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final article = review.item.grammaticalMarker.trim().toLowerCase();
    final accent = _articleColor(article);

    return Semantics(
      button: onFlip != null,
      label: revealed ? 'إخفاء معنى البطاقة' : 'إظهار معنى البطاقة',
      child: TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
        tween: Tween<double>(end: revealed ? math.pi : 0),
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 420),
        curve: Curves.easeInOutCubic,
        builder: (context, angle, _) {
          final showBack = angle > math.pi / 2;
          final transform = Matrix4.identity()
            ..setEntry(3, 2, .0012)
            ..rotateY(angle);

          return Transform(
            alignment: Alignment.center,
            transform: transform,
            child: Transform(
              alignment: Alignment.center,
              transform: showBack
                  ? (Matrix4.identity()..rotateY(math.pi))
                  : Matrix4.identity(),
              child: AppGlassCard(
                onTap: onFlip,
                blur: 22,
                opacity: .14,
                borderColor: accent.withAlpha(120),
                glowColor: accent,
                child: ConstrainedBox(
                  constraints: const BoxConstraints(minHeight: 260),
                  child: AnimatedSwitcher(
                    duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
                    child: showBack
                        ? _CardBack(
                            key: const ValueKey<String>('daily-card-back'),
                            review: review,
                            accent: accent,
                            sourceLanguageCode: sourceLanguageCode,
                            translationLanguageCode: translationLanguageCode,
                          )
                        : _CardFront(
                            key: const ValueKey<String>('daily-card-front'),
                            review: review,
                            article: article,
                            accent: accent,
                            sourceLanguageCode: sourceLanguageCode,
                          ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Color _articleColor(String article) => switch (article) {
        'der' => AppColors.articleDer,
        'die' => AppColors.articleDie,
        'das' => AppColors.articleDas,
        _ => AppColors.articleOther,
      };
}
