FILE: lib/features/dashboard/application/dashboard_analytics_builder.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import '../../../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../../../core/srs/srs_models.dart';
import '../../../domain/adaptive_agent/adaptive_srs_agent.dart';
import '../../../language/language_content_intelligence.dart';
import '../../../models/learner.dart';
import '../../../models/mistake.dart';
import '../../../services/mistake_engine.dart';

final class LearnerDashboardBundle {
  final LearnerDashboardAnalytics analytics;
  final Map<String, MistakeRecord> mistakesByItem;

  const LearnerDashboardBundle({
    required this.analytics,
    required this.mistakesByItem,
  });
}

/// Bridges persisted learner evidence into the pure dashboard domain.
abstract final class DashboardAnalyticsBuilder {
  static LearnerDashboardBundle build<T extends LearningContent>({
    required LearnerState state,
    required List<T> corpus,
    required LanguageContentIntelligence contentIntelligence,
    required DateTime nowUtc,
    int timezoneOffsetMinutes = 0,
    int reviewLimit = 10,
  }) {
    if (!nowUtc.isUtc) {
      throw ArgumentError('nowUtc must be in UTC');
    }

    final report = MistakeEngine.from(
      state.attempts,
      corpus,
      now: nowUtc,
    );
    final srsStates = <String, SrsItemState>{};
    for (final card in state.meaningReviewCards) {
      srsStates[card.itemId] = SrsItemState(
        intervalDays: card.intervalDays,
        repetitions: card.repetitions,
        dueDate: card.dueAt.toUtc(),
        lastReviewedDate: card.lastReviewedAt?.toUtc(),
        state: _cardState(card.memoryState),
      );
    }

    final levels = <String, String>{};
    final skills = <String, String>{};
    final labels = <String, String>{};
    for (final item in corpus) {
      levels[item.id] = _levelCode(contentIntelligence.profile(item).inferredLevel);
      skills[item.id] = item.skill;
      labels[item.id] = item.grammaticalMarker.trim().isEmpty
          ? item.sourceText
          : '${item.grammaticalMarker} ${item.sourceText}';
    }

    final masteredIds = <String>{
      for (final entry in srsStates.entries)
        if (entry.value.state == CardState.mastered) entry.key,
    };
    final correctAttempts = state.attempts.where((a) => a.correct).length;
    final analytics = AdaptiveSrsAgent().analyze(
      activityTimesUtc: state.attempts.map((a) => a.at.toUtc()),
      mistakes: report.items,
      states: srsStates,
      totalAttempts: state.attempts.length,
      correctAttempts: correctAttempts,
      curriculumLevelByItem: levels,
      masteredItemIds: masteredIds,
      nowUtc: nowUtc,
      timezoneOffsetMinutes: timezoneOffsetMinutes,
      reviewLimit: reviewLimit,
      skillByItem: skills,
      displayLabelByItem: labels,
    );

    return LearnerDashboardBundle(
      analytics: analytics,
      mistakesByItem: Map<String, MistakeRecord>.unmodifiable(
        {for (final mistake in report.items) mistake.itemId: mistake},
      ),
    );
  }

  static CardState _cardState(MemoryState state) => switch (state) {
        MemoryState.newCard => CardState.newCard,
        MemoryState.learning || MemoryState.relearning => CardState.learning,
        MemoryState.young => CardState.reviewing,
        MemoryState.mature => CardState.mastered,
      };

  static String _levelCode(ContentLevel level) => switch (level) {
        ContentLevel.a1 => 'A1',
        ContentLevel.a2 => 'A2',
        ContentLevel.b1 => 'B1',
        ContentLevel.unknown => 'unknown',
      };
}

          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          Text(
            queue.isEmpty ? strings.noStrugglingWords : strings.priorityNote,
            style: AppTypography.body.copyWith(color: secondaryText),
          ),
          if (queue.isNotEmpty) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            for (final item in queue.take(5)) ...[
              _ReviewRow(
                item: item,
                strings: strings,
                textColor: textColor,
                secondaryText: secondaryText,
                onTap: onStartQuickReview == null
                    ? null
                    : () => onStartQuickReview!([item.itemId]),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
            ],
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            FilledButton.icon(
              onPressed: onStartQuickReview == null
                  ? null
                  : () => onStartQuickReview!(ids),
              icon: const Icon(Icons.bolt_rounded),
              label: Text(strings.quickReview),
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: AppColors.primary,
                foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                textStyle: AppTypography.label,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _ReviewRow extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ReviewRow({
    required this.item,
    required this.strings,
    required this.textColor,
    required this.secondaryText,
    this.onTap,
  });

  final AdaptiveReviewItem item;
  final _DashboardStrings strings;
  final Color textColor;
  final Color secondaryText;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final priority = item.priority.round();
    return AppGlassCard(
      onTap: onTap,
      blur: 10,
      opacity: .08,
      borderRadius: 20,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 10),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text(
                  item.displayLabel,
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: AppTypography.body.copyWith(
                    color: textColor,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 2),
                Text(
                  strings.reviewRow(priority, item.reviewIntervalDays),
                  style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(color: secondaryText),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          if (onTap != null)
            const Icon(
              Icons.arrow_forward_rounded,
              color: AppColors.primary,
              size: 20,
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class InMemoryDialogueRepository implements DialogueRepository {
  InMemoryDialogueRepository({List<DialogueScenario>? scenarios})
      : _scenarios = List<DialogueScenario>.unmodifiable(
          scenarios ?? DefaultDialogueScenarios.all,
        );

  final List<DialogueScenario> _scenarios;
  final Map<String, DialogueProgress> _progress = <String, DialogueProgress>{};

  @override
  List<DialogueScenario> get scenarios => _scenarios;

  @override
  DialogueScenario? scenarioById(String scenarioId) {
    for (final scenario in _scenarios) {
      if (scenario.id == scenarioId) return scenario;
    }
    return null;
  }

  @override
  DialogueProgress progressFor(String scenarioId) {
    return _progress[scenarioId] ?? DialogueProgress.empty(scenarioId);
  }

  @override
  void recordCompletion(
    DialogueSessionResult result, {
    DateTime? completedAt,
  }) {
    if (scenarioById(result.scenarioId) == null) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        result.scenarioId,
        'result.scenarioId',
        'Unknown dialogue scenario.',
      );
    }
    final previous = progressFor(result.scenarioId);
    _progress[result.scenarioId] = DialogueProgress(
      scenarioId: result.scenarioId,
      completedRuns: previous.completedRuns + 1,
      bestScorePercent: result.scorePercent > previous.bestScorePercent
          ? result.scorePercent
          : previous.bestScorePercent,
      lastScorePercent: result.scorePercent,
      lastCompletedAt: completedAt ?? DateTime.now().toUtc(),
    );
  }
}

final class DialogueAudioRuntimeAdapter implements DialogueAudioPort {
  const DialogueAudioRuntimeAdapter({
    required this.runtime,
    this.languageCode = 'de',
  });

  final IAudioRuntime runtime;
  final String languageCode;

  @override
  Future<bool> speak(DialogueTurn turn) async {
    if (turn.germanText.trim().isEmpty) return false;
    final result = await runtime.play(
      AudioRequest(
        text: turn.germanText,
        languageCode: languageCode,
        conceptId: turn.audioConceptId ?? turn.id,
        variant: AudioVariant.sentence,
      ),
    );
    return result.played;
  }
}

import 'dialogue_models.dart';

abstract interface class DialogueAudioPort {
  Future<bool> speak(DialogueTurn turn);
}

final class SilentDialogueAudioPort implements DialogueAudioPort {
  const SilentDialogueAudioPort();

  @override
  Future<bool> speak(DialogueTurn turn) async => false;
}

final class DialogueSessionResult {
  const DialogueSessionResult({
    required this.scenarioId,
    required this.points,
    required this.maxPoints,
    required this.scorePercent,
    required this.answeredChoices,
    required this.transcript,
  });

  final String scenarioId;
  final int points;
  final int maxPoints;
  final int scorePercent;
  final int answeredChoices;
  final List<DialogueTurn> transcript;
}

final class DialogueStepResult {
  const DialogueStepResult({
    required this.selectedTurn,
    required this.currentNode,
    required this.completed,
    required this.scorePercent,
  });

  final DialogueTurn selectedTurn;
  final DialogueNode currentNode;
  final bool completed;
  final int scorePercent;
}

final class DialogueProgress {
  const DialogueProgress({
    required this.scenarioId,
    required this.completedRuns,
    required this.bestScorePercent,
    required this.lastScorePercent,
    required this.lastCompletedAt,
  });

  const DialogueProgress.empty(String scenarioId)
      : this(
          scenarioId: scenarioId,
          completedRuns: 0,
          bestScorePercent: 0,
          lastScorePercent: 0,
          lastCompletedAt: null,
        );

  final String scenarioId;
  final int completedRuns;
  final int bestScorePercent;
  final int lastScorePercent;
  final DateTime? lastCompletedAt;

  bool get isCompleted => completedRuns > 0;
}

abstract interface class DialogueRepository {
  List<DialogueScenario> get scenarios;

  DialogueScenario? scenarioById(String scenarioId);

  DialogueProgress progressFor(String scenarioId);

  void recordCompletion(
    DialogueSessionResult result, {
    DateTime? completedAt,
  });
}

final class DialogueEngine {
  DialogueEngine(this.scenario)
      : _currentNodeId = scenario.startNodeId,
        _completed = scenario.startNode.isTerminal,
        _transcript = <DialogueTurn>[scenario.startNode.turn];

  final DialogueScenario scenario;
  final List<DialogueTurn> _transcript;
  String _currentNodeId;
  int _points = 0;
  int _maxPoints = 0;
  int _answeredChoices = 0;
  bool _completed;

  DialogueNode get currentNode => scenario.node(_currentNodeId);

  List<DialogueTurn> get transcript =>
      List<DialogueTurn>.unmodifiable(_transcript);

  bool get isCompleted => _completed;

  int get scorePercent {
    if (_maxPoints == 0) return _completed ? 100 : 0;
    return ((_points / _maxPoints) * 100).round().clamp(0, 100).toInt();
  }

  DialogueStepResult choose(String choiceId) {
    if (_completed) {
      throw StateError('Dialogue session is already complete.');
    }
    final node = currentNode;
    DialogueChoice? choice;
    for (final candidate in node.choices) {
      if (candidate.id == choiceId) {
        choice = candidate;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (choice == null) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        choiceId,
        'choiceId',
        'Choice is not available from node ${node.id}.',
      );
    }

    final learnerTurn = DialogueTurn(
      id: '${node.id}:${choice.id}',
      speaker: DialogueSpeaker.learner,
      germanText: choice.germanText,
      arabicTranslation: choice.arabicTranslation,
      audioConceptId: choice.id,
    );
    _transcript.add(learnerTurn);
    _points += choice.points;
    _maxPoints += node.maxChoicePoints;
    _answeredChoices += 1;

    _currentNodeId = choice.nextNodeId;
    final next = currentNode;
    _transcript.add(next.turn);
    _completed = next.isTerminal;

    return DialogueStepResult(
      selectedTurn: learnerTurn,
      currentNode: next,
      completed: _completed,
      scorePercent: scorePercent,
    );
  }

  DialogueSessionResult get result {
    return DialogueSessionResult(
      scenarioId: scenario.id,
      points: _points,
      maxPoints: _maxPoints,
      scorePercent: scorePercent,
      answeredChoices: _answeredChoices,
      transcript: transcript,
    );
  }
}

enum DialogueSpeaker { learner, interlocutor }

final class DialogueTurn {
  const DialogueTurn({
    required this.id,
    required this.speaker,
    required this.germanText,
    required this.arabicTranslation,
    this.audioConceptId,
  });

  final String id;
  final DialogueSpeaker speaker;
  final String germanText;
  final String arabicTranslation;
  final String? audioConceptId;
}

final class DialogueChoice {
  const DialogueChoice({
    required this.id,
    required this.germanText,
    required this.arabicTranslation,
    required this.nextNodeId,
    required this.points,
  }) : assert(points >= 0);

  final String id;
  final String germanText;
  final String arabicTranslation;
  final String nextNodeId;
  final int points;
}

final class DialogueNode {
  const DialogueNode({
    required this.id,
    required this.turn,
    this.choices = const <DialogueChoice>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final DialogueTurn turn;
  final List<DialogueChoice> choices;

  bool get isTerminal => choices.isEmpty;

  int get maxChoicePoints {
    if (choices.isEmpty) return 0;
    return choices
        .map((choice) => choice.points)
        .reduce((current, value) => current > value ? current : value);
  }
}

final class DialogueScenario {
  DialogueScenario({
    required this.id,
    required this.titleGerman,
    required this.titleArabic,
    required this.startNodeId,
    required Map<String, DialogueNode> nodes,
  }) : nodes = Map<String, DialogueNode>.unmodifiable(nodes) {
    _validate();
  }

  final String id;
  final String titleGerman;
  final String titleArabic;
  final String startNodeId;
  final Map<String, DialogueNode> nodes;

  DialogueNode get startNode => node(startNodeId);

  DialogueNode node(String nodeId) {
    final result = nodes[nodeId];
    if (result == null) {
      throw DialogueDefinitionException(
        'Scenario $id references missing node $nodeId.',
      );
    }
    return result;
  }

  void _validate() {
    if (id.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw const DialogueDefinitionException('Scenario id must not be empty.');
    }
    if (!nodes.containsKey(startNodeId)) {
      throw DialogueDefinitionException(
        'Scenario $id has missing start node $startNodeId.',
      );
    }
    for (final entry in nodes.entries) {
      if (entry.key != entry.value.id) {
        throw DialogueDefinitionException(
          'Scenario $id node key ${entry.key} does not match ${entry.value.id}.',
        );
      }
      if (entry.value.turn.id.trim().isEmpty ||
          entry.value.turn.germanText.trim().isEmpty) {
        throw DialogueDefinitionException(
          'Scenario $id node ${entry.key} has an invalid turn.',
        );
      }
      final choiceIds = <String>{};
      for (final choice in entry.value.choices) {
        if (!choiceIds.add(choice.id)) {
          throw DialogueDefinitionException(
            'Scenario $id node ${entry.key} repeats choice ${choice.id}.',
          );
        }
        if (!nodes.containsKey(choice.nextNodeId)) {
          throw DialogueDefinitionException(
            'Scenario $id choice ${choice.id} references missing node '
            '${choice.nextNodeId}.',
          );
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

final class DialogueDefinitionException implements Exception {
  const DialogueDefinitionException(this.message);

  final String message;

  @override
  String toString() => 'DialogueDefinitionException: $message';
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../design_system/app_audio_button.dart';
import '../../../design_system/app_colors.dart';
import '../../../design_system/app_glass_card.dart';
import '../../../design_system/app_typography.dart';
import '../domain/dialogue_engine.dart';
import '../domain/dialogue_models.dart';

class DialogueChatView extends StatefulWidget {
  const DialogueChatView({
    required this.scenario,
    required this.repository,
    required this.audioPort,
    this.onCompleted,
    super.key,
  });

  final DialogueScenario scenario;
  final DialogueRepository repository;
  final DialogueAudioPort audioPort;
  final ValueChanged<DialogueSessionResult>? onCompleted;

  @override
  State<DialogueChatView> createState() => _DialogueChatViewState();
}

class _DialogueChatViewState extends State<DialogueChatView> {
  late final DialogueEngine _engine;
  final Set<String> _revealedTranslations = <String>{};
  final Set<String> _busyAudioIds = <String>{};

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _engine = DialogueEngine(widget.scenario);
  }

  void _toggleTranslation(DialogueTurn turn) {
    setState(() {
      if (!_revealedTranslations.add(turn.id)) {
        _revealedTranslations.remove(turn.id);
      }
    });
  }

  Future<void> _speakTurn(DialogueTurn turn) async {
    await _speakWithId(turn.id, turn);
  }

  Future<void> _speakChoice(DialogueChoice choice) async {
    final audioId = 'choice:${choice.id}';
    await _speakWithId(
      audioId,
      DialogueTurn(
        id: audioId,
        speaker: DialogueSpeaker.learner,
        germanText: choice.germanText,
        arabicTranslation: choice.arabicTranslation,
        audioConceptId: choice.id,
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _speakWithId(
    String audioId,
    DialogueTurn turn,
  ) async {
    if (_busyAudioIds.contains(audioId)) return;
    setState(() => _busyAudioIds.add(audioId));
    try {
      await widget.audioPort.speak(turn);
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _busyAudioIds.remove(audioId));
      }
    }
  }

  void _choose(DialogueChoice choice) {
    final step = _engine.choose(choice.id);
    if (step.completed) {
      final result = _engine.result;
      widget.repository.recordCompletion(result);
      widget.onCompleted?.call(result);
    }
    setState(() {});
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final current = _engine.currentNode;
    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: DecoratedBox(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          gradient: LinearGradient(
            begin: Alignment.topCenter,
            end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
            colors: <Color>[
              theme.colorScheme.surface,
              AppColors.primary.withAlpha(18),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        child: SafeArea(
          child: Column(
            children: <Widget>[
              _Header(
                titleArabic: widget.scenario.titleArabic,
                titleGerman: widget.scenario.titleGerman,
                scorePercent: _engine.scorePercent,
              ),
              Expanded(
                child: ListView.builder(
                  key: const Key('dialogue-transcript'),
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 12, 16, 20),
                  itemCount: _engine.transcript.length,
                  itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                    final turn = _engine.transcript[index];
                    return _DialogueBubble(
                      turn: turn,
                      translationVisible:
                          _revealedTranslations.contains(turn.id),
                      audioBusy: _busyAudioIds.contains(turn.id),
                      onToggleTranslation: () =>
                          _toggleTranslation(turn),
                      onListen: () => _speakTurn(turn),
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),
              if (_engine.isCompleted)
                _CompletionPanel(result: _engine.result)
              else
                _ChoicePanel(
                  node: current,
                  busyAudioIds: _busyAudioIds,
                  onChoose: _choose,
                  onListen: _speakChoice,
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _Header extends StatelessWidget {
  const _Header({
    required this.titleArabic,
    required this.titleGerman,
    required this.scorePercent,
  });

  final String titleArabic;
  final String titleGerman;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 12, 16, 4),
        child: AppGlassCard(
          glowColor: AppColors.primary,
          child: Row(
            children: <Widget>[
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    AppDirectionalText(
                      titleArabic,
                      languageCode: 'ar',
                      style: AppTypography.title,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 2),
                    AppDirectionalText(
                      titleGerman,
                      languageCode: 'de',
                      style: AppTypography.label,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              AppDirectionalText(
                '$scorePercent%',
                languageCode: 'ar',
                style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(
                  color: AppColors.mastery,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
}

class _DialogueBubble extends StatelessWidget {
  const _DialogueBubble({
    required this.turn,
    required this.translationVisible,
    required this.audioBusy,
    required this.onToggleTranslation,
    required this.onListen,
  });

  final DialogueTurn turn;
  final bool translationVisible;
  final bool audioBusy;
  final VoidCallback onToggleTranslation;
  final VoidCallback onListen;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final learner = turn.speaker == DialogueSpeaker.learner;
    final accent = learner ? AppColors.secondary : AppColors.primary;
    return Align(
      alignment: learner ? Alignment.centerRight : Alignment.centerLeft,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 6),
        child: ConstrainedBox(
          constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 560),
          child: AppGlassCard(
            key: ValueKey<String>('dialogue-turn-${turn.id}'),
            onTap: onToggleTranslation,
            borderColor: accent.withAlpha(95),
            glowColor: accent,
            opacity: learner ? .15 : .10,
            child: Row(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: <Widget>[
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      AppDirectionalText(
                        turn.germanText,
                        languageCode: 'de',
                        style: AppTypography.body.copyWith(
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                        ),
                      ),
                      if (translationVisible) ...<Widget>[
                        const SizedBox(height: 8),
                        AppDirectionalText(
                          turn.arabicTranslation,
                          key: ValueKey<String>(
                            'dialogue-translation-${turn.id}',
                          ),
                          languageCode: 'ar',
                          style: AppTypography.body,
                        ),
                      ],
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                AppAudioButton(
                  key: ValueKey<String>('dialogue-listen-${turn.id}'),
                  onPressed: audioBusy ? null : onListen,
                  semanticLabel: 'استمع إلى الجملة الألمانية',
                  isBusy: audioBusy,
                  activeColor: accent,
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/doppelkonnektoren_models.dart';
import '../domain/doppelkonnektoren_repository.dart';

final class DoppelkonnektorenNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  DoppelkonnektorenNotifier(this._repository);

  final DoppelkonnektorenRepository _repository;

  List<DoppelConnectorChallengeItem> _challenges =
      const <DoppelConnectorChallengeItem>[];
  DoppelConnectorChallengeItem? _currentChallenge;
  List<String> _connectorOptions = const <String>[];
  String? _selectedConnector;
  bool? _isCorrect;
  String? _feedbackExplanation;
  DoppelConnectorType? _activeType;
  int _currentIndex = -1;
  bool _isBusy = false;

  DoppelConnectorChallengeItem? get currentChallenge => _currentChallenge;

  List<String> get connectorOptions => _connectorOptions;

  String? get selectedConnector => _selectedConnector;

  bool? get isCorrect => _isCorrect;

  String? get feedbackExplanation => _feedbackExplanation;

  DoppelConnectorType? get activeType => _activeType;

  bool get isBusy => _isBusy;

  Future<void> nextChallenge() async {
    if (_isBusy) return;
    _isBusy = true;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      if (_challenges.isEmpty) {
        _challenges = await _repository.getChallenges(
          type: _activeType,
        );
        _currentIndex = -1;
      }
      await _selectNext();
    } finally {
      _isBusy = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  Future<void> filterByType(DoppelConnectorType? type) async {
    if (_isBusy) return;
    _isBusy = true;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      _activeType = type;
      _challenges = await _repository.getChallenges(type: type);
      _currentIndex = -1;
      _currentChallenge = null;
      _connectorOptions = const <String>[];
      _clearAnswerState();
      await _selectNext();
    } finally {
      _isBusy = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  Future<void> submitAnswer(
    String connectorFormula, [
    String? constructedSentence,
  ]) async {
    final challenge = _currentChallenge;
    if (_isBusy || challenge == null) return;

    final selected = connectorFormula.trim();
    if (selected.isEmpty) {
      _selectedConnector = '';
      _isCorrect = false;
      _feedbackExplanation = 'اختر الرابط المزدوج قبل التحقق.';
      notifyListeners();
      return;
    }

    final selectedType = _typeForFormula(selected);
    _isBusy = true;
    _selectedConnector = selected;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      final sentence =
          constructedSentence ?? challenge.correctSentence;
      final pairCorrect = selectedType != null &&
          await _repository.validateConnectorPair(
            challenge.id,
            selectedType.firstPart,
            selectedType.secondPart,
          );
      final sentenceCorrect = await _repository.validateSentence(
        challenge.id,
        sentence,
      );
      _isCorrect = pairCorrect && sentenceCorrect;
      _feedbackExplanation = _buildFeedback(
        challenge: challenge,
        pairCorrect: pairCorrect,
        sentenceCorrect: sentenceCorrect,
      );
    } finally {
      _isBusy = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _selectNext() async {
    if (_challenges.isEmpty) {
      _currentChallenge = null;
      _connectorOptions = const <String>[];
      _clearAnswerState();
      _feedbackExplanation =
          'لا توجد تحديات Doppelkonnektoren متاحة لهذا التصنيف.';
      return;
    }

    _currentIndex = (_currentIndex + 1) % _challenges.length;
    _currentChallenge = _challenges[_currentIndex];
    _connectorOptions = await _repository.getConnectorOptions(
      _currentChallenge!.id,
    );
    _clearAnswerState();
  }

  void _clearAnswerState() {
    _selectedConnector = null;
    _isCorrect = null;
    _feedbackExplanation = null;
  }

  static DoppelConnectorType? _typeForFormula(String value) {
    final normalized = _normalizeFormula(value);
    for (final type in DoppelConnectorType.values) {
      if (_normalizeFormula(type.formula) == normalized) return type;
    }
    return null;
  }

  static String _normalizeFormula(String value) => value
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replaceAll('...', '…')
      .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');

  static String _buildFeedback({
    required DoppelConnectorChallengeItem challenge,
    required bool pairCorrect,
    required bool sentenceCorrect,
  }) {
    if (pairCorrect && sentenceCorrect) {
      return challenge.arabicExplanation;
    }

    if (!pairCorrect && !sentenceCorrect) {
      return 'اختيار الرابط وبنية الجملة يحتاجان مراجعة. '
          '${challenge.arabicExplanation}';
    }

    if (!pairCorrect) {
      return 'الرابط الصحيح هنا هو ${challenge.type.formula}. '
          '${challenge.arabicExplanation}';
    }

    return 'الرابط صحيح، لكن ترتيب الجملة لا يطابق البنية المستهدفة. '
        '${challenge.arabicExplanation}';
  }
}

      id: 'weder_health_extremes',
      type: DoppelConnectorType.wederNoch,
      topic: DoppelConnectorTopic.health,
      sourceIdea:
          'Ein nachhaltiger Alltag braucht keine extremen Trainingspläne und keine unrealistischen Schlafziele.',
      correctSentence:
          'Ein nachhaltiger Alltag braucht weder extreme Trainingspläne noch unrealistische Schlafziele.',
      arabicTranslation:
          'لا يحتاج الروتين المستدام إلى خطط تدريب متطرفة ولا إلى أهداف نوم غير واقعية.',
      arabicExplanation:
          'weder … noch ينفي الاسمين المتوازيين extreme Trainingspläne وunrealistische Schlafziele. الفعل braucht يبقى في موقعه الطبيعي في Hauptsatz.',
    ),
  ];

  @override
  Future<List<DoppelConnectorChallengeItem>> getChallenges({
    DoppelConnectorType? type,
  }) async {
    final values = type == null
        ? _bank
        : _bank.where((item) => item.type == type);
    return List<DoppelConnectorChallengeItem>.unmodifiable(values);
  }

  @override
  Future<List<String>> getConnectorOptions(String challengeId) async {
    final challenge = _find(challengeId);
    if (challenge == null) return const <String>[];

    final expected = challenge.type.formula;
    final options = <String>[expected];
    for (final type in DoppelConnectorType.values) {
      if (type.formula != expected) options.add(type.formula);
    }
    return List<String>.unmodifiable(options);
  }

  @override
  Future<bool> validateConnectorPair(
    String challengeId,
    String firstPart,
    String secondPart,
  ) async {
    final challenge = _find(challengeId);
    if (challenge == null) return false;
    return _normalizeToken(firstPart) ==
            _normalizeToken(challenge.type.firstPart) &&
        _normalizeToken(secondPart) ==
            _normalizeToken(challenge.type.secondPart);
  }

  @override
  Future<bool> validateSentence(
    String challengeId,
    String sentence,
  ) async {
    final challenge = _find(challengeId);
    if (challenge == null) return false;
    return _normalizeSentence(sentence) ==
        _normalizeSentence(challenge.correctSentence);
  }

  static DoppelConnectorChallengeItem? _find(String id) {
    final normalizedId = id.trim();
    for (final item in _bank) {
      if (item.id == normalizedId) return item;
    }
    return null;
  }

  static String _normalizeToken(String value) =>
      value.trim().toLowerCase().replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');

  static String _normalizeSentence(String value) {
    return value
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ')
        .replaceAll(' ,', ',')
        .replaceAll(' .', '.')
        .replaceAll(' ?', '?')
        .replaceAll(' !', '!')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[.!?]+$'), '')
        .trim();
  }
}

enum DoppelConnectorType {
  jeDesto,
  sowohlAlsAuch,
  wederNoch,
}

enum DoppelConnectorTopic {
  studies,
  productivity,
  health,
  science,
}

extension DoppelConnectorTypeMetadata on DoppelConnectorType {
  String get firstPart => switch (this) {
        DoppelConnectorType.jeDesto => 'je',
        DoppelConnectorType.sowohlAlsAuch => 'sowohl',
        DoppelConnectorType.wederNoch => 'weder',
      };

  String get secondPart => switch (this) {
        DoppelConnectorType.jeDesto => 'desto',
        DoppelConnectorType.sowohlAlsAuch => 'als auch',
        DoppelConnectorType.wederNoch => 'noch',
      };

  String get formula => '$firstPart … $secondPart';

  bool get requiresComparative =>
      this == DoppelConnectorType.jeDesto;

  String get arabicLabel => switch (this) {
        DoppelConnectorType.jeDesto =>
          'كلما … كان / أصبح … أكثر',
        DoppelConnectorType.sowohlAlsAuch =>
          'كِلا … و … / بالإضافة إلى الاثنين',
        DoppelConnectorType.wederNoch =>
          'لا … ولا …',
      };

  String get grammarHint => switch (this) {
        DoppelConnectorType.jeDesto =>
          'je + Komparativ … desto + Komparativ',
        DoppelConnectorType.sowohlAlsAuch =>
          'sowohl + Element A … als auch + Element B',
        DoppelConnectorType.wederNoch =>
          'weder + Element A … noch + Element B',
      };
}

extension DoppelConnectorTopicLabel on DoppelConnectorTopic {
  String get arabicLabel => switch (this) {
        DoppelConnectorTopic.studies => 'الدراسة',
        DoppelConnectorTopic.productivity => 'الإنتاجية',
        DoppelConnectorTopic.health => 'الصحة',
        DoppelConnectorTopic.science => 'العلوم',
      };
}

final class DoppelConnectorChallengeItem {
  DoppelConnectorChallengeItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.type,
    required this.topic,
    required this.sourceIdea,
    required this.correctSentence,
    required this.arabicTranslation,
    required this.arabicExplanation,
  }) {
    if (id.trim().isEmpty ||
        sourceIdea.trim().isEmpty ||
        correctSentence.trim().isEmpty ||
        arabicTranslation.trim().isEmpty ||
        arabicExplanation.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('Invalid Doppelkonnektor challenge.');
    }
  }

  final String id;
  final DoppelConnectorType type;
  final DoppelConnectorTopic topic;
  final String sourceIdea;
  final String correctSentence;
  final String arabicTranslation;
  final String arabicExplanation;

  String get formula => type.formula;
}

import 'dart:async';


import '../../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import '../application/doppelkonnektoren_notifier.dart';
import '../domain/doppelkonnektoren_models.dart';

final class DoppelkonnektorenScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const DoppelkonnektorenScreen({
    required this.notifier,
    super.key,
  });

  final DoppelkonnektorenNotifier notifier;

  @override
  State<DoppelkonnektorenScreen> createState() =>
      _DoppelkonnektorenScreenState();
}

final class _DoppelkonnektorenScreenState
    extends State<DoppelkonnektorenScreen> {
  String? _selectedConnector;

  DoppelkonnektorenNotifier get notifier => widget.notifier;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    notifier.addListener(_refresh);
    if (notifier.currentChallenge == null) {
      unawaited(notifier.nextChallenge());
    }
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant DoppelkonnektorenScreen oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.notifier == notifier) return;
    oldWidget.notifier.removeListener(_refresh);
    notifier.addListener(_refresh);
    _selectedConnector = null;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    notifier.removeListener(_refresh);
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _refresh() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  Future<void> _filter(DoppelConnectorType? type) async {
    setState(() => _selectedConnector = null);
    await notifier.filterByType(type);
  }

  Future<void> _next() async {
    setState(() => _selectedConnector = null);
    await notifier.nextChallenge();
  }

  Future<void> _submit() async {
    final selected = _selectedConnector;
    if (selected == null) return;
    await notifier.submitAnswer(selected);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface =
        dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface;
    final challenge = notifier.currentChallenge;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 18, 16, 28),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: <Widget>[
                _HeaderCard(surface: surface, dark: dark),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                _ConnectorFilter(
                  activeType: notifier.activeType,
                  enabled: !notifier.isBusy,
                  onSelected: (type) => unawaited(_filter(type)),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                if (challenge == null)
                  _EmptyCard(
                    surface: surface,
                    dark: dark,
                    isBusy: notifier.isBusy,
                    message: notifier.feedbackExplanation,
                    onRetry: () => unawaited(notifier.nextChallenge()),
                  )
                else ...<Widget>[
                  _FormulaCard(
                    challenge: challenge,
                    surface: surface,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  _PromptCard(
                    challenge: challenge,
                    surface: surface,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  _ConnectorOptions(
                    options: notifier.connectorOptions,
                    selected: _selectedConnector,
                    enabled: !notifier.isBusy &&
                        notifier.isCorrect == null,
                    surface: surface,
                    dark: dark,
                    onSelected: (value) {
                      setState(() => _selectedConnector = value);
                    },
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  _SubmitCard(
                    enabled: _selectedConnector != null &&
                        !notifier.isBusy &&
                        notifier.isCorrect == null,
                    surface: surface,
                    onTap: () => unawaited(_submit()),
                  ),
                  if (notifier.isCorrect != null) ...<Widget>[
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    _FeedbackCard(
                      challenge: challenge,
                      correct: notifier.isCorrect!,
                      explanation:
                          notifier.feedbackExplanation ?? '',
                      surface: surface,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    _NextCard(
                      surface: surface,
                      enabled: !notifier.isBusy,
                      onTap: () => unawaited(_next()),
                    ),
                  ],
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _ConnectorFilter extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ConnectorFilter({
    required this.activeType,
    required this.enabled,
    required this.onSelected,
  });

  final DoppelConnectorType? activeType;
  final bool enabled;
  final ValueChanged<DoppelConnectorType?> onSelected;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    const values = <DoppelConnectorType?>[
      null,
      DoppelConnectorType.jeDesto,
      DoppelConnectorType.sowohlAlsAuch,
      DoppelConnectorType.wederNoch,
    ];

    return Wrap(
      spacing: 8,
      runSpacing: 8,
      children: <Widget>[
        for (final type in values)
          AppGlassCard(
            onTap: enabled ? () => onSelected(type) : null,
            padding:
                const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 11, vertical: 8),
            borderColor: activeType == type
                ? AppColors.secondary
                : AppColors.glassBorderDark,
            glowColor:
                activeType == type ? AppColors.secondary : null,
            child: type == null
                ? _ArabicText(
                    'الكل',
                    style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
                      color: activeType == null
                          ? AppColors.secondary
                          : null,
                    ),
                  )
                : _GermanText(
                    type.formula,
                    style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
                      color: activeType == type
                          ? AppColors.secondary
                          : null,
                    ),
                  ),
          ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

final class _ConnectorOptions extends StatelessWidget {

    required this.options,
    required this.selected,
    required this.enabled,
    required this.surface,
    required this.dark,
    required this.onSelected,
  });

  final String? selected;
  final bool enabled;
  final Color surface;
  final bool dark;
  final ValueChanged<String> onSelected;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Column(
        children: <Widget>[
          for (var index = 0; index < options.length; index += 1) ...<Widget>[
            AppGlassCard(
              onTap: enabled ? () => onSelected(options[index]) : null,
              backgroundColor: surface,
              borderColor: selected == options[index]
                  ? AppColors.primary
                  : (dark
                      ? AppColors.glassBorderDark
                      : AppColors.glassBorderLight),
              glowColor:
                  selected == options[index] ? AppColors.primary : null,
              child: Row(
                textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                children: <Widget>[
                  _OptionIndex(
                    index: index,
                    selected: selected == options[index],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  Expanded(
                    child: _GermanText(
                      options[index],
                      style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(
                        color: selected == options[index]
                            ? AppColors.primary
                            : null,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  Icon(
                    selected == options[index]
                        ? Icons.radio_button_checked_rounded
                        : Icons.radio_button_off_rounded,
                    color: selected == options[index]
                        ? AppColors.primary
                        : AppColors.glassBorderDark,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            if (index != options.length - 1)
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
          ],
        ],
      );

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/error_diagnostic_repository.dart';
import '../domain/error_pattern_analyzer.dart';
import '../domain/error_pattern_models.dart';

final class ErrorPatternAgentNotifier extends ChangeNotifier
    implements ErrorDiagnosticSink {
  ErrorPatternAgentNotifier(
    this._repository, {
    ErrorPatternAnalyzer analyzer = const ErrorPatternAnalyzer(),
    DateTime Function()? now,
  })  : _analyzer = analyzer,
        _now = now ?? DateTime.now;

  final ErrorDiagnosticRepository _repository;
  final ErrorPatternAnalyzer _analyzer;
  final DateTime Function() _now;

  List<ErrorLogEntry> _entries = const <ErrorLogEntry>[];
  BlindSpotReport _report = BlindSpotReport(
    generatedAt: DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(0, isUtc: true),
    totalErrors: 0,
    topBlindSpots: const <BlindSpotDiagnostic>[],
  );
  bool _initialized = false;
  bool _busy = false;
  String? _lastError;

  List<ErrorLogEntry> get entries => List.unmodifiable(_entries);
  BlindSpotReport get report => _report;
  bool get initialized => _initialized;
  bool get busy => _busy;
  String? get lastError => _lastError;

  Future<void> initialize() async {
    if (_initialized || _busy) return;
    _busy = true;
    _lastError = null;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      _entries = await _repository.loadEntries();
      _report = _analyzer.buildReport(_entries, now: _now());
      _initialized = true;
    } on Object {
      _lastError = 'تعذر تحميل سجل التشخيص المحلي.';
    } finally {
      _busy = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> recordFailure(LearningFailureSignal signal) async {
    final entry = _analyzer.entryFromSignal(signal);
    if (entry == null) return;
    try {
      await _repository.appendEntry(entry);
      final next = <ErrorLogEntry>[..._entries, entry];
      _entries = List.unmodifiable(
        next.length <= LocalDiagnosticPolicy.maxInMemoryEntries
            ? next
            : next.sublist(
                next.length - LocalDiagnosticPolicy.maxInMemoryEntries,
              ),
      );
      _report = _analyzer.buildReport(_entries, now: _now());
      _initialized = true;
      _lastError = null;
      notifyListeners();
    } on Object {
      _lastError = 'تعذر حفظ حدث التشخيص محلياً.';
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  Future<void> clear() async {
    _busy = true;
    _lastError = null;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      await _repository.clearEntries();
      _entries = const <ErrorLogEntry>[];
      _report = _analyzer.buildReport(_entries, now: _now());
    } on Object {
      _lastError = 'تعذر مسح سجل التشخيص المحلي.';
    } finally {
      _busy = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }
}

abstract final class LocalDiagnosticPolicy {
  static const int maxInMemoryEntries = 500;
}

FILE: lib/features/error_pattern_agent/data/local_error_diagnostic_repository.dart

import 'dart:convert';

import '../../../services/preferences_service.dart';
import '../domain/error_diagnostic_repository.dart';
import '../domain/error_pattern_models.dart';

final class LocalErrorDiagnosticRepository
    implements ErrorDiagnosticRepository {
  LocalErrorDiagnosticRepository(this._preferences);

  static final String storageKey = 'error_pattern_diagnostic_entries_v1';
  static final int maxEntries = 500;

  final PreferencesService _preferences;
  Future<void> _writeQueue = Future<void>.value();

  @override
  Future<List<ErrorLogEntry>> loadEntries() async {
    final raw = _preferences.getString(storageKey);
    if (raw == null || raw.trim().isEmpty) {
      return const <ErrorLogEntry>[];
    }
    try {
      final decoded = jsonDecode(raw);
      if (decoded is! List) return const <ErrorLogEntry>[];
      final entries = <ErrorLogEntry>[];
      for (final value in decoded) {
        if (value is! Map) continue;
        final parsed = ErrorLogEntry.fromJson(<String, Object?>{
          for (final item in value.entries)
            if (item.key is String) item.key as String: item.value,
        });
        if (parsed != null) entries.add(parsed);
      }
      entries.sort((a, b) => a.timestamp.compareTo(b.timestamp));
      return List<ErrorLogEntry>.unmodifiable(
        entries.length <= maxEntries
            ? entries
            : entries.sublist(entries.length - maxEntries),
      );
    } on Object {
      return const <ErrorLogEntry>[];
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> appendEntry(ErrorLogEntry entry) => _enqueue(() async {
        final entries = <ErrorLogEntry>[...await loadEntries(), entry];
        final bounded = entries.length <= maxEntries
            ? entries
            : entries.sublist(entries.length - maxEntries);
        final payload = jsonEncode(
          bounded.map((item) => item.toJson()).toList(growable: false),
        );
        final saved = await _preferences.setString(storageKey, payload);
        if (!saved) {
          throw StateError('error diagnostic persistence failed');
        }
      });

  @override
  Future<void> clearEntries() => _enqueue(() async {
        final removed = await _preferences.remove(storageKey);
        if (!removed && _preferences.getString(storageKey) != null) {
          throw StateError('error diagnostic clear failed');
        }
      });

  Future<void> _enqueue(Future<void> Function() action) {
    final next = _writeQueue.then((_) => action());
    _writeQueue = next.catchError((_) {});
    return next;
  }
}

import 'error_pattern_models.dart';

final class ErrorPatternAnalyzer {
  const ErrorPatternAnalyzer();

  static const Set<String> _genderArticles = <String>{'der', 'die', 'das'};
  static const Set<String> _caseArticles = <String>{
    'der', 'die', 'das', 'den', 'dem', 'des',
    'ein', 'eine', 'einen', 'einem', 'einer', 'eines',
    'kein', 'keine', 'keinen', 'keinem', 'keiner', 'keines',
  };

  ErrorPatternType? classify(LearningFailureSignal signal) {
    if (signal.explicitType != null) return signal.explicitType;
    final tag = _normalize(signal.skillTag);
    final expected = _normalize(signal.expected);
    final actual = _normalize(signal.actual);

    if (_containsAny(tag, const <String>{
      'word_order', 'wordorder', 'sentence_reorder', 'reorder', 'v2',
    })) {
      return ErrorPatternType.wordOrderDrift;
    }
    if (_containsAny(tag, const <String>{
      'case', 'akkusativ', 'accusative', 'dativ', 'dative',
      'genitiv', 'genitive', 'nominativ', 'nominative',
    })) {
      return ErrorPatternType.caseMismatch;
    }
    if (_containsAny(tag, const <String>{
      'gender', 'article_gender', 'noun_gender',
    })) {
      return ErrorPatternType.genderConfusion;
    }

    if (_genderArticles.contains(expected) &&
        _genderArticles.contains(actual) &&
        expected != actual) {
      return ErrorPatternType.genderConfusion;
    }
    if (_caseArticles.contains(expected) &&
        _caseArticles.contains(actual) &&
        expected != actual) {
      return ErrorPatternType.caseMismatch;
    }
    if (signal.source == ErrorEventSource.grammar &&
        _sameWordsDifferentOrder(expected, actual)) {
      return ErrorPatternType.wordOrderDrift;
    }
    return null;
  }

  ErrorLogEntry? entryFromSignal(LearningFailureSignal signal) {
    final type = classify(signal);
    if (type == null) return null;
    return ErrorLogEntry(
      id: 'diag_${signal.occurredAt.toUtc().microsecondsSinceEpoch}_${type.name}',
      type: type,
      focus: _bounded(signal.focus, 160),
      expected: _bounded(signal.expected, 240),
      actual: _bounded(signal.actual, 240),
      source: signal.source,
      timestamp: signal.occurredAt.toUtc(),
    );
  }

  BlindSpotReport buildReport(
    Iterable<ErrorLogEntry> entries, {
    DateTime? now,
  }) {
    final safeNow = (now ?? DateTime.now()).toUtc();
    final all = entries.toList(growable: false);
    if (all.isEmpty) {
      return BlindSpotReport(
        generatedAt: safeNow,
        totalErrors: 0,
        topBlindSpots: const <BlindSpotDiagnostic>[],
      );
    }

    final byType = <ErrorPatternType, List<ErrorLogEntry>>{};
    for (final entry in all) {
      byType.putIfAbsent(entry.type, () => <ErrorLogEntry>[]).add(entry);
    }

    final diagnostics = <BlindSpotDiagnostic>[];
    for (final pair in byType.entries) {
      final group = pair.value
        ..sort((a, b) => b.timestamp.compareTo(a.timestamp));
      final count = group.length;
      final frequency = count / all.length;
      final focus = _topFocus(group);
      diagnostics.add(
        BlindSpotDiagnostic(
          type: pair.key,
          count: count,
          frequency: frequency,
          severity: _severity(count, frequency),
          focus: focus,
          recommendationAr: recommendationFor(pair.key),
          commonActual: group.first.actual,
          expectedExample: group.first.expected,
        ),
      );
    }

    diagnostics.sort((a, b) {
      final countOrder = b.count.compareTo(a.count);
      if (countOrder != 0) return countOrder;
      final frequencyOrder = b.frequency.compareTo(a.frequency);
      if (frequencyOrder != 0) return frequencyOrder;
      return a.type.index.compareTo(b.type.index);
    });

    return BlindSpotReport(
      generatedAt: safeNow,
      totalErrors: all.length,
      topBlindSpots: List<BlindSpotDiagnostic>.unmodifiable(
        diagnostics.take(3),
      ),
    );
  }

  String recommendationFor(ErrorPatternType type) => switch (type) {
        ErrorPatternType.genderConfusion =>
          'راجع الاسم دائماً مع أداة تعريفه، ثم اختبر der/die/das في جمل قصيرة قبل الانتقال لكلمة جديدة.',
        ErrorPatternType.caseMismatch =>
          'حدّد وظيفة الاسم أولاً، ثم طبّق أداة الحالة: Nominativ أو Akkusativ أو Dativ قبل اختيار النهاية.',
        ErrorPatternType.wordOrderDrift =>
          'ابنِ الجملة على قاعدة الفعل في الموقع الثاني، وحدد موضع الفعل المنفصل أو المصدر قبل إضافة التفاصيل.',
      };

  DiagnosticSeverity _severity(int count, double frequency) {
    if (count >= 5 && frequency >= 0.35) return DiagnosticSeverity.high;
    if (count >= 3 || frequency >= 0.25) return DiagnosticSeverity.moderate;
    return DiagnosticSeverity.low;
  }

  String _topFocus(List<ErrorLogEntry> entries) {
    final counts = <String, int>{};
    for (final entry in entries) {
      final focus = entry.focus.trim();
      if (focus.isEmpty) continue;
      counts.update(focus, (value) => value + 1, ifAbsent: () => 1);
    }
    if (counts.isEmpty) return 'قاعدة عامة';
    final ranked = counts.entries.toList()
      ..sort((a, b) {
        final countOrder = b.value.compareTo(a.value);
        return countOrder != 0 ? countOrder : a.key.compareTo(b.key);
      });
    return ranked.first.key;
  }

  bool _sameWordsDifferentOrder(String expected, String actual) {
    final expectedParts =
        expected.split(' ').where((x) => x.isNotEmpty).toList();
    final actualParts =
        actual.split(' ').where((x) => x.isNotEmpty).toList();
    if (expectedParts.length < 2 || expectedParts.length != actualParts.length) {
      return false;
    }
    if (expectedParts.join(' ') == actualParts.join(' ')) return false;
    expectedParts.sort();
    actualParts.sort();
    return expectedParts.join('\u0000') == actualParts.join('\u0000');
  }

  bool _containsAny(String value, Set<String> needles) =>
      needles.any(value.contains);

  String _normalize(String value) =>
      value.trim().toLowerCase().replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');

  String _bounded(String value, int max) {
    final normalized = value.trim();
    return normalized.length <= max
        ? normalized
        : normalized.substring(0, max);
  }
}

enum ErrorPatternType {
  genderConfusion,
  caseMismatch,
  wordOrderDrift;

  String get wireName => switch (this) {
        ErrorPatternType.genderConfusion => 'gender_confusion',
        ErrorPatternType.caseMismatch => 'case_mismatch',
        ErrorPatternType.wordOrderDrift => 'word_order_drift',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        ErrorPatternType.genderConfusion => 'التباس جنس الاسم وأداة التعريف',
        ErrorPatternType.caseMismatch => 'عدم تطابق الحالة الإعرابية',
        ErrorPatternType.wordOrderDrift => 'انحراف ترتيب الكلمات',
      };

  static ErrorPatternType? fromWireName(String? value) => switch (value) {
        'gender_confusion' => ErrorPatternType.genderConfusion,
        'case_mismatch' => ErrorPatternType.caseMismatch,
        'word_order_drift' => ErrorPatternType.wordOrderDrift,
        _ => null,
      };
}

enum DiagnosticSeverity {
  low('للمراقبة'),
  moderate('متكرر'),
  high('متكرر بوضوح');

  const DiagnosticSeverity(this.labelAr);
  final String labelAr;
}

enum ErrorEventSource { flashcard, grammar }

final class LearningFailureSignal {
  const LearningFailureSignal({
    required this.source,
    required this.skillTag,
    required this.expected,
    required this.actual,
    required this.focus,
    required this.occurredAt,
    this.explicitType,
  });

  final ErrorEventSource source;
  final String skillTag;
  final String expected;
  final String actual;
  final String focus;
  final DateTime occurredAt;
  final ErrorPatternType? explicitType;
}

final class ErrorLogEntry {
  const ErrorLogEntry({
    required this.id,
    required this.type,
    required this.focus,
    required this.expected,
    required this.actual,
    required this.source,
    required this.timestamp,
  });

  final String id;
  final ErrorPatternType type;
  final String focus;
  final String expected;
  final String actual;
  final ErrorEventSource source;
  final DateTime timestamp;

  Map<String, Object?> toJson() => <String, Object?>{
        'id': id,
        'type': type.wireName,
        'focus': focus,
        'expected': expected,
        'actual': actual,
        'source': source.name,
        'timestamp': timestamp.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
      };

  static ErrorLogEntry? fromJson(Map<String, Object?> json) {
    final type = ErrorPatternType.fromWireName(json['type']?.toString());
    final timestamp = DateTime.tryParse(json['timestamp']?.toString() ?? '');
    if (type == null || timestamp == null) return null;
    final source = switch (json['source']?.toString()) {
      'grammar' => ErrorEventSource.grammar,
      'flashcard' => ErrorEventSource.flashcard,
      _ => null,
    };
    if (source == null) return null;
    final id = _bounded(json['id']?.toString() ?? '', 160);
    if (id.isEmpty) return null;
    return ErrorLogEntry(
      id: id,
      type: type,
      focus: _bounded(json['focus']?.toString() ?? '', 160),
      expected: _bounded(json['expected']?.toString() ?? '', 240),
      actual: _bounded(json['actual']?.toString() ?? '', 240),
      source: source,
      timestamp: timestamp.toUtc(),
    );
  }

  static String _bounded(String value, int max) {
    final normalized = value.trim();
    if (normalized.length <= max) return normalized;
    return normalized.substring(0, max);
  }
}

final class BlindSpotDiagnostic {
  const BlindSpotDiagnostic({
    required this.type,
    required this.count,
    required this.frequency,
    required this.severity,
    required this.focus,
    required this.recommendationAr,
    required this.commonActual,
    required this.expectedExample,
  });

  final ErrorPatternType type;
  final int count;
  final double frequency;
  final DiagnosticSeverity severity;
  final String focus;
  final String recommendationAr;
  final String commonActual;
  final String expectedExample;
}

final class BlindSpotReport {
  const BlindSpotReport({
    required this.generatedAt,
    required this.totalErrors,
    required this.topBlindSpots,
  });

  final DateTime generatedAt;
  final int totalErrors;
  final List<BlindSpotDiagnostic> topBlindSpots;

  bool get isEmpty => topBlindSpots.isEmpty;
}

import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class BlindSpotRadarScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const BlindSpotRadarScreen({required this.notifier, super.key});

  final ErrorPatternAgentNotifier notifier;

  @override
  State<BlindSpotRadarScreen> createState() => _BlindSpotRadarScreenState();
}

class _BlindSpotRadarScreenState extends State<BlindSpotRadarScreen> {
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    widget.notifier.initialize();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Directionality(
        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
        child: Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('رادار النقاط العمياء')),
          body: AnimatedBuilder(
            animation: widget.notifier,
            builder: (context, _) {
              final notifier = widget.notifier;
              final report = notifier.report;
              return ListView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 32),
                children: [
                  AppGlassCard(
                    glowColor: AppColors.primary,
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          'تشخيص لغوي تراكمي',
                          style: AppTypography.title,
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 6),
                        Text(
                          'يعرض أنماط الإجابات المتكررة فقط، ولا يقيّم الشخصية أو القدرة العامة للمتعلم.',
                          style: AppTypography.body,
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 12),
                        if (notifier.busy && !notifier.initialized)
                          const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
                        else
                          SizedBox(
                            height: 250,
                            child: CustomPaint(
                              painter: _BlindSpotRadarPainter(report),
                              child: const SizedBox.expand(),
                            ),
                          ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 8),
                        Text(
                          'سجل مصنّف: ${report.totalErrors} خطأ لغوي',
                          style: AppTypography.label,
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  if (notifier.lastError != null) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    AppGlassCard(
                      glowColor: AppColors.tertiary,
                      child: Text(
                        notifier.lastError!,
                        style: AppTypography.body,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  if (report.isEmpty)
                    AppGlassCard(
                      child: Text(
                        'لا توجد أنماط متكررة كافية بعد. سيظهر التقرير بعد تسجيل أخطاء قابلة للتصنيف من البطاقات أو تمارين القواعد.',
                        style: AppTypography.body,
                      ),
                    )
                  else
                    for (final diagnostic in report.topBlindSpots) ...[
                      GlassDiagnosticCard(diagnostic: diagnostic),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    ],
                ],
              );
            },
          ),
        ),
      );
}

class _BlindSpotRadarPainter extends CustomPainter {
  const _BlindSpotRadarPainter(this.report);

  final BlindSpotReport report;

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final center = Offset(size.width / 2, size.height / 2);
    final radius = math.min(size.width, size.height) * .34;
    final gridPaint = Paint()
      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
      ..strokeWidth = 1
      ..color = AppColors.primary.withAlpha(55);
    final fillPaint = Paint()
      ..style = PaintingStyle.fill
      ..color = AppColors.achievement.withAlpha(45);
    final linePaint = Paint()
      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
      ..strokeWidth = 2.2
      ..color = AppColors.achievement;

    for (final scale in <double>[.33, .66, 1]) {
      canvas.drawPath(_triangle(center, radius * scale), gridPaint);
    }
    final values = <ErrorPatternType, double>{
      for (final type in ErrorPatternType.values) type: 0,
      for (final item in report.topBlindSpots)
        item.type: item.frequency.clamp(0, 1).toDouble(),
    };
    final points = <Offset>[];
    for (var index = 0; index < ErrorPatternType.values.length; index++) {
      final angle = -math.pi / 2 + (index * 2 * math.pi / 3);
      final value = values[ErrorPatternType.values[index]] ?? 0;
      points.add(
        center +
            Offset(math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle)) * radius * value,
      );
      final axisEnd =
          center + Offset(math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle)) * radius;
      canvas.drawLine(center, axisEnd, gridPaint);
    }
    if (points.length == 3) {
      final path = Path()..moveTo(points.first.dx, points.first.dy);
      for (final point in points.skip(1)) {
        path.lineTo(point.dx, point.dy);
      }
      path.close();
      canvas.drawPath(path, fillPaint);
      canvas.drawPath(path, linePaint);
    }
  }

  Path _triangle(Offset center, double radius) {
    final path = Path();
    for (var index = 0; index < 3; index++) {
      final angle = -math.pi / 2 + (index * 2 * math.pi / 3);
      final point =
          center + Offset(math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle)) * radius;
      if (index == 0) {
        path.moveTo(point.dx, point.dy);
      } else {
        path.lineTo(point.dx, point.dy);
      }
    }
    return path..close();
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _BlindSpotRadarPainter oldDelegate) =>
      oldDelegate.report != report;
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../../design_system/app_colors.dart';
import '../../../../design_system/app_glass_card.dart';
import '../../../../design_system/app_typography.dart';
import '../../domain/error_pattern_models.dart';

class GlassDiagnosticCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const GlassDiagnosticCard({required this.diagnostic, super.key});

  final BlindSpotDiagnostic diagnostic;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final accent = switch (diagnostic.severity) {
      DiagnosticSeverity.high => AppColors.tertiary,
      DiagnosticSeverity.moderate => AppColors.achievement,
      DiagnosticSeverity.low => AppColors.secondary,
    };
    return AppGlassCard(
      glowColor: accent,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [

FILE: lib/features/exam_simulator/application/exam_session_notifier.dart

import 'dart:async';

import '../domain/exam_models.dart';
import '../domain/exam_repository.dart';
import '../domain/exam_scoring_engine.dart';

final class ExamSessionState {
  const ExamSessionState({
    required this.exam,
    required this.session,
    required this.remainingSeconds,
    this.report,
  });

  final ExamDefinition exam;
  final ExamSession session;
  final int remainingSeconds;
  final ExamScoreReport? report;

  ExamQuestion get currentQuestion =>
      exam.questions[session.currentQuestionIndex];

  int get answeredCount => session.answers.length;

  double get progress =>
      ((session.currentQuestionIndex + 1) / exam.questions.length)
          .clamp(0.0, 1.0)
          .toDouble();

  bool get isFinished => session.isFinished;
}

final class ExamSessionNotifier {
  ExamSessionNotifier(this._repository);

  final ExamRepository _repository;
  final StreamController<ExamSessionState> _changes =
      StreamController<ExamSessionState>.broadcast();

  ExamSessionState? _state;
  Timer? _timer;
  bool _disposed = false;

  ExamSessionState get state {
    final value = _state;
    if (value == null) {
      throw StateError('Exam session has not started');
    }
    return value;
  }

  Stream<ExamSessionState> get changes => _changes.stream;

  Future<ExamSessionState> start({
    required CefrExamLevel level,
    required DateTime startedAtUtc,
  }) async {
    _ensureActive();
    if (!startedAtUtc.isUtc) {
      throw ArgumentError('startedAtUtc must be UTC');
    }

    final exam = await _repository.loadExam(level);
    final session = ExamSession(
      examId: exam.id,
      startedAtUtc: startedAtUtc,
      durationSeconds: exam.duration.inSeconds,
      currentQuestionIndex: 0,
      answers: const <String, int>{},
    );
    _emit(
      ExamSessionState(
        exam: exam,
        session: session,
        remainingSeconds: exam.duration.inSeconds,
      ),
    );
    _startTimer();
    return state;
  }

  bool answerCurrent(int optionIndex) {
    final current = state;
    if (current.isFinished) return false;

    final question = current.currentQuestion;
    if (optionIndex < 0 || optionIndex >= question.options.length) {
      return false;
    }

    final answers = Map<String, int>.from(current.session.answers);
    answers[question.id] = optionIndex;
    _emit(
      ExamSessionState(
        exam: current.exam,
        session: current.session.copyWith(answers: answers),
        remainingSeconds: current.remainingSeconds,
        report: current.report,
      ),
    );
    return true;
  }

  bool goNext() {
    final current = state;
    if (current.isFinished) return false;
    final next = current.session.currentQuestionIndex + 1;
    if (next >= current.exam.questions.length) return false;
    _moveTo(next);
    return true;
  }

  bool goPrevious() {
    final current = state;
    if (current.isFinished) return false;
    final previous = current.session.currentQuestionIndex - 1;
    if (previous < 0) return false;
    _moveTo(previous);
    return true;
  }

  bool goToQuestion(int index) {
    final current = state;
    if (current.isFinished) return false;
    if (index < 0 || index >= current.exam.questions.length) return false;
    _moveTo(index);
    return true;
  }

  void synchronize(DateTime nowUtc) {
    final current = state;
    if (current.isFinished) return;
    if (!nowUtc.isUtc) {
      throw ArgumentError('nowUtc must be UTC');
    }

    final remaining = current.session.remainingSeconds(nowUtc);
    if (remaining <= 0) {
      _finish(nowUtc, timedOut: true);
      return;
    }
    if (remaining != current.remainingSeconds) {
      _emit(
        ExamSessionState(
          exam: current.exam,
          session: current.session,
          remainingSeconds: remaining,
          report: current.report,
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  ExamScoreReport submit({required DateTime submittedAtUtc}) {
    final current = state;
    final existing = current.report;
    if (existing != null) return existing;
    if (!submittedAtUtc.isUtc) {
      throw ArgumentError('submittedAtUtc must be UTC');
    }
    return _finish(submittedAtUtc, timedOut: false);
  }

  ExamScoreReport _finish(
    DateTime submittedAtUtc, {
    required bool timedOut,
  }) {
    final current = state;
    final report = ExamScoringEngine.score(
      exam: current.exam,
      answers: current.session.answers,
    );
    _timer?.cancel();
    _timer = null;
    _emit(
      ExamSessionState(
        exam: current.exam,
        session: current.session.copyWith(
          submittedAtUtc: submittedAtUtc.toUtc(),
          timedOut: timedOut,
        ),
        remainingSeconds: 0,
        report: report,
      ),
    );
    return report;
  }

  void _moveTo(int index) {
    final current = state;
    _emit(
      ExamSessionState(
        exam: current.exam,
        session: current.session.copyWith(currentQuestionIndex: index),
        remainingSeconds: current.remainingSeconds,
        report: current.report,
      ),
    );
  }

  void _startTimer() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    _timer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (_) {
      if (_disposed || _state == null || state.isFinished) return;
      synchronize(DateTime.now().toUtc());
    });
  }

  void _emit(ExamSessionState next) {
    _state = next;
    if (!_changes.isClosed) _changes.add(next);
  }

  Future<void> dispose() async {
    if (_disposed) return;
    _disposed = true;
    _timer?.cancel();
    _timer = null;
    await _changes.close();
  }

  void _ensureActive() {
    if (_disposed) {
      throw StateError('ExamSessionNotifier is disposed');
    }
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/exam_simulator/domain/exam_models.dart

enum CefrExamLevel {
  a1('A1'),
  a2('A2');

  const CefrExamLevel(this.label);
  final String label;
}

enum ExamSection {
  lesen('Lesen'),
  hoeren('Hören'),
  schreiben('Schreiben');

  const ExamSection(this.label);
  final String label;
}

final class ExamQuestion {
  const ExamQuestion({
    required this.id,
    required this.section,
    required this.prompt,
    required this.options,
    required this.correctOptionIndex,
    required this.points,
    this.stimulus,
  })  : assert(options.length >= 2),
        assert(correctOptionIndex >= 0),
        assert(correctOptionIndex < options.length),
        assert(points > 0);

  final String id;
  final ExamSection section;
  final String prompt;
  final String? stimulus;
  final List<String> options;
  final int correctOptionIndex;
  final int points;
}

final class ExamDefinition {
  const ExamDefinition({
    required this.id,
    required this.level,
    required this.title,
    required this.duration,
    required this.questions,
  }) : assert(questions.length > 0);

  final String id;
  final CefrExamLevel level;
  final String title;
  final Duration duration;
  final List<ExamQuestion> questions;

  int get totalPoints =>
      questions.fold<int>(0, (sum, question) => sum + question.points);
}

final class ExamSession {
  const ExamSession({
    required this.examId,
    required this.startedAtUtc,
    required this.durationSeconds,
    required this.currentQuestionIndex,
    required this.answers,
    this.submittedAtUtc,
    this.timedOut = false,
  })  : assert(durationSeconds > 0),
        assert(currentQuestionIndex >= 0);

  final String examId;
  final DateTime startedAtUtc;
  final int durationSeconds;
  final int currentQuestionIndex;
  final Map<String, int> answers;
  final DateTime? submittedAtUtc;
  final bool timedOut;

  bool get isFinished => submittedAtUtc != null;

  DateTime get deadlineUtc =>
      startedAtUtc.add(Duration(seconds: durationSeconds));

  int remainingSeconds(DateTime nowUtc) {
    if (isFinished) return 0;
    final value = deadlineUtc.difference(nowUtc.toUtc()).inSeconds;
    return value.clamp(0, durationSeconds).toInt();
  }

  ExamSession copyWith({
    int? currentQuestionIndex,
    Map<String, int>? answers,
    DateTime? submittedAtUtc,
    bool? timedOut,
  }) {
    return ExamSession(
      examId: examId,
      startedAtUtc: startedAtUtc,
      durationSeconds: durationSeconds,
      currentQuestionIndex:
          currentQuestionIndex ?? this.currentQuestionIndex,
      answers: Map<String, int>.unmodifiable(answers ?? this.answers),
      submittedAtUtc: submittedAtUtc ?? this.submittedAtUtc,
      timedOut: timedOut ?? this.timedOut,
    );
  }
}

final class ExamSectionScore {
  const ExamSectionScore({
    required this.section,
    required this.earnedPoints,
    required this.possiblePoints,
    required this.percentage,
  });

  final ExamSection section;
  final int earnedPoints;
  final int possiblePoints;
  final int percentage;
}

final class ExamScoreReport {
  const ExamScoreReport({
    required this.level,
    required this.totalScore,
    required this.passThreshold,
    required this.passed,
    required this.sections,
  });

  final CefrExamLevel level;
  final int totalScore;
  final int passThreshold;
  final bool passed;
  final Map<ExamSection, ExamSectionScore> sections;
}

import 'exam_models.dart';

abstract final class ExamScoringEngine {
  static const int passThreshold = 60;

  static ExamScoreReport score({
    required ExamDefinition exam,
    required Map<String, int> answers,
  }) {
    final sectionEarned = <ExamSection, int>{
      for (final section in ExamSection.values) section: 0,
    };
    final sectionPossible = <ExamSection, int>{
      for (final section in ExamSection.values) section: 0,
    };

    var earned = 0;
    for (final question in exam.questions) {
      sectionPossible[question.section] =
          sectionPossible[question.section]! + question.points;
      final selected = answers[question.id];
      final valid = selected != null &&
          selected >= 0 &&
          selected < question.options.length;
      if (valid && selected == question.correctOptionIndex) {
        earned += question.points;
        sectionEarned[question.section] =
            sectionEarned[question.section]! + question.points;
      }
    }

    final totalPossible = exam.totalPoints;
    final normalizedScore = totalPossible <= 0
        ? 0
        : ((earned / totalPossible) * 100).round().clamp(0, 100).toInt();

    final sections = <ExamSection, ExamSectionScore>{};
    for (final section in ExamSection.values) {
      final possible = sectionPossible[section]!;
      final sectionValue = sectionEarned[section]!;
      final percentage = possible <= 0
          ? 0
          : ((sectionValue / possible) * 100)
              .round()
              .clamp(0, 100)
              .toInt();
      sections[section] = ExamSectionScore(
        section: section,
        earnedPoints: sectionValue,
        possiblePoints: possible,
        percentage: percentage,
      );
    }

    return ExamScoreReport(
      level: exam.level,
      totalScore: normalizedScore,
      passThreshold: passThreshold,
      passed: normalizedScore >= passThreshold,
      sections: Map<ExamSection, ExamSectionScore>.unmodifiable(sections),
    );
  }
}

                dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,

  @override

      body: SafeArea(

              state: state,
              notifier: notifier,
              onReportReady: onReportReady,
            );
          },
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
