import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/email_builder_models.dart';
import '../domain/email_builder_repository.dart';

final class EmailBuilderNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  EmailBuilderNotifier(this._repository);

  final EmailBuilderRepository _repository;

  List<EmailScenario> _scenarios = const <EmailScenario>[];
  List<EmailTemplateBlock> _availableBlocks =
      const <EmailTemplateBlock>[];
  EmailScenario? _activeScenario;
  Map<LetterSection, EmailTemplateBlock> _selectedBlocks =
      <LetterSection, EmailTemplateBlock>{};
  Set<LetterSection> _registerMismatchSections = <LetterSection>{};
  Set<LetterSection> _invalidPhraseSections = <LetterSection>{};
  bool? _isStructureValid;
  bool _isLoading = false;
  int _generation = 0;

  List<EmailScenario> get scenarios =>
      List<EmailScenario>.unmodifiable(_scenarios);
  List<EmailTemplateBlock> get availableBlocks =>
      List<EmailTemplateBlock>.unmodifiable(_availableBlocks);
  EmailScenario? get activeScenario => _activeScenario;
  Map<LetterSection, EmailTemplateBlock> get selectedBlocks =>
      Map<LetterSection, EmailTemplateBlock>.unmodifiable(_selectedBlocks);
  Set<LetterSection> get registerMismatchSections =>
      Set<LetterSection>.unmodifiable(_registerMismatchSections);
  Set<LetterSection> get invalidPhraseSections =>
      Set<LetterSection>.unmodifiable(_invalidPhraseSections);
  bool? get isStructureValid => _isStructureValid;
  bool get isLoading => _isLoading;

  String get previewText {
    final paragraphs = <String>[];
    for (final section in LetterSection.values) {
      final block = _selectedBlocks[section];
      if (block != null) paragraphs.add(block.text);
    }
    return paragraphs.join('\n\n');
  }

  bool get isComplete =>
      _selectedBlocks.length == LetterSection.values.length;

  List<EmailTemplateBlock> blocksForSection(LetterSection section) =>
      List<EmailTemplateBlock>.unmodifiable(
        _availableBlocks.where((item) => item.section == section),
      );

  Future<void> load() async {
    final generation = ++_generation;
    _isLoading = true;
    notifyListeners();

    try {
      final loaded = await _repository.getScenarios();
      if (generation != _generation) return;
      _scenarios = List<EmailScenario>.unmodifiable(loaded);
      if (_activeScenario == null && _scenarios.isNotEmpty) {
        await _activateScenario(_scenarios.first, generation);
      }
    } finally {
      if (generation == _generation) {
        _isLoading = false;
        notifyListeners();
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> selectScenario(String scenarioId) async {
    final scenario = _findScenario(scenarioId);
    if (scenario == null) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        scenarioId,
        'scenarioId',
        'unknown correspondence scenario',
      );
    }

    final generation = ++_generation;
    _isLoading = true;
    _activeScenario = scenario;
    _availableBlocks = const <EmailTemplateBlock>[];
    _selectedBlocks = <LetterSection, EmailTemplateBlock>{};
    _registerMismatchSections = <LetterSection>{};
    _invalidPhraseSections = <LetterSection>{};
    _isStructureValid = null;
    notifyListeners();

    try {
      await _activateScenario(scenario, generation);
    } finally {
      if (generation == _generation) {
        _isLoading = false;
        notifyListeners();
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> selectSectionBlock(String blockId) async {
    final scenario = _activeScenario;
    final block = _findBlock(blockId);
    if (scenario == null || block == null) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        blockId,
        'blockId',
        'block is not available for the active scenario',
      );
    }

    _selectedBlocks = Map<LetterSection, EmailTemplateBlock>.from(
      _selectedBlocks,
    )..[block.section] = block;
    _isStructureValid = null;
    notifyListeners();

    final registerOk = await _repository.isRegisterAppropriate(
      scenarioId: scenario.id,
      block: block,
    );
    final phraseOk = await _repository.validatePhrase(
      scenarioId: scenario.id,
      blockId: block.id,
    );
    if (_activeScenario?.id != scenario.id ||
        _selectedBlocks[block.section]?.id != block.id) {
      return;
    }

    final registerMismatch =
        Set<LetterSection>.from(_registerMismatchSections);
    final phraseIssues = Set<LetterSection>.from(_invalidPhraseSections);

    if (registerOk) {
      registerMismatch.remove(block.section);
    } else {
      registerMismatch.add(block.section);
    }

    if (phraseOk) {
      phraseIssues.remove(block.section);
    } else {
      phraseIssues.add(block.section);
    }

    _registerMismatchSections = registerMismatch;
    _invalidPhraseSections = phraseIssues;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> validateLetterStructure() async {
    final scenario = _activeScenario;
    if (scenario == null) {
      _isStructureValid = false;
      notifyListeners();
      return;
    }

    final ordered = _orderedSelectedBlocks();

    final fingerprint = _selectionFingerprint();
    final structurallyValid =
        await _repository.validateStructure(ordered);
    if (_activeScenario?.id != scenario.id ||
        fingerprint != _selectionFingerprint()) {
      return;
    }

    _isStructureValid = structurallyValid &&
        ordered.length == LetterSection.values.length &&
        _registerMismatchSections.isEmpty &&
        _invalidPhraseSections.isEmpty;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void resetTemplate() {
    _generation++;
    _selectedBlocks = <LetterSection, EmailTemplateBlock>{};
    _registerMismatchSections = <LetterSection>{};
    _invalidPhraseSections = <LetterSection>{};
    _isStructureValid = null;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  List<EmailTemplateBlock> _orderedSelectedBlocks() {
    final ordered = <EmailTemplateBlock>[];
    for (final section in LetterSection.values) {
      final block = _selectedBlocks[section];
      if (block != null) ordered.add(block);
    }
    return ordered;
  }

  String _selectionFingerprint() {
    return LetterSection.values
        .map((section) => _selectedBlocks[section]?.id ?? '-')
        .join('|');
  }

  Future<void> _activateScenario(
    EmailScenario scenario,
    int generation,
  ) async {
    final blocks = await _repository.getBlocks(scenarioId: scenario.id);
    if (generation != _generation) return;
    _activeScenario = scenario;
    _availableBlocks = List<EmailTemplateBlock>.unmodifiable(blocks);
    _selectedBlocks = <LetterSection, EmailTemplateBlock>{};
    _registerMismatchSections = <LetterSection>{};
    _invalidPhraseSections = <LetterSection>{};
    _isStructureValid = null;
  }

  EmailScenario? _findScenario(String id) {
    for (final scenario in _scenarios) {
      if (scenario.id == id) return scenario;
    }
    return null;
  }

  EmailTemplateBlock? _findBlock(String id) {
    for (final block in _availableBlocks) {
      if (block.id == id) return block;
    }
    return null;
  }
}

import '../domain/email_builder_models.dart';
import '../domain/email_builder_repository.dart';

final class LocalEmailBuilderRepository implements EmailBuilderRepository {
  LocalEmailBuilderRepository()
      : _scenarios = _buildScenarios(),
        _blocks = _buildBlocks();

  final List<EmailScenario> _scenarios;
  final List<EmailTemplateBlock> _blocks;

  @override
  Future<List<EmailScenario>> getScenarios() async =>
      List<EmailScenario>.unmodifiable(_scenarios);

  @override
  Future<List<EmailTemplateBlock>> getBlocks({
    required String scenarioId,
    LetterSection? section,
  }) async {
    final selected = _blocks.where((block) {
      if (block.scenarioId != scenarioId) return false;
      return section == null || block.section == section;
    }).toList(growable: false);
    return List<EmailTemplateBlock>.unmodifiable(selected);
  }

  @override
  Future<bool> validateStructure(List<EmailTemplateBlock> blocks) async {
    if (blocks.length != LetterSection.values.length) return false;
    if (blocks.map((item) => item.scenarioId).toSet().length != 1) {
      return false;
    }
    final seen = <LetterSection>{};
    for (var index = 0; index < LetterSection.values.length; index++) {
      final block = blocks[index];
      if (block.section != LetterSection.values[index]) return false;
      if (!seen.add(block.section)) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  @override
  Future<bool> isRegisterAppropriate({
    required String scenarioId,
    required EmailTemplateBlock block,
  }) async {
    final scenario = _scenarioById(scenarioId);
    return scenario != null &&
        block.scenarioId == scenarioId &&
        block.register == scenario.targetRegister;
  }

  @override
  Future<bool> validatePhrase({
    required String scenarioId,
    required String blockId,
  }) async {
    final block = _blockById(blockId);
    if (block == null || block.scenarioId != scenarioId) return false;
    if (!_isPhraseWellFormed(block)) return false;
    return isRegisterAppropriate(
      scenarioId: scenarioId,
      block: block,
    );
  }

  EmailScenario? _scenarioById(String id) {
    for (final scenario in _scenarios) {
      if (scenario.id == id) return scenario;
    }
    return null;
  }

  EmailTemplateBlock? _blockById(String id) {
    for (final block in _blocks) {
      if (block.id == id) return block;
    }
    return null;
  }

  static bool _isPhraseWellFormed(EmailTemplateBlock block) {
    if (block.text.trim().isEmpty) return false;
    if (block.section == LetterSection.salutation) {
      if (!block.text.endsWith(',')) return false;
      if (block.register == EmailRegister.formalOfficial) {
        return block.text.startsWith('Sehr geehrte');
      }
    }
    if (block.section == LetterSection.closingSignoff &&
        block.register == EmailRegister.formalOfficial) {
      return block.text == 'Mit freundlichen Grüßen';
    }
    return true;
  }

  static List<EmailScenario> _buildScenarios() {
    return const <EmailScenario>[
      EmailScenario(
        id: 'appointment_b1',
        titleDe: 'Termin vereinbaren',
        titleAr: 'طلب موعد',
        level: 'B1',
        promptDe:
            'Sie möchten einen Beratungstermin vereinbaren. Schreiben Sie eine formelle E-Mail und nennen Sie Anlass, Wunschzeit und eine höfliche Bitte um Bestätigung.',
        targetRegister: EmailRegister.formalOfficial,
      ),
      EmailScenario(
        id: 'complaint_b2',
        titleDe: 'Formelle Beschwerde',
        titleAr: 'شكوى رسمية',
        level: 'B2',
        promptDe:
            'Sie sind mit einer Dienstleistung unzufrieden. Beschreiben Sie sachlich das Problem, nennen Sie die Folgen und formulieren Sie eine angemessene Lösung.',
        targetRegister: EmailRegister.formalOfficial,
      ),
      EmailScenario(
        id: 'apology_work_b1',
        titleDe: 'Entschuldigung im Beruf',
        titleAr: 'اعتذار مهني',
        level: 'B1/B2',

enum EmailRegister {
  formalOfficial,
  semiFormalWork,
  informalFriendly,
}

enum LetterSection {
  salutation,
  openingHook,
  mainBodyReason,
  requestOrComplaint,
  closingSignoff,
}

final class EmailScenario {
  const EmailScenario({
    required this.id,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.level,
    required this.promptDe,
    required this.targetRegister,
  });

  final String id;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String level;
  final String promptDe;
  final EmailRegister targetRegister;
}

final class EmailTemplateBlock {
  const EmailTemplateBlock({
    required this.id,
    required this.scenarioId,
    required this.section,
    required this.text,
    required this.register,
    required this.toneAr,
    required this.translationAr,
    required this.punctuationNoteAr,
    required this.applications,
  });

  final String id;
  final String scenarioId;
  final LetterSection section;
  final String text;
  final EmailRegister register;
  final String toneAr;
  final String translationAr;
  final String punctuationNoteAr;
  final List<String> applications;

  String get registerLabelAr => switch (register) {
        EmailRegister.formalOfficial => 'رسمي',
        EmailRegister.semiFormalWork => 'مهني شبه رسمي',
        EmailRegister.informalFriendly => 'ودي غير رسمي',
      };

  String get sectionLabelAr => switch (section) {
        LetterSection.salutation => 'التحية',
        LetterSection.openingHook => 'البداية',
        LetterSection.mainBodyReason => 'سبب الرسالة',
        LetterSection.requestOrComplaint => 'الطلب أو الشكوى',
        LetterSection.closingSignoff => 'الخاتمة',
      };
}

import 'email_builder_models.dart';

abstract interface class EmailBuilderRepository {
  Future<List<EmailScenario>> getScenarios();

  Future<List<EmailTemplateBlock>> getBlocks({
    required String scenarioId,
    LetterSection? section,
  });

  Future<bool> validateStructure(List<EmailTemplateBlock> blocks);

  Future<bool> isRegisterAppropriate({
    required String scenarioId,
    required EmailTemplateBlock block,
  });

  Future<bool> validatePhrase({
    required String scenarioId,
    required String blockId,
  });
}

import 'dart:async';


import '../../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import '../application/email_builder_notifier.dart';
import '../domain/email_builder_models.dart';

final class EmailBuilderScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const EmailBuilderScreen({
    required this.notifier,
    super.key,
  });

  final EmailBuilderNotifier notifier;

  @override
  State<EmailBuilderScreen> createState() => _EmailBuilderScreenState();
}

final class _EmailBuilderScreenState extends State<EmailBuilderScreen> {
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    if (widget.notifier.scenarios.isEmpty && !widget.notifier.isLoading) {
      unawaited(widget.notifier.load());
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Directionality(
        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
        child: Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(
            title: const Text(
              'منشئ الإيميل الرسمي · E-Mail Builder',
              textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
            ),
          ),
          body: SafeArea(
            child: ListenableBuilder(
              listenable: widget.notifier,
              builder: (context, _) {
                final notifier = widget.notifier;
                if (notifier.isLoading && notifier.scenarios.isEmpty) {
                  return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
                }
                if (notifier.scenarios.isEmpty) {
                  return _EmptyState(
                    onRetry: () => unawaited(notifier.load()),
                  );
                }

                return SingleChildScrollView(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 36),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      _ScenarioSelector(notifier: notifier),
                      const SizedBox(height: 14),
                      _RegisterGuide(scenario: notifier.activeScenario),
                      const SizedBox(height: 14),
                      _EmailPaper(notifier: notifier),
                      const SizedBox(height: 14),
                      for (final section in LetterSection.values) ...<Widget>[
                        _SectionPicker(
                          section: section,
                          notifier: notifier,
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      ],
                      _ValidationPanel(notifier: notifier),
                    ],
                  ),
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
}

final class _ScenarioSelector extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ScenarioSelector({required this.notifier});

  final EmailBuilderNotifier notifier;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(90),
        glowColor: AppColors.primary,
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            const Text(
              'اختر سيناريو المراسلة',
              textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
              style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
              initialValue: notifier.activeScenario?.id,
              isExpanded: true,
              decoration: const InputDecoration(
                border: OutlineInputBorder(),
              ),
              items: <DropdownMenuItem<String>>[
                for (final scenario in notifier.scenarios)
                  DropdownMenuItem<String>(
                    value: scenario.id,
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      children: <Widget>[
                        Text(
                          scenario.titleAr + ' · ' + scenario.level,
                          textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        ),
                        Text(
                          scenario.titleDe,
                          textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          style: AppTypography.label,
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
              ],
              onChanged: notifier.isLoading
                  ? null
                  : (value) {
                      if (value != null) {
                        unawaited(notifier.selectScenario(value));
                      }
                    },
            ),
            if (notifier.activeScenario != null) ...<Widget>[
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Text(
                notifier.activeScenario!.promptDe,
                textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                style: AppTypography.body,
              ),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      );
}

final class _RegisterGuide extends StatelessWidget {
  const _RegisterGuide({required this.scenario});

  final EmailScenario? scenario;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final active = scenario;
    if (active == null) return const SizedBox.shrink();

    return AppGlassCard(

      glowColor: AppColors.secondary,
      child: Row(

          const Icon(
            Icons.tune_rounded,

          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: <Widget>[
                const Text(
                  'النبرة المطلوبة',
                  textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                  style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                Text(
                  _registerLabel(active.targetRegister),
                  textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                  style: AppTypography.body.copyWith(
                    color: AppColors.secondary,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  static String _registerLabel(EmailRegister register) => switch (register) {
        EmailRegister.formalOfficial => 'رسمي رسمي · Formal',
        EmailRegister.semiFormalWork => 'مهني شبه رسمي · Semi-formal',
        EmailRegister.informalFriendly => 'ودي غير رسمي · Informal',
      };
}

final class _EmailPaper extends StatelessWidget {
  const _EmailPaper({required this.notifier});

  final EmailBuilderNotifier notifier;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final background =
        isDark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface;
    final border = isDark
        ? AppColors.glassBorderDark
        : AppColors.glassBorderLight;

    return AppGlassCard(
      backgroundColor: background,
      opacity: 1,
      borderColor: border,
      glowColor: AppColors.achievement,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          Row(
            children: <Widget>[
              const Icon(
                Icons.mail_outline_rounded,
                color: AppColors.achievement,
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  'معاينة الرسالة',
                  textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                  style: AppTypography.title,
                ),
              ),
              Text(
                notifier.selectedBlocks.length.toString() +
                    ' / ' +
                    LetterSection.values.length.toString(),
                textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
                  color: AppColors.achievement,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          for (final section in LetterSection.values) ...<Widget>[
            _PaperSection(
              section: section,
              block: notifier.selectedBlocks[section],
            ),
            if (section != LetterSection.values.last)
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _PaperSection extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PaperSection({
    required this.section,
    required this.block,
  });

  final LetterSection section;
  final EmailTemplateBlock? block;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final selected = block;
    return DecoratedBox(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        border: Border(
          left: BorderSide(
            color: selected == null
                ? AppColors.glassBorderLight
                : AppColors.primary,
            width: 3,
          ),
        ),
      ),
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(start: 12),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            Text(
              _sectionLabel(section),
              textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
              style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
                color: AppColors.primary,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 5),
            if (selected == null)
              Text(
                '— اختر عبارة لهذا القسم —',
                textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                style: AppTypography.body,
              )
            else
              Text(
                selected.text,
                textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                    ),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _SectionPicker extends StatelessWidget {
  const _SectionPicker({
    required this.section,
    required this.notifier,
  });

  final LetterSection section;
  final EmailBuilderNotifier notifier;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final options = notifier.blocksForSection(section);
    final selectedId = notifier.selectedBlocks[section]?.id;

    return AppGlassCard(
      borderColor: _sectionColor(section).withAlpha(80),
      glowColor: _sectionColor(section),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          Row(
            children: <Widget>[
              Icon(
                _sectionIcon(section),
                color: _sectionColor(section),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  _sectionLabel(section),
                  textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                  style: AppTypography.title,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          if (options.isEmpty)
            Text(
              'لا توجد عبارات متاحة لهذا القسم.',
              textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
              style: AppTypography.body,
            )
          else
            for (final block in options) ...<Widget>[
              _BlockOption(
                block: block,
                selected: selectedId == block.id,
                registerMismatch:
                    notifier.registerMismatchSections.contains(section) &&
                        selectedId == block.id,
                phraseIssue:
                    notifier.invalidPhraseSections.contains(section) &&
                        selectedId == block.id,
                onTap: () => unawaited(
                  notifier.selectSectionBlock(block.id),
                ),
              ),
              if (block != options.last) const SizedBox(height: 10),
            ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  static Color _sectionColor(LetterSection section) => switch (section) {
        LetterSection.salutation => AppColors.primary,

        LetterSection.requestOrComplaint => AppColors.tertiary,
        LetterSection.closingSignoff => AppColors.mastery,
      };

  static IconData _sectionIcon(LetterSection section) => switch (section) {
        LetterSection.salutation => Icons.waving_hand_outlined,
        LetterSection.openingHook => Icons.short_text_rounded,
        LetterSection.mainBodyReason => Icons.subject_rounded,
        LetterSection.requestOrComplaint => Icons.assignment_outlined,

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/genitiv_models.dart';
import '../domain/genitiv_repository.dart';

final class GenitivNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  GenitivNotifier({
    required GenitivRepository repository,
  }) : _repository = repository;

  final GenitivRepository _repository;

  List<GenitivChallengeItem> _challenges =
      const <GenitivChallengeItem>[];
  GenitivChallengeItem? _currentChallenge;
  GenitivDrillType? _filter;
  String? _selectedArticle;
  String? _selectedNounSuffix;
  String? _selectedPreposition;
  bool? _isCorrect;
  bool _showExplanation = false;
  String _explanationAr = '';
  bool _isBusy = false;
  int _currentIndex = -1;

  GenitivChallengeItem? get currentChallenge => _currentChallenge;
  GenitivDrillType? get filter => _filter;
  String? get selectedArticle => _selectedArticle;
  String? get selectedNounSuffix => _selectedNounSuffix;
  String? get selectedPreposition => _selectedPreposition;
  bool? get isCorrect => _isCorrect;
  bool get showExplanation => _showExplanation;
  String get explanationAr => _explanationAr;
  bool get isBusy => _isBusy;

  void selectArticle(String value) {
    if (_showExplanation) return;
    final normalized = value.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (normalized != 'des' && normalized != 'der') return;
    if (_selectedArticle == normalized) return;
    _selectedArticle = normalized;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void selectNounSuffix(String value) {
    if (_showExplanation) return;
    final normalized = value.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!const <String>{'', 's', 'es'}.contains(normalized)) return;
    if (_selectedNounSuffix == normalized) return;
    _selectedNounSuffix = normalized;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void selectPreposition(String value) {
    if (_showExplanation) return;
    final normalized = value.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!const <String>{
      'wegen',
      'während',
      'trotz',
      'anstatt',
    }.contains(normalized)) {
      return;
    }
    if (_selectedPreposition == normalized) return;
    _selectedPreposition = normalized;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> checkGenitivAnswer(
    String chosenArticle,
    String chosenNounSuffix, {
    String? chosenPreposition,
  }) async {
    final challenge = _currentChallenge;
    if (challenge == null) {
      throw StateError('No active Genitiv challenge.');
    }
    if (_showExplanation) {
      throw StateError('Current Genitiv challenge has already been scored.');
    }

    _setBusy(true);
    try {
      final normalizedArticle = chosenArticle.trim().toLowerCase();
      final normalizedSuffix = chosenNounSuffix.trim().toLowerCase();
      final normalizedPreposition =
          chosenPreposition?.trim().toLowerCase();

      final correct = await _repository.validateAnswer(
        challenge.id,
        chosenArticle: normalizedArticle,
        chosenNounSuffix: normalizedSuffix,
        chosenPreposition: normalizedPreposition,
      );

      _selectedArticle = normalizedArticle;
      _selectedNounSuffix = normalizedSuffix;
      _selectedPreposition = normalizedPreposition;
      _isCorrect = correct;
      _showExplanation = true;
      _explanationAr = challenge.explanationAr;
    } finally {
      _setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> nextChallenge() async {
    if (_isBusy) return;

    _setBusy(true);
    try {
      if (_challenges.isEmpty) {
        _challenges = await _repository.getChallenges(type: _filter);
      }

      if (_challenges.isEmpty) {
        _currentChallenge = null;
        _currentIndex = -1;
        _clearAttempt();
        return;
      }

      _currentIndex = (_currentIndex + 1) % _challenges.length;
      _currentChallenge = _challenges[_currentIndex];
      _clearAttempt();
    } finally {
      _setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> filterByType(GenitivDrillType type) async {
    if (_isBusy) return;

    _setBusy(true);
    try {
      _filter = type;
      _challenges = await _repository.getChallenges(type: type);
      _currentIndex = _challenges.isEmpty ? -1 : 0;
      _currentChallenge =
          _challenges.isEmpty ? null : _challenges.first;
      _clearAttempt();
    } finally {
      _setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  void _clearAttempt() {
    _selectedArticle = null;
    _selectedNounSuffix = null;
    _selectedPreposition = null;
    _isCorrect = null;
    _showExplanation = false;
    _explanationAr = '';
  }

  void _setBusy(bool value) {
    if (_isBusy == value) return;
    _isBusy = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

      explanationAr:
          'anstatt يمكن أن يأتي مع Genitiv: anstatt der Antwort.',
    ),
  ];

  @override
  Future<List<GenitivChallengeItem>> getChallenges({
    GenitivDrillType? type,
  }) async {
    final result = type == null
        ? _bank
        : _bank.where((item) => item.type == type);
    return List<GenitivChallengeItem>.unmodifiable(result);
  }

  @override
  Future<bool> validateAnswer(
    String challengeId, {
    required String chosenArticle,
    required String chosenNounSuffix,
    String? chosenPreposition,
  }) async {
    final normalizedId = challengeId.trim();
    GenitivChallengeItem? challenge;
    for (final item in _bank) {
      if (item.id == normalizedId) {
        challenge = item;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (challenge == null) return false;

    final articleMatches =
        chosenArticle.trim().toLowerCase() == challenge.correctArticle;
    final suffixMatches =
        chosenNounSuffix.trim().toLowerCase() ==
            challenge.correctNounSuffix;

    final prepositionMatches =
        challenge.type == GenitivDrillType.possessionArticle
            ? true
            : chosenPreposition?.trim().toLowerCase() ==
                challenge.genitivPreposition;

    return articleMatches && suffixMatches && prepositionMatches;
  }
}

enum GenitivDrillType {
  possessionArticle,
  genitivPrepositions,
}

enum GenitivGender {
  maskulin,
  neutrum,
  feminin,
  plural,
}

final class GenitivChallengeItem {
  const GenitivChallengeItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.type,
    required this.sentenceContext,
    required this.targetNoun,
    required this.gender,
    required this.correctArticle,
    required this.correctNounSuffix,
    required this.suffixReasonAr,
    required this.arabicTranslation,
    required this.explanationAr,
    this.genitivPreposition,
  })  : assert(id.length > 0),
        assert(sentenceContext.length > 0),
        assert(targetNoun.length > 0),
        assert(correctArticle == 'des' || correctArticle == 'der'),
        assert(
          correctNounSuffix == '' ||
              correctNounSuffix == 's' ||
              correctNounSuffix == 'es',
        ),
        assert(suffixReasonAr.length > 0),
        assert(arabicTranslation.length > 0),
        assert(explanationAr.length > 0),
        assert(
          type != GenitivDrillType.genitivPrepositions ||
              genitivPreposition != null,
        );

  final String id;
  final GenitivDrillType type;
  final String sentenceContext;
  final String targetNoun;
  final GenitivGender gender;
  final String correctArticle;
  final String correctNounSuffix;
  final String suffixReasonAr;
  final String? genitivPreposition;
  final String arabicTranslation;
  final String explanationAr;

  String get inflectedNoun => '$targetNoun$correctNounSuffix';

  bool get takesNounEnding =>
      gender == GenitivGender.maskulin ||
      gender == GenitivGender.neutrum;

  String get genderLabelDe => switch (gender) {
        GenitivGender.maskulin => 'Maskulin',
        GenitivGender.neutrum => 'Neutrum',
        GenitivGender.feminin => 'Feminin',
        GenitivGender.plural => 'Plural',
      };
}

}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../design_system/app_colors.dart';
import '../../../design_system/app_glass_card.dart';
import '../../../design_system/app_typography.dart';
import '../application/genitiv_notifier.dart';
import '../domain/genitiv_models.dart';

class GenitivScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const GenitivScreen({
    required this.notifier,
    super.key,
  });

  final GenitivNotifier notifier;

  @override
  State<GenitivScreen> createState() => _GenitivScreenState();
}

class _GenitivScreenState extends State<GenitivScreen> {
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    Future<void>.microtask(widget.notifier.nextChallenge);
  }

  Future<void> _submit() async {
    final notifier = widget.notifier;
    final challenge = notifier.currentChallenge;
    final article = notifier.selectedArticle;
    final suffix = notifier.selectedNounSuffix;

    if (challenge == null || article == null || suffix == null) return;

    if (challenge.type == GenitivDrillType.genitivPrepositions &&
        notifier.selectedPreposition == null) {
      return;
    }

    await notifier.checkGenitivAnswer(
      article,
      suffix,
      chosenPreposition: notifier.selectedPreposition,
    );
  }

  Future<void> _next() => widget.notifier.nextChallenge();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: widget.notifier,
      builder: (context, _) {
        final notifier = widget.notifier;
        final challenge = notifier.currentChallenge;

        return Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(
            title: Text(
              'Genitiv Arena',
              textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,

                        challenge: challenge,

                      const SizedBox(height: 12),

class _RelationshipCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _RelationshipCard({
    required this.challenge,
    required this.selectedArticle,
    required this.selectedSuffix,
    required this.revealed,
  });

  final GenitivChallengeItem challenge;
  final String? selectedArticle;
  final String? selectedSuffix;
  final bool revealed;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final article = revealed ? challenge.correctArticle : selectedArticle;
    final suffix = revealed ? challenge.correctNounSuffix : selectedSuffix;
    final nounAccent =
        challenge.takesNounEnding ? AppColors.tertiary : AppColors.secondary;

    return AppGlassCard(
      borderColor: nounAccent.withAlpha(78),
      glowColor: revealed ? nounAccent : null,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          Text(
            'المضاف إليه',
            textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
            style: AppTypography.title,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: <Widget>[
              Text(
                article ?? '___',
                textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(
                  color: AppColors.primary,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Flexible(
                child: RichText(
                  textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  text: TextSpan(
                    style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(
                      color: AppColors.secondary,
                    ),
                    children: <InlineSpan>[
                      TextSpan(text: challenge.targetNoun),
                      TextSpan(
                        text: suffix == null
                            ? '___'
                            : suffix.isEmpty
                                ? ''
                                : suffix,
                        style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(
                          color: nounAccent,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          Text(
            challenge.takesNounEnding
                ? 'المذكر والمحايد يأخذان عادةً -s أو -es في هذا النوع من الأمثلة.'
                : 'المؤنث والجمع هنا لا يأخذان -s أو -es؛ التغيير الأساسي في الأداة.',
            textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(color: nounAccent),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../../../core/explain_why/deterministic_explain_why_engine.dart';
import '../../../core/explainer/explainer_models.dart';
import '../domain/grammar_drill_evaluator.dart';
import '../domain/grammar_drill_models.dart';
import '../../error_pattern_agent/domain/error_diagnostic_repository.dart';
import '../../error_pattern_agent/domain/error_pattern_models.dart';

final class GrammarDrillState {
  final List<GrammarDrill> exercises;
  final int currentIndex;
  final List<String> orderedTokenIds;
  final String selectedAnswer;
  final int points;
  final int attempts;
  final int correctCount;
  final int positiveStreak;
  final String feedbackAr;
  final String? feedbackReasonCode;
  final bool isAnswered;
  final bool lastAnswerCorrect;
  final bool completed;

  const GrammarDrillState({
    required this.exercises,
    required this.currentIndex,
    required this.orderedTokenIds,
    required this.selectedAnswer,
    required this.points,
    required this.attempts,
    required this.correctCount,
    required this.positiveStreak,
    required this.feedbackAr,
    required this.feedbackReasonCode,
    required this.isAnswered,
    required this.lastAnswerCorrect,
    required this.completed,
  });

  factory GrammarDrillState.initial(List<GrammarDrill> exercises) =>
      GrammarDrillState(
        exercises: List<GrammarDrill>.unmodifiable(exercises),
        currentIndex: 0,
        orderedTokenIds: const <String>[],
        selectedAnswer: '',
        points: 0,
        attempts: 0,
        correctCount: 0,
        positiveStreak: 0,
        feedbackAr: '',
        feedbackReasonCode: null,
        isAnswered: false,
        lastAnswerCorrect: false,
        completed: false,
      );

  GrammarDrill get currentExercise => exercises[currentIndex];

  double get accuracy => attempts == 0 ? 0 : correctCount / attempts;

  GrammarDrillState copyWith({
    int? currentIndex,
    List<String>? orderedTokenIds,
    String? selectedAnswer,
    int? points,
    int? attempts,
    int? correctCount,
    int? positiveStreak,
    String? feedbackAr,
    String? feedbackReasonCode,
    bool clearFeedbackReasonCode = false,
    bool? isAnswered,
    bool? lastAnswerCorrect,
    bool? completed,
  }) =>
      GrammarDrillState(
        exercises: exercises,
        currentIndex: currentIndex ?? this.currentIndex,
        orderedTokenIds: orderedTokenIds ?? this.orderedTokenIds,
        selectedAnswer: selectedAnswer ?? this.selectedAnswer,
        points: points ?? this.points,
        attempts: attempts ?? this.attempts,
        correctCount: correctCount ?? this.correctCount,
        positiveStreak: positiveStreak ?? this.positiveStreak,
        feedbackAr: feedbackAr ?? this.feedbackAr,
        feedbackReasonCode: clearFeedbackReasonCode
            ? null
            : (feedbackReasonCode ?? this.feedbackReasonCode),
        isAnswered: isAnswered ?? this.isAnswered,
        lastAnswerCorrect:
            lastAnswerCorrect ?? this.lastAnswerCorrect,
        completed: completed ?? this.completed,
      );
}

final class GrammarDrillNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  final GrammarDrillEvaluator evaluator;
  final ExplainWhyEngine explainWhyEngine;
  final ErrorDiagnosticSink errorDiagnosticSink;
  late GrammarDrillState _state;

  GrammarDrillNotifier(
    List<GrammarDrill> exercises, {
    required this.explainWhyEngine,
    this.evaluator = const GrammarDrillEvaluator(),
    this.errorDiagnosticSink = const NoopErrorDiagnosticSink(),
  }) {
    if (exercises.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(exercises, 'exercises', 'must not be empty');
    }
    _state = GrammarDrillState.initial(exercises);
  }

  GrammarDrillState get state => _state;

  void addSentenceToken(String tokenId) {
    if (_state.isAnswered || _state.completed) return;
    final exercise = _state.currentExercise;
    if (exercise is! SentenceReorderExercise) return;
    if (!exercise.tokens.any((token) => token.id == tokenId)) return;
    if (_state.orderedTokenIds.contains(tokenId)) return;
    _update(
      _state.copyWith(
        orderedTokenIds: List<String>.unmodifiable(
          <String>[..._state.orderedTokenIds, tokenId],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void removeSentenceToken(String tokenId) {
    if (_state.isAnswered || _state.completed) return;
    _update(
      _state.copyWith(
        orderedTokenIds: List<String>.unmodifiable(
          _state.orderedTokenIds.where((id) => id != tokenId),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void setAnswer(String answer) {
    if (_state.isAnswered || _state.completed) return;
    _update(_state.copyWith(selectedAnswer: answer));
  }

  void checkAnswer() {
    if (_state.isAnswered || _state.completed) return;
    final current = _state.currentExercise;
    final Object answer = current is SentenceReorderExercise
        ? _state.orderedTokenIds
        : _state.selectedAnswer;
    final evaluation = evaluator.evaluate(current, answer);
    final explanation = explainWhyEngine.explain(
      ExplainerRequest(
        reasonCode: evaluation.reasonCode,
        correct: evaluation.correct,
        arguments: evaluation.reasonArguments,
      ),
    );
    final streak = evaluation.correct ? _state.positiveStreak + 1 : 0;
    final bonus = evaluation.correct ? (streak * 10).clamp(0, 50).toInt() : 0;

    _update(
      _state.copyWith(
        points: _state.points + evaluation.score + bonus,
        attempts: _state.attempts + 1,
        correctCount:
            _state.correctCount + (evaluation.correct ? 1 : 0),
        positiveStreak: streak,
        feedbackAr: explanation.text,
        feedbackReasonCode: explanation.reasonCode,
        isAnswered: true,
        lastAnswerCorrect: evaluation.correct,
      ),
    );
    if (!evaluation.correct) {
      unawaited(_recordDiagnosticFailure(current, answer));
    }
  }

  Future<void> _recordDiagnosticFailure(
    GrammarDrill exercise,
    Object answer,
  ) async {
    final signal = switch (exercise) {
      SentenceReorderExercise sentence => LearningFailureSignal(
          source: ErrorEventSource.grammar,
          skillTag: 'sentence_reorder',
          expected: _sentenceText(
            sentence,
            sentence.correctTokenIds,
          ),
          actual: _sentenceText(
            sentence,
            answer is List<String> ? answer : const <String>[],
          ),
          focus: 'V2 / Satzstellung',
          occurredAt: DateTime.now(),
        ),
      CaseSelectionDrill grammarCase => LearningFailureSignal(
          source: ErrorEventSource.grammar,
          skillTag: 'case_${grammarCase.targetCase.name}',
          expected: grammarCase.expectedArticle,
          actual: answer.toString(),
          focus: grammarCase.noun,
          occurredAt: DateTime.now(),
        ),
      VerbConjugationDrill verb => LearningFailureSignal(
          source: ErrorEventSource.grammar,
          skillTag: 'verb_conjugation',
          expected: verb.expectedForm,
          actual: answer.toString(),
          focus: verb.infinitive,
          occurredAt: DateTime.now(),
        ),
    };
    try {
      await errorDiagnosticSink.recordFailure(signal);
    } on Object {
      // Diagnostics never block the exercise feedback loop.
    }
  }

  String _sentenceText(
    SentenceReorderExercise exercise,
    List<String> ids,
  ) {
    final byId = <String, GrammarToken>{
      for (final token in exercise.tokens) token.id: token,
    };
    return ids
        .map((id) => byId[id]?.text)
        .whereType<String>()
        .join(' ');
  }

  void retry() {
    if (_state.completed) return;
    _update(
      _state.copyWith(
        orderedTokenIds: const <String>[],
        selectedAnswer: '',
        feedbackAr: '',
        clearFeedbackReasonCode: true,
        isAnswered: false,
        lastAnswerCorrect: false,
      ),
    );
  }

  void next() {
    if (_state.completed) return;
    final nextIndex = _state.currentIndex + 1;
    if (nextIndex >= _state.exercises.length) {
      _update(_state.copyWith(completed: true));
      return;
    }
    _update(
      _state.copyWith(
        currentIndex: nextIndex,
        orderedTokenIds: const <String>[],
        selectedAnswer: '',
        feedbackAr: '',
        clearFeedbackReasonCode: true,
        isAnswered: false,
        lastAnswerCorrect: false,
      ),
    );
  }

  void restart() {
    _update(GrammarDrillState.initial(_state.exercises));
  }

  void _update(GrammarDrillState value) {
    _state = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

import 'dart:math';

import '../domain/grammar_drill_models.dart';

abstract final class SentenceTokenBank {
  static List<GrammarToken> shuffled(
    SentenceReorderExercise exercise, {
    int? seed,
  }) {
    if (exercise.tokens.length < 2) {
      return List<GrammarToken>.unmodifiable(exercise.tokens);
    }

    final resolvedSeed = seed ?? _stableSeed(exercise.id);
    final result = List<GrammarToken>.of(exercise.tokens)
      ..shuffle(Random(resolvedSeed));

    if (_matchesCanonicalOrder(result, exercise.correctTokenIds)) {
      final first = result.removeAt(0);
      result.add(first);
    }
    return List<GrammarToken>.unmodifiable(result);
  }

  static int _stableSeed(String value) {
    var hash = 17;
    for (final unit in value.codeUnits) {
      hash = ((hash * 37) ^ unit) & 0x7fffffff;
    }
    return hash;
  }

  static bool _matchesCanonicalOrder(
    List<GrammarToken> tokens,
    List<String> correctTokenIds,
  ) {
    if (tokens.length != correctTokenIds.length) return false;
    for (var index = 0; index < tokens.length; index++) {
      if (tokens[index].id != correctTokenIds[index]) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }
}

import '../../../core/explain_why/deterministic_explain_why_engine.dart';
import '../../../core/l10n/l10n_dictionary_codec.dart';

typedef ExplainWhyTextAssetReader = Future<String> Function(String assetPath);

abstract final class ArDeGrammarExplainWhyCatalog {
  static const String assetPath = 'assets/l10n/explain_why/ar.json';

  static ExplainWhyEngine? _cachedEngine;

  static ExplainWhyEngine decode(String encoded) {
    final dictionary = L10nDictionaryCodec.decodeJson(
      encoded,
      localeTag: 'ar',
    );
    return DeterministicExplainWhyEngine.fromDictionary(
      dictionary: dictionary,
    );
  }

  static Future<ExplainWhyEngine> load({
    required ExplainWhyTextAssetReader readText,
  }) async {
    final cached = _cachedEngine;
    if (cached != null) return cached;

    final loaded = decode(await readText(assetPath));
    _cachedEngine = loaded;
    return loaded;
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/grammar/domain/grammar_drill_evaluator.dart

import 'grammar_drill_models.dart';

final class GrammarEvaluation {
  GrammarEvaluation({
    required this.correct,
    required this.score,
    required this.reasonCode,
    Map<String, String> reasonArguments = const <String, String>{},
  }) : reasonArguments =
            Map<String, String>.unmodifiable(reasonArguments);

  final bool correct;
  final int score;
  final String reasonCode;
  final Map<String, String> reasonArguments;
}

final class GrammarDrillEvaluator {
  const GrammarDrillEvaluator();

  GrammarEvaluation evaluate(GrammarDrill drill, Object answer) {
    return switch (drill) {
      SentenceReorderExercise exercise => _evaluateSentence(exercise, answer),
      VerbConjugationDrill exercise => _evaluateVerb(exercise, answer),
      CaseSelectionDrill exercise => _evaluateCase(exercise, answer),
    };
  }

  GrammarEvaluation _evaluateSentence(
    SentenceReorderExercise exercise,
    Object answer,
  ) {
    if (answer is! List<String>) {
      return GrammarEvaluation(
        correct: false,
        score: 0,
        reasonCode: 'grammar.input.incomplete',
      );
    }
    final expected = exercise.correctTokenIds;
    final correct = answer.length == expected.length &&
        List.generate(
          expected.length,
          (index) => answer[index] == expected[index],
        ).every((value) => value);

    return GrammarEvaluation(
      correct: correct,
      score: correct ? 100 : 0,
      reasonCode: exercise.reasonCode,
      reasonArguments: exercise.reasonArguments,
    );
  }

  GrammarEvaluation _evaluateVerb(
    VerbConjugationDrill exercise,
    Object answer,
  ) {
    final normalized = _normalize(answer.toString());
    final accepted = <String>{
      _normalize(exercise.expectedForm),
      ...exercise.acceptedForms.map(_normalize),
    };
    final correct = accepted.contains(normalized);

    return GrammarEvaluation(
      correct: correct,
      score: correct ? 100 : 0,
      reasonCode: exercise.reasonCode,
      reasonArguments: <String, String>{
        ...exercise.reasonArguments,
        'pronoun': exercise.pronoun,
        'infinitive': exercise.infinitive,
        'expected': exercise.expectedForm,
      },
    );
  }

  GrammarEvaluation _evaluateCase(
    CaseSelectionDrill exercise,
    Object answer,
  ) {
    final correct =
        _normalize(answer.toString()) == _normalize(exercise.expectedArticle);
    return GrammarEvaluation(
      correct: correct,
      score: correct ? 100 : 0,
      reasonCode: exercise.reasonCode,
      reasonArguments: <String, String>{
        ...exercise.reasonArguments,
        'caseLabel': exercise.targetCase.label,
        'noun': exercise.noun,
        'expected': exercise.expectedArticle,
      },
    );
  }

  String _normalize(String value) => value
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[.!?,;:،؛؟]'), '')
      .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');
}

import '../../../core/explain_why/deterministic_explain_why_engine.dart';

enum GrammarLevel {
  a1('A1'),
  a2('A2'),
  b1('B1');

  final String code;
  const GrammarLevel(this.code);
}

enum GrammarCase {
  nominative('Nominativ'),
  accusative('Akkusativ'),
  dative('Dativ'),
  genitive('Genitiv');

  final String label;
  const GrammarCase(this.label);
}

enum GrammarTokenRole {
  subject,
  verb,
  connector,
  articleMasculine,
  articleFeminine,
  articleNeuter,
  accusativeMarker,
  dativeMarker,
  other,
}

final class GrammarToken {
  final String id;
  final String text;
  final GrammarTokenRole role;

  const GrammarToken({
    required this.id,
    required this.text,
    this.role = GrammarTokenRole.other,
  });
}

sealed class GrammarDrill {
  final String id;
  final GrammarLevel level;
  final String titleAr;
  final String instructionAr;
  final String reasonCode;
  final Map<String, String> reasonArguments;

  const GrammarDrill({
    required this.id,
    required this.level,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.instructionAr,
    required this.reasonCode,
    this.reasonArguments = const <String, String>{},
  });
}

final class SentenceReorderExercise extends GrammarDrill {
  final List<GrammarToken> tokens;
  final List<String> correctTokenIds;
  final String translationAr;

  const SentenceReorderExercise({
    required super.id,
    required super.level,
    required super.titleAr,
    required super.instructionAr,
    required super.reasonCode,
    super.reasonArguments,
    required this.tokens,
    required this.correctTokenIds,
    required this.translationAr,
  });
}

final class VerbConjugationDrill extends GrammarDrill {
  final String infinitive;
  final String pronoun;
  final String sentencePrefix;
  final String sentenceSuffix;
  final String expectedForm;
  final List<String> acceptedForms;

  const VerbConjugationDrill({
    required super.id,
    required super.level,
    required super.titleAr,
    required super.instructionAr,
    required super.reasonCode,
    super.reasonArguments,
    required this.infinitive,
    required this.pronoun,
    required this.sentencePrefix,
    required this.sentenceSuffix,
    required this.expectedForm,
    this.acceptedForms = const <String>[],
  });
}

final class CaseSelectionDrill extends GrammarDrill {
  final GrammarCase targetCase;
  final String sentenceBefore;
  final String noun;
  final String sentenceAfter;
  final List<String> options;
  final String expectedArticle;

  const CaseSelectionDrill({
    required super.id,
    required super.level,
    required super.titleAr,
    required super.instructionAr,
    required super.reasonCode,
    super.reasonArguments,
    required this.targetCase,
    required this.sentenceBefore,
    required this.noun,
    required this.sentenceAfter,
    required this.options,
    required this.expectedArticle,
  });
}

abstract interface class GrammarDrillRepository {
  ExplainWhyEngine get explainWhyEngine;
  List<GrammarDrill> forLevel(GrammarLevel level);
  GrammarDrill? byId(String id);
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class GrammarDrillScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const GrammarDrillScreen({
    required this.exercises,
    required this.levelLabel,
    required this.explainWhyEngine,
    required this.targetLanguageCode,
    required this.onSpeakGerman,
    this.errorDiagnosticSink,
    super.key,
  });

  final List<GrammarDrill> exercises;
  final String levelLabel;
  final ExplainWhyEngine explainWhyEngine;
  final String targetLanguageCode;

class _GrammarDrillScreenState extends State<GrammarDrillScreen> {
  late final GrammarDrillNotifier _notifier;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _notifier = GrammarDrillNotifier(
      widget.exercises,
      explainWhyEngine: widget.explainWhyEngine,
      errorDiagnosticSink:
          widget.errorDiagnosticSink ?? const NoopErrorDiagnosticSink(),

  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _notifier.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Directionality(
        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
        child: Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(
            title: AppDirectionalText(
              'تدريب القواعد · ${widget.levelLabel}',
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
          ),
          body: AnimatedBuilder(
            animation: _notifier,
            builder: (context, _) {
              final state = _notifier.state;
              if (state.completed) {
                return _CompletionView(
                  state: state,
                  onRestart: _notifier.restart,
                );
              }

              final exercise = state.currentExercise;
              return ListView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 32),
                children: <Widget>[
                  _ProgressHeader(state: state),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  AppGlassCard(
                    glowColor: AppColors.achievement,
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                      children: <Widget>[
                        AppDirectionalText(
                          exercise.titleAr,
                          languageCode: 'ar',
                          style: AppTypography.title,
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 5),
                        AppDirectionalText(
                          exercise.instructionAr,
                          languageCode: 'ar',
                          style: AppTypography.body,
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  _ExerciseBody(
                    exercise: exercise,
                    state: state,
                    notifier: _notifier,
                    targetLanguageCode: widget.targetLanguageCode,
                    onSpeakGerman: widget.onSpeakGerman,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  if (state.isAnswered)
                    ExplainWhyFeedbackCard(
                      explanation: state.feedbackAr,
                      reasonCode: state.feedbackReasonCode ?? 'unknown',
                      correct: state.lastAnswerCorrect,
                    ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  FilledButton.icon(
                    onPressed: state.isAnswered
                        ? (state.lastAnswerCorrect
                            ? _notifier.next
                            : _notifier.retry)
                        : _notifier.checkAnswer,
                    icon: Icon(

                          ? Icons.refresh_rounded

                    label: AppDirectionalText(

                      style: AppTypography.label,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              );
            },
          ),
        ),
      );
}

class _ProgressHeader extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ProgressHeader({required this.state});

  final GrammarDrillState state;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final total = state.exercises.length;
    final current = state.currentIndex + 1;
    return AppGlassCard(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
      child: Row(
        children: <Widget>[
          Expanded(
            child: LinearProgressIndicator(
              value: current / total,
              minHeight: 8,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              valueColor:
                  const AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(AppColors.primary),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Text('$current/$total', style: AppTypography.label),
          const SizedBox(width: 14),
          Text('XP ${state.points}', style: AppTypography.label),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _ExerciseBody extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ExerciseBody({
    required this.exercise,
    required this.state,
    required this.notifier,
    required this.targetLanguageCode,
    required this.onSpeakGerman,
  });

  final GrammarDrill exercise;
  final GrammarDrillState state;
  final GrammarDrillNotifier notifier;
  final String targetLanguageCode;
  final void Function(String text, String conceptId) onSpeakGerman;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return switch (exercise) {
      SentenceReorderExercise sentence => InteractiveSentenceBuilderWidget(
          exercise: sentence,
          orderedTokenIds: state.orderedTokenIds,
          onAddToken: notifier.addSentenceToken,
          onRemoveToken: notifier.removeSentenceToken,
          enabled: !state.isAnswered,
          targetLanguageCode: targetLanguageCode,
          onSpeakSentence: state.isAnswered && state.lastAnswerCorrect
              ? () => onSpeakGerman(
                    _correctSentence(sentence),
                    'grammar.drill.${sentence.id}.answer',
                  )
              : null,
        ),
      VerbConjugationDrill verb => _VerbConjugationCard(
          exercise: verb,
          value: state.selectedAnswer,
          enabled: !state.isAnswered,
          targetLanguageCode: targetLanguageCode,
          onChanged: notifier.setAnswer,
          onSpeakGerman: onSpeakGerman,
        ),
      CaseSelectionDrill grammarCase => _CaseSelectionCard(
          exercise: grammarCase,
          value: state.selectedAnswer,
          enabled: !state.isAnswered,
          targetLanguageCode: targetLanguageCode,
          onChanged: notifier.setAnswer,
          onSpeakGerman: onSpeakGerman,
        ),
    };
  }
}

            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            AppDirectionalText(
              '${exercise.sentencePrefix} ___ ${exercise.sentenceSuffix}',
              languageCode: targetLanguageCode,
              style: AppTypography.body.copyWith(fontSize: 18),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            TextFormField(
              key: ValueKey('${exercise.id}-$enabled'),
              enabled: enabled,
              initialValue: value,
              onChanged: onChanged,
              textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
              style: AppTypography.body,
              decoration: const InputDecoration(
                border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                labelText: 'التصريف الصحيح',
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

class _CaseSelectionCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _CaseSelectionCard({
    required this.exercise,
    required this.value,
    required this.enabled,
    required this.targetLanguageCode,
    required this.onChanged,
    required this.onSpeakGerman,
  });

  final CaseSelectionDrill exercise;
  final String value;
  final bool enabled;
  final String targetLanguageCode;
  final ValueChanged<String> onChanged;
  final void Function(String text, String conceptId) onSpeakGerman;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final caseColor = switch (exercise.targetCase) {
      GrammarCase.nominative => AppColors.primary,
      GrammarCase.accusative => AppColors.tertiary,
      GrammarCase.dative => AppColors.secondary,
      GrammarCase.genitive => AppColors.achievement,
    };
    return AppGlassCard(
      glowColor: caseColor,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          Row(
            children: <Widget>[
              Icon(Icons.rule_rounded, color: caseColor),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Expanded(
                child: AppDirectionalText(
                  exercise.targetCase.label,
                  languageCode: targetLanguageCode,
                  style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(color: caseColor),
                ),
              ),
              AppAudioButton(
                onPressed: () => onSpeakGerman(
                  exercise.noun,
                  'grammar.drill.${exercise.id}.noun',
                ),
                semanticLabel: 'استمع إلى الاسم ${exercise.noun}',
                activeColor: caseColor,
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          AppDirectionalText(
            '${exercise.sentenceBefore} ___ ${exercise.noun} '
            '${exercise.sentenceAfter}',
            languageCode: targetLanguageCode,
            style: AppTypography.title,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          Wrap(
            spacing: 8,
            runSpacing: 8,
            children: <Widget>[
              for (final option in exercise.options)
                ChoiceChip(
                  label: AppDirectionalText(
                    option,
                    languageCode: targetLanguageCode,
                    style: AppTypography.label,
                  ),
                  selected: value == option,
                  selectedColor: _articleColor(option).withAlpha(48),
                  side: BorderSide(color: _articleColor(option)),
                  onSelected: enabled ? (_) => onChanged(option) : null,
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Color _articleColor(String article) => switch (article.toLowerCase()) {
        'der' => AppColors.articleDer,
        'die' => AppColors.articleDie,
        'das' => AppColors.articleDas,
        'den' => AppColors.tertiary,
        'dem' => AppColors.secondary,
        _ => AppColors.articleOther,
      };
}

class _CompletionView extends StatelessWidget {
  const _CompletionView({
    required this.state,

  });

              AppDirectionalText(

                languageCode: 'ar',
                style: AppTypography.title,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),

                languageCode: 'ar',
                style: AppTypography.body,

              FilledButton.icon(
                onPressed: onRestart,
                icon: const Icon(Icons.replay_rounded),
                label: AppDirectionalText(

                ),
              ),

String _correctSentence(SentenceReorderExercise exercise) {
  final byId = <String, String>{
    for (final token in exercise.tokens) token.id: token.text,
  };
  return exercise.correctTokenIds
      .map((id) => byId[id])
      .whereType<String>()
      .join(' ');
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../../design_system/app_audio_button.dart';
import '../../../../design_system/app_colors.dart';
import '../../../../design_system/app_glass_card.dart';
import '../../../../design_system/app_typography.dart';
import '../../application/sentence_token_bank.dart';
import '../../domain/grammar_drill_models.dart';

class InteractiveSentenceBuilderWidget extends StatefulWidget {
  const InteractiveSentenceBuilderWidget({
    required this.exercise,
    required this.orderedTokenIds,
    required this.onAddToken,
    required this.onRemoveToken,
    required this.targetLanguageCode,
    this.onSpeakSentence,
    this.enabled = true,
    super.key,
  });

  final SentenceReorderExercise exercise;
  final List<String> orderedTokenIds;
  final ValueChanged<String> onAddToken;
  final ValueChanged<String> onRemoveToken;
  final String targetLanguageCode;
  final VoidCallback? onSpeakSentence;
  final bool enabled;

  @override
  State<InteractiveSentenceBuilderWidget> createState() =>
      _InteractiveSentenceBuilderWidgetState();
}

class _InteractiveSentenceBuilderWidgetState
    extends State<InteractiveSentenceBuilderWidget> {
  late List<GrammarToken> _tokenBank;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _tokenBank = SentenceTokenBank.shuffled(widget.exercise);
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(
    covariant InteractiveSentenceBuilderWidget oldWidget,
  ) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.exercise.id != widget.exercise.id) {
      _tokenBank = SentenceTokenBank.shuffled(widget.exercise);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final byId = <String, GrammarToken>{
      for (final token in widget.exercise.tokens) token.id: token,
    };
    final selected = widget.orderedTokenIds
        .map((id) => byId[id])
        .whereType<GrammarToken>()
        .toList(growable: false);
    final available = _tokenBank
        .where((token) => !widget.orderedTokenIds.contains(token.id))
        .toList(growable: false);

    return AppGlassCard(
      glowColor: AppColors.primary,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          Row(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: <Widget>[
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    AppDirectionalText(
                      widget.exercise.instructionAr,
                      languageCode: 'ar',
                      style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(fontSize: 17),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    AppDirectionalText(
                      widget.exercise.translationAr,
                      languageCode: 'ar',
                      style: AppTypography.body,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              if (widget.onSpeakSentence != null) ...<Widget>[
                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                AppAudioButton(
                  onPressed: widget.onSpeakSentence,
                  semanticLabel: 'استمع إلى الجملة الصحيحة',
                  activeColor: AppColors.primary,
                ),
              ],
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          DragTarget<String>(
            onWillAcceptWithDetails: (_) => widget.enabled,
            onAcceptWithDetails: (details) =>
                widget.onAddToken(details.data),
            builder: (context, candidates, rejected) => AnimatedContainer(
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
              constraints: const BoxConstraints(minHeight: 82),
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: candidates.isNotEmpty
                    ? AppColors.primary.withAlpha(22)
                    : Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface.withAlpha(80),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                border: Border.all(
                  color: candidates.isNotEmpty
                      ? AppColors.primary
                      : Theme.of(context).dividerColor,
                ),
              ),
              child: Wrap(
                spacing: 8,
                runSpacing: 8,
                children: selected.isEmpty
                    ? <Widget>[
                        AppDirectionalText(
                          'اسحب الكلمات إلى هنا أو اضغط عليها بالترتيب.',
                          languageCode: 'ar',
                          style: AppTypography.label,
                        ),
                      ]
                    : <Widget>[
                        for (final token in selected)
                          _TokenChip(
                            token: token,
                            selected: true,
                            enabled: widget.enabled,
                            languageCode: widget.targetLanguageCode,
                            onTap: () => widget.onRemoveToken(token.id),
                          ),
                      ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          Wrap(
            spacing: 8,
            runSpacing: 8,
            children: <Widget>[
              for (final token in available)
                Draggable<String>(
                  data: token.id,
                  feedback: Material(
                    color: Colors.transparent,
                    child: _TokenChip(
                      token: token,
                      selected: false,
                      enabled: widget.enabled,
                      languageCode: widget.targetLanguageCode,
                    ),
                  ),
                  childWhenDragging: Opacity(
                    opacity: .35,
                    child: _TokenChip(
                      token: token,
                      selected: false,
                      enabled: false,
                      languageCode: widget.targetLanguageCode,
                    ),
                  ),
                  child: _TokenChip(
                    token: token,
                    selected: false,
                    enabled: widget.enabled,
                    languageCode: widget.targetLanguageCode,
                    onTap: widget.enabled
                        ? () => widget.onAddToken(token.id)
                        : null,
                  ),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _TokenChip extends StatelessWidget {
  const _TokenChip({
    required this.token,
    required this.selected,
    required this.enabled,
    required this.languageCode,
    this.onTap,
  });

  final GrammarToken token;
  final bool selected;
  final bool enabled;
  final String languageCode;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final accent = _accentFor(token);
    return ActionChip(
      onPressed: enabled ? onTap : null,
      avatar: selected
          ? Icon(Icons.check_rounded, size: 16, color: accent)
          : null,
      label: AppDirectionalText(
        token.text,
        languageCode: languageCode,
        style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
          color: enabled ? accent : accent.withAlpha(110),
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
        ),
      ),
      side: BorderSide(color: accent.withAlpha(120)),
      backgroundColor: accent.withAlpha(selected ? 28 : 16),
    );
  }

  Color _accentFor(GrammarToken token) {
    final normalized = token.text
        .toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-zäöüß]'), '');
    if (normalized == 'der') return AppColors.articleDer;
    if (normalized == 'die') return AppColors.articleDie;
    if (normalized == 'das') return AppColors.articleDas;

    return switch (token.role) {
      GrammarTokenRole.verb => AppColors.primary,
      GrammarTokenRole.connector => AppColors.achievement,
      GrammarTokenRole.accusativeMarker => AppColors.tertiary,
      GrammarTokenRole.dativeMarker => AppColors.secondary,
      GrammarTokenRole.articleMasculine => AppColors.articleDer,
      GrammarTokenRole.articleFeminine => AppColors.articleDie,
      GrammarTokenRole.articleNeuter => AppColors.articleDas,
      GrammarTokenRole.subject || GrammarTokenRole.other =>
        AppColors.articleOther,
    };
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/imperativ_models.dart';
import '../domain/imperativ_repository.dart';

final class ImperativState {
  const ImperativState({
    required this.drills,
    required this.currentIndex,
    required this.input,
    required this.checked,
    required this.correct,
    required this.feedbackAr,
    required this.filter,
  });

  final List<ImperativDrillItem> drills;
  final int currentIndex;
  final String input;
  final bool checked;
  final bool correct;
  final String feedbackAr;
  final ImperativTarget? filter;

  ImperativDrillItem get current => drills[currentIndex];

  ImperativState copyWith({
    List<ImperativDrillItem>? drills,
    int? currentIndex,
    String? input,
    bool? checked,
    bool? correct,
    String? feedbackAr,
    ImperativTarget? filter,
    bool clearFilter = false,
  }) =>
      ImperativState(
        drills: drills ?? this.drills,
        currentIndex: currentIndex ?? this.currentIndex,
        input: input ?? this.input,
        checked: checked ?? this.checked,
        correct: correct ?? this.correct,
        feedbackAr: feedbackAr ?? this.feedbackAr,
        filter: clearFilter ? null : (filter ?? this.filter),
      );
}

final class ImperativNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  ImperativNotifier(this._repository)
      : _state = ImperativState(
          drills: List<ImperativDrillItem>.unmodifiable(
            _repository.allDrills,
          ),
          currentIndex: 0,
          input: '',
          checked: false,
          correct: false,
          feedbackAr: '',
          filter: null,
        ) {
    if (_state.drills.isEmpty) {
      throw StateError('Imperativ drill bank must not be empty');
    }
  }

  final ImperativRepository _repository;
  ImperativState _state;

  ImperativState get state => _state;

  void checkImperativForm(String input) {
    final item = _state.current;
    final correct = _repository.isCorrect(item, input);
    _state = _state.copyWith(
      input: input,
      checked: true,
      correct: correct,
      feedbackAr: correct
          ? 'صحيح. ${item.explanationAr}'
          : 'راجع الصيغة: ${item.correctForm} — ${item.explanationAr}',
    );
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void nextDrill() {
    final nextIndex = (_state.currentIndex + 1) % _state.drills.length;
    _state = _state.copyWith(
      currentIndex: nextIndex,
      input: '',
      checked: false,
      correct: false,
      feedbackAr: '',
    );
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void filterByTarget(ImperativTarget target) {
    final filtered = _repository.forTarget(target);
    if (filtered.isEmpty) {
      throw StateError('No Imperativ drills for ${target.name}');
    }
    _state = ImperativState(
      drills: List<ImperativDrillItem>.unmodifiable(filtered),
      currentIndex: 0,
      input: '',
      checked: false,
      correct: false,
      feedbackAr: '',
      filter: target,
    );
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

          'sein شاذ أيضاً مع wir: نقول Seien wir! وليس Sind wir.',
    ),
