  @override
  List<ImperativDrillItem> get allDrills =>
      List<ImperativDrillItem>.unmodifiable(_drills);

  @override
  ImperativDrillItem? byId(String id) {
    final normalized = id.trim();
    for (final item in _drills) {
      if (item.id == normalized) return item;
    }
    return null;
  }

  @override
  List<ImperativDrillItem> forTarget(ImperativTarget target) =>
      List<ImperativDrillItem>.unmodifiable(
        _drills.where((item) => item.target == target),
      );

  @override
  bool isCorrect(ImperativDrillItem item, String candidate) {
    if (!respectsImperativStructure(item, candidate)) return false;
    final normalized = normalizeForComparison(candidate);
    final accepted = <String>[item.correctForm, ...item.acceptedForms];
    return accepted.any(
      (form) => normalizeForComparison(form) == normalized,
    );
  }

  @override
  bool respectsImperativStructure(
    ImperativDrillItem item,
    String candidate,
  ) {
    final normalized = normalizeForComparison(candidate);
    if (normalized.isEmpty) return false;
    final tokens = normalized.split(' ');
    final first = tokens.first;

    return switch (item.target) {
      ImperativTarget.duForm =>
        !tokens.contains('du') &&
            !first.toLowerCase().endsWith('st'),
      ImperativTarget.ihrForm => !tokens.contains('ihr'),
      ImperativTarget.sieForm =>
        tokens.contains('Sie') &&
            !tokens.contains('du') &&
            !tokens.contains('ihr'),
      ImperativTarget.wirForm =>
        tokens.contains('wir') &&
            !tokens.contains('du') &&
            !tokens.contains('ihr'),
    };
  }

  @override
  String normalizeForComparison(String value) => value
      .trim()
      .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[.!?…]+$'), '')
      .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');
}

enum ImperativTarget { duForm, ihrForm, sieForm, wirForm }

enum ImperativVowelChange {
  none,
  eToI,
  eToIe,
  umlautDropped,
  irregularSein,
}

extension ImperativTargetLabels on ImperativTarget {
  String get pronoun => switch (this) {
        ImperativTarget.duForm => 'du',
        ImperativTarget.ihrForm => 'ihr',
        ImperativTarget.sieForm => 'Sie',
        ImperativTarget.wirForm => 'wir',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        ImperativTarget.duForm => 'أنت · du',
        ImperativTarget.ihrForm => 'أنتم · ihr',
        ImperativTarget.sieForm => 'حضرتك / حضراتكم · Sie',
        ImperativTarget.wirForm => 'لنقم معاً · wir',
      };
}

extension ImperativVowelChangeLabels on ImperativVowelChange {
  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        ImperativVowelChange.none => 'بناء قياسي لصيغة الأمر',
        ImperativVowelChange.eToI => 'يتحوّل e إلى i',
        ImperativVowelChange.eToIe => 'يتحوّل e إلى ie',
        ImperativVowelChange.umlautDropped => 'يُحذف الـ Umlaut في صيغة du',
        ImperativVowelChange.irregularSein => 'فعل sein له صيغة أمر استثنائية',
      };
}

final class ImperativDrillItem {
  const ImperativDrillItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.infinitive,
    required this.target,
    required this.correctForm,
    required this.vowelChange,
    required this.referenceForm,
    required this.contextSentence,
    required this.explanationAr,
    this.acceptedForms = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final String infinitive;
  final ImperativTarget target;
  final String correctForm;
  final ImperativVowelChange vowelChange;
  final String referenceForm;
  final String contextSentence;
  final String explanationAr;
  final List<String> acceptedForms;
}

import 'imperativ_models.dart';

abstract interface class ImperativRepository {
  List<ImperativDrillItem> get allDrills;

  List<ImperativDrillItem> forTarget(ImperativTarget target);

  ImperativDrillItem? byId(String id);

  bool isCorrect(ImperativDrillItem item, String candidate);

  bool respectsImperativStructure(
    ImperativDrillItem item,
    String candidate,
  );

  String normalizeForComparison(String value);
}

class _MorphologyCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _MorphologyCard({
    required this.item,
    required this.revealAnswer,
  });

  final ImperativDrillItem item;
  final bool revealAnswer;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final (removed, added) = _changeTokens(item);
    return AppGlassCard(
      glowColor: AppColors.achievement,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          Text('ماذا تغيّر؟', style: AppTypography.title),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text(
            revealAnswer
                ? '${item.referenceForm}  →  ${item.correctForm}'
                : '${item.referenceForm}  →  _____',
            textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge?.copyWith(
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          Wrap(
            spacing: 8,
            runSpacing: 8,
            children: [
              _ChangeToken(
                label: 'محذوف / متغيّر',
                value: removed,
                color: AppColors.tertiary,
              ),
              _ChangeToken(
                label: 'المضاف / الناتج',
                value: added,
                color: AppColors.mastery,
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          Text(
            item.vowelChange.labelAr,
            style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
              color: AppColors.achievement,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  (String, String) _changeTokens(ImperativDrillItem item) {
    if (item.vowelChange == ImperativVowelChange.eToI) {
      return ('e + du/-st', 'i');
    }
    if (item.vowelChange == ImperativVowelChange.eToIe) {
      return ('e + du/-st', 'ie');
    }
    if (item.vowelChange == ImperativVowelChange.umlautDropped) {
      return ('Umlaut + du/-st', 'a/o/u');
    }
    if (item.vowelChange == ImperativVowelChange.irregularSein) {
      return ('bist / seid / sind', 'sei / seid / seien');
    }
    return switch (item.target) {
      ImperativTarget.duForm => ('du + -st', 'جذر الفعل'),
      ImperativTarget.ihrForm => ('ihr', 'صيغة ihr بلا ضمير'),
      ImperativTarget.sieForm => ('—', 'المصدر + Sie'),
      ImperativTarget.wirForm => ('—', 'المصدر + wir'),
    };
  }
}

                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyLarge?.copyWith(
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,

              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
}

      ),

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/infinitiv_models.dart';
import '../domain/infinitiv_repository.dart';

final class InfinitivNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  InfinitivNotifier({
    required InfinitivRepository repository,
  }) : _repository = repository;

  final InfinitivRepository _repository;

  List<InfinitivChallengeItem> _challenges =
      const <InfinitivChallengeItem>[];
  InfinitivChallengeItem? _currentChallenge;
  InfinitivClauseType? _filter;
  String? _selectedAnswer;
  bool? _isCorrect;
  bool _showExplanation = false;
  String _explanationAr = '';
  bool _isBusy = false;
  int _currentIndex = -1;
  int _answeredCount = 0;
  int _correctCount = 0;

  InfinitivChallengeItem? get currentChallenge => _currentChallenge;
  InfinitivClauseType? get filter => _filter;
  String? get selectedAnswer => _selectedAnswer;
  bool? get isCorrect => _isCorrect;
  bool get showExplanation => _showExplanation;
  String get explanationAr => _explanationAr;
  bool get isBusy => _isBusy;
  int get answeredCount => _answeredCount;
  int get correctCount => _correctCount;

  double get accuracy =>
      _answeredCount == 0 ? 0 : _correctCount / _answeredCount;

  void selectAnswer(String value) {
    if (_showExplanation || _isBusy) return;
    final challenge = _currentChallenge;
    if (challenge == null) return;

    final normalized = value.trim();
    if (!challenge.answerOptions.contains(normalized)) return;
    if (_selectedAnswer == normalized) return;

    _selectedAnswer = normalized;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> checkAnswer() async {
    final challenge = _currentChallenge;
    final answer = _selectedAnswer;
    if (challenge == null) {
      throw StateError('No active infinitive challenge.');
    }
    if (answer == null) {
      throw StateError('Select an answer before scoring.');
    }
    if (_showExplanation) {
      throw StateError('Current challenge has already been scored.');
    }

    _setBusy(true);
    try {
      final correct = await _repository.validateAnswer(
        challenge.id,
        answer,
      );

      _isCorrect = correct;
      _showExplanation = true;
      _explanationAr = challenge.ruleExplanationAr;
      _answeredCount += 1;
      if (correct) _correctCount += 1;
    } finally {
      _setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> nextChallenge() async {
    if (_isBusy) return;

    _setBusy(true);
    try {
      if (_challenges.isEmpty) {
        _challenges = await _repository.getChallenges(type: _filter);
      }

      if (_challenges.isEmpty) {
        _currentChallenge = null;
        _currentIndex = -1;
        _clearAttempt();
        return;
      }

      _currentIndex = (_currentIndex + 1) % _challenges.length;
      _currentChallenge = _challenges[_currentIndex];
      _clearAttempt();
    } finally {
      _setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> filterByType(InfinitivClauseType type) async {
    if (_isBusy) return;

    _setBusy(true);
    try {
      _filter = type;
      _challenges = await _repository.getChallenges(type: type);
      _currentIndex = _challenges.isEmpty ? -1 : 0;
      _currentChallenge =
          _challenges.isEmpty ? null : _challenges.first;
      _clearAttempt();
    } finally {
      _setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  void reset() {
    _challenges = const <InfinitivChallengeItem>[];
    _currentChallenge = null;
    _filter = null;
    _currentIndex = -1;
    _answeredCount = 0;
    _correctCount = 0;
    _clearAttempt();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void _clearAttempt() {
    _selectedAnswer = null;
    _isCorrect = null;
    _showExplanation = false;
    _explanationAr = '';
  }

  void _setBusy(bool value) {
    if (_isBusy == value) return;
    _isBusy = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

      ruleExplanationAr:

      requiresSameSubject: true,
    ),
  ];

  @override
  Future<List<InfinitivChallengeItem>> getChallenges({
    InfinitivClauseType? type,
  }) async {
    final result =
        type == null ? _bank : _bank.where((item) => item.type == type);
    return List<InfinitivChallengeItem>.unmodifiable(result);
  }

  @override
  Future<bool> validateAnswer(
    String challengeId,
    String constructedClause,
  ) async {
    final id = challengeId.trim();
    InfinitivChallengeItem? challenge;
    for (final item in _bank) {
      if (item.id == id) {
        challenge = item;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (challenge == null) return false;

    return _normalize(constructedClause) ==
        _normalize(challenge.correctConstruction);
  }

  static String _normalize(String value) {
    return value
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s*,\s*'), ', ')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[.!?]+$'), '')
        .trim();
  }
}

enum InfinitivClauseType {
  infinitivMitZu,
  umZu,
  ohneZu,
  anstattZu,
}

extension InfinitivClauseTypeMetadata on InfinitivClauseType {
  String get marker => switch (this) {
        InfinitivClauseType.infinitivMitZu => 'zu',
        InfinitivClauseType.umZu => 'um ... zu',
        InfinitivClauseType.ohneZu => 'ohne ... zu',
        InfinitivClauseType.anstattZu => 'anstatt ... zu',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        InfinitivClauseType.infinitivMitZu => 'Infinitiv mit zu',
        InfinitivClauseType.umZu => 'الغرض: um ... zu',
        InfinitivClauseType.ohneZu => 'بدون فعل: ohne ... zu',
        InfinitivClauseType.anstattZu => 'بدل فعل: anstatt ... zu',
      };
}

final class InfinitivChallengeItem {
  InfinitivChallengeItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.type,
    required this.mainClause,
    required this.infinitivePhrase,
    required this.correctConstruction,
    required List<String> answerOptions,
    required this.arabicTranslation,
    required this.ruleExplanationAr,
    required this.requiresSameSubject,
  }) : answerOptions = List<String>.unmodifiable(answerOptions) {
    if (id.trim().isEmpty || id.length > 160) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(id, 'id', 'invalid challenge id');
    }
    if (mainClause.trim().isEmpty ||
        infinitivePhrase.trim().isEmpty ||
        correctConstruction.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('challenge text must not be empty');
    }
    if (this.answerOptions.length < 2) {
      throw ArgumentError('at least two answer options are required');
    }
    if (!this.answerOptions.contains(correctConstruction)) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'answerOptions must contain correctConstruction exactly',
      );
    }
    if (arabicTranslation.trim().isEmpty ||
        ruleExplanationAr.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('Arabic guidance must not be empty');
    }
  }

  final String id;
  final InfinitivClauseType type;
  final String mainClause;
  final String infinitivePhrase;
  final String correctConstruction;
  final List<String> answerOptions;
  final String arabicTranslation;
  final String ruleExplanationAr;
  final bool requiresSameSubject;

  String get marker => type.marker;
}

    String challengeId,
    String constructedClause,
  );
}

class _InfinitivKonstruktionenScreenState
    extends State<InfinitivKonstruktionenScreen> {
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    Future<void>.microtask(widget.notifier.nextChallenge);
  }

  Future<void> _submit() => widget.notifier.checkAnswer();

  Future<void> _next() => widget.notifier.nextChallenge();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: widget.notifier,
      builder: (context, _) {
        final notifier = widget.notifier;
        final challenge = notifier.currentChallenge;

        return Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(
            title: Text(
              'Infinitiv mit zu',
              textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
          ),
          body: SafeArea(
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  _ScoreCard(notifier: notifier),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  _TypeFilter(
                    selected: notifier.filter,
                    busy: notifier.isBusy,
                    onSelected: notifier.filterByType,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  if (notifier.isBusy && challenge == null)
                    const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
                  else if (challenge == null)
                    AppGlassCard(
                      child: Text(
                        'لا توجد تمارين متاحة حاليًا.',
                        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                        style: AppTypography.body,
                      ),
                    )
                  else ...<Widget>[
                    _ChallengeCard(challenge: challenge),
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    _AnswerOptions(
                      challenge: challenge,
                      selected: notifier.selectedAnswer,
                      enabled:
                          !notifier.showExplanation && !notifier.isBusy,
                      onSelected: notifier.selectAnswer,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    if (!notifier.showExplanation)
                      FilledButton.icon(
                        onPressed:
                            notifier.selectedAnswer == null || notifier.isBusy
                                ? null
                                : _submit,
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.check_rounded),
                        label: Text(
                          'تحقق من الإجابة',
                          textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                          style: AppTypography.label,
                        ),
                      )
                    else ...<Widget>[
                      _ExplanationCard(
                        challenge: challenge,
                        isCorrect: notifier.isCorrect == true,
                        explanationAr: notifier.explanationAr,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      FilledButton.icon(
                        onPressed: notifier.isBusy ? null : _next,
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded),
                        label: Text(
                          'التحدي التالي',
                          textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                          style: AppTypography.label,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ],
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  }

Color _accentFor(InfinitivClauseType type) => switch (type) {
      InfinitivClauseType.infinitivMitZu => AppColors.primary,
      InfinitivClauseType.umZu => AppColors.mastery,
      InfinitivClauseType.ohneZu => AppColors.secondary,
      InfinitivClauseType.anstattZu => AppColors.tertiary,
    };

FILE: lib/features/komposita_builder/application/komposita_notifier.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../../../core/localization/german_article_style.dart';
import '../domain/komposita_models.dart';
import '../domain/komposita_repository.dart';

enum KompositaMode { deconstruct, assemble }

final class KompositaNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  KompositaNotifier({
    required KompositaRepository repository,
  }) : _repository = repository;

  final KompositaRepository _repository;

  List<KompositaChallengeItem> _challenges =
      const <KompositaChallengeItem>[];
  KompositaChallengeItem? _currentChallenge;
  KompositaMode _mode = KompositaMode.assemble;
  GermanArticle? _selectedArticle;
  LinkingElement? _selectedLinkingElement;
  List<String> _assembledParts = const <String>[];
  bool? _isCorrect;
  bool _showExplanation = false;
  String _explanationAr = '';
  bool _isBusy = false;
  int _currentIndex = -1;

  KompositaChallengeItem? get currentChallenge => _currentChallenge;
  KompositaMode get mode => _mode;
  GermanArticle? get selectedArticle => _selectedArticle;
  LinkingElement? get selectedLinkingElement => _selectedLinkingElement;
  List<String> get assembledParts => _assembledParts;
  bool? get isCorrect => _isCorrect;
  bool get showExplanation => _showExplanation;
  String get explanationAr => _explanationAr;
  bool get isBusy => _isBusy;

  void setMode(KompositaMode value) {
    if (_mode == value) return;
    _mode = value;
    _clearAttempt();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void choosePart(String rawWord) {
    final challenge = _currentChallenge;
    if (challenge == null || _showExplanation) return;

    final word = rawWord.trim();
    if (word.isEmpty) return;

    final allowedCount = challenge.parts
        .where((part) => part.word == word)
        .length;
    final selectedCount = _assembledParts
        .where((part) => part == word)
        .length;
    if (allowedCount == 0 || selectedCount >= allowedCount) return;

    _assembledParts = List<String>.unmodifiable(
      <String>[..._assembledParts, word],
    );
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void removeLastPart() {
    if (_assembledParts.isEmpty || _showExplanation) return;
    _assembledParts = List<String>.unmodifiable(
      _assembledParts.sublist(0, _assembledParts.length - 1),
    );
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearAssembly() {
    if (_assembledParts.isEmpty || _showExplanation) return;
    _assembledParts = const <String>[];
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void selectArticle(GermanArticle article) {
    if (_showExplanation) return;
    if (_selectedArticle == article) return;
    _selectedArticle = article;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void selectLinkingElement(LinkingElement element) {
    if (_showExplanation) return;
    if (_selectedLinkingElement == element) return;
    _selectedLinkingElement = element;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> checkComposition(
    List<String> orderedParts,
    LinkingElement linkingElement,
    GermanArticle finalArticle,
  ) async {
    final challenge = _currentChallenge;
    if (challenge == null) {
      throw StateError('No active Komposita challenge.');
    }
    if (_showExplanation) {
      throw StateError('Current challenge has already been scored.');
    }

    final normalizedParts = orderedParts
        .map((part) => part.trim())
        .where((part) => part.isNotEmpty)
        .toList(growable: false);
    if (normalizedParts.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        orderedParts,
        'orderedParts',
        'must contain at least one part',
      );
    }

    _setBusy(true);
    try {
      final correct = await _repository.validateComposition(
        challenge.id,
        orderedParts: normalizedParts,
        linkingElement: linkingElement,
        finalArticle: finalArticle,
      );

      _assembledParts = List<String>.unmodifiable(normalizedParts);
      _selectedLinkingElement = linkingElement;
      _selectedArticle = finalArticle;
      _isCorrect = correct;
      _showExplanation = true;
      _explanationAr = challenge.derivationExplanationAr;
    } finally {
      _setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> nextChallenge() async {
    if (_isBusy) return;

    _setBusy(true);
    try {
      if (_challenges.isEmpty) {
        _challenges = await _repository.getChallenges();
      }

      if (_challenges.isEmpty) {
        _currentChallenge = null;
        _currentIndex = -1;
        _clearAttempt();
        return;
      }

      _currentIndex = (_currentIndex + 1) % _challenges.length;
      _currentChallenge = _challenges[_currentIndex];
      _clearAttempt();
    } finally {
      _setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  void reset() {
    _challenges = const <KompositaChallengeItem>[];
    _currentChallenge = null;
    _mode = KompositaMode.assemble;
    _currentIndex = -1;
    _clearAttempt();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void _clearAttempt() {
    _selectedArticle = null;
    _selectedLinkingElement = null;
    _assembledParts = const <String>[];
    _isCorrect = null;
    _showExplanation = false;
    _explanationAr = '';
  }

  void _setBusy(bool value) {
    if (_isBusy == value) return;
    _isBusy = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

  @override
  Future<List<KompositaChallengeItem>> getChallenges({
    String? level,
    LinkingElement? linkingElement,
  }) async {
    final normalizedLevel = level?.trim().toUpperCase();
    final result = _bank.where((item) {
      if (normalizedLevel != null &&
          normalizedLevel.isNotEmpty &&
          item.level != normalizedLevel) {
        return false;
      }
      if (linkingElement != null &&
          item.linkingElement != linkingElement) {
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    }).toList(growable: false);

    return List<KompositaChallengeItem>.unmodifiable(result);
  }

  @override
  Future<bool> validateComposition(
    String challengeId, {
    required List<String> orderedParts,
    required LinkingElement linkingElement,
    required GermanArticle finalArticle,
  }) async {
    final normalizedId = challengeId.trim();
    KompositaChallengeItem? challenge;
    for (final item in _bank) {
      if (item.id == normalizedId) {
        challenge = item;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (challenge == null) return false;

    final normalizedParts = orderedParts
        .map((part) => part.trim().toLowerCase())
        .toList(growable: false);
    final expectedParts = challenge.parts
        .map((part) => part.word.trim().toLowerCase())
        .toList(growable: false);

    return _sameOrderedParts(normalizedParts, expectedParts) &&
        linkingElement == challenge.linkingElement &&
        finalArticle == challenge.finalArticle;
  }

  static bool _sameOrderedParts(
    List<String> submitted,
    List<String> expected,
  ) {
    if (submitted.length != expected.length) return false;
    for (var index = 0; index < expected.length; index++) {
      if (submitted[index] != expected[index]) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }
}

import '../../../core/localization/german_article_style.dart';

enum LinkingElement { none, s, es, n, en, er }

extension LinkingElementSurface on LinkingElement {
  String get surface => switch (this) {
        LinkingElement.none => '',
        LinkingElement.s => 's',
        LinkingElement.es => 'es',
        LinkingElement.n => 'n',
        LinkingElement.en => 'en',
        LinkingElement.er => 'er',
      };
}

final class CompoundWordPart {
  const CompoundWordPart({
    required this.word,
    required this.arabicMeaning,
    required this.originalArticle,
  })  : assert(word.length > 0),
        assert(arabicMeaning.length > 0);

  final String word;
  final String arabicMeaning;
  final GermanArticle originalArticle;
}

final class KompositaChallengeItem {
  KompositaChallengeItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.compoundWord,
    required List<CompoundWordPart> parts,
    required this.linkingElement,
    required this.finalArticle,
    required this.articleRuleAr,
    required this.overallMeaningAr,
    required this.derivationExplanationAr,
    required this.level,
  }) : parts = List<CompoundWordPart>.unmodifiable(parts) {
    if (id.trim().isEmpty || id.length > 160) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(id, 'id', 'invalid challenge id');
    }
    if (compoundWord.trim().isEmpty || compoundWord.length > 120) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        compoundWord,
        'compoundWord',
        'invalid compound word',
      );
    }
    if (this.parts.length < 2) {
      throw ArgumentError('a compound challenge requires at least two parts');
    }
    if (this.parts.last.originalArticle != finalArticle) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'finalArticle must match the article of the final compound part',
      );
    }
    if (!const <String>{'A1', 'A2', 'B1'}.contains(level)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(level, 'level', 'must be A1, A2 or B1');
    }
  }

  static const String canonicalArticleRuleAr =
      'الأداة تحددها الكلمة الأخيرة دائماً.';

  final String id;
  final String compoundWord;
  final List<CompoundWordPart> parts;
  final LinkingElement linkingElement;
  final GermanArticle finalArticle;
  final String articleRuleAr;
  final String overallMeaningAr;
  final String derivationExplanationAr;
  final String level;

  String get displayWithArticle =>
      '${finalArticle.name} ${compoundWord.trim()}';

  List<String> get orderedPartWords => List<String>.unmodifiable(
        parts.map((part) => part.word),
      );
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../core/localization/german_article_style.dart';
import '../../../design_system/app_colors.dart';
import '../../../design_system/app_glass_card.dart';
import '../../../design_system/app_typography.dart';
import '../application/komposita_notifier.dart';
import '../domain/komposita_models.dart';

class KompositaBuilderScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const KompositaBuilderScreen({
    required this.notifier,
    super.key,
  });

  final KompositaNotifier notifier;

  @override
  State<KompositaBuilderScreen> createState() =>
      _KompositaBuilderScreenState();
}

class _KompositaBuilderScreenState extends State<KompositaBuilderScreen> {
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    Future<void>.microtask(widget.notifier.nextChallenge);
  }

  Future<void> _submit() async {
    final notifier = widget.notifier;
    final linking = notifier.selectedLinkingElement;
    final article = notifier.selectedArticle;
    if (linking == null || article == null || notifier.assembledParts.isEmpty) {
      return;
    }

    await notifier.checkComposition(
      notifier.assembledParts,
      linking,
      article,
    );
  }

  Future<void> _next() => widget.notifier.nextChallenge();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: widget.notifier,
      builder: (context, _) {
        final notifier = widget.notifier;
        final challenge = notifier.currentChallenge;

        return Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(
            title: Text(
              'Komposita Builder',
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
          ),
          body: Directionality(
            textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
            child: SafeArea(
              child: ListView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                children: <Widget>[
                  _ModeSelector(
                    mode: notifier.mode,
                    onChanged: notifier.setMode,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  if (notifier.isBusy && challenge == null)
                    const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
                  else if (challenge == null)
                    AppGlassCard(
                      child: Text(
                        'لا توجد تحديات Komposita متاحة حاليًا.',
                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                        style: AppTypography.body,
                      ),
                    )
                  else if (notifier.mode == KompositaMode.deconstruct)
                    _DeconstructView(challenge: challenge)
                  else
                    _AssembleView(
                      challenge: challenge,
                      notifier: notifier,
                      onSubmit: _submit,
                      onNext: _next,
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

    required this.onChanged,

  final KompositaMode mode;
  final ValueChanged<KompositaMode> onChanged;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AppGlassCard(

      borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(68),
      child: SegmentedButton<KompositaMode>(
        segments: const <ButtonSegment<KompositaMode>>[
          ButtonSegment<KompositaMode>(
            value: KompositaMode.assemble,
            label: Text('تركيب'),
            icon: Icon(Icons.extension_rounded),
          ),
          ButtonSegment<KompositaMode>(
            value: KompositaMode.deconstruct,
            label: Text('تفكيك'),
            icon: Icon(Icons.account_tree_outlined),
          ),
        ],
        selected: <KompositaMode>{mode},
        onSelectionChanged: (selection) {
          if (selection.isNotEmpty) onChanged(selection.first);
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _PartsBreakdown extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PartsBreakdown({required this.challenge});

  final KompositaChallengeItem challenge;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final children = <Widget>[];

    for (var index = 0; index < challenge.parts.length; index++) {
      final part = challenge.parts[index];
      children.add(
        Expanded(
          child: _PartDetailCard(
            part: part,
            label: index == challenge.parts.length - 1
                ? 'Grundwort'
                : 'Bestimmungswort',
          ),
        ),
      );

      if (index < challenge.parts.length - 1) {
        children.add(
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: <Widget>[
                const Icon(
                  Icons.add_rounded,
                  color: AppColors.secondary,
                ),
                Text(
                  challenge.linkingElement == LinkingElement.none
                      ? '—'
                      : '+${challenge.linkingElement.surface}',
                  textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                  style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
                    color: AppColors.secondary,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        );
      }
    }

    return AppGlassCard(
      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
        children: children,
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _AssembleView extends StatelessWidget {
  const _AssembleView({
    required this.challenge,
    required this.notifier,
    required this.onSubmit,
    required this.onNext,
  });

  final KompositaChallengeItem challenge;
  final KompositaNotifier notifier;
  final Future<void> Function() onSubmit;
  final Future<void> Function() onNext;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final availableParts = challenge.parts
        .where((part) {
          final requiredCount = challenge.parts
              .where((candidate) => candidate.word == part.word)
              .length;
          final usedCount = notifier.assembledParts
              .where((word) => word == part.word)
              .length;
          return usedCount < requiredCount;
        })
        .toList(growable: false);

    return Column(
      children: <Widget>[
        AppGlassCard(
          borderColor: AppColors.secondary.withAlpha(78),
          glowColor: AppColors.secondary,
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: <Widget>[
              Text(
                'ركّب الكلمة المناسبة للمعنى:',
                style: AppTypography.label,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Text(
                challenge.overallMeaningAr,
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                style: AppTypography.title,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 5),
              Text(
                'المستوى: ${challenge.level}',
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
                  color: AppColors.secondary,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 14),
        _PuzzleSource(
          parts: availableParts,
          enabled: !notifier.showExplanation,
          onSelected: notifier.choosePart,
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 14),
        _AssemblyTarget(
          parts: notifier.assembledParts,
          enabled: !notifier.showExplanation,
          onAccepted: notifier.choosePart,
          onUndo: notifier.removeLastPart,
          onClear: notifier.clearAssembly,
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 14),
        _LinkingElementSelector(
          selected: notifier.selectedLinkingElement,
          enabled: !notifier.showExplanation,
          onSelected: notifier.selectLinkingElement,
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 14),
        _ArticleSelector(
          selected: notifier.selectedArticle,
          enabled: !notifier.showExplanation,
          onSelected: notifier.selectArticle,
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 14),
        _ArticleRuleCard(
          challenge: challenge,
          selectedArticle: notifier.selectedArticle,
          lastPartWord: notifier.assembledParts.isEmpty
              ? null
              : notifier.assembledParts.last,
          revealed: notifier.showExplanation,
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 14),
        if (!notifier.showExplanation)
          FilledButton.icon(
            onPressed: notifier.isBusy ||
                    notifier.assembledParts.length != challenge.parts.length ||
                    notifier.selectedArticle == null ||
                    notifier.selectedLinkingElement == null
                ? null
                : onSubmit,
            icon: const Icon(Icons.check_rounded),
            label: const Text('تحقق من التركيب'),
          )
        else ...<Widget>[
          _ResultCard(
            challenge: challenge,
            isCorrect: notifier.isCorrect == true,
            explanationAr: notifier.explanationAr,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          FilledButton.icon(
            onPressed: notifier.isBusy ? null : onNext,
            icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded),
            label: const Text('الكلمة التالية'),
          ),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _PuzzleSource extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PuzzleSource({
    required this.parts,
    required this.enabled,
    required this.onSelected,
  });

  final List<CompoundWordPart> parts;
  final bool enabled;
  final ValueChanged<String> onSelected;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AppGlassCard(
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          Text('قطع البازل', style: AppTypography.title),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          Wrap(
            alignment: WrapAlignment.center,
            spacing: 10,
            runSpacing: 10,
            children: parts
                .map(
                  (part) => _DraggablePart(
                    part: part,
                    enabled: enabled,
                    onTap: () => onSelected(part.word),
                  ),
                )
                .toList(growable: false),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

class _DraggablePart extends StatelessWidget {
  const _DraggablePart({
    required this.part,
    required this.enabled,
    required this.onTap,
  });

  final CompoundWordPart part;
  final bool enabled;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final color = _articleColor(part.originalArticle);
    final piece = _PuzzlePiece(part: part, color: color);

    return Draggable<String>(
      data: part.word,
      maxSimultaneousDrags: enabled ? 1 : 0,
      feedback: Material(
        color: Colors.transparent,
        child: SizedBox(width: 130, child: piece),
      ),
      childWhenDragging: Opacity(opacity: .32, child: piece),
      child: GestureDetector(
        onTap: enabled ? onTap : null,
        child: piece,
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _AssemblyTarget extends StatelessWidget {
  const _AssemblyTarget({
    required this.parts,
    required this.enabled,
    required this.onAccepted,
    required this.onUndo,
    required this.onClear,
  });

  final List<String> parts;
  final bool enabled;
  final ValueChanged<String> onAccepted;
  final VoidCallback onUndo;
  final VoidCallback onClear;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return DragTarget<String>(
      onWillAcceptWithDetails: (_) => enabled,
      onAcceptWithDetails: (details) => onAccepted(details.data),
      builder: (context, candidates, rejected) {
        final active = candidates.isNotEmpty;
        return AppGlassCard(
          blur: 20,
          opacity: active ? .18 : .12,
          borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(active ? 140 : 72),
          glowColor: active ? AppColors.primary : null,
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: <Widget>[
              Row(
                children: <Widget>[
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      'منطقة التركيب',
                      style: AppTypography.title,
                    ),
                  ),
                  IconButton(
                    onPressed: enabled && parts.isNotEmpty ? onUndo : null,
                    tooltip: 'تراجع',
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.undo_rounded),
                  ),
                  IconButton(
                    onPressed: enabled && parts.isNotEmpty ? onClear : null,
                    tooltip: 'مسح',
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.clear_all_rounded),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              if (parts.isEmpty)
                Text(
                  'اسحب القطع إلى هنا أو اضغط عليها بالترتيب.',
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  style: AppTypography.body,
                )
              else
                Wrap(
                  alignment: WrapAlignment.center,
                  spacing: 7,
                  runSpacing: 7,
                  children: parts
                      .map(
                        (part) => DecoratedBox(
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(18),
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                            border: Border.all(
                              color: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(72),
                            ),
                          ),
                          child: Padding(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                              horizontal: 12,
                              vertical: 8,
                            ),
                            child: Text(
                              part,
                              textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                              style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(
                                color: AppColors.primary,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      )
                      .toList(growable: false),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

Color _articleColor(GermanArticle article) => switch (article) {
      GermanArticle.der => AppColors.articleDer,
      GermanArticle.die => AppColors.articleDie,
      GermanArticle.das => AppColors.articleDas,
    };

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/konjunktiv_models.dart';
import '../domain/konjunktiv_repository.dart';

final class KonjunktivNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  KonjunktivNotifier(this._repository);

  final KonjunktivRepository _repository;

  List<KonjunktivChallengeItem> _challenges =
      const <KonjunktivChallengeItem>[];
  KonjunktivChallengeItem? _currentChallenge;
  List<String> _options = const <String>[];
  String? _selectedAnswer;
  bool? _isCorrect;
  String? _feedbackExplanation;
  KonjunktivUsage? _activeUsage;
  int _currentIndex = -1;
  bool _isBusy = false;

  KonjunktivChallengeItem? get currentChallenge => _currentChallenge;

  List<String> get options => _options;

  String? get selectedAnswer => _selectedAnswer;

  bool? get isCorrect => _isCorrect;

  String? get feedbackExplanation => _feedbackExplanation;

  KonjunktivUsage? get activeUsage => _activeUsage;

  bool get isBusy => _isBusy;

  Future<void> nextChallenge() async {
    if (_isBusy) return;
    _isBusy = true;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      if (_challenges.isEmpty) {
        _challenges = await _repository.getChallenges(
          usage: _activeUsage,
        );
        _currentIndex = -1;
      }
      await _selectNextFromLoaded();
    } finally {
      _isBusy = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  Future<void> filterByUsage(KonjunktivUsage? usage) async {
    if (_isBusy) return;
    _isBusy = true;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      _activeUsage = usage;
      _challenges = await _repository.getChallenges(usage: usage);
      _currentIndex = -1;
      _currentChallenge = null;
      _options = const <String>[];
      _clearAnswerState();
      await _selectNextFromLoaded();
    } finally {
      _isBusy = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  Future<void> checkKonjunktivAnswer(
    String conjugatedForm, [
    String? constructedSentence,
  ]) async {
    if (_isBusy) return;
    final challenge = _currentChallenge;
    if (challenge == null) return;

    final answer = conjugatedForm.trim();
    if (answer.isEmpty) {
      _selectedAnswer = '';
      _isCorrect = false;
      _feedbackExplanation = 'اختر صيغة قبل التحقق.';
      notifyListeners();
      return;
    }

    _isBusy = true;
    _selectedAnswer = answer;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      final sentence =
          constructedSentence ?? challenge.konjunktivSentence;
      final results = await Future.wait<bool>(<Future<bool>>[
        _repository.validateConjugation(challenge.id, answer),
        _repository.validateSentence(challenge.id, sentence),
      ]);
      final formCorrect = results[0];
      final sentenceCorrect = results[1];
      _isCorrect = formCorrect && sentenceCorrect;
      _feedbackExplanation = _feedbackFor(
        challenge: challenge,
        formCorrect: formCorrect,
        sentenceCorrect: sentenceCorrect,
      );
    } finally {
      _isBusy = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _selectNextFromLoaded() async {
    if (_challenges.isEmpty) {
      _currentChallenge = null;
      _options = const <String>[];
      _clearAnswerState();
      _feedbackExplanation =
          'لا توجد تحديات متاحة لهذا التصنيف حالياً.';
      return;
    }

    _currentIndex = (_currentIndex + 1) % _challenges.length;
    _currentChallenge = _challenges[_currentIndex];
    _options = await _repository.getAnswerOptions(
      _currentChallenge!.id,
    );
    _clearAnswerState();
  }

  void _clearAnswerState() {
    _selectedAnswer = null;
    _isCorrect = null;
    _feedbackExplanation = null;
  }

  String _feedbackFor({
    required KonjunktivChallengeItem challenge,
    required bool formCorrect,
    required bool sentenceCorrect,
  }) {
    if (formCorrect && sentenceCorrect) {
      return challenge.arabicExplanation;
    }

    if (!formCorrect && !sentenceCorrect) {
      return 'التصريف وتركيب الجملة يحتاجان مراجعة. '
          '${challenge.arabicExplanation}';
    }

    if (!formCorrect) {
      final expected =
          _options.isEmpty ? 'الصيغة الصحيحة' : _options.first;
      return 'الصيغة المختارة غير صحيحة؛ راجع ${expected}. '
          '${challenge.arabicExplanation}';
    }

    return 'التصريف صحيح، لكن ترتيب الجملة لا يطابق الصياغة المستهدفة. '
        '${challenge.arabicExplanation}';
  }
}

  @override
  Future<List<KonjunktivChallengeItem>> getChallenges({
    KonjunktivUsage? usage,
  }) async {
    final items = usage == null
        ? _records
        : _records.where((record) => record.item.usage == usage);
    return List<KonjunktivChallengeItem>.unmodifiable(
      items.map((record) => record.item),
    );
  }

  @override
  Future<List<String>> getAnswerOptions(String challengeId) async {
    final record = _recordFor(challengeId);
    if (record == null) return const <String>[];
    return List<String>.unmodifiable(record.options);
  }

  @override
  Future<bool> validateConjugation(
    String challengeId,
    String conjugatedForm,
  ) async {
    final record = _recordFor(challengeId);
    if (record == null) return false;
    final submitted = _normalizeForm(conjugatedForm);
    return record.acceptedForms
        .map(_normalizeForm)
        .contains(submitted);
  }

  @override
  Future<bool> validateSentence(
    String challengeId,
    String constructedSentence,
  ) async {
    final record = _recordFor(challengeId);
    if (record == null) return false;
    return _normalizeSentence(constructedSentence) ==
        _normalizeSentence(record.item.konjunktivSentence);
  }

  static _KonjunktivRecord? _recordFor(String challengeId) {
    final id = challengeId.trim();
    for (final record in _records) {
      if (record.item.id == id) return record;
    }
    return null;
  }

  static String _normalizeForm(String value) {
    return value.trim().toLowerCase().replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');
  }

  static String _normalizeSentence(String value) {
    return value
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll('„', '"')
        .replaceAll('“', '"')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+([,;:!?])'), r'$1')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[.!?]+$'), '')
        .trim();
  }
}

final class _KonjunktivRecord {
  const _KonjunktivRecord({
    required this.item,
    required this.acceptedForms,
    required this.options,
  });

  final KonjunktivChallengeItem item;
  final List<String> acceptedForms;
  final List<String> options;
}

FILE: lib/features/konjunktiv_ii/domain/konjunktiv_models.dart
--------------------------------------------------
enum KonjunktivUsage {
  politeRequest,
  unrealWish,
  hypotheticalCondition,
  advice,
}

enum KonjunktivFormType {
  auxiliaryWuerde,
  coreOriginal,
}

final class KonjunktivChallengeItem {
  const KonjunktivChallengeItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.indicativeSentence,
    required this.konjunktivSentence,
    required this.targetVerb,
    required this.formType,
    required this.personalPronoun,
    required this.usage,
    required this.arabicTranslation,
    required this.arabicExplanation,
  })  : assert(id.length > 0),
        assert(indicativeSentence.length > 0),
        assert(konjunktivSentence.length > 0),
        assert(targetVerb.length > 0),
        assert(personalPronoun.length > 0),
        assert(arabicTranslation.length > 0),
        assert(arabicExplanation.length > 0);

  final String id;
  final String indicativeSentence;
  final String konjunktivSentence;
  final String targetVerb;
  final KonjunktivFormType formType;
  final String personalPronoun;
  final KonjunktivUsage usage;
  final String arabicTranslation;
  final String arabicExplanation;
}

extension KonjunktivUsageLabel on KonjunktivUsage {

import 'dart:async';


import '../../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import '../application/konjunktiv_notifier.dart';
import '../domain/konjunktiv_models.dart';

final class KonjunktivScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const KonjunktivScreen({
    required this.notifier,
    super.key,
  });

  final KonjunktivNotifier notifier;

  @override
  State<KonjunktivScreen> createState() => _KonjunktivScreenState();
}

final class _KonjunktivScreenState extends State<KonjunktivScreen> {
  String? _selectedOption;

  KonjunktivNotifier get notifier => widget.notifier;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    notifier.addListener(_refresh);
    if (notifier.currentChallenge == null) {
      unawaited(notifier.nextChallenge());
    }
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant KonjunktivScreen oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.notifier == notifier) return;
    oldWidget.notifier.removeListener(_refresh);
    notifier.addListener(_refresh);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    notifier.removeListener(_refresh);
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _refresh() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  Future<void> _selectUsage(KonjunktivUsage? usage) async {
    setState(() => _selectedOption = null);
    await notifier.filterByUsage(usage);
  }

  Future<void> _next() async {
    setState(() => _selectedOption = null);
    await notifier.nextChallenge();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final challenge = notifier.currentChallenge;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: Text('ساحة Konjunktiv II', style: AppTypography.title),
          backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
          elevation: 0,
        ),
        body: SafeArea(
          top: false,
          child: challenge == null
              ? _EmptyState(
                  isBusy: notifier.isBusy,
                  message: notifier.feedbackExplanation,
                  onRetry: () => unawaited(notifier.nextChallenge()),
                )
              : ListView(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 10, 16, 28),
                  children: <Widget>[
                    _UsageFilter(
                      activeUsage: notifier.activeUsage,
                      enabled: !notifier.isBusy,
                      onSelected: (usage) =>
                          unawaited(_selectUsage(usage)),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    _ToneIndicator(
                      usage: challenge.usage,
                      dark: dark,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    _RealityCard(
                      challenge: challenge,
                      dark: dark,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    _PromptCard(
                      challenge: challenge,
                      dark: dark,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    Text(
                      'اختر الصيغة الأنسب',
                      style: AppTypography.title,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 3),
                    Text(
                      'هل تحتاج صيغة أصلية مثل wäre / hätte / könnte، أم würde + Infinitiv؟',
                      style: AppTypography.body,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 9),
                    _AnswerOptions(
                      options: notifier.options,
                      selected: _selectedOption,
                      enabled: !notifier.isBusy &&
                          notifier.isCorrect == null,
                      onSelected: (value) {
                        setState(() => _selectedOption = value);
                      },
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    _CheckButton(
                      enabled: _selectedOption != null &&
                          !notifier.isBusy &&
                          notifier.isCorrect == null,
                      onTap: () => unawaited(
                        notifier.checkKonjunktivAnswer(
                          _selectedOption!,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (notifier.isCorrect != null) ...<Widget>[
                      const SizedBox(height: 14),
                      _FeedbackCard(
                        challenge: challenge,
                        isCorrect: notifier.isCorrect!,
                        explanation:
                            notifier.feedbackExplanation ?? '',
                        dark: dark,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      AppGlassCard(
                        onTap: notifier.isBusy
                            ? null
                            : () => unawaited(_next()),
                        borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(92),
                        glowColor: AppColors.primary,
                        backgroundColor: dark
                            ? AppColors.darkSurface
                            : AppColors.lightSurface,
                        child: Row(

                          children: <Widget>[
                            const Icon(
                              Icons.arrow_back_rounded,
                              color: AppColors.primary,
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(width: 8),
                            Text(
                              'التحدي التالي',
                              style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(
                                color: dark
                                    ? AppColors.primaryDark
                                    : AppColors.primary,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],

FILE: lib/features/learning/application/local_learning_recovery_controller.dart

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../../../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../../../services/repository.dart';
import '../../session/universal_session_orchestrator.dart';
import '../domain/local_learning_recovery.dart';

/// Application boundary for return-time local learning recovery.
///
/// Reads only the canonical pair-scoped progress authority and delegates every
/// answer write to [UniversalSessionOrchestrator]. No recovery-specific progress
/// store is created.
final class LocalLearningRecoveryController extends ChangeNotifier {
  LocalLearningRecoveryController({
    required LearnerRepository repository,
    required UniversalSessionOrchestrator sessionOrchestrator,
    required LearningRecoveryContentLookup contentLookup,
    LocalLearningRecoveryPlanner planner =
        const LocalLearningRecoveryPlanner(),
  })  : _repository = repository,
        _sessionOrchestrator = sessionOrchestrator,
        _contentLookup = contentLookup,
        _planner = planner;

  final LearnerRepository _repository;
  final UniversalSessionOrchestrator _sessionOrchestrator;
  final LearningRecoveryContentLookup _contentLookup;
  final LocalLearningRecoveryPlanner _planner;

  int _requestGeneration = 0;
  bool _checking = false;
  LocalLearningRecoveryPlan? _plan;

  bool get isChecking => _checking;
  LocalLearningRecoveryPlan? get plan => _plan;
  bool get hasRecovery => _plan != null;

  Future<LocalLearningRecoveryPlan?> refreshOnReturn({
    DateTime? now,
  }) async {
    final generation = ++_requestGeneration;
    _checking = true;
    notifyListeners();

    try {
      final snapshot = await _repository.loadPairProgress();
      final next = _planner.build(
        snapshot: snapshot,
        contentLookup: _contentLookup,
        now: now,
      );
      if (generation != _requestGeneration) return _plan;
      _plan = next;
      return _plan;
    } on Object {
      if (generation == _requestGeneration) {
        _plan = null;
      }
      return null;
    } finally {
      if (generation == _requestGeneration) {
        _checking = false;
        notifyListeners();
      }
    }
  }

  Future<SessionStateSnapshot> record({
    required LocalLearningRecoveryItem recoveryItem,
    required String answer,
    required bool correct,
    required int seconds,
    bool hinted = false,
  }) {
    return _sessionOrchestrator.record(
      SessionReviewInput<LearningContent>(
        item: recoveryItem.item,
        answer: answer,
        correct: correct,
        seconds: seconds.clamp(1, 3600).toInt(),
        hinted: hinted,
        facetType: recoveryItem.facetType,
        variantKey: recoveryItem.variantKey,
        skillOverride: recoveryItem.item.skill,
      ),
    );
  }

  void dismiss() {
    if (_plan == null) return;
    _plan = null;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}


--------------------------------------------------
FILE: lib/features/learning/application/local_learning_recovery_session_coordinator.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import '../../session/universal_session_orchestrator.dart';
import '../data/local_learning_recovery_state_store.dart';
import '../domain/local_learning_recovery.dart';
import '../domain/local_learning_recovery_resume.dart';
import 'local_learning_recovery_controller.dart';

final class LocalLearningRecoverySessionCoordinator {
  LocalLearningRecoverySessionCoordinator({
    required LocalLearningRecoveryController controller,
    required LocalLearningRecoveryStateStore stateStore,
    LocalLearningRecoveryResumePlanner resumePlanner =
        const LocalLearningRecoveryResumePlanner(),
    DateTime Function()? clock,
  })  : _controller = controller,
        _stateStore = stateStore,
        _resumePlanner = resumePlanner,
        _clock = clock ?? DateTime.now;

  static const Duration newPromptCooldown = Duration(hours: 12);
  static const Duration resumePromptCooldown = Duration(minutes: 45);

  final LocalLearningRecoveryController _controller;
  final LocalLearningRecoveryStateStore _stateStore;
  final LocalLearningRecoveryResumePlanner _resumePlanner;
  final DateTime Function() _clock;

  Future<LocalLearningRecoverySession?> prepare(
    LocalLearningRecoveryPlan plan,
  ) async {
    final now = _clock().toUtc();
    final cursor = await _stateStore.loadCursor(plan.pairKey);
    final session = _resumePlanner.restore(
      plan: plan,
      cursor: cursor,
      now: now,
    );

    if (cursor != null && !session.resumed) {
      await _stateStore.clearCursor(plan.pairKey);
    }

    final lastPrompt = await _stateStore.loadLastPromptAt(plan.pairKey);
    if (lastPrompt != null) {
      if (now.isBefore(lastPrompt)) return null;
      final cooldown =
          session.resumed ? resumePromptCooldown : newPromptCooldown;
      if (now.difference(lastPrompt) < cooldown) return null;
    }
    return session;
  }

  Future<void> markPrompted(LocalLearningRecoverySession session) {
    return _stateStore.markPrompted(
      session.plan.pairKey,
      _clock().toUtc(),
    );
  }

  Future<void> begin(LocalLearningRecoverySession session) {
    return _stateStore.saveCursor(
      LocalLearningRecoveryResumeCursor(
        pairKey: session.plan.pairKey,
        createdAtUtc: _clock().toUtc(),
        remainingReviewKeys:
            session.plan.items.map((item) => item.reviewKey),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<SessionStateSnapshot> record({
    required LocalLearningRecoverySession session,
    required int itemIndex,
    required bool correct,
    required Duration elapsed,
  }) async {
    final items = session.plan.items;
    if (itemIndex < 0 || itemIndex >= items.length) {
      throw RangeError.index(itemIndex, items, 'itemIndex');
    }
    final item = items[itemIndex];
    final snapshot = await _controller.record(
      recoveryItem: item,
      answer: correct
          ? 'local_learning_recovery:remembered'
          : 'local_learning_recovery:missed',
      correct: correct,
      seconds: elapsed.inSeconds.clamp(1, 3600).toInt(),
      hinted: false,
    );

    final cursor = await _stateStore.loadCursor(session.plan.pairKey);
    final remaining = cursor == null
        ? items
            .skip(itemIndex + 1)
            .map((candidate) => candidate.reviewKey)
            .toList(growable: false)
        : cursor.remainingReviewKeys
            .where((key) => key != item.reviewKey)
            .toList(growable: false);

    if (remaining.isEmpty) {
      await _stateStore.clearCursor(session.plan.pairKey);
    } else {
      await _stateStore.saveCursor(
        LocalLearningRecoveryResumeCursor(
          pairKey: session.plan.pairKey,
          createdAtUtc: cursor?.createdAtUtc ?? _clock().toUtc(),
          remainingReviewKeys: remaining,
        ),
      );
    }
    return snapshot;
  }
}

import '../../../core/models/language_catalog_models.dart';
import '../../../core/packs/pack_models.dart';
import '../../../core/progress/offline_pair_progress_engine.dart';
import '../../../core/storage/local_db/pair_progress_database.dart';
import '../../../services/repository.dart';
import '../../../services/sqlite_policy.dart';

/// Owns the database connection used by the existing canonical pair-progress
/// authority. It does not introduce a second progress model or scheduler.
final class LocalLearningRecoveryPairProgressLease {
  const LocalLearningRecoveryPairProgressLease._(this._store);

  static const String databaseFileName = 'pair_progress_v2.db';

  final PairProgressDatabase? _store;

  static Future<LocalLearningRecoveryPairProgressLease> bind({
    required LearnerRepository repository,
    required String sourceLanguageId,
    required String targetLanguageId,
    required bool sourceIsRtl,
    required bool targetIsRtl,
    required int migratedAchievementPoints,
    AppSqlitePolicy sqlitePolicy = const AppSqlitePolicy(),
  }) async {
    if (repository.hasPairProgressAuthority) {
      return const LocalLearningRecoveryPairProgressLease._(null);
    }

    final request = PackPairRequest(
      sourceLanguageTag: sourceLanguageId,
      targetLanguageTag: targetLanguageId,
    );
    final path = await sqlitePolicy.resolvePath(fileName: databaseFileName);
    final database = await sqlitePolicy.openWritable(
      path: path,
      version: PairProgressDatabase.schemaVersion,
    );

    try {
      final store = await PairProgressDatabase.attach(database);
      final engine = OfflinePairProgressEngine(store);
      final pair = ResolvedLanguagePair(
        source: LanguageMetadata(
          id: request.source,
          name: request.source.toUpperCase(),
          isRtl: sourceIsRtl,
        ),
        target: LanguageMetadata(
          id: request.target,
          name: request.target.toUpperCase(),
          isRtl: targetIsRtl,
        ),
        pairKey: request.pairKey,
        generation: 0,
        route: PackRouteDecision(
          request: request,
          availability: PackAvailabilityStatus.available,
          status: PackAcquisitionStatus.localReady,
          localPack: null,
          providerCandidates: const <String>[],
        ),
      );

      final legacy = repository.load();
      final needsMigration = legacy.reviewCards.isNotEmpty ||
          legacy.learned.isNotEmpty ||
          legacy.review.isNotEmpty;
      await repository.bindPairProgressAuthority(
        engine: engine,
        pair: pair,
        migrateLegacy: needsMigration,
        migratedAchievementPoints: migratedAchievementPoints,
      );
      return LocalLearningRecoveryPairProgressLease._(store);
    } on Object {
      await database.close();
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    await _store?.close();
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';

import '../../../services/preferences_service.dart';
import '../domain/local_learning_recovery_resume.dart';

abstract interface class LocalLearningRecoveryStateStore {
  Future<LocalLearningRecoveryResumeCursor?> loadCursor(String pairKey);
  Future<void> saveCursor(LocalLearningRecoveryResumeCursor cursor);
  Future<void> clearCursor(String pairKey);
  Future<DateTime?> loadLastPromptAt(String pairKey);
  Future<void> markPrompted(String pairKey, DateTime at);
}

/// Stores orchestration-only recovery metadata.
///
/// This store never persists mastery, SRS due dates, scores, XP, streaks, or
/// learner progress. Canonical progress remains owned by LearnerRepository and
/// its pair-scoped progress authority.
final class PreferencesLocalLearningRecoveryStateStore
    implements LocalLearningRecoveryStateStore {
  const PreferencesLocalLearningRecoveryStateStore(this._preferences);

  static const String _cursorPrefix = 'local_learning_recovery_cursor_v1:';
  static const String _promptPrefix = 'local_learning_recovery_prompt_v1:';

  final PreferencesService _preferences;

  @override
  Future<LocalLearningRecoveryResumeCursor?> loadCursor(String pairKey) async {
    final storageKey = _key(_cursorPrefix, pairKey);
    final raw = _preferences.getString(storageKey);
    if (raw == null || raw.trim().isEmpty) return null;
    try {
      final cursor =
          LocalLearningRecoveryResumeCursor.fromJson(jsonDecode(raw));
      if (cursor == null || cursor.pairKey != pairKey.trim()) {
        await _preferences.remove(storageKey);
        return null;
      }
      return cursor;
    } on FormatException {
      await _preferences.remove(storageKey);
      return null;
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> saveCursor(LocalLearningRecoveryResumeCursor cursor) async {
    final written = await _preferences.setString(
      _key(_cursorPrefix, cursor.pairKey),
      jsonEncode(cursor.toJson()),
    );
    if (!written) {
      throw StateError('local_learning_recovery_cursor_write_failed');
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> clearCursor(String pairKey) async {
    await _preferences.remove(_key(_cursorPrefix, pairKey));
  }

  @override
  Future<DateTime?> loadLastPromptAt(String pairKey) async {
    final raw = _preferences.getString(_key(_promptPrefix, pairKey));
    return DateTime.tryParse(raw ?? '')?.toUtc();
  }

  @override
  Future<void> markPrompted(String pairKey, DateTime at) async {
    final written = await _preferences.setString(
      _key(_promptPrefix, pairKey),
      at.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
    );
    if (!written) {
      throw StateError('local_learning_recovery_prompt_write_failed');
    }
  }

  static String _key(String prefix, String pairKey) {
    final normalized = pairKey.trim();
    if (normalized.isEmpty || normalized.length > 80) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(pairKey, 'pairKey', 'invalid pair key');
    }
    final encoded =
        base64Url.encode(utf8.encode(normalized)).replaceAll('=', '');
    return '$prefix$encoded';
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/learning/domain/adaptive_error_bank.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'dart:math' as math;

import '../../../core/srs/srs_models.dart';
import '../../../models/mistake.dart';

/// Compact learning-oriented classification used by the adaptive review policy.
enum AdaptiveErrorType { vocabulary, grammar, conjugation }

/// Immutable scheduling projection derived from the canonical mistake bank.
///
/// This value does not own persistence. The existing learner/mistake pipeline
/// remains the single source of truth for recorded attempts and mistakes.
final class AdaptiveErrorSignal {
  final String itemId;
  final AdaptiveErrorType type;
  final double priority;
  final int reviewIntervalDays;
  final DateTime nextReviewAt;

  const AdaptiveErrorSignal({
    required this.itemId,
    required this.type,
    required this.priority,
    required this.reviewIntervalDays,
    required this.nextReviewAt,
  });
}

/// Pure policy layer over the canonical [MistakeRecord] bank and SRS state.
///
/// It deliberately owns no storage and creates no second mistake repository.
/// Its only responsibility is to classify canonical errors, calculate an
/// urgency score, and shorten the next interval for struggling material.
final class AdaptiveErrorBank {
  static const double _maxPriority = 100;
  static const double _maxIntervalReduction = 0.70;

  const AdaptiveErrorBank();

  AdaptiveErrorType classify(
    MistakeRecord mistake, {
    String? skill,
  }) {
    final normalizedSkill = (skill ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (_isConjugationSkill(normalizedSkill)) {
      return AdaptiveErrorType.conjugation;
    }

    switch (mistake.category) {
      case MistakeCategory.grammar:
      case MistakeCategory.wordOrder:
      case MistakeCategory.article:
        return AdaptiveErrorType.grammar;
      case MistakeCategory.vocabulary:
      case MistakeCategory.translation:
      case MistakeCategory.writing:
      case MistakeCategory.production:
      case MistakeCategory.listening:
        return AdaptiveErrorType.vocabulary;
    }
  }

  /// Returns a deterministic 0..100 urgency score.
  ///
  /// Recurrent failures dominate, recent failures increase urgency, and an
  /// older last-seen timestamp decays the recency contribution instead of
  /// making stale records permanently outrank active problems.
  double priorityScore(
    MistakeRecord mistake, {
    DateTime? now,
  }) {
    final at = (now ?? DateTime.now()).toUtc();
    final severity = mistake.severity.clamp(0, 100).toDouble();
    final failureRate = mistake.failureRate.clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
    final recentFailureRate =
        mistake.recentFailureRate.clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
    final unresolvedErrors =
        math.max(0, mistake.errorCount - mistake.correctiveStreak);

    final daysSinceSeen = mistake.lastSeenAt == null
        ? 30
        : math.max(0, at.difference(mistake.lastSeenAt!.toUtc()).inDays);
    final recency = (1.0 - math.min(daysSinceSeen, 30) / 30.0) * 10.0;

    final raw = severity * 0.45 +
        failureRate * 20.0 +
        recentFailureRate * 15.0 +
        math.min(unresolvedErrors, 5) * 2.0 +
        recency;
    return raw.clamp(0.0, _maxPriority).toDouble();
  }

  /// Shortens the canonical SRS interval in proportion to error urgency.
  ///
  /// The result is always at least one day and never longer than the canonical
  /// interval. A priority of 100 may reduce the interval by up to 70%.
  int acceleratedIntervalDays(
    SrsItemState state,
    MistakeRecord mistake, {
    DateTime? now,
  }) {
    final canonicalInterval = math.max(1, state.intervalDays);
    final urgency = priorityScore(mistake, now: now) / _maxPriority;
    final factor = 1.0 - urgency * _maxIntervalReduction;
    final accelerated = (canonicalInterval * factor).round();
    return accelerated.clamp(1, canonicalInterval).toInt();
  }

  AdaptiveErrorSignal signalFor(
    MistakeRecord mistake,
    SrsItemState state, {
    required DateTime reviewedAtUtc,
    String? skill,
  }) {
    if (!reviewedAtUtc.isUtc) {
      throw ArgumentError('reviewedAtUtc must be in UTC');
    }

    final priority = priorityScore(mistake, now: reviewedAtUtc);
    final interval = acceleratedIntervalDays(
      state,
      mistake,
      now: reviewedAtUtc,
    );
    return AdaptiveErrorSignal(
      itemId: mistake.itemId,
      type: classify(mistake, skill: skill),
      priority: priority,
      reviewIntervalDays: interval,
      nextReviewAt: reviewedAtUtc.add(Duration(days: interval)),
    );
  }

  List<AdaptiveErrorSignal> prioritize(
    Iterable<MistakeRecord> mistakes,
    Map<String, SrsItemState> states, {
    required DateTime reviewedAtUtc,
    Map<String, String> skillByItem = const <String, String>{},
  }) {
    if (!reviewedAtUtc.isUtc) {
      throw ArgumentError('reviewedAtUtc must be in UTC');
    }

    final signals = <AdaptiveErrorSignal>[];
    for (final mistake in mistakes) {
      final state = states[mistake.itemId];
      if (state == null) continue;
      signals.add(
        signalFor(
          mistake,
          state,
          reviewedAtUtc: reviewedAtUtc,
          skill: skillByItem[mistake.itemId],
        ),
      );
    }
    signals.sort((a, b) {
      final byPriority = b.priority.compareTo(a.priority);
      if (byPriority != 0) return byPriority;
      return a.itemId.compareTo(b.itemId);
    });
    return List<AdaptiveErrorSignal>.unmodifiable(signals);
  }

  static bool _isConjugationSkill(String value) =>
      value == 'conjugation' ||
      value == 'verb_conjugation' ||
      value == 'verb-conjugation' ||
      value == 'konjugation';
}
