import '../../../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../../../core/progress/pair_progress_models.dart';
import '../../../core/srs_facets.dart';

typedef LearningRecoveryContentLookup = LearningContent? Function(
  String conceptId,
);

enum LocalLearningRecoveryReason {
  due,
  previousErrors,
  dueAndPreviousErrors,
}

final class LocalLearningRecoveryItem {
  const LocalLearningRecoveryItem({
    required this.item,
    required this.reason,
    required this.facetType,
    required this.variantKey,
    required this.dueAt,
    required this.incorrectCount,
    required this.successRate,
  });

  final LearningContent item;
  final LocalLearningRecoveryReason reason;
  final ReviewFacetType facetType;
  final String? variantKey;
  final DateTime dueAt;
  final int incorrectCount;
  final double successRate;

  String get reviewKey => ReviewFacetKey(
        conceptId: item.id,
        facetType: facetType,
        variantKey: variantKey,
      ).storageKey;
}

final class LocalLearningRecoveryPlan {
  LocalLearningRecoveryPlan({
    required this.pairKey,
    required this.generatedAtUtc,
    required this.estimatedMinutes,
    required Iterable<LocalLearningRecoveryItem> items,
  }) : items = List<LocalLearningRecoveryItem>.unmodifiable(items);

  final String pairKey;
  final DateTime generatedAtUtc;
  final int estimatedMinutes;
  final List<LocalLearningRecoveryItem> items;
}

/// Pure, local-only recovery policy over the canonical pair progress snapshot.
///
/// It owns no persistence and never creates new SRS state. Candidates are
/// limited to already-due review cards or cards with recorded previous errors.
/// Selection memory is bounded by [maxSessionItems] rather than the size of the
/// learner history.
final class LocalLearningRecoveryPlanner {
  const LocalLearningRecoveryPlanner({
    this.minSessionItems = 4,
    this.maxSessionItems = 8,
    this.estimatedSecondsPerItem = 75,
  })  : assert(minSessionItems > 0),
        assert(maxSessionItems >= minSessionItems),
        assert(estimatedSecondsPerItem > 0);

  final int minSessionItems;
  final int maxSessionItems;
  final int estimatedSecondsPerItem;

  LocalLearningRecoveryPlan? build({
    required PairProgressSnapshot snapshot,
    required LearningRecoveryContentLookup contentLookup,
    DateTime? now,
  }) {
    final generatedAtUtc = (now ?? DateTime.now()).toUtc();
    final selected = <_RecoveryCandidate>[];
    final seenReviewKeys = <String>{};

    for (final card in snapshot.cards) {
      final review = card.reviewCard;
      if (review == null || !review.facetKey.isValid) continue;

      final isDue = !review.dueAt.toUtc().isAfter(generatedAtUtc);
      final hasPreviousErrors =
          card.incorrectCount > 0 || review.failures > 0;
      if (!isDue && !hasPreviousErrors) continue;

      final item = contentLookup(review.itemId);
      if (item == null) continue;

      final candidate = _RecoveryCandidate(
        item: item,
        reason: switch ((isDue, hasPreviousErrors)) {
          (true, true) =>
            LocalLearningRecoveryReason.dueAndPreviousErrors,
          (true, false) => LocalLearningRecoveryReason.due,
          (false, true) =>
            LocalLearningRecoveryReason.previousErrors,
          (false, false) => throw StateError('unreachable'),
        },
        facetType: review.facetType,
        variantKey: review.variantKey,
        dueAt: review.dueAt.toUtc(),
        lastReviewedAt: card.lastReviewedAt.toUtc(),
        incorrectCount: card.incorrectCount,
        failureCount: review.failures,
        successRate: review.successRate,
      );

      if (!seenReviewKeys.add(candidate.reviewKey)) continue;
      _insertBounded(selected, candidate, maxSessionItems);
    }

    if (selected.length < minSessionItems) return null;

    final items = selected
        .map((candidate) => candidate.toRecoveryItem())
        .toList(growable: false);
    final estimatedMinutes =
        ((items.length * estimatedSecondsPerItem) / 60)
            .ceil()
            .clamp(5, 10)
            .toInt();

    return LocalLearningRecoveryPlan(
      pairKey: snapshot.pairKey,
      generatedAtUtc: generatedAtUtc,
      estimatedMinutes: estimatedMinutes,
      items: items,
    );
  }

  static void _insertBounded(
    List<_RecoveryCandidate> selected,
    _RecoveryCandidate candidate,
    int limit,
  ) {
    var index = 0;
    while (index < selected.length &&
        _compare(selected[index], candidate) <= 0) {
      index += 1;
    }
    selected.insert(index, candidate);
    if (selected.length > limit) {
      selected.removeLast();
    }
  }

  static int _compare(
    _RecoveryCandidate a,
    _RecoveryCandidate b,
  ) {
    if (a.isDue != b.isDue) return a.isDue ? -1 : 1;

    if (a.isDue && b.isDue) {
      final dueAt = a.dueAt.compareTo(b.dueAt);
      if (dueAt != 0) return dueAt;
    }

    final errors = b.errorWeight.compareTo(a.errorWeight);
    if (errors != 0) return errors;

    final success = a.successRate.compareTo(b.successRate);
    if (success != 0) return success;

    final lastReviewed = a.lastReviewedAt.compareTo(b.lastReviewedAt);
    if (lastReviewed != 0) return lastReviewed;

    return a.reviewKey.compareTo(b.reviewKey);
  }
}

final class _RecoveryCandidate {
  const _RecoveryCandidate({
    required this.item,
    required this.reason,
    required this.facetType,
    required this.variantKey,
    required this.dueAt,
    required this.lastReviewedAt,
    required this.incorrectCount,
    required this.failureCount,
    required this.successRate,
  });

  final LearningContent item;
  final LocalLearningRecoveryReason reason;
  final ReviewFacetType facetType;
  final String? variantKey;
  final DateTime dueAt;
  final DateTime lastReviewedAt;
  final int incorrectCount;
  final int failureCount;
  final double successRate;

  bool get isDue => reason != LocalLearningRecoveryReason.previousErrors;
  int get errorWeight => incorrectCount + failureCount;

  String get reviewKey => ReviewFacetKey(
        conceptId: item.id,
        facetType: facetType,
        variantKey: variantKey,
      ).storageKey;

  LocalLearningRecoveryItem toRecoveryItem() {
    return LocalLearningRecoveryItem(
      item: item,
      reason: reason,
      facetType: facetType,
      variantKey: variantKey,
      dueAt: dueAt,
      incorrectCount: incorrectCount,
      successRate: successRate,
    );
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/learning/domain/local_learning_recovery_resume.dart

import 'local_learning_recovery.dart';

final class LocalLearningRecoveryResumeCursor {
  LocalLearningRecoveryResumeCursor({
    required this.pairKey,
    required this.createdAtUtc,
    required Iterable<String> remainingReviewKeys,
  }) : remainingReviewKeys = List<String>.unmodifiable(
          remainingReviewKeys
              .map((value) => value.trim())
              .where((value) => value.isNotEmpty)
              .take(8),
        ) {
    if (pairKey.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(pairKey, 'pairKey', 'must not be empty');
    }
  }

  final String pairKey;
  final DateTime createdAtUtc;
  final List<String> remainingReviewKeys;

  Map<String, Object?> toJson() => <String, Object?>{
        'pairKey': pairKey,
        'createdAtUtc': createdAtUtc.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
        'remainingReviewKeys': remainingReviewKeys,
      };

  static LocalLearningRecoveryResumeCursor? fromJson(Object? raw) {
    if (raw is! Map) return null;
    final pairKey = raw['pairKey']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
    final createdAtUtc =
        DateTime.tryParse(raw['createdAtUtc']?.toString() ?? '')?.toUtc();
    final rawKeys = raw['remainingReviewKeys'];
    if (pairKey.isEmpty || createdAtUtc == null || rawKeys is! List) {
      return null;
    }
    final keys = rawKeys
        .whereType<String>()
        .map((value) => value.trim())
        .where((value) => value.isNotEmpty)
        .take(8)
        .toList(growable: false);
    if (keys.isEmpty) return null;
    return LocalLearningRecoveryResumeCursor(
      pairKey: pairKey,
      createdAtUtc: createdAtUtc,
      remainingReviewKeys: keys,
    );
  }
}

final class LocalLearningRecoverySession {
  const LocalLearningRecoverySession({
    required this.plan,
    required this.resumed,
  });

  final LocalLearningRecoveryPlan plan;
  final bool resumed;
}

final class LocalLearningRecoveryResumePlanner {
  const LocalLearningRecoveryResumePlanner();

  static const Duration resumeTtl = Duration(hours: 24);

  LocalLearningRecoverySession restore({
    required LocalLearningRecoveryPlan plan,
    required LocalLearningRecoveryResumeCursor? cursor,
    required DateTime now,
  }) {
    final at = now.toUtc();
    final validCursor = cursor != null &&
        cursor.pairKey == plan.pairKey &&
        !at.isBefore(cursor.createdAtUtc) &&
        at.difference(cursor.createdAtUtc) <= resumeTtl;

    if (validCursor) {
      final byKey = <String, LocalLearningRecoveryItem>{
        for (final item in plan.items) item.reviewKey: item,
      };
      final remaining = <LocalLearningRecoveryItem>[];
      final seen = <String>{};
      for (final key in cursor.remainingReviewKeys) {
        final item = byKey[key];
        if (item == null || !seen.add(key)) continue;
        remaining.add(item);
      }
      if (remaining.isNotEmpty) {
        return LocalLearningRecoverySession(
          resumed: true,
          plan: LocalLearningRecoveryPlan(
            pairKey: plan.pairKey,
            generatedAtUtc: plan.generatedAtUtc,
            estimatedMinutes: _estimateMinutes(remaining.length),
            items: remaining,
          ),
        );
      }
    }

    return LocalLearningRecoverySession(
      plan: plan,
      resumed: false,
    );
  }

  static int _estimateMinutes(int itemCount) =>
      ((itemCount * 75) / 60).ceil().clamp(5, 10).toInt();
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

enum FeedbackTone {
  positive,
  guidance,
  neutral,
}

class InteractiveFeedbackMascot extends StatelessWidget {
  const InteractiveFeedbackMascot({
    super.key,
    required this.title,
    required this.explanation,
    required this.score,
    this.tone = FeedbackTone.neutral,
    this.onTap,
  });

  final String title;
  final String explanation;
  final double score;
  final FeedbackTone tone;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final normalizedScore = score.clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
    final percentage = (normalizedScore * 100).round().toString() + '%';
    final accent = switch (tone) {
      FeedbackTone.positive => scheme.primary,
      FeedbackTone.guidance => scheme.tertiary,
      FeedbackTone.neutral => scheme.secondary,
    };
    final icon = switch (tone) {
      FeedbackTone.positive => Icons.auto_awesome,
      FeedbackTone.guidance => Icons.lightbulb_outline,
      FeedbackTone.neutral => Icons.insights_outlined,
    };

    return Semantics(
      container: true,
      button: onTap != null,
      label: title + '. ' + percentage + '. ' + explanation,
      child: Card(
        clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
        child: InkWell(
          onTap: onTap,
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            child: Row(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: <Widget>[
                AnimatedContainer(
                  duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 220),
                  curve: Curves.easeOut,
                  width: 54,
                  height: 54,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                    color: accent.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                    border: Border.all(color: accent),
                  ),
                  child: Icon(icon, color: accent),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 14),
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      Row(
                        children: <Widget>[
                          Expanded(
                            child: Text(
                              title,
                              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                            ),
                          ),
                          Text(
                            percentage,
                            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.labelLarge,
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 8),
                      LinearProgressIndicator(
                        value: normalizedScore,
                        color: accent,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 10),
                      Text(explanation),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../core/theme/adaptive_glass_surface.dart';

typedef LocalLearningRecoveryPromptBuilder = Widget Function(
  BuildContext context,
  LocalLearningRecoveryPlan plan,
);

/// Observes app lifecycle only while the learning surface is mounted.
///
/// A resume event triggers an async canonical SRS read; animation frames never
/// perform SQLite, worker, EventBus, JSON, or network work.
class LocalLearningRecoveryLifecycleHost extends StatefulWidget {
  const LocalLearningRecoveryLifecycleHost({
    super.key,
    required this.controller,
    required this.child,
    required this.promptBuilder,
    this.checkImmediately = true,
  });

  final LocalLearningRecoveryController controller;
  final Widget child;
  final LocalLearningRecoveryPromptBuilder promptBuilder;
  final bool checkImmediately;

  @override
  State<LocalLearningRecoveryLifecycleHost> createState() =>
      _LocalLearningRecoveryLifecycleHostState();
}

class _LocalLearningRecoveryLifecycleHostState
    extends State<LocalLearningRecoveryLifecycleHost>
    with WidgetsBindingObserver {
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);
    if (widget.checkImmediately) {
      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
        if (!mounted) return;
        unawaited(widget.controller.refreshOnReturn());
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {
    if (state == AppLifecycleState.resumed) {
      unawaited(widget.controller.refreshOnReturn());
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: widget.controller,
      child: widget.child,
      builder: (context, child) {
        final plan = widget.controller.plan;
        return Stack(
          fit: StackFit.passthrough,
          children: <Widget>[
            if (child != null) child,
            if (plan != null)
              Align(
                alignment: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                child: SafeArea(
                  minimum: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                  child: widget.promptBuilder(context, plan),
                ),
              ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../../../services/preferences_service.dart';
import '../../../services/repository.dart';
import '../../session/universal_session_orchestrator.dart';
import '../application/local_learning_recovery_controller.dart';
import '../application/local_learning_recovery_session_coordinator.dart';
import '../data/local_learning_recovery_state_store.dart';
import '../domain/local_learning_recovery_resume.dart';
import 'local_learning_recovery_host.dart';
import 'widgets/smart_orb.dart';

/// Production orchestration surface for Local Learning Recovery.
///
/// It owns only ephemeral UI/session state plus a bounded resume cursor.
/// Canonical learning progress and SRS writes stay in LearnerRepository through
/// UniversalSessionOrchestrator.
class LocalLearningRecoveryRuntimeHost extends StatefulWidget {
  const LocalLearningRecoveryRuntimeHost({
    super.key,
    required this.repository,
    required this.preferences,
    required this.corpus,
    required this.child,
  });

  final LearnerRepository repository;
  final PreferencesService preferences;
  final List<LearningContent> corpus;
  final Widget child;

  @override
  State<LocalLearningRecoveryRuntimeHost> createState() =>
      _LocalLearningRecoveryRuntimeHostState();
}

class _LocalLearningRecoveryRuntimeHostState
    extends State<LocalLearningRecoveryRuntimeHost>
    with WidgetsBindingObserver {
  late final UniversalSessionOrchestrator _sessionOrchestrator;
  late final LocalLearningRecoveryController _controller;
  late final LocalLearningRecoverySessionCoordinator _coordinator;

  bool _evaluating = false;
  bool _promptOpen = false;
  bool _sessionOpen = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);

    final contentById = <String, LearningContent>{
      for (final item in widget.corpus)
        if (item.id.trim().isNotEmpty) item.id: item,
    };
    _sessionOrchestrator =
        UniversalSessionOrchestrator(repository: widget.repository);
    _controller = LocalLearningRecoveryController(
      repository: widget.repository,
      sessionOrchestrator: _sessionOrchestrator,
      contentLookup: (conceptId) => contentById[conceptId],
    );
    _coordinator = LocalLearningRecoverySessionCoordinator(
      controller: _controller,
      stateStore:
          PreferencesLocalLearningRecoveryStateStore(widget.preferences),
    );

    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      unawaited(_evaluateReturn());
    });
  }

  @override
  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {
    if (state == AppLifecycleState.resumed) {
      unawaited(_evaluateReturn());
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
    _controller.dispose();
    _sessionOrchestrator.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _evaluateReturn() async {
    if (!mounted || _evaluating || _promptOpen || _sessionOpen) return;
    _evaluating = true;
    try {
      final plan = await _controller.refreshOnReturn();
      _controller.dismiss();
      if (!mounted || plan == null) return;

      final session = await _coordinator.prepare(plan);
      if (!mounted || session == null) return;

      _promptOpen = true;
      await _coordinator.markPrompted(session);
      if (!mounted) return;
      final start = await showModalBottomSheet<bool>(
        context: context,
        useSafeArea: true,
        showDragHandle: true,
        builder: (sheetContext) => Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 0, 12, 16),
          child: LocalLearningRecoveryPrompt(
            plan: session.plan,
            title: session.resumed
                ? 'نكمل جلسة الاسترجاع؟'
                : 'جلسة استرجاع قصيرة؟',
            message:
                'لديك ${session.plan.items.length} مراجعات محلية، '
                'حوالي ${session.plan.estimatedMinutes} دقائق. '
                'يمكنك التوقف والمتابعة لاحقًا بلا أي عقوبة.',
            actionLabel: session.resumed ? 'متابعة' : 'ابدأ',
            dismissLabel: 'لاحقًا',
            orbSemanticsLabel: 'توجيه جلسة الاسترجاع',
            onStart: () => Navigator.of(sheetContext).pop(true),
            onDismiss: () => Navigator.of(sheetContext).pop(false),
          ),
        ),
      );
      _promptOpen = false;
      if (!mounted || start != true) return;

      await _coordinator.begin(session);
      if (!mounted) return;
      _sessionOpen = true;
      await Navigator.of(context).push<void>(
        MaterialPageRoute<void>(
          builder: (_) => LocalLearningRecoverySessionScreen(
            session: session,
            coordinator: _coordinator,
          ),
        ),
      );
      _sessionOpen = false;
    } on Object {
      _promptOpen = false;
      _sessionOpen = false;
      // Recovery is optional: fail closed without blocking the main learning UI.
    } finally {
      _evaluating = false;
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => widget.child;
}

class LocalLearningRecoverySessionScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const LocalLearningRecoverySessionScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.session,
    required this.coordinator,
  });

  final LocalLearningRecoverySession session;
  final LocalLearningRecoverySessionCoordinator coordinator;

  @override
  State<LocalLearningRecoverySessionScreen> createState() =>
      _LocalLearningRecoverySessionScreenState();
}

class _LocalLearningRecoverySessionScreenState
    extends State<LocalLearningRecoverySessionScreen> {
  int _index = 0;
  int _correct = 0;
  bool _revealed = false;
  bool _busy = false;
  bool _completed = false;
  DateTime _startedAt = DateTime.now();
  SmartOrbFeedback _feedback = SmartOrbFeedback.neutral;

  void _reveal() {
    if (_revealed || _busy || _completed) return;
    setState(() {
      _revealed = true;
      _feedback = SmartOrbFeedback.guidance;
    });
  }

  Future<void> _grade(bool correct) async {
    if (_busy || _completed) return;
    final elapsed = DateTime.now().difference(_startedAt);
    setState(() => _busy = true);

    try {
      await widget.coordinator.record(
        session: widget.session,
        itemIndex: _index,
        correct: correct,
        elapsed: elapsed,
      );
      if (!mounted) return;

      final last = _index + 1 >= widget.session.plan.items.length;
      setState(() {
        _busy = false;
        if (correct) _correct += 1;
        _feedback =
            correct ? SmartOrbFeedback.success : SmartOrbFeedback.incorrect;
        if (last) {
          _completed = true;
        } else {
          _index += 1;
          _revealed = false;
          _startedAt = DateTime.now();
        }
      });
    } on Object {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() => _busy = false);
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text(
            'تعذر حفظ المراجعة محليًا. بقيت البطاقة في مكانها.',
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_completed) {
      return _LocalLearningRecoveryCompletion(
        reviewed: widget.session.plan.items.length,
        correct: _correct,
      );
    }

    final item = widget.session.plan.items[_index].item;
    final theme = Theme.of(context);

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(widget.session.resumed ? 'متابعة الاسترجاع' : 'الاسترجاع'),
      ),
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Directionality(
          textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
          child: ListView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
            children: <Widget>[
              Center(
                child: SmartOrb(
                  size: 92,
                  semanticsLabel: 'تغذية راجعة للاسترجاع',
                  state: SmartOrbDomainState(feedback: _feedback),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),
              Text(
                'بطاقة ${_index + 1} من ${widget.session.plan.items.length}',
                style: theme.textTheme.labelLarge,
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              LinearProgressIndicator(
                value: (_index + 1) / widget.session.plan.items.length,
                minHeight: 6,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 20),
              Card(
                clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
                child: InkWell(
                  onTap: _revealed ? null : _reveal,
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                    child: Column(
                      children: <Widget>[
                        Text(
                          item.sourceText,
                          style: theme.textTheme.headlineSmall?.copyWith(
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                          ),
                          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 16),
                        if (!_revealed)
                          const Text(
                            'استدعِ المعنى أولًا، ثم اضغط لإظهار الإجابة.',
                            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                          )
                        else ...<Widget>[
                          Text(
                            item.translationText,
                            style: theme.textTheme.titleMedium,
                            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                          ),
                          if (item.exampleText.trim().isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                            const Divider(height: 28),
                            Text(
                              item.exampleText,
                              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                            ),
                            if (item.exampleTranslationText.trim().isNotEmpty)
                              Padding(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 6),
                                child: Text(
                                  item.exampleTranslationText,
                                  style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall,
                                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                                ),
                              ),
                          ],
                        ],
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 18),
              if (_revealed)
                Row(
                  children: <Widget>[
                    Expanded(
                      child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                        onPressed: _busy ? null : () => _grade(false),
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh_rounded),
                        label: const Text('احتاج مراجعة'),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 12),
                    Expanded(
                      child: FilledButton.icon(
                        onPressed: _busy ? null : () => _grade(true),
                        icon: _busy
                            ? const SizedBox.square(
                                dimension: 16,
                                child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                                  strokeWidth: 2,
                                ),
                              )
                            : const Icon(Icons.check_rounded),
                        label: const Text('تذكرت'),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),
              Text(
                'الخروج لا يسبب عقوبة. المتبقي محفوظ محليًا للاستئناف.',
                style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall,
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _LocalLearningRecoveryCompletion extends StatelessWidget {

                  ),

                  'اكتملت المراجعة',

                      ),

                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,

                  'هذا يكفي الآن. سيحدد SRS المحلي موعدك التالي، '
                  'ولا توجد سلسلة أو عقوبة على التوقف.',
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 22),
                FilledButton.icon(
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.done_rounded),
                  label: const Text('إنهاء'),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../core/settings/speech_rate_settings.dart';

class OfflineSpeechRateSelector extends StatelessWidget {
  const OfflineSpeechRateSelector({
    super.key,
    required this.controller,
    this.onPreview,
  });

  final SpeechRateSettingsController controller;
  final Future<void> Function(double speedMultiplier)? onPreview;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: controller,
      builder: (context, _) {
        return Wrap(
          crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,
          spacing: 8,
          runSpacing: 8,
          children: <Widget>[
            for (final preset in SpeechRatePreset.values)
              ChoiceChip(
                label: Text(preset.label),
                selected: controller.preset == preset,
                onSelected: (selected) {
                  if (selected) controller.setPreset(preset);
                },
              ),
            if (onPreview != null)
              IconButton(
                tooltip: 'Preview',
                onPressed: () => unawaited(
                  onPreview!(controller.speedMultiplier),
                ),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.volume_up_outlined),
              ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../../core/theme/adaptive_glass_surface.dart';
import '../../../../core/theme/smart_orb_theme.dart';

enum SmartOrbFeedback {
  neutral,
  success,
  guidance,
  incorrect,
}

@immutable
final class SmartOrbDomainState {
  const SmartOrbDomainState({
    this.isSpeaking = false,
    this.feedback = SmartOrbFeedback.neutral,
  });

  final bool isSpeaking;
  final SmartOrbFeedback feedback;

  SmartOrbDomainState copyWith({
    bool? isSpeaking,
    SmartOrbFeedback? feedback,
  }) =>
      SmartOrbDomainState(
        isSpeaking: isSpeaking ?? this.isSpeaking,
        feedback: feedback ?? this.feedback,
      );

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      identical(this, other) ||
      other is SmartOrbDomainState &&
          other.isSpeaking == isSpeaking &&
          other.feedback == feedback;

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(isSpeaking, feedback);
}

class SmartOrb extends StatefulWidget {
  const SmartOrb({
    super.key,
    required this.state,
    this.size = 112,
    this.semanticsLabel = 'Interactive feedback core',
  }) : assert(size >= 64 && size <= 240);

  final SmartOrbDomainState state;
  final double size;
  final String semanticsLabel;

  @override
  State<SmartOrb> createState() => _SmartOrbState();
}

class _SmartOrbState extends State<SmartOrb>
    with TickerProviderStateMixin {
  late final AnimationController _pulseController;
  late final AnimationController _feedbackController;
  late final AnimationController _shakeController;
  late final Listenable _frameRepaint;

  bool _reduceMotion = false;
  bool _motionInitialized = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _pulseController = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 1120),
    );
    _feedbackController = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 720),
    );
    _shakeController = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 460),
    );
    _frameRepaint = Listenable.merge(<Listenable>[
      _pulseController,
      _feedbackController,
      _shakeController,
    ]);
  }

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    final tokens = SmartOrbThemeTokens.of(context);
    _pulseController.duration = tokens.pulsePeriod;
    _feedbackController.duration = tokens.feedbackDuration;
    _shakeController.duration = tokens.shakeDuration;

    final motionChanged =
        !_motionInitialized || _reduceMotion != tokens.reduceMotion;
    _reduceMotion = tokens.reduceMotion;
    _motionInitialized = true;
    if (motionChanged) {
      _syncFrameState(forceFeedback: true);
    }
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant SmartOrb oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.state == widget.state) return;

    if (oldWidget.state.isSpeaking != widget.state.isSpeaking) {
      _syncPulse();
    }
    if (oldWidget.state.feedback != widget.state.feedback) {
      _triggerFeedback();
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _pulseController.dispose();
    _feedbackController.dispose();
    _shakeController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _syncFrameState({bool forceFeedback = false}) {
    _syncPulse();
    if (forceFeedback ||
        widget.state.feedback != SmartOrbFeedback.neutral) {
      _triggerFeedback();
    }
  }

  void _syncPulse() {
    if (_reduceMotion) {
      _pulseController
        ..stop()
        ..value = widget.state.isSpeaking ? 0.45 : 0;
      return;
    }

    if (widget.state.isSpeaking) {
      if (!_pulseController.isAnimating) {
        _pulseController.repeat(reverse: true);
      }
      return;
    }

    if (_pulseController.value == 0) return;
    _pulseController.animateBack(
      0,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
      curve: Curves.easeOut,
    );
  }

  void _triggerFeedback() {
    final feedback = widget.state.feedback;
    if (feedback == SmartOrbFeedback.neutral) {
      _feedbackController
        ..stop()
        ..value = 0;
      _shakeController
        ..stop()
        ..value = 0;
      return;
    }

    if (_reduceMotion) {
      _feedbackController
        ..stop()
        ..value = 0.5;
      _shakeController
        ..stop()
        ..value = 0;
      return;
    }

    _feedbackController.forward(from: 0);
    if (feedback == SmartOrbFeedback.guidance ||
        feedback == SmartOrbFeedback.incorrect) {
      _shakeController.forward(from: 0);
    } else {
      _shakeController
        ..stop()
        ..value = 0;
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final tokens = SmartOrbThemeTokens.of(context);

    return Semantics(
      image: true,
      label: widget.semanticsLabel,
      value: _semanticValue(widget.state),
      child: SizedBox.square(
        dimension: widget.size,
        child: AdaptiveGlassSurface(
          padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
          borderRadius: widget.size / 2,
          blurSigma: tokens.glassBlurSigma,
          child: RepaintBoundary(
            child: CustomPaint(
              painter: _SmartOrbPainter(
                domainState: widget.state,
                palette: tokens.palette,
                pulse: _pulseController,
                feedback: _feedbackController,
                shake: _shakeController,
                repaint: _frameRepaint,
              ),
              child: const SizedBox.expand(),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  static String _semanticValue(SmartOrbDomainState state) {
    final feedback = switch (state.feedback) {
      SmartOrbFeedback.neutral => 'neutral',
      SmartOrbFeedback.success => 'success',
      SmartOrbFeedback.guidance => 'guidance',
      SmartOrbFeedback.incorrect => 'incorrect answer',
    };
    return state.isSpeaking ? '$feedback, speaking' : feedback;
  }
}

final class _SmartOrbPainter extends CustomPainter {
  _SmartOrbPainter({
    required this.domainState,
    required this.palette,
    required this.pulse,
    required this.feedback,
    required this.shake,
    required Listenable repaint,
  }) : super(repaint: repaint);

  final SmartOrbDomainState domainState;
  final SmartOrbPalette palette;
  final Animation<double> pulse;
  final Animation<double> feedback;
  final Animation<double> shake;

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final minSide = math.min(size.width, size.height);
    if (minSide <= 0) return;

    final center = Offset(size.width / 2, size.height / 2);
    final pulseValue = domainState.isSpeaking
        ? pulse.value.clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble()
        : 0.0;
    final feedbackEnvelope =
        domainState.feedback == SmartOrbFeedback.neutral
            ? 0.0
            : 0.16 +
                math.sin(math.pi * feedback.value).abs() * 0.84;
    final activeColor = _activeColor();
    final shakeOffset = _shakeOffset(minSide);

    canvas.save();
    canvas.translate(shakeOffset, 0);

    final radius = minSide * (0.292 + pulseValue * 0.018);
    final haloRadius =
        radius * (1.48 + pulseValue * 0.08 + feedbackEnvelope * 0.05);
    final haloRect = Rect.fromCircle(
      center: center,
      radius: haloRadius,
    );
    final haloOpacity =
        0.10 + pulseValue * 0.10 + feedbackEnvelope * 0.24;

    canvas.drawCircle(
      center,
      haloRadius,
      Paint()
        ..shader = RadialGradient(
          colors: <Color>[
            activeColor.withValues(alpha: haloOpacity),
            activeColor.withValues(alpha: haloOpacity * 0.28),
            Colors.transparent,
          ],
          stops: const <double>[0, 0.58, 1],
        ).createShader(haloRect),
    );

    final orbRect = Rect.fromCircle(center: center, radius: radius);
    canvas.drawCircle(
      center,
      radius,
      Paint()
        ..shader = RadialGradient(
          center: const Alignment(-0.34, -0.38),
          radius: 1.05,
          colors: <Color>[
            palette.glassHighlight.withValues(alpha: 0.86),
            activeColor.withValues(
              alpha: 0.34 + feedbackEnvelope * 0.18,
            ),
            palette.core.withValues(alpha: 0.24),
          ],
          stops: const <double>[0, 0.46, 1],
        ).createShader(orbRect),
    );

    canvas.drawCircle(
      center,
      radius,
      Paint()
        ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
        ..strokeWidth = math.max(1.0, minSide * 0.012)
        ..color = palette.outline.withValues(alpha: 0.72),
    );

    final orbitPaint = Paint()
      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
      ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round
      ..strokeWidth = math.max(1.0, minSide * 0.013)
      ..color = activeColor.withValues(
        alpha: 0.46 + feedbackEnvelope * 0.30,
      );
    final orbitRect = Rect.fromCircle(
      center: center,
      radius: radius * 0.79,
    );
    final phase = pulseValue * 0.18;
    canvas.drawArc(
      orbitRect,
      -0.88 + phase,
      math.pi * 1.18,
      false,
      orbitPaint,
    );
    orbitPaint.strokeWidth *= 0.72;
    canvas.drawArc(
      orbitRect,
      2.20 + phase,
      math.pi * 0.72,
      false,
      orbitPaint,
    );

    final polygonRadius = radius * 0.50;
    final polygon = _regularPolygon(
      center: center,
      radius: polygonRadius,
      sides: 6,
      rotation: math.pi / 6 + pulseValue * 0.04,
    );
    canvas.drawPath(
      polygon,
      Paint()
        ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
        ..strokeWidth = math.max(1.0, minSide * 0.010)
        ..color = activeColor.withValues(
          alpha: 0.56 + feedbackEnvelope * 0.26,
        ),
    );

    final diamond = _regularPolygon(
      center: center,
      radius: radius * 0.25,
      sides: 4,
      rotation: math.pi / 4,
    );
    canvas.drawPath(
      diamond,
      Paint()
        ..style = PaintingStyle.fill
        ..color = activeColor.withValues(
          alpha: 0.16 + feedbackEnvelope * 0.18,
        ),
    );

    final pulseRingRadius = radius * (1.08 + pulseValue * 0.14);
    canvas.drawCircle(
      center,
      pulseRingRadius,
      Paint()
        ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
        ..strokeWidth = math.max(1.0, minSide * 0.008)
        ..color = activeColor.withValues(
          alpha: domainState.isSpeaking
              ? 0.18 + pulseValue * 0.34
              : 0.10 + feedbackEnvelope * 0.12,
        ),
    );

    canvas.restore();
  }

  Color _activeColor() => switch (domainState.feedback) {
        SmartOrbFeedback.neutral => palette.core,
        SmartOrbFeedback.success => palette.success,
        SmartOrbFeedback.guidance => palette.guidance,
        SmartOrbFeedback.incorrect => palette.incorrect,
      };

  double _shakeOffset(double minSide) {
    if (domainState.feedback != SmartOrbFeedback.guidance &&
        domainState.feedback != SmartOrbFeedback.incorrect) {
      return 0;
    }
    final progress = shake.value.clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
    final envelope = 1 - progress;
    return math.sin(progress * math.pi * 6) *
        minSide *
        0.026 *
        envelope;
  }

  static Path _regularPolygon({
    required Offset center,
    required double radius,
    required int sides,
    required double rotation,
  }) {
    final path = Path();
    for (var index = 0; index < sides; index += 1) {
      final angle =
          rotation + (math.pi * 2 * index / sides);
      final point = Offset(
        center.dx + math.cos(angle) * radius,
        center.dy + math.sin(angle) * radius,
      );
      if (index == 0) {
        path.moveTo(point.dx, point.dy);
      } else {
        path.lineTo(point.dx, point.dy);
      }
    }
    path.close();
    return path;
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _SmartOrbPainter oldDelegate) =>
      oldDelegate.domainState != domainState ||
      oldDelegate.palette.core != palette.core ||
      oldDelegate.palette.success != palette.success ||
      oldDelegate.palette.guidance != palette.guidance ||
      oldDelegate.palette.incorrect != palette.incorrect ||
      oldDelegate.palette.glassHighlight !=
          palette.glassHighlight ||
      oldDelegate.palette.outline != palette.outline;
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/lexicon_models.dart';
import '../domain/lexicon_repositories.dart';

final class LexiconSearchState {
  const LexiconSearchState({
    this.query = const LexiconSearchQuery(),
    this.results = const <SearchResultItem>[],
    this.bookmarks = const <UserBookmark>[],
    this.bookmarkItems = const <String, SearchResultItem>{},
    this.notes = const <String, WordPersonalNote>{},
    this.isSearching = false,
    this.isLoadingUserData = false,
    this.errorMessage,
  });

  final LexiconSearchQuery query;
  final List<SearchResultItem> results;
  final List<UserBookmark> bookmarks;
  final Map<String, SearchResultItem> bookmarkItems;
  final Map<String, WordPersonalNote> notes;
  final bool isSearching;
  final bool isLoadingUserData;
  final String? errorMessage;

  LexiconSearchState copyWith({
    LexiconSearchQuery? query,
    List<SearchResultItem>? results,
    List<UserBookmark>? bookmarks,
    Map<String, SearchResultItem>? bookmarkItems,
    Map<String, WordPersonalNote>? notes,
    bool? isSearching,
    bool? isLoadingUserData,
    String? errorMessage,
    bool clearError = false,
  }) {
    return LexiconSearchState(
      query: query ?? this.query,
      results: results ?? this.results,
      bookmarks: bookmarks ?? this.bookmarks,
      bookmarkItems: bookmarkItems ?? this.bookmarkItems,
      notes: notes ?? this.notes,
      isSearching: isSearching ?? this.isSearching,
      isLoadingUserData: isLoadingUserData ?? this.isLoadingUserData,
      errorMessage: clearError ? null : (errorMessage ?? this.errorMessage),
    );
  }
}

final class LexiconSearchNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  LexiconSearchNotifier({
    required LexiconSearchRepository searchRepository,
    required BookmarkRepository bookmarkRepository,
    this.debounceDuration = const Duration(milliseconds: 220),
  })  : _searchRepository = searchRepository,
        _bookmarkRepository = bookmarkRepository;

  final LexiconSearchRepository _searchRepository;
  final BookmarkRepository _bookmarkRepository;
  final Duration debounceDuration;

  Timer? _debounce;
  int _searchEpoch = 0;
  bool _disposed = false;
  LexiconSearchState _state = const LexiconSearchState();

  LexiconSearchState get state => _state;

  bool isBookmarked(String wordId) =>
      _state.bookmarks.any((bookmark) => bookmark.wordId == wordId);

  WordPersonalNote? noteFor(String wordId) => _state.notes[wordId];

  Future<void> initialize() async {
    _ensureActive();
    _setState(_state.copyWith(isLoadingUserData: true, clearError: true));
    try {
      final bookmarks = await _bookmarkRepository.loadBookmarks();
      final notes = await _bookmarkRepository.loadNotes();
      final items = <String, SearchResultItem>{};
      for (final bookmark in bookmarks) {
        final item = await _searchRepository.byId(bookmark.wordId);
        if (item != null) items[bookmark.wordId] = item;
      }
      _setState(
        _state.copyWith(
          bookmarks: List<UserBookmark>.unmodifiable(bookmarks),
          bookmarkItems: Map<String, SearchResultItem>.unmodifiable(items),
          notes: Map<String, WordPersonalNote>.unmodifiable(notes),
          isLoadingUserData: false,
          clearError: true,
        ),
      );
    } catch (error) {
      _setState(
        _state.copyWith(
          isLoadingUserData: false,
          errorMessage: error.toString(),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  void updateText(String value) {
    _ensureActive();
    _setState(
      _state.copyWith(
        query: _state.query.copyWith(text: value),
        isSearching: true,
        clearError: true,
      ),
    );
    _scheduleSearch();
  }

  void toggleArticle(LexiconArticle article) {
    _ensureActive();
    final articles = <LexiconArticle>{..._state.query.filters.articles};
    if (!articles.add(article)) articles.remove(article);
    _setFilters(_state.query.filters.copyWith(
      articles: Set<LexiconArticle>.unmodifiable(articles),
    ));
  }

  void toggleCefrLevel(String level) {
    _ensureActive();
    final normalized = level.trim().toUpperCase();
    if (!LexiconSearchFilters.supportedCefrLevels.contains(normalized)) {
      return;
    }
    final levels = <String>{..._state.query.filters.cefrLevels};
    if (!levels.add(normalized)) levels.remove(normalized);
    _setFilters(_state.query.filters.copyWith(
      cefrLevels: Set<String>.unmodifiable(levels),
    ));
  }

  Future<void> searchNow() {
    _ensureActive();
    _debounce?.cancel();
    return _executeSearch(++_searchEpoch);
  }

  Future<void> toggleBookmark(
    SearchResultItem item, {
    List<String> collections = const <String>[],
  }) async {
    _ensureActive();
    final existing = _state.bookmarks.where(
      (bookmark) => bookmark.wordId == item.wordId,
    );
    if (existing.isNotEmpty) {
      await _bookmarkRepository.removeBookmark(item.wordId);
      final bookmarks = _state.bookmarks
          .where((bookmark) => bookmark.wordId != item.wordId)
          .toList(growable: false);
      final items = <String, SearchResultItem>{..._state.bookmarkItems}
        ..remove(item.wordId);
      _setState(_state.copyWith(
        bookmarks: List<UserBookmark>.unmodifiable(bookmarks),
        bookmarkItems: Map<String, SearchResultItem>.unmodifiable(items),
      ));
      return;
    }

    final bookmark = UserBookmark(
      wordId: item.wordId,
      addedAt: DateTime.now().toUtc(),
      collections: collections,
    );
    await _bookmarkRepository.saveBookmark(bookmark);
    _setState(_state.copyWith(
      bookmarks: List<UserBookmark>.unmodifiable(
        <UserBookmark>[bookmark, ..._state.bookmarks],
      ),
      bookmarkItems: Map<String, SearchResultItem>.unmodifiable(
        <String, SearchResultItem>{..._state.bookmarkItems, item.wordId: item},
      ),
    ));
  }

  Future<void> updateCollections(
    String wordId,
    List<String> collections,
  ) async {
    _ensureActive();
    final index = _state.bookmarks.indexWhere((item) => item.wordId == wordId);
    if (index < 0) return;
    final updated = _state.bookmarks[index].copyWith(collections: collections);
    await _bookmarkRepository.saveBookmark(updated);
    final bookmarks = <UserBookmark>[..._state.bookmarks]..[index] = updated;
    _setState(_state.copyWith(
      bookmarks: List<UserBookmark>.unmodifiable(bookmarks),
    ));
  }

  Future<void> saveNote(
    String wordId,
    String note, {
    List<String> examples = const <String>[],
  }) async {
    _ensureActive();
    final normalizedNote = note.trim();
    final normalizedExamples = examples
        .map((value) => value.trim())
        .where((value) => value.isNotEmpty)
        .toList(growable: false);
    if (normalizedNote.isEmpty && normalizedExamples.isEmpty) {
      await removeNote(wordId);
      return;
    }
    final value = WordPersonalNote(
      wordId: wordId,
      note: normalizedNote,
      examples: normalizedExamples,
      updatedAt: DateTime.now().toUtc(),
    );
    await _bookmarkRepository.saveNote(value);
    _setState(_state.copyWith(
      notes: Map<String, WordPersonalNote>.unmodifiable(
        <String, WordPersonalNote>{..._state.notes, wordId: value},
      ),
    ));
  }

  Future<void> removeNote(String wordId) async {
    _ensureActive();
    await _bookmarkRepository.removeNote(wordId);
    final notes = <String, WordPersonalNote>{..._state.notes}..remove(wordId);
    _setState(_state.copyWith(
      notes: Map<String, WordPersonalNote>.unmodifiable(notes),
    ));
  }

  void _setFilters(LexiconSearchFilters filters) {
    _setState(
      _state.copyWith(
        query: _state.query.copyWith(filters: filters),
        isSearching: true,
        clearError: true,
      ),
    );
    _scheduleSearch(immediate: true);
  }

  void _scheduleSearch({bool immediate = false}) {
    _debounce?.cancel();
    final epoch = ++_searchEpoch;
    if (immediate || debounceDuration == Duration.zero) {
      unawaited(_executeSearch(epoch));
      return;
    }
    _debounce = Timer(debounceDuration, () => unawaited(_executeSearch(epoch)));
  }

  Future<void> _executeSearch(int epoch) async {
    final query = _state.query;
    try {
      final results = await _searchRepository.search(query);
      if (_disposed || epoch != _searchEpoch) return;
      _setState(_state.copyWith(
        results: List<SearchResultItem>.unmodifiable(results),
        isSearching: false,
        clearError: true,
      ));
    } catch (error) {
      if (_disposed || epoch != _searchEpoch) return;
      _setState(_state.copyWith(
        isSearching: false,
        errorMessage: error.toString(),
      ));
    }
  }

  void _setState(LexiconSearchState value) {
    if (_disposed) return;
    _state = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void _ensureActive() {
    if (_disposed) throw StateError('LexiconSearchNotifier is disposed');
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    if (_disposed) return;
    _disposed = true;
    _debounce?.cancel();
    _searchEpoch += 1;
    super.dispose();
  }
}

import '../../../core/infrastructure/storage/local_storage_repository.dart';
import '../domain/lexicon_models.dart';
import '../domain/lexicon_repositories.dart';

final class LocalBookmarkRepository implements BookmarkRepository {
  LocalBookmarkRepository(this._storage);

  final LocalStorageRepository _storage;

  @override
  Future<List<UserBookmark>> loadBookmarks() async {
    final payload = await _loadPayload();
    final raw = payload['bookmarks'];
    if (raw is! List) return const <UserBookmark>[];

    final bookmarks = raw
        .whereType<Map>()
        .map((entry) => _bookmarkFromJson(Map<String, Object?>.from(entry)))
        .whereType<UserBookmark>()
        .toList(growable: false)
      ..sort((a, b) => b.addedAt.compareTo(a.addedAt));
    return List<UserBookmark>.unmodifiable(bookmarks);
  }

  @override
  Future<Map<String, WordPersonalNote>> loadNotes() async {
    final payload = await _loadPayload();
    final raw = payload['notes'];
    if (raw is! List) return const <String, WordPersonalNote>{};

    final notes = <String, WordPersonalNote>{};
    for (final entry in raw.whereType<Map>()) {
      final note = _noteFromJson(Map<String, Object?>.from(entry));
      if (note != null) notes[note.wordId] = note;
    }
    return Map<String, WordPersonalNote>.unmodifiable(notes);
  }

  @override
  Future<void> saveBookmark(UserBookmark bookmark) async {
    final bookmarks = <String, UserBookmark>{
      for (final item in await loadBookmarks()) item.wordId: item,
      bookmark.wordId: _normalizedBookmark(bookmark),
    };
    await _write(bookmarks: bookmarks.values);
  }

  @override
  Future<void> removeBookmark(String wordId) async {
    final bookmarks = <String, UserBookmark>{
      for (final item in await loadBookmarks()) item.wordId: item,
    }..remove(wordId.trim());
    await _write(bookmarks: bookmarks.values);
  }

  @override
  Future<void> saveNote(WordPersonalNote note) async {
    final notes = <String, WordPersonalNote>{
      ...await loadNotes(),
      note.wordId: _normalizedNote(note),
    };
    await _write(notes: notes.values);
  }

  @override
  Future<void> removeNote(String wordId) async {
    final notes = <String, WordPersonalNote>{...await loadNotes()}
      ..remove(wordId.trim());
    await _write(notes: notes.values);
  }

  Future<Map<String, Object?>> _loadPayload() async {
    return await _storage.load(StorageBucket.lexiconUserData) ??
        const <String, Object?>{};
  }

  Future<void> _write({
    Iterable<UserBookmark>? bookmarks,
    Iterable<WordPersonalNote>? notes,
  }) async {
    final currentBookmarks = bookmarks ?? await loadBookmarks();
    final currentNotes = notes ?? (await loadNotes()).values;
    await _storage.save(
      StorageBucket.lexiconUserData,
      <String, Object?>{
        'schema_version': 1,
        'bookmarks': currentBookmarks.map(_bookmarkToJson).toList(),
        'notes': currentNotes.map(_noteToJson).toList(),
      },
    );
  }

  UserBookmark _normalizedBookmark(UserBookmark bookmark) {
    final collections = bookmark.collections
        .map((value) => value.trim())
        .where((value) => value.isNotEmpty)
        .toSet()
        .toList(growable: false)
      ..sort();
    return bookmark.copyWith(
      collections: List<String>.unmodifiable(collections),
    );
  }

  WordPersonalNote _normalizedNote(WordPersonalNote note) {
    final examples = note.examples
        .map((value) => value.trim())
        .where((value) => value.isNotEmpty)
        .toSet()
        .toList(growable: false);
    return WordPersonalNote(
      wordId: note.wordId.trim(),
      note: note.note.trim(),
      examples: List<String>.unmodifiable(examples),
      updatedAt: note.updatedAt.toUtc(),
    );
  }

  Map<String, Object?> _bookmarkToJson(UserBookmark bookmark) =>
      <String, Object?>{
        'word_id': bookmark.wordId,
        'added_at': bookmark.addedAt.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
        'collections': bookmark.collections,
      };

  Map<String, Object?> _noteToJson(WordPersonalNote note) => <String, Object?>{
        'word_id': note.wordId,
        'note': note.note,
        'examples': note.examples,
        'updated_at': note.updatedAt.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
      };

  UserBookmark? _bookmarkFromJson(Map<String, Object?> json) {
    final wordId = json['word_id'];
    final addedAt = DateTime.tryParse(json['added_at']?.toString() ?? '');
    if (wordId is! String || wordId.trim().isEmpty || addedAt == null) {
      return null;
    }
    final rawCollections = json['collections'];
    final collections = rawCollections is List
        ? rawCollections
            .whereType<String>()
            .map((value) => value.trim())
            .where((value) => value.isNotEmpty)
            .toSet()
            .toList(growable: false)
        : const <String>[];
    return UserBookmark(
      wordId: wordId.trim(),
      addedAt: addedAt.toUtc(),
      collections: List<String>.unmodifiable(collections),
    );
  }

  WordPersonalNote? _noteFromJson(Map<String, Object?> json) {
    final wordId = json['word_id'];
    final note = json['note'];
    final updatedAt = DateTime.tryParse(json['updated_at']?.toString() ?? '');
    if (wordId is! String || note is! String || updatedAt == null) return null;
    final rawExamples = json['examples'];
    final examples = rawExamples is List
        ? rawExamples.whereType<String>().toList(growable: false)
        : const <String>[];
    return WordPersonalNote(
      wordId: wordId.trim(),
      note: note.trim(),
      examples: List<String>.unmodifiable(examples),
      updatedAt: updatedAt.toUtc(),
    );
  }
}


--------------------------------------------------
FILE: lib/features/lexicon_search/data/offline_lexicon_search_repository.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import '../../srs/corpus_sqlite_repository.dart';
import '../domain/german_search_normalizer.dart';
import '../domain/lexicon_models.dart';
import '../domain/lexicon_repositories.dart';

/// Lexicon projection over the admitted indexed SQLite corpus.
///
/// CEFR, article, German text and Arabic meaning all come from the same
/// [IndexedSrsCorpusRepository]. No secondary CEFR resolver or legacy
/// in-memory search graph participates in this runtime path.
final class OfflineLexiconSearchRepository implements LexiconSearchRepository {
  const OfflineLexiconSearchRepository({
    required IndexedSrsCorpusRepository corpusRepository,
  }) : _corpusRepository = corpusRepository;

  final IndexedSrsCorpusRepository _corpusRepository;

  @override
  Future<SearchResultItem?> byId(String wordId) async {
    final id = wordId.trim();
    if (id.isEmpty) return null;
    final rows = await _corpusRepository.fetchByIds(<String>[id]);
    return rows.isEmpty ? null : _map(rows.single);
  }

  @override
  Future<List<SearchResultItem>> search(LexiconSearchQuery query) async {
    final requestedLevels = query.filters.cefrLevels
        .map((value) => value.trim().toUpperCase())
        .where((value) => value.isNotEmpty)
        .toSet();
    if (requestedLevels.any(
      (value) => !LexiconSearchFilters.supportedCefrLevels.contains(value),
    )) {
      return const <SearchResultItem>[];
    }

    final articleFilters = <String>{
      for (final article in query.filters.articles)
        if (article != LexiconArticle.none) article.name,
    };
    final rows = await _corpusRepository.searchContent(
      terms: GermanSearchNormalizer.variants(query.text),
      cefrLevels: requestedLevels,
      articles: articleFilters,
      limit: query.limit,
    );
    return List<SearchResultItem>.unmodifiable(rows.map(_map));
  }

  SearchResultItem _map(SrsCorpusItem item) {
    return SearchResultItem(
      wordId: item.id,
      germanWord: item.german,
      article: switch (item.article.trim().toLowerCase()) {
        'der' => LexiconArticle.der,
        'die' => LexiconArticle.die,
        'das' => LexiconArticle.das,
        _ => LexiconArticle.none,
      },
      arabicMeaning: item.arabic,
      cefrLevel: item.cefr.trim(),
    );
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/lexicon_search/domain/german_search_normalizer.dart
--------------------------------------------------
abstract final class GermanSearchNormalizer {
  static Set<String> variants(String input) {
    final base = normalize(input);
    if (base.isEmpty) return const <String>{};

    final transliterated = base
        .replaceAll('ä', 'ae')
        .replaceAll('ö', 'oe')
        .replaceAll('ü', 'ue');
    final folded = transliterated
        .replaceAll('ae', 'a')
        .replaceAll('oe', 'o')
        .replaceAll('ue', 'u');

    return <String>{base, transliterated, folded};
  }

  static String normalize(String value) {
    return value
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll('ß', 'ss')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[\u064B-\u065F\u0670\u06D6-\u06ED]'), '')
        .replaceAll('\u0640', '')
        .replaceAll(RegExp('[أإآ]'), 'ا')
        .replaceAll('ى', 'ي')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'''[.,!?;:،؛؟„“"'’()\[\]{}<>/\\|+*=~^]'''), ' ')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ')
        .trim();
  }
}

enum LexiconArticle { der, die, das, none }

final class LexiconSearchFilters {
  static const List<String> supportedCefrLevels = <String>[
    'A1',
    'A2',
    'B1',
    'B2',
  ];

  const LexiconSearchFilters({
    this.cefrLevels = const <String>{},
    this.articles = const <LexiconArticle>{},
  });

  final Set<String> cefrLevels;
  final Set<LexiconArticle> articles;

  bool get isEmpty => cefrLevels.isEmpty && articles.isEmpty;

  LexiconSearchFilters copyWith({
    Set<String>? cefrLevels,
    Set<LexiconArticle>? articles,
  }) {
    return LexiconSearchFilters(
      cefrLevels: cefrLevels ?? this.cefrLevels,
      articles: articles ?? this.articles,
    );
  }
}

final class LexiconSearchQuery {
  const LexiconSearchQuery({
    this.text = '',
    this.filters = const LexiconSearchFilters(),
    this.limit = 80,
  }) : assert(limit > 0 && limit <= 200);

  final String text;
  final LexiconSearchFilters filters;
  final int limit;

  LexiconSearchQuery copyWith({
    String? text,
    LexiconSearchFilters? filters,
    int? limit,
  }) {
    return LexiconSearchQuery(
      text: text ?? this.text,
      filters: filters ?? this.filters,
      limit: limit ?? this.limit,
    );
  }
}

final class SearchResultItem {
  const SearchResultItem({
    required this.wordId,
    required this.germanWord,
    required this.arabicMeaning,
    required this.cefrLevel,
    this.article = LexiconArticle.none,
  });

  final String wordId;
  final String germanWord;
  final LexiconArticle article;
  final String arabicMeaning;
  final String cefrLevel;

  bool get hasArticle => article != LexiconArticle.none;

  bool get hasCefrLevel =>
      LexiconSearchFilters.supportedCefrLevels.contains(cefrLevel);

  String get articleLabel => switch (article) {
        LexiconArticle.der => 'der',
        LexiconArticle.die => 'die',
        LexiconArticle.das => 'das',
        LexiconArticle.none => '',
      };
}

final class UserBookmark {
  const UserBookmark({
    required this.wordId,
    required this.addedAt,
    this.collections = const <String>[],
  });

  final String wordId;
  final DateTime addedAt;
  final List<String> collections;

  UserBookmark copyWith({
    DateTime? addedAt,
    List<String>? collections,
  }) {
    return UserBookmark(
      wordId: wordId,
      addedAt: addedAt ?? this.addedAt,
      collections: collections ?? this.collections,
    );
  }
}

final class WordPersonalNote {
  const WordPersonalNote({
    required this.wordId,
    required this.note,
    required this.updatedAt,
    this.examples = const <String>[],
  });

  final String wordId;
  final String note;
  final List<String> examples;
  final DateTime updatedAt;
}

class BookmarksCollectionScreen extends StatefulWidget {

class _BookmarksCollectionScreenState
    extends State<BookmarksCollectionScreen> {
  String? _selectedCollection;

  @override
  void initState() {

  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: widget.notifier,
      builder: (context, _) {
        final state = widget.notifier.state;

            .expand((bookmark) => bookmark.collections)
            .toSet()
            .toList(growable: false)
          ..sort();

                    glowColor: AppColors.achievement,
                    child: Row(
                      children: <Widget>[
                        const Icon(
                          Icons.collections_bookmark_rounded,
                          color: AppColors.achievement,

                                  onBookmarkToggle: () =>
                                      widget.notifier.toggleBookmark(item),

                                      TextButton.icon(

                                            widget.onReviewWord!(item),
                                        icon: const Icon(Icons.bolt_rounded),
                                        label: const Text('مراجعة'),

                            );
                          },
                        ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> _editCollections(UserBookmark bookmark) async {
    final controller = TextEditingController(
      text: bookmark.collections.join('، '),
    );
    final value = await showDialog<String>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('تصنيف الكلمة'),
        content: TextField(
          controller: controller,
          autofocus: true,
          textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
          decoration: const InputDecoration(
            hintText: 'مثال: سفر، أفعال مهمة',
          ),
        ),
        actions: <Widget>[
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext),
            child: const Text('إلغاء'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, controller.text),
            child: const Text('حفظ'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    controller.dispose();
    if (value == null) return;
    final collections = value
        .split(RegExp(r'[,،]'))
        .map((entry) => entry.trim())
        .where((entry) => entry.isNotEmpty)
        .toList(growable: false);
    await widget.notifier.updateCollections(bookmark.wordId, collections);
  }

  Future<void> _editNote(
    SearchResultItem item,
    WordPersonalNote? current,
  ) async {
    final noteController = TextEditingController(text: current?.note ?? '');
    final examplesController = TextEditingController(
      text: current?.examples.join('\n') ?? '',
    );
    final save = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(
        title: Text('ملاحظة على ${item.germanWord}'),
        content: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: <Widget>[
              TextField(
                controller: noteController,
                minLines: 2,
                maxLines: 5,
                textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'ملاحظتك',
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              TextField(
                controller: examplesController,
                minLines: 2,
                maxLines: 5,
                textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'أمثلة خاصة — مثال في كل سطر',
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        actions: <Widget>[
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, false),
            child: const Text('إلغاء'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, true),
            child: const Text('حفظ'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (save == true) {
      await widget.notifier.saveNote(
        item.wordId,
        noteController.text,
        examples: examplesController.text.split('\n'),
      );
    }
    noteController.dispose();
    examplesController.dispose();
  }
}

class _Filters extends StatelessWidget {
  const _Filters({required this.notifier});

  final LexiconSearchNotifier notifier;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final filters = notifier.state.query.filters;
    return SizedBox(
      width: double.infinity,
      child: Wrap(
        spacing: AppDesignTokens.spaceS,
        runSpacing: AppDesignTokens.spaceS,
        children: <Widget>[
          _articleChip('der', LexiconArticle.der, AppColors.articleDer, filters),
          _articleChip('die', LexiconArticle.die, AppColors.articleDie, filters),
          _articleChip('das', LexiconArticle.das, AppColors.articleDas, filters),
          for (final level in LexiconSearchFilters.supportedCefrLevels)
            FilterChip(
              label: Text(level, style: AppTypography.label),
              selected: filters.cefrLevels.contains(level),
              onSelected: (_) => notifier.toggleCefrLevel(level),
              selectedColor: AppColors.secondary.withAlpha(24),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _articleChip(
    String label,
    LexiconArticle article,
    Color color,
    LexiconSearchFilters filters,
  ) {
    final selected = filters.articles.contains(article);
    return FilterChip(
      label: Text(
        label,
        style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
          color: selected ? color : null,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
        ),
      ),
      selected: selected,
      onSelected: (_) => notifier.toggleArticle(article),
      selectedColor: color.withAlpha(22),
      side: BorderSide(color: color.withAlpha(selected ? 150 : 60)),
      checkmarkColor: color,
    );
  }
}

                          vertical: AppDesignTokens.spaceS / 2,
                        ),
                        child: Text(
                          item.cefrLevel,
                          style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
                            color: AppColors.secondary,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  IconButton(
                    tooltip: isBookmarked
                        ? 'إزالة من المفضلة'
                        : 'إضافة إلى المفضلة',
                    onPressed: onBookmarkToggle,
                    icon: Icon(
                      isBookmarked
                          ? Icons.bookmark_rounded
                          : Icons.bookmark_border_rounded,
                      color: isBookmarked
                          ? AppColors.achievement
                          : AppColors.primary,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ],
          ),
          if (note != null &&
              (note!.note.isNotEmpty || note!.examples.isNotEmpty)) ...<Widget>[
            const SizedBox(height: AppDesignTokens.spaceS),
            Divider(color: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(35), height: 1),
            const SizedBox(height: AppDesignTokens.spaceS),
            if (note!.note.isNotEmpty)
              AppDirectionalText(
                note!.note,
                languageCode: 'ar',
                maxLines: 3,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
              ),
            if (note!.examples.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
              const SizedBox(height: AppDesignTokens.spaceS / 2),
              AppDirectionalText(
                note!.examples.first,
                languageCode: 'de',
                maxLines: 2,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                style: AppTypography.label,
              ),
            ],
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Color _articleColor(LexiconArticle article) => switch (article) {
        LexiconArticle.der => AppColors.articleDer,
        LexiconArticle.die => AppColors.articleDie,
        LexiconArticle.das => AppColors.articleDas,
        LexiconArticle.none => AppColors.articleOther,
      };
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'bicycle_models.dart';
import 'bicycle_routes.dart';

final class BicycleMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  BicycleDomain _domain = BicycleDomain.all;
  String _query = '';

  BicycleDomain get domain => _domain;
  String get query => _query;

  List<BicycleRouteDescriptor> get visibleRoutes {
    return List<BicycleRouteDescriptor>.unmodifiable(
      BicycleRoutes.all.where((route) {
        final domainMatches =
            _domain == BicycleDomain.all || route.domain == _domain;
        return domainMatches && route.matches(_query);
      }),
    );
  }

  String get safetyNoteDe =>
      'Verkehrszeichen, lokale Führungen und aktuelle Regeln vor Ort beachten. Bei Unsicherheit defensiv fahren und die zuständige Verkehrsregelung prüfen.';

  String get safetyNoteAr =>
      'انتبه دائمًا للإشارات والمسارات المحلية والقواعد الحالية. عند الشك قد بحذر وتحقق من التنظيم المروري المعمول به.';

  void setDomain(BicycleDomain value) {
    if (_domain == value) return;
    _domain = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearFilters() {
    if (_domain == BicycleDomain.all && _query.isEmpty) return;
    _domain = BicycleDomain.all;
    _query = '';
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

enum BicycleDomain {
  all,
  purchaseMaintenance,
  trafficRules;

  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        BicycleDomain.all => 'Alle Bereiche',
        BicycleDomain.purchaseMaintenance => 'Kauf & Werkstatt',
        BicycleDomain.trafficRules => 'Verkehr & Sicherheit',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        BicycleDomain.all => 'كل الأقسام',
        BicycleDomain.purchaseMaintenance => 'الشراء والصيانة',
        BicycleDomain.trafficRules => 'المرور والسلامة',
      };
}

enum BicycleRouteId {
  purchaseMaintenance,
  trafficRules,
}

final class BicycleRouteDescriptor {
  const BicycleRouteDescriptor({
    required this.id,
    required this.domain,
    required this.routeName,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.descriptionDe,
    required this.descriptionAr,
    this.searchTerms = const <String>[],
  });

  final BicycleRouteId id;
  final BicycleDomain domain;
  final String routeName;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String descriptionDe;
  final String descriptionAr;
  final List<String> searchTerms;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = _normalize(query);
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;
    return _normalize(<String>[
      titleDe,
      titleAr,
      descriptionDe,
      descriptionAr,
      ...searchTerms,
    ].join(' ')).contains(needle);
  }

  static String _normalize(String value) {
    return value
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll('ä', 'a')
        .replaceAll('ö', 'o')
        .replaceAll('ü', 'u')
        .replaceAll('ß', 'ss')
        .replaceAll('ـ', '');
  }
}

enum BicycleShopTopic {
  all,
  purchaseAdvice,
  fitAndSize,
  repair,
  maintenance;

  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        BicycleShopTopic.all => 'Alle Themen',
        BicycleShopTopic.purchaseAdvice => 'Kaufberatung',
        BicycleShopTopic.fitAndSize => 'Größe & Einstellung',
        BicycleShopTopic.repair => 'Reparatur',
        BicycleShopTopic.maintenance => 'Wartung',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        BicycleShopTopic.all => 'كل المواضيع',
        BicycleShopTopic.purchaseAdvice => 'نصيحة الشراء',
        BicycleShopTopic.fitAndSize => 'المقاس والضبط',
        BicycleShopTopic.repair => 'إصلاح الأعطال',
        BicycleShopTopic.maintenance => 'الصيانة',
      };

final class BicycleShopPhrase {
  const BicycleShopPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.topic,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.contextDe,
    required this.contextAr,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final BicycleShopTopic topic;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String contextDe;
  final String contextAr;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = _normalize(query);
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;
    return _normalize(<String>[
      topic.labelDe,
      topic.labelAr,
      german,
      arabic,
      contextDe,
      contextAr,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ')).contains(needle);
  }

  static String _normalize(String value) {
    return value
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll('ä', 'a')
        .replaceAll('ö', 'o')
        .replaceAll('ü', 'u')
        .replaceAll('ß', 'ss')
        .replaceAll('ـ', '');
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/life_bicycle_mobility/traffic_rules/bicycle_traffic_rules_agent.dart

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'bicycle_traffic_rules_models.dart';
import 'bicycle_traffic_rules_phrase_bank.dart';

final class BicycleTrafficRulesAgent extends ChangeNotifier {
  BicycleRuleTopic _topic = BicycleRuleTopic.all;
  String _query = '';

  BicycleRuleTopic get topic => _topic;
  String get query => _query;

  List<BicycleRulePhrase> get allPhrases =>
      List<BicycleRulePhrase>.unmodifiable(BicycleTrafficRulesPhraseBank.all);

  List<BicycleRulePhrase> get visiblePhrases {
    return List<BicycleRulePhrase>.unmodifiable(
      BicycleTrafficRulesPhraseBank.all.where(
        (item) =>
            (_topic == BicycleRuleTopic.all || item.topic == _topic) &&
            item.matches(_query),
      ),
    );
  }

  String get legalNoteDe =>
      'Die konkrete Beschilderung vor Ort geht allgemeinen Lernbeispielen vor. Radwegpflicht, Ampelführung und örtliche Verkehrsführung immer anhand der aktuellen Zeichen prüfen.';

  String get legalNoteAr =>
      'الإشارات الفعلية في المكان مقدمة على أمثلة التعلم العامة. تحقق دائمًا من إلزامية المسار وإشارة الدراجة وتنظيم الطريق الحالي.';

  void setTopic(BicycleRuleTopic value) {
    if (_topic == value) return;
    _topic = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}


--------------------------------------------------
FILE: lib/features/life_bicycle_mobility/traffic_rules/bicycle_traffic_rules_models.dart
--------------------------------------------------
enum BicycleRuleTopic {
  all,
  cycleLane,
  trafficSignals,
  lighting,
  safeRiding;

  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        BicycleRuleTopic.all => 'Alle Regeln',
        BicycleRuleTopic.cycleLane => 'Radweg',
        BicycleRuleTopic.trafficSignals => 'Ampeln & Vorfahrt',
        BicycleRuleTopic.lighting => 'Beleuchtung',
        BicycleRuleTopic.safeRiding => 'Sicher fahren',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        BicycleRuleTopic.all => 'كل القواعد',
        BicycleRuleTopic.cycleLane => 'مسار الدراجات',
        BicycleRuleTopic.trafficSignals => 'الإشارات والأولوية',
        BicycleRuleTopic.lighting => 'الإضاءة',
        BicycleRuleTopic.safeRiding => 'القيادة الآمنة',
      };
}

final class BicycleRulePhrase {
  const BicycleRulePhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.topic,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.contextDe,
    required this.contextAr,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final BicycleRuleTopic topic;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String contextDe;
  final String contextAr;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = _normalize(query);
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;
    return _normalize(<String>[
      topic.labelDe,
      topic.labelAr,
      german,
      arabic,
      contextDe,
      contextAr,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ')).contains(needle);
  }

  static String _normalize(String value) => value
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replaceAll('ä', 'a')
      .replaceAll('ö', 'o')
      .replaceAll('ü', 'u')
      .replaceAll('ß', 'ss')
      .replaceAll('ـ', '');
}
