FILE: lib/features/life_bureaucracy/application/bureaucracy_master_orchestrator.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/bureaucracy_models.dart';
import 'city_registration_sub_agent.dart';
import 'immigration_office_sub_agent.dart';

final class BureaucracyMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  BureaucracyMasterOrchestrator({
    this.cityAgent = const CityRegistrationSubAgent(),
    this.immigrationAgent = const ImmigrationOfficeSubAgent(),
  });

  final CityRegistrationSubAgent cityAgent;
  final ImmigrationOfficeSubAgent immigrationAgent;

  BureaucracyCategory _activeCategory = BureaucracyCategory.cityRegistration;
  String _query = '';
  String? _selectedGuideId;
  final Set<String> _readyDocumentIds = <String>{};

  BureaucracyCategory get activeCategory => _activeCategory;
  BureaucracyRegister get activeRegister => BureaucracyRegister.formalSie;
  String get query => _query;

  List<BureaucracyGuide> get visibleGuides {
    final normalized = _normalize(_query);
    return List<BureaucracyGuide>.unmodifiable(
      _guidesFor(_activeCategory).where(
        (guide) => guide.matches(normalized),
      ),
    );
  }

  BureaucracyGuide? get activeGuide {
    final visible = visibleGuides;
    if (visible.isEmpty) return null;

    final selectedId = _selectedGuideId;
    if (selectedId != null) {
      for (final guide in visible) {
        if (guide.id == selectedId) return guide;
      }
    }
    return visible.first;
  }

  ChecklistSnapshot get panicChecklist {
    final guide = activeGuide;
    if (guide == null) {
      return ChecklistSnapshot(
        documents: const <OfficialDocument>[],
        readyDocumentIds: const <String>{},
      );
    }

    final guideIds = guide.documents.map((document) => document.id).toSet();
    return ChecklistSnapshot(
      documents: guide.documents,
      readyDocumentIds: _readyDocumentIds.intersection(guideIds),
    );
  }

  void setCategory(BureaucracyCategory category) {
    if (_activeCategory == category && _query.isEmpty) return;

    _activeCategory = category;
    _query = '';
    _selectedGuideId = null;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void search(String value) {
    final next = value.trim();
    if (_query == next) return;

    _query = next;
    final selected = _selectedGuideId;
    if (selected != null &&
        !visibleGuides.any((guide) => guide.id == selected)) {
      _selectedGuideId = null;
    }
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearSearch() => search('');

  void selectGuide(String guideId) {
    final normalizedId = guideId.trim();
    final categoryGuides = _guidesFor(_activeCategory);
    final belongsToCategory =
        categoryGuides.any((guide) => guide.id == normalizedId);

    if (!belongsToCategory) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        guideId,
        'guideId',
        'Guide does not belong to the active bureaucracy category.',
      );
    }

    if (_selectedGuideId == normalizedId) return;
    _selectedGuideId = normalizedId;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setDocumentReady(String documentId, bool ready) {
    final guide = activeGuide;
    if (guide == null) {
      throw StateError('No active bureaucracy guide.');
    }

    final normalizedId = documentId.trim();
    final belongsToGuide =
        guide.documents.any((document) => document.id == normalizedId);
    if (!belongsToGuide) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        documentId,
        'documentId',
        'Document does not belong to the active guide.',
      );
    }

    final changed = ready
        ? _readyDocumentIds.add(normalizedId)
        : _readyDocumentIds.remove(normalizedId);
    if (changed) notifyListeners();
  }

  bool isDocumentReady(String documentId) =>
      _readyDocumentIds.contains(documentId.trim());

  List<BureaucracyGuide> _guidesFor(BureaucracyCategory category) =>
      switch (category) {
        BureaucracyCategory.cityRegistration => cityAgent.guides,
        BureaucracyCategory.immigrationOffice => immigrationAgent.guides,
      };

  static String _normalize(String value) =>
      value.trim().toLowerCase().replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');
}

FILE: lib/features/life_bureaucracy/domain/bureaucracy_models.dart

enum BureaucracyCategory {
  cityRegistration,
  immigrationOffice,
}

enum BureaucracyIntent {
  registrationAppointment,
  housingConfirmation,
  certificateRequest,
  residencePermitExtension,
  biometricPhoto,
  statusInquiry,
}

enum BureaucracyRegister {
  formalSie,
}

extension BureaucracyCategoryLabels on BureaucracyCategory {
  String get germanLabel => switch (this) {
        BureaucracyCategory.cityRegistration => 'Bürgeramt & Anmeldung',
        BureaucracyCategory.immigrationOffice => 'Ausländerbehörde',
      };

  String get arabicLabel => switch (this) {
        BureaucracyCategory.cityRegistration => 'مكتب المواطنين وتسجيل السكن',
        BureaucracyCategory.immigrationOffice => 'دائرة شؤون الأجانب',
      };
}

extension BureaucracyRegisterLabels on BureaucracyRegister {
  String get germanLabel => switch (this) {
        BureaucracyRegister.formalSie => 'Sie-Form',
      };

  String get arabicLabel => switch (this) {
        BureaucracyRegister.formalSie => 'صيغة رسمية مهذبة',
      };
}

final class OfficialDocument {
  const OfficialDocument({
    required this.id,
    required this.nameDe,
    required this.nameAr,
    required this.noteAr,
  });

  final String id;
  final String nameDe;
  final String nameAr;
  final String noteAr;
}

final class BureaucracyGuide {
  const BureaucracyGuide({
    required this.id,
    required this.category,
    required this.intent,
    required this.register,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.phraseDe,
    required this.phraseAr,
    required this.explanationAr,
    required this.documents,
  });

  final String id;
  final BureaucracyCategory category;
  final BureaucracyIntent intent;
  final BureaucracyRegister register;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String phraseDe;
  final String phraseAr;
  final String explanationAr;
  final List<OfficialDocument> documents;

  bool matches(String normalizedQuery) {
    if (normalizedQuery.isEmpty) return true;

    final haystack = <String>[
      id,
      titleDe,
      titleAr,
      phraseDe,
      phraseAr,
      explanationAr,
      category.germanLabel,
      category.arabicLabel,
      register.germanLabel,
      register.arabicLabel,
      for (final document in documents) ...<String>[
        document.nameDe,
        document.nameAr,
        document.noteAr,
      ],
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase();

    return haystack.contains(normalizedQuery);
  }
}

final class ChecklistSnapshot {
  ChecklistSnapshot({
    required List<OfficialDocument> documents,
    required Set<String> readyDocumentIds,
  })  : documents = List<OfficialDocument>.unmodifiable(documents),
        readyDocumentIds = Set<String>.unmodifiable(readyDocumentIds);

  final List<OfficialDocument> documents;
  final Set<String> readyDocumentIds;

  List<OfficialDocument> get missingDocuments => List<OfficialDocument>.unmodifiable(
        documents.where(
          (document) => !readyDocumentIds.contains(document.id),
        ),
      );

  int get readyCount =>
      documents.where((document) => readyDocumentIds.contains(document.id)).length;

  bool get isReady => documents.isNotEmpty && readyCount == documents.length;
}

    orchestrator.addListener(_refresh);

  void didUpdateWidget(covariant LifeBureaucracyScreen oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.orchestrator == orchestrator) return;
    oldWidget.orchestrator.removeListener(_refresh);
    orchestrator.addListener(_refresh);
    _searchController.text = orchestrator.query;
  }

    orchestrator.removeListener(_refresh);
    _searchController.dispose();
    super.dispose();

  }
  void _selectCategory(BureaucracyCategory category) {
    _searchController.clear();
    orchestrator.setCategory(category);
  }

    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

final class _SearchCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _SearchCard({
    required this.controller,
    required this.query,
    required this.surface,
    required this.border,
    required this.onChanged,
    required this.onClear,
  });
  final TextEditingController controller;
  final String query;
  final Color surface;
  final Color border;
  final ValueChanged<String> onChanged;
  final VoidCallback onClear;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final direction =
        _containsArabic(query) ? TextDirection.rtl : TextDirection.ltr;
    return AppGlassCard(
      backgroundColor: surface,
      borderColor: border,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          AppDirectionalText(
            'بحث في العبارات والمستندات',
            languageCode: 'ar',
            style: AppTypography.label,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: _BureaucracyUiTokens.smallGap),
          Directionality(
            textDirection: direction,
            child: TextField(
              controller: controller,
              onChanged: onChanged,
              style: AppTypography.body,
              textInputAction: TextInputAction.search,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                hintText: 'Anmeldung / Aufenthaltstitel / الإقامة',
                suffixIcon: query.isEmpty
                    ? const Icon(Icons.search_rounded)
                    : IconButton(
                        onPressed: onClear,
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded),
                      ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
  static bool _containsArabic(String value) =>
      value.runes.any((rune) => rune >= 0x0600 && rune <= 0x06FF);
}
final class _GuidesSection extends StatelessWidget {
  const _GuidesSection({
    required this.guides,
    required this.activeGuide,
    required this.surface,
    required this.border,
    required this.onSelected,
  });
  final List<BureaucracyGuide> guides;
  final BureaucracyGuide? activeGuide;
  final Color surface;
  final Color border;
  final ValueChanged<String> onSelected;
  @override

          'لا توجد نتيجة مطابقة في هذه الفئة. جرّب كلمة ألمانية أو عربية أخرى.',
          languageCode: 'ar',

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: <Widget>[
        AppDirectionalText(
          'المعاملات المتاحة',
          languageCode: 'ar',
          style: AppTypography.title,
        ),

final class _PanicChecklistCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PanicChecklistCard({
    required this.guide,
    required this.checklist,
    required this.surface,
    required this.border,
    required this.isReady,
    required this.onChanged,
  });
  final BureaucracyGuide guide;
  final ChecklistSnapshot checklist;
  final Color surface;
  final Color border;
  final bool Function(String documentId) isReady;
  final void Function(String documentId, bool ready) onChanged;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final accent =
        checklist.isReady ? AppColors.mastery : AppColors.tertiary;
    return AppGlassCard(
      backgroundColor: surface,
      borderColor: accent,
      glowColor: accent,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          AppDirectionalText(
            checklist.isReady
                ? 'قائمة المستندات: جاهزة'
                : 'قائمة المستندات السريعة قبل الموعد',
            languageCode: 'ar',
            style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(color: accent),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: _BureaucracyUiTokens.smallGap),
          AppDirectionalText(
            'Dokumenten-Check: ' +
                checklist.readyCount.toString() +
                '/' +
                checklist.documents.length.toString(),
            languageCode: 'de',
            style: AppTypography.label,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: _BureaucracyUiTokens.contentGap),
          for (var index = 0;
              index < guide.documents.length;
              index++) ...<Widget>[
            _DocumentChecklistRow(
              document: guide.documents[index],
              ready: isReady(guide.documents[index].id),
              surface: surface,
              border: border,
              onTap: () {
                final current = isReady(guide.documents[index].id);
                onChanged(guide.documents[index].id, !current);
              },
            ),
            if (index != guide.documents.length - 1)
              const SizedBox(height: _BureaucracyUiTokens.smallGap),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'auto_workshop_sub_agent.dart';
import 'car_service_models.dart';
import 'tuev_inspection_sub_agent.dart';

final class CarServiceMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  CarServiceMasterOrchestrator({
    AutoWorkshopSubAgent workshopAgent = const AutoWorkshopSubAgent(),
    TuevInspectionSubAgent inspectionAgent = const TuevInspectionSubAgent(),
  })  : _workshopAgent = workshopAgent,
        _inspectionAgent = inspectionAgent;

  final AutoWorkshopSubAgent _workshopAgent;
  final TuevInspectionSubAgent _inspectionAgent;

  CarServiceMode _mode = CarServiceMode.all;
  String _query = '';
  bool _seasonalTireExpanded = false;

  CarServiceMode get mode => _mode;
  String get query => _query;
  bool get seasonalTireExpanded => _seasonalTireExpanded;

  String get seasonalTireGerman =>
      'O bis O ist eine Faustregel: Winterreifen von Oktober bis Ostern. '
      'Rechtlich gilt in Deutschland keine feste O-bis-O-Frist, sondern eine '
      'situative Winterreifenpflicht bei winterlichen Straßenverhältnissen. '
      'Geeignete Winter- oder Ganzjahresreifen brauchen das Alpine-Symbol.';

  String get seasonalTireArabic =>
      'قاعدة «من O إلى O» هي تذكير تقريبي: من أكتوبر إلى عيد الفصح. '
      'قانونيًا لا يوجد موعد ثابت بهذه الصيغة في ألمانيا؛ بل يعتمد وجوب '
      'الإطارات الشتوية على ظروف الطريق الشتوية. ويجب أن تحمل الإطارات '
      'المناسبة رمز Alpine.';

  String get seasonalTireSafetyGerman =>
      'Bei Glatteis, Schneeglätte, Schneematsch, Eis- oder Reifglätte '
      'muss die Bereifung zur Situation passen.';

  String get seasonalTireSafetyArabic =>
      'عند الجليد أو الثلج أو الوحل الثلجي أو الصقيع يجب استخدام إطارات '
      'مناسبة للظروف الشتوية.';

  List<CarServicePhrase> get allPhrases =>
      List<CarServicePhrase>.unmodifiable(<CarServicePhrase>[
        ..._workshopAgent.phrases,
        ..._inspectionAgent.phrases,
      ]);

  List<CarServicePhrase> get visiblePhrases {
    final normalizedQuery = _normalize(_query);

    final result = allPhrases.where((item) {
      final modeMatches = _mode == CarServiceMode.all || item.mode == _mode;
      final queryMatches = normalizedQuery.isEmpty ||
          _normalize(item.searchableText).contains(normalizedQuery);
      return modeMatches && queryMatches;
    }).toList(growable: false);

    return List<CarServicePhrase>.unmodifiable(result);
  }

  void setMode(CarServiceMode value) {
    if (_mode == value) return;
    _mode = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearFilters() {
    if (_mode == CarServiceMode.all && _query.isEmpty) return;
    _mode = CarServiceMode.all;
    _query = '';
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void toggleSeasonalTireDetails() {
    _seasonalTireExpanded = !_seasonalTireExpanded;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  static String _normalize(String value) {
    return value
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll('ä', 'a')
        .replaceAll('ö', 'o')
        .replaceAll('ü', 'u')
        .replaceAll('ß', 'ss')
        .replaceAll('ـ', '');
  }
}

enum CarServiceMode {
  all,
  workshop,
  inspection;

  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        CarServiceMode.all => 'Alle',
        CarServiceMode.workshop => 'Werkstatt',
        CarServiceMode.inspection => 'HU / TÜV',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        CarServiceMode.all => 'الكل',
        CarServiceMode.workshop => 'ورشة الصيانة',
        CarServiceMode.inspection => 'الفحص الدوري',
      };
}

enum CarServiceTopic {
  appointment,
  costEstimate,
  oilChange,
  brakePads,
  tires,
  huPreparation,
  inspectionReport,
  inspectionSticker;

  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        CarServiceTopic.appointment => 'Werkstatttermin',
        CarServiceTopic.costEstimate => 'Kostenvoranschlag',
        CarServiceTopic.oilChange => 'Ölwechsel',
        CarServiceTopic.brakePads => 'Bremsbeläge',
        CarServiceTopic.tires => 'Reifen',
        CarServiceTopic.huPreparation => 'HU vorbereiten',
        CarServiceTopic.inspectionReport => 'Prüfbericht',
        CarServiceTopic.inspectionSticker => 'HU-Plakette',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        CarServiceTopic.appointment => 'موعد الورشة',
        CarServiceTopic.costEstimate => 'تقدير التكلفة',
        CarServiceTopic.oilChange => 'تغيير الزيت',
        CarServiceTopic.brakePads => 'بطانات الفرامل',
        CarServiceTopic.tires => 'الإطارات',
        CarServiceTopic.huPreparation => 'التحضير للفحص',
        CarServiceTopic.inspectionReport => 'تقرير الفحص',
        CarServiceTopic.inspectionSticker => 'ملصق الفحص',
      };
}

final class CarServicePhrase {
  const CarServicePhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.mode,
    required this.topic,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    this.noteDe,
    this.noteAr,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final CarServiceMode mode;
  final CarServiceTopic topic;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String? noteDe;
  final String? noteAr;
  final List<String> keywords;

  String get searchableText => <String>[
        titleDe,
        titleAr,
        german,
        arabic,
        topic.labelDe,
        topic.labelAr,
        ...keywords,
      ].join(' ');
}

import 'package:deutsch_bilarabi/features/phase3_integration/life_feature_text.dart';

import '../../design_system/app_colors.dart';
import '../../design_system/app_glass_card.dart';
import '../../design_system/app_typography.dart' hide AppDirectionalText;
import 'car_service_master_orchestrator.dart';
import 'car_service_models.dart';

abstract final class _CarServiceUiTokens {
  static const double pageInset = 16;
  static const double sectionGap = 14;
  static const double contentGap = 10;
  static const double controlGap = 8;
  static const double iconSize = 22;
}

class CarServiceMasterHub extends StatefulWidget {
  const CarServiceMasterHub({
    this.orchestrator,
    super.key,
  });

  final CarServiceMasterOrchestrator? orchestrator;

  @override
  State<CarServiceMasterHub> createState() => _CarServiceMasterHubState();
}

class _CarServiceMasterHubState extends State<CarServiceMasterHub> {
  late final CarServiceMasterOrchestrator _orchestrator;
  late final bool _ownsOrchestrator;
  late final TextEditingController _searchController;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ownsOrchestrator = widget.orchestrator == null;
    _orchestrator = widget.orchestrator ?? CarServiceMasterOrchestrator();
    _searchController = TextEditingController(text: _orchestrator.query);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchController.dispose();
    if (_ownsOrchestrator) {
      _orchestrator.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: _orchestrator,
      builder: (context, _) {
        final phrases = _orchestrator.visiblePhrases;

        return Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(
            title: AppDirectionalText(
              'Werkstatt & HU',
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
          ),
          body: SafeArea(
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(_CarServiceUiTokens.pageInset),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  _HeaderCard(count: phrases.length),
                  const SizedBox(height: _CarServiceUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _ModeFilter(orchestrator: _orchestrator),
                  const SizedBox(height: _CarServiceUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _SearchCard(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    searchController: _searchController,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: _CarServiceUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _SeasonalTireBar(orchestrator: _orchestrator),
                  const SizedBox(height: _CarServiceUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  if (phrases.isEmpty)
                    const _EmptyState()
                  else
                    for (final phrase in phrases) ...<Widget>[
                      _PhraseCard(phrase: phrase),
                      const SizedBox(height: _CarServiceUiTokens.contentGap),
                    ],
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

final class _HeaderCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _HeaderCard({required this.count});

  final int count;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return AppGlassCard(
      glowColor: AppColors.primary,
      borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(78),
      backgroundColor: dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          AppDirectionalText(
            'Autowerkstatt · Hauptuntersuchung',
            languageCode: 'de',
            style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(color: AppColors.primary),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: _CarServiceUiTokens.controlGap),
          AppDirectionalText(
            'عبارات عملية لصيانة السيارة، الورشة، الفحص الدوري وسلامة الطريق.',
            languageCode: 'ar',
            style: AppTypography.body,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: _CarServiceUiTokens.controlGap),
          AppDirectionalText(
            'Treffer: ' + count.toString(),
            languageCode: 'de',
            style: AppTypography.label,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _SearchCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _SearchCard({
    required this.orchestrator,
    required this.searchController,
  });

  final CarServiceMasterOrchestrator orchestrator;
  final TextEditingController searchController;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return AppGlassCard(
      borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(62),
      backgroundColor: dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
      child: TextField(
        key: const ValueKey<String>('car-service-search'),
        controller: searchController,
        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
        style: AppTypography.body,
        onChanged: orchestrator.setQuery,
        decoration: InputDecoration(
          prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search_rounded),
          label: AppDirectionalText(
            'ابحث بالألمانية أو العربية',
            languageCode: 'ar',
            style: AppTypography.label,
          ),
          suffixIcon: orchestrator.query.isEmpty
              ? null
              : IconButton(
                  tooltip: 'Suche löschen',
                  onPressed: () {
                    searchController.clear();
                    orchestrator.setQuery('');
                  },
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded),
                ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _PhraseCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PhraseCard({required this.phrase});

  final CarServicePhrase phrase;

  Color get _accent => switch (phrase.mode) {
        CarServiceMode.workshop => AppColors.primary,
        CarServiceMode.inspection => AppColors.secondary,
        CarServiceMode.all => AppColors.tertiary,
      };

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return AppGlassCard(
      borderColor: _accent.withAlpha(72),
      glowColor: _accent,
      backgroundColor: dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          Wrap(
            spacing: _CarServiceUiTokens.controlGap,
            runSpacing: _CarServiceUiTokens.controlGap,
            crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,
            children: <Widget>[
              AppDirectionalText(
                phrase.mode.labelDe,
                languageCode: 'de',
                style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(color: _accent),
              ),
              AppDirectionalText(
                phrase.topic.labelDe,
                languageCode: 'de',
                style: AppTypography.label,
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: _CarServiceUiTokens.contentGap),
          AppDirectionalText(
            phrase.titleDe,
            languageCode: 'de',
            style: AppTypography.title,
          ),
          AppDirectionalText(
            phrase.titleAr,
            languageCode: 'ar',
            style: AppTypography.label,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: _CarServiceUiTokens.contentGap),
          AppDirectionalText(
            phrase.german,
            languageCode: 'de',
            style: AppTypography.body,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: _CarServiceUiTokens.controlGap),
          AppDirectionalText(
            phrase.arabic,
            languageCode: 'ar',
            style: AppTypography.body,
          ),
          if (phrase.noteDe != null) ...<Widget>[
            const SizedBox(height: _CarServiceUiTokens.contentGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              phrase.noteDe!,
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.label,
            ),
          ],
          if (phrase.noteAr != null) ...<Widget>[
            const SizedBox(height: _CarServiceUiTokens.controlGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              phrase.noteAr!,
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.label,
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

enum CareerStage {
  application,
  interview,
  followUp;

  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        CareerStage.application => 'Bewerbung',
        CareerStage.interview => 'Vorstellungsgespräch',
        CareerStage.followUp => 'Nachfassen',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        CareerStage.application => 'التقديم',
        CareerStage.interview => 'المقابلة',
        CareerStage.followUp => 'المتابعة',
      };
}

enum CareerTopic {
  cv,
  coverLetter,
  openPosition,
  selfIntroduction,
  experience,
  qualifications,
  workingHours,
  teamStructure,
  followUp;
}

final class CareerPhrase {
  const CareerPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.stage,
    required this.topic,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    this.noteAr,
    this.urgent = false,
  });

  final String id;
  final CareerStage stage;
  final CareerTopic topic;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String? noteAr;
  final bool urgent;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final normalized = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (normalized.isEmpty) return true;
    return german.toLowerCase().contains(normalized) ||
        arabic.toLowerCase().contains(normalized) ||
        (noteAr?.toLowerCase().contains(normalized) ?? false) ||
        stage.labelDe.toLowerCase().contains(normalized) ||
        stage.labelAr.contains(normalized);
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'career_content.dart';
import 'career_models.dart';

final class CareerMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  CareerMasterOrchestrator({
    CareerStage initialStage = CareerStage.application,
  }) : _stage = initialStage;

  CareerStage _stage;
  String _query = '';

  CareerStage get stage => _stage;
  String get query => _query;

  static const List<CareerPhrase> _allItems = <CareerPhrase>[
    ...ApplicationDocsSubAgent.items,
    ...JobInterviewSubAgent.items,
  ];

  List<CareerPhrase> get visibleItems => List<CareerPhrase>.unmodifiable(
        _allItems.where(
          (item) => (_query.trim().isNotEmpty || item.stage == _stage) &&
              item.matches(_query),
        ),
      );

  List<CareerPhrase> get urgentPrep => List<CareerPhrase>.unmodifiable(
        JobInterviewSubAgent.items.where((item) => item.urgent),
      );

  void setStage(CareerStage stage) {
    if (_stage == stage) return;
    _stage = stage;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String query) {
    final normalized = query.trimLeft();
    if (_query == normalized) return;
    _query = normalized;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearQuery() {
    if (_query.isEmpty) return;
    _query = '';
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

          children: <Widget>[

              borderColor: AppColors.primary,
              backgroundColor: surface,
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  AppDirectionalText(
                    'Bewerbung & Karriere',
                    languageCode: 'de',
                    style: AppTypography.title,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: _CareerUiTokens.compactGap),
                  AppDirectionalText(
                    'التقديم والمسار المهني',
                    languageCode: 'ar',
                    style: AppTypography.body,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: _CareerUiTokens.sectionGap),
            _StageSelector(
              selected: _orchestrator.stage,
              onSelected: _orchestrator.setStage,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: _CareerUiTokens.sectionGap),
            _SearchCard(
              onChanged: _orchestrator.setQuery,
              onClear: _orchestrator.clearQuery,

enum ChildcareCategory {
  enrollmentAttendance,
  parentCommunication,
}

extension ChildcareCategoryLabels on ChildcareCategory {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        ChildcareCategory.enrollmentAttendance => 'Anmeldung & Alltag',
        ChildcareCategory.parentCommunication => 'Elterngespräche',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        ChildcareCategory.enrollmentAttendance => 'التسجيل والحضور',
        ChildcareCategory.parentCommunication => 'التواصل واجتماعات الأهل',
      };
}

enum ChildcareStatus {
  planningEnrollment,
  enrolled,
  absentToday,
  parentMeeting,
}

extension ChildcareStatusLabels on ChildcareStatus {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        ChildcareStatus.planningEnrollment => 'Anmeldung planen',
        ChildcareStatus.enrolled => 'Angemeldet',
        ChildcareStatus.absentToday => 'Heute abwesend',
        ChildcareStatus.parentMeeting => 'Elterngespräch',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        ChildcareStatus.planningEnrollment => 'تجهيز التسجيل',
        ChildcareStatus.enrolled => 'مسجّل',
        ChildcareStatus.absentToday => 'غائب اليوم',
        ChildcareStatus.parentMeeting => 'اجتماع أولياء الأمور',
      };
}

final class ChildcarePhrase {
  const ChildcarePhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.category,
    required this.topicDe,
    required this.topicAr,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    this.tags = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final ChildcareCategory category;
  final String topicDe;
  final String topicAr;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final List<String> tags;
}

final class ChildcareMasterHub {
  ChildcareMasterHub({required Iterable<ChildcarePhrase> entries})
      : _entries = List<ChildcarePhrase>.unmodifiable(entries);

  final List<ChildcarePhrase> _entries;
  final Set<ChildcareCategory> _selected = <ChildcareCategory>{
    ChildcareCategory.enrollmentAttendance,
    ChildcareCategory.parentCommunication,
  };

  String _query = '';
  ChildcareStatus _status = ChildcareStatus.planningEnrollment;

  String get query => _query;
  ChildcareStatus get status => _status;
  Set<ChildcareCategory> get selected =>
      Set<ChildcareCategory>.unmodifiable(_selected);

  List<ChildcarePhrase> get visibleEntries {
    final q = _normalize(_query);
    return List<ChildcarePhrase>.unmodifiable(
      _entries.where((entry) {
        if (!_selected.contains(entry.category)) return false;
        if (q.isEmpty) return true;
        final text = _normalize(<String>[
          entry.topicDe,
          entry.topicAr,
          entry.german,
          entry.arabic,
          ...entry.tags,
        ].join(' '));
        return text.contains(q);
      }),
    );
  }

  void setQuery(String value) => _query = value.trim();

  void toggleCategory(ChildcareCategory category) {
    if (_selected.contains(category)) {
      _selected.remove(category);
    } else {
      _selected.add(category);
    }
  }

  void setStatus(ChildcareStatus value) => _status = value;

  String get statusPromptDe => switch (_status) {
        ChildcareStatus.planningEnrollment =>
          'Welche Unterlagen und Fristen gelten für die Anmeldung meines Kindes?',
        ChildcareStatus.enrolled =>
          'Wo finde ich die aktuellen Informationen zu Bringzeit, Abholzeit und Ansprechpartnern?',
        ChildcareStatus.absentToday =>
          'Mein Kind kann heute nicht kommen. Ich möchte die Abwesenheit rechtzeitig melden.',
        ChildcareStatus.parentMeeting =>
          'Ich möchte einen Termin für ein Elterngespräch vereinbaren und wissen, welche Themen vorbereitet werden.',
      };

  String get statusPromptAr => switch (_status) {
        ChildcareStatus.planningEnrollment =>
          'ما الوثائق والمواعيد المطلوبة لتسجيل طفلي؟',
        ChildcareStatus.enrolled =>
          'أين أجد المعلومات الحالية عن وقت الحضور والاستلام والأشخاص المسؤولين؟',
        ChildcareStatus.absentToday =>
          'طفلي لن يتمكن من الحضور اليوم، وأريد إبلاغكم بالغياب في الوقت المناسب.',
        ChildcareStatus.parentMeeting =>
          'أريد تحديد موعد لاجتماع مع الأهل ومعرفة المواضيع التي يُفضّل التحضير لها.',
      };

  static String _normalize(String value) {
    var out = value.toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll('ä', 'a')
        .replaceAll('ö', 'o')
        .replaceAll('ü', 'u')
        .replaceAll('ß', 'ss');
    out = out.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-z0-9ء-ي ]'), ' ');
    return out.replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ').trim();
  }
}

final class _StatusCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _StatusCard({
    required this.surface,
    required this.hub,
    required this.onChanged,
  });

  final Color surface;
  final ChildcareMasterHub hub;
  final VoidCallback onChanged;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        key: const ValueKey<String>('childcare-status-card'),
        backgroundColor: surface,
        glowColor: AppColors.tertiary,
        borderColor: AppColors.tertiary.withAlpha(_ChildcareUi.borderAlpha),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            AppDirectionalText(
              'الموقف الحالي',
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: _ChildcareUi.smallGap),
            Wrap(
              spacing: _ChildcareUi.smallGap,
              runSpacing: _ChildcareUi.smallGap,
              children: <Widget>[
                for (final status in ChildcareStatus.values)
                  ChoiceChip(
                    key: ValueKey<String>('childcare-status-${status.name}'),
                    selected: hub.status == status,
                    selectedColor:
                        AppColors.tertiary.withAlpha(_ChildcareUi.selectedAlpha),
                    label: Column(
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      children: <Widget>[
                        AppDirectionalText(
                          status.labelAr,
                          languageCode: 'ar',
                          style: AppTypography.label,
                        ),
                        AppDirectionalText(
                          status.labelDe,
                          languageCode: 'de',
                          style: AppTypography.label,
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    onSelected: (_) {
                      hub.setStatus(status);
                      onChanged();
                    },
                  ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: _ChildcareUi.smallGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              hub.statusPromptDe,
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(color: AppColors.tertiary),
            ),
            AppDirectionalText(
              hub.statusPromptAr,
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.body,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

final class _CategoryCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _CategoryCard({
    required this.surface,
    required this.hub,
    required this.onChanged,
  });

  final Color surface;
  final ChildcareMasterHub hub;
  final VoidCallback onChanged;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        backgroundColor: surface,
        borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(_ChildcareUi.borderAlpha),
        child: Wrap(
          spacing: _ChildcareUi.smallGap,
          runSpacing: _ChildcareUi.smallGap,
          children: <Widget>[
            for (final category in ChildcareCategory.values)
              FilterChip(
                key: ValueKey<String>('childcare-category-${category.name}'),
                selected: hub.selected.contains(category),
                selectedColor:
                    AppColors.primary.withAlpha(_ChildcareUi.selectedAlpha),
                label: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    AppDirectionalText(
                      category.labelAr,
                      languageCode: 'ar',
                      style: AppTypography.label,
                    ),
                    AppDirectionalText(
                      category.labelDe,
                      languageCode: 'de',
                      style: AppTypography.label,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                onSelected: (_) {
                  hub.toggleCategory(category);
                  onChanged();
                },
              ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

final class _PhraseCard extends StatelessWidget {

              entry.topicDe,

              entry.arabic,
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.body,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

import 'clothing_dependencies.dart';
import 'clothing_models.dart';
import 'fitting/fitting_models.dart';
import 'tailoring/tailoring_models.dart';

enum ClothingHubSource { fitting, tailoring }

final class ClothingHubPhrase {
  final ClothingHubSource source;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;

  const ClothingHubPhrase({
    required this.source,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
  });
}

final class ClothingMasterOrchestrator {
  final ClothingAlterationsDependencies dependencies;

  const ClothingMasterOrchestrator({
    this.dependencies = const ClothingAlterationsDependencies(),
  });

  static const List<ClothingFabricInfo> fabricGuide = <ClothingFabricInfo>[
    ClothingFabricInfo(
      fabric: ClothingFabric.cotton,
      descriptionDe: 'Baumwolle ist ein natürlicher Stoff für viele Alltagshemden.',
      descriptionAr: 'القطن خامة طبيعية شائعة في القمصان اليومية.',
      carePromptDe: 'Welche Waschanleitung gilt für dieses Baumwollstück?',
      carePromptAr: 'ما تعليمات غسل هذه القطعة القطنية؟',
    ),
    ClothingFabricInfo(
      fabric: ClothingFabric.wool,
      descriptionDe: 'Wolle wird häufig für klassische Jacken und Wintermäntel verwendet.',
      descriptionAr: 'يستخدم الصوف كثيراً في السترات الكلاسيكية والمعاطف الشتوية.',
      carePromptDe: 'Wie soll ich dieses Wollstück waschen und bügeln?',
      carePromptAr: 'كيف ينبغي غسل هذه القطعة الصوفية وكيها؟',
    ),
  ];

  static const List<StandardClothingSize> sizeGuide = <StandardClothingSize>[
    StandardClothingSize(
      garment: ClothingGarment.shirt,
      label: 'M',
      euReference: '39/40',
      noteDe: 'Referenzgröße; Herstellerangaben und Anprobe prüfen.',
      noteAr: 'مقاس مرجعي؛ يُراجع دليل الشركة وتجربة القطعة.',
    ),
    StandardClothingSize(
      garment: ClothingGarment.trousers,
      label: 'M',
      euReference: '48/50',
      noteDe: 'Bundweite und Beinlänge zusätzlich prüfen.',
      noteAr: 'يُفحص أيضاً عرض الخصر وطول الساق.',
    ),
    StandardClothingSize(
      garment: ClothingGarment.jacket,
      label: 'M',
      euReference: '48/50',
      noteDe: 'Schulterweite und Ärmellänge bei der Anprobe prüfen.',
      noteAr: 'يُفحص عرض الكتفين وطول الأكمام أثناء التجربة.',
    ),
    StandardClothingSize(
      garment: ClothingGarment.winterCoat,
      label: 'M',
      euReference: '48/50',
      noteDe: 'Genügend Platz für Kleidung darunter einplanen.',
      noteAr: 'يُراعى وجود مساحة كافية للملابس أسفل المعطف.',
    ),
  ];

  List<ClothingHubPhrase> search(String query) {
    final fitting = dependencies.fittingAgent.findDialogues(query: query);
    final tailoring = dependencies.tailoringAgent.findDialogues(query: query);
    return List<ClothingHubPhrase>.unmodifiable(<ClothingHubPhrase>[
      for (final item in fitting)
        ClothingHubPhrase(
          source: ClothingHubSource.fitting,
          german: item.german,
          arabic: item.arabic,
        ),
      for (final item in tailoring)
        ClothingHubPhrase(
          source: ClothingHubSource.tailoring,
          german: item.german,
          arabic: item.arabic,
        ),
    ]);
  }

  List<FittingDialogue> fittingFor(FittingGarmentType garment) =>
      dependencies.fittingAgent.findDialogues(garment: garment);

  List<TailoringDialogue> tailoringFor(TailoringService service) =>
      dependencies.tailoringAgent.findDialogues(service: service);

  AlterationReceipt createReceipt({
    required String receiptId,
    required ClothingGarment garment,
    required String serviceDe,
    required String serviceAr,
    required DateTime receivedAt,
    required DateTime readyAt,
    double? agreedPriceEuro,
  }) {
    final id = receiptId.trim();
    if (id.isEmpty || id.length > 80) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(receiptId, 'receiptId', 'invalid receipt id');
    }
    if (readyAt.isBefore(receivedAt)) {
      throw ArgumentError('readyAt must not be before receivedAt');
    }
    if (agreedPriceEuro != null &&
        (!agreedPriceEuro.isFinite || agreedPriceEuro < 0)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        agreedPriceEuro,
        'agreedPriceEuro',
        'must be a finite non-negative value',
      );
    }
    return AlterationReceipt(
      receiptId: id,
      garment: garment,
      serviceDe: serviceDe.trim(),
      serviceAr: serviceAr.trim(),
      receivedAt: receivedAt,
      readyAt: readyAt,
      agreedPriceEuro: agreedPriceEuro,
    );
  }
}

import 'package:deutsch_bilarabi/features/phase3_integration/life_feature_text.dart';

import 'tailoring/tailoring_panel.dart';

class ClothingAlterationsMasterScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ClothingAlterationsMasterScreen({
    this.orchestrator = const ClothingMasterOrchestrator(),
    super.key,
  });

  final ClothingMasterOrchestrator orchestrator;

  @override
  State<ClothingAlterationsMasterScreen> createState() =>
      _ClothingAlterationsMasterScreenState();
}

class _ClothingAlterationsMasterScreenState
    extends State<ClothingAlterationsMasterScreen> {
  String _query = '';

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: DefaultTabController(
        length: 3,
        child: Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(
            title: const Text('الملابس والخياطة'),
            bottom: const TabBar(
              tabs: <Tab>[
                Tab(text: 'المركز'),
                Tab(text: 'القياس'),
                Tab(text: 'الخياطة'),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          body: TabBarView(
            children: <Widget>[
              _overview(context),
              ClothingFittingPanel(
                agent: widget.orchestrator.dependencies.fittingAgent,
              ),
              ClothingTailoringPanel(
                agent: widget.orchestrator.dependencies.tailoringAgent,
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _overview(BuildContext context) {
    final matches = widget.orchestrator.search(_query);
    return SingleChildScrollView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          AppGlassCard(
            glowColor: AppColors.primary,
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                Text(
                  'Clothing & Änderungsschneiderei',
                  textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                  style: AppTypography.title,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 6),
                Text(
                  'مركز عملي للملابس اليومية الكلاسيكية، القياس، والخياطة.',
                  style: AppTypography.body,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                TextField(
                  onChanged: (value) => setState(() => _query = value),
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.search_rounded),
                    labelText: 'ابحث في عبارات القياس والخياطة',
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          if (_query.trim().isNotEmpty)
            AppGlassCard(
              glowColor: AppColors.achievement,
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text('نتائج البحث', style: AppTypography.title),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  if (matches.isEmpty)
                    Text('لا توجد نتيجة مطابقة.', style: AppTypography.body),
                  for (final item in matches) ...[
                    Text(
                      item.german,
                      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                      style: AppTypography.body.copyWith(
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      ),
                    ),
                    Text(item.arabic, style: AppTypography.body),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  ],
                ],
              ),
            ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          AppGlassCard(
            glowColor: AppColors.secondary,
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text('الخامات الطبيعية', style: AppTypography.title),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                for (final info in ClothingMasterOrchestrator.fabricGuide) ...[
                  Text(
                    info.fabric.arabic + ' · ' + info.fabric.german,
                    style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
                      color: AppColors.secondary,
                    ),
                  ),
                  Text(
                    info.descriptionDe,
                    textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                    style: AppTypography.body,
                  ),
                  Text(info.descriptionAr, style: AppTypography.body),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          AppGlassCard(
            glowColor: AppColors.achievement,
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text('مراجع المقاسات', style: AppTypography.title),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                for (final size in ClothingMasterOrchestrator.sizeGuide) ...[
                  Text(
                    size.garment.arabic +
                        ' · ' +
                        size.garment.german +
                        ' · ' +
                        size.label +
                        ' · EU ' +
                        size.euReference,
                    style: AppTypography.body.copyWith(
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                    ),
                  ),
                  Text(size.noteAr, style: AppTypography.body),

                ],

            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

enum ClothingGarment {
  shirt('Hemd', 'قميص'),
  trousers('Hose', 'بنطال'),
  jacket('Jacke', 'سترة'),
  winterCoat('Wintermantel', 'معطف شتوي');

  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  const ClothingGarment(this.german, this.arabic);
}

enum ClothingFabric {
  cotton('Baumwolle', 'قطن'),
  wool('Wolle', 'صوف');

  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  const ClothingFabric(this.german, this.arabic);
}

final class StandardClothingSize {
  final ClothingGarment garment;
  final String label;
  final String euReference;
  final String noteDe;
  final String noteAr;

  const StandardClothingSize({
    required this.garment,
    required this.label,
    required this.euReference,
    required this.noteDe,
    required this.noteAr,
  });
}

final class ClothingFabricInfo {
  final ClothingFabric fabric;
  final String descriptionDe;
  final String descriptionAr;
  final String carePromptDe;
  final String carePromptAr;

  const ClothingFabricInfo({
    required this.fabric,
    required this.descriptionDe,
    required this.descriptionAr,
    required this.carePromptDe,
    required this.carePromptAr,
  });
}

final class AlterationReceipt {
  final String receiptId;
  final ClothingGarment garment;
  final String serviceDe;
  final String serviceAr;
  final DateTime receivedAt;
  final DateTime readyAt;
  final double? agreedPriceEuro;

  const AlterationReceipt({
    required this.receiptId,
    required this.garment,
    required this.serviceDe,
    required this.serviceAr,
    required this.receivedAt,
    required this.readyAt,
    this.agreedPriceEuro,
  });

  bool get isChronologicallyValid => !readyAt.isBefore(receivedAt);
}

FILE: lib/features/life_clothing_alterations/fitting/fitting_agent.dart

import 'fitting_catalog.dart';
import 'fitting_models.dart';

final class ClothingFittingAgent {
  const ClothingFittingAgent();

  List<FittingDialogue> findDialogues({
    FittingGarmentType? garment,
    String query = '',
  }) {
    final needle = _normalize(query);
    return List<FittingDialogue>.unmodifiable(
      FittingCatalog.dialogues.where((dialogue) {
        if (garment != null && dialogue.garment != garment) return false;
        if (needle.isEmpty) return true;
        final haystack = _normalize(
          <String>[
            dialogue.german,
            dialogue.arabic,
            ...dialogue.keywords,
          ].join(' '),
        );
        return haystack.contains(needle);
      }),
    );
  }

  FabricCareNote? careFor(NaturalFabric fabric) {
    for (final note in FittingCatalog.fabrics) {
      if (note.fabric == fabric) return note;
    }
    return null;
  }

  String comfortRequest({
    required FittingGarmentType garment,
    required FitDimension dimension,
  }) {
    return switch (dimension) {
      FitDimension.length =>
        'Könnten Sie mir die ' + garment.german + ' in einer passenderen Länge zeigen?',
      FitDimension.width =>
        'Haben Sie die ' + garment.german + ' mit etwas mehr Weite?',
      FitDimension.comfort =>
        'Haben Sie die ' + garment.german + ' in einer etwas bequemeren Passform?',
    };
  }

  static String _normalize(String value) => value
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');
}

enum FittingGarmentType {
  jacket('Jacke', 'سترة'),
  shirt('Hemd', 'قميص'),
  trousers('Hose', 'بنطال');

  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  const FittingGarmentType(this.german, this.arabic);
}

enum NaturalFabric {
  cotton('Baumwolle', 'قطن'),
  wool('Wolle', 'صوف');

  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  const NaturalFabric(this.german, this.arabic);
}

enum FitDimension {
  length('Länge', 'الطول'),
  width('Weite', 'العرض'),
  comfort('bequemer Sitz', 'الراحة');

  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  const FitDimension(this.german, this.arabic);
}

final class FittingDialogue {
  final String id;
  final FittingGarmentType garment;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final Set<String> keywords;

  const FittingDialogue({
    required this.id,
    required this.garment,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.keywords,
  });
}

final class FabricCareNote {
  final NaturalFabric fabric;
  final String materialQuestionDe;
  final String materialQuestionAr;
  final String careQuestionDe;
  final String careQuestionAr;

  const FabricCareNote({
    required this.fabric,
    required this.materialQuestionDe,
    required this.materialQuestionAr,
    required this.careQuestionDe,
    required this.careQuestionAr,
  });
}

import 'tailoring_catalog.dart';
import 'tailoring_models.dart';

final class ClothingTailoringAgent {
  const ClothingTailoringAgent();

  List<TailoringDialogue> findDialogues({
    TailoringService? service,
    String query = '',
  }) {
    final needle = _normalize(query);
    return List<TailoringDialogue>.unmodifiable(
      TailoringCatalog.dialogues.where((dialogue) {
        if (service != null && dialogue.service != service) return false;
        if (needle.isEmpty) return true;
        final text = <String>[
          dialogue.german,
          dialogue.arabic,
          dialogue.service.german,
          dialogue.service.arabic,
          ...dialogue.keywords,
        ].join(' ');
        return _normalize(text).contains(needle);
      }),
    );
  }

  TailoringAgreement? agreementFor(TailoringService service) {
    for (final agreement in TailoringCatalog.agreements) {
      if (agreement.service == service) return agreement;
    }
    return null;
  }

  static String _normalize(String value) => value
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');
}

FILE: lib/features/life_culture/application/culture_master_orchestrator.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/culture_models.dart';
import 'adult_education_sub_agent.dart';
import 'public_library_sub_agent.dart';

final class CultureMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  CultureMasterOrchestrator({
    this.libraryAgent = const PublicLibrarySubAgent(),
    this.adultEducationAgent = const AdultEducationSubAgent(),
  });

  final PublicLibrarySubAgent libraryAgent;
  final AdultEducationSubAgent adultEducationAgent;

  CultureDomain _activeDomain = CultureDomain.publicLibrary;
  String _query = '';
  String? _selectedGuideId;

  CultureDomain get activeDomain => _activeDomain;
  String get query => _query;
  CultureGuide get quickCardRenewalGuide => libraryAgent.quickCardRenewalGuide;

  List<CultureGuide> get visibleGuides {
    final normalized = _normalize(_query);
    return List<CultureGuide>.unmodifiable(
      _guidesFor(_activeDomain).where(
        (guide) => guide.matches(normalized),
      ),
    );
  }

  CultureGuide? get activeGuide {
    final visible = visibleGuides;
    if (visible.isEmpty) return null;

    final selectedId = _selectedGuideId;
    if (selectedId != null) {
      for (final guide in visible) {
        if (guide.id == selectedId) return guide;
      }
    }
    return visible.first;
  }

  void setDomain(CultureDomain domain) {
    if (_activeDomain == domain && _query.isEmpty && _selectedGuideId == null) {
      return;
    }

    _activeDomain = domain;
    _query = '';
    _selectedGuideId = null;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void search(String value) {
    final next = value.trim();
    if (_query == next) return;

    _query = next;
    final selected = _selectedGuideId;
    if (selected != null &&
        !visibleGuides.any((guide) => guide.id == selected)) {
      _selectedGuideId = null;
    }
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearSearch() => search('');

  void selectGuide(String guideId) {
    final normalizedId = guideId.trim();
    final belongsToDomain = _guidesFor(_activeDomain).any(
      (guide) => guide.id == normalizedId,
    );

    if (!belongsToDomain) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        guideId,
        'guideId',
        'Guide does not belong to the active culture domain.',
      );
    }

    if (_selectedGuideId == normalizedId) return;
    _selectedGuideId = normalizedId;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void openQuickCardRenewal() {
    final renewal = quickCardRenewalGuide;
    final changed = _activeDomain != CultureDomain.publicLibrary ||
        _query.isNotEmpty ||
        _selectedGuideId != renewal.id;

    _activeDomain = CultureDomain.publicLibrary;
    _query = '';
    _selectedGuideId = renewal.id;

    if (changed) notifyListeners();
  }

  List<CultureGuide> _guidesFor(CultureDomain domain) => switch (domain) {
        CultureDomain.publicLibrary => libraryAgent.guides,
        CultureDomain.adultEducation => adultEducationAgent.guides,
      };

  static String _normalize(String value) =>
      value.trim().toLowerCase().replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');
}

--------------------------------------------------
FILE: lib/features/life_culture/domain/culture_models.dart
--------------------------------------------------
enum CultureDomain {
  publicLibrary,
  adultEducation,
}

enum CultureIntent {
  libraryCardIssuance,
  libraryCardRenewal,
  loanExtension,
  digitalMediaOnleihe,
  studyRoomEtiquette,
  vhsCourseRegistration,
  scheduleInquiry,
  materialsInquiry,
  attendanceCertificate,
}

extension CultureDomainLabels on CultureDomain {
  String get germanLabel => switch (this) {
        CultureDomain.publicLibrary => 'Stadtbibliothek',
        CultureDomain.adultEducation => 'Volkshochschule (VHS)',
      };

  String get arabicLabel => switch (this) {
        CultureDomain.publicLibrary => 'المكتبة العامة',
        CultureDomain.adultEducation => 'تعليم الكبار (VHS)',
      };
}

final class CultureGuide {
  const CultureGuide({
    required this.id,
    required this.domain,
    required this.intent,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.phraseDe,
    required this.phraseAr,
    required this.noteAr,
    this.searchTerms = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final CultureDomain domain;
  final CultureIntent intent;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String phraseDe;
  final String phraseAr;
  final String noteAr;
  final List<String> searchTerms;

  bool matches(String normalizedQuery) {
    if (normalizedQuery.isEmpty) return true;

    final haystack = <String>[
      id,
      titleDe,
      titleAr,
      phraseDe,
      phraseAr,
      noteAr,
      domain.germanLabel,
      domain.arabicLabel,
      ...searchTerms,
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase();

    return haystack.contains(normalizedQuery);
  }
}

import '../../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import '../application/culture_master_orchestrator.dart';
import '../domain/culture_models.dart';

abstract final class _CultureUiTokens {
  static const double pageInset = 16;
  static const double topInset = 18;
  static const double bottomInset = 32;
  static const double sectionGap = 14;
  static const double contentGap = 10;
  static const double smallGap = 7;
  static const double chipHorizontal = 12;
  static const double chipVertical = 10;
  static const double icon = 28;
}

final class LifeCultureScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const LifeCultureScreen({
    required this.orchestrator,
    super.key,
  });

  final CultureMasterOrchestrator orchestrator;

  @override
  State<LifeCultureScreen> createState() => _LifeCultureScreenState();
}

final class _LifeCultureScreenState extends State<LifeCultureScreen> {
  final TextEditingController _searchController = TextEditingController();

  CultureMasterOrchestrator get orchestrator => widget.orchestrator;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    orchestrator.addListener(_refresh);
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant LifeCultureScreen oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.orchestrator == orchestrator) return;
    oldWidget.orchestrator.removeListener(_refresh);
    orchestrator.addListener(_refresh);
    _searchController.text = orchestrator.query;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    orchestrator.removeListener(_refresh);
    _searchController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _refresh() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  void _selectDomain(CultureDomain domain) {
    _searchController.clear();
    orchestrator.setDomain(domain);
  }

  void _openQuickRenewal() {
    _searchController.clear();
    orchestrator.openQuickCardRenewal();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final background =
        isDark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground;
    final surface = isDark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface;
    final border =
        isDark ? AppColors.glassBorderDark : AppColors.glassBorderLight;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: background,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              _CultureUiTokens.pageInset,
              _CultureUiTokens.topInset,
              _CultureUiTokens.pageInset,
              _CultureUiTokens.bottomInset,
            ),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: <Widget>[
                _HeaderCard(surface: surface, border: border),
                const SizedBox(height: _CultureUiTokens.sectionGap),
                _DomainSelector(
                  activeDomain: orchestrator.activeDomain,
                  surface: surface,
                  border: border,
                  onSelected: _selectDomain,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: _CultureUiTokens.sectionGap),
                _QuickRenewalBar(
                  guide: orchestrator.quickCardRenewalGuide,
                  surface: surface,
                  onOpen: _openQuickRenewal,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: _CultureUiTokens.sectionGap),
                _SearchCard(
                  controller: _searchController,
                  query: orchestrator.query,
                  surface: surface,
                  border: border,
                  onChanged: orchestrator.search,
                  onClear: () {
                    _searchController.clear();
                    orchestrator.clearSearch();
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: _CultureUiTokens.sectionGap),
                _GuidesSection(
                  guides: orchestrator.visibleGuides,
                  activeGuide: orchestrator.activeGuide,
                  surface: surface,
                  border: border,
                  onSelected: orchestrator.selectGuide,
                ),
                if (orchestrator.activeGuide != null) ...<Widget>[
                  const SizedBox(height: _CultureUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _GuideDetailsCard(
                    guide: orchestrator.activeGuide!,
                    surface: surface,
                    border: border,
                  ),
                ],
                const SizedBox(height: _CultureUiTokens.sectionGap),
                _LocalVariationNote(surface: surface, border: border),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _SearchCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _SearchCard({
    required this.controller,
    required this.query,
    required this.surface,
    required this.border,
    required this.onChanged,
    required this.onClear,
  });

  final TextEditingController controller;
  final String query;
  final Color surface;
  final Color border;
  final ValueChanged<String> onChanged;
  final VoidCallback onClear;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final direction =
        _containsArabic(query) ? TextDirection.rtl : TextDirection.ltr;

    return AppGlassCard(
      backgroundColor: surface,
      borderColor: border,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          AppDirectionalText(
            'ابحث بالألمانية أو العربية',
            languageCode: 'ar',
            style: AppTypography.label,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: _CultureUiTokens.smallGap),
          Directionality(
            textDirection: direction,
            child: TextField(
              controller: controller,
              onChanged: onChanged,
              style: AppTypography.body,
              textInputAction: TextInputAction.search,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                hintText: 'Onleihe / VHS / شهادة الحضور',
                suffixIcon: query.isEmpty
                    ? const Icon(Icons.search_rounded)
                    : IconButton(
                        onPressed: onClear,
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded),
                      ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  static bool _containsArabic(String value) =>
      value.runes.any((rune) => rune >= 0x0600 && rune <= 0x06FF);
}

final class _GuidesSection extends StatelessWidget {

        const SizedBox(height: _CultureUiTokens.contentGap),
        for (var index = 0; index < guides.length; index++) ...<Widget>[
          AppGlassCard(

                  guides[index].titleAr,
                  languageCode: 'ar',
                  style: AppTypography.body,
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          if (index != guides.length - 1)

  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(

          children: <Widget>[

FILE: lib/features/life_cycling/cycling_master_orchestrator.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'bike_repair_sub_agent.dart';
import 'cycle_traffic_sub_agent.dart';
import 'cycling_models.dart';

final class CyclingMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  CyclingMasterOrchestrator({
    CycleTrafficSubAgent traffic = const CycleTrafficSubAgent(),
    BikeRepairSubAgent repair = const BikeRepairSubAgent(),
  })  : _traffic = traffic,
        _repair = repair;

  final CycleTrafficSubAgent _traffic;
  final BikeRepairSubAgent _repair;

  CyclingCategory _category = CyclingCategory.trafficSafety;
  String _query = '';

  CyclingCategory get category => _category;
  String get query => _query;

  List<BikeSafetyCheckItem> get safetyChecklist => _traffic.safetyChecklist;

  List<CyclingPhrase> get visiblePhrases {
    final source = switch (_category) {
      CyclingCategory.trafficSafety => _traffic.phrases,
      CyclingCategory.workshopRepair => _repair.phrases,
    };

    return List<CyclingPhrase>.unmodifiable(
      source.where((phrase) => phrase.matches(_query)),
    );
  }

  void setCategory(CyclingCategory value) {
    if (_category == value) return;
    _category = value;
    _query = '';
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearSearch() => setQuery('');
}

enum CyclingCategory { trafficSafety, workshopRepair }

enum CyclingTopic {
  equipment,
  radweg,
  oneWayStreet,
  handSignal,
  tyre,
  innerTube,
  chain,
  workshop,
}

extension CyclingCategoryLabels on CyclingCategory {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        CyclingCategory.trafficSafety => 'Verkehr & Sicherheit',
        CyclingCategory.workshopRepair => 'Werkstatt & Reparatur',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        CyclingCategory.trafficSafety => 'المرور والسلامة',
        CyclingCategory.workshopRepair => 'الورشة والإصلاح',
      };
}

extension CyclingTopicLabels on CyclingTopic {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        CyclingTopic.equipment => 'Verkehrssicheres Fahrrad',
        CyclingTopic.radweg => 'Radwegbenutzungspflicht',
        CyclingTopic.oneWayStreet => 'Einbahnstraße',
        CyclingTopic.handSignal => 'Handzeichen',
        CyclingTopic.tyre => 'Reifen flicken',
        CyclingTopic.innerTube => 'Schlauch wechseln',
        CyclingTopic.chain => 'Kette spannen',
        CyclingTopic.workshop => 'Fahrradwerkstatt',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        CyclingTopic.equipment => 'تجهيزات الدراجة الآمنة',
        CyclingTopic.radweg => 'إلزام استخدام مسار الدراجات',
        CyclingTopic.oneWayStreet => 'شارع باتجاه واحد',
        CyclingTopic.handSignal => 'إشارة اليد',
        CyclingTopic.tyre => 'ترقيع الإطار',
        CyclingTopic.innerTube => 'تغيير الأنبوب الداخلي',
        CyclingTopic.chain => 'شد السلسلة',
        CyclingTopic.workshop => 'ورشة الدراجات',
      };
}

final class CyclingPhrase {
  const CyclingPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.category,
    required this.topic,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final CyclingCategory category;
  final CyclingTopic topic;
  final String titleDe;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;

    return <String>[
      titleDe,
      german,
      arabic,
      topic.labelDe,
      topic.labelAr,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase().contains(needle);
  }
}

final class BikeSafetyCheckItem {
  const BikeSafetyCheckItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.labelDe,
    required this.labelAr,
    required this.legalBasis,
  });

  final String id;
  final String labelDe;
  final String labelAr;
  final String legalBasis;
}

import '../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import 'cycling_master_orchestrator.dart';
import 'cycling_models.dart';

abstract final class CyclingUiTokens {
  static const double pageInset = 16;
  static const double bottomInset = 32;
  static const double sectionGap = 18;
  static const double itemGap = 12;
  static const double compactGap = 8;
  static const int borderAlpha = 88;
}

final class CyclingMasterHub extends StatefulWidget {
  const CyclingMasterHub({
    this.orchestrator,
    super.key,
  });

  final CyclingMasterOrchestrator? orchestrator;

  @override
  State<CyclingMasterHub> createState() => _CyclingMasterHubState();
}

final class _CyclingMasterHubState extends State<CyclingMasterHub> {
  late final CyclingMasterOrchestrator _orchestrator;
  late final bool _ownsOrchestrator;
  late final TextEditingController _searchController;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ownsOrchestrator = widget.orchestrator == null;
    _orchestrator = widget.orchestrator ?? CyclingMasterOrchestrator();
    _searchController = TextEditingController(text: _orchestrator.query);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchController.dispose();
    if (_ownsOrchestrator) _orchestrator.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _selectCategory(CyclingCategory category) {
    _orchestrator.setCategory(category);
    if (_searchController.text.isNotEmpty) _searchController.clear();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return Directionality(
      key: const ValueKey<String>('cycling-german-direction'),
      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              CyclingUiTokens.pageInset,
              CyclingUiTokens.pageInset,
              CyclingUiTokens.pageInset,
              CyclingUiTokens.bottomInset,
            ),
            child: AnimatedBuilder(
              animation: _orchestrator,
              builder: (context, _) => Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  _HeaderCard(dark: dark),
                  const SizedBox(height: CyclingUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _SafetyChecklistBar(
                    items: _orchestrator.safetyChecklist,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: CyclingUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _CategorySelector(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    onSelected: _selectCategory,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: CyclingUiTokens.itemGap),
                  _SearchField(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    controller: _searchController,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: CyclingUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _PhraseList(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _SearchField extends StatelessWidget {
  const _SearchField({
    required this.orchestrator,
    required this.controller,
  });

  final CyclingMasterOrchestrator orchestrator;
  final TextEditingController controller;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => TextField(
        key: const ValueKey<String>('cycling-search'),
        controller: controller,
        onChanged: orchestrator.setQuery,
        textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
        decoration: InputDecoration(
          prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search),
          suffixIcon: orchestrator.query.isEmpty
              ? null
              : IconButton(
                  onPressed: () {
                    controller.clear();
                    orchestrator.clearSearch();
                  },
                  tooltip: 'Clear search',
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.close),
                ),
          labelText: 'Suche · بحث',
          hintText: 'Radweg, Handzeichen, Reifen, Kette ...',
          border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
        ),
      );

}

final class _PhraseList extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PhraseList({
    required this.orchestrator,
    required this.dark,
  });

  final CyclingMasterOrchestrator orchestrator;
  final bool dark;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final phrases = orchestrator.visiblePhrases;

    if (phrases.isEmpty) {
      return AppGlassCard(
        borderColor:
            AppColors.tertiary.withAlpha(CyclingUiTokens.borderAlpha),
        backgroundColor: dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
        child: Directionality(
          textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
          child: AppDirectionalText(
            'لا توجد نتائج مطابقة في هذا القسم.',
            languageCode: 'ar',
            style: AppTypography.body,
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: <Widget>[
        for (var index = 0; index < phrases.length; index++) ...<Widget>[
          _PhraseCard(
            phrase: phrases[index],
            dark: dark,
          ),
          if (index != phrases.length - 1)
            const SizedBox(height: CyclingUiTokens.itemGap),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }
}

final class _PhraseCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PhraseCard({
    required this.phrase,
    required this.dark,
  });

  final CyclingPhrase phrase;
  final bool dark;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final accent = phrase.category == CyclingCategory.trafficSafety
        ? AppColors.primary
        : AppColors.secondary;

    return AppGlassCard(
      borderColor: accent.withAlpha(CyclingUiTokens.borderAlpha),
      backgroundColor: dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          AppDirectionalText(
            phrase.topic.labelDe,
            languageCode: 'de',
            style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(color: accent),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: CyclingUiTokens.compactGap),
          AppDirectionalText(
            phrase.titleDe,
            languageCode: 'de',
            style: AppTypography.title,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: CyclingUiTokens.compactGap),
          AppDirectionalText(
            phrase.german,
            languageCode: 'de',
            style: AppTypography.body,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: CyclingUiTokens.compactGap),
          Directionality(
            textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
            child: AppDirectionalText(
              phrase.arabic,
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.body,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

FILE: lib/features/life_dentist_clinic/dentist_models.dart
