enum DentistCategory {
  checkup,
  cleaning,
  appointment;

  String get german => switch (this) {
        DentistCategory.checkup => 'Kontrolluntersuchung',
        DentistCategory.cleaning => 'Zahnreinigung',
        DentistCategory.appointment => 'Termin & Empfang',
      };

  String get arabic => switch (this) {
        DentistCategory.checkup => 'الفحص الدوري',
        DentistCategory.cleaning => 'تنظيف الأسنان والجير',
        DentistCategory.appointment => 'المواعيد والاستقبال',
      };
}

final class DentistPhrase {
  const DentistPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.category,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.tags,
  });

  final String id;
  final DentistCategory category;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final List<String> tags;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;
    return german.toLowerCase().contains(needle) ||
        arabic.toLowerCase().contains(needle) ||
        tags.any((tag) => tag.toLowerCase().contains(needle));
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/life_diy/diy_master_orchestrator.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'diy_models.dart';
import 'hardware_store_sub_agent.dart';
import 'tool_rental_sub_agent.dart';

final class DiyMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  DiyMasterOrchestrator({
    HardwareStoreSubAgent hardwareStore = const HardwareStoreSubAgent(),
    ToolRentalSubAgent toolRental = const ToolRentalSubAgent(),
  })  : _hardwareStore = hardwareStore,
        _toolRental = toolRental;

  final HardwareStoreSubAgent _hardwareStore;
  final ToolRentalSubAgent _toolRental;

  DiyDomain _domain = DiyDomain.materialsHardware;
  String _query = '';
  double _conversionValue = 1000;
  DiyLengthUnit _fromUnit = DiyLengthUnit.millimeter;
  DiyLengthUnit _toUnit = DiyLengthUnit.meter;
  int _screwDiameterMm = 5;

  DiyDomain get domain => _domain;
  String get query => _query;
  double get conversionValue => _conversionValue;
  DiyLengthUnit get fromUnit => _fromUnit;
  DiyLengthUnit get toUnit => _toUnit;
  int get screwDiameterMm => _screwDiameterMm;

  List<DiyPhrase> get visiblePhrases {
    final source = switch (_domain) {
      DiyDomain.materialsHardware => _hardwareStore.phrases,
      DiyDomain.servicesRental => _toolRental.phrases,
    };

    return List<DiyPhrase>.unmodifiable(
      source.where((phrase) => phrase.matches(_query)),
    );
  }

  double get convertedValue => _conversionValue *
      _fromUnit.metersPerUnit /
      _toUnit.metersPerUnit;

  String get formattedInputValue => _formatNumber(_conversionValue);

  String get formattedConversion {
    final value = convertedValue;
    return '${_formatNumber(value)} ${_toUnit.symbol}';
  }

  DiySizingPrompt get sizingPrompt => DiySizingPrompt(
        german:
            'Ich habe eine Schraube mit $_screwDiameterMm mm Durchmesser. Welcher Dübel ist laut Herstellerangabe für meinen Untergrund passend?',
        arabic:
            'لدي برغي بقطر $_screwDiameterMm مم. ما قطعة التثبيت المناسبة لهذا السطح حسب تعليمات الشركة المصنّعة؟',
      );

  static String _formatNumber(double value) {
    final fixed = value.toStringAsFixed(3);
    return fixed.replaceFirst(RegExp(r'\.?0+$'), '');
  }

  void setDomain(DiyDomain value) {
    if (_domain == value) return;
    _domain = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearSearch() => setQuery('');

  void setConversionValue(double value) {
    if (!value.isFinite || value < 0 || _conversionValue == value) return;
    _conversionValue = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setFromUnit(DiyLengthUnit value) {
    if (_fromUnit == value) return;
    _fromUnit = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setToUnit(DiyLengthUnit value) {
    if (_toUnit == value) return;
    _toUnit = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setScrewDiameterMm(int value) {
    if (value <= 0 || _screwDiameterMm == value) return;
    _screwDiameterMm = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/life_diy/diy_models.dart

enum DiyDomain { materialsHardware, servicesRental }

enum DiyLengthUnit { millimeter, centimeter, meter }

extension DiyDomainLabels on DiyDomain {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        DiyDomain.materialsHardware => 'Material & Beschläge',
        DiyDomain.servicesRental => 'Service & Geräteverleih',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        DiyDomain.materialsHardware => 'مواد وأدوات تثبيت',
        DiyDomain.servicesRental => 'خدمات وتأجير معدات',
      };
}

extension DiyLengthUnitLabels on DiyLengthUnit {
  String get symbol => switch (this) {
        DiyLengthUnit.millimeter => 'mm',
        DiyLengthUnit.centimeter => 'cm',
        DiyLengthUnit.meter => 'm',
      };

  double get metersPerUnit => switch (this) {
        DiyLengthUnit.millimeter => 0.001,
        DiyLengthUnit.centimeter => 0.01,
        DiyLengthUnit.meter => 1,
      };
}

final class DiyPhrase {
  const DiyPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.domain,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.contextDe,
    required this.contextAr,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final DiyDomain domain;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String contextDe;
  final String contextAr;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;

    final haystack = <String>[
      german,
      arabic,
      contextDe,
      contextAr,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase();

    return haystack.contains(needle);
  }
}

final class DiySizingPrompt {
  const DiySizingPrompt({
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
  });

  final String german;
  final String arabic;
}

import '../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import 'diy_master_orchestrator.dart';
import 'diy_models.dart';

abstract final class DiyUiTokens {
  static const double pageInset = 16;
  static const double bottomInset = 32;
  static const double sectionGap = 18;
  static const double itemGap = 12;
  static const double compactGap = 8;
}

final class DiyMasterHub extends StatefulWidget {
  const DiyMasterHub({
    this.orchestrator,
    super.key,
  });

  final DiyMasterOrchestrator? orchestrator;

  @override
  State<DiyMasterHub> createState() => _DiyMasterHubState();
}

final class _DiyMasterHubState extends State<DiyMasterHub> {
  late final DiyMasterOrchestrator _orchestrator;
  late final bool _ownsOrchestrator;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ownsOrchestrator = widget.orchestrator == null;
    _orchestrator = widget.orchestrator ?? DiyMasterOrchestrator();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    if (_ownsOrchestrator) {
      _orchestrator.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              DiyUiTokens.pageInset,
              DiyUiTokens.pageInset,
              DiyUiTokens.pageInset,
              DiyUiTokens.bottomInset,
            ),
            child: AnimatedBuilder(
              animation: _orchestrator,
              builder: (context, _) => Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  _HeaderCard(dark: dark),
                  const SizedBox(height: DiyUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _SearchField(orchestrator: _orchestrator),
                  const SizedBox(height: DiyUiTokens.itemGap),
                  _DomainSelector(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: DiyUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _QuickSizingBar(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: DiyUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _PhraseList(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _UnitDropdown extends StatelessWidget {
  const _UnitDropdown({
    required this.label,
    required this.value,
    required this.onChanged,
    super.key,
  });

  final String label;
  final DiyLengthUnit value;
  final ValueChanged<DiyLengthUnit> onChanged;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => InputDecorator(
        decoration: InputDecoration(
          labelText: label,
          border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
        ),
        child: DropdownButtonHideUnderline(
          child: DropdownButton<DiyLengthUnit>(
            value: value,
            isExpanded: true,
            items: <DropdownMenuItem<DiyLengthUnit>>[
              for (final unit in DiyLengthUnit.values)
                DropdownMenuItem<DiyLengthUnit>(
                  value: unit,
                  child: Text(unit.symbol),
                ),
            ],
            onChanged: (next) {
              if (next != null) onChanged(next);
            },
          ),
        ),
      );
}

final class _PhraseList extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PhraseList({
    required this.orchestrator,
    required this.dark,
  });

  final DiyMasterOrchestrator orchestrator;
  final bool dark;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final phrases = orchestrator.visiblePhrases;
    if (phrases.isEmpty) {
      return AppGlassCard(
        borderColor: AppColors.tertiary.withAlpha(96),
        backgroundColor: dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
        child: AppDirectionalText(
          'لا توجد نتائج في هذا القسم. جرّب كلمة بحث أخرى.',
          languageCode: 'ar',
          style: AppTypography.body,
        ),
      );
    }

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: <Widget>[
        for (var index = 0; index < phrases.length; index++) ...<Widget>[
          _PhraseCard(phrase: phrases[index], dark: dark),
          if (index != phrases.length - 1)
            const SizedBox(height: DiyUiTokens.itemGap),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }
}

final class _PhraseCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PhraseCard({
    required this.phrase,
    required this.dark,
  });

  final DiyPhrase phrase;
  final bool dark;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(80),
        backgroundColor: dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            AppDirectionalText(
              phrase.contextDe,
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.label,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: DiyUiTokens.compactGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              phrase.german,
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: DiyUiTokens.compactGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              phrase.arabic,
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.body,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: DiyUiTokens.compactGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              phrase.contextAr,
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.label,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

        DoctorHubPhrase(
          id: 'ueberweisung_frage',
          german: 'Ist eine Überweisung nötig?',
          arabic: 'هل الإحالة الطبية مطلوبة؟',
          tags: <String>['Überweisung', 'إحالة', 'Facharzt'],
          clinicType: DoctorClinicType.facharzt,
        ),
      ];

  List<DoctorHubPhrase> search(
    String query, {
    DoctorClinicType? clinicType,
  }) =>
      List<DoctorHubPhrase>.unmodifiable(
        overviewPhrases.where(
          (item) =>
              (clinicType == null ||
                  item.clinicType == null ||
                  item.clinicType == clinicType) &&
              item.matches(query),
        ),
      );

      List<DoctorHubPhrase>.unmodifiable(_items[stage]!);

enum DoctorClinicType {
  hausarzt,
  facharzt;

  String get german => switch (this) {
        DoctorClinicType.hausarzt => 'Hausarzt',
        DoctorClinicType.facharzt => 'Facharzt',
      };

  String get arabic => switch (this) {
        DoctorClinicType.hausarzt => 'طبيب الأسرة',
        DoctorClinicType.facharzt => 'الطبيب المختص',
      };
}

enum DoctorDocumentKind {
  gesundheitskarte,
  ueberweisung,
}

final class DoctorDocumentCard {
  const DoctorDocumentCard({
    required this.id,
    required this.kind,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.promptDe,
    required this.explanationAr,
    this.clinicType,
  });

  final String id;
  final DoctorDocumentKind kind;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String promptDe;
  final String explanationAr;
  final DoctorClinicType? clinicType;
}

final class DoctorAppointmentChecklistItem {
  const DoctorAppointmentChecklistItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.detailDe,
    required this.detailAr,
  });

  final String id;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String detailDe;
  final String detailAr;
}

final class DoctorHubPhrase {
  const DoctorHubPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.tags,
    this.clinicType,
  });

  final String id;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final List<String> tags;
  final DoctorClinicType? clinicType;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;
    return german.toLowerCase().contains(needle) ||
        arabic.toLowerCase().contains(needle) ||
        tags.any((tag) => tag.toLowerCase().contains(needle));
  }
}

final class _DoctorAppointmentMasterHubState
    extends State<DoctorAppointmentMasterHub> {
  DoctorClinicType? _clinicType;
  String _query = '';

  List<DoctorHubPhrase> get _visiblePhrases =>
      widget.orchestrator.search(
        _query,
        clinicType: _clinicType,
      );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final background =
        dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground;
    final surface = dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface;
    final border =
        dark ? AppColors.glassBorderDark : AppColors.glassBorderLight;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,

        backgroundColor: background,
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: const AppDirectionalText(
            'زيارة عيادة الطبيب',
            languageCode: 'ar',
          ),
        ),
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              _DoctorHubTokens.pageInset,
              _DoctorHubTokens.pageInset,
              _DoctorHubTokens.pageInset,
              _DoctorHubTokens.bottomInset,
            ),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: <Widget>[
                _HeaderCard(surface: surface, border: border),

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/driving_models.dart';
import 'fahrschule_sub_agent.dart';
import 'vehicle_admin_sub_agent.dart';

final class DrivingMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  DrivingMasterOrchestrator({
    this.fahrschule = const FahrschuleSubAgent(),
    this.vehicleAdmin = const VehicleAdminSubAgent(),
  });

  final FahrschuleSubAgent fahrschule;
  final VehicleAdminSubAgent vehicleAdmin;

  DrivingCategory _category = DrivingCategory.fahrschule;
  String _searchQuery = '';

  DrivingCategory get category => _category;
  String get searchQuery => _searchQuery;

  List<DrivingLearningItem> get activeItems => switch (_category) {
        DrivingCategory.fahrschule => fahrschule.items,
        DrivingCategory.vehicleAdmin => vehicleAdmin.items,
      };

  List<DrivingLearningItem> get visibleItems =>
      List<DrivingLearningItem>.unmodifiable(
        activeItems.where((item) => item.matches(_searchQuery)),
      );

  List<DrivingExamPrepItem> get quickExamPrep =>
      const <DrivingExamPrepItem>[
        DrivingExamPrepItem(
          id: 'prep_theory',
          focusDe: 'Theorieprüfung',
          german: 'Ich lese jede Frage und alle Antworten zuerst genau.',
          arabic: 'أقرأ كل سؤال وجميع الإجابات أولاً بدقة.',
        ),
        DrivingExamPrepItem(
          id: 'prep_practical',
          focusDe: 'Praktische Prüfung',
          german: 'Bitte fahren Sie rechts ran, sobald es sicher möglich ist.',
          arabic: 'من فضلك توقف إلى اليمين عندما يصبح ذلك آمناً.',
        ),
        DrivingExamPrepItem(
          id: 'prep_first_aid',
          focusDe: 'Erste-Hilfe-Nachweis',
          german: 'Ich habe die Bescheinigung vom Erste-Hilfe-Kurs dabei.',
          arabic: 'لدي شهادة دورة الإسعافات الأولية معي.',
        ),
      ];

  void switchCategory(DrivingCategory category) {
    if (_category == category) return;
    _category = category;
    _searchQuery = '';
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setSearchQuery(String query) {
    if (_searchQuery == query) return;
    _searchQuery = query;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearSearch() {
    if (_searchQuery.isEmpty) return;
    _searchQuery = '';
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

enum DrivingCategory {
  fahrschule,
  vehicleAdmin,
}

enum DrivingTopic {
  enrollment,
  theoryClass,
  practicalLesson,
  firstAid,
  registration,
  inspection,
  emissionsSticker,
}

extension DrivingCategoryLabels on DrivingCategory {
  String get germanLabel => switch (this) {
        DrivingCategory.fahrschule => 'Fahrschule',
        DrivingCategory.vehicleAdmin => 'Zulassung & TÜV',
      };

  String get arabicLabel => switch (this) {
        DrivingCategory.fahrschule => 'مدرسة القيادة',
        DrivingCategory.vehicleAdmin => 'تسجيل المركبة والفحص',
      };
}

extension DrivingTopicLabels on DrivingTopic {
  String get germanLabel => switch (this) {
        DrivingTopic.enrollment => 'Anmeldung',
        DrivingTopic.theoryClass => 'Theorieunterricht',
        DrivingTopic.practicalLesson => 'Fahrstunde',
        DrivingTopic.firstAid => 'Erste-Hilfe-Kurs',
        DrivingTopic.registration => 'Kfz-Zulassung',
        DrivingTopic.inspection => 'Hauptuntersuchung',
        DrivingTopic.emissionsSticker => 'Umweltplakette',
      };

  String get arabicLabel => switch (this) {
        DrivingTopic.enrollment => 'التسجيل',
        DrivingTopic.theoryClass => 'دروس النظري',
        DrivingTopic.practicalLesson => 'درس القيادة العملي',
        DrivingTopic.firstAid => 'دورة الإسعافات الأولية',
        DrivingTopic.registration => 'تسجيل المركبة',
        DrivingTopic.inspection => 'الفحص الدوري',
        DrivingTopic.emissionsSticker => 'الملصق البيئي',
      };
}

final class DrivingLearningItem {
  const DrivingLearningItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.category,
    required this.topic,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.tags,
  });

  final String id;
  final DrivingCategory category;
  final DrivingTopic topic;
  final String titleDe;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final List<String> tags;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;

    return titleDe.toLowerCase().contains(needle) ||
        german.toLowerCase().contains(needle) ||
        arabic.toLowerCase().contains(needle) ||
        topic.germanLabel.toLowerCase().contains(needle) ||
        topic.arabicLabel.toLowerCase().contains(needle) ||
        tags.any((tag) => tag.toLowerCase().contains(needle));
  }
}

final class DrivingExamPrepItem {
  const DrivingExamPrepItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.focusDe,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
  });

  final String id;
  final String focusDe;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
}

final class DrivingMasterScreen extends StatefulWidget {

final class _DrivingMasterScreenState extends State<DrivingMasterScreen> {
  late final DrivingMasterOrchestrator _orchestrator;
  late final bool _ownsOrchestrator;
  late final TextEditingController _searchController;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ownsOrchestrator = widget.orchestrator == null;
    _orchestrator = widget.orchestrator ?? DrivingMasterOrchestrator();
    _searchController = TextEditingController(text: _orchestrator.searchQuery);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchController.dispose();
    if (_ownsOrchestrator) _orchestrator.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _switchCategory(DrivingCategory category) {
    _orchestrator.switchCategory(category);
    if (_searchController.text.isNotEmpty) {
      _searchController.clear();
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Directionality(
      key: const ValueKey<String>('driving-arabic-direction'),
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark
            ? AppColors.darkBackground
            : AppColors.lightBackground,
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: const Text('القيادة والمركبة · Fahrschule & Kfz'),
        ),
        body: SafeArea(
          child: ListenableBuilder(
            listenable: _orchestrator,
            builder: (context, _) {
              return SingleChildScrollView(
                padding: _DrivingUiTokens.screenPadding,
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    const _HeroCard(),
                    const SizedBox(height: _DrivingUiTokens.spaceM),
                    _QuickExamPrepBar(
                      items: _orchestrator.quickExamPrep,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: _DrivingUiTokens.spaceM),
                    _CategorySwitcher(
                      selected: _orchestrator.category,
                      onSelected: _switchCategory,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: _DrivingUiTokens.spaceM),
                    _SearchCard(
                      controller: _searchController,
                      query: _orchestrator.searchQuery,
                      onChanged: _orchestrator.setSearchQuery,

import 'drogerie_models.dart';

final class DrogerieMasterOrchestrator {
  const DrogerieMasterOrchestrator();

  List<DrogerieCategory> get categories => DrogerieCategory.values;

  static const List<DrogeriePhrase> _items = <DrogeriePhrase>[
    DrogeriePhrase(
      id: 'clean_detergent',
      category: DrogerieCategory.householdCleaning,
      german: 'Wo finde ich Waschmittel für Buntwäsche?',
      arabic: 'أين أجد منظف الغسيل للملابس الملونة؟',
      tags: <String>['Waschmittel', 'Buntwäsche', 'Reinigung'],
    ),
    DrogeriePhrase(
      id: 'clean_allpurpose',
      category: DrogerieCategory.householdCleaning,
      german: 'Ich suche einen Allzweckreiniger.',
      arabic: 'أبحث عن منظف متعدد الاستخدامات.',
      tags: <String>['Allzweckreiniger', 'Haushalt'],
    ),
    DrogeriePhrase(
      id: 'care_shampoo',
      category: DrogerieCategory.personalCare,
      german: 'Wo stehen Shampoo und Duschgel?',
      arabic: 'أين يوجد الشامبو وجل الاستحمام؟',
      tags: <String>['Shampoo', 'Duschgel', 'Körperpflege'],
    ),
    DrogeriePhrase(
      id: 'care_sensitive',
      category: DrogerieCategory.personalCare,
      german: 'Haben Sie eine parfümfreie Variante für empfindliche Haut?',
      arabic: 'هل لديكم نوع خالٍ من العطر للبشرة الحساسة؟',
      tags: <String>['parfümfrei', 'empfindliche Haut'],
    ),
    DrogeriePhrase(
      id: 'dm_payback',
      category: DrogerieCategory.loyalty,
      brand: DrogerieBrand.dm,
      german: 'Kann ich bei dm PAYBACK Punkte sammeln oder einlösen?',
      arabic: 'هل يمكنني جمع نقاط PAYBACK أو استخدامها لدى dm؟',
      tags: <String>['dm', 'PAYBACK', 'Punkte', 'نقاط'],
    ),
    DrogeriePhrase(
      id: 'rossmann_coupon',
      category: DrogerieCategory.loyalty,
      brand: DrogerieBrand.rossmann,
      german: 'Wo aktiviere ich den Coupon in der ROSSMANN-App?',
      arabic: 'أين أفعّل الكوبون في تطبيق ROSSMANN؟',
      tags: <String>['ROSSMANN', 'App', 'Coupon', 'Treueaktion'],
    ),
  ];

  List<DrogeriePhrase> get allItems =>
      List<DrogeriePhrase>.unmodifiable(_items);

  List<DrogeriePhrase> itemsFor(DrogerieCategory category) =>
      List<DrogeriePhrase>.unmodifiable(
        _items.where((item) => item.category == category),
      );

  List<DrogeriePhrase> search(
    String query, {
    DrogerieCategory? category,
    DrogerieBrand? brand,
  }) =>
      List<DrogeriePhrase>.unmodifiable(
        _items.where(
          (item) =>
              (category == null || item.category == category) &&
              (brand == null ||
                  item.brand == DrogerieBrand.neutral ||
                  item.brand == brand) &&
              item.matches(query),
        ),
      );
}

enum DrogerieCategory {
  householdCleaning,
  personalCare,
  loyalty;

  String get german => switch (this) {
        DrogerieCategory.householdCleaning => 'Haushalt & Reinigung',
        DrogerieCategory.personalCare => 'Körperpflege',
        DrogerieCategory.loyalty => 'Kundenkarte & Vorteile',
      };

  String get arabic => switch (this) {
        DrogerieCategory.householdCleaning => 'المنظفات المنزلية',
        DrogerieCategory.personalCare => 'العناية الشخصية',
        DrogerieCategory.loyalty => 'النقاط والكوبونات',
      };
}

enum DrogerieBrand {
  neutral,
  dm,
  rossmann;

  String get label => switch (this) {
        DrogerieBrand.neutral => 'Drogeriemarkt',
        DrogerieBrand.dm => 'dm',
        DrogerieBrand.rossmann => 'ROSSMANN',
      };
}

final class DrogeriePhrase {
  const DrogeriePhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.category,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.tags,
    this.brand = DrogerieBrand.neutral,
  });

  final String id;
  final DrogerieCategory category;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final List<String> tags;
  final DrogerieBrand brand;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;
    return german.toLowerCase().contains(needle) ||
        arabic.toLowerCase().contains(needle) ||
        brand.label.toLowerCase().contains(needle) ||
        tags.any((tag) => tag.toLowerCase().contains(needle));
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/life_education/application/family_education_master_orchestrator.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import '../data/education_catalog.dart';
import '../domain/education_models.dart';

final class DaycareSubAgent {
  DaycareSubAgent(Iterable<EducationEntry> entries)
      : entries = List<EducationEntry>.unmodifiable(
          entries.where((entry) => entry.area == EducationArea.daycare),
        );

  final List<EducationEntry> entries;

  List<EducationEntry> byTopic(EducationTopic topic) =>
      List<EducationEntry>.unmodifiable(
        entries.where((entry) => entry.topic == topic),
      );

  List<EducationEntry> search({
    EducationLevel? level,
    String query = '',
  }) =>
      _filterEntries(
        entries,
        level: level,
        query: query,
      );
}

final class SchoolCommunicationSubAgent {
  SchoolCommunicationSubAgent(Iterable<EducationEntry> entries)
      : entries = List<EducationEntry>.unmodifiable(
          entries.where((entry) => entry.area == EducationArea.school),
        );

  final List<EducationEntry> entries;

  List<EducationEntry> byTopic(EducationTopic topic) =>
      List<EducationEntry>.unmodifiable(
        entries.where((entry) => entry.topic == topic),
      );

  List<EducationEntry> search({
    EducationLevel? level,
    String query = '',
  }) =>
      _filterEntries(
        entries,
        level: level,
        query: query,
      );
}

final class FamilyEducationMasterOrchestrator {
  FamilyEducationMasterOrchestrator._({
    required this.entries,
    required this.daycare,
    required this.school,
    required Map<EducationArea, EmergencyAbsenceMessage> absenceByArea,
  }) : _absenceByArea =
            Map<EducationArea, EmergencyAbsenceMessage>.unmodifiable(
          absenceByArea,
        );

  factory FamilyEducationMasterOrchestrator.standard() {
    final entries = List<EducationEntry>.unmodifiable(EducationCatalog.entries);
    _validate(entries);

    return FamilyEducationMasterOrchestrator._(
      entries: entries,
      daycare: DaycareSubAgent(entries),
      school: SchoolCommunicationSubAgent(entries),
      absenceByArea: const <EducationArea, EmergencyAbsenceMessage>{
        EducationArea.daycare: EducationCatalog.daycareAbsence,
        EducationArea.school: EducationCatalog.schoolAbsence,
      },
    );
  }

  final List<EducationEntry> entries;
  final DaycareSubAgent daycare;
  final SchoolCommunicationSubAgent school;
  final Map<EducationArea, EmergencyAbsenceMessage> _absenceByArea;

  List<EducationEntry> filter({
    EducationLevel? level,
    EducationArea? area,
    String query = '',
  }) {
    final scoped = area == null
        ? entries
        : entries.where((entry) => entry.area == area);

    return _filterEntries(
      scoped,
      level: level,
      query: query,
    );
  }

  EmergencyAbsenceMessage emergencyAbsence(EducationArea area) {
    final message = _absenceByArea[area];
    if (message == null) {
      throw StateError('Missing emergency absence message');
    }
    return message;
  }

  static void _validate(List<EducationEntry> entries) {
    if (entries.isEmpty) {
      throw StateError('Family education catalog must not be empty');
    }

    final ids = <String>{};
    for (final entry in entries) {
      if (entry.id.trim().isEmpty || !ids.add(entry.id)) {
        throw StateError('Education entry ids must be non-empty and unique');
      }
      if (entry.germanText.trim().isEmpty || entry.arabicText.trim().isEmpty) {
        throw StateError('Every education entry needs German and Arabic text');
      }
    }

    for (final level in EducationLevel.values) {
      if (!entries.any((entry) => entry.level == level)) {
        throw StateError('Every CEFR filter must contain at least one entry');
      }
    }

    const requiredDaycareTopics = <EducationTopic>{
      EducationTopic.dropOffPickup,
      EducationTopic.allergy,
      EducationTopic.dailyRoutine,
      EducationTopic.careTimes,
    };
    const requiredSchoolTopics = <EducationTopic>{
      EducationTopic.sickLeave,
      EducationTopic.parentTeacherConference,
      EducationTopic.homework,
    };

    final daycareTopics = entries
        .where((entry) => entry.area == EducationArea.daycare)
        .map((entry) => entry.topic)
        .toSet();
    final schoolTopics = entries
        .where((entry) => entry.area == EducationArea.school)
        .map((entry) => entry.topic)
        .toSet();

    if (!daycareTopics.containsAll(requiredDaycareTopics)) {
      throw StateError('Daycare sub-agent is missing a required topic');
    }
    if (!schoolTopics.containsAll(requiredSchoolTopics)) {
      throw StateError('School sub-agent is missing a required topic');
    }
  }
}

List<EducationEntry> _filterEntries(
  Iterable<EducationEntry> source, {
  EducationLevel? level,
  String query = '',
}) {
  final normalizedQuery = _normalize(query);
  final tokens = normalizedQuery.isEmpty
      ? const <String>[]
      : normalizedQuery.split(' ').where((token) => token.isNotEmpty).toList();

  final results = source.where((entry) {
    if (level != null && entry.level != level) return false;
    if (tokens.isEmpty) return true;

    final haystack = _normalize(entry.searchableText);
    return tokens.every(haystack.contains);
  }).toList(growable: false);

  return List<EducationEntry>.unmodifiable(results);
}

String _normalize(String value) {
  return value
      .toLowerCase()
      .trim()
      .replaceAll('ä', 'ae')
      .replaceAll('ö', 'oe')
      .replaceAll('ü', 'ue')
      .replaceAll('ß', 'ss')
      .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[\u064B-\u065F\u0670]'), '')
      .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ')
      .trim();
}

--------------------------------------------------
FILE: lib/features/life_education/domain/education_models.dart
--------------------------------------------------
enum EducationLevel {
  a1a2('A1/A2'),
  b1('B1'),
  b2('B2');

  const EducationLevel(this.label);

  final String label;
}

enum EducationArea {
  daycare,
  school,
}

enum EducationTopic {
  dropOffPickup,
  allergy,
  dailyRoutine,
  careTimes,
  sickLeave,
  parentTeacherConference,
  homework,
}

final class EducationEntry {
  const EducationEntry({
    required this.id,
    required this.area,
    required this.level,
    required this.topic,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.germanText,
    required this.arabicText,
    this.noteAr = '',
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
    this.formalRegister = false,
  });

  final String id;
  final EducationArea area;
  final EducationLevel level;
  final EducationTopic topic;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String germanText;
  final String arabicText;
  final String noteAr;
  final List<String> keywords;
  final bool formalRegister;

  String get searchableText => <String>[
        id,
        titleDe,
        titleAr,
        germanText,
        arabicText,
        noteAr,
        ...keywords,
      ].join(' ');
}

final class EmergencyAbsenceMessage {
  const EmergencyAbsenceMessage({
    required this.area,
    required this.level,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.germanText,
    required this.arabicGuidance,
    required this.isFormal,
  });

  final EducationArea area;
  final EducationLevel level;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String germanText;
  final String arabicGuidance;
  final bool isFormal;
}

FILE: lib/features/life_education/presentation/family_education_master_screen.dart

import '../../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import '../application/family_education_master_orchestrator.dart';
import '../domain/education_models.dart';

abstract final class _EducationUiTokens {
  static const double pageInset = 16;
  static const double sectionGap = 14;
  static const double contentGap = 10;
  static const double compactGap = 8;
  static const double bottomInset = 32;
  static const double iconSize = 20;
}

final class FamilyEducationMasterScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  FamilyEducationMasterScreen({
    FamilyEducationMasterOrchestrator? orchestrator,
    super.key,
  }) : orchestrator =
            orchestrator ?? FamilyEducationMasterOrchestrator.standard();

  final FamilyEducationMasterOrchestrator orchestrator;

  @override
  State<FamilyEducationMasterScreen> createState() =>
      _FamilyEducationMasterScreenState();
}

final class _FamilyEducationMasterScreenState
    extends State<FamilyEducationMasterScreen> {
  EducationLevel? _selectedLevel;
  EducationArea? _selectedArea;
  EducationArea _absenceArea = EducationArea.school;
  String _query = '';

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final background =
        isDark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground;
    final results = widget.orchestrator.filter(
      level: _selectedLevel,
      area: _selectedArea,
      query: _query,
    );

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: background,
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: AppDirectionalText(
            'Kita & Schule',
            languageCode: 'de',
            style: AppTypography.title,
          ),
        ),
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              _EducationUiTokens.pageInset,
              _EducationUiTokens.pageInset,
              _EducationUiTokens.pageInset,
              _EducationUiTokens.bottomInset,
            ),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: <Widget>[
                _EmergencyAbsenceBar(
                  message:
                      widget.orchestrator.emergencyAbsence(_absenceArea),
                  selectedArea: _absenceArea,
                  onAreaChanged: (area) {
                    setState(() => _absenceArea = area);
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: _EducationUiTokens.sectionGap),
                _FilterPanel(
                  selectedLevel: _selectedLevel,
                  selectedArea: _selectedArea,
                  onLevelChanged: (level) {
                    setState(() => _selectedLevel = level);
                  },
                  onAreaChanged: (area) {
                    setState(() => _selectedArea = area);
                  },
                  onQueryChanged: (query) {
                    setState(() => _query = query);
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: _EducationUiTokens.sectionGap),
                _ResultsHeader(count: results.length),
                const SizedBox(height: _EducationUiTokens.contentGap),
                if (results.isEmpty)
                  const _EmptyState()
                else
                  for (var index = 0; index < results.length; index++) ...[
                    _EducationEntryCard(entry: results[index]),
                    if (index != results.length - 1)
                      const SizedBox(height: _EducationUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _EmergencyAbsenceBar extends StatelessWidget {
  const _EmergencyAbsenceBar({
    required this.message,
    required this.selectedArea,
    required this.onAreaChanged,
  });

  final EmergencyAbsenceMessage message;
  final EducationArea selectedArea;
  final ValueChanged<EducationArea> onAreaChanged;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        borderColor: AppColors.tertiary,
        glowColor: AppColors.tertiary,
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            Row(
              children: <Widget>[
                const Icon(
                  Icons.notification_important_outlined,
                  color: AppColors.tertiary,
                  size: _EducationUiTokens.iconSize,
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: _EducationUiTokens.compactGap),
                Expanded(
                  child: AppDirectionalText(
                    'شريط الغياب العاجل',
                    languageCode: 'ar',
                    style: AppTypography.title,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: _EducationUiTokens.contentGap),
            Wrap(
              spacing: _EducationUiTokens.compactGap,
              runSpacing: _EducationUiTokens.compactGap,
              children: EducationArea.values
                  .map(
                    (area) => ChoiceChip(
                      label: Text(
                        _areaLabelAr(area),
                        style: AppTypography.label,
                      ),
                      selected: selectedArea == area,
                      selectedColor: AppColors.tertiary,
                      onSelected: (_) => onAreaChanged(area),
                    ),
                  )
                  .toList(growable: false),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: _EducationUiTokens.contentGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              message.titleDe,
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(color: AppColors.tertiary),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: _EducationUiTokens.compactGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              message.germanText,
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.body,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: _EducationUiTokens.compactGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              message.arabicGuidance,
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.body,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

final class _FilterPanel extends StatelessWidget {
  const _FilterPanel({
    required this.selectedLevel,
    required this.selectedArea,
    required this.onLevelChanged,
    required this.onAreaChanged,
    required this.onQueryChanged,
  });

  final EducationLevel? selectedLevel;
  final EducationArea? selectedArea;
  final ValueChanged<EducationLevel?> onLevelChanged;
  final ValueChanged<EducationArea?> onAreaChanged;
  final ValueChanged<String> onQueryChanged;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        borderColor: AppColors.primary,
        glowColor: AppColors.primary,
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            AppDirectionalText(
              'بحث وتصفية المحتوى',
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: _EducationUiTokens.contentGap),
            TextField(
              textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
              style: AppTypography.body,
              textInputAction: TextInputAction.search,
              onChanged: onQueryChanged,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                prefixIcon: const Icon(
                  Icons.search,
                  color: AppColors.primary,
                ),
                label: Text(
                  'ابحث: Hausaufgaben، حساسية، Elternabend...',
                  style: AppTypography.body,
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: _EducationUiTokens.contentGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              'المستوى',
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.label,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: _EducationUiTokens.compactGap),
            Wrap(
              spacing: _EducationUiTokens.compactGap,
              runSpacing: _EducationUiTokens.compactGap,
              children: <Widget>[
                FilterChip(
                  label: Text('الكل', style: AppTypography.label),
                  selected: selectedLevel == null,
                  selectedColor: AppColors.primary,
                  onSelected: (_) => onLevelChanged(null),
                ),
                for (final level in EducationLevel.values)
                  FilterChip(
                    label: Text(level.label, style: AppTypography.label),
                    selected: selectedLevel == level,
                    selectedColor: AppColors.primary,
                    onSelected: (_) => onLevelChanged(level),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: _EducationUiTokens.contentGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              'القسم',
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.label,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: _EducationUiTokens.compactGap),
            Wrap(
              spacing: _EducationUiTokens.compactGap,
              runSpacing: _EducationUiTokens.compactGap,
              children: <Widget>[
                FilterChip(
                  label: Text('الكل', style: AppTypography.label),
                  selected: selectedArea == null,
                  selectedColor: AppColors.secondary,
                  onSelected: (_) => onAreaChanged(null),
                ),
                for (final area in EducationArea.values)
                  FilterChip(
                    label: Text(
                      _areaLabelAr(area),
                      style: AppTypography.label,
                    ),
                    selected: selectedArea == area,
                    selectedColor: AppColors.secondary,
                    onSelected: (_) => onAreaChanged(area),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

final class _EducationEntryCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _EducationEntryCard({required this.entry});

  final EducationEntry entry;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final accent = _areaColor(entry.area);

    return AppGlassCard(
      borderColor: accent,
      glowColor: accent,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          Wrap(
            spacing: _EducationUiTokens.compactGap,
            runSpacing: _EducationUiTokens.compactGap,
            children: <Widget>[
              _MetaChip(label: entry.level.label, accent: accent),
              _MetaChip(label: _areaLabelAr(entry.area), accent: accent),
              _MetaChip(label: _topicLabelAr(entry.topic), accent: accent),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: _EducationUiTokens.contentGap),
          AppDirectionalText(
            entry.titleDe,
            languageCode: 'de',
            style: AppTypography.title,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: _EducationUiTokens.compactGap),
          AppDirectionalText(
            entry.titleAr,
            languageCode: 'ar',
            style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(color: accent),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: _EducationUiTokens.contentGap),
          AppDirectionalText(
            entry.germanText,
            languageCode: 'de',
            style: AppTypography.body,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: _EducationUiTokens.compactGap),
          AppDirectionalText(
            entry.arabicText,
            languageCode: 'ar',
            style: AppTypography.body,
          ),
          if (entry.noteAr.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
            const SizedBox(height: _EducationUiTokens.compactGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              entry.noteAr,
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(color: AppColors.tertiary),
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _MetaChip extends StatelessWidget {
  const _MetaChip({
    required this.label,
    required this.accent,
  });

  final String label;
  final Color accent;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => DecoratedBox(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          border: Border.all(color: accent),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(_EducationUiTokens.contentGap),
        ),
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
            horizontal: _EducationUiTokens.contentGap,
            vertical: _EducationUiTokens.compactGap,
          ),
          child: Text(
            label,
            style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(color: accent),
          ),
        ),
      );
}

Color _areaColor(EducationArea area) => switch (area) {
      EducationArea.daycare => AppColors.secondary,
      EducationArea.school => AppColors.primary,
    };

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'electronics_appliances_models.dart';
import 'electronics_appliances_routes.dart';

final class ElectronicsAppliancesMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  ElectronicsDomain _domain = ElectronicsDomain.all;
  String _query = '';

  ElectronicsDomain get domain => _domain;
  String get query => _query;

  List<ElectronicsRouteDescriptor> get visibleRoutes {
    return List<ElectronicsRouteDescriptor>.unmodifiable(
      ElectronicsAppliancesRoutes.all.where((route) {
        final domainMatches =
            _domain == ElectronicsDomain.all || route.domain == _domain;
        return domainMatches && route.matches(_query);
      }),
    );
  }

  String get guidanceDe =>
      'Technische Daten immer am konkreten Modell prüfen. Garantiebedingungen des Anbieters und gesetzliche Gewährleistungsrechte nicht miteinander verwechseln.';

  String get guidanceAr =>
      'تحقق من المواصفات على الموديل نفسه، ولا تخلط بين ضمان الجهة المقدمة Garantie وحقوق العيوب القانونية Gewährleistung.';

  void setDomain(ElectronicsDomain value) {
    if (_domain == value) return;
    _domain = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearFilters() {
    if (_domain == ElectronicsDomain.all && _query.isEmpty) return;
    _domain = ElectronicsDomain.all;
    _query = '';
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

enum ElectronicsDomain {
  all,
  specificationsWarranty,
  serviceRepair;

  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        ElectronicsDomain.all => 'Alle Bereiche',
        ElectronicsDomain.specificationsWarranty => 'Beratung & Garantie',
        ElectronicsDomain.serviceRepair => 'Service & Reparatur',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        ElectronicsDomain.all => 'كل الأقسام',
        ElectronicsDomain.specificationsWarranty => 'المواصفات والكفالة',
        ElectronicsDomain.serviceRepair => 'الصيانة والإصلاح',
      };
}

enum ElectronicsRouteId {
  specificationsWarranty,
  serviceRepair,
}

final class ElectronicsRouteDescriptor {
  const ElectronicsRouteDescriptor({
    required this.id,
    required this.domain,
    required this.routeName,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.descriptionDe,
    required this.descriptionAr,
    this.searchTerms = const <String>[],
  });

  final ElectronicsRouteId id;
  final ElectronicsDomain domain;
  final String routeName;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String descriptionDe;
  final String descriptionAr;
  final List<String> searchTerms;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = _normalize(query);
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;
    return _normalize(<String>[
      titleDe,
      titleAr,
      descriptionDe,
      descriptionAr,
      ...searchTerms,
    ].join(' ')).contains(needle);
  }

  static String _normalize(String value) {
    return value
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll('ä', 'a')
        .replaceAll('ö', 'o')
        .replaceAll('ü', 'u')
        .replaceAll('ß', 'ss')
        .replaceAll('ـ', '');
  }
}

class ElectronicsAppliancesMasterHub extends StatefulWidget {

    this.orchestrator,
    this.onRouteSelected,
    super.key,
  });

  final ElectronicsAppliancesMasterOrchestrator? orchestrator;
  final ValueChanged<ElectronicsRouteDescriptor>? onRouteSelected;

  @override
  State<ElectronicsAppliancesMasterHub> createState() =>
      _ElectronicsAppliancesMasterHubState();
}

class _ElectronicsAppliancesMasterHubState
    extends State<ElectronicsAppliancesMasterHub> {
  late final ElectronicsAppliancesMasterOrchestrator _orchestrator;
  late final bool _owns;
  late final TextEditingController _search;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _owns = widget.orchestrator == null;
    _orchestrator =
        widget.orchestrator ?? ElectronicsAppliancesMasterOrchestrator();
    _search = TextEditingController(text: _orchestrator.query);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _search.dispose();
    if (_owns) _orchestrator.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: _orchestrator,
      builder: (context, _) {
        final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
        return Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(
            title: AppDirectionalText(
              'Elektronik & Haushaltsgeräte',
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
          ),
          body: SafeArea(
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(_Ui.inset),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  AppGlassCard(
                    glowColor: AppColors.primary,
                    borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(76),
                    backgroundColor:
                        dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                      children: <Widget>[
                        AppDirectionalText(
                          'Geräte auswählen und Service klären',
                          languageCode: 'de',
                          style: AppTypography.title,

enum ServiceRepairTopic {
  all,
  faultReport,
  diagnosis,
  costEstimate,
  repairStatus;

  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        ServiceRepairTopic.all => 'Alle Themen',
        ServiceRepairTopic.faultReport => 'Defekt melden',
        ServiceRepairTopic.diagnosis => 'Diagnose',
        ServiceRepairTopic.costEstimate => 'Kostenvoranschlag',
        ServiceRepairTopic.repairStatus => 'Reparaturstatus',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        ServiceRepairTopic.all => 'كل المواضيع',
        ServiceRepairTopic.faultReport => 'الإبلاغ عن العطل',
        ServiceRepairTopic.diagnosis => 'التشخيص',
        ServiceRepairTopic.costEstimate => 'تقدير التكلفة',
        ServiceRepairTopic.repairStatus => 'حالة الإصلاح',
      };
}

final class ServiceRepairPhrase {
  const ServiceRepairPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.topic,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.contextDe,
    required this.contextAr,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final ServiceRepairTopic topic;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String contextDe;
  final String contextAr;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = _normalize(query);
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;
    return _normalize(<String>[
      topic.labelDe,
      topic.labelAr,
      german,
      arabic,
      contextDe,
      contextAr,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ')).contains(needle);
  }

  static String _normalize(String value) => value
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replaceAll('ä', 'a')
      .replaceAll('ö', 'o')
      .replaceAll('ü', 'u')
      .replaceAll('ß', 'ss')
      .replaceAll('ـ', '');
}

FILE: lib/features/life_electronics_appliances/specs_warranty/specs_warranty_agent.dart

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'specs_warranty_models.dart';
import 'specs_warranty_phrase_bank.dart';

final class SpecsWarrantyAgent extends ChangeNotifier {
  SpecsWarrantyTopic _topic = SpecsWarrantyTopic.all;
  String _query = '';

  SpecsWarrantyTopic get topic => _topic;
  String get query => _query;
  List<SpecsWarrantyPhrase> get allPhrases =>
      List<SpecsWarrantyPhrase>.unmodifiable(SpecsWarrantyPhraseBank.all);

  List<SpecsWarrantyPhrase> get visiblePhrases =>
      List<SpecsWarrantyPhrase>.unmodifiable(
        SpecsWarrantyPhraseBank.all.where(
          (item) =>
              (_topic == SpecsWarrantyTopic.all || item.topic == _topic) &&
              item.matches(_query),
        ),
      );

  String get guidanceDe =>
      'Modellnummer, Datenblatt und Kaufunterlagen konkret prüfen. Eine freiwillige Garantie kann eigene Bedingungen haben und ist nicht dasselbe wie gesetzliche Gewährleistungsrechte.';

  String get guidanceAr =>
      'تحقق من رقم الموديل والمواصفات وإثبات الشراء. Garantie قد تكون بشروط خاصة وهي ليست نفسها حقوق Gewährleistung القانونية.';

  void setTopic(SpecsWarrantyTopic value) {
    if (_topic == value) return;
    _topic = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/life_electronics_appliances/specs_warranty/specs_warranty_models.dart
--------------------------------------------------
enum SpecsWarrantyTopic {
  all,
  specifications,
  comparison,
  warranty,
  returnExchange;

  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        SpecsWarrantyTopic.all => 'Alle Themen',
        SpecsWarrantyTopic.specifications => 'Technische Daten',
        SpecsWarrantyTopic.comparison => 'Vergleichen',
        SpecsWarrantyTopic.warranty => 'Garantie & Gewährleistung',
        SpecsWarrantyTopic.returnExchange => 'Rückgabe & Umtausch',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        SpecsWarrantyTopic.all => 'كل المواضيع',
        SpecsWarrantyTopic.specifications => 'المواصفات التقنية',
        SpecsWarrantyTopic.comparison => 'المقارنة',
        SpecsWarrantyTopic.warranty => 'الكفالة وحقوق العيوب',
        SpecsWarrantyTopic.returnExchange => 'الإرجاع والاستبدال',
      };
}

final class SpecsWarrantyPhrase {
  const SpecsWarrantyPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.topic,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.contextDe,
    required this.contextAr,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final SpecsWarrantyTopic topic;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String contextDe;
  final String contextAr;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = _normalize(query);
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;
    return _normalize(<String>[
      topic.labelDe,
      topic.labelAr,
      german,
      arabic,
      contextDe,
      contextAr,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ')).contains(needle);
  }

  static String _normalize(String value) => value
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replaceAll('ä', 'a')
      .replaceAll('ö', 'o')
      .replaceAll('ü', 'u')
      .replaceAll('ß', 'ss')
      .replaceAll('ـ', '');
}

import '../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import 'emergency_health_master_orchestrator.dart';
import 'emergency_health_models.dart';

abstract final class EmergencyHealthUiTokens {
  static const double pageInset = 16;
  static const double topInset = 18;
  static const double bottomInset = 32;
  static const double sectionGap = 16;
  static const double itemGap = 12;
  static const double compactGap = 8;
}

final class EmergencyHealthMasterHub extends StatefulWidget {
  const EmergencyHealthMasterHub({
    this.orchestrator,
    super.key,
  });

  final EmergencyHealthMasterOrchestrator? orchestrator;

  @override
  State<EmergencyHealthMasterHub> createState() =>
      _EmergencyHealthMasterHubState();
}

final class _EmergencyHealthMasterHubState
    extends State<EmergencyHealthMasterHub> {
  late final EmergencyHealthMasterOrchestrator _orchestrator;
  late final bool _ownsOrchestrator;
  final TextEditingController _searchController = TextEditingController();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ownsOrchestrator = widget.orchestrator == null;
    _orchestrator =
        widget.orchestrator ?? EmergencyHealthMasterOrchestrator();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchController.dispose();
    if (_ownsOrchestrator) {
      _orchestrator.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _switchDomain(EmergencyHealthDomain domain) {
    _searchController.clear();
    _orchestrator.switchDomain(domain);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final background =
        dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground;
    final surface = dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface;
    final border =
        dark ? AppColors.glassBorderDark : AppColors.glassBorderLight;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: background,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: AnimatedBuilder(
            animation: _orchestrator,
            builder: (context, _) => SingleChildScrollView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                EmergencyHealthUiTokens.pageInset,
                EmergencyHealthUiTokens.topInset,
                EmergencyHealthUiTokens.pageInset,
                EmergencyHealthUiTokens.bottomInset,
              ),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  _Header(surface: surface, border: border),
                  const SizedBox(height: EmergencyHealthUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _ServiceDecision(surface: surface, border: border),
                  const SizedBox(height: EmergencyHealthUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _DomainSelector(
                    domain: _orchestrator.domain,
                    surface: surface,
                    border: border,
                    onSelected: _switchDomain,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: EmergencyHealthUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _ImmediateChecklist(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    surface: surface,
                    border: border,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: EmergencyHealthUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _SearchCard(
                    controller: _searchController,
                    query: _orchestrator.query,
                    surface: surface,
                    border: border,
                    onChanged: _orchestrator.setQuery,
                    onClear: () {
                      _searchController.clear();
                      _orchestrator.clearSearch();
                    },
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: EmergencyHealthUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _PhraseResults(
                    items: _orchestrator.visibleItems,
                    surface: surface,
                    border: border,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _Header extends StatelessWidget {

  final Color surface;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(

              color: AppColors.primary,
              size: 34,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: EmergencyHealthUiTokens.itemGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              'Notruf, Notdienst & medizinische Hilfe',
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(color: AppColors.primary),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: EmergencyHealthUiTokens.compactGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              'طوارئ الصحة والخدمات الطبية',
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: EmergencyHealthUiTokens.compactGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              'Schnelle Sprachhilfe für 112, 116 117 und Apotheken-Notdienst.',
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.body,
            ),
            AppDirectionalText(

final class _DomainSelector extends StatelessWidget {
  const _DomainSelector({
    required this.domain,
    required this.surface,
    required this.border,
    required this.onSelected,
  });

  final EmergencyHealthDomain domain;
  final Color surface;
  final Color border;
  final ValueChanged<EmergencyHealthDomain> onSelected;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Wrap(
        spacing: EmergencyHealthUiTokens.itemGap,
        runSpacing: EmergencyHealthUiTokens.itemGap,
        children: <Widget>[
          for (final value in EmergencyHealthDomain.values)
            AppGlassCard(
              onTap: () => onSelected(value),
              backgroundColor: surface,
              borderColor: value == domain ? AppColors.secondary : border,
              glowColor: value == domain ? AppColors.secondary : null,
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  AppDirectionalText(
                    value.labelDe,
                    languageCode: 'de',
                    style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
                      color: value == domain ? AppColors.secondary : null,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: EmergencyHealthUiTokens.compactGap),

                    value.labelAr,
                    languageCode: 'ar',
                    style: AppTypography.label,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
        ],

final class _ImmediateChecklist extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ImmediateChecklist({
    required this.orchestrator,
    required this.surface,
    required this.border,
  });

  final EmergencyHealthMasterOrchestrator orchestrator;
  final Color surface;
  final Color border;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        backgroundColor: surface,
        borderColor: border,
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            AppDirectionalText(
              'Sofort-Check',
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
            AppDirectionalText(
              'قائمة التصرف الفوري',
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.body,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: EmergencyHealthUiTokens.itemGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              '${orchestrator.completedActionCount}/${orchestrator.immediateActions.length} erledigt',
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.label,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: EmergencyHealthUiTokens.itemGap),
            for (var index = 0;
                index < orchestrator.immediateActions.length;
                index++) ...<Widget>[
              _ChecklistRow(
                action: orchestrator.immediateActions[index],
                checked: orchestrator.isActionComplete(
                  orchestrator.immediateActions[index].id,
                ),
                onTap: () {
                  final action = orchestrator.immediateActions[index];
                  orchestrator.setActionComplete(
                    action.id,
                    !orchestrator.isActionComplete(action.id),
                  );
                },
              ),
              if (index != orchestrator.immediateActions.length - 1)
                const SizedBox(height: EmergencyHealthUiTokens.compactGap),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      );
}

final class _ChecklistRow extends StatelessWidget {

            children: <Widget>[

                    : Icons.radio_button_unchecked_rounded,

                      action.titleDe,
                      languageCode: 'de',
                      style: AppTypography.label,

                      action.titleAr,
                      languageCode: 'ar',
                      style: AppTypography.body,
                    ),
                    AppDirectionalText(
                      action.detailAr,
                      languageCode: 'ar',
                      style: AppTypography.label,
                    ),

}

final class _SearchCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _SearchCard({
    required this.controller,
    required this.query,
    required this.surface,
    required this.border,
    required this.onChanged,
    required this.onClear,
  });

  final TextEditingController controller;
  final String query;
  final Color surface;
  final Color border;
  final ValueChanged<String> onChanged;
  final VoidCallback onClear;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        backgroundColor: surface,
        borderColor: border,
        child: Directionality(
          textDirection: _hasArabic(query)
              ? TextDirection.rtl
              : TextDirection.ltr,
          child: TextField(
            controller: controller,
            onChanged: onChanged,
            style: AppTypography.body,
            decoration: InputDecoration(
              hintText: 'Atemnot / Schmerzen / الموقع',
              prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search_rounded),
              suffixIcon: query.isEmpty
                  ? null
                  : IconButton(
                      onPressed: onClear,
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded),
                    ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );

  static bool _hasArabic(String value) =>
      value.runes.any((rune) => rune >= 0x0600 && rune <= 0x06FF);
}

final class _PhraseResults extends StatelessWidget {

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'emergency_health_models.dart';

final class EmergencyHealthMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  EmergencyHealthMasterOrchestrator({
    List<EmergencyHealthContentSource> contentSources =
        const <EmergencyHealthContentSource>[],
  }) : _contentSources =
            List<EmergencyHealthContentSource>.unmodifiable(contentSources);

  final List<EmergencyHealthContentSource> _contentSources;

  EmergencyHealthDomain _domain = EmergencyHealthDomain.ambulance112;
  String _query = '';
  final Set<String> _completedActionIds = <String>{};

  EmergencyHealthDomain get domain => _domain;
  String get query => _query;
  List<EmergencyChecklistAction> get immediateActions => _immediateActions;
  int get completedActionCount => _completedActionIds.length;
  bool get isImmediateChecklistComplete =>
      _completedActionIds.length == _immediateActions.length;

  List<EmergencyPhrase> get visibleItems {
    final sourceItems = _contentSources
        .where((source) => source.domain == _domain)
        .expand((source) => source.items);

    return List<EmergencyPhrase>.unmodifiable(
      sourceItems.where((item) => item.matches(_query)),
    );
  }

  void switchDomain(EmergencyHealthDomain value) {
    if (_domain == value && _query.isEmpty) return;
    _domain = value;
    _query = '';
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    final next = value.trim();
    if (_query == next) return;
    _query = next;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearSearch() => setQuery('');

  bool isActionComplete(String actionId) =>
      _completedActionIds.contains(actionId.trim());

  void setActionComplete(String actionId, bool complete) {
    final normalizedId = actionId.trim();
    if (!_immediateActions.any((action) => action.id == normalizedId)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        actionId,
        'actionId',
        'Unknown emergency-health checklist action.',
      );
    }

    final changed = complete
        ? _completedActionIds.add(normalizedId)
        : _completedActionIds.remove(normalizedId);

    if (changed) notifyListeners();
  }

  static const List<EmergencyChecklistAction> _immediateActions =
      <EmergencyChecklistAction>[
    EmergencyChecklistAction(
      id: 'scene_safety',
      titleDe: 'Eigenschutz zuerst',
      titleAr: 'السلامة أولًا',
      detailAr:
          'ابتعد عن الخطر المباشر ولا تعرّض نفسك أو المصاب لخطر إضافي قبل طلب المساعدة.',
    ),
    EmergencyChecklistAction(
      id: 'choose_service',
      titleDe: '112 oder 116 117?',
      titleAr: 'اختر الجهة الصحيحة',
      detailAr:
          'في الخطر المهدد للحياة اتصل بـ112. للحاجة الطبية العاجلة غير المهددة للحياة خارج أوقات العيادات استخدم 116117.',
    ),
    EmergencyChecklistAction(
      id: 'exact_location',
      titleDe: 'Notfallort bereithalten',
      titleAr: 'جهّز الموقع الدقيق',
      detailAr:
          'حضّر الشارع والرقم والطابق أو علامة واضحة تساعد الطاقم على الوصول بسرعة.',
    ),
    EmergencyChecklistAction(
      id: 'describe_condition',
      titleDe: 'Zustand kurz beschreiben',
      titleAr: 'صف الحالة باختصار',
      detailAr:
          'اذكر ما حدث، عدد المصابين، الوعي والتنفس والنزيف أو الأعراض الشديدة بوضوح.',
    ),
    EmergencyChecklistAction(
      id: 'wait_questions',
      titleDe: 'Auf Rückfragen warten',
      titleAr: 'انتظر أسئلة الموظف',
      detailAr:
          'لا تغلق الاتصال من نفسك؛ أجب عن الأسئلة واتبع تعليمات مركز الاتصال.',
    ),
  ];
}

enum EmergencyHealthDomain { ambulance112, medicalOnCall }

enum EmergencyUrgency { lifeThreatening, urgentNonLifeThreatening }

extension EmergencyHealthDomainLabels on EmergencyHealthDomain {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        EmergencyHealthDomain.ambulance112 => 'Notruf 112',
        EmergencyHealthDomain.medicalOnCall => 'Notdienst & 116 117',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        EmergencyHealthDomain.ambulance112 => 'طوارئ الإسعاف 112',
        EmergencyHealthDomain.medicalOnCall => 'الطبيب المناوب والصيدلية',
      };
}

final class EmergencyPhrase {
  const EmergencyPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.domain,
    required this.urgency,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.explanationAr,
    this.tags = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final EmergencyHealthDomain domain;
  final EmergencyUrgency urgency;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String explanationAr;
  final List<String> tags;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;

    final haystack = <String>[
      titleDe,
      titleAr,
      german,
      arabic,
      explanationAr,
      ...tags,
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase();

    return haystack.contains(needle);
  }
}

abstract interface class EmergencyHealthContentSource {
  EmergencyHealthDomain get domain;
  List<EmergencyPhrase> get items;
}

final class EmergencyChecklistAction {
  const EmergencyChecklistAction({
    required this.id,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.detailAr,
  });

  final String id;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String detailAr;
}

final class EmergencyMedicalTerm {
  const EmergencyMedicalTerm({
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.explanationAr,
  });

  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String explanationAr;
}

  });

  final String exampleAr;

final class UrgentMedicalTerms {
  const UrgentMedicalTerms();

  List<UrgentMedicalTermEntry> get entries => _entries;

  String painScalePhraseDe(int score) {
    _validateScore(score);
    return 'Die Schmerzen sind $score von 10.';
  }

  String painScalePhraseAr(int score) {
    _validateScore(score);
    return 'شدة الألم $score من 10.';
  }

  static void _validateScore(int score) {
    if (score < 0 || score > 10) {
      throw RangeError.range(score, 0, 10, 'score');
    }
  }

  static const List<UrgentMedicalTermEntry> _entries =

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'environment_models.dart';
import 'gardening_balcony_sub_agent.dart';
import 'weather_alerts_sub_agent.dart';

final class EnvironmentMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  EnvironmentMasterOrchestrator({
    WeatherAlertsSubAgent weatherAlerts = const WeatherAlertsSubAgent(),
    GardeningBalconySubAgent gardening = const GardeningBalconySubAgent(),
  })  : _weatherAlerts = weatherAlerts,
        _gardening = gardening;

  final WeatherAlertsSubAgent _weatherAlerts;
  final GardeningBalconySubAgent _gardening;

  EnvironmentCategory _category = EnvironmentCategory.severeWeather;
  String _query = '';
  EnvironmentUrgentAlert? _activeUrgentAlert;

  EnvironmentCategory get category => _category;
  String get query => _query;
  EnvironmentUrgentAlert? get activeUrgentAlert => _activeUrgentAlert;

  List<EnvironmentUrgentAlert> get urgentAlerts => const <EnvironmentUrgentAlert>[
        EnvironmentUrgentAlert(
          kind: UrgentWeatherKind.unwetter,
          titleDe: 'Unwetter',
          titleAr: 'طقس خطير',
          scriptDe:
              'Es gibt eine Unwetterwarnung. Wo finde ich die aktuelle amtliche Warnlage für meine Region?',
          scriptAr:
              'هناك تحذير من طقس خطير. أين أجد أحدث التحذيرات الرسمية لمنطقتي؟',
        ),
        EnvironmentUrgentAlert(
          kind: UrgentWeatherKind.glaette,
          titleDe: 'Glättegefahr',
          titleAr: 'خطر الانزلاق',
          scriptDe:
              'Es besteht Glättegefahr. Welche Wege sollte ich meiden, und ist der öffentliche Verkehr betroffen?',
          scriptAr:
              'هناك خطر انزلاق بسبب الجليد. ما الطرق التي ينبغي تجنبها، وهل تأثرت المواصلات العامة؟',
        ),
      ];

  List<EnvironmentEntry> get visibleEntries {
    final source = switch (_category) {
      EnvironmentCategory.severeWeather => _weatherAlerts.entries,
      EnvironmentCategory.gardeningBalcony => _gardening.entries,
    };
    return List<EnvironmentEntry>.unmodifiable(
      source.where((entry) => entry.matches(_query)),
    );
  }

  void setCategory(EnvironmentCategory value) {
    if (_category == value) return;
    _category = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearSearch() => setQuery('');

  void selectUrgentAlert(UrgentWeatherKind kind) {
    final selected = urgentAlerts.firstWhere((alert) => alert.kind == kind);
    if (_activeUrgentAlert?.kind == selected.kind) return;
    _activeUrgentAlert = selected;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearUrgentAlert() {
    if (_activeUrgentAlert == null) return;
    _activeUrgentAlert = null;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/life_environment/environment_models.dart
