enum EnvironmentCategory { severeWeather, gardeningBalcony }

enum UrgentWeatherKind { unwetter, glaette }

extension EnvironmentCategoryLabels on EnvironmentCategory {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        EnvironmentCategory.severeWeather => 'Unwetter & Warnungen',
        EnvironmentCategory.gardeningBalcony => 'Garten & Balkon',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        EnvironmentCategory.severeWeather => 'الطقس والتحذيرات',
        EnvironmentCategory.gardeningBalcony => 'الحديقة والشرفة',
      };
}

final class EnvironmentUrgentAlert {
  const EnvironmentUrgentAlert({
    required this.kind,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.scriptDe,
    required this.scriptAr,
  });

  final UrgentWeatherKind kind;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String scriptDe;
  final String scriptAr;
}

final class EnvironmentEntry {
  const EnvironmentEntry({
    required this.id,
    required this.category,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.contextDe,
    required this.contextAr,
    this.sourceLabel,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final EnvironmentCategory category;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String contextDe;
  final String contextAr;
  final String? sourceLabel;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;

    final haystack = <String>[
      titleDe,
      titleAr,
      german,
      arabic,
      contextDe,
      contextAr,
      if (sourceLabel != null) sourceLabel!,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase();

    return haystack.contains(needle);
  }
}

import '../../design_system/design_system.dart';

abstract final class EnvironmentUiTokens {
  static const double pageInset = 16;
  static const double bottomInset = 32;
  static const double sectionGap = 18;
  static const double itemGap = 12;
  static const double compactGap = 8;
}

final class EnvironmentMasterHub extends StatefulWidget {
  const EnvironmentMasterHub({
    this.orchestrator,
    super.key,
  });

  final EnvironmentMasterOrchestrator? orchestrator;

  @override
  State<EnvironmentMasterHub> createState() => _EnvironmentMasterHubState();
}

final class _EnvironmentMasterHubState extends State<EnvironmentMasterHub> {
  late final EnvironmentMasterOrchestrator _orchestrator;
  late final bool _ownsOrchestrator;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ownsOrchestrator = widget.orchestrator == null;
    _orchestrator = widget.orchestrator ?? EnvironmentMasterOrchestrator();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    if (_ownsOrchestrator) {
      _orchestrator.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              EnvironmentUiTokens.pageInset,
              EnvironmentUiTokens.pageInset,
              EnvironmentUiTokens.pageInset,
              EnvironmentUiTokens.bottomInset,
            ),
            child: AnimatedBuilder(
              animation: _orchestrator,
              builder: (context, _) => Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  _HeaderCard(dark: dark),
                  const SizedBox(height: EnvironmentUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _UrgentWeatherAlertBar(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: EnvironmentUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _SearchField(orchestrator: _orchestrator),
                  const SizedBox(height: EnvironmentUiTokens.itemGap),
                  _CategorySelector(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: EnvironmentUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _EntryList(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

  Widget build(BuildContext context) {

      borderColor: AppColors.secondary.withAlpha(112),
      backgroundColor: dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,

          Wrap(

            runSpacing: EnvironmentUiTokens.compactGap,
            children: <Widget>[
              for (final alert in orchestrator.urgentAlerts)
                ChoiceChip(
                  key: ValueKey<String>(
                    'environment-alert-${alert.kind.name}',
                  ),
                  selected: active?.kind == alert.kind,
                  onSelected: (_) => orchestrator.selectUrgentAlert(alert.kind),
                  avatar: Icon(
                    alert.kind == UrgentWeatherKind.unwetter
                        ? Icons.thunderstorm_outlined
                        : Icons.ac_unit_outlined,
                  ),
                  label: Text(
                    '${alert.titleDe} · ${alert.titleAr}',
                    style: AppTypography.label,
                  ),
                ),
            ],
          ),
          if (active != null) ...<Widget>[
            const SizedBox(height: EnvironmentUiTokens.itemGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              active.scriptDe,
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.body,

            AppDirectionalText(
              active.scriptAr,

              style: AppTypography.body,

import '../../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import 'assembly_models.dart';
import 'assembly_service_agent.dart';
import 'defects_reklamation_agent.dart';

final class AssemblyDefectsHubController extends ChangeNotifier {
  AssemblyDefectsHubController({
    AssemblyServiceAgent assemblyAgent = const AssemblyServiceAgent(),
    DefectsReklamationAgent defectsAgent = const DefectsReklamationAgent(),
  }) : _scenarios = <AssemblyScenario>[
          ...assemblyAgent.scenarios,
          ...defectsAgent.scenarios,
        ];

  final List<AssemblyScenario> _scenarios;
  AssemblyIssue _issue = AssemblyIssue.instructions;
  String _query = '';

  AssemblyIssue get issue => _issue;
  String get query => _query;

  List<AssemblyScenario> get visibleScenarios =>
      List<AssemblyScenario>.unmodifiable(
        _scenarios.where(
          (scenario) => scenario.issue == _issue && scenario.matches(_query),
        ),
      );

  void setIssue(AssemblyIssue value) {
    if (_issue == value) return;
    _issue = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

final class AssemblyDefectsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const AssemblyDefectsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<AssemblyDefectsScreen> createState() => _AssemblyDefectsScreenState();
}

final class _AssemblyDefectsScreenState extends State<AssemblyDefectsScreen> {
  late final AssemblyDefectsHubController _controller;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _controller = AssemblyDefectsHubController();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface = dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: const Text('التركيب والقطع الناقصة · Aufbau & Reklamation'),
        ),
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 32),
            child: AnimatedBuilder(
              animation: _controller,
              builder: (context, _) => Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  TextField(
                    onChanged: _controller.setQuery,
                    textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(
                      prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.search),
                      labelText: 'Suche · بحث',
                      hintText: 'Aufbauanleitung, Schrauben, verkratzt ...',
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  AppGlassCard(
                    backgroundColor: surface,
                    borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(88),
                    child: Wrap(
                      spacing: 8,
                      runSpacing: 8,
                      children: <Widget>[
                        for (final issue in AssemblyIssue.values)
                          FilterChip(
                            selected: _controller.issue == issue,
                            onSelected: (_) => _controller.setIssue(issue),
                            label: Text(_issueLabel(issue)),
                          ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  for (final scenario in _controller.visibleScenarios) ...<Widget>[
                    AppGlassCard(
                      backgroundColor: surface,
                      borderColor: AppColors.secondary.withAlpha(88),
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                        children: <Widget>[
                          AppDirectionalText(

FILE: lib/features/life_furniture_home_setup/assembly/assembly_models.dart

enum AssemblyIssue {
  instructions,
  tools,
  montageService,
  missingPart,
  wrongScrew,
  transportDamage,
}

final class AssemblyScenario {
  const AssemblyScenario({
    required this.id,
    required this.issue,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final AssemblyIssue issue;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;
    final haystack = <String>[
      titleDe,
      titleAr,
      german,
      arabic,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase();
    return haystack.contains(needle);
  }
}

final class ReplacementPartRequest {
  const ReplacementPartRequest({
    required this.orderNumber,
    required this.partNumber,
    required this.issue,
    required this.descriptionDe,
  });

  final String orderNumber;
  final String partNumber;
  final AssemblyIssue issue;
  final String descriptionDe;

  bool get isDefectCase =>
      issue == AssemblyIssue.missingPart ||
      issue == AssemblyIssue.wrongScrew ||
      issue == AssemblyIssue.transportDamage;
}

enum FurnitureHomeSection { shopping, delivery, warranty }

enum FurnitureRequestStatus { planning, ordered, delivered, issueReported }

final class FurniturePurchaseRequest {
  const FurniturePurchaseRequest({
    required this.id,
    required this.itemNameDe,
    required this.itemNameAr,
    required this.quantity,
    this.widthCm,
    this.heightCm,
    this.depthCm,
    this.status = FurnitureRequestStatus.planning,
  });

  final String id;
  final String itemNameDe;
  final String itemNameAr;
  final int quantity;
  final double? widthCm;
  final double? heightCm;
  final double? depthCm;
  final FurnitureRequestStatus status;

  String get dimensionsLabel {
    final values = <String>[
      if (heightCm != null) 'Höhe ${_format(heightCm!)} cm',
      if (widthCm != null) 'Breite ${_format(widthCm!)} cm',
      if (depthCm != null) 'Tiefe ${_format(depthCm!)} cm',
    ];
    return values.isEmpty ? 'Maße noch offen' : values.join(' · ');
  }

  static String _format(double value) => value == value.roundToDouble()
      ? value.toInt().toString()
      : value.toStringAsFixed(1);
}

enum FurnitureDeliveryLevel { curbside, apartment }

final class FurnitureDeliveryRequest {
  const FurnitureDeliveryRequest({
    required this.orderId,
    required this.level,
    required this.addressNote,
    this.preferredWindow,
  });

  final String orderId;
  final FurnitureDeliveryLevel level;
  final String addressNote;
  final String? preferredWindow;

  String get labelDe => switch (level) {
        FurnitureDeliveryLevel.curbside =>
          'Lieferung bis zur Bordsteinkante',
        FurnitureDeliveryLevel.apartment =>
          'Lieferung bis in die Wohnung',
      };
}

final class FurnitureWarrantyCase {
  const FurnitureWarrantyCase({
    required this.orderId,
    required this.problemDe,
    required this.problemAr,
    required this.purchaseDate,
    this.receiptAvailable = true,
  });

  final String orderId;
  final String problemDe;
  final String problemAr;
  final DateTime purchaseDate;
  final bool receiptAvailable;

  bool isWithinMonths(int months, DateTime now) {
    final boundary = DateTime(
      purchaseDate.year,
      purchaseDate.month + months,
      purchaseDate.day,
    );
    return !now.isAfter(boundary);
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'furniture_home_models.dart';

final class FurnitureHomeSetupModule {
  const FurnitureHomeSetupModule();

  static const String routeName = '/life/furniture-home-setup';

  FurnitureHomeSetupController createController() =>
      FurnitureHomeSetupController();
}

final class FurnitureHomeSetupController extends ChangeNotifier {
  FurnitureHomeSection _section = FurnitureHomeSection.shopping;
  String _query = '';

  final List<FurniturePurchaseRequest> _purchases =
      <FurniturePurchaseRequest>[];
  final List<FurnitureDeliveryRequest> _deliveries =
      <FurnitureDeliveryRequest>[];
  final List<FurnitureWarrantyCase> _warrantyCases =
      <FurnitureWarrantyCase>[];

  FurnitureHomeSection get section => _section;
  String get query => _query;

  List<FurniturePurchaseRequest> get purchases =>
      List<FurniturePurchaseRequest>.unmodifiable(_purchases);
  List<FurnitureDeliveryRequest> get deliveries =>
      List<FurnitureDeliveryRequest>.unmodifiable(_deliveries);
  List<FurnitureWarrantyCase> get warrantyCases =>
      List<FurnitureWarrantyCase>.unmodifiable(_warrantyCases);

  void setSection(FurnitureHomeSection value) {
    if (_section == value) return;
    _section = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void addPurchase(FurniturePurchaseRequest request) {
    _purchases.add(request);
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void addDelivery(FurnitureDeliveryRequest request) {
    _deliveries.add(request);
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void addWarrantyCase(FurnitureWarrantyCase warrantyCase) {
    _warrantyCases.add(warrantyCase);
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

final class ShoppingDeliveryHubController extends ChangeNotifier {
  ShoppingDeliveryHubController({
    FurnitureStoreShoppingAgent storeAgent =
        const FurnitureStoreShoppingAgent(),
    DeliveryTransportAgent deliveryAgent = const DeliveryTransportAgent(),
  }) : _scenarios = <FurnitureShoppingScenario>[
          ...storeAgent.scenarios,
          ...deliveryAgent.scenarios,
        ];

  final List<FurnitureShoppingScenario> _scenarios;
  FurnitureService _service = FurnitureService.store;
  String _query = '';

  FurnitureService get service => _service;
  String get query => _query;

  List<FurnitureShoppingScenario> get visibleScenarios =>
      List<FurnitureShoppingScenario>.unmodifiable(
        _scenarios.where(
          (scenario) =>
              scenario.service == _service && scenario.matches(_query),
        ),
      );

  void setService(FurnitureService value) {
    if (_service == value) return;
    _service = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

enum FurnitureService { store, curbside, apartment, transporter }

final class FurnitureShoppingScenario {
  const FurnitureShoppingScenario({
    required this.id,
    required this.service,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final FurnitureService service;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;
    final haystack = <String>[
      titleDe,
      titleAr,
      german,
      arabic,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase();
    return haystack.contains(needle);
  }
}

final class FurnitureDimensions {
  const FurnitureDimensions({
    required this.heightCm,
    required this.widthCm,
    required this.depthCm,
  });

  final double heightCm;
  final double widthCm;
  final double depthCm;

  String get labelDe =>
      'Höhe ${_fmt(heightCm)} cm · Breite ${_fmt(widthCm)} cm · Tiefe ${_fmt(depthCm)} cm';

  static String _fmt(double value) => value == value.roundToDouble()
      ? value.toInt().toString()
      : value.toStringAsFixed(1);
}

  void setTopic(CarwashTopic value) {

enum CarwashTopic {
  all,
  program,
  preparation,
  conveyor,
  aftercare;

  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        CarwashTopic.all => 'Alle Themen',
        CarwashTopic.program => 'Waschprogramm',
        CarwashTopic.preparation => 'Vorbereitung',
        CarwashTopic.conveyor => 'Einfahrt & Förderband',
        CarwashTopic.aftercare => 'Ausfahrt & Nachpflege',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        CarwashTopic.all => 'كل المواضيع',
        CarwashTopic.program => 'برنامج الغسيل',
        CarwashTopic.preparation => 'تجهيز السيارة',
        CarwashTopic.conveyor => 'الدخول والناقل',
        CarwashTopic.aftercare => 'الخروج والعناية',
      };
}

final class CarwashPhrase {
  const CarwashPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.topic,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.contextDe,
    required this.contextAr,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final CarwashTopic topic;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String contextDe;
  final String contextAr;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = _normalize(query);
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;
    return _normalize(<String>[
      topic.labelDe,
      topic.labelAr,
      german,
      arabic,
      contextDe,
      contextAr,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ')).contains(needle);
  }

  static String _normalize(String value) => value
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replaceAll('ä', 'a')
      .replaceAll('ö', 'o')
      .replaceAll('ü', 'u')
      .replaceAll('ß', 'ss')
      .replaceAll('ـ', '');
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'fuel_payment_models.dart';
import 'fuel_payment_phrase_bank.dart';

final class FuelPaymentAgent extends ChangeNotifier {
  FuelPaymentTopic _topic = FuelPaymentTopic.all;
  String _query = '';

  FuelPaymentTopic get topic => _topic;
  String get query => _query;
  List<FuelPaymentPhrase> get allPhrases =>
      List<FuelPaymentPhrase>.unmodifiable(FuelPaymentPhraseBank.all);

  List<FuelPaymentPhrase> get visiblePhrases =>
      List<FuelPaymentPhrase>.unmodifiable(
        FuelPaymentPhraseBank.all.where(
          (item) =>
              (_topic == FuelPaymentTopic.all || item.topic == _topic) &&
              item.matches(_query),
        ),
      );

  String get safetyNoteDe =>
      'Kraftstoff nie nach Farbe oder Gewohnheit auswählen. Fahrzeugfreigabe und Kennzeichnung vergleichen; bei vermuteter Fehlbetankung Motor nicht starten und Hilfe holen.';

  String get safetyNoteAr =>
      'لا تختَر الوقود حسب اللون أو العادة. قارن النوع المسموح بعلامة المضخة، وإذا اشتبهت بخطأ في التعبئة فلا تشغل المحرك واطلب المساعدة.';

  void setTopic(FuelPaymentTopic value) {
    if (_topic == value) return;
    _topic = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/life_gas_station_carwash/fuel_payment/fuel_payment_models.dart
--------------------------------------------------
enum FuelPaymentTopic {
  all,
  fuelChoice,
  pumpUse,
  payment,
  receiptHelp;

  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        FuelPaymentTopic.all => 'Alle Themen',
        FuelPaymentTopic.fuelChoice => 'Kraftstoff wählen',
        FuelPaymentTopic.pumpUse => 'Zapfsäule',
        FuelPaymentTopic.payment => 'Bezahlen',
        FuelPaymentTopic.receiptHelp => 'Beleg & Hilfe',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        FuelPaymentTopic.all => 'كل المواضيع',
        FuelPaymentTopic.fuelChoice => 'اختيار الوقود',
        FuelPaymentTopic.pumpUse => 'استخدام المضخة',
        FuelPaymentTopic.payment => 'الدفع',
        FuelPaymentTopic.receiptHelp => 'الإيصال والمساعدة',
      };
}

final class FuelPaymentPhrase {
  const FuelPaymentPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.topic,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.contextDe,
    required this.contextAr,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final FuelPaymentTopic topic;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String contextDe;
  final String contextAr;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = _normalize(query);
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;
    return _normalize(<String>[
      topic.labelDe,
      topic.labelAr,
      german,
      arabic,
      contextDe,
      contextAr,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ')).contains(needle);
  }

  static String _normalize(String value) => value
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replaceAll('ä', 'a')
      .replaceAll('ö', 'o')
      .replaceAll('ü', 'u')
      .replaceAll('ß', 'ss')
      .replaceAll('ـ', '');
}

final class GasStationCarwashMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  GasStationDomain _domain = GasStationDomain.all;
  String _query = '';

  GasStationDomain get domain => _domain;
  String get query => _query;

  List<GasStationRouteDescriptor> get visibleRoutes {
    return List<GasStationRouteDescriptor>.unmodifiable(
      GasStationCarwashRoutes.all.where((route) {
        final domainMatches =
            _domain == GasStationDomain.all || route.domain == _domain;
        return domainMatches && route.matches(_query);
      }),
    );
  }

  String get safetyNoteDe =>
      'Beim Kraftstoff immer Fahrzeugfreigabe, Tankdeckelhinweis und Zapfsäulenkennzeichnung prüfen. In Waschanlagen gelten die konkreten Anweisungen der Anlage und des Personals.';

  String get safetyNoteAr =>
      'تحقق دائمًا من نوع الوقود المسموح للسيارة ومن علامة غطاء الخزان والمضخة. وفي المغسلة اتبع تعليمات المنشأة والموظفين حرفيًا.';

  void setDomain(GasStationDomain value) {
    if (_domain == value) return;
    _domain = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearFilters() {
    if (_domain == GasStationDomain.all && _query.isEmpty) return;
    _domain = GasStationDomain.all;
    _query = '';
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

enum GasStationDomain {
  all,
  fuelPayment,
  automaticWash;

  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        GasStationDomain.all => 'Alle Bereiche',
        GasStationDomain.fuelPayment => 'Tanken & Bezahlen',
        GasStationDomain.automaticWash => 'Autowäsche',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        GasStationDomain.all => 'كل الأقسام',
        GasStationDomain.fuelPayment => 'الوقود والدفع',
        GasStationDomain.automaticWash => 'غسيل السيارة',
      };
}

enum GasStationRouteId {
  fuelPayment,
  automaticWash,
}

final class GasStationRouteDescriptor {
  const GasStationRouteDescriptor({
    required this.id,
    required this.domain,
    required this.routeName,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.descriptionDe,
    required this.descriptionAr,
    this.searchTerms = const <String>[],
  });

  final GasStationRouteId id;
  final GasStationDomain domain;
  final String routeName;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String descriptionDe;
  final String descriptionAr;
  final List<String> searchTerms;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = _normalize(query);
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;
    return _normalize(<String>[
      titleDe,
      titleAr,
      descriptionDe,
      descriptionAr,
      ...searchTerms,
    ].join(' ')).contains(needle);
  }

  static String _normalize(String value) {
    return value
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll('ä', 'a')
        .replaceAll('ö', 'o')
        .replaceAll('ü', 'u')
        .replaceAll('ß', 'ss')
        .replaceAll('ـ', '');
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/haircut_models.dart';
import '../payment/washing_payment_agent.dart';
import '../styles/appointment_style_agent.dart';
import '../styles/haircut_phrase.dart';

final class HaircutBarbershopModule {
  const HaircutBarbershopModule();

  static const String routeName = '/life/haircut-barbershop';

  HaircutMasterOrchestrator createOrchestrator() =>
      HaircutMasterOrchestrator(
        appointmentStyleAgent: const AppointmentStyleAgent(),
        washingPaymentAgent: const WashingPaymentAgent(),
      );
}

final class HaircutMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  HaircutMasterOrchestrator({
    required AppointmentStyleAgent appointmentStyleAgent,
    required WashingPaymentAgent washingPaymentAgent,
  })  : _appointmentStyleAgent = appointmentStyleAgent,
        _washingPaymentAgent = washingPaymentAgent;

  final AppointmentStyleAgent _appointmentStyleAgent;
  final WashingPaymentAgent _washingPaymentAgent;

  String _query = '';
  HaircutLevel? _level;
  HaircutTopic? _topic;
  HaircutServiceKind? _selectedService;

  String get query => _query;
  HaircutLevel? get level => _level;
  HaircutTopic? get topic => _topic;
  HaircutServiceKind? get selectedService => _selectedService;

  List<HaircutServiceOption> get services => HaircutBarbershopCatalog.services;

  List<SalonOpeningHours> get openingHours =>
      HaircutBarbershopCatalog.sampleOpeningHours;

  List<HaircutPhrase> get results {
    final combined = <HaircutPhrase>[
      ..._appointmentStyleAgent.search(
        _query,
        level: _level,
        topic: _topic,
      ),
      ..._washingPaymentAgent.search(
        _query,
        level: _level,
        topic: _topic,
      ),
    ];
    return List<HaircutPhrase>.unmodifiable(combined);
  }

  List<HaircutPhrase> get quickPhrases => List<HaircutPhrase>.unmodifiable(
        <HaircutPhrase>[
          ..._appointmentStyleAgent.quickPhrases,
          ..._washingPaymentAgent.quickPhrases,
        ],
      );

  void setQuery(String value) {
    final next = value.trim();
    if (_query == next) return;
    _query = next;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setLevel(HaircutLevel? value) {
    if (_level == value) return;
    _level = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setTopic(HaircutTopic? value) {
    if (_topic == value) return;
    _topic = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void selectService(HaircutServiceKind? value) {
    if (_selectedService == value) return;
    _selectedService = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void resetFilters() {
    final changed = _query.isNotEmpty ||
        _level != null ||
        _topic != null ||
        _selectedService != null;
    _query = '';
    _level = null;
    _topic = null;
    _selectedService = null;
    if (changed) notifyListeners();
  }
}

final class SalonPaymentSummary {
  SalonPaymentSummary({
    required this.serviceTotal,
    required this.tip,
    this.receiptRequested = false,
  }) {
    if (serviceTotal < 0) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(serviceTotal, 'serviceTotal', 'must be >= 0');
    }
    if (tip < 0) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(tip, 'tip', 'must be >= 0');
    }
  }

  final double serviceTotal;
  final double tip;
  final bool receiptRequested;

  double get total => serviceTotal + tip;

  SalonPaymentSummary copyWith({
    double? serviceTotal,
    double? tip,
    bool? receiptRequested,
  }) =>
      SalonPaymentSummary(
        serviceTotal: serviceTotal ?? this.serviceTotal,
        tip: tip ?? this.tip,
        receiptRequested: receiptRequested ?? this.receiptRequested,
      );
}

import '../styles/haircut_phrase.dart';
import 'washing_payment_content.dart';

final class WashingPaymentAgent {
  const WashingPaymentAgent();

  List<HaircutPhrase> get all => WashingPaymentContent.phrases;

  List<HaircutPhrase> search(
    String query, {
    HaircutLevel? level,
    HaircutTopic? topic,
  }) =>
      List<HaircutPhrase>.unmodifiable(
        all.where((phrase) {
          final levelMatches = level == null || phrase.level == level;
          final topicMatches = topic == null || phrase.topic == topic;
          return levelMatches && topicMatches && phrase.matches(query);
        }),
      );

  List<HaircutPhrase> get washingPhrases =>
      search('', topic: HaircutTopic.washing);

  List<HaircutPhrase> get carePhrases => search('', topic: HaircutTopic.care);

  List<HaircutPhrase> get paymentPhrases =>
      search('', topic: HaircutTopic.payment);

  List<HaircutPhrase> get quickPhrases => List<HaircutPhrase>.unmodifiable(
        all.where((phrase) => phrase.quick),
      );
}

import '../../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import '../application/haircut_master_orchestrator.dart';
import '../domain/haircut_models.dart';
import '../styles/haircut_phrase.dart';

abstract final class HaircutUiTokens {
  static const double page = 16;
  static const double gapXs = 6;
  static const double gapSm = 10;
  static const double gapMd = 14;
  static const double gapLg = 18;
  static const double chipHorizontal = 12;
  static const double chipVertical = 8;
  static const double icon = 24;
}

final class HaircutMasterScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const HaircutMasterScreen({
    this.module = const HaircutBarbershopModule(),
    super.key,
  });

  final HaircutBarbershopModule module;

  @override
  State<HaircutMasterScreen> createState() => _HaircutMasterScreenState();
}

final class _HaircutMasterScreenState extends State<HaircutMasterScreen> {
  late final HaircutMasterOrchestrator _orchestrator;
  late final TextEditingController _searchController;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _orchestrator = widget.module.createOrchestrator();
    _searchController = TextEditingController();
    _orchestrator.addListener(_refresh);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _orchestrator.removeListener(_refresh);
    _orchestrator.dispose();
    _searchController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _refresh() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (_searchController.text != _orchestrator.query) {
      _searchController.text = _orchestrator.query;
      _searchController.selection = TextSelection.collapsed(
        offset: _searchController.text.length,
      );
    }
    setState(() {});
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface = dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface;
    final border =
        dark ? AppColors.glassBorderDark : AppColors.glassBorderLight;
    final results = _orchestrator.results;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: const Text('الحلاقة والعناية · Friseursalon'),
        ),
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              HaircutUiTokens.page,
              HaircutUiTokens.page,
              HaircutUiTokens.page,
              32,
            ),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: <Widget>[
                _HeaderCard(surface: surface, border: border),
                const SizedBox(height: HaircutUiTokens.gapMd),
                _SearchCard(
                  controller: _searchController,
                  query: _orchestrator.query,
                  surface: surface,
                  border: border,
                  onChanged: _orchestrator.setQuery,
                  onClear: () {
                    _searchController.clear();
                    _orchestrator.setQuery('');
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: HaircutUiTokens.gapMd),
                _LevelFilters(
                  active: _orchestrator.level,
                  surface: surface,
                  border: border,
                  onSelected: _orchestrator.setLevel,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: HaircutUiTokens.gapMd),
                _ServiceOverview(
                  services: _orchestrator.services,
                  selected: _orchestrator.selectedService,
                  surface: surface,
                  border: border,
                  onSelected: _orchestrator.selectService,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: HaircutUiTokens.gapMd),
                _OpeningHoursCard(
                  hours: _orchestrator.openingHours,
                  surface: surface,
                  border: border,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: HaircutUiTokens.gapMd),
                _QuickPhrasesCard(
                  phrases: _orchestrator.quickPhrases,
                  surface: surface,
                  border: border,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: HaircutUiTokens.gapMd),
                _ResultSummary(
                  count: results.length,
                  canReset: _orchestrator.query.isNotEmpty ||
                      _orchestrator.level != null ||
                      _orchestrator.topic != null ||
                      _orchestrator.selectedService != null,
                  surface: surface,
                  border: border,
                  onReset: () {
                    _searchController.clear();
                    _orchestrator.resetFilters();
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: HaircutUiTokens.gapSm),
                if (results.isEmpty)
                  _EmptyCard(surface: surface, border: border)
                else
                  for (var index = 0; index < results.length; index += 1) ...[
                    _PhraseCard(
                      phrase: results[index],
                      surface: surface,
                      border: border,
                    ),
                    if (index != results.length - 1)
                      const SizedBox(height: HaircutUiTokens.gapSm),
                  ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _SearchCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _SearchCard({
    required this.controller,
    required this.query,
    required this.surface,
    required this.border,
    required this.onChanged,
    required this.onClear,
  });

  final TextEditingController controller;
  final String query;
  final Color surface;
  final Color border;
  final ValueChanged<String> onChanged;
  final VoidCallback onClear;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final direction = RegExp(r'[\u0600-\u06FF]').hasMatch(query)
        ? TextDirection.rtl
        : TextDirection.ltr;

    return AppGlassCard(
      backgroundColor: surface,
      borderColor: border,
      child: Directionality(
        textDirection: direction,
        child: TextField(
          key: const ValueKey<String>('haircut-search'),
          controller: controller,
          textDirection: direction,
          onChanged: onChanged,
          style: AppTypography.body,
          decoration: InputDecoration(
            prefixIcon: const Icon(
              Icons.search_rounded,
              color: AppColors.primary,
            ),
            hintText: 'Termin · Schere · Bart · Waschen · Rechnung',
            suffixIcon: query.isEmpty
                ? null
                : IconButton(
                    onPressed: onClear,
                    icon: const Icon(
                      Icons.close_rounded,
                      color: AppColors.secondary,
                    ),
                  ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _LevelFilters extends StatelessWidget {
  const _LevelFilters({
    required this.active,
    required this.surface,
    required this.border,
    required this.onSelected,
  });

  final HaircutLevel? active;
  final Color surface;
  final Color border;
  final ValueChanged<HaircutLevel?> onSelected;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final values = <HaircutLevel?>[null, ...HaircutLevel.values];

    return AppGlassCard(
      backgroundColor: surface,
      borderColor: border,
      child: Wrap(
        spacing: HaircutUiTokens.gapSm,
        runSpacing: HaircutUiTokens.gapSm,
        children: <Widget>[
          for (final level in values)
            AppGlassCard(
              onTap: () => onSelected(level),
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: HaircutUiTokens.chipHorizontal,
                vertical: HaircutUiTokens.chipVertical,
              ),
              borderColor: active == level ? AppColors.primary : border,
              glowColor: active == level ? AppColors.primary : null,
              backgroundColor: surface,
              child: AppDirectionalText(
                level?.label ?? 'Alle',
                languageCode: 'de',
                style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
                  color: active == level ? AppColors.primary : null,
                ),
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'appointment_style_content.dart';
import 'haircut_phrase.dart';

final class AppointmentStyleAgent {
  const AppointmentStyleAgent();

  List<HaircutPhrase> get all => AppointmentStyleContent.phrases;

  List<HaircutPhrase> search(
    String query, {
    HaircutLevel? level,
    HaircutTopic? topic,
  }) =>
      List<HaircutPhrase>.unmodifiable(
        all.where((phrase) {
          final levelMatches = level == null || phrase.level == level;
          final topicMatches = topic == null || phrase.topic == topic;
          return levelMatches && topicMatches && phrase.matches(query);
        }),
      );

  List<HaircutPhrase> get quickPhrases => List<HaircutPhrase>.unmodifiable(
        all.where((phrase) => phrase.quick),
      );

  List<HaircutPhrase> get appointmentPhrases => search(
        '',
        topic: HaircutTopic.appointment,
      );

  List<HaircutPhrase> get classicHaircutPhrases => search(
        '',
        topic: HaircutTopic.haircut,
      );

  List<HaircutPhrase> get beardMoustachePhrases => search(
        '',
        topic: HaircutTopic.beardMoustache,
      );
}

FILE: lib/features/life_haircut_barbershop/styles/haircut_phrase.dart

enum HaircutTopic {
  appointment,
  haircut,
  beardMoustache,
  washing,
  care,
  payment,
}

enum HaircutLevel {
  a1a2,
  b1,
  b2,
}

extension HaircutLevelLabel on HaircutLevel {
  String get label => switch (this) {
        HaircutLevel.a1a2 => 'A1/A2',
        HaircutLevel.b1 => 'B1',
        HaircutLevel.b2 => 'B2',
      };
}

final class HaircutPhrase {
  const HaircutPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.topic,
    required this.level,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.noteArabic,
    this.quick = false,
  });

  final String id;
  final HaircutTopic topic;
  final HaircutLevel level;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String noteArabic;
  final bool quick;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final normalized = _normalize(query);
    if (normalized.isEmpty) return true;
    final haystack = _normalize('$german $arabic $noteArabic');
    return haystack.contains(normalized);
  }
}

String _normalize(String value) => value
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[.!?,;:()\[\]{}"“”„]'), '')
    .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');

  static const double bottomInset = 32;

  static const double itemGap = 12;
  static const double compactGap = 8;
}

final class HardwareStoreMasterHub extends StatefulWidget {
  const HardwareStoreMasterHub({
    this.orchestrator,
    super.key,
  });

  final HardwareStoreMasterOrchestrator? orchestrator;

  @override
  State<HardwareStoreMasterHub> createState() =>
      _HardwareStoreMasterHubState();
}

final class _HardwareStoreMasterHubState
    extends State<HardwareStoreMasterHub> {
  late final HardwareStoreMasterOrchestrator _orchestrator;
  late final bool _ownsOrchestrator;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ownsOrchestrator = widget.orchestrator == null;
    _orchestrator =
        widget.orchestrator ?? HardwareStoreMasterOrchestrator();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    if (_ownsOrchestrator) {
      _orchestrator.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              HardwareStoreUiTokens.pageInset,
              HardwareStoreUiTokens.pageInset,
              HardwareStoreUiTokens.pageInset,
              HardwareStoreUiTokens.bottomInset,
            ),
            child: AnimatedBuilder(
              animation: _orchestrator,
              builder: (context, _) => Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  _HeaderCard(dark: dark),
                  const SizedBox(height: HardwareStoreUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _SearchCard(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: HardwareStoreUiTokens.itemGap),
                  _SectionSelector(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: HardwareStoreUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _CatalogCard(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: HardwareStoreUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _PhraseList(
                    phrases: _orchestrator.visiblePhrases,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'services/cutting_rental_sub_agent.dart';

final class HardwareStoreMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  HardwareStoreMasterOrchestrator({
    ToolsMaterialsSubAgent toolsMaterials = const ToolsMaterialsSubAgent(),
    CuttingRentalSubAgent cuttingRental = const CuttingRentalSubAgent(),
  })  : _toolsMaterials = toolsMaterials,
        _cuttingRental = cuttingRental;

  final ToolsMaterialsSubAgent _toolsMaterials;
  final CuttingRentalSubAgent _cuttingRental;

  HardwareStoreSection _section = HardwareStoreSection.toolsMaterials;
  String _query = '';

  HardwareStoreSection get section => _section;
  String get query => _query;

  List<DiyPhrase> get visiblePhrases => switch (_section) {
        HardwareStoreSection.toolsMaterials => _toolsMaterials.search(_query),
        HardwareStoreSection.cuttingRental => _cuttingRental.search(_query),
      };

  List<HardwareStoreCatalogItem> get catalogItems =>
      List<HardwareStoreCatalogItem>.unmodifiable(_catalogItems);

  void setSection(HardwareStoreSection value) {
    if (_section == value) return;
    _section = value;
    _query = '';
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    final normalized = value.trim();
    if (_query == normalized) return;
    _query = normalized;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearSearch() => setQuery('');

  static const List<HardwareStoreCatalogItem> _catalogItems =
      <HardwareStoreCatalogItem>[
    HardwareStoreCatalogItem(
      id: 'catalog-screws',
      kind: HardwareStoreItemKind.tool,

    ),
    HardwareStoreCatalogItem(
      id: 'catalog-drill-bits',
      kind: HardwareStoreItemKind.tool,
      nameDe: 'Bohrer & Bits',
      nameAr: 'رؤوس مثقاب ولقم',
      noteDe: 'Den Bohrer passend zum Werkstoff auswählen.',
      noteAr: 'اختر رأس المثقاب حسب المادة المراد العمل عليها.',
    ),
    HardwareStoreCatalogItem(
      id: 'catalog-paint',
      kind: HardwareStoreItemKind.material,
      nameDe: 'Farben & Klebstoffe',
      nameAr: 'دهانات ومواد لاصقة',
      noteDe: 'Einsatzbereich und Herstellerangaben vergleichen.',
      noteAr: 'قارن مجال الاستخدام وتعليمات الشركة المصنّعة.',
    ),
    HardwareStoreCatalogItem(
      id: 'catalog-plumbing',
      kind: HardwareStoreItemKind.material,
      nameDe: 'Sanitär- & Elektrobedarf',
      nameAr: 'مستلزمات سباكة وكهرباء بسيطة',
      noteDe: 'Fertige, passend gekennzeichnete Produkte auswählen.',
      noteAr: 'اختر منتجات جاهزة ومطابقة للمواصفات المطلوبة.',

enum HardwareStoreSection { toolsMaterials, cuttingRental }

extension HardwareStoreSectionLabels on HardwareStoreSection {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        HardwareStoreSection.toolsMaterials => 'Werkzeuge & Materialien',
        HardwareStoreSection.cuttingRental => 'Zuschnitt & Mietgeräte',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        HardwareStoreSection.toolsMaterials => 'الأدوات والمواد',
        HardwareStoreSection.cuttingRental => 'القص وتأجير المعدات',
      };
}

enum HardwareStoreItemKind { tool, material, cuttingService, rentalService }

extension HardwareStoreItemKindLabels on HardwareStoreItemKind {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        HardwareStoreItemKind.tool => 'Werkzeug',
        HardwareStoreItemKind.material => 'Material',
        HardwareStoreItemKind.cuttingService => 'Zuschnittservice',
        HardwareStoreItemKind.rentalService => 'Mietservice',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        HardwareStoreItemKind.tool => 'أداة',
        HardwareStoreItemKind.material => 'مادة',
        HardwareStoreItemKind.cuttingService => 'خدمة قص',
        HardwareStoreItemKind.rentalService => 'خدمة تأجير',
      };
}

  final String noteAr;
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'hardware_store_master_hub.dart';
import 'hardware_store_master_orchestrator.dart';
import 'services/cutting_rental_sub_agent.dart';
import 'tools/tools_materials_sub_agent.dart';

final class HardwareStoreModuleDependencies {
  const HardwareStoreModuleDependencies({
    this.toolsMaterials = const ToolsMaterialsSubAgent(),
    this.cuttingRental = const CuttingRentalSubAgent(),
  });

  final ToolsMaterialsSubAgent toolsMaterials;
  final CuttingRentalSubAgent cuttingRental;

  HardwareStoreMasterOrchestrator createOrchestrator() =>
      HardwareStoreMasterOrchestrator(
        toolsMaterials: toolsMaterials,
        cuttingRental: cuttingRental,
      );
}

abstract final class HardwareStoreModule {
  static const String routeName = '/life/hardware-store-diy';

  static Map<String, WidgetBuilder> routes({
    HardwareStoreModuleDependencies dependencies =
        const HardwareStoreModuleDependencies(),
  }) =>
      <String, WidgetBuilder>{
        routeName: (_) => HardwareStoreMasterHub(
              orchestrator: dependencies.createOrchestrator(),
            ),
      };
}

import '../../life_diy/diy_models.dart';
import 'cutting_rental_bank.dart';

final class CuttingRentalSubAgent {
  const CuttingRentalSubAgent();

  List<DiyPhrase> get phrases =>
      List<DiyPhrase>.unmodifiable(CuttingRentalBank.phrases);

  List<String> get rentalChecklistDe => const <String>[
        'Kaution und Zahlungsart bestätigen',
        'Zustand des Geräts bei Übernahme dokumentieren',
        'Rückgabezeit und Rückgabestelle bestätigen',
        'Zubehör und enthaltene Teile gemeinsam prüfen',
      ];

  DiyPhrase? byId(String id) {
    for (final phrase in CuttingRentalBank.phrases) {
      if (phrase.id == id) return phrase;
    }
    return null;
  }

  List<DiyPhrase> search(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return phrases;

    return CuttingRentalBank.phrases
        .where((phrase) => phrase.matches(needle))
        .toList(growable: false);
  }
}

import '../../life_diy/diy_models.dart';
import 'tools_materials_bank.dart';

final class ToolsMaterialsSubAgent {
  const ToolsMaterialsSubAgent();

  List<DiyPhrase> get phrases =>
      List<DiyPhrase>.unmodifiable(ToolsMaterialsBank.phrases);

  DiyPhrase? byId(String id) {
    for (final phrase in ToolsMaterialsBank.phrases) {
      if (phrase.id == id) return phrase;
    }
    return null;
  }

  List<DiyPhrase> search(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return phrases;

    return ToolsMaterialsBank.phrases
        .where((phrase) => phrase.matches(needle))
        .toList(growable: false);
  }
}

--------------------------------------------------
FILE: lib/features/life_health/application/health_master_orchestrator.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import '../domain/health_models.dart';
import 'hausarzt_agent.dart';
import 'pharmacy_agent.dart';

final class HealthMasterOrchestrator {
  const HealthMasterOrchestrator({
    required this.pharmacy,
    required this.hausarzt,
  });

  final PharmacyAgent pharmacy;
  final HausarztAgent hausarzt;

  List<HealthLearningItem> get allItems =>
      List<HealthLearningItem>.unmodifiable(
        <HealthLearningItem>[
          ...pharmacy.items,
          ...hausarzt.items,
        ],
      );

  List<EmergencyQuickAction> get emergencyActions =>
      const <EmergencyQuickAction>[
        EmergencyQuickAction(
          id: 'emergency_112',
          german: 'Es ist ein Notfall. Bitte rufen Sie 112.',
          arabic: 'هذه حالة طارئة. يرجى الاتصال بالرقم 112.',
          phoneNumber: '112',
          isEmergency: true,
        ),
        EmergencyQuickAction(
          id: 'emergency_help',
          german: 'Ich brauche sofort medizinische Hilfe.',
          arabic: 'أحتاج إلى مساعدة طبية فوراً.',
          phoneNumber: '112',
          isEmergency: true,
        ),
      ];

  List<HealthLearningItem> filterByLevel(HealthLevel level) =>
      List<HealthLearningItem>.unmodifiable(
        allItems.where((item) => item.level == level),
      );

  List<HealthLearningItem> searchSymptoms(
    String query, {
    HealthLevel? level,
  }) {
    final symptomTopics = <HealthTopic>{
      HealthTopic.symptom,
      HealthTopic.commonRemedy,
    };

    return List<HealthLearningItem>.unmodifiable(
      allItems.where(
        (item) =>
            symptomTopics.contains(item.topic) &&
            (level == null || item.level == level) &&
            item.matches(query),
      ),
    );
  }

  List<HealthLearningItem> itemsForService(
    HealthService service, {
    HealthLevel? level,
  }) =>
      List<HealthLearningItem>.unmodifiable(
        allItems.where(
          (item) =>
              item.service == service &&
              (level == null || item.level == level),
        ),
      );
}

--------------------------------------------------
FILE: lib/features/life_health/domain/health_models.dart
--------------------------------------------------
enum HealthLevel { a1a2, b1, b2 }

enum HealthService { pharmacy, hausarzt }

enum HealthTopic {
  prescription,
  dosage,
  activeIngredient,
  commonRemedy,
  appointment,
  symptom,
  sickLeaveNote,
}

extension HealthLevelLabels on HealthLevel {
  String get german => switch (this) {
        HealthLevel.a1a2 => 'A1/A2',
        HealthLevel.b1 => 'B1',
        HealthLevel.b2 => 'B2',
      };

  String get arabic => switch (this) {
        HealthLevel.a1a2 => 'مبتدئ',
        HealthLevel.b1 => 'متوسط',
        HealthLevel.b2 => 'متقدم',
      };
}

extension HealthServiceLabels on HealthService {
  String get german => switch (this) {
        HealthService.pharmacy => 'Apotheke',
        HealthService.hausarzt => 'Hausarzt',
      };

  String get arabic => switch (this) {
        HealthService.pharmacy => 'الصيدلية',
        HealthService.hausarzt => 'طبيب الأسرة',
      };
}

final class HealthLearningItem {
  const HealthLearningItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.level,
    required this.service,
    required this.topic,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.tags,
  });

  final String id;
  final HealthLevel level;
  final HealthService service;
  final HealthTopic topic;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final List<String> tags;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;

    return german.toLowerCase().contains(needle) ||
        arabic.toLowerCase().contains(needle) ||
        tags.any((tag) => tag.toLowerCase().contains(needle));
  }
}

final class EmergencyQuickAction {
  const EmergencyQuickAction({
    required this.id,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.phoneNumber,
    required this.isEmergency,
  });

  final String id;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String phoneNumber;
  final bool isEmergency;
}

final class _HealthMasterScreenState extends State<HealthMasterScreen> {
  HealthLevel? _level;
  String _query = '';

  List<HealthLearningItem> get _visibleItems {
    if (_query.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      return widget.orchestrator.searchSymptoms(_query, level: _level);
    }
    if (_level != null) {
      return widget.orchestrator.filterByLevel(_level!);
    }
    return widget.orchestrator.allItems;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface = dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface;
    final border =
        dark ? AppColors.glassBorderDark : AppColors.glassBorderLight;
    final items = _visibleItems;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: <Widget>[
                _HeaderCard(surface: surface, border: border),
                Divider(color: border),
                _EmergencyBar(
                  actions: widget.orchestrator.emergencyActions,
                  surface: surface,
                  border: border,
                ),
                Divider(color: border),
                _LevelFilter(
                  selected: _level,

                  border: border,
                  onChanged: (value) => setState(() => _query = value),
                ),
                Divider(color: border),

                      )
                      .toList(growable: false),

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'craft_repair_sub_agent.dart';
import 'home_services_models.dart';
import 'locksmith_emergency_sub_agent.dart';

final class HomeServicesMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  HomeServicesMasterOrchestrator({
    LocksmithEmergencySubAgent locksmith =
        const LocksmithEmergencySubAgent(),
    CraftRepairSubAgent craftRepair = const CraftRepairSubAgent(),
  })  : _locksmith = locksmith,
        _craftRepair = craftRepair;

  final LocksmithEmergencySubAgent _locksmith;
  final CraftRepairSubAgent _craftRepair;

  HomeServicesDomain _domain = HomeServicesDomain.locksmithEmergency;
  String _query = '';

  HomeServicesDomain get domain => _domain;
  String get query => _query;

  List<HomeServicePhrase> get visiblePhrases {
    final source = switch (_domain) {
      HomeServicesDomain.locksmithEmergency => _locksmith.phrases,
      HomeServicesDomain.urgentRepairs => _craftRepair.phrases,
    };

    return List<HomeServicePhrase>.unmodifiable(
      source.where((phrase) => phrase.matches(_query)),
    );
  }

  List<ConsumerProtectionWarning> get consumerWarnings =>
      _consumerWarnings;

  void setDomain(HomeServicesDomain value) {
    if (_domain == value) return;
    _domain = value;
    _query = '';
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearSearch() => setQuery('');

  static const List<ConsumerProtectionWarning> _consumerWarnings =
      <ConsumerProtectionWarning>[
    ConsumerProtectionWarning(
      id: 'price-before-dispatch',
      german:
          'Vor der Anfahrt einen verbindlichen Festpreis inklusive Anfahrt '
          'und möglicher Zuschläge vereinbaren.',
      arabic:
          'اتفق قبل وصول الفني على السعر الثابت والملزم الذي يشمل أجرة الوصول وأي رسوم إضافية محتملة.',
    ),
    ConsumerProtectionWarning(
      id: 'identity-before-work',
      german:
          'Vor Arbeitsbeginn Ausweis oder Firmennachweis und Firmennamen prüfen.',
      arabic:
          'تحقق من هوية الفني أو إثبات الشركة واسمها قبل بدء العمل.',
    ),
    ConsumerProtectionWarning(
      id: 'approve-extra-work',
      german:
          'Zusätzliche Arbeiten oder Teile erst nach Erklärung und Preisangabe freigeben.',
      arabic:
          'لا توافق على أعمال أو قطع إضافية قبل شرحها وتحديد سعرها.',
    ),
    ConsumerProtectionWarning(
      id: 'request-invoice',
      german:
          'Eine vollständige Rechnung mit Firma, Leistung und Einzelbeträgen verlangen.',
      arabic:

enum HomeServicesDomain {
  locksmithEmergency,
  urgentRepairs,
}

extension HomeServicesDomainLabels on HomeServicesDomain {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        HomeServicesDomain.locksmithEmergency =>
          'Schlüsseldienst & Schlüsselnotfall',
        HomeServicesDomain.urgentRepairs =>
          'Heizung & Sanitär-Notdienst',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        HomeServicesDomain.locksmithEmergency =>
          'خدمة الأقفال وطوارئ المفاتيح',
        HomeServicesDomain.urgentRepairs =>
          'طوارئ التدفئة والسباكة',
      };
}

final class HomeServicePhrase {
  const HomeServicePhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.domain,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.contextDe,
    required this.contextAr,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final HomeServicesDomain domain;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String contextDe;
  final String contextAr;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;

    final haystack = <String>[
      german,
      arabic,
      contextDe,
      contextAr,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase();

    return haystack.contains(needle);
  }
}

final class ConsumerProtectionWarning {
  const ConsumerProtectionWarning({
    required this.id,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
  });

  final String id;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
}

import '../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import 'home_services_master_orchestrator.dart';
import 'home_services_models.dart';

abstract final class HomeServicesUiTokens {
  static const double pageInset = 16;
  static const double bottomInset = 32;
  static const double sectionGap = 18;
  static const double itemGap = 12;
  static const double compactGap = 8;
  static const double warningBorderAlpha = 120;
  static const double surfaceBorderAlpha = 80;
}

final class HomeServicesMasterHub extends StatefulWidget {
  const HomeServicesMasterHub({
    this.orchestrator,
    super.key,
  });

  final HomeServicesMasterOrchestrator? orchestrator;

  @override
  State<HomeServicesMasterHub> createState() =>
      _HomeServicesMasterHubState();
}

final class _HomeServicesMasterHubState
    extends State<HomeServicesMasterHub> {
  late final HomeServicesMasterOrchestrator _orchestrator;
  late final bool _ownsOrchestrator;
  late final TextEditingController _searchController;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ownsOrchestrator = widget.orchestrator == null;
    _orchestrator =
        widget.orchestrator ?? HomeServicesMasterOrchestrator();
    _searchController = TextEditingController(text: _orchestrator.query);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchController.dispose();
    if (_ownsOrchestrator) {
      _orchestrator.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              HomeServicesUiTokens.pageInset,
              HomeServicesUiTokens.pageInset,
              HomeServicesUiTokens.pageInset,
              HomeServicesUiTokens.bottomInset,
            ),
            child: AnimatedBuilder(
              animation: _orchestrator,
              builder: (context, _) => Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  _HeaderCard(dark: dark),
                  const SizedBox(
                    height: HomeServicesUiTokens.sectionGap,
                  ),
                  _ConsumerProtectionBar(
                    warnings: _orchestrator.consumerWarnings,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(
                    height: HomeServicesUiTokens.sectionGap,
                  ),
                  _DomainSelector(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                    onDomainSelected: _selectDomain,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(
                    height: HomeServicesUiTokens.itemGap,
                  ),
                  _SearchField(
                    controller: _searchController,
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(
                    height: HomeServicesUiTokens.sectionGap,
                  ),
                  _PhraseList(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _selectDomain(HomeServicesDomain domain) {
    if (_orchestrator.domain == domain) return;
    _orchestrator.setDomain(domain);
    _searchController.clear();
  }
}

final class _PhraseList extends StatelessWidget {

  });

            dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,

        ),
      );
    }

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: <Widget>[
        Row(
          children: <Widget>[
            Expanded(
              child: AppDirectionalText(
                orchestrator.domain.labelDe,
                languageCode: 'de',

              ),

            ),

              Icons.emergency_outlined,
              color: AppColors.primary,
            ),
          ],
        ),
        const SizedBox(
          height: HomeServicesUiTokens.itemGap,
        ),
        for (var index = 0; index < phrases.length; index++) ...<Widget>[
          _PhraseCard(
            phrase: phrases[index],
            dark: dark,
          ),
          if (index != phrases.length - 1)
            const SizedBox(
              height: HomeServicesUiTokens.itemGap,
            ),
        ],
      ],
    );

}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/housing_models.dart';

final class HousingMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  HousingMasterOrchestrator({
    this.apartmentAgent = const ApartmentHuntingSubAgent(),
    this.maintenanceAgent = const MaintenanceRepairSubAgent(),
  });

  final ApartmentHuntingSubAgent apartmentAgent;
  final MaintenanceRepairSubAgent maintenanceAgent;

  HousingCategory _category = HousingCategory.apartmentHunting;
  HousingLevel _level = HousingLevel.a1a2;
  HousingQuickAction? _lastQuickAction;
  String? _lastQuickActionText;

  HousingCategory get category => _category;
  HousingLevel get level => _level;
  HousingQuickAction? get lastQuickAction => _lastQuickAction;
  String? get lastQuickActionText => _lastQuickActionText;

  List<HousingPhrase> get visiblePhrases => switch (_category) {
        HousingCategory.apartmentHunting =>
          apartmentAgent.phrasesFor(_level),
        HousingCategory.maintenanceRepair =>
          maintenanceAgent.phrasesFor(_level),
      };

  List<HousingQuickAction> get availableQuickActions => switch (_category) {
        HousingCategory.apartmentHunting =>
          apartmentAgent.quickActions,
        HousingCategory.maintenanceRepair =>
          maintenanceAgent.quickActions,
      };

  void switchCategory(HousingCategory category) {
    if (_category == category) return;
    _category = category;
    _clearQuickAction();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setLevel(HousingLevel level) {
    if (_level == level) return;
    _level = level;
    _clearQuickAction();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  String runQuickAction(HousingQuickAction action) {
    if (!availableQuickActions.contains(action)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        action,
        'action',
        'Quick action is not available for the active housing category.',
      );
    }

    final text = switch (_category) {
      HousingCategory.apartmentHunting =>
        apartmentAgent.quickActionText(action),
      HousingCategory.maintenanceRepair =>
        maintenanceAgent.quickActionText(action),
    };

    _lastQuickAction = action;
    _lastQuickActionText = text;
    notifyListeners();
    return text;
  }

  void clearQuickAction() {
    if (_lastQuickAction == null && _lastQuickActionText == null) return;
    _clearQuickAction();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void _clearQuickAction() {
    _lastQuickAction = null;
    _lastQuickActionText = null;
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/life_housing/domain/housing_models.dart

enum HousingCategory {
  apartmentHunting,
  maintenanceRepair,
}

enum HousingLevel {
  a1a2,
  b1,
  b2,
}

enum HousingQuickAction {
  contactLandlord,
  askAboutKaution,
  reportPlumbing,
  reportHeating,
  arrangeInternet,
}

extension HousingCategoryLabels on HousingCategory {
  String get germanLabel => switch (this) {
        HousingCategory.apartmentHunting => 'Wohnungssuche',
        HousingCategory.maintenanceRepair => 'Handwerker',
      };

  String get arabicLabel => switch (this) {
        HousingCategory.apartmentHunting => 'البحث عن سكن',
        HousingCategory.maintenanceRepair => 'الصيانة والإصلاح',
      };
}

extension HousingLevelLabels on HousingLevel {
  String get label => switch (this) {
        HousingLevel.a1a2 => 'A1/A2',
        HousingLevel.b1 => 'B1',
        HousingLevel.b2 => 'B2',
      };
}

extension HousingQuickActionLabels on HousingQuickAction {
  String get germanLabel => switch (this) {
        HousingQuickAction.contactLandlord => 'Vermieter kontaktieren',
        HousingQuickAction.askAboutKaution => 'Kaution fragen',
        HousingQuickAction.reportPlumbing => 'Wasserproblem melden',
        HousingQuickAction.reportHeating => 'Heizung melden',
        HousingQuickAction.arrangeInternet => 'Internet-Termin',
      };

  String get arabicLabel => switch (this) {
        HousingQuickAction.contactLandlord => 'التواصل مع المؤجر',
        HousingQuickAction.askAboutKaution => 'السؤال عن التأمين',
        HousingQuickAction.reportPlumbing => 'بلاغ مشكلة مياه',
        HousingQuickAction.reportHeating => 'بلاغ التدفئة',
        HousingQuickAction.arrangeInternet => 'موعد تركيب الإنترنت',
      };
}

final class HousingPhrase {
  const HousingPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.category,
    required this.level,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.textDe,
    required this.explanationAr,
  });

  final String id;
  final HousingCategory category;
  final HousingLevel level;
  final String titleDe;
  final String textDe;
  final String explanationAr;
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

abstract final class HousingDesignTokens {
  static const double spaceXs = 6;
  static const double spaceS = 10;
  static const double spaceM = 14;
  static const double spaceL = 18;
  static const double spaceXl = 28;

  static const double cardRadius = 24;
  static const double compactCardRadius = 20;
  static const double iconS = 20;
  static const double iconM = 28;

  static const int selectedFillAlpha = 36;
  static const int subtleBorderAlpha = 72;
  static const int accentBorderAlpha = 80;
  static const int heroBorderAlpha = 90;
  static const int strongBorderAlpha = 100;

  static const EdgeInsetsDirectional screenPadding =
      EdgeInsetsDirectional.fromSTEB(spaceM, spaceM, spaceM, spaceXl);

  static const EdgeInsets cardPadding = EdgeInsets.all(spaceM);

  static const EdgeInsets compactCardPadding =
      EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: spaceM, vertical: spaceS);
}

import '../../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import '../application/housing_master_orchestrator.dart';
import '../domain/housing_models.dart';
import 'housing_design_tokens.dart';

final class HousingMasterScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const HousingMasterScreen({
    this.orchestrator,
    super.key,
  });

  final HousingMasterOrchestrator? orchestrator;

  @override
  State<HousingMasterScreen> createState() => _HousingMasterScreenState();
}

final class _HousingMasterScreenState extends State<HousingMasterScreen> {
  late final HousingMasterOrchestrator _orchestrator;
  late final bool _ownsOrchestrator;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ownsOrchestrator = widget.orchestrator == null;
    _orchestrator = widget.orchestrator ?? HousingMasterOrchestrator();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    if (_ownsOrchestrator) _orchestrator.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Directionality(
      key: const ValueKey<String>('housing-arabic-direction'),
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: const Text('السكن والصيانة · Wohnung & Handwerker'),
        ),
        body: SafeArea(
          child: ListenableBuilder(
            listenable: _orchestrator,
            builder: (context, _) {
              return SingleChildScrollView(
                padding: HousingDesignTokens.screenPadding,
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    const _HeroCard(),
                    const SizedBox(height: HousingDesignTokens.spaceM),
                    _CategorySwitcher(orchestrator: _orchestrator),
                    const SizedBox(height: HousingDesignTokens.spaceM),
                    _LevelFilter(orchestrator: _orchestrator),
                    const SizedBox(height: HousingDesignTokens.spaceM),
                    _QuickActionBar(orchestrator: _orchestrator),
                    if (_orchestrator.lastQuickActionText != null) ...<Widget>[
                      const SizedBox(height: HousingDesignTokens.spaceM),
                      _QuickActionResult(orchestrator: _orchestrator),
                    ],
                    const SizedBox(height: HousingDesignTokens.spaceL),
                    _PhraseSection(orchestrator: _orchestrator),
                  ],
                ),
              );
            },
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

  const _HeroCard();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AppGlassCard(

      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          Row(
            children: <Widget>[
              const Icon(
                Icons.home,
                color: AppColors.primary,
                size: HousingDesignTokens.iconM,
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: HousingDesignTokens.spaceS),

                child: Text(
                  'Housing & Home Maintenance Master Hub',
                  style: AppTypography.title,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: HousingDesignTokens.spaceS),
          Directionality(
            key: const ValueKey<String>('housing-german-direction'),
            textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
            child: Text(
              'Wohnungssuche & Handwerker',
              style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(
                color: AppColors.secondary,
