            style: AppTypography.body,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _CategorySwitcher extends StatelessWidget {
  const _CategorySwitcher({required this.orchestrator});

  final HousingMasterOrchestrator orchestrator;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AppGlassCard(
      padding: HousingDesignTokens.cardPadding,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          Text('المسار', style: AppTypography.title),
          const SizedBox(height: HousingDesignTokens.spaceS),
          for (final category in HousingCategory.values) ...<Widget>[
            _CategoryCard(
              category: category,
              selected: orchestrator.category == category,
              onTap: () => orchestrator.switchCategory(category),
            ),
            if (category != HousingCategory.values.last)
              const SizedBox(height: HousingDesignTokens.spaceS),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _CategoryCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _CategoryCard({
    required this.category,
    required this.selected,
    required this.onTap,
  });

  final HousingCategory category;
  final bool selected;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final accent = category == HousingCategory.apartmentHunting
        ? AppColors.primary
        : AppColors.secondary;

    return AppGlassCard(
      onTap: selected ? null : onTap,
      padding: HousingDesignTokens.compactCardPadding,
      borderRadius: HousingDesignTokens.compactCardRadius,
      borderColor: selected ? accent : Theme.of(context).dividerColor,
      glowColor: selected ? accent : null,
      child: Row(
        children: <Widget>[
          Icon(
            category == HousingCategory.apartmentHunting
                ? Icons.apartment
                : Icons.build,
            color: accent,
            size: HousingDesignTokens.iconM,
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: HousingDesignTokens.spaceS),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: <Widget>[
                AppDirectionalText(
                  category.germanLabel,
                  languageCode: 'de',
                  style: AppTypography.title,
                ),
                AppDirectionalText(
                  category.arabicLabel,
                  languageCode: 'ar',
                  style: AppTypography.label,
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          if (selected)
            const Icon(
              Icons.check_circle_outline,
              color: AppColors.mastery,
              size: HousingDesignTokens.iconS,
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _LevelFilter extends StatelessWidget {
  const _LevelFilter({required this.orchestrator});

  final HousingMasterOrchestrator orchestrator;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AppGlassCard(
      padding: HousingDesignTokens.cardPadding,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          Text('المستوى', style: AppTypography.title),
          const SizedBox(height: HousingDesignTokens.spaceS),
          Wrap(
            spacing: HousingDesignTokens.spaceS,
            runSpacing: HousingDesignTokens.spaceS,
            children: <Widget>[
              for (final level in HousingLevel.values)
                ChoiceChip(
                  label: Text(
                    level.label,
                    textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                    style: AppTypography.label,
                  ),
                  selected: orchestrator.level == level,
                  selectedColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(HousingDesignTokens.selectedFillAlpha),
                  side: BorderSide(
                    color: orchestrator.level == level
                        ? AppColors.primary
                        : Theme.of(context).dividerColor,
                  ),
                  onSelected: (_) => orchestrator.setLevel(level),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _QuickActionBar extends StatelessWidget {
  const _QuickActionBar({required this.orchestrator});

  final HousingMasterOrchestrator orchestrator;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final actions = orchestrator.availableQuickActions;

    return AppGlassCard(
      padding: HousingDesignTokens.cardPadding,
      borderColor: AppColors.tertiary.withAlpha(HousingDesignTokens.accentBorderAlpha),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          Text('إجراءات سريعة', style: AppTypography.title),
          const SizedBox(height: HousingDesignTokens.spaceXs),
          Text(
            'اختر موقفًا للحصول على صياغة ألمانية جاهزة ومحترمة.',
            style: AppTypography.label,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: HousingDesignTokens.spaceS),
          LayoutBuilder(
            builder: (context, constraints) {
              return Wrap(
                spacing: HousingDesignTokens.spaceS,
                runSpacing: HousingDesignTokens.spaceS,
                children: <Widget>[
                  for (final action in actions)
                    SizedBox(
                      width: constraints.maxWidth,
                      child: AppGlassCard(
                        onTap: () => orchestrator.runQuickAction(action),
                        padding: HousingDesignTokens.compactCardPadding,
                        borderRadius: HousingDesignTokens.compactCardRadius,
                        borderColor: AppColors.tertiary.withAlpha(HousingDesignTokens.accentBorderAlpha),
                        child: Row(
                          children: <Widget>[
                            Icon(
                              _quickActionIcon(action),
                              color: AppColors.tertiary,
                              size: HousingDesignTokens.iconS,
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(width: HousingDesignTokens.spaceS),
                            Expanded(
                              child: Column(
                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                                children: <Widget>[
                                  AppDirectionalText(
                                    action.germanLabel,
                                    languageCode: 'de',
                                    style: AppTypography.label,
                                  ),
                                  AppDirectionalText(
                                    action.arabicLabel,
                                    languageCode: 'ar',
                                    style: AppTypography.label,
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                ],
              );
            },
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  IconData _quickActionIcon(HousingQuickAction action) => switch (action) {
        HousingQuickAction.contactLandlord => Icons.mail,
        HousingQuickAction.askAboutKaution => Icons.receipt,
        HousingQuickAction.reportPlumbing => Icons.water_drop,
        HousingQuickAction.reportHeating => Icons.thermostat,
        HousingQuickAction.arrangeInternet => Icons.wifi,
      };
}

final class _QuickActionResult extends StatelessWidget {
  const _QuickActionResult({required this.orchestrator});

  final HousingMasterOrchestrator orchestrator;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final action = orchestrator.lastQuickAction!;
    final text = orchestrator.lastQuickActionText!;

    return AppGlassCard(
      padding: HousingDesignTokens.cardPadding,
      borderColor: AppColors.mastery.withAlpha(HousingDesignTokens.strongBorderAlpha),
      glowColor: AppColors.mastery,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          Row(
            children: <Widget>[
              const Icon(
                Icons.flash_on,
                color: AppColors.mastery,
                size: HousingDesignTokens.iconS,
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: HousingDesignTokens.spaceS),
              Expanded(
                child: AppDirectionalText(
                  action.germanLabel,
                  languageCode: 'de',
                  style: AppTypography.title,
                ),
              ),
              IconButton(
                onPressed: orchestrator.clearQuickAction,
                icon: const Icon(Icons.close),
                tooltip: 'إغلاق',
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: HousingDesignTokens.spaceS),
          AppDirectionalText(
            text,
            languageCode: 'de',
            style: AppTypography.body,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _PhraseSection extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PhraseSection({required this.orchestrator});

  final HousingMasterOrchestrator orchestrator;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final phrases = orchestrator.visiblePhrases;

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: <Widget>[
        Row(
          children: <Widget>[
            Expanded(
              child: Text(
                'تدريب ' + orchestrator.level.label,
                style: AppTypography.title,
              ),
            ),
            AppDirectionalText(
              orchestrator.category.germanLabel,
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
                color: AppColors.primary,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: HousingDesignTokens.spaceS),
        for (final phrase in phrases) ...<Widget>[
          _PhraseCard(phrase: phrase),
          if (phrase != phrases.last)
            const SizedBox(height: HousingDesignTokens.spaceS),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }
}

final class _PhraseCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PhraseCard({required this.phrase});

  final HousingPhrase phrase;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final accent = phrase.category == HousingCategory.apartmentHunting
        ? AppColors.primary
        : AppColors.secondary;

    return AppGlassCard(
      padding: HousingDesignTokens.cardPadding,
      borderColor: accent.withAlpha(HousingDesignTokens.subtleBorderAlpha),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          AppDirectionalText(
            phrase.titleDe,
            languageCode: 'de',
            style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(color: accent),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: HousingDesignTokens.spaceXs),
          AppDirectionalText(
            phrase.textDe,
            languageCode: 'de',
            style: AppTypography.title,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: HousingDesignTokens.spaceS),
          AppDirectionalText(
            phrase.explanationAr,
            languageCode: 'ar',
            style: AppTypography.body,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

enum IntercityTravelCategory {
  iceBooking,
  delaySupport,
  bahnCard,
}

extension IntercityTravelCategoryLabels on IntercityTravelCategory {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        IntercityTravelCategory.iceBooking => 'ICE-Buchung',
        IntercityTravelCategory.delaySupport => 'Verspätung & Umstieg',
        IntercityTravelCategory.bahnCard => 'BahnCard',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        IntercityTravelCategory.iceBooking => 'حجز قطارات ICE',
        IntercityTravelCategory.delaySupport => 'التأخير وتبديل القطارات',
        IntercityTravelCategory.bahnCard => 'بطاقة BahnCard',
      };
}

enum JourneySituation {
  planning,
  delayed,
  missedConnection,
  bahnCardQuestion,
}

extension JourneySituationLabels on JourneySituation {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        JourneySituation.planning => 'Reise planen',
        JourneySituation.delayed => 'Zug verspätet',
        JourneySituation.missedConnection => 'Anschluss verpasst',
        JourneySituation.bahnCardQuestion => 'BahnCard-Frage',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        JourneySituation.planning => 'تخطيط الرحلة',
        JourneySituation.delayed => 'القطار متأخر',
        JourneySituation.missedConnection => 'فاتني القطار التالي',
        JourneySituation.bahnCardQuestion => 'استفسار BahnCard',
      };
}

final class IntercityPhrase {
  const IntercityPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.category,
    required this.topicDe,
    required this.topicAr,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    this.tags = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final IntercityTravelCategory category;
  final String topicDe;
  final String topicAr;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final List<String> tags;
}

final class IntercityTrainTravelMasterHub {
  IntercityTrainTravelMasterHub({required Iterable<IntercityPhrase> entries})
      : _entries = List<IntercityPhrase>.unmodifiable(entries);

  final List<IntercityPhrase> _entries;
  final Set<IntercityTravelCategory> _selected = <IntercityTravelCategory>{
    IntercityTravelCategory.iceBooking,
    IntercityTravelCategory.delaySupport,
    IntercityTravelCategory.bahnCard,
  };

  String _query = '';
  JourneySituation _situation = JourneySituation.planning;

  String get query => _query;
  JourneySituation get situation => _situation;
  Set<IntercityTravelCategory> get selected =>
      Set<IntercityTravelCategory>.unmodifiable(_selected);

  List<IntercityPhrase> get visibleEntries {
    final q = _normalize(_query);
    return List<IntercityPhrase>.unmodifiable(
      _entries.where((entry) {
        if (!_selected.contains(entry.category)) return false;
        if (q.isEmpty) return true;
        final text = _normalize(<String>[
          entry.topicDe,
          entry.topicAr,
          entry.german,
          entry.arabic,
          ...entry.tags,
        ].join(' '));
        return text.contains(q);
      }),
    );
  }

  void setQuery(String value) => _query = value.trim();

  void toggleCategory(IntercityTravelCategory category) {
    if (_selected.contains(category)) {
      _selected.remove(category);
    } else {
      _selected.add(category);
    }
  }

  void setSituation(JourneySituation value) => _situation = value;

  String get situationPromptDe => switch (_situation) {
        JourneySituation.planning =>
          'Ich möchte eine ICE-Verbindung buchen. Können Sie mir Fahrpreis, Umstiege und Reservierungsoptionen erklären?',
        JourneySituation.delayed =>
          'Mein ICE hat Verspätung. Welche aktuelle Verbindung kann ich für die Weiterfahrt nutzen?',
        JourneySituation.missedConnection =>
          'Wegen der Verspätung habe ich meinen Anschluss verpasst. Welche nächste Verbindung soll ich nehmen?',
        JourneySituation.bahnCardQuestion =>
          'Ich möchte wissen, welche BahnCard zu meinen Fahrten passt und welche Vertragsbedingungen gelten.',
      };

  String get situationPromptAr => switch (_situation) {
        JourneySituation.planning =>
          'أريد حجز رحلة بقطار ICE. هل يمكنكم شرح السعر والتبديلات وخيارات حجز المقعد؟',
        JourneySituation.delayed =>
          'قطار ICE الخاص بي متأخر. ما الرحلة الحالية التي يمكنني استخدامها لمتابعة السفر؟',
        JourneySituation.missedConnection =>
          'بسبب التأخير فاتني القطار التالي. ما الرحلة التالية التي ينبغي أن أستخدمها؟',
        JourneySituation.bahnCardQuestion =>
          'أريد معرفة أي بطاقة BahnCard تناسب رحلاتي وما شروط العقد.',
      };

  static String _normalize(String value) {
    var out = value.toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll('ä', 'a')
        .replaceAll('ö', 'o')
        .replaceAll('ü', 'u')
        .replaceAll('ß', 'ss');
    out = out.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-z0-9ء-ي ]'), ' ');
    return out.replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ').trim();
  }
}

abstract final class _TrainUi {
  static const double inset = 16;
  static const double gap = 14;
  static const double smallGap = 8;
  static const double radius = 18;
  static const int borderAlpha = 72;
  static const int selectedAlpha = 32;
}

final class IntercityTrainTravelMasterScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const IntercityTrainTravelMasterScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<IntercityTrainTravelMasterScreen> createState() =>
      _IntercityTrainTravelMasterScreenState();
}

final class _IntercityTrainTravelMasterScreenState
    extends State<IntercityTrainTravelMasterScreen> {
  late final IntercityTrainTravelMasterHub _hub;
  final TextEditingController _search = TextEditingController();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _hub = IntercityTrainTravelMasterHub(
      entries: <IntercityPhrase>[
        ...IceBookingAgent.entries,
        ...DelayBahnCardAgent.entries,
      ],
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _search.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Color _surface(BuildContext context) =>
      Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark
          ? AppColors.darkSurface
          : AppColors.lightSurface;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final surface = _surface(context);
    final entries = _hub.visibleEntries;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: SafeArea(
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(_TrainUi.inset),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: <Widget>[
              AppGlassCard(
                key: const ValueKey<String>('intercity-train-header'),
                backgroundColor: surface,
                glowColor: AppColors.primary,
                borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(_TrainUi.borderAlpha),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    AppDirectionalText(
                      'السفر بالقطارات بين المدن',
                      languageCode: 'ar',
                      style: AppTypography.title,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: _TrainUi.smallGap),
                    AppDirectionalText(
                      'DB Fernverkehr · ICE · BahnCard',
                      languageCode: 'de',
                      style: AppTypography.display.copyWith(
                        color: AppColors.primary,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: _TrainUi.smallGap),
                    AppDirectionalText(
                      'عبارات عملية لحجز ICE، المقاعد والتبديلات، التعامل مع التأخير، والاستفسار عن BahnCard.',
                      languageCode: 'ar',
                      style: AppTypography.body,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: _TrainUi.gap),
              _SituationCard(
                surface: surface,
                hub: _hub,
                onChanged: () => setState(() {}),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: _TrainUi.gap),
              _CategoryCard(
                surface: surface,
                hub: _hub,
                onChanged: () => setState(() {}),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: _TrainUi.gap),
              AppGlassCard(
                backgroundColor: surface,
                borderColor:
                    AppColors.secondary.withAlpha(_TrainUi.borderAlpha),
                child: TextField(
                  key: const ValueKey<String>('intercity-train-search'),
                  controller: _search,
                  textDirection: RegExp(r'[ء-ي]').hasMatch(_search.text)
                      ? TextDirection.rtl
                      : TextDirection.ltr,
                  style: AppTypography.body,
                  onChanged: (value) {
                    setState(() => _hub.setQuery(value));
                  },
                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                    hintText: 'ICE · Verspätung · BahnCard · مقعد',
                    hintStyle: AppTypography.body,
                    prefixIcon:
                        const Icon(Icons.search, color: AppColors.secondary),
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(

                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: _TrainUi.gap),
              AppDirectionalText(
                'عبارات السفر',
                languageCode: 'ar',
                style: AppTypography.title,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: _TrainUi.smallGap),
              if (entries.isEmpty)
                AppGlassCard(
                  key: const ValueKey<String>('intercity-train-empty'),
                  backgroundColor: surface,
                  child: AppDirectionalText(
                    'لا توجد نتائج. عدّل البحث أو أعد تفعيل القسم المطلوب.',
                    languageCode: 'ar',
                    style: AppTypography.body,
                  ),
                )
              else
                for (var i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) ...<Widget>[
                  _PhraseCard(entry: entries[i], surface: surface),
                  if (i != entries.length - 1)
                    const SizedBox(height: _TrainUi.smallGap),
                ],
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

  List<CourseFundingRequestModel> get courseRequests =>
      _courseRequests;
  List<ConsultationAppointmentModel> get appointments =>
      _appointments;

  List<JobcenterHubEntry> get visibleEntries =>
      List<JobcenterHubEntry>.unmodifiable(
        _entries.where(
          (entry) =>
              entry.section == _activeSection &&
              entry.matches(_query),
        ),
      );

        JobcenterSection.overview => null,
        JobcenterSection.consultationJobs =>
          dependencies.consultationRoute,

          dependencies.applicationsRoute,

    if (_activeSection == section) return;
    _activeSection = section;
    _query = '';
    notifyListeners();

    final next = value.trim();
    if (_query == next) return;

    notifyListeners();

enum ApplicationsTopic {
  hauptantrag,
  housingCosts,
  approvalNotice,
  objection,
  delayedPayment,
}

extension ApplicationsTopicLabels on ApplicationsTopic {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        ApplicationsTopic.hauptantrag => 'Hauptantrag',
        ApplicationsTopic.housingCosts => 'Unterkunft',
        ApplicationsTopic.approvalNotice => 'Bescheid',
        ApplicationsTopic.objection => 'Widerspruch',
        ApplicationsTopic.delayedPayment => 'Zahlung',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        ApplicationsTopic.hauptantrag => 'الطلب الرئيسي',
        ApplicationsTopic.housingCosts => 'تكاليف السكن',
        ApplicationsTopic.approvalNotice => 'إشعار الموافقة',
        ApplicationsTopic.objection => 'الاعتراض',
        ApplicationsTopic.delayedPayment => 'الدفعة',
      };
}

final class ApplicationsPhrase {
  const ApplicationsPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.topic,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.contextDe,
    required this.contextAr,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final ApplicationsTopic topic;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String contextDe;
  final String contextAr;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;

    final haystack = <String>[
      id,
      german,
      arabic,
      contextDe,
      contextAr,
      topic.labelDe,
      topic.labelAr,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase();

    return haystack.contains(needle);
  }
}


--------------------------------------------------
FILE: lib/features/life_jobcenter_employment/applications/applications_notices_orchestrator.dart

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'applications_models.dart';
import 'applications_phrase_bank.dart';

final class ApplicationsNoticesOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  ApplicationsNoticesOrchestrator({
    ApplicationsPhraseBank bank = const ApplicationsPhraseBank(),
  }) : _bank = bank;

  final ApplicationsPhraseBank _bank;

  ApplicationsTopic _activeTopic = ApplicationsTopic.hauptantrag;
  String _query = '';

  ApplicationsTopic get activeTopic => _activeTopic;
  String get query => _query;

  List<ApplicationsPhrase> get visiblePhrases =>
      List<ApplicationsPhrase>.unmodifiable(
        _bank.phrases.where(
          (phrase) =>
              phrase.topic == _activeTopic &&
              phrase.matches(_query),
        ),
      );

  void setTopic(ApplicationsTopic topic) {
    if (_activeTopic == topic) return;
    _activeTopic = topic;
    _query = '';
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    final next = value.trim();
    if (_query == next) return;
    _query = next;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearSearch() => setQuery('');
}

import '../../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import 'applications_models.dart';
import 'applications_notices_orchestrator.dart';

abstract final class _ApplicationsUiTokens {
  static const double pageInset = 16;
  static const double topInset = 18;
  static const double bottomInset = 32;
  static const double sectionGap = 14;
  static const double contentGap = 10;
  static const double smallGap = 7;
}

final class ApplicationsNoticesScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ApplicationsNoticesScreen({
    required this.orchestrator,
    super.key,
  });

  final ApplicationsNoticesOrchestrator orchestrator;

  @override
  State<ApplicationsNoticesScreen> createState() =>
      _ApplicationsNoticesScreenState();
}

final class _ApplicationsNoticesScreenState
    extends State<ApplicationsNoticesScreen> {
  final TextEditingController _searchController =
      TextEditingController();

  ApplicationsNoticesOrchestrator get orchestrator =>
      widget.orchestrator;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    orchestrator.addListener(_refresh);
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(
    covariant ApplicationsNoticesScreen oldWidget,
  ) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.orchestrator == orchestrator) return;
    oldWidget.orchestrator.removeListener(_refresh);
    orchestrator.addListener(_refresh);
    _searchController.text = orchestrator.query;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    orchestrator.removeListener(_refresh);
    _searchController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _refresh() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  void _selectTopic(ApplicationsTopic topic) {
    _searchController.clear();
    orchestrator.setTopic(topic);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark =
        Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface =
        isDark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface;
    final border = isDark
        ? AppColors.glassBorderDark
        : AppColors.glassBorderLight;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: isDark
            ? AppColors.darkBackground
            : AppColors.lightBackground,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              _ApplicationsUiTokens.pageInset,
              _ApplicationsUiTokens.topInset,
              _ApplicationsUiTokens.pageInset,
              _ApplicationsUiTokens.bottomInset,
            ),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: <Widget>[
                _HeaderCard(surface: surface, border: border),
                const SizedBox(
                  height: _ApplicationsUiTokens.sectionGap,
                ),
                _ProtectionCard(surface: surface),
                const SizedBox(
                  height: _ApplicationsUiTokens.sectionGap,
                ),
                _TopicSelector(
                  activeTopic: orchestrator.activeTopic,
                  surface: surface,
                  border: border,
                  onSelected: _selectTopic,
                ),
                const SizedBox(
                  height: _ApplicationsUiTokens.sectionGap,
                ),
                _SearchCard(
                  controller: _searchController,
                  query: orchestrator.query,
                  surface: surface,
                  border: border,
                  onChanged: orchestrator.setQuery,
                  onClear: () {
                    _searchController.clear();
                    orchestrator.clearSearch();
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(
                  height: _ApplicationsUiTokens.sectionGap,
                ),
                _PhraseList(
                  phrases: orchestrator.visiblePhrases,
                  surface: surface,
                  border: border,
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _TopicSelector extends StatelessWidget {

final class _SearchCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _SearchCard({
    required this.controller,
    required this.query,
    required this.surface,
    required this.border,
    required this.onChanged,
    required this.onClear,
  });

  final TextEditingController controller;
  final String query;
  final Color surface;
  final Color border;
  final ValueChanged<String> onChanged;
  final VoidCallback onClear;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        backgroundColor: surface,
        borderColor: border,
        child: Directionality(
          textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
          child: TextField(
            controller: controller,
            onChanged: onChanged,
            textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
            decoration: InputDecoration(
              labelText: 'Suche · بحث',
              hintText:
                  'Hauptantrag, Unterkunft, Bescheid, Zahlung ...',
              prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search_rounded),
              suffixIcon: query.isEmpty
                  ? null
                  : IconButton(
                      onPressed: onClear,
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded),
                    ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
}

final class _PhraseList extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PhraseList({
    required this.phrases,
    required this.surface,
    required this.border,
  });

  final List<ApplicationsPhrase> phrases;
  final Color surface;
  final Color border;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (phrases.isEmpty) {
      return AppGlassCard(
        backgroundColor: surface,
        borderColor: AppColors.tertiary,
        child: AppDirectionalText(
          'لا توجد نتيجة مطابقة في هذا القسم.',
          languageCode: 'ar',
          style: AppTypography.body,
        ),
      );
    }

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: <Widget>[
        for (var index = 0; index < phrases.length; index++) ...<Widget>[
          _PhraseCard(
            phrase: phrases[index],
            surface: surface,
            border: border,
          ),
          if (index != phrases.length - 1)
            const SizedBox(
              height: _ApplicationsUiTokens.contentGap,
            ),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }
}

            AppDirectionalText(

              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.label,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'consultation_models.dart';
import 'consultation_phrase_bank.dart';

final class ConsultationJobsOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  ConsultationJobsOrchestrator({
    ConsultationPhraseBank bank = const ConsultationPhraseBank(),
  }) : _bank = bank;

  final ConsultationPhraseBank _bank;

  ConsultationTopic _activeTopic =
      ConsultationTopic.adviserMeeting;
  String _query = '';

  ConsultationTopic get activeTopic => _activeTopic;
  String get query => _query;

  List<ConsultationPhrase> get visiblePhrases =>
      List<ConsultationPhrase>.unmodifiable(
        _bank.phrases.where(
          (phrase) =>
              phrase.topic == _activeTopic &&
              phrase.matches(_query),
        ),
      );

  void setTopic(ConsultationTopic topic) {
    if (_activeTopic == topic) return;
    _activeTopic = topic;
    _query = '';
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    final next = value.trim();
    if (_query == next) return;
    _query = next;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearSearch() => setQuery('');
}

enum ConsultationTopic {
  adviserMeeting,
  skillsProfile,
  courseFunding,
  applications,
  travelCosts,
}

extension ConsultationTopicLabels on ConsultationTopic {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        ConsultationTopic.adviserMeeting => 'Beratung',
        ConsultationTopic.skillsProfile => 'Fähigkeiten',
        ConsultationTopic.courseFunding => 'Kursförderung',
        ConsultationTopic.applications => 'Bewerbungen',
        ConsultationTopic.travelCosts => 'Fahrtkosten',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        ConsultationTopic.adviserMeeting => 'الاستشارة',
        ConsultationTopic.skillsProfile => 'المهارات',
        ConsultationTopic.courseFunding => 'تمويل الدورات',
        ConsultationTopic.applications => 'طلبات التوظيف',
        ConsultationTopic.travelCosts => 'تكاليف السفر',
      };
}

final class ConsultationPhrase {
  const ConsultationPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.topic,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.contextDe,
    required this.contextAr,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final ConsultationTopic topic;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String contextDe;
  final String contextAr;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;

    final haystack = <String>[
      id,
      german,
      arabic,
      contextDe,
      contextAr,
      topic.labelDe,
      topic.labelAr,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase();

    return haystack.contains(needle);
  }
}

import '../../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import 'consultation_jobs_orchestrator.dart';
import 'consultation_models.dart';

abstract final class _ConsultationUiTokens {
  static const double pageInset = 16;
  static const double topInset = 18;
  static const double bottomInset = 32;
  static const double sectionGap = 14;
  static const double contentGap = 10;
  static const double smallGap = 7;
}

final class ConsultationJobsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ConsultationJobsScreen({
    required this.orchestrator,
    super.key,
  });

  final ConsultationJobsOrchestrator orchestrator;

  @override
  State<ConsultationJobsScreen> createState() =>
      _ConsultationJobsScreenState();
}

final class _ConsultationJobsScreenState
    extends State<ConsultationJobsScreen> {
  final TextEditingController _searchController =
      TextEditingController();

  ConsultationJobsOrchestrator get orchestrator =>
      widget.orchestrator;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    orchestrator.addListener(_refresh);
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant ConsultationJobsScreen oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.orchestrator == orchestrator) return;
    oldWidget.orchestrator.removeListener(_refresh);
    orchestrator.addListener(_refresh);
    _searchController.text = orchestrator.query;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    orchestrator.removeListener(_refresh);
    _searchController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _refresh() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  void _selectTopic(ConsultationTopic topic) {
    _searchController.clear();
    orchestrator.setTopic(topic);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark =
        Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface =
        isDark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface;
    final border = isDark
        ? AppColors.glassBorderDark
        : AppColors.glassBorderLight;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: isDark
            ? AppColors.darkBackground
            : AppColors.lightBackground,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              _ConsultationUiTokens.pageInset,
              _ConsultationUiTokens.topInset,
              _ConsultationUiTokens.pageInset,
              _ConsultationUiTokens.bottomInset,
            ),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: <Widget>[
                _HeaderCard(surface: surface, border: border),
                const SizedBox(
                  height: _ConsultationUiTokens.sectionGap,
                ),
                _SafetyCard(surface: surface),
                const SizedBox(
                  height: _ConsultationUiTokens.sectionGap,
                ),
                _TopicSelector(
                  activeTopic: orchestrator.activeTopic,
                  surface: surface,
                  border: border,
                  onSelected: _selectTopic,
                ),
                const SizedBox(
                  height: _ConsultationUiTokens.sectionGap,
                ),
                _SearchCard(
                  controller: _searchController,
                  query: orchestrator.query,
                  surface: surface,
                  border: border,
                  onChanged: orchestrator.setQuery,
                  onClear: () {
                    _searchController.clear();
                    orchestrator.clearSearch();
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(
                  height: _ConsultationUiTokens.sectionGap,
                ),
                _PhraseList(
                  phrases: orchestrator.visiblePhrases,
                  surface: surface,
                  border: border,
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _PhraseList extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PhraseList({
    required this.phrases,
    required this.surface,
    required this.border,
  });

  final List<ConsultationPhrase> phrases;
  final Color surface;
  final Color border;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (phrases.isEmpty) {
      return AppGlassCard(
        backgroundColor: surface,
        borderColor: AppColors.tertiary,
        child: AppDirectionalText(
          'لا توجد نتيجة مطابقة في هذا القسم.',
          languageCode: 'ar',
          style: AppTypography.body,
        ),
      );
    }

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: <Widget>[
        for (var index = 0; index < phrases.length; index++) ...<Widget>[
          _PhraseCard(
            phrase: phrases[index],
            surface: surface,
            border: border,
          ),
          if (index != phrases.length - 1)
            const SizedBox(
              height: _ConsultationUiTokens.contentGap,
            ),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }
}

enum JobcenterSection {
  overview,
  consultationJobs,
  applicationsNotices,

enum JobcenterRequestStatus {
  preparation,
  submitted,
  appointmentPlanned,
}

extension JobcenterSectionLabels on JobcenterSection {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        JobcenterSection.overview => 'Übersicht',
        JobcenterSection.consultationJobs => 'Beratung & Jobsuche',
        JobcenterSection.applicationsNotices => 'Anträge & Bescheide',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        JobcenterSection.overview => 'نظرة عامة',
        JobcenterSection.consultationJobs => 'الاستشارة والبحث عن عمل',
        JobcenterSection.applicationsNotices => 'الطلبات والإشعارات',
      };
}

  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        JobcenterRequestStatus.preparation => 'Vorbereitung',
        JobcenterRequestStatus.submitted => 'Eingereicht',
        JobcenterRequestStatus.appointmentPlanned => 'Termin geplant',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        JobcenterRequestStatus.preparation => 'قيد التجهيز',
        JobcenterRequestStatus.submitted => 'تم التقديم',
        JobcenterRequestStatus.appointmentPlanned => 'موعد مخطط',
      };
}

final class JobcenterHubEntry {
  const JobcenterHubEntry({
    required this.id,
    required this.section,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.bodyDe,
    required this.bodyAr,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final JobcenterSection section;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String bodyDe;
  final String bodyAr;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;

    final haystack = <String>[
      id,
      titleDe,
      titleAr,
      bodyDe,
      bodyAr,
      section.labelDe,
      section.labelAr,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase();

    return haystack.contains(needle);
  }
}

final class LifeJobcenterEmploymentScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const LifeJobcenterEmploymentScreen({
    required this.orchestrator,
    this.onOpenRoute,
    super.key,
  });

  final JobcenterMasterOrchestrator orchestrator;
  final ValueChanged<JobcenterRouteSpec>? onOpenRoute;

  @override
  State<LifeJobcenterEmploymentScreen> createState() =>
      _LifeJobcenterEmploymentScreenState();
}

final class _LifeJobcenterEmploymentScreenState
    extends State<LifeJobcenterEmploymentScreen> {
  final TextEditingController _searchController =
      TextEditingController();

  JobcenterMasterOrchestrator get orchestrator =>
      widget.orchestrator;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    orchestrator.addListener(_refresh);
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(
    covariant LifeJobcenterEmploymentScreen oldWidget,
  ) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.orchestrator == orchestrator) return;
    oldWidget.orchestrator.removeListener(_refresh);
    orchestrator.addListener(_refresh);
    _searchController.text = orchestrator.query;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    orchestrator.removeListener(_refresh);
    _searchController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _refresh() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  void _selectSection(JobcenterSection section) {
    _searchController.clear();
    orchestrator.setSection(section);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark =
        Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface =
        isDark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface;
    final border = isDark
        ? AppColors.glassBorderDark
        : AppColors.glassBorderLight;
    final activeRoute = orchestrator.activeRoute;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: isDark
            ? AppColors.darkBackground
            : AppColors.lightBackground,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              _JobcenterUiTokens.pageInset,
              _JobcenterUiTokens.topInset,
              _JobcenterUiTokens.pageInset,
              _JobcenterUiTokens.bottomInset,
            ),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: <Widget>[
                _HeaderCard(surface: surface, border: border),
                const SizedBox(
                  height: _JobcenterUiTokens.sectionGap,
                ),
                _ProtectionNote(
                  surface: surface,
                  border: border,
                ),
                const SizedBox(
                  height: _JobcenterUiTokens.sectionGap,
                ),
                _SectionSelector(
                  activeSection: orchestrator.activeSection,
                  surface: surface,
                  border: border,
                  onSelected: _selectSection,
                ),
                const SizedBox(
                  height: _JobcenterUiTokens.sectionGap,
                ),
                _SearchCard(
                  controller: _searchController,
                  query: orchestrator.query,
                  surface: surface,
                  border: border,
                  onChanged: orchestrator.setQuery,
                  onClear: () {
                    _searchController.clear();
                    orchestrator.clearSearch();
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(
                  height: _JobcenterUiTokens.sectionGap,
                ),
                if (orchestrator.activeSection ==
                    JobcenterSection.overview) ...<Widget>[
                  _SharedModelsCard(
                    orchestrator: orchestrator,
                    surface: surface,
                    border: border,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(
                    height: _JobcenterUiTokens.sectionGap,
                  ),
                ],
                _EntriesSection(
                  entries: orchestrator.visibleEntries,
                  surface: surface,
                  border: border,
                ),
                if (activeRoute != null) ...<Widget>[
                  const SizedBox(
                    height: _JobcenterUiTokens.sectionGap,
                  ),

                    route: activeRoute,
                    surface: surface,

                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'dry_cleaning_sub_agent.dart';
import 'laundry_models.dart';
import 'self_service_laundromat_sub_agent.dart';

final class LaundryMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  LaundryMasterOrchestrator({
    SelfServiceLaundromatSubAgent selfService =
        const SelfServiceLaundromatSubAgent(),
    DryCleaningSubAgent dryCleaning = const DryCleaningSubAgent(),
  })  : _selfService = selfService,
        _dryCleaning = dryCleaning;

  final SelfServiceLaundromatSubAgent _selfService;
  final DryCleaningSubAgent _dryCleaning;

  LaundryDomain _domain = LaundryDomain.selfServiceLaundromat;
  String _query = '';

  LaundryDomain get domain => _domain;
  String get query => _query;

  List<LaundryPhrase> get visiblePhrases {
    final source = switch (_domain) {
      LaundryDomain.selfServiceLaundromat => _selfService.phrases,
      LaundryDomain.professionalCleaning => _dryCleaning.phrases,
    };

    return List<LaundryPhrase>.unmodifiable(
      source.where((phrase) => phrase.matches(_query)),
    );
  }

  List<FabricCareSymbol> get fabricCareSymbols => _fabricCareSymbols;

  void setDomain(LaundryDomain value) {
    if (_domain == value) return;
    _domain = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearSearch() => setQuery('');

  static const List<FabricCareSymbol> _fabricCareSymbols = <FabricCareSymbol>[
    FabricCareSymbol(
      id: 'wash-40',
      symbol: '40°',
      german: 'Waschbottich 40 °C: bei höchstens 40 °C waschen.',
      arabic: 'حوض غسيل 40°: الغسل بدرجة حرارة لا تتجاوز 40 مئوية.',
    ),
    FabricCareSymbol(
      id: 'no-bleach',
      symbol: '△×',
      german: 'Durchgestrichenes Dreieck: nicht bleichen.',
      arabic: 'مثلث مشطوب: لا تستخدم المبيّض.',
    ),
    FabricCareSymbol(
      id: 'tumble-low',
      symbol: '□○•',
      german: 'Trockner mit einem Punkt: schonend bei niedriger Temperatur.',
      arabic: 'رمز المجفف بنقطة واحدة: تجفيف لطيف بحرارة منخفضة.',
    ),
    FabricCareSymbol(
      id: 'iron-medium',
      symbol: 'Bügeleisen ••',
      german: 'Bügeleisen mit zwei Punkten: mit mittlerer Temperatur bügeln.',
      arabic: 'مكواة بنقطتين: الكيّ بدرجة حرارة متوسطة.',

    FabricCareSymbol(

enum LaundryDomain {
  selfServiceLaundromat,
  professionalCleaning,
}

extension LaundryDomainLabels on LaundryDomain {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        LaundryDomain.selfServiceLaundromat => 'Waschsalon · Selbstbedienung',
        LaundryDomain.professionalCleaning => 'Reinigung · Bügelservice',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        LaundryDomain.selfServiceLaundromat => 'مغسلة ذاتية الخدمة',
        LaundryDomain.professionalCleaning => 'تنظيف احترافي وكيّ',
      };
}

final class LaundryPhrase {
  const LaundryPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.domain,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.contextDe,
    required this.contextAr,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final LaundryDomain domain;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String contextDe;
  final String contextAr;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;

    final haystack = <String>[
      german,
      arabic,
      contextDe,
      contextAr,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase();

    return haystack.contains(needle);
  }
}

final class FabricCareSymbol {
  const FabricCareSymbol({
    required this.id,
    required this.symbol,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
  });

  final String id;
  final String symbol;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
}

import '../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import 'laundry_master_orchestrator.dart';
import 'laundry_models.dart';

abstract final class LaundryUiTokens {
  static const double pageInset = 16;
  static const double bottomInset = 32;
  static const double sectionGap = 18;
  static const double itemGap = 12;
  static const double compactGap = 8;
}

final class LaundryMasterHub extends StatefulWidget {
  const LaundryMasterHub({
    this.orchestrator,
    super.key,
  });

  final LaundryMasterOrchestrator? orchestrator;

  @override
  State<LaundryMasterHub> createState() => _LaundryMasterHubState();
}

final class _LaundryMasterHubState extends State<LaundryMasterHub> {
  late final LaundryMasterOrchestrator _orchestrator;
  late final bool _ownsOrchestrator;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ownsOrchestrator = widget.orchestrator == null;
    _orchestrator = widget.orchestrator ?? LaundryMasterOrchestrator();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    if (_ownsOrchestrator) {
      _orchestrator.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              LaundryUiTokens.pageInset,
              LaundryUiTokens.pageInset,
              LaundryUiTokens.pageInset,
              LaundryUiTokens.bottomInset,
            ),
            child: AnimatedBuilder(
              animation: _orchestrator,
              builder: (context, _) => Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  _HeaderCard(dark: dark),
                  const SizedBox(height: LaundryUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _SearchField(orchestrator: _orchestrator),
                  const SizedBox(height: LaundryUiTokens.itemGap),
                  _DomainSelector(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: LaundryUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _FabricCareGuide(
                    key: const ValueKey<String>(
                      'laundry-care-symbols-guide',
                    ),
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: LaundryUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _PhraseList(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _HeaderCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _HeaderCard({required this.dark});

  final bool dark;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        glowColor: AppColors.primary,
        borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(96),
        backgroundColor: dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            AppDirectionalText(
              'Waschsalon & Chemische Reinigung',
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: LaundryUiTokens.compactGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              'عبارات عملية للمغسلة الذاتية والتنظيف الاحترافي والكيّ، مع دليل سريع لرموز العناية بالأقمشة.',
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.body,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );

}

final class _SearchField extends StatelessWidget {
  const _SearchField({required this.orchestrator});

  final LaundryMasterOrchestrator orchestrator;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => TextField(
        key: const ValueKey<String>('laundry-search'),
        onChanged: orchestrator.setQuery,
        textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
        decoration: const InputDecoration(
          prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.search),
          labelText: 'Suche · بحث',
          hintText: 'Waschmarken, Feinwäsche, Trockner, Abholschein ...',
          border: OutlineInputBorder(),
        ),
      );
}

final class _DomainSelector extends StatelessWidget {
  const _DomainSelector({
    required this.orchestrator,
    required this.dark,
  });

  final LaundryMasterOrchestrator orchestrator;
  final bool dark;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        borderColor: AppColors.secondary.withAlpha(96),
        backgroundColor: dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
        child: Wrap(
          spacing: LaundryUiTokens.compactGap,
          runSpacing: LaundryUiTokens.compactGap,
          children: <Widget>[
            for (final domain in LaundryDomain.values)
              FilterChip(
                key: ValueKey<String>('laundry-domain-${domain.name}'),
                selected: orchestrator.domain == domain,
                onSelected: (_) => orchestrator.setDomain(domain),
                label: Text(
                  '${domain.labelDe} · ${domain.labelAr}',
                  style: AppTypography.label,
                ),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

final class _PhraseList extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PhraseList({
    required this.orchestrator,
    required this.dark,
  });

  final LaundryMasterOrchestrator orchestrator;
  final bool dark;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final phrases = orchestrator.visiblePhrases;

    if (phrases.isEmpty) {
      return AppGlassCard(
        borderColor: AppColors.tertiary.withAlpha(96),
        backgroundColor: dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
        child: AppDirectionalText(
          'لا توجد نتائج في هذا القسم. جرّب كلمة بحث أخرى.',
          languageCode: 'ar',
          style: AppTypography.body,
        ),
      );
    }

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: <Widget>[
        for (var index = 0; index < phrases.length; index++) ...<Widget>[
          _PhraseCard(
            phrase: phrases[index],
            dark: dark,
          ),
          if (index != phrases.length - 1)
            const SizedBox(height: LaundryUiTokens.itemGap),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }
}

final class _PhraseCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PhraseCard({
    required this.phrase,
    required this.dark,
  });

  final LaundryPhrase phrase;
  final bool dark;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(80),
        backgroundColor: dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            AppDirectionalText(
              phrase.contextDe,
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.label,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: LaundryUiTokens.compactGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              phrase.german,
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: LaundryUiTokens.compactGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              phrase.arabic,
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.body,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: LaundryUiTokens.compactGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              phrase.contextAr,
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.label,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'lost_found_models.dart';
import 'municipal_lost_property_sub_agent.dart';
import 'transit_recovery_sub_agent.dart';

final class LostFoundMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  LostFoundMasterOrchestrator({
    MunicipalLostPropertySubAgent municipal =
        const MunicipalLostPropertySubAgent(),
    TransitRecoverySubAgent transit = const TransitRecoverySubAgent(),
  })  : _municipal = municipal,
        _transit = transit;

  final MunicipalLostPropertySubAgent _municipal;
  final TransitRecoverySubAgent _transit;

  LostFoundDomain _domain = LostFoundDomain.municipal;
  String _query = '';
  final Set<String> _completedActionIds = <String>{};

  LostFoundDomain get domain => _domain;
  String get query => _query;

  List<ImmediateLostAction> get immediateActions => _immediateActions;

  int get completedActionCount => _completedActionIds.length;

  bool get isImmediateChecklistComplete =>
      _completedActionIds.length == _immediateActions.length;

  List<LostFoundItem> get visibleItems {
    final source = switch (_domain) {
      LostFoundDomain.municipal => _municipal.items,
      LostFoundDomain.publicTransit => _transit.items,
    };

    return List<LostFoundItem>.unmodifiable(
      source.where((item) => item.matches(_query)),
    );
  }

  void switchDomain(LostFoundDomain value) {
    if (_domain == value) return;
    _domain = value;
    _query = '';
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearSearch() => setQuery('');

  bool isActionComplete(String actionId) =>
      _completedActionIds.contains(actionId.trim());

  void setActionComplete(String actionId, bool complete) {
    final normalizedId = actionId.trim();
    if (!_immediateActions.any((action) => action.id == normalizedId)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        actionId,
        'actionId',
        'Unknown immediate lost-item action.',
      );
    }

    final changed = complete
        ? _completedActionIds.add(normalizedId)
        : _completedActionIds.remove(normalizedId);

    if (changed) notifyListeners();
  }

  static const List<ImmediateLostAction> _immediateActions =
      <ImmediateLostAction>[
    ImmediateLostAction(
      id: 'record_where_when',
      titleDe: 'Verlustort und Zeit notieren',
      titleAr: 'دوّن مكان ووقت الفقد',
      detailAr:
          'اكتب الخط أو المحطة أو الشارع والوقت التقريبي فورًا قبل نسيان التفاصيل.',
    ),
    ImmediateLostAction(
      id: 'secure_sensitive_items',
      titleDe: 'Sensible Gegenstände sichern',
      titleAr: 'أمّن الأغراض الحساسة',
      detailAr:
          'إذا كان المفقود بطاقة أو هاتفًا أو مفتاحًا حساسًا، اتخذ إجراءات الحماية المناسبة فورًا.',
    ),
    ImmediateLostAction(
      id: 'collect_identifiers',
      titleDe: 'Merkmale sammeln',
      titleAr: 'اجمع العلامات المميزة',
      detailAr:
          'جهّز اللون والعلامة والرقم التسلسلي وصورة أو فاتورة إن كانت متوفرة.',
    ),
    ImmediateLostAction(
      id: 'submit_loss_report',
      titleDe: 'Verlustmeldung aufgeben',
      titleAr: 'قدّم بلاغ فقدان',
      detailAr:
          'استخدم الجهة المختصة: Fundbüro البلدي أو شركة النقل أو DB Fundservice بحسب مكان الفقد.',
    ),
    ImmediateLostAction(
      id: 'save_reference_and_proof',
      titleDe: 'Vorgangsnummer & Eigentumsnachweis sichern',
      titleAr: 'احفظ رقم المعاملة وإثبات الملكية',
      detailAr:
          'احتفظ برقم البلاغ وبأي إثبات يساعدك عند المطابقة أو الاستلام.',
    ),
  ];
}

enum LostFoundDomain { municipal, publicTransit }

enum LostFoundTopic {
  onlineCatalog,
  lossReport,
  ownershipAndFees,
  dbFundservice,
  stationRecovery,
  localTransit,
  finderReward,
}

extension LostFoundDomainLabels on LostFoundDomain {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        LostFoundDomain.municipal => 'Kommunales Fundbüro',
        LostFoundDomain.publicTransit => 'ÖPNV & Bahn',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        LostFoundDomain.municipal => 'مكتب المفقودات البلدي',
        LostFoundDomain.publicTransit => 'المواصلات العامة والقطارات',
      };
}

final class LostFoundItem {
  const LostFoundItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.domain,
    required this.topic,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.contextDe,
    required this.contextAr,
    this.tags = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final LostFoundDomain domain;
  final LostFoundTopic topic;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String contextDe;
  final String contextAr;
  final List<String> tags;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;

    final haystack = <String>[
      titleDe,
      titleAr,
      german,
      arabic,
      contextDe,
      contextAr,
      ...tags,
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase();

    return haystack.contains(needle);
  }
}

final class ImmediateLostAction {
  const ImmediateLostAction({
    required this.id,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.detailAr,
  });

  final String id;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String detailAr;
}

import '../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import 'lost_found_master_orchestrator.dart';
import 'lost_found_models.dart';

abstract final class LostFoundUiTokens {
  static const double pageInset = 16;
  static const double topInset = 18;
  static const double bottomInset = 32;
  static const double sectionGap = 18;
  static const double itemGap = 12;
  static const double compactGap = 8;
  static const double chipHorizontal = 12;
  static const double chipVertical = 9;
  static const double icon = 28;
  static const double statusIcon = 22;
}

final class LostFoundMasterHub extends StatefulWidget {
  const LostFoundMasterHub({
    this.orchestrator,
    super.key,
  });

  final LostFoundMasterOrchestrator? orchestrator;

  @override
  State<LostFoundMasterHub> createState() => _LostFoundMasterHubState();
}

final class _LostFoundMasterHubState extends State<LostFoundMasterHub> {
  late final LostFoundMasterOrchestrator _orchestrator;
  late final bool _ownsOrchestrator;
  final TextEditingController _searchController = TextEditingController();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ownsOrchestrator = widget.orchestrator == null;
    _orchestrator = widget.orchestrator ?? LostFoundMasterOrchestrator();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchController.dispose();
    if (_ownsOrchestrator) {
      _orchestrator.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _switchDomain(LostFoundDomain domain) {
    _searchController.clear();
    _orchestrator.switchDomain(domain);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final background =
        dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground;
    final surface = dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface;
    final border =
        dark ? AppColors.glassBorderDark : AppColors.glassBorderLight;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: background,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: AnimatedBuilder(
            animation: _orchestrator,
            builder: (context, _) => SingleChildScrollView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                LostFoundUiTokens.pageInset,
                LostFoundUiTokens.topInset,
                LostFoundUiTokens.pageInset,
                LostFoundUiTokens.bottomInset,
              ),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  _HeaderCard(surface: surface, border: border),
                  const SizedBox(height: LostFoundUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _DomainSelector(
                    domain: _orchestrator.domain,
                    surface: surface,
                    border: border,
                    onSelected: _switchDomain,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: LostFoundUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _ImmediateActionBar(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    surface: surface,
                    border: border,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: LostFoundUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _SearchCard(
                    controller: _searchController,
                    query: _orchestrator.query,
                    surface: surface,
                    border: border,
                    onChanged: _orchestrator.setQuery,
                    onClear: () {
                      _searchController.clear();
                      _orchestrator.clearSearch();
                    },
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: LostFoundUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _ResultsSection(
                    items: _orchestrator.visibleItems,
                    surface: surface,
                    border: border,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: LostFoundUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _ScopeNote(surface: surface, border: border),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _HeaderCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _HeaderCard({required this.surface, required this.border});

  final Color surface;
  final Color border;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        backgroundColor: surface,
        borderColor: border,
        glowColor: AppColors.primary,
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            Row(
              children: <Widget>[
                const Icon(
                  Icons.find_in_page_rounded,
                  color: AppColors.primary,
                  size: LostFoundUiTokens.icon,
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: LostFoundUiTokens.itemGap),
                Expanded(
                  child: AppDirectionalText(
                    'Fundbüro & DB Fundservice',
                    languageCode: 'de',

final class _ImmediateActionBar extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ImmediateActionBar({
    required this.orchestrator,
    required this.surface,
    required this.border,
  });

  final LostFoundMasterOrchestrator orchestrator;
  final Color surface;
  final Color border;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final complete = orchestrator.isImmediateChecklistComplete;
    final accent = complete ? AppColors.mastery : AppColors.tertiary;

    return AppGlassCard(
      backgroundColor: surface,
      borderColor: accent,
      glowColor: accent,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          Row(
            children: <Widget>[
              Icon(
                complete
                    ? Icons.task_alt_rounded
                    : Icons.notification_important_rounded,
                color: accent,
                size: LostFoundUiTokens.icon,
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: LostFoundUiTokens.itemGap),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    AppDirectionalText(
                      'Sofort-Check: Verlustmeldung aufgeben',
                      languageCode: 'de',
                      style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(color: accent),
                    ),
                    AppDirectionalText(
                      complete
                          ? 'تم تجهيز خطوات البلاغ الأساسية.'
                          : 'نفّذ هذه الخطوات سريعًا بعد اكتشاف الفقد.',
                      languageCode: 'ar',
                      style: AppTypography.body,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: LostFoundUiTokens.itemGap),
          AppDirectionalText(
            '${orchestrator.completedActionCount}/${orchestrator.immediateActions.length} erledigt',
            languageCode: 'de',
            style: AppTypography.label,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: LostFoundUiTokens.itemGap),
          for (var index = 0;
              index < orchestrator.immediateActions.length;
              index++) ...<Widget>[
            _ActionRow(
              action: orchestrator.immediateActions[index],
              complete: orchestrator.isActionComplete(
                orchestrator.immediateActions[index].id,
              ),
              surface: surface,
              border: border,
              onTap: () {
                final action = orchestrator.immediateActions[index];
                orchestrator.setActionComplete(
                  action.id,
                  !orchestrator.isActionComplete(action.id),
                );
              },
            ),
            if (index != orchestrator.immediateActions.length - 1)
              const SizedBox(height: LostFoundUiTokens.compactGap),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _SearchCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _SearchCard({
    required this.controller,
    required this.query,
    required this.surface,
    required this.border,
    required this.onChanged,
    required this.onClear,
  });

  final TextEditingController controller;
  final String query;
  final Color surface;
  final Color border;
  final ValueChanged<String> onChanged;
  final VoidCallback onClear;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final direction =
        _containsArabic(query) ? TextDirection.rtl : TextDirection.ltr;

    return AppGlassCard(
      backgroundColor: surface,
      borderColor: border,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          AppDirectionalText(
            'Suche / بحث',
            languageCode: 'de',
            style: AppTypography.label,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: LostFoundUiTokens.compactGap),
          Directionality(
            textDirection: direction,
            child: TextField(
              controller: controller,
              onChanged: onChanged,
              textInputAction: TextInputAction.search,
              style: AppTypography.body,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                hintText: 'Seriennummer / Fundstelle / القطار',
                suffixIcon: query.isEmpty
                    ? const Icon(Icons.search_rounded)
                    : IconButton(
                        onPressed: onClear,
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded),
                      ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  static bool _containsArabic(String value) =>
      value.runes.any((rune) => rune >= 0x0600 && rune <= 0x06FF);
}

import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'lost_found_models.dart';

final class TransitRecoverySubAgent {
  const TransitRecoverySubAgent();

  List<LostFoundItem> get items => _items;

  double finderRewardEuro({
    required double itemValueEuro,
    bool foundInPublicTransport = false,
  }) {
    if (!itemValueEuro.isFinite || itemValueEuro <= 0) return 0;

    final firstBand = math.min(itemValueEuro, 500.0) * 0.05;
    final excess = math.max(itemValueEuro - 500.0, 0.0) * 0.03;
    final ordinaryReward = firstBand + excess;

    if (!foundInPublicTransport) return ordinaryReward;
    if (itemValueEuro < 50) return 0;
    return ordinaryReward / 2;
  }

  static const List<LostFoundItem> _items = <LostFoundItem>[
    LostFoundItem(
      id: 'transit_db_fundservice',
      domain: LostFoundDomain.publicTransit,
      topic: LostFoundTopic.dbFundservice,

          'Ich habe meinen Rucksack im Zug verloren. Wo kann ich beim DB Fundservice eine Verlustmeldung online erfassen?',
      arabic:
          'فقدت حقيبة ظهري في القطار. أين أستطيع تسجيل بلاغ فقدان إلكتروني لدى خدمة مفقودات دويتشه بان؟',

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../data/local_mobility_repository.dart';
import '../domain/mobility_models.dart';

class LongDistanceTrainSubAgent {
  const LongDistanceTrainSubAgent(this.repository);

  final LocalMobilityRepository repository;

  List<MobilityLesson> platformChanges({MobilityLevel? level}) =>
      _topic(MobilityTopic.platformChange, level);

  List<MobilityLesson> delays({MobilityLevel? level}) =>
      _topic(MobilityTopic.delay, level);

  List<MobilityLesson> seatReservations({MobilityLevel? level}) =>
      _topic(MobilityTopic.seatReservation, level);

  List<MobilityLesson> _topic(
    MobilityTopic topic,
    MobilityLevel? level,
  ) =>
      repository
          .byTopic(topic)
          .where(
            (item) =>
                item.mode == MobilityMode.longDistance &&
                (level == null || item.level == level),
          )
          .toList(growable: false);
}

class LocalTransitSubAgent {
  const LocalTransitSubAgent(this.repository);

  final LocalMobilityRepository repository;

  List<MobilityLesson> localTickets({MobilityLevel? level}) =>
      _topic(MobilityTopic.localTicket, level);

  List<MobilityLesson> deutschlandticket({MobilityLevel? level}) =>
      _topic(MobilityTopic.deutschlandticket, level);

  List<MobilityLesson> busConnections({MobilityLevel? level}) =>
      _topic(MobilityTopic.busConnection, level);

  List<MobilityLesson> _topic(
    MobilityTopic topic,
    MobilityLevel? level,
  ) =>
      repository
          .byTopic(topic)
          .where(
            (item) =>
                item.mode == MobilityMode.localTransit &&
                (level == null || item.level == level),
          )
          .toList(growable: false);
}

class MobilityMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  MobilityMasterOrchestrator(this.repository)
      : longDistance = LongDistanceTrainSubAgent(repository),
        localTransit = LocalTransitSubAgent(repository);

  final LocalMobilityRepository repository;
  final LongDistanceTrainSubAgent longDistance;
  final LocalTransitSubAgent localTransit;

  MobilityLevel? _selectedLevel;
  String _query = '';
  bool _isPanicBarOpen = false;

  MobilityLevel? get selectedLevel => _selectedLevel;
  String get query => _query;
  bool get isPanicBarOpen => _isPanicBarOpen;

  List<MobilityLesson> get visibleItems =>
      repository.search(_query, level: _selectedLevel);

  List<PlatformPanicStep> get platformPanicSteps => const <PlatformPanicStep>[
        PlatformPanicStep(
          titleDe: '1. Anzeigetafel prüfen',
          instructionAr:
              'طابق رقم القطار والوجهة أولًا، ثم اقرأ رقم الرصيف الجديد.',
        ),
        PlatformPanicStep(
          titleDe: '2. Gleiswechsel bestätigen',
          instructionAr:
              'تحقق من إعلان المحطة أو التطبيق الرسمي قبل مغادرة الرصيف الحالي.',
        ),
        PlatformPanicStep(
          titleDe: '3. Zum neuen Gleis gehen',
          instructionAr:
              'اتبع لوحات Gleis واستخدم المصعد أو الدرج المناسب دون استعجال خطر.',
        ),
        PlatformPanicStep(
          titleDe: '4. Bei Unklarheit nachfragen',
          instructionAr:
              'قل: Entschuldigung, von welchem Gleis fährt mein Zug ab?',
        ),
      ];

  void setLevel(MobilityLevel? level) {
    if (_selectedLevel == level) return;
    _selectedLevel = level;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void search(String value) {
    final normalized = value.trim();
    if (_query == normalized) return;
    _query = normalized;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearSearch() => search('');

  void togglePanicBar() {
    _isPanicBarOpen = !_isPanicBarOpen;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

  List<MobilityLesson> all() => List<MobilityLesson>.unmodifiable(_items);

  List<MobilityLesson> byLevel(MobilityLevel level) =>
      _items.where((item) => item.level == level).toList(growable: false);

  List<MobilityLesson> byTopic(MobilityTopic topic) =>
      _items.where((item) => item.topic == topic).toList(growable: false);

  List<MobilityLesson> byMode(MobilityMode mode) =>
      _items.where((item) => item.mode == mode).toList(growable: false);

  List<MobilityLesson> search(
    String query, {
    MobilityLevel? level,
  }) {
    final normalized = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    final scoped = level == null ? _items : byLevel(level);
    if (normalized.isEmpty) {
      return List<MobilityLesson>.unmodifiable(scoped);
    }

    return scoped
        .where(
          (item) => item.searchableText.toLowerCase().contains(normalized),
        )
        .toList(growable: false);
  }
}
