enum MobilityLevel { a1a2, b1, b2 }

extension MobilityLevelLabels on MobilityLevel {
  String get label => switch (this) {
        MobilityLevel.a1a2 => 'A1/A2',
        MobilityLevel.b1 => 'B1',
        MobilityLevel.b2 => 'B2',
      };
}

enum MobilityMode { longDistance, localTransit }

extension MobilityModeLabels on MobilityMode {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        MobilityMode.longDistance => 'Deutsche Bahn & Fernverkehr',
        MobilityMode.localTransit => 'ÖPNV: Bus & U-Bahn',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        MobilityMode.longDistance => 'القطارات والسفر بين المدن',
        MobilityMode.localTransit => 'النقل المحلي: الحافلة والمترو',
      };
}

enum MobilityTopic {
  platformChange,
  delay,
  seatReservation,
  localTicket,
  deutschlandticket,
  busConnection,
}

extension MobilityTopicLabels on MobilityTopic {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        MobilityTopic.platformChange => 'Gleiswechsel',
        MobilityTopic.delay => 'Verspätung',
        MobilityTopic.seatReservation => 'Sitzplatzreservierung',
        MobilityTopic.localTicket => 'Fahrkarten vor Ort',
        MobilityTopic.deutschlandticket => 'Deutschlandticket',
        MobilityTopic.busConnection => 'Bus- & U-Bahn-Verbindung',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        MobilityTopic.platformChange => 'تغيير الرصيف',
        MobilityTopic.delay => 'التأخير',
        MobilityTopic.seatReservation => 'حجز المقعد',
        MobilityTopic.localTicket => 'التذاكر المحلية',
        MobilityTopic.deutschlandticket => 'تذكرة ألمانيا',
        MobilityTopic.busConnection => 'وصلات الحافلة والمترو',
      };
}

class MobilityLesson {
  const MobilityLesson({
    required this.id,
    required this.level,
    required this.mode,
    required this.topic,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.phraseDe,
    required this.meaningAr,
    required this.actionAr,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final MobilityLevel level;
  final MobilityMode mode;
  final MobilityTopic topic;
  final String titleDe;
  final String phraseDe;
  final String meaningAr;
  final String actionAr;
  final List<String> keywords;

  String get searchableText => <String>[
        titleDe,
        phraseDe,
        meaningAr,
        actionAr,
        topic.labelDe,
        topic.labelAr,
        mode.labelDe,
        mode.labelAr,
        ...keywords,
      ].join(' ');
}

class PlatformPanicStep {
  const PlatformPanicStep({
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.instructionAr,
  });

  final String titleDe;
  final String instructionAr;
}

      List<OpticianPhrase>.unmodifiable(_items);

  List<OpticianPhrase> itemsFor(OpticianCategory category) =>
      List<OpticianPhrase>.unmodifiable(
        _items.where((item) => item.category == category),
      );

  List<OpticianPhrase> search(
    String query, {
    OpticianCategory? category,
  }) =>
      List<OpticianPhrase>.unmodifiable(
        _items.where(
          (item) =>
              (category == null || item.category == category) &&
              item.matches(query),
        ),
      );

FILE: lib/features/life_optician_glasses/optician_models.dart
--------------------------------------------------
enum OpticianCategory {
  visionExam,
  lensMeasurements,
  glassesOrder;

  String get german => switch (this) {
        OpticianCategory.visionExam => 'Sehtest',
        OpticianCategory.lensMeasurements => 'Glaswerte & Messung',
        OpticianCategory.glassesOrder => 'Brille bestellen',
      };

  String get arabic => switch (this) {
        OpticianCategory.visionExam => 'فحص النظر',
        OpticianCategory.lensMeasurements => 'قياسات العدسات',
        OpticianCategory.glassesOrder => 'تفصيل النظارة',
      };
}

final class OpticianPhrase {
  const OpticianPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.category,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.tags,
  });

  final String id;
  final OpticianCategory category;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final List<String> tags;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;
    return german.toLowerCase().contains(needle) ||
        arabic.toLowerCase().contains(needle) ||
        tags.any((tag) => tag.toLowerCase().contains(needle));
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/outdoors_models.dart';

final class OutdoorsMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  OutdoorsMasterOrchestrator({
    this.familyStayAgent = const FamilyStaySubAgent(),
    this.natureTrailsAgent = const NatureTrailsSubAgent(),
  });

  final FamilyStaySubAgent familyStayAgent;
  final NatureTrailsSubAgent natureTrailsAgent;

  OutdoorsCategory _category = OutdoorsCategory.accommodation;
  String _searchQuery = '';

  OutdoorsCategory get category => _category;
  String get searchQuery => _searchQuery;
  List<TrailRule> get trailRules => natureTrailsAgent.trailRules;

  List<OutdoorsPhrase> get visiblePhrases {
    final source = switch (_category) {
      OutdoorsCategory.accommodation => familyStayAgent.phrases,
      OutdoorsCategory.natureHiking => natureTrailsAgent.phrases,
    };

    final query = _searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (query.isEmpty) {
      return List<OutdoorsPhrase>.unmodifiable(source);
    }

    return List<OutdoorsPhrase>.unmodifiable(
      source.where((item) => _matches(item, query)),
    );
  }

  void switchCategory(OutdoorsCategory category) {
    if (_category == category) return;
    _category = category;
    _searchQuery = '';
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setSearchQuery(String value) {
    if (_searchQuery == value) return;
    _searchQuery = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  bool _matches(OutdoorsPhrase item, String query) {
    final searchable = <String>[
      item.titleDe,
      item.textDe,
      item.explanationAr,
      item.topic.germanLabel,
      item.topic.arabicLabel,
      ...item.tags,
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase();

    return searchable.contains(query);
  }
}

enum OutdoorsCategory {
  accommodation,
  natureHiking,
}

enum OutdoorsTopic {
  hostelBooking,
  familyRoom,
  breakfast,
  houseRules,
  checkInOut,
  trailMarkers,
  trailEtiquette,
  barbecueArea,
  natureReserve,
}

extension OutdoorsCategoryLabels on OutdoorsCategory {
  String get germanLabel => switch (this) {
        OutdoorsCategory.accommodation => 'Unterkunft',
        OutdoorsCategory.natureHiking => 'Natur & Wandern',
      };

  String get arabicLabel => switch (this) {
        OutdoorsCategory.accommodation => 'الإقامة',
        OutdoorsCategory.natureHiking => 'الطبيعة والمشي',
      };
}

extension OutdoorsTopicLabels on OutdoorsTopic {
  String get germanLabel => switch (this) {
        OutdoorsTopic.hostelBooking => 'Jugendherberge buchen',
        OutdoorsTopic.familyRoom => 'Familienzimmer',
        OutdoorsTopic.breakfast => 'Frühstück',
        OutdoorsTopic.houseRules => 'Hausordnung',
        OutdoorsTopic.checkInOut => 'Check-in & Check-out',
        OutdoorsTopic.trailMarkers => 'Wegmarkierungen',
        OutdoorsTopic.trailEtiquette => 'Wanderregeln',
        OutdoorsTopic.barbecueArea => 'Grillplätze',
        OutdoorsTopic.natureReserve => 'Naturschutzgebiet',
      };

  String get arabicLabel => switch (this) {
        OutdoorsTopic.hostelBooking => 'حجز بيت شباب',
        OutdoorsTopic.familyRoom => 'غرفة عائلية',
        OutdoorsTopic.breakfast => 'الإفطار',
        OutdoorsTopic.houseRules => 'قواعد المكان',
        OutdoorsTopic.checkInOut => 'الدخول والمغادرة',
        OutdoorsTopic.trailMarkers => 'علامات المسار',
        OutdoorsTopic.trailEtiquette => 'آداب المشي',
        OutdoorsTopic.barbecueArea => 'أماكن الشواء',
        OutdoorsTopic.natureReserve => 'المحمية الطبيعية',
      };
}

final class OutdoorsPhrase {
  const OutdoorsPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.category,
    required this.topic,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.textDe,
    required this.explanationAr,
    this.tags = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final OutdoorsCategory category;
  final OutdoorsTopic topic;
  final String titleDe;
  final String textDe;
  final String explanationAr;
  final List<String> tags;
}

final class TrailRule {
  const TrailRule({
    required this.id,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
  });

  final String id;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
}

import '../../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import '../application/outdoors_master_orchestrator.dart';
import '../domain/outdoors_models.dart';
import 'outdoors_design_tokens.dart';

final class OutdoorsMasterScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const OutdoorsMasterScreen({
    this.orchestrator,
    super.key,
  });

  final OutdoorsMasterOrchestrator? orchestrator;

  @override
  State<OutdoorsMasterScreen> createState() => _OutdoorsMasterScreenState();
}

final class _OutdoorsMasterScreenState extends State<OutdoorsMasterScreen> {
  late final OutdoorsMasterOrchestrator _orchestrator;
  late final bool _ownsOrchestrator;
  late final TextEditingController _searchController;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ownsOrchestrator = widget.orchestrator == null;
    _orchestrator = widget.orchestrator ?? OutdoorsMasterOrchestrator();
    _searchController = TextEditingController(text: _orchestrator.searchQuery);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchController.dispose();
    if (_ownsOrchestrator) {
      _orchestrator.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return Directionality(
      key: const ValueKey<String>('outdoors-arabic-direction'),
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: ListenableBuilder(
            listenable: _orchestrator,
            builder: (context, _) {
              return SingleChildScrollView(
                padding: OutdoorsDesignTokens.screenPadding,
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    const _HeaderCard(),
                    const SizedBox(height: OutdoorsDesignTokens.spaceM),
                    _CategoryFilter(
                      orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                      onCategorySelected: _selectCategory,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: OutdoorsDesignTokens.spaceM),
                    _SearchCard(
                      controller: _searchController,
                      onChanged: _orchestrator.setSearchQuery,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: OutdoorsDesignTokens.spaceM),
                    _TrailEtiquetteBar(rules: _orchestrator.trailRules),
                    const SizedBox(height: OutdoorsDesignTokens.spaceL),
                    _PhraseSection(orchestrator: _orchestrator),
                  ],
                ),
              );
            },
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _selectCategory(OutdoorsCategory category) {
    if (_orchestrator.category == category) return;
    _orchestrator.switchCategory(category);
    _searchController.clear();
  }
}

final class _CategoryCard extends StatelessWidget {

    required this.onTap,
  });

  final bool selected;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  Widget build(BuildContext context) {

      padding: OutdoorsDesignTokens.compactCardPadding,

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'pet_regulations_sub_agent.dart';
import 'pets_models.dart';
import 'vet_clinic_sub_agent.dart';

final class PetsMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  PetsMasterOrchestrator({
    VetClinicSubAgent veterinary = const VetClinicSubAgent(),
    PetRegulationsSubAgent regulations = const PetRegulationsSubAgent(),
  })  : _veterinary = veterinary,
        _regulations = regulations;

  final VetClinicSubAgent _veterinary;
  final PetRegulationsSubAgent _regulations;

  PetsCategory _category = PetsCategory.veterinary;
  String _query = '';

  PetsCategory get category => _category;
  String get query => _query;

  List<String> get emergencyScripts => const <String>[
        'Mein Tier braucht dringend tierärztliche Hilfe.',
        'Wo ist der nächste tierärztliche Notdienst?',
        'Mein Tier hat Atemnot, starke Blutungen oder einen Krampfanfall.',
      ];

  List<PetPhrase> get visiblePhrases {
    final source = switch (_category) {
      PetsCategory.veterinary => _veterinary.phrases,
      PetsCategory.regulationsAdoption => _regulations.phrases,
    };
    return List<PetPhrase>.unmodifiable(
      source.where((phrase) => phrase.matches(_query)),
    );
  }

  void setCategory(PetsCategory value) {
    if (_category == value) return;
    _category = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearSearch() => setQuery('');
}

FILE: lib/features/life_pets/pets_models.dart

enum PetsCategory { veterinary, regulationsAdoption }

extension PetsCategoryLabels on PetsCategory {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        PetsCategory.veterinary => 'Tierarzt',
        PetsCategory.regulationsAdoption => 'Regeln & Tierheim',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        PetsCategory.veterinary => 'الرعاية البيطرية',
        PetsCategory.regulationsAdoption => 'القوانين والتبنّي',
      };
}

final class PetPhrase {
  const PetPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.category,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.contextDe,
    required this.contextAr,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final PetsCategory category;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String contextDe;
  final String contextAr;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;

    final haystack = <String>[
      german,
      arabic,
      contextDe,
      contextAr,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase();

    return haystack.contains(needle);
  }
}

abstract final class PetsUiTokens {
  static const double pageInset = 16;
  static const double bottomInset = 32;
  static const double sectionGap = 18;
  static const double itemGap = 12;
  static const double compactGap = 8;
}

final class PetsMasterHub extends StatefulWidget {
  const PetsMasterHub({
    this.orchestrator,
    super.key,
  });

  final PetsMasterOrchestrator? orchestrator;

  @override
  State<PetsMasterHub> createState() => _PetsMasterHubState();
}

final class _PetsMasterHubState extends State<PetsMasterHub> {
  late final PetsMasterOrchestrator _orchestrator;
  late final bool _ownsOrchestrator;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ownsOrchestrator = widget.orchestrator == null;
    _orchestrator = widget.orchestrator ?? PetsMasterOrchestrator();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    if (_ownsOrchestrator) {
      _orchestrator.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              PetsUiTokens.pageInset,
              PetsUiTokens.pageInset,
              PetsUiTokens.pageInset,
              PetsUiTokens.bottomInset,
            ),
            child: AnimatedBuilder(
              animation: _orchestrator,
              builder: (context, _) => Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  _HeaderCard(dark: dark),
                  const SizedBox(height: PetsUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _EmergencyBar(orchestrator: _orchestrator, dark: dark),
                  const SizedBox(height: PetsUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _SearchField(orchestrator: _orchestrator),
                  const SizedBox(height: PetsUiTokens.itemGap),
                  _CategorySelector(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: PetsUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _PhraseList(orchestrator: _orchestrator, dark: dark),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/life_pharmacy_medication/consultation/otc_consultation_controller.dart

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'otc_consultation_sub_agent.dart';
import 'otc_models.dart';

final class OtcConsultationController extends ChangeNotifier {
  OtcConsultationController({
    OtcConsultationSubAgent agent = const OtcConsultationSubAgent(),
  }) : _agent = agent;

  final OtcConsultationSubAgent _agent;

  OtcTopic _topic = OtcTopic.mildPain;
  String _query = '';

  OtcTopic get topic => _topic;
  String get query => _query;

  List<OtcPhrase> get visiblePhrases => List<OtcPhrase>.unmodifiable(
        _agent.phrases.where(
          (phrase) =>
              phrase.topic == _topic &&
              phrase.matches(_query),
        ),
      );

  void setTopic(OtcTopic value) {
    if (_topic == value && _query.isEmpty) return;
    _topic = value;
    _query = '';
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    final next = value.trim();
    if (_query == next) return;
    _query = next;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearSearch() => setQuery('');
}

final class _PhraseList extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PhraseList({
    required this.controller,
    required this.dark,
  });

  final OtcConsultationController controller;
  final bool dark;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final phrases = controller.visiblePhrases;
    if (phrases.isEmpty) {
      return AppGlassCard(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
        child: AppDirectionalText(
          'لا توجد نتيجة في هذا الموضوع. جرّب بحثاً آخر.',
          languageCode: 'ar',
          style: AppTypography.body,
        ),
      );
    }

    return Column(
      children: <Widget>[
        for (var index = 0;
            index < phrases.length;
            index++) ...<Widget>[
          AppGlassCard(
            borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(80),
            backgroundColor:
                dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: <Widget>[
                AppDirectionalText(
                  phrases[index].contextDe,
                  languageCode: 'de',
                  style: AppTypography.label,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                AppDirectionalText(
                  phrases[index].german,
                  languageCode: 'de',
                  style: AppTypography.title,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                AppDirectionalText(
                  phrases[index].arabic,
                  languageCode: 'ar',
                  style: AppTypography.body,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                AppDirectionalText(
                  phrases[index].contextAr,
                  languageCode: 'ar',
                  style: AppTypography.label,
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          if (index != phrases.length - 1)
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/life_pharmacy_medication/consultation/otc_models.dart

enum OtcTopic {
  mildPain,
  coldSymptoms,
  dosage,
  mealTiming,
  leaflet,
  sideEffects,
  expiryAndStorage,
}

extension OtcTopicLabels on OtcTopic {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        OtcTopic.mildPain => 'Leichte Schmerzen',
        OtcTopic.coldSymptoms => 'Erkältung',
        OtcTopic.dosage => 'Dosierung',
        OtcTopic.mealTiming => 'Einnahme & Essen',
        OtcTopic.leaflet => 'Packungsbeilage',
        OtcTopic.sideEffects => 'Nebenwirkungen',
        OtcTopic.expiryAndStorage => 'Verfallsdatum & Lagerung',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        OtcTopic.mildPain => 'ألم خفيف',
        OtcTopic.coldSymptoms => 'نزلة برد',
        OtcTopic.dosage => 'الجرعة',
        OtcTopic.mealTiming => 'التناول والطعام',
        OtcTopic.leaflet => 'النشرة الداخلية',
        OtcTopic.sideEffects => 'الآثار الجانبية',
        OtcTopic.expiryAndStorage => 'الصلاحية والحفظ',
      };
}

final class OtcPhrase {
  const OtcPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.topic,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.contextDe,
    required this.contextAr,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final OtcTopic topic;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String contextDe;
  final String contextAr;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;

    return <String>[
      id,
      topic.labelDe,
      topic.labelAr,
      german,
      arabic,
      contextDe,
      contextAr,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase().contains(needle);
  }
}

final class PharmacyHubCard {
  const PharmacyHubCard({
    required this.id,
    required this.section,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.bodyDe,
    required this.bodyAr,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final PharmacyHubSection section;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String bodyDe;
  final String bodyAr;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;

    return <String>[
      id,
      titleDe,
      titleAr,
      bodyDe,
      bodyAr,
      section.labelDe,
      section.labelAr,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase().contains(needle);
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'prescription_dispensing_sub_agent.dart';
import 'prescription_models.dart';

final class PrescriptionDispensingController extends ChangeNotifier {
  PrescriptionDispensingController({
    PrescriptionDispensingSubAgent agent =
        const PrescriptionDispensingSubAgent(),
  }) : _agent = agent;

  final PrescriptionDispensingSubAgent _agent;

  PrescriptionChannel _channel = PrescriptionChannel.ePrescription;
  String _query = '';

  PrescriptionChannel get channel => _channel;
  String get query => _query;

  List<PrescriptionPhrase> get visiblePhrases =>
      List<PrescriptionPhrase>.unmodifiable(
        _agent.phrases.where(
          (phrase) =>
              phrase.channel == _channel &&
              phrase.matches(_query),
        ),
      );

  void setChannel(PrescriptionChannel value) {
    if (_channel == value && _query.isEmpty) return;
    _channel = value;
    _query = '';
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    final next = value.trim();
    if (_query == next) return;
    _query = next;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearSearch() => setQuery('');
}

    extends State<PrescriptionDispensingScreen> {

  late final bool _ownsController;

    super.initState();
    _ownsController = widget.controller == null;
    _controller =
        widget.controller ?? PrescriptionDispensingController();

  @override

  final String id;

  final String contextAr;

  bool matches(String query) {

      channel.labelAr,
      german,
      arabic,

      contextAr,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase().contains(needle);

final class SafetyMasterOrchestrator {

    required this.roadsideAssistance,

  final OfficialReportingSubAgent officialReporting;

  List<SafetyLearningItem> get allItems => List<SafetyLearningItem>.unmodifiable(
        <SafetyLearningItem>[
          ...roadsideAssistance.items,
          ...officialReporting.items,
        ],

          authorityArabic: 'الإسعاف / الإطفاء',

          arabicGuide:
              'لحالة طبية أو حريق أو إنقاذ عاجل: اذكر ما حدث، عدد المصابين، والطريق والاتجاه وعلامة الكيلومتر.',
        ),
        SafetyPanicAction(
          id: 'panic_110',
          phoneNumber: '110',
          authorityGerman: 'Polizei',
          authorityArabic: 'الشرطة',
          germanScript:
              'Ich brauche die Polizei. Es besteht eine unmittelbare Gefahr. Wir sind auf der A3 Richtung Köln bei Kilometer 245.',
          arabicGuide:
              'عند خطر فوري يحتاج الشرطة: اذكر نوع الخطر، موقعك، الطريق والاتجاه وعلامة الكيلومتر.',
        ),
      ];

  List<SafetyLearningItem> itemsForCategory(SafetyCategory category) =>
      List<SafetyLearningItem>.unmodifiable(
        allItems.where((item) => item.category == category),
      );

  List<SafetyLearningItem> search(
    String query, {
    SafetyCategory? category,
  }) =>
      List<SafetyLearningItem>.unmodifiable(
        allItems.where(
          (item) =>
              (category == null || item.category == category) &&
              item.matches(query),
        ),
      );
}

enum SafetyCategory { roadsideAssistance, officialReporting }

enum SafetyTopic {
  breakdown,
  flatTire,
  towing,
  highwayLocation,
  lostItem,
  bikeTheft,
  insuranceClaim,
}

extension SafetyCategoryLabels on SafetyCategory {
  String get german => switch (this) {
        SafetyCategory.roadsideAssistance => 'Pannenhilfe',
        SafetyCategory.officialReporting => 'Offizielle Meldungen',
      };

  String get arabic => switch (this) {
        SafetyCategory.roadsideAssistance => 'المساعدة على الطريق',
        SafetyCategory.officialReporting => 'البلاغات الرسمية',
      };
}

extension SafetyTopicLabels on SafetyTopic {
  String get german => switch (this) {
        SafetyTopic.breakdown => 'Panne',
        SafetyTopic.flatTire => 'Reifenpanne',
        SafetyTopic.towing => 'Abschleppen',
        SafetyTopic.highwayLocation => 'Standort auf der Autobahn',
        SafetyTopic.lostItem => 'Fundsache',
        SafetyTopic.bikeTheft => 'Fahrraddiebstahl',
        SafetyTopic.insuranceClaim => 'Versicherungsschaden',
      };
}

final class SafetyLearningItem {
  const SafetyLearningItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.category,
    required this.topic,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.tags,
  });

  final String id;
  final SafetyCategory category;
  final SafetyTopic topic;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final List<String> tags;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;

    return german.toLowerCase().contains(needle) ||
        arabic.toLowerCase().contains(needle) ||
        topic.german.toLowerCase().contains(needle) ||
        tags.any((tag) => tag.toLowerCase().contains(needle));
  }
}

final class SafetyPanicAction {
  const SafetyPanicAction({
    required this.id,
    required this.phoneNumber,
    required this.authorityGerman,
    required this.authorityArabic,
    required this.germanScript,
    required this.arabicGuide,
  });

  final String id;
  final String phoneNumber;
  final String authorityGerman;
  final String authorityArabic;
  final String germanScript;
  final String arabicGuide;
}

import '../../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import '../application/safety_master_orchestrator.dart';
import '../domain/safety_models.dart';

final class SafetyMasterScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const SafetyMasterScreen({
    required this.orchestrator,
    super.key,
  });

  final SafetyMasterOrchestrator orchestrator;

  @override
  State<SafetyMasterScreen> createState() => _SafetyMasterScreenState();
}

final class _SafetyMasterScreenState extends State<SafetyMasterScreen> {
  SafetyCategory? _category;
  String _query = '';

  List<SafetyLearningItem> get _visibleItems {
    if (_query.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      return widget.orchestrator.search(_query, category: _category);
    }
    if (_category != null) {
      return widget.orchestrator.itemsForCategory(_category!);
    }
    return widget.orchestrator.allItems;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface = dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface;
    final border =
        dark ? AppColors.glassBorderDark : AppColors.glassBorderLight;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: <Widget>[
                _HeaderCard(surface: surface, border: border),
                Divider(color: border),
                _PanicBar(
                  actions: widget.orchestrator.panicActions,
                  surface: surface,
                  border: border,
                ),
                Divider(color: border),
                _CategorySwitcher(
                  selected: _category,
                  surface: surface,
                  border: border,
                  onSelected: (category) =>
                      setState(() => _category = category),
                  onClear: () => setState(() => _category = null),
                ),
                Divider(color: border),
                _SearchCard(
                  surface: surface,
                  border: border,
                  onChanged: (value) => setState(() => _query = value),
                ),
                Divider(color: border),
                for (final category in SafetyCategory.values)
                  if (_category == null || _category == category)
                    _CategorySection(
                      category: category,
                      items: _visibleItems
                          .where((item) => item.category == category)
                          .toList(growable: false),
                      surface: surface,
                      border: border,
                    ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import '../postal_models.dart';

enum PackstationScenario {
  packstation,
  deliveryProblems;

  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        PackstationScenario.packstation => 'Packstation',
        PackstationScenario.deliveryProblems => 'Zustellung & Retoure',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        PackstationScenario.packstation => 'ماكينة الطرود',
        PackstationScenario.deliveryProblems => 'التسليم والإرجاع',
      };
}

final class PackstationPhrase {
  const PackstationPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.scenario,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.contextDe,
    required this.contextAr,
    required this.carriers,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final PackstationScenario scenario;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String contextDe;
  final String contextAr;
  final List<PostalCarrier> carriers;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;
    return <String>[
      german,
      arabic,
      contextDe,
      contextAr,
      ...keywords,
      ...carriers.map((carrier) => carrier.labelDe),
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase().contains(needle);
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/life_postal_delivery/packstation/packstation_orchestrator.dart

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'packstation_models.dart';
import 'packstation_sub_agent.dart';

final class PackstationOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  PackstationOrchestrator({
    PackstationSubAgent agent = const PackstationSubAgent(),
  }) : _agent = agent;

  final PackstationSubAgent _agent;

  PackstationScenario _scenario = PackstationScenario.packstation;
  String _query = '';

  PackstationScenario get scenario => _scenario;
  String get query => _query;

  List<PackstationPhrase> get visiblePhrases =>
      List<PackstationPhrase>.unmodifiable(
        _agent.phrases.where(
          (phrase) =>
              (_query.trim().isNotEmpty || phrase.scenario == _scenario) &&
              phrase.matches(_query),
        ),
      );

  void setScenario(PackstationScenario value) {
    if (_scenario == value) return;
    _scenario = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearSearch() => setQuery('');
}

final class PackstationIssuesScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const PackstationIssuesScreen({
    this.orchestrator,
    super.key,
  });

  final PackstationOrchestrator? orchestrator;

  @override
  State<PackstationIssuesScreen> createState() =>
      _PackstationIssuesScreenState();
}

final class _PackstationIssuesScreenState
    extends State<PackstationIssuesScreen> {
  late final PackstationOrchestrator _orchestrator;
  late final bool _ownsOrchestrator;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ownsOrchestrator = widget.orchestrator == null;
    _orchestrator = widget.orchestrator ?? PackstationOrchestrator();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    if (_ownsOrchestrator) _orchestrator.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              PackstationUiTokens.pageInset,
              PackstationUiTokens.pageInset,
              PackstationUiTokens.pageInset,
              PackstationUiTokens.bottomInset,
            ),
            child: AnimatedBuilder(
              animation: _orchestrator,
              builder: (context, _) => Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  _HeaderCard(dark: dark),
                  const SizedBox(height: PackstationUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _SearchField(orchestrator: _orchestrator),

                  _PhraseList(

                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _PhraseList extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PhraseList({
    required this.orchestrator,
    required this.dark,
  });

  final PackstationOrchestrator orchestrator;
  final bool dark;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final phrases = orchestrator.visiblePhrases;

    if (phrases.isEmpty) {
      return AppGlassCard(
        backgroundColor: dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
        child: AppDirectionalText(
          'لا توجد عبارات مطابقة. جرّب كلمة بحث أخرى.',
          languageCode: 'ar',
          style: AppTypography.body,
        ),
      );
    }

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: <Widget>[
        for (var index = 0; index < phrases.length; index++) ...<Widget>[
          _PhraseCard(phrase: phrases[index], dark: dark),
          if (index != phrases.length - 1)
            const SizedBox(height: PackstationUiTokens.itemGap),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'postal_models.dart';

final class PostalDeliveryMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  PostalServiceArea _area = PostalServiceArea.shipping;
  String _query = '';

  PostalServiceArea get area => _area;
  String get query => _query;

  List<PostalHubAction> get visibleActions => List<PostalHubAction>.unmodifiable(
        _actions.where(
          (action) =>
              (_query.trim().isNotEmpty || action.area == _area) &&
              action.matches(_query),
        ),
      );

  void setArea(PostalServiceArea value) {
    if (_area == value) return;
    _area = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearSearch() => setQuery('');

  static const List<PostalHubAction> _actions = <PostalHubAction>[

enum PostalCarrier {
  dhl,
  hermes,
  deutschePost;

  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        PostalCarrier.dhl => 'DHL',
        PostalCarrier.hermes => 'Hermes',
        PostalCarrier.deutschePost => 'Deutsche Post',
      };
}

enum PostalServiceArea {
  shipping,
  packstationIssues;

  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        PostalServiceArea.shipping => 'Versenden & Abholen',
        PostalServiceArea.packstationIssues => 'Packstation & Zustellung',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        PostalServiceArea.shipping => 'الإرسال والاستلام',
        PostalServiceArea.packstationIssues => 'باك شتيشن ومشاكل التسليم',
      };
}

final class PostalTrackingNumber {
  const PostalTrackingNumber({
    required this.carrier,
    required this.value,
  });

  final PostalCarrier carrier;
  final String value;

  String get normalized =>
      value.toUpperCase().replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^A-Z0-9]'), '');
}

final class ParcelDimensions {
  const ParcelDimensions({
    required this.lengthCm,
    required this.widthCm,
    required this.heightCm,
    required this.weightKg,
  })  : assert(lengthCm > 0),
        assert(widthCm > 0),
        assert(heightCm > 0),
        assert(weightKg > 0);

  final double lengthCm;
  final double widthCm;
  final double heightCm;
  final double weightKg;

  String get dimensionLabelDe =>
      '${_number(lengthCm)} × ${_number(widthCm)} × ${_number(heightCm)} cm';

  String get weightLabelDe => '${_number(weightKg)} kg';

  static String _number(double value) {
    if (value == value.roundToDouble()) return value.toInt().toString();
    return value.toStringAsFixed(1).replaceFirst(RegExp(r'\.0$'), '');
  }
}

final class DeliveryNotificationCard {
  const DeliveryNotificationCard({
    required this.carrier,
    required this.pickupLocation,
    required this.pickupDeadline,
    required this.referenceNumber,
  });

  final PostalCarrier carrier;
  final String pickupLocation;
  final String pickupDeadline;
  final String referenceNumber;
}

final class PostalHubAction {
  const PostalHubAction({
    required this.id,
    required this.area,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.descriptionDe,
    required this.descriptionAr,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final PostalServiceArea area;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String descriptionDe;
  final String descriptionAr;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;
    return <String>[
      titleDe,
      titleAr,
      descriptionDe,
      descriptionAr,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase().contains(needle);
  }
}

import '../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import 'postal_master_orchestrator.dart';
import 'postal_models.dart';

abstract final class PostalUiTokens {
  static const double pageInset = 16;
  static const double bottomInset = 32;
  static const double sectionGap = 18;
  static const double itemGap = 12;
  static const double compactGap = 8;
}

final class PostalDeliveryMasterHub extends StatefulWidget {
  const PostalDeliveryMasterHub({
    this.orchestrator,
    super.key,
  });

  final PostalDeliveryMasterOrchestrator? orchestrator;

  @override
  State<PostalDeliveryMasterHub> createState() =>
      _PostalDeliveryMasterHubState();
}

final class _PostalDeliveryMasterHubState
    extends State<PostalDeliveryMasterHub> {
  late final PostalDeliveryMasterOrchestrator _orchestrator;
  late final bool _ownsOrchestrator;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ownsOrchestrator = widget.orchestrator == null;
    _orchestrator =
        widget.orchestrator ?? PostalDeliveryMasterOrchestrator();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    if (_ownsOrchestrator) _orchestrator.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              PostalUiTokens.pageInset,
              PostalUiTokens.pageInset,
              PostalUiTokens.pageInset,
              PostalUiTokens.bottomInset,
            ),
            child: AnimatedBuilder(
              animation: _orchestrator,
              builder: (context, _) => Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  _HeaderCard(dark: dark),

import '../postal_models.dart';

enum ShippingScenario {
  send,
  pickup;

  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        ShippingScenario.send => 'Versenden',
        ShippingScenario.pickup => 'Abholen',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        ShippingScenario.send => 'إرسال',
        ShippingScenario.pickup => 'استلام',
      };
}

final class ShippingPhrase {
  const ShippingPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.scenario,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.contextDe,
    required this.contextAr,
    required this.carriers,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final ShippingScenario scenario;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String contextDe;
  final String contextAr;
  final List<PostalCarrier> carriers;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;
    return <String>[
      german,
      arabic,
      contextDe,
      contextAr,
      ...keywords,
      ...carriers.map((carrier) => carrier.labelDe),
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase().contains(needle);
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/life_postal_delivery/shipping/shipping_orchestrator.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'shipping_models.dart';
import 'shipping_sub_agent.dart';

final class ShippingOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  ShippingOrchestrator({
    ShippingSubAgent agent = const ShippingSubAgent(),
  }) : _agent = agent;

  final ShippingSubAgent _agent;

  ShippingScenario _scenario = ShippingScenario.send;
  String _query = '';

  ShippingScenario get scenario => _scenario;
  String get query => _query;

  List<ShippingPhrase> get visiblePhrases => List<ShippingPhrase>.unmodifiable(
        _agent.phrases.where(
          (phrase) =>
              (_query.trim().isNotEmpty || phrase.scenario == _scenario) &&
              phrase.matches(_query),
        ),
      );

  void setScenario(ShippingScenario value) {
    if (_scenario == value) return;
    _scenario = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearSearch() => setQuery('');
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'anmeldung_models.dart';
import 'anmeldung_phrase_bank.dart';

final class AnmeldungAppointmentsAgent extends ChangeNotifier {
  RegistrationAction _registrationAction = RegistrationAction.all;
  AppointmentAction _appointmentAction = AppointmentAction.all;
  String _query = '';

  RegistrationAction get registrationAction => _registrationAction;
  AppointmentAction get appointmentAction => _appointmentAction;
  String get query => _query;

  List<AnmeldungPhrase> get allPhrases =>
      List<AnmeldungPhrase>.unmodifiable(AnmeldungPhraseBank.all);

  List<AnmeldungPhrase> get visiblePhrases {
    return List<AnmeldungPhrase>.unmodifiable(
      AnmeldungPhraseBank.all.where((phrase) {
        final registrationMatches =
            _registrationAction == RegistrationAction.all ||
                phrase.registrationAction == _registrationAction;
        final appointmentMatches =
            _appointmentAction == AppointmentAction.all ||
                phrase.appointmentAction == _appointmentAction;
        return registrationMatches &&
            appointmentMatches &&
            phrase.matches(_query);
      }),
    );
  }

  String get preparationNoteDe =>
      'Welche Unterlagen, Fristen und Buchungswege gelten, kann örtlich und je nach Anliegen variieren. Vor dem Termin die Angaben der zuständigen Meldebehörde prüfen.';

  String get preparationNoteAr =>
      'قد تختلف المستندات والمواعيد وطريقة الحجز حسب المدينة ونوع المعاملة. تحقق من تعليمات دائرة التسجيل المختصة قبل الموعد.';

  void setRegistrationAction(RegistrationAction value) {
    if (_registrationAction == value) return;
    _registrationAction = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setAppointmentAction(AppointmentAction value) {
    if (_appointmentAction == value) return;
    _appointmentAction = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearFilters() {
    if (_registrationAction == RegistrationAction.all &&
        _appointmentAction == AppointmentAction.all &&
        _query.isEmpty) {
      return;
    }
    _registrationAction = RegistrationAction.all;
    _appointmentAction = AppointmentAction.all;
    _query = '';
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

enum RegistrationAction {
  all,
  anmeldung,
  ummeldung,
  meldebestaetigung;

  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        RegistrationAction.all => 'Alle',
        RegistrationAction.anmeldung => 'Anmeldung',
        RegistrationAction.ummeldung => 'Ummeldung',
        RegistrationAction.meldebestaetigung => 'Meldebestätigung',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        RegistrationAction.all => 'الكل',
        RegistrationAction.anmeldung => 'تسجيل السكن',
        RegistrationAction.ummeldung => 'تغيير السكن',
        RegistrationAction.meldebestaetigung => 'شهادة التسجيل',
      };
}

enum AppointmentAction {
  all,
  book,
  confirm,
  reschedule;

  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        AppointmentAction.all => 'Alle Termine',
        AppointmentAction.book => 'Buchen',
        AppointmentAction.confirm => 'Bestätigen',
        AppointmentAction.reschedule => 'Ändern',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        AppointmentAction.all => 'كل المواعيد',
        AppointmentAction.book => 'حجز',
        AppointmentAction.confirm => 'تأكيد',
        AppointmentAction.reschedule => 'تعديل',
      };
}

final class AnmeldungPhrase {
  const AnmeldungPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.registrationAction,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.contextDe,
    required this.contextAr,
    this.appointmentAction,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final RegistrationAction registrationAction;
  final AppointmentAction? appointmentAction;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String contextDe;
  final String contextAr;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = _normalize(query);
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;

    return _normalize(<String>[
      german,
      arabic,
      contextDe,
      contextAr,
      registrationAction.labelDe,
      registrationAction.labelAr,
      if (appointmentAction != null) appointmentAction!.labelDe,
      if (appointmentAction != null) appointmentAction!.labelAr,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ')).contains(needle);
  }

  static String _normalize(String value) {
    return value
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll('ä', 'a')
        .replaceAll('ö', 'o')
        .replaceAll('ü', 'u')
        .replaceAll('ß', 'ss')
        .replaceAll('ـ', '');
  }
}

  static const double itemGap = 10;
  static const double controlGap = 8;
}

class AnmeldungAppointmentsHub extends StatefulWidget {
  const AnmeldungAppointmentsHub({
    this.agent,
    super.key,
  });

  final AnmeldungAppointmentsAgent? agent;

  @override
  State<AnmeldungAppointmentsHub> createState() =>
      _AnmeldungAppointmentsHubState();
}

class _AnmeldungAppointmentsHubState extends State<AnmeldungAppointmentsHub> {
  late final AnmeldungAppointmentsAgent _agent;
  late final bool _ownsAgent;
  late final TextEditingController _searchController;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ownsAgent = widget.agent == null;
    _agent = widget.agent ?? AnmeldungAppointmentsAgent();
    _searchController = TextEditingController(text: _agent.query);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchController.dispose();
    if (_ownsAgent) _agent.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: _agent,
      builder: (context, _) {
        final phrases = _agent.visiblePhrases;

        return Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(
            title: AppDirectionalText(
              'Anmeldung & Termine',
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
          ),
          body: SafeArea(
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(_AnmeldungUi.inset),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  _NoticeCard(agent: _agent),
                  const SizedBox(height: _AnmeldungUi.sectionGap),
                  _RegistrationFilter(agent: _agent),
                  const SizedBox(height: _AnmeldungUi.sectionGap),
                  _AppointmentFilter(agent: _agent),
                  const SizedBox(height: _AnmeldungUi.sectionGap),
                  _SearchCard(
                    agent: _agent,
                    controller: _searchController,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: _AnmeldungUi.sectionGap),
                  if (phrases.isEmpty)
                    const _EmptyState()
                  else
                    for (final phrase in phrases) ...<Widget>[
                      _PhraseCard(phrase: phrase),
                      const SizedBox(height: _AnmeldungUi.itemGap),
                    ],
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

enum DocumentsTopic {
  all,
  formFilling,
  identityProof,
  certification,
  powerOfAttorney,
  missingDocuments;

  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        DocumentsTopic.all => 'Alle Themen',
        DocumentsTopic.formFilling => 'Antrag ausfüllen',
        DocumentsTopic.identityProof => 'Identitätsnachweis',
        DocumentsTopic.certification => 'Beglaubigung',
        DocumentsTopic.powerOfAttorney => 'Vollmacht',
        DocumentsTopic.missingDocuments => 'Nachreichen',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        DocumentsTopic.all => 'كل المواضيع',
        DocumentsTopic.formFilling => 'تعبئة الطلب',
        DocumentsTopic.identityProof => 'إثبات الهوية',
        DocumentsTopic.certification => 'تصديق الأوراق',
        DocumentsTopic.powerOfAttorney => 'الوكالة',
        DocumentsTopic.missingDocuments => 'استكمال المستندات',
      };
}

final class DocumentsPhrase {
  const DocumentsPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.topic,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.contextDe,
    required this.contextAr,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final DocumentsTopic topic;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String contextDe;
  final String contextAr;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = _normalize(query);
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;

    return _normalize(<String>[
      topic.labelDe,
      topic.labelAr,
      german,
      arabic,
      contextDe,
      contextAr,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ')).contains(needle);
  }

  static String _normalize(String value) {
    return value
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll('ä', 'a')
        .replaceAll('ö', 'o')
        .replaceAll('ü', 'u')
        .replaceAll('ß', 'ss')
        .replaceAll('ـ', '');
  }

abstract final class _DocumentsUi {
  static const double inset = 16;
  static const double sectionGap = 14;
  static const double itemGap = 10;
  static const double controlGap = 8;
}

class FormsDocumentsHub extends StatefulWidget {
  const FormsDocumentsHub({
    this.agent,
    super.key,
  });

  final FormsDocumentsAgent? agent;

  @override
  State<FormsDocumentsHub> createState() => _FormsDocumentsHubState();
}

class _FormsDocumentsHubState extends State<FormsDocumentsHub> {
  late final FormsDocumentsAgent _agent;
  late final bool _ownsAgent;
  late final TextEditingController _searchController;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ownsAgent = widget.agent == null;
    _agent = widget.agent ?? FormsDocumentsAgent();
    _searchController = TextEditingController(text: _agent.query);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchController.dispose();
    if (_ownsAgent) _agent.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: _agent,
      builder: (context, _) {
        final phrases = _agent.visiblePhrases;

        return Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(
            title: AppDirectionalText(
              'Formulare & Dokumente',
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
          ),
          body: SafeArea(
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(_DocumentsUi.inset),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  _NoticeCard(agent: _agent),
                  const SizedBox(height: _DocumentsUi.sectionGap),
                  _TopicFilter(agent: _agent),
                  const SizedBox(height: _DocumentsUi.sectionGap),
                  _SearchCard(
                    agent: _agent,
                    controller: _searchController,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: _DocumentsUi.sectionGap),
                  if (phrases.isEmpty)
                    const _EmptyState()
                  else
                    for (final phrase in phrases) ...<Widget>[
                      _PhraseCard(phrase: phrase),
                      const SizedBox(height: _DocumentsUi.itemGap),
                    ],
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'documents_models.dart';
import 'forms_documents_phrase_bank.dart';

final class FormsDocumentsAgent extends ChangeNotifier {
  DocumentsTopic _topic = DocumentsTopic.all;
  String _query = '';

  DocumentsTopic get topic => _topic;
  String get query => _query;

  List<DocumentsPhrase> get allPhrases =>
      List<DocumentsPhrase>.unmodifiable(FormsDocumentsPhraseBank.all);

  List<DocumentsPhrase> get visiblePhrases {
    return List<DocumentsPhrase>.unmodifiable(
      FormsDocumentsPhraseBank.all.where((phrase) {
        final topicMatches =
            _topic == DocumentsTopic.all || phrase.topic == _topic;
        return topicMatches && phrase.matches(_query);
      }),
    );
  }

  String get officialNoteDe =>
      'Form, Beglaubigung, Vollmacht und Nachreichfrist können je nach Behörde und Verfahren unterschiedlich sein. Anforderungen immer bei der zuständigen Stelle bestätigen.';

  String get officialNoteAr =>
      'قد تختلف صيغة التصديق والوكالة ومهلة استكمال المستندات حسب الدائرة ونوع الإجراء. أكّد المتطلبات دائمًا لدى الجهة المختصة.';

  void setTopic(DocumentsTopic value) {
    if (_topic == value) return;
    _topic = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearFilters() {
    if (_topic == DocumentsTopic.all && _query.isEmpty) return;
    _topic = DocumentsTopic.all;
    _query = '';
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

final class OfficialDocument {
  const OfficialDocument({
    required this.id,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.kind,
    required this.applicableOffices,
    this.required = true,
    this.noteDe,
    this.noteAr,
  });

  final String id;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final OfficialDocumentKind kind;
  final List<PublicOfficeType> applicableOffices;
  final bool required;
  final String? noteDe;
  final String? noteAr;

  bool matchesOffice(PublicOfficeType office) {
    return office == PublicOfficeType.all || applicableOffices.contains(office);
  }
}

final class OfficialAppointment {
  const OfficialAppointment({
    required this.id,
    required this.office,
    required this.purposeDe,
    required this.purposeAr,
    this.reference,
    this.dateLabel,
    this.statusDe,
    this.statusAr,
  });

  final String id;
  final PublicOfficeType office;
  final String purposeDe;
  final String purposeAr;
  final String? reference;
  final String? dateLabel;
  final String? statusDe;
  final String? statusAr;
}

enum PublicOfficeRouteId {
  anmeldungAppointments,
  formsDocuments,
}

final class PublicOfficeRouteDescriptor {
  const PublicOfficeRouteDescriptor({
    required this.id,
    required this.routeName,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.descriptionDe,
    required this.descriptionAr,
    required this.supportedOffices,
    this.searchTerms = const <String>[],
  });

  final PublicOfficeRouteId id;
  final String routeName;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String descriptionDe;
  final String descriptionAr;
  final List<PublicOfficeType> supportedOffices;
  final List<String> searchTerms;

  bool supportsOffice(PublicOfficeType office) {
    return office == PublicOfficeType.all || supportedOffices.contains(office);
  }

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = _normalize(query);
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;
    return _normalize(<String>[
      titleDe,
      titleAr,
      descriptionDe,
      descriptionAr,
      ...searchTerms,
    ].join(' ')).contains(needle);
  }

  static String _normalize(String value) {
    return value
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll('ä', 'a')
        .replaceAll('ö', 'o')
        .replaceAll('ü', 'u')
        .replaceAll('ß', 'ss')
        .replaceAll('ـ', '');
  }
}

abstract interface class PublicOfficeModuleDependency {
  PublicOfficeRouteDescriptor get route;

  Iterable<OfficialDocument> get documents;
}

abstract final class PublicOfficeRoutes {
  static const String anmeldungRouteName =

  static const String documentsRouteName =

FILE: lib/features/life_public_offices/public_offices_master_orchestrator.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'public_office_models.dart';
import 'public_office_routes.dart';

final class PublicOfficesMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  PublicOfficesMasterOrchestrator({
    Iterable<PublicOfficeModuleDependency> dependencies =
        const <PublicOfficeModuleDependency>[],
    Iterable<OfficialAppointment> appointments =
        const <OfficialAppointment>[],
  })  : _dependencies =
            List<PublicOfficeModuleDependency>.unmodifiable(dependencies),
        _appointments = List<OfficialAppointment>.unmodifiable(appointments);

  final List<PublicOfficeModuleDependency> _dependencies;
  final List<OfficialAppointment> _appointments;

  PublicOfficeType _office = PublicOfficeType.all;
  String _query = '';

  PublicOfficeType get office => _office;
  String get query => _query;

  List<PublicOfficeRouteDescriptor> get visibleRoutes {
    return List<PublicOfficeRouteDescriptor>.unmodifiable(
      PublicOfficeRoutes.all.where(
        (route) => route.supportsOffice(_office) && route.matches(_query),
      ),
    );
  }

  List<OfficialDocument> get documents {
    return List<OfficialDocument>.unmodifiable(
      _dependencies
          .expand((dependency) => dependency.documents)
          .where((document) => document.matchesOffice(_office)),
    );
  }

  List<OfficialAppointment> get appointments {
    if (_office == PublicOfficeType.all) return _appointments;
    return List<OfficialAppointment>.unmodifiable(
      _appointments.where((appointment) => appointment.office == _office),
    );
  }

  PublicOfficeModuleDependency? dependencyFor(PublicOfficeRouteId id) {
    for (final dependency in _dependencies) {
      if (dependency.route.id == id) return dependency;
    }
    return null;
  }

  void setOffice(PublicOfficeType value) {
    if (_office == value) return;
    _office = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearFilters() {
    if (_office == PublicOfficeType.all && _query.isEmpty) return;
    _office = PublicOfficeType.all;
    _query = '';
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

import 'package:deutsch_bilarabi/features/phase3_integration/life_feature_text.dart';

import '../../design_system/app_colors.dart';
import '../../design_system/app_glass_card.dart';
import '../../design_system/app_typography.dart' hide AppDirectionalText;
import 'public_office_models.dart';
import 'public_offices_master_orchestrator.dart';

abstract final class _PublicOfficeUiTokens {
  static const double pageInset = 16;
  static const double sectionGap = 14;
  static const double itemGap = 10;
  static const double controlGap = 8;
}

class PublicOfficesMasterHub extends StatefulWidget {
  const PublicOfficesMasterHub({
    this.orchestrator,
    this.onRouteSelected,
    super.key,
  });

  final PublicOfficesMasterOrchestrator? orchestrator;
  final ValueChanged<PublicOfficeRouteDescriptor>? onRouteSelected;

  @override
  State<PublicOfficesMasterHub> createState() => _PublicOfficesMasterHubState();
}

class _PublicOfficesMasterHubState extends State<PublicOfficesMasterHub> {
  late final PublicOfficesMasterOrchestrator _orchestrator;
  late final bool _ownsOrchestrator;
  late final TextEditingController _searchController;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ownsOrchestrator = widget.orchestrator == null;
    _orchestrator = widget.orchestrator ?? PublicOfficesMasterOrchestrator();
    _searchController = TextEditingController(text: _orchestrator.query);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchController.dispose();
    if (_ownsOrchestrator) {
      _orchestrator.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: _orchestrator,
      builder: (context, _) {
        final routes = _orchestrator.visibleRoutes;

        return Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(
            title: AppDirectionalText(
              'Behörden & Verwaltung',
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
          ),
          body: SafeArea(
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(_PublicOfficeUiTokens.pageInset),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  const _IntroCard(),
                  const SizedBox(height: _PublicOfficeUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _OfficeFilter(orchestrator: _orchestrator),
                  const SizedBox(height: _PublicOfficeUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _SearchCard(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    controller: _searchController,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: _PublicOfficeUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  if (routes.isEmpty)
                    const _EmptyState()
                  else
                    for (final route in routes) ...<Widget>[
                      _RouteCard(
                        route: route,
                        dependency:
                            _orchestrator.dependencyFor(route.id) != null,
                        onTap: widget.onRouteSelected == null
                            ? null
                            : () => widget.onRouteSelected!(route),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: _PublicOfficeUiTokens.itemGap),
                    ],
                  if (_orchestrator.appointments.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                    const SizedBox(height: _PublicOfficeUiTokens.sectionGap),
                    _AppointmentsCard(
                      appointments: _orchestrator.appointments,
                    ),
                  ],
                  if (_orchestrator.documents.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                    const SizedBox(height: _PublicOfficeUiTokens.sectionGap),
                    _DocumentsCard(documents: _orchestrator.documents),
                  ],
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

import '../rent_housing_models.dart';
import 'caretaker_sub_agent.dart';
import 'defect_notice_sub_agent.dart';

final class HandoverCatalog {
  const HandoverCatalog({
    this.protocol = const HandoverProtocolSubAgent(),
    this.defects = const DefectNoticeSubAgent(),
    this.caretaker = const CaretakerSubAgent(),
  });

  final HandoverProtocolSubAgent protocol;
  final DefectNoticeSubAgent defects;
  final CaretakerSubAgent caretaker;

  List<RentHousingEntry> get entries => List<RentHousingEntry>.unmodifiable(
        <RentHousingEntry>[
          ...protocol.entries,
          ...defects.entries,
          ...caretaker.entries,
        ],
      );

  List<RentHousingEntry> search(String query) => List<RentHousingEntry>.unmodifiable(
        entries.where((entry) => entry.matches(query)),
      );
}

final class RentHousingMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  RentHousingSection _section = RentHousingSection.contractAndCosts;
  String _query = '';

  RentHousingSection get section => _section;
  String get query => _query;

  static const List<RentHousingEntry> _coreEntries = <RentHousingEntry>[
    RentHousingEntry(
      id: 'rent-core-mietvertrag',
      section: RentHousingSection.contractAndCosts,

          'أريد مراجعة عقد الإيجار بهدوء. ما المبالغ والمواعيد المتفق عليها صراحةً هنا؟',
      contextDe:
          'Vertragstext lesen und konkrete Angaben markieren, statt Bedingungen zu erraten',
      contextAr:
          'قراءة نص العقد وتحديد البنود الفعلية بدل افتراض شروط غير مكتوبة',
      keywords: <String>['Mietvertrag', 'Vertrag', 'Frist', 'Kaution'],
    ),
    RentHousingEntry(
      id: 'rent-core-nebenkosten',
      section: RentHousingSection.contractAndCosts,
      titleDe: 'Nebenkosten',
      titleAr: 'التكاليف الإضافية',
      german:
          'Welche Nebenkosten sind vereinbart, und welche Vorauszahlungen stehen im Vertrag?',
      arabic:
          'ما التكاليف الإضافية المتفق عليها، وما الدفعات المقدمة المذكورة في العقد؟',
      contextDe:
          'Kaltmiete, Vorauszahlungen und weitere vereinbarte Kosten getrennt erfassen',
      contextAr:
          'فصل الإيجار الأساسي عن الدفعات المقدمة وبقية التكاليف المتفق عليها',
      keywords: <String>[
        'Nebenkosten',
        'Kaltmiete',
        'Warmmiete',
        'Vorauszahlung',
      ],
    ),
    RentHousingEntry(
      id: 'rent-core-uebergabeprotokoll',
      section: RentHousingSection.handoverAndDefects,
      titleDe: 'Übergabeprotokoll',
      titleAr: 'محضر تسليم واستلام الشقة',
      german:
          'Lassen Sie uns Zustand, Schlüssel und Zählerstände im Übergabeprotokoll festhalten.',
      arabic:
          'دعنا نسجل حالة الشقة والمفاتيح وقراءات العدادات في محضر التسليم.',
      contextDe:
          'Beobachtbare Angaben bei Einzug oder Auszug gemeinsam dokumentieren',
      contextAr:
          'توثيق المعلومات القابلة للملاحظة عند الاستلام أو التسليم',
      keywords: <String>[
        'Übergabeprotokoll',
        'Zählerstand',
        'Schlüssel',
        'Einzug',
        'Auszug',
      ],
    ),
  ];

  List<RentHousingEntry> get visibleEntries => List<RentHousingEntry>.unmodifiable(
        _coreEntries.where(
          (entry) => entry.section == _section && entry.matches(_query),
        ),
      );

  void setSection(RentHousingSection value) {
    if (_section == value) return;
    _section = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearSearch() => setQuery('');
}

enum RentHousingSection { contractAndCosts, handoverAndDefects }

extension RentHousingSectionLabels on RentHousingSection {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        RentHousingSection.contractAndCosts => 'Mietvertrag & Nebenkosten',
        RentHousingSection.handoverAndDefects => 'Übergabe & Mängel',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        RentHousingSection.contractAndCosts => 'عقد الإيجار والتكاليف',
        RentHousingSection.handoverAndDefects => 'التسليم والعيوب',
      };
}

final class RentHousingEntry {
  const RentHousingEntry({
    required this.id,
    required this.section,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.contextDe,
    required this.contextAr,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final RentHousingSection section;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String contextDe;
  final String contextAr;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;

    return <String>[
      titleDe,
      titleAr,
      german,
      arabic,
      contextDe,
      contextAr,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase().contains(needle);
  }
}

final class RentContractRecord {
  const RentContractRecord({
    required this.kaltmiete,
    required this.nebenkostenAdvance,
    required this.heatingAdvance,
    required this.kaution,
    this.currencyCode = 'EUR',
  });

  final double kaltmiete;
  final double nebenkostenAdvance;
  final double heatingAdvance;
  final double kaution;
  final String currencyCode;

  double get monthlyPlannedOutlay =>
      kaltmiete + nebenkostenAdvance + heatingAdvance;
}

final class NebenkostenItem {
  const NebenkostenItem({
    required this.labelDe,
    required this.labelAr,
    required this.amount,
  });

  final String labelDe;
  final String labelAr;
  final double amount;
}

final class MeterReading {
  const MeterReading({
    required this.labelDe,
    required this.value,
  });

  final String labelDe;
  final String value;
}

final class HandoverProtocolRecord {
  const HandoverProtocolRecord({
    required this.addressLabel,
    required this.meterReadings,
    required this.keysCount,
    required this.notes,
  });

  final String addressLabel;
  final List<MeterReading> meterReadings;
  final int keysCount;
  final String notes;
}

abstract final class RentHousingUiTokens {
  static const double pageInset = 16;
  static const double bottomInset = 32;
  static const double sectionGap = 18;
  static const double itemGap = 12;
  static const double compactGap = 8;
}

final class RentHousingMasterHub extends StatefulWidget {
  const RentHousingMasterHub({
    this.orchestrator,
    super.key,
  });

  final RentHousingMasterOrchestrator? orchestrator;

  @override
  State<RentHousingMasterHub> createState() => _RentHousingMasterHubState();
}

final class _RentHousingMasterHubState extends State<RentHousingMasterHub> {
  late final RentHousingMasterOrchestrator _orchestrator;
  late final bool _ownsOrchestrator;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ownsOrchestrator = widget.orchestrator == null;
    _orchestrator = widget.orchestrator ?? RentHousingMasterOrchestrator();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    if (_ownsOrchestrator) {
      _orchestrator.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              RentHousingUiTokens.pageInset,
              RentHousingUiTokens.pageInset,
              RentHousingUiTokens.pageInset,
              RentHousingUiTokens.bottomInset,
            ),
            child: AnimatedBuilder(
              animation: _orchestrator,
              builder: (context, _) => Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  _HeaderCard(dark: dark),
                  const SizedBox(height: RentHousingUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _SearchField(orchestrator: _orchestrator),
                  const SizedBox(height: RentHousingUiTokens.itemGap),
                  _SectionSelector(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: RentHousingUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _CoreDataCard(dark: dark),
                  const SizedBox(height: RentHousingUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _EntryList(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _EntryList extends StatelessWidget {
  const _EntryList({
    required this.orchestrator,
    required this.dark,
  });

  final RentHousingMasterOrchestrator orchestrator;
  final bool dark;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final entries = orchestrator.visibleEntries;

    if (entries.isEmpty) {
      return AppGlassCard(
        borderColor: AppColors.tertiary.withAlpha(96),
        backgroundColor: dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
        child: AppDirectionalText(
          'لا توجد نتيجة في هذا القسم. جرّب كلمة أخرى.',
          languageCode: 'ar',
          style: AppTypography.body,
        ),
      );
    }

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: <Widget>[
        for (var index = 0; index < entries.length; index++) ...<Widget>[
          _EntryCard(entry: entries[index], dark: dark),
          if (index != entries.length - 1)
            const SizedBox(height: RentHousingUiTokens.itemGap),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }
}

import '../rent_housing_models.dart';
import 'house_rules_sub_agent.dart';
import 'rent_contract_sub_agent.dart';
import 'termination_deposit_sub_agent.dart';

final class RentHousingRulesCatalog {
  const RentHousingRulesCatalog({
    this.contract = const RentContractSubAgent(),
    this.houseRules = const HouseRulesSubAgent(),
    this.termination = const TerminationDepositSubAgent(),
  });

  final RentContractSubAgent contract;
  final HouseRulesSubAgent houseRules;
  final TerminationDepositSubAgent termination;

  List<RentHousingEntry> get entries => List<RentHousingEntry>.unmodifiable(
        <RentHousingEntry>[
          ...contract.entries,
          ...houseRules.entries,
          ...termination.entries,
        ],
      );

  List<RentHousingEntry> search(String query) => List<RentHousingEntry>.unmodifiable(
        entries.where((entry) => entry.matches(query)),
      );
}

FILE: lib/features/life_restaurant_dining/billing/billing_models.dart

enum BillingPhraseKind { payment, tipping, feedback }

enum PaymentSplitMode { together, separate }

enum PaymentMethod { cash, card }

final class BillingPhrase {
  const BillingPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.kind,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.contextDe,
    required this.contextAr,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final BillingPhraseKind kind;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String contextDe;
  final String contextAr;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;
    return <String>[
      german,
      arabic,
      contextDe,
      contextAr,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase().contains(needle);
  }
}

enum OrderingStage { reservationSeating, menuOrdering }

enum SeatingPreference { indoor, outdoor, any }

extension SeatingPreferenceLabels on SeatingPreference {
  String get german => switch (this) {
        SeatingPreference.indoor => 'drinnen',
        SeatingPreference.outdoor => 'draußen',
        SeatingPreference.any => 'egal ob drinnen oder draußen',
      };

  String get arabic => switch (this) {
        SeatingPreference.indoor => 'في الداخل',
        SeatingPreference.outdoor => 'في الخارج',
        SeatingPreference.any => 'لا فرق بين الداخل والخارج',
      };
}

final class ReservationPlan {
  const ReservationPlan({
    required this.partySize,
    this.seating = SeatingPreference.any,
  }) : assert(partySize > 0);

  final int partySize;
  final SeatingPreference seating;
}

final class OrderingPhrase {
  const OrderingPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.stage,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.contextDe,
    required this.contextAr,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final OrderingStage stage;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String contextDe;
  final String contextAr;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;
    return <String>[
      german,
      arabic,
      contextDe,
      contextAr,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase().contains(needle);
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/life_restaurant_dining/ordering/ordering_orchestrator.dart
