import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'menu_ordering_agent.dart';
import 'ordering_models.dart';
import 'reservation_seating_agent.dart';

final class RestaurantOrderingOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  RestaurantOrderingOrchestrator({
    ReservationSeatingAgent reservation = const ReservationSeatingAgent(),
    MenuOrderingAgent menu = const MenuOrderingAgent(),
  })  : _reservation = reservation,
        _menu = menu;

  final ReservationSeatingAgent _reservation;
  final MenuOrderingAgent _menu;

  OrderingStage _stage = OrderingStage.reservationSeating;
  String _query = '';

  OrderingStage get stage => _stage;
  String get query => _query;

  List<OrderingPhrase> get visiblePhrases {
    final source = switch (_stage) {
      OrderingStage.reservationSeating => _reservation.phrases,
      OrderingStage.menuOrdering => _menu.phrases,
    };
    return List<OrderingPhrase>.unmodifiable(
      source.where((item) => item.matches(_query)),
    );
  }

  String buildReservation(ReservationPlan plan) =>
      _reservation.reservationRequest(plan);

  void setStage(OrderingStage value) {
    if (_stage == value) return;
    _stage = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearSearch() => setQuery('');
}

import 'ordering_models.dart';

final class ReservationSeatingAgent {
  const ReservationSeatingAgent();

  List<OrderingPhrase> get phrases => _phrases;

  String reservationRequest(ReservationPlan plan) {
    final party = _partySizeGerman(plan.partySize);
    final seating = switch (plan.seating) {
      SeatingPreference.indoor => ' Wir würden gern drinnen sitzen.',
      SeatingPreference.outdoor => ' Wir würden gern draußen sitzen.',
      SeatingPreference.any => '',
    };
    return 'Ich möchte einen Tisch für $party reservieren.$seating';
  }

  static String _partySizeGerman(int size) => switch (size) {
        1 => 'eine Person',
        2 => 'zwei Personen',
        3 => 'drei Personen',
        4 => 'vier Personen',
        5 => 'fünf Personen',
        6 => 'sechs Personen',
        _ => '$size Personen',
      };

  static const List<OrderingPhrase> _phrases = <OrderingPhrase>[
    OrderingPhrase(
      id: 'reservation-time',
      stage: OrderingStage.reservationSeating,
      german: 'Haben Sie heute Abend um 19 Uhr einen Tisch für zwei Personen frei?',
      arabic: 'هل لديكم طاولة متاحة لشخصين اليوم الساعة السابعة مساءً؟',
      contextDe: 'Nach einem freien Tisch zu einer bestimmten Zeit fragen',
      contextAr: 'السؤال عن توفر طاولة في وقت محدد',
      keywords: <String>['reservieren', 'Tisch', 'frei', 'Uhr'],
    ),
    OrderingPhrase(
      id: 'reservation-group',
      stage: OrderingStage.reservationSeating,
      german: 'Ich möchte einen Tisch für sechs Personen reservieren.',
      arabic: 'أود حجز طاولة لستة أشخاص.',
      contextDe: 'Eine Reservierung für eine Gruppe formulieren',
      contextAr: 'حجز طاولة لمجموعة',
      keywords: <String>['Gruppe', 'sechs Personen', 'Reservierung'],
    ),
    OrderingPhrase(
      id: 'seating-indoor',
      stage: OrderingStage.reservationSeating,
      german: 'Wir würden gern drinnen sitzen, wenn möglich.',
      arabic: 'نود الجلوس في الداخل إن أمكن.',

      keywords: <String>['drinnen', 'Innenbereich', 'sitzen'],

    OrderingPhrase(
      id: 'seating-outdoor',
      stage: OrderingStage.reservationSeating,
      german: 'Können wir draußen sitzen?',

      contextAr: 'طلب الجلوس في الخارج',
      keywords: <String>['draußen', 'Terrasse', 'Außenbereich'],
    ),
  ];
}

enum DiningVenueType { restaurant, cafe, fastFood }

enum MealOption { vegetarian, vegan, glutenFree, halalRequested }

enum BillSplitMode { together, separate }

extension DiningVenueLabels on DiningVenueType {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        DiningVenueType.restaurant => 'Restaurant',
        DiningVenueType.cafe => 'Café',
        DiningVenueType.fastFood => 'Schnellrestaurant',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        DiningVenueType.restaurant => 'مطعم',
        DiningVenueType.cafe => 'مقهى',
        DiningVenueType.fastFood => 'وجبات سريعة',
      };
}

extension MealOptionLabels on MealOption {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        MealOption.vegetarian => 'Vegetarisch',
        MealOption.vegan => 'Vegan',
        MealOption.glutenFree => 'Glutenfrei',
        MealOption.halalRequested => 'Halal erfragen',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        MealOption.vegetarian => 'نباتي',
        MealOption.vegan => 'نباتي بالكامل',
        MealOption.glutenFree => 'خالٍ من الغلوتين',
        MealOption.halalRequested => 'الاستفسار عن الحلال',
      };
}

final class RestaurantMenuItem {
  const RestaurantMenuItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.nameDe,
    required this.nameAr,
    required this.descriptionDe,
    required this.descriptionAr,
    this.options = const <MealOption>{},
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final String nameDe;
  final String nameAr;
  final String descriptionDe;
  final String descriptionAr;
  final Set<MealOption> options;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;
    return <String>[
      nameDe,
      nameAr,
      descriptionDe,
      descriptionAr,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase().contains(needle);
  }
}

final class BillTipPhrase {
  const BillTipPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.contextDe,
    this.splitMode,
  });

  final String id;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String contextDe;
  final BillSplitMode? splitMode;
}

  static const double itemGap = 12;
  static const double compactGap = 8;
}

final class RestaurantDiningMasterHub extends StatefulWidget {
  const RestaurantDiningMasterHub({
    this.orchestrator,
    this.orchestratorFactory,
    super.key,
  });

  static const String routeName = '/life/restaurant-dining';

  final RestaurantDiningMasterOrchestrator? orchestrator;
  final RestaurantDiningMasterOrchestrator Function()? orchestratorFactory;

  @override
  State<RestaurantDiningMasterHub> createState() =>
      _RestaurantDiningMasterHubState();
}

final class _RestaurantDiningMasterHubState
    extends State<RestaurantDiningMasterHub> {
  late final RestaurantDiningMasterOrchestrator _orchestrator;
  late final bool _ownsOrchestrator;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    if (widget.orchestrator != null) {
      _orchestrator = widget.orchestrator!;
      _ownsOrchestrator = false;
    } else {
      _orchestrator =
          widget.orchestratorFactory?.call() ?? RestaurantDiningMasterOrchestrator();
      _ownsOrchestrator = true;
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    if (_ownsOrchestrator) {
      _orchestrator.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              RestaurantDiningUiTokens.pageInset,
              RestaurantDiningUiTokens.pageInset,
              RestaurantDiningUiTokens.pageInset,
              RestaurantDiningUiTokens.bottomInset,
            ),
            child: AnimatedBuilder(
              animation: _orchestrator,
              builder: (context, _) => Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  _HeaderCard(dark: dark),
                  const SizedBox(height: RestaurantDiningUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _VenueSelector(orchestrator: _orchestrator, dark: dark),
                  const SizedBox(height: RestaurantDiningUiTokens.itemGap),
                  _SearchField(orchestrator: _orchestrator),
                  const SizedBox(height: RestaurantDiningUiTokens.itemGap),
                  _MealOptions(orchestrator: _orchestrator, dark: dark),
                  const SizedBox(height: RestaurantDiningUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _MenuCard(orchestrator: _orchestrator, dark: dark),
                  const SizedBox(height: RestaurantDiningUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _BillTipCard(orchestrator: _orchestrator, dark: dark),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'donation_and_social_sub_agent.dart';
import 'flea_market_and_ads_sub_agent.dart';
import 'secondhand_models.dart';

final class SecondhandMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  SecondhandMasterOrchestrator({
    FleaMarketAndAdsSubAgent fleaMarketAndAds =
        const FleaMarketAndAdsSubAgent(),
    DonationAndSocialSubAgent donationAndSocial =
        const DonationAndSocialSubAgent(),
  })  : _fleaMarketAndAds = fleaMarketAndAds,
        _donationAndSocial = donationAndSocial;

  final FleaMarketAndAdsSubAgent _fleaMarketAndAds;
  final DonationAndSocialSubAgent _donationAndSocial;

  SecondhandDomain _domain = SecondhandDomain.fleaMarketsAndAds;
  String _query = '';

  SecondhandDomain get domain => _domain;
  String get query => _query;

  List<SecondhandBargainingTip> get bargainingTips =>
      const <SecondhandBargainingTip>[
        SecondhandBargainingTip(
          german:
              'VB bedeutet Verhandlungsbasis: freundlich fragen, nicht fordern.',
          arabic:
              'VB تعني أن السعر قابل للتفاوض: اسأل بلطف بدل فرض سعر جديد.',
        ),
        SecondhandBargainingTip(
          german:
              'Erst den Zustand prüfen, dann einen fairen konkreten Vorschlag machen: „Wie wäre es mit 25 Euro?“',
          arabic:
              'افحص حالة السلعة أولًا، ثم قدّم عرضًا واضحًا ومنصفًا: «ما رأيك في 25 يورو؟»',
        ),
        SecondhandBargainingTip(
          german:
              'Bei Abholung Preis, Zeitpunkt und Zahlungsart vorher bestätigen.',
          arabic:
              'عند الاستلام أكّد السعر والموعد وطريقة الدفع مسبقًا.',
        ),
      ];

  List<SecondhandEntry> get visibleEntries {
    final source = switch (_domain) {
      SecondhandDomain.fleaMarketsAndAds => _fleaMarketAndAds.entries,
      SecondhandDomain.donationAndSocialStores => _donationAndSocial.entries,
    };

    return List<SecondhandEntry>.unmodifiable(
      source.where((entry) => entry.matches(_query)),
    );
  }

  void setDomain(SecondhandDomain value) {
    if (_domain == value) return;
    _domain = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearSearch() => setQuery('');
}

FILE: lib/features/life_secondhand/secondhand_models.dart

enum SecondhandDomain { fleaMarketsAndAds, donationAndSocialStores }

extension SecondhandDomainLabels on SecondhandDomain {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        SecondhandDomain.fleaMarketsAndAds => 'Flohmarkt & Kleinanzeigen',
        SecondhandDomain.donationAndSocialStores =>
          'Sozialkaufhaus & Kleidercontainer',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        SecondhandDomain.fleaMarketsAndAds => 'أسواق المستعمل والإعلانات المحلية',
        SecondhandDomain.donationAndSocialStores =>
          'المتاجر الاجتماعية وحاويات الملابس',
      };
}

final class SecondhandBargainingTip {
  const SecondhandBargainingTip({
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
  });

  final String german;
  final String arabic;
}

final class SecondhandEntry {
  const SecondhandEntry({
    required this.id,
    required this.domain,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.contextDe,
    required this.contextAr,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final SecondhandDomain domain;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String contextDe;
  final String contextAr;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;

    final haystack = <String>[
      titleDe,
      titleAr,
      german,
      arabic,
      contextDe,
      contextAr,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase();

    return haystack.contains(needle);
  }
}

abstract final class SecondhandUiTokens {
  static const double pageInset = 16;
  static const double bottomInset = 32;
  static const double sectionGap = 18;
  static const double itemGap = 12;
  static const double compactGap = 8;
}

final class SecondhandMasterHub extends StatefulWidget {
  const SecondhandMasterHub({
    this.orchestrator,
    super.key,
  });

  final SecondhandMasterOrchestrator? orchestrator;

  @override
  State<SecondhandMasterHub> createState() => _SecondhandMasterHubState();
}

final class _SecondhandMasterHubState extends State<SecondhandMasterHub> {
  late final SecondhandMasterOrchestrator _orchestrator;
  late final bool _ownsOrchestrator;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ownsOrchestrator = widget.orchestrator == null;
    _orchestrator = widget.orchestrator ?? SecondhandMasterOrchestrator();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    if (_ownsOrchestrator) {
      _orchestrator.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              SecondhandUiTokens.pageInset,
              SecondhandUiTokens.pageInset,
              SecondhandUiTokens.pageInset,
              SecondhandUiTokens.bottomInset,
            ),
            child: AnimatedBuilder(
              animation: _orchestrator,
              builder: (context, _) => Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  _HeaderCard(dark: dark),
                  const SizedBox(height: SecondhandUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _FriendlyBargainingTipsBar(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: SecondhandUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _SearchField(orchestrator: _orchestrator),
                  const SizedBox(height: SecondhandUiTokens.itemGap),
                  _DomainSelector(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: SecondhandUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _EntryList(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _EntryList extends StatelessWidget {

    final entries = orchestrator.visibleEntries;

        borderColor: AppColors.tertiary.withAlpha(96),
        backgroundColor: dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
        child: AppDirectionalText(
          'لا توجد نتائج في هذا القسم. جرّب كلمة بحث أخرى.',
          languageCode: 'ar',
          style: AppTypography.body,
        ),
      );
    }

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: <Widget>[
        for (var index = 0; index < entries.length; index++) ...<Widget>[
          _SecondhandEntryCard(entry: entries[index], dark: dark),
          if (index != entries.length - 1)
            const SizedBox(height: SecondhandUiTokens.itemGap),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }
}

enum ServiceCategory {
  postal,
  telecom,
}

extension ServiceCategoryLabels on ServiceCategory {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        ServiceCategory.postal => 'Post & Pakete',
        ServiceCategory.telecom => 'Internet & Mobilfunk',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        ServiceCategory.postal => 'البريد والطرود',
        ServiceCategory.telecom => 'الإنترنت والاتصالات',
      };
}

enum PackageTrackingStatus {
  expected,
  inTransit,
  readyForPickup,
  delayed,
  missing,
}

extension PackageTrackingStatusLabels on PackageTrackingStatus {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        PackageTrackingStatus.expected => 'Angekündigt',
        PackageTrackingStatus.inTransit => 'Unterwegs',
        PackageTrackingStatus.readyForPickup => 'Abholbereit',
        PackageTrackingStatus.delayed => 'Verspätet',
        PackageTrackingStatus.missing => 'Nicht angekommen',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        PackageTrackingStatus.expected => 'تم إنشاء الشحنة',
        PackageTrackingStatus.inTransit => 'في الطريق',
        PackageTrackingStatus.readyForPickup => 'جاهزة للاستلام',
        PackageTrackingStatus.delayed => 'متأخرة',
        PackageTrackingStatus.missing => 'لم تصل',
      };
}

final class ServicePhrase {
  const ServicePhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.category,
    required this.topicDe,
    required this.topicAr,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    this.tags = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final ServiceCategory category;
  final String topicDe;
  final String topicAr;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final List<String> tags;
}

final class PackageStatusGuidance {
  const PackageStatusGuidance({
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.detailDe,
    required this.detailAr,
  });

  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String detailDe;
  final String detailAr;
}

final class MissingPackageStep {
  const MissingPackageStep({
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
  });

  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
}

final class ServicesMasterOrchestrator {
  ServicesMasterOrchestrator({
    required Iterable<ServicePhrase> entries,
  }) : _entries = List<ServicePhrase>.unmodifiable(entries);

  final List<ServicePhrase> _entries;
  final Set<ServiceCategory> _selectedCategories = <ServiceCategory>{
    ServiceCategory.postal,
    ServiceCategory.telecom,
  };

  String _query = '';
  PackageTrackingStatus _trackingStatus = PackageTrackingStatus.inTransit;
  bool _missingPackageExpanded = false;

  String get query => _query;

  PackageTrackingStatus get trackingStatus => _trackingStatus;

  bool get missingPackageExpanded => _missingPackageExpanded;

  Set<ServiceCategory> get selectedCategories =>
      Set<ServiceCategory>.unmodifiable(_selectedCategories);

  List<ServicePhrase> get visibleEntries {
    final normalizedQuery = _normalize(_query);

    final filtered = _entries.where((entry) {
      if (!_selectedCategories.contains(entry.category)) return false;
      if (normalizedQuery.isEmpty) return true;

      final searchable = _normalize(
        <String>[
          entry.topicDe,
          entry.topicAr,
          entry.german,
          entry.arabic,
          ...entry.tags,
        ].join(' '),
      );
      return searchable.contains(normalizedQuery);
    }).toList(growable: false);

    return List<ServicePhrase>.unmodifiable(filtered);
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    _query = value.trim();
  }

  void toggleCategory(ServiceCategory category) {
    if (_selectedCategories.contains(category)) {
      _selectedCategories.remove(category);
    } else {
      _selectedCategories.add(category);
    }
  }

  void setTrackingStatus(PackageTrackingStatus status) {
    _trackingStatus = status;
    if (status != PackageTrackingStatus.missing) {
      _missingPackageExpanded = false;
    }
  }

  void activateMissingPackagePanic() {
    _trackingStatus = PackageTrackingStatus.missing;
    _missingPackageExpanded = true;
  }

  void dismissMissingPackagePanic() {
    _missingPackageExpanded = false;
  }

  PackageStatusGuidance get trackingGuidance => switch (_trackingStatus) {
        PackageTrackingStatus.expected => const PackageStatusGuidance(
            titleDe: 'Sendung angekündigt',
            titleAr: 'تم إنشاء بيانات الشحنة',
            detailDe:
                'Prüfen Sie, ob der Absender das Paket bereits an den Dienstleister übergeben hat.',
            detailAr:
                'تحقق مما إذا كان المرسل قد سلّم الطرد فعلياً إلى شركة الشحن.',
          ),
        PackageTrackingStatus.inTransit => const PackageStatusGuidance(
            titleDe: 'Sendung ist unterwegs',
            titleAr: 'الشحنة في الطريق',
            detailDe:
                'Behalten Sie den letzten Scan, den Ort und das voraussichtliche Zustellfenster im Blick.',
            detailAr:
                'راقب آخر تحديث للمسح والموقع وموعد التسليم المتوقع.',
          ),
        PackageTrackingStatus.readyForPickup => const PackageStatusGuidance(
            titleDe: 'Abholung vorbereiten',
            titleAr: 'جهّز معلومات الاستلام',
            detailDe:
                'Halten Sie Abholcode, Benachrichtigung und gegebenenfalls einen Ausweis bereit.',
            detailAr:
                'جهّز رمز الاستلام والإشعار، ومعرّف الهوية إذا طُلب.',
          ),
        PackageTrackingStatus.delayed => const PackageStatusGuidance(
            titleDe: 'Verzögerung dokumentieren',
            titleAr: 'وثّق التأخير',
            detailDe:
                'Notieren Sie Sendungsnummer und letzten Scan und stellen Sie eine sachliche Statusanfrage.',
            detailAr:
                'دوّن رقم الشحنة وآخر تحديث ثم أرسل استفساراً رسمياً عن الحالة.',
          ),
        PackageTrackingStatus.missing => const PackageStatusGuidance(
            titleDe: 'Sendung nicht angekommen',
            titleAr: 'الشحنة لم تصل',
            detailDe:
                'Prüfen Sie Zustellort und Zustellnachweis und melden Sie die Abweichung mit der Sendungsnummer.',
            detailAr:
                'تحقق من مكان وإثبات التسليم ثم بلّغ عن المشكلة باستخدام رقم الشحنة.',
          ),
      };

  static const List<MissingPackageStep> missingPackageSteps =
      <MissingPackageStep>[
    MissingPackageStep(
      titleDe: 'Sendungsnummer und letzten Tracking-Scan sichern.',
      titleAr: 'احفظ رقم الشحنة وآخر تحديث للتتبع.',
    ),
    MissingPackageStep(
      titleDe: 'Ablageort, Nachbarn und Zustellnachweis prüfen.',
      titleAr: 'تحقق من مكان التسليم والجيران وإثبات التسليم.',
    ),
    MissingPackageStep(
      titleDe: 'Beim Zustelldienst eine sachliche Nachforschung anfragen.',
      titleAr: 'اطلب من شركة التوصيل فتح متابعة رسمية للشحنة.',
    ),
  ];

  static String _normalize(String value) {
    var normalized = value.toLowerCase();
    normalized = normalized
        .replaceAll('ä', 'a')
        .replaceAll('ö', 'o')
        .replaceAll('ü', 'u')
        .replaceAll('ß', 'ss');
    normalized = normalized.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-z0-9ء-ي ]'), ' ');
    return normalized.replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ').trim();
  }
}

import '../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import 'postal_logistics_sub_agent.dart';

abstract final class _ServicesUiTokens {
  static const double pageInset = 16;
  static const double sectionGap = 14;
  static const double itemGap = 10;
  static const double compactGap = 8;
  static const double fieldRadius = 18;
  static const double iconSize = 22;
  static const int softBorderAlpha = 88;
  static const int subtleBorderAlpha = 56;
  static const int selectedAlpha = 34;
}

final class ServicesMasterHubScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ServicesMasterHubScreen({
    this.orchestrator,
    this.postalAgent = const PostalLogisticsSubAgent(),
    this.telecomAgent = const TelecomSubAgent(),
    super.key,
  });

  final ServicesMasterOrchestrator? orchestrator;
  final PostalLogisticsSubAgent postalAgent;
  final TelecomSubAgent telecomAgent;

  @override
  State<ServicesMasterHubScreen> createState() =>
      _ServicesMasterHubScreenState();
}

final class _ServicesMasterHubScreenState
    extends State<ServicesMasterHubScreen> {
  late final ServicesMasterOrchestrator _orchestrator;
  late final TextEditingController _searchController;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _orchestrator = widget.orchestrator ??
        ServicesMasterOrchestrator(
          entries: <ServicePhrase>[
            ...PostalLogisticsSubAgent.entries,
            ...TelecomSubAgent.entries,
          ],
        );
    _searchController = TextEditingController(text: _orchestrator.query);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  TextDirection get _searchDirection =>
      RegExp(r'[ء-ي]').hasMatch(_searchController.text)
          ? TextDirection.rtl
          : TextDirection.ltr;

  Color _surface(BuildContext context) =>
      Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark
          ? AppColors.darkSurface
          : AppColors.lightSurface;

  void _setQuery(String value) {
    setState(() {
      _orchestrator.setQuery(value);
    });
  }

  void _toggleCategory(ServiceCategory category) {
    setState(() {
      _orchestrator.toggleCategory(category);
    });
  }

  void _setTrackingStatus(PackageTrackingStatus status) {
    setState(() {
      _orchestrator.setTrackingStatus(status);
    });
  }

  void _activateMissingPackage() {
    setState(() {
      _orchestrator.activateMissingPackagePanic();
    });
  }

  void _dismissMissingPackage() {
    setState(() {
      _orchestrator.dismissMissingPackagePanic();
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final entries = _orchestrator.visibleEntries;
    final surface = _surface(context);

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: SafeArea(
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(_ServicesUiTokens.pageInset),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: <Widget>[
              _HeaderCard(surface: surface),
              const SizedBox(height: _ServicesUiTokens.sectionGap),
              _TrackingCard(
                surface: surface,
                current: _orchestrator.trackingStatus,
                guidance: _orchestrator.trackingGuidance,
                onChanged: _setTrackingStatus,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: _ServicesUiTokens.sectionGap),
              _CategoryCard(
                surface: surface,
                selected: _orchestrator.selectedCategories,
                onToggle: _toggleCategory,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: _ServicesUiTokens.sectionGap),
              _SearchCard(
                surface: surface,
                controller: _searchController,
                textDirection: _searchDirection,
                onChanged: _setQuery,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: _ServicesUiTokens.sectionGap),
              _MissingPackageBar(
                surface: surface,
                expanded: _orchestrator.missingPackageExpanded,
                onActivate: _activateMissingPackage,
                onDismiss: _dismissMissingPackage,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: _ServicesUiTokens.sectionGap),
              _ResultsHeader(count: entries.length),
              const SizedBox(height: _ServicesUiTokens.itemGap),
              if (entries.isEmpty)
                _EmptyResultsCard(surface: surface)
              else
                for (var index = 0; index < entries.length; index++) ...<Widget>[
                  _ServicePhraseCard(
                    entry: entries[index],
                    surface: surface,
                  ),
                  if (index != entries.length - 1)
                    const SizedBox(height: _ServicesUiTokens.itemGap),
                ],
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

        key: ValueKey<String>('service-entry-${entry.id}'),

              entry.topicDe,
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.label,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: _ServicesUiTokens.compactGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              entry.german,
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.title,

            const SizedBox(height: _ServicesUiTokens.compactGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              entry.arabic,

              style: AppTypography.body,
            ),
          ],
        ),

}

enum QuickServiceCategory {
  shoeRepair,
  keyService,
}

extension QuickServiceCategoryLabels on QuickServiceCategory {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        QuickServiceCategory.shoeRepair => 'Schuhreparatur',
        QuickServiceCategory.keyService => 'Schlüsselservice',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        QuickServiceCategory.shoeRepair => 'تصليح الأحذية',
        QuickServiceCategory.keyService => 'خدمة المفاتيح',
      };
}

enum QuickServiceUrgency {
  normal,
  sameDay,
  urgentLockout,
}

extension QuickServiceUrgencyLabels on QuickServiceUrgency {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        QuickServiceUrgency.normal => 'Normal',
        QuickServiceUrgency.sameDay => 'Heute',
        QuickServiceUrgency.urgentLockout => 'Dringend',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        QuickServiceUrgency.normal => 'عادي',
        QuickServiceUrgency.sameDay => 'اليوم',
        QuickServiceUrgency.urgentLockout => 'عاجل',
      };
}

final class QuickServicePhrase {
  const QuickServicePhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.category,
    required this.topicDe,
    required this.topicAr,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    this.tags = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final QuickServiceCategory category;
  final String topicDe;
  final String topicAr;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final List<String> tags;
}

final class QuickServiceMasterHub {
  QuickServiceMasterHub({required Iterable<QuickServicePhrase> entries})
      : _entries = List<QuickServicePhrase>.unmodifiable(entries);

  final List<QuickServicePhrase> _entries;
  final Set<QuickServiceCategory> _selected = <QuickServiceCategory>{
    QuickServiceCategory.shoeRepair,
    QuickServiceCategory.keyService,
  };

  String _query = '';
  QuickServiceUrgency _urgency = QuickServiceUrgency.normal;

  String get query => _query;
  QuickServiceUrgency get urgency => _urgency;
  Set<QuickServiceCategory> get selected =>
      Set<QuickServiceCategory>.unmodifiable(_selected);

  List<QuickServicePhrase> get visibleEntries {
    final q = _normalize(_query);
    return List<QuickServicePhrase>.unmodifiable(
      _entries.where((entry) {
        if (!_selected.contains(entry.category)) return false;
        if (q.isEmpty) return true;
        final text = _normalize(<String>[
          entry.topicDe,
          entry.topicAr,
          entry.german,
          entry.arabic,
          ...entry.tags,
        ].join(' '));
        return text.contains(q);
      }),
    );
  }

  void setQuery(String value) => _query = value.trim();

  void toggleCategory(QuickServiceCategory category) {
    if (_selected.contains(category)) {
      _selected.remove(category);
    } else {
      _selected.add(category);
    }
  }

  void setUrgency(QuickServiceUrgency value) => _urgency = value;

  String get urgencyPromptDe => switch (_urgency) {
        QuickServiceUrgency.normal =>
          'Wann wäre die Reparatur oder Anfertigung voraussichtlich fertig?',
        QuickServiceUrgency.sameDay =>
          'Wäre eine Fertigstellung noch heute möglich, und kostet der Expressservice extra?',
        QuickServiceUrgency.urgentLockout =>
          'Ich bin ausgesperrt. Können Sie mir bitte den Gesamtpreis inklusive Anfahrt vorab nennen?',
      };

  String get urgencyPromptAr => switch (_urgency) {
        QuickServiceUrgency.normal =>
          'متى يُتوقع أن تكون عملية الإصلاح أو التجهيز جاهزة؟',
        QuickServiceUrgency.sameDay =>
          'هل يمكن إنهاء الخدمة اليوم، وهل توجد رسوم إضافية للخدمة السريعة؟',
        QuickServiceUrgency.urgentLockout =>
          'أنا خارج المنزل ولا أستطيع الدخول. هل يمكنكم إخباري بالسعر الإجمالي مع أجرة الوصول مسبقاً؟',
      };

  static String _normalize(String value) {
    var out = value.toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll('ä', 'a')
        .replaceAll('ö', 'o')
        .replaceAll('ü', 'u')
        .replaceAll('ß', 'ss');
    out = out.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-z0-9ء-ي ]'), ' ');
    return out.replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ').trim();
  }
}

abstract final class _QuickUi {
  static const double inset = 16;
  static const double gap = 14;
  static const double smallGap = 8;
  static const double radius = 18;
  static const int borderAlpha = 72;
  static const int selectedAlpha = 32;
}

final class ShoeRepairKeysMasterScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ShoeRepairKeysMasterScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<ShoeRepairKeysMasterScreen> createState() =>
      _ShoeRepairKeysMasterScreenState();
}

final class _ShoeRepairKeysMasterScreenState
    extends State<ShoeRepairKeysMasterScreen> {
  late final QuickServiceMasterHub _hub;
  final TextEditingController _search = TextEditingController();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _hub = QuickServiceMasterHub(
      entries: <QuickServicePhrase>[
        ...ShoeRepairAgent.entries,
        ...KeyServiceAgent.entries,
      ],
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _search.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Color _surface(BuildContext context) =>
      Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark
          ? AppColors.darkSurface
          : AppColors.lightSurface;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final surface = _surface(context);
    final entries = _hub.visibleEntries;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: SafeArea(
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(_QuickUi.inset),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: <Widget>[
              AppGlassCard(
                key: const ValueKey<String>('quick-services-header'),
                backgroundColor: surface,
                glowColor: AppColors.primary,
                borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(_QuickUi.borderAlpha),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    AppDirectionalText(
                      'الخدمات السريعة',
                      languageCode: 'ar',
                      style: AppTypography.title,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: _QuickUi.smallGap),
                    AppDirectionalText(
                      'Schuhreparatur & Schlüsselservice',
                      languageCode: 'de',
                      style: AppTypography.display.copyWith(
                        color: AppColors.primary,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: _QuickUi.smallGap),
                    AppDirectionalText(
                      'عبارات عملية لتصليح الأحذية، نسخ المفاتيح والاستفسار الآمن عن خدمة فتح الباب.',
                      languageCode: 'ar',
                      style: AppTypography.body,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: _QuickUi.gap),
              _UrgencyCard(
                surface: surface,
                hub: _hub,
                onChanged: () => setState(() {}),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: _QuickUi.gap),
              _CategoryCard(
                surface: surface,
                hub: _hub,
                onChanged: () => setState(() {}),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: _QuickUi.gap),
              AppGlassCard(
                backgroundColor: surface,
                borderColor:
                    AppColors.secondary.withAlpha(_QuickUi.borderAlpha),
                child: TextField(
                  key: const ValueKey<String>('quick-services-search'),

                  textDirection: RegExp(r'[ء-ي]').hasMatch(_search.text)

              const SizedBox(height: _QuickUi.smallGap),

final class _UrgencyCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _UrgencyCard({
    required this.surface,
    required this.hub,
    required this.onChanged,
  });

  final Color surface;
  final QuickServiceMasterHub hub;
  final VoidCallback onChanged;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        key: const ValueKey<String>('quick-services-urgency'),
        backgroundColor: surface,
        glowColor: AppColors.tertiary,
        borderColor: AppColors.tertiary.withAlpha(_QuickUi.borderAlpha),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            AppDirectionalText(
              'سرعة الخدمة',
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: _QuickUi.smallGap),
            Wrap(
              spacing: _QuickUi.smallGap,
              runSpacing: _QuickUi.smallGap,
              children: <Widget>[
                for (final urgency in QuickServiceUrgency.values)
                  ChoiceChip(
                    key: ValueKey<String>('quick-urgency-${urgency.name}'),
                    selected: hub.urgency == urgency,
                    selectedColor:
                        AppColors.tertiary.withAlpha(_QuickUi.selectedAlpha),
                    label: Column(
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      children: <Widget>[
                        AppDirectionalText(
                          urgency.labelAr,
                          languageCode: 'ar',
                          style: AppTypography.label,
                        ),
                        AppDirectionalText(
                          urgency.labelDe,
                          languageCode: 'de',
                          style: AppTypography.label,
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    onSelected: (_) {
                      hub.setUrgency(urgency);
                      onChanged();
                    },
                  ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: _QuickUi.smallGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              hub.urgencyPromptDe,
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(color: AppColors.tertiary),
            ),
            AppDirectionalText(
              hub.urgencyPromptAr,
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.body,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

final class _CategoryCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _CategoryCard({
    required this.surface,
    required this.hub,
    required this.onChanged,
  });

  final Color surface;
  final QuickServiceMasterHub hub;
  final VoidCallback onChanged;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        backgroundColor: surface,
        borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(_QuickUi.borderAlpha),
        child: Wrap(
          spacing: _QuickUi.smallGap,
          runSpacing: _QuickUi.smallGap,
          children: <Widget>[
            for (final category in QuickServiceCategory.values)
              FilterChip(
                key: ValueKey<String>('quick-category-${category.name}'),
                selected: hub.selected.contains(category),
                selectedColor:
                    AppColors.primary.withAlpha(_QuickUi.selectedAlpha),
                label: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    AppDirectionalText(
                      category.labelAr,
                      languageCode: 'ar',
                      style: AppTypography.label,
                    ),
                    AppDirectionalText(
                      category.labelDe,
                      languageCode: 'de',
                      style: AppTypography.label,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                onSelected: (_) {
                  hub.toggleCategory(category);
                  onChanged();
                },
              ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

final class _PhraseCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PhraseCard({required this.entry, required this.surface});

  Color get _accent => switch (entry.category) {
        QuickServiceCategory.shoeRepair => AppColors.primary,
        QuickServiceCategory.keyService => AppColors.secondary,
      };

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        key: ValueKey<String>('quick-entry-${entry.id}'),
        backgroundColor: surface,
        glowColor: _accent,
        borderColor: _accent.withAlpha(_QuickUi.borderAlpha),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            AppDirectionalText(
              entry.topicAr,
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(color: _accent),
            ),
            AppDirectionalText(
              entry.topicDe,
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.label,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: _QuickUi.smallGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              entry.german,
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: _QuickUi.smallGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              entry.arabic,
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.body,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

    ),

  @override
  List<ShoppingPhrase> get phrases => _items;

  @override
  List<ShoppingPhrase> search(
    String query, {
    ShoppingLevel? level,
  }) =>
      _searchAgentItems(_items, query, level);

  List<ShoppingPhrase> get panicPhrases => List<ShoppingPhrase>.unmodifiable(
        _items.where((item) => item.isPanicPhrase),
      );
}

List<ShoppingPhrase> _searchAgentItems(
  List<ShoppingPhrase> source,
  String query,
  ShoppingLevel? level,
) {
  final results = source.where((item) {
    final levelMatches = level == null || item.level == level;
    return levelMatches && item.matches(query);
  }).toList(growable: false);

  return List<ShoppingPhrase>.unmodifiable(results);
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/shopping_models.dart';

final class ShoppingMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  ShoppingMasterOrchestrator({
    required ShoppingSubAgent groceryAgent,
    required ShoppingSubAgent returnWarrantyAgent,
  })  : _groceryAgent = groceryAgent,
        _returnWarrantyAgent = returnWarrantyAgent {
    if (_groceryAgent.type != ShoppingAgentType.grocery) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        groceryAgent.type,
        'groceryAgent',
        'must expose ShoppingAgentType.grocery',
      );
    }
    if (_returnWarrantyAgent.type != ShoppingAgentType.returnWarranty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        returnWarrantyAgent.type,
        'returnWarrantyAgent',
        'must expose ShoppingAgentType.returnWarranty',
      );
    }
  }

  final ShoppingSubAgent _groceryAgent;
  final ShoppingSubAgent _returnWarrantyAgent;

  String _query = '';
  ShoppingLevel? _activeLevel;
  bool _isPanicBarOpen = false;

  String get query => _query;
  ShoppingLevel? get activeLevel => _activeLevel;
  bool get isPanicBarOpen => _isPanicBarOpen;

  List<ShoppingPhrase> get results => List<ShoppingPhrase>.unmodifiable(
        <ShoppingPhrase>[
          ..._groceryAgent.search(_query, level: _activeLevel),
          ..._returnWarrantyAgent.search(_query, level: _activeLevel),
        ],
      );

  List<ShoppingPhrase> get panicPhrases => List<ShoppingPhrase>.unmodifiable(
        <ShoppingPhrase>[
          ..._groceryAgent.panicPhrases,
          ..._returnWarrantyAgent.panicPhrases,
        ],
      );

  int get groceryResultCount =>
      results.where((item) => item.agent == ShoppingAgentType.grocery).length;

  int get returnWarrantyResultCount => results
      .where((item) => item.agent == ShoppingAgentType.returnWarranty)
      .length;

  void setQuery(String value) {
    final next = value.trim();
    if (_query == next) return;
    _query = next;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearSearch() {
    if (_query.isEmpty) return;
    _query = '';
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setLevel(ShoppingLevel? level) {
    if (_activeLevel == level) return;
    _activeLevel = level;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void togglePanicBar() {
    _isPanicBarOpen = !_isPanicBarOpen;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void closePanicBar() {
    if (!_isPanicBarOpen) return;
    _isPanicBarOpen = false;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void resetFilters() {
    final changed = _query.isNotEmpty || _activeLevel != null;
    _query = '';
    _activeLevel = null;
    if (changed) notifyListeners();
  }
}

enum ShoppingLevel {
  a1a2,
  b1,
  b2,
}

extension ShoppingLevelLabels on ShoppingLevel {
  String get germanLabel => switch (this) {
        ShoppingLevel.a1a2 => 'A1 / A2',
        ShoppingLevel.b1 => 'B1',
        ShoppingLevel.b2 => 'B2',
      };

  String get arabicLabel => switch (this) {
        ShoppingLevel.a1a2 => 'أساسي A1/A2',
        ShoppingLevel.b1 => 'متوسط B1',
        ShoppingLevel.b2 => 'متقدم B2',
      };
}

enum ShoppingAgentType {
  grocery,
  returnWarranty,
}

extension ShoppingAgentTypeLabels on ShoppingAgentType {
  String get germanLabel => switch (this) {
        ShoppingAgentType.grocery => 'Supermarkt & Lebensmittel',
        ShoppingAgentType.returnWarranty => 'Umtausch & Reklamation',
      };

  String get arabicLabel => switch (this) {
        ShoppingAgentType.grocery => 'السوبرماركت والمواد الغذائية',
        ShoppingAgentType.returnWarranty => 'الاستبدال والشكاوى والضمان',
      };
}

final class ShoppingPhrase {
  const ShoppingPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.level,
    required this.agent,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.usageArabic,
    required this.searchTags,
    this.isPanicPhrase = false,
  });

  final String id;
  final ShoppingLevel level;
  final ShoppingAgentType agent;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String usageArabic;
  final List<String> searchTags;
  final bool isPanicPhrase;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final normalized = normalizeShoppingSearch(query);
    if (normalized.isEmpty) return true;

    final searchable = <String>[
      german,
      arabic,
      usageArabic,
      ...searchTags,
    ].map(normalizeShoppingSearch);

    return searchable.any((value) => value.contains(normalized));
  }
}

abstract interface class ShoppingSubAgent {
  ShoppingAgentType get type;

  List<ShoppingPhrase> get phrases;

  List<ShoppingPhrase> search(
    String query, {
    ShoppingLevel? level,
  });

  List<ShoppingPhrase> get panicPhrases;
}

String normalizeShoppingSearch(String value) => value
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[.!?,;:()\[\]{}"“”„]'), '')
    .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');

import '../../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import '../application/shopping_master_orchestrator.dart';
import '../domain/shopping_models.dart';

abstract final class ShoppingUiTokens {
  static const double pageHorizontal = 16;
  static const double pageTop = 18;
  static const double pageBottom = 28;
  static const double gapXs = 6;
  static const double gapSm = 10;
  static const double gapMd = 14;
  static const double gapLg = 18;
  static const double chipHorizontal = 12;
  static const double chipVertical = 9;
  static const double iconSm = 20;
  static const double iconMd = 28;
  static const double iconLg = 36;
  static const double panicIcon = 24;
}

final class ShoppingMasterScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ShoppingMasterScreen({
    required this.orchestrator,
    super.key,
  });

  final ShoppingMasterOrchestrator orchestrator;

  @override
  State<ShoppingMasterScreen> createState() => _ShoppingMasterScreenState();
}

final class _ShoppingMasterScreenState extends State<ShoppingMasterScreen> {
  late final TextEditingController _searchController;

  ShoppingMasterOrchestrator get orchestrator => widget.orchestrator;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _searchController = TextEditingController(text: orchestrator.query);
    orchestrator.addListener(_refresh);
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant ShoppingMasterScreen oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.orchestrator == orchestrator) return;
    oldWidget.orchestrator.removeListener(_refresh);
    orchestrator.addListener(_refresh);
    _searchController.text = orchestrator.query;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    orchestrator.removeListener(_refresh);
    _searchController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _refresh() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (_searchController.text != orchestrator.query) {
      _searchController.text = orchestrator.query;
      _searchController.selection = TextSelection.collapsed(
        offset: _searchController.text.length,
      );
    }
    setState(() {});
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface = dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface;
    final border =
        dark ? AppColors.glassBorderDark : AppColors.glassBorderLight;
    final results = orchestrator.results;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              ShoppingUiTokens.pageHorizontal,
              ShoppingUiTokens.pageTop,
              ShoppingUiTokens.pageHorizontal,
              ShoppingUiTokens.pageBottom,
            ),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: <Widget>[
                _HeaderCard(surface: surface, border: border),
                const SizedBox(height: ShoppingUiTokens.gapMd),
                _SearchCard(
                  controller: _searchController,
                  query: orchestrator.query,
                  surface: surface,
                  border: border,
                  onChanged: orchestrator.setQuery,
                  onClear: () {
                    _searchController.clear();
                    orchestrator.clearSearch();
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: ShoppingUiTokens.gapMd),
                _LevelFilters(
                  activeLevel: orchestrator.activeLevel,
                  surface: surface,
                  border: border,
                  onSelected: orchestrator.setLevel,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: ShoppingUiTokens.gapMd),
                _PanicBar(
                  isOpen: orchestrator.isPanicBarOpen,
                  phrases: orchestrator.panicPhrases,
                  surface: surface,
                  border: border,
                  onToggle: orchestrator.togglePanicBar,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: ShoppingUiTokens.gapMd),
                _ResultSummary(
                  total: results.length,
                  groceryCount: orchestrator.groceryResultCount,
                  returnCount: orchestrator.returnWarrantyResultCount,
                  surface: surface,
                  border: border,
                  canReset: orchestrator.query.isNotEmpty ||
                      orchestrator.activeLevel != null,
                  onReset: () {
                    _searchController.clear();
                    orchestrator.resetFilters();
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: ShoppingUiTokens.gapMd),
                if (results.isEmpty)
                  _EmptyResults(surface: surface, border: border)
                else
                  for (var index = 0; index < results.length; index += 1) ...[
                    _PhraseCard(
                      phrase: results[index],
                      surface: surface,
                      border: border,
                    ),
                    if (index != results.length - 1)
                      const SizedBox(height: ShoppingUiTokens.gapSm),
                  ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _SearchCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _SearchCard({
    required this.controller,
    required this.query,
    required this.surface,
    required this.border,
    required this.onChanged,
    required this.onClear,
  });

  final TextEditingController controller;
  final String query;
  final Color surface;
  final Color border;
  final ValueChanged<String> onChanged;
  final VoidCallback onClear;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final direction = _directionForQuery(query);

    return AppGlassCard(
      backgroundColor: surface,
      borderColor: border,
      glowColor: AppColors.secondary,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          AppDirectionalText(
            'ابحث بالألمانية أو العربية',
            languageCode: 'ar',
            style: AppTypography.title,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: ShoppingUiTokens.gapSm),
          Directionality(
            textDirection: direction,
            child: TextField(
              controller: controller,
              textDirection: direction,
              style: AppTypography.body,
              textInputAction: TextInputAction.search,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                hintText: 'Zutaten · Kasse · Rechnung · مكونات · ضمان',
                prefixIcon: const Icon(
                  Icons.search_rounded,
                  color: AppColors.primary,
                  size: ShoppingUiTokens.iconSm,
                ),
                suffixIcon: query.isEmpty
                    ? null
                    : IconButton(
                        onPressed: onClear,
                        icon: const Icon(
                          Icons.close_rounded,
                          color: AppColors.secondary,
                          size: ShoppingUiTokens.iconSm,
                        ),
                      ),
              ),
              onChanged: onChanged,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _LevelFilters extends StatelessWidget {
  const _LevelFilters({
    required this.activeLevel,
    required this.surface,
    required this.border,
    required this.onSelected,
  });

  final ShoppingLevel? activeLevel;
  final Color surface;
  final Color border;
  final ValueChanged<ShoppingLevel?> onSelected;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final levels = <ShoppingLevel?>[null, ...ShoppingLevel.values];

    return AppGlassCard(
      backgroundColor: surface,
      borderColor: border,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          AppDirectionalText(
            'فلترة المستوى',
            languageCode: 'ar',
            style: AppTypography.title,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: ShoppingUiTokens.gapSm),
          Wrap(
            spacing: ShoppingUiTokens.gapSm,
            runSpacing: ShoppingUiTokens.gapSm,
            children: <Widget>[
              for (final level in levels)
                AppGlassCard(
                  onTap: () => onSelected(level),
                  backgroundColor: surface,
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                    horizontal: ShoppingUiTokens.chipHorizontal,
                    vertical: ShoppingUiTokens.chipVertical,
                  ),
                  borderColor:
                      activeLevel == level ? AppColors.primary : border,
                  glowColor:
                      activeLevel == level ? AppColors.primary : null,
                  child: AppDirectionalText(
                    level?.germanLabel ?? 'Alle',
                    languageCode: 'de',
                    style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
                      color:
                          activeLevel == level ? AppColors.primary : null,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

                    languageCode: 'ar',
                    style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(
                      color: AppColors.tertiary,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                Icon(
                  isOpen
                      ? Icons.expand_less_rounded
                      : Icons.expand_more_rounded,
                  color: AppColors.tertiary,
                  size: ShoppingUiTokens.iconMd,
                ),
              ],
            ),
            if (isOpen) ...<Widget>[
              const SizedBox(height: ShoppingUiTokens.gapMd),
              for (var index = 0; index < phrases.length; index += 1) ...[
                _PanicPhrase(phrase: phrases[index]),
                if (index != phrases.length - 1)
                  const SizedBox(height: ShoppingUiTokens.gapSm),
              ],
            ],
          ],
        ),
      );
}

  }
}

Color _agentAccent(ShoppingAgentType agent) => switch (agent) {
      ShoppingAgentType.grocery => AppColors.secondary,
      ShoppingAgentType.returnWarranty => AppColors.tertiary,
    };

TextDirection _directionForQuery(String query) {
  final hasArabic = RegExp(r'[\u0600-\u06FF]').hasMatch(query);
  return hasArabic ? TextDirection.rtl : TextDirection.ltr;
}

FILE: lib/features/life_social/social_master_orchestrator.dart

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'neighborhood_sub_agent.dart';
import 'occasions_sub_agent.dart';
import 'social_models.dart';

final class SocialMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  SocialMasterOrchestrator({
    NeighborhoodSubAgent neighborhood = const NeighborhoodSubAgent(),
    OccasionsSubAgent occasions = const OccasionsSubAgent(),
  })  : _neighborhood = neighborhood,
        _occasions = occasions;

  final NeighborhoodSubAgent _neighborhood;
  final OccasionsSubAgent _occasions;

  SocialTone _tone = SocialTone.sie;
  SocialCategory _category = SocialCategory.neighborhood;
  String _query = '';

  SocialTone get tone => _tone;
  SocialCategory get category => _category;
  String get query => _query;

  List<String> get quickResponses => switch (_tone) {
        SocialTone.du => const <String>[
            'Danke dir, sehr freundlich.',
            'Kein Problem, gern.',
            'Entschuldige bitte die Umstände.',
          ],
        SocialTone.sie => const <String>[
            'Vielen Dank, das ist sehr freundlich.',
            'Kein Problem, sehr gern.',
            'Entschuldigen Sie bitte die Umstände.',
          ],
      };

  List<SocialPhrase> get visiblePhrases {
    final source = switch (_category) {
      SocialCategory.neighborhood => _neighborhood.phrases,
      SocialCategory.occasions => _occasions.phrases,
    };
    return List<SocialPhrase>.unmodifiable(
      source.where((phrase) => phrase.matches(_query)),
    );
  }

  void setTone(SocialTone value) {
    if (_tone == value) return;
    _tone = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setCategory(SocialCategory value) {
    if (_category == value) return;
    _category = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearSearch() => setQuery('');
}


--------------------------------------------------
FILE: lib/features/life_social/social_models.dart
--------------------------------------------------
enum SocialTone { du, sie }

enum SocialCategory { neighborhood, occasions }

extension SocialToneLabels on SocialTone {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        SocialTone.du => 'Du',
        SocialTone.sie => 'Sie',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        SocialTone.du => 'غير رسمي',
        SocialTone.sie => 'رسمي',
      };
}

extension SocialCategoryLabels on SocialCategory {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        SocialCategory.neighborhood => 'Nachbarschaft',
        SocialCategory.occasions => 'Anlässe',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        SocialCategory.neighborhood => 'الجيرة',
        SocialCategory.occasions => 'المناسبات',
      };
}

final class SocialPhrase {
  const SocialPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.category,
    required this.germanDu,
    required this.germanSie,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.contextDe,
    required this.contextAr,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final SocialCategory category;
  final String germanDu;
  final String germanSie;
  final String arabic;
  final String contextDe;
  final String contextAr;
  final List<String> keywords;

  String germanFor(SocialTone tone) => switch (tone) {
        SocialTone.du => germanDu,
        SocialTone.sie => germanSie,
      };

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;

    final haystack = <String>[
      germanDu,
      germanSie,
      arabic,
      contextDe,
      contextAr,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase();

    return haystack.contains(needle);
  }
}

import '../../design_system/design_system.dart';

abstract final class SocialUiTokens {
  static const double pageInset = 16;
  static const double bottomInset = 32;
  static const double sectionGap = 18;
  static const double itemGap = 12;
  static const double compactGap = 8;
}

final class SocialMasterHub extends StatefulWidget {
  const SocialMasterHub({
    this.orchestrator,
    super.key,
  });

  final SocialMasterOrchestrator? orchestrator;

  @override
  State<SocialMasterHub> createState() => _SocialMasterHubState();
}

final class _SocialMasterHubState extends State<SocialMasterHub> {
  late final SocialMasterOrchestrator _orchestrator;
  late final bool _ownsOrchestrator;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ownsOrchestrator = widget.orchestrator == null;
    _orchestrator = widget.orchestrator ?? SocialMasterOrchestrator();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    if (_ownsOrchestrator) {
      _orchestrator.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              SocialUiTokens.pageInset,
              SocialUiTokens.pageInset,
              SocialUiTokens.pageInset,
              SocialUiTokens.bottomInset,
            ),
            child: AnimatedBuilder(
              animation: _orchestrator,
              builder: (context, _) => Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  _HeaderCard(dark: dark),
                  const SizedBox(height: SocialUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _ToneSelector(orchestrator: _orchestrator, dark: dark),
                  const SizedBox(height: SocialUiTokens.itemGap),
                  _SearchField(orchestrator: _orchestrator),
                  const SizedBox(height: SocialUiTokens.itemGap),
                  _CategorySelector(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: SocialUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _QuickResponsesBar(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: SocialUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _PhraseList(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _PhraseList extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PhraseList({
    required this.orchestrator,
    required this.dark,
  });

  final SocialMasterOrchestrator orchestrator;
  final bool dark;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final phrases = orchestrator.visiblePhrases;
    if (phrases.isEmpty) {
      return AppGlassCard(
        borderColor: AppColors.tertiary.withAlpha(96),
        backgroundColor: dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
        child: AppDirectionalText(
          'لا توجد نتائج في هذا القسم. جرّب كلمة بحث أخرى.',
          languageCode: 'ar',
          style: AppTypography.body,
        ),
      );
    }

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: <Widget>[
        for (var index = 0; index < phrases.length; index++) ...<Widget>[
          _PhraseCard(
            phrase: phrases[index],
            tone: orchestrator.tone,
            dark: dark,
          ),
          if (index != phrases.length - 1)
            const SizedBox(height: SocialUiTokens.itemGap),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }
}

final class _PhraseCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PhraseCard({
    required this.phrase,
    required this.tone,
    required this.dark,
  });

  final SocialPhrase phrase;
  final SocialTone tone;
  final bool dark;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(80),
        backgroundColor: dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            AppDirectionalText(
              phrase.contextDe,
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.label,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: SocialUiTokens.compactGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              phrase.germanFor(tone),
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: SocialUiTokens.compactGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              phrase.arabic,
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.body,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: SocialUiTokens.compactGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              phrase.contextAr,
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.label,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

--------------------------------------------------
FILE: lib/features/life_sports/sports_master_orchestrator.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'community_club_sub_agent.dart';
import 'gym_fitness_sub_agent.dart';
import 'sports_models.dart';

final class SportsMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  SportsMasterOrchestrator({
    GymFitnessSubAgent gymAgent = const GymFitnessSubAgent(),
    CommunityClubSubAgent clubAgent = const CommunityClubSubAgent(),
  })  : _gymAgent = gymAgent,
        _clubAgent = clubAgent;

  final GymFitnessSubAgent _gymAgent;
  final CommunityClubSubAgent _clubAgent;

  SportsFacilityType _facility = SportsFacilityType.all;
  SportsLevel? _level;
  String _query = '';
  bool _pauseExpanded = false;

  SportsFacilityType get facility => _facility;
  SportsLevel? get level => _level;
  String get query => _query;
  bool get pauseExpanded => _pauseExpanded;

  String get membershipPauseGerman =>
      'Ich möchte meine Mitgliedschaft vorübergehend pausieren. '
      'Welche Ruhezeit ist laut meinem Vertrag möglich?';

  String get membershipPauseArabic =>
      'أريد إيقاف عضويتي مؤقتًا. ما مدة التجميد المتاحة وفق عقدي؟';

  String get membershipPauseNoteGerman =>
      'Ruhezeiten, Nachweise und Gebühren richten sich nach dem jeweiligen Vertrag.';

  String get membershipPauseNoteArabic =>
      'مدة التجميد والمستندات والرسوم تعتمد على عقد النادي نفسه.';

  List<SportsPhrase> get allPhrases => List<SportsPhrase>.unmodifiable(
        <SportsPhrase>[
          ..._gymAgent.phrases,
          ..._clubAgent.phrases,
        ],
      );

  List<SportsPhrase> get visiblePhrases {
    final normalizedQuery = _normalize(_query);
    final result = allPhrases.where((item) {
      final facilityMatches = _facility == SportsFacilityType.all ||
          item.facility == _facility;
      final levelMatches = _level == null || item.level == _level;
      final queryMatches = normalizedQuery.isEmpty ||
          _normalize(item.searchableText).contains(normalizedQuery);

      return facilityMatches && levelMatches && queryMatches;
    }).toList(growable: false);

    return List<SportsPhrase>.unmodifiable(result);
  }

  void setFacility(SportsFacilityType value) {
    if (_facility == value) return;
    _facility = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setLevel(SportsLevel? value) {
    if (_level == value) return;
    _level = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearFilters() {
    final alreadyClear = _facility == SportsFacilityType.all &&
        _level == null &&
        _query.isEmpty;
    if (alreadyClear) return;

    _facility = SportsFacilityType.all;
    _level = null;
    _query = '';
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void togglePauseDetails() {
    _pauseExpanded = !_pauseExpanded;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  static String _normalize(String value) {
    return value
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll('ä', 'a')
        .replaceAll('ö', 'o')
        .replaceAll('ü', 'u')
        .replaceAll('ß', 'ss')
        .replaceAll('ـ', '');
  }
}

enum SportsFacilityType {
  all,
  gym,
  communityClub;

  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        SportsFacilityType.all => 'Alle',
        SportsFacilityType.gym => 'Fitnessstudio',
        SportsFacilityType.communityClub => 'Sportverein',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        SportsFacilityType.all => 'الكل',
        SportsFacilityType.gym => 'النادي الرياضي',
        SportsFacilityType.communityClub => 'النادي المجتمعي',
      };
}

enum SportsLevel {
  a2,
  b1,
  b2;

  String get label => name.toUpperCase();
}

enum SportsTopic {
  trialTraining,
  equipment,
  hygiene,
  coaching,
  contract,
  registration,
  membershipFees,
  schedule;

  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        SportsTopic.trialTraining => 'Probetraining',
        SportsTopic.equipment => 'Geräte',
        SportsTopic.hygiene => 'Hygiene',
        SportsTopic.coaching => 'Training',
        SportsTopic.contract => 'Vertrag',
        SportsTopic.registration => 'Anmeldung',
        SportsTopic.membershipFees => 'Mitgliedsbeitrag',
        SportsTopic.schedule => 'Trainingsplan',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        SportsTopic.trialTraining => 'تجربة تدريب',
        SportsTopic.equipment => 'الأجهزة',
        SportsTopic.hygiene => 'النظافة',
        SportsTopic.coaching => 'التدريب',
        SportsTopic.contract => 'العقد',
        SportsTopic.registration => 'التسجيل',
        SportsTopic.membershipFees => 'رسوم العضوية',
        SportsTopic.schedule => 'المواعيد',
      };
}

final class SportsPhrase {
  const SportsPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.facility,
    required this.level,
    required this.topic,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    this.noteDe,
    this.noteAr,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final SportsFacilityType facility;
  final SportsLevel level;
  final SportsTopic topic;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String? noteDe;
  final String? noteAr;
  final List<String> keywords;

  String get searchableText => <String>[
        titleDe,
        titleAr,
        german,
        arabic,
        topic.labelDe,
        topic.labelAr,
        ...keywords,
      ].join(' ');
}

import 'package:deutsch_bilarabi/features/phase3_integration/life_feature_text.dart';

import '../../design_system/app_colors.dart';
import '../../design_system/app_glass_card.dart';
import '../../design_system/app_typography.dart' hide AppDirectionalText;
import 'sports_master_orchestrator.dart';
import 'sports_models.dart';

abstract final class _SportsUiTokens {
  static const double pageInset = 16;
  static const double sectionGap = 14;
  static const double contentGap = 10;
  static const double controlGap = 8;
  static const double iconSize = 22;
}

class SportsMasterHub extends StatefulWidget {
  const SportsMasterHub({
    this.orchestrator,
    super.key,
  });

  final SportsMasterOrchestrator? orchestrator;

  @override
  State<SportsMasterHub> createState() => _SportsMasterHubState();
}

class _SportsMasterHubState extends State<SportsMasterHub> {
  late final SportsMasterOrchestrator _orchestrator;
  late final bool _ownsOrchestrator;
  late final TextEditingController _searchController;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ownsOrchestrator = widget.orchestrator == null;
    _orchestrator = widget.orchestrator ?? SportsMasterOrchestrator();
    _searchController = TextEditingController(text: _orchestrator.query);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchController.dispose();
    if (_ownsOrchestrator) {
      _orchestrator.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: _orchestrator,
      builder: (context, _) {
        final phrases = _orchestrator.visiblePhrases;
        return Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(
            title: AppDirectionalText(
              'Sport & Fitness',
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
          ),
          body: SafeArea(
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(_SportsUiTokens.pageInset),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  _HeaderCard(count: phrases.length),
                  const SizedBox(height: _SportsUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _FacilityFilter(orchestrator: _orchestrator),
                  const SizedBox(height: _SportsUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _SearchAndLevelCard(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    searchController: _searchController,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: _SportsUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _MembershipPauseBar(orchestrator: _orchestrator),
                  const SizedBox(height: _SportsUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  if (phrases.isEmpty)
                    const _EmptyState()
                  else
                    for (final phrase in phrases) ...<Widget>[
                      _PhraseCard(phrase: phrase),
                      const SizedBox(height: _SportsUiTokens.contentGap),
                    ],
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

final class _HeaderCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _HeaderCard({required this.count});

  final int count;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    return AppGlassCard(
      glowColor: AppColors.primary,
      borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(78),
      backgroundColor: dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          AppDirectionalText(
            'Fitnessstudio & Sportverein',
            languageCode: 'de',
            style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(color: AppColors.primary),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: _SportsUiTokens.controlGap),
          AppDirectionalText(
            'عبارات يومية صحية للتدريب والعضوية والرياضة المجتمعية.',
            languageCode: 'ar',
            style: AppTypography.body,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: _SportsUiTokens.controlGap),
          AppDirectionalText(
            'Treffer: ' + count.toString(),
            languageCode: 'de',
            style: AppTypography.label,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _FacilityFilter extends StatelessWidget {
  const _FacilityFilter({required this.orchestrator});

  final SportsMasterOrchestrator orchestrator;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {

enum CheckoutSituation {
  pfand,
  checkout,
  returnExchange,
}

final class CheckoutPhrase {
  const CheckoutPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.kind,
    required this.topicDe,
    required this.topicAr,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final CheckoutSituation kind;
  final String topicDe;
  final String topicAr;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = _normalize(query);
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;

    final haystack = _normalize(
      <String>[
        topicDe,
        topicAr,
        german,
        arabic,
        ...keywords,
      ].join(' '),
    );
    return haystack.contains(needle);
  }

  static String _normalize(String value) {
    var normalized = value.toLowerCase();
    normalized = normalized
        .replaceAll('ä', 'a')
        .replaceAll('ö', 'o')
        .replaceAll('ü', 'u')
        .replaceAll('ß', 'ss');
    normalized = normalized.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-z0-9ء-ي ]'), ' ');
    return normalized.replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ').trim();
  }
}

enum ProductInquiryKind {
  location,
  dietaryIngredients,
  freshCounter,
}

final class ProductInquiryPhrase {
  const ProductInquiryPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.kind,
    required this.topicDe,
    required this.topicAr,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final ProductInquiryKind kind;
  final String topicDe;
  final String topicAr;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
