    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;

    final haystack = _normalize(
      <String>[
        topicDe,
        topicAr,
        german,
        arabic,
        ...keywords,
      ].join(' '),
    );
    return haystack.contains(needle);
  }

  static String _normalize(String value) {
    var normalized = value.toLowerCase();
    normalized = normalized
        .replaceAll('ä', 'a')

        .replaceAll('ü', 'u')

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'supermarket_models.dart';

final class SupermarketMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  SupermarketMasterOrchestrator({
    List<GroceryProduct> products = _defaultProducts,
    List<GroceryOffer> offers = _defaultOffers,
    Kassenbon receipt = _defaultReceipt,
  })  : products = List<GroceryProduct>.unmodifiable(products),
        offers = List<GroceryOffer>.unmodifiable(offers),
        receipt = receipt;

  final List<GroceryProduct> products;
  final List<GroceryOffer> offers;
  final Kassenbon receipt;

  String _query = '';

  String get query => _query;

  List<GroceryProduct> get visibleProducts => List<GroceryProduct>.unmodifiable(
        products.where((product) => product.matches(_query)),
      );

  List<GroceryOffer> get visibleOffers => List<GroceryOffer>.unmodifiable(
        offers.where((offer) {
          if (offer.matches(_query)) return true;
          final product = products.where((item) => item.id == offer.productId);
          return product.isNotEmpty && product.first.matches(_query);
        }),
      );

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearSearch() => setQuery('');

  static const List<GroceryProduct> _defaultProducts = <GroceryProduct>[
    GroceryProduct(
      id: 'product-oats',
      nameDe: 'Haferflocken',
      nameAr: 'رقائق الشوفان',

      ingredientNoteDe:
          'Beispieldatensatz: Kennzeichnungen immer auf der aktuellen Packung prüfen.',
      ingredientNoteAr:
          'بيانات تعليمية: يجب دائمًا التحقق من العلامات على العبوة الحالية.',
      dietaryFlags: <GroceryDietFlag>{
        GroceryDietFlag.vegan,
        GroceryDietFlag.glutenFree,
      },
    ),
    GroceryProduct(
      id: 'product-milk',
      nameDe: 'Vollmilch',
      nameAr: 'حليب كامل الدسم',
      aisleDe: 'Kühlregal',
      aisleAr: 'الثلاجات',
      ingredientNoteDe: 'Milchprodukt; Zutaten- und Allergenhinweise prüfen.',
      ingredientNoteAr: 'منتج حليب؛ تحقق من المكونات وتحذيرات الحساسية.',
    ),
    GroceryProduct(
      id: 'product-cheese',
      nameDe: 'Gouda am Stück',
      nameAr: 'جبنة غودا قطعة كاملة',
      aisleDe: 'Kühlregal / Käsetheke',
      aisleAr: 'الثلاجات أو قسم الأجبان',
      ingredientNoteDe:
          'Bei loser Ware Zutaten und Allergene direkt an der Theke erfragen.',
      ingredientNoteAr:
          'عند شراء منتج غير معبأ اسأل موظف القسم مباشرة عن المكونات والحساسيات.',
    ),
  ];

  static const List<GroceryOffer> _defaultOffers = <GroceryOffer>[
    GroceryOffer(
      id: 'offer-oats',
      productId: 'product-oats',
      labelDe: 'Angebot: Haferflocken',

enum GroceryDietFlag {
  vegan,
  glutenFree,
  halalCertified,
  containsPork,
}

extension GroceryDietFlagLabels on GroceryDietFlag {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        GroceryDietFlag.vegan => 'Vegan',
        GroceryDietFlag.glutenFree => 'Glutenfrei',
        GroceryDietFlag.halalCertified => 'Halal-zertifiziert',
        GroceryDietFlag.containsPork => 'Enthält Schweinefleisch',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        GroceryDietFlag.vegan => 'نباتي بالكامل',
        GroceryDietFlag.glutenFree => 'خالٍ من الغلوتين',
        GroceryDietFlag.halalCertified => 'معتمد حلال',
        GroceryDietFlag.containsPork => 'يحتوي على مشتقات الخنزير',
      };
}

final class GroceryProduct {
  const GroceryProduct({
    required this.id,
    required this.nameDe,
    required this.nameAr,
    required this.aisleDe,
    required this.aisleAr,
    this.ingredientNoteDe = '',
    this.ingredientNoteAr = '',
    this.dietaryFlags = const <GroceryDietFlag>{},
  });

  final String id;
  final String nameDe;
  final String nameAr;
  final String aisleDe;
  final String aisleAr;
  final String ingredientNoteDe;
  final String ingredientNoteAr;
  final Set<GroceryDietFlag> dietaryFlags;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = _normalize(query);
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;

    final haystack = _normalize(
      <String>[
        nameDe,
        nameAr,
        aisleDe,
        aisleAr,
        ingredientNoteDe,
        ingredientNoteAr,
        ...dietaryFlags.map((flag) => flag.labelDe),
        ...dietaryFlags.map((flag) => flag.labelAr),
      ].join(' '),
    );
    return haystack.contains(needle);
  }
}

final class GroceryOffer {
  const GroceryOffer({
    required this.id,
    required this.productId,
    required this.labelDe,
    required this.labelAr,
    required this.priceEuro,
    required this.unitLabel,
  });

  final String id;
  final String productId;
  final String labelDe;
  final String labelAr;
  final double priceEuro;
  final String unitLabel;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = _normalize(query);
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;
    return _normalize('$labelDe $labelAr $unitLabel').contains(needle);
  }
}

final class ReceiptLine {
  const ReceiptLine({
    required this.label,
    required this.quantity,
    required this.unitPriceEuro,
  });

  final String label;
  final int quantity;
  final double unitPriceEuro;

  double get total => quantity * unitPriceEuro;
}

final class Kassenbon {
  const Kassenbon({
    required this.id,
    required this.lines,
  });

  final String id;
  final List<ReceiptLine> lines;

  double get total => lines.fold<double>(
        0,
        (sum, line) => sum + line.total,
      );
}

final class SupermarketModuleRoute {
  const SupermarketModuleRoute({
    required this.id,
    required this.labelDe,
    required this.labelAr,
    required this.relativePath,
  });

  final String id;
  final String labelDe;
  final String labelAr;
  final String relativePath;
}

String _normalize(String value) {
  var normalized = value.toLowerCase();
  normalized = normalized
      .replaceAll('ä', 'a')
      .replaceAll('ö', 'o')
      .replaceAll('ü', 'u')
      .replaceAll('ß', 'ss');
  normalized = normalized.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-z0-9ء-ي ]'), ' ');
  return normalized.replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ').trim();
}

abstract final class SupermarketUiTokens {
  static const double pageInset = 16;
  static const double bottomInset = 32;
  static const double sectionGap = 18;
  static const double itemGap = 12;
  static const double compactGap = 8;
  static const int softBorderAlpha = 88;
  static const int subtleBorderAlpha = 56;
}

final class SupermarketGroceriesMasterHub extends StatefulWidget {
  const SupermarketGroceriesMasterHub({
    this.module = const SupermarketGroceriesModule(),
    super.key,
  });

  final SupermarketGroceriesModule module;

  @override
  State<SupermarketGroceriesMasterHub> createState() =>
      _SupermarketGroceriesMasterHubState();
}

final class _SupermarketGroceriesMasterHubState
    extends State<SupermarketGroceriesMasterHub> {
  late final SupermarketMasterOrchestrator _orchestrator;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _orchestrator = widget.module.createOrchestrator();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _orchestrator.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              SupermarketUiTokens.pageInset,
              SupermarketUiTokens.pageInset,
              SupermarketUiTokens.pageInset,
              SupermarketUiTokens.bottomInset,
            ),
            child: AnimatedBuilder(
              animation: _orchestrator,
              builder: (context, _) => Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  _HeaderCard(dark: dark),
                  const SizedBox(height: SupermarketUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _SearchField(orchestrator: _orchestrator),
                  const SizedBox(height: SupermarketUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _ModuleRoutesCard(
                    routes: widget.module.routes,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: SupermarketUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _ProductsCard(
                    products: _orchestrator.visibleProducts,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: SupermarketUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _OffersCard(
                    offers: _orchestrator.visibleOffers,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: SupermarketUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _ReceiptPreview(
                    receipt: _orchestrator.receipt,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'home_internet_sub_agent.dart';
import 'mobile_and_sim_sub_agent.dart';
import 'telecom_models.dart';

final class TelecomMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  TelecomMasterOrchestrator({
    HomeInternetSubAgent homeInternet = const HomeInternetSubAgent(),
    MobileAndSimSubAgent mobileAndSim = const MobileAndSimSubAgent(),
  })  : _homeInternet = homeInternet,
        _mobileAndSim = mobileAndSim;

  final HomeInternetSubAgent _homeInternet;
  final MobileAndSimSubAgent _mobileAndSim;

  TelecomDomain _domain = TelecomDomain.homeInternet;
  String _query = '';
  bool _outageHelpExpanded = false;

  TelecomDomain get domain => _domain;
  String get query => _query;
  bool get outageHelpExpanded => _outageHelpExpanded;

  List<TelecomPhrase> get visiblePhrases {
    final source = switch (_domain) {
      TelecomDomain.homeInternet => _homeInternet.phrases,
      TelecomDomain.mobilePrepaid => _mobileAndSim.phrases,
    };

    return List<TelecomPhrase>.unmodifiable(
      source.where((phrase) => phrase.matches(_query)),
    );
  }

  List<NetworkOutageStep> get outageSteps => _outageSteps;

  NetworkOutagePrompt get outagePrompt => _outagePrompt;

  void setDomain(TelecomDomain value) {
    if (_domain == value) return;
    _domain = value;
    _query = '';
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearSearch() => setQuery('');

  void expandOutageHelp() {
    if (_outageHelpExpanded) return;
    _outageHelpExpanded = true;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void dismissOutageHelp() {
    if (!_outageHelpExpanded) return;
    _outageHelpExpanded = false;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void toggleOutageHelp() {
    _outageHelpExpanded = !_outageHelpExpanded;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  static const List<NetworkOutageStep> _outageSteps = <NetworkOutageStep>[
    NetworkOutageStep(
      german:
          '1. Prüfen Sie Router, Stromversorgung und sichtbare Statusleuchten.',
      arabic:
          '1. تحقق من الراوتر ومصدر الكهرباء ومؤشرات الحالة الظاهرة.',
    ),
    NetworkOutageStep(
      german:
          '2. Prüfen Sie Kabel und Steckverbindungen, ohne Geräte zu öffnen.',
      arabic:
          '2. تحقق من الكابلات والتوصيلات الخارجية دون فتح الأجهزة.',
    ),
    NetworkOutageStep(
      german:
          '3. Notieren Sie Zeitpunkt, betroffene Geräte und die angezeigte Fehlermeldung.',
      arabic:
          '3. دوّن وقت المشكلة والأجهزة المتأثرة ورسالة الخطأ الظاهرة.',
    ),
    NetworkOutageStep(
      german:
          '4. Fragen Sie den Anbieter nach einer bekannten Störung und lassen Sie bei Bedarf eine Störungsmeldung aufnehmen.',
      arabic:
          '4. اسأل مزود الخدمة عن وجود عطل معروف، واطلب تسجيل بلاغ عطل عند الحاجة.',
    ),
  ];

  static const NetworkOutagePrompt _outagePrompt = NetworkOutagePrompt(
    german:
        'Seit wann besteht die Störung, und ist für meinen Anschluss bereits eine bekannte Netzstörung gemeldet?',
    arabic:
        'منذ متى يوجد العطل، وهل هناك عطل معروف ومُسجل حاليًا على خطي؟',
  );
}

enum TelecomDomain {
  homeInternet,
  mobilePrepaid,
}

extension TelecomDomainLabels on TelecomDomain {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        TelecomDomain.homeInternet => 'Internet zu Hause · DSL/Glasfaser',
        TelecomDomain.mobilePrepaid => 'Mobilfunk & Prepaid',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        TelecomDomain.homeInternet => 'إنترنت المنزل · DSL/ألياف',
        TelecomDomain.mobilePrepaid => 'الهاتف المحمول والدفع المسبق',
      };
}

final class TelecomPhrase {
  const TelecomPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.domain,
    required this.topicDe,
    required this.topicAr,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final TelecomDomain domain;
  final String topicDe;
  final String topicAr;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = _normalize(query);
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;

    final searchable = _normalize(
      <String>[
        topicDe,
        topicAr,
        german,
        arabic,
        ...keywords,
      ].join(' '),
    );
    return searchable.contains(needle);
  }

  static String _normalize(String value) {
    var normalized = value.toLowerCase();
    normalized = normalized
        .replaceAll('ä', 'a')
        .replaceAll('ö', 'o')
        .replaceAll('ü', 'u')
        .replaceAll('ß', 'ss');
    normalized = normalized.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-z0-9ء-ي ]'), ' ');
    return normalized.replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ').trim();
  }
}

final class NetworkOutageStep {
  const NetworkOutageStep({
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
  });

  final String german;
  final String arabic;
}

final class NetworkOutagePrompt {
  const NetworkOutagePrompt({
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
  });

  final String german;
  final String arabic;
}

import '../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import 'telecom_master_orchestrator.dart';
import 'telecom_models.dart';

abstract final class TelecomUiTokens {
  static const double pageInset = 16;
  static const double bottomInset = 32;
  static const double sectionGap = 18;
  static const double itemGap = 12;
  static const double compactGap = 8;
  static const int softBorderAlpha = 88;
  static const int subtleBorderAlpha = 56;
}

final class TelecomMasterHub extends StatefulWidget {
  const TelecomMasterHub({
    this.orchestrator,
    super.key,
  });

  final TelecomMasterOrchestrator? orchestrator;

  @override
  State<TelecomMasterHub> createState() => _TelecomMasterHubState();
}

final class _TelecomMasterHubState extends State<TelecomMasterHub> {
  late final TelecomMasterOrchestrator _orchestrator;
  late final bool _ownsOrchestrator;
  late final TextEditingController _searchController;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ownsOrchestrator = widget.orchestrator == null;
    _orchestrator = widget.orchestrator ?? TelecomMasterOrchestrator();
    _searchController = TextEditingController(text: _orchestrator.query);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchController.dispose();
    if (_ownsOrchestrator) {
      _orchestrator.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  TextDirection get _searchDirection =>
      RegExp(r'[ء-ي]').hasMatch(_searchController.text)
          ? TextDirection.rtl
          : TextDirection.ltr;

  void _setDomain(TelecomDomain domain) {
    _orchestrator.setDomain(domain);
    _searchController.clear();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              TelecomUiTokens.pageInset,
              TelecomUiTokens.pageInset,
              TelecomUiTokens.pageInset,
              TelecomUiTokens.bottomInset,
            ),
            child: AnimatedBuilder(
              animation: _orchestrator,
              builder: (context, _) => Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  _HeaderCard(dark: dark),
                  const SizedBox(height: TelecomUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _SearchField(
                    controller: _searchController,
                    textDirection: _searchDirection,
                    onChanged: _orchestrator.setQuery,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: TelecomUiTokens.itemGap),
                  _DomainSelector(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                    onDomainSelected: _setDomain,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: TelecomUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _NetworkOutageActionBar(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: TelecomUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _PhraseList(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

            const _GermanText(

final class _PhraseList extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PhraseList({
    required this.orchestrator,
    required this.dark,
  });

  final TelecomMasterOrchestrator orchestrator;
  final bool dark;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final phrases = orchestrator.visiblePhrases;

    if (phrases.isEmpty) {
      return AppGlassCard(
        key: const ValueKey<String>('telecom-empty-results'),
        borderColor:
            AppColors.primary.withAlpha(TelecomUiTokens.subtleBorderAlpha),
        backgroundColor: dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
        child: const _ArabicText(
          'لا توجد نتائج في هذا القسم. جرّب كلمة أخرى أو غيّر نوع الخدمة.',
        ),
      );
    }

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: <Widget>[
        for (var index = 0; index < phrases.length; index++) ...<Widget>[
          _PhraseCard(
            phrase: phrases[index],
            dark: dark,
          ),
          if (index != phrases.length - 1)
            const SizedBox(height: TelecomUiTokens.itemGap),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }
}

final class _PhraseCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PhraseCard({
    required this.phrase,
    required this.dark,
  });

  final TelecomPhrase phrase;
  final bool dark;

  Color get _accent => switch (phrase.domain) {
        TelecomDomain.homeInternet => AppColors.primary,
        TelecomDomain.mobilePrepaid => AppColors.secondary,
      };

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        key: ValueKey<String>('telecom-phrase-${phrase.id}'),
        glowColor: _accent,
        borderColor:
            _accent.withAlpha(TelecomUiTokens.subtleBorderAlpha),
        backgroundColor: dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            _GermanText(
              phrase.topicDe,
              emphasized: true,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: TelecomUiTokens.compactGap),
            _ArabicText(
              phrase.topicAr,
              emphasized: true,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: TelecomUiTokens.itemGap),
            _GermanText(
              phrase.german,
              title: true,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: TelecomUiTokens.compactGap),
            _ArabicText(phrase.arabic),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

final class _GermanText extends StatelessWidget {
  const _GermanText(
    this.text, {
    this.title = false,
    this.emphasized = false,
  });

  final String text;
  final bool title;
  final bool emphasized;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Directionality(
        textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
        child: AppDirectionalText(
          text,
          languageCode: 'de',
          style: title
              ? AppTypography.title
              : emphasized
                  ? AppTypography.label
                  : AppTypography.body,
        ),
      );
}

final class _ArabicText extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ArabicText(
    this.text, {
    this.emphasized = false,
  });

  final String text;
  final bool emphasized;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Directionality(
        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
        child: AppDirectionalText(
          text,
          languageCode: 'ar',
          style: emphasized ? AppTypography.label : AppTypography.body,
        ),
      );
}

FILE: lib/features/life_travel_agency/travel_agency_master_hub.dart

enum TravelAgencyCategory {
  flights,
  hotels,
  holidays,
}

extension TravelAgencyCategoryLabels on TravelAgencyCategory {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        TravelAgencyCategory.flights => 'Flüge',
        TravelAgencyCategory.hotels => 'Hotels',
        TravelAgencyCategory.holidays => 'Urlaubspakete',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        TravelAgencyCategory.flights => 'تذاكر الطيران',
        TravelAgencyCategory.hotels => 'الفنادق',
        TravelAgencyCategory.holidays => 'العطلات والباقات',
      };
}

final class TravelAgencyPhrase {
  const TravelAgencyPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.category,
    required this.topicDe,
    required this.topicAr,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    this.tags = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final TravelAgencyCategory category;
  final String topicDe;
  final String topicAr;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final List<String> tags;
}

final class TripRequestSummary {
  const TripRequestSummary({
    required this.destination,
    required this.travellers,
    required this.flexibleDates,
  });

  final String destination;
  final int travellers;
  final bool flexibleDates;

  String get german =>
      'Reiseziel: ${destination.isEmpty ? 'noch offen' : destination} · Reisende: $travellers · Flexible Daten: ${flexibleDates ? 'ja' : 'nein'}';

  String get arabic =>
      'الوجهة: ${destination.isEmpty ? 'غير محددة بعد' : destination} · المسافرون: $travellers · التواريخ المرنة: ${flexibleDates ? 'نعم' : 'لا'}';
}

final class TravelAgencyMasterHub {
  TravelAgencyMasterHub({required Iterable<TravelAgencyPhrase> entries})
      : _entries = List<TravelAgencyPhrase>.unmodifiable(entries);

  final List<TravelAgencyPhrase> _entries;
  final Set<TravelAgencyCategory> _selected = <TravelAgencyCategory>{
    TravelAgencyCategory.flights,
    TravelAgencyCategory.hotels,
    TravelAgencyCategory.holidays,
  };

  String _query = '';
  String _destination = '';
  int _travellers = 1;
  bool _flexibleDates = false;

  String get query => _query;
  Set<TravelAgencyCategory> get selected =>
      Set<TravelAgencyCategory>.unmodifiable(_selected);

  TripRequestSummary get tripSummary => TripRequestSummary(
        destination: _destination,
        travellers: _travellers,
        flexibleDates: _flexibleDates,
      );

  List<TravelAgencyPhrase> get visibleEntries {
    final q = _normalize(_query);
    return List<TravelAgencyPhrase>.unmodifiable(
      _entries.where((entry) {
        if (!_selected.contains(entry.category)) return false;
        if (q.isEmpty) return true;
        final text = _normalize(<String>[
          entry.topicDe,
          entry.topicAr,
          entry.german,
          entry.arabic,
          ...entry.tags,
        ].join(' '));
        return text.contains(q);
      }),
    );
  }

  void setQuery(String value) => _query = value.trim();

  void toggleCategory(TravelAgencyCategory category) {
    if (_selected.contains(category)) {
      _selected.remove(category);
    } else {
      _selected.add(category);
    }
  }

  void setDestination(String value) => _destination = value.trim();

  void setTravellers(int value) => _travellers = value.clamp(1, 9);

  void toggleFlexibleDates() => _flexibleDates = !_flexibleDates;

  static String _normalize(String value) {
    var out = value.toLowerCase()
      ..replaceAll('ä', 'a')
      ..replaceAll('ö', 'o')
      ..replaceAll('ü', 'u')
      ..replaceAll('ß', 'ss');
    out = out
        .replaceAll('ä', 'a')
        .replaceAll('ö', 'o')
        .replaceAll('ü', 'u')
        .replaceAll('ß', 'ss');
    out = out.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-z0-9ء-ي ]'), ' ');
    return out.replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ').trim();
  }
}

import '../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import 'flight_hotel_booking_agent.dart';

abstract final class _TravelUi {
  static const double inset = 16;
  static const double gap = 14;
  static const double smallGap = 8;
  static const double radius = 18;
  static const int borderAlpha = 72;
  static const int selectedAlpha = 32;
}

final class TravelAgencyMasterScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const TravelAgencyMasterScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<TravelAgencyMasterScreen> createState() =>
      _TravelAgencyMasterScreenState();
}

final class _TravelAgencyMasterScreenState extends State<TravelAgencyMasterScreen> {
  late final TravelAgencyMasterHub _hub;
  final TextEditingController _search = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController _destination = TextEditingController();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _hub = TravelAgencyMasterHub(
      entries: <TravelAgencyPhrase>[
        ...FlightHotelBookingAgent.entries,
        ...HolidayPackageAgent.entries,
      ],
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _search.dispose();
    _destination.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Color _surface(BuildContext context) =>
      Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark
          ? AppColors.darkSurface
          : AppColors.lightSurface;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final surface = _surface(context);
    final entries = _hub.visibleEntries;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: SafeArea(
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(_TravelUi.inset),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: <Widget>[
              AppGlassCard(
                key: const ValueKey<String>('travel-agency-header'),
                backgroundColor: surface,
                glowColor: AppColors.primary,
                borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(_TravelUi.borderAlpha),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    AppDirectionalText(
                      'وكالة السياحة والسفر',
                      languageCode: 'ar',
                      style: AppTypography.title,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: _TravelUi.smallGap),
                    AppDirectionalText(
                      'Reisebüro · Flüge · Hotels · Urlaub',
                      languageCode: 'de',
                      style: AppTypography.display.copyWith(
                        color: AppColors.primary,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: _TravelUi.smallGap),
                    AppDirectionalText(
                      'تدريب عملي كامل لحجز الرحلات والفنادق والعطلات والاستفسار عن الشروط والأسعار.',
                      languageCode: 'ar',
                      style: AppTypography.body,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: _TravelUi.gap),
              _TripPlannerCard(
                surface: surface,
                hub: _hub,
                destinationController: _destination,
                onChanged: () => setState(() {}),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: _TravelUi.gap),
              _CategoryCard(
                surface: surface,
                hub: _hub,
                onChanged: () => setState(() {}),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: _TravelUi.gap),
              AppGlassCard(
                backgroundColor: surface,
                borderColor:
                    AppColors.secondary.withAlpha(_TravelUi.borderAlpha),
                child: TextField(
                  key: const ValueKey<String>('travel-agency-search'),
                  controller: _search,
                  textDirection: RegExp(r'[ء-ي]').hasMatch(_search.text)
                      ? TextDirection.rtl
                      : TextDirection.ltr,
                  style: AppTypography.body,
                  onChanged: (value) {
                    setState(() {
                      _hub.setQuery(value);
                    });
                  },
                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                    hintText: 'Flug · Hotel · Pauschalreise · إلغاء',
                    hintStyle: AppTypography.body,
                    prefixIcon:
                        const Icon(Icons.search, color: AppColors.secondary),
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(_TravelUi.radius),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: _TravelUi.gap),
              AppDirectionalText(
                'عبارات الوكالة',
                languageCode: 'ar',
                style: AppTypography.title,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: _TravelUi.smallGap),
              if (entries.isEmpty)
                AppGlassCard(
                  key: const ValueKey<String>('travel-agency-empty'),
                  backgroundColor: surface,
                  child: AppDirectionalText(
                    'لا توجد نتائج. غيّر البحث أو أعد تفعيل القسم المطلوب.',
                    languageCode: 'ar',
                    style: AppTypography.body,
                  ),
                )
              else
                for (var i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) ...<Widget>[
                  _PhraseCard(entry: entries[i], surface: surface),
                  if (i != entries.length - 1)
                    const SizedBox(height: _TravelUi.smallGap),
                ],
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _TripPlannerCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _TripPlannerCard({
    required this.surface,
    required this.hub,
    required this.destinationController,
    required this.onChanged,
  });

  final Color surface;
  final TravelAgencyMasterHub hub;
  final TextEditingController destinationController;
  final VoidCallback onChanged;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final summary = hub.tripSummary;
    return AppGlassCard(
      key: const ValueKey<String>('travel-trip-planner'),
      backgroundColor: surface,
      glowColor: AppColors.tertiary,
      borderColor: AppColors.tertiary.withAlpha(_TravelUi.borderAlpha),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          AppDirectionalText(
            'ملخص طلب الرحلة',
            languageCode: 'ar',
            style: AppTypography.title,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: _TravelUi.smallGap),
          TextField(
            key: const ValueKey<String>('travel-destination'),
            controller: destinationController,
            textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
            onChanged: (value) {
              hub.setDestination(value);
              onChanged();
            },
            decoration: InputDecoration(
              labelText: 'Reiseziel',
              labelStyle: AppTypography.label,
              border: OutlineInputBorder(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(_TravelUi.radius),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: _TravelUi.smallGap),
          Wrap(
            spacing: _TravelUi.smallGap,
            runSpacing: _TravelUi.smallGap,
            children: <Widget>[
              for (final count in <int>[1, 2, 3, 4])
                ChoiceChip(
                  key: ValueKey<String>('travel-count-$count'),
                  selected: summary.travellers == count,
                  selectedColor:
                      AppColors.tertiary.withAlpha(_TravelUi.selectedAlpha),
                  label: AppDirectionalText(
                    '$count Reisende',
                    languageCode: 'de',
                    style: AppTypography.label,
                  ),
                  onSelected: (_) {
                    hub.setTravellers(count);
                    onChanged();
                  },
                ),
              FilterChip(
                key: const ValueKey<String>('travel-flexible-dates'),
                selected: summary.flexibleDates,
                selectedColor:
                    AppColors.tertiary.withAlpha(_TravelUi.selectedAlpha),
                label: AppDirectionalText(
                  'Flexible Reisedaten',
                  languageCode: 'de',
                  style: AppTypography.label,
                ),
                onSelected: (_) {
                  hub.toggleFlexibleDates();
                  onChanged();
                },
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: _TravelUi.smallGap),
          AppDirectionalText(
            summary.german,
            languageCode: 'de',
            style: AppTypography.label,
          ),
          AppDirectionalText(
            summary.arabic,
            languageCode: 'ar',
            style: AppTypography.body,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _CategoryCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _CategoryCard({
    required this.surface,
    required this.hub,
    required this.onChanged,
  });

  final Color surface;
  final TravelAgencyMasterHub hub;
  final VoidCallback onChanged;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        backgroundColor: surface,
        borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(_TravelUi.borderAlpha),
        child: Wrap(
          spacing: _TravelUi.smallGap,
          runSpacing: _TravelUi.smallGap,
          children: <Widget>[
            for (final category in TravelAgencyCategory.values)
              FilterChip(
                key: ValueKey<String>('travel-category-${category.name}'),
                selected: hub.selected.contains(category),
                selectedColor:
                    AppColors.primary.withAlpha(_TravelUi.selectedAlpha),
                label: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    AppDirectionalText(
                      category.labelAr,
                      languageCode: 'ar',
                      style: AppTypography.label,
                    ),
                    AppDirectionalText(
                      category.labelDe,
                      languageCode: 'de',
                      style: AppTypography.label,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                onSelected: (_) {
                  hub.toggleCategory(category);
                  onChanged();
                },
              ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

final class _PhraseCard extends StatelessWidget {

      };

        key: ValueKey<String>('travel-entry-${entry.id}'),
        backgroundColor: surface,
        borderColor: _accent.withAlpha(_TravelUi.borderAlpha),
        glowColor: _accent,
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            AppDirectionalText(
              entry.topicAr,
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(color: _accent),
            ),
            AppDirectionalText(
              entry.topicDe,
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.label,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: _TravelUi.smallGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              entry.german,
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: _TravelUi.smallGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              entry.arabic,
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.body,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'energy_contracts_sub_agent.dart';
import 'meter_and_invoice_sub_agent.dart';
import 'utilities_models.dart';

final class UtilitiesMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  UtilitiesMasterOrchestrator({
    MeterAndInvoiceSubAgent meterAndInvoice =
        const MeterAndInvoiceSubAgent(),
    EnergyContractsSubAgent energyContracts =
        const EnergyContractsSubAgent(),
  })  : _meterAndInvoice = meterAndInvoice,
        _energyContracts = energyContracts;

  final MeterAndInvoiceSubAgent _meterAndInvoice;
  final EnergyContractsSubAgent _energyContracts;

  UtilitiesCategory _category =
      UtilitiesCategory.meterReadingsInvoices;
  String _query = '';

  UtilitiesCategory get category => _category;
  String get query => _query;

  UtilitiesPhrase get quickMeterReadingGuide =>
      _meterAndInvoice.quickMeterReadingGuide;

  List<UtilitiesPhrase> get visiblePhrases {
    final source = switch (_category) {
      UtilitiesCategory.meterReadingsInvoices =>
        _meterAndInvoice.phrases,
      UtilitiesCategory.contractsSwitching =>
        _energyContracts.phrases,
    };

    return List<UtilitiesPhrase>.unmodifiable(
      source.where((phrase) => phrase.matches(_query)),
    );
  }

  void setCategory(UtilitiesCategory value) {
    if (_category == value && _query.isEmpty) return;

    _category = value;
    _query = '';
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    final normalized = value.trim();
    if (_query == normalized) return;

    _query = normalized;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearSearch() => setQuery('');

  void openQuickMeterReadingGuide() {
    const quickQuery = 'Zählerstand melden';
    final changed =
        _category != UtilitiesCategory.meterReadingsInvoices ||
        _query != quickQuery;

    _category = UtilitiesCategory.meterReadingsInvoices;
    _query = quickQuery;

    if (changed) notifyListeners();
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/life_utilities/utilities_models.dart

enum UtilitiesCategory {
  meterReadingsInvoices,
  contractsSwitching,
}

extension UtilitiesCategoryLabels on UtilitiesCategory {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        UtilitiesCategory.meterReadingsInvoices =>
          'Zählerstände & Rechnungen',
        UtilitiesCategory.contractsSwitching =>
          'Verträge & Anbieterwechsel',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        UtilitiesCategory.meterReadingsInvoices =>
          'قراءات العدادات والفواتير',
        UtilitiesCategory.contractsSwitching =>
          'العقود وتغيير المزوّد',
      };
}

final class UtilitiesPhrase {
  const UtilitiesPhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.category,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.contextDe,
    required this.contextAr,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final UtilitiesCategory category;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String contextDe;
  final String contextAr;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;

    final haystack = <String>[
      id,
      german,
      arabic,
      contextDe,
      contextAr,
      category.labelDe,
      category.labelAr,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase();

    return haystack.contains(needle);
  }
}

import '../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import 'utilities_master_orchestrator.dart';
import 'utilities_models.dart';

abstract final class UtilitiesUiTokens {
  static const double pageInset = 16;
  static const double bottomInset = 32;
  static const double sectionGap = 18;
  static const double itemGap = 12;
  static const double compactGap = 8;
  static const double iconSize = 28;
}

final class UtilitiesMasterHub extends StatefulWidget {
  const UtilitiesMasterHub({
    this.orchestrator,
    super.key,
  });

  final UtilitiesMasterOrchestrator? orchestrator;

  @override
  State<UtilitiesMasterHub> createState() =>
      _UtilitiesMasterHubState();
}

final class _UtilitiesMasterHubState
    extends State<UtilitiesMasterHub> {
  late UtilitiesMasterOrchestrator _orchestrator;
  late bool _ownsOrchestrator;
  final TextEditingController _searchController =
      TextEditingController();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ownsOrchestrator = widget.orchestrator == null;
    _orchestrator =
        widget.orchestrator ?? UtilitiesMasterOrchestrator();
    _searchController.text = _orchestrator.query;
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant UtilitiesMasterHub oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.orchestrator == widget.orchestrator) return;

    if (_ownsOrchestrator) {
      _orchestrator.dispose();
    }

    _ownsOrchestrator = widget.orchestrator == null;
    _orchestrator =
        widget.orchestrator ?? UtilitiesMasterOrchestrator();
    _searchController.text = _orchestrator.query;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchController.dispose();
    if (_ownsOrchestrator) {
      _orchestrator.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _setCategory(UtilitiesCategory category) {
    _orchestrator.setCategory(category);
    _searchController.clear();
  }

  void _openQuickGuide() {
    _orchestrator.openQuickMeterReadingGuide();
    _searchController.text = _orchestrator.query;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark =
        Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: dark
            ? AppColors.darkBackground
            : AppColors.lightBackground,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              UtilitiesUiTokens.pageInset,
              UtilitiesUiTokens.pageInset,
              UtilitiesUiTokens.pageInset,
              UtilitiesUiTokens.bottomInset,
            ),
            child: AnimatedBuilder(
              animation: _orchestrator,
              builder: (context, _) => Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  _HeaderCard(dark: dark),
                  const SizedBox(
                    height: UtilitiesUiTokens.sectionGap,
                  ),
                  _SearchField(
                    controller: _searchController,
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(
                    height: UtilitiesUiTokens.itemGap,
                  ),
                  _CategorySelector(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                    onSelected: _setCategory,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(
                    height: UtilitiesUiTokens.sectionGap,
                  ),
                  _QuickMeterReadingBar(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                    onOpen: _openQuickGuide,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(
                    height: UtilitiesUiTokens.sectionGap,
                  ),
                  _PhraseList(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _SearchField extends StatelessWidget {
  const _SearchField({
    required this.controller,
    required this.orchestrator,
  });

  final TextEditingController controller;
  final UtilitiesMasterOrchestrator orchestrator;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final direction = _containsArabic(controller.text)
        ? TextDirection.rtl
        : TextDirection.ltr;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: direction,
      child: TextField(
        key: const ValueKey<String>('utilities-search'),
        controller: controller,
        onChanged: orchestrator.setQuery,
        decoration: InputDecoration(
          prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search),
          labelText: 'Suche · بحث',
          hintText:
              'Zählerstand, Nachzahlung, Tarif, Kündigungsfrist ...',
          suffixIcon: orchestrator.query.isEmpty
              ? null
              : IconButton(
                  onPressed: () {
                    controller.clear();
                    orchestrator.clearSearch();
                  },
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.close),
                ),
          border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  static bool _containsArabic(String value) =>
      value.runes.any(
        (rune) => rune >= 0x0600 && rune <= 0x06FF,
      );
}

final class _PhraseList extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PhraseList({
    required this.orchestrator,
    required this.dark,
  });

  final UtilitiesMasterOrchestrator orchestrator;
  final bool dark;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final phrases = orchestrator.visiblePhrases;

    if (phrases.isEmpty) {
      return AppGlassCard(
        borderColor: AppColors.tertiary.withAlpha(96),
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
        child: AppDirectionalText(
          'لا توجد نتائج في هذا القسم. جرّب كلمة بحث ألمانية أو عربية أخرى.',
          languageCode: 'ar',
          style: AppTypography.body,
        ),
      );
    }

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: <Widget>[
        for (var index = 0;
            index < phrases.length;
            index++) ...<Widget>[
          _PhraseCard(
            phrase: phrases[index],
            dark: dark,
          ),
          if (index != phrases.length - 1)
            const SizedBox(
              height: UtilitiesUiTokens.itemGap,
            ),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }
}

final class _PhraseCard extends StatelessWidget {

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'bulky_and_depot_sub_agent.dart';
import 'household_sorting_sub_agent.dart';
import 'waste_models.dart';

final class WasteMasterOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  WasteMasterOrchestrator({
    HouseholdSortingSubAgent householdSorting =
        const HouseholdSortingSubAgent(),
    BulkyAndDepotSubAgent bulkyAndDepot = const BulkyAndDepotSubAgent(),
  })  : _householdSorting = householdSorting,
        _bulkyAndDepot = bulkyAndDepot;

  final HouseholdSortingSubAgent _householdSorting;
  final BulkyAndDepotSubAgent _bulkyAndDepot;

  WasteCategory _category = WasteCategory.householdSortingPfand;
  String _query = '';
  String _lookupQuery = '';

  WasteCategory get category => _category;
  String get query => _query;
  String get lookupQuery => _lookupQuery;

  List<WastePhrase> get visiblePhrases {
    final source = switch (_category) {
      WasteCategory.householdSortingPfand => _householdSorting.phrases,
      WasteCategory.bulkyWasteDepot => _bulkyAndDepot.phrases,
    };

    return List<WastePhrase>.unmodifiable(
      source.where((phrase) => phrase.matches(_query)),
    );
  }

  WasteLookupResult get lookupResult {
    final needle = _lookupQuery.trim().toLowerCase();

    if (needle.isEmpty) {
      return const WasteLookupResult(
        routeDe: 'Gegenstand eingeben',
        routeAr: 'اكتب اسم الغرض',
        noteDe:
            'Die Schnellhilfe gibt eine sichere Orientierung und verweist bei örtlich unterschiedlichen Regeln auf die Kommune.',
        noteAr:
            'تعطي الأداة توجيهاً سريعاً، وتطلب الرجوع للبلدية عندما تختلف القواعد محلياً.',
        isKnown: false,
      );
    }

    if (_containsAny(needle, const <String>[
      'batterie',
      'batterien',
      'akku',
      'akkus',
    ])) {
      return const WasteLookupResult(
        routeDe: 'Sammelstelle / Rücknahmestelle',
        routeAr: 'نقطة تجميع أو استرجاع مخصصة',
        noteDe:
            'Batterien und Akkus getrennt sammeln und die lokalen Annahmehinweise beachten.',
        noteAr:
            'اجمع البطاريات بشكل منفصل واتبع تعليمات نقطة الاستلام المحلية.',
        isKnown: true,
      );
    }

    if (_containsAny(needle, const <String>[
      'zeitung',
      'papier',
      'karton',
      'pappe',
    ])) {
      return const WasteLookupResult(
        routeDe: 'Altpapier',
        routeAr: 'الورق والكرتون المخصصان لإعادة التدوير',
        noteDe:
            'Sauberes Papier und Karton nach den örtlichen Vorgaben zur Papiersammlung geben.',
        noteAr:
            'ضع الورق والكرتون النظيفين في مسار جمع الورق حسب تعليمات البلدية.',
        isKnown: true,
      );
    }

    if (_containsAny(needle, const <String>[
      'glas',
      'glasflasche',
      'marmeladenglas',
    ])) {
      return const WasteLookupResult(
        routeDe: 'Altglas nach Glasfarbe',
        routeAr: 'حاوية الزجاج حسب لون الزجاج',
        noteDe:
            'Pfand zuerst prüfen und anschließend Farbe sowie örtliche Einwurfzeiten beachten.',
        noteAr:
            'تحقق أولاً من وجود تأمين على العبوة ثم راعِ اللون وأوقات الإلقاء المحلية.',
        isKnown: true,
      );
    }

    if (_containsAny(needle, const <String>[
      'verpackung',
      'kunststoffverpackung',
      'dose',
      'konservendose',
    ])) {
      return const WasteLookupResult(
        routeDe: 'Gelber Sack / Gelbe Tonne',
        routeAr: 'الكيس الأصفر أو الحاوية الصفراء',
        noteDe:
            'Für leere Verkaufsverpackungen die Kennzeichnung und die lokalen Sammelregeln prüfen.',
        noteAr:
            'للعبوات الفارغة تحقق من العلامة ومن نظام الجمع المحلي.',
        isKnown: true,
      );
    }

    if (_containsAny(needle, const <String>[
      'bananenschale',
      'kaffeesatz',
      'bioabfall',
      'biomüll',
    ])) {
      return const WasteLookupResult(
        routeDe: 'Biotonne – lokale Vorgaben prüfen',
        routeAr: 'حاوية العضويات مع التحقق من القواعد المحلية',
        noteDe:
            'Welche Küchenabfälle angenommen werden, kann örtlich unterschiedlich geregelt sein.',
        noteAr:
            'قد تختلف أنواع مخلفات المطبخ المقبولة من بلدية إلى أخرى.',
        isKnown: true,
      );
    }

    if (_containsAny(needle, const <String>[
      'pfandflasche',
      'mehrwegflasche',
      'einwegpfand',
      'mehrwegpfand',
    ])) {
      return const WasteLookupResult(
        routeDe: 'Pfandrückgabe',
        routeAr: 'إرجاع العبوة واسترداد التأمين',
        noteDe:
            'Pfandkennzeichnung prüfen und die Flasche über eine passende Rücknahmestelle zurückgeben.',
        noteAr:
            'تحقق من علامة التأمين وأعد العبوة إلى نقطة استرجاع مناسبة.',
        isKnown: true,
      );
    }

    return const WasteLookupResult(
      routeDe: 'Lokale Abfallberatung prüfen',
      routeAr: 'تحقق من دليل النفايات المحلي',
      noteDe:
          'Bei unbekannten oder gemischten Stoffen nicht raten: kommunales Abfall-ABC oder Wertstoffhof fragen.',
      noteAr:
          'عند عدم معرفة المادة أو كونها مختلطة لا تخمّن؛ راجع دليل البلدية أو مركز التدوير.',
      isKnown: false,
    );
  }

  static bool _containsAny(String source, List<String> candidates) =>
      candidates.any(source.contains);

  void setCategory(WasteCategory value) {
    if (_category == value) return;
    _category = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setQuery(String value) {
    if (_query == value) return;
    _query = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearSearch() => setQuery('');

  void setLookupQuery(String value) {
    if (_lookupQuery == value) return;
    _lookupQuery = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

enum WasteCategory { householdSortingPfand, bulkyWasteDepot }

extension WasteCategoryLabels on WasteCategory {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        WasteCategory.householdSortingPfand => 'Mülltrennung & Pfand',
        WasteCategory.bulkyWasteDepot => 'Sperrmüll & Wertstoffhof',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        WasteCategory.householdSortingPfand => 'فرز النفايات والعبوات المرتجعة',
        WasteCategory.bulkyWasteDepot => 'النفايات كبيرة الحجم ومركز التدوير',
      };
}

final class WastePhrase {
  const WastePhrase({
    required this.id,
    required this.category,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.contextDe,
    required this.contextAr,
    this.keywords = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final WasteCategory category;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String contextDe;
  final String contextAr;
  final List<String> keywords;

  bool matches(String query) {
    final needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (needle.isEmpty) return true;

    final haystack = <String>[
      german,
      arabic,
      contextDe,
      contextAr,
      ...keywords,
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase();

    return haystack.contains(needle);
  }
}

final class WasteLookupResult {
  const WasteLookupResult({
    required this.routeDe,
    required this.routeAr,
    required this.noteDe,
    required this.noteAr,
    required this.isKnown,
  });

  final String routeDe;
  final String routeAr;
  final String noteDe;
  final String noteAr;
  final bool isKnown;
}

abstract final class WasteUiTokens {
  static const double pageInset = 16;
  static const double bottomInset = 32;
  static const double sectionGap = 18;
  static const double itemGap = 12;
  static const double compactGap = 8;
}

final class WasteRecyclingMasterHub extends StatefulWidget {
  const WasteRecyclingMasterHub({
    this.orchestrator,
    super.key,
  });

  final WasteMasterOrchestrator? orchestrator;

  @override
  State<WasteRecyclingMasterHub> createState() =>
      _WasteRecyclingMasterHubState();
}

final class _WasteRecyclingMasterHubState
    extends State<WasteRecyclingMasterHub> {
  late final WasteMasterOrchestrator _orchestrator;
  late final bool _ownsOrchestrator;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ownsOrchestrator = widget.orchestrator == null;
    _orchestrator = widget.orchestrator ?? WasteMasterOrchestrator();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    if (_ownsOrchestrator) {
      _orchestrator.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              WasteUiTokens.pageInset,
              WasteUiTokens.pageInset,
              WasteUiTokens.pageInset,
              WasteUiTokens.bottomInset,
            ),
            child: AnimatedBuilder(
              animation: _orchestrator,
              builder: (context, _) => Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  _HeaderCard(dark: dark),
                  const SizedBox(height: WasteUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _SearchField(orchestrator: _orchestrator),
                  const SizedBox(height: WasteUiTokens.itemGap),
                  _CategorySelector(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: WasteUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _QuickSortingLookupBar(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: WasteUiTokens.sectionGap),
                  _PhraseList(
                    orchestrator: _orchestrator,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

  final bool dark;

    final phrases = orchestrator.visiblePhrases;

        borderColor: AppColors.tertiary.withAlpha(96),
        backgroundColor: dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
        child: AppDirectionalText(

          style: AppTypography.body,
        ),

    }

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: <Widget>[
        for (var index = 0; index < phrases.length; index++) ...<Widget>[
          _PhraseCard(
            phrase: phrases[index],
            dark: dark,
          ),
          if (index != phrases.length - 1)
            const SizedBox(height: WasteUiTokens.itemGap),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }

import '../domain/audio_services.dart';
import '../domain/listening_models.dart';

final class ListeningAudioPlayerFacade implements AudioPlayerFacade {
  const ListeningAudioPlayerFacade(this._player);

  final AudioPlayerService _player;

  @override
  Future<bool> playDrill(
    ListeningDrill drill, {
    ListeningPlaybackSpeed speed = ListeningPlaybackSpeed.normal,
  }) {
    return _player.play(
      AudioPlaybackRequest(
        text: drill.audioText,
        languageCode: drill.languageCode,
        speedFactor: speed.factor,
        conceptId: drill.conceptId ?? drill.id,
        variant: AudioPlaybackVariant.listening,
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Future<void> stop() => _player.stop();
}

FILE: lib/features/listening/application/listening_session_notifier.dart

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/audio_services.dart';
import '../domain/listening_models.dart';
import 'pronunciation_matcher.dart';

class ListeningSessionNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  ListeningSessionNotifier({
    required List<ListeningDrill> drills,
    required AudioPlayerFacade player,
    required AudioRecorderService recorder,
  })  : _drills = List<ListeningDrill>.unmodifiable(drills),
        _player = player,
        _recorder = recorder {
    if (_drills.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('Listening session requires at least one drill.');
    }
  }

  final List<ListeningDrill> _drills;
  final AudioPlayerFacade _player;
  final AudioRecorderService _recorder;
  final Set<int> _answeredIndices = <int>{};

  int _index = 0;
  int _score = 0;
  bool _playing = false;
  bool _recording = false;
  ListeningAnswerResult? _lastAnswer;
  PronunciationFeedback? _pronunciationFeedback;

  ListeningDrill get currentDrill => _drills[_index];
  int get currentIndex => _index;
  int get totalDrills => _drills.length;
  int get score => _score;
  bool get isPlaying => _playing;
  bool get isRecording => _recording;
  bool get canAdvance => _answeredIndices.contains(_index);
  bool get isComplete => canAdvance && _index == _drills.length - 1;
  ListeningAnswerResult? get lastAnswer => _lastAnswer;
  PronunciationFeedback? get pronunciationFeedback => _pronunciationFeedback;

  Future<bool> playCurrent([
    ListeningPlaybackSpeed speed = ListeningPlaybackSpeed.normal,
  ]) async {
    if (_playing) return false;
    _playing = true;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      return await _player.playDrill(currentDrill, speed: speed);
    } finally {
      _playing = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  ListeningAnswerResult submitOption(String optionId) {
    _ensureUnanswered();
    final drill = currentDrill;
    if (drill.type != ListeningDrillType.multipleChoice) {
      throw StateError('Current listening drill is not multiple choice.');
    }

    ListeningOption? option;
    for (final candidate in drill.options) {
      if (candidate.id == optionId) {
        option = candidate;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (option == null) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(optionId, 'optionId', 'Unknown option.');
    }

    return _recordAnswer(
      answer: option.id,
      expected: drill.correctOptionId!,
      correct: option.id == drill.correctOptionId,
    );
  }

  ListeningAnswerResult submitDictation(String answer) {
    _ensureUnanswered();
    final drill = currentDrill;
    if (drill.type != ListeningDrillType.dictation) {
      throw StateError('Current listening drill is not dictation.');
    }
    final expected = _normalizeAnswer(drill.expectedText!);
    final normalized = _normalizeAnswer(answer);
    return _recordAnswer(
      answer: normalized,
      expected: expected,
      correct: normalized.isNotEmpty && normalized == expected,
    );
  }

  void next() {
    if (!canAdvance) {
      throw StateError('Answer the current listening drill before advancing.');
    }
    if (_index >= _drills.length - 1) return;
    _index += 1;
    _lastAnswer = null;
    _pronunciationFeedback = null;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<PronunciationFeedback> evaluatePronunciation() async {
    if (_recording) {
      throw StateError('Pronunciation capture is already running.');
    }
    _recording = true;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      final allowed = await _recorder.requestPermission();
      final recording = allowed
          ? await _recorder.capturePronunciation(
              targetText: currentDrill.audioText,
              targetPhonemes: currentDrill.targetPhonemes,
            )
          : const AudioRecordingResult.unavailable(
              'microphone_permission_required',
            );
      final feedback = PronunciationMatcher.evaluate(
        recording: recording,
        targetText: currentDrill.audioText,
        targetPhonemes: currentDrill.targetPhonemes,
      );
      _pronunciationFeedback = feedback;
      return feedback;
    } finally {
      _recording = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  ListeningAnswerResult _recordAnswer({
    required String answer,
    required String expected,
    required bool correct,
  }) {
    _answeredIndices.add(_index);
    final result = ListeningAnswerResult(
      correct: correct,
      pointsAwarded: correct ? 10 : 0,
      normalizedExpected: expected,
      normalizedAnswer: answer,
    );
    _score += result.pointsAwarded;
    _lastAnswer = result;
    notifyListeners();
    return result;
  }

  void _ensureUnanswered() {
    if (_answeredIndices.contains(_index)) {
      throw StateError('Current listening drill has already been answered.');
    }
  }

  static String _normalizeAnswer(String value) {
    return value
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[.,!?;:„“"…]'), '')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    unawaited(_player.stop());
    super.dispose();
  }
}

import '../domain/audio_services.dart';
import '../domain/listening_models.dart';

abstract final class PronunciationMatcher {
  static PronunciationFeedback evaluate({
    required AudioRecordingResult recording,
    required String targetText,
    required List<String> targetPhonemes,
  }) {
    if (!recording.available) {
      return PronunciationFeedback(
        signalAvailable: false,
        accuracy: null,
        textAccuracy: null,
        phonemeMatches: const <PronunciationPhonemeMatch>[],
        messageArabic: _unavailableMessage(recording.reason),
      );
    }

    final recognized = recording.recognizedText?.trim();
    final textAccuracy =
        recognized == null || recognized.isEmpty
            ? null
            : _textSimilarity(targetText, recognized);

    final observed = recording.recognizedPhonemes;
    if (targetPhonemes.isEmpty || observed.isEmpty) {
      return PronunciationFeedback(
        signalAvailable: true,
        accuracy: null,
        textAccuracy: textAccuracy,
        phonemeMatches: const <PronunciationPhonemeMatch>[],
        recognizedText: recognized,
        messageArabic:
            'تم التقاط النطق، لكن محلل الفونيمات لم يوفّر قياسًا صوتيًا موثوقًا. '
            'لن يتم اختلاق درجة فونيمات.',
      );
    }

    final alignment = _align(targetPhonemes, observed);
    final matched = alignment.where((item) => item.matched).length;
    final denominator =
        targetPhonemes.length > observed.length
            ? targetPhonemes.length
            : observed.length;
    final accuracy =
        denominator == 0 ? 0.0 : (matched / denominator).clamp(0.0, 1.0);

    return PronunciationFeedback(
      signalAvailable: true,
      accuracy: accuracy.toDouble(),
      textAccuracy: textAccuracy,
      phonemeMatches: List<PronunciationPhonemeMatch>.unmodifiable(alignment),
      recognizedText: recognized,
      messageArabic: accuracy >= .85
          ? 'مطابقة الفونيمات قوية. حافظ على نفس وضوح المخارج.'
          : accuracy >= .6
              ? 'المطابقة جيدة جزئيًا. راجع الفونيمات غير المتطابقة.'
              : 'تحتاج بعض الأصوات إلى تدريب إضافي. راجع الفونيمات المحددة.',
    );
  }

  static List<PronunciationPhonemeMatch> _align(
    List<String> target,
    List<String> observed,
  ) {
    final rows = target.length + 1;
    final cols = observed.length + 1;
    final cost = List<List<int>>.generate(
      rows,
      (_) => List<int>.filled(cols, 0),
    );
    for (var i = 0; i < rows; i += 1) {
      cost[i][0] = i;
    }
    for (var j = 0; j < cols; j += 1) {
      cost[0][j] = j;
    }
    for (var i = 1; i < rows; i += 1) {
      for (var j = 1; j < cols; j += 1) {
        final substitution =
            cost[i - 1][j - 1] + (target[i - 1] == observed[j - 1] ? 0 : 1);
        final deletion = cost[i - 1][j] + 1;
        final insertion = cost[i][j - 1] + 1;
        var best = substitution;
        if (deletion < best) best = deletion;
        if (insertion < best) best = insertion;
        cost[i][j] = best;
      }
    }

    var i = target.length;
    var j = observed.length;
    final reversed = <PronunciationPhonemeMatch>[];
    while (i > 0) {
      if (j > 0) {
        final equal = target[i - 1] == observed[j - 1];
        final diagonal = cost[i - 1][j - 1] + (equal ? 0 : 1);
        if (cost[i][j] == diagonal) {
          reversed.add(
            PronunciationPhonemeMatch(
              target: target[i - 1],
              observed: observed[j - 1],
              matched: equal,
            ),
          );
          i -= 1;
          j -= 1;
          continue;
        }
      }
      if (cost[i][j] == cost[i - 1][j] + 1) {
        reversed.add(
          PronunciationPhonemeMatch(
            target: target[i - 1],
            observed: null,
            matched: false,
          ),
        );
        i -= 1;
      } else if (j > 0) {
        j -= 1;
      }
    }

    return reversed.reversed.toList(growable: false);
  }

  static double _textSimilarity(String target, String observed) {
    final left = _normalizeText(target);
    final right = _normalizeText(observed);
    if (left == right) return 1;
    if (left.isEmpty || right.isEmpty) return 0;

    final previous = List<int>.generate(right.length + 1, (index) => index);
    for (var i = 1; i <= left.length; i += 1) {
      final current = List<int>.filled(right.length + 1, 0);
      current[0] = i;
      for (var j = 1; j <= right.length; j += 1) {
        final substitution =
            previous[j - 1] + (left[i - 1] == right[j - 1] ? 0 : 1);
        final deletion = previous[j] + 1;
        final insertion = current[j - 1] + 1;
        var best = substitution;
        if (deletion < best) best = deletion;
        if (insertion < best) best = insertion;
        current[j] = best;
      }
      for (var j = 0; j < current.length; j += 1) {
        previous[j] = current[j];
      }
    }
    final longest = left.length > right.length ? left.length : right.length;
    return (1 - previous[right.length] / longest).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
  }

  static String _normalizeText(String value) {
    return value
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[.,!?;:„“"…]'), '')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');
  }

  static String _unavailableMessage(String? reason) => switch (reason) {
        'microphone_permission_required' =>
          'إذن الميكروفون مطلوب قبل بدء تدريب النطق.',
        _ => 'التسجيل غير متاح حاليًا، لذلك لم يتم إنشاء تقييم نطق.',
      };
}

import 'listening_models.dart';

enum AudioPlaybackVariant { listening, pronunciation }

final class AudioPlaybackRequest {
  const AudioPlaybackRequest({
    required this.text,
    required this.languageCode,
    required this.speedFactor,
    required this.variant,
    this.conceptId,
  }) : assert(speedFactor > 0 && speedFactor <= 1);

  final String text;
  final String languageCode;
  final double speedFactor;
  final AudioPlaybackVariant variant;
  final String? conceptId;
}

final class AudioRecordingResult {
  const AudioRecordingResult.available({
    this.recognizedText,
    this.recognizedPhonemes = const <String>[],
  })  : available = true,
        reason = null;

  const AudioRecordingResult.unavailable(this.reason)
      : available = false,
        recognizedText = null,
        recognizedPhonemes = const <String>[];

  final bool available;
  final String? recognizedText;
  final List<String> recognizedPhonemes;
  final String? reason;
}

abstract interface class AudioPlayerService {
  Future<bool> play(AudioPlaybackRequest request);

  Future<void> stop();
}

abstract interface class AudioRecorderService {
  Future<bool> requestPermission();

  Future<AudioRecordingResult> capturePronunciation({
    required String targetText,
    List<String> targetPhonemes = const <String>[],
  });
}

abstract interface class AudioPlayerFacade {
  Future<bool> playDrill(
    ListeningDrill drill, {
    ListeningPlaybackSpeed speed = ListeningPlaybackSpeed.normal,
  });

  Future<void> stop();
}

enum ListeningDrillType { multipleChoice, dictation }

enum ListeningPlaybackSpeed {
  normal(1.0),
  slow(.8);

  const ListeningPlaybackSpeed(this.factor);
  final double factor;
}

final class ListeningOption {
  const ListeningOption({
    required this.id,
    required this.text,
  });

  final String id;
  final String text;
}

final class ListeningDrill {
  ListeningDrill._({
    required this.id,
    required this.type,
    required this.promptArabic,
    required this.audioText,
    required this.languageCode,
    required this.options,
    required this.correctOptionId,
    required this.expectedText,
    required this.targetPhonemes,
    this.conceptId,
  }) {
    _validate();
  }

  factory ListeningDrill.multipleChoice({
    required String id,
    required String promptArabic,
    required String audioText,
    required String languageCode,
    required List<ListeningOption> options,
    required String correctOptionId,
    String? conceptId,
    List<String> targetPhonemes = const <String>[],
  }) {
    return ListeningDrill._(
      id: id,
      type: ListeningDrillType.multipleChoice,
      promptArabic: promptArabic,
      audioText: audioText,
      languageCode: languageCode,
      options: List<ListeningOption>.unmodifiable(options),
      correctOptionId: correctOptionId,
      expectedText: null,
      conceptId: conceptId,
      targetPhonemes: List<String>.unmodifiable(targetPhonemes),
    );
  }

  factory ListeningDrill.dictation({
    required String id,
    required String promptArabic,
    required String audioText,
    required String languageCode,
    required String expectedText,
    String? conceptId,
    List<String> targetPhonemes = const <String>[],
  }) {
    return ListeningDrill._(
      id: id,
      type: ListeningDrillType.dictation,
      promptArabic: promptArabic,
      audioText: audioText,
      languageCode: languageCode,
      options: const <ListeningOption>[],
      correctOptionId: null,
      expectedText: expectedText,
      conceptId: conceptId,
      targetPhonemes: List<String>.unmodifiable(targetPhonemes),
    );
  }

  final String id;
  final ListeningDrillType type;
  final String promptArabic;
  final String audioText;
  final String languageCode;
  final List<ListeningOption> options;
  final String? correctOptionId;
  final String? expectedText;
  final String? conceptId;
  final List<String> targetPhonemes;

  void _validate() {
    if (id.trim().isEmpty ||
        promptArabic.trim().isEmpty ||
        audioText.trim().isEmpty ||
        languageCode.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('Listening drill text fields must not be empty.');
    }

    if (type == ListeningDrillType.multipleChoice) {
      if (options.length < 2) {
        throw ArgumentError(
          'Multiple-choice listening drills require at least two options.',
        );
      }
      final ids = options.map((option) => option.id).toSet();
      if (ids.length != options.length ||
          !ids.contains(correctOptionId) ||
          options.any(
            (option) => option.id.trim().isEmpty || option.text.trim().isEmpty,
          )) {
        throw ArgumentError('Listening drill options are invalid.');
      }
      return;
    }

    if (expectedText == null || expectedText!.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('Dictation drills require expected text.');
    }
  }
}

final class ListeningAnswerResult {
  const ListeningAnswerResult({
    required this.correct,
    required this.pointsAwarded,
    required this.normalizedExpected,
    required this.normalizedAnswer,
  });

  final bool correct;
  final int pointsAwarded;
  final String normalizedExpected;
  final String normalizedAnswer;
}

final class PronunciationPhonemeMatch {
  const PronunciationPhonemeMatch({
    required this.target,
    required this.observed,
    required this.matched,
  });

  final String target;
  final String? observed;
  final bool matched;
}

final class PronunciationFeedback {
  const PronunciationFeedback({
    required this.signalAvailable,
    required this.accuracy,
    required this.textAccuracy,
    required this.phonemeMatches,
    required this.messageArabic,
    this.recognizedText,
  });

  final bool signalAvailable;

  /// Null unless a recorder/analyzer supplied measured phoneme observations.
  final double? accuracy;

  /// Optional normalized text-recognition similarity, distinct from phoneme accuracy.
  final double? textAccuracy;
  final List<PronunciationPhonemeMatch> phonemeMatches;
  final String messageArabic;
  final String? recognizedText;

  bool get phonemeAccuracyAvailable =>
      accuracy != null && phonemeMatches.isNotEmpty;
}

import '../../audio/domain/entities/audio_request.dart' as core_audio;
import '../../audio/domain/services/i_audio_runtime.dart';
import '../../pronunciation/domain/services/pronunciation_signal_probe.dart';
import '../domain/audio_services.dart';

final class RuntimeAudioPlayerService implements AudioPlayerService {
  const RuntimeAudioPlayerService(this._runtime);

  final IAudioRuntime _runtime;

  @override
  Future<bool> play(AudioPlaybackRequest request) async {
    if (request.text.trim().isEmpty) return false;
    final result = await _runtime.play(
      core_audio.AudioRequest(
        text: request.text,
        languageCode: request.languageCode,
        conceptId: request.conceptId,
        variant: request.variant == AudioPlaybackVariant.pronunciation
            ? core_audio.AudioVariant.pronunciation
            : core_audio.AudioVariant.sentence,
        rate: request.speedFactor <= .8 ? .38 : null,
      ),
    );
    return result.played;
  }

  @override
  Future<void> stop() => _runtime.stop();
}

final class SignalAudioRecorderService implements AudioRecorderService {
  const SignalAudioRecorderService(this._probe);

  final PronunciationSignalProbe _probe;

  @override
  Future<bool> requestPermission() => _probe.requestPermission();

  @override
  Future<AudioRecordingResult> capturePronunciation({
    required String targetText,
    List<String> targetPhonemes = const <String>[],
  }) async {
    final capture = await _probe.capture(
      maxDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 1800),
    );
    if (!capture.available) {
      return AudioRecordingResult.unavailable(
        capture.reason ?? 'pronunciation_capture_unavailable',
      );
    }
    return const AudioRecordingResult.available();
  }
}
