class ListeningPracticeScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ListeningPracticeScreen({
    required this.notifier,
    super.key,
  });

  final ListeningSessionNotifier notifier;

  @override
  State<ListeningPracticeScreen> createState() =>
      _ListeningPracticeScreenState();
}

class _ListeningPracticeScreenState extends State<ListeningPracticeScreen> {
  final TextEditingController _dictationController = TextEditingController();

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _dictationController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _recordPronunciation() async {
    await widget.notifier.evaluatePronunciation();
  }

  void _submitDictation() {
    if (widget.notifier.canAdvance) return;
    widget.notifier.submitDictation(_dictationController.text);
  }

  void _next() {
    if (widget.notifier.isComplete) return;
    widget.notifier.next();
    _dictationController.clear();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: widget.notifier,
      builder: (context, _) {
        final notifier = widget.notifier;
        final drill = notifier.currentDrill;
        final answer = notifier.lastAnswer;
        return Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(
            title: const Text('تدريب الاستماع والنطق'),
          ),
          body: Directionality(
            textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
            child: SafeArea(
              child: ListView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                children: <Widget>[
                  _ProgressHeader(notifier: notifier),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  AudioWaveGlassCard(
                    isBusy: notifier.isPlaying,
                    onPlayNormal: () async {
                      await notifier.playCurrent();
                    },
                    onPlaySlow: () async {
                      await notifier.playCurrent(ListeningPlaybackSpeed.slow);
                    },
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  AppGlassCard(
                    child: Text(
                      drill.promptArabic,
                      style: AppTypography.title,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  if (drill.type == ListeningDrillType.multipleChoice)
                    _MultipleChoicePanel(
                      drill: drill,
                      enabled: !notifier.canAdvance,
                      onSelected: notifier.submitOption,
                    )
                  else
                    _DictationPanel(
                      controller: _dictationController,
                      enabled: !notifier.canAdvance,
                      onSubmit: _submitDictation,
                    ),
                  if (answer != null) ...<Widget>[
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    _AnswerFeedback(answer: answer),
                  ],
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  InteractivePronunciationCard(
                    feedback: notifier.pronunciationFeedback,
                    isRecording: notifier.isRecording,
                    onRecord:
                        notifier.isRecording ? null : _recordPronunciation,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  if (notifier.canAdvance && !notifier.isComplete)
                    FilledButton(
                      onPressed: _next,
                      child: const Text('السؤال التالي'),
                    ),
                  if (notifier.isComplete)
                    AppGlassCard(
                      glowColor: AppColors.mastery,
                      borderColor: AppColors.mastery.withAlpha(100),
                      child: Text(
                        'اكتمل التدريب — النقاط ${notifier.score}',
                        style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(
                          color: AppColors.mastery,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../../design_system/app_audio_button.dart';
import '../../../../design_system/app_colors.dart';
import '../../../../design_system/app_glass_card.dart';
import '../../../../design_system/app_typography.dart';

class AudioWaveGlassCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const AudioWaveGlassCard({
    required this.onPlayNormal,
    required this.onPlaySlow,
    this.isBusy = false,
    this.title = 'استمع إلى المقطع',
    super.key,
  });

  final VoidCallback? onPlayNormal;
  final VoidCallback? onPlaySlow;
  final bool isBusy;
  final String title;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AppGlassCard(
      glowColor: AppColors.primary,
      borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(72),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          Text(title, style: AppTypography.title),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          SizedBox(
            height: 58,
            child: CustomPaint(
              painter: _WavePainter(color: AppColors.primary),
              child: const SizedBox.expand(),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: <Widget>[
              _PlaybackAction(
                label: 'عادي',
                speedLabel: '1×',
                busy: isBusy,
                onPressed: onPlayNormal,
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 18),
              _PlaybackAction(
                label: 'بطيء',
                speedLabel: '0.8×',
                busy: isBusy,
                onPressed: onPlaySlow,
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _PlaybackAction extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PlaybackAction({
    required this.label,
    required this.speedLabel,
    required this.busy,
    required this.onPressed,
  });

  final String label;
  final String speedLabel;
  final bool busy;
  final VoidCallback? onPressed;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Semantics(
      label: '$label $speedLabel',
      child: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: <Widget>[
          AppAudioButton(
            onPressed: busy ? null : onPressed,
            semanticLabel: '$label $speedLabel',
            isBusy: busy,
            activeColor: AppColors.primary,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 5),
          Text('$label · $speedLabel', style: AppTypography.label),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _WavePainter extends CustomPainter {
  const _WavePainter({required this.color});

  final Color color;

  static const List<double> _levels = <double>[
    .22, .48, .72, .38, .86, .56, .94, .44, .68,
    .34, .78, .5, .9, .62, .4, .7, .3, .58,
  ];

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final paint = Paint()
      ..color = color.withAlpha(190)
      ..strokeWidth = 3
      ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round;
    final spacing = size.width / _levels.length;
    final centerY = size.height / 2;

    for (var index = 0; index < _levels.length; index += 1) {
      final height = size.height * _levels[index];
      final x = spacing * (index + .5);
      canvas.drawLine(
        Offset(x, centerY - height / 2),
        Offset(x, centerY + height / 2),
        paint,
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _WavePainter oldDelegate) =>
      oldDelegate.color != color;
}

FILE: lib/features/listening/presentation/widgets/interactive_pronunciation_card.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../../design_system/app_colors.dart';
import '../../../../design_system/app_glass_card.dart';
import '../../../../design_system/app_typography.dart';
import '../../domain/listening_models.dart';

class InteractivePronunciationCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const InteractivePronunciationCard({
    required this.feedback,
    required this.isRecording,
    required this.onRecord,
    super.key,
  });

  final PronunciationFeedback? feedback;
  final bool isRecording;
  final VoidCallback? onRecord;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final current = feedback;
    final accent = _feedbackColor(current);

    return AppGlassCard(
      borderColor: accent.withAlpha(90),
      glowColor: accent,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          Row(
            children: <Widget>[
              Expanded(
                child: Text('تدريب النطق', style: AppTypography.title),
              ),
              FilledButton.icon(
                onPressed: isRecording ? null : onRecord,
                icon: isRecording
                    ? const SizedBox.square(
                        dimension: 16,
                        child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                      )
                    : const Icon(Icons.mic_none_rounded),
                label: Text(isRecording ? 'جاري التسجيل' : 'ابدأ'),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          if (current != null) ...<Widget>[
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            if (current.phonemeAccuracyAvailable) ...<Widget>[
              _AccuracyBar(
                label: 'دقة الفونيمات',
                value: current.accuracy!,
                color: accent,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              Wrap(
                spacing: 7,
                runSpacing: 7,
                children: current.phonemeMatches
                    .map((match) => _PhonemeChip(match: match))
                    .toList(growable: false),
              ),
            ] else
              Row(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Icon(Icons.info_outline_rounded, color: accent),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      'دقة الفونيمات غير متاحة لهذا القياس.',
                      style: AppTypography.label,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            if (current.textAccuracy != null) ...<Widget>[
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              _AccuracyBar(
                label: 'مطابقة النص المتعرّف عليه',
                value: current.textAccuracy!,
                color: AppColors.secondary,
              ),
            ],
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Text(current.messageArabic, style: AppTypography.body),
          ] else ...<Widget>[
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Text(
              'اسمع المقطع أولًا، ثم سجّل نطقك لمقارنة القياسات المتاحة.',
              style: AppTypography.body,
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Color _feedbackColor(PronunciationFeedback? current) {
    final score = current?.accuracy;
    if (current == null) return AppColors.primary;
    if (score == null) return AppColors.tertiary;
    if (score >= .85) return AppColors.mastery;
    if (score >= .6) return AppColors.xp;
    return AppColors.articleDie;
  }
}

class _AccuracyBar extends StatelessWidget {
  const _AccuracyBar({
    required this.label,
    required this.value,
    required this.color,
  });

  final String label;
  final double value;
  final Color color;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final safe = value.clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: <Widget>[
        Row(
          children: <Widget>[
            Expanded(child: Text(label, style: AppTypography.label)),
            Text(
              '${(safe * 100).round()}%',
              style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(color: color),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 5),
        LinearProgressIndicator(
          value: safe,
          minHeight: 7,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
          color: color,
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _PhonemeChip extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PhonemeChip({required this.match});

  final PronunciationPhonemeMatch match;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final color = match.matched ? AppColors.mastery : AppColors.articleDie;
    final observed = match.observed;
    return DecoratedBox(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: color.withAlpha(24),
        border: Border.all(color: color.withAlpha(100)),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
      ),
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 6),
        child: Text(
          observed == null || observed == match.target
              ? match.target
              : '${match.target} → $observed',
          textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
          style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(color: color),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/nomen_verb_verbindungen/application/nvv_notifier.dart

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/nvv_models.dart';
import '../domain/nvv_repository.dart';

final class NvvNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  NvvNotifier({required NvvRepository repository}) : _repository = repository;

  final NvvRepository _repository;

  List<NvvChallengeItem> _challenges = const <NvvChallengeItem>[];
  NvvChallengeItem? _currentChallenge;
  List<String> _displayedOptions = const <String>[];
  String? _selectedVerb;
  bool? _isCorrect;
  bool _showExplanation = false;
  bool _isBusy = false;
  int _currentIndex = -1;
  NvvRegister? _activeRegister;
  NvvContext? _activeContext;

  ReplacementDirection _replacementDirection =
      ReplacementDirection.simpleToNvv;
  String? _replacementAnswer;
  bool? _replacementCorrect;
  bool _showReplacementExplanation = false;

  NvvChallengeItem? get currentChallenge => _currentChallenge;
  List<String> get displayedOptions => _displayedOptions;
  String? get selectedVerb => _selectedVerb;
  bool? get isCorrect => _isCorrect;
  bool get showExplanation => _showExplanation;
  bool get isBusy => _isBusy;
  NvvRegister? get activeRegister => _activeRegister;
  NvvContext? get activeContext => _activeContext;
  ReplacementDirection get replacementDirection => _replacementDirection;
  String? get replacementAnswer => _replacementAnswer;
  bool? get replacementCorrect => _replacementCorrect;
  bool get showReplacementExplanation => _showReplacementExplanation;

  Future<void> checkPair(String selectedVerb) async {
    final challenge = _requireChallenge();
    if (_showExplanation) {
      throw StateError('Current challenge has already been checked.');
    }

    final verb = selectedVerb.trim();
    if (verb.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        selectedVerb,
        'selectedVerb',
        'must not be empty',
      );
    }

    _setBusy(true);
    try {
      _selectedVerb = verb;
      _isCorrect = await _repository.validateAnswer(challenge.id, verb);
      _showExplanation = true;
    } finally {
      _setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> checkReplacement(String candidate) async {
    final challenge = _requireChallenge();
    if (_showReplacementExplanation) {
      throw StateError('Current replacement has already been checked.');
    }

    final answer = candidate.trim();
    if (answer.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        candidate,
        'candidate',
        'must not be empty',
      );
    }

    _setBusy(true);
    try {
      _replacementAnswer = answer;
      _replacementCorrect = await _repository.validateReplacement(
        challenge.id,
        _replacementDirection,
        answer,
      );
      _showReplacementExplanation = true;
    } finally {
      _setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  void setReplacementDirection(ReplacementDirection direction) {
    if (_replacementDirection == direction) return;
    _replacementDirection = direction;
    _clearReplacementState();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> nextChallenge() async {
    if (_isBusy) return;

    _setBusy(true);
    try {
      if (_challenges.isEmpty) {
        _challenges = await _repository.getChallenges(
          register: _activeRegister,
          context: _activeContext,
        );
      }

      if (_challenges.isEmpty) {
        _clearChallenge();
        return;
      }

      _currentIndex = (_currentIndex + 1) % _challenges.length;
      _activate(_challenges[_currentIndex]);
    } finally {
      _setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> filterByRegister(NvvRegister register) async {
    if (_isBusy) return;

    _setBusy(true);
    try {
      _activeRegister = register;
      _activeContext = null;
      _challenges = await _repository.getChallenges(register: register);
      _activateFirstOrClear();
    } finally {
      _setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> filterByContext(NvvContext context) async {
    if (_isBusy) return;

    _setBusy(true);
    try {
      _activeContext = context;
      _activeRegister = null;
      _challenges = await _repository.getChallenges(context: context);
      _activateFirstOrClear();
    } finally {
      _setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> clearFilters() async {
    if (_isBusy) return;

    _setBusy(true);
    try {
      _activeRegister = null;
      _activeContext = null;
      _challenges = await _repository.getChallenges();
      _activateFirstOrClear();
    } finally {
      _setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  void _activateFirstOrClear() {
    _currentIndex = _challenges.isEmpty ? -1 : 0;
    if (_challenges.isEmpty) {
      _clearChallenge();
    } else {
      _activate(_challenges.first);
    }
  }

  void _activate(NvvChallengeItem challenge) {
    _currentChallenge = challenge;
    _selectedVerb = null;
    _isCorrect = null;
    _showExplanation = false;
    _clearReplacementState();
    _displayedOptions = _buildOptions(challenge);
  }

  List<String> _buildOptions(NvvChallengeItem challenge) {
    final verbs = <String>{challenge.correctVerb};
    for (final item in _challenges) {
      if (item.correctVerb != challenge.correctVerb) {
        verbs.add(item.correctVerb);
      }
      if (verbs.length >= 4) break;
    }

    final options = verbs.toList(growable: false)..sort();
    return List<String>.unmodifiable(options);
  }

  NvvChallengeItem _requireChallenge() {
    final challenge = _currentChallenge;
    if (challenge == null) {
      throw StateError('No active Nomen-Verb-Verbindung challenge.');
    }
    return challenge;
  }

  void _clearReplacementState() {
    _replacementAnswer = null;
    _replacementCorrect = null;
    _showReplacementExplanation = false;
  }

  void _clearChallenge() {
    _currentChallenge = null;
    _displayedOptions = const <String>[];
    _selectedVerb = null;
    _isCorrect = null;
    _showExplanation = false;
    _clearReplacementState();
    _currentIndex = -1;
  }

  void _setBusy(bool value) {
    if (_isBusy == value) return;
    _isBusy = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

    NvvChallengeItem(

      trainingSentence: 'Jede Person kann einen konkreten Verbesserungsvorschlag ___.',
    ),
  ];

  @override
  Future<List<NvvChallengeItem>> getChallenges({
    NvvRegister? register,
    NvvContext? context,
  }) async {
    final items = _bank.where((item) {
      final registerMatches = register == null || item.register == register;
      final contextMatches = context == null || item.context == context;
      return registerMatches && contextMatches;
    });
    return List<NvvChallengeItem>.unmodifiable(items);
  }

  @override
  Future<List<NvvChallengeItem>> search(String query) async {
    final normalized = _normalize(query);
    if (normalized.isEmpty) return const <NvvChallengeItem>[];

    return List<NvvChallengeItem>.unmodifiable(
      _bank.where((item) {
        final haystack = <String>[
          item.nominalPart,
          item.correctVerb,
          item.simpleEquivalent,
          item.arabicTranslation,
          item.preposition ?? '',
          item.caseHint ?? '',
          item.context.name,
        ].join(' ');
        return _normalize(haystack).contains(normalized);
      }),
    );
  }

  @override
  Future<bool> validateAnswer(
    String challengeId,
    String selectedVerb,
  ) async {
    final challenge = _find(challengeId);
    if (challenge == null) return false;
    return _normalize(challenge.correctVerb) == _normalize(selectedVerb);
  }

  @override
  Future<bool> validateReplacement(
    String challengeId,
    ReplacementDirection direction,
    String candidate,
  ) async {
    final challenge = _find(challengeId);
    if (challenge == null) return false;

    final normalized = _normalize(candidate);
    if (normalized.isEmpty) return false;

    if (direction == ReplacementDirection.simpleToNvv) {
      return normalized == _normalize(challenge.nvvPhrase);
    }

    return challenge.simpleEquivalent
        .split('/')
        .map(_normalize)
        .contains(normalized);
  }

  NvvChallengeItem? _find(String id) {
    final normalizedId = id.trim();
    if (normalizedId.isEmpty) return null;
    for (final item in _bank) {
      if (item.id == normalizedId) return item;
    }
    return null;
  }

  static String _normalize(String value) =>
      value.trim().toLowerCase().replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');
}

enum NvvRegister { everyday, formalWorkplace, academicOfficial }

enum NvvContext {
  office,
  academics,
  healthcare,
  constructiveFeedback,
}

enum ReplacementDirection { simpleToNvv, nvvToSimple }

final class NvvChallengeItem {
  const NvvChallengeItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.register,
    required this.nominalPart,
    required this.correctVerb,
    required this.simpleEquivalent,
    required this.arabicTranslation,
    required this.arabicUsageExplanation,
    required this.trainingSentence,
    this.context = NvvContext.office,
    this.level = 'B2',
    this.preposition,
    this.caseHint,
  })  : assert(id.length > 0),
        assert(nominalPart.length > 0),
        assert(correctVerb.length > 0),
        assert(simpleEquivalent.length > 0),
        assert(arabicTranslation.length > 0),
        assert(arabicUsageExplanation.length > 0),
        assert(trainingSentence.length > 0),
        assert(level == 'B2'),
        assert(
          (preposition == null && caseHint == null) ||
              (preposition != null && caseHint != null),
        );

  final String id;
  final NvvRegister register;
  final NvvContext context;
  final String level;

  /// Nominal element including its determiner where natural.
  final String nominalPart;

  /// Infinitive of the verb that forms the fixed collocation.
  final String correctVerb;

  /// A simpler lexical equivalent, e.g. "entscheiden".
  final String simpleEquivalent;

  /// Optional governed preposition, e.g. "auf".
  final String? preposition;

  /// Case governed by [preposition], e.g. "Akkusativ" or "Dativ".
  final String? caseHint;

  final String arabicTranslation;
  final String arabicUsageExplanation;

  /// Realistic sentence containing "___" as the answer slot.
  final String trainingSentence;

  String get nvvPhrase => '$nominalPart $correctVerb';

  String replacementPrompt(ReplacementDirection direction) => switch (direction) {
        ReplacementDirection.simpleToNvv => simpleEquivalent,
        ReplacementDirection.nvvToSimple => nvvPhrase,
      };

  String replacementAnswer(ReplacementDirection direction) => switch (direction) {
        ReplacementDirection.simpleToNvv => nvvPhrase,
        ReplacementDirection.nvvToSimple => simpleEquivalent,
      };

  String? get grammarHint {
    final prep = preposition;
    final grammaticalCase = caseHint;
    if (prep == null || grammaticalCase == null) return null;
    return '$prep + $grammaticalCase';
  }
}

import 'nvv_models.dart';

abstract class NvvRepository {
  Future<List<NvvChallengeItem>> getChallenges({
    NvvRegister? register,
    NvvContext? context,
  });

  Future<List<NvvChallengeItem>> search(String query);

  Future<bool> validateAnswer(
    String challengeId,
    String selectedVerb,
  );

  Future<bool> validateReplacement(
    String challengeId,
    ReplacementDirection direction,
    String candidate,
  );
}

import 'dart:async';


import '../../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import '../application/nvv_notifier.dart';
import '../domain/nvv_models.dart';

class NvvScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const NvvScreen({
    required this.notifier,
    super.key,
  });

  final NvvNotifier notifier;

  @override
  State<NvvScreen> createState() => _NvvScreenState();
}

class _NvvScreenState extends State<NvvScreen> {
  final TextEditingController _replacementController =
      TextEditingController();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    unawaited(widget.notifier.nextChallenge());
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _replacementController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _selectVerb(String verb) async {
    if (widget.notifier.showExplanation || widget.notifier.isBusy) return;
    await widget.notifier.checkPair(verb);
  }

  Future<void> _checkReplacement() async {
    if (widget.notifier.showReplacementExplanation ||
        widget.notifier.isBusy) {
      return;
    }
    final answer = _replacementController.text.trim();
    if (answer.isEmpty) return;
    await widget.notifier.checkReplacement(answer);
  }

  void _setDirection(ReplacementDirection direction) {
    widget.notifier.setReplacementDirection(direction);
    _replacementController.clear();
  }

  Future<void> _filterContext(NvvContext context) async {
    await widget.notifier.filterByContext(context);
    _replacementController.clear();
  }

  Future<void> _clearFilters() async {
    await widget.notifier.clearFilters();
    _replacementController.clear();
  }

  Future<void> _nextChallenge() async {
    await widget.notifier.nextChallenge();
    _replacementController.clear();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: widget.notifier,
      builder: (context, _) {
        final notifier = widget.notifier;
        final challenge = notifier.currentChallenge;

        return Directionality(
          textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
          child: Scaffold(
            appBar: AppBar(
              title: Text(
                'B2 Nomen-Verb-Verbindungen',
                textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                style: AppTypography.title,
              ),
            ),
            body: SafeArea(
              child: SingleChildScrollView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    _ContextFilter(
                      activeContext: notifier.activeContext,
                      busy: notifier.isBusy,
                      onContext: _filterContext,
                      onAll: _clearFilters,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    if (notifier.isBusy && challenge == null)
                      const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
                    else if (challenge == null)
                      AppGlassCard(
                        child: AppDirectionalText(
                          'لا توجد تراكيب متاحة لهذا التصنيف.',
                          languageCode: 'ar',
                          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                          style: AppTypography.body,
                        ),
                      )
                    else ...<Widget>[
                      _ChallengeCard(challenge: challenge),
                      const SizedBox(height: 14),
                      _ReplacementTrainerCard(
                        challenge: challenge,
                        notifier: notifier,
                        controller: _replacementController,
                        onDirectionChanged: _setDirection,
                        onCheck: _checkReplacement,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 14),
                      _VerbPairCard(
                        challenge: challenge,
                        notifier: notifier,
                        onSelected: _selectVerb,
                      ),
                      if (notifier.showExplanation) ...<Widget>[
                        const SizedBox(height: 14),
                        _PairExplanationCard(
                          challenge: challenge,
                          isCorrect: notifier.isCorrect == true,
                          selectedVerb: notifier.selectedVerb!,
                        ),
                      ],
                      const SizedBox(height: 14),
                      FilledButton.icon(
                        onPressed:
                            notifier.isBusy ? null : _nextChallenge,
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded),
                        label: const AppDirectionalText(
                          'التحدي التالي',
                          languageCode: 'ar',
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

class _ContextFilter extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ContextFilter({
    required this.activeContext,
    required this.busy,
    required this.onContext,
    required this.onAll,
  });

  final NvvContext? activeContext;
  final bool busy;
  final ValueChanged<NvvContext> onContext;
  final VoidCallback onAll;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AppGlassCard(
      borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(72),
      glowColor: AppColors.primary,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          AppDirectionalText(
            'سياق B2 المهني',
            languageCode: 'ar',
            style: AppTypography.title,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          Wrap(
            spacing: 8,
            runSpacing: 8,
            children: <Widget>[
              for (final item in NvvContext.values)
                _FilterPill(
                  label: _contextLabel(item),
                  selected: activeContext == item,
                  enabled: !busy,
                  onTap: () => onContext(item),
                ),
              _FilterPill(
                label: 'الكل',
                selected: activeContext == null,
                enabled: !busy,
                onTap: onAll,
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  static String _contextLabel(NvvContext context) => switch (context) {
        NvvContext.office => 'العمل',
        NvvContext.academics => 'الدراسة',
        NvvContext.healthcare => 'الصحة',
        NvvContext.constructiveFeedback => 'ملاحظات بنّاءة',
      };
}

    required this.onTap,
  });

  final String label;
  final bool selected;

  @override

      glowColor: selected ? color : null,
      child: AppDirectionalText(
        label,
        languageCode: 'de',
        style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(color: color),
      ),

FILE: lib/features/orthography_numbers/application/orthography_notifier.dart

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/orthography_models.dart';
import '../domain/orthography_repository.dart';

final class OrthographyState {
  const OrthographyState({
    required this.exercises,
    required this.currentIndex,
    required this.selectedCommaGaps,
    required this.input,
    required this.checked,
    required this.correct,
    required this.feedbackAr,
    required this.filter,
  });

  final List<OrthographyExercise> exercises;
  final int currentIndex;
  final Set<int> selectedCommaGaps;
  final String input;
  final bool checked;
  final bool correct;
  final String feedbackAr;
  final OrthographyTopic? filter;

  OrthographyExercise get current => exercises[currentIndex];
}

final class OrthographyNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  OrthographyNotifier(this._repository)
      : _state = OrthographyState(
          exercises: List<OrthographyExercise>.unmodifiable(
            _repository.allExercises,
          ),
          currentIndex: 0,
          selectedCommaGaps: const <int>{},
          input: '',
          checked: false,
          correct: false,
          feedbackAr: '',
          filter: null,
        ) {
    if (_state.exercises.isEmpty) {
      throw StateError('Orthography exercise bank must not be empty');
    }
  }

  final OrthographyRepository _repository;
  OrthographyState _state;

  OrthographyState get state => _state;

  void toggleCommaAfter(int tokenIndex) {
    final exercise = _state.current;
    if (_state.checked || !exercise.isCommaPlacement) return;
    if (tokenIndex < 0 || tokenIndex >= exercise.tokens.length - 1) {
      return;
    }
    final next = Set<int>.from(_state.selectedCommaGaps);
    if (!next.add(tokenIndex)) next.remove(tokenIndex);
    _replace(
      selectedCommaGaps: Set<int>.unmodifiable(next),
    );
  }

  void checkCommaPlacement() {
    final exercise = _state.current;
    if (!exercise.isCommaPlacement) return;
    final correct = _repository.isCommaPlacementCorrect(
      exercise,
      _state.selectedCommaGaps,
    );
    _replace(
      checked: true,
      correct: correct,
      feedbackAr: correct
          ? 'صحيح. ${exercise.explanationAr}'
          : 'راجع موضع الفاصلة. ${exercise.explanationAr}',
    );
  }

  void checkTextAnswer(String answer) {
    final exercise = _state.current;
    if (exercise.kind != OrthographyExerciseKind.textEntry) return;
    final correct = _repository.isTextAnswerCorrect(exercise, answer);
    _replace(
      input: answer,
      checked: true,
      correct: correct,
      feedbackAr: correct
          ? 'صحيح. ${exercise.explanationAr}'
          : 'راجع الكتابة. ${exercise.explanationAr}',
    );
  }

  void nextExercise() {
    final nextIndex = (_state.currentIndex + 1) % _state.exercises.length;
    _state = OrthographyState(
      exercises: _state.exercises,
      currentIndex: nextIndex,
      selectedCommaGaps: const <int>{},
      input: '',
      checked: false,
      correct: false,
      feedbackAr: '',
      filter: _state.filter,
    );
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void filterByTopic(OrthographyTopic topic) {
    final filtered = _repository.forTopic(topic);
    if (filtered.isEmpty) {
      throw StateError('No orthography exercises for ${topic.name}');
    }
    _state = OrthographyState(
      exercises: List<OrthographyExercise>.unmodifiable(filtered),
      currentIndex: 0,
      selectedCommaGaps: const <int>{},
      input: '',
      checked: false,
      correct: false,
      feedbackAr: '',
      filter: topic,
    );
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void _replace({
    Set<int>? selectedCommaGaps,
    String? input,
    bool? checked,
    bool? correct,
    String? feedbackAr,
  }) {
    _state = OrthographyState(
      exercises: _state.exercises,
      currentIndex: _state.currentIndex,
      selectedCommaGaps:
          selectedCommaGaps ?? _state.selectedCommaGaps,
      input: input ?? _state.input,
      checked: checked ?? _state.checked,
      correct: correct ?? _state.correct,
      feedbackAr: feedbackAr ?? _state.feedbackAr,
      filter: _state.filter,
    );
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

      acceptedAnswers: <String>['-1.000.000,5'],
    ),
  ];

  static final List<String> _months = <String>[
    'Januar',
    'Februar',
    'März',
    'April',
    'Mai',
    'Juni',
    'Juli',
    'August',
    'September',
    'Oktober',
    'November',
    'Dezember',
  ];

  @override
  List<OrthographyExercise> get allExercises =>
      List<OrthographyExercise>.unmodifiable(_exercises);

  @override
  OrthographyExercise? byId(String id) {
    final normalized = id.trim();
    for (final exercise in _exercises) {
      if (exercise.id == normalized) return exercise;
    }
    return null;
  }

  @override
  List<OrthographyExercise> forTopic(OrthographyTopic topic) =>
      List<OrthographyExercise>.unmodifiable(
        _exercises.where((exercise) => exercise.topic == topic),
      );

  @override
  bool isCommaPlacementCorrect(
    OrthographyExercise exercise,
    Set<int> selectedGaps,
  ) {
    if (!exercise.isCommaPlacement) return false;
    return _setEquals(exercise.correctCommaGaps, selectedGaps);
  }

  @override
  bool isTextAnswerCorrect(
    OrthographyExercise exercise,
    String answer,
  ) {
    if (exercise.kind != OrthographyExerciseKind.textEntry) return false;
    final normalized = normalizeTextAnswer(answer);
    return exercise.acceptedAnswers.any(
      (candidate) => normalizeTextAnswer(candidate) == normalized,
    );
  }

  @override
  String formatDateLong(DateTime date) =>
      '${date.day}. ${_months[date.month - 1]} ${date.year}';

  @override
  String formatDateNumeric(DateTime date) =>
      '${_twoDigits(date.day)}.${_twoDigits(date.month)}.${date.year}';

  @override
  String formatNumber(String canonicalNumber) {
    final normalized = canonicalNumber.trim();
    final match = RegExp(r'^(-?)(\d+)(?:\.(\d+))?$').firstMatch(normalized);
    if (match == null) {
      throw FormatException(
        'Expected canonical decimal number',
        canonicalNumber,
      );
    }

    final sign = match.group(1) ?? '';
    final integer = match.group(2)!;
    final fraction = match.group(3);
    final grouped = _groupThousands(integer);
    return fraction == null || fraction.isEmpty
        ? '$sign$grouped'
        : '$sign$grouped,$fraction';
  }

  @override
  String renderCommaSentence(
    OrthographyExercise exercise,
    Set<int> selectedGaps,
  ) {
    if (!exercise.isCommaPlacement) return exercise.promptDe;
    final parts = <String>[];
    for (var index = 0; index < exercise.tokens.length; index++) {
      final suffix = selectedGaps.contains(index) ? ',' : '';
      parts.add('${exercise.tokens[index]}$suffix');
    }
    return parts.join(' ');
  }

  @override
  String normalizeTextAnswer(String value) =>
      value.trim().replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');

  bool _setEquals(Set<int> left, Set<int> right) =>
      left.length == right.length && left.containsAll(right);

  String _groupThousands(String digits) {
    final buffer = StringBuffer();
    final firstGroup = digits.length % 3;
    var index = 0;
    if (firstGroup > 0) {
      buffer.write(digits.substring(0, firstGroup));
      index = firstGroup;
    }
    while (index < digits.length) {
      if (buffer.isNotEmpty) buffer.write('.');
      buffer.write(digits.substring(index, index + 3));
      index += 3;
    }
    return buffer.toString();
  }

  String _twoDigits(int value) => value.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
}

FILE: lib/features/orthography_numbers/domain/orthography_models.dart
--------------------------------------------------
enum OrthographyTopic {
  comma,
  spelling,
  capitalization,
  punctuation,
  date,
  number,
}

enum OrthographyExerciseKind {
  commaPlacement,
  textEntry,
}

extension OrthographyTopicLabels on OrthographyTopic {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        OrthographyTopic.comma => 'Kommas',
        OrthographyTopic.spelling => 'Rechtschreibung',
        OrthographyTopic.capitalization => 'Großschreibung',
        OrthographyTopic.punctuation => 'Satzzeichen',
        OrthographyTopic.date => 'Datum',
        OrthographyTopic.number => 'Zahlen',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        OrthographyTopic.comma => 'الفواصل',
        OrthographyTopic.spelling => 'الإملاء',
        OrthographyTopic.capitalization => 'الحروف الكبيرة',
        OrthographyTopic.punctuation => 'علامات الترقيم',
        OrthographyTopic.date => 'التاريخ',
        OrthographyTopic.number => 'الأرقام',
      };
}

final class OrthographyExercise {
  const OrthographyExercise({
    required this.id,
    required this.topic,
    required this.kind,
    required this.promptDe,
    required this.instructionAr,
    required this.explanationAr,
    this.tokens = const <String>[],
    this.correctCommaGaps = const <int>{},
    this.acceptedAnswers = const <String>[],
  });

  final String id;
  final OrthographyTopic topic;
  final OrthographyExerciseKind kind;
  final String promptDe;
  final String instructionAr;
  final String explanationAr;
  final List<String> tokens;
  final Set<int> correctCommaGaps;
  final List<String> acceptedAnswers;

  bool get isCommaPlacement =>
      kind == OrthographyExerciseKind.commaPlacement;
}

import 'orthography_models.dart';

abstract interface class OrthographyRepository {
  List<OrthographyExercise> get allExercises;

  List<OrthographyExercise> forTopic(OrthographyTopic topic);

  OrthographyExercise? byId(String id);

  bool isCommaPlacementCorrect(
    OrthographyExercise exercise,

  );

  );

  );

}

class _CommaPlacementCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _CommaPlacementCard({
    required this.state,
    required this.onToggle,
    required this.onCheck,
    required this.onNext,
  });

  final OrthographyState state;
  final ValueChanged<int> onToggle;
  final VoidCallback onCheck;
  final VoidCallback onNext;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final exercise = state.current;
    return AppGlassCard(
      glowColor: state.checked
          ? (state.correct ? AppColors.mastery : AppColors.tertiary)
          : AppColors.achievement,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          AppDirectionalText(
            'اضغط على الكلمة التي تريد وضع فاصلة بعدها',
            languageCode: 'ar',
            style: AppTypography.body,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Directionality(
            textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
            child: Wrap(
              spacing: 8,
              runSpacing: 8,
              children: [
                for (var index = 0;
                    index < exercise.tokens.length;
                    index++)
                  _CommaTokenButton(
                    token: exercise.tokens[index],
                    showComma: state.selectedCommaGaps.contains(index),
                    enabled:
                        !state.checked && index < exercise.tokens.length - 1,
                    onPressed: () => onToggle(index),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          AppDirectionalText(
            _renderSentence(exercise, state.selectedCommaGaps),
            languageCode: 'de',
            style: AppTypography.body,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          if (!state.checked)
            FilledButton.icon(
              onPressed: onCheck,
              icon: const Icon(Icons.check_rounded),
              label: AppDirectionalText(
                'تحقق من الفواصل',
                languageCode: 'ar',
                style: AppTypography.label,
              ),
            )
          else ...[
            _FeedbackPanel(state: state),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            FilledButton.icon(
              onPressed: onNext,
              icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_forward_rounded),
              label: AppDirectionalText(
                'التمرين التالي',
                languageCode: 'ar',
                style: AppTypography.label,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  String _renderSentence(
    OrthographyExercise exercise,
    Set<int> selectedGaps,
  ) {
    final parts = <String>[];
    for (var index = 0; index < exercise.tokens.length; index++) {
      final suffix = selectedGaps.contains(index) ? ',' : '';
      parts.add('${exercise.tokens[index]}$suffix');
    }
    return parts.join(' ');
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/pack_passport/application/pack_passport_controller.dart

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../../../core/packs/pack_models.dart';
import '../domain/pack_passport_models.dart';

enum PackPassportLoadState {
  idle,
  loading,
  ready,
  failed,
}

final class PackPassportController extends ChangeNotifier {
  PackPassportController({
    required PackPassportAssembler assembler,
  }) : _assembler = assembler;

  final PackPassportAssembler _assembler;

  PackPassportLoadState _state = PackPassportLoadState.idle;
  List<PackPassportEntry> _entries = const <PackPassportEntry>[];
  Object? _lastError;
  int _generation = 0;

  PackPassportLoadState get state => _state;
  List<PackPassportEntry> get entries => _entries;
  Object? get lastError => _lastError;

  Future<void> refresh(
    Iterable<PackPairRequest> requests,
  ) async {
    final generation = ++_generation;
    final unique = <String, PackPairRequest>{};

    for (final request in requests) {
      final pairKey = request.pairKey;
      unique.putIfAbsent(pairKey, () => request);
    }

    _state = PackPassportLoadState.loading;
    _lastError = null;
    notifyListeners();

    try {
      final next = await Future.wait(
        unique.values.map(_assembler.build),
        eagerError: true,
      );
      if (generation != _generation) return;

      next.sort((a, b) => a.pairKey.compareTo(b.pairKey));
      _entries = List<PackPassportEntry>.unmodifiable(next);
      _state = PackPassportLoadState.ready;
      notifyListeners();
    } on Object catch (error) {
      if (generation != _generation) return;
      _entries = const <PackPassportEntry>[];
      _lastError = error;
      _state = PackPassportLoadState.failed;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  Future<void> refreshDirection(
    String sourceLanguageCode,
    String targetLanguageCode,
  ) =>
      refresh(
        <PackPairRequest>[
          PackPairRequest(
            sourceLanguageTag: sourceLanguageCode,
            targetLanguageTag: targetLanguageCode,
          ),
        ],
      );

  void invalidatePendingRefresh() {
    _generation += 1;
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/pack_passport/domain/pack_passport_models.dart

import '../../../core/pack_acquisition/hybrid_pad_models.dart';
import '../../../core/packs/pack_models.dart';

enum PackPassportInstallState {
  notInstalled,
  partial,
  installed,
}

enum PackPassportVerificationStatus {
  unverified,
  verified,
  blocked,
}

final class PackPassportLogicalState {
  final String logicalPackId;
  final String? version;
  final int schemaVersion;
  final String sha256;
  final bool verified;
  final String? failureReason;
  final bool installed;
  final num storageBytes;

  const PackPassportLogicalState({
    this.logicalPackId = '',
    this.version,
    this.schemaVersion = 1,
    this.sha256 = '',
    this.verified = false,
    this.failureReason,
    this.installed = false,
    this.storageBytes = 0,
  });
}

abstract interface class PackPassportLogicalStateSource {
  Future<PackPassportLogicalState?> stateFor(String logicalPackId);
}

final class PackPassportEntry {
  PackPassportEntry({
    required this.request,
    required this.installState,
    required this.offlineReady,
    required this.requiredComponentCount,
    required this.installedComponentCount,
    required this.expectedSizeBytes,
    required this.installedSizeBytes,
    required this.versionSummary,
    required this.verificationStatus,
    required Iterable<String> logicalPackIds,
    required Iterable<String> physicalShardIds,
    this.blockReason,
  })  : logicalPackIds = List<String>.unmodifiable(logicalPackIds),
        physicalShardIds = List<String>.unmodifiable(physicalShardIds);

  final PackPairRequest request;
  final PackPassportInstallState installState;
  final bool offlineReady;
  final int requiredComponentCount;
  final int installedComponentCount;
  final int expectedSizeBytes;
  final int installedSizeBytes;
  final String versionSummary;
  final PackPassportVerificationStatus verificationStatus;
  final List<String> logicalPackIds;
  final List<String> physicalShardIds;
  final String? blockReason;

  String get pairKey => request.pairKey;
}

final class PackPassportAssembler {
  const PackPassportAssembler({
    required this.catalog,
    required this.stateSource,
  });

  final HybridPadCatalog catalog;
  final PackPassportLogicalStateSource stateSource;

  Future<PackPassportEntry> build(PackPairRequest request) async {
    final requirements = catalog.requirementsFor(request);
    final states = <PackPassportLogicalState?>[];

    for (final descriptor in requirements) {
      states.add(await stateSource.stateFor(descriptor.id));
    }

    var installedCount = 0;
    var installedSizeBytes = 0;
    var allVerified = true;
    String? blockReason;

    for (var index = 0; index < requirements.length; index += 1) {
      final state = states[index];
      if (state == null || !state.installed) {
        allVerified = false;
        continue;
      }

      installedCount += 1;
      installedSizeBytes += (state.storageBytes).toInt();

      final descriptor = requirements[index];
      final descriptorMatches =
          state.logicalPackId == descriptor.id &&
          state.version == descriptor.version &&
          state.schemaVersion == descriptor.schemaVersion &&
          state.sha256 == descriptor.sha256;
      if (!state.verified || !descriptorMatches) {
        allVerified = false;
      }
      if (!descriptorMatches && blockReason == null) {
        blockReason =
            'Installed logical pack does not match the active descriptor: '
            '${descriptor.id}';
      }
      if (blockReason == null &&
          state.failureReason != null &&
          state.failureReason!.trim().isNotEmpty) {
        blockReason = state.failureReason!.trim();
      }
    }

    final installState = installedCount == 0
        ? PackPassportInstallState.notInstalled
        : installedCount == requirements.length
            ? PackPassportInstallState.installed
            : PackPassportInstallState.partial;

    final verificationStatus = blockReason != null
        ? PackPassportVerificationStatus.blocked
        : allVerified && installState == PackPassportInstallState.installed
            ? PackPassportVerificationStatus.verified
            : PackPassportVerificationStatus.unverified;

    final offlineReady =
        installState == PackPassportInstallState.installed &&
            verificationStatus == PackPassportVerificationStatus.verified;

    final versions = <String>{};
    for (var index = 0; index < requirements.length; index += 1) {
      final state = states[index];
      final version = state?.version?.trim();
      versions.add(
        version == null || version.isEmpty
            ? requirements[index].version
            : version,
      );
    }

    final physicalShardIds = requirements
        .map((descriptor) => catalog.shardForLogicalPack(descriptor.id).id)
        .toSet()
        .toList(growable: false)
      ..sort();

    return PackPassportEntry(
      request: request,
      installState: installState,
      offlineReady: offlineReady,
      requiredComponentCount: requirements.length,
      installedComponentCount: installedCount,
      expectedSizeBytes: requirements.fold<int>(
        0,
        (total, descriptor) => total + descriptor.sizeBytes,
      ),
      installedSizeBytes: installedSizeBytes,
      versionSummary: versions.length == 1
          ? versions.single
          : (versions.toList(growable: false)..sort()).join(' + '),
      verificationStatus: verificationStatus,
      logicalPackIds: requirements.map((descriptor) => descriptor.id),
      physicalShardIds: physicalShardIds,
      blockReason: blockReason,
    );
  }
}

typedef PackPassportLanguageLabelBuilder = String Function(
  String languageCode,
);

final class PackPassportPanel extends StatelessWidget {
  const PackPassportPanel({
    super.key,
    required this.controller,
    this.strings,
    this.languageLabelBuilder,
  });

  final PackPassportController controller;
  final PackPassportStrings? strings;
  final PackPassportLanguageLabelBuilder? languageLabelBuilder;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final copy = strings ?? PackPassportStrings.arabic();
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: controller,
      builder: (context, _) {
        return Semantics(
          container: true,
          label: copy.title,
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: <Widget>[
              Text(
                copy.title,
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              _buildBody(context, copy),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _buildBody(
    BuildContext context,
    PackPassportStrings copy,
  ) {
    switch (controller.state) {
      case PackPassportLoadState.idle:
        return _InfoSurface(
          icon: Icons.inventory_2_outlined,
          text: copy.empty,
        );
      case PackPassportLoadState.loading:
        return _InfoSurface(
          icon: Icons.sync,
          text: copy.loading,
          progress: true,
        );
      case PackPassportLoadState.failed:
        return _InfoSurface(
          icon: Icons.warning_amber_rounded,
          text: copy.failed,
          error: true,
        );
      case PackPassportLoadState.ready:
        if (controller.entries.isEmpty) {
          return _InfoSurface(
            icon: Icons.inventory_2_outlined,
            text: copy.empty,
          );
        }
        return Column(
          children: <Widget>[
            for (final entry in controller.entries) ...<Widget>[
              _PackPassportCard(
                entry: entry,
                strings: copy,
                languageLabelBuilder: languageLabelBuilder,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
            ],
          ],
        );
    }
  }
}

                  icon: Icons.offline_bolt_outlined,
                  label: strings.offlineReady,
                  value: entry.offlineReady ? strings.yes : strings.no,
                  status: entry.offlineReady
                      ? _VisualStatus.good
                      : _VisualStatus.pending,
                ),
                _StatusPill(
                  icon: Icons.sd_storage_outlined,
                  label: strings.size,
                  value: _sizeText(entry),
                  status: _VisualStatus.neutral,
                ),
                _StatusPill(
                  icon: Icons.sell_outlined,
                  label: strings.version,
                  value: entry.versionSummary,
                  status: _VisualStatus.neutral,
                ),
                _StatusPill(
                  icon: Icons.verified_user_outlined,
                  label: strings.verified,
                  value: verifiedText,
                  status: entry.verificationStatus ==
                          PackPassportVerificationStatus.verified
                      ? _VisualStatus.good
                      : entry.verificationStatus ==
                              PackPassportVerificationStatus.blocked
                          ? _VisualStatus.error
                          : _VisualStatus.pending,
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Text(
              '${strings.logicalPacks}: ${entry.logicalPackIds.length}'
              ' · '
              '${strings.physicalShards}: ${entry.physicalShardIds.length}',
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall,
            ),
            if (entry.blockReason != null) ...<Widget>[
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Text(
                entry.blockReason!,
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                      color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error,
                    ),
              ),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  String _languageLabel(String code) =>
      languageLabelBuilder?.call(code) ?? code.toUpperCase();

  String _installedText() {
    switch (entry.installState) {
      case PackPassportInstallState.notInstalled:
        return strings.notInstalled;
      case PackPassportInstallState.partial:
        return '${strings.partial} '
            '(${entry.installedComponentCount}/'
            '${entry.requiredComponentCount})';
      case PackPassportInstallState.installed:
        return strings.yes;
    }
  }

  String _verificationText() {
    switch (entry.verificationStatus) {
      case PackPassportVerificationStatus.unverified:
        return strings.unverified;
      case PackPassportVerificationStatus.verified:
        return strings.yes;
      case PackPassportVerificationStatus.blocked:
        return strings.blocked;
    }
  }

  static String _sizeText(PackPassportEntry entry) {
    final installed = _formatBytes(entry.installedSizeBytes);
    final expected = _formatBytes(entry.expectedSizeBytes);
    if (entry.installedSizeBytes <= 0) return expected;
    if (entry.installedSizeBytes == entry.expectedSizeBytes) {
      return installed;
    }
    return '$installed / $expected';
  }

  static String _formatBytes(int bytes) {
    if (bytes < 1024) return '$bytes B';
    final kib = bytes / 1024;
    if (kib < 1024) return '${kib.toStringAsFixed(1)} KiB';
    final mib = kib / 1024;
    if (mib < 1024) return '${mib.toStringAsFixed(1)} MiB';
    final gib = mib / 1024;
    return '${gib.toStringAsFixed(1)} GiB';
  }
}

enum _VisualStatus {
  neutral,
  pending,
  good,
  error,
}

final class _StatusPill extends StatelessWidget {
  const _StatusPill({
    required this.icon,
    required this.label,
    required this.value,
    required this.status,
  });

  final IconData icon;
  final String label;
  final String value;
  final _VisualStatus status;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final foreground = switch (status) {
      _VisualStatus.good => scheme.primary,
      _VisualStatus.pending => scheme.tertiary,
      _VisualStatus.error => scheme.error,
      _VisualStatus.neutral => scheme.onSurfaceVariant,
    };

    return Semantics(
      label: '$label: $value',
      child: DecoratedBox(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          border: Border.all(
            color: scheme.outlineVariant,
          ),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
        ),
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
            horizontal: 10,
            vertical: 7,
          ),
          child: Row(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: <Widget>[
              Icon(
                icon,
                size: 16,
                color: foreground,
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 6),
              Text(
                '$label: $value',
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.labelMedium?.copyWith(
                      color: foreground,
                    ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _InfoSurface extends StatelessWidget {
  const _InfoSurface({
    required this.icon,
    required this.text,
    this.progress = false,
    this.error = false,
  });

  final IconData icon;
  final String text;
  final bool progress;
  final bool error;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    return AdaptiveGlassSurface(
      child: Row(
        children: <Widget>[
          if (progress)
            const SizedBox.square(
              dimension: 20,
              child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
            )
          else
            Icon(
              icon,
              color: error ? scheme.error : scheme.onSurfaceVariant,
            ),
          const SizedBox(width: 10),
          Expanded(child: Text(text)),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/partizip_adjektive/application/partizip_notifier.dart

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/partizip_models.dart';
import '../domain/partizip_repository.dart';

final class PartizipState {
  const PartizipState({
    required this.exercises,
    required this.currentIndex,
    required this.input,
    required this.orderedTokens,
    required this.checked,
    required this.correct,
    required this.feedbackAr,
    required this.filter,
  });

  final List<PartizipExercise> exercises;
  final int currentIndex;
  final String input;
  final List<String> orderedTokens;
  final bool checked;
  final bool correct;
  final String feedbackAr;
  final PartizipKind? filter;

  PartizipExercise get current => exercises[currentIndex];
}

final class PartizipNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  PartizipNotifier(this._repository)
      : _state = PartizipState(
          exercises: List<PartizipExercise>.unmodifiable(
            _repository.allExercises,
          ),
          currentIndex: 0,
          input: '',
          orderedTokens: const <String>[],
          checked: false,
          correct: false,
          feedbackAr: '',
          filter: null,
        ) {
    if (_state.exercises.isEmpty) {
      throw StateError('Partizip exercise bank must not be empty');
    }
  }

  final PartizipRepository _repository;
  PartizipState _state;

  PartizipState get state => _state;

  void checkAttribute(String candidate) {
    final exercise = _state.current;
    final correct = _repository.isAnswerCorrect(exercise, candidate);
    _state = PartizipState(
      exercises: _state.exercises,
      currentIndex: _state.currentIndex,
      input: candidate,
      orderedTokens: _state.orderedTokens,
      checked: true,
      correct: correct,
      feedbackAr: correct
          ? 'صحيح. ${exercise.explanationAr}'
          : 'راجع ترتيب الوصف ونهاية الصفة. ${exercise.explanationAr}',
      filter: _state.filter,
    );
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void addToken(String token) {
    if (_state.checked) return;
    final available = List<String>.from(_state.current.attributeTokens);
    for (final selected in _state.orderedTokens) {
      available.remove(selected);
    }
    if (!available.contains(token)) return;
    final next = <String>[..._state.orderedTokens, token];
    _replaceTokens(next);
  }

  void removeLastToken() {
    if (_state.checked || _state.orderedTokens.isEmpty) return;
    final next = List<String>.from(_state.orderedTokens)..removeLast();
    _replaceTokens(next);
  }

  void checkTokenOrder() {
    final correct = _repository.isTokenOrderCorrect(
      _state.current,
      _state.orderedTokens,
    );
    final exercise = _state.current;
    _state = PartizipState(
      exercises: _state.exercises,
      currentIndex: _state.currentIndex,
      input: _state.input,
      orderedTokens: _state.orderedTokens,
      checked: true,
      correct: correct,
      feedbackAr: correct
          ? 'الترتيب صحيح. ${exercise.explanationAr}'
          : 'الوصف الموسّع يجب أن يبقى كاملاً قبل الاسم. ${exercise.explanationAr}',
      filter: _state.filter,
    );
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void nextExercise() {
    final nextIndex = (_state.currentIndex + 1) % _state.exercises.length;
    _state = PartizipState(
      exercises: _state.exercises,
      currentIndex: nextIndex,
      input: '',
      orderedTokens: const <String>[],
      checked: false,
      correct: false,
      feedbackAr: '',
      filter: _state.filter,
    );
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void filterByKind(PartizipKind kind) {
    final filtered = _repository.forKind(kind);
    if (filtered.isEmpty) {
      throw StateError('No Partizip exercises for ${kind.name}');
    }
    _state = PartizipState(
      exercises: List<PartizipExercise>.unmodifiable(filtered),
      currentIndex: 0,
      input: '',
      orderedTokens: const <String>[],
      checked: false,
      correct: false,
      feedbackAr: '',
      filter: kind,
    );
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void _replaceTokens(List<String> tokens) {
    _state = PartizipState(
      exercises: _state.exercises,
      currentIndex: _state.currentIndex,
      input: _state.input,
      orderedTokens: List<String>.unmodifiable(tokens),
      checked: _state.checked,
      correct: _state.correct,
      feedbackAr: _state.feedbackAr,
      filter: _state.filter,
    );
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

  @override
  List<PartizipExercise> get allExercises =>
      List<PartizipExercise>.unmodifiable(_exercises);

  @override
  PartizipExercise? byId(String id) {
    final normalized = id.trim();
    for (final exercise in _exercises) {
      if (exercise.id == normalized) return exercise;
    }
    return null;
  }

  @override
  List<PartizipExercise> forKind(PartizipKind kind) =>
      List<PartizipExercise>.unmodifiable(
        _exercises.where((exercise) => exercise.kind == kind),
      );

  @override
  String formPartizipI(String infinitive) {
    final normalized = infinitive.trim();
    if (normalized.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        infinitive,
        'infinitive',
        'must not be empty',
      );
    }
    return '${normalized}d';
  }

  @override
  String? partizipIIFor(String infinitive) {
    final normalized = infinitive.trim().toLowerCase();
    for (final exercise in _exercises) {
      if (exercise.kind == PartizipKind.partizipII &&
          exercise.infinitive.toLowerCase() == normalized) {
        return exercise.participle;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  @override
  String formAdjective({
    required String participle,
    required String ending,
  }) {
    final base = participle.trim();
    final suffix = ending.trim().replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^-'), '');
    if (base.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        participle,
        'participle',
        'must not be empty',
      );
    }
    const endings = <String>{'e', 'en', 'em', 'er', 'es'};
    if (!endings.contains(suffix)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        ending,
        'ending',
        'must be a German adjective ending',
      );
    }
    return '$base$suffix';
  }

  @override
  bool isAnswerCorrect(
    PartizipExercise exercise,
    String candidate,
  ) =>
      normalizeAnswer(candidate) ==
      normalizeAnswer(exercise.correctAttribute);

  @override
  bool isTokenOrderCorrect(
    PartizipExercise exercise,
    List<String> candidateTokens,
  ) {
    if (candidateTokens.length != exercise.attributeTokens.length) {
      return false;
    }
    for (var index = 0; index < candidateTokens.length; index++) {
      if (candidateTokens[index] != exercise.attributeTokens[index]) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    return true;
  }

  @override
  String normalizeAnswer(String value) =>
      value.trim().replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/passiv_models.dart';
import '../domain/passiv_repository.dart';

final class PassivNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  PassivNotifier(this._repository);

  final PassivRepository _repository;

  List<PassivDrillItem> _drills = const <PassivDrillItem>[];
  PassivType? _activeType;
  int _currentIndex = 0;
  String? _selectedAuxiliary;
  String? _selectedPreposition;
  String? _selectedPartizipII;
  bool? _isCorrect;
  bool _showExplanation = false;
  bool _isLoading = false;
  int _generation = 0;

  List<PassivDrillItem> get drills =>
      List<PassivDrillItem>.unmodifiable(_drills);
  PassivType? get activeType => _activeType;
  int get currentIndex => _currentIndex;
  String? get selectedAuxiliary => _selectedAuxiliary;
  String? get selectedPreposition => _selectedPreposition;
  String? get selectedPartizipII => _selectedPartizipII;
  bool? get isCorrect => _isCorrect;
  bool get showExplanation => _showExplanation;
  bool get isLoading => _isLoading;

  PassivDrillItem? get currentDrill {
    if (_drills.isEmpty || _currentIndex >= _drills.length) return null;
    return _drills[_currentIndex];
  }

  List<String> get auxiliaryOptions {
    final current = currentDrill;
    if (current == null) return const <String>[];
    return _options(
      correct: current.auxiliaryForm,
      candidates: _drills.map((item) => item.auxiliaryForm),
      limit: 4,
    );
  }

  List<String> get prepositionOptions => const <String>['von', 'durch'];

  List<String> get partizipOptions {
    final current = currentDrill;
    if (current == null) return const <String>[];
    return _options(
      correct: current.partizipII,
      candidates: _drills.map((item) => item.partizipII),
      limit: 4,
    );
  }

  bool get canCheck =>
      currentDrill != null &&
      _selectedAuxiliary != null &&
      _selectedPreposition != null &&
      _selectedPartizipII != null &&
      !_showExplanation;

  Future<void> load({PassivType? type}) async {
    final generation = ++_generation;
    _isLoading = true;
    _activeType = type;
    notifyListeners();

    try {
      final loaded = await _repository.getDrills(type: type);
      if (generation != _generation) return;
      _drills = List<PassivDrillItem>.unmodifiable(loaded);
      _currentIndex = 0;
      _clearAnswerState();
    } finally {
      if (generation == _generation) {
        _isLoading = false;
        notifyListeners();
      }
    }
  }

  void selectAuxiliary(String value) {
    if (_showExplanation || currentDrill == null) return;
    _generation++;
    _selectedAuxiliary = value.trim();
    _isCorrect = null;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void selectPreposition(String value) {
    if (_showExplanation || currentDrill == null) return;
    _generation++;
    _selectedPreposition = value.trim().toLowerCase();
    _isCorrect = null;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void selectPartizipII(String value) {
    if (_showExplanation || currentDrill == null) return;
    _generation++;
    _selectedPartizipII = value.trim();
    _isCorrect = null;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> checkTransformation({
    required String auxiliaryForm,
    required String agentPreposition,
    required String partizipII,
  }) async {
    final drill = currentDrill;
    if (drill == null || _showExplanation) return;

    final generation = ++_generation;
    _selectedAuxiliary = auxiliaryForm.trim();
    _selectedPreposition = agentPreposition.trim().toLowerCase();
    _selectedPartizipII = partizipII.trim();
    _isCorrect = null;
    notifyListeners();

    final correct = await _repository.checkTransformation(
      drillId: drill.id,
      auxiliaryForm: _selectedAuxiliary!,
      agentPreposition: _selectedPreposition!,
      partizipII: _selectedPartizipII!,
    );
    if (generation != _generation || currentDrill?.id != drill.id) return;

    _isCorrect = correct;
    _showExplanation = true;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void nextDrill() {
    if (_drills.isEmpty || !_showExplanation) return;
    _generation++;
    _currentIndex = (_currentIndex + 1) % _drills.length;
    _clearAnswerState();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> switchPassivType(PassivType type) async {
    if (_activeType == type && _drills.isNotEmpty) {
      _generation++;
      _currentIndex = 0;
      _clearAnswerState();
      notifyListeners();
      return;
    }
    await load(type: type);
  }

  void _clearAnswerState() {
    _selectedAuxiliary = null;
    _selectedPreposition = null;
    _selectedPartizipII = null;
    _isCorrect = null;
    _showExplanation = false;
  }

  static List<String> _options({
    required String correct,
    required Iterable<String> candidates,
    required int limit,
  }) {
    final unique = <String>{correct};
    for (final candidate in candidates) {
      if (unique.length >= limit) break;
      unique.add(candidate);
    }
    final options = unique.toList(growable: false)..sort();
    return List<String>.unmodifiable(options);
  }
}

import '../domain/passiv_models.dart';
import '../domain/passiv_repository.dart';

final class LocalPassivRepository implements PassivRepository {
  LocalPassivRepository() : _drills = _buildValidatedBank();

  final List<PassivDrillItem> _drills;

  @override
  Future<List<PassivDrillItem>> getDrills({
    PassivType? type,
  }) async {
    final selected = type == null
        ? _drills
        : _drills
            .where((item) => item.type == type)
            .toList(growable: false);
    return List<PassivDrillItem>.unmodifiable(selected);
  }

  @override
  Future<bool> checkTransformation({
    required String drillId,
    required String auxiliaryForm,
    required String agentPreposition,
    required String partizipII,
  }) async {
    final auxiliary = _normalize(auxiliaryForm);
    final preposition = _normalize(agentPreposition);
    final participle = _normalize(partizipII);

    for (final drill in _drills) {
      if (drill.id != drillId) continue;
      return auxiliary == _normalize(drill.auxiliaryForm) &&
          preposition == _normalize(drill.agentPreposition) &&
          participle == _normalize(drill.partizipII);
    }
    return false;
  }

  static String _normalize(String value) =>
      value.trim().toLowerCase().replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');

  static List<PassivDrillItem> _buildValidatedBank() {
    const drills = <PassivDrillItem>[
      PassivDrillItem(
        id: 'vorgang_praesens_person',
        activeSentence: 'Der Mechaniker repariert den Motor.',
        passiveSentence: 'Der Motor wird von dem Mechaniker repariert.',
        originalAgent: 'der Mechaniker',
        agentPreposition: 'von',
        agentCaseLabel: 'Dativ',
        akkusativObject: 'den Motor',
        nominativSubject: 'der Motor',
        auxiliaryForm: 'wird',
        partizipII: 'repariert',
        type: PassivType.vorgangspassiv,
        tense: PassivTense.praesens,
        explanationAr:

        akkusativObject: 'die Tür',
        nominativSubject: 'die Tür',

        partizipII: 'geschlossen',

        tense: PassivTense.praeteritum,
        explanationAr:
            'في الماضي نستخدم Präteritum من sein: war + Partizip II. الجملة تصف أن الباب كان في حالة الإغلاق، وليس لحظة تنفيذ الإغلاق.',
      ),
      PassivDrillItem(
        id: 'zustand_praeteritum_lights',
        activeSentence: 'Jemand schaltete die Lichter aus.',
        passiveSentence: 'Die Lichter waren ausgeschaltet.',
        originalAgent: 'jemand',
        agentPreposition: 'von',
        agentCaseLabel: 'Dativ',
        akkusativObject: 'die Lichter',
        nominativSubject: 'die Lichter',
        auxiliaryForm: 'waren',
        partizipII: 'ausgeschaltet',
        type: PassivType.zustandspassiv,
        tense: PassivTense.praeteritum,
        explanationAr:
            'لأن الفاعل النحوي الجديد جمع نستخدم waren. Zustandspassiv يصف حالة الأضواء بعد إطفائها: Die Lichter waren ausgeschaltet.',
      ),
      PassivDrillItem(
        id: 'zustand_perfekt_room',
        activeSentence: 'Jemand hat das Zimmer vorbereitet.',
        passiveSentence: 'Das Zimmer ist vorbereitet gewesen.',
        originalAgent: 'jemand',
        agentPreposition: 'von',
        agentCaseLabel: 'Dativ',
        akkusativObject: 'das Zimmer',
        nominativSubject: 'das Zimmer',
        auxiliaryForm: 'ist',
        partizipII: 'vorbereitet',
        type: PassivType.zustandspassiv,
        tense: PassivTense.perfekt,
        explanationAr:
            'Perfekt لـ Zustandspassiv يتكون من sein + Partizip II + gewesen. الجملة تركز على أن الغرفة كانت في حالة الجاهزية، لا على عملية تجهيزها.',
      ),
    ];

    final ids = drills.map((item) => item.id).toSet();
    if (ids.length != drills.length) {
      throw StateError('passiv drill bank contains duplicate ids');
    }

    for (final drill in drills) {
      final expectedCase =
          drill.agentPreposition == 'von' ? 'Dativ' : 'Akkusativ';
      if (drill.agentPreposition != 'von' &&
          drill.agentPreposition != 'durch') {
        throw StateError('unsupported agent preposition: ${drill.id}');
      }
      if (drill.agentCaseLabel != expectedCase) {
        throw StateError('agent case does not match preposition: ${drill.id}');
      }
      if (!drill.passiveSentence.contains(drill.auxiliaryForm) ||
          !drill.passiveSentence.contains(drill.partizipII)) {
        throw StateError('passive sentence does not match drill: ${drill.id}');
      }
    }

    return List<PassivDrillItem>.unmodifiable(drills);
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/passiv_arena/domain/passiv_models.dart

enum PassivType { vorgangspassiv, zustandspassiv }

enum PassivTense { praesens, praeteritum, perfekt }

final class PassivDrillItem {
  const PassivDrillItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.activeSentence,
    required this.passiveSentence,
    required this.originalAgent,
    required this.agentPreposition,
    required this.agentCaseLabel,
    required this.akkusativObject,
    required this.nominativSubject,
    required this.auxiliaryForm,
    required this.partizipII,
    required this.type,
    required this.tense,
    required this.explanationAr,
  });

  final String id;
  final String activeSentence;
  final String passiveSentence;
  final String originalAgent;
  final String agentPreposition;
  final String agentCaseLabel;
  final String akkusativObject;
  final String nominativSubject;
  final String auxiliaryForm;
  final String partizipII;
  final PassivType type;
  final PassivTense tense;
  final String explanationAr;

  String get typeLabelAr => switch (type) {
        PassivType.vorgangspassiv => 'مجهول الحدث',
        PassivType.zustandspassiv => 'مجهول الحالة',
      };

  String get tenseLabel => switch (tense) {
        PassivTense.praesens => 'Präsens',
        PassivTense.praeteritum => 'Präteritum',
        PassivTense.perfekt => 'Perfekt',
      };

  String get structureLabel {
    return switch ((type, tense)) {
      (PassivType.vorgangspassiv, PassivTense.praesens) =>
        'werden (Präsens) + Partizip II',
      (PassivType.vorgangspassiv, PassivTense.praeteritum) =>
        'werden (Präteritum) + Partizip II',
      (PassivType.vorgangspassiv, PassivTense.perfekt) =>
        'sein + Partizip II + worden',
      (PassivType.zustandspassiv, PassivTense.praesens) =>
        'sein (Präsens) + Partizip II',
      (PassivType.zustandspassiv, PassivTense.praeteritum) =>
        'sein (Präteritum) + Partizip II',
      (PassivType.zustandspassiv, PassivTense.perfekt) =>
        'sein + Partizip II + gewesen',
    };
  }
}

import 'passiv_models.dart';

abstract interface class PassivRepository {
  Future<List<PassivDrillItem>> getDrills({
    PassivType? type,
  });

  Future<bool> checkTransformation({
    required String drillId,
    required String auxiliaryForm,
    required String agentPreposition,
    required String partizipII,
  });
}
