import 'dart:async';


import '../../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import '../application/passiv_notifier.dart';
import '../domain/passiv_models.dart';

final class PassivScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const PassivScreen({
    required this.notifier,
    super.key,
  });

  final PassivNotifier notifier;

  @override
  State<PassivScreen> createState() => _PassivScreenState();
}

final class _PassivScreenState extends State<PassivScreen> {
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    if (widget.notifier.currentDrill == null &&
        !widget.notifier.isLoading) {
      unawaited(
        widget.notifier.load(type: PassivType.vorgangspassiv),
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Directionality(
        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
        child: Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(
            title: const Text('ساحة المبني للمجهول · Passiv Arena'),
          ),
          body: ListenableBuilder(
            listenable: widget.notifier,
            builder: (context, _) {
              final notifier = widget.notifier;
              final drill = notifier.currentDrill;

              if (notifier.isLoading && drill == null) {
                return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
              }
              if (drill == null) {
                return _EmptyState(
                  onRetry: () => unawaited(
                    notifier.load(type: PassivType.vorgangspassiv),
                  ),
                );
              }

              return ListView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 36),
                children: <Widget>[
                  _TypeSelector(notifier: notifier),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  _TransformationCard(
                    drill: drill,
                    currentIndex: notifier.currentIndex,
                    total: notifier.drills.length,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  _ChoiceSection(
                    title: '1. الفعل المساعد',
                    hint: drill.structureLabel,
                    options: notifier.auxiliaryOptions,
                    selected: notifier.selectedAuxiliary,
                    correct: drill.auxiliaryForm,
                    answered: notifier.showExplanation,
                    onSelected: notifier.selectAuxiliary,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  _ChoiceSection(
                    title: '2. حرف الجر للفاعل الأصلي',
                    hint:
                        'von + Dativ للأشخاص · durch + Akkusativ للوسيلة أو السبب',
                    options: notifier.prepositionOptions,
                    selected: notifier.selectedPreposition,
                    correct: drill.agentPreposition,
                    answered: notifier.showExplanation,
                    onSelected: notifier.selectPreposition,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  _ChoiceSection(
                    title: '3. Partizip II',
                    hint: 'اختر التصريف الثالث الصحيح للفعل',
                    options: notifier.partizipOptions,
                    selected: notifier.selectedPartizipII,
                    correct: drill.partizipII,
                    answered: notifier.showExplanation,
                    onSelected: notifier.selectPartizipII,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  FilledButton.icon(
                    onPressed: notifier.canCheck
                        ? () => unawaited(
                              notifier.checkTransformation(
                                auxiliaryForm:
                                    notifier.selectedAuxiliary!,
                                agentPreposition:
                                    notifier.selectedPreposition!,
                                partizipII:
                                    notifier.selectedPartizipII!,
                              ),
                            )
                        : null,
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.fact_check_outlined),
                    label: const Text('تحقق من التحويل'),
                  ),
                  if (notifier.showExplanation) ...<Widget>[
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    _FeedbackCard(
                      drill: drill,
                      correct: notifier.isCorrect == true,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    FilledButton.tonalIcon(
                      onPressed: notifier.nextDrill,
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded),
                      label: const Text('التمرين التالي'),
                    ),
                  ],
                ],
              );
            },
          ),
        ),
      );
}

final class _TypeSelector extends StatelessWidget {

  final PassivNotifier notifier;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(

            Wrap(
              spacing: 10,

              children: <Widget>[

                      PassivType.zustandspassiv,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

  });

  final String title;
  final String hint;
  final List<String> options;
  final String? selected;
  final String correct;
  final bool answered;
  final ValueChanged<String> onSelected;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(

          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,

            Text(title, style: AppTypography.title),

            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Wrap(
              alignment: WrapAlignment.center,
              spacing: 10,
              runSpacing: 10,
              children: <Widget>[
                for (final option in options)
                  _OptionCard(
                    option: option,
                    selected: selected == option,
                    correct: option == correct,
                    answered: answered,
                    onTap: answered ? null : () => onSelected(option),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

final class _OptionCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _OptionCard({
    required this.option,
    required this.selected,
    required this.correct,
    required this.answered,
    required this.onTap,
  });

  final String option;
  final bool selected;
  final bool correct;
  final bool answered;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final error = Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error;
    final border = answered && correct
        ? AppColors.mastery
        : answered && selected && !correct
            ? error
            : selected
                ? AppColors.primary
                : Theme.of(context).dividerColor;

    return SizedBox(
      width: 118,
      child: AppGlassCard(
        onTap: onTap,
        borderRadius: 20,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
          horizontal: 12,
          vertical: 14,
        ),
        borderColor: border,
        glowColor: selected || (answered && correct) ? border : null,
        child: Text(
          option,
          textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                color: border,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
              ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _FeedbackCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _FeedbackCard({
    required this.drill,
    required this.correct,
  });

  final PassivDrillItem drill;
  final bool correct;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final error = Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error;
    final color = correct ? AppColors.mastery : error;

    return AppGlassCard(
      borderColor: color.withAlpha(120),
      glowColor: color,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,

          Row(

                color: color,

                  style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(color: color),

          ),

          _SentenceBlock(

}

import '../domain/passiversatz_models.dart';

final class PassiversatzEngine {
  const PassiversatzEngine();

  List<PassiversatzChallenge> get challenges => _challenges;

  PassiversatzChallenge byId(String id) {
    for (final challenge in _challenges) {
      if (challenge.id == id) return challenge;
    }
    throw StateError('Unknown Passiversatz challenge: $id');
  }

  PassiversatzChallenge challengeAt(int index) {
    if (_challenges.isEmpty) {
      throw StateError('No Passiversatz challenges are configured.');
    }
    return _challenges[index % _challenges.length];
  }

  PassiversatzEvaluation evaluate({
    required PassiversatzChallenge challenge,
    required PassiversatzForm form,
    required String answer,
  }) {
    final alternative = challenge.alternativeFor(form);
    if (alternative == null) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        form,
        'form',
        'The selected form is not valid for this challenge.',
      );
    }

    return PassiversatzEvaluation(
      form: form,
      submitted: answer,
      expected: alternative.sentence,
      isCorrect: _normalize(answer) == _normalize(alternative.sentence),
    );
  }

  static String _normalize(String value) {
    return value
        .trim()
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[.!?]+$'), '')
        .toLowerCase();
  }

  static const List<PassiversatzChallenge> _challenges =
      <PassiversatzChallenge>[

      alternatives: <PassiversatzAlternative>[

--------------------------------------------------
FILE: lib/features/passiversatzformen/domain/passiversatz_models.dart

enum PassiversatzForm {
  sichLassen,
  seinZuInfinitiv,
  adjective,
}

extension PassiversatzFormLabels on PassiversatzForm {
  String get germanLabel => switch (this) {
        PassiversatzForm.sichLassen => 'sich lassen + Infinitiv',
        PassiversatzForm.seinZuInfinitiv => 'sein + zu + Infinitiv',
        PassiversatzForm.adjective => 'Adjektiv auf -bar/-lich',
      };

  String get arabicLabel => switch (this) {
        PassiversatzForm.sichLassen => 'إمكانية التنفيذ',
        PassiversatzForm.seinZuInfinitiv => 'إمكانية أو ضرورة حسب السياق',
        PassiversatzForm.adjective => 'صفة تعبّر عن القابلية',
      };
}

final class PassiversatzAlternative {
  const PassiversatzAlternative({
    required this.form,
    required this.sentence,
    required this.noteAr,
  });

  final PassiversatzForm form;
  final String sentence;
  final String noteAr;
}

final class PassiversatzChallenge {
  const PassiversatzChallenge({
    required this.id,
    required this.contextAr,
    required this.passiveSentence,
    required this.alternatives,
    required this.ruleAr,
  });

  final String id;
  final String contextAr;
  final String passiveSentence;
  final List<PassiversatzAlternative> alternatives;
  final String ruleAr;

  PassiversatzAlternative? alternativeFor(PassiversatzForm form) {
    for (final alternative in alternatives) {
      if (alternative.form == form) return alternative;
    }
    return null;
  }
}

final class PassiversatzEvaluation {
  const PassiversatzEvaluation({
    required this.form,
    required this.submitted,
    required this.expected,
    required this.isCorrect,
  });

  final PassiversatzForm form;
  final String submitted;
  final String expected;
  final bool isCorrect;
}

import '../../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import '../application/passiversatz_engine.dart';
import '../domain/passiversatz_models.dart';

abstract final class _PassiversatzLayout {
  static const EdgeInsetsDirectional pagePadding = EdgeInsetsDirectional.fromSTEB(
    16,
    16,
    16,
    32,
  );
  static const EdgeInsets cardPadding = EdgeInsets.all(16);
  static const double gapXs = 6;
  static const double gapS = 10;
  static const double gapM = 14;
  static const double icon = 28;
}

final class PassiversatzScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const PassiversatzScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<PassiversatzScreen> createState() => _PassiversatzScreenState();
}

final class _PassiversatzScreenState extends State<PassiversatzScreen> {
  static const PassiversatzEngine _engine = PassiversatzEngine();

  final TextEditingController _answerController = TextEditingController();
  int _challengeIndex = 0;
  PassiversatzForm? _selectedForm;
  PassiversatzEvaluation? _evaluation;

  PassiversatzChallenge get _challenge =>
      _engine.challengeAt(_challengeIndex);

  PassiversatzForm get _activeForm =>
      _selectedForm ?? _challenge.alternatives.first.form;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _answerController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _selectForm(PassiversatzForm form) {
    setState(() {
      _selectedForm = form;
      _evaluation = null;
      _answerController.clear();
    });
  }

  void _checkAnswer() {
    if (_answerController.text.trim().isEmpty) return;
    setState(() {
      _evaluation = _engine.evaluate(
        challenge: _challenge,
        form: _activeForm,
        answer: _answerController.text,
      );
    });
  }

  void _nextChallenge() {
    setState(() {
      _challengeIndex = (_challengeIndex + 1) % _engine.challenges.length;
      _selectedForm = null;
      _evaluation = null;
      _answerController.clear();
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final challenge = _challenge;
    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: const Text('بدائل المبني للمجهول · Passiversatzformen'),
        ),
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: _PassiversatzLayout.pagePadding,
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: <Widget>[
                _IntroCard(
                  current: _challengeIndex + 1,
                  total: _engine.challenges.length,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: _PassiversatzLayout.gapM),
                _ChallengeCard(challenge: challenge),
                const SizedBox(height: _PassiversatzLayout.gapM),
                _FormPicker(
                  challenge: challenge,
                  selected: _activeForm,
                  onSelected: _selectForm,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: _PassiversatzLayout.gapM),
                _AnswerCard(
                  controller: _answerController,
                  selectedForm: _activeForm,
                  evaluation: _evaluation,
                  onChanged: () => setState(() {}),
                  onCheck: _checkAnswer,
                ),
                if (_evaluation != null) ...<Widget>[
                  const SizedBox(height: _PassiversatzLayout.gapM),
                  _FeedbackCard(
                    challenge: challenge,
                    evaluation: _evaluation!,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: _PassiversatzLayout.gapM),
                  FilledButton.tonalIcon(
                    onPressed: _nextChallenge,
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded),
                    label: const Text('التمرين التالي'),
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _AnswerCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _AnswerCard({
    required this.controller,
    required this.selectedForm,
    required this.evaluation,
    required this.onChanged,
    required this.onCheck,
  });

  final TextEditingController controller;
  final PassiversatzForm selectedForm;
  final PassiversatzEvaluation? evaluation;
  final VoidCallback onChanged;
  final VoidCallback onCheck;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        padding: _PassiversatzLayout.cardPadding,
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            Text(
              'اكتب التحويل',
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: _PassiversatzLayout.gapXs),
            Text(
              selectedForm.germanLabel,
              textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
              style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
                color: AppColors.primary,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: _PassiversatzLayout.gapS),
            Directionality(
              textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
              child: TextField(
                controller: controller,
                enabled: evaluation == null,
                textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                autocorrect: false,
                enableSuggestions: false,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                  hintText: 'Deine Umformung …',
                ),
                onChanged: (_) => onChanged(),
                onSubmitted: (_) {
                  if (controller.text.trim().isNotEmpty && evaluation == null) {
                    onCheck();
                  }
                },
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: _PassiversatzLayout.gapM),
            FilledButton.icon(
              onPressed: controller.text.trim().isEmpty || evaluation != null
                  ? null
                  : onCheck,
              icon: const Icon(Icons.fact_check_outlined),
              label: const Text('تحقق من التحويل'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

final class _FeedbackCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _FeedbackCard({
    required this.challenge,
    required this.evaluation,
  });

  final PassiversatzChallenge challenge;
  final PassiversatzEvaluation evaluation;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final alternative = challenge.alternativeFor(evaluation.form)!;
    final color = evaluation.isCorrect
        ? AppColors.mastery
        : Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error;

    return AppGlassCard(
      padding: _PassiversatzLayout.cardPadding,
      borderColor: color.withAlpha(120),
      glowColor: color,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          Row(
            children: <Widget>[
              Icon(
                evaluation.isCorrect
                    ? Icons.check_circle_outline
                    : Icons.info_outline,
                color: color,
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: _PassiversatzLayout.gapS),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  evaluation.isCorrect
                      ? 'التحويل صحيح'
                      : 'الصياغة تحتاج تصحيحاً',
                  style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(color: color),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: _PassiversatzLayout.gapS),
          Text(
            'الصياغة المعتمدة:',
            style: AppTypography.label,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: _PassiversatzLayout.gapXs),
          Directionality(
            textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
            child: Text(
              evaluation.expected,
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                    color: color,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                  ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: _PassiversatzLayout.gapS),
          Text(alternative.noteAr, style: AppTypography.body),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class LifeCurriculumLink {
  const LifeCurriculumLink({
    required this.ordinal,
    required this.featureKey,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.curriculumTaskId,
  });

  final int ordinal;
  final String featureKey;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String curriculumTaskId;
}

final class LifeCurriculumCatalog {
  LifeCurriculumCatalog._(List<LifeCurriculumLink> links)
      : links = List<LifeCurriculumLink>.unmodifiable(links),
        _byFeatureKey = <String, LifeCurriculumLink>{
          for (final link in links) link.featureKey: link,
        } {
    if (this.links.length != 50) {
      throw StateError('Life curriculum catalog must contain exactly 50 tasks.');
    }
    if (_byFeatureKey.length != this.links.length) {
      throw StateError('Life feature keys must be unique.');
    }
    final ordinals = this.links.map((link) => link.ordinal).toSet();
    if (ordinals.length != 50 ||
        !List<int>.generate(50, (index) => index + 1)
            .every(ordinals.contains)) {
      throw StateError('Life task ordinals must be exactly 1..50.');
    }
  }

  factory LifeCurriculumCatalog.standard() =>
      LifeCurriculumCatalog._(_standardLinks);

  final List<LifeCurriculumLink> links;
  final Map<String, LifeCurriculumLink> _byFeatureKey;

  LifeCurriculumLink? find(String featureKey) =>
      _byFeatureKey[featureKey.trim()];

  LifeCurriculumLink require(String featureKey) {
    final link = find(featureKey);
    if (link == null) {
      throw StateError('Unknown life feature key: $featureKey');
    }
    return link;
  }

--------------------------------------------------
FILE: lib/features/phase3_integration/life_feature_runtime.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../../core/agents/polyglot_agent_models.dart';
import '../../core/l10n/l10n.dart';
import '../../core/orchestration/orchestration.dart';

final class LifeFeatureRuntime extends ChangeNotifier {
  LifeFeatureRuntime._({
    required AgentEventBus eventBus,
    required OrchestrationKernel kernel,
    required AgentEndpoint endpoint,
    required DynamicL10nEngine engine,
  })  : _eventBus = eventBus,
        _kernel = kernel,
        _endpoint = endpoint,
        _engine = engine {
    _subscription = endpoint.allEvents.listen(_handleEvent);
  }

  static LifeFeatureRuntime? _shared;

  static LifeFeatureRuntime get shared =>
      _shared ??= _createApplicationRuntime();

  static void ensureSharedStarted() {
    shared;
  }

  factory LifeFeatureRuntime.isolated({
    required AgentEventBus eventBus,
    required String initialUserLanguageTag,
    required String initialSourceLanguageTag,
    required String initialTargetLanguageTag,
  }) {
    final kernel = OrchestrationKernel(
      eventBus: eventBus,
      services: ServiceContainer(),
    );
    final endpoint = kernel.connect(
      AgentDescriptor(
        id: 'features.life-runtime-isolated',
        role: AgentRole.task,
        subscriptions: const <String>{
          AgentTopics.localizationChanged,
          AgentTopics.routeSelected,
          AgentTopics.ttsPrepared,
          AgentTopics.grammarResponse,
        },
        observesTargetedEvents: true,
      ),
    );
    return LifeFeatureRuntime._(
      eventBus: eventBus,
      kernel: kernel,
      endpoint: endpoint,
      engine: DynamicL10nEngine(
        initialState: LocalizationState.fromLanguageTags(
          userLanguageTag: initialUserLanguageTag,
          sourceLanguageTag: initialSourceLanguageTag,
          targetLanguageTag: initialTargetLanguageTag,
        ),
        fallbackLanguageTag: 'en',
      ),
    );
  }

  static LifeFeatureRuntime _createApplicationRuntime() {
    final eventBus = AgentEventBus();
    final kernel = OrchestrationKernel(
      eventBus: eventBus,
      services: ServiceContainer(),
    );
    final endpoint = kernel.connect(
      AgentDescriptor(
        id: 'features.life-runtime',
        role: AgentRole.task,
        subscriptions: const <String>{
          AgentTopics.localizationChanged,
          AgentTopics.routeSelected,
          AgentTopics.ttsPrepared,
          AgentTopics.grammarResponse,
        },
        observesTargetedEvents: true,
      ),
    );
    return LifeFeatureRuntime._(
      eventBus: eventBus,
      kernel: kernel,
      endpoint: endpoint,
      engine: DynamicL10nEngine(
        initialState: LocalizationState.fromLanguageTags(
          userLanguageTag: 'ar',
          sourceLanguageTag: 'ar',
          targetLanguageTag: 'de',
        ),
        fallbackLanguageTag: 'en',
      ),
    );
  }

  final AgentEventBus _eventBus;
  final OrchestrationKernel _kernel;
  final AgentEndpoint _endpoint;
  final DynamicL10nEngine _engine;

  late final StreamSubscription<AgentEvent> _subscription;
  final Map<String, Map<String, L10nMessage>> _literalMessages =
      <String, Map<String, L10nMessage>>{};

  int _requestSequence = 0;
  bool _closed = false;

  L10nRuntimeSnapshot get snapshot => _engine.snapshot;
  bool get isClosed => _closed;

  String resolveUiLiteral(String raw) {
    _ensureOpen();
    final text = raw.trim();
    if (text.isEmpty) return raw;
    final key = _ensureUiLiteral(
      raw: raw,
      primaryLocale: _inferLiteralLocale(raw),
    );
    return _engine.uiText(key);
  }

  String resolveDirectionalLiteral(
    String raw, {
    required String languageCode,
  }) {
    _ensureOpen();
    final text = raw.trim();
    if (text.isEmpty) return raw;

    // Directional source/target text is learning content, not UI chrome.
    // Validate the explicit language identity, then preserve canonical content
    // exactly instead of admitting it into the UI fallback dictionaries.
    AppLocale.parse(languageCode);
    return raw;
  }

  bool isTargetLanguage(String languageTag) {
    final requested = AppLocale.parse(languageTag).languageCode;
    return requested == snapshot.targetLocale.languageCode;
  }

  Future<TtsVoiceDispatch> requestSpeech({
    required String text,
    required String languageTag,
    double speed = 1.0,
  }) async {
    _ensureOpen();
    final request = TtsVoiceRequest(
      text: text,
      targetLanguageTag: languageTag,
      speed: speed,
    );
    final correlationId = _nextCorrelation('tts');
    final response = _endpoint
        .events(AgentTopics.ttsPrepared)
        .firstWhere(
          (event) => event.context.correlationId == correlationId,
        )
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 2));

    _endpoint.publish(
      topic: AgentTopics.ttsRequest,
      targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.voice},
      context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty(correlationId),
      payload: request.toEventPayload(),
    );

    return TtsVoiceDispatch.fromEvent(await response);
  }

  Future<GrammarAgentResult> requestGrammar({
    required UniversalGrammarCapability capability,
    int seed = 0,
    int count = 6,
  }) async {
    _ensureOpen();
    final correlationId = _nextCorrelation('grammar');
    final response = _endpoint
        .events(AgentTopics.grammarResponse)
        .firstWhere(
          (event) => event.context.correlationId == correlationId,
        )
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 2));

    _endpoint.publish(
      topic: AgentTopics.grammarRequest,
      targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.grammar},
      context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty(correlationId),
      payload: <String, Object?>{
        'capability': capability.wireName,
        'seed': seed,
        'count': count.clamp(1, 20).toInt(),
      },
    );

    return GrammarAgentResult.fromEvent(await response);
  }

  void _handleEvent(AgentEvent event) {
    if (_closed) return;
    switch (event.topic) {
      case AgentTopics.localizationChanged:
        _applyLocalePayload(event.payload);
        return;
      case AgentTopics.routeSelected:
        if (event.payload['ok'] == true) {
          _applyLocalePayload(event.payload);
        }
        return;
    }
  }

  void _applyLocalePayload(Map<String, Object?> payload) {
    final user = _optionalLanguage(payload['userLocale']);
    final source = _optionalLanguage(
      payload['sourceLocale'] ?? payload['sourceLanguage'],
    );
    final target = _optionalLanguage(
      payload['targetLocale'] ?? payload['targetLanguage'],
    );

    var changed = false;
    if (user != null &&
        user != _engine.snapshot.userLocale.languageTag) {
      _engine.setUserLanguage(user);
      changed = true;
    }
    if (source != null &&
        target != null &&
        (source != _engine.snapshot.sourceLocale.languageTag ||
            target != _engine.snapshot.targetLocale.languageTag)) {
      _engine.setLearningPair(
        sourceLanguageTag: source,
        targetLanguageTag: target,
      );
      changed = true;
    }
    if (changed) notifyListeners();
  }

  String _ensureUiLiteral({
    required String raw,
    required String primaryLocale,
  }) {
    final key = 'life.literal.' + _fnv1a32(raw);
    _putUiLiteral(primaryLocale, key, raw);
    _putUiLiteral('en', key, raw);
    return key;
  }

  void _putUiLiteral(String localeTag, String key, String raw) {
    final locale = AppLocale.parse(localeTag).languageTag;
    final messages = _literalMessages.putIfAbsent(
      locale,
      () => <String, L10nMessage>{},
    );
    if (messages.containsKey(key)) return;

    messages[key] = L10nMessage(
      key: key,
      template: raw,
    );
    _engine.registerDictionary(
      L10nDictionary(
        locale: AppLocale.parse(locale),
        sourceFormat: L10nSourceFormat.json,
        messages: messages,
      ),
    );
  }

  String _nextCorrelation(String purpose) {
    _requestSequence += 1;
    return 'features.life.' +
        purpose +
        '.' +
        _requestSequence.toString();
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    _closed = true;
    await _subscription.cancel();
    await _kernel.close();
    await _engine.close();
    if (identical(_shared, this)) {
      _shared = null;
    }
  }

  void _ensureOpen() {
    if (_closed || _eventBus.isClosed) {
      throw StateError('LifeFeatureRuntime is closed.');
    }
  }

  static String? _optionalLanguage(Object? value) {
    if (value is! String || value.trim().isEmpty) return null;
    return AppLocale.parse(value).languageTag;
  }

  static String _inferLiteralLocale(String raw) {
    if (RegExp(r'[\u0600-\u06ff]').hasMatch(raw)) return 'ar';
    if (RegExp(r'[\u0400-\u04ff]').hasMatch(raw)) return 'ru';
    if (RegExp(r'[\u0370-\u03ff]').hasMatch(raw)) return 'el';
    if (RegExp(r'[\u3040-\u30ff]').hasMatch(raw)) return 'ja';
    if (RegExp(r'[\uac00-\ud7af]').hasMatch(raw)) return 'ko';
    if (RegExp(r'[\u4e00-\u9fff]').hasMatch(raw)) return 'cmn';
    return 'de';
  }

  static String _fnv1a32(String value) {
    var hash = 0x811c9dc5;
    for (final unit in value.codeUnits) {
      hash ^= unit;
      hash = (hash * 0x01000193) & 0xffffffff;
    }
    return hash.toRadixString(16).padLeft(8, '0');
  }
}

import '../../core/curriculum/advanced_vocabulary.dart';
import '../../core/curriculum/canonical_curriculum_50.dart';
import 'life_curriculum_catalog.dart';
import 'production_agent_runtime.dart';

Future<void> main() async {
  final catalog = LifeCurriculumCatalog.standard();

  _expect(catalog.links.length, 50, 'life catalog contains exactly 50 tasks');
  _expect(
    catalog.links.map((link) => link.featureKey).toSet().length,
    50,
    'life feature keys are unique',
  );
  _expect(
    catalog.links.any((link) => link.featureKey == 'life_maintenance'),
    true,
    'maintenance is the fiftieth life feature',
  );

  final curriculumIds = CanonicalCurriculum50.tasks
      .map((task) => task.id)
      .toSet();
  for (final link in catalog.links) {
    _expect(
      curriculumIds.contains(link.curriculumTaskId),
      true,
      'life task ${link.featureKey} points to a valid curriculum task',
    );
  }

  final projections = <VocabularyFlashcardProjection>[
    const VocabularyFlashcardProjection(
      id: 'haus',
      frontText: 'Haus',
      backText: 'بيت',
      frontLanguageCode: 'de',
      backLanguageCode: 'ar',
      article: 'das',
      frontSupportingText: 'Plural: Häuser',
      backSupportingText: 'Ich bin zu Hause.',
      semanticLabel: 'A1 noun: Haus — بيت',
    ),
  ];
  final decks = VocabularyProjectionDeckRegistry(
    <String, List<VocabularyFlashcardProjection>>{
      'main-vocabulary': projections,
    },
  );

  final runtime = Phase3AgentRuntime.start(
    catalog: catalog,
    decks: decks,
  );

  final design = await runtime.requestDesign();
  _expect(design.navigation, 'bottom', 'design agent selects bottom navigation');
  _expect(design.flashcardMode, '3d', 'design agent selects 3D flashcards');
  _expect(design.direction, 'rtl', 'design agent preserves Arabic RTL shell');

  final route = await runtime.requestRoute('life_maintenance');
  _expect(route.featureKey, 'life_maintenance', 'routing agent resolves feature');
  _expect(
    route.curriculumTaskId.isNotEmpty,
    true,
    'routing agent returns curriculum linkage',
  );

  final cards = await runtime.requestCards('main-vocabulary');
  _expect(cards.deckId, 'main-vocabulary', 'cards agent resolves deck');
  _expect(cards.cardCount, 1, 'cards agent returns projection count');

  var missingDeckRejected = false;
  try {
    await runtime.requestCards('missing-deck');
  } on StateError {
    missingDeckRejected = true;
  }
  _expect(
    missingDeckRejected,
    true,
    'cards agent rejects unknown decks through the event response',
  );

  var missingRouteRejected = false;
  try {
    await runtime.requestRoute('life_missing');
  } on StateError {
    missingRouteRejected = true;
  }
  _expect(
    missingRouteRejected,
    true,
    'routing agent rejects unknown feature keys',
  );

  await runtime.close();
  _expect(runtime.isClosed, true, 'runtime closes streams and endpoints');
}

void _expect(Object? actual, Object? expected, String contract) {
  if (actual != expected) {
    throw StateError(
      'Contract failed: $contract. Expected <$expected>, got <$actual>.',
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

Future<void> main() async {
  final bus = AgentEventBus.isolated();
  final observerKernel = OrchestrationKernel(
    eventBus: bus,
    services: ServiceContainer(),
  );
  final localization = observerKernel.connect(
    AgentDescriptor(
      id: 'phase7.contract.localization',
      role: AgentRole.localization,
      subscriptions: const <String>{AgentTopics.contextUpdated},
    ),
  );
  final voice = observerKernel.connect(
    AgentDescriptor(
      id: 'phase7.contract.voice',
      role: AgentRole.voice,
      subscriptions: const <String>{AgentTopics.ttsRequest},
    ),
  );
  final grammar = observerKernel.connect(
    AgentDescriptor(
      id: 'phase7.contract.grammar',
      role: AgentRole.grammar,
      subscriptions: const <String>{AgentTopics.grammarRequest},
    ),
  );

  final featureRuntime = LifeFeatureRuntime.isolated(
    eventBus: bus,
    initialUserLanguageTag: 'ar',
    initialSourceLanguageTag: 'ar',
    initialTargetLanguageTag: 'de',
  );

  final voiceSub = voice.events(AgentTopics.ttsRequest).listen((event) {
    voice.publish(
      topic: AgentTopics.ttsPrepared,
      targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.task},
      context: event.context,
      payload: <String, Object?>{
        'accepted': true,
        'text': event.payload['text'] as String,
        'targetLanguage': event.payload['targetLanguage'] as String,
        'speed': event.payload['speed'] as num,
        'backend': 'contract',
        'providerReady': true,
      },
    );
  });
  final grammarSub =
      grammar.events(AgentTopics.grammarRequest).listen((event) {
    grammar.publish(
      topic: AgentTopics.grammarResponse,
      targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.task},
      context: event.context,
      payload: <String, Object?>{
        'ok': true,
        'capability': event.payload['capability'] as String,
        'targetLanguage': 'de',
        'engineId': 'contract.german',
        'items': const <Object?>[],
      },
    );
  });

  localization.publish(
    topic: AgentTopics.localizationChanged,
    targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{
      AgentRole.design,
      AgentRole.routing,
    },
    context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty('phase7-l10n-1'),
    payload: const <String, Object?>{
      'revision': 12,
      'userLocale': 'en',
      'sourceLocale': 'ar',
      'targetLocale': 'de',
      'direction': 'ltr',
      'isRtl': false,
      'loadedLocales': <String>['ar', 'de', 'en'],
    },
  );

  await Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);
  _expect(
    featureRuntime.snapshot.userLocale.languageCode,
    'en',
    'feature runtime follows localization.changed UI locale',
  );
  _expect(
    featureRuntime.snapshot.sourceLocale.languageCode,
    'ar',
    'feature runtime keeps explicit source locale',
  );
  _expect(
    featureRuntime.snapshot.targetLocale.languageCode,
    'de',
    'feature runtime keeps explicit target locale',
  );

  final localized = featureRuntime.resolveUiLiteral(
    'Fahrrad & Mobilität',
  );
  _expect(
    localized,
    'Fahrrad & Mobilität',
    'literal rendering is resolved through DynamicL10nEngine fallback',
  );

  final speech = await featureRuntime.requestSpeech(
    text: 'Guten Morgen',
    languageTag: 'de',
    speed: 0.85,
  );
  _expect(speech.accepted, true, 'target-side TTS request succeeds');
  _expect(speech.targetLanguageTag, 'de', 'TTS target is explicit');
  _expect(speech.speed, 0.85, 'TTS speed is preserved');

  final grammarResult = await featureRuntime.requestGrammar(
    capability: UniversalGrammarCapability.konjunktivIi,
    seed: 3,
    count: 2,
  );
  _expect(grammarResult.ok, true, 'grammar query uses event route');
  _expect(
    grammarResult.engineId,
    'contract.german',
    'grammar response comes from event-stream agent',
  );

  await featureRuntime.close();
  await grammarSub.cancel();
  await voiceSub.cancel();
  await observerKernel.close();

  final catalog = LifeCurriculumCatalog.standard();
  _expect(catalog.links.length, 50, 'all fifty life tasks remain registered');

  final runtime = Phase3AgentRuntime.start(
    catalog: catalog,
    decks: VocabularyProjectionDeckRegistry(
      <String, List<VocabularyFlashcardProjection>>{
        'contract': const <VocabularyFlashcardProjection>[],
      },
    ),

  final appBus = AgentEventBus();
  final appKernel = OrchestrationKernel(
    eventBus: appBus,
    services: ServiceContainer(),
  );
  final appLocalization = appKernel.connect(
    AgentDescriptor(
      id: 'phase7.contract.app-localization',
      role: AgentRole.localization,
      subscriptions: const <String>{AgentTopics.contextUpdated},
    ),
  );
  final appVoice = appKernel.connect(
    AgentDescriptor(
      id: 'phase7.contract.app-voice',
      role: AgentRole.voice,
      subscriptions: const <String>{AgentTopics.ttsRequest},
    ),
  );
  final appGrammar = appKernel.connect(
    AgentDescriptor(
      id: 'phase7.contract.app-grammar',
      role: AgentRole.grammar,
      subscriptions: const <String>{AgentTopics.grammarRequest},

  final appVoiceSub = appVoice
      .events(AgentTopics.ttsRequest)
      .listen((event) {
    appVoice.publish(
      topic: AgentTopics.ttsPrepared,
      targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.system},
      context: event.context,
      payload: <String, Object?>{
        'accepted': true,
        'text': event.payload['text'] as String,
        'targetLanguage': event.payload['targetLanguage'] as String,
        'speed': event.payload['speed'] as num,
        'backend': 'phase3-contract',
        'providerReady': true,
      },
    );
  });
  final appGrammarSub = appGrammar
      .events(AgentTopics.grammarRequest)
      .listen((event) {
    appGrammar.publish(
      topic: AgentTopics.grammarResponse,
      targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.system},
      context: event.context,
      payload: <String, Object?>{
        'ok': true,
        'capability': event.payload['capability'] as String,
        'targetLanguage': 'ar',
        'engineId': 'phase3-contract.grammar',
        'items': const <Object?>[],

  appLocalization.publish(
    topic: AgentTopics.localizationChanged,
    targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{
      AgentRole.design,
      AgentRole.routing,
    },
    context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty('phase7-runtime-l10n'),
    payload: const <String, Object?>{
      'revision': 13,
      'userLocale': 'de',
      'sourceLocale': 'de',
      'targetLocale': 'ar',
      'direction': 'ltr',
      'isRtl': false,
      'loadedLocales': <String>['ar', 'de', 'en'],

  await Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);
  final design = await runtime.requestDesign();

    design.direction,

  final route = await runtime.requestRoute('life_bicycle_mobility');

FILE: lib/features/phase3_integration/production_agent_runtime.dart

import 'dart:async';

import '../../core/agents/polyglot_agent_models.dart';
import '../../core/curriculum/advanced_vocabulary.dart';
import '../../core/orchestration/orchestration.dart';
import 'life_curriculum_catalog.dart';
import 'life_feature_runtime.dart';

final class VocabularyProjectionDeckRegistry {
  VocabularyProjectionDeckRegistry(
    Map<String, List<VocabularyFlashcardProjection>> decks,
  ) : _decks = Map<String, List<VocabularyFlashcardProjection>>.unmodifiable(
          <String, List<VocabularyFlashcardProjection>>{
            for (final entry in decks.entries)
              entry.key.trim(): List<VocabularyFlashcardProjection>.unmodifiable(
                entry.value,
              ),
          },
        ) {
    if (_decks.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('At least one vocabulary projection deck is required.');
    }
    if (_decks.keys.any((key) => key.isEmpty)) {
      throw ArgumentError('Vocabulary deck ids must not be empty.');
    }
  }

  final Map<String, List<VocabularyFlashcardProjection>> _decks;

  bool contains(String deckId) => _decks.containsKey(deckId.trim());

  List<VocabularyFlashcardProjection> require(String deckId) {
    final deck = _decks[deckId.trim()];
    if (deck == null) {
      throw StateError('Unknown vocabulary deck: $deckId');
    }
    return deck;
  }
}

final class Phase3DesignProfile {
  const Phase3DesignProfile({
    required this.navigation,
    required this.flashcardMode,
    required this.direction,
    required this.density,
  });

  final String navigation;
  final String flashcardMode;
  final String direction;
  final String density;
}

final class Phase3RouteSelection {
  const Phase3RouteSelection({
    required this.featureKey,
    required this.curriculumTaskId,
  });

  final String featureKey;
  final String curriculumTaskId;
}

final class Phase3CardsReady {
  const Phase3CardsReady({
    required this.deckId,
    required this.cardCount,
  });

  final String deckId;
  final int cardCount;
}

final class Phase3AgentRuntime {
  Phase3AgentRuntime._({
    required AgentEventBus eventBus,
    required OrchestrationKernel kernel,
    required AgentEndpoint taskEndpoint,
    required _DesignProductionAgent designAgent,
    required _RoutingProductionAgent routingAgent,
    required _CardsProductionAgent cardsAgent,
  })  : _eventBus = eventBus,
        _kernel = kernel,
        _taskEndpoint = taskEndpoint,
        _designAgent = designAgent,
        _routingAgent = routingAgent,
        _cardsAgent = cardsAgent;

  factory Phase3AgentRuntime.start({
    required LifeCurriculumCatalog catalog,
    required VocabularyProjectionDeckRegistry decks,
  }) {
    LifeFeatureRuntime.ensureSharedStarted();
    final eventBus = AgentEventBus();
    final services = ServiceContainer();
    services.registerSingleton(_catalogToken, catalog);
    services.registerSingleton(_decksToken, decks);

    final kernel = OrchestrationKernel(
      eventBus: eventBus,
      services: services,
    );
    final taskEndpoint = kernel.connect(
      AgentDescriptor(
        id: 'phase3.task-ui',
        role: AgentRole.task,
        subscriptions: <String>{
          AgentTopics.routeSelected,
          AgentTopics.contextUpdated,
          AgentTopics.localizationChanged,
          AgentTopics.ttsPrepared,
          AgentTopics.grammarResponse,
        },
        observesTargetedEvents: true,
      ),
    );
    final designEndpoint = kernel.connect(
      AgentDescriptor(
        id: 'phase3.design-agent',
        role: AgentRole.design,
        subscriptions: <String>{
          AgentTopics.designRequest,
          AgentTopics.localizationChanged,
        },
      ),
    );
    final routingEndpoint = kernel.connect(
      AgentDescriptor(
        id: 'phase3.routing-agent',
        role: AgentRole.routing,
        subscriptions: <String>{
          AgentTopics.routeRequest,
          AgentTopics.localizationChanged,
        },
      ),
    );
    final cardsEndpoint = kernel.connect(
      AgentDescriptor(
        id: 'phase3.cards-agent',
        role: AgentRole.cards,
        subscriptions: <String>{
          AgentTopics.cardsRequest,
          AgentTopics.localizationChanged,
        },
        observesTargetedEvents: true,
      ),
    );

    return Phase3AgentRuntime._(
      eventBus: eventBus,
      kernel: kernel,
      taskEndpoint: taskEndpoint,
      designAgent: _DesignProductionAgent(designEndpoint),
      routingAgent: _RoutingProductionAgent(routingEndpoint),
      cardsAgent: _CardsProductionAgent(cardsEndpoint),
    );
  }

  static final ServiceToken<LifeCurriculumCatalog> _catalogToken =
      ServiceToken<LifeCurriculumCatalog>('phase3.catalog');
  static final ServiceToken<VocabularyProjectionDeckRegistry> _decksToken =
      ServiceToken<VocabularyProjectionDeckRegistry>('phase3.decks');

  final AgentEventBus _eventBus;
  final OrchestrationKernel _kernel;
  final AgentEndpoint _taskEndpoint;
  final _DesignProductionAgent _designAgent;
  final _RoutingProductionAgent _routingAgent;
  final _CardsProductionAgent _cardsAgent;

  int _requestSequence = 0;
  bool _closed = false;

  bool get isClosed => _closed;
  int get publishedEventCount => _eventBus.publishedCount;

  Future<Phase3DesignProfile> requestDesign() async {
    _ensureOpen();
    final correlationId = _nextCorrelation('design');
    final response = _waitForContext(correlationId, 'design.ready');
    _taskEndpoint.publish(
      topic: AgentTopics.designRequest,
      targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.design},
      context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty(correlationId),
      payload: const <String, Object?>{'surface': 'phase3-shell'},
    );
    final event = await response;
    return Phase3DesignProfile(
      navigation: _stringPayload(event, 'navigation'),
      flashcardMode: _stringPayload(event, 'flashcardMode'),
      direction: _stringPayload(event, 'direction'),
      density: _stringPayload(event, 'density'),
    );
  }

  Future<Phase3RouteSelection> requestRoute(String featureKey) async {
    _ensureOpen();
    final correlationId = _nextCorrelation('route');
    final response = _taskEndpoint
        .events(AgentTopics.routeSelected)
        .firstWhere(
          (event) => event.context.correlationId == correlationId,
        )
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 2));

    _taskEndpoint.publish(
      topic: AgentTopics.routeRequest,
      targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.routing},
      context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty(correlationId),
      payload: <String, Object?>{'featureKey': featureKey.trim()},
    );

    final event = await response;
    if (event.payload['ok'] != true) {
      throw StateError(
        event.payload['message'] as String? ?? 'Route request was rejected.',
      );
    }
    return Phase3RouteSelection(
      featureKey: _stringPayload(event, 'featureKey'),
      curriculumTaskId: _stringPayload(event, 'curriculumTaskId'),
    );
  }

  Future<Phase3CardsReady> requestCards(String deckId) async {
    _ensureOpen();
    final correlationId = _nextCorrelation('cards');
    final response = _taskEndpoint
        .events(AgentTopics.contextUpdated)
        .firstWhere(
          (event) => event.context.correlationId == correlationId,
        )
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 2));

    _taskEndpoint.publish(
      topic: AgentTopics.cardsRequest,
      targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.cards},
      context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty(correlationId),
      payload: <String, Object?>{'deckId': deckId.trim()},
    );

    final event = await response;
    if (event.payload['kind'] == 'cards.error') {
      throw StateError(
        event.payload['message'] as String? ?? 'Card request was rejected.',
      );
    }
    if (event.payload['kind'] != 'cards.ready') {
      throw StateError('Unexpected Cards Agent response.');
    }
    return Phase3CardsReady(
      deckId: _stringPayload(event, 'deckId'),
      cardCount: (event.payload['cardCount'] as num).toInt(),
    );
  }

  Future<TtsVoiceDispatch> requestSpeech({
    required String text,
    required String targetLanguageTag,
    double speed = 1.0,
  }) async {
    _ensureOpen();
    final request = TtsVoiceRequest(
      text: text,
      targetLanguageTag: targetLanguageTag,
      speed: speed,
    );
    final correlationId = _nextCorrelation('tts');
    final response = _taskEndpoint
        .events(AgentTopics.ttsPrepared)
        .firstWhere(
          (event) => event.context.correlationId == correlationId,
        )
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 2));

    _taskEndpoint.publish(
      topic: AgentTopics.ttsRequest,
      targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.voice},
      context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty(correlationId),
      payload: request.toEventPayload(),
    );

    return TtsVoiceDispatch.fromEvent(await response);
  }

  Future<GrammarAgentResult> requestGrammar({
    required UniversalGrammarCapability capability,
    int seed = 0,
    int count = 6,
  }) async {
    _ensureOpen();
    final correlationId = _nextCorrelation('grammar');
    final response = _taskEndpoint
        .events(AgentTopics.grammarResponse)
        .firstWhere(
          (event) => event.context.correlationId == correlationId,
        )
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 2));

    _taskEndpoint.publish(
      topic: AgentTopics.grammarRequest,
      targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.grammar},
      context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty(correlationId),
      payload: <String, Object?>{
        'capability': capability.wireName,
        'seed': seed,
        'count': count.clamp(1, 20).toInt(),
      },
    );

    return GrammarAgentResult.fromEvent(await response);
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    _closed = true;
    await _designAgent.close();
    await _routingAgent.close();
    await _cardsAgent.close();
    await _kernel.close();
  }

  Future<AgentEvent> _waitForContext(
    String correlationId,
    String kind,
  ) =>
      _taskEndpoint
          .events(AgentTopics.contextUpdated)
          .firstWhere(
            (event) =>
                event.context.correlationId == correlationId &&
                event.payload['kind'] == kind,
          )
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 2));

  String _nextCorrelation(String purpose) {
    _requestSequence += 1;
    return 'phase3.$purpose.$_requestSequence';
  }

  void _ensureOpen() {
    if (_closed) {
      throw StateError('Phase3AgentRuntime is closed.');
    }
  }

  static String _stringPayload(AgentEvent event, String key) {
    final value = event.payload[key];
    if (value is! String || value.isEmpty) {
      throw StateError('Agent response is missing $key.');
    }
    return value;
  }
}

final class _DesignProductionAgent {
  _DesignProductionAgent(this.endpoint) {
    _subscription = endpoint.allEvents.listen(_accept);
  }

  final AgentEndpoint endpoint;
  late final StreamSubscription<AgentEvent> _subscription;
  String _direction = 'rtl';

  void _accept(AgentEvent event) {
    switch (event.topic) {
      case AgentTopics.localizationChanged:
        final direction = event.payload['direction'];
        if (direction is String && (direction == 'ltr' || direction == 'rtl')) {
          _direction = direction;
        }
        return;
      case AgentTopics.designRequest:
        _handleDesign(event);
        return;
    }
  }

  void _handleDesign(AgentEvent event) {
    endpoint.publish(
      topic: AgentTopics.contextUpdated,
      targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.task},
      context: event.context,
      payload: <String, Object?>{
        'kind': 'design.ready',
        'navigation': 'bottom',
        'flashcardMode': '3d',
        'direction': _direction,
        'density': 'comfortable',
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> close() => _subscription.cancel();
}

final class _RoutingProductionAgent {
  _RoutingProductionAgent(this.endpoint)
      : _catalog = endpoint.resolve(Phase3AgentRuntime._catalogToken) {
    _subscription = endpoint.allEvents.listen(_accept);
  }

  final AgentEndpoint endpoint;
  final LifeCurriculumCatalog _catalog;
  late final StreamSubscription<AgentEvent> _subscription;

  String _userLocale = 'ar';
  String _sourceLocale = 'ar';
  String _targetLocale = 'de';
  String _direction = 'rtl';

  void _accept(AgentEvent event) {
    switch (event.topic) {
      case AgentTopics.localizationChanged:
        _applyLocalization(event);
        return;
      case AgentTopics.routeRequest:
        _handleRoute(event);
        return;
    }
  }

  void _applyLocalization(AgentEvent event) {
    _userLocale = _locale(event.payload['userLocale'], _userLocale);
    _sourceLocale = _locale(event.payload['sourceLocale'], _sourceLocale);
    _targetLocale = _locale(event.payload['targetLocale'], _targetLocale);
    final direction = event.payload['direction'];
    if (direction is String && (direction == 'ltr' || direction == 'rtl')) {
      _direction = direction;
    }
  }

  void _handleRoute(AgentEvent event) {
    final featureKey = event.payload['featureKey'];
    final link = featureKey is String ? _catalog.find(featureKey) : null;

    endpoint.publish(
      topic: AgentTopics.routeSelected,
      targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.task},
      context: event.context,
      payload: link == null
          ? <String, Object?>{
              'ok': false,
              'message': 'Unknown life feature route.',
            }
          : <String, Object?>{
              'ok': true,
              'featureKey': link.featureKey,
              'curriculumTaskId': link.curriculumTaskId,
              'userLocale': _userLocale,
              'sourceLocale': _sourceLocale,
              'targetLocale': _targetLocale,
              'direction': _direction,
            },
    );
  }

  Future<void> close() => _subscription.cancel();
}

final class _CardsProductionAgent {
  _CardsProductionAgent(this.endpoint)
      : _decks = endpoint.resolve(Phase3AgentRuntime._decksToken) {
    _subscription = endpoint.allEvents.listen(_accept);
  }

  final AgentEndpoint endpoint;
  final VocabularyProjectionDeckRegistry _decks;
  late final StreamSubscription<AgentEvent> _subscription;

  String _sourceLocale = 'ar';
  String _targetLocale = 'de';

  void _accept(AgentEvent event) {
    switch (event.topic) {
      case AgentTopics.localizationChanged:
        _sourceLocale = _locale(
          event.payload['sourceLocale'],
          _sourceLocale,
        );
        _targetLocale = _locale(
          event.payload['targetLocale'],
          _targetLocale,
        );
        return;
      case AgentTopics.cardsRequest:
        _handleCards(event);
        return;
    }
  }

  void _handleCards(AgentEvent event) {
    final deckId = event.payload['deckId'];
    if (deckId is! String || !_decks.contains(deckId)) {
      endpoint.publish(
        topic: AgentTopics.contextUpdated,
        targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.task},
        context: event.context,
        payload: const <String, Object?>{
          'kind': 'cards.error',
          'message': 'Unknown vocabulary deck.',
        },
      );
      return;
    }

    final deck = _decks.require(deckId);
    endpoint.publish(
      topic: AgentTopics.contextUpdated,
      targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.task},
      context: event.context,
      payload: <String, Object?>{
        'kind': 'cards.ready',
        'deckId': deckId,
        'cardCount': deck.length,
        'sourceLocale': _sourceLocale,
        'targetLocale': _targetLocale,
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> close() => _subscription.cancel();
}

String _locale(Object? value, String fallback) {
  if (value is! String || value.trim().isEmpty) return fallback;
  return value.trim();
}

import '../data/phonetik_catalog.dart';
import '../domain/phonetik_models.dart';

final class PhonetikTrainerEngine {
  PhonetikTrainerEngine(Iterable<PhonetikFocus> focuses)
      : focuses = List<PhonetikFocus>.unmodifiable(focuses) {
    _validateCatalog(this.focuses);
  }

  factory PhonetikTrainerEngine.standard() =>
      PhonetikTrainerEngine(PhonetikCatalog.focuses);

  final List<PhonetikFocus> focuses;

  PhonetikFocus? focusById(String id) {
    final normalized = id.trim().toLowerCase();
    for (final focus in focuses) {
      if (focus.id.toLowerCase() == normalized) return focus;
    }
    return null;
  }

  PhonetikAnswerResult evaluate({
    required String focusId,
    required String selectedChoice,
  }) {
    final focus = focusById(focusId);
    if (focus == null) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(focusId, 'focusId', 'Unknown phonetics focus');
    }

    final selected = selectedChoice.trim();
    if (!focus.exercise.choices.contains(selected)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        selectedChoice,
        'selectedChoice',
        'Choice does not belong to this exercise',
      );
    }

    final isCorrect = selected == focus.exercise.correctChoice;
    return PhonetikAnswerResult(
      isCorrect: isCorrect,
      selectedChoice: selected,
      expectedChoice: focus.exercise.correctChoice,
      feedbackAr: isCorrect
          ? 'إجابة صحيحة. ${focus.exercise.explanationAr}'
          : 'جرّب مرة أخرى. ${focus.exercise.explanationAr}',
    );
  }

  List<PhonetikFocus> practiceOrder(Set<String> completedFocusIds) {
    final completed = completedFocusIds.map((id) => id.trim()).toSet();
    return List<PhonetikFocus>.unmodifiable(<PhonetikFocus>[
      ...focuses.where((focus) => !completed.contains(focus.id)),
      ...focuses.where((focus) => completed.contains(focus.id)),
    ]);
  }

  static void _validateCatalog(List<PhonetikFocus> focuses) {
    if (focuses.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('Phonetics catalog must not be empty');
    }

    final ids = <String>{};
    for (final focus in focuses) {
      if (focus.id.trim().isEmpty || !ids.add(focus.id)) {
        throw ArgumentError('Phonetics focus ids must be non-empty and unique');
      }
      if (focus.examples.isEmpty) {
        throw ArgumentError('Every phonetics focus needs examples: ${focus.id}');
      }
      if (focus.exercise.choices.length < 2 ||
          !focus.exercise.choices.contains(focus.exercise.correctChoice)) {
        throw ArgumentError('Invalid exercise choices for ${focus.id}');
      }
    }
  }
}

enum PhonetikTopic {
  ichAch,
  umlautA,
  umlautO,
  umlautU,
  spSt,
  stressIntonation,
}

final class PhonetikExample {
  const PhonetikExample({
    required this.word,
    required this.ipa,
    required this.hintAr,
  });

  final String word;
  final String ipa;
  final String hintAr;
}

final class PhonetikExercise {
  const PhonetikExercise({
    required this.promptAr,
    required this.choices,
    required this.correctChoice,
    required this.explanationAr,
  });

  final String promptAr;
  final List<String> choices;
  final String correctChoice;
  final String explanationAr;
}

final class PhonetikFocus {
  const PhonetikFocus({
    required this.id,
    required this.topic,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.articulationAr,
    required this.examples,
    required this.exercise,
  });

  final String id;
  final PhonetikTopic topic;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String articulationAr;
  final List<PhonetikExample> examples;
  final PhonetikExercise exercise;
}

final class PhonetikAnswerResult {
  const PhonetikAnswerResult({
    required this.isCorrect,
    required this.selectedChoice,
    required this.expectedChoice,
    required this.feedbackAr,
  });

  final bool isCorrect;
  final String selectedChoice;
  final String expectedChoice;
  final String feedbackAr;
}

import '../../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import '../application/phonetik_engine.dart';
import '../domain/phonetik_models.dart';

abstract final class _PhonetikUiTokens {
  static const double pageInset = 16;
  static const double sectionGap = 14;
  static const double contentGap = 10;
  static const double chipGap = 8;
  static const double bottomInset = 32;
}

final class PhonetikTrainerScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  PhonetikTrainerScreen({
    PhonetikTrainerEngine? engine,
    super.key,
  }) : engine = engine ?? PhonetikTrainerEngine.standard();

  final PhonetikTrainerEngine engine;

  @override
  State<PhonetikTrainerScreen> createState() => _PhonetikTrainerScreenState();
}

final class _PhonetikTrainerScreenState extends State<PhonetikTrainerScreen> {
  final Map<String, String> _selectedChoices = <String, String>{};
  final Map<String, PhonetikAnswerResult> _results =
      <String, PhonetikAnswerResult>{};

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final background =
        isDark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: background,
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: Text(
            'مدرب النطق الألماني',
            style: AppTypography.title,
            textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
          ),
        ),
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              _PhonetikUiTokens.pageInset,
              _PhonetikUiTokens.pageInset,
              _PhonetikUiTokens.pageInset,
              _PhonetikUiTokens.bottomInset,
            ),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: <Widget>[
                const _IntroCard(),
                const SizedBox(height: _PhonetikUiTokens.sectionGap),
                for (var index = 0;
                    index < widget.engine.focuses.length;
                    index++) ...<Widget>[
                  _FocusCard(
                    focus: widget.engine.focuses[index],
                    selectedChoice:
                        _selectedChoices[widget.engine.focuses[index].id],
                    result: _results[widget.engine.focuses[index].id],
                    onChoiceSelected: (choice) {
                      final focus = widget.engine.focuses[index];
                      setState(() {
                        _selectedChoices[focus.id] = choice;
                        _results[focus.id] = widget.engine.evaluate(
                          focusId: focus.id,
                          selectedChoice: choice,
                        );
                      });
                    },
                  ),
                  if (index != widget.engine.focuses.length - 1)
                    const SizedBox(height: _PhonetikUiTokens.sectionGap),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _IntroCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _IntroCard();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        glowColor: AppColors.primary,
        borderColor: AppColors.primary,
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            AppDirectionalText(
              'Phonetik & Aussprache',
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: _PhonetikUiTokens.contentGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              'تدريب مركز على موضع اللسان والشفتين والاحتكاك والنبر. اقرأ المثال ببطء ثم أعده بإيقاع طبيعي.',
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.body,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

final class _FocusCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _FocusCard({
    required this.focus,
    required this.onChoiceSelected,
    this.selectedChoice,
    this.result,
  });

  final PhonetikFocus focus;
  final String? selectedChoice;
  final PhonetikAnswerResult? result;
  final ValueChanged<String> onChoiceSelected;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        glowColor: _accentFor(focus.topic),
        borderColor: _accentFor(focus.topic),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            AppDirectionalText(
              focus.titleDe,
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: _PhonetikUiTokens.chipGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              focus.titleAr,
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
                color: _accentFor(focus.topic),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: _PhonetikUiTokens.contentGap),
            AppDirectionalText(
              focus.articulationAr,
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.body,
            ),
            const Divider(),
            for (final example in focus.examples)
              _ExampleTile(example: example),
            const Divider(),
            AppDirectionalText(
              focus.exercise.promptAr,
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.label,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: _PhonetikUiTokens.chipGap),
            Wrap(
              spacing: _PhonetikUiTokens.chipGap,
              runSpacing: _PhonetikUiTokens.chipGap,
              children: <Widget>[
                for (final choice in focus.exercise.choices)
                  ChoiceChip(
                    label: AppDirectionalText(
                      choice,
                      languageCode: _choiceLanguageCode(choice),
                      style: AppTypography.label,
                    ),
                    selected: selectedChoice == choice,
                    selectedColor: _accentFor(focus.topic),
                    onSelected: (_) => onChoiceSelected(choice),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
            if (result != null) ...<Widget>[
              const SizedBox(height: _PhonetikUiTokens.contentGap),
              AppDirectionalText(
                result!.feedbackAr,
                languageCode: 'ar',
                style: AppTypography.body.copyWith(
                  color: result!.isCorrect
                      ? AppColors.mastery
                      : AppColors.tertiary,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      );

  static Color _accentFor(PhonetikTopic topic) => switch (topic) {
        PhonetikTopic.ichAch => AppColors.primary,
        PhonetikTopic.umlautA => AppColors.articleDie,
        PhonetikTopic.umlautO => AppColors.secondary,
        PhonetikTopic.umlautU => AppColors.articleDer,
        PhonetikTopic.spSt => AppColors.tertiary,
        PhonetikTopic.stressIntonation => AppColors.achievement,
      };

  static String _choiceLanguageCode(String choice) {
    final hasArabic =
        choice.runes.any((rune) => rune >= 0x0600 && rune <= 0x06FF);
    return hasArabic ? 'ar' : 'de';
  }
}

final class _ExampleTile extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ExampleTile({required this.example});

  final PhonetikExample example;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => ListTile(
        contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
        title: AppDirectionalText(
          example.word,
          languageCode: 'de',
          style: AppTypography.title,
        ),
        subtitle: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            AppDirectionalText(
              example.ipa,
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.label,
            ),
            AppDirectionalText(
              example.hintAr,
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.body,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

final class PlacementTestState {
  const PlacementTestState({
    this.session,
    this.currentQuestion,
    this.result,
    this.learningGoal,
    this.lastAnswerCorrect,
    this.resultPersisted = false,
    this.isLoading = false,
    this.isApplyingResult = false,
    this.isPlayingAudio = false,
    this.audioUnavailable = false,
    this.errorMessage,
  });

  final AssessmentSession? session;
  final PlacementQuestion? currentQuestion;
  final PlacementResult? result;
  final PlacementLearningGoal? learningGoal;
  final bool? lastAnswerCorrect;
  final bool resultPersisted;
  final bool isLoading;
  final bool isApplyingResult;
  final bool isPlayingAudio;
  final bool audioUnavailable;
  final String? errorMessage;

  double get progress => session?.progress ?? 0;
  bool get hasStarted => session != null;
  bool get canStartLearning =>
      result != null && resultPersisted && !isApplyingResult;
}

  PlacementTestNotifier({
    required PlacementRepository repository,
    required PlacementProfileRepository profileRepository,
    PlacementAudioGateway audioGateway =
        const UnavailablePlacementAudioGateway(),
    AdaptivePlacementEngine engine = const AdaptivePlacementEngine(),
    DateTime Function()? clock,
  })  : _repository = repository,
        _profileRepository = profileRepository,
        _audioGateway = audioGateway,
        _engine = engine,
        _clock = clock ?? DateTime.now;

  static const String _startLoadError =
      'تعذر تجهيز أسئلة تحديد المستوى. أعد المحاولة.';
  static const String _nextQuestionLoadError =
      'تعذر تحميل السؤال التالي. أعد المحاولة دون فقدان إجاباتك.';
  static const String _answerStateError =
      'تعذر متابعة الاختبار بأمان. أعد المحاولة دون فقدان إجاباتك.';
  static const String _resultSaveError =
      'تعذر حفظ نتيجة الاختبار محلياً. أعد المحاولة قبل بدء التعلم.';
  static const String _audioError =
      'تعذر تشغيل الصوت حالياً؛ يمكنك متابعة الاختبار بدون صوت.';

  final PlacementRepository _repository;
  final PlacementProfileRepository _profileRepository;
  final PlacementAudioGateway _audioGateway;
  final AdaptivePlacementEngine _engine;
  final DateTime Function() _clock;

  PlacementTestState _state = const PlacementTestState();
  DateTime? _resultPersistenceTimestamp;
  bool _disposed = false;

  PlacementTestState get state => _state;

  void selectGoal(PlacementLearningGoal goal) {
    if (_disposed || _state.hasStarted || _state.isLoading) return;
    _setState(PlacementTestState(learningGoal: goal));
  }

  Future<void> start() async {
    if (_disposed ||
        _state.session != null ||
        _state.isLoading ||
        _state.isApplyingResult) {
      return;
    }
    final goal = _state.learningGoal ?? PlacementLearningGoal.general;
    _resultPersistenceTimestamp = null;
    _setState(
      PlacementTestState(
        learningGoal: goal,
        isLoading: true,
      ),
    );

    try {
      final now = _clock();
      final session = _engine.start(
        sessionId: 'placement_${now.microsecondsSinceEpoch}',
        now: now,
      );
      final question = await _repository.nextQuestion(
        level: session.currentLevel,
        excludeIds: const <String>{},
      );
      if (question == null) {
        _setState(
          PlacementTestState(
            learningGoal: goal,
            errorMessage: 'لا توجد أسئلة تشخيصية متاحة حالياً.',
          ),
        );
        return;
      }
      _setState(
        PlacementTestState(
          session: session,
          currentQuestion: question,
          learningGoal: goal,
        ),
      );
    } on Object {
      _setState(
        PlacementTestState(
          learningGoal: goal,
          errorMessage: _startLoadError,
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> submitOption(String optionId) async {
    if (_disposed) return;
    final session = _state.session;
    final question = _state.currentQuestion;
    if (session == null ||
        question == null ||
        _state.isLoading ||
        _state.isApplyingResult ||
        _state.result != null) {
      return;
    }

    final goal = _state.learningGoal;
    _setState(
      PlacementTestState(
        session: session,
        currentQuestion: question,
        learningGoal: goal,
        lastAnswerCorrect: _state.lastAnswerCorrect,
        isLoading: true,
        audioUnavailable: _state.audioUnavailable,
      ),
    );

    late final AssessmentSession updated;
    try {
      updated = _engine.recordAnswer(
        session: session,
        question: question,
        selectedOptionId: optionId,
      );
    } on Object {
      _setState(
        PlacementTestState(
          session: session,
          learningGoal: goal,
          lastAnswerCorrect: _state.lastAnswerCorrect,
          errorMessage: _answerStateError,
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    final lastAnswerCorrect = updated.answers.last.correct;
    if (updated.completed) {
      await _finish(
        updated,
        lastAnswerCorrect: lastAnswerCorrect,
      );
      return;
    }

    await _loadNextQuestion(
      updated,
      lastAnswerCorrect: lastAnswerCorrect,
    );
  }

  Future<void> retry() async {
    if (_disposed || _state.isLoading || _state.isApplyingResult) return;

    final result = _state.result;
    final session = _state.session;
    if (result != null && !_state.resultPersisted) {
      if (session == null) return;
      await _persistResult(
        session: session,
        result: result,
        lastAnswerCorrect: _state.lastAnswerCorrect ?? false,
      );
      return;
    }

    if (session == null) {
      await start();
      return;
    }

    if (_state.currentQuestion != null && _state.errorMessage == null) {
      return;
    }

    if (session.completed) {
      await _finish(
        session,
        lastAnswerCorrect: _state.lastAnswerCorrect ?? false,
      );
      return;
    }

    await _loadNextQuestion(
      session,
      lastAnswerCorrect: _state.lastAnswerCorrect,
    );
  }

  Future<bool> replayCurrentAudio() async {
    if (_disposed) return false;
    final question = _state.currentQuestion;
    if (question == null || !question.hasAudio || _state.isPlayingAudio) {
      return false;
    }

    _setState(
      PlacementTestState(
        session: _state.session,
        currentQuestion: question,
        result: _state.result,
        learningGoal: _state.learningGoal,
        lastAnswerCorrect: _state.lastAnswerCorrect,
        resultPersisted: _state.resultPersisted,
        isPlayingAudio: true,
      ),
    );

    try {
      final played = await _audioGateway.play(question);
      _setState(
        PlacementTestState(
          session: _state.session,
          currentQuestion: question,
          result: _state.result,
          learningGoal: _state.learningGoal,
          lastAnswerCorrect: _state.lastAnswerCorrect,
          resultPersisted: _state.resultPersisted,
          audioUnavailable: !played,
        ),
      );
      return played;
    } on Object {
      _setState(
        PlacementTestState(
          session: _state.session,
          currentQuestion: question,
          result: _state.result,
          learningGoal: _state.learningGoal,
          lastAnswerCorrect: _state.lastAnswerCorrect,
          resultPersisted: _state.resultPersisted,
          audioUnavailable: true,
          errorMessage: _audioError,
        ),
      );
      return false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _loadNextQuestion(
    AssessmentSession session, {
    required bool? lastAnswerCorrect,
  }) async {
    final goal = _state.learningGoal;
    _setState(
      PlacementTestState(
        session: session,
        learningGoal: goal,
        lastAnswerCorrect: lastAnswerCorrect,
        isLoading: true,
      ),
    );

    try {
      final next = await _repository.nextQuestion(
        level: session.currentLevel,
        excludeIds: session.answeredQuestionIds,
      );
      if (next == null) {
        await _finish(
          session.copyWith(completed: true),
          lastAnswerCorrect: lastAnswerCorrect ?? false,
        );
        return;
      }

      _setState(
        PlacementTestState(
          session: session,
          currentQuestion: next,
          learningGoal: goal,
          lastAnswerCorrect: lastAnswerCorrect,
        ),
      );
    } on Object {
      _setState(
        PlacementTestState(
          session: session,
          learningGoal: goal,
          lastAnswerCorrect: lastAnswerCorrect,
          errorMessage: _nextQuestionLoadError,
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _finish(
    AssessmentSession session, {
    required bool lastAnswerCorrect,
  }) async {
    final completed =
        session.completed ? session : session.copyWith(completed: true);
    final goal = _state.learningGoal ?? PlacementLearningGoal.general;

    late final PlacementResult result;
    try {
      result = _engine.resultFor(completed).copyWith(
            learningGoal: goal,
          );
    } on Object {
      _setState(
        PlacementTestState(
          session: completed,
          learningGoal: goal,
          lastAnswerCorrect: lastAnswerCorrect,
          errorMessage: _answerStateError,
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    await _persistResult(
      session: completed,
      result: result,
      lastAnswerCorrect: lastAnswerCorrect,
    );
  }

  Future<void> _persistResult({
    required AssessmentSession session,
    required PlacementResult result,
    required bool lastAnswerCorrect,
  }) async {
    final goal = result.learningGoal ??
        _state.learningGoal ??
        PlacementLearningGoal.general;
    _setState(
      PlacementTestState(
        session: session,
        result: result,
        learningGoal: goal,
        lastAnswerCorrect: lastAnswerCorrect,
        isApplyingResult: true,
      ),
    );

    final at = _resultPersistenceTimestamp ??= _clock();
    try {
      await _profileRepository.applyResult(result, at: at);
      _setState(
        PlacementTestState(
          session: session,
          result: result,
          learningGoal: goal,
          lastAnswerCorrect: lastAnswerCorrect,
          resultPersisted: true,
        ),
      );
    } on Object {
      _setState(
        PlacementTestState(
          session: session,
          result: result,
          learningGoal: goal,
          lastAnswerCorrect: lastAnswerCorrect,
          errorMessage: _resultSaveError,
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  void _setState(PlacementTestState value) {
    if (_disposed) return;
    _state = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _disposed = true;
    super.dispose();
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/placement/data/learner_placement_profile_repository.dart
