import '../../../models/diagnostic_placement.dart';
import '../../../models/learner.dart';
import '../../../services/repository.dart';
import '../domain/placement_models.dart';
import '../domain/placement_repositories.dart';

final class LearnerPlacementProfileRepository
    implements PlacementProfileRepository {
  const LearnerPlacementProfileRepository(this.repository);

  final LearnerRepository repository;

  @override
  Future<void> applyResult(PlacementResult result, {DateTime? at}) async {
    final now = at ?? DateTime.now();
    final state = await repository.reloadPersisted();
    final review = <String>{...state.review};
    final cards = <String, ReviewCard>{...state.reviewCards};

    for (final itemId in result.reviewItemIds) {
      final normalized = itemId.trim();
      if (normalized.isEmpty) continue;
      review.add(normalized);
      cards.putIfAbsent(
        normalized,
        () => ReviewCard(
          itemId: normalized,
          dueAt: now.add(
            Duration(days: result.initialReviewIntervalDays),
          ),
          difficulty: result.initialSrsDifficulty,
        ),
      );
    }

    final record = PlacementDiagnosticRecord(
      id: 'placement_${now.microsecondsSinceEpoch}',
      at: now,
      answered: result.answeredCount,
      scoredAnswers: result.answeredCount,
      score: result.proficiencyScore,
      confidence: result.confidence,
      band: switch (result.level) {
        PlacementLevel.a1 => DiagnosticPlacementBand.foundation,
        PlacementLevel.a2 => DiagnosticPlacementBand.developing,
        PlacementLevel.b1 => DiagnosticPlacementBand.strong,
        PlacementLevel.b2 => DiagnosticPlacementBand.strong,
      },
      dimensionScores: const <DiagnosticDimension, double>{},
      weakDimensions: const <DiagnosticDimension>[],
      reviewItemIds: result.reviewItemIds,
      curriculumStartLevel: result.level.label,
      recommendedStartTaskOrder: result.level.recommendedStartTaskOrder,
      learningGoal:
          (result.learningGoal ?? PlacementLearningGoal.general).name,
    );

    await repository.save(
      state.copyWith(
        review: review,
        reviewCards: cards,
      ),
    );
    await repository.recordPlacementDiagnostic(record);
  }
}

  @override
  Future<int> availableQuestionCount() async => _questions.length;

  @override
  Future<PlacementQuestion?> nextQuestion({
    required PlacementLevel level,
    required Set<String> excludeIds,
  }) async {
    for (final question in _questions) {
      if (question.level == level && !excludeIds.contains(question.id)) {
        return question;
      }
    }

    for (var distance = 1; distance <= 3; distance += 1) {
      final lower = level.rank - distance;
      final higher = level.rank + distance;
      for (final candidateRank in <int>[lower, higher]) {
        if (candidateRank < 0 || candidateRank > 3) continue;
        final candidateLevel = PlacementLevel.fromRank(candidateRank);
        for (final question in _questions) {
          if (question.level == candidateLevel &&
              !excludeIds.contains(question.id)) {
            return question;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return null;
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/placement/data/placement_audio_runtime_adapter.dart

import '../../../features/audio/domain/entities/audio_request.dart';
import '../../../features/audio/domain/services/i_audio_runtime.dart';
import '../domain/placement_models.dart';
import '../domain/placement_repositories.dart';

final class PlacementAudioRuntimeAdapter implements PlacementAudioGateway {
  const PlacementAudioRuntimeAdapter(this.runtime);

  final IAudioRuntime runtime;

  @override
  Future<bool> play(PlacementQuestion question) async {
    final text = question.audioText?.trim();
    if (text == null || text.isEmpty) return false;
    final result = await runtime.play(
      AudioRequest(
        text: text,
        languageCode: question.audioLanguageCode,
        conceptId: question.reviewItemId ?? question.id,
        variant: AudioVariant.sentence,
      ),
    );
    return result.played;
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/placement/domain/adaptive_placement_engine.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'placement_models.dart';

final class AdaptivePlacementEngine {
  const AdaptivePlacementEngine();

  static const int defaultMaxQuestions = 9;
  static const int minQuestionsBeforeEarlyStop = 5;

  AssessmentSession start({
    required String sessionId,
    DateTime? now,
    int maxQuestions = defaultMaxQuestions,
  }) {
    final boundedMax = maxQuestions.clamp(5, 15).toInt();
    return AssessmentSession(
      id: sessionId,
      startedAt: now ?? DateTime.now(),
      currentLevel: PlacementLevel.a2,
      abilityEstimate: 1.0,
      answers: const <PlacementAnswer>[],
      maxQuestions: boundedMax,
    );
  }

  AssessmentSession recordAnswer({
    required AssessmentSession session,
    required PlacementQuestion question,
    required String selectedOptionId,
  }) {
    if (session.completed) {
      throw StateError('Placement session is already complete.');
    }
    if (session.answeredQuestionIds.contains(question.id)) {
      throw StateError('Placement question has already been answered.');
    }

    final correct = question.isCorrect(selectedOptionId);
    final nextLevel = correct
        ? PlacementLevel.fromRank(question.level.rank + 1)
        : PlacementLevel.fromRank(question.level.rank - 1);
    final ability = _updatedAbility(
      current: session.abilityEstimate,
      difficulty: question.level.rank,
      correct: correct,
    );
    final answers = List<PlacementAnswer>.unmodifiable(
      <PlacementAnswer>[
        ...session.answers,
        PlacementAnswer(
          questionId: question.id,
          questionLevel: question.level,
          pattern: question.pattern,
          skillTag: question.skillTag,
          selectedOptionId: selectedOptionId,
          correct: correct,
          reviewItemId: question.reviewItemId,
        ),
      ],
    );

    final updated = session.copyWith(
      currentLevel: nextLevel,
      abilityEstimate: ability,
      answers: answers,
    );
    return shouldStop(updated)
        ? updated.copyWith(completed: true)
        : updated;
  }

  bool shouldStop(AssessmentSession session) {
    if (session.answers.length >= session.maxQuestions) return true;
    if (session.answers.length < minQuestionsBeforeEarlyStop) return false;

    final recent = session.answers.reversed.take(3).toList(growable: false);
    final unanimous = recent.every((answer) => answer.correct) ||
        recent.every((answer) => !answer.correct);
    final decisiveAbility =
        session.abilityEstimate <= .35 || session.abilityEstimate >= 2.65;
    return unanimous && decisiveAbility;
  }

  PlacementResult resultFor(AssessmentSession session) {
    if (session.answers.isEmpty) {
      throw StateError('Cannot score an empty placement session.');
    }

    final score =
        (session.abilityEstimate / 3 * 100).clamp(0.0, 100.0).toDouble();
    final level = _levelForScore(score);
    final correct = session.answers.where((answer) => answer.correct).length;
    final wrong = session.answers.where((answer) => !answer.correct).toList();
    final reviewItemIds = <String>[];
    for (final answer in wrong) {
      final id = answer.reviewItemId?.trim();
      if (id != null && id.isNotEmpty && !reviewItemIds.contains(id)) {
        reviewItemIds.add(id);
      }
    }

    return PlacementResult(
      level: level,
      proficiencyScore: score,
      confidence: _confidence(session),
      answeredCount: session.answers.length,
      correctCount: correct,
      recommendations: _recommendations(wrong, level),
      reviewItemIds: List<String>.unmodifiable(reviewItemIds.take(20)),
      initialReviewIntervalDays: switch (level) {
        PlacementLevel.a1 => 1,
        PlacementLevel.a2 => 2,
        PlacementLevel.b1 => 3,
        PlacementLevel.b2 => 4,
      },
      initialSrsDifficulty: switch (level) {
        PlacementLevel.a1 => 1.70,
        PlacementLevel.a2 => 1.40,
        PlacementLevel.b1 => 1.15,
        PlacementLevel.b2 => 1.0,
      },
    );
  }

  double _updatedAbility({
    required double current,
    required int difficulty,
    required bool correct,
  }) {
    final target = correct
        ? math.min(3.0, difficulty + .65)
        : math.max(0.0, difficulty - .65);
    return (current * .55 + target * .45).clamp(0.0, 3.0).toDouble();
  }

  PlacementLevel _levelForScore(double score) {
    if (score < 30) return PlacementLevel.a1;
    if (score < 55) return PlacementLevel.a2;
    if (score < 80) return PlacementLevel.b1;
    return PlacementLevel.b2;
  }

  double _confidence(AssessmentSession session) {
    final sample =
        (session.answers.length / session.maxQuestions).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    final decisive = session.abilityEstimate <= .35 ||
        session.abilityEstimate >= 2.65;
    final evidenceBoost = session.answers.length >= minQuestionsBeforeEarlyStop
        ? (decisive ? .25 : .12)
        : 0.0;
    return (.55 + sample * .33 + evidenceBoost)
        .clamp(0.0, 1.0)
        .toDouble();
  }

  List<String> _recommendations(
    List<PlacementAnswer> wrong,
    PlacementLevel level,
  ) {
    final counts = <String, int>{};
    for (final answer in wrong) {
      counts[answer.skillTag] = (counts[answer.skillTag] ?? 0) + 1;
    }
    final ranked = counts.entries.toList()
      ..sort((left, right) {
        final byCount = right.value.compareTo(left.value);
        if (byCount != 0) return byCount;
        return left.key.compareTo(right.key);
      });

    final recommendations = <String>[
      switch (level) {
        PlacementLevel.a1 =>
          'ابدأ بتثبيت مفردات A1 والجمل اليومية القصيرة قبل رفع الحمل.',
        PlacementLevel.a2 =>
          'ابدأ من A2 مع مراجعة انتقائية لثغرات A1 التي ظهرت في الاختبار.',
        PlacementLevel.b1 =>
          'ابدأ من B1 مع مراجعات قصيرة للمهارات التي أخطأت فيها فقط.',
        PlacementLevel.b2 =>
          'ابدأ من B2 مع مراجعة مركزة فقط للثغرات التي كشفها الاختبار.',
      },
    ];
    for (final entry in ranked.take(2)) {
      recommendations.add(_recommendationForSkill(entry.key));
    }
    return List<String>.unmodifiable(recommendations);
  }

  String _recommendationForSkill(String skill) => switch (skill) {
        'grammar' => 'أعطِ أولوية لتمارين القواعد وبناء الجملة.',
        'listening' => 'زد جرعة الاستماع القصير وإعادة الاستماع الموجّه.',
        'translation' => 'راجع الربط المباشر بين المعنى العربي والتعبير الألماني.',
        'vocabulary' => 'ثبّت المفردات عالية التكرار قبل إضافة كلمات جديدة.',
        _ => 'راجع الأسئلة التي أخطأت فيها ضمن جلسات قصيرة متكررة.',
      };
}

enum PlacementLevel {
  a1(0, 'A1'),
  a2(1, 'A2'),
  b1(2, 'B1'),
  b2(3, 'B2');

  const PlacementLevel(this.rank, this.label);

  final int rank;
  final String label;

  int get recommendedStartTaskOrder => switch (this) {
        PlacementLevel.a1 => 1,
        PlacementLevel.a2 => 21,
        PlacementLevel.b1 => 31,
        PlacementLevel.b2 => 41,
      };

  static PlacementLevel fromRank(int rank) => switch (rank.clamp(0, 3)) {
        0 => PlacementLevel.a1,
        1 => PlacementLevel.a2,
        2 => PlacementLevel.b1,
        _ => PlacementLevel.b2,
      };
}

enum PlacementLearningGoal {
  general,
  dailyLife,
  work,
  studyExam,
  travel,
}

enum PlacementQuestionPattern {
  multipleChoice,
  grammar,
  translation,
  listening,
}

final class PlacementOption {
  const PlacementOption({
    required this.id,
    required this.text,
  });

  final String id;
  final String text;
}

final class PlacementQuestion {
  PlacementQuestion({
    required this.id,
    required this.promptArabic,
    required this.level,
    required this.pattern,
    required List<PlacementOption> options,
    required this.correctOptionId,
    required this.skillTag,
    this.audioText,
    this.audioLanguageCode = 'de',
    this.reviewItemId,
  }) : options = List<PlacementOption>.unmodifiable(options) {
    if (id.trim().isEmpty ||
        promptArabic.trim().isEmpty ||
        skillTag.trim().isEmpty ||
        options.length < 2 ||
        !options.any((option) => option.id == correctOptionId)) {
      throw ArgumentError('Invalid placement question.');
    }
  }

  final String id;
  final String promptArabic;
  final PlacementLevel level;
  final PlacementQuestionPattern pattern;
  final List<PlacementOption> options;
  final String correctOptionId;
  final String skillTag;
  final String? audioText;
  final String audioLanguageCode;
  final String? reviewItemId;

  bool get hasAudio => audioText?.trim().isNotEmpty == true;

  bool isCorrect(String optionId) => optionId == correctOptionId;
}

final class PlacementAnswer {
  const PlacementAnswer({
    required this.questionId,
    required this.questionLevel,
    required this.pattern,
    required this.skillTag,
    required this.selectedOptionId,
    required this.correct,
    this.reviewItemId,
  });

  final String questionId;
  final PlacementLevel questionLevel;
  final PlacementQuestionPattern pattern;
  final String skillTag;
  final String selectedOptionId;
  final bool correct;
  final String? reviewItemId;
}

final class AssessmentSession {
  const AssessmentSession({
    required this.id,
    required this.startedAt,
    required this.currentLevel,
    required this.abilityEstimate,
    required this.answers,
    required this.maxQuestions,
    this.completed = false,
  });

  final String id;
  final DateTime startedAt;
  final PlacementLevel currentLevel;
  final double abilityEstimate;
  final List<PlacementAnswer> answers;
  final int maxQuestions;
  final bool completed;

  double get progress =>
      (answers.length / maxQuestions).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();

  Set<String> get answeredQuestionIds =>
      answers.map((answer) => answer.questionId).toSet();

  AssessmentSession copyWith({
    PlacementLevel? currentLevel,
    double? abilityEstimate,
    List<PlacementAnswer>? answers,
    bool? completed,
  }) =>
      AssessmentSession(
        id: id,
        startedAt: startedAt,
        currentLevel: currentLevel ?? this.currentLevel,
        abilityEstimate: abilityEstimate ?? this.abilityEstimate,
        answers: answers ?? this.answers,
        maxQuestions: maxQuestions,
        completed: completed ?? this.completed,
      );
}

final class PlacementResult {
  const PlacementResult({
    required this.level,
    required this.proficiencyScore,
    required this.confidence,
    required this.answeredCount,
    required this.correctCount,
    required this.recommendations,
    required this.reviewItemIds,
    required this.initialReviewIntervalDays,
    required this.initialSrsDifficulty,
    this.learningGoal,
  });

  final PlacementLevel level;
  final double proficiencyScore;
  final double confidence;
  final int answeredCount;
  final int correctCount;
  final List<String> recommendations;
  final List<String> reviewItemIds;
  final int initialReviewIntervalDays;
  final double initialSrsDifficulty;
  final PlacementLearningGoal? learningGoal;

  PlacementResult copyWith({
    PlacementLearningGoal? learningGoal,
  }) =>
      PlacementResult(
        level: level,
        proficiencyScore: proficiencyScore,
        confidence: confidence,
        answeredCount: answeredCount,
        correctCount: correctCount,
        recommendations: recommendations,
        reviewItemIds: reviewItemIds,
        initialReviewIntervalDays: initialReviewIntervalDays,
        initialSrsDifficulty: initialSrsDifficulty,
        learningGoal: learningGoal ?? this.learningGoal,
      );
}

import 'placement_models.dart';

abstract interface class PlacementRepository {
  Future<PlacementQuestion?> nextQuestion({
    required PlacementLevel level,
    required Set<String> excludeIds,
  });

  Future<int> availableQuestionCount();
}

abstract interface class PlacementProfileRepository {
  Future<void> applyResult(PlacementResult result, {DateTime? at});
}

abstract interface class PlacementAudioGateway {
  Future<bool> play(PlacementQuestion question);
}

final class UnavailablePlacementAudioGateway implements PlacementAudioGateway {
  const UnavailablePlacementAudioGateway();

  @override
  Future<bool> play(PlacementQuestion question) async => false;

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../design_system/app_audio_button.dart';
import '../../../design_system/app_colors.dart';
import '../../../design_system/app_glass_card.dart';

class PlacementTestScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const PlacementTestScreen({
    required this.notifier,
    required this.onStartLearning,
    super.key,
  });

  final PlacementTestNotifier notifier;
  final VoidCallback onStartLearning;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: notifier,
      builder: (context, _) {
        final state = notifier.state;
        final result = state.result;
        if (result != null) {
          return PlacementResultScreen(
            result: result,
            resultPersisted: state.resultPersisted,
            isApplyingResult: state.isApplyingResult,
            errorMessage: state.errorMessage,
            onRetryPersist: () => unawaited(notifier.retry()),
            onStartLearning: onStartLearning,
          );
        }

        if (!state.hasStarted) {
          return _buildOnboarding(context, state);
        }

        final question = state.currentQuestion;
        return Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('اختبار تحديد المستوى')),
          body: SafeArea(
            child: question == null
                ? _buildEmptyState(
                    state,
                    onRetry: () => unawaited(notifier.retry()),
                  )
                : _buildQuestion(context, state, question),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _buildOnboarding(
    BuildContext context,
    PlacementTestState state,
  ) {
    final selected = state.learningGoal;
    return Scaffold(
      body: SafeArea(
        child: ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 22, 18, 28),
          children: <Widget>[
            Center(
              child: SmartOrb(
                state: SmartOrbDomainState(
                  feedback: selected == null
                      ? SmartOrbFeedback.neutral
                      : SmartOrbFeedback.guidance,
                ),
                size: 118,
                semanticsLabel: 'مرشد تحديد المستوى',
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 18),
            Text(
              'ابدأ من المستوى المناسب لك',
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: AppTypography.display,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Text(
              'اختر هدفك أولاً. بعدها سنطرح اختباراً قصيراً متكيّفاً من A1 إلى B2.',
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
              style: AppTypography.body,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 18),
            for (final goal in const <PlacementLearningGoal>[
              PlacementLearningGoal.dailyLife,
              PlacementLearningGoal.work,
              PlacementLearningGoal.studyExam,
              PlacementLearningGoal.travel,

              AppGlassCard(
                onTap: state.isLoading ? null : () => notifier.selectGoal(goal),
                glowColor: selected == goal
                    ? AppColors.primary
                    : AppColors.secondary,
                borderColor: selected == goal
                    ? AppColors.primary

                        _goalLabel(goal),
                        style: AppTypography.title,
                        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,

        ),
      ),
    );
  }

                  Expanded(

                      'السؤال $number',

                  DecoratedBox(

                        style: AppTypography.body,
                      ),

            style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(color: AppColors.articleDie),
          ),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }

  SmartOrbFeedback _orbFeedback(PlacementTestState state) {
    if (state.lastAnswerCorrect == true) return SmartOrbFeedback.success;
    if (state.lastAnswerCorrect == false) return SmartOrbFeedback.incorrect;
    return SmartOrbFeedback.guidance;
  }

  String _orbGuidance(PlacementTestState state) {
    if (state.isPlayingAudio) return 'استمع الآن؛ لا حاجة للاستعجال.';
    if (state.lastAnswerCorrect == true) {
      return 'إجابة جيدة. سنرفع الصعوبة تدريجياً.';
    }
    if (state.lastAnswerCorrect == false) {
      return 'سنكيّف السؤال التالي مع مستواك.';
    }
    return 'اختر الإجابة الأقرب لما تعرفه الآن.';
  }

  String _goalLabel(PlacementLearningGoal goal) => switch (goal) {
        PlacementLearningGoal.dailyLife => 'الحياة اليومية والتواصل',
        PlacementLearningGoal.work => 'العمل والمسار المهني',
        PlacementLearningGoal.studyExam => 'الدراسة والاستعداد للامتحانات',
        PlacementLearningGoal.travel => 'السفر والمواقف العملية',
        PlacementLearningGoal.general => 'تعلّم عام',
      };

  IconData _goalIcon(PlacementLearningGoal goal) => switch (goal) {
        PlacementLearningGoal.dailyLife => Icons.forum_outlined,
        PlacementLearningGoal.work => Icons.work_outline_rounded,
        PlacementLearningGoal.studyExam => Icons.school_outlined,
        PlacementLearningGoal.travel => Icons.luggage_outlined,
        PlacementLearningGoal.general => Icons.language_rounded,
      };

  Color _patternColor(PlacementQuestionPattern pattern) => switch (pattern) {
        PlacementQuestionPattern.listening => AppColors.secondary,
        PlacementQuestionPattern.grammar => AppColors.achievement,
        PlacementQuestionPattern.translation => AppColors.primary,
        PlacementQuestionPattern.multipleChoice => AppColors.tertiary,
      };
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/placement_agent_models.dart';
import '../domain/placement_agent_repository.dart';

final class _PlacementAnswerEvidence {
  const _PlacementAnswerEvidence({
    required this.question,
    required this.correct,
  });

  final PlacementQuestionItem question;
  final bool correct;
}

final class PlacementAgentNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  PlacementAgentNotifier(
    this._repository, {
    this.maxQuestions = 8,
  }) : assert(maxQuestions > 0);

  final PlacementAgentRepository _repository;
  final int maxQuestions;

  List<PlacementQuestionItem> _questions = const <PlacementQuestionItem>[];
  final List<_PlacementAnswerEvidence> _answers =
      <_PlacementAnswerEvidence>[];
  PlacementQuestionItem? _currentQuestion;
  PlacementAssessmentResult? _result;
  int _targetDifficulty = 3;
  bool _isBusy = false;

  PlacementQuestionItem? get currentQuestion => _currentQuestion;

  bool get isCompleted => _result != null;

  bool get isBusy => _isBusy;

  PlacementAssessmentResult? get result => _result;

  double get progress {
    if (isCompleted) return 1;
    final denominator = maxQuestions < _questions.length
        ? maxQuestions
        : _questions.length;
    if (denominator <= 0) return 0;
    return (_answers.length / denominator).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
  }

  Future<void> resetAssessment() async {
    if (_isBusy) return;
    _isBusy = true;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      _questions = await _repository.getCalibratedQuestions();
      _answers.clear();
      _result = null;
      _targetDifficulty = 3;
      _currentQuestion = _selectNextQuestion();
    } finally {
      _isBusy = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  Future<void> submitAnswer(int selectedIndex) async {
    final question = _currentQuestion;
    if (_isBusy || question == null || isCompleted) return;
    if (selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= question.options.length) {
      throw RangeError.index(
        selectedIndex,
        question.options,
        'selectedIndex',
      );
    }

    _isBusy = true;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      final correct = question.isCorrect(selectedIndex);
      _answers.add(
        _PlacementAnswerEvidence(question: question, correct: correct),
      );
      _targetDifficulty = correct
          ? (question.difficulty + 1).clamp(1, 5).toInt()
          : (question.difficulty - 1).clamp(1, 5).toInt();

      final hasReachedLimit = _answers.length >= maxQuestions;
      final nextQuestion = hasReachedLimit ? null : _selectNextQuestion();
      if (hasReachedLimit || nextQuestion == null) {
        _currentQuestion = null;
        _result = _buildResult();
        await _repository.saveAssessmentResult(_result!);
      } else {
        _currentQuestion = nextQuestion;
      }
    } finally {
      _isBusy = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  PlacementQuestionItem? _selectNextQuestion() {
    final answeredIds = <String>{
      for (final answer in _answers) answer.question.id,
    };
    final repository = _repository;
    if (repository is AdaptivePlacementQuestionSource) {
      return (repository as dynamic).selectNextQuestion(
        answeredIds: answeredIds,
        targetDifficulty: _targetDifficulty,
      );
    }

    final available = _questions
        .where((question) => !answeredIds.contains(question.id))
        .toList(growable: false);
    if (available.isEmpty) return null;
    available.sort((left, right) {
      final leftDistance = (left.difficulty - _targetDifficulty).abs();
      final rightDistance = (right.difficulty - _targetDifficulty).abs();
      final byDistance = leftDistance.compareTo(rightDistance);
      if (byDistance != 0) return byDistance;
      return left.id.compareTo(right.id);
    });
    return available.first;
  }

  PlacementAssessmentResult _buildResult() {
    if (_answers.isEmpty) {
      return PlacementAssessmentResult(
        inferredLevel: LanguageCefrSubLevel.a1_1,
        accuracy: 0,
        masteredSkills: const <String>[],
        skillsToStrengthen: const <String>[],
      );
    }

    final correctCount =
        _answers.where((answer) => answer.correct).length;
    final accuracy = correctCount / _answers.length;
    var weightedCorrect = 0;
    var weightedTotal = 0;
    final skillEvidence = <String, List<bool>>{};

    for (final answer in _answers) {
      final difficulty = answer.question.difficulty;
      weightedTotal += difficulty;
      if (answer.correct) weightedCorrect += difficulty;
      skillEvidence
          .putIfAbsent(answer.question.targetSkill, () => <bool>[])
          .add(answer.correct);
    }

    final weightedAccuracy =
        weightedTotal == 0 ? 0.0 : weightedCorrect / weightedTotal;
    final diagnosticScore = (accuracy * .70) + (weightedAccuracy * .30);
    final inferredLevel = switch (diagnosticScore) {
      >= .82 => LanguageCefrSubLevel.a2_2,
      >= .62 => LanguageCefrSubLevel.a2_1,
      >= .42 => LanguageCefrSubLevel.a1_2,
      _ => LanguageCefrSubLevel.a1_1,
    };

    final mastered = <String>[];
    final strengthen = <String>[];
    final skills = skillEvidence.keys.toList()..sort();
    for (final skill in skills) {
      final evidence = skillEvidence[skill]!;
      final correct = evidence.where((value) => value).length;
      final skillAccuracy = correct / evidence.length;
      if (skillAccuracy >= .70) {
        mastered.add(skill);
      } else {
        strengthen.add(skill);
      }
    }

    return PlacementAssessmentResult(
      inferredLevel: inferredLevel,
      accuracy: accuracy,
      masteredSkills: mastered,
      skillsToStrengthen: strengthen,
    );
  }
}

  @override
  Future<List<PlacementQuestionItem>> getCalibratedQuestions() async =>
      List<PlacementQuestionItem>.unmodifiable(_questionBank);

  @override
  Future<void> saveAssessmentResult(PlacementAssessmentResult result) async {
    _latestResult = result;
  }

  @override
  Future<PlacementAssessmentResult?> getLatestResult() async => _latestResult;

  @override
  PlacementQuestionItem? selectNextQuestion({
    required Set<String> answeredIds,
    required int targetDifficulty,
  }) {
    final available = _questionBank
        .where((question) => !answeredIds.contains(question.id))
        .toList(growable: false);
    if (available.isEmpty) return null;

    final safeTarget = targetDifficulty.clamp(1, 5).toInt();
    final ranked = List<PlacementQuestionItem>.of(available)
      ..sort((left, right) {
        final leftDistance = (left.difficulty - safeTarget).abs();
        final rightDistance = (right.difficulty - safeTarget).abs();
        final distanceOrder = leftDistance.compareTo(rightDistance);
        if (distanceOrder != 0) return distanceOrder;

        final difficultyOrder = safeTarget >= 3
            ? right.difficulty.compareTo(left.difficulty)
            : left.difficulty.compareTo(right.difficulty);
        if (difficultyOrder != 0) return difficultyOrder;
        return left.id.compareTo(right.id);
      });
    return ranked.first;
  }
}

enum LanguageCefrSubLevel { a1_1, a1_2, a2_1, a2_2 }

enum PlacementQuestionFocus { grammar, vocabulary }

final class PlacementQuestionItem {
  const PlacementQuestionItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.questionText,
    required this.options,
    required this.correctAnswerIndex,
    required this.difficulty,
    required this.targetSkill,
    required this.focus,
  })  : assert(id.length > 0),
        assert(options.length >= 2),
        assert(correctAnswerIndex >= 0),
        assert(correctAnswerIndex < options.length),
        assert(difficulty >= 1 && difficulty <= 5);

  final String id;
  final String questionText;
  final List<String> options;
  final int correctAnswerIndex;
  final int difficulty;
  final String targetSkill;
  final PlacementQuestionFocus focus;

  bool isCorrect(int selectedIndex) => selectedIndex == correctAnswerIndex;
}

final class PlacementAssessmentResult {
  PlacementAssessmentResult({
    required this.inferredLevel,
    required double accuracy,
    required List<String> masteredSkills,
    required List<String> skillsToStrengthen,
  })  : accuracy = accuracy.clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble(),
        masteredSkills = List<String>.unmodifiable(masteredSkills),
        skillsToStrengthen = List<String>.unmodifiable(skillsToStrengthen);

  final LanguageCefrSubLevel inferredLevel;
  final double accuracy;
  final List<String> masteredSkills;
  final List<String> skillsToStrengthen;
}

extension LanguageCefrSubLevelLabel on LanguageCefrSubLevel {
  String get label => switch (this) {
        LanguageCefrSubLevel.a1_1 => 'A1.1',
        LanguageCefrSubLevel.a1_2 => 'A1.2',
        LanguageCefrSubLevel.a2_1 => 'A2.1',
        LanguageCefrSubLevel.a2_2 => 'A2.2',
      };
}

import 'placement_agent_models.dart';

abstract class PlacementAgentRepository {
  Future<List<PlacementQuestionItem>> getCalibratedQuestions();

  Future<void> saveAssessmentResult(PlacementAssessmentResult result);

  Future<PlacementAssessmentResult?> getLatestResult();
}

abstract interface class AdaptivePlacementQuestionSource {
  PlacementQuestionItem? selectNextQuestion({
    required Set<String> answeredIds,
    required int targetDifficulty,
  });
}

import 'dart:async';


import '../../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import '../application/placement_agent_notifier.dart';
import '../domain/placement_agent_models.dart';

final class DiagnosticPlacementScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const DiagnosticPlacementScreen({
    required this.notifier,
    super.key,
  });

  final PlacementAgentNotifier notifier;

  @override
  State<DiagnosticPlacementScreen> createState() =>
      _DiagnosticPlacementScreenState();
}

final class _DiagnosticPlacementScreenState
    extends State<DiagnosticPlacementScreen> {
  PlacementAgentNotifier get notifier => widget.notifier;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    notifier.addListener(_refresh);
    if (notifier.currentQuestion == null && !notifier.isCompleted) {
      unawaited(notifier.resetAssessment());
    }
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant DiagnosticPlacementScreen oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.notifier == notifier) return;
    oldWidget.notifier.removeListener(_refresh);
    notifier.addListener(_refresh);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    notifier.removeListener(_refresh);
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _refresh() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: Text('التقييم التشخيصي', style: AppTypography.title),
          backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
          elevation: 0,
        ),
        body: SafeArea(
          top: false,
          child: AnimatedSwitcher(
            duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 260),
            child: notifier.isCompleted
                ? _ResultView(
                    key: const ValueKey<String>('placement-result'),
                    result: notifier.result!,
                    onReset: () => unawaited(notifier.resetAssessment()),
                  )
                : _QuestionView(
                    key: ValueKey<String>(
                      notifier.currentQuestion?.id ?? 'loading',
                    ),
                    notifier: notifier,
                  ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

        for (var index = 0; index < question.options.length; index += 1) ...[
          AppGlassCard(
            onTap: notifier.isBusy
                ? null
                : () => unawaited(notifier.submitAnswer(index)),
            borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(72),
            backgroundColor:
                dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
            child: Row(
              children: <Widget>[
                Container(
                  width: 34,
                  height: 34,
                  alignment: Alignment.center,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                    color: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(26),
                  ),
                  child: Text(
                    '${index + 1}',
                    style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
                      color:
                          dark ? AppColors.primaryDark : AppColors.primary,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 12),
                Expanded(
                  child: AppDirectionalText(
                    question.options[index],
                    languageCode: _optionLanguage(question.options[index]),
                    style: AppTypography.body.copyWith(
                      color: dark ? Colors.white : AppColors.darkSurface,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          if (index != question.options.length - 1)
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }

  static String _optionLanguage(String value) =>
      RegExp(r'[\u0600-\u06FF]').hasMatch(value) ? 'ar' : 'de';
}

FILE: lib/features/placement_assessment/application/placement_notifier.dart

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/placement_models.dart';
import '../domain/placement_repository.dart';

final class PlacementNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  PlacementNotifier(
    this._repository, {
    this.maxQuestions = 8,
  }) : assert(maxQuestions > 0);

  final PlacementRepository _repository;
  final int maxQuestions;

  final List<PlacementAnswerRecord> _answers =
      <PlacementAnswerRecord>[];
  PlacementQuestionItem? _currentQuestion;
  PlacementResult? _result;
  CefrLevel _targetLevel = CefrLevel.a2;
  double _targetDifficulty = 1.0;
  bool _isBusy = false;

  PlacementQuestionItem? get currentQuestion => _currentQuestion;

  List<PlacementAnswerRecord> get answers =>
      List<PlacementAnswerRecord>.unmodifiable(_answers);

  PlacementResult? get result => _result;

  bool get isBusy => _isBusy;

  bool get isCompleted => _result != null;

  CefrLevel get currentEstimatedLevel =>
      _result?.finalLevel ?? _estimateLevel(_answers);

  double get progress {
    if (isCompleted) return 1;
    return (_answers.length / maxQuestions)
        .clamp(0.0, 1.0)
        .toDouble();
  }

  Future<void> restartAssessment() async {
    if (_isBusy) return;
    _isBusy = true;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      _answers.clear();
      _result = null;
      _targetLevel = CefrLevel.a2;
      _targetDifficulty = 1.0;
      _currentQuestion = await _repository.nextAdaptiveQuestion(
        targetLevel: _targetLevel,
        targetDifficulty: _targetDifficulty,
        excludeIds: const <String>{},
        skillAttempts: const <AssessmentSkillCategory, int>{},
      );
      if (_currentQuestion == null) {
        _result = calculateFinalLevel();
      }
    } finally {
      _isBusy = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  Future<void> submitAnswer(int optionIndex) async {
    final question = _currentQuestion;
    if (question == null || _isBusy || isCompleted) return;
    if (optionIndex < 0 || optionIndex >= question.options.length) {
      throw RangeError.index(
        optionIndex,
        question.options,
        'optionIndex',
      );
    }

    _isBusy = true;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      final correct = question.isCorrect(optionIndex);
      _answers.add(
        PlacementAnswerRecord(
          questionId: question.id,
          level: question.targetLevel,
          skill: question.skill,
          difficultyWeight: question.difficultyWeight,
          isCorrect: correct,
        ),
      );

      _targetLevel = _nextTargetLevel(
        question.targetLevel,
        correct,
      );
      _targetDifficulty = _nextDifficulty(
        question.difficultyWeight,
        correct,
      );

      if (_answers.length >= maxQuestions) {
        _currentQuestion = null;
        _result = calculateFinalLevel();
        return;
      }

      final next = await _repository.nextAdaptiveQuestion(
        targetLevel: _targetLevel,
        targetDifficulty: _targetDifficulty,
        excludeIds: _answeredIds(_answers),
        skillAttempts: _skillAttemptCounts(_answers),
      );
      if (next == null) {
        _currentQuestion = null;
        _result = calculateFinalLevel();
        return;
      }
      _currentQuestion = next;
    } finally {
      _isBusy = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  PlacementResult calculateFinalLevel() =>
      _repository.calculateStandardizedResult(
        List<PlacementAnswerRecord>.unmodifiable(_answers),
      );

  static CefrLevel _nextTargetLevel(
    CefrLevel answeredLevel,
    bool correct,
  ) {
    final delta = correct ? 1 : -1;
    return CefrLevelMetadata.fromRank(answeredLevel.rank + delta);
  }

  static double _nextDifficulty(
    double answeredDifficulty,
    bool correct,
  ) {
    final delta = correct ? .15 : -.15;
    return (answeredDifficulty + delta)
        .clamp(.55, 1.70)
        .toDouble();
  }

  static Set<String> _answeredIds(
    List<PlacementAnswerRecord> answers,
  ) =>
      <String>{
        for (final answer in answers) answer.questionId,
      };

  static Map<AssessmentSkillCategory, int> _skillAttemptCounts(
    List<PlacementAnswerRecord> answers,
  ) {
    final counts = <AssessmentSkillCategory, int>{};
    for (final answer in answers) {
      counts[answer.skill] = (counts[answer.skill] ?? 0) + 1;
    }
    return counts;
  }

  static CefrLevel _estimateLevel(
    List<PlacementAnswerRecord> answers,
  ) {
    if (answers.isEmpty) return CefrLevel.a2;
    final score = _standardizedScore(answers);
    if (score >= 87.5) return CefrLevel.b2;
    if (score >= 62.5) return CefrLevel.b1;
    if (score >= 37.5) return CefrLevel.a2;
    return CefrLevel.a1;
  }

  static double _standardizedScore(
    List<PlacementAnswerRecord> answers,
  ) {
    var weightedEvidence = 0.0;
    var totalWeight = 0.0;
    for (final answer in answers) {
      final weight =
          answer.difficultyWeight.clamp(.1, 3.0).toDouble();
      final boundaryEvidence =
          (answer.level.rank + (answer.isCorrect ? 1 : 0)) / 4;
      weightedEvidence += boundaryEvidence * weight;
      totalWeight += weight;
    }
    if (totalWeight == 0) return 0;
    return (weightedEvidence / totalWeight * 100)
        .clamp(0.0, 100.0)
        .toDouble();
  }
}

  @override
  Future<List<PlacementQuestionItem>> getQuestionBundle({
    CefrLevel? level,
  }) async {
    final values = level == null
        ? _questionBank
        : _questionBank.where((question) => question.targetLevel == level);
    return List<PlacementQuestionItem>.unmodifiable(values);
  }

  @override
  Future<PlacementQuestionItem?> nextAdaptiveQuestion({
    required CefrLevel targetLevel,
    required double targetDifficulty,
    required Set<String> excludeIds,
    required Map<AssessmentSkillCategory, int> skillAttempts,
  }) async {
    final available = _questionBank
        .where((question) => !excludeIds.contains(question.id))
        .toList(growable: false);
    if (available.isEmpty) return null;

    final ranked = List<PlacementQuestionItem>.of(available)
      ..sort((left, right) {
        final leftLevelDistance =
            (left.targetLevel.rank - targetLevel.rank).abs();
        final rightLevelDistance =
            (right.targetLevel.rank - targetLevel.rank).abs();
        final byLevel = leftLevelDistance.compareTo(rightLevelDistance);
        if (byLevel != 0) return byLevel;

        final leftAttempts = skillAttempts[left.skill] ?? 0;
        final rightAttempts = skillAttempts[right.skill] ?? 0;
        final byCoverage = leftAttempts.compareTo(rightAttempts);
        if (byCoverage != 0) return byCoverage;

        final leftDifficultyDistance =
            (left.difficultyWeight - targetDifficulty).abs();
        final rightDifficultyDistance =
            (right.difficultyWeight - targetDifficulty).abs();
        final byDifficulty =
            leftDifficultyDistance.compareTo(rightDifficultyDistance);
        if (byDifficulty != 0) return byDifficulty;

        return left.id.compareTo(right.id);
      });

    return ranked.first;
  }

  @override
  PlacementResult calculateStandardizedResult(
    List<PlacementAnswerRecord> answers,
  ) {
    if (answers.isEmpty) {
      return PlacementResult(
        finalLevel: CefrLevel.a1,
        standardizedScore: 0,
        skillAccuracy: <AssessmentSkillCategory, double>{
          for (final skill in AssessmentSkillCategory.values) skill: 0,
        },
        learningPlan: const <String>[
          'ابدأ من A1 لبناء أساس ثابت في الجمل اليومية والمفردات الأساسية.',
        ],
      );
    }

    var weightedEvidence = 0.0;
    var totalWeight = 0.0;
    final attempts = <AssessmentSkillCategory, int>{};
    final correctBySkill = <AssessmentSkillCategory, int>{};

    for (final answer in answers) {
      final weight = answer.difficultyWeight.clamp(.1, 3.0).toDouble();
      final boundaryEvidence =
          (answer.level.rank + (answer.isCorrect ? 1 : 0)) / 4;
      weightedEvidence += boundaryEvidence * weight;
      totalWeight += weight;
      attempts[answer.skill] = (attempts[answer.skill] ?? 0) + 1;
      if (answer.isCorrect) {
        correctBySkill[answer.skill] =
            (correctBySkill[answer.skill] ?? 0) + 1;
      }
    }

    final score = totalWeight == 0
        ? 0.0
        : (weightedEvidence / totalWeight * 100)
            .clamp(0.0, 100.0)
            .toDouble();
    final level = _levelForScore(score);
    final accuracy = <AssessmentSkillCategory, double>{
      for (final skill in AssessmentSkillCategory.values)
        skill: (attempts[skill] ?? 0) == 0
            ? 0
            : (correctBySkill[skill] ?? 0) / attempts[skill]!,
    };

    return PlacementResult(
      finalLevel: level,
      standardizedScore: score,
      skillAccuracy: accuracy,
      learningPlan: _learningPlan(
        level: level,
        skillAccuracy: accuracy,
        attempts: attempts,
      ),
    );
  }

  static CefrLevel _levelForScore(double score) {
    if (score >= 87.5) return CefrLevel.b2;
    if (score >= 62.5) return CefrLevel.b1;
    if (score >= 37.5) return CefrLevel.a2;
    return CefrLevel.a1;
  }

  static List<String> _learningPlan({
    required CefrLevel level,
    required Map<AssessmentSkillCategory, double> skillAccuracy,
    required Map<AssessmentSkillCategory, int> attempts,
  }) {
    final plan = <String>[
      switch (level) {
        CefrLevel.a1 =>
          'ابدأ من A1 مع تثبيت تراكيب الجملة الأساسية والمفردات عالية التكرار.',
        CefrLevel.a2 =>
          'ابدأ من A2 مع مراجعة انتقائية لثغرات A1 قبل رفع كثافة المهام.',
        CefrLevel.b1 =>
          'ابدأ من B1 وركّز على إنتاج جمل أطول وربط الأفكار والسياقات العملية.',
        CefrLevel.b2 =>
          'ابدأ من B2 مع تدريب مكثف على الدقة والأسلوب وفهم النصوص المركبة.',
      },
    ];

    final observed = AssessmentSkillCategory.values
        .where((skill) => (attempts[skill] ?? 0) > 0)
        .toList(growable: false)
      ..sort((left, right) {
        final byAccuracy =
            skillAccuracy[left]!.compareTo(skillAccuracy[right]!);
        if (byAccuracy != 0) return byAccuracy;
        return left.index.compareTo(right.index);
      });

    for (final skill in observed.take(2)) {
      if (skillAccuracy[skill]! >= .75) continue;
      plan.add(_recommendationFor(skill));
    }
    return List<String>.unmodifiable(plan);
  }

  static String _recommendationFor(AssessmentSkillCategory skill) =>
      switch (skill) {
        AssessmentSkillCategory.grammar =>
          'خصص مراجعات قصيرة للقواعد التي تغيّر ترتيب الفعل والحالات الإعرابية.',
        AssessmentSkillCategory.vocabulary =>
          'زد التعرض للمفردات الشائعة داخل جمل وسياقات بدل حفظ الكلمات منفردة.',
        AssessmentSkillCategory.readingComprehension =>
          'تدرّب على استخراج الفكرة والاستنتاج من نصوص قصيرة ثم أطول تدريجياً.',
        AssessmentSkillCategory.practicalContext =>
          'تدرّب على مواقف الحياة والعمل والرسائل بصيغ مناسبة للمقام.',
      };
}

enum CefrLevel { a1, a2, b1, b2 }

enum AssessmentSkillCategory {
  grammar,
  vocabulary,
  readingComprehension,
  practicalContext,
}

extension CefrLevelMetadata on CefrLevel {
  int get rank => switch (this) {
        CefrLevel.a1 => 0,
        CefrLevel.a2 => 1,
        CefrLevel.b1 => 2,
        CefrLevel.b2 => 3,
      };

  String get label => switch (this) {
        CefrLevel.a1 => 'A1',
        CefrLevel.a2 => 'A2',
        CefrLevel.b1 => 'B1',
        CefrLevel.b2 => 'B2',
      };

  static CefrLevel fromRank(int rank) => switch (rank.clamp(0, 3)) {
        0 => CefrLevel.a1,
        1 => CefrLevel.a2,
        2 => CefrLevel.b1,
        _ => CefrLevel.b2,
      };
}

extension AssessmentSkillCategoryLabel on AssessmentSkillCategory {
  String get arabicLabel => switch (this) {
        AssessmentSkillCategory.grammar => 'القواعد',
        AssessmentSkillCategory.vocabulary => 'المفردات',
        AssessmentSkillCategory.readingComprehension => 'فهم المقروء',
        AssessmentSkillCategory.practicalContext => 'السياق العملي',
      };
}

final class PlacementQuestionItem {
  PlacementQuestionItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.question,
    required List<String> options,
    required this.correctAnswerIndex,
    required this.targetLevel,
    required this.difficultyWeight,
    required this.skill,
    required this.arabicExplanation,
  }) : options = List<String>.unmodifiable(options) {
    if (id.trim().isEmpty ||
        question.trim().isEmpty ||
        options.length < 2 ||
        correctAnswerIndex < 0 ||
        correctAnswerIndex >= options.length ||
        difficultyWeight <= 0 ||
        arabicExplanation.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('Invalid placement question.');
    }
  }

  final String id;
  final String question;
  final List<String> options;
  final int correctAnswerIndex;
  final CefrLevel targetLevel;
  final double difficultyWeight;
  final AssessmentSkillCategory skill;
  final String arabicExplanation;

  bool isCorrect(int optionIndex) => optionIndex == correctAnswerIndex;
}

final class PlacementAnswerRecord {
  const PlacementAnswerRecord({
    required this.questionId,
    required this.level,
    required this.skill,
    required this.difficultyWeight,
    required this.isCorrect,
  });

  final String questionId;
  final CefrLevel level;
  final AssessmentSkillCategory skill;
  final double difficultyWeight;
  final bool isCorrect;
}

final class PlacementResult {
  PlacementResult({
    required this.finalLevel,
    required double standardizedScore,
    required Map<AssessmentSkillCategory, double> skillAccuracy,
    required List<String> learningPlan,
  })  : standardizedScore =
            standardizedScore.clamp(0.0, 100.0).toDouble(),
        skillAccuracy =
            Map<AssessmentSkillCategory, double>.unmodifiable(
          <AssessmentSkillCategory, double>{
            for (final entry in skillAccuracy.entries)
              entry.key: entry.value.clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble(),
          },
        ),
        learningPlan = List<String>.unmodifiable(learningPlan);

  final CefrLevel finalLevel;
  final double standardizedScore;
  final Map<AssessmentSkillCategory, double> skillAccuracy;
  final List<String> learningPlan;
}

import 'dart:async';


import '../../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import '../application/placement_notifier.dart';
import '../domain/placement_models.dart';

final class PlacementScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const PlacementScreen({
    required this.notifier,
    super.key,
  });

  final PlacementNotifier notifier;

  @override
  State<PlacementScreen> createState() => _PlacementScreenState();
}

final class _PlacementScreenState extends State<PlacementScreen> {
  int? _selectedOptionIndex;

  PlacementNotifier get notifier => widget.notifier;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    notifier.addListener(_refresh);
    if (notifier.currentQuestion == null && !notifier.isCompleted) {
      unawaited(notifier.restartAssessment());
    }
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant PlacementScreen oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.notifier == notifier) return;
    oldWidget.notifier.removeListener(_refresh);
    notifier.addListener(_refresh);
    _selectedOptionIndex = null;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    notifier.removeListener(_refresh);
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _refresh() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  Future<void> _submitSelected() async {
    final selected = _selectedOptionIndex;
    if (selected == null || notifier.isBusy) return;
    await notifier.submitAnswer(selected);
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => _selectedOptionIndex = null);
  }

  Future<void> _restart() async {
    setState(() => _selectedOptionIndex = null);
    await notifier.restartAssessment();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface =
        dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 18, 16, 28),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: <Widget>[
                _HeaderCard(
                  dark: dark,
                  surface: surface,
                  estimatedLevel: notifier.currentEstimatedLevel,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                _ProgressCard(
                  progress: notifier.progress,
                  answered: notifier.answers.length,
                  total: notifier.maxQuestions,
                  dark: dark,
                  surface: surface,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                if (notifier.isCompleted && notifier.result != null)
                  _ResultCard(
                    result: notifier.result!,
                    dark: dark,
                    surface: surface,
                    onRestart: () => unawaited(_restart()),
                  )
                else if (notifier.currentQuestion != null)
                  _QuestionSection(
                    question: notifier.currentQuestion!,
                    selectedOptionIndex: _selectedOptionIndex,
                    enabled: !notifier.isBusy,
                    dark: dark,
                    surface: surface,
                    onSelect: (index) {
                      setState(() => _selectedOptionIndex = index);
                    },
                    onSubmit: () => unawaited(_submitSelected()),
                  )
                else
                  _LoadingCard(
                    dark: dark,
                    surface: surface,
                    isBusy: notifier.isBusy,
                    onRetry: () =>
                        unawaited(notifier.restartAssessment()),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

  }) : textAlign = null;

  final TextStyle style;
  final TextAlign? textAlign;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Directionality(
        textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
        child: Text(
          text,
          style: style,
          textAlign: textAlign,
        ),
      );
}

FILE: lib/features/prepositions_arena/application/preposition_arena_notifier.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/preposition_case_rules.dart';
import '../domain/preposition_models.dart';
import '../domain/prepositions_repository.dart';

enum PrepositionArenaStatus { idle, active, completed }

final class PrepositionArenaState {
  const PrepositionArenaState({
    this.status = PrepositionArenaStatus.idle,
    this.challenges = const <PrepositionChallenge>[],
    this.currentIndex = 0,
    this.correctCount = 0,
    this.answeredCount = 0,
    this.selectedType,
    this.selectedLevel,
    this.lastResult,
  });

  final PrepositionArenaStatus status;
  final List<PrepositionChallenge> challenges;
  final int currentIndex;
  final int correctCount;
  final int answeredCount;
  final PrepositionType? selectedType;
  final String? selectedLevel;
  final PrepositionAnswerResult? lastResult;

  PrepositionChallenge? get currentChallenge {
    if (status != PrepositionArenaStatus.active ||
        currentIndex < 0 ||
        currentIndex >= challenges.length) {
      return null;
    }
    return challenges[currentIndex];
  }

  bool get hasAnsweredCurrent => lastResult != null;

  bool get isCompleted => status == PrepositionArenaStatus.completed;

  double get accuracy =>
      answeredCount == 0 ? 0 : correctCount / answeredCount;

  PrepositionArenaState copyWith({
    PrepositionArenaStatus? status,
    List<PrepositionChallenge>? challenges,
    int? currentIndex,
    int? correctCount,
    int? answeredCount,
    PrepositionType? selectedType,
    String? selectedLevel,
    bool clearSelectedType = false,
    PrepositionAnswerResult? lastResult,
    bool clearLastResult = false,
  }) {
    return PrepositionArenaState(
      status: status ?? this.status,
      challenges: challenges ?? this.challenges,
      currentIndex: currentIndex ?? this.currentIndex,
      correctCount: correctCount ?? this.correctCount,
      answeredCount: answeredCount ?? this.answeredCount,
      selectedType: clearSelectedType
          ? null
          : selectedType ?? this.selectedType,
      selectedLevel: selectedLevel ?? this.selectedLevel,
      lastResult: clearLastResult ? null : lastResult ?? this.lastResult,
    );
  }
}

final class PrepositionArenaNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  PrepositionArenaNotifier({
    required PrepositionsRepository repository,
    PrepositionCaseRules rules = const PrepositionCaseRules(),
  })  : _repository = repository,
        _rules = rules;

  final PrepositionsRepository _repository;
  final PrepositionCaseRules _rules;

  PrepositionArenaState _state = const PrepositionArenaState();

  PrepositionArenaState get state => _state;

  void start({
    PrepositionType? type,
    String? level,
    int limit = 10,
  }) {
    final safeLimit = limit.clamp(1, 20).toInt();
    final source = _repository.challenges(type: type, level: level);
    final challenges = source.take(safeLimit).toList(growable: false);

    _state = PrepositionArenaState(
      status: challenges.isEmpty
          ? PrepositionArenaStatus.completed
          : PrepositionArenaStatus.active,
      challenges: List<PrepositionChallenge>.unmodifiable(challenges),
      selectedType: type,
      selectedLevel: level?.trim().toUpperCase(),
    );
    notifyListeners();
  }

  String expectedAnswerForCurrent() {
    final challenge = _state.currentChallenge;
    if (challenge == null) {
      throw StateError('No active preposition challenge.');
    }
    return _expectedFor(challenge).answer;
  }

  PrepositionAnswerResult submit(String rawAnswer) {
    final challenge = _state.currentChallenge;
    if (challenge == null) {
      throw StateError('No active preposition challenge.');
    }
    if (_state.hasAnsweredCurrent) {
      throw StateError('Current challenge has already been scored.');
    }

    final expected = _expectedFor(challenge);
    final selected = rawAnswer.trim();
    final isCorrect =
        selected.toLowerCase() == expected.answer.toLowerCase();
    final result = PrepositionAnswerResult(
      isCorrect: isCorrect,
      selectedAnswer: selected,
      expectedAnswer: expected.answer,
      explanationAr: challenge.explanationAr,
      grammaticalCase: expected.grammaticalCase,
      articleForm: expected.articleForm,
    );

    _state = _state.copyWith(
      correctCount: _state.correctCount + (isCorrect ? 1 : 0),
      answeredCount: _state.answeredCount + 1,
      lastResult: result,
    );
    notifyListeners();
    return result;
  }

  void next() {
    if (_state.status != PrepositionArenaStatus.active) return;
    if (!_state.hasAnsweredCurrent) {
      throw StateError('Answer the current challenge before continuing.');
    }

    final nextIndex = _state.currentIndex + 1;
    if (nextIndex >= _state.challenges.length) {
      _state = _state.copyWith(
        status: PrepositionArenaStatus.completed,
        clearLastResult: true,
      );
    } else {
      _state = _state.copyWith(
        currentIndex: nextIndex,
        clearLastResult: true,
      );
    }
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void restart() {
    start(
      type: _state.selectedType,
      level: _state.selectedLevel,
      limit: _state.challenges.length,
    );
  }

  _ExpectedAnswer _expectedFor(PrepositionChallenge challenge) {
    final preposition = _repository.byId(challenge.prepositionId);
    if (preposition == null) {
      throw StateError(
        'Unknown preposition id: ${challenge.prepositionId}',
      );
    }
    final grammaticalCase = _rules.caseFor(
      preposition: preposition,
      spatialQuestion: challenge.spatialQuestion,
    );

    if (challenge.kind == PrepositionChallengeKind.prepositionChoice) {
      final answer = challenge.correctPreposition?.trim();
      if (answer == null || answer.isEmpty) {
        throw StateError('Missing correct preposition answer.');
      }
      return _ExpectedAnswer(
        answer: answer,
        grammaticalCase: grammaticalCase,
      );
    }

    final baseArticle = challenge.baseArticle;
    if (baseArticle == null) {
      throw StateError('Missing base article for article challenge.');
    }
    final form = _rules.articleForm(
      baseArticle: baseArticle,
      grammaticalCase: grammaticalCase,
    );
    return _ExpectedAnswer(
      answer: form.surfaceArticle,
      grammaticalCase: grammaticalCase,
      articleForm: form,
    );
  }
}

final class _ExpectedAnswer {
  const _ExpectedAnswer({
    required this.answer,
    required this.grammaticalCase,
    this.articleForm,
  });

  final String answer;
  final GermanGrammaticalCase grammaticalCase;
  final GermanArticleCaseForm? articleForm;
}

  @override
  List<PrepositionItem> allPrepositions() =>
      List<PrepositionItem>.unmodifiable(_items);

  @override
  PrepositionItem? byId(String id) {
    final normalized = id.trim().toLowerCase();
    for (final item in _items) {
      if (item.id == normalized) return item;
    }
    return null;
  }

  @override
  List<PrepositionChallenge> challenges({
    PrepositionType? type,
    String? level,
  }) {
    final normalizedLevel = level?.trim().toUpperCase();
    final result = <PrepositionChallenge>[];
    for (final challenge in _challenges) {
      final preposition = byId(challenge.prepositionId);
      if (preposition == null) continue;
      if (type != null && preposition.type != type) continue;
      if (normalizedLevel != null &&
          normalizedLevel.isNotEmpty &&
          challenge.level != normalizedLevel) {
        continue;
      }
      result.add(challenge);
    }
    return List<PrepositionChallenge>.unmodifiable(result);
  }
}


--------------------------------------------------
FILE: lib/features/prepositions_arena/domain/preposition_case_rules.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import '../../../core/localization/german_article_style.dart';
import 'preposition_models.dart';

final class PrepositionCaseRules {
  const PrepositionCaseRules();

  GermanGrammaticalCase caseFor({
    required PrepositionItem preposition,
    required SpatialQuestion spatialQuestion,
  }) {
    return switch (preposition.type) {
      PrepositionType.accusative => GermanGrammaticalCase.accusative,
      PrepositionType.dative => GermanGrammaticalCase.dative,
      PrepositionType.twoWay => switch (spatialQuestion) {
          SpatialQuestion.wohin => GermanGrammaticalCase.accusative,
          SpatialQuestion.wo => GermanGrammaticalCase.dative,
          SpatialQuestion.none => throw StateError(
              'Two-way prepositions require a Wo/Wohin context.',
            ),
        },
    };
  }

  GermanArticleCaseForm articleForm({
    required GermanArticle baseArticle,
    required GermanGrammaticalCase grammaticalCase,
  }) {
    final surface = switch ((baseArticle, grammaticalCase)) {
      (GermanArticle.der, GermanGrammaticalCase.accusative) => 'den',
      (GermanArticle.der, GermanGrammaticalCase.dative) => 'dem',
      (GermanArticle.die, GermanGrammaticalCase.accusative) => 'die',
      (GermanArticle.die, GermanGrammaticalCase.dative) => 'der',
      (GermanArticle.das, GermanGrammaticalCase.accusative) => 'das',
      (GermanArticle.das, GermanGrammaticalCase.dative) => 'dem',
    };
    return GermanArticleCaseForm(
      baseArticle: baseArticle,
      grammaticalCase: grammaticalCase,
      surfaceArticle: surface,
    );
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/prepositions_arena/domain/preposition_models.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import '../../../core/localization/german_article_style.dart';

enum PrepositionType { accusative, dative, twoWay }

enum GermanGrammaticalCase { accusative, dative }

enum SpatialQuestion { none, wohin, wo }

enum PrepositionChallengeKind { prepositionChoice, articleChoice }

final class PrepositionItem {
  const PrepositionItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.preposition,
    required this.type,
    required this.meaningAr,
    required this.level,
  });

  final String id;
  final String preposition;
  final PrepositionType type;
  final String meaningAr;
  final String level;
}

final class GermanArticleCaseForm {
  const GermanArticleCaseForm({
    required this.baseArticle,
    required this.grammaticalCase,
    required this.surfaceArticle,
  });

  final GermanArticle baseArticle;
  final GermanGrammaticalCase grammaticalCase;
  final String surfaceArticle;
}

final class PrepositionChallenge {
  PrepositionChallenge({
    required this.id,
    required this.kind,
    required this.sentenceTemplate,
    required this.translationAr,
    required this.prepositionId,
    required List<String> options,
    required this.explanationAr,
    required this.level,
    this.correctPreposition,
    this.baseArticle,
    this.spatialQuestion = SpatialQuestion.none,
  }) : options = List<String>.unmodifiable(options) {
    if (id.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(id, 'id', 'must not be empty');
    }
    if (!sentenceTemplate.contains('___')) {
      throw ArgumentError('sentenceTemplate must contain ___');
    }
    if (this.options.length < 2) {
      throw ArgumentError('challenge requires at least two options');
    }
    if (kind == PrepositionChallengeKind.prepositionChoice &&
        (correctPreposition == null || correctPreposition!.trim().isEmpty)) {
      throw ArgumentError('preposition challenge requires correctPreposition');
    }
    if (kind == PrepositionChallengeKind.articleChoice &&
        baseArticle == null) {
      throw ArgumentError('article challenge requires baseArticle');
    }
  }

  final String id;
  final PrepositionChallengeKind kind;
  final String sentenceTemplate;
  final String translationAr;
  final String prepositionId;
  final String? correctPreposition;
  final GermanArticle? baseArticle;
  final SpatialQuestion spatialQuestion;
  final List<String> options;
  final String explanationAr;
  final String level;
}

final class PrepositionAnswerResult {
  const PrepositionAnswerResult({
    required this.isCorrect,
    required this.selectedAnswer,
    required this.expectedAnswer,
    required this.explanationAr,
    this.grammaticalCase,
    this.articleForm,
  });

  final bool isCorrect;
  final String selectedAnswer;
  final String expectedAnswer;
  final String explanationAr;
  final GermanGrammaticalCase? grammaticalCase;
  final GermanArticleCaseForm? articleForm;
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../design_system/app_colors.dart';
import '../../../design_system/app_glass_card.dart';
import '../../../design_system/app_typography.dart';
import '../application/preposition_arena_notifier.dart';
import '../domain/preposition_models.dart';
import 'widgets/drag_drop_case_card_widget.dart';

class PrepositionArenaScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const PrepositionArenaScreen({
    required this.notifier,
    this.level,
    this.sessionLimit = 10,
    super.key,
  });

  final PrepositionArenaNotifier notifier;
  final String? level;
  final int sessionLimit;

  @override
  State<PrepositionArenaScreen> createState() =>
      _PrepositionArenaScreenState();
}

class _PrepositionArenaScreenState extends State<PrepositionArenaScreen> {
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    widget.notifier.start(
      level: widget.level,
      limit: widget.sessionLimit,
    );
  }

  void _startType(PrepositionType type) {
    widget.notifier.start(
      type: type,
      level: widget.level,
      limit: widget.sessionLimit,
    );
  }

  void _submit(String answer) {
    final state = widget.notifier.state;
    if (state.hasAnsweredCurrent) return;
    widget.notifier.submit(answer);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: widget.notifier,
      builder: (context, _) {
        final state = widget.notifier.state;
        return Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(
            title: const Text('ساحة حروف الجر والحالات'),
          ),
          body: Directionality(
            textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
            child: SafeArea(
              child: ListView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                children: <Widget>[
                  _CaseFilterRow(
                    selected: state.selectedType,
                    onSelected: _startType,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  if (state.isCompleted)
                    _CompletionCard(
                      state: state,
                      onRestart: widget.notifier.restart,
                    )
                  else if (state.currentChallenge != null) ...<Widget>[
                    _ProgressCard(state: state),
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    _ChallengePrompt(
                      challenge: state.currentChallenge!,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    DragDropCaseCardWidget(
                      challenge: state.currentChallenge!,
                      selectedAnswer: state.lastResult?.selectedAnswer,
                      result: state.lastResult,
                      enabled: !state.hasAnsweredCurrent,
                      onSelected: _submit,
                    ),
                    if (state.lastResult != null) ...<Widget>[
                      const SizedBox(height: 14),
                      _AnswerExplanation(result: state.lastResult!),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      FilledButton.icon(
                        onPressed: widget.notifier.next,
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded),
                        label: const Text('التالي'),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ],
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

class _CaseFilterRow extends StatelessWidget {

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../../core/localization/german_article_style.dart';
import '../../../../design_system/app_colors.dart';
import '../../../../design_system/app_glass_card.dart';
import '../../../../design_system/app_typography.dart';
import '../../domain/preposition_models.dart';

class DragDropCaseCardWidget extends StatelessWidget {
  const DragDropCaseCardWidget({
    required this.challenge,
    required this.onSelected,
    this.selectedAnswer,
    this.result,
    this.enabled = true,
    super.key,
  });

  final PrepositionChallenge challenge;
  final ValueChanged<String> onSelected;
  final String? selectedAnswer;
  final PrepositionAnswerResult? result;
  final bool enabled;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final accent = _accentFor(challenge.baseArticle);
    final isArticle =
        challenge.kind == PrepositionChallengeKind.articleChoice;

    return AppGlassCard(
      blur: 22,
      opacity: .14,
      borderColor: accent.withAlpha(92),
      glowColor: accent,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          Row(
            children: <Widget>[
              Icon(
                isArticle
                    ? Icons.style_rounded
                    : Icons.swap_horiz_rounded,
                color: accent,
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 9),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  isArticle
                      ? 'اختر الأداة المصروفة الصحيحة'
                      : 'اختر حرف الجر الصحيح',
                  style: AppTypography.title,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          DragTarget<String>(
            onWillAcceptWithDetails: (_) => enabled,
            onAcceptWithDetails: (details) {
              if (enabled) onSelected(details.data);
            },
            builder: (context, candidates, rejected) {
              final active = candidates.isNotEmpty;
              return AnimatedContainer(
                duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(minHeight: 74),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: accent.withAlpha(active ? 28 : 14),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                  border: Border.all(
                    color: accent.withAlpha(active ? 150 : 72),
                    width: active ? 1.8 : 1.1,
                  ),
                ),
                alignment: Alignment.center,
                child: Text(
                  selectedAnswer?.isNotEmpty == true
                      ? selectedAnswer!
                      : 'اسحب الإجابة إلى هنا أو اضغط عليها',
                  textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                  style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(
                    color: selectedAnswer == null
                        ? null
                        : _resultColor(result, accent),
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                  ),
                ),
              );
            },
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          Wrap(
            alignment: WrapAlignment.center,
            spacing: 10,
            runSpacing: 10,
            children: challenge.options
                .map(
                  (option) => _DraggableOption(
                    option: option,
                    accent: accent,
                    enabled: enabled,
                    selected: selectedAnswer == option,
                    onTap: () {
                      if (enabled) onSelected(option);
                    },
                  ),
                )
                .toList(growable: false),
          ),
          if (result?.articleForm != null) ...<Widget>[
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            _ArticleTransformation(
              form: result!.articleForm!,
              accent: accent,
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Color _accentFor(GermanArticle? article) => switch (article) {
        GermanArticle.der => AppColors.articleDer,
        GermanArticle.die => AppColors.articleDie,
        GermanArticle.das => AppColors.articleDas,
        null => AppColors.primary,
      };

  Color _resultColor(
    PrepositionAnswerResult? answer,
    Color accent,
  ) {
    if (answer == null) return accent;
    return answer.isCorrect ? AppColors.mastery : AppColors.articleDie;
  }
}

class _DraggableOption extends StatelessWidget {
  const _DraggableOption({
    required this.option,
    required this.accent,
    required this.enabled,
    required this.selected,
    required this.onTap,
  });

  final String option;
  final Color accent;
  final bool enabled;
  final bool selected;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final chip = _OptionChip(
      option: option,
      accent: accent,
      selected: selected,
    );
    return Draggable<String>(
      data: option,
      maxSimultaneousDrags: enabled ? 1 : 0,
      feedback: Material(
        color: Colors.transparent,
        child: SizedBox(width: 112, child: chip),
      ),
      childWhenDragging: Opacity(opacity: .35, child: chip),
      child: GestureDetector(
        onTap: enabled ? onTap : null,
        child: chip,
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _OptionChip extends StatelessWidget {
  const _OptionChip({
    required this.option,
    required this.accent,
    required this.selected,
  });

  final String option;
  final Color accent;
  final bool selected;

      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: accent.withAlpha(selected ? 34 : 18),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        border: Border.all(
          color: accent.withAlpha(selected ? 150 : 74),
        ),
        boxShadow: selected
            ? <BoxShadow>[
                BoxShadow(
                  color: accent.withAlpha(28),
                  blurRadius: 16,
                  spreadRadius: 1,
                ),
              ]
            : const <BoxShadow>[],
      ),
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 11),
        child: Text(
          option,
          textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
          style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(
            color: accent,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

    required this.form,
    required this.accent,
  });

  final GermanArticleCaseForm form;

  @override

                fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/reflexive_models.dart';
import '../domain/reflexive_repository.dart';

final class ReflexiveState {
  const ReflexiveState({
    required this.drills,
    required this.currentIndex,
    required this.selectedPronoun,
    required this.checked,
    required this.correct,
    required this.feedbackAr,
    required this.filter,
  });

  final List<ReflexiveDrillItem> drills;
  final int currentIndex;
  final String? selectedPronoun;
  final bool checked;
  final bool correct;
  final String feedbackAr;
  final ReflexiveCase? filter;

  ReflexiveDrillItem get current => drills[currentIndex];
}

final class ReflexiveNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  ReflexiveNotifier(this._repository)
      : _state = ReflexiveState(
          drills: List<ReflexiveDrillItem>.unmodifiable(
            _repository.allDrills,
          ),
          currentIndex: 0,
          selectedPronoun: null,
          checked: false,
          correct: false,
          feedbackAr: '',
          filter: null,
        ) {
    if (_state.drills.isEmpty) {
      throw StateError('Reflexive drill bank must not be empty');
    }
  }

  final ReflexiveRepository _repository;
  ReflexiveState _state;

  ReflexiveState get state => _state;

  void checkReflexivePronoun(String candidate) {
    final item = _state.current;
    final normalized = _repository.normalizePronoun(candidate);
    final correct = _repository.isCorrectPronoun(item, normalized);
    _state = ReflexiveState(
      drills: _state.drills,
      currentIndex: _state.currentIndex,
      selectedPronoun: normalized,
      checked: true,
      correct: correct,
      feedbackAr: correct
          ? 'صحيح. ${item.explanationAr}'
          : 'الإجابة الصحيحة: ${item.reflexivePronoun}. ${item.explanationAr}',
      filter: _state.filter,
    );
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void nextDrill() {
    final nextIndex = (_state.currentIndex + 1) % _state.drills.length;
    _state = ReflexiveState(
      drills: _state.drills,
      currentIndex: nextIndex,
      selectedPronoun: null,
      checked: false,
      correct: false,
      feedbackAr: '',
      filter: _state.filter,
    );
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void filterByCase(ReflexiveCase reflexCase) {
    final filtered = _repository.forCase(reflexCase);
    if (filtered.isEmpty) {
      throw StateError('No reflexive drills for ${reflexCase.name}');
    }
    _state = ReflexiveState(
      drills: List<ReflexiveDrillItem>.unmodifiable(filtered),
      currentIndex: 0,
      selectedPronoun: null,
      checked: false,
      correct: false,
      feedbackAr: '',
      filter: reflexCase,
    );
    notifyListeners();
  }
}
