    ),
    ReflexiveDrillItem(
      id: 'helfen_wir_reciprocal_dat',
      infinitiveWithSich: 'sich helfen',
      subjectPronoun: 'wir',
      reflexivePronoun: 'uns',
      reflexiveCase: ReflexiveCase.dativ,
      reflexiveType: ReflexiveType.reciprocal,
      caseReasonAr:
          'الفعل helfen نفسه يطلب Dativ، وuns هنا تبادلي بمعنى نساعد بعضنا بعضاً.',
      contextSentence: 'Wir helfen uns bei den Hausaufgaben.',
      translationAr: 'نساعد بعضنا بعضاً في الواجبات.',
      explanationAr:
          'هذه حالة Dativ بسبب قاعدة helfen، وليست بسبب وجود مفعول Akkusativ إضافي.',
    ),
  ];

  static const Map<String, Map<ReflexiveCase, String>> _pronouns =
      <String, Map<ReflexiveCase, String>>{
    'ich': <ReflexiveCase, String>{
      ReflexiveCase.akkusativ: 'mich',
      ReflexiveCase.dativ: 'mir',
    },
    'du': <ReflexiveCase, String>{
      ReflexiveCase.akkusativ: 'dich',
      ReflexiveCase.dativ: 'dir',
    },
    'er': <ReflexiveCase, String>{
      ReflexiveCase.akkusativ: 'sich',
      ReflexiveCase.dativ: 'sich',
    },
    'sie': <ReflexiveCase, String>{
      ReflexiveCase.akkusativ: 'sich',
      ReflexiveCase.dativ: 'sich',
    },
    'es': <ReflexiveCase, String>{
      ReflexiveCase.akkusativ: 'sich',
      ReflexiveCase.dativ: 'sich',
    },
    'wir': <ReflexiveCase, String>{
      ReflexiveCase.akkusativ: 'uns',
      ReflexiveCase.dativ: 'uns',
    },
    'ihr': <ReflexiveCase, String>{
      ReflexiveCase.akkusativ: 'euch',
      ReflexiveCase.dativ: 'euch',
    },
  };

  @override
  List<ReflexiveDrillItem> get allDrills =>
      List<ReflexiveDrillItem>.unmodifiable(_drills);

  @override
  ReflexiveDrillItem? byId(String id) {
    final normalized = id.trim();
    for (final item in _drills) {
      if (item.id == normalized) return item;
    }
    return null;
  }

  @override
  List<ReflexiveDrillItem> forCase(ReflexiveCase reflexCase) =>
      List<ReflexiveDrillItem>.unmodifiable(
        _drills.where((item) => item.reflexiveCase == reflexCase),
      );

  @override
  bool isCorrectPronoun(
    ReflexiveDrillItem item,
    String candidate,
  ) =>
      normalizePronoun(candidate) ==
      normalizePronoun(item.reflexivePronoun);

  @override
  bool isCorrectCase(
    ReflexiveDrillItem item,
    ReflexiveCase candidate,
  ) =>
      item.reflexiveCase == candidate;

  @override
  String? expectedPronoun({
    required String subjectPronoun,
    required ReflexiveCase reflexCase,
  }) {
    final subject = normalizePronoun(subjectPronoun);
    return _pronouns[subject]?[reflexCase];
  }

  @override
  String normalizePronoun(String value) => value.trim().toLowerCase();
}

FILE: lib/features/reflexive_verbs/domain/reflexive_models.dart
--------------------------------------------------
enum ReflexiveCase { akkusativ, dativ }

enum ReflexiveType { trueReflexive, optionalReflexive, reciprocal }

extension ReflexiveCaseLabels on ReflexiveCase {
  String get labelDe => switch (this) {
        ReflexiveCase.akkusativ => 'Akkusativ',
        ReflexiveCase.dativ => 'Dativ',
      };

  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        ReflexiveCase.akkusativ => 'حالة النصب · Akkusativ',
        ReflexiveCase.dativ => 'حالة الجر غير المباشر · Dativ',
      };
}

extension ReflexiveTypeLabels on ReflexiveType {
  String get labelAr => switch (this) {
        ReflexiveType.trueReflexive => 'فعل انعكاسي حتمي',
        ReflexiveType.optionalReflexive => 'استعمال انعكاسي اختياري',
        ReflexiveType.reciprocal => 'استعمال تبادلي بين أكثر من شخص',
      };
}

final class ReflexiveDrillItem {
  const ReflexiveDrillItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.infinitiveWithSich,
    required this.subjectPronoun,
    required this.reflexivePronoun,
    required this.reflexiveCase,
    required this.reflexiveType,
    required this.caseReasonAr,
    required this.contextSentence,
    required this.translationAr,
    required this.explanationAr,
    this.additionalObject,
  });

  final String id;
  final String infinitiveWithSich;
  final String subjectPronoun;
  final String reflexivePronoun;
  final ReflexiveCase reflexiveCase;
  final ReflexiveType reflexiveType;
  final String? additionalObject;
  final String caseReasonAr;
  final String contextSentence;
  final String translationAr;
  final String explanationAr;

  bool get hasAdditionalObject =>
      additionalObject != null && additionalObject!.trim().isNotEmpty;
}

import 'reflexive_models.dart';

abstract interface class ReflexiveRepository {
  List<ReflexiveDrillItem> get allDrills;

  List<ReflexiveDrillItem> forCase(ReflexiveCase reflexCase);

  ReflexiveDrillItem? byId(String id);

  bool isCorrectPronoun(
    ReflexiveDrillItem item,
    String candidate,
  );

  bool isCorrectCase(
    ReflexiveDrillItem item,
    ReflexiveCase candidate,
  );

  String? expectedPronoun({
    required String subjectPronoun,
    required ReflexiveCase reflexCase,
  });

  String normalizePronoun(String value);
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../design_system/app_colors.dart';
import '../../../design_system/app_glass_card.dart';
import '../../../design_system/app_typography.dart';
import '../application/reflexive_notifier.dart';
import '../domain/reflexive_models.dart';

class ReflexiveScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const ReflexiveScreen({required this.notifier, super.key});

  final ReflexiveNotifier notifier;

  static const List<String> _pronounChoices = <String>[
    'mich',
    'mir',
    'dich',
    'dir',
    'sich',
    'uns',
    'euch',
  ];

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: Text(
            'Reflexive Verben Arena',
            textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
          ),
        ),
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 32),
            child: AnimatedBuilder(
              animation: notifier,
              builder: (context, _) {
                final state = notifier.state;
                final item = state.current;
                return Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: [
                    _CaseFilterCard(
                      selected: state.filter,
                      onSelected: notifier.filterByCase,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    _GrammarClueCard(item: item),
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    _ContextCard(item: item),
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    AppGlassCard(
                      glowColor: state.checked
                          ? (state.correct
                              ? AppColors.mastery
                              : AppColors.tertiary)
                          : AppColors.primary,
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                        children: [
                          Text(
                            'اختر الضمير الانعكاسي المناسب',
                            textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                            style: AppTypography.title,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 12),
                          Wrap(
                            spacing: 8,
                            runSpacing: 8,
                            children: [
                              for (final pronoun in _pronounChoices)
                                _PronounButton(
                                  pronoun: pronoun,
                                  selected: state.selectedPronoun == pronoun,
                                  checked: state.checked,
                                  isCorrectOption:
                                      item.reflexivePronoun == pronoun,
                                  onPressed: state.checked
                                      ? null
                                      : () => notifier
                                          .checkReflexivePronoun(pronoun),
                                ),
                            ],
                          ),
                          if (state.checked) ...[
                            const SizedBox(height: 14),
                            _FeedbackPanel(state: state),
                            const SizedBox(height: 12),
                            FilledButton.icon(
                              onPressed: notifier.nextDrill,
                              icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_forward_rounded),
                              label: Text(
                                'التمرين التالي',
                                textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
}

class _CaseFilterCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _CaseFilterCard({
    required this.selected,
    required this.onSelected,
  });

  final ReflexiveCase? selected;
  final ValueChanged<ReflexiveCase> onSelected;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        glowColor: AppColors.primary,
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            Text(
              'تدريب حسب الحالة',
              textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Wrap(
              spacing: 8,
              runSpacing: 8,
              children: [
                for (final reflexCase in ReflexiveCase.values)
                  ChoiceChip(
                    label: Text(
                      reflexCase.labelDe,
                      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                    ),
                    selected: selected == reflexCase,
                    selectedColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(32),
                    side: BorderSide(
                      color: selected == reflexCase
                          ? AppColors.primary
                          : AppColors.secondary,
                    ),
                    onSelected: (_) => onSelected(reflexCase),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

class _GrammarClueCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _GrammarClueCard({required this.item});

  final ReflexiveDrillItem item;

FILE: lib/features/relativsaetze/application/relativsaetze_notifier.dart

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/relativsaetze_models.dart';
import '../domain/relativsaetze_repository.dart';

final class RelativsaetzeNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  RelativsaetzeNotifier(this._repository);

  final RelativsaetzeRepository _repository;

  List<RelativeClauseChallengeItem> _challenges =
      const <RelativeClauseChallengeItem>[];
  RelativeClauseChallengeItem? _currentChallenge;
  List<String> _options = const <String>[];
  String? _selectedPronoun;
  bool? _isCorrect;
  String? _feedbackExplanation;
  RelativeClauseFocus? _activeFocus;
  int _currentIndex = -1;
  bool _isBusy = false;

  RelativeClauseChallengeItem? get currentChallenge => _currentChallenge;

  List<String> get options => _options;

  String? get selectedPronoun => _selectedPronoun;

  bool? get isCorrect => _isCorrect;

  String? get feedbackExplanation => _feedbackExplanation;

  RelativeClauseFocus? get activeFocus => _activeFocus;

  bool get isBusy => _isBusy;

  Future<void> nextChallenge() async {
    if (_isBusy) return;
    _isBusy = true;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      if (_challenges.isEmpty) {
        _challenges = await _repository.getChallenges(
          focus: _activeFocus,
        );
        _currentIndex = -1;
      }
      await _selectNext();
    } finally {
      _isBusy = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  Future<void> filterByFocus(RelativeClauseFocus? focus) async {
    if (_isBusy) return;
    _isBusy = true;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      _activeFocus = focus;
      _challenges = await _repository.getChallenges(focus: focus);
      _currentIndex = -1;
      _currentChallenge = null;
      _options = const <String>[];
      _clearAnswer();
      await _selectNext();
    } finally {
      _isBusy = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  Future<void> submitAnswer(
    String pronoun, [
    String? constructedSentence,
  ]) async {
    final challenge = _currentChallenge;
    if (_isBusy || challenge == null) return;

    final answer = pronoun.trim();
    if (answer.isEmpty) {
      _selectedPronoun = '';
      _isCorrect = false;
      _feedbackExplanation = 'اختر الضمير النسبي قبل التحقق.';
      notifyListeners();
      return;
    }

    _isBusy = true;
    _selectedPronoun = answer;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      final sentence =
          constructedSentence ?? challenge.correctSentence;
      final validations = await Future.wait<bool>(<Future<bool>>[
        _repository.validatePronoun(challenge.id, answer),
        _repository.validateSentence(challenge.id, sentence),
      ]);
      final pronounCorrect = validations[0];
      final sentenceCorrect = validations[1];
      _isCorrect = pronounCorrect && sentenceCorrect;
      _feedbackExplanation = _buildFeedback(
        challenge: challenge,
        pronounCorrect: pronounCorrect,
        sentenceCorrect: sentenceCorrect,
      );
    } finally {
      _isBusy = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _selectNext() async {
    if (_challenges.isEmpty) {
      _currentChallenge = null;
      _options = const <String>[];
      _clearAnswer();
      _feedbackExplanation =
          'لا توجد تحديات Relativsätze متاحة لهذا التصنيف.';
      return;
    }

    _currentIndex = (_currentIndex + 1) % _challenges.length;
    _currentChallenge = _challenges[_currentIndex];
    _options = await _repository.getAnswerOptions(
      _currentChallenge!.id,
    );
    _clearAnswer();
  }

  void _clearAnswer() {
    _selectedPronoun = null;
    _isCorrect = null;
    _feedbackExplanation = null;
  }

  static String _buildFeedback({
    required RelativeClauseChallengeItem challenge,
    required bool pronounCorrect,
    required bool sentenceCorrect,
  }) {
    if (pronounCorrect && sentenceCorrect) {
      return challenge.arabicExplanation;
    }

    if (!pronounCorrect && !sentenceCorrect) {
      return 'الضمير وترتيب الجملة يحتاجان مراجعة. '
          '${challenge.arabicExplanation}';
    }

    if (!pronounCorrect) {
      return 'الضمير غير صحيح. الصيغة المطلوبة هنا هي '
          '${challenge.expectedPronoun}. '
          '${challenge.arabicExplanation}';
    }

    return 'الضمير صحيح، لكن ترتيب Relativsatz غير صحيح؛ '
        'تأكد من وضع الفعل المصرف في النهاية. '
        '${challenge.arabicExplanation}';
  }
}

    ),
  ];

  @override
  Future<List<RelativeClauseChallengeItem>> getChallenges({
    RelativeClauseFocus? focus,
  }) async {
    final challenges = focus == null
        ? _bank
        : _bank.where((item) => item.focus == focus);
    return List<RelativeClauseChallengeItem>.unmodifiable(challenges);
  }

  @override
  Future<List<String>> getAnswerOptions(String challengeId) async {
    final challenge = _find(challengeId);
    if (challenge == null) return const <String>[];

    final expected = challenge.expectedPronoun;
    final candidates = challenge.focus ==
            RelativeClauseFocus.genitivePossession
        ? <String>['dessen', 'deren', 'dem', 'der']
        : <String>['der', 'die', 'das', 'den', 'dem', 'denen'];

    final options = <String>[expected];
    for (final candidate in candidates) {
      if (candidate != expected && !options.contains(candidate)) {
        options.add(candidate);
      }
      if (options.length == 4) break;
    }
    return List<String>.unmodifiable(options);
  }

  @override
  Future<bool> validatePronoun(
    String challengeId,
    String pronoun,
  ) async {
    final challenge = _find(challengeId);
    if (challenge == null) return false;
    return _normalizeToken(pronoun) ==
        _normalizeToken(challenge.expectedPronoun);
  }

  @override
  Future<bool> validateSentence(
    String challengeId,
    String sentence,
  ) async {
    final challenge = _find(challengeId);
    if (challenge == null) return false;
    return _normalizeSentence(sentence) ==
        _normalizeSentence(challenge.correctSentence);
  }

  static RelativeClauseChallengeItem? _find(String id) {
    final normalizedId = id.trim();
    for (final item in _bank) {
      if (item.id == normalizedId) return item;
    }
    return null;
  }

  static String _normalizeToken(String value) =>
      value.trim().toLowerCase().replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');

  static String _normalizeSentence(String value) {
    return value
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ')
        .replaceAll(' ,', ',')
        .replaceAll(' .', '.')
        .replaceAll(' ?', '?')
        .replaceAll(' !', '!')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[.!?]+$'), '')
        .trim();
  }
}

enum RelativePronounCase {
  nominative,
  accusative,
  dative,
  genitive,
}

enum RelativeAntecedentGender {
  masculine,
  feminine,
  neuter,
  plural,
}

enum RelativeClauseFocus {
  prepositional,
  genitivePossession,
}

extension RelativePronounCaseLabel on RelativePronounCase {
  String get germanLabel => switch (this) {
        RelativePronounCase.nominative => 'Nominativ',
        RelativePronounCase.accusative => 'Akkusativ',
        RelativePronounCase.dative => 'Dativ',
        RelativePronounCase.genitive => 'Genitiv',
      };

  String get arabicLabel => switch (this) {
        RelativePronounCase.nominative => 'الرفع',
        RelativePronounCase.accusative => 'النصب',
        RelativePronounCase.dative => 'الداتيف',
        RelativePronounCase.genitive => 'الملكية / الجينيتيف',
      };
}

extension RelativeAntecedentGenderPronoun on RelativeAntecedentGender {
  String pronounFor(RelativePronounCase grammaticalCase) => switch (
        (this, grammaticalCase)
      ) {
        (RelativeAntecedentGender.masculine, RelativePronounCase.nominative) =>
          'der',
        (RelativeAntecedentGender.masculine, RelativePronounCase.accusative) =>
          'den',
        (RelativeAntecedentGender.masculine, RelativePronounCase.dative) =>
          'dem',
        (RelativeAntecedentGender.masculine, RelativePronounCase.genitive) =>
          'dessen',
        (RelativeAntecedentGender.feminine, RelativePronounCase.nominative) =>
          'die',
        (RelativeAntecedentGender.feminine, RelativePronounCase.accusative) =>
          'die',
        (RelativeAntecedentGender.feminine, RelativePronounCase.dative) =>
          'der',
        (RelativeAntecedentGender.feminine, RelativePronounCase.genitive) =>
          'deren',
        (RelativeAntecedentGender.neuter, RelativePronounCase.nominative) =>
          'das',
        (RelativeAntecedentGender.neuter, RelativePronounCase.accusative) =>
          'das',
        (RelativeAntecedentGender.neuter, RelativePronounCase.dative) =>
          'dem',
        (RelativeAntecedentGender.neuter, RelativePronounCase.genitive) =>
          'dessen',
        (RelativeAntecedentGender.plural, RelativePronounCase.nominative) =>
          'die',
        (RelativeAntecedentGender.plural, RelativePronounCase.accusative) =>
          'die',
        (RelativeAntecedentGender.plural, RelativePronounCase.dative) =>
          'denen',
        (RelativeAntecedentGender.plural, RelativePronounCase.genitive) =>
          'deren',
      };

  String get arabicLabel => switch (this) {
        RelativeAntecedentGender.masculine => 'مذكر',
        RelativeAntecedentGender.feminine => 'مؤنث',
        RelativeAntecedentGender.neuter => 'محايد',
        RelativeAntecedentGender.plural => 'جمع',
      };
}

extension RelativeClauseFocusLabel on RelativeClauseFocus {
  String get arabicLabel => switch (this) {
        RelativeClauseFocus.prepositional => 'حرف جر + ضمير نسبي',
        RelativeClauseFocus.genitivePossession => 'Genitiv: dessen / deren',
      };
}

final class RelativeClauseChallengeItem {
  RelativeClauseChallengeItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.antecedent,
    required this.antecedentGender,
    required this.sourceSentence,
    required this.relativeIdea,
    required this.correctSentence,
    required this.grammaticalCase,
    required this.focus,
    required this.arabicExplanation,
    this.preposition,
  }) {
    if (id.trim().isEmpty ||
        antecedent.trim().isEmpty ||
        sourceSentence.trim().isEmpty ||
        relativeIdea.trim().isEmpty ||
        correctSentence.trim().isEmpty ||
        arabicExplanation.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('Invalid relative clause challenge.');
    }
    if (focus == RelativeClauseFocus.prepositional &&
        (preposition == null || preposition!.trim().isEmpty)) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'Prepositional relative clause requires a preposition.',
      );
    }
    if (focus == RelativeClauseFocus.genitivePossession &&
        grammaticalCase != RelativePronounCase.genitive) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'Genitive possession requires the genitive relative form.',
      );
    }
  }

  final String id;
  final String antecedent;
  final RelativeAntecedentGender antecedentGender;
  final String sourceSentence;
  final String relativeIdea;
  final String correctSentence;
  final RelativePronounCase grammaticalCase;
  final RelativeClauseFocus focus;
  final String arabicExplanation;
  final String? preposition;

  String get expectedPronoun =>
      antecedentGender.pronounFor(grammaticalCase);
}

import 'dart:async';


import '../../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import '../application/relativsaetze_notifier.dart';
import '../domain/relativsaetze_models.dart';

final class RelativsaetzeScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const RelativsaetzeScreen({
    required this.notifier,
    super.key,
  });

  final RelativsaetzeNotifier notifier;

  @override
  State<RelativsaetzeScreen> createState() => _RelativsaetzeScreenState();
}

final class _RelativsaetzeScreenState extends State<RelativsaetzeScreen> {
  String? _selectedPronoun;

  RelativsaetzeNotifier get notifier => widget.notifier;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    notifier.addListener(_refresh);
    if (notifier.currentChallenge == null) {
      unawaited(notifier.nextChallenge());
    }
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant RelativsaetzeScreen oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.notifier == notifier) return;
    oldWidget.notifier.removeListener(_refresh);
    notifier.addListener(_refresh);
    _selectedPronoun = null;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    notifier.removeListener(_refresh);
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _refresh() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  Future<void> _filter(RelativeClauseFocus? focus) async {
    setState(() => _selectedPronoun = null);
    await notifier.filterByFocus(focus);
  }

  Future<void> _next() async {
    setState(() => _selectedPronoun = null);
    await notifier.nextChallenge();
  }

  Future<void> _submit() async {
    final selected = _selectedPronoun;
    if (selected == null) return;
    await notifier.submitAnswer(selected);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface =
        dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface;
    final challenge = notifier.currentChallenge;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 18, 16, 28),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: <Widget>[
                _HeaderCard(
                  dark: dark,
                  surface: surface,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                _FocusFilter(
                  activeFocus: notifier.activeFocus,
                  enabled: !notifier.isBusy,
                  onSelected: (focus) => unawaited(_filter(focus)),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                if (challenge == null)
                  _EmptyCard(
                    surface: surface,
                    dark: dark,
                    isBusy: notifier.isBusy,
                    message: notifier.feedbackExplanation,
                    onRetry: () => unawaited(notifier.nextChallenge()),
                  )
                else ...<Widget>[
                  _GrammarPathCard(
                    challenge: challenge,
                    surface: surface,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  _PromptCard(
                    challenge: challenge,
                    surface: surface,
                    dark: dark,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  _AnswerOptions(
                    options: notifier.options,
                    selected: _selectedPronoun,
                    enabled: !notifier.isBusy &&
                        notifier.isCorrect == null,
                    surface: surface,
                    dark: dark,
                    onSelected: (value) {
                      setState(() => _selectedPronoun = value);
                    },
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  _SubmitCard(
                    enabled: _selectedPronoun != null &&
                        !notifier.isBusy &&
                        notifier.isCorrect == null,
                    surface: surface,
                    onTap: () => unawaited(_submit()),
                  ),
                  if (notifier.isCorrect != null) ...<Widget>[
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    _FeedbackCard(
                      challenge: challenge,
                      correct: notifier.isCorrect!,
                      explanation:
                          notifier.feedbackExplanation ?? '',
                      surface: surface,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    _NextCard(
                      surface: surface,
                      enabled: !notifier.isBusy,
                      onTap: () => unawaited(_next()),
                    ),
                  ],
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/search_models.dart';
import '../domain/search_repositories.dart';

final class BookmarksState {
  const BookmarksState({
    this.bookmarks = const <UserBookmark>[],
    this.notes = const <String, CustomWordNote>{},
    this.isLoading = false,
    this.errorMessage,
  });

  final List<UserBookmark> bookmarks;
  final Map<String, CustomWordNote> notes;
  final bool isLoading;
  final String? errorMessage;
}

class BookmarksNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  BookmarksNotifier({required BookmarksRepository repository})
      : _repository = repository;

  final BookmarksRepository _repository;
  BookmarksState _state = const BookmarksState();

  BookmarksState get state => _state;

  bool isFavorite(String wordId) =>
      _state.bookmarks.any((bookmark) => bookmark.item.id == wordId);

  CustomWordNote? noteFor(String wordId) => _state.notes[wordId];

  Future<void> load() async {
    _setState(
      BookmarksState(
        bookmarks: _state.bookmarks,
        notes: _state.notes,
        isLoading: true,
      ),
    );
    try {
      final bookmarks = await _repository.loadBookmarks();
      final notes = await _repository.loadNotes();
      _setState(
        BookmarksState(
          bookmarks: List<UserBookmark>.unmodifiable(bookmarks),
          notes: Map<String, CustomWordNote>.unmodifiable(notes),
        ),
      );
    } catch (error) {
      _setState(
        BookmarksState(
          bookmarks: _state.bookmarks,
          notes: _state.notes,
          errorMessage: error.toString(),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> toggle(SearchResultItem item) async {
    final existing = _state.bookmarks.where(
      (bookmark) => bookmark.item.id == item.id,
    );
    if (existing.isNotEmpty) {
      await _repository.removeBookmark(item.id);
      final remaining = _state.bookmarks
          .where((bookmark) => bookmark.item.id != item.id)
          .toList(growable: false);
      _setState(
        BookmarksState(
          bookmarks: List<UserBookmark>.unmodifiable(remaining),
          notes: _state.notes,
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    final bookmark = UserBookmark(item: item, createdAt: DateTime.now().toUtc());
    await _repository.saveBookmark(bookmark);
    _setState(
      BookmarksState(
        bookmarks: List<UserBookmark>.unmodifiable(
          <UserBookmark>[bookmark, ..._state.bookmarks],
        ),
        notes: _state.notes,
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> saveNote(String wordId, String text) async {
    final normalized = text.trim();
    if (normalized.isEmpty) {
      await removeNote(wordId);
      return;
    }
    final note = CustomWordNote(
      wordId: wordId,
      text: normalized,
      updatedAt: DateTime.now().toUtc(),
    );
    await _repository.saveNote(note);
    _setState(
      BookmarksState(
        bookmarks: _state.bookmarks,
        notes: Map<String, CustomWordNote>.unmodifiable(
          <String, CustomWordNote>{..._state.notes, wordId: note},
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> removeNote(String wordId) async {
    await _repository.removeNote(wordId);
    final notes = <String, CustomWordNote>{..._state.notes}..remove(wordId);
    _setState(
      BookmarksState(
        bookmarks: _state.bookmarks,
        notes: Map<String, CustomWordNote>.unmodifiable(notes),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _setState(BookmarksState value) {
    _state = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/search_models.dart';
import '../domain/search_repositories.dart';

final class SearchState {
  const SearchState({
    this.query = const SearchQuery(),
    this.results = const <SearchResultItem>[],
    this.isLoading = false,
    this.errorMessage,
  });

  final SearchQuery query;
  final List<SearchResultItem> results;
  final bool isLoading;
  final String? errorMessage;
}

class SearchController extends ChangeNotifier {
  SearchController({
    required SearchRepository repository,
    this.debounceDuration = const Duration(milliseconds: 260),
  }) : _repository = repository;

  final SearchRepository _repository;
  final Duration debounceDuration;

  Timer? _debounce;
  int _requestEpoch = 0;
  SearchState _state = const SearchState();

  SearchState get state => _state;

  void updateText(String text) {
    final epoch = ++_requestEpoch;
    _setState(
      SearchState(
        query: _state.query.copyWith(text: text),
        results: _state.results,
        isLoading: true,
      ),
    );
    _schedule(epoch);
  }

  void toggleFilter(SearchFilter filter) {
    final next = <SearchFilter>{..._state.query.filters};
    if (!next.add(filter)) next.remove(filter);
    final epoch = ++_requestEpoch;
    _setState(
      SearchState(
        query: _state.query.copyWith(
          filters: Set<SearchFilter>.unmodifiable(next),
        ),
        results: _state.results,
        isLoading: true,
      ),
    );
    _schedule(epoch, immediate: true);
  }

  Future<void> refresh() {
    final epoch = ++_requestEpoch;
    return _execute(epoch);
  }

  void _schedule(int epoch, {bool immediate = false}) {
    _debounce?.cancel();
    if (immediate || debounceDuration == Duration.zero) {
      unawaited(_execute(epoch));
      return;
    }
    _debounce = Timer(debounceDuration, () => unawaited(_execute(epoch)));
  }

  Future<void> _execute(int epoch) async {
    _debounce?.cancel();
    final query = _state.query;
    _setState(
      SearchState(
        query: query,
        results: _state.results,
        isLoading: true,
      ),
    );

    try {
      final results = await _repository.search(query);
      if (epoch != _requestEpoch) return;
      _setState(
        SearchState(
          query: query,
          results: results,
        ),
      );
    } catch (error) {
      if (epoch != _requestEpoch) return;
      _setState(
        SearchState(
          query: query,
          results: _state.results,
          errorMessage: error.toString(),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  void _setState(SearchState value) {
    _state = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _debounce?.cancel();
    _requestEpoch += 1;
    super.dispose();
  }
}

import '../../../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../../../services/search_index.dart';
import '../domain/search_models.dart';
import '../domain/search_repositories.dart';
import 'search_text_normalizer.dart';

typedef SearchItemTypeResolver<T extends LearningContent> = SearchItemType Function(T item);

final class LexiconSearchRepository<T extends LearningContent>
    implements SearchRepository {
  LexiconSearchRepository({
    required SearchIndex<T> index,
    required Iterable<T> corpus,
    SearchItemTypeResolver<T>? typeResolver,
  })  : _index = index,
        _itemsById = <String, T>{for (final item in corpus) item.id: item},
        _typeResolver = typeResolver;

  final SearchIndex<T> _index;
  final Map<String, T> _itemsById;
  final SearchItemTypeResolver<T>? _typeResolver;

  @override
  Future<SearchResultItem?> byId(String id) async {
    final item = _itemsById[id.trim()];
    return item == null ? null : _toDomain(item);
  }

  @override
  Future<List<SearchResultItem>> search(SearchQuery query) async {
    final variants = SearchTextNormalizer.variants(query.text);
    final scored = <String, ({T item, int score})>{};
    final searchTerms = variants.isEmpty ? const <String>{''} : variants;
    final candidateLimit = (query.limit * 4).clamp(1, 200).toInt();

    for (final term in searchTerms) {
      for (final result in _index.searchDetailed(term, limit: candidateLimit)) {
        final existing = scored[result.item.id];
        if (existing == null || result.score > existing.score) {
          scored[result.item.id] = (item: result.item, score: result.score);
        }
      }
    }

    final ranked = scored.values.toList(growable: false)
      ..sort((left, right) {
        final byScore = right.score.compareTo(left.score);
        if (byScore != 0) return byScore;
        return left.item.sourceText.toLowerCase().compareTo(
              right.item.sourceText.toLowerCase(),
            );
      });

    return List<SearchResultItem>.unmodifiable(
      ranked
          .map((entry) => _toDomain(entry.item))
          .where((item) => _matchesFilters(item, query.filters))
          .take(query.limit),
    );
  }

  SearchResultItem _toDomain(T item) {
    final article = _article(item.grammaticalMarker);
    return SearchResultItem(
      id: item.id,
      term: item.sourceText,
      translationArabic: item.translationText,
      type: _typeResolver?.call(item) ?? _inferType(item, article),
      article: article,
      aliases: List<String>.unmodifiable(
        <String>[
          if (item.pluralForm.trim().isNotEmpty) item.pluralForm,
          ...item.acceptedForms.where((value) => value.trim().isNotEmpty),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  SearchItemType _inferType(T item, GermanArticle article) {
    if (article != GermanArticle.none) return SearchItemType.noun;
    final skill = item.skill.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (skill == 'verb' ||
        skill == 'verbs' ||
        skill.contains('conjug') ||
        skill.contains('verb')) {
      return SearchItemType.verb;
    }
    return SearchItemType.other;
  }

  GermanArticle _article(String value) => switch (value.trim().toLowerCase()) {
        'der' => GermanArticle.der,
        'die' => GermanArticle.die,
        'das' => GermanArticle.das,
        _ => GermanArticle.none,
      };

  bool _matchesFilters(SearchResultItem item, Set<SearchFilter> filters) {
    if (filters.isEmpty) return true;
    final hasTypeFilter = filters.contains(SearchFilter.verbs) ||
        filters.contains(SearchFilter.nouns);
    final typeMatches = !hasTypeFilter ||
        (filters.contains(SearchFilter.verbs) &&
            item.type == SearchItemType.verb) ||
        (filters.contains(SearchFilter.nouns) &&
            item.type == SearchItemType.noun);
    if (!typeMatches) return false;

    final hasArticleFilter = filters.contains(SearchFilter.der) ||
        filters.contains(SearchFilter.die) ||
        filters.contains(SearchFilter.das);
    if (!hasArticleFilter) return true;
    return switch (item.article) {
      GermanArticle.der => filters.contains(SearchFilter.der),
      GermanArticle.die => filters.contains(SearchFilter.die),
      GermanArticle.das => filters.contains(SearchFilter.das),
      GermanArticle.none => false,
    };
  }
}

enum SearchFilter { verbs, nouns, der, die, das }

final class SearchQuery {
  const SearchQuery({
    this.text = '',
    this.filters = const <SearchFilter>{},
    this.limit = 80,
  }) : assert(limit > 0);

  final String text;
  final Set<SearchFilter> filters;
  final int limit;

  SearchQuery copyWith({
    String? text,
    Set<SearchFilter>? filters,
    int? limit,
  }) =>
      SearchQuery(
        text: text ?? this.text,
        filters: filters ?? this.filters,
        limit: limit ?? this.limit,
      );
}

  final String term;
  final String translationArabic;
  final SearchItemType type;

FILE: lib/features/search/infrastructure/local_bookmarks_repository.dart

import 'dart:convert';

import '../../../services/preferences_service.dart';
import '../../../services/user_vocabulary_service.dart';
import '../domain/search_models.dart';
import '../domain/search_repositories.dart';

final class LocalBookmarksRepository implements BookmarksRepository {
  LocalBookmarksRepository({
    required FavoritesRepository favorites,
    required PreferencesService preferences,
    required SearchRepository searchRepository,
  })  : _favorites = favorites,
        _preferences = preferences,
        _searchRepository = searchRepository;

  static const String notesKey = 'search_custom_word_notes_v1';

  final FavoritesRepository _favorites;
  final PreferencesService _preferences;
  final SearchRepository _searchRepository;

  @override
  Future<List<UserBookmark>> loadBookmarks() async {
    final ids = (await _favorites.getFavorites()).toList(growable: false)
      ..sort();
    final bookmarks = <UserBookmark>[];
    for (final id in ids) {
      final item = await _searchRepository.byId(id);
      if (item != null) bookmarks.add(UserBookmark(item: item));
    }
    return List<UserBookmark>.unmodifiable(bookmarks);
  }

  @override
  Future<void> saveBookmark(UserBookmark bookmark) async {
    if (!await _favorites.isFavorite(bookmark.item.id)) {
      await _favorites.toggleFavorite(bookmark.item.id);
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> removeBookmark(String wordId) async {
    if (await _favorites.isFavorite(wordId)) {
      await _favorites.toggleFavorite(wordId);
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<Map<String, CustomWordNote>> loadNotes() async {
    final raw = _preferences.readText(notesKey);
    if (raw == null || raw.trim().isEmpty) {
      return const <String, CustomWordNote>{};
    }

    Object? decoded;
    try {
      decoded = jsonDecode(raw);
    } on FormatException {
      return const <String, CustomWordNote>{};
    }
    if (decoded is! List) return const <String, CustomWordNote>{};

    final notes = <String, CustomWordNote>{};
    for (final entry in decoded) {
      if (entry is! Map) continue;
      final note = _noteFromJson(Map<String, Object?>.from(entry));
      if (note != null) notes[note.wordId] = note;
    }
    return Map<String, CustomWordNote>.unmodifiable(notes);
  }

  @override
  Future<void> saveNote(CustomWordNote note) async {
    final notes = <String, CustomWordNote>{
      ...await loadNotes(),
      note.wordId: note,
    };
    await _persistNotes(notes);
  }

  @override
  Future<void> removeNote(String wordId) async {
    final notes = <String, CustomWordNote>{...await loadNotes()}
      ..remove(wordId);
    await _persistNotes(notes);
  }

  Future<void> _persistNotes(Map<String, CustomWordNote> notes) async {
    final value = jsonEncode(
      notes.values.map(_noteToJson).toList(growable: false),
    );
    await _preferences.writeText(notesKey, value);
  }

  Map<String, Object?> _noteToJson(CustomWordNote note) => <String, Object?>{
        'wordId': note.wordId,
        'text': note.text,
        'updatedAt': note.updatedAt.toIso8601String(),
      };

  CustomWordNote? _noteFromJson(Map<String, Object?> json) {
    final wordId = json['wordId'];
    final text = json['text'];
    final updatedAt = DateTime.tryParse(json['updatedAt']?.toString() ?? '');
    if (wordId is! String || text is! String || updatedAt == null) return null;
    return CustomWordNote(wordId: wordId, text: text, updatedAt: updatedAt);
  }
}

  Widget build(BuildContext context) {

                      ? Center(

                      : ListView.separated(

                          itemCount: state.bookmarks.length,
                          separatorBuilder: (_, __) =>
                              const SizedBox(height: 10),
                          itemBuilder: (context, index) {

                            final note = state.notes[bookmark.item.id];
                            return _FavoriteCard(

                              onRemove: () => notifier.toggle(bookmark.item),

                              ),
                            );
                          },
                        ),

            ),

    BuildContext context,
    SearchResultItem item,
    CustomWordNote? note,
  ) async {

    final value = await showDialog<String>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(

            hintText: 'اكتب ملاحظتك الشخصية…',
          ),
        ),
        actions: <Widget>[
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext),
            child: const Text('إلغاء'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, controller.text),
            child: const Text('حفظ'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    controller.dispose();
    if (value == null) return;
    await notifier.saveNote(item.id, value);
  }

class GlassSearchBarWidget extends StatelessWidget {

    this.controller,
    this.isLoading = false,
    super.key,
  });

  final TextEditingController? controller;
  final ValueChanged<String> onChanged;
  final Set<SearchFilter> activeFilters;
  final ValueChanged<SearchFilter> onFilterToggle;

  Widget build(BuildContext context) {

      glowColor: AppColors.primary,
      borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(70),
      child: Column(

        children: <Widget>[
          TextField(
            controller: controller,
            onChanged: onChanged,
            textInputAction: TextInputAction.search,
            decoration: InputDecoration(
              hintText: 'ابحث بالألمانية أو العربية…',
              prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search_rounded),
              suffixIcon: isLoading
                  ? const Padding(
                      padding: EdgeInsets.all(13),
                      child: SizedBox.square(
                        dimension: 18,
                        child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                      ),
                    )
                  : null,
              border: InputBorder.none,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          Wrap(
            spacing: 8,
            runSpacing: 8,
            children: <Widget>[
              _filterChip('أفعال', SearchFilter.verbs, AppColors.primary),
              _filterChip('أسماء', SearchFilter.nouns, AppColors.secondary),
              _filterChip('der', SearchFilter.der, AppColors.articleDer),
              _filterChip('die', SearchFilter.die, AppColors.articleDie),
              _filterChip('das', SearchFilter.das, AppColors.articleDas),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _filterChip(String label, SearchFilter filter, Color color) {
    final selected = activeFilters.contains(filter);
    return FilterChip(
      label: Text(
        label,
        style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
          color: selected ? color : null,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
        ),
      ),
      selected: selected,
      onSelected: (_) => onFilterToggle(filter),
      selectedColor: color.withAlpha(24),
      side: BorderSide(color: color.withAlpha(selected ? 150 : 70)),
      checkmarkColor: color,
    );
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/sentence_builder_agent/application/sentence_builder_notifier.dart

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/sentence_builder_models.dart';
import '../domain/sentence_builder_repository.dart';

final class SentenceBuilderNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  SentenceBuilderNotifier(this._repository);

  final SentenceBuilderRepository _repository;

  SentencePuzzle? _activePuzzle;
  List<WordTileItem> _currentArrangement = const <WordTileItem>[];
  bool? _isCorrect;
  String _feedbackMessage = '';
  bool _isBusy = false;

  SentencePuzzle? get activePuzzle => _activePuzzle;

  List<WordTileItem> get currentArrangement => _currentArrangement;

  bool? get isCorrect => _isCorrect;

  String get feedbackMessage => _feedbackMessage;

  bool get isBusy => _isBusy;

  List<WordTileItem> get availableTiles {
    final usedIds = _currentArrangement.map((tile) => tile.id).toSet();
    return List<WordTileItem>.unmodifiable(
      (_activePuzzle?.shuffledTiles ?? const <WordTileItem>[])
          .where((tile) => !usedIds.contains(tile.id)),
    );
  }

  Future<void> loadLevel(String level) async {
    if (_isBusy) return;
    _isBusy = true;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      final puzzles = await _repository.getPuzzlesByLevel(level);
      _activePuzzle = puzzles.isEmpty ? null : puzzles.first;
      _currentArrangement = const <WordTileItem>[];
      _isCorrect = null;
      _feedbackMessage = puzzles.isEmpty
          ? 'لا توجد ألغاز متاحة لهذا المستوى بعد.'
          : '';
    } finally {
      _isBusy = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  void pickTile(WordTileItem tile) {
    final puzzle = _activePuzzle;
    if (puzzle == null || _isBusy) return;
    final belongsToPuzzle =
        puzzle.shuffledTiles.any((candidate) => candidate.id == tile.id);
    final alreadyPicked =
        _currentArrangement.any((candidate) => candidate.id == tile.id);
    if (!belongsToPuzzle || alreadyPicked) return;

    _currentArrangement = List<WordTileItem>.unmodifiable(
      <WordTileItem>[..._currentArrangement, tile],
    );
    _isCorrect = null;
    _feedbackMessage = '';
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void removeTile(WordTileItem tile) {
    if (_isBusy) return;
    final next = _currentArrangement
        .where((candidate) => candidate.id != tile.id)
        .toList(growable: false);
    if (next.length == _currentArrangement.length) return;

    _currentArrangement = List<WordTileItem>.unmodifiable(next);
    _isCorrect = null;
    _feedbackMessage = '';
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> verifySentence() async {
    final puzzle = _activePuzzle;
    if (puzzle == null || _isBusy) return;

    if (_currentArrangement.length != puzzle.shuffledTiles.length) {
      _isCorrect = false;
      _feedbackMessage =
          'أكمل جميع أجزاء الجملة أولًا، ثم تحقّق من الترتيب.';
      notifyListeners();
      return;
    }

    _isBusy = true;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      final arrangedIds =
          _currentArrangement.map((tile) => tile.id).toList(growable: false);
      final correct = await _repository.validateArrangement(
        puzzle.id,
        arrangedIds,
      );
      _isCorrect = correct;
      _feedbackMessage = correct
          ? 'ممتاز. ${puzzle.ruleExplanation}'
          : _incorrectFeedback(puzzle.structureType);
    } finally {
      _isBusy = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  String _incorrectFeedback(SentenceStructureType type) => switch (type) {
        SentenceStructureType.mainClause =>
          'الترتيب يحتاج تعديلًا: في الجملة الرئيسية يأتي الفعل المصرف '
              'في الموقع الثاني. راجع موضع الفاعل وبقية المكملات.',
        SentenceStructureType.subordinateWeil =>
          'راجع ترتيب weil: بعد weil تبدأ الجملة الفرعية، ويأتي الفاعل '
              'قبل بقية العناصر بينما ينتقل الفعل المصرف إلى النهاية.',
        SentenceStructureType.questionInversion =>
          'راجع صيغة السؤال: في سؤال نعم/لا يبدأ الفعل المصرف، '
              'ثم يأتي الفاعل وبعده بقية عناصر الجملة.',
      };
}

          ),
        ],
      ),
    ),
  ];

  late final Map<String, SentencePuzzle> _byId = <String, SentencePuzzle>{
    for (final seed in _seeds) seed.puzzle.id: seed.puzzle,
  };

  @override
  Future<List<SentencePuzzle>> getPuzzlesByLevel(String level) async {
    final normalized = level.trim().toUpperCase();
    final requestedBand = normalized.startsWith('A2') ? 'A2' : 'A1';
    return List<SentencePuzzle>.unmodifiable(
      _seeds
          .where((seed) => seed.level == requestedBand)
          .map((seed) => seed.puzzle),
    );
  }

  @override
  Future<bool> validateArrangement(
    String puzzleId,
    List<String> arrangedTileIds,
  ) async {
    final puzzle = _byId[puzzleId];
    if (puzzle == null) return false;
    final expected = puzzle.correctArrangement
        .map((tile) => tile.id)
        .toList(growable: false);
    if (arrangedTileIds.length != expected.length) return false;

    final seen = <String>{};
    for (var index = 0; index < expected.length; index += 1) {
      final actualId = arrangedTileIds[index];
      if (!seen.add(actualId) || actualId != expected[index]) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }
}

final class _PuzzleSeed {
  const _PuzzleSeed({
    required this.level,
    required this.puzzle,
  });

  final String level;
  final SentencePuzzle puzzle;
}

FILE: lib/features/sentence_builder_agent/domain/sentence_builder_models.dart

enum SentenceStructureType {
  mainClause,
  subordinateWeil,
  questionInversion,
}

enum WordGrammaticalFunction {
  subject,
  verb,
  object,
  adverbial,
}

final class WordTileItem {
  const WordTileItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.germanText,
    required this.grammaticalFunction,
    required this.correctPosition,
  })  : assert(id.length > 0),
        assert(germanText.length > 0),
        assert(correctPosition >= 0);

  final String id;
  final String germanText;
  final WordGrammaticalFunction grammaticalFunction;
  final int correctPosition;
}

final class SentencePuzzle {
  SentencePuzzle({
    required this.id,
    required this.completedSentence,
    required this.arabicTranslation,
    required List<WordTileItem> shuffledTiles,
    required this.structureType,
    required this.ruleExplanation,
  }) : shuffledTiles = List<WordTileItem>.unmodifiable(shuffledTiles);

  final String id;
  final String completedSentence;
  final String arabicTranslation;
  final List<WordTileItem> shuffledTiles;
  final SentenceStructureType structureType;
  final String ruleExplanation;

  List<WordTileItem> get correctArrangement {
    final tiles = List<WordTileItem>.of(shuffledTiles)
      ..sort(
        (left, right) =>
            left.correctPosition.compareTo(right.correctPosition),
      );
    return List<WordTileItem>.unmodifiable(tiles);
  }
}

import 'sentence_builder_models.dart';

abstract class SentenceBuilderRepository {
  Future<List<SentencePuzzle>> getPuzzlesByLevel(String level);

  Future<bool> validateArrangement(
    String puzzleId,
    List<String> arrangedTileIds,
  );
}

import 'dart:async';


import '../../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import '../application/sentence_builder_notifier.dart';
import '../domain/sentence_builder_models.dart';

final class SentenceBuilderScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const SentenceBuilderScreen({
    required this.notifier,
    this.level = 'A1',
    super.key,
  });

  final SentenceBuilderNotifier notifier;
  final String level;

  @override
  State<SentenceBuilderScreen> createState() => _SentenceBuilderScreenState();
}

final class _SentenceBuilderScreenState extends State<SentenceBuilderScreen> {
  SentenceBuilderNotifier get notifier => widget.notifier;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    notifier.addListener(_refresh);
    if (notifier.activePuzzle == null) {
      unawaited(notifier.loadLevel(widget.level));
    }
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant SentenceBuilderScreen oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.notifier != notifier) {
      oldWidget.notifier.removeListener(_refresh);
      notifier.addListener(_refresh);
    }
    if (oldWidget.level != widget.level) {
      unawaited(notifier.loadLevel(widget.level));
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    notifier.removeListener(_refresh);
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _refresh() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: Text('بناء الجملة', style: AppTypography.title),
          backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
          elevation: 0,
        ),
        body: SafeArea(
          top: false,
          child: _Body(
            notifier: notifier,
            dark: dark,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _Body extends StatelessWidget {
  const _Body({
    required this.notifier,
    required this.dark,
  });

  final SentenceBuilderNotifier notifier;
  final bool dark;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {

    if (puzzle == null) {
      return Center(
        child: notifier.isBusy

                notifier.feedbackMessage.isEmpty
                    ? 'لا يوجد تمرين متاح.'

    return ListView(

          child: Column(

            children: <Widget>[
              Text(

                  color: dark ? AppColors.primaryDark : AppColors.primary,

              ),

              Text(
                puzzle.arabicTranslation,
                style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(
                  color: dark ? Colors.white : AppColors.darkSurface,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              Text(
                _structureLabel(puzzle.structureType),
                style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
                  color: AppColors.secondary,
                ),
              ),

          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 14),
        _ArrangementCard(
          notifier: notifier,
          dark: dark,
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 14),
        AppGlassCard(
          borderColor:
              dark ? AppColors.glassBorderDark : AppColors.glassBorderLight,
          backgroundColor:
              dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: <Widget>[
              Text(
                'بنك الكلمات',
                style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(
                  color: dark ? Colors.white : AppColors.darkSurface,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Wrap(
                spacing: 9,
                runSpacing: 9,
                children: <Widget>[
                  for (final tile in notifier.availableTiles)
                    _WordTile(
                      tile: tile,
                      onTap: () => notifier.pickTile(tile),
                      dark: dark,
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ],

        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 14),
        AppGlassCard(
          onTap: notifier.isBusy
              ? null
              : () => unawaited(notifier.verifySentence()),

          borderColor: AppColors.mastery.withAlpha(80),
          backgroundColor:
              dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,

          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 220),
          child: notifier.feedbackMessage.isEmpty
              ? const SizedBox.shrink()
              : Padding(
                  key: ValueKey<String>(notifier.feedbackMessage),
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 14),
                  child: _FeedbackCard(

                    message: notifier.feedbackMessage,
                    dark: dark,

                ),

  static String _structureLabel(SentenceStructureType type) => switch (type) {
        SentenceStructureType.mainClause =>
          'جملة رئيسية · الفعل في الموقع 2',
        SentenceStructureType.subordinateWeil =>
          'جملة فرعية مع weil · الفعل في النهاية',
        SentenceStructureType.questionInversion =>
          'سؤال نعم/لا · الفعل قبل الفاعل',
      };
}

    required this.notifier,
    required this.dark,
  });

  final bool dark;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        glowColor: AppColors.achievement,

            dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,

            Text(

              style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(

            if (notifier.currentArrangement.isEmpty)
              Text(

                style: AppTypography.body.copyWith(

            else

                textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,

                  runSpacing: 8,

                    for (final tile in notifier.currentArrangement)
                      _WordTile(
                        tile: tile,

                        dark: dark,
                        selected: true,
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

final class _WordTile extends StatelessWidget {
  const _WordTile({
    required this.tile,
    required this.onTap,
    required this.dark,
    this.selected = false,
  });

  final WordTileItem tile;
  final VoidCallback onTap;
  final bool dark;
  final bool selected;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final accent = selected ? AppColors.achievement : AppColors.primary;
    return Semantics(
      button: true,
      label: selected
          ? 'إزالة ${tile.germanText} من الجملة'
          : 'إضافة ${tile.germanText} إلى الجملة',
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: onTap,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
        child: DecoratedBox(
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
            color: accent.withAlpha(dark ? 38 : 24),
            border: Border.all(color: accent.withAlpha(96)),
          ),
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 13, vertical: 10),
            child: AppDirectionalText(
              tile.germanText,
              languageCode: 'de',
              style: AppTypography.body.copyWith(
                color: dark ? Colors.white : AppColors.darkSurface,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _FeedbackCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _FeedbackCard({
    required this.isCorrect,
    required this.message,
    required this.dark,
  });

  final bool? isCorrect;
  final String message;
  final bool dark;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final accent = isCorrect == true ? AppColors.mastery : AppColors.tertiary;
    return AppGlassCard(
      glowColor: accent,
      borderColor: accent.withAlpha(80),
      backgroundColor:
          dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: <Widget>[
          Icon(
            isCorrect == true
                ? Icons.check_circle_rounded
                : Icons.lightbulb_outline_rounded,
            color: accent,
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 10),
          Expanded(
            child: Text(
              message,
              style: AppTypography.body.copyWith(
                color: dark ? Colors.white : AppColors.darkSurface,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}


--------------------------------------------------
FILE: lib/features/separable_verbs/application/separable_verbs_notifier.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/separable_verbs_models.dart';
import '../domain/separable_verbs_repository.dart';

final class SeparableVerbsNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  SeparableVerbsNotifier(this._repository);

  final SeparableVerbsRepository _repository;

  List<VerbPrefixDrillItem> _allDrills = const <VerbPrefixDrillItem>[];
  List<VerbPrefixDrillItem> _visibleDrills = const <VerbPrefixDrillItem>[];
  int _currentIndex = 0;
  PrefixType? _activeFilter;
  PrefixPlacement? _selectedPlacement;
  String? _selectedConjugation;
  bool? _isCorrect;
  String _explanation = '';
  bool _isBusy = false;

  VerbPrefixDrillItem? get currentVerb {
    if (_visibleDrills.isEmpty) return null;
    final safeIndex =
        _currentIndex >= 0 && _currentIndex < _visibleDrills.length
            ? _currentIndex
            : 0;
    return _visibleDrills[safeIndex];
  }

  String get interactiveSentence =>
      currentVerb?.trainingSentenceTemplate ?? '';

  PrefixType? get activeFilter => _activeFilter;

  PrefixPlacement? get selectedPlacement => _selectedPlacement;

  String? get selectedConjugation => _selectedConjugation;

  bool? get isCorrect => _isCorrect;

  String get explanation => _explanation;

  bool get isBusy => _isBusy;

  int get drillNumber => _visibleDrills.isEmpty ? 0 : _currentIndex + 1;

  int get drillCount => _visibleDrills.length;

  Future<void> initialize() async {
    if (_isBusy) return;
    _isBusy = true;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      _allDrills = await _repository.getDrills();
      _visibleDrills = List<VerbPrefixDrillItem>.unmodifiable(_allDrills);
      _currentIndex = 0;
      _activeFilter = null;
      _resetAnswerState();
    } finally {
      _isBusy = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  Future<void> checkPrefixPlacement(
    PrefixPlacement placement, {
    required String conjugatedVerb,
  }) async {
    final item = currentVerb;
    if (item == null || _isBusy) return;

    _isBusy = true;
    _selectedPlacement = placement;
    _selectedConjugation = conjugatedVerb.trim();
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      final correct = await _repository.validateAnswer(
        drillId: item.id,
        selectedPlacement: placement,
        conjugatedVerb: conjugatedVerb,
      );
      _isCorrect = correct;
      _explanation = correct
          ? 'صحيح: السابقة ${item.prefix}. ${item.ruleExplanation}'
          : _incorrectExplanation(item, placement, conjugatedVerb);
    } finally {
      _isBusy = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  void nextDrill() {
    if (_visibleDrills.isEmpty || _isBusy) return;
    _currentIndex = (_currentIndex + 1) % _visibleDrills.length;
    _resetAnswerState();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> filterByType(PrefixType type) async {
    if (_isBusy) return;
    if (_allDrills.isEmpty) {
      await initialize();
    }
    _activeFilter = type;
    _visibleDrills = List<VerbPrefixDrillItem>.unmodifiable(
      _allDrills.where((item) => item.prefixType == type),
    );
    _currentIndex = 0;
    _resetAnswerState();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearFilter() {
    if (_isBusy || _allDrills.isEmpty) return;
    _activeFilter = null;
    _visibleDrills = List<VerbPrefixDrillItem>.unmodifiable(_allDrills);
    _currentIndex = 0;
    _resetAnswerState();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void _resetAnswerState() {
    _selectedPlacement = null;
    _selectedConjugation = null;
    _isCorrect = null;
    _explanation = '';
  }

  String _incorrectExplanation(
    VerbPrefixDrillItem item,
    PrefixPlacement placement,
    String conjugatedVerb,
  ) {
    final selectedVerb = conjugatedVerb.trim();
    final verbCorrect =
        selectedVerb.toLowerCase() == item.expectedConjugatedVerb.toLowerCase();
    final placementCorrect = placement == item.expectedPlacement;

    if (!verbCorrect && !placementCorrect) {
      return 'يوجد خطآن: التصريف الصحيح مع ${item.subjectPronoun} هو '
          '${item.expectedConjugatedVerb}، وموضع السابقة ${item.prefix} هو '
          '${item.placementLabel}. ${item.ruleExplanation}';
    }
    if (!verbCorrect) {
      return 'موضع السابقة صحيح، لكن التصريف يحتاج تعديلًا: '
          '${item.subjectPronoun} → ${item.expectedConjugatedVerb}.';
    }
    return 'التصريف صحيح، لكن موضع السابقة ${item.prefix} غير صحيح: '
        '${item.ruleExplanation}';
  }
}

      type: PrefixType.dualVariable,
      placement: PrefixPlacement.position2Attached,
      template: 'Wir ___ den Park zu Fuß.',
      completed: 'Wir durchqueren den Park zu Fuß.',
      translation: 'نعبر الحديقة سيرًا على الأقدام.',
      meaning:
          'durchqueren يعني اجتياز مكان من طرف إلى آخر؛ durch لا تنفصل في هذا الفعل.',
      rule:
          'durch من السوابق التي قد تتغير حسب الفعل والمعنى، '
          'لكنها في durchqueren تبقى متصلة: durchqueren في الموقع الثاني.',
      subject: 'wir',
      conjugated: 'durchqueren',
      choices: <String>['durchqueren', 'queren', 'durchquert'],
    ),
    _item(
      id: 'dual_durch_review',
      infinitive: 'durchgehen',
      prefix: 'durch',
      root: 'gehen',
      type: PrefixType.dualVariable,
      placement: PrefixPlacement.sentenceEndDetached,
      template: 'Wir ___ den Plan noch einmal ___.',
      completed: 'Wir gehen den Plan noch einmal durch.',
      translation: 'نراجع الخطة مرة أخرى خطوة بخطوة.',
      meaning:
          'durch|gehen هنا يعني مراجعة شيء بالكامل؛ السابقة تنفصل.',
      rule:
          'durch متغيرة. في معنى المراجعة الكاملة تكون انفصالية: gehen ... durch.',
      subject: 'wir',
      conjugated: 'gehen',
      choices: <String>['gehen', 'durchgehen', 'geht'],
    ),
  ];

  late final Map<String, VerbPrefixDrillItem> _byId =
      <String, VerbPrefixDrillItem>{
    for (final item in _drills) item.id: item,
  };

  @override
  Future<List<VerbPrefixDrillItem>> getDrills() async =>
      List<VerbPrefixDrillItem>.unmodifiable(_drills);

  @override
  Future<bool> validateAnswer({
    required String drillId,
    required PrefixPlacement selectedPlacement,
    required String conjugatedVerb,
  }) async {
    final item = _byId[drillId];
    if (item == null) return false;

    final normalizedVerb = conjugatedVerb.trim().toLowerCase();
    return selectedPlacement == item.expectedPlacement &&
        normalizedVerb == item.expectedConjugatedVerb.toLowerCase();
  }
}

VerbPrefixDrillItem _item({
  required String id,
  required String infinitive,
  required String prefix,
  required String root,
  required PrefixType type,
  required PrefixPlacement placement,
  required String template,
  required String completed,
  required String translation,
  required String meaning,
  required String rule,
  required String subject,
  required String conjugated,
  required List<String> choices,
}) =>
    VerbPrefixDrillItem(
      id: id,
      fullInfinitive: infinitive,
      prefix: prefix,
      rootVerb: root,
      prefixType: type,
      ruleExplanation: rule,
      expectedPlacement: placement,
      trainingSentenceTemplate: template,
      completedSentence: completed,
      arabicTranslation: translation,
      meaningExplanationAr: meaning,
      subjectPronoun: subject,
      expectedConjugatedVerb: conjugated,
      conjugationChoices: choices,
    );

enum PrefixType {
  separable,
  inseparable,
  dualVariable,
}

enum PrefixPlacement {
  position2Attached,
  sentenceEndDetached,
}

final class VerbPrefixDrillItem {
  VerbPrefixDrillItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.fullInfinitive,
    required this.prefix,
    required this.rootVerb,
    required this.prefixType,
    required this.ruleExplanation,
    required this.expectedPlacement,
    required this.trainingSentenceTemplate,
    required this.completedSentence,
    required this.arabicTranslation,
    required this.meaningExplanationAr,
    required this.subjectPronoun,
    required this.expectedConjugatedVerb,
    required List<String> conjugationChoices,
  })  : assert(id.length > 0),
        assert(fullInfinitive.length > 0),
        assert(prefix.length > 0),
        assert(rootVerb.length > 0),
        assert(conjugationChoices.length >= 2),
        conjugationChoices = List<String>.unmodifiable(conjugationChoices);

  final String id;
  final String fullInfinitive;
  final String prefix;
  final String rootVerb;
  final PrefixType prefixType;
  final String ruleExplanation;
  final PrefixPlacement expectedPlacement;
  final String trainingSentenceTemplate;
  final String completedSentence;
  final String arabicTranslation;
  final String meaningExplanationAr;
  final String subjectPronoun;
  final String expectedConjugatedVerb;
  final List<String> conjugationChoices;

  bool get separatesInThisMeaning =>
      expectedPlacement == PrefixPlacement.sentenceEndDetached;

  String get placementLabel => switch (expectedPlacement) {
        PrefixPlacement.position2Attached => 'Position 2 · السابقة متصلة',
        PrefixPlacement.sentenceEndDetached => 'Satzende · السابقة منفصلة',
      };
}

import 'dart:async';


import '../../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import '../application/separable_verbs_notifier.dart';
import '../domain/separable_verbs_models.dart';

final class SeparableVerbsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const SeparableVerbsScreen({
    required this.notifier,
    super.key,
  });

  final SeparableVerbsNotifier notifier;

  @override
  State<SeparableVerbsScreen> createState() => _SeparableVerbsScreenState();
}

final class _SeparableVerbsScreenState extends State<SeparableVerbsScreen> {
  PrefixPlacement? _placement;
  String? _conjugation;
  String? _lastDrillId;

  SeparableVerbsNotifier get notifier => widget.notifier;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    notifier.addListener(_onNotifierChanged);
    unawaited(notifier.initialize());
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant SeparableVerbsScreen oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.notifier == notifier) return;
    oldWidget.notifier.removeListener(_onNotifierChanged);
    notifier.addListener(_onNotifierChanged);
    _placement = null;
    _conjugation = null;
    _lastDrillId = null;
    unawaited(notifier.initialize());
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    notifier.removeListener(_onNotifierChanged);
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onNotifierChanged() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    final currentId = notifier.currentVerb?.id;
    if (currentId != _lastDrillId) {
      _lastDrillId = currentId;
      _placement = null;
      _conjugation = null;
    }
    setState(() {});
  }

  void _selectPlacement(PrefixPlacement placement) {
    setState(() => _placement = placement);
  }

  void _selectConjugation(String conjugation) {
    setState(() => _conjugation = conjugation);
  }

  void _verify() {
    final placement = _placement;
    final conjugation = _conjugation;
    if (placement == null || conjugation == null || notifier.isBusy) return;
    unawaited(
      notifier.checkPrefixPlacement(
        placement,
        conjugatedVerb: conjugation,
      ),
    );
  }

  void _next() {
    notifier.nextDrill();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final item = notifier.currentVerb;

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor:
            dark ? AppColors.darkBackground : AppColors.lightBackground,
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: Text('الأفعال الانفصالية والمتصلة', style: AppTypography.title),
          backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
          elevation: 0,
        ),
        body: SafeArea(
          top: false,
          child: item == null
              ? Center(
                  child: notifier.isBusy
                      ? const CircularProgressIndicator()
                      : Text(
                          'لا توجد تمارين متاحة.',
                          style: AppTypography.body,
                        ),
                )
              : ListView(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 10, 16, 28),
                  children: <Widget>[
                    _FilterRow(
                      activeFilter: notifier.activeFilter,
                      onAll: notifier.clearFilter,
                      onType: (type) =>
                          unawaited(notifier.filterByType(type)),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    _HeaderCard(
                      item: item,
                      drillNumber: notifier.drillNumber,
                      drillCount: notifier.drillCount,
                      dark: dark,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    _DetachmentIndicator(
                      item: item,
                      selectedPlacement: _placement,
                      checkedPlacement: notifier.selectedPlacement,
                      isCorrect: notifier.isCorrect,
                      dark: dark,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    _SentenceCard(item: item, dark: dark),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    _ConjugationCard(
                      item: item,
                      selected: _conjugation,
                      onSelected: _selectConjugation,
                      dark: dark,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    _PlacementCard(
                      selected: _placement,
                      onSelected: _selectPlacement,
                      dark: dark,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    AppGlassCard(
                      onTap: _placement == null ||
                              _conjugation == null ||
                              notifier.isBusy
                          ? null
                          : _verify,
                      glowColor: AppColors.mastery,
                      borderColor: AppColors.mastery.withAlpha(84),
                      backgroundColor:
                          dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
                      child: Center(
                        child: Text(
                          notifier.isBusy ? 'جارٍ التحقق…' : 'تحقق من الإجابة',
                          style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(
                            color: AppColors.mastery,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (notifier.explanation.isNotEmpty) ...[
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      _FeedbackCard(
                        explanation: notifier.explanation,
                        isCorrect: notifier.isCorrect,
                        dark: dark,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      AppGlassCard(
                        onTap: _next,
                        glowColor: AppColors.primary,
                        backgroundColor:
                            dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
                        child: Center(
                          child: Text(
                            'التمرين التالي',
                            style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(
                              color: dark
                                  ? AppColors.primaryDark
                                  : AppColors.primary,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ],
                ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
