final class _DetachmentIndicator extends StatelessWidget {
  const _DetachmentIndicator({
    required this.item,
    required this.selectedPlacement,
    required this.checkedPlacement,
    required this.isCorrect,
    required this.dark,
  });

  final VerbPrefixDrillItem item;
  final PrefixPlacement? selectedPlacement;
  final PrefixPlacement? checkedPlacement;
  final bool? isCorrect;
  final bool dark;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final requested = checkedPlacement ?? selectedPlacement;
    final displayPlacement = isCorrect == false
        ? item.expectedPlacement
        : requested;
    final showDetached =
        displayPlacement == PrefixPlacement.sentenceEndDetached;
    final corrective = isCorrect == false;

    return AppGlassCard(
      glowColor: corrective ? AppColors.tertiary : AppColors.achievement,
      borderColor: (corrective ? AppColors.tertiary : AppColors.achievement)
          .withAlpha(78),
      backgroundColor:
          dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          Text(
            corrective
                ? 'الموضع الصحيح'
                : 'مؤشر انفصال السابقة',
            style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
              color: corrective ? AppColors.tertiary : AppColors.achievement,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          AnimatedSwitcher(
            duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 260),
            child: displayPlacement == null
                ? Directionality(
                    key: const ValueKey<String>('neutral'),
                    textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                    child: Row(
                      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                      children: <Widget>[
                        _VerbPart(text: item.prefix, accent: AppColors.tertiary),
                        const Padding(
                          padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
                          child: Icon(Icons.add_rounded, size: 20),
                        ),
                        _VerbPart(text: item.rootVerb, accent: AppColors.primary),
                      ],
                    ),
                  )
                : showDetached
                    ? Directionality(
                        key: const ValueKey<String>('detached'),
                        textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                        child: Row(
                          children: <Widget>[
                            _VerbPart(
                              text: item.expectedConjugatedVerb,
                              accent: AppColors.primary,
                            ),
                            const Expanded(
                              child: Padding(
                                padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10),
                                child: Divider(),
                              ),
                            ),
                            const Icon(
                              Icons.arrow_forward_rounded,
                              color: AppColors.achievement,
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(width: 8),
                            _VerbPart(
                              text: item.prefix,
                              accent: AppColors.achievement,
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      )
                    : Directionality(
                        key: const ValueKey<String>('attached'),
                        textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                        child: Center(
                          child: _VerbPart(
                            text: item.expectedConjugatedVerb,
                            accent: AppColors.primary,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
          ),
          if (displayPlacement != null) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Text(
              showDetached
                  ? 'الفعل المصرف في Position 2، والسابقة في Satzende.'
                  : 'السابقة تبقى متصلة بالفعل المصرف في Position 2.',
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
                color: dark ? Colors.white70 : AppColors.darkSurface,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

      borderColor: accent.withAlpha(82),
      backgroundColor:
          dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: <Widget>[
          Icon(
            isCorrect == true
                ? Icons.check_circle_rounded
                : Icons.lightbulb_outline_rounded,
            color: accent,
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 10),
          Expanded(
            child: Text(
              explanation,
              style: AppTypography.body.copyWith(
                color: dark ? Colors.white : AppColors.darkSurface,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

import '../../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../../core/srs_facets.dart';
import '../../services/repository.dart';

final class SessionStateSnapshot {
  const SessionStateSnapshot({
    this.answered = 0,
    this.correct = 0,
    this.combo = 0,
    this.bestCombo = 0,
    this.sessionXp = 0,
    this.lastCorrect,
    this.lastFacet,
  });

  final int answered;
  final int correct;
  final int combo;
  final int bestCombo;
  final int sessionXp;
  final bool? lastCorrect;
  final ReviewFacetType? lastFacet;

  double get accuracy =>
      answered == 0 ? 0 : (correct / answered).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();

  SessionStateSnapshot copyWith({
    int? answered,
    int? correct,
    int? combo,
    int? bestCombo,
    int? sessionXp,
    bool? lastCorrect,
    ReviewFacetType? lastFacet,
  }) {
    return SessionStateSnapshot(
      answered: answered ?? this.answered,
      correct: correct ?? this.correct,
      combo: combo ?? this.combo,
      bestCombo: bestCombo ?? this.bestCombo,
      sessionXp: sessionXp ?? this.sessionXp,
      lastCorrect: lastCorrect,
      lastFacet: lastFacet,
    );
  }
}

final class SessionReviewInput<T extends LearningContent> {
  const SessionReviewInput({
    required this.item,
    required this.answer,
    required this.correct,
    required this.seconds,
    this.hinted = false,
    this.facetType = ReviewFacetType.meaningRecall,
    this.variantKey,
    this.skillOverride,
  });

  final T item;
  final String answer;
  final bool correct;
  final int seconds;
  final bool hinted;
  final ReviewFacetType facetType;
  final String? variantKey;
  final String? skillOverride;
}

abstract interface class SessionHapticDriver {
  Future<void> onCorrect({required int combo});
  Future<void> onIncorrect();
}

final class FlutterSessionHapticDriver implements SessionHapticDriver {
  const FlutterSessionHapticDriver();

  @override
  Future<void> onCorrect({required int combo}) {
    if (combo >= 5) return HapticFeedback.heavyImpact();
    if (combo >= 3) return HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
    if (combo >= 2) return HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
    return HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
  }

  @override
  Future<void> onIncorrect() => HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
}

final class UniversalSessionOrchestrator extends ChangeNotifier {
  UniversalSessionOrchestrator({
    required LearnerRepository repository,
    SessionHapticDriver haptics = const FlutterSessionHapticDriver(),
  })  : _repository = repository,
        _haptics = haptics;

  final LearnerRepository _repository;
  final SessionHapticDriver _haptics;

  SessionStateSnapshot _state = const SessionStateSnapshot();
  Future<void> _queue = Future<void>.value();

  SessionStateSnapshot get state => _state;

  Future<SessionStateSnapshot> record<T extends LearningContent>(
    SessionReviewInput<T> input,
  ) {
    final completer = Completer<SessionStateSnapshot>();
    _queue = _queue.then((_) async {
      try {
        completer.complete(await _recordNow(input));
      } on Object catch (error, stackTrace) {
        completer.completeError(error, stackTrace);
      }
    });
    return completer.future;
  }

  Future<SessionStateSnapshot> _recordNow<T extends LearningContent>(
    SessionReviewInput<T> input,
  ) async {
    final beforeGamification =
        await _repository.loadGamificationSnapshot();
    final beforeXp = beforeGamification.profile.totalXp;

    if (input.facetType == ReviewFacetType.meaningRecall &&
        ReviewFacetKey.normalizeVariant(input.variantKey) == null) {
      await _repository.record(
        item: input.item,
        answer: input.answer,
        correct: input.correct,
        seconds: input.seconds,
        hinted: input.hinted,
        skillOverride: input.skillOverride,
      );
    } else {
      await _repository.recordFacet(
        item: input.item,
        facetType: input.facetType,
        variantKey: input.variantKey,
        answer: input.answer,
        correct: input.correct,
        seconds: input.seconds,
        hinted: input.hinted,
      );
    }

    await _repository.reloadPersisted();
    final afterGamification =
        await _repository.loadGamificationSnapshot();
    final awardedXp =
        (afterGamification.profile.totalXp - beforeXp)
            .clamp(0, LearnerRepository.maxXp)
            .toInt();
    final combo = input.correct ? _state.combo + 1 : 0;
    final correctCount = _state.correct + (input.correct ? 1 : 0);

    _state = _state.copyWith(
      answered: _state.answered + 1,
      correct: correctCount,
      combo: combo,
      bestCombo: combo > _state.bestCombo ? combo : _state.bestCombo,
      sessionXp: (_state.sessionXp + awardedXp)
          .clamp(0, LearnerRepository.maxXp)
          .toInt(),
      lastCorrect: input.correct,
      lastFacet: input.facetType,
    );

    if (input.correct) {
      await _haptics.onCorrect(combo: combo);
    } else {
      await _haptics.onIncorrect();
    }

    notifyListeners();
    return _state;
  }

  void resetSession() {
    _state = const SessionStateSnapshot();
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/speaking_exam_models.dart';
import '../domain/speaking_exam_repository.dart';

final class SpeakingExamNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  SpeakingExamNotifier(this._repository);

  final SpeakingExamRepository _repository;

  List<SpeakingExamScenario> _scenarios =
      const <SpeakingExamScenario>[];
  int _scenarioIndex = 0;
  int _currentPhaseIndex = 0;
  int _secondsRemaining = 0;
  bool _isRunning = false;
  bool _isCompleted = false;
  bool _isLoading = false;
  DebateStance? _selectedStance;
  ExamProvider? _providerFilter;
  ExamLevel? _levelFilter;
  Timer? _ticker;
  int _requestGeneration = 0;

  List<SpeakingExamScenario> get scenarios =>
      List<SpeakingExamScenario>.unmodifiable(_scenarios);
  int get scenarioIndex => _scenarioIndex;
  int get currentPhaseIndex => _currentPhaseIndex;
  int get secondsRemaining => _secondsRemaining;
  bool get isRunning => _isRunning;
  bool get isCompleted => _isCompleted;
  bool get isLoading => _isLoading;
  DebateStance? get selectedStance => _selectedStance;
  ExamProvider? get providerFilter => _providerFilter;
  ExamLevel? get levelFilter => _levelFilter;

  SpeakingExamScenario? get currentScenario {
    if (_scenarios.isEmpty || _scenarioIndex >= _scenarios.length) {
      return null;
    }
    return _scenarios[_scenarioIndex];
  }

  SpeakingPhaseConfig? get currentPhase {
    final scenario = currentScenario;
    if (scenario == null ||
        _currentPhaseIndex >= scenario.phases.length) {
      return null;
    }
    return scenario.phases[_currentPhaseIndex];
  }

  double get phaseProgress {
    final phase = currentPhase;
    if (phase == null || phase.duration.inSeconds <= 0) return 0;
    final elapsed =
        phase.duration.inSeconds - _secondsRemaining;
    return (elapsed / phase.duration.inSeconds).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
  }

  String get formattedRemaining {
    final minutes = _secondsRemaining ~/ 60;
    final seconds = _secondsRemaining % 60;
    final mm = minutes.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    final ss = seconds.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    return mm + ':' + ss;
  }

  Future<void> load({
    ExamProvider? provider,
    ExamLevel? level,
  }) async {
    final generation = ++_requestGeneration;
    pauseTimer(notify: false);
    _isLoading = true;
    notifyListeners();

    final loaded = await _repository.getScenarios(
      provider: provider,
      level: level,
    );
    if (generation != _requestGeneration) return;

    _scenarios = List<SpeakingExamScenario>.unmodifiable(loaded);
    _providerFilter = provider;
    _levelFilter = level;
    _scenarioIndex = 0;
    _resetExamState();
    _isLoading = false;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void startTimer() {
    if (_isCompleted || currentPhase == null || _isRunning) return;

    _isRunning = true;
    _ticker?.cancel();
    _ticker = Timer.periodic(
      const Duration(seconds: 1),
      (_) => advanceClock(const Duration(seconds: 1)),
    );
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void pauseTimer({bool notify = true}) {
    _ticker?.cancel();
    _ticker = null;
    final changed = _isRunning;
    _isRunning = false;
    if (notify && changed) notifyListeners();
  }

  void resetCurrentPhase() {
    pauseTimer(notify: false);
    final phase = currentPhase;
    _secondsRemaining = phase?.duration.inSeconds ?? 0;
    _isCompleted = false;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void advanceClock(Duration elapsed) {
    if (_isCompleted || currentPhase == null) return;

    var remainingElapsed = elapsed.inSeconds;
    if (remainingElapsed <= 0) return;

    while (remainingElapsed > 0 && !_isCompleted) {
      if (remainingElapsed < _secondsRemaining) {
        _secondsRemaining -= remainingElapsed;
        remainingElapsed = 0;
        break;
      }

      remainingElapsed -= _secondsRemaining;
      _advancePhaseInternal();
    }

    notifyListeners();
  }

  void nextPhase() {
    if (_isCompleted || currentScenario == null) return;
    _advancePhaseInternal();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void previousPhase() {
    final scenario = currentScenario;
    if (scenario == null || _currentPhaseIndex <= 0) return;

    _currentPhaseIndex--;
    _isCompleted = false;
    _secondsRemaining =
        scenario.phases[_currentPhaseIndex].duration.inSeconds;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void selectStance(DebateStance stance) {
    if (_selectedStance == stance) return;
    _selectedStance = stance;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void nextScenario() {
    if (_scenarios.isEmpty) return;

    pauseTimer(notify: false);
    _scenarioIndex = (_scenarioIndex + 1) % _scenarios.length;
    _resetExamState();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> applyFilter({
    ExamProvider? provider,
    ExamLevel? level,
  }) async {
    await load(provider: provider, level: level);
  }

  void _advancePhaseInternal() {
    final scenario = currentScenario;
    if (scenario == null) return;

    if (_currentPhaseIndex >= scenario.phases.length - 1) {
      pauseTimer(notify: false);
      _secondsRemaining = 0;
      _isCompleted = true;
      return;
    }

    _currentPhaseIndex++;
    _secondsRemaining =
        scenario.phases[_currentPhaseIndex].duration.inSeconds;
  }

  void _resetExamState() {
    _currentPhaseIndex = 0;
    _selectedStance = null;
    _isCompleted = false;
    _isRunning = false;
    _ticker?.cancel();
    _ticker = null;
    _secondsRemaining =
        currentPhase?.duration.inSeconds ?? 0;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _ticker?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }
}

enum ExamProvider { goethe, telc }

enum ExamLevel { b1, b2 }

enum SpeakingPhaseType {
  preparation,
  presentation,
  partnerQuestions,
  discussion,
  jointPlanning,
  wrapUp,
}

enum DebateStance { pro, contra, balanced }

final class SpeakingPhaseConfig {
  const SpeakingPhaseConfig({
    required this.type,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.duration,
    required this.guidanceAr,
  });

  final SpeakingPhaseType type;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final Duration duration;
  final String guidanceAr;
}

final class SpeakingExamScenario {
  const SpeakingExamScenario({
    required this.id,
    required this.provider,
    required this.level,
    required this.topicDe,
    required this.topicAr,
    required this.presentationPromptDe,
    required this.presentationPointsDe,
    required this.presentationPointsAr,
    required this.debateStatementDe,
    required this.debateStatementAr,
    required this.proArgumentsDe,
    required this.contraArgumentsDe,
    required this.partnerQuestionsDe,
    required this.planningTaskDe,
    required this.planningTaskAr,
    required this.phases,
  });

  final String id;
  final ExamProvider provider;
  final ExamLevel level;
  final String topicDe;
  final String topicAr;
  final String presentationPromptDe;
  final List<String> presentationPointsDe;
  final List<String> presentationPointsAr;
  final String debateStatementDe;
  final String debateStatementAr;
  final List<String> proArgumentsDe;
  final List<String> contraArgumentsDe;
  final List<String> partnerQuestionsDe;
  final String planningTaskDe;
  final String planningTaskAr;
  final List<SpeakingPhaseConfig> phases;

  String get providerLabel => switch (provider) {
        ExamProvider.goethe => 'Goethe',
        ExamProvider.telc => 'telc',
      };

  String get levelLabel => switch (level) {
        ExamLevel.b1 => 'B1',
        ExamLevel.b2 => 'B2',
      };
}

import 'dart:async';
import '../../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import '../application/speaking_exam_notifier.dart';
import '../domain/speaking_exam_models.dart';
final class SpeakingExamScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const SpeakingExamScreen({required this.notifier, super.key});
  final SpeakingExamNotifier notifier;
  @override
  State<SpeakingExamScreen> createState() => _SpeakingExamScreenState();
}
final class _SpeakingExamScreenState extends State<SpeakingExamScreen> {
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    if (widget.notifier.currentScenario == null &&
        !widget.notifier.isLoading) {
      unawaited(widget.notifier.load());
    }
  }
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Directionality(
        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
        child: Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(
            title: const Text(
              'محاكي الامتحان الشفهي · Mündliche Prüfung',
              textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
            ),
          ),
          body: SafeArea(
            child: ListenableBuilder(
              listenable: widget.notifier,
              builder: (context, _) {
                final notifier = widget.notifier;
                final scenario = notifier.currentScenario;
                if (notifier.isLoading && scenario == null) {
                  return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
                }
                return SingleChildScrollView(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 36),
                  child: scenario == null
                      ? _EmptyState(
                          onRetry: () => unawaited(notifier.load()),
                        )
                      : Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                          children: <Widget>[
                            _FilterBar(notifier: notifier),
                            const SizedBox(height: 14),
                            _ScenarioHeader(
                              scenario: scenario,
                              notifier: notifier,
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(height: 14),
                            _TimerCard(notifier: notifier),
                            const SizedBox(height: 14),
                            _PhaseStrip(notifier: notifier),
                            const SizedBox(height: 14),
                            _GuidanceCard(notifier: notifier),
                            const SizedBox(height: 14),
                            _PresentationCard(scenario: scenario),
                            const SizedBox(height: 14),
                            _DebateCard(
                              scenario: scenario,
                              notifier: notifier,
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(height: 14),
                            _PlanningAndQuestionsCard(scenario: scenario),
                            const SizedBox(height: 14),
                            _NavigationCard(notifier: notifier),
                          ],
                        ),
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
}
final class _FilterBar extends StatelessWidget {
  const _FilterBar({required this.notifier});
  final SpeakingExamNotifier notifier;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        borderColor: AppColors.secondary.withAlpha(80),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            Text(
              'نوع التدريب',
              textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Wrap(
              spacing: 8,
              runSpacing: 8,
              children: <Widget>[
                _FilterButton(
                  label: 'Goethe B1',
                  selected: notifier.providerFilter == ExamProvider.goethe &&
                      notifier.levelFilter == ExamLevel.b1,
                  onTap: () => unawaited(notifier.applyFilter(
                    provider: ExamProvider.goethe,
                    level: ExamLevel.b1,
                  )),
                ),
                _FilterButton(
                  label: 'Goethe B2',
                  selected: notifier.providerFilter == ExamProvider.goethe &&
                      notifier.levelFilter == ExamLevel.b2,
                  onTap: () => unawaited(notifier.applyFilter(
                    provider: ExamProvider.goethe,
                    level: ExamLevel.b2,
                  )),
                ),
                _FilterButton(
                  label: 'telc B1',
                  selected: notifier.providerFilter == ExamProvider.telc &&
                      notifier.levelFilter == ExamLevel.b1,
                  onTap: () => unawaited(notifier.applyFilter(
                    provider: ExamProvider.telc,
                    level: ExamLevel.b1,
                  )),
                ),
                _FilterButton(
                  label: 'telc B2',
                  selected: notifier.providerFilter == ExamProvider.telc &&
                      notifier.levelFilter == ExamLevel.b2,
                  onTap: () => unawaited(notifier.applyFilter(
                    provider: ExamProvider.telc,
                    level: ExamLevel.b2,
                  )),
                ),
                _FilterButton(
                  label: 'الكل',
                  selected: notifier.providerFilter == null &&
                      notifier.levelFilter == null,
                  onTap: () => unawaited(notifier.load()),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}
final class _FilterButton extends StatelessWidget {
  const _FilterButton({
    required this.label,
    required this.selected,
    required this.onTap,
  });
  final String label;
  final bool selected;
  final VoidCallback onTap;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        onTap: onTap,
        borderRadius: 18,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 9),
        borderColor:
            selected ? AppColors.secondary : Theme.of(context).dividerColor,
        glowColor: selected ? AppColors.secondary : null,
        child: Text(
          label,
          textDirection: label == 'الكل'
              ? TextDirection.rtl
              : TextDirection.ltr,
          style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
            color: selected
                ? AppColors.secondary
                : Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurface,
          ),
        ),
      );
}

final class _TimerCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _TimerCard({required this.notifier});
  final SpeakingExamNotifier notifier;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final phase = notifier.currentPhase;
    if (phase == null) {
      return AppGlassCard(
        borderColor: AppColors.mastery.withAlpha(100),
        glowColor: AppColors.mastery,
        child: Text(
          'اكتملت المحاكاة. انتقل إلى سيناريو جديد أو راجع إجاباتك.',
          textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
          style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(color: AppColors.mastery),
        ),
      );
    }
    final timerColor = notifier.secondsRemaining <= 30
        ? Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error
        : AppColors.tertiary;
    return AppGlassCard(
      borderColor: AppColors.tertiary.withAlpha(100),
      glowColor: notifier.isRunning ? AppColors.tertiary : null,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          Wrap(
            alignment: WrapAlignment.spaceBetween,
            crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,
            spacing: 12,
            runSpacing: 12,
            children: <Widget>[
              Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Text(
                    phase.titleDe,
                    textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                    style: AppTypography.title,
                  ),
                  Text(
                    phase.titleAr,
                    textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                    style: AppTypography.label,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              Text(
                notifier.formattedRemaining,
                textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                style: AppTypography.display.copyWith(color: timerColor),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          ClipRRect(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            child: LinearProgressIndicator(
              minHeight: 10,
              value: notifier.phaseProgress,
              backgroundColor:
                  Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
              valueColor:
                  const AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(AppColors.tertiary),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          Wrap(
            spacing: 8,
            runSpacing: 8,
            children: <Widget>[
              FilledButton.icon(
                onPressed:
                    notifier.isRunning ? notifier.pauseTimer : notifier.startTimer,
                icon: Icon(
                  notifier.isRunning
                      ? Icons.pause_rounded
                      : Icons.play_arrow_rounded,
                ),
                label: Text(
                  notifier.isRunning ? 'إيقاف مؤقت' : 'ابدأ المؤقت',
                  textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                ),
              ),
              OutlinedButton.icon(
                onPressed: notifier.resetCurrentPhase,
                icon: const Icon(Icons.restart_alt_rounded),
                label: const Text(
                  'إعادة المرحلة',
                  textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
final class _PhaseStrip extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PhaseStrip({required this.notifier});
  final SpeakingExamNotifier notifier;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final phases =
        notifier.currentScenario?.phases ?? const <SpeakingPhaseConfig>[];
    return AppGlassCard(
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          Text(
            'مراحل المحاكاة',
            textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
            style: AppTypography.title,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          Wrap(
            spacing: 8,
            runSpacing: 8,
            children: <Widget>[
              for (var index = 0; index < phases.length; index++)
                _PhasePill(
                  label: (index + 1).toString() + '. ' + phases[index].titleDe,
                  current: index == notifier.currentPhaseIndex &&
                      !notifier.isCompleted,
                  completed:
                      notifier.isCompleted || index < notifier.currentPhaseIndex,
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
final class _PhasePill extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PhasePill({
    required this.label,
    required this.current,
    required this.completed,
  });
  final String label;
  final bool current;
  final bool completed;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final color = completed
        ? AppColors.mastery
        : current
            ? AppColors.tertiary
            : Theme.of(context).colorScheme.outline;
    return AppGlassCard(
      borderRadius: 16,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 8),
      borderColor: color.withAlpha(100),
      glowColor: current ? color : null,
      child: Row(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: <Widget>[
          Icon(
            completed
                ? Icons.check_circle_outline
                : current
                    ? Icons.timer_outlined
                    : Icons.circle_outlined,
            size: 16,
            color: color,
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 6),
          Text(
            label,
            textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
            style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(color: color),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
final class _GuidanceCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _GuidanceCard({required this.notifier});
  final SpeakingExamNotifier notifier;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final phase = notifier.currentPhase;
    if (phase == null) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    return AppGlassCard(
      borderColor: AppColors.secondary.withAlpha(90),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          Text(
            'ماذا تفعل الآن؟',
            textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
            style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(color: AppColors.secondary),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text(
            phase.guidanceAr,
            textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
            style: AppTypography.body,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
final class _PresentationCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PresentationCard({required this.scenario});
  final SpeakingExamScenario scenario;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(80),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            const _SectionTitle(
              icon: Icons.record_voice_over_outlined,
              title: 'بطاقة العرض',
              color: AppColors.primary,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Text(
              scenario.presentationPromptDe,
              textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            for (var index = 0;
                index < scenario.presentationPointsDe.length;
                index++) ...<Widget>[
              AppGlassCard(
                borderRadius: 16,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    Text(
                      '• ' + scenario.presentationPointsDe[index],
                      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                      style: AppTypography.body.copyWith(
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (index < scenario.presentationPointsAr.length) ...<Widget>[
                      const SizedBox(height: 4),
                      Text(
                        scenario.presentationPointsAr[index],
                        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                        style: AppTypography.label,
                      ),
                    ],
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              if (index != scenario.presentationPointsDe.length - 1)
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      );
}
final class _DebateCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _DebateCard({
    required this.scenario,
    required this.notifier,
  });
  final SpeakingExamScenario scenario;
  final SpeakingExamNotifier notifier;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        borderColor: AppColors.achievement.withAlpha(85),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            const _SectionTitle(
              icon: Icons.forum_outlined,
              title: 'بطاقة النقاش والمناظرة',
              color: AppColors.achievement,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Text(
              scenario.debateStatementDe,
              textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
              style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(
                color: AppColors.achievement,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            Text(
              scenario.debateStatementAr,
              textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
              style: AppTypography.body,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Wrap(
              spacing: 8,
              runSpacing: 8,
              children: <Widget>[
                _StanceButton(
                  label: 'PRO',
                  selected: notifier.selectedStance == DebateStance.pro,
                  color: AppColors.mastery,
                  onTap: () => notifier.selectStance(DebateStance.pro),
                ),
                _StanceButton(
                  label: 'CONTRA',
                  selected: notifier.selectedStance == DebateStance.contra,
                  color: AppColors.tertiary,
                  onTap: () => notifier.selectStance(DebateStance.contra),
                ),
                _StanceButton(
                  label: 'ABWÄGEN',
                  selected:
                      notifier.selectedStance == DebateStance.balanced,
                  color: AppColors.secondary,
                  onTap: () =>
                      notifier.selectStance(DebateStance.balanced),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            LayoutBuilder(
              builder: (context, constraints) {
                final pro = _ArgumentList(
                  title: 'Dafür',
                  items: scenario.proArgumentsDe,
                  color: AppColors.mastery,
                );
                final contra = _ArgumentList(
                  title: 'Dagegen',
                  items: scenario.contraArgumentsDe,
                  color: AppColors.tertiary,
                );
                if (constraints.maxWidth < 560) {
                  return Column(
                    children: <Widget>[
                      pro,
                      const SizedBox(height: 10),
                      contra,
                    ],
                  );
                }
                return Row(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    Expanded(child: pro),
                    const SizedBox(width: 10),
                    Expanded(child: contra),
                  ],
                );
              },
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

final class _NavigationCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _NavigationCard({required this.notifier});
  final SpeakingExamNotifier notifier;

  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        child: Wrap(
          alignment: WrapAlignment.spaceBetween,
          spacing: 8,
          runSpacing: 8,
          children: <Widget>[
            OutlinedButton.icon(
              onPressed:
                  notifier.currentPhaseIndex > 0 && !notifier.isCompleted
                      ? notifier.previousPhase
                      : null,
              icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_forward_rounded),
              label: const Text(
                'المرحلة السابقة',
                textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
              ),
            ),
            FilledButton.icon(
              onPressed:
                  notifier.isCompleted ? notifier.nextScenario : notifier.nextPhase,

                    ? Icons.skip_next_rounded
                    : Icons.arrow_back_rounded,

                textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

final class SrsCorpusContract {
  const SrsCorpusContract._();

  /// Schema of the derived, language-neutral runtime SRS corpus.
  static const int schemaVersion = 2;

  static const String metadataTable = 'srs_corpus_metadata';
  static const String contentTable = 'srs_corpus_content';
  static const String acceptedTable = 'srs_corpus_accepted';
  static const String verbTable = 'srs_corpus_verb_rows';

  static const String metadataSchemaVersionKey = 'schemaVersion';
  static const String metadataStateKey = 'state';
  static const String metadataContentRowsKey = 'contentRows';
  static const String metadataVerbRowsKey = 'verbRows';
  static const String metadataSourceContentSha256Key = 'sourceContentSha256';

  static const Set<String> requiredIndexes = <String>{
    'idx_srs_content_topic_skill_id',
    'idx_srs_content_german',
    'idx_srs_content_cefr_id',
    'idx_srs_accepted_form',
    'idx_srs_verbs_infinitive_person',
  };

  static const List<String> createSchemaStatements = <String>[
    '''
CREATE TABLE srs_corpus_metadata (
  key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  value TEXT NOT NULL
)
''',
    '''
CREATE TABLE srs_corpus_content (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  german TEXT NOT NULL,
  arabic TEXT NOT NULL,
  sentence TEXT NOT NULL,
  sentence_ar TEXT NOT NULL,
  topic TEXT NOT NULL,
  skill TEXT NOT NULL,
  cefr TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (cefr IN ('unknown', 'A1', 'A2', 'B1', 'B2', 'C1', 'C2')),
  article TEXT NOT NULL,
  plural TEXT NOT NULL
)
''',
    '''
CREATE TABLE srs_corpus_accepted (
  content_id TEXT NOT NULL
    REFERENCES srs_corpus_content(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,
  form TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (content_id, ordinal)
)
''',
    '''
CREATE TABLE srs_corpus_verb_rows (
  row_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  content_id TEXT NOT NULL
    REFERENCES srs_corpus_content(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  row_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,
  infinitive TEXT NOT NULL,
  arabic TEXT NOT NULL,
  group_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  person TEXT NOT NULL,
  person_ar TEXT NOT NULL,
  form TEXT NOT NULL,
  past TEXT NOT NULL,
  past_arabic TEXT NOT NULL,
  example TEXT NOT NULL,
  example_ar TEXT NOT NULL,
  past_example TEXT NOT NULL,
  past_example_ar TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (content_id, row_ordinal)
)
''',
  ];

  static const List<String> createIndexStatements = <String>[
    '''
CREATE INDEX idx_srs_content_topic_skill_id
ON srs_corpus_content(topic, skill, id)
''',
    '''
CREATE INDEX idx_srs_content_german
ON srs_corpus_content(german, id)
''',
    '''
CREATE INDEX idx_srs_content_cefr_id
ON srs_corpus_content(cefr, id)
''',
    '''
CREATE INDEX idx_srs_accepted_form
ON srs_corpus_accepted(form, content_id)
''',
    '''
CREATE INDEX idx_srs_verbs_infinitive_person
ON srs_corpus_verb_rows(infinitive, person, content_id)
''',
  ];
}

/// Cardinality declared by an admitted language pack.
///
/// Content rows must be non-empty. Verb rows may legitimately be zero for
/// languages/packs that do not expose conjugation rows through the legacy
/// migration surface.
final class SrsCorpusCardinality {
  SrsCorpusCardinality({
    required this.contentRows,
    required this.verbRows,
  }) {
    if (contentRows < 1) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        contentRows,
        'contentRows',
        'must be positive',
      );
    }
    if (verbRows < 0) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        verbRows,
        'verbRows',
        'must not be negative',
      );
    }
  }

  final int contentRows;
  final int verbRows;
}

final class SrsCorpusVerification {
  const SrsCorpusVerification({
    required this.schemaVersion,
    required this.contentRows,
    required this.verbRows,
    required this.expectedContentRows,
    required this.expectedVerbRows,
    required this.sourceContentSha256,
    required this.indexes,
  });

  final int schemaVersion;
  final int contentRows;
  final int verbRows;
  final int expectedContentRows;
  final int expectedVerbRows;
  final String sourceContentSha256;
  final Set<String> indexes;

  bool get hasExpectedCardinality =>
      contentRows == expectedContentRows &&
      verbRows == expectedVerbRows;
}


--------------------------------------------------
FILE: lib/features/srs/corpus_sqlite_migrator.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:sqflite_common/sqlite_api.dart';

import 'corpus_sqlite_contract.dart';
import 'corpus_sqlite_repository.dart';

final class SrsCorpusMigrationReport {
  const SrsCorpusMigrationReport({
    required this.contentRows,
    required this.verbRows,
    required this.acceptedRows,
  });

  final int contentRows;
  final int verbRows;
  final int acceptedRows;

  bool matches(SrsCorpusCardinality expected) =>
      contentRows == expected.contentRows &&
      verbRows == expected.verbRows;
}

/// Deterministically migrates the admitted legacy SQLite lexicon table into
/// normalized, indexed SRS tables. The target is marked ready only after
/// exact cardinality and index verification succeeds.
final class SrsCorpusSqliteMigrator {
  const SrsCorpusSqliteMigrator({
    this.pageSize = 256,
  }) : assert(pageSize > 0 && pageSize <= 1024);

  static const Set<String> _supportedCefrLevels = <String>{
    'unknown',
    'A1',
    'A2',
    'B1',
    'B2',
    'C1',
    'C2',
  };

  final int pageSize;

  Future<SrsCorpusMigrationReport> migrate({
    required Database source,
    required Database target,
    required SrsCorpusCardinality expectedCardinality,
    required String sourceContentSha256,
  }) async {
    final normalizedSourceContentSha256 = _requireSha256(
      sourceContentSha256,
    );
    await _requireLegacySource(
      source,
      expectedCardinality: expectedCardinality,
    );
    await _requireEmptyTarget(target);

    await target.execute('PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON');
    for (final statement in SrsCorpusContract.createSchemaStatements) {
      await target.execute(statement);
    }

    final metadata = <String, String>{
      SrsCorpusContract.metadataSchemaVersionKey:
          SrsCorpusContract.schemaVersion.toString(),
      SrsCorpusContract.metadataStateKey: 'building',
      SrsCorpusContract.metadataContentRowsKey:
          expectedCardinality.contentRows.toString(),
      SrsCorpusContract.metadataVerbRowsKey:
          expectedCardinality.verbRows.toString(),
      SrsCorpusContract.metadataSourceContentSha256Key:
          normalizedSourceContentSha256,
    };
    for (final entry in metadata.entries) {
      await target.insert(
        SrsCorpusContract.metadataTable,
        <String, Object?>{
          'key': entry.key,
          'value': entry.value,
        },
      );
    }

    var contentRows = 0;
    var verbRows = 0;
    var acceptedRows = 0;
    String? afterId;

    while (true) {
      final rows = await source.rawQuery(
        '''
SELECT l.id, l.surface, l.fields_json, c.cefr
FROM lexicon l
JOIN concepts c ON c.concept_id = l.id
${afterId == null ? '' : 'WHERE l.id > ?'}
ORDER BY l.id ASC
LIMIT ?
''',
        <Object?>[
          if (afterId != null) afterId,
          pageSize,
        ],
      );
      if (rows.isEmpty) break;

      final batch = target.batch();
      for (final row in rows) {
        final id = _requiredString(row['id'], 'id', maxLength: 160);
        final german = _requiredString(
          row['surface'],
          'surface',
          maxLength: 4000,
        );
        final fields = _decodeFields(row['fields_json']);
        final arabic = _firstString(
          fields,
          const <String>['translation', 'translationText', 'arabic'],
          required: true,
        );

        batch.insert(
          SrsCorpusContract.contentTable,
          <String, Object?>{
            'id': id,
            'german': german,
            'arabic': arabic,
            'sentence': _firstString(
              fields,
              const <String>['example', 'sentence'],
            ),
            'sentence_ar': _firstString(
              fields,
              const <String>['exampleTranslation', 'sentenceAr'],
            ),
            'topic': _firstString(
              fields,
              const <String>['topic'],
              fallback: 'pack',
            ),
            'skill': _firstString(
              fields,
              const <String>['skill'],
              fallback: 'recall',
            ),
            'cefr': _requiredCefr(row['cefr'], id),
            'article': _firstString(
              fields,
              const <String>['article', 'grammaticalMarker'],
            ),
            'plural': _firstString(
              fields,
              const <String>['plural'],
            ),
          },
          conflictAlgorithm: ConflictAlgorithm.abort,
        );
        contentRows += 1;

        final accepted = _boundedStringList(
          fields['accepted'],
          maxEntries: 32,
          maxLength: 200,
        );
        for (var index = 0; index < accepted.length; index += 1) {
          batch.insert(
            SrsCorpusContract.acceptedTable,
            <String, Object?>{
              'content_id': id,
              'ordinal': index,
              'form': accepted[index],
            },
            conflictAlgorithm: ConflictAlgorithm.abort,
          );
          acceptedRows += 1;
        }

        final rawVerbRows = fields['verbRows'];
        if (rawVerbRows != null && rawVerbRows is! List) {
          throw StateError('srs_corpus_verb_rows_invalid:$id');
        }
        final nestedVerbRows =
            rawVerbRows is List ? rawVerbRows : const <Object?>[];
        if (nestedVerbRows.length > 128) {
          throw StateError('srs_corpus_verb_rows_excessive:$id');
        }

        for (var index = 0; index < nestedVerbRows.length; index += 1) {
          final raw = nestedVerbRows[index];
          if (raw is! Map) {
            throw StateError('srs_corpus_verb_row_invalid:$id');
          }
          final verb = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw);
          batch.insert(
            SrsCorpusContract.verbTable,
            <String, Object?>{
              'content_id': id,
              'row_ordinal': index,
              'infinitive': _mapString(
                verb,
                'infinitive',
                fallback: german,
              ),
              'arabic': _mapString(
                verb,
                'arabic',
                fallback: arabic,
              ),
              'group_name': _mapString(
                verb,
                'group',
                fallback: 'pack',
              ),
              'person': _mapString(
                verb,
                'person',
                required: true,
              ),
              'person_ar': _mapString(verb, 'personAr'),
              'form': _mapString(
                verb,
                'form',
                required: true,
              ),
              'past': _mapString(verb, 'past'),
              'past_arabic': _mapString(verb, 'pastArabic'),
              'example': _mapString(verb, 'example'),
              'example_ar': _mapString(verb, 'exampleAr'),
              'past_example': _mapString(verb, 'pastExample'),
              'past_example_ar': _mapString(verb, 'pastExampleAr'),
            },
            conflictAlgorithm: ConflictAlgorithm.abort,
          );
          verbRows += 1;
        }

        afterId = id;
      }

      await batch.commit(noResult: true);
      if (rows.length < pageSize) break;
    }

    if (contentRows != expectedCardinality.contentRows) {
      throw StateError(
        'srs_corpus_content_cardinality_mismatch:'
        '$contentRows/${expectedCardinality.contentRows}',
      );
    }
    if (verbRows != expectedCardinality.verbRows) {
      throw StateError(
        'srs_corpus_verb_cardinality_mismatch:'
        '$verbRows/${expectedCardinality.verbRows}',
      );
    }

    for (final statement in SrsCorpusContract.createIndexStatements) {
      await target.execute(statement);
    }
    await target.execute(
      'PRAGMA user_version=${SrsCorpusContract.schemaVersion}',
    );
    await target.update(
      SrsCorpusContract.metadataTable,
      const <String, Object?>{'value': 'ready'},
      where: 'key = ?',
      whereArgs: const <Object?>[SrsCorpusContract.metadataStateKey],
    );

    final verification = await IndexedSrsCorpusRepository.verifyDatabase(
      target,
      expectedCardinality: expectedCardinality,
      sourceContentSha256: normalizedSourceContentSha256,
    );
    if (!verification.hasExpectedCardinality) {
      throw StateError('srs_corpus_verification_failed');
    }

    return SrsCorpusMigrationReport(
      contentRows: contentRows,
      verbRows: verbRows,
      acceptedRows: acceptedRows,
    );
  }

  Future<void> _requireLegacySource(
    Database source, {
    required SrsCorpusCardinality expectedCardinality,
  }) async {
    final rows = await source.rawQuery(
      "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master "
      "WHERE type = 'table' AND name IN ('lexicon', 'concepts')",
    );
    final tables = rows
        .map((row) => row['name']?.toString())
        .whereType<String>()
        .toSet();
    if (!tables.contains('lexicon')) {
      throw StateError('srs_corpus_legacy_lexicon_missing');
    }
    if (!tables.contains('concepts')) {
      throw StateError('srs_corpus_concepts_missing');
    }
    final countRows = await source.rawQuery(
      'SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM lexicon l '
      'JOIN concepts c ON c.concept_id = l.id',
    );
    final raw = countRows.length == 1 ? countRows.single['count'] : null;
    final actual = raw is int ? raw : int.tryParse(raw?.toString() ?? '');
    if (actual != expectedCardinality.contentRows) {
      throw StateError(
        'srs_corpus_source_content_cardinality_mismatch:'
        '$actual/${expectedCardinality.contentRows}',
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _requireEmptyTarget(Database target) async {
    final rows = await target.rawQuery(
      "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master "
      "WHERE type = 'table' AND name LIKE 'srs_corpus_%'",
    );
    if (rows.isNotEmpty) {
      throw StateError('srs_corpus_target_not_empty');
    }
  }

  String _requireSha256(String raw) {
    final normalized = raw.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!RegExp(r'^[a-f0-9]{64}$').hasMatch(normalized)) {
      throw StateError('srs_corpus_source_sha256_invalid');
    }
    return normalized;
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> _decodeFields(Object? raw) {
    if (raw is! String || raw.length > 512 * 1024) {
      throw const FormatException('srs_corpus_fields_invalid');
    }
    final decoded = jsonDecode(raw);
    if (decoded is! Map) {
      throw const FormatException('srs_corpus_fields_not_object');
    }
    return Map<String, dynamic>.from(decoded);
  }

  String _requiredCefr(Object? raw, String id) {
    if (raw is! String) {
      throw StateError('srs_corpus_cefr_invalid:$id');
    }
    final value = raw.trim();
    if (!_supportedCefrLevels.contains(value)) {
      throw StateError('srs_corpus_cefr_invalid:$id');
    }
    return value;
  }

  String _requiredString(
    Object? raw,
    String field, {
    required int maxLength,
  }) {
    if (raw is! String) {
      throw StateError('srs_corpus_${field}_invalid');
    }
    final value = raw.trim();
    if (value.isEmpty || value.length > maxLength) {
      throw StateError('srs_corpus_${field}_invalid');
    }
    return value;
  }

  String _firstString(
    Map<String, dynamic> fields,
    List<String> keys, {
    bool required = false,
    String fallback = '',
  }) {
    for (final key in keys) {
      final raw = fields[key];
      if (raw is String) {
        final value = raw.trim();
        if (value.isNotEmpty && value.length <= 4000) {
          return value;
        }
      }
    }
    if (required) {
      throw StateError('srs_corpus_required_text_missing');
    }
    return fallback;
  }

  String _mapString(
    Map<String, dynamic> row,
    String key, {
    bool required = false,
    String fallback = '',
  }) {
    final raw = row[key];
    if (raw is String) {
      final value = raw.trim();
      if (value.isNotEmpty && value.length <= 4000) {
        return value;
      }
    }
    if (required) {
      throw StateError('srs_corpus_verb_required_text_missing:$key');
    }
    return fallback;
  }

  List<String> _boundedStringList(
    Object? raw, {
    required int maxEntries,
    required int maxLength,
  }) {
    if (raw is! List) return const <String>[];
    if (raw.length > maxEntries) {
      throw StateError('srs_corpus_string_list_excessive');
    }
    return raw
        .whereType<String>()
        .map((value) => value.trim())
        .where(
          (value) => value.isNotEmpty && value.length <= maxLength,
        )
        .toList(growable: false);
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/srs/corpus_sqlite_repository.dart

import 'package:sqflite_common/sqlite_api.dart';

import 'corpus_sqlite_contract.dart';

final class SrsCorpusItem {
  SrsCorpusItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.sentence,
    required this.sentenceAr,
    required this.topic,
    required this.skill,
    required this.cefr,
    required this.article,
    required this.plural,
    required this.accepted,
  });

  final String id;
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final String sentence;
  final String sentenceAr;
  final String topic;
  final String skill;
  final String cefr;
  final String article;
  final String plural;
  final List<String> accepted;
}

final class SrsVerbRow {
  SrsVerbRow({
    required this.contentId,
    required this.infinitive,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.group,
    required this.person,
    required this.personAr,
    required this.form,
    required this.past,
    required this.pastArabic,
    required this.example,
    required this.exampleAr,
    required this.pastExample,
    required this.pastExampleAr,
  });

  final String contentId;
  final String infinitive;
  final String arabic;
  final String group;
  final String person;
  final String personAr;
  final String form;
  final String past;
  final String pastArabic;
  final String example;
  final String exampleAr;
  final String pastExample;
  final String pastExampleAr;
}

final class IndexedSrsCorpusRepository {
  IndexedSrsCorpusRepository._(this._database, this.verification);

  final Database _database;
  final SrsCorpusVerification verification;

  static Future<IndexedSrsCorpusRepository> open(
    Database database, {
    required SrsCorpusCardinality expectedCardinality,
    required String sourceContentSha256,
  }) async {
    final verification = await verifyDatabase(
      database,
      expectedCardinality: expectedCardinality,
      sourceContentSha256: sourceContentSha256,
    );
    return IndexedSrsCorpusRepository._(database, verification);
  }

  static Future<SrsCorpusVerification> verifyDatabase(
    Database database, {
    required SrsCorpusCardinality expectedCardinality,
    required String sourceContentSha256,
  }) async {
    final metadata = await _metadata(database);
    if (metadata['state'] != 'ready') {
      throw StateError('srs_corpus_not_ready');
    }
    final schemaVersion = int.tryParse(
      metadata[SrsCorpusContract.metadataSchemaVersionKey] ?? '',
    );
    if (schemaVersion != SrsCorpusContract.schemaVersion) {
      throw StateError('srs_corpus_schema_mismatch');
    }

    final declaredContentRows = _requiredMetadataInt(
      metadata,
      SrsCorpusContract.metadataContentRowsKey,
      allowZero: false,
    );
    final declaredVerbRows = _requiredMetadataInt(
      metadata,
      SrsCorpusContract.metadataVerbRowsKey,
      allowZero: true,
    );
    if (declaredContentRows != expectedCardinality.contentRows ||
        declaredVerbRows != expectedCardinality.verbRows) {
      throw StateError('srs_corpus_declared_cardinality_mismatch');
    }

    final expectedSha256 = sourceContentSha256.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!RegExp(r'^[a-f0-9]{64}$').hasMatch(expectedSha256)) {
      throw StateError('srs_corpus_source_sha256_invalid');
    }
    final declaredSha256 =
        metadata[SrsCorpusContract.metadataSourceContentSha256Key]
            ?.trim()
            .toLowerCase();
    if (declaredSha256 != expectedSha256) {
      throw StateError('srs_corpus_source_sha256_mismatch');
    }

    final contentRows = await _count(
      database,
      SrsCorpusContract.contentTable,
    );
    final verbRows = await _count(
      database,
      SrsCorpusContract.verbTable,
    );

    if (contentRows != expectedCardinality.contentRows) {
      throw StateError(
        'srs_corpus_content_cardinality_mismatch:'
        '$contentRows/${expectedCardinality.contentRows}',
      );
    }
    if (verbRows != expectedCardinality.verbRows) {
      throw StateError(
        'srs_corpus_verb_cardinality_mismatch:'
        '$verbRows/${expectedCardinality.verbRows}',
      );
    }

    final indexRows = await database.rawQuery(
      "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master "
      "WHERE type = 'index' AND name LIKE 'idx_srs_%'",
    );
    final indexes = indexRows
        .map((row) => row['name']?.toString())
        .whereType<String>()
        .toSet();
    if (!indexes.containsAll(SrsCorpusContract.requiredIndexes)) {
      throw StateError('srs_corpus_required_index_missing');
    }

    await _verifySqliteIntegrity(database);

    return SrsCorpusVerification(
      schemaVersion: schemaVersion!,
      contentRows: contentRows,
      verbRows: verbRows,
      expectedContentRows: expectedCardinality.contentRows,
      expectedVerbRows: expectedCardinality.verbRows,
      sourceContentSha256: expectedSha256,
      indexes: Set<String>.unmodifiable(indexes),
    );
  }

  Future<List<SrsCorpusItem>> fetchPage({
    String? afterId,
    String? topic,
    String? skill,
    int limit = 32,
  }) async {
    final safeLimit = limit.clamp(1, 128).toInt();
    final clauses = <String>[];
    final args = <Object?>[];

    final cleanAfter = afterId?.trim();
    if (cleanAfter != null && cleanAfter.isNotEmpty) {
      clauses.add('id > ?');
      args.add(cleanAfter);
    }
    final cleanTopic = topic?.trim();
    if (cleanTopic != null && cleanTopic.isNotEmpty) {
      clauses.add('topic = ?');
      args.add(cleanTopic);
    }
    final cleanSkill = skill?.trim();
    if (cleanSkill != null && cleanSkill.isNotEmpty) {
      clauses.add('skill = ?');
      args.add(cleanSkill);
    }

    final rows = await _database.query(
      SrsCorpusContract.contentTable,
      columns: const <String>[
        'id',
        'german',
        'arabic',
        'sentence',
        'sentence_ar',
        'topic',
        'skill',
        'cefr',
        'article',
        'plural',
      ],
      where: clauses.isEmpty ? null : clauses.join(' AND '),
      whereArgs: args.isEmpty ? null : args,
      orderBy: 'id ASC',
      limit: safeLimit,
    );
    return _hydrate(rows);
  }

  Future<List<SrsCorpusItem>> fetchByIds(Iterable<String> ids) async {
    final normalized = ids
        .map((id) => id.trim())
        .where((id) => id.isNotEmpty)
        .toSet()
        .toList(growable: false);
    if (normalized.isEmpty) return const <SrsCorpusItem>[];
    if (normalized.length > 128) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        normalized.length,
        'ids',
        'SRS corpus slices are bounded to 128 IDs',
      );
    }

    final placeholders =
        List<String>.filled(normalized.length, '?').join(',');
    final rows = await _database.rawQuery(
      '''
SELECT id, german, arabic, sentence, sentence_ar, topic, skill, cefr, article, plural
FROM ${SrsCorpusContract.contentTable}
WHERE id IN ($placeholders)
''',
      normalized,
    );

    final hydrated = await _hydrate(rows);
    final byId = <String, SrsCorpusItem>{
      for (final item in hydrated) item.id: item,
    };
    return normalized
        .map((id) => byId[id])
        .whereType<SrsCorpusItem>()
        .toList(growable: false);
  }

  Future<List<SrsCorpusItem>> searchContent({
    Iterable<String> terms = const <String>[],
    Set<String> cefrLevels = const <String>{},
    Set<String> articles = const <String>{},
    int limit = 80,
  }) async {
    final safeLimit = limit.clamp(1, 200).toInt();
    final normalizedTerms = terms
        .map((value) => value.trim())
        .where((value) => value.isNotEmpty && value.length <= 200)
        .toSet()
        .take(6)
        .toList(growable: false);
    final normalizedLevels = cefrLevels
        .map((value) => value.trim().toUpperCase())
        .where(
          (value) => const <String>{'A1', 'A2', 'B1', 'B2'}.contains(value),
        )
        .toSet()
        .toList(growable: false);
    final normalizedArticles = articles
        .map((value) => value.trim().toLowerCase())
        .where((value) => const <String>{'der', 'die', 'das'}.contains(value))
        .toSet()
        .toList(growable: false);

    final clauses = <String>[];
    final args = <Object?>[];

    if (normalizedTerms.isNotEmpty) {
      final textClauses = <String>[];
      for (final term in normalizedTerms) {
        textClauses.add(
          '(german LIKE ? COLLATE NOCASE OR arabic LIKE ? '
          'OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ${SrsCorpusContract.acceptedTable} a '
          'WHERE a.content_id = ${SrsCorpusContract.contentTable}.id '
          'AND a.form LIKE ? COLLATE NOCASE))',
        );
        final pattern = '%$term%';
        args.addAll(<Object?>[pattern, pattern, pattern]);
      }
      clauses.add('(${textClauses.join(' OR ')})');
    }

    if (normalizedLevels.isNotEmpty) {
      final placeholders =
          List<String>.filled(normalizedLevels.length, '?').join(',');
      clauses.add('cefr IN ($placeholders)');
      args.addAll(normalizedLevels);
    }

    if (normalizedArticles.isNotEmpty) {
      final placeholders =
          List<String>.filled(normalizedArticles.length, '?').join(',');
      clauses.add('article IN ($placeholders)');
      args.addAll(normalizedArticles);
    }

    final where = clauses.isEmpty ? '' : 'WHERE ${clauses.join(' AND ')}';
    final rows = await _database.rawQuery(
      '''
SELECT id, german, arabic, sentence, sentence_ar, topic, skill, cefr, article, plural
FROM ${SrsCorpusContract.contentTable}
$where
ORDER BY german COLLATE NOCASE ASC, id ASC
LIMIT ?
''',
      <Object?>[...args, safeLimit],
    );
    return _hydrate(rows);
  }
  Future<List<SrsVerbRow>> fetchVerbRows({
    required String infinitive,
    int limit = 32,
  }) async {
    final clean = infinitive.trim();
    if (clean.isEmpty) return const <SrsVerbRow>[];

    final rows = await _database.query(
      SrsCorpusContract.verbTable,
      where: 'infinitive = ?',
      whereArgs: <Object?>[clean],
      orderBy: 'content_id ASC, row_ordinal ASC',
      limit: limit.clamp(1, 128).toInt(),
    );
    return rows.map(_verbFromRow).toList(growable: false);
  }

  Future<List<SrsCorpusItem>> _hydrate(
    List<Map<String, Object?>> rows,
  ) async {
    if (rows.isEmpty) return const <SrsCorpusItem>[];

    final ids = rows.map((row) => row['id']!.toString()).toList();
    final placeholders = List<String>.filled(ids.length, '?').join(',');
    final acceptedRows = await _database.rawQuery(
      '''
SELECT content_id, ordinal, form
FROM ${SrsCorpusContract.acceptedTable}
WHERE content_id IN ($placeholders)
ORDER BY content_id ASC, ordinal ASC
''',
      ids,
    );

    final accepted = <String, List<String>>{};
    for (final row in acceptedRows) {
      final id = row['content_id']!.toString();
      accepted.putIfAbsent(id, () => <String>[]).add(
            row['form']!.toString(),
          );
    }

    return rows
        .map(
          (row) => SrsCorpusItem(
            id: row['id']!.toString(),
            german: row['german']!.toString(),
            arabic: row['arabic']!.toString(),
            sentence: row['sentence']!.toString(),
            sentenceAr: row['sentence_ar']!.toString(),
            topic: row['topic']!.toString(),
            skill: row['skill']!.toString(),
            cefr: row['cefr']!.toString(),
            article: row['article']!.toString(),
            plural: row['plural']!.toString(),
            accepted: List<String>.unmodifiable(
              accepted[row['id']!.toString()] ?? const <String>[],
            ),
          ),
        )
        .toList(growable: false);
  }

  static Future<Map<String, String>> _metadata(Database database) async {
    final rows = await database.query(
      SrsCorpusContract.metadataTable,
      limit: 32,
    );
    return <String, String>{
      for (final row in rows)
        if (row['key'] != null && row['value'] != null)
          row['key'].toString(): row['value'].toString(),
    };
  }

  static int _requiredMetadataInt(
    Map<String, String> metadata,
    String key, {
    required bool allowZero,
  }) {
    final value = int.tryParse(metadata[key] ?? '');
    final minimum = allowZero ? 0 : 1;
    if (value == null || value < minimum) {
      throw StateError('srs_corpus_metadata_invalid:$key');
    }
    return value;
  }

  static Future<void> _verifySqliteIntegrity(Database database) async {
    final integrityRows = await database.rawQuery('PRAGMA quick_check');
    final integrityOk = integrityRows.length == 1 &&
        integrityRows.single.values.any(
          (value) => value?.toString().toLowerCase() == 'ok',
        );
    if (!integrityOk) {
      throw StateError('srs_corpus_integrity_check_failed');
    }

    final foreignKeyRows = await database.rawQuery('PRAGMA foreign_key_check');
    if (foreignKeyRows.isNotEmpty) {
      throw StateError('srs_corpus_foreign_key_check_failed');
    }
  }

  static Future<int> _count(Database database, String table) async {
    final rows = await database.rawQuery(
      'SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM $table',
    );
    if (rows.length != 1) {
      throw StateError('srs_corpus_count_failed:$table');
    }
    final raw = rows.single['count'];
    if (raw is int) return raw;
    return int.parse(raw.toString());
  }

  static SrsVerbRow _verbFromRow(Map<String, Object?> row) => SrsVerbRow(
        contentId: row['content_id']!.toString(),
        infinitive: row['infinitive']!.toString(),
        arabic: row['arabic']!.toString(),
        group: row['group_name']!.toString(),
        person: row['person']!.toString(),
        personAr: row['person_ar']!.toString(),
        form: row['form']!.toString(),
        past: row['past']!.toString(),
        pastArabic: row['past_arabic']!.toString(),
        example: row['example']!.toString(),
        exampleAr: row['example_ar']!.toString(),
        pastExample: row['past_example']!.toString(),
        pastExampleAr: row['past_example_ar']!.toString(),
      );
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/story_models.dart';
import '../domain/story_repository.dart';

final class StoryReaderState {
  const StoryReaderState({
    this.story,
    this.paragraphIndex = 0,
    this.revealedWord,
    this.showParagraphTranslation = false,
    this.answers = const <String, String>{},
    this.answerCorrectness = const <String, bool>{},
    this.isLoading = false,
    this.errorMessage,
  });

  final StoryItem? story;
  final int paragraphIndex;
  final StoryInteractiveWord? revealedWord;
  final bool showParagraphTranslation;
  final Map<String, String> answers;
  final Map<String, bool> answerCorrectness;
  final bool isLoading;
  final String? errorMessage;

  StoryParagraph? get currentParagraph {
    final value = story;
    if (value == null || paragraphIndex >= value.paragraphs.length) return null;
    return value.paragraphs[paragraphIndex];
  }

  bool get isLastParagraph {
    final value = story;
    return value != null && paragraphIndex == value.paragraphs.length - 1;
  }
}

class StoryReaderNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  StoryReaderNotifier({required StoryRepository repository})
      : _repository = repository;

  final StoryRepository _repository;
  StoryReaderState _state = const StoryReaderState();

  StoryReaderState get state => _state;

  double get completionFraction {
    final story = _state.story;
    if (story == null) return 0;
    final paragraphUnits = _state.paragraphIndex + 1;
    final completedUnits = paragraphUnits + _state.answers.length;
    final totalUnits = story.paragraphs.length + story.questions.length;
    return (completedUnits / totalUnits).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
  }

  int get comprehensionScorePercent {
    final story = _state.story;
    if (story == null || story.questions.isEmpty) return 0;
    final correct = _state.answerCorrectness.values.where((value) => value).length;
    return ((correct / story.questions.length) * 100).round();
  }

  bool get comprehensionComplete {
    final story = _state.story;
    return story != null && _state.answers.length == story.questions.length;
  }

  Future<void> loadStory(String storyId) async {
    if (_state.isLoading) return;
    _setState(const StoryReaderState(isLoading: true));
    try {
      final story = await _repository.getStory(storyId);
      if (story == null) {
        _setState(
          const StoryReaderState(errorMessage: 'القصة المطلوبة غير موجودة.'),
        );
        return;
      }
      _setState(StoryReaderState(story: story));
    } catch (error) {
      _setState(StoryReaderState(errorMessage: error.toString()));
    }
  }

  void nextParagraph() {
    final story = _state.story;
    if (story == null || _state.paragraphIndex >= story.paragraphs.length - 1) {
      return;
    }
    _setState(
      StoryReaderState(
        story: story,
        paragraphIndex: _state.paragraphIndex + 1,
        answers: _state.answers,
        answerCorrectness: _state.answerCorrectness,
      ),
    );
  }

  void previousParagraph() {
    final story = _state.story;
    if (story == null || _state.paragraphIndex <= 0) return;
    _setState(
      StoryReaderState(
        story: story,
        paragraphIndex: _state.paragraphIndex - 1,
        answers: _state.answers,
        answerCorrectness: _state.answerCorrectness,
      ),
    );
  }

  void toggleWordMeaning(String wordId) {
    final paragraph = _state.currentParagraph;
    if (paragraph == null) return;
    final word = paragraph.wordById(wordId);
    if (word == null) return;
    final sameWord = _state.revealedWord?.id == word.id;
    _setState(
      StoryReaderState(
        story: _state.story,
        paragraphIndex: _state.paragraphIndex,
        revealedWord: sameWord ? null : word,
        showParagraphTranslation: _state.showParagraphTranslation,
        answers: _state.answers,
        answerCorrectness: _state.answerCorrectness,
      ),
    );
  }

  void toggleParagraphTranslation() {
    if (_state.currentParagraph == null) return;
    _setState(
      StoryReaderState(
        story: _state.story,
        paragraphIndex: _state.paragraphIndex,
        revealedWord: _state.revealedWord,
        showParagraphTranslation: !_state.showParagraphTranslation,
        answers: _state.answers,
        answerCorrectness: _state.answerCorrectness,
      ),
    );
  }

  void answerQuestion(String questionId, String optionId) {
    final story = _state.story;
    if (story == null) return;
    StoryComprehensionQuestion? question;
    for (final candidate in story.questions) {
      if (candidate.id == questionId) {
        question = candidate;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (question == null ||
        !question.options.any((option) => option.id == optionId)) {
      return;
    }

    _setState(
      StoryReaderState(
        story: story,
        paragraphIndex: _state.paragraphIndex,
        revealedWord: _state.revealedWord,
        showParagraphTranslation: _state.showParagraphTranslation,
        answers: Map<String, String>.unmodifiable(
          <String, String>{..._state.answers, questionId: optionId},
        ),
        answerCorrectness: Map<String, bool>.unmodifiable(
          <String, bool>{
            ..._state.answerCorrectness,
            questionId: question.isCorrect(optionId),
          },
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _setState(StoryReaderState value) {
    _state = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

import '../../audio/domain/entities/audio_request.dart';
import '../../audio/domain/services/i_audio_runtime.dart';
import '../domain/story_audio_port.dart';

final class StoryAudioRuntimeAdapter implements StoryAudioPort {
  const StoryAudioRuntimeAdapter({
    required this.runtime,
    this.languageCode = 'de',
  });

  final IAudioRuntime runtime;
  final String languageCode;

  @override
  Future<bool> speak({
    required String text,
    required String conceptId,
  }) async {
    final value = text.trim();
    if (value.isEmpty) return false;
    final result = await runtime.play(
      AudioRequest(
        text: value,
        languageCode: languageCode,
        conceptId: conceptId,
        variant: AudioVariant.sentence,
      ),
    );
    return result.played;
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/stories/domain/story_models.dart

enum StoryLevel {
  a1('A1'),
  a2('A2');

  const StoryLevel(this.label);
  final String label;
}

final class StoryInteractiveWord {
  const StoryInteractiveWord({
    required this.id,
    required this.surface,
    required this.meaningArabic,
  });

  final String id;
  final String surface;
  final String meaningArabic;
}

final class StoryWordToken {
  const StoryWordToken({
    required this.displayText,
    this.interactiveWord,
  });

  final String displayText;
  final StoryInteractiveWord? interactiveWord;
  bool get isInteractive => interactiveWord != null;
}

final class StoryParagraph {
  StoryParagraph({
    required this.textGerman,
    required this.translationArabic,
    required List<StoryInteractiveWord> interactiveWords,
  }) : interactiveWords = List<StoryInteractiveWord>.unmodifiable(
          interactiveWords,
        ) {
    if (textGerman.trim().isEmpty || translationArabic.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('Story paragraph text and translation are required.');
    }
  }

  final String textGerman;
  final String translationArabic;
  final List<StoryInteractiveWord> interactiveWords;

  List<StoryWordToken> get tokens {
    final lookup = <String, StoryInteractiveWord>{
      for (final word in interactiveWords) _normalize(word.surface): word,
    };
    return textGerman
        .trim()
        .split(RegExp(r'\s+'))
        .map(
          (part) => StoryWordToken(
            displayText: part,
            interactiveWord: lookup[_normalize(part)],
          ),
        )
        .toList(growable: false);
  }

  StoryInteractiveWord? wordById(String id) {
    for (final word in interactiveWords) {
      if (word.id == id) return word;
    }
    return null;
  }

  static String _normalize(String value) => value
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[.,!?;:"„“‚‘()\[\]{}]'), '');
}

final class StoryQuestionOption {
  const StoryQuestionOption({
    required this.id,
    required this.textArabic,
  });

  final String id;
  final String textArabic;
}

final class StoryComprehensionQuestion {
  StoryComprehensionQuestion({
    required this.id,
    required this.promptArabic,
    required List<StoryQuestionOption> options,
    required this.correctOptionId,
  }) : options = List<StoryQuestionOption>.unmodifiable(options) {
    if (id.trim().isEmpty ||
        promptArabic.trim().isEmpty ||
        options.length < 2 ||
        !options.any((option) => option.id == correctOptionId)) {
      throw ArgumentError('Invalid comprehension question.');
    }
  }

  final String id;
  final String promptArabic;
  final List<StoryQuestionOption> options;
  final String correctOptionId;

  bool isCorrect(String optionId) => optionId == correctOptionId;
}

final class StoryItem {
  StoryItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.titleArabic,
    required this.titleGerman,
    required this.level,
    required this.coverKey,
    required List<StoryParagraph> paragraphs,
    required List<StoryComprehensionQuestion> questions,
  })  : paragraphs = List<StoryParagraph>.unmodifiable(paragraphs),
        questions = List<StoryComprehensionQuestion>.unmodifiable(questions) {
    if (id.trim().isEmpty ||
        titleArabic.trim().isEmpty ||
        titleGerman.trim().isEmpty ||
        paragraphs.isEmpty ||
        questions.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('Story identity, paragraphs and questions are required.');
    }
  }

  final String id;
  final String titleArabic;
  final String titleGerman;
  final StoryLevel level;
  final String coverKey;
  final List<StoryParagraph> paragraphs;
  final List<StoryComprehensionQuestion> questions;
}

      await widget.audioPort.speak(

FILE: lib/features/sync/application/sync_conflict_resolver.dart
