import '../domain/sync_models.dart';

final class SyncConflictResolver {
  const SyncConflictResolver();

  bool requiresUserResolution({
    required SyncProgressSnapshot local,
    required SyncProgressSnapshot remote,
  }) {
    if (local.revision == remote.revision) return false;
    return local.updatedAtUtc.isAtSameMomentAs(remote.updatedAtUtc);
  }

  SyncProgressSnapshot resolve({
    required SyncProgressSnapshot local,
    required SyncProgressSnapshot remote,
    required SyncConflictResolutionStrategy strategy,
  }) {
    final newer = remote.updatedAtUtc.isAfter(local.updatedAtUtc) ? remote : local;

    final mergedSrs = _mergeSrs(local.srs, remote.srs);
    final mergedAchievements = <String>{
      ...local.achievementIds,
      ...remote.achievementIds,
    };
    final protectedCurrent =
        local.currentStreak > remote.currentStreak
            ? local.currentStreak
            : remote.currentStreak;
    final protectedLongest =
        local.longestStreak > remote.longestStreak
            ? local.longestStreak
            : remote.longestStreak;
    final safeLongest =
        protectedLongest < protectedCurrent ? protectedCurrent : protectedLongest;

    return switch (strategy) {
      SyncConflictResolutionStrategy.lastWriteWinsProtectHigherStreak =>
        newer.copyWith(
          currentStreak: protectedCurrent,
          longestStreak: safeLongest,
          srs: mergedSrs,
          achievementIds: mergedAchievements,
        ),
      SyncConflictResolutionStrategy.mergeProgress => newer.copyWith(
          currentStreak: protectedCurrent,
          longestStreak: safeLongest,
          totalXp: local.totalXp > remote.totalXp
              ? local.totalXp
              : remote.totalXp,
          srs: mergedSrs,
          achievementIds: mergedAchievements,
        ),
      SyncConflictResolutionStrategy.keepLocal => local.copyWith(
          currentStreak: protectedCurrent,
          longestStreak: safeLongest,
        ),
      SyncConflictResolutionStrategy.keepRemote => remote.copyWith(
          currentStreak: protectedCurrent,
          longestStreak: safeLongest,
        ),
    };
  }

  Map<String, SyncSrsRecord> _mergeSrs(
    Map<String, SyncSrsRecord> local,
    Map<String, SyncSrsRecord> remote,
  ) {
    final keys = <String>{...local.keys, ...remote.keys};
    final result = <String, SyncSrsRecord>{};
    for (final key in keys) {
      final left = local[key];
      final right = remote[key];
      if (left == null) {
        result[key] = right!;
        continue;
      }
      if (right == null) {
        result[key] = left;
        continue;
      }
      if (right.updatedAtUtc.isAfter(left.updatedAtUtc)) {
        result[key] = right;
      } else if (left.updatedAtUtc.isAfter(right.updatedAtUtc)) {
        result[key] = left;
      } else {
        result[key] = _tieBreak(left, right);
      }
    }
    return Map<String, SyncSrsRecord>.unmodifiable(result);
  }

  SyncSrsRecord _tieBreak(SyncSrsRecord left, SyncSrsRecord right) {
    final leftEvidence = left.successes + left.failures + left.repetitions;
    final rightEvidence = right.successes + right.failures + right.repetitions;
    if (rightEvidence > leftEvidence) return right;
    if (leftEvidence > rightEvidence) return left;
    return right.dueAtUtc.isAfter(left.dueAtUtc) ? right : left;
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/sync_models.dart';
import '../domain/sync_services.dart';
import 'sync_conflict_resolver.dart';

final class SyncCoordinatorState {
  const SyncCoordinatorState({
    this.status = SyncStatus.offline,
    this.pendingCount = 0,
    this.conflict,
    this.lastSyncedAtUtc,
    this.message,
  });

  final SyncStatus status;
  final int pendingCount;
  final SyncConflict? conflict;
  final DateTime? lastSyncedAtUtc;
  final String? message;

  SyncCoordinatorState copyWith({
    SyncStatus? status,
    int? pendingCount,
    SyncConflict? conflict,
    bool clearConflict = false,
    DateTime? lastSyncedAtUtc,
    String? message,
    bool clearMessage = false,
  }) {
    return SyncCoordinatorState(
      status: status ?? this.status,
      pendingCount: pendingCount ?? this.pendingCount,
      conflict: clearConflict ? null : conflict ?? this.conflict,
      lastSyncedAtUtc: lastSyncedAtUtc ?? this.lastSyncedAtUtc,
      message: clearMessage ? null : message ?? this.message,
    );
  }
}

final class SyncCoordinatorNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  SyncCoordinatorNotifier({
    required this.syncKey,
    required SyncRepository repository,
    required CloudStorageService cloud,
    required ConnectivityService connectivity,
    SyncConflictResolver resolver = const SyncConflictResolver(),
  })  : _repository = repository,
        _cloud = cloud,
        _connectivity = connectivity,
        _resolver = resolver {
    if (syncKey.trim().isEmpty || syncKey.length > 160) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(syncKey, 'syncKey', 'invalid sync key');
    }
  }

  final String syncKey;
  final SyncRepository _repository;
  final CloudStorageService _cloud;
  final ConnectivityService _connectivity;
  final SyncConflictResolver _resolver;

  SyncCoordinatorState _state = const SyncCoordinatorState();
  StreamSubscription<bool>? _connectivitySubscription;
  Future<void> _serial = Future<void>.value();
  bool _disposed = false;

  SyncCoordinatorState get state => _state;

  Future<void> start() async {
    if (_disposed) return;
    await _connectivitySubscription?.cancel();
    final pending = await _repository.pendingMutations();
    final online = await _connectivity.isOnline();
    _state = _state.copyWith(
      status: online ? SyncStatus.upToDate : SyncStatus.offline,
      pendingCount: pending.length,
      clearMessage: true,
    );
    notifyListeners();

    _connectivitySubscription = _connectivity.changes.distinct().listen(
      _onConnectivityChanged,
    );

    if (online) {
      await syncNow();
    }
  }

  Future<void> enqueueMutation(SyncQueueItem item) async {
    await _repository.enqueue(item);
    final pending = await _repository.pendingMutations();
    _state = _state.copyWith(pendingCount: pending.length);
    notifyListeners();

    if (await _connectivity.isOnline()) {
      await syncNow();
    } else {
      _setStatus(SyncStatus.offline);
    }
  }

  Future<void> saveLocalSnapshot(
    SyncProgressSnapshot snapshot, {
    SyncQueueItem? mutation,
  }) async {
    await _repository.saveSnapshot(snapshot);
    if (mutation != null) {
      await _repository.enqueue(mutation);
    }
    final pending = await _repository.pendingMutations();
    _state = _state.copyWith(pendingCount: pending.length);
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> syncNow() => _serialize(_syncNowInternal);

  Future<void> settle() => _serial;

  Future<void> resolveConflict(
    SyncConflictResolutionStrategy strategy,
  ) {
    return _serialize(() async {
      final conflict = _state.conflict;
      if (conflict == null) return;
      if (!await _connectivity.isOnline()) {
        _setStatus(SyncStatus.offline);
        return;
      }

      _setStatus(SyncStatus.syncing);
      final resolved = _resolver.resolve(
        local: conflict.local,
        remote: conflict.remote,
        strategy: strategy,
      );
      await _repository.saveSnapshot(resolved);
      final pending = await _repository.pendingMutations();
      final result = await _cloud.pushSnapshot(
        syncKey: syncKey,
        snapshot: resolved,
        mutations: pending,
        expectedRevision: conflict.remote.revision,
      );
      await _applyPushResult(result, pending);
    });
  }

  Future<void> _syncNowInternal() async {
    if (_disposed) return;
    if (_state.status == SyncStatus.conflictDetected &&
        _state.conflict != null) {
      return;
    }
    if (!await _connectivity.isOnline()) {
      _setStatus(SyncStatus.offline);
      return;
    }

    _setStatus(SyncStatus.syncing);
    try {
      final pending = await _repository.pendingMutations();
      final local = await _repository.loadSnapshot();
      final remote = await _cloud.fetchSnapshot(syncKey);

      if (local == null && pending.isNotEmpty) {
        throw StateError('Pending mutations require a local snapshot.');
      }

      if (local == null && remote == null) {
        _state = _state.copyWith(
          status: SyncStatus.upToDate,
          pendingCount: 0,
          lastSyncedAtUtc: DateTime.now().toUtc(),
          clearConflict: true,
          clearMessage: true,
        );
        notifyListeners();
        return;
      }

      if (local == null && remote != null) {
        await _repository.saveSnapshot(remote);
        _state = _state.copyWith(
          status: SyncStatus.upToDate,
          pendingCount: 0,
          lastSyncedAtUtc: DateTime.now().toUtc(),
          clearConflict: true,
          clearMessage: true,
        );
        notifyListeners();
        return;
      }

      if (local != null && remote == null) {
        final result = await _cloud.pushSnapshot(
          syncKey: syncKey,
          snapshot: local,
          mutations: pending,
        );
        await _applyPushResult(result, pending);
        return;
      }

      final safeLocal = local!;
      final safeRemote = remote!;
      if (_resolver.requiresUserResolution(
        local: safeLocal,
        remote: safeRemote,
      )) {
        _state = _state.copyWith(
          status: SyncStatus.conflictDetected,
          pendingCount: pending.length,
          conflict: SyncConflict(local: safeLocal, remote: safeRemote),
          message: 'sync_conflict_requires_confirmation',
        );
        notifyListeners();
        return;
      }

      final resolved = _resolver.resolve(
        local: safeLocal,
        remote: safeRemote,
        strategy:
            SyncConflictResolutionStrategy.lastWriteWinsProtectHigherStreak,
      );
      await _repository.saveSnapshot(resolved);
      final result = await _cloud.pushSnapshot(
        syncKey: syncKey,
        snapshot: resolved,
        mutations: pending,
        expectedRevision: safeRemote.revision,
      );
      await _applyPushResult(result, pending);
    } on Object {
      final pending = await _repository.pendingMutations();
      _state = _state.copyWith(
        status: SyncStatus.offline,
        pendingCount: pending.length,
        message: 'sync_unavailable_queue_preserved',
      );
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _applyPushResult(
    CloudPushResult result,
    List<SyncQueueItem> pending,
  ) async {
    if (!result.applied) {
      final local = await _repository.loadSnapshot();
      final remote = result.conflict;
      if (local != null && remote != null) {
        _state = _state.copyWith(
          status: SyncStatus.conflictDetected,
          pendingCount: pending.length,
          conflict: SyncConflict(local: local, remote: remote),
          message: 'sync_conflict_requires_confirmation',
        );
        notifyListeners();
        return;
      }
      throw StateError('Cloud conflict did not include a remote snapshot.');
    }

    final applied = result.snapshot;
    if (applied == null) {
      throw StateError('Applied cloud result requires a snapshot.');
    }

    await _repository.saveSnapshot(applied);
    await _repository.acknowledge(
      pending.map((item) => item.id).toSet(),
    );
    final remaining = await _repository.pendingMutations();
    _state = _state.copyWith(
      status: SyncStatus.upToDate,
      pendingCount: remaining.length,
      lastSyncedAtUtc: DateTime.now().toUtc(),
      clearConflict: true,
      clearMessage: true,
    );
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void _onConnectivityChanged(bool online) {
    if (_disposed) return;
    if (!online) {
      _setStatus(SyncStatus.offline);
      return;
    }
    unawaited(syncNow());
  }

  Future<T> _serialize<T>(Future<T> Function() operation) {
    final completer = Completer<T>();
    _serial = _serial.then((_) async {
      try {
        completer.complete(await operation());
      } on Object catch (error, stackTrace) {
        completer.completeError(error, stackTrace);
      }
    });
    return completer.future;
  }

  void _setStatus(SyncStatus status) {
    if (_disposed) return;
    _state = _state.copyWith(status: status);
    notifyListeners();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _disposed = true;
    unawaited(_connectivitySubscription?.cancel());
    super.dispose();
  }
}

import '../../../core/srs_facets.dart';
import '../../../features/gamification/domain/gamification_models.dart';
import '../../../models/learner.dart';
import '../domain/sync_models.dart';

abstract final class CanonicalSyncSnapshotMapper {
  static SyncProgressSnapshot fromCanonicalState({
    required LearnerState learner,
    required GamificationSnapshot gamification,
    required String revision,
  }) {
    final srs = <String, SyncSrsRecord>{};
    for (final entry in learner.reviewCards.entries) {
      final card = entry.value;
      final updatedAt =
          card.lastReviewedAt?.toUtc() ?? learner.updatedAt.toUtc();
      srs[entry.key] = SyncSrsRecord(
        key: entry.key,
        updatedAtUtc: updatedAt,
        dueAtUtc: card.dueAt.toUtc(),
        repetitions: card.repetitions,
        intervalDays: card.intervalDays,
        lapses: card.lapses,
        successes: card.successes,
        failures: card.failures,
        difficulty: card.difficulty,
        stabilityDays: card.stabilityDays,
        lastReviewedAtUtc: card.lastReviewedAt?.toUtc(),
      );
    }

    final profile = gamification.profile;

    return SyncProgressSnapshot(
      revision: revision,
      updatedAtUtc: learner.updatedAt.toUtc(),
      currentStreak: profile.currentStreak,
      longestStreak: profile.longestStreak,
      totalXp: profile.totalXp,
      srs: srs,
      achievementIds: gamification.unlockedBadgeIds,
    );
  }

  static LearnerState applyToLearnerState({
    required LearnerState local,
    required SyncProgressSnapshot snapshot,
  }) {
    final reviewCards = <String, ReviewCard>{...local.reviewCards};

    for (final entry in snapshot.srs.entries) {
      final key = ReviewFacetKey.fromStorageKey(entry.key);
      if (!key.isValid) continue;
      final record = entry.value;
      reviewCards[entry.key] = ReviewCard(
        itemId: key.conceptId,
        facetType: key.facetType,
        variantKey: key.normalizedVariantKey,
        repetitions: record.repetitions,
        intervalDays: record.intervalDays,
        lapses: record.lapses,
        successes: record.successes,
        failures: record.failures,
        difficulty: record.difficulty,
        stabilityDays: record.stabilityDays,
        dueAt: record.dueAtUtc,
        lastReviewedAt: record.lastReviewedAtUtc,
      );
    }

    return local.copyWith(
      reviewCards: reviewCards,
    );
  }
}

import '../../../core/infrastructure/storage/local_storage_repository.dart';
import '../domain/sync_models.dart';
import '../domain/sync_services.dart';

final class LocalSyncRepository implements SyncRepository {
  LocalSyncRepository(this._storage);

  final LocalStorageRepository _storage;
  Future<void> _writeTail = Future<void>.value();

  @override
  Future<void> enqueue(SyncQueueItem item) {
    return _serialize(() async {
      final state = await _readState();
      final byEntity = <String, SyncQueueItem>{
        for (final existing in state.queue) existing.entityKey: existing,
      };
      final previous = byEntity[item.entityKey];
      if (previous == null ||
          !item.updatedAtUtc.isBefore(previous.updatedAtUtc)) {
        byEntity[item.entityKey] = item;
      }
      final queue = byEntity.values.toList(growable: false)
        ..sort((a, b) {
          final time = a.updatedAtUtc.compareTo(b.updatedAtUtc);
          return time != 0 ? time : a.id.compareTo(b.id);
        });
      await _writeState(_StoredSyncState(queue: queue, snapshot: state.snapshot));
    });
  }

  @override
  Future<List<SyncQueueItem>> pendingMutations() async {
    final state = await _readAfterWrites();
    return List<SyncQueueItem>.unmodifiable(state.queue);
  }

  @override
  Future<void> acknowledge(Set<String> ids) {
    if (ids.isEmpty) return Future<void>.value();
    return _serialize(() async {
      final state = await _readState();
      final queue = state.queue
          .where((item) => !ids.contains(item.id))
          .toList(growable: false);
      await _writeState(_StoredSyncState(queue: queue, snapshot: state.snapshot));
    });
  }

  @override
  Future<SyncProgressSnapshot?> loadSnapshot() async =>
      (await _readAfterWrites()).snapshot;

  @override
  Future<void> saveSnapshot(SyncProgressSnapshot snapshot) {
    return _serialize(() async {
      final state = await _readState();
      await _writeState(_StoredSyncState(queue: state.queue, snapshot: snapshot));
    });
  }

  Future<T> _serialize<T>(Future<T> Function() action) {
    final next = _writeTail.then((_) => action());
    _writeTail = next.then<void>((_) {}).catchError((_) {});
    return next;
  }

  Future<_StoredSyncState> _readAfterWrites() async {
    await _writeTail;
    return _readState();
  }

  Future<_StoredSyncState> _readState() async {
    final raw = await _storage.load(StorageBucket.syncPendingMutations);
    if (raw == null) return const _StoredSyncState();

    final queue = <SyncQueueItem>[];
    final rawQueue = raw['queue'];
    if (rawQueue is List) {
      for (final entry in rawQueue.whereType<Map>()) {
        final json = <String, Object?>{
          for (final item in entry.entries)
            if (item.key is String) item.key as String: item.value,
        };
        try {
          queue.add(SyncQueueItem.fromJson(json));
        } on FormatException {
          continue;
        } on ArgumentError {
          continue;
        }
      }
    }

    SyncProgressSnapshot? snapshot;
    final rawSnapshot = raw['snapshot'];
    if (rawSnapshot is Map) {
      final json = <String, Object?>{
        for (final entry in rawSnapshot.entries)
          if (entry.key is String) entry.key as String: entry.value,
      };
      try {
        snapshot = SyncProgressSnapshot.fromJson(json);
      } on FormatException {
        snapshot = null;
      } on ArgumentError {
        snapshot = null;
      }
    }
    return _StoredSyncState(queue: queue, snapshot: snapshot);
  }

  Future<void> _writeState(_StoredSyncState state) {
    return _storage.save(
      StorageBucket.syncPendingMutations,
      <String, Object?>{
        'queue': state.queue.map((item) => item.toJson()).toList(growable: false),
        if (state.snapshot != null) 'snapshot': state.snapshot!.toJson(),
      },
    );
  }
}

final class _StoredSyncState {
  const _StoredSyncState({
    this.queue = const <SyncQueueItem>[],
    this.snapshot,
  });

  final List<SyncQueueItem> queue;
  final SyncProgressSnapshot? snapshot;
}

enum SyncStatus { offline, syncing, upToDate, conflictDetected }

enum SyncConflictResolutionStrategy {
  lastWriteWinsProtectHigherStreak,
  mergeProgress,
  keepLocal,
  keepRemote,
}

final class SyncSrsRecord {
  const SyncSrsRecord({
    required this.key,
    required this.updatedAtUtc,
    required this.dueAtUtc,
    required this.repetitions,
    required this.lapses,
    required this.successes,
    required this.failures,
    this.intervalDays = 0,
    this.difficulty = 1.3,
    this.stabilityDays = 0,
    this.lastReviewedAtUtc,
  });

  final String key;
  final DateTime updatedAtUtc;
  final DateTime dueAtUtc;
  final int repetitions;
  final int intervalDays;
  final int lapses;
  final int successes;
  final int failures;
  final double difficulty;
  final double stabilityDays;
  final DateTime? lastReviewedAtUtc;

  Map<String, Object?> toJson() => <String, Object?>{
        'key': key,
        'updatedAtUtc': updatedAtUtc.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
        'dueAtUtc': dueAtUtc.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
        'repetitions': repetitions,
        'intervalDays': intervalDays,
        'lapses': lapses,
        'successes': successes,
        'failures': failures,
        'difficulty': difficulty,
        'stabilityDays': stabilityDays,
        if (lastReviewedAtUtc != null)
          'lastReviewedAtUtc': lastReviewedAtUtc!.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
      };

  factory SyncSrsRecord.fromJson(Map<String, Object?> json) {
    final lastRaw = json['lastReviewedAtUtc'];
    DateTime? lastReviewed;
    if (lastRaw is String) {
      lastReviewed = DateTime.tryParse(lastRaw)?.toUtc();
    }
    return SyncSrsRecord(
      key: _requiredText(json['key'], 'key'),
      updatedAtUtc: _requiredUtc(json['updatedAtUtc'], 'updatedAtUtc'),
      dueAtUtc: _requiredUtc(json['dueAtUtc'], 'dueAtUtc'),
      repetitions: _boundedInt(json['repetitions'], 0, 10000),
      intervalDays: _boundedInt(json['intervalDays'], 0, 3650),
      lapses: _boundedInt(json['lapses'], 0, 10000),
      successes: _boundedInt(json['successes'], 0, 100000),
      failures: _boundedInt(json['failures'], 0, 100000),
      difficulty: _boundedDouble(json['difficulty'], .5, 2.5, 1.3),
      stabilityDays: _boundedDouble(
        json['stabilityDays'],
        0,
        3650,
        0,
      ),
      lastReviewedAtUtc: lastReviewed,
    );
  }
}

final class SyncProgressSnapshot {
  SyncProgressSnapshot({
    required this.revision,
    required DateTime updatedAtUtc,
    required int currentStreak,
    required int longestStreak,
    required int totalXp,
    required Map<String, SyncSrsRecord> srs,
    required Set<String> achievementIds,
  })  : updatedAtUtc = updatedAtUtc.toUtc(),
        currentStreak = currentStreak.clamp(0, 10000).toInt(),
        longestStreak = longestStreak.clamp(0, 10000).toInt(),
        totalXp = totalXp.clamp(0, 100000000).toInt(),
        srs = Map<String, SyncSrsRecord>.unmodifiable(srs),
        achievementIds = Set<String>.unmodifiable(achievementIds) {
    if (revision.trim().isEmpty || revision.length > 160) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(revision, 'revision', 'invalid revision');
    }
    if (this.longestStreak < this.currentStreak) {
      throw ArgumentError('longestStreak cannot be below currentStreak');
    }
  }

  final String revision;
  final DateTime updatedAtUtc;
  final int currentStreak;
  final int longestStreak;
  final int totalXp;
  final Map<String, SyncSrsRecord> srs;
  final Set<String> achievementIds;

  SyncProgressSnapshot copyWith({
    String? revision,
    DateTime? updatedAtUtc,
    int? currentStreak,
    int? longestStreak,
    int? totalXp,
    Map<String, SyncSrsRecord>? srs,
    Set<String>? achievementIds,
  }) {
    return SyncProgressSnapshot(
      revision: revision ?? this.revision,
      updatedAtUtc: updatedAtUtc ?? this.updatedAtUtc,
      currentStreak: currentStreak ?? this.currentStreak,
      longestStreak: longestStreak ?? this.longestStreak,
      totalXp: totalXp ?? this.totalXp,
      srs: srs ?? this.srs,
      achievementIds: achievementIds ?? this.achievementIds,
    );
  }

  Map<String, Object?> toJson() {
    final achievements = achievementIds.toList(growable: false)..sort();
    return <String, Object?>{
      'revision': revision,
      'updatedAtUtc': updatedAtUtc.toIso8601String(),
      'currentStreak': currentStreak,
      'longestStreak': longestStreak,
      'totalXp': totalXp,
      'srs': <String, Object?>{
        for (final entry in srs.entries) entry.key: entry.value.toJson(),
      },
      'achievementIds': achievements,
    };
  }

  factory SyncProgressSnapshot.fromJson(Map<String, Object?> json) {
    final rawSrs = json['srs'];
    final parsedSrs = <String, SyncSrsRecord>{};
    if (rawSrs is Map) {
      for (final entry in rawSrs.entries) {
        if (entry.key is! String || entry.value is! Map) continue;
        final value = <String, Object?>{
          for (final child in (entry.value as Map).entries)
            if (child.key is String) (child.key as String): child.value,
        };
        try {
          parsedSrs[entry.key as String] = SyncSrsRecord.fromJson(value);
        } on FormatException {
          continue;
        } on ArgumentError {
          continue;
        }
      }
    }

    final rawAchievements = json['achievementIds'];
    final achievements = <String>{};
    if (rawAchievements is List) {
      for (final value in rawAchievements.whereType<String>()) {
        final normalized = value.trim();
        if (normalized.isNotEmpty && normalized.length <= 120) {
          achievements.add(normalized);
        }
      }
    }

    final current = _boundedInt(json['currentStreak'], 0, 10000);
    final longest = _boundedInt(json['longestStreak'], current, 10000);
    return SyncProgressSnapshot(
      revision: _requiredText(json['revision'], 'revision'),
      updatedAtUtc: _requiredUtc(json['updatedAtUtc'], 'updatedAtUtc'),
      currentStreak: current,
      longestStreak: longest,
      totalXp: _boundedInt(json['totalXp'], 0, 100000000),
      srs: parsedSrs,
      achievementIds: achievements,
    );
  }
}

final class SyncQueueItem {
  SyncQueueItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.entityKey,
    required DateTime updatedAtUtc,
    required Map<String, Object?> payload,
  })  : updatedAtUtc = updatedAtUtc.toUtc(),
        payload = Map<String, Object?>.unmodifiable(payload) {
    if (id.trim().isEmpty || id.length > 160) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(id, 'id', 'invalid mutation id');
    }
    if (entityKey.trim().isEmpty || entityKey.length > 200) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(entityKey, 'entityKey', 'invalid entity key');
    }
  }

  final String id;
  final String entityKey;
  final DateTime updatedAtUtc;
  final Map<String, Object?> payload;

  Map<String, Object?> toJson() => <String, Object?>{
        'id': id,
        'entityKey': entityKey,
        'updatedAtUtc': updatedAtUtc.toIso8601String(),
        'payload': payload,
      };

  factory SyncQueueItem.fromJson(Map<String, Object?> json) {
    final rawPayload = json['payload'];
    final payload = <String, Object?>{};
    if (rawPayload is Map) {
      for (final entry in rawPayload.entries) {
        if (entry.key is String) {
          payload[entry.key as String] = entry.value;
        }
      }
    }
    return SyncQueueItem(
      id: _requiredText(json['id'], 'id'),
      entityKey: _requiredText(json['entityKey'], 'entityKey'),
      updatedAtUtc: _requiredUtc(json['updatedAtUtc'], 'updatedAtUtc'),
      payload: payload,
    );
  }
}

final class SyncConflict {
  const SyncConflict({
    required this.local,
    required this.remote,
  });

  final SyncProgressSnapshot local;
  final SyncProgressSnapshot remote;
}

final class CloudPushResult {
  const CloudPushResult._({
    required this.applied,
    this.snapshot,
    this.conflict,
  });

  factory CloudPushResult.applied(SyncProgressSnapshot snapshot) =>
      CloudPushResult._(applied: true, snapshot: snapshot);

  factory CloudPushResult.conflict(SyncProgressSnapshot remote) =>
      CloudPushResult._(applied: false, conflict: remote);

  final bool applied;
  final SyncProgressSnapshot? snapshot;
  final SyncProgressSnapshot? conflict;
}

String _requiredText(Object? value, String field) {
  if (value is! String) throw FormatException('missing $field');
  final normalized = value.trim();
  if (normalized.isEmpty) throw FormatException('empty $field');
  return normalized;
}

DateTime _requiredUtc(Object? value, String field) {
  if (value is! String) throw FormatException('missing $field');
  final parsed = DateTime.tryParse(value);
  if (parsed == null) throw FormatException('invalid $field');
  return parsed.toUtc();
}

int _boundedInt(Object? value, int min, int max) {
  final parsed = value is num ? value.toInt() : int.tryParse('$value');
  final safe = parsed ?? min;
  return safe.clamp(min, max).toInt();
}

double _boundedDouble(
  Object? value,
  double min,
  double max,
  double fallback,
) {
  final parsed = value is num ? value.toDouble() : double.tryParse('$value');
  if (parsed == null || !parsed.isFinite) return fallback;
  return parsed.clamp(min, max).toDouble();
}

abstract interface class CloudStorageService {

  Future<CloudPushResult> pushSnapshot({
    required String syncKey,
    required SyncProgressSnapshot snapshot,
    required List<SyncQueueItem> mutations,

  });

FILE: lib/features/sync/infrastructure/connectivity_signal_bridge.dart

import 'dart:async';

import '../domain/sync_services.dart';

/// Infrastructure bridge for platform/network reachability signals.
///
/// The composition root can feed this adapter from an existing platform signal.
/// It intentionally performs no background polling and defaults to offline.
final class ConnectivitySignalBridge implements ConnectivityService {
  ConnectivitySignalBridge({bool initialOnline = false})
      : _online = initialOnline;

  bool _online;
  final StreamController<bool> _changes =
      StreamController<bool>.broadcast(sync: true);

  @override
  Future<bool> isOnline() async => _online;

  @override
  Stream<bool> get changes => _changes.stream;

  void update(bool online) {
    if (_online == online || _changes.isClosed) return;
    _online = online;
    _changes.add(online);
  }

  Future<void> dispose() async {
    await _changes.close();
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/sync/infrastructure/http_cloud_storage_service.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;

import '../domain/sync_models.dart';
import '../domain/sync_services.dart';

typedef CloudHeadersProvider = Future<Map<String, String>> Function();

final class HttpCloudStorageService implements CloudStorageService {
  HttpCloudStorageService({
    required Uri baseUri,
    required Set<String> allowedHosts,
    http.Client? client,
    CloudHeadersProvider? headersProvider,
    this.timeout = const Duration(seconds: 12),
  })  : baseUri = baseUri.path.endsWith('/')
            ? baseUri
            : baseUri.replace(path: '${baseUri.path}/'),
        allowedHosts = Set<String>.unmodifiable(
          allowedHosts.map((host) => host.trim().toLowerCase()),
        ),
        client = client ?? http.Client(),
        _headersProvider = headersProvider {
    _validateEndpoint(this.baseUri, this.allowedHosts);
    if (timeout < const Duration(seconds: 1) ||
        timeout > const Duration(seconds: 30)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(timeout, 'timeout', 'must be 1..30 seconds');
    }
  }

  static const int maxResponseBytes = 512 * 1024;
  static const int maxRequestBytes = 256 * 1024;

  final Uri baseUri;
  final Set<String> allowedHosts;
  final http.Client client;
  final CloudHeadersProvider? _headersProvider;
  final Duration timeout;

  @override
  Future<SyncProgressSnapshot?> fetchSnapshot(String syncKey) async {
    final uri = _syncUri(syncKey);
    final request = http.Request('GET', uri)
      ..followRedirects = false
      ..headers.addAll(await _headers());
    final response = await client
        .send(request)
        .then(http.Response.fromStream)
        .timeout(timeout);

    if (response.statusCode == 404) return null;
    _guardResponse(response);
    if (response.statusCode < 200 || response.statusCode >= 300) {
      throw StateError('Cloud sync fetch failed.');
    }
    final decoded = _decodeMap(response.body);
    return SyncProgressSnapshot.fromJson(_map(decoded['snapshot']));
  }

  @override
  Future<CloudPushResult> pushSnapshot({
    required String syncKey,
    required SyncProgressSnapshot snapshot,
    required List<SyncQueueItem> mutations,
    String? expectedRevision,
  }) async {
    final body = jsonEncode(<String, Object?>{
      'snapshot': snapshot.toJson(),
      'mutations': mutations.map((item) => item.toJson()).toList(growable: false),
      if (expectedRevision != null) 'expectedRevision': expectedRevision,
    });
    if (utf8.encode(body).length > maxRequestBytes) {
      throw StateError('Cloud sync request exceeds the bounded payload size.');
    }

    final request = http.Request('PUT', _syncUri(syncKey))
      ..followRedirects = false
      ..headers.addAll(await _headers())
      ..headers['content-type'] = 'application/json'
      ..body = body;
    final response = await client
        .send(request)
        .then(http.Response.fromStream)
        .timeout(timeout);

    _guardResponse(response);
    final decoded = _decodeMap(response.body);
    if (response.statusCode == 409) {
      return CloudPushResult.conflict(
        SyncProgressSnapshot.fromJson(_map(decoded['remote'])),
      );
    }
    if (response.statusCode < 200 || response.statusCode >= 300) {
      throw StateError('Cloud sync push failed.');
    }
    return CloudPushResult.applied(
      SyncProgressSnapshot.fromJson(_map(decoded['snapshot'])),
    );
  }

  Future<Map<String, String>> _headers() async {
    final provided = await _headersProvider?.call() ?? const <String, String>{};
    return <String, String>{
      'accept': 'application/json',
      for (final entry in provided.entries)
        if (_safeHeader(entry.key, entry.value)) entry.key: entry.value,
    };
  }

  Uri _syncUri(String syncKey) {
    final normalized = syncKey.trim();
    if (normalized.isEmpty || normalized.length > 160) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(syncKey, 'syncKey', 'invalid sync key');
    }
    return baseUri.resolve(
      'v1/sync/${Uri.encodeComponent(normalized)}',
    );
  }

  static void _validateEndpoint(Uri uri, Set<String> allowedHosts) {
    if (uri.scheme != 'https' ||
        uri.host.isEmpty ||
        uri.userInfo.isNotEmpty ||
        uri.query.isNotEmpty ||
        uri.fragment.isNotEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('Cloud sync endpoint must be a clean HTTPS URI.');
    }
    if (allowedHosts.isEmpty ||
        !allowedHosts.contains(uri.host.toLowerCase())) {
      throw ArgumentError('Cloud sync endpoint host must be allowlisted.');
    }
  }

  static void _guardResponse(http.Response response) {
    if (response.statusCode >= 300 && response.statusCode < 400) {
      throw StateError('Cloud sync redirects are blocked.');
    }
    if (response.bodyBytes.length > maxResponseBytes) {
      throw StateError('Cloud sync response exceeds the bounded size.');
    }
    final contentType = response.headers['content-type']?.toLowerCase() ?? '';
    if (response.bodyBytes.isNotEmpty &&
        !contentType.startsWith('application/json')) {
      throw StateError('Cloud sync response must be JSON.');
    }
  }

  static Map<String, Object?> _decodeMap(String body) {
    if (body.trim().isEmpty) return const <String, Object?>{};
    final decoded = jsonDecode(body);
    return _map(decoded);
  }

  static Map<String, Object?> _map(Object? value) {
    if (value is! Map) throw const FormatException('expected JSON object');
    return <String, Object?>{
      for (final entry in value.entries)
        if (entry.key is String) entry.key as String: entry.value,
    };
  }

  static bool _safeHeader(String name, String value) {
    final normalized = name.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (normalized.isEmpty ||
        normalized == 'host' ||
        normalized == 'content-length' ||
        value.contains('\n') ||
        value.contains('\r')) {
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  void close() => client.close();
}

FILE: lib/features/verb_conjugation/application/verb_drill_notifier.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'dart:math';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/verb_models.dart';
import '../domain/verb_repository.dart';

enum VerbDrillMode { multipleChoice, letterOrder }

class VerbLetterTile {
  const VerbLetterTile({required this.id, required this.letter});

  final String id;
  final String letter;
}

class VerbDrillQuestion {
  const VerbDrillQuestion({
    required this.id,
    required this.verb,
    required this.tense,
    required this.pronoun,
    required this.mode,
    required this.correctAnswer,
    required this.options,
    required this.letterTiles,
  });

  final String id;
  final VerbItem verb;
  final VerbTense tense;
  final GermanPronoun pronoun;
  final VerbDrillMode mode;
  final String correctAnswer;
  final List<String> options;
  final List<VerbLetterTile> letterTiles;

  String get mistakeKey =>
      '${verb.infinitive}|${tense.name}|${pronoun.name}';
}

class VerbDrillNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  VerbDrillNotifier(
    this._repository, {
    Random? random,
    DateTime Function()? now,
  })  : _random = random ?? Random(),
        _now = now ?? DateTime.now;

  final VerbRepository _repository;
  final Random _random;
  final DateTime Function() _now;

  bool _started = false;
  bool _completed = false;
  bool _answered = false;
  bool _lastCorrect = false;
  bool _timedOut = false;
  int _questionIndex = 0;
  int _totalQuestions = 10;
  int _secondsPerQuestion = 12;
  int _remainingSeconds = 12;
  int _score = 0;
  int _correctAnswers = 0;
  int _streak = 0;
  int _totalResponseMillis = 0;
  int _answeredCount = 0;
  Duration _lastResponseTime = Duration.zero;
  DateTime? _questionStartedAt;
  VerbDrillQuestion? _currentQuestion;
  final Map<String, int> _mistakes = <String, int>{};
  final List<VerbLetterTile> _chosenLetterTiles = <VerbLetterTile>[];

  bool get started => _started;
  bool get completed => _completed;
  bool get answered => _answered;
  bool get lastCorrect => _lastCorrect;
  bool get timedOut => _timedOut;
  int get questionIndex => _questionIndex;
  int get totalQuestions => _totalQuestions;
  int get secondsPerQuestion => _secondsPerQuestion;
  int get remainingSeconds => _remainingSeconds;
  int get score => _score;
  int get correctAnswers => _correctAnswers;
  int get streak => _streak;
  Duration get lastResponseTime => _lastResponseTime;
  VerbDrillQuestion? get currentQuestion => _currentQuestion;
  Map<String, int> get repeatedMistakes => Map.unmodifiable(_mistakes);
  List<VerbLetterTile> get chosenLetterTiles =>
      List.unmodifiable(_chosenLetterTiles);

  double get accuracy =>
      _answeredCount == 0 ? 0 : _correctAnswers / _answeredCount;

  Duration get averageResponseTime => _answeredCount == 0
      ? Duration.zero
      : Duration(milliseconds: _totalResponseMillis ~/ _answeredCount);

  List<VerbLetterTile> get availableLetterTiles {
    final question = _currentQuestion;
    if (question == null) return const <VerbLetterTile>[];
    final chosenIds = _chosenLetterTiles.map((tile) => tile.id).toSet();
    return question.letterTiles
        .where((tile) => !chosenIds.contains(tile.id))
        .toList(growable: false);
  }

  String get letterAnswer =>
      _chosenLetterTiles.map((tile) => tile.letter).join();

  void start({int totalQuestions = 10, int secondsPerQuestion = 12}) {
    if (totalQuestions <= 0) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(totalQuestions, 'totalQuestions', 'must be > 0');
    }
    if (secondsPerQuestion < 3) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        secondsPerQuestion,
        'secondsPerQuestion',
        'must be at least 3',
      );
    }
    if (_repository.commonVerbs.isEmpty) {
      throw StateError('verb repository is empty');
    }

    _started = true;
    _completed = false;
    _answered = false;
    _lastCorrect = false;
    _timedOut = false;
    _questionIndex = 0;
    _totalQuestions = totalQuestions;
    _secondsPerQuestion = secondsPerQuestion;
    _remainingSeconds = secondsPerQuestion;
    _score = 0;
    _correctAnswers = 0;
    _streak = 0;
    _totalResponseMillis = 0;
    _answeredCount = 0;
    _lastResponseTime = Duration.zero;
    _mistakes.clear();
    _chosenLetterTiles.clear();
    _currentQuestion = _buildQuestion(0);
    _questionStartedAt = _now();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void tick() {
    if (!_started || _completed || _answered || _questionStartedAt == null) {
      return;
    }
    final elapsed = _now().difference(_questionStartedAt!);
    final nextRemaining = max(0, _secondsPerQuestion - elapsed.inSeconds);
    if (nextRemaining != _remainingSeconds) {
      _remainingSeconds = nextRemaining;
      notifyListeners();
    }
    if (nextRemaining == 0) {
      submit('', forceTimeout: true);
    }
  }

  void chooseLetter(String tileId) {
    if (_answered || _completed) return;
    final tile =
        availableLetterTiles.where((item) => item.id == tileId).firstOrNull;
    if (tile == null) return;
    _chosenLetterTiles.add(tile);
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void removeLastLetter() {
    if (_answered || _completed || _chosenLetterTiles.isEmpty) return;
    _chosenLetterTiles.removeLast();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearLetters() {
    if (_answered || _completed || _chosenLetterTiles.isEmpty) return;
    _chosenLetterTiles.clear();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void submitLetterAnswer() => submit(letterAnswer);

  void submit(String answer, {bool forceTimeout = false}) {
    final question = _currentQuestion;
    if (!_started || _completed || _answered || question == null) return;

    final elapsed = _elapsed();
    final deadlineReached =
        elapsed >= Duration(seconds: _secondsPerQuestion);
    final timedOut = forceTimeout || deadlineReached;
    final correct = !timedOut && _matches(question, answer);
    _answered = true;
    _lastCorrect = correct;
    _timedOut = timedOut;
    if (timedOut) _remainingSeconds = 0;
    _lastResponseTime = elapsed;
    _answeredCount++;
    _totalResponseMillis += elapsed.inMilliseconds;

    if (correct) {
      _correctAnswers++;
      _streak++;
      final speedSeconds = max(0, _secondsPerQuestion - elapsed.inSeconds);
      final speedBonus = speedSeconds * 8;
      final streakBonus = min(_streak, 5) * 10;
      _score += 100 + speedBonus + streakBonus;
    } else {
      _streak = 0;
      _mistakes.update(
        question.mistakeKey,
        (count) => count + 1,
        ifAbsent: () => 1,
      );
    }
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void next() {
    if (!_started || _completed || !_answered) return;
    if (_questionIndex + 1 >= _totalQuestions) {
      _completed = true;
      _currentQuestion = null;
      notifyListeners();
      return;
    }

    _questionIndex++;
    _answered = false;
    _lastCorrect = false;
    _timedOut = false;
    _remainingSeconds = _secondsPerQuestion;
    _chosenLetterTiles.clear();
    _currentQuestion = _buildQuestion(_questionIndex);
    _questionStartedAt = _now();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Duration _elapsed() {
    final startedAt = _questionStartedAt;
    if (startedAt == null) return Duration.zero;
    final elapsed = _now().difference(startedAt);
    return elapsed.isNegative ? Duration.zero : elapsed;
  }

  bool _matches(VerbDrillQuestion question, String answer) {
    if (question.mode == VerbDrillMode.letterOrder) {
      return _lettersOnly(answer) == _lettersOnly(question.correctAnswer);
    }
    return _normalize(answer) == _normalize(question.correctAnswer);
  }

  VerbDrillQuestion _buildQuestion(int index) {
    final verbs = _repository.commonVerbs;
    final verb = verbs[_random.nextInt(verbs.length)];
    final tense = VerbTense.values[_random.nextInt(VerbTense.values.length)];
    final pronoun = GermanPronoun.values[
      _random.nextInt(GermanPronoun.values.length)
    ];
    final correct = verb.tableFor(tense).formFor(pronoun);
    final mode = index.isEven
        ? VerbDrillMode.multipleChoice
        : VerbDrillMode.letterOrder;

    final options = _buildOptions(
      verbs: verbs,
      currentVerb: verb,
      tense: tense,
      pronoun: pronoun,
      correct: correct,
    );
    final letters = _buildLetterTiles(correct);

    return VerbDrillQuestion(
      id: '${index}_${verb.infinitive}_${tense.name}_${pronoun.name}',
      verb: verb,
      tense: tense,
      pronoun: pronoun,
      mode: mode,
      correctAnswer: correct,
      options: options,
      letterTiles: letters,
    );
  }

  List<String> _buildOptions({
    required List<VerbItem> verbs,
    required VerbItem currentVerb,
    required VerbTense tense,
    required GermanPronoun pronoun,
    required String correct,
  }) {
    final candidates = <String>{correct};
    final shuffled = List<VerbItem>.from(verbs)..shuffle(_random);
    for (final verb in shuffled) {
      if (verb.infinitive == currentVerb.infinitive) continue;
      candidates.add(verb.tableFor(tense).formFor(pronoun));
      if (candidates.length >= 4) break;
    }
    final options = candidates.toList(growable: false)..shuffle(_random);
    return options;
  }

  List<VerbLetterTile> _buildLetterTiles(String answer) {
    final letters = answer
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), '')
        .runes
        .map(String.fromCharCode)
        .toList(growable: false);
    final tiles = <VerbLetterTile>[
      for (var index = 0; index < letters.length; index++)
        VerbLetterTile(
          id: 'letter_${_questionIndex}_${index}_${letters[index]}',
          letter: letters[index],
        ),
    ]..shuffle(_random);
    return tiles;
  }

  String _normalize(String value) =>
      value.trim().toLowerCase().replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');

  String _lettersOnly(String value) =>
      value.toLowerCase().replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), '');
}

extension _FirstOrNull<T> on Iterable<T> {
  T? get firstOrNull {
    final iterator = this.iterator;
    return iterator.moveNext() ? iterator.current : null;
  }
}

VerbLexemeSpec _seed(
  String infinitive,
  String meaningAr,
  VerbKind kind,
  String present,
  String preterite,
  PerfectAuxiliary auxiliary,
  String participle, {
  List<String> emphasis = const <String>[],
}) =>
    VerbLexemeSpec(
      infinitive: infinitive,
      meaningAr: meaningAr,
      kind: kind,
      presentForms: _forms(present),
      preteriteForms: _forms(preterite),
      auxiliary: auxiliary,
      participle: participle,
      presentEmphasisTokens: emphasis,
    );

Map<GermanPronoun, String> _forms(String compact) {
  final values = compact.split('|');
  if (values.length != GermanPronoun.values.length) {
    throw StateError('expected six forms, found ${values.length}: $compact');
  }
  return <GermanPronoun, String>{
    for (var index = 0; index < GermanPronoun.values.length; index++)
      GermanPronoun.values[index]: values[index],
  };
}

import '../domain/verb_conjugation_factory.dart';
import '../domain/verb_models.dart';
import '../domain/verb_repository.dart';
import 'common_verb_seeds.dart';

class LocalVerbRepository implements VerbRepository {
  LocalVerbRepository() : _verbs = _buildValidatedBank();

  final List<VerbItem> _verbs;

  @override
  List<VerbItem> get commonVerbs => _verbs;

  @override
  VerbItem? byInfinitive(String infinitive) {
    final normalized = infinitive.trim().toLowerCase();
    for (final verb in _verbs) {
      if (verb.infinitive.toLowerCase() == normalized) return verb;
    }
    return null;
  }

  static List<VerbItem> _buildValidatedBank() {
    final seeds = buildCommonVerbSeeds();
    if (seeds.length != 50) {
      throw StateError('common verb bank must contain exactly 50 verbs');
    }
    final verbs = seeds.map(VerbConjugationFactory.build).toList(growable: false);
    final unique = verbs.map((verb) => verb.infinitive).toSet();
    if (unique.length != verbs.length) {
      throw StateError('common verb bank contains duplicate infinitives');
    }
    return List.unmodifiable(verbs);
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/verb_conjugation/domain/verb_conjugation_factory.dart

import 'verb_models.dart';

abstract final class VerbConjugationFactory {
  static const Map<GermanPronoun, String> _habenPresent = {
    GermanPronoun.ich: 'habe',
    GermanPronoun.du: 'hast',
    GermanPronoun.erSieEs: 'hat',
    GermanPronoun.wir: 'haben',
    GermanPronoun.ihr: 'habt',
    GermanPronoun.sieSie: 'haben',
  };

  static const Map<GermanPronoun, String> _seinPresent = {
    GermanPronoun.ich: 'bin',
    GermanPronoun.du: 'bist',
    GermanPronoun.erSieEs: 'ist',
    GermanPronoun.wir: 'sind',
    GermanPronoun.ihr: 'seid',
    GermanPronoun.sieSie: 'sind',
  };

  static VerbItem build(VerbLexemeSpec spec) {
    _validateForms(spec.infinitive, spec.presentForms, VerbTense.praesens);
    _validateForms(
      spec.infinitive,
      spec.preteriteForms,
      VerbTense.praeteritum,
    );
    if (spec.participle.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw StateError('${spec.infinitive} has an empty Partizip II');
    }

    final auxiliaryForms = switch (spec.auxiliary) {
      PerfectAuxiliary.haben => _habenPresent,
      PerfectAuxiliary.sein => _seinPresent,
    };
    final perfektForms = <GermanPronoun, String>{
      for (final pronoun in GermanPronoun.values)
        pronoun: '${auxiliaryForms[pronoun]} ${spec.participle}',
    };

    return VerbItem(
      infinitive: spec.infinitive,
      meaningAr: spec.meaningAr,
      kind: spec.kind,
      presentEmphasisTokens: List.unmodifiable(spec.presentEmphasisTokens),
      tables: Map.unmodifiable({
        VerbTense.praesens: VerbConjugationTable(
          tense: VerbTense.praesens,
          forms: Map.unmodifiable(spec.presentForms),
        ),
        VerbTense.praeteritum: VerbConjugationTable(
          tense: VerbTense.praeteritum,
          forms: Map.unmodifiable(spec.preteriteForms),
        ),
        VerbTense.perfekt: VerbConjugationTable(
          tense: VerbTense.perfekt,
          forms: Map.unmodifiable(perfektForms),
          auxiliary: spec.auxiliary,
          participle: spec.participle,
        ),
      }),
    );
  }

  static List<VerbTextSegment> emphasisFor({
    required VerbItem verb,
    required VerbTense tense,
    required GermanPronoun pronoun,
  }) {
    final form = verb.tableFor(tense).formFor(pronoun);
    if (tense != VerbTense.praesens || verb.presentEmphasisTokens.isEmpty) {
      return <VerbTextSegment>[
        VerbTextSegment(form, emphasized: false),
      ];
    }

    var bestIndex = -1;
    var bestToken = '';
    for (final token in verb.presentEmphasisTokens) {
      final index = form.toLowerCase().indexOf(token.toLowerCase());
      if (index >= 0 && (bestIndex < 0 || index < bestIndex)) {
        bestIndex = index;
        bestToken = form.substring(index, index + token.length);
      }
    }
    if (bestIndex < 0) {
      return <VerbTextSegment>[
        VerbTextSegment(form, emphasized: false),
      ];
    }

    return <VerbTextSegment>[
      if (bestIndex > 0)
        VerbTextSegment(form.substring(0, bestIndex), emphasized: false),
      VerbTextSegment(bestToken, emphasized: true),
      if (bestIndex + bestToken.length < form.length)
        VerbTextSegment(
          form.substring(bestIndex + bestToken.length),
          emphasized: false,
        ),
    ];
  }

  static void _validateForms(
    String infinitive,
    Map<GermanPronoun, String> forms,
    VerbTense tense,
  ) {
    if (forms.length != GermanPronoun.values.length) {
      throw StateError('$infinitive has incomplete ${tense.label} forms');
    }
    for (final pronoun in GermanPronoun.values) {
      final form = forms[pronoun];
      if (form == null || form.trim().isEmpty) {
        throw StateError(
          '$infinitive has no ${tense.label} form for ${pronoun.label}',
        );
      }
    }
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/verb_conjugation/domain/verb_models.dart
--------------------------------------------------
enum VerbKind { regular, irregular, separable }

enum VerbTense {
  praesens('Präsens'),
  praeteritum('Präteritum'),
  perfekt('Perfekt');

  const VerbTense(this.label);
  final String label;
}

enum PerfectAuxiliary {
  haben('haben'),
  sein('sein');

  const PerfectAuxiliary(this.infinitive);
  final String infinitive;
}

enum GermanPronoun {
  ich('ich'),
  du('du'),
  erSieEs('er/sie/es'),
  wir('wir'),
  ihr('ihr'),
  sieSie('sie/Sie');

  const GermanPronoun(this.label);
  final String label;
}

class VerbConjugationTable {
  const VerbConjugationTable({
    required this.tense,
    required this.forms,
    this.auxiliary,
    this.participle,
  });

  final VerbTense tense;
  final Map<GermanPronoun, String> forms;
  final PerfectAuxiliary? auxiliary;
  final String? participle;

  String formFor(GermanPronoun pronoun) => forms[pronoun] ?? '';
}

class VerbItem {
  const VerbItem({
    required this.infinitive,
    required this.meaningAr,
    required this.kind,
    required this.tables,
    this.presentEmphasisTokens = const <String>[],
  });

  final String infinitive;
  final String meaningAr;
  final VerbKind kind;
  final Map<VerbTense, VerbConjugationTable> tables;
  final List<String> presentEmphasisTokens;

  VerbConjugationTable tableFor(VerbTense tense) {
    final table = tables[tense];
    if (table == null) {
      throw StateError('$infinitive is missing ${tense.label}');
    }
    return table;
  }
}

class VerbLexemeSpec {
  const VerbLexemeSpec({
    required this.infinitive,
    required this.meaningAr,
    required this.kind,
    required this.presentForms,
    required this.preteriteForms,
    required this.auxiliary,
    required this.participle,
    this.presentEmphasisTokens = const <String>[],
  });

  final String infinitive;
  final String meaningAr;
  final VerbKind kind;
  final Map<GermanPronoun, String> presentForms;
  final Map<GermanPronoun, String> preteriteForms;
  final PerfectAuxiliary auxiliary;
  final String participle;
  final List<String> presentEmphasisTokens;
}

class VerbTextSegment {
  const VerbTextSegment(this.text, {required this.emphasized});

  final String text;
  final bool emphasized;
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class VerbConjugationScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const VerbConjugationScreen({required this.repository, super.key});

  final VerbRepository repository;

  @override
  State<VerbConjugationScreen> createState() => _VerbConjugationScreenState();
}

class _VerbConjugationScreenState extends State<VerbConjugationScreen> {
  late final VerbDrillNotifier _drillNotifier;
  late final List<VerbItem> _verbs;
  late VerbItem _selectedVerb;
  VerbTense _selectedTense = VerbTense.praesens;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _verbs = widget.repository.commonVerbs;
    if (_verbs.isEmpty) {
      throw StateError('VerbConjugationScreen requires a non-empty repository');
    }
    _selectedVerb = _verbs.first;
    _drillNotifier = VerbDrillNotifier(widget.repository);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _drillNotifier.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../../design_system/app_colors.dart';
import '../../../../design_system/app_glass_card.dart';
import '../../../../design_system/app_typography.dart';

class RapidConjugationDrillWidget extends StatefulWidget {
  const RapidConjugationDrillWidget({required this.notifier, super.key});

  final VerbDrillNotifier notifier;

  @override
  State<RapidConjugationDrillWidget> createState() =>
      _RapidConjugationDrillWidgetState();
}

class _RapidConjugationDrillWidgetState
    extends State<RapidConjugationDrillWidget> {
  Timer? _ticker;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ticker = Timer.periodic(
      const Duration(milliseconds: 250),
      (_) => widget.notifier.tick(),
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _ticker?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AnimatedBuilder(
        animation: widget.notifier,
        builder: (context, _) {
          final notifier = widget.notifier;
          if (!notifier.started) {
            return _StartArenaCard(onStart: () => notifier.start());
          }
          if (notifier.completed) {
            return _ArenaSummary(notifier: notifier);
          }
          final question = notifier.currentQuestion;
          if (question == null) return const SizedBox.shrink();

          return AppGlassCard(
            glowColor: notifier.remainingSeconds <= 4
                ? AppColors.tertiary
                : AppColors.primary,
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                _ArenaHeader(notifier: notifier),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                Text(
                  '${question.pronoun.label} · ${question.verb.infinitive}',
                  textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  style: AppTypography.display.copyWith(fontSize: 26),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                Text(
                  '${question.tense.label} · ${question.verb.meaningAr}',
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  style: AppTypography.body,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 18),
                if (question.mode == VerbDrillMode.multipleChoice)
                  _MultipleChoiceBody(
                    notifier: notifier,
                    options: question.options,
                  )
                else
                  _LetterOrderBody(notifier: notifier),
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                if (notifier.answered)
                  _AnswerFeedback(notifier: notifier),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                if (notifier.answered)
                  FilledButton.icon(
                    onPressed: notifier.next,
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_forward_rounded),
                    label: const Text('التالي'),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          );
        },
      );
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/prefix_models.dart';
import '../domain/prefix_repository.dart';

final class PrefixNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  PrefixNotifier(this._repository);

  final PrefixRepository _repository;

  List<PrefixDrillItem> _drills = const <PrefixDrillItem>[];
  VerbPrefixClass? _activeClass;
  int _currentIndex = 0;
  String _answerText = '';
  bool? _isCorrect;
  bool _showExplanation = false;
  String _feedbackAr = '';
  bool _isLoading = false;
  int _generation = 0;

  List<PrefixDrillItem> get drills =>
      List<PrefixDrillItem>.unmodifiable(_drills);
  VerbPrefixClass? get activeClass => _activeClass;
  int get currentIndex => _currentIndex;
  String get answerText => _answerText;
  bool? get isCorrect => _isCorrect;
  bool get showExplanation => _showExplanation;
  String get feedbackAr => _feedbackAr;
  bool get isLoading => _isLoading;

  PrefixDrillItem? get currentDrill {
    if (_drills.isEmpty || _currentIndex >= _drills.length) return null;
    return _drills[_currentIndex];
  }

  bool get canCheck =>
      currentDrill != null &&
      _answerText.trim().isNotEmpty &&
      !_showExplanation;

  Future<void> load({VerbPrefixClass? verbClass}) async {
    final generation = ++_generation;
    _isLoading = true;
    _activeClass = verbClass;
    notifyListeners();

    try {
      final loaded = await _repository.getDrills(verbClass: verbClass);
      if (generation != _generation) return;
      _drills = List<PrefixDrillItem>.unmodifiable(loaded);
      _currentIndex = 0;
      _resetAnswerState();
    } finally {
      if (generation == _generation) {
        _isLoading = false;
        notifyListeners();
      }
    }
  }

  void updateAnswer(String value) {
    if (_showExplanation) return;
    _generation++;
    _answerText = value;
    _isCorrect = null;
    _feedbackAr = '';
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> checkAnswer(String answer) async {
    final drill = currentDrill;
    if (drill == null || _showExplanation) return;

    final generation = ++_generation;
    _answerText = answer.trim();
    _isCorrect = null;
    _feedbackAr = '';
    notifyListeners();

    final correct = await _repository.checkAnswer(
      drillId: drill.id,
      answer: _answerText,
    );
    if (generation != _generation || currentDrill?.id != drill.id) {
      return;
    }

    _isCorrect = correct;
    _feedbackAr = correct
        ? 'إجابة صحيحة. راقب موضع السابقة وشكل Partizip II.'
        : 'راجع ترتيب الفعل السابقة. قارن إجابتك بالنموذج والشرح.';
    _showExplanation = true;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void nextDrill() {
    if (_drills.isEmpty || !_showExplanation) return;
    _generation++;
    _currentIndex = (_currentIndex + 1) % _drills.length;
    _resetAnswerState();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> switchVerbClass(VerbPrefixClass verbClass) async {
    if (_activeClass == verbClass && _drills.isNotEmpty) {
      _generation++;
      _currentIndex = 0;
      _resetAnswerState();
      notifyListeners();
      return;
    }
    await load(verbClass: verbClass);
  }

  Future<void> showAllClasses() async {
    if (_activeClass == null && _drills.isNotEmpty) {
      _generation++;
      _currentIndex = 0;
      _resetAnswerState();
      notifyListeners();
      return;
    }
    await load();
  }

  void _resetAnswerState() {
    _answerText = '';
    _isCorrect = null;
    _showExplanation = false;
    _feedbackAr = '';
  }
}

import '../domain/prefix_models.dart';
import '../domain/prefix_repository.dart';

final class LocalPrefixRepository implements PrefixRepository {
  LocalPrefixRepository() : _drills = _buildValidatedBank();

  final List<PrefixDrillItem> _drills;

  @override
  Future<List<PrefixDrillItem>> getDrills({
    VerbPrefixClass? verbClass,
  }) async {
    final selected = verbClass == null
        ? _drills
        : _drills
            .where((item) => item.verbClass == verbClass)
            .toList(growable: false);
    return List<PrefixDrillItem>.unmodifiable(selected);
  }

  @override
  Future<bool> checkAnswer({
    required String drillId,
    required String answer,
  }) async {
    final drill = _findById(drillId);
    if (drill == null) return false;
    return _normalize(answer) == _normalize(drill.correctSentence);
  }

  PrefixDrillItem? _findById(String id) {
    for (final drill in _drills) {
      if (drill.id == id) return drill;
    }
    return null;
  }

  static String _normalize(String value) {
    return value
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ')
        .replaceAll(' .', '.')
        .replaceAll(' ,', ',');
  }

  static List<PrefixDrillItem> _buildValidatedBank() {
    const drills = <PrefixDrillItem>[
      PrefixDrillItem(
        id: 'travel_ankommen',
        infinitive: 'ankommen',
        prefix: 'an',
        stem: 'kommen',
        verbClass: VerbPrefixClass.trennbar,
        context: PrefixContext.travel,
        isSeparableInContext: true,
        sentencePrompt: 'Der Zug ___ um 18 Uhr in Berlin ___.',
        correctSentence: 'Der Zug kommt um 18 Uhr in Berlin an.',
        partizipII: 'angekommen',
        translationAr: 'يصل القطار إلى برلين الساعة السادسة مساءً.',
        explanationAr:
            'الفعل ankommen منفصل: في الجملة الرئيسية يأتي kommen في الموقع الثاني وتنتقل an إلى النهاية. في Partizip II تدخل ge بين السابقة والجذر: angekommen.',
      ),
      PrefixDrillItem(
        id: 'technology_einschalten',
        infinitive: 'einschalten',
        prefix: 'ein',
        stem: 'schalten',
        verbClass: VerbPrefixClass.trennbar,
        context: PrefixContext.technology,
        isSeparableInContext: true,
        sentencePrompt: 'Der Techniker ___ den Server ___.',
        correctSentence: 'Der Techniker schaltet den Server ein.',
        partizipII: 'eingeschaltet',
        translationAr: 'يشغّل الفني الخادم.',
        explanationAr:
            'einschalten فعل منفصل. السابقة ein تنتقل إلى نهاية الجملة الرئيسية، وPartizip II هو eingeschaltet.',
      ),
      PrefixDrillItem(
        id: 'literature_vorlesen',
        infinitive: 'vorlesen',
        prefix: 'vor',
        stem: 'lesen',
        verbClass: VerbPrefixClass.trennbar,
        context: PrefixContext.literature,
        isSeparableInContext: true,
        sentencePrompt: 'Die Autorin ___ einen Abschnitt aus dem Roman ___.',
        correctSentence:
            'Die Autorin liest einen Abschnitt aus dem Roman vor.',
        partizipII: 'vorgelesen',
        translationAr: 'تقرأ الكاتبة مقطعاً من الرواية بصوت مرتفع.',
        explanationAr:

      ),
      PrefixDrillItem(
        id: 'engineering_einbauen',
        infinitive: 'einbauen',

        verbClass: VerbPrefixClass.trennbar,

        correctSentence: 'Die Autorin beschreibt die Landschaft sehr präzise.',

        translationAr: 'تصف الكاتبة المنظر الطبيعي بدقة كبيرة.',
        explanationAr:
            'be- من السوابق غير المنفصلة. يبقى الفعل كلمة واحدة، وPartizip II هو beschrieben من دون ge.',
      ),
      PrefixDrillItem(
        id: 'engineering_berechnen',
        infinitive: 'berechnen',
        prefix: 'be',
        stem: 'rechnen',
        verbClass: VerbPrefixClass.untrennbar,
        context: PrefixContext.engineering,
        isSeparableInContext: false,
        sentencePrompt: 'Der Ingenieur ___ die maximale Belastung.',
        correctSentence: 'Der Ingenieur berechnet die maximale Belastung.',
        partizipII: 'berechnet',
        translationAr: 'يحسب المهندس الحمولة القصوى.',
        explanationAr:
            'berechnen غير منفصل بسبب السابقة be-. في Partizip II نقول berechnet من دون ge.',
      ),
      PrefixDrillItem(
        id: 'literature_uebersetzen_translate',
        infinitive: 'übersetzen',
        prefix: 'über',
        stem: 'setzen',
        verbClass: VerbPrefixClass.doppeldeutig,
        context: PrefixContext.literature,
        isSeparableInContext: false,
        sentencePrompt: 'Sie ___ den Roman ins Arabische.',
        correctSentence: 'Sie übersetzt den Roman ins Arabische.',
        partizipII: 'übersetzt',
        translationAr: 'تترجم الرواية إلى العربية.',
        explanationAr:
            'عندما يعني übersetzen «يترجم»، يكون غير منفصل وتكون النبرة على الجذر. لذلك: sie übersetzt، وPartizip II هو übersetzt من دون ge.',
      ),
      PrefixDrillItem(
        id: 'travel_uebersetzen_cross',
        infinitive: 'übersetzen',
        prefix: 'über',
        stem: 'setzen',
        verbClass: VerbPrefixClass.doppeldeutig,
        context: PrefixContext.travel,
        isSeparableInContext: true,
        sentencePrompt: 'Der Fährmann ___ die Reisenden ans andere Ufer ___.',
        correctSentence:
            'Der Fährmann setzt die Reisenden ans andere Ufer über.',
        partizipII: 'übergesetzt',
        translationAr: 'ينقل عامل العبّارة المسافرين إلى الضفة الأخرى.',
        explanationAr:
            'عندما يعني über|setzen «ينقل إلى الجهة الأخرى»، يكون منفصلاً: setzt ... über. وPartizip II هو übergesetzt.',
      ),
      PrefixDrillItem(
        id: 'engineering_umfahren_avoid',
        infinitive: 'umfahren',
        prefix: 'um',
        stem: 'fahren',
        verbClass: VerbPrefixClass.doppeldeutig,
        context: PrefixContext.engineering,
        isSeparableInContext: false,
        sentencePrompt: 'Der Testwagen ___ das Hindernis automatisch.',
        correctSentence: 'Der Testwagen umfährt das Hindernis automatisch.',
        partizipII: 'umfahren',
        translationAr: 'تلتف سيارة الاختبار حول العائق تلقائياً.',
        explanationAr:
            'عندما يعني umfahren «يلتف حول شيء»، يكون غير منفصل. لذلك نقول umfährt وPartizip II هو umfahren من دون ge.',
      ),
      PrefixDrillItem(
        id: 'engineering_umfahren_knock',
        infinitive: 'umfahren',
        prefix: 'um',
        stem: 'fahren',
        verbClass: VerbPrefixClass.doppeldeutig,
        context: PrefixContext.engineering,
        isSeparableInContext: true,
        sentencePrompt: 'Beim Test ___ das Fahrzeug einen Kegel ___.',
        correctSentence: 'Beim Test fährt das Fahrzeug einen Kegel um.',
        partizipII: 'umgefahren',
        translationAr: 'أثناء الاختبار تطيح المركبة بمخروط مروري.',
        explanationAr:
            'عندما يعني um|fahren «يُسقط شيئاً بالاصطدام به»، يكون منفصلاً: fährt ... um. وPartizip II هو umgefahren.',
      ),
    ];

    final ids = drills.map((item) => item.id).toSet();
    if (ids.length != drills.length) {
      throw StateError('prefix drill bank contains duplicate ids');
    }

    for (final drill in drills) {
      if (!drill.infinitive.startsWith(drill.prefix)) {
        throw StateError('prefix does not match infinitive: ${drill.id}');
      }
      if (drill.verbClass == VerbPrefixClass.trennbar &&
          !drill.isSeparableInContext) {
        throw StateError('trennbar drill must separate: ${drill.id}');
      }
      if (drill.verbClass == VerbPrefixClass.untrennbar &&
          drill.isSeparableInContext) {
        throw StateError('untrennbar drill must not separate: ${drill.id}');
      }
      if (drill.correctSentence.trim().isEmpty ||
          drill.translationAr.trim().isEmpty ||
          drill.explanationAr.trim().isEmpty) {
        throw StateError('incomplete prefix drill: ${drill.id}');
      }
    }

    return List<PrefixDrillItem>.unmodifiable(drills);
  }
}


--------------------------------------------------
FILE: lib/features/verb_prefixes/domain/prefix_models.dart
--------------------------------------------------
enum VerbPrefixClass { trennbar, untrennbar, doppeldeutig }

enum PrefixContext { travel, technology, literature, engineering }

final class PrefixDrillItem {
  const PrefixDrillItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.infinitive,
    required this.prefix,
    required this.stem,
    required this.verbClass,
    required this.context,
    required this.isSeparableInContext,
    required this.sentencePrompt,
    required this.correctSentence,
    required this.partizipII,
    required this.translationAr,
    required this.explanationAr,
  });

  final String id;
  final String infinitive;
  final String prefix;
  final String stem;
  final VerbPrefixClass verbClass;
  final PrefixContext context;
  final bool isSeparableInContext;
  final String sentencePrompt;
  final String correctSentence;
  final String partizipII;
  final String translationAr;
  final String explanationAr;

  String get classLabelDe => switch (verbClass) {
        VerbPrefixClass.trennbar => 'Trennbar',
        VerbPrefixClass.untrennbar => 'Untrennbar',
        VerbPrefixClass.doppeldeutig => 'Doppeldeutig',
      };

  String get contextLabelAr => switch (context) {
        PrefixContext.travel => 'السفر',
        PrefixContext.technology => 'التكنولوجيا',
        PrefixContext.literature => 'الأدب',
        PrefixContext.engineering => 'الهندسة',
      };

  String get splitLabel =>
      isSeparableInContext ? '$prefix | $stem' : '$prefix$stem';
}

import 'prefix_models.dart';

abstract interface class PrefixRepository {
  Future<List<PrefixDrillItem>> getDrills({
    VerbPrefixClass? verbClass,
  });

  Future<bool> checkAnswer({
    required String drillId,
    required String answer,
  });
}

import 'dart:async';


import '../../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import '../application/prefix_notifier.dart';
import '../domain/prefix_models.dart';

final class PrefixArenaScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const PrefixArenaScreen({
    required this.notifier,
    super.key,
  });

  final PrefixNotifier notifier;

  @override
  State<PrefixArenaScreen> createState() => _PrefixArenaScreenState();
}

final class _PrefixArenaScreenState extends State<PrefixArenaScreen> {
  late final TextEditingController _answerController;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _answerController = TextEditingController();
    if (widget.notifier.drills.isEmpty && !widget.notifier.isLoading) {
      unawaited(widget.notifier.load());
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _answerController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Directionality(
        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
        child: Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(
            title: const Text(
              'ساحة سوابق الأفعال · Präfix-Arena',
              textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
            ),
          ),
          body: SafeArea(
            child: ListenableBuilder(
              listenable: widget.notifier,
              builder: (context, _) {
                final notifier = widget.notifier;
                final drill = notifier.currentDrill;

                if (notifier.isLoading && drill == null) {
                  return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
                }
                if (drill == null) {
                  return _EmptyState(
                    onRetry: () => unawaited(notifier.load()),
                  );
                }

                return SingleChildScrollView(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 36),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      _ClassSelector(
                        notifier: notifier,
                        onChanged: _clearInput,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 14),
                      _ProgressCard(notifier: notifier),
                      const SizedBox(height: 14),
                      _VerbMapCard(drill: drill),
                      const SizedBox(height: 14),
                      _ExerciseCard(
                        drill: drill,
                        controller: _answerController,
                        notifier: notifier,
                      ),
                      if (notifier.showExplanation) ...<Widget>[
                        const SizedBox(height: 14),
                        _FeedbackCard(
                          drill: drill,
                          correct: notifier.isCorrect == true,
                          feedbackAr: notifier.feedbackAr,
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 14),
                        FilledButton.icon(
                          onPressed: () {
                            notifier.nextDrill();
                            _clearInput();
                          },
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded),
                          label: const Text(
                            'التمرين التالي',
                            textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ],
                  ),
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );

  void _clearInput() {
    _answerController.clear();
  }
}

final class _ClassSelector extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ClassSelector({
    required this.notifier,
    required this.onChanged,
  });

  final PrefixNotifier notifier;
  final VoidCallback onChanged;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        glowColor: AppColors.primary,
        borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(90),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            Text(
              'اختر نوع السابقة',
              textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Wrap(
              spacing: 9,
              runSpacing: 9,
              children: <Widget>[
                ChoiceChip(
                  label: const Text(
                    'Alle',
                    textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                  ),
                  selected: notifier.activeClass == null,
                  selectedColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(34),
                  side: BorderSide(
                    color: notifier.activeClass == null
                        ? AppColors.primary
                        : Theme.of(context).dividerColor,
                  ),
                  onSelected: (_) {
                    onChanged();
                    unawaited(notifier.showAllClasses());
                  },
                ),
                for (final verbClass in VerbPrefixClass.values)
                  ChoiceChip(
                    label: Text(
                      _classLabel(verbClass),
                      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                    ),
                    selected: notifier.activeClass == verbClass,
                    selectedColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(34),
                    side: BorderSide(
                      color: notifier.activeClass == verbClass
                          ? AppColors.primary
                          : Theme.of(context).dividerColor,
                    ),
                    onSelected: (_) {
                      onChanged();
                      unawaited(notifier.switchVerbClass(verbClass));
                    },
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );

  static String _classLabel(VerbPrefixClass value) => switch (value) {
        VerbPrefixClass.trennbar => 'Trennbar',
        VerbPrefixClass.untrennbar => 'Untrennbar',
        VerbPrefixClass.doppeldeutig => 'Doppeldeutig',
      };
}

final class _ExerciseCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ExerciseCard({
    required this.drill,
    required this.controller,
    required this.notifier,
  });

  final PrefixDrillItem drill;
  final TextEditingController controller;
  final PrefixNotifier notifier;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        borderColor: AppColors.glassBorderLight,
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            Text(
              'أكمل الجملة',
              textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Text(
              drill.sentencePrompt,
              textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge?.copyWith(
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                  ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Text(
              drill.translationAr,
              textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
              style: AppTypography.body,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            TextField(
              controller: controller,
              enabled: !notifier.showExplanation,
              textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
              textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
              onChanged: notifier.updateAnswer,
              onSubmitted: notifier.showExplanation
                  ? null
                  : (value) => unawaited(notifier.checkAnswer(value)),
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                labelText: 'Deutscher Satz',
                hintText: drill.sentencePrompt,
                border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            FilledButton.icon(
              onPressed: notifier.canCheck
                  ? () => unawaited(
                        notifier.checkAnswer(controller.text),
                      )
                  : null,
              icon: const Icon(Icons.fact_check_outlined),
              label: const Text(
                'تحقق',
                textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

  final VoidCallback onRetry;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => SingleChildScrollView(
