import '../../../core/agents/system_agent_runtime.dart';
import '../domain/verb_conjugation_models.dart';

final class VerbConjugationEngine {
  VerbConjugationEngine({
    required SystemAgentRuntime runtime,
    required Iterable<VerbConjugation> verbs,
  })  : _runtime = runtime,
        _byId = _indexById(verbs),
        _candidateChunks = _buildCandidateChunks(verbs);

  static const int maxCandidatesPerWorkerJob = 5000;

  final SystemAgentRuntime _runtime;
  final Map<String, VerbConjugation> _byId;
  final List<List<Map<String, Object?>>> _candidateChunks;

  int get verbCount => _byId.length;

  VerbConjugation? byId(String id) => _byId[id.trim()];

  Future<List<VerbSearchHit>> search(
    String query, {
    int limit = 20,
  }) async {
    final normalized = query.trim();
    if (normalized.isEmpty || _candidateChunks.isEmpty) {
      return const <VerbSearchHit>[];
    }

    final boundedLimit = limit.clamp(1, 100).toInt();
    final batches = await Future.wait(
      _candidateChunks.map(
        (chunk) => _runtime.rankFuzzyCandidates(
          query: normalized,
          candidates: chunk,
          limit: boundedLimit,
        ),
      ),
    );

    final bestScores = <String, double>{};
    for (final batch in batches) {
      if (batch == null) continue;
      for (final row in batch) {
        final id = row['id'];
        final rawScore = row['score'];
        if (id is! String || rawScore is! num || !_byId.containsKey(id)) {
          continue;
        }
        final score = rawScore.toDouble().clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
        final previous = bestScores[id];
        if (previous == null || score > previous) {
          bestScores[id] = score;
        }
      }
    }

    final hits = bestScores.entries
        .map(
          (entry) => VerbSearchHit(
            verb: _byId[entry.key]!,
            score: entry.value,
          ),
        )
        .toList(growable: false)
      ..sort((left, right) {
        final byScore = right.score.compareTo(left.score);
        if (byScore != 0) return byScore;
        return left.verb.infinitive.compareTo(right.verb.infinitive);
      });

    return List<VerbSearchHit>.unmodifiable(
      hits.take(boundedLimit),
    );
  }

  static Map<String, VerbConjugation> _indexById(
    Iterable<VerbConjugation> verbs,
  ) {
    final indexed = <String, VerbConjugation>{};
    for (final verb in verbs) {
      final id = verb.id.trim();
      if (indexed.containsKey(id)) {
        throw ArgumentError('Duplicate verb id: ' + id);
      }
      indexed[id] = verb;
    }
    return Map<String, VerbConjugation>.unmodifiable(indexed);
  }

  static List<List<Map<String, Object?>>> _buildCandidateChunks(
    Iterable<VerbConjugation> verbs,
  ) {
    final chunks = <List<Map<String, Object?>>>[];
    var current = <Map<String, Object?>>[];

    for (final verb in verbs) {
      if (current.length == maxCandidatesPerWorkerJob) {
        chunks.add(List<Map<String, Object?>>.unmodifiable(current));
        current = <Map<String, Object?>>[];
      }
      current.add(
        <String, Object?>{
          'id': verb.id.trim(),
          'text': verb.searchText,
        },
      );
    }

    if (current.isNotEmpty) {
      chunks.add(List<Map<String, Object?>>.unmodifiable(current));
    }
    return List<List<Map<String, Object?>>>.unmodifiable(chunks);
  }
}

FILE: lib/features/verbs/domain/verb_conjugation_models.dart

enum VerbPerson { ich, du, erSieEs, wir, ihr, sieSie }

extension VerbPersonLabel on VerbPerson {
  String get label => switch (this) {
        VerbPerson.ich => 'ich',
        VerbPerson.du => 'du',
        VerbPerson.erSieEs => 'er / sie / es',
        VerbPerson.wir => 'wir',
        VerbPerson.ihr => 'ihr',
        VerbPerson.sieSie => 'sie / Sie',
      };
}

final class VerbTenseTable {
  VerbTenseTable({
    required this.key,
    required this.label,
    required Map<VerbPerson, String> forms,
  }) : forms = Map<VerbPerson, String>.unmodifiable(forms) {
    if (key.trim().isEmpty || label.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('Verb tense key and label must not be empty.');
    }
    for (final entry in this.forms.entries) {
      if (entry.value.trim().isEmpty) {
        throw ArgumentError(
          'Verb form for ' + entry.key.label + ' must not be empty.',
        );
      }
    }
  }

  final String key;
  final String label;
  final Map<VerbPerson, String> forms;

  String formFor(VerbPerson person) => forms[person] ?? '—';
}

final class VerbConjugation {
  VerbConjugation({
    required this.id,
    required this.infinitive,
    required this.meaning,
    required List<VerbTenseTable> tenses,
    this.pastParticiple,
    this.auxiliary,
    this.isSeparable = false,
  }) : tenses = List<VerbTenseTable>.unmodifiable(tenses) {
    if (id.trim().isEmpty ||
        infinitive.trim().isEmpty ||
        meaning.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'Verb id, infinitive and meaning must not be empty.',
      );
    }
    if (this.tenses.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('A verb must provide at least one tense table.');
    }
  }

  final String id;
  final String infinitive;
  final String meaning;
  final List<VerbTenseTable> tenses;
  final String? pastParticiple;
  final String? auxiliary;
  final bool isSeparable;

  String get searchText => <String>[
        infinitive,
        meaning,
        if (pastParticiple != null) pastParticiple!,
        if (auxiliary != null) auxiliary!,
      ].join(' ');

  String? get perfektSummary {
    final aux = auxiliary?.trim() ?? '';
    final participle = pastParticiple?.trim() ?? '';
    if (aux.isEmpty || participle.isEmpty) return null;
    return aux + ' ' + participle;
  }
}

final class VerbSearchHit {
  const VerbSearchHit({
    required this.verb,
    required this.score,
  });

  final VerbConjugation verb;
  final double score;
}

FILE: lib/features/verbs/presentation/verb_search_panel.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../core/theme/adaptive_glass_surface.dart';
import '../application/verb_conjugation_engine.dart';
import '../domain/verb_conjugation_models.dart';

class VerbSearchPanel extends StatefulWidget {
  const VerbSearchPanel({
    super.key,
    required this.engine,
    required this.onSelected,
    this.limit = 20,
    this.searchHint = 'Verb suchen…',
  });

  final VerbConjugationEngine engine;
  final ValueChanged<VerbConjugation> onSelected;
  final int limit;
  final String searchHint;

  @override
  State<VerbSearchPanel> createState() => _VerbSearchPanelState();
}

class _VerbSearchPanelState extends State<VerbSearchPanel> {
  final TextEditingController _controller = TextEditingController();

  Timer? _debounce;
  List<VerbSearchHit> _hits = const <VerbSearchHit>[];
  bool _loading = false;
  int _generation = 0;
  String? _error;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _debounce?.cancel();
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onChanged(String raw) {
    _debounce?.cancel();
    final query = raw.trim();
    final generation = ++_generation;

    if (query.isEmpty) {
      setState(() {
        _hits = const <VerbSearchHit>[];
        _loading = false;
        _error = null;
      });
      return;
    }

    setState(() {
      _loading = true;
      _error = null;
    });

    _debounce = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 160), () async {
      try {
        final hits = await widget.engine.search(
          query,
          limit: widget.limit,
        );
        if (!mounted || generation != _generation) return;
        setState(() {
          _hits = hits;
          _loading = false;
        });
      } on Object {
        if (!mounted || generation != _generation) return;
        setState(() {
          _hits = const <VerbSearchHit>[];
          _loading = false;
          _error = 'verb_search_unavailable';
        });
      }
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AdaptiveGlassSurface(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
      child: Column(
        children: <Widget>[
        TextField(
          controller: _controller,
          onChanged: _onChanged,
          textInputAction: TextInputAction.search,
          decoration: InputDecoration(
            hintText: widget.searchHint,
            prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search),
            suffixIcon: _loading
                ? const Padding(
                    padding: EdgeInsets.all(12),
                    child: SizedBox.square(
                      dimension: 20,
                      child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                    ),
                  )
                : null,
          ),
        ),
        if (_error != null)
          const Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
            child: Text('Search is temporarily unavailable.'),
          ),
        if (_hits.isNotEmpty)
          ListView.separated(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
            shrinkWrap: true,
            physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
            itemCount: _hits.length,
            separatorBuilder: (_, __) => const Divider(height: 1),
            itemBuilder: (context, index) {
              final hit = _hits[index];
              return ListTile(
                title: Text(hit.verb.infinitive),
                subtitle: Text(hit.verb.meaning),
                trailing: Text(
                  (hit.score * 100).round().toString() + '%',
                ),
                onTap: () => widget.onSelected(hit.verb),
              );
            },
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:typed_data';


import '../../../../core/media/media_loader_service.dart';
import '../../../../design_system/design_system.dart';

class AppGlassImageCard extends StatefulWidget {
  const AppGlassImageCard({
    required this.wordId,
    required this.mediaLoader,
    this.semanticLabel,
    this.height = 168,
    super.key,
  });

  final String wordId;
  final MediaLoaderService mediaLoader;
  final String? semanticLabel;
  final double height;

  @override
  State<AppGlassImageCard> createState() => _AppGlassImageCardState();
}

class _AppGlassImageCardState extends State<AppGlassImageCard> {
  late Future<Uint8List?> _image;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _image = widget.mediaLoader.loadWordImage(widget.wordId);
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant AppGlassImageCard oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.wordId != widget.wordId ||
        oldWidget.mediaLoader != widget.mediaLoader) {
      _image = widget.mediaLoader.loadWordImage(widget.wordId);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    return AppGlassCard(
      padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
      borderColor: dark ? AppColors.glassBorderDark : AppColors.glassBorderLight,
      backgroundColor: dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface,
      child: SizedBox(
        height: widget.height,
        width: double.infinity,
        child: FutureBuilder<Uint8List?>(
          future: _image,
          builder: (context, snapshot) {
            final bytes = snapshot.data;
            if (snapshot.connectionState != ConnectionState.done) {
              return const _ImageShimmerSkeleton();
            }
            if (snapshot.hasError || bytes == null || bytes.isEmpty) {
              return const _ImagePlaceholder();
            }
            return Semantics(
              image: true,
              label: widget.semanticLabel ?? widget.wordId,
              child: ClipRRect(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
                child: Image.memory(
                  bytes,
                  fit: BoxFit.cover,
                  gaplessPlayback: true,
                  filterQuality: FilterQuality.medium,
                  errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => const _ImagePlaceholder(),
                ),
              ),
            );
          },
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _ImagePlaceholder extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ImagePlaceholder();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    return DecoratedBox(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        gradient: dark ? AppColors.glassDarkGradient : AppColors.glassLightGradient,
      ),
      child: Center(
        child: Icon(
          Icons.image_outlined,
          size: 36,
          color: dark ? AppColors.primaryDark : AppColors.primary,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _ImageShimmerSkeleton extends StatefulWidget {
  const _ImageShimmerSkeleton();

  @override
  State<_ImageShimmerSkeleton> createState() => _ImageShimmerSkeletonState();
}

class _ImageShimmerSkeletonState extends State<_ImageShimmerSkeleton>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late final AnimationController _controller = AnimationController(
    vsync: this,
    duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 1100),
  )..repeat();

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final edge = dark ? AppColors.glassDarkEnd : AppColors.glassLightEnd;
    final highlight = dark ? AppColors.glassDarkStart : AppColors.glassLightStart;
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: _controller,
      builder: (context, child) {
        final position = (_controller.value * 2.4) - 1.2;
        return DecoratedBox(
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            gradient: LinearGradient(
              begin: Alignment(position - 1, 0),
              end: Alignment(position + 1, 0),
              colors: <Color>[edge, highlight, edge],
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../domain/word_formation_models.dart';
import '../domain/word_formation_repository.dart';

final class WordFormationNotifier extends ChangeNotifier {
  WordFormationNotifier(this._repository);

  final WordFormationRepository _repository;

  List<WordDerivationItem> _drills = const <WordDerivationItem>[];
  int _currentIndex = 0;
  SuffixCategory? _activeCategory;
  String? _selectedSuffix;
  String? _formedWord;
  String? _generatedArticle;
  bool? _isCorrect;
  bool _showExplanation = false;
  bool _isLoading = false;
  int _requestGeneration = 0;

  List<WordDerivationItem> get drills =>
      List<WordDerivationItem>.unmodifiable(_drills);
  int get currentIndex => _currentIndex;
  SuffixCategory? get activeCategory => _activeCategory;
  String? get selectedSuffix => _selectedSuffix;
  String? get formedWord => _formedWord;
  String? get generatedArticle => _generatedArticle;
  bool? get isCorrect => _isCorrect;
  bool get showExplanation => _showExplanation;
  bool get isLoading => _isLoading;

  WordDerivationItem? get currentDrill {
    if (_drills.isEmpty || _currentIndex >= _drills.length) return null;
    return _drills[_currentIndex];
  }

  List<String> get availableSuffixes {
    final current = currentDrill;
    if (current == null) return const <String>[];

    final preferred = <String>[
      for (final item in _drills)
        if (item.category == current.category) item.suffix,
    ];
    final fallback = <String>[
      for (final item in _drills) item.suffix,
    ];

    final unique = <String>{...preferred, ...fallback}.toList(growable: false);
    if (unique.length <= 5) return unique;

    final answer = current.suffix;
    final distractors = unique.where((value) => value != answer).take(4);
    return <String>[answer, ...distractors];
  }

  Future<void> load({SuffixCategory? category}) async {
    final generation = ++_requestGeneration;
    _isLoading = true;
    notifyListeners();

    final loaded = await _repository.getDrills(category: category);
    if (generation != _requestGeneration) return;

    _drills = List<WordDerivationItem>.unmodifiable(loaded);
    _activeCategory = category;
    _currentIndex = 0;
    _clearAttempt();
    _isLoading = false;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> combineSuffix(String suffix) async {
    final drill = currentDrill;
    if (drill == null || _showExplanation) return;

    final selected = _normalizeForCategory(suffix, drill.category);
    final expected = _normalizeForCategory(drill.suffix, drill.category);
    final generation = ++_requestGeneration;

    _selectedSuffix = selected;
    _formedWord = drill.composeAttempt(selected);
    _generatedArticle = WordDerivationItem.articleForAffix(
      selected,
      category: drill.category,
    );
    _isCorrect = null;
    _showExplanation = false;
    notifyListeners();

    final wordCorrect = await _repository.checkDerivedWord(
      drill.id,
      _formedWord!,
    );
    final articleCorrect = await _repository.checkArticle(
      drill.id,
      _generatedArticle ?? '',
    );

    if (generation != _requestGeneration ||
        currentDrill?.id != drill.id) {
      return;
    }

    _isCorrect =
        selected == expected && wordCorrect && articleCorrect;
    _showExplanation = true;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void nextDrill() {
    if (_drills.isEmpty) return;
    _requestGeneration++;
    _currentIndex = (_currentIndex + 1) % _drills.length;
    _clearAttempt();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> filterByCategory(SuffixCategory category) async {
    await load(category: category);
  }

  Future<void> clearCategoryFilter() async {
    await load();
  }

  void _clearAttempt() {
    _selectedSuffix = null;
    _formedWord = null;
    _generatedArticle = null;
    _isCorrect = null;
    _showExplanation = false;
  }

  static String _normalizeForCategory(
    String value,
    SuffixCategory category,
  ) {
    final trimmed = value.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (trimmed.isEmpty) return '';

    if (category == SuffixCategory.verbPrefixDerivation) {
      return trimmed.endsWith('-') ? trimmed : '$trimmed-';
    }

    return trimmed.startsWith('-') ? trimmed : '-$trimmed';
  }
}

import '../domain/word_formation_models.dart';
import '../domain/word_formation_repository.dart';

final class LocalWordFormationRepository implements WordFormationRepository {
  LocalWordFormationRepository() : _drills = _buildBank();

  final List<WordDerivationItem> _drills;

  @override
  Future<List<WordDerivationItem>> getDrills({
    SuffixCategory? category,
  }) async {
    final selected = category == null
        ? _drills
        : _drills
            .where((item) => item.category == category)
            .toList(growable: false);
    return List<WordDerivationItem>.unmodifiable(selected);
  }

  @override
  Future<bool> checkDerivedWord(
    String drillId,
    String candidate,
  ) async {
    final item = _find(drillId);
    if (item == null) return false;
    return candidate.trim() == item.derivedWord;
  }

  @override
  Future<bool> checkArticle(
    String drillId,
    String article,
  ) async {
    final item = _find(drillId);
    if (item == null) return false;

    final expected = item.article;
    final candidate = article.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (expected == null) return candidate.isEmpty;
    return candidate == expected;
  }

  WordDerivationItem? _find(String id) {
    for (final item in _drills) {
      if (item.id == id) return item;
    }
    return null;
  }

  static List<WordDerivationItem> _buildBank() {

        exercisePromptAr:
            'اشتق اسماً من hoffen باستخدام اللاحقة المناسبة.',
      ),
      WordDerivationItem(

        derivedWord: 'Pünktlichkeit',
        category: SuffixCategory.nounSuffix,
        arabicMeaning: 'الالتزام بالمواعيد',

            'اختر البادئة التي تنتج الفعل verstehen.',
      ),
    ];

    final ids = items.map((item) => item.id).toSet();
    if (ids.length != items.length) {
      throw StateError('word formation bank contains duplicate ids');
    }
    return List<WordDerivationItem>.unmodifiable(items);
  }
}


--------------------------------------------------
FILE: lib/features/word_formation/domain/word_formation_models.dart
--------------------------------------------------
enum SuffixCategory {
  nounSuffix,
  adjectiveSuffix,
  verbPrefixDerivation,
}

final class WordDerivationItem {
  const WordDerivationItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.rootWord,
    required this.rootWordType,
    required this.suffix,
    required this.derivedWord,
    required this.category,
    required this.arabicMeaning,
    required this.semanticShiftAr,
    required this.exercisePromptAr,
  });

  final String id;
  final String rootWord;
  final String rootWordType;
  final String suffix;
  final String derivedWord;
  final SuffixCategory category;
  final String arabicMeaning;
  final String semanticShiftAr;
  final String exercisePromptAr;

  String? get article => articleForAffix(
        suffix,
        category: category,
      );

  bool get isPrefixDerivation =>
      category == SuffixCategory.verbPrefixDerivation;

  String composeAttempt(String selectedAffix) {
    final normalized = normalizeAffix(selectedAffix);
    if (normalized == normalizeAffix(suffix)) return derivedWord;

    if (normalized.endsWith('-')) {
      final prefix = normalized.substring(0, normalized.length - 1);
      return '$prefix$rootWord';
    }

    final ending =
        normalized.startsWith('-') ? normalized.substring(1) : normalized;
    return '$rootWord$ending';
  }

  static String? articleForAffix(
    String affix, {
    required SuffixCategory category,
  }) {
    if (category != SuffixCategory.nounSuffix) return null;

    return switch (normalizeAffix(affix)) {
      '-ung' || '-heit' || '-keit' || '-schaft' => 'die',
      _ => null,
    };
  }

  static String normalizeAffix(String value) {
    final trimmed = value.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (trimmed.isEmpty) return '';
    if (trimmed.endsWith('-')) return trimmed;
    return trimmed.startsWith('-') ? trimmed : '-$trimmed';
  }
}

import 'dart:async';


import '../../../design_system/design_system.dart';
import '../application/word_formation_notifier.dart';
import '../domain/word_formation_models.dart';

final class WordFormationScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const WordFormationScreen({
    required this.notifier,
    super.key,
  });

  final WordFormationNotifier notifier;

  @override
  State<WordFormationScreen> createState() => _WordFormationScreenState();
}

final class _WordFormationScreenState extends State<WordFormationScreen> {
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    if (widget.notifier.currentDrill == null &&
        !widget.notifier.isLoading) {
      unawaited(widget.notifier.load());
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: const Text(
            'اشتقاق الكلمات · Wortbildung',
            textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
          ),
        ),
        body: SafeArea(
          child: ListenableBuilder(
            listenable: widget.notifier,
            builder: (context, _) {
              final notifier = widget.notifier;
              final drill = notifier.currentDrill;

              if (notifier.isLoading && drill == null) {
                return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
              }

              return SingleChildScrollView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 32),
                child: drill == null
                    ? _EmptyState(
                        onRetry: () => unawaited(notifier.load()),
                      )
                    : Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                        children: <Widget>[
                          _HeaderCard(notifier: notifier),
                          const SizedBox(height: 14),
                          _CategoryFilters(notifier: notifier),
                          const SizedBox(height: 14),
                          const _GoldenRuleCard(),
                          const SizedBox(height: 14),
                          _DerivationWorkbench(
                            drill: drill,
                            notifier: notifier,
                          ),
                          if (notifier.showExplanation) ...<Widget>[
                            const SizedBox(height: 14),
                            _FeedbackCard(
                              drill: drill,
                              notifier: notifier,
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(height: 14),
                            FilledButton.icon(
                              onPressed: notifier.nextDrill,
                              icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded),
                              label: const Text(
                                'التمرين التالي',
                                textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ],
                      ),
              );
            },
          ),
        ),
      );
}

final class _DerivationWorkbench extends StatelessWidget {

                ),

                  Icons.arrow_forward_rounded,
                  color: AppColors.achievement,

                _GermanToken(
                  label: notifier.formedWord ?? '…',
                  accent: AppColors.achievement,
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Text(

              textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,

              style: AppTypography.label,

            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            Text(
              drill.isPrefixDerivation
                  ? 'اختر البادئة'
                  : 'اختر اللاحقة',
              textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
              style: AppTypography.label,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Wrap(
              alignment: WrapAlignment.center,
              spacing: 8,
              runSpacing: 8,
              children: <Widget>[
                for (final suffix in notifier.availableSuffixes)
                  _SuffixChoice(
                    suffix: suffix,
                    selected: notifier.selectedSuffix == suffix,
                    disabled: notifier.showExplanation,
                    onTap: () => unawaited(
                      notifier.combineSuffix(suffix),
                    ),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

              'لا توجد تمارين اشتقاق متاحة.',
              textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
              style: AppTypography.title,
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            FilledButton(
              onPressed: onRetry,
              child: const Text(
                'إعادة التحميل',
                textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../../../core/explainer/explainer.dart';
import '../../../core/quick_review/quick_review.dart';
import '../../../design_system/app_audio_button.dart';
import '../../../design_system/app_colors.dart';
import '../../../design_system/app_glass_card.dart';
import '../../../design_system/app_typography.dart';
import '../../../features/audio/hybrid_pronunciation_service.dart';
import '../../../features/daily_drill/domain/daily_drill_repository.dart';

class V11QuickReviewScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const V11QuickReviewScreen({
    required this.session,
    required this.reviewSink,
    required this.pronunciationAudio,
    required this.explainerService,
    required this.sourceLanguageCode,
    required this.translationLanguageCode,
    super.key,
  });

  final QuickReviewSession session;
  final DailyDrillReviewSink reviewSink;
  final HybridPronunciationService pronunciationAudio;
  final ExplainerService explainerService;
  final String sourceLanguageCode;
  final String translationLanguageCode;

  @override
  State<V11QuickReviewScreen> createState() => _V11QuickReviewScreenState();
}

class _V11QuickReviewScreenState extends State<V11QuickReviewScreen> {
  int _index = 0;
  int _correct = 0;
  int _currentStreak = 0;
  int _sessionXp = 0;
  bool _revealed = false;
  bool _busy = false;
  bool _audioBusy = false;
  bool _explanationBusy = false;
  ExplainerResult? _explanation;
  DateTime _cardStartedAt = DateTime.now();

  QuickReviewCard? get _current {
    if (widget.session.isEmpty ||
        _index < 0 ||
        _index >= widget.session.cards.length) {
      return null;
    }
    return widget.session.cards[_index];
  }

  bool get _completed =>
      widget.session.isEmpty || _index >= widget.session.cards.length;

  Future<void> _playCurrent() async {
    final card = _current;
    if (card == null || _busy || _audioBusy) return;
    setState(() => _audioBusy = true);
    try {
      final result = await widget.pronunciationAudio.play(
        conceptId: card.contentId,
        text: card.sourceText,
        languageCode: widget.sourceLanguageCode,
      );
      if (!mounted || result.played) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: AppDirectionalText(
            'الصوت المحلي غير متاح: ${result.reason ?? 'unknown'}',
            languageCode: 'ar',
            style: AppTypography.body,
          ),
        ),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _audioBusy = false);
      }
    }
  }

  void _reveal() {
    if (_busy || _revealed || _current == null) return;
    setState(() => _revealed = true);
  }

  Future<void> _explainCurrent() async {
    final card = _current;
    if (card == null || _explanationBusy) return;
    setState(() => _explanationBusy = true);
    try {
      final result = await widget.explainerService.explainWhy(
        ExplainerRequest(contentId: card.contentId),
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _explanation = result;
        _explanationBusy = false;
      });
    } on Object {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() => _explanationBusy = false);
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: AppDirectionalText(
            'تعذر تحميل الشرح المحلي لهذه البطاقة.',
            languageCode: 'ar',
            style: AppTypography.body,
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _grade(bool correct) async {
    final card = _current;
    if (card == null || _busy || !_revealed) return;

    setState(() => _busy = true);
    final elapsed = DateTime.now().difference(_cardStartedAt);
    try {
      final receipt = await widget.reviewSink.record(
        item: _QuickReviewLearningContent(card),
        correct: correct,
        seconds: elapsed.inSeconds.clamp(1, 3600).toInt(),
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        if (correct) _correct += 1;
        _currentStreak = receipt.currentStreak;
        _sessionXp = receipt.sessionXp;
        _index += 1;
        _revealed = false;
        _busy = false;
        _explanation = null;
        _cardStartedAt = DateTime.now();
      });
    } on Object {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() => _busy = false);
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: AppDirectionalText(
            'تعذر حفظ المراجعة الآن. لم يتم تجاوز البطاقة.',
            languageCode: 'ar',
            style: AppTypography.body,
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Directionality(
        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
        child: Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(
            title: AppDirectionalText(
              'المراجعة السريعة',
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
          ),
          body: SafeArea(
            child: _completed ? _completion() : _activeReview(),
          ),
        ),
      );

  Widget _activeReview() {
    final card = _current!;
    return ListView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 28),
      children: <Widget>[
        _header(),
        const SizedBox(height: 14),
        AppGlassCard(
          glowColor: _articleColor(card.grammaticalMarker),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: <Widget>[
              if (card.grammaticalMarker.trim().isNotEmpty)
                AppDirectionalText(
                  card.grammaticalMarker,
                  languageCode: widget.sourceLanguageCode,
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
                    color: _articleColor(card.grammaticalMarker),
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                  ),
                ),
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              AppDirectionalText(
                card.sourceText,
                languageCode: widget.sourceLanguageCode,
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                style: AppTypography.display,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),
              Center(
                child: AppAudioButton(
                  key: const Key('quick-review-audio'),
                  onPressed:
                      _busy || _audioBusy ? null : () => unawaited(_playCurrent()),
                  semanticLabel: 'استمع إلى المفردة الألمانية',
                  isBusy: _audioBusy,
                  activeColor: _articleColor(card.grammaticalMarker),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              if (!_revealed)
                FilledButton.icon(
                  key: const Key('quick-review-reveal'),
                  onPressed: _busy ? null : _reveal,
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.visibility_rounded),
                  label: AppDirectionalText(
                    'إظهار الإجابة',
                    languageCode: 'ar',
                    style: AppTypography.label,
                  ),
                )
              else ...<Widget>[
                const Divider(),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                AppDirectionalText(
                  card.translationText,
                  languageCode: widget.translationLanguageCode,
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  style: AppTypography.title,
                ),
                if (card.exampleText.trim().isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  AppDirectionalText(
                    card.exampleText,
                    languageCode: widget.sourceLanguageCode,
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: AppTypography.body.copyWith(
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
                if (card.exampleTranslationText.trim().isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  AppDirectionalText(
                    card.exampleTranslationText,
                    languageCode: widget.translationLanguageCode,
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: AppTypography.body,
                  ),
                ],
                if (card.pluralForm.trim().isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                  Row(
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      AppDirectionalText(
                        'الجمع:',
                        languageCode: 'ar',
                        style: AppTypography.label,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 6),
                      AppDirectionalText(
                        card.pluralForm,
                        languageCode: widget.sourceLanguageCode,
                        style: AppTypography.label,
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ],
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                OutlinedButton.icon(
                  key: const Key('quick-review-explain'),
                  onPressed: _explanationBusy
                      ? null
                      : () => unawaited(_explainCurrent()),
                  icon: _explanationBusy
                      ? const SizedBox.square(
                          dimension: 16,
                          child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                        )
                      : const Icon(Icons.lightbulb_outline_rounded),
                  label: AppDirectionalText(
                    'لماذا؟',
                    languageCode: 'ar',
                    style: AppTypography.label,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ],
          ),
        ),
        if (_explanation != null) ...<Widget>[
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          _ExplanationCard(
            result: _explanation!,
            sourceLanguageCode: widget.sourceLanguageCode,
            translationLanguageCode: widget.translationLanguageCode,
          ),
        ],
        if (_revealed) ...<Widget>[
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          Row(
            children: <Widget>[
              Expanded(
                child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                  key: const Key('quick-review-forgot'),
                  onPressed: _busy ? null : () => unawaited(_grade(false)),
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh_rounded),
                  label: AppDirectionalText(
                    'نسيت',
                    languageCode: 'ar',
                    style: AppTypography.label,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 10),
              Expanded(
                child: FilledButton.icon(
                  key: const Key('quick-review-remembered'),
                  onPressed: _busy ? null : () => unawaited(_grade(true)),
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.check_rounded),
                  label: AppDirectionalText(
                    'تذكرت',
                    languageCode: 'ar',
                    style: AppTypography.label,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _header() {
    final total = widget.session.cards.length;
    final current = (_index + 1).clamp(1, total);
    return AppGlassCard(
      borderColor: AppColors.primary.withAlpha(72),
      child: Row(
        children: <Widget>[
          Expanded(
            child: LinearProgressIndicator(
              value: total == 0 ? 0 : current / total,
              minHeight: 7,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          AppDirectionalText(
            '$current/$total',
            languageCode: 'ar',
            style: AppTypography.label,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _completion() {
    if (widget.session.isEmpty) {
      return Center(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
          child: AppDirectionalText(
            'لا توجد بطاقات مراجعة مستحقة الآن.',
            languageCode: 'ar',
            style: AppTypography.body,
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    return Center(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
        child: AppGlassCard(
          glowColor: AppColors.mastery,
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: <Widget>[
              const Icon(Icons.task_alt_rounded, size: 52),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              AppDirectionalText(
                'اكتملت المراجعة',
                languageCode: 'ar',
                style: AppTypography.title,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              AppDirectionalText(
                'صحيح $_correct/${widget.session.length} · '
                'السلسلة $_currentStreak · XP $_sessionXp',
                languageCode: 'ar',
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                style: AppTypography.body,
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Color _articleColor(String raw) => switch (raw.trim().toLowerCase()) {
        'der' => AppColors.articleDer,
        'die' => AppColors.articleDie,
        'das' => AppColors.articleDas,
        _ => AppColors.articleOther,
      };
}

class _ExplanationCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ExplanationCard({
    required this.result,
    required this.sourceLanguageCode,
    required this.translationLanguageCode,
  });

  final ExplainerResult result;
  final String sourceLanguageCode;
  final String translationLanguageCode;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (!result.found ||
        (result.explanationText.isEmpty && result.facts.isEmpty)) {
      return AppGlassCard(
        key: const Key('quick-review-explanation-card'),
        child: AppDirectionalText(
          'لا يوجد شرح محلي موثّق إضافي لهذه البطاقة.',
          languageCode: 'ar',
          style: AppTypography.body,
        ),
      );
    }

    return AppGlassCard(
      key: const Key('quick-review-explanation-card'),
      glowColor: AppColors.secondary,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          AppDirectionalText(
            'لماذا؟',
            languageCode: 'ar',
            style: AppTypography.title,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          if (result.explanationText.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
            AppDirectionalText(
              result.explanationText,
              key: const Key('quick-review-reason-text'),
              languageCode: translationLanguageCode,
              style: AppTypography.body.copyWith(
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
              ),
            ),
            if (result.facts.isNotEmpty) const SizedBox(height: 10),
          ],
          for (final fact in result.facts) ...<Widget>[
            Row(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: <Widget>[
                AppDirectionalText(
                  '${_label(fact.kind)}:',
                  languageCode: 'ar',
                  style: AppTypography.label,
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 6),
                Expanded(
                  child: AppDirectionalText(
                    fact.value,
                    languageCode: _factLanguageCode(fact.kind),
                    style: AppTypography.body,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            if (fact.evidence.isNotEmpty)
              AppDirectionalText(
                fact.evidence.join(' · '),
                languageCode: _factLanguageCode(fact.kind),
                style: AppTypography.label,
              ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  String _factLanguageCode(ExplainerFactKind kind) => switch (kind) {
        ExplainerFactKind.meaning => translationLanguageCode,
        _ => sourceLanguageCode,
      };

  String _label(ExplainerFactKind kind) => switch (kind) {
        ExplainerFactKind.meaning => 'المعنى',
        ExplainerFactKind.grammaticalMarker => 'الأداة',
        ExplainerFactKind.pluralForm => 'الجمع',
        ExplainerFactKind.usageExample => 'مثال',
        ExplainerFactKind.verbAgreement => 'التصريف',
        ExplainerFactKind.pastForm => 'الماضي',
      };
}

final class _QuickReviewLearningContent implements LearningContent {
  _QuickReviewLearningContent(QuickReviewCard card)
      : id = card.contentId,
        sourceText = card.sourceText,
        translationText = card.translationText,
        exampleText = card.exampleText,
        exampleTranslationText = card.exampleTranslationText,
        topic = card.topic,
        skill = card.skill,
        grammaticalMarker = card.grammaticalMarker,
        pluralForm = card.pluralForm,
        acceptedForms = List<String>.unmodifiable(card.acceptedForms);

  @override
  final String id;
  @override
  final String sourceText;
  @override
  final String translationText;
  @override
  final String exampleText;
  @override
  final String exampleTranslationText;
  @override
  final String topic;
  @override
  final String skill;
  @override
  final String grammaticalMarker;
  @override
  final String pluralForm;
  @override
  final List<String> acceptedForms;
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../core/explainer/explainer.dart';
import '../../../core/memory.dart';
import '../../../core/quick_review/quick_review.dart';
import '../../../design_system/app_colors.dart';
import '../../../design_system/app_glass_card.dart';
import '../../../design_system/app_typography.dart';
import '../../../features/audio/hybrid_pronunciation_service.dart';
import '../../../features/daily_drill/domain/daily_drill_repository.dart';
import 'v11_quick_review_screen.dart';

class SrsReviewHubScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const SrsReviewHubScreen({
    required this.session,
    required this.sourceLanguageCode,
    required this.translationLanguageCode,
    required this.reviewSink,
    required this.pronunciationAudio,
    required this.explainerService,
    super.key,
  });

  final QuickReviewSession session;
  final String sourceLanguageCode;
  final String translationLanguageCode;
  final DailyDrillReviewSink reviewSink;
  final HybridPronunciationService pronunciationAudio;
  final ExplainerService explainerService;

  Future<void> _startReview(BuildContext context) async {
    await Navigator.of(context).push<void>(
      MaterialPageRoute<void>(
        builder: (_) => V11QuickReviewScreen(
          session: session,
          reviewSink: reviewSink,
          pronunciationAudio: pronunciationAudio,
          explainerService: explainerService,
          sourceLanguageCode: sourceLanguageCode,
          translationLanguageCode: translationLanguageCode,
        ),
      ),
    );
    if (context.mounted) {
      Navigator.of(context).pop();
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final overdue = session.cards
        .where((card) => card.reason == MemoryReviewReason.overdue)
        .length;
    final lapses = session.cards.where((card) => card.lapses > 0).length;
    final averageInterval = session.cards.isEmpty
        ? 0
        : (session.cards.fold<int>(
                  0,
                  (sum, card) => sum + card.intervalDays,
                ) /
                session.cards.length)
            .round();

    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: AppDirectionalText(
            'مركز المراجعة SRS',
            languageCode: 'ar',
            style: AppTypography.title,
          ),
        ),
        body: SafeArea(
          child: ListView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 32),
            children: <Widget>[
              AppGlassCard(
                glowColor: AppColors.primary,
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    AppDirectionalText(
                      'مراجعة ذكية بدون تشتيت',
                      languageCode: 'ar',
                      style: AppTypography.title,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    AppDirectionalText(
                      session.isEmpty
                          ? 'لا توجد بطاقات مستحقة الآن. '
                              'سيبقى تقدمك محفوظًا محليًا.'
                          : 'هذه الجلسة مبنية من بطاقات SRS المستحقة '
                              'في الحالة المحلية الحالية فقط.',
                      languageCode: 'ar',
                      style: AppTypography.body,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),
              _ReviewStatsGrid(
                due: session.length,
                overdue: overdue,
                lapses: lapses,
                averageInterval: averageInterval,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),
              if (session.cards.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                AppDirectionalText(
                  'بطاقات الجلسة',
                  languageCode: 'ar',
                  style: AppTypography.title,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                for (var index = 0;
                    index < session.cards.length && index < 5;
                    index++) ...<Widget>[
                  _DueCardPreview(
                    card: session.cards[index],
                    sourceLanguageCode: sourceLanguageCode,
                    translationLanguageCode: translationLanguageCode,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                ],
                if (session.cards.length > 5)
                  AppGlassCard(
                    opacity: .12,
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                    child: AppDirectionalText(
                      'و${session.cards.length - 5} بطاقات أخرى '
                      'ضمن هذه الجلسة.',
                      languageCode: 'ar',
                      style: AppTypography.label,
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    ),
                  ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
              ],
              FilledButton.icon(
                key: const Key('srs-review-hub-start'),
                onPressed: session.isEmpty
                    ? null
                    : () => unawaited(_startReview(context)),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.play_circle_outline_rounded),
                label: AppDirectionalText(
                  session.isEmpty
                      ? 'لا توجد مراجعة مستحقة'
                      : 'ابدأ جلسة المراجعة',
                  languageCode: 'ar',
                  style: AppTypography.label,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _ReviewStatsGrid extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ReviewStatsGrid({
    required this.due,
    required this.overdue,
    required this.lapses,
    required this.averageInterval,
  });

  final int due;
  final int overdue;
  final int lapses;
  final int averageInterval;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {

      _ReviewStat(
        label: 'مستحقة الآن',
        value: '$due',
        icon: Icons.schedule_rounded,
        accent: AppColors.primary,
      ),
      _ReviewStat(
        label: 'متأخرة',

                        stat.value,
                        languageCode: 'ar',

                          color: stat.accent,
                        ),
                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 3),
                      AppDirectionalText(
                        stat.label,
                        languageCode: 'ar',
                        style: AppTypography.label,
                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

class _DueCardPreview extends StatelessWidget {
  const _DueCardPreview({
    required this.card,
    required this.sourceLanguageCode,
    required this.translationLanguageCode,
  });

  final QuickReviewCard card;
  final String sourceLanguageCode;
  final String translationLanguageCode;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AppGlassCard(
        borderColor: _reasonColor(card.reason).withAlpha(100),
        glowColor: _reasonColor(card.reason),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
        child: Row(
          children: <Widget>[
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  AppDirectionalText(
                    card.sourceText,
                    languageCode: sourceLanguageCode,
                    style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(fontSize: 17),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  AppDirectionalText(
                    card.translationText,
                    languageCode: translationLanguageCode,
                    style: AppTypography.body,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  AppDirectionalText(
                    _reasonLabel(card.reason),
                    languageCode: 'ar',
                    style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
                      color: _reasonColor(card.reason),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 10),
            AppDirectionalText(
              '${card.intervalDays}د',
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.label,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );

  Color _reasonColor(MemoryReviewReason reason) => switch (reason) {
        MemoryReviewReason.overdue => AppColors.tertiary,
        MemoryReviewReason.lapse => AppColors.secondary,
        MemoryReviewReason.consolidation => AppColors.mastery,
        MemoryReviewReason.due => AppColors.primary,
      };

  String _reasonLabel(MemoryReviewReason reason) => switch (reason) {
        MemoryReviewReason.overdue => 'متأخرة عن موعدها',
        MemoryReviewReason.lapse => 'تحتاج إعادة تثبيت',
        MemoryReviewReason.consolidation => 'تثبيت الذاكرة',
        MemoryReviewReason.due => 'مستحقة الآن',
      };
}

class _ReviewStat {
  const _ReviewStat({
    required this.label,
    required this.value,
    required this.icon,
    required this.accent,
  });

  final String label;
  final String value;
  final IconData icon;
  final Color accent;
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_tts/flutter_tts.dart';

class AudioStudyPlayer extends StatefulWidget {
  final List<Map<String, String>> words;

  const AudioStudyPlayer({
    super.key,
    required this.words,
  });

  @override
  State<AudioStudyPlayer> createState() => _AudioStudyPlayerState();
}

class _AudioStudyPlayerState extends State<AudioStudyPlayer> {
  final FlutterTts _tts = FlutterTts();
  int _currentIndex = 0;
  bool _isPlaying = false;
  bool _showTranslation = false;
  Timer? _loopTimer;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _initTts();
  }

  Future<void> _initTts() async {
    await _tts.setLanguage('de-DE');
    await _tts.setSpeechRate(0.45);
    await _tts.setVolume(1.0);
    await _tts.setPitch(1.0);
  }

  void _startLoop() {
    if (widget.words.isEmpty) return;
    setState(() => _isPlaying = true);
    _playCurrentStep();
  }

  void _pauseLoop() {
    _loopTimer?.cancel();
    _tts.stop();
    setState(() => _isPlaying = false);
  }

  Future<void> _playCurrentStep() async {
    if (!_isPlaying || !mounted) return;

    final word = widget.words[_currentIndex];
    setState(() => _showTranslation = false);

    // نطق الكلمة الألمانية
    await _tts.speak(word['german'] ?? '');

    // إظهار الترجمة بعد فاصل زمني قصير
    _loopTimer = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 1800), () {
      if (!mounted || !_isPlaying) return;
      setState(() => _showTranslation = true);

      // الانتقال للكلمة التالية تلقائياً بعد مهلة استيعاب
      _loopTimer = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 2200), () {
        if (!mounted || !_isPlaying) return;
        if (_currentIndex < widget.words.length - 1) {
          setState(() => _currentIndex++);
          _playCurrentStep();
        } else {
          setState(() {
            _isPlaying = false;
            _currentIndex = 0;
          });
        }
      });
    });
  }

  void _nextWord() {
    _pauseLoop();
    if (_currentIndex < widget.words.length - 1) {
      setState(() {
        _currentIndex++;
        _showTranslation = false;
      });
    }
  }

  void _prevWord() {
    _pauseLoop();
    if (_currentIndex > 0) {
      setState(() {
        _currentIndex--;
        _showTranslation = false;
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _loopTimer?.cancel();
    _tts.stop();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (widget.words.isEmpty) {
      return const Center(child: Text('لا توجد كلمات متاحة حالياً'));
    }

    final current = widget.words[_currentIndex];

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('المشغل الصوتي التلقائي'),
        centerTitle: true,
      ),
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24.0),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
              Text(
                'الكلمة ${_currentIndex + 1} من ${widget.words.length}',
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 32),
              // بطاقة الكلمة الألمانية
              Card(
                elevation: 4,
                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16)),
                child: Container(
                  width: double.infinity,
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 40, horizontal: 20),
                  child: Column(
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        current['german'] ?? '',
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 32,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          color: Colors.blueAccent,
                        ),
                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 24),
                      AnimatedOpacity(
                        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
                        opacity: _showTranslation ? 1.0 : 0.0,
                        child: Text(
                          current['arabic'] ?? '',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 24,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                            color: Colors.black87,
                          ),
                          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 48),
              // أزرار التحكم
              Row(
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                children: [
                  IconButton(
                    iconSize: 36,
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.skip_previous_rounded),
                    onPressed: _currentIndex > 0 ? _prevWord : null,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 20),
                  FloatingActionButton.large(
                    onPressed: _isPlaying ? _pauseLoop : _startLoop,
                    child: Icon(_isPlaying ? Icons.pause_rounded : Icons.play_arrow_rounded),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 20),
                  IconButton(
                    iconSize: 36,
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.skip_next_rounded),
                    onPressed: _currentIndex < widget.words.length - 1 ? _nextWord : null,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:math';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class InstantQuizScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final List<Map<String, String>> words;

  const InstantQuizScreen({super.key, required this.words});

  @override
  State<InstantQuizScreen> createState() => _InstantQuizScreenState();
}

class _InstantQuizScreenState extends State<InstantQuizScreen> {
  int _currentIndex = 0;
  int _score = 0;
  List<String> _options = [];
  String? _selectedAnswer;
  bool _answered = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _generateQuestion();
  }

  void _generateQuestion() {
    if (widget.words.length < 4) return;
    _answered = false;
    _selectedAnswer = null;

    final currentWord = widget.words[_currentIndex];
    final correctAnswer = currentWord['arabic'] ?? '';

    final random = Random();
    final otherOptions = widget.words
        .where((w) => (w['arabic'] ?? '') != correctAnswer)
        .map((w) => w['arabic'] ?? '')
        .toList();

    otherOptions.shuffle(random);
    final selectedWrong = otherOptions.take(3).toList();

    _options = [correctAnswer, ...selectedWrong]..shuffle(random);
  }

  void _handleSelect(String answer) {
    if (_answered) return;
    final correctAnswer = widget.words[_currentIndex]['arabic'] ?? '';
    setState(() {
      _answered = true;
      _selectedAnswer = answer;
      if (answer == correctAnswer) _score++;
    });
  }

  void _nextQuestion() {
    if (_currentIndex < widget.words.length - 1) {
      setState(() {
        _currentIndex++;
        _generateQuestion();
      });
    } else {
      _showResultDialog();
    }
  }

  void _showResultDialog() {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: false,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('نتيجة الاختبار', textAlign: TextAlign.center),
        content: Text(
          'أحسنت! نتيجتك: $_score من أصل ${widget.words.length}',
          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              Navigator.pop(ctx);
              Navigator.pop(context);
            },
            child: const Text('إنهاء'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (widget.words.length < 4) {
      return Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('اختبار سريع')),
        body: const Center(
          child: Text('تحتاج إلى 4 كلمات على الأقل لتشغيل الاختبار.'),
        ),
      );
    }

    final currentWord = widget.words[_currentIndex];
    final correctAnswer = currentWord['arabic'] ?? '';

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text('سؤال ${_currentIndex + 1} / ${widget.words.length}'),
        centerTitle: true,
      ),
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20.0),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: [
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              Card(
                elevation: 3,
                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16)),
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 36, horizontal: 16),
                  child: Text(
                    currentWord['german'] ?? '',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 30,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      color: Colors.blueAccent,
                    ),
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 32),
              ..._options.map((option) {
                Color btnColor = Colors.white;
                if (_answered) {
                  if (option == correctAnswer) {
                    btnColor = Colors.green.shade100;
                  } else if (option == _selectedAnswer) {
                    btnColor = Colors.red.shade100;
                  }
                }

                return Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 6.0),
                  child: OutlinedButton(
                    style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: btnColor,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                    ),
                    onPressed: () => _handleSelect(option),
                    child: Text(
                      option,
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                    ),
                  ),
                );
              }),
              const Spacer(),
              if (_answered)
                ElevatedButton(
                  style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),
                    shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                  ),
                  onPressed: _nextQuestion,
                  child: Text(
                    _currentIndex < widget.words.length - 1 ? 'السؤال التالي' : 'عرض النتيجة',
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18),
                  ),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
