import '../language_exercise_strategy.dart';
import '../../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../../models/assessment.dart';
import '../../models/conversation.dart';
import '../../models/mistake.dart';
import '../../models/production.dart';

/// German-specific exercise wording and scenario data.
final class GermanLanguageExerciseStrategy implements LanguageExerciseStrategy {
  const GermanLanguageExerciseStrategy();

  @override
  AssessmentQuestion assessmentQuestion(
    LearningContent x,
    int index,
    int seed,
  ) {
    final types = AssessmentQuestionType.values;
    final type = types[(index + seed + x.id.length) % types.length];
    switch (type) {
      case AssessmentQuestionType.recall:
        return AssessmentQuestion(
          id: 'q_${x.id}_r',
          itemId: x.id,
          prompt: 'ما الكلمة/العبارة الألمانية؟ ${x.translationText}',
          expected: x.sourceText,
          type: type,
          accepted: x.acceptedForms,
          skill: 'recall',
        );
      case AssessmentQuestionType.translation:
        return AssessmentQuestion(
          id: 'q_${x.id}_t',
          itemId: x.id,
          prompt: 'ترجم إلى الألمانية: ${x.exampleTranslationText}',
          expected: x.exampleText,
          type: type,
          accepted: [...x.acceptedForms, x.sourceText],
          skill: 'transfer',
        );
      case AssessmentQuestionType.listening:
        return AssessmentQuestion(
          id: 'q_${x.id}_l',
          itemId: x.id,
          prompt: 'استمع ثم اكتب الجملة الألمانية.',
          expected: x.exampleText,
          type: type,
          accepted: x.acceptedForms,
          skill: 'listening',
        );
      case AssessmentQuestionType.production:
        return AssessmentQuestion(
          id: 'q_${x.id}_p',
          itemId: x.id,
          prompt: 'اكتب جملة ألمانية مناسبة باستخدام: ${x.sourceText}',
          expected: x.exampleText,
          type: type,
          accepted: x.acceptedForms,
          skill: 'production',
        );
      case AssessmentQuestionType.grammar:
        return AssessmentQuestion(
          id: 'q_${x.id}_g',
          itemId: x.id,
          prompt: x.grammaticalMarker.isEmpty
              ? 'اكتب الكلمة الألمانية الصحيحة.'
              : 'اكتب الكلمة مع Artikel الصحيح: ${x.translationText}',
          expected: x.grammaticalMarker.isEmpty
              ? x.sourceText
              : '${x.grammaticalMarker} ${x.sourceText}',
          type: type,
          accepted: [...x.acceptedForms, x.sourceText],
          skill: 'recall',
        );
    }
  }

  @override
  ProductionTask? productionTask(
    LearningContent item, {
    MistakeRecord? mistake,
    ProductionMode? mode,
  }) {
    if (item.exampleText.trim().isEmpty) return null;
    final selected = mode ?? _modeFor(mistake);
    final expected = item.exampleText.trim();
    final accepted = <String>{
      expected,
      ...item.acceptedForms,
    }.where((x) => x.trim().isNotEmpty).toList();
    switch (selected) {
      case ProductionMode.recognize:
        return ProductionTask(
          itemId: item.id,
          mode: selected,
          prompt:
              'اختر الجملة الألمانية التي تعبّر عن: ${item.exampleTranslationText}',
          expected: expected,
          accepted: accepted,
          hint: item.sourceText,
        );
      case ProductionMode.guided:
        return ProductionTask(
          itemId: item.id,
          mode: selected,
          prompt:
              'اكتب جملة ألمانية باستخدام «${item.sourceText}» للتعبير عن: ${item.exampleTranslationText}',
          expected: expected,
          accepted: accepted,
          hint: 'ابدأ من معنى الجملة العربية، ثم ثبّت الفعل في موقعه الصحيح.',
        );
      case ProductionMode.free:
        return ProductionTask(
          itemId: item.id,
          mode: selected,
          prompt:
              'اكتب جملة ألمانية جديدة من إنشائك باستخدام «${item.sourceText}».',
          expected: expected,
          accepted: accepted,
          hint:
              'الجملة الجديدة لا يلزم أن تطابق المثال حرفيًا؛ المطلوب استعمال الكلمة استعمالًا صحيحًا.',
        );
    }
  }

  @override
  RepairDrill? repairDrill(LearningContent? item, MistakeRecord mistake) {
    if (item == null) {
      if (mistake.category != MistakeCategory.writing) return null;
      return RepairDrill(
        mistake: mistake,
        steps: [
          RepairStep(
            mode: RepairMode.recognize,
            prompt:
                'اقرأ المشكلة وحدد الجزء الذي تحتاج إلى إصلاحه: ${mistake.normalizedKey.replaceFirst('writing:', '')}',
            expected: 'أحدد الخطأ',
          ),
          RepairStep(
            mode: RepairMode.correct,
            prompt: 'اكتب الجملة الألمانية مصححة.',
            expected: 'جملة ألمانية صحيحة',
          ),
          RepairStep(
            mode: RepairMode.produce,
            prompt: 'اكتب جملة ألمانية جديدة تستخدم القاعدة نفسها.',
            expected: 'جملة ألمانية جديدة',
          ),
        ],
      );
    }
    final expected = mistake.category == MistakeCategory.article &&
            item.grammaticalMarker.isNotEmpty
        ? '${item.grammaticalMarker} ${item.sourceText}'
        : item.sourceText;
    final accepted = <String>{
      expected,
      item.sourceText,
      ...item.acceptedForms,
    }.where((x) => x.trim().isNotEmpty).toList();
    final firstPrompt = mistake.category == MistakeCategory.article
        ? 'حدّد Artikel الصحيح ثم اكتب الاسم كاملًا: ${item.translationText}'
        : mistake.category == MistakeCategory.grammar
            ? 'حدّد القاعدة التي أخطأت فيها ثم اختر الصيغة الصحيحة: ${item.translationText}'
            : 'استرجع الإجابة الصحيحة من المعنى: ${item.translationText}';
    final correctionPrompt = mistake.category == MistakeCategory.grammar
        ? 'طبّق القاعدة وصحّح العبارة كاملة.'
        : 'صحّح الخطأ ثم اكتب العبارة كاملة.';
    return RepairDrill(
      mistake: mistake,
      steps: [
        RepairStep(
          mode: RepairMode.recognize,
          prompt: firstPrompt,
          expected: expected,
          accepted: accepted,
        ),
        RepairStep(
          mode: RepairMode.correct,
          prompt: correctionPrompt,
          expected: expected,
          accepted: accepted,
        ),
        RepairStep(
          mode: RepairMode.produce,
          prompt: 'استخدم الكلمة في جملة ألمانية جديدة.',
          expected: item.exampleText,
          accepted: [item.exampleText, ...item.acceptedForms],
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  @override
  List<ConversationScenario> get conversationScenarios => _scenarios;

  ProductionMode _modeFor(MistakeRecord? mistake) {
    if (mistake == null) return ProductionMode.guided;
    if (mistake.category == MistakeCategory.production ||
        mistake.category == MistakeCategory.writing ||
        mistake.category == MistakeCategory.wordOrder)
      return ProductionMode.guided;
    if (mistake.errorCount >= 3 || mistake.recentFailureRate >= .6)
      return ProductionMode.recognize;
    return ProductionMode.guided;
  }

FILE: lib/language/german/german_text_normalizer.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import '../language_text_normalizer.dart';

/// German answer normalization kept outside the language-agnostic core.
final class GermanTextNormalizer implements LanguageTextNormalizer {
  const GermanTextNormalizer();

  @override
  String answer(String value) => value
      .toLowerCase()
      .replaceAll('ä', 'a')
      .replaceAll('ö', 'o')
      .replaceAll('ü', 'u')
      .replaceAll('ß', 'ss')
      .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[.!?,;:،؛؟]'), '')
      .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ')
      .trim();
}

--------------------------------------------------
FILE: lib/language/language_capability.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'language_role.dart';

/// Universal capability vocabulary. Language-specific rules live behind these
/// declarations rather than in Shared Core.
enum LanguageCapability {
  learnerFacingLocalization,
  normalization,
  segmentation,
  grammar,
  morphology,
  vocabularyContent,
  writing,
  searchIndexing,
  textToSpeech,
  speechToText,
  pronunciation,
  conversation,
  assessment,
  offlineContent,
  pairIntelligence,
  scriptOrthography,
  transliteration,
  listening,
  speaking,
  lexicalEnrichment,
  levelMapping,
  providerDependentBehavior,
}

/// Explicit operational capability state.
///
/// Missing or unknown declarations are not encoded as an operational state.
/// They fail closed at the later Registry/consumer lookup boundary.
enum LanguageCapabilityState {
  supported,
  limited,
  unsupported,
  notApplicable,
  blocked,
  quarantined,
}

extension LanguageCapabilityStatePolicy on LanguageCapabilityState {
  /// Whether a caller requiring this capability may use it.
  ///
  /// LIMITED remains fail-closed unless that caller explicitly accepts the
  /// declared limitation. Every other non-supported state is fail-closed.
  bool allowsRequiredUse({bool acceptLimited = false}) {
    switch (this) {
      case LanguageCapabilityState.supported:
        return true;
      case LanguageCapabilityState.limited:
        return acceptLimited;
      case LanguageCapabilityState.unsupported:
      case LanguageCapabilityState.notApplicable:
      case LanguageCapabilityState.blocked:
      case LanguageCapabilityState.quarantined:
        return false;
    }
  }

  bool get isFailClosed => !allowsRequiredUse();
}

/// One role-scoped capability declaration bound to an exact snapshot.
final class LanguageCapabilityStatus {
  final LanguageRole role;
  final LanguageCapability capability;
  final LanguageCapabilityState state;
  final String snapshotVersion;
  final String snapshotHash;
  final String? limitation;
  final String? justification;

  LanguageCapabilityStatus({
    required this.role,
    required this.capability,
    required this.state,
    required this.snapshotVersion,
    required this.snapshotHash,
    this.limitation,
    this.justification,
  }) {
    _requireNonEmpty(snapshotVersion, 'snapshotVersion');
    _requireNonEmpty(snapshotHash, 'snapshotHash');
    if (state == LanguageCapabilityState.limited &&
        (limitation == null || limitation!.trim().isEmpty)) {
      throw ArgumentError('LIMITED capability state requires a limitation');
    }
    switch (state) {
      case LanguageCapabilityState.notApplicable:
        if (justification == null || justification!.trim().isEmpty) {
          throw ArgumentError(
            'NOT_APPLICABLE capability state requires a justification',
          );
        }
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
  }

  Map<String, Object?> toMap() => <String, Object?>{
        'role': role.wireName,
        'capability': capability.name,
        'state': state.name,
        'snapshotVersion': snapshotVersion,
        'snapshotHash': snapshotHash,
        'limitation': limitation,
        'justification': justification,
      };

  static void _requireNonEmpty(String value, String field) {
    if (value.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(value, field, 'must not be empty');
    }
  }
}

/// Stable, version-independent identity for one language.
///
/// Runtime source/user selection is deliberately not part of this value.
/// Equality is anchored to [languageId]; presentation/locale metadata may
/// evolve without changing the stable language identity used by consumers.
final class LanguageIdentity {
  final String languageId;
  final String displayName;
  final String primaryLocale;

  LanguageIdentity({
    required this.languageId,
    required this.displayName,
    required this.primaryLocale,
  }) {
    _requireNonEmpty(languageId, 'languageId');
    _requireNonEmpty(displayName, 'displayName');
    _requireNonEmpty(primaryLocale, 'primaryLocale');
  }

  Map<String, String> toMap() => <String, String>{
        'languageId': languageId,
        'displayName': displayName,
        'primaryLocale': primaryLocale,
      };

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      identical(this, other) ||
      other is LanguageIdentity && other.languageId == languageId;

  @override
  int get hashCode => languageId.hashCode;

  static void _requireNonEmpty(String value, String field) {
    if (value.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(value, field, 'must not be empty');
    }
  }
}

FILE: lib/language/language_role.dart

/// Independent language roles used by multilingual contracts.
///
/// A single language may occupy more than one role. In particular USER and
/// SOURCE may intentionally be the same language while their evidence remains
/// scoped to the distinct role.
enum LanguageRole {
  user,
  source,
  target;

  String get wireName {
    switch (this) {
      case LanguageRole.user:
        return 'USER_LANGUAGE';
      case LanguageRole.source:
        return 'SOURCE_LANGUAGE';
      case LanguageRole.target:
        return 'TARGET_LANGUAGE';
    }
  }
}

/// Technical eligibility for one language to occupy one role.
///
/// Eligibility is independent from lifecycle/readiness. UNKNOWN and INELIGIBLE
/// fail closed and cannot be used to construct a role lifecycle/status record.
enum LanguageRoleEligibilityState {
  eligible,
  ineligible,
  unknown;

  bool get allowsRole => this == LanguageRoleEligibilityState.eligible;

  bool get isFailClosed => !allowsRole;
}

/// Explicit eligibility declaration for exactly one language + role.
final class LanguageRoleEligibilityRecord {
  final String languageId;
  final LanguageRole role;
  final LanguageRoleEligibilityState state;
  final String? reason;

  LanguageRoleEligibilityRecord({
    required this.languageId,
    required this.role,
    required this.state,
    this.reason,
  }) {
    _requireNonEmpty(languageId, 'languageId');
    if (state == LanguageRoleEligibilityState.ineligible &&
        (reason == null || reason!.trim().isEmpty)) {
      throw ArgumentError('INELIGIBLE role requires an explicit reason');
    }
  }

  bool get allowsRole => state.allowsRole;

  bool get isFailClosed => state.isFailClosed;

  Map<String, Object?> toMap() => <String, Object?>{
        'languageId': languageId,
        'role': role.wireName,
        'state': state.name,
        'reason': reason,
      };
}

void _requireNonEmpty(String value, String field) {
  if (value.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(value, field, 'must not be empty');
  }
}

FILE: lib/language/language_role_status.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'language_role.dart';

/// Per-role lifecycle/status. This record is not an aggregate deployment
/// readiness authority.
enum LanguageRoleStatusState {
  registered,
  specified,
  implemented,
  tested,
  verified,
  productionReady,
  blocked,
  quarantined,
  deprecated,
  superseded,
}

extension LanguageRoleStatusStatePolicy on LanguageRoleStatusState {
  /// Required-use semantics are intentionally fail-closed.
  ///
  /// Earlier lifecycle states, including VERIFIED, do not silently imply
  /// production readiness. Only the explicit per-role PRODUCTION_READY state
  /// can satisfy a caller that requires this status.
  bool allowsRequiredUse() {
    switch (this) {
      case LanguageRoleStatusState.productionReady:
        return true;
      case LanguageRoleStatusState.registered:
      case LanguageRoleStatusState.specified:
      case LanguageRoleStatusState.implemented:
      case LanguageRoleStatusState.tested:
      case LanguageRoleStatusState.verified:
      case LanguageRoleStatusState.blocked:
      case LanguageRoleStatusState.quarantined:
      case LanguageRoleStatusState.deprecated:
      case LanguageRoleStatusState.superseded:
        return false;
    }
  }

  bool get isFailClosed => !allowsRequiredUse();
}

/// Exact version/hash coordinate for one artifact consumed by role evidence.
final class ArtifactEvidenceCoordinate {
  final String artifactType;
  final String version;
  final String hash;
  final String? reference;

  ArtifactEvidenceCoordinate({
    required this.artifactType,
    required this.version,
    required this.hash,
    this.reference,
  }) {
    _requireNonEmpty(artifactType, 'artifactType');
    _requireNonEmpty(version, 'version');
    _requireNonEmpty(hash, 'hash');
  }

  Map<String, Object?> toMap() => <String, Object?>{
        'artifactType': artifactType,
        'version': version,
        'hash': hash,
        'reference': reference,
      };
}

/// Exact evidence envelope for one language + one role.
///
/// Every coordinate is descriptive evidence input. This class does not compute
/// role readiness and does not promote deployment state.
final class LanguageRoleEvidenceBinding {
  final String languageId;
  final LanguageRole role;
  final String universalContractVersion;
  final String universalContractHash;
  final String manifestStaticFingerprint;
  final String capabilitySnapshotVersion;
  final String capabilitySnapshotHash;
  final List<ArtifactEvidenceCoordinate> consumedArtifactCoordinates;
  final String compatibilityPolicyVersion;
  final String compatibilityPolicyHash;
  final String readinessValidatorFingerprint;
  final String readinessEvidenceRef;

  LanguageRoleEvidenceBinding({
    required this.languageId,
    required this.role,
    required this.universalContractVersion,
    required this.universalContractHash,
    required this.manifestStaticFingerprint,
    required this.capabilitySnapshotVersion,
    required this.capabilitySnapshotHash,
    List<ArtifactEvidenceCoordinate> consumedArtifactCoordinates = const [],
    required this.compatibilityPolicyVersion,
    required this.compatibilityPolicyHash,
    required this.readinessValidatorFingerprint,
    required this.readinessEvidenceRef,
  }) : consumedArtifactCoordinates =
            List<ArtifactEvidenceCoordinate>.unmodifiable(
          consumedArtifactCoordinates,
        ) {
    _requireNonEmpty(languageId, 'languageId');
    _requireNonEmpty(universalContractVersion, 'universalContractVersion');
    _requireNonEmpty(universalContractHash, 'universalContractHash');
    _requireNonEmpty(manifestStaticFingerprint, 'manifestStaticFingerprint');
    _requireNonEmpty(capabilitySnapshotVersion, 'capabilitySnapshotVersion');
    _requireNonEmpty(capabilitySnapshotHash, 'capabilitySnapshotHash');
    _requireNonEmpty(compatibilityPolicyVersion, 'compatibilityPolicyVersion');
    _requireNonEmpty(compatibilityPolicyHash, 'compatibilityPolicyHash');
    _requireNonEmpty(
      readinessValidatorFingerprint,
      'readinessValidatorFingerprint',
    );
    _requireNonEmpty(readinessEvidenceRef, 'readinessEvidenceRef');
  }

  Map<String, Object?> toMap() => <String, Object?>{
        'languageId': languageId,
        'role': role.wireName,
        'universalContractVersion': universalContractVersion,
        'universalContractHash': universalContractHash,
        'manifestStaticFingerprint': manifestStaticFingerprint,
        'capabilitySnapshotVersion': capabilitySnapshotVersion,
        'capabilitySnapshotHash': capabilitySnapshotHash,
        'consumedArtifactCoordinates': consumedArtifactCoordinates
            .map((coordinate) => coordinate.toMap())
            .toList(growable: false),
        'compatibilityPolicyVersion': compatibilityPolicyVersion,
        'compatibilityPolicyHash': compatibilityPolicyHash,
        'readinessValidatorFingerprint': readinessValidatorFingerprint,
        'readinessEvidenceRef': readinessEvidenceRef,
      };
}

/// Status for exactly one eligible language + role.
///
/// Eligibility is a separate axis and must be explicitly ELIGIBLE before a
/// lifecycle/status record can exist. Evidence is required before VERIFIED or
/// PRODUCTION_READY. This class does not derive aggregate readiness.
final class LanguageRoleStatusRecord {
  final String languageId;
  final LanguageRole role;
  final LanguageRoleEligibilityRecord eligibility;
  final LanguageRoleStatusState state;
  final LanguageRoleEvidenceBinding? evidenceBinding;

  factory LanguageRoleStatusRecord({
    required String languageId,
    required LanguageRole role,
    required LanguageRoleEligibilityRecord eligibility,
    required LanguageRoleStatusState state,
    LanguageRoleEvidenceBinding? evidenceBinding,
  }) {
    _requireNonEmpty(languageId, 'languageId');

    if (eligibility.languageId != languageId || eligibility.role != role) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'eligibility must match the record languageId and role',
      );
    }

    if (!eligibility.allowsRole) {
      throw StateError('role lifecycle/status requires explicit ELIGIBLE role');
    }

    if (evidenceBinding != null &&
        (evidenceBinding.languageId != languageId ||
            evidenceBinding.role != role)) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'evidence binding must match the record languageId and role',
      );
    }

    if ((state == LanguageRoleStatusState.verified ||
            state == LanguageRoleStatusState.productionReady) &&
        evidenceBinding == null) {
      throw StateError(
        'verified role states require exact role-scoped evidence binding',
      );
    }

    return LanguageRoleStatusRecord._(
      languageId: languageId,
      role: role,
      eligibility: eligibility,
      state: state,
      evidenceBinding: evidenceBinding,
    );
  }

  const LanguageRoleStatusRecord._({
    required this.languageId,
    required this.role,
    required this.eligibility,
    required this.state,
    required this.evidenceBinding,
  });

  bool get isFailClosed => state.isFailClosed;

  Map<String, Object?> toMap() => <String, Object?>{
        'languageId': languageId,
        'role': role.wireName,
        'eligibility': eligibility.toMap(),
        'state': state.name,
        'evidenceBinding': evidenceBinding?.toMap(),
      };
}

void _requireNonEmpty(String value, String field) {
  if (value.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(value, field, 'must not be empty');
  }
}

FILE: lib/language/pair/arabic_german_gold_standard.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'pair_mechanics.dart';

enum GoldCaseLifecycle { candidate, canonical }

final class ArabicGermanGoldCase {
  final String caseId;
  final String semanticIntentId;
  final String sourceText;
  final String canonicalTargetText;
  final List<String> acceptedTargetForms;
  final String skill;
  final String level;
  final List<String> provenanceRefs;
  final List<String> evidenceRefs;
  final GoldCaseLifecycle lifecycle;
  final String contrastiveNotes;

  ArabicGermanGoldCase({
    required this.caseId,
    required this.semanticIntentId,
    required this.sourceText,
    required this.canonicalTargetText,
    required List<String> acceptedTargetForms,
    required this.skill,
    required this.level,
    required List<String> provenanceRefs,
    required List<String> evidenceRefs,
    required this.lifecycle,
    this.contrastiveNotes = '',
  })  : acceptedTargetForms = List<String>.unmodifiable(acceptedTargetForms),
        provenanceRefs = List<String>.unmodifiable(provenanceRefs),
        evidenceRefs = List<String>.unmodifiable(evidenceRefs);

  PairIdentity get pair => ArabicGermanGoldStandard.pair;
}

abstract final class ArabicGermanGoldStandard {
  static const int maxTextLength = 500;
  static const int maxIdentifierLength = 160;
  static const int maxAcceptedForms = 16;
  static const int maxReferenceCount = 32;
  static const int maxReferenceLength = 240;

  static final PairIdentity pair = PairIdentity(
    sourceLanguageId: 'ar',
    targetLanguageId: 'de',
  );

  static List<String> validate(ArabicGermanGoldCase value) {
    final errors = <String>[];

    _validateRequiredIdentifier(errors, 'caseId', value.caseId);
    _validateRequiredIdentifier(
      errors,
      'semanticIntentId',
      value.semanticIntentId,
    );
    _validateRequiredIdentifier(errors, 'skill', value.skill);
    _validateRequiredIdentifier(errors, 'level', value.level);
    _validateRequiredText(errors, 'sourceText', value.sourceText);
    _validateRequiredText(
      errors,
      'canonicalTargetText',
      value.canonicalTargetText,
    );

    if (value.acceptedTargetForms.length > maxAcceptedForms) {
      errors.add('acceptedTargetForms');
    }
    for (final form in value.acceptedTargetForms) {
      if (form.trim().isEmpty || form.length > maxTextLength) {
        if (!errors.contains('acceptedTargetForms')) {
          errors.add('acceptedTargetForms');
        }
        break;
      }
    }

    _validateRefs(errors, 'provenanceRefs', value.provenanceRefs);
    _validateRefs(errors, 'evidenceRefs', value.evidenceRefs);

    if (value.contrastiveNotes.length > maxTextLength) {
      errors.add('contrastiveNotes');
    }

    return List<String>.unmodifiable(errors);
  }

  static bool countsTowardReadiness(ArabicGermanGoldCase value) {
    return value.lifecycle == GoldCaseLifecycle.canonical &&
        validate(value).isEmpty;
  }

  static void _validateRequiredIdentifier(
    List<String> errors,
    String field,
    String value,
  ) {
    if (value.trim().isEmpty || value.length > maxIdentifierLength) {
      errors.add(field);
    }
  }

  static void _validateRequiredText(
    List<String> errors,
    String field,
    String value,
  ) {
    if (value.trim().isEmpty || value.length > maxTextLength) {
      errors.add(field);
    }
  }

  static void _validateRefs(
    List<String> errors,
    String field,
    List<String> refs,
  ) {
    if (refs.isEmpty || refs.length > maxReferenceCount) {
      errors.add(field);
      return;
    }
    if (refs.any(
      (ref) => ref.trim().isEmpty || ref.length > maxReferenceLength,
    )) {
      errors.add(field);
    }
  }
}

extension BoundedFixtureStringRepeat on String {
  String operator *(int count) {
    if (count <= 0) return '';
    return List<String>.filled(count, this, growable: false).join();
  }
}

FILE: lib/language/pair/pair_mechanics.dart

import 'dart:convert';

import '../language_capability.dart';
import '../language_role.dart';

/// Ordered identity for one directed source -> target language pair.
///
/// Direction is part of identity. This type does not register, synthesize, or
/// infer the reverse pair.
final class PairIdentity {
  final String sourceLanguageId;
  final String targetLanguageId;

  PairIdentity({
    required this.sourceLanguageId,
    required this.targetLanguageId,
  }) {
    _requireNonEmpty(sourceLanguageId, 'sourceLanguageId');
    _requireNonEmpty(targetLanguageId, 'targetLanguageId');
    if (sourceLanguageId == targetLanguageId) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'directed pair requires distinct source and target languages',
      );
    }
  }

  /// Stable, direction-bound serialization with no separator ambiguity.
  String get stableId =>
      'pair-v1:${_hexUtf8(sourceLanguageId)}>${_hexUtf8(targetLanguageId)}';

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      identical(this, other) ||
      other is PairIdentity &&
          other.sourceLanguageId == sourceLanguageId &&
          other.targetLanguageId == targetLanguageId;

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(sourceLanguageId, targetLanguageId);

  @override
  String toString() => stableId;
}

/// One pair endpoint validated against the F1-A1 role-eligibility contract.
final class PairEndpoint {
  final String languageId;
  final LanguageRole role;
  final LanguageRoleEligibilityRecord eligibility;

  PairEndpoint._({
    required this.languageId,
    required this.role,
    required this.eligibility,
  }) {
    _requireNonEmpty(languageId, 'languageId');
    if (eligibility.languageId != languageId || eligibility.role != role) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'endpoint eligibility must match exact language and role',
      );
    }
    if (!eligibility.allowsRole) {
      throw StateError('pair endpoint requires explicit ELIGIBLE role');
    }
  }

  factory PairEndpoint.source({
    required String languageId,
    required LanguageRoleEligibilityRecord eligibility,
  }) {
    return PairEndpoint._(
      languageId: languageId,
      role: LanguageRole.source,
      eligibility: eligibility,
    );
  }

  factory PairEndpoint.target({
    required String languageId,
    required LanguageRoleEligibilityRecord eligibility,
  }) {
    return PairEndpoint._(
      languageId: languageId,
      role: LanguageRole.target,
      eligibility: eligibility,
    );
  }
}

/// Direction-bound reference only. It contains no linguistic override truth.
final class DirectedPairOverrideRef {
  final String overrideId;
  final PairIdentity pair;

  DirectedPairOverrideRef({required this.overrideId, required this.pair}) {
    _requireNonEmpty(overrideId, 'overrideId');
  }

  bool appliesTo(PairIdentity requestedPair) => pair == requestedPair;
}

/// One input explicitly declared by a registered pair mechanics rule.
final class PairRuleInputRequirement {
  final String inputKey;
  final LanguageRole role;
  final bool acceptsLimited;
  final bool acceptsNotApplicable;

  const PairRuleInputRequirement({
    required this.inputKey,
    required this.role,
    this.acceptsLimited = false,
    this.acceptsNotApplicable = false,
  })  : assert(inputKey != ''),
        assert(role != LanguageRole.user);
}

/// Mechanics-only rule metadata.
///
/// A rule without declared pair inputs cannot emit a linguistic candidate.
final class PairRule {
  final String ruleId;
  final String ruleVersion;
  final String candidateKind;
  final List<PairRuleInputRequirement> requiredInputs;

  PairRule({
    required this.ruleId,
    required this.ruleVersion,
    required this.candidateKind,
    required List<PairRuleInputRequirement> requiredInputs,
  }) : requiredInputs = List<PairRuleInputRequirement>.unmodifiable(
          requiredInputs,
        ) {
    _requireNonEmpty(ruleId, 'ruleId');
    _requireNonEmpty(ruleVersion, 'ruleVersion');
    _requireNonEmpty(candidateKind, 'candidateKind');

    final seen = <String>{};
    for (final requirement in this.requiredInputs) {
      _requireNonEmpty(requirement.inputKey, 'inputKey');
      if (requirement.role == LanguageRole.user) {
        throw ArgumentError('pair rules may require SOURCE/TARGET inputs only');
      }
      final key = '${requirement.role.wireName}|${requirement.inputKey}';
      if (!seen.add(key)) {
        throw ArgumentError('duplicate pair rule input requirement: $key');
      }
    }
  }
}

/// Synthetic/mechanics fact consumed only when a rule explicitly declares it.
///
/// [valueFingerprint] is an opaque already-derived fact coordinate/value hash.
/// Factory-3 does not interpret it as semantic or linguistic truth.
final class PairInputFact {
  final String languageId;
  final LanguageRole role;
  final String inputKey;
  final LanguageCapabilityState state;
  final String valueFingerprint;

  PairInputFact({
    required this.languageId,
    required this.role,
    required this.inputKey,
    required this.state,
    required this.valueFingerprint,
  }) {
    _requireNonEmpty(languageId, 'languageId');
    _requireNonEmpty(inputKey, 'inputKey');
    _requireNonEmpty(valueFingerprint, 'valueFingerprint');
  }
}

/// Candidate-only lifecycle. Verified/readiness states deliberately do not exist.
enum PairCandidateState { derivedCandidate, reviewNeeded, conflict }

/// Immutable mechanics candidate. No method can promote it to readiness.
final class PairCandidate {
  final String candidateId;
  final String fingerprint;
  final PairIdentity pair;
  final String ruleId;
  final String ruleVersion;
  final String candidateKind;
  final PairCandidateState state;
  final List<PairInputFact> declaredInputs;

  PairCandidate._({
    required this.candidateId,
    required this.fingerprint,
    required this.pair,
    required this.ruleId,
    required this.ruleVersion,
    required this.candidateKind,
    required this.state,
    required List<PairInputFact> declaredInputs,
  }) : declaredInputs = List<PairInputFact>.unmodifiable(declaredInputs);
}

/// Fail-closed result for one direct rule evaluation.
final class PairEvaluation {
  final PairCandidate? candidate;
  final String? blockedReason;

  const PairEvaluation._({
    required this.candidate,
    required this.blockedReason,
  });

  bool get isBlocked => candidate == null;

  factory PairEvaluation.blocked(String reason) {
    _requireNonEmpty(reason, 'reason');
    return PairEvaluation._(candidate: null, blockedReason: reason);
  }

  factory PairEvaluation.candidate(PairCandidate candidate) {
    return PairEvaluation._(candidate: candidate, blockedReason: null);
  }
}

/// Factory-3 mechanics evaluator.
///
/// It has no resolver or bridge parameter, so it can consume only facts bound
/// directly to the declared SOURCE/TARGET endpoints. Extra languages and
/// undeclared product/runtime facts are ignored rather than used as pivots.
abstract final class PairMechanics {
  static PairEvaluation evaluate({
    required PairEndpoint source,
    required PairEndpoint target,
    required PairRule rule,
    required List<PairInputFact> facts,
  }) {
    if (source.role != LanguageRole.source) {
      return PairEvaluation.blocked('source endpoint is not SOURCE role');
    }
    if (target.role != LanguageRole.target) {
      return PairEvaluation.blocked('target endpoint is not TARGET role');
    }

    final pair = PairIdentity(
      sourceLanguageId: source.languageId,
      targetLanguageId: target.languageId,
    );

    if (rule.requiredInputs.isEmpty) {
      return PairEvaluation.blocked(
        'no declared pair inputs; non-pair differences cannot emit a candidate',
      );
    }

    final requirements = List<PairRuleInputRequirement>.from(
      rule.requiredInputs,
    )..sort((a, b) => _requirementKey(a).compareTo(_requirementKey(b)));

    final selected = <PairInputFact>[];

    for (final requirement in requirements) {
      final expectedLanguageId = switch (requirement.role) {
        LanguageRole.source => source.languageId,
        LanguageRole.target => target.languageId,
        LanguageRole.user => '',
      };

      final matches = facts
          .where(
            (fact) =>
                fact.languageId == expectedLanguageId &&
                fact.role == requirement.role &&
                fact.inputKey == requirement.inputKey,
          )
          .toList(growable: false);

      if (matches.isEmpty) {
        return PairEvaluation.blocked(
          'missing required input ${_requirementKey(requirement)}',
        );
      }
      if (matches.length != 1) {
        return PairEvaluation.blocked(
          'ambiguous required input ${_requirementKey(requirement)}',
        );
      }

      final fact = matches.single;
      if (!_allowsFact(requirement, fact.state)) {
        return PairEvaluation.blocked(
          'required input ${_requirementKey(requirement)} '
          'is fail closed in state ${fact.state.name}',
        );
      }
      selected.add(fact);
    }

    selected.sort((a, b) => _factKey(a).compareTo(_factKey(b)));

    final canonicalParts = <String>[
      'pair-mechanics-candidate-v1',
      pair.stableId,
      _lengthPrefixed(rule.ruleId),
      _lengthPrefixed(rule.ruleVersion),
      _lengthPrefixed(rule.candidateKind),
      for (final fact in selected)
        [
          _lengthPrefixed(fact.languageId),
          _lengthPrefixed(fact.role.wireName),
          _lengthPrefixed(fact.inputKey),
          _lengthPrefixed(fact.state.name),
          _lengthPrefixed(fact.valueFingerprint),
        ].join('|'),
    ];

    final fingerprint = 'hex-v1:${_hexUtf8(canonicalParts.join('\u001f'))}';
    final candidateId = [
      'pair-candidate-v1',
      _hexUtf8(pair.stableId),
      _hexUtf8(rule.ruleId),
      _hexUtf8(rule.ruleVersion),
      _hexUtf8(fingerprint),
    ].join(':');

    return PairEvaluation.candidate(
      PairCandidate._(
        candidateId: candidateId,
        fingerprint: fingerprint,
        pair: pair,
        ruleId: rule.ruleId,
        ruleVersion: rule.ruleVersion,
        candidateKind: rule.candidateKind,
        state: PairCandidateState.derivedCandidate,
        declaredInputs: selected,
      ),
    );
  }

  static bool _allowsFact(
    PairRuleInputRequirement requirement,
    LanguageCapabilityState state,
  ) {
    switch (state) {
      case LanguageCapabilityState.supported:
        return true;
      case LanguageCapabilityState.limited:
        return requirement.acceptsLimited;
      case LanguageCapabilityState.notApplicable:
        return requirement.acceptsNotApplicable;
      case LanguageCapabilityState.unsupported:
      case LanguageCapabilityState.blocked:
      case LanguageCapabilityState.quarantined:
        return false;
    }
  }

  static String _requirementKey(PairRuleInputRequirement requirement) =>
      '${requirement.role.wireName}|${requirement.inputKey}';

  static String _factKey(PairInputFact fact) =>
      '${fact.role.wireName}|${fact.inputKey}|${fact.languageId}';
}

String _lengthPrefixed(String value) {
  final bytes = utf8.encode(value);
  return '${bytes.length}:${_hexBytes(bytes)}';
}

String _hexUtf8(String value) => _hexBytes(utf8.encode(value));

String _hexBytes(List<int> bytes) =>
    bytes.map((byte) => byte.toRadixString(16).padLeft(2, '0')).join();

void _requireNonEmpty(String value, String field) {
  if (value.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(value, field, 'must not be empty');
  }
}

FILE: lib/language/quality/mandatory_gate_reducer.dart

import '../language_capability.dart';
import '../language_role.dart';
import '../language_role_status.dart';

/// Fail-closed evidence outcomes for the bounded Factory-4 reducer.
///
/// This vocabulary is quality-evidence plumbing only. It does not represent
/// language, pair, deployment, or production readiness.
enum QualityGateDisposition {
  pass,
  fail,
  unknown,
  blocked,
  quarantined,
  notApplicable,
}

/// Synthetic evidence classes used to preserve authority boundaries.
///
/// In particular, a candidate cannot satisfy a Golden requirement and a
/// self-test result is only one evidence class among potentially many required
/// quality gates.
enum QualityEvidenceKind { generic, candidate, golden, selfTest }

/// One declared quality-gate requirement.
///
/// The reducer consumes already-integrated F1-A1 role/capability primitives.
/// It does not resolve manifests, semantic identities, pair truth, runtime
/// activation, or any language-specific facts.
final class QualityGateRequirement {
  final String gateId;
  final bool mandatory;
  final String? languageId;
  final LanguageRole? role;
  final LanguageCapability? capability;
  final QualityEvidenceKind? requiredEvidenceKind;
  final bool allowNotApplicable;
  final bool acceptLimitedCapability;

  QualityGateRequirement({
    required this.gateId,
    this.mandatory = true,
    this.languageId,
    this.role,
    this.capability,
    this.requiredEvidenceKind,
    this.allowNotApplicable = false,
    this.acceptLimitedCapability = false,
  }) {
    _requireNonEmpty(gateId, 'gateId');
    if (languageId != null) {
      _requireNonEmpty(languageId!, 'languageId');
    }
    if ((languageId == null) != (role == null)) {
      throw ArgumentError('languageId and role must be declared together');
    }
    if (capability != null && role == null) {
      throw ArgumentError('capability requirements must be role-scoped');
    }
  }
}

/// One synthetic evidence record submitted to a quality gate.
///
/// F1-A1 objects remain authoritative for their own invariants. Optional
/// coordinates here exist only so Factory-4 can reject cross-role,
/// cross-language, or capability mismatches instead of silently reusing
/// unrelated evidence.
final class QualityGateEvidence {
  final String gateId;
  final QualityGateDisposition disposition;
  final QualityEvidenceKind kind;
  final String? languageId;
  final LanguageRole? role;
  final LanguageRoleEligibilityRecord? eligibility;
  final LanguageRoleStatusRecord? roleStatus;
  final LanguageRoleEvidenceBinding? roleEvidenceBinding;
  final LanguageCapabilityStatus? capabilityStatus;

  const QualityGateEvidence({
    required this.gateId,
    required this.disposition,
    this.kind = QualityEvidenceKind.generic,
    this.languageId,
    this.role,
    this.eligibility,
    this.roleStatus,
    this.roleEvidenceBinding,
    this.capabilityStatus,
  });
}

/// Evaluated result for exactly one declared gate.
final class QualityGateEvaluation {
  final QualityGateRequirement requirement;
  final QualityGateDisposition disposition;
  final bool satisfied;
  final bool acceptedNotApplicable;
  final String reason;

  const QualityGateEvaluation({
    required this.requirement,
    required this.disposition,
    required this.satisfied,
    required this.acceptedNotApplicable,
    required this.reason,
  });
}

/// Aggregate result over mandatory quality gates only.
///
/// Optional evidence is preserved in [results] but cannot improve or mask a
/// mandatory non-pass. A successful reduction is not a readiness receipt.
final class QualityReductionResult {
  final QualityGateDisposition disposition;
  final bool mandatorySatisfied;
  final List<QualityGateEvaluation> results;

  QualityReductionResult({
    required this.disposition,
    required this.mandatorySatisfied,
    required List<QualityGateEvaluation> results,
  }) : results = List<QualityGateEvaluation>.unmodifiable(results);
}

/// Pure, deterministic reducer for the admitted F1-A1-only Factory-4 slice.
abstract final class QualityGateReducer {
  static QualityReductionResult reduce({
    required List<QualityGateRequirement> requirements,
    required List<QualityGateEvidence> evidence,
  }) {
    final evidenceByGate = <String, List<QualityGateEvidence>>{};
    for (final item in evidence) {
      evidenceByGate.putIfAbsent(item.gateId, () => <QualityGateEvidence>[])
        ..add(item);
    }

    final evaluations = <QualityGateEvaluation>[];
    for (final requirement in requirements) {
      final matching =
          evidenceByGate[requirement.gateId] ?? const <QualityGateEvidence>[];

      if (matching.isEmpty) {
        evaluations.add(
          QualityGateEvaluation(
            requirement: requirement,
            disposition: QualityGateDisposition.unknown,
            satisfied: false,
            acceptedNotApplicable: false,
            reason: 'missing required evidence for ' + requirement.gateId,
          ),
        );
        continue;
      }

      if (matching.length != 1) {
        evaluations.add(
          QualityGateEvaluation(
            requirement: requirement,
            disposition: QualityGateDisposition.fail,
            satisfied: false,
            acceptedNotApplicable: false,
            reason: 'duplicate/conflicting evidence for ' + requirement.gateId,
          ),
        );
        continue;
      }

      evaluations.add(_evaluate(requirement, matching.single));
    }

    final mandatory =
        evaluations.where((item) => item.requirement.mandatory).toList();
    final mandatorySatisfied = mandatory.every((item) => item.satisfied);

    if (mandatorySatisfied) {
      return QualityReductionResult(
        disposition: QualityGateDisposition.pass,
        mandatorySatisfied: true,
        results: evaluations,
      );
    }

    return QualityReductionResult(
      disposition: _strongestMandatoryFailure(mandatory),
      mandatorySatisfied: false,
      results: evaluations,
    );
  }

  static QualityGateEvaluation _evaluate(
    QualityGateRequirement requirement,
    QualityGateEvidence evidence,
  ) {
    final scopeFailure = _validateScope(requirement, evidence);
    if (scopeFailure != null) {
      return _failure(requirement, QualityGateDisposition.fail, scopeFailure);
    }

    if (requirement.requiredEvidenceKind != null &&
        evidence.kind != requirement.requiredEvidenceKind) {
      return _failure(
        requirement,
        QualityGateDisposition.fail,
        'evidence kind does not satisfy ' +
            requirement.requiredEvidenceKind!.name,
      );
    }

    final roleStatusFailure = _evaluateRoleStatus(requirement, evidence);
    if (roleStatusFailure != null) {
      return roleStatusFailure;
    }

    final capabilityEvaluation = _evaluateCapability(requirement, evidence);
    final acceptedCapabilityNotApplicable =
        capabilityEvaluation?.acceptedNotApplicable ?? false;
    if (capabilityEvaluation != null && !capabilityEvaluation.satisfied) {
      return capabilityEvaluation;
    }
    if (acceptedCapabilityNotApplicable &&
        evidence.disposition != QualityGateDisposition.notApplicable) {
      return _failure(
        requirement,
        QualityGateDisposition.fail,
        'NOT_APPLICABLE capability must use NOT_APPLICABLE evidence',
      );
    }

    switch (evidence.disposition) {
      case QualityGateDisposition.pass:
        return _pass(requirement);
      case QualityGateDisposition.fail:
        return _failure(
          requirement,
          QualityGateDisposition.fail,
          'evidence reported FAIL',
        );
      case QualityGateDisposition.unknown:
        return _failure(
          requirement,
          QualityGateDisposition.unknown,
          'evidence reported UNKNOWN',
        );
      case QualityGateDisposition.blocked:
        return _failure(
          requirement,
          QualityGateDisposition.blocked,
          'evidence reported BLOCKED',
        );
      case QualityGateDisposition.quarantined:
        return _failure(
          requirement,
          QualityGateDisposition.quarantined,
          'evidence reported QUARANTINED',
        );
      case QualityGateDisposition.notApplicable:
        if (acceptedCapabilityNotApplicable) {
          return capabilityEvaluation!;
        }
        final status = evidence.capabilityStatus;
        final justified = status != null &&
            status.state == LanguageCapabilityState.notApplicable &&
            status.justification != null &&
            status.justification!.trim().isNotEmpty;
        if (requirement.allowNotApplicable && justified) {
          return QualityGateEvaluation(
            requirement: requirement,
            disposition: QualityGateDisposition.notApplicable,
            satisfied: true,
            acceptedNotApplicable: true,
            reason: 'justified NOT_APPLICABLE accepted for this gate',
          );
        }
        return _failure(
          requirement,
          QualityGateDisposition.fail,
          'NOT_APPLICABLE is not justified/allowed for this gate',
        );
    }
  }

  static String? _validateScope(
    QualityGateRequirement requirement,
    QualityGateEvidence evidence,
  ) {
    if (requirement.languageId != null &&
        evidence.languageId != requirement.languageId) {
      return 'language scope mismatch';
    }
    if (requirement.role != null && evidence.role != requirement.role) {
      return 'role scope mismatch';
    }

    final expectedLanguage = requirement.languageId ?? evidence.languageId;
    final expectedRole = requirement.role ?? evidence.role;

    final eligibility = evidence.eligibility;
    if ((requirement.languageId != null || requirement.role != null) &&
        eligibility == null) {
      return 'scoped gate requires explicit role eligibility';
    }
    if (eligibility != null) {
      if (expectedLanguage == null ||
          expectedRole == null ||
          eligibility.languageId != expectedLanguage ||
          eligibility.role != expectedRole) {
        return 'eligibility scope mismatch';
      }
      if (!eligibility.allowsRole) {
        return 'role eligibility fails closed';
      }
    }

    final roleStatus = evidence.roleStatus;
    if (roleStatus != null &&
        (expectedLanguage == null ||
            expectedRole == null ||
            roleStatus.languageId != expectedLanguage ||
            roleStatus.role != expectedRole)) {
      return 'role status scope mismatch';
    }

    final binding = evidence.roleEvidenceBinding;
    if (binding != null &&
        (expectedLanguage == null ||
            expectedRole == null ||
            binding.languageId != expectedLanguage ||
            binding.role != expectedRole)) {
      return 'role evidence binding scope mismatch';
    }

    final capabilityStatus = evidence.capabilityStatus;
    final nestedBinding = roleStatus?.evidenceBinding;
    if (nestedBinding != null) {
      if (binding == null) {
        return 'nested role evidence binding requires consumed role evidence binding';
      }
      if (!_sameRoleEvidenceBinding(nestedBinding, binding)) {
        return 'nested role evidence binding does not match consumed role evidence binding';
      }
      if (capabilityStatus != null &&
          (nestedBinding.capabilitySnapshotVersion !=
                  capabilityStatus.snapshotVersion ||
              nestedBinding.capabilitySnapshotHash !=
                  capabilityStatus.snapshotHash)) {
        return 'nested role evidence binding capability snapshot mismatch';
      }
    }

    if (binding != null &&
        capabilityStatus != null &&
        (binding.capabilitySnapshotVersion !=
                capabilityStatus.snapshotVersion ||
            binding.capabilitySnapshotHash != capabilityStatus.snapshotHash)) {
      return 'capability snapshot does not match role evidence binding';
    }

    return null;
  }

  static bool _sameRoleEvidenceBinding(
    LanguageRoleEvidenceBinding left,
    LanguageRoleEvidenceBinding right,
  ) {
    if (left.languageId != right.languageId ||
        left.role != right.role ||
        left.universalContractVersion != right.universalContractVersion ||
        left.universalContractHash != right.universalContractHash ||
        left.manifestStaticFingerprint != right.manifestStaticFingerprint ||
        left.capabilitySnapshotVersion != right.capabilitySnapshotVersion ||
        left.capabilitySnapshotHash != right.capabilitySnapshotHash ||
        left.compatibilityPolicyVersion != right.compatibilityPolicyVersion ||
        left.compatibilityPolicyHash != right.compatibilityPolicyHash ||
        left.readinessValidatorFingerprint !=
            right.readinessValidatorFingerprint ||
        left.readinessEvidenceRef != right.readinessEvidenceRef ||
        left.consumedArtifactCoordinates.length !=
            right.consumedArtifactCoordinates.length) {
      return false;
    }

    for (var index = 0;
        index < left.consumedArtifactCoordinates.length;
        index++) {
      final leftCoordinate = left.consumedArtifactCoordinates[index];
      final rightCoordinate = right.consumedArtifactCoordinates[index];
      if (leftCoordinate.artifactType != rightCoordinate.artifactType ||
          leftCoordinate.version != rightCoordinate.version ||
          leftCoordinate.hash != rightCoordinate.hash ||
          leftCoordinate.reference != rightCoordinate.reference) {
        return false;
      }
    }

    return true;
  }

  static QualityGateEvaluation? _evaluateRoleStatus(
    QualityGateRequirement requirement,
    QualityGateEvidence evidence,
  ) {
    final status = evidence.roleStatus;
    if (status == null) {
      return null;
    }

    switch (status.state) {
      case LanguageRoleStatusState.blocked:
        return _failure(
          requirement,
          QualityGateDisposition.blocked,
          'role status is BLOCKED',
        );
      case LanguageRoleStatusState.quarantined:
        return _failure(
          requirement,
          QualityGateDisposition.quarantined,
          'role status is QUARANTINED',
        );
      case LanguageRoleStatusState.productionReady:
        return null;
      case LanguageRoleStatusState.registered:
      case LanguageRoleStatusState.specified:
      case LanguageRoleStatusState.implemented:
      case LanguageRoleStatusState.tested:
      case LanguageRoleStatusState.verified:
      case LanguageRoleStatusState.deprecated:
      case LanguageRoleStatusState.superseded:
        return _failure(
          requirement,
          QualityGateDisposition.fail,
          'role status does not allow required use',
        );
    }
  }

  static QualityGateEvaluation? _evaluateCapability(
    QualityGateRequirement requirement,
    QualityGateEvidence evidence,
  ) {
    final requiredCapability = requirement.capability;
    if (requiredCapability == null) {
      return null;
    }

    final status = evidence.capabilityStatus;
    if (status == null) {
      return _failure(
        requirement,
        QualityGateDisposition.unknown,
        'missing required capability declaration',
      );
    }

    if (status.capability != requiredCapability) {
      return _failure(
        requirement,
        QualityGateDisposition.fail,
        'capability scope mismatch',
      );
    }

    if (requirement.role != null && status.role != requirement.role) {
      return _failure(
        requirement,
        QualityGateDisposition.fail,
        'capability role scope mismatch',
      );
    }

    switch (status.state) {
      case LanguageCapabilityState.supported:
        return null;
      case LanguageCapabilityState.limited:
        if (requirement.acceptLimitedCapability) {
          return null;
        }
        return _failure(
          requirement,
          QualityGateDisposition.fail,
          'LIMITED capability requires explicit acceptance',
        );
      case LanguageCapabilityState.unsupported:
        return _failure(
          requirement,
          QualityGateDisposition.fail,
          'required capability is UNSUPPORTED',
        );
      case LanguageCapabilityState.notApplicable:
        final justified = status.justification != null &&
            status.justification!.trim().isNotEmpty;
        if (requirement.allowNotApplicable && justified) {
          return QualityGateEvaluation(
            requirement: requirement,
            disposition: QualityGateDisposition.notApplicable,
            satisfied: true,
            acceptedNotApplicable: true,
            reason: 'justified NOT_APPLICABLE accepted for this gate',
          );
        }
        return _failure(
          requirement,
          QualityGateDisposition.fail,
          'NOT_APPLICABLE is not allowed for required use',
        );
      case LanguageCapabilityState.blocked:
        return _failure(
          requirement,
          QualityGateDisposition.blocked,
          'required capability is BLOCKED',
        );
      case LanguageCapabilityState.quarantined:
        return _failure(
          requirement,
          QualityGateDisposition.quarantined,
          'required capability is QUARANTINED',
        );
    }
  }

  static QualityGateEvaluation _pass(QualityGateRequirement requirement) {
    return QualityGateEvaluation(
      requirement: requirement,
      disposition: QualityGateDisposition.pass,
      satisfied: true,
      acceptedNotApplicable: false,
      reason: 'gate satisfied',
    );
  }

  static QualityGateEvaluation _failure(
    QualityGateRequirement requirement,
    QualityGateDisposition disposition,
    String reason,
  ) {
    return QualityGateEvaluation(
      requirement: requirement,
      disposition: disposition,
      satisfied: false,
      acceptedNotApplicable: false,
      reason: reason,
    );
  }

  static QualityGateDisposition _strongestMandatoryFailure(
    List<QualityGateEvaluation> mandatory,
  ) {
    var strongest = QualityGateDisposition.unknown;
    var strongestRank = -1;

    for (final result in mandatory) {
      if (result.satisfied) {
        continue;
      }
      final rank = _failureRank(result.disposition);
      if (rank > strongestRank) {
        strongest = result.disposition;
        strongestRank = rank;
      }
    }

    return strongest;
  }

  static int _failureRank(QualityGateDisposition disposition) {
    switch (disposition) {
      case QualityGateDisposition.quarantined:
        return 4;
      case QualityGateDisposition.blocked:
        return 3;
      case QualityGateDisposition.fail:
        return 2;
      case QualityGateDisposition.unknown:
        return 1;
      case QualityGateDisposition.pass:
      case QualityGateDisposition.notApplicable:
        return 0;
    }
  }
}

void _requireNonEmpty(String value, String field) {
  if (value.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(value, field, 'must not be empty');
  }
}

import '../models/content.dart';
import '../services/verb_index.dart';
import 'language_content_intelligence.dart';
import 'language_content_pack.dart';
import 'language_content_quality.dart';
import 'language_exercise_strategy.dart';

import 'language_presentation.dart';
import 'language_text_normalizer.dart';

/// Immutable content view admitted from an active offline pack.
final class RuntimeLanguageContentPack implements LanguageContentPack {
  const RuntimeLanguageContentPack({
    required this.items,
    required this.verbIndex,
  });

  @override
  final List<ContentItem> items;

  @override
  final VerbIndex verbIndex;
}

/// Preserves language-specific intelligence while replacing only its content
/// source with a verified runtime pack.
final class RuntimeLanguagePack implements LanguagePack {
  const RuntimeLanguagePack({
    required this.base,

/// Canonical provider-independent account identity.
final class AccountIdentity {
  const AccountIdentity({required this.userId});

  final String userId;

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) {
    return other is AccountIdentity && other.userId == userId;
  }

  @override
  int get hashCode => userId.hashCode;
}

enum AccountProvider { emailOtp, google, apple }

/// Immutable authentication state exposed to the application.
final class AccountSession {
  const AccountSession._({
    required this.isAuthenticated,
    this.identity,
    this.expiresAt,
  });

  const AccountSession.unauthenticated() : this._(isAuthenticated: false);

  const AccountSession.authenticated({
    required AccountIdentity identity,
    DateTime? expiresAt,
  }) : this._(isAuthenticated: true, identity: identity, expiresAt: expiresAt);

  final bool isAuthenticated;
  final AccountIdentity? identity;
  final DateTime? expiresAt;

  bool get requiresReauthentication {
    if (!isAuthenticated || expiresAt == null) {
      return false;
    }
    return !DateTime.now().isBefore(expiresAt!);
  }

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) {
    return other is AccountSession &&
        other.isAuthenticated == isAuthenticated &&
        other.identity == identity &&
        other.expiresAt == expiresAt;
  }

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(isAuthenticated, identity, expiresAt);
}

FILE: lib/models/ai_runtime_config.dart
--------------------------------------------------
/// Non-secret compile-time configuration for the optional cloud AI adapter.
///
/// The UI must never read compile-time defines directly. Missing or invalid
/// values produce an unconfigured state so the composition root can fail
/// closed to the offline gateway.
final class AiRuntimeConfig {
  const AiRuntimeConfig._({
    required this.baseUri,
    required this.allowedHosts,
    required this.allowedHostsValid,
  });

  static const String baseUrlDefine = 'DEUTSCH_AI_BASE_URL';
  static const String allowedHostsDefine = 'DEUTSCH_AI_ALLOWED_HOSTS';
  static const int maxHostEntries = 32;
  static const int maxHostLength = 253;

  final Uri? baseUri;
  final Set<String> allowedHosts;
  final bool allowedHostsValid;

  bool get isConfigured =>
      allowedHostsValid &&
      baseUri != null &&
      allowedHosts.contains(baseUri!.host.toLowerCase());

  static AiRuntimeConfig fromEnvironment() {
    const rawBaseUrl = String.fromEnvironment(baseUrlDefine, defaultValue: '');
    const rawAllowedHosts = String.fromEnvironment(
      allowedHostsDefine,
      defaultValue: '',
    );
    final baseUri = _parseBaseUri(rawBaseUrl);
    final parsed = _parseAllowedHosts(rawAllowedHosts);
    return AiRuntimeConfig._(
      baseUri: baseUri,
      allowedHosts: parsed.hosts,
      allowedHostsValid: parsed.valid,
    );
  }

  static Uri? _parseBaseUri(String raw) {
    final value = raw.trim();
    if (value.isEmpty) return null;
    late final Uri uri;
    try {
      uri = Uri.parse(value);
    } on FormatException {
      return null;
    }
    if (uri.scheme.toLowerCase() != 'https' || uri.host.isEmpty) return null;
    if (uri.userInfo.isNotEmpty ||
        uri.query.isNotEmpty ||
        uri.fragment.isNotEmpty) {
      return null;
    }
    if (uri.host.length > maxHostLength) return null;
    return uri.path.endsWith('/') ? uri : uri.replace(path: '${uri.path}/');
  }

  static ({Set<String> hosts, bool valid}) _parseAllowedHosts(String raw) {
    final value = raw.trim();
    if (value.isEmpty) return (hosts: const <String>{}, valid: false);
    final rawParts = value.split(',');
    final parts = rawParts.map((host) => host.trim().toLowerCase()).toSet();
    if (rawParts.length > maxHostEntries ||
        parts.any((host) => host.isEmpty || host.length > maxHostLength) ||
        parts.any((host) => Uri(scheme: 'https', host: host).host != host)) {
      return (hosts: const <String>{}, valid: false);
    }
    return (hosts: Set.unmodifiable(parts), valid: true);
  }
}

enum AssessmentQuestionType {

  translation,

  final AssessmentQuestionType type;

  final String skill;
  const AssessmentQuestion({
    required this.id,
    required this.itemId,
    required this.prompt,
    required this.expected,
    required this.type,
    required this.accepted,
    required this.skill,
  });
}

class AssessmentResponse {
  final String questionId, itemId, answer;
  final bool correct, hinted;
  const AssessmentResponse({
    required this.questionId,
    required this.itemId,
    this.answer = '',
    required this.correct,
    required this.hinted,
  });
}

class AssessmentResult {
  final String id;
  final DateTime at;
  final int answered, correct, cleanCorrect;
  final double score;
  final Map<String, double> skillScores;
  final List<String> weakSkills, nextReviewItemIds;
  const AssessmentResult({
    required this.id,
    required this.at,
    required this.answered,
    required this.correct,
    required this.cleanCorrect,
    required this.score,
    required this.skillScores,
    required this.weakSkills,
    required this.nextReviewItemIds,
  });

String assessmentNormalize(String value) => value
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[.!?]+$'), '')
    .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');
bool assessmentAnswerMatches(
  AssessmentResponse response,
  AssessmentQuestion q,
) {
  if (!response.correct) return false;
  final a = assessmentNormalize(response.answer);
  if (a.isEmpty) return true;
  return {
    assessmentNormalize(q.expected),
    ...q.accepted.map(assessmentNormalize),
  }.contains(a);
}

ContentItem? assessmentFindItem(List<ContentItem> items, String id) {
  for (final x in items) {
    if (x.id == id) return x;
  }
  return null;
}

/// Semantic authentication operations exposed by the backend API contract.
enum BackendAuthenticationOperation {
  requestEmailOtp,
  verifyEmailOtp,
  authenticateProvider,
  currentSession,
  renewSession,
  revokeSession,
  signOut,
}

/// Transient request for the authentication API. It contains no session or
/// entitlement state and is never intended for persistence.
final class BackendAuthenticationApiRequest {
  const BackendAuthenticationApiRequest({
    required this.operation,
    this.email,
    this.otp,
    this.assertion,
    this.credentials,
  });

  const BackendAuthenticationApiRequest.requestEmailOtp({required String email})
      : this(
          operation: BackendAuthenticationOperation.requestEmailOtp,
          email: email,
        );

  const BackendAuthenticationApiRequest.verifyEmailOtp({
    required String email,
    required String otp,
  }) : this(
          operation: BackendAuthenticationOperation.verifyEmailOtp,
          email: email,
          otp: otp,
        );

  const BackendAuthenticationApiRequest.authenticateProvider({
    required ProviderAuthenticationAssertion assertion,
  }) : this(
          operation: BackendAuthenticationOperation.authenticateProvider,
          assertion: assertion,
        );

  const BackendAuthenticationApiRequest.currentSession({
    SecureSessionCredentials? credentials,
  }) : this(
          operation: BackendAuthenticationOperation.currentSession,
          credentials: credentials,
        );

  const BackendAuthenticationApiRequest.renewSession({
    required SecureSessionCredentials credentials,
  }) : this(
          operation: BackendAuthenticationOperation.renewSession,
          credentials: credentials,
        );

  const BackendAuthenticationApiRequest.revokeSession({
    SecureSessionCredentials? credentials,
  }) : this(
          operation: BackendAuthenticationOperation.revokeSession,
          credentials: credentials,
        );

  const BackendAuthenticationApiRequest.signOut()
      : this(operation: BackendAuthenticationOperation.signOut);

  final BackendAuthenticationOperation operation;
  final String? email;
  final String? otp;
  final ProviderAuthenticationAssertion? assertion;
  final SecureSessionCredentials? credentials;
}

/// Semantic authentication response. A session is present only when the API
/// operation produces one; callers must still validate authentication state.
final class BackendAuthenticationApiResponse {
  const BackendAuthenticationApiResponse({this.session, this.credentials});

  final AccountSession? session;
  final SecureSessionCredentials? credentials;
}

/// Non-secret runtime configuration for the authentication backend.
///
/// Values come from Dart compile-time defines. Missing or invalid configuration
/// is represented as an unconfigured state so boot can fail closed.
final class BackendRuntimeConfig {
  const BackendRuntimeConfig._({
    required this.baseUri,
    required this.allowedHosts,
    required this.allowedHostsValid,
  });

  static const String baseUrlDefine = 'DEUTSCH_AUTH_BASE_URL';
  static const String allowedHostsDefine = 'DEUTSCH_AUTH_ALLOWED_HOSTS';
  static const int maxHostEntries = 32;
  static const int maxHostLength = 253;

  final Uri? baseUri;
  final Set<String> allowedHosts;
  final bool allowedHostsValid;

  bool get isConfigured {
    if (!allowedHostsValid) return false;
    return baseUri != null &&
        (allowedHosts.isEmpty ||
            allowedHosts.contains(baseUri!.host.toLowerCase()));
  }

  static BackendRuntimeConfig fromEnvironment() {
    const rawBaseUrl = String.fromEnvironment(baseUrlDefine, defaultValue: '');
    const rawAllowedHosts = String.fromEnvironment(
      allowedHostsDefine,
      defaultValue: '',
    );

    final baseUri = _parseBaseUri(rawBaseUrl);
    final parsedAllowedHosts = _parseAllowedHosts(rawAllowedHosts);
    return BackendRuntimeConfig._(
      baseUri: baseUri,
      allowedHosts: parsedAllowedHosts.hosts,
      allowedHostsValid: parsedAllowedHosts.valid,
    );
  }

  static Uri? _parseBaseUri(String raw) {
    final value = raw.trim();
    if (value.isEmpty) return null;

    late final Uri uri;
    try {
      uri = Uri.parse(value);
    } on FormatException {
      return null;
    }

    if (uri.scheme.toLowerCase() != 'https' || uri.host.isEmpty) return null;
    if (uri.userInfo.isNotEmpty) return null;
    if (uri.query.isNotEmpty || uri.fragment.isNotEmpty) return null;
    if (uri.host.length > maxHostLength) return null;

    return uri.path.endsWith('/') ? uri : uri.replace(path: '${uri.path}/');
  }

  static ({Set<String> hosts, bool valid}) _parseAllowedHosts(String raw) {
    final value = raw.trim();
    if (value.isEmpty) {
      return (hosts: const <String>{}, valid: true);
    }

    final rawParts = value.split(',');
    final parts = rawParts.map((host) => host.trim().toLowerCase()).toSet();
    if (rawParts.length > maxHostEntries ||
        parts.any((host) => host.isEmpty || host.length > maxHostLength) ||
        parts.any((host) => Uri(scheme: 'https', host: host).host != host)) {
      return (hosts: const <String>{}, valid: false);
    }
    return (hosts: Set.unmodifiable(parts), valid: true);
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

@immutable
class GrammarTopic {
  final String id;
  final String level; // A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String summaryAr;
  final List<GrammarRule> rules;
  final List<MiniCheckQuestion> miniChecks;

  const GrammarTopic({
    required this.id,
    required this.level,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.summaryAr,
    this.rules = const [],
    this.miniChecks = const [],
  });

  GrammarTopic copyWith({
    String? id,
    String? level,
    String? titleDe,
    String? titleAr,
    String? summaryAr,
    List<GrammarRule>? rules,
    List<MiniCheckQuestion>? miniChecks,
  }) {
    return GrammarTopic(
      id: id ?? this.id,
      level: level ?? this.level,
      titleDe: titleDe ?? this.titleDe,
      titleAr: titleAr ?? this.titleAr,
      summaryAr: summaryAr ?? this.summaryAr,
      rules: rules ?? this.rules,
      miniChecks: miniChecks ?? this.miniChecks,
    );
  }

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) {
    if (identical(this, other)) return true;
    return other is GrammarTopic &&
        other.id == id &&
        other.level == level &&
        other.titleDe == titleDe &&
        other.titleAr == titleAr &&
        other.summaryAr == summaryAr &&
        listEquals(other.rules, rules) &&
        listEquals(other.miniChecks, miniChecks);
  }

  @override
  int get hashCode {
    return id.hashCode ^
        level.hashCode ^
        titleDe.hashCode ^
        titleAr.hashCode ^
        summaryAr.hashCode ^
        Object.hashAll(rules) ^
        Object.hashAll(miniChecks);
  }
}

@immutable
class GrammarRule {
  final String id;
  final String title;
  final String explanationAr;
  final List<GrammarExample> examples;
  // Syntax tables can be represented as List of rows (List of columns)
  final List<List<String>> table;

  const GrammarRule({
    required this.id,
    required this.title,
    required this.explanationAr,
    this.examples = const [],
    this.table = const [],
  });

  GrammarRule copyWith({
    String? id,
    String? title,
    String? explanationAr,
    List<GrammarExample>? examples,
    List<List<String>>? table,
  }) {
    return GrammarRule(
      id: id ?? this.id,
      title: title ?? this.title,
      explanationAr: explanationAr ?? this.explanationAr,
      examples: examples ?? this.examples,
      table: table ?? this.table,
    );
  }

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) {
    if (identical(this, other)) return true;
    return other is GrammarRule &&
        other.id == id &&
        other.title == title &&
        other.explanationAr == explanationAr &&
        listEquals(other.examples, examples) &&
        _tableEquals(other.table, table);
  }

  bool _tableEquals(List<List<String>> a, List<List<String>> b) {
    if (a.length != b.length) return false;
    for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
      if (!listEquals(a[i], b[i])) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  @override
  int get hashCode {
    return id.hashCode ^
        title.hashCode ^
        explanationAr.hashCode ^
        Object.hashAll(examples) ^
        _tableHashCode();
  }

  int _tableHashCode() {
    int hash = 0;
    for (var row in table) {
      hash ^= Object.hashAll(row);
    }
    return hash;
  }
}

@immutable
class GrammarExample {
  final String german;
  final String arabic;

  const GrammarExample({required this.german, required this.arabic});

  GrammarExample copyWith({String? german, String? arabic}) {
    return GrammarExample(
      german: german ?? this.german,
      arabic: arabic ?? this.arabic,
    );
  }

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) {
    if (identical(this, other)) return true;
    return other is GrammarExample &&
        other.german == german &&
        other.arabic == arabic;
  }

  @override
  int get hashCode => german.hashCode ^ arabic.hashCode;
}
