import 'diagnostic_placement.dart';
import '../core/srs_facets.dart';

class Attempt {
  final String id, itemId, skill, answer;
  final bool correct, hinted;
  final int seconds;
  final DateTime at;
  final ReviewFacetType facetType;
  final String? variantKey;
  const Attempt({
    required this.id,
    required this.itemId,
    required this.skill,
    required this.answer,
    required this.correct,
    required this.hinted,
    required this.seconds,
    required this.at,
    this.facetType = ReviewFacetType.meaningRecall,
    this.variantKey,
  });
  bool get isMeaningFacet =>
      facetType == ReviewFacetType.meaningRecall &&
      ReviewFacetKey.normalizeVariant(variantKey) == null;

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
        'id': id,
        'itemId': itemId,
        'skill': skill,
        'answer': answer,
        'correct': correct,
        'hinted': hinted,
        'seconds': seconds,
        'at': at.toIso8601String(),
        'facetType': facetType.wireName,
        if (ReviewFacetKey.normalizeVariant(variantKey) != null)
          'variantKey': ReviewFacetKey.normalizeVariant(variantKey),
      };
  factory Attempt.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> j) => Attempt(
        id: j['id'] ?? '',
        itemId: j['itemId'] ?? '',
        skill: j['skill'] ?? 'recall',
        answer: j['answer'] ?? '',
        correct: j['correct'] == true,
        hinted: j['hinted'] == true,
        seconds: (j['seconds'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 5,
        at: DateTime.tryParse(j['at'] ?? '') ?? DateTime.now(),
        facetType: ReviewFacetType.fromWire(j['facetType']?.toString()),
        variantKey:
            ReviewFacetKey.normalizeVariant(j['variantKey']?.toString()),
      );
}

class AssessmentHistory {
  final String id;
  final DateTime at;
  final double score;
  final List<String> weakSkills;
  final int answered;
  const AssessmentHistory({
    required this.id,
    required this.at,
    required this.score,
    required this.weakSkills,
    required this.answered,
  });
  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
        'id': id,
        'at': at.toIso8601String(),
        'score': score.clamp(0, 100),
        'weakSkills': weakSkills.take(8).toList(),
        'answered': answered.clamp(0, 100),
      };
  factory AssessmentHistory.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> j) {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    var safeAt = DateTime.tryParse(j['at']?.toString() ?? '') ?? now;
    if (safeAt.isAfter(now.add(const Duration(days: 1)))) safeAt = now;
    if (safeAt.isBefore(DateTime(2000))) safeAt = now;
    final rawId = (j['id'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    return AssessmentHistory(
      id: rawId.substring(0, rawId.length.clamp(0, 160).toInt()),
      at: safeAt,
      score: (((j['score'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0).clamp(0, 100)).toDouble(),
      weakSkills: (j['weakSkills'] is List
          ? (j['weakSkills'] as List)
              .whereType<String>()
              .map((x) => x.trim())
              .where((x) => x.isNotEmpty)
              .take(8)
              .toList()
          : const <String>[]),
      answered: (((j['answered'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0).clamp(0, 100)).toInt(),
    );
  }
}

enum MemoryState { newCard, learning, relearning, young, mature }

class ReviewCard {
  final String itemId;
  final ReviewFacetType facetType;
  final String? variantKey;
  final int repetitions, intervalDays, lapses, successes, failures;
  final double difficulty, stabilityDays;
  final DateTime dueAt;
  final DateTime? lastReviewedAt;

  const ReviewCard({
    required this.itemId,
    this.facetType = ReviewFacetType.meaningRecall,
    this.variantKey,
    this.repetitions = 0,
    this.intervalDays = 0,
    this.lapses = 0,
    this.successes = 0,
    this.failures = 0,
    this.difficulty = 1.3,
    this.stabilityDays = 0,
    required this.dueAt,
    this.lastReviewedAt,
  });

  String get conceptId => itemId;

  ReviewFacetKey get facetKey => ReviewFacetKey(
        conceptId: itemId,
        facetType: facetType,
        variantKey: variantKey,
      );

  String get storageKey => facetKey.storageKey;

  MemoryState get memoryState {
    if (repetitions <= 0 && lapses > 0) return MemoryState.relearning;
    if (repetitions <= 0) return MemoryState.newCard;
    if (intervalDays >= 14 || stabilityDays >= 14) return MemoryState.mature;
    if (intervalDays >= 2 || stabilityDays >= 2) return MemoryState.young;
    return MemoryState.learning;
  }

  double get successRate {
    final total = successes + failures;
    return total == 0 ? 0 : successes / total;
  }

  ReviewCard copyWith({
    int? repetitions,
    int? intervalDays,
    int? lapses,
    int? successes,
    int? failures,
    double? difficulty,
    double? stabilityDays,
    DateTime? dueAt,
    DateTime? lastReviewedAt,
  }) =>
      ReviewCard(
        itemId: itemId,
        facetType: facetType,
        variantKey: variantKey,
        repetitions: repetitions ?? this.repetitions,
        intervalDays: intervalDays ?? this.intervalDays,
        lapses: lapses ?? this.lapses,
        successes: successes ?? this.successes,
        failures: failures ?? this.failures,
        difficulty: difficulty ?? this.difficulty,
        stabilityDays: stabilityDays ?? this.stabilityDays,
        dueAt: dueAt ?? this.dueAt,
        lastReviewedAt: lastReviewedAt ?? this.lastReviewedAt,
      );

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
        'itemId': itemId,
        'facetType': facetType.wireName,
        if (ReviewFacetKey.normalizeVariant(variantKey) != null)
          'variantKey': ReviewFacetKey.normalizeVariant(variantKey),
        'repetitions': repetitions,
        'intervalDays': intervalDays,
        'lapses': lapses,
        'successes': successes,
        'failures': failures,
        'difficulty': difficulty,
        'stabilityDays': stabilityDays,
        'dueAt': dueAt.toIso8601String(),
        'lastReviewedAt': lastReviewedAt?.toIso8601String(),
      };

  factory ReviewCard.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> j) {
    final id = (j['itemId'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    final now = DateTime.now();
    var due = DateTime.tryParse((j['dueAt'] ?? '').toString()) ?? now;
    var last = DateTime.tryParse((j['lastReviewedAt'] ?? '').toString());
    if (due.isBefore(DateTime(2000))) due = now;
    if (due.isAfter(now.add(const Duration(days: 3650))))
      due = now.add(const Duration(days: 3650));
    if (last != null && last.isAfter(now.add(const Duration(days: 1))))
      last = now;
    if (last != null && last.isBefore(DateTime(2000))) last = now;
    return ReviewCard(
      itemId: id,
      facetType: ReviewFacetType.fromWire(j['facetType']?.toString()),
      variantKey: ReviewFacetKey.normalizeVariant(j['variantKey']?.toString()),
      repetitions: _boundInt(_int(j['repetitions']), 0, 1000),
      intervalDays: _boundInt(_int(j['intervalDays']), 0, 3650),
      lapses: _boundInt(_int(j['lapses']), 0, 1000),
      successes: _boundInt(_int(j['successes']), 0, 10000),
      failures: _boundInt(_int(j['failures']), 0, 10000),
      difficulty: _boundDouble(_double(j['difficulty'], 1.3), .5, 2.5),
      stabilityDays: _boundDouble(_double(j['stabilityDays'], 0), 0, 3650),
      dueAt: due,
      lastReviewedAt: last,
    );
  }

  static int _int(Object? v) =>
      v is num ? v.toInt() : int.tryParse(v?.toString() ?? '') ?? 0;
  static double _double(Object? v, double fallback) {
    final parsed =
        v is num ? v.toDouble() : double.tryParse(v?.toString() ?? '');
    return parsed == null || !parsed.isFinite ? fallback : parsed;
  }
  static int _boundInt(int v, int min, int max) =>
      v < min ? min : (v > max ? max : v);
  static double _boundDouble(double v, double min, double max) =>
      v < min ? min : (v > max ? max : v);
}

class LearnerState {
  final int xp, streak;
  final Set<String> learned, review, favoriteVerbs;
  final Map<String, ReviewCard> reviewCards;
  final List<Attempt> attempts;
  final List<AssessmentHistory> assessmentHistory;
  final List<PlacementDiagnosticRecord> placementHistory;
  final DateTime updatedAt;
  const LearnerState({
    this.xp = 0,
    this.streak = 0,
    this.learned = const {},
    this.review = const {},
    this.favoriteVerbs = const {},
    this.reviewCards = const {},
    this.attempts = const [],
    this.assessmentHistory = const [],
    this.placementHistory = const [],
    required this.updatedAt,
  });
  Iterable<ReviewCard> get meaningReviewCards sync* {
    for (final card in reviewCards.values) {
      if (card.facetKey.isLegacyMeaningKey) yield card;
    }
  }

  Iterable<Attempt> get meaningAttempts sync* {
    for (final attempt in attempts) {
      if (attempt.isMeaningFacet) yield attempt;
    }
  }

  ReviewCard? reviewCardForFacet(
    String conceptId, {
    ReviewFacetType facetType = ReviewFacetType.meaningRecall,
    String? variantKey,
  }) {
    final key = ReviewFacetKey(
      conceptId: conceptId,
      facetType: facetType,
      variantKey: variantKey,
    );
    if (!key.isValid) return null;
    return reviewCards[key.storageKey];
  }

  Iterable<ReviewCard> reviewCardsForConcept(String conceptId) sync* {
    final normalized = conceptId.trim();
    if (normalized.isEmpty) return;
    for (final card in reviewCards.values) {
      if (card.itemId == normalized) yield card;
    }
  }

  LearnerState copyWith({
    int? xp,
    int? streak,
    Set<String>? learned,
    Set<String>? review,
    Set<String>? favoriteVerbs,
    Map<String, ReviewCard>? reviewCards,
    List<Attempt>? attempts,
    List<AssessmentHistory>? assessmentHistory,
    List<PlacementDiagnosticRecord>? placementHistory,
  }) =>
      LearnerState(
        xp: xp ?? this.xp,
        streak: streak ?? this.streak,
        learned: learned ?? this.learned,
        review: review ?? this.review,
        favoriteVerbs: favoriteVerbs ?? this.favoriteVerbs,
        reviewCards: reviewCards ?? this.reviewCards,
        attempts: attempts ?? this.attempts,
        assessmentHistory: assessmentHistory ?? this.assessmentHistory,
        placementHistory: placementHistory ?? this.placementHistory,
        updatedAt: DateTime.now(),
      );
}

String mistakeCategoryLabel(MistakeCategory x) =>
    const {
      MistakeCategory.vocabulary: 'مفردات',
      MistakeCategory.article: 'Artikel',
      MistakeCategory.grammar: 'قواعد',
      MistakeCategory.translation: 'ترجمة',
      MistakeCategory.wordOrder: 'ترتيب الجملة',
      MistakeCategory.writing: 'كتابة',
      MistakeCategory.production: 'إنتاج',
      MistakeCategory.listening: 'استماع',
    }[x] ??
    'تدريب';

bool repairStepAccepts(
  RepairStep step,
  String answer,
  String Function(String value) normalize,
) {
  final normalized = normalize(answer);
  if (normalized.isEmpty) return false;
  if (normalize(step.expected) == normalized) return true;
  return step.accepted.any((value) => normalize(value) == normalized);
}

FILE: lib/models/secure_session_credentials.dart

import 'dart:convert';

/// Opaque credential required only by the authenticated session layer.
///
/// The model intentionally exposes only the opaque value. Concrete credential
/// semantics belong to the backend contract, not to unrelated application state.
final class SecureSessionCredentials {
  static const int maxValueBytes = 16 * 1024;

  factory SecureSessionCredentials(String value) {
    if (value.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(value, 'value', 'must not be empty');
    }
    final valueBytes = utf8.encode(value);
    if (valueBytes.length > maxValueBytes) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(value, 'value', 'exceeds the maximum size');
    }
    return SecureSessionCredentials._(value);
  }

  const SecureSessionCredentials._(this.value);

  final String value;
}

class WordProfile<T extends LearningContent> {
  final T item;
  final List<String> relatedForms;
  final List<String> relatedWords;
  final List<String> relatedExamples;
  final int attempts;
  final int errors;
  final bool due;
  final double masteryScore;

  const WordProfile({
    required this.item,
    this.relatedForms = const [],
    this.relatedWords = const [],
    this.relatedExamples = const [],
    this.attempts = 0,
    this.errors = 0,
    this.due = false,
    this.masteryScore = 0,
  });

  String get displayForm => item.grammaticalMarker.isEmpty
      ? item.sourceText
      : '${item.grammaticalMarker} ${item.sourceText}';
  double get successRate => attempts == 0 ? 0 : (attempts - errors) / attempts;
  bool get needsPractice => due || errors > 0 || attempts == 0;
  int get masteryPercent => (masteryScore.clamp(0.0, 1.0) * 100).round();
  String get masteryLabel => masteryPercent >= 85
      ? 'متقنة'
      : masteryPercent >= 65
          ? 'جيدة'
          : masteryPercent >= 40
              ? 'تحتاج تثبيتًا'
              : 'تحتاج تدريبًا';
}

import 'assessment.dart';

enum DiagnosticDimension {
  meaning,
  grammar,
  listening,
  transfer,
  production;

  String get wireName => name;

  static DiagnosticDimension? fromWire(String? raw) {
    final value = raw?.trim().toLowerCase();
    for (final dimension in DiagnosticDimension.values) {
      if (dimension.wireName == value) return dimension;
    }
    return null;
  }
}

enum DiagnosticPlacementBand {
  foundation,
  basic,
  developing,
  strong;

  String get wireName => name;

  static DiagnosticPlacementBand fromWire(String? raw) {
    final value = raw?.trim().toLowerCase();
    for (final band in DiagnosticPlacementBand.values) {
      if (band.wireName == value) return band;
    }
    return DiagnosticPlacementBand.foundation;
  }
}

final class DiagnosticQuestion {
  const DiagnosticQuestion({
    required this.question,
    required this.dimension,
    required this.difficultyBand,
  });

  final AssessmentQuestion question;
  final DiagnosticDimension dimension;
  final int difficultyBand;
}

final class DiagnosticResponse {
  const DiagnosticResponse({
    required this.questionId,
    required this.itemId,
    required this.dimension,
    required this.correct,
    required this.hinted,
    required this.skipped,
    this.difficultyBand = 1,
  });

  final String questionId;
  final String itemId;
  final DiagnosticDimension dimension;
  final bool correct;
  final bool hinted;
  final bool skipped;
  final int difficultyBand;

  double get evidenceValue {
    if (skipped || !correct) return 0;
    return hinted ? .7 : 1;
  }
}

final class PlacementDiagnosticResult {
  const PlacementDiagnosticResult({
    required this.answered,
    required this.scoredAnswers,
    required this.cleanCorrect,
    required this.score,
    required this.confidence,
    required this.band,
    required this.dimensionScores,
    required this.weakDimensions,
    required this.reviewItemIds,
  });

  final int answered;
  final int scoredAnswers;
  final int cleanCorrect;
  final double score;
  final double confidence;
  final DiagnosticPlacementBand band;
  final Map<DiagnosticDimension, double> dimensionScores;
  final List<DiagnosticDimension> weakDimensions;
  final List<String> reviewItemIds;

  bool get isCefrCertification => false;

  PlacementDiagnosticRecord toRecord({required DateTime at, String? id}) =>
      PlacementDiagnosticRecord(
        id: id ?? 'placement_${at.microsecondsSinceEpoch}',
        at: at,
        answered: answered,
        scoredAnswers: scoredAnswers,
        score: score,
        confidence: confidence,
        band: band,
        dimensionScores: dimensionScores,
        weakDimensions: weakDimensions,
        reviewItemIds: reviewItemIds,
      );
}

final class PlacementDiagnosticRecord {
  const PlacementDiagnosticRecord({
    required this.id,
    required this.at,
    required this.answered,
    required this.scoredAnswers,
    required this.score,
    required this.confidence,
    required this.band,
    required this.dimensionScores,
    required this.weakDimensions,
    required this.reviewItemIds,
    this.curriculumStartLevel,
    this.recommendedStartTaskOrder = 1,
    this.learningGoal,
  });

  final String id;
  final DateTime at;
  final int answered;
  final int scoredAnswers;
  final double score;
  final double confidence;
  final DiagnosticPlacementBand band;
  final Map<DiagnosticDimension, double> dimensionScores;
  final List<DiagnosticDimension> weakDimensions;
  final List<String> reviewItemIds;
  final String? curriculumStartLevel;
  final int recommendedStartTaskOrder;
  final String? learningGoal;

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => <String, dynamic>{
        'id': id,
        'at': at.toIso8601String(),
        'answered': answered,
        'scoredAnswers': scoredAnswers,
        'score': score,
        'confidence': confidence,
        'band': band.wireName,
        'dimensionScores': <String, double>{
          for (final entry in dimensionScores.entries)
            entry.key.wireName: entry.value,
        },
        'weakDimensions': weakDimensions
            .map((dimension) => dimension.wireName)
            .toList(growable: false),
        'reviewItemIds': reviewItemIds.take(20).toList(growable: false),
        if (curriculumStartLevel != null)
          'curriculumStartLevel': curriculumStartLevel,
        'recommendedStartTaskOrder':
            recommendedStartTaskOrder.clamp(1, 50),
        if (learningGoal != null) 'learningGoal': learningGoal,
      };

  factory PlacementDiagnosticRecord.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    var at = DateTime.tryParse(json['at']?.toString() ?? '') ?? now;
    if (at.isBefore(DateTime(2000)) ||
        at.isAfter(now.add(const Duration(days: 1)))) {
      at = now;
    }

    final scores = <DiagnosticDimension, double>{};
    final rawScores = json['dimensionScores'];
    if (rawScores is Map) {
      for (final entry in rawScores.entries) {
        final dimension = DiagnosticDimension.fromWire(entry.key.toString());
        final raw = entry.value;
        if (dimension == null || raw is! num) continue;
        scores[dimension] = raw.toDouble().clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
      }
    }

    final weak = <DiagnosticDimension>[];
    final rawWeak = json['weakDimensions'];
    if (rawWeak is List) {
      for (final raw in rawWeak.take(DiagnosticDimension.values.length)) {
        final dimension = DiagnosticDimension.fromWire(raw?.toString());
        if (dimension != null && !weak.contains(dimension)) weak.add(dimension);
      }
    }

    final reviewIds = <String>[];
    final rawReviewIds = json['reviewItemIds'];
    if (rawReviewIds is List) {
      for (final raw in rawReviewIds.take(20)) {
        final value = raw?.toString().trim() ?? '';
        if (value.isNotEmpty &&
            value.length <= 160 &&
            !reviewIds.contains(value)) {
          reviewIds.add(value);
        }
      }
    }

    final rawId = json['id']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
    return PlacementDiagnosticRecord(
      id: rawId.length > 160 ? rawId.substring(0, 160) : rawId,
      at: at,
      answered: _boundedInt(json['answered'], 0, 20),
      scoredAnswers: _boundedInt(json['scoredAnswers'], 0, 20),
      score: _boundedDouble(json['score'], 0, 100),
      confidence: _boundedDouble(json['confidence'], 0, 1),
      band: DiagnosticPlacementBand.fromWire(json['band']?.toString()),
      dimensionScores: Map<DiagnosticDimension, double>.unmodifiable(scores),
      weakDimensions: List<DiagnosticDimension>.unmodifiable(weak),
      reviewItemIds: List<String>.unmodifiable(reviewIds),
      curriculumStartLevel: _placementLevel(
        json['curriculumStartLevel']?.toString(),
      ),
      recommendedStartTaskOrder:
          _boundedInt(json['recommendedStartTaskOrder'], 1, 50),
      learningGoal: _learningGoal(json['learningGoal']?.toString()),
    );
  }


  static String? _placementLevel(String? raw) {
    final value = raw?.trim().toUpperCase();
    return const <String>{'A1', 'A2', 'B1', 'B2'}.contains(value)
        ? value
        : null;
  }

  static String? _learningGoal(String? raw) {
    final value = raw?.trim();
    return const <String>{
      'general',
      'dailyLife',
      'work',
      'studyExam',
      'travel',
    }.contains(value)
        ? value
        : null;
  }

  static int _boundedInt(Object? raw, int min, int max) {
    final value =
        raw is num ? raw.toInt() : int.tryParse(raw?.toString() ?? '');
    return (value ?? min).clamp(min, max).toInt();
  }

  static double _boundedDouble(Object? raw, double min, double max) {
    final value =
        raw is num ? raw.toDouble() : double.tryParse(raw?.toString() ?? '');
    return (value ?? min).clamp(min, max).toDouble();
  }
}

final class GrammarRuleDetail {
  const GrammarRuleDetail({

  final String id;

  final String explanationAr;
  final int orderIndex;
  final List<List<String>> table;
  final List<GrammarExampleDetail> examples;
}

FILE: lib/models/linguistics/german_noun_forms.dart

import 'german_grammar_types.dart';

final class GermanNounCaseForms {
  const GermanNounCaseForms({
    required this.nominativeSingular,
    required this.accusativeSingular,
    required this.dativeSingular,
    required this.genitiveSingular,
    this.nominativePlural,
    this.accusativePlural,
    this.dativePlural,
    this.genitivePlural,
  });

  final String nominativeSingular;
  final String accusativeSingular;
  final String dativeSingular;
  final String genitiveSingular;
  final String? nominativePlural;
  final String? accusativePlural;
  final String? dativePlural;
  final String? genitivePlural;

  String? formFor(GermanCase grammaticalCase, {required bool plural}) {
    if (!plural) {
      return switch (grammaticalCase) {
        GermanCase.nominative => nominativeSingular,
        GermanCase.accusative => accusativeSingular,
        GermanCase.dative => dativeSingular,
        GermanCase.genitive => genitiveSingular,
      };
    }
    return switch (grammaticalCase) {
      GermanCase.nominative => nominativePlural,
      GermanCase.accusative => accusativePlural,
      GermanCase.dative => dativePlural,
      GermanCase.genitive => genitivePlural,
    };
  }
}

final class GermanWordFamilyMember {
  const GermanWordFamilyMember({
    required this.concept,
    required this.relationType,
    required this.semanticDistance,
    required this.pedagogicalLevel,
    required this.interferenceRisk,
    this.prefix,
    this.suffix,
  });

  final GermanWordFamilyRelationType relationType;
  final String? prefix;
  final String? suffix;
  final GermanSemanticDistance semanticDistance;
  final CefrLevel pedagogicalLevel;

final class GermanWordFamily {
  const GermanWordFamily({
    required this.familyId,
    required this.baseConceptId,
    required this.members,
  });

  final String familyId;
  final String baseConceptId;
  final List<GermanWordFamilyMember> members;

  GermanWordFamilyMember? get baseMember {
    for (final member in members) {
      if (member.concept.id == baseConceptId && member.isBase) {
        return member;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  bool get hasInterferenceRisk =>
      members.any((member) => member.interferenceRisk);
}

FILE: lib/semantic_content/artifact_provenance.dart

/// Provenance state is descriptive evidence only.
///
/// Factory-2 does not own canonical publication or readiness authority.
enum ArtifactProvenanceStatus { unknown, candidate, reviewed }

/// Exact version/fingerprint coordinate for one consumed or produced artifact.
final class ArtifactFingerprint {
  final String artifactType;
  final String version;
  final String fingerprint;
  final String? reference;

  ArtifactFingerprint({
    required this.artifactType,
    required this.version,
    required this.fingerprint,
    this.reference,
  }) {
    _requireNonEmpty(artifactType, 'artifactType');
    _requireNonEmpty(version, 'version');
    _requireNonEmpty(fingerprint, 'fingerprint');
    if (reference != null) {
      _requireNonEmpty(reference!, 'reference');
    }
  }

  Map<String, Object?> toMap() => <String, Object?>{
        'artifactType': artifactType,
        'version': version,
        'fingerprint': fingerprint,
        'reference': reference,
      };
}

/// Bounded provenance/evidence envelope.
///
/// Even REVIEWED provenance is not, by itself, canonical or readiness truth.
/// Those verdicts belong to later promotion/readiness authorities.
final class ArtifactProvenance {
  final ArtifactProvenanceStatus status;
  final String producer;
  final List<String> evidenceRefs;
  final List<ArtifactFingerprint> inputFingerprints;

  ArtifactProvenance({
    required this.status,
    required this.producer,
    List<String> evidenceRefs = const <String>[],
    List<ArtifactFingerprint> inputFingerprints = const <ArtifactFingerprint>[],
  })  : evidenceRefs = List<String>.unmodifiable(evidenceRefs),
        inputFingerprints = List<ArtifactFingerprint>.unmodifiable(
          inputFingerprints,
        ) {
    _requireNonEmpty(producer, 'producer');
    for (final evidenceRef in this.evidenceRefs) {
      _requireNonEmpty(evidenceRef, 'evidenceRef');
    }
  }

  factory ArtifactProvenance.unknown({
    required String producer,
    List<ArtifactFingerprint> inputFingerprints = const <ArtifactFingerprint>[],
  }) =>
      ArtifactProvenance(
        status: ArtifactProvenanceStatus.unknown,
        producer: producer,
        inputFingerprints: inputFingerprints,
      );

  /// Provenance can never certify canonical publication by itself.
  bool get grantsCanonicalAuthority => false;

  /// Provenance can never certify runtime/readiness state by itself.
  bool get grantsReadinessAuthority => false;

  Map<String, Object?> toMap() => <String, Object?>{
        'status': status.name,
        'producer': producer,
        'evidenceRefs': evidenceRefs,
        'inputFingerprints': inputFingerprints
            .map((fingerprint) => fingerprint.toMap())
            .toList(),
      };
}

void _requireNonEmpty(String value, String field) {
  if (value.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(value, field, 'must not be empty');
  }
}

import '../language/language_identity.dart';
import 'artifact_provenance.dart';

enum LanguageRealizationKind { lexeme, phrase, utterance, other }

/// Opaque language-owned payload envelope.
///
/// Factory-2 validates ownership/version coordinates but does not interpret
/// German, Arabic, Hindi, Mandarin or other language-specific morphology.
final class LanguageOwnedExtension {
  final String languageId;
  final String schemaRef;
  final String schemaVersion;
  final Map<String, Object?> payload;

  LanguageOwnedExtension({
    required this.languageId,
    required this.schemaRef,
    required this.schemaVersion,
    Map<String, Object?> payload = const <String, Object?>{},
  }) : payload = Map<String, Object?>.unmodifiable(payload) {
    _requireNonEmpty(languageId, 'languageId');
    _requireNonEmpty(schemaRef, 'schemaRef');
    _requireNonEmpty(schemaVersion, 'schemaVersion');
  }

  Map<String, Object?> toMap() => <String, Object?>{
        'languageId': languageId,
        'schemaRef': schemaRef,
        'schemaVersion': schemaVersion,
        'payload': payload,
      };
}

/// Natural realization of one explicit semantic identity in one language.
///
/// Surface text is realization data only. It never allocates or replaces the
/// semantic identity supplied by the caller.
final class LanguageRealization {
  final String realizationId;
  final String semanticId;
  final LanguageIdentity language;
  final int realizationVersion;
  final LanguageRealizationKind kind;
  final String? surface;
  final List<String> acceptedForms;
  final List<LanguageOwnedExtension> extensions;
  final ArtifactProvenance provenance;

  LanguageRealization({
    required this.realizationId,
    required this.semanticId,
    required this.language,
    required this.realizationVersion,
    required this.kind,
    this.surface,
    List<String> acceptedForms = const <String>[],
    List<LanguageOwnedExtension> extensions = const <LanguageOwnedExtension>[],
    required this.provenance,
  })  : acceptedForms = List<String>.unmodifiable(acceptedForms),
        extensions = List<LanguageOwnedExtension>.unmodifiable(extensions) {
    _requireNonEmpty(realizationId, 'realizationId');
    _requireNonEmpty(semanticId, 'semanticId');
    if (realizationVersion <= 0) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        realizationVersion,
        'realizationVersion',
        'must be positive',
      );
    }
    if (surface != null) {
      _requireNonEmpty(surface!, 'surface');
    }
    for (final form in this.acceptedForms) {
      _requireNonEmpty(form, 'acceptedForm');
    }
    for (final extension in this.extensions) {
      if (extension.languageId != language.languageId) {
        throw StateError(
          'language-owned extension must match realization language',
        );
      }
    }
  }

  Map<String, Object?> toMap() => <String, Object?>{
        'realizationId': realizationId,
        'semanticId': semanticId,
        'languageId': language.languageId,
        'realizationVersion': realizationVersion,
        'kind': kind.name,
        'surface': surface,
        'acceptedForms': acceptedForms,
        'extensions': extensions.map((extension) => extension.toMap()).toList(),
        'provenance': provenance.toMap(),
      };
}

void _requireNonEmpty(String value, String field) {
  if (value.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(value, field, 'must not be empty');
  }
}

/// Stable learner-addressable content coordinate.
///
/// This key is deliberately independent from semantic identity. The same
/// semantic concept in two languages does not automatically share learner
/// progress, and equal local IDs in different language/namespace coordinates
/// remain distinct.
final class LearnerContentKey {
  static const String legacyGermanNamespace = 'legacy-german-canonical';

  final String languageId;
  final String contentNamespaceId;
  final String localItemId;

  LearnerContentKey({
    required this.languageId,
    required this.contentNamespaceId,
    required this.localItemId,
  }) {
    _requireNonEmpty(languageId, 'languageId');
    _requireNonEmpty(contentNamespaceId, 'contentNamespaceId');
    _requireNonEmpty(localItemId, 'localItemId');
  }

  factory LearnerContentKey.germanLegacy(String localItemId) =>
      LearnerContentKey(
        languageId: 'de',
        contentNamespaceId: legacyGermanNamespace,
        localItemId: localItemId,
      );

  Map<String, String> toMap() => <String, String>{
        'languageId': languageId,
        'contentNamespaceId': contentNamespaceId,
        'localItemId': localItemId,
      };

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      identical(this, other) ||
      other is LearnerContentKey &&
          other.languageId == languageId &&
          other.contentNamespaceId == contentNamespaceId &&
          other.localItemId == localItemId;

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(languageId, contentNamespaceId, localItemId);

  @override
  String toString() => '$languageId/$contentNamespaceId/$localItemId';
}

void _requireNonEmpty(String value, String field) {
  if (value.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(value, field, 'must not be empty');
  }
}

FILE: lib/semantic_content/legacy_binding.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'artifact_provenance.dart';
import 'learner_content_key.dart';

/// Compatibility binding from historical/local identity into the neutral model.
///
/// Legacy identity remains a compatibility/persistence coordinate. It never
/// becomes semantic identity, and semantic identity never replaces learner
/// mastery identity.
final class LegacyBinding {
  static const String germanLegacyNamespace = 'legacy-german-content';

  final String legacyNamespace;
  final String legacyId;
  final int bindingVersion;
  final String languageId;
  final List<String> semanticRefs;
  final List<String> realizationRefs;
  final List<String> compatibilityProjectionRefs;
  final LearnerContentKey? learnerContentKey;
  final ArtifactProvenance provenance;

  LegacyBinding({
    required this.legacyNamespace,
    required this.legacyId,
    required this.bindingVersion,
    required this.languageId,
    List<String> semanticRefs = const <String>[],
    List<String> realizationRefs = const <String>[],
    List<String> compatibilityProjectionRefs = const <String>[],
    this.learnerContentKey,
    required this.provenance,
  })  : semanticRefs = List<String>.unmodifiable(semanticRefs),
        realizationRefs = List<String>.unmodifiable(realizationRefs),
        compatibilityProjectionRefs = List<String>.unmodifiable(
          compatibilityProjectionRefs,
        ) {
    _requireNonEmpty(legacyNamespace, 'legacyNamespace');
    _requireNonEmpty(legacyId, 'legacyId');
    _requireNonEmpty(languageId, 'languageId');
    if (bindingVersion <= 0) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        bindingVersion,
        'bindingVersion',
        'must be positive',
      );
    }
    _validateRefs(this.semanticRefs, 'semanticRef');
    _validateRefs(this.realizationRefs, 'realizationRef');
    _validateRefs(
      this.compatibilityProjectionRefs,
      'compatibilityProjectionRef',
    );
    if (learnerContentKey != null &&
        learnerContentKey!.languageId != languageId) {
      throw StateError(
        'learner content key language must match legacy binding language',
      );
    }
  }

  factory LegacyBinding.german({
    required String legacyId,
    required int bindingVersion,
    List<String> semanticRefs = const <String>[],
    List<String> realizationRefs = const <String>[],
    List<String> compatibilityProjectionRefs = const <String>[],
    required ArtifactProvenance provenance,
  }) =>
      LegacyBinding(
        legacyNamespace: germanLegacyNamespace,
        legacyId: legacyId,
        bindingVersion: bindingVersion,
        languageId: 'de',
        semanticRefs: semanticRefs,
        realizationRefs: realizationRefs,
        compatibilityProjectionRefs: compatibilityProjectionRefs,
        learnerContentKey: LearnerContentKey.germanLegacy(legacyId),
        provenance: provenance,
      );

  /// Resolve learner-addressable compatibility identity.
  ///
  /// Generic legacy bindings are allowed to be non-learner-addressable. In
  /// that case lookup fails closed rather than inventing a global bare ID.
  LearnerContentKey resolveLearnerContentKey() {
    final key = learnerContentKey;
    if (key == null) {
      throw StateError(
        'legacy binding has no explicit learner content compatibility key',
      );
    }
    return key;
  }

  Map<String, Object?> toMap() => <String, Object?>{
        'legacyNamespace': legacyNamespace,
        'legacyId': legacyId,
        'bindingVersion': bindingVersion,
        'languageId': languageId,
        'semanticRefs': semanticRefs,
        'realizationRefs': realizationRefs,
        'compatibilityProjectionRefs': compatibilityProjectionRefs,
        'learnerContentKey': learnerContentKey?.toMap(),
        'provenance': provenance.toMap(),
      };
}

void _validateRefs(List<String> refs, String field) {
  for (final ref in refs) {
    _requireNonEmpty(ref, field);
  }
}

void _requireNonEmpty(String value, String field) {
  if (value.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(value, field, 'must not be empty');
  }
}

import 'artifact_provenance.dart';

/// Language-neutral semantic record kinds.
///
/// The identifier is explicit and opaque. This model intentionally exposes no
/// allocator from row order, legacy numeric suffixes, surface text or
/// translation text.
enum SemanticKind { concept, intent, proposition, relation, other }

final class SemanticRecord {
  final String semanticId;
  final int semanticVersion;
  final SemanticKind kind;
  final String? conceptId;
  final String? intentId;
  final List<String> domainRefs;
  final Map<String, Object?> neutralConstraints;
  final ArtifactProvenance provenance;

  SemanticRecord({
    required this.semanticId,
    required this.semanticVersion,
    required this.kind,
    this.conceptId,
    this.intentId,
    List<String> domainRefs = const <String>[],
    Map<String, Object?> neutralConstraints = const <String, Object?>{},
    required this.provenance,
  })  : domainRefs = List<String>.unmodifiable(domainRefs),
        neutralConstraints = Map<String, Object?>.unmodifiable(
          neutralConstraints,
        ) {
    _requireNonEmpty(semanticId, 'semanticId');
    if (semanticVersion <= 0) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        semanticVersion,
        'semanticVersion',
        'must be positive',
      );
    }
    if (conceptId != null) {
      _requireNonEmpty(conceptId!, 'conceptId');
    }
    if (intentId != null) {
      _requireNonEmpty(intentId!, 'intentId');
    }
    for (final domainRef in this.domainRefs) {
      _requireNonEmpty(domainRef, 'domainRef');
    }
  }

  /// Stable meaning identity. Presentation aliases never replace this value.
  String get identityKey => semanticId;

  Map<String, Object?> toMap() => <String, Object?>{
        'semanticId': semanticId,
        'semanticVersion': semanticVersion,
        'kind': kind.name,
        'conceptId': conceptId,
        'intentId': intentId,
        'domainRefs': domainRefs,
        'neutralConstraints': neutralConstraints,
        'provenance': provenance.toMap(),
      };
}

void _requireNonEmpty(String value, String field) {
  if (value.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(value, field, 'must not be empty');
  }
}

import '../models/learner.dart';
import 'mastery.dart';
import '../core/date_utils.dart';

class AdaptiveFocus {
  static String dimensionForItem(
    String itemId,
    List<Attempt> attempts, {
    ReviewCard? reviewCard,
    DateTime? now,
  }) {
    final rows =
        attempts.where((a) => a.itemId == itemId).toList(growable: false);
    return dimensionForRows(itemId, rows, reviewCard: reviewCard, now: now);
  }

  /// Same decision when the caller already grouped attempts by item.
  static String dimensionForRows(
    String itemId,
    List<Attempt> rows, {
    ReviewCard? reviewCard,
    DateTime? now,
  }) {
    final at = now ?? DateTime.now();
    final evidence = Mastery.forItemRows(
      itemId,
      rows,
      reviewCard: reviewCard,
      now: at,
    );
    final latestByDimension = <String, DateTime>{};
    for (final a in rows) {
      final dimension = _categoryDimension(a.skill);
      final latest = latestByDimension[dimension];
      if (latest == null || a.at.isAfter(latest))
        latestByDimension[dimension] = a.at;
    }
    final scores = <String, double>{
      for (final entry in evidence.skillScores.entries)
        entry.key: _recencyAdjusted(
          entry.key,
          entry.value,
          latestByDimension,
          at,
        ),
    };
    for (final a in rows.where((x) => !x.correct)) {
      final key = _categoryDimension(a.skill);
      scores[key] = (scores[key] ?? .50) - .12;
    }
    if (scores.isEmpty) return 'recall';
    return scores.entries.reduce((a, b) => a.value <= b.value ? a : b).key;
  }

  static double _recencyAdjusted(
    String dimension,
    double score,
    Map<String, DateTime> latestByDimension,
    DateTime now,
  ) {
    final latest = latestByDimension[dimension];
    if (latest == null) return score;
    final days = now.toUtcMidnight
        .difference(latest.toUtcMidnight)
        .inDays
        .clamp(0, 60)
        .toDouble();
    final decay = (days / 60) * .12;
    return (score - decay).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
  }

  static String _categoryDimension(String skill) {
    switch (skill.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'listening':
        return 'listening';
      case 'production':
      case 'writing':
        return 'production';
      case 'transfer':
      case 'grammar':
        return 'transfer';
      case 'recall':
      default:
        return 'recall';
    }
  }

  static String modeFor(
    String itemId,
    List<Attempt> attempts, {
    ReviewCard? reviewCard,
    DateTime? now,
  }) {
    return dimensionForItem(itemId, attempts, reviewCard: reviewCard, now: now);
  }

  static String modeForRows(
    String itemId,
    List<Attempt> rows, {
    ReviewCard? reviewCard,
    DateTime? now,
  }) {
    return dimensionForRows(itemId, rows, reviewCard: reviewCard, now: now);
  }
}

import '../models/learner.dart';
import '../core/date_utils.dart';

enum TeacherActionType { baseline, review, repair, newContent, consolidation }

class TeacherAction {
  final TeacherActionType type;
  final String skill;
  final String title;
  final String reason;
  final int itemCount;
  final double confidence;
  final double reviewPressure;
  final double newContentReadiness;
  final double recentFailureRate;
  const TeacherAction({
    required this.type,
    required this.skill,
    required this.title,
    required this.reason,
    required this.itemCount,
    this.confidence = .5,
    this.reviewPressure = 0,
    this.newContentReadiness = 1,
    this.recentFailureRate = 0,
  });
}

class AdaptiveTeacher {
  static const skills = ['recall', 'listening', 'production', 'transfer'];

  static TeacherAction next(LearnerState state, {DateTime? now}) {
    final at = now ?? DateTime.now();
    final meaningAttempts = state.meaningAttempts.toList(growable: false);
    final attemptsBySkill = <String, List<Attempt>>{};
    var recentFailureCount = 0;
    var recentAttemptCount = 0;
    for (final a in meaningAttempts) {
      (attemptsBySkill[a.skill] ??= <Attempt>[]).add(a);
      if (at.toUtcMidnight.difference(a.at.toUtcMidnight).inDays <= 14) {
        recentAttemptCount++;
        if (!a.correct) recentFailureCount++;
      }
    }
    final scoresBySkill = <String, double>{};
    for (final skill in skills) {
      scoresBySkill[skill] = _scoreForAttempts(attemptsBySkill[skill]);
    }
    final recentFailureRate =
        recentAttemptCount == 0 ? 0.0 : recentFailureCount / recentAttemptCount;
    final due = _dueCount(state, at);
    final reviewPressure = _reviewPressure(state, at, due);
    final newContentReadiness = _newContentReadiness(
      recentFailureRate,
      reviewPressure,
    );
    final weak = _weakest(state, attemptsBySkill, scoresBySkill);

    if (due > 0 || state.review.isNotEmpty) {
      final count = due.clamp(2, 10).toInt();
      return TeacherAction(
        type: TeacherActionType.review,
        skill: weak,
        title: 'مراجعة مستحقة',
        reason: reviewPressure >= .7
            ? 'ضغط المراجعة مرتفع؛ سنخفض الحمل الجديد ونثبت العناصر المعرضة للنسيان أولًا.'
            : 'لديك عناصر حان وقت تثبيتها قبل إضافة حمل جديد.',
        itemCount: count,
        confidence: _confidence(state),
        reviewPressure: reviewPressure,
        newContentReadiness: newContentReadiness,
        recentFailureRate: recentFailureRate,
      );
    }
    if (state.attempts.isEmpty) {
      return const TeacherAction(
        type: TeacherActionType.baseline,
        skill: 'recall',
        title: 'قياس البداية',
        reason: 'سنقيس أكثر من مهارة قبل بناء الخطة الشخصية.',
        itemCount: 8,
        confidence: .35,
        reviewPressure: 0,
        newContentReadiness: .5,
      );
    }
    final score = scoresBySkill[weak] ?? .5;
    if (score < .62 || recentFailureRate >= .60) {
      return TeacherAction(
        type: TeacherActionType.repair,
        skill: weak,
        title: 'علاج نقطة الضعف',
        reason: recentFailureRate >= .60
            ? 'الأخطاء الحديثة مرتفعة؛ سنوقف التوسع مؤقتًا ونركز على إصلاح السبب.'
            : 'أداؤك الحديث في هذه المهارة منخفض، لذلك سنركز عليها الآن.',
        itemCount: recentFailureRate >= .60 ? 5 : 8,
        confidence: _confidence(state),
        reviewPressure: reviewPressure,
        newContentReadiness: newContentReadiness,
        recentFailureRate: recentFailureRate,
      );
    }
    if (score < .82 || recentFailureRate >= .40) {
      return TeacherAction(
        type: TeacherActionType.consolidation,
        skill: weak,
        title: 'تثبيت المهارة',
        reason:
            'المهارة تتحسن، لكنها تحتاج تنويعًا ومزيدًا من الاسترجاع قبل رفع الصعوبة.',
        itemCount: 6,
        confidence: _confidence(state),
        reviewPressure: reviewPressure,
        newContentReadiness: newContentReadiness,
        recentFailureRate: recentFailureRate,
      );
    }
    return TeacherAction(
      type: TeacherActionType.newContent,
      skill: weak,
      title: 'محتوى جديد محسوب',
      reason: newContentReadiness < .75
          ? 'الأداء جيد، لكننا سنضيف محتوى جديدًا تدريجيًا مع الحفاظ على التثبيت.'
          : 'المهارات المقاسة مستقرة بما يكفي لإضافة محتوى جديد تدريجيًا.',
      itemCount: newContentReadiness >= .75 ? 8 : 6,
      confidence: _confidence(state),
      reviewPressure: reviewPressure,
      newContentReadiness: newContentReadiness,
      recentFailureRate: recentFailureRate,
    );
  }

  static String _weakest(
    LearnerState state,
    Map<String, List<Attempt>> attemptsBySkill,
    Map<String, double> scoresBySkill,
  ) {
    var selected = 'recall';
    var selectedScore = 1.0;
    var measured = false;
    for (final skill in skills) {
      final attempts = attemptsBySkill[skill];
      if (attempts == null || attempts.length < 2) continue;
      measured = true;
      final score = scoresBySkill[skill] ?? .5;
      if (score < selectedScore) {
        selectedScore = score;
        selected = skill;
      }
    }
    if (measured) return selected;
    return state.meaningAttempts.isEmpty
        ? 'recall'
        : state.meaningAttempts.last.skill;
  }

  static double _scoreForAttempts(List<Attempt>? attempts) {
    if (attempts == null || attempts.isEmpty) return .5;
    final recent = attempts.length > 20
        ? attempts.sublist(attempts.length - 20)
        : attempts;
    var weight = 1.0;
    var total = 0.0;
    var score = 0.0;
    for (final attempt in recent.reversed) {
      final hintPenalty = attempt.hinted ? .82 : 1.0;
      score += (attempt.correct ? 1 : 0) * weight * hintPenalty;
      total += weight;
      weight *= .93;
    }
    return total == 0 ? .5 : (score / total).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
  }

  static int _dueCount(LearnerState state, DateTime now) {
    var due = 0;
    for (final card in state.meaningReviewCards) {
      if (!card.dueAt.isAfter(now)) due++;
    }
    return due;
  }

  static double _reviewPressure(
    LearnerState state,
    DateTime now,
    int dueCount,
  ) {
    final total = state.meaningReviewCards.length;
    if (total == 0) return 0;
    final dueRatio = dueCount / total;
    var recentFailureCount = 0;
    var recentAttemptCount = 0;
    for (final a in state.attempts) {
      if (now.toUtcMidnight.difference(a.at.toUtcMidnight).inDays <= 14) {
        recentAttemptCount++;
        if (!a.correct) recentFailureCount++;
      }
    }
    final failureRatio =
        recentAttemptCount == 0 ? 0.0 : recentFailureCount / recentAttemptCount;
    return (dueRatio * .6 + failureRatio * .4).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
  }

  static double _newContentReadiness(
    double recentFailureRate,
    double reviewPressure,
  ) {
    if (recentFailureRate >= .60 || reviewPressure >= .85) return 0;
    if (recentFailureRate >= .40 || reviewPressure >= .65) return .35;
    if (recentFailureRate >= .20 || reviewPressure >= .40) return .70;
    return 1.0;
  }

  static double _confidence(LearnerState state) {
    final attempts = state.meaningAttempts.length;
    return (attempts / 40).clamp(.35, .95).toDouble();
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;

class AiReview {
  final String corrected;
  final List<String> issues;
  final String explanation;
  const AiReview({
    required this.corrected,
    required this.issues,
    required this.explanation,
  });
}

abstract class AiGateway {
  bool get enabled;
  Future<AiReview> reviewWriting(String text, {String level = 'A1'});
  Future<String> continueConversation({
    required String scenario,
    required String message,
    String level = 'A1',
  });
}

class OfflineAiGateway implements AiGateway {
  const OfflineAiGateway();
  @override
  bool get enabled => false;
  @override
  Future<AiReview> reviewWriting(String text, {String level = 'A1'}) async =>
      const AiReview(
        corrected: '',
        issues: ['المراجعة السحابية غير مفعّلة؛ استخدم الفحص المحلي.'],
        explanation: 'لا يتم إرسال النص إلى أي خادم.',
      );
  @override
  Future<String> continueConversation({
    required String scenario,
    required String message,
    String level = 'A1',
  }) async =>
      'الوضع المحلي: أكمل الحوار باستخدام العبارات المقترحة داخل التطبيق.';
}

/// Optional remote adapter. It requires an HTTPS endpoint supplied by the app owner.
/// No API key is embedded in the APK and no endpoint is enabled by default.
class HttpsAiGateway implements AiGateway {
  final Uri baseUri;
  final http.Client client;
  final Duration timeout;
  final Set<String> allowedHosts;
  static const maxResponseBytes = 512 * 1024;
  static const minRequestInterval = Duration(milliseconds: 750);
  Future<void> _requestTail = Future<void>.value();
  DateTime? _lastRequestAt;
  HttpsAiGateway({
    required Uri baseUri,
    required String allowedHostsCsv,
    http.Client? client,
    this.timeout = const Duration(seconds: 12),
  })  : baseUri = baseUri.path.endsWith('/')
            ? baseUri
            : baseUri.replace(path: '${baseUri.path}/'),
        allowedHosts = allowedHostsCsv
            .split(',')
            .map((host) => host.trim().toLowerCase())
            .where((host) => host.isNotEmpty)
            .toSet(),
        client = client ?? http.Client() {
    if (baseUri.scheme != 'https')
      throw ArgumentError('AI endpoint must use HTTPS.');
    if (baseUri.host.isEmpty)
      throw ArgumentError('AI endpoint must include a host.');
    if (baseUri.userInfo.isNotEmpty)
      throw ArgumentError('AI endpoint must not include credentials.');
    if (baseUri.query.isNotEmpty || baseUri.fragment.isNotEmpty)
      throw ArgumentError(
        'AI endpoint must not include query or fragment data.',
      );
    if (baseUri.host.length > 253)
      throw ArgumentError('AI endpoint host is too long.');
    if (allowedHosts.isEmpty)
      throw ArgumentError('Cloud AI host allowlist is required.');
    if (!allowedHosts.contains(baseUri.host.toLowerCase())) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'Allowed AI endpoint host does not match configured endpoint.',
      );
    }
  }
  @override
  bool get enabled => true;

  Future<void> _paceRequests() {
    _requestTail = _requestTail.then((_) async {
      final now = DateTime.now();
      final last = _lastRequestAt;
      if (last != null) {
        final elapsed = now.difference(last);
        final remaining = minRequestInterval - elapsed;
        if (remaining > Duration.zero) await Future<void>.delayed(remaining);
      }
      _lastRequestAt = DateTime.now();
    });
    return _requestTail;
  }

  static final RegExp _sensitivePayload = RegExp(
    r'(?:\b[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z]{2,}\b)|'
    r'(?:\b(?:\+?\d[\d .()\-]{7,}\d)\b)|'
    r'(?:\b(?:api[_-]?key|access[_-]?token|refresh[_-]?token|authorization|bearer)\b\s*[:=]\s*\S+)|'
    r'(?:\b\d[\d -]{11,18}\d\b)',
    caseSensitive: false,
  );

  static void _guardOutgoingText(String value) {
    if (_sensitivePayload.hasMatch(value)) {
      throw StateError(
        'Potentially sensitive data blocked before cloud AI transmission.',
      );
    }
  }

  Future<AiReview> reviewWriting(String text, {String level = 'A1'}) async {
    _guardOutgoingText(text);
    await _paceRequests();
    final body = jsonEncode({
      'task': 'writing_review',
      'level': level,
      'text': text.trim().substring(
            0,
            text.trim().length.clamp(0, 2000).toInt(),
          ),
    });
    final request = http.Request('POST', baseUri.resolve('v1/review'))
      ..followRedirects = false
      ..headers['content-type'] = 'application/json'
      ..body = body;
    final response = await client
        .send(request)
        .then(http.Response.fromStream)
        .timeout(timeout);
    if (response.statusCode >= 300 && response.statusCode < 400)
      throw StateError('AI endpoint redirects are blocked.');
    if (response.statusCode < 200 || response.statusCode >= 300)
      throw StateError('AI review request failed.');
    _guardResponse(response);
    final json = jsonDecode(response.body);
    if (json is! Map) throw StateError('Invalid AI response.');
    return AiReview(
      corrected: (json['corrected'] ?? '').toString().substring(
            0,
            (json['corrected'] ?? '').toString().length.clamp(0, 2000).toInt(),
          ),
      issues: (json['issues'] is List
          ? (json['issues'] as List).whereType<String>().take(8).toList()
          : const <String>[]),
      explanation: (json['explanation'] ?? '').toString().substring(
            0,
            (json['explanation'] ?? '')
                .toString()
                .length
                .clamp(0, 3000)
                .toInt(),
          ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Future<String> continueConversation({
    required String scenario,
    required String message,
    String level = 'A1',
  }) async {
    _guardOutgoingText(scenario);
    _guardOutgoingText(message);
    await _paceRequests();
    final body = jsonEncode({
      'task': 'conversation',
      'level': level,
      'scenario': scenario.substring(0, scenario.length.clamp(0, 160).toInt()),
      'message': message.trim().substring(
            0,
            message.trim().length.clamp(0, 2000).toInt(),
          ),
    });
    final request = http.Request('POST', baseUri.resolve('v1/conversation'))
      ..followRedirects = false
      ..headers['content-type'] = 'application/json'
      ..body = body;
    final response = await client
        .send(request)
        .then(http.Response.fromStream)
        .timeout(timeout);
    if (response.statusCode >= 300 && response.statusCode < 400)
      throw StateError('AI endpoint redirects are blocked.');
    if (response.statusCode < 200 || response.statusCode >= 300)
      throw StateError('Conversation request failed.');
    _guardResponse(response);
    final json = jsonDecode(response.body);
    if (json is! Map) throw StateError('Invalid AI response.');
    return (json['reply'] ?? '').toString().substring(
          0,
          (json['reply'] ?? '').toString().length.clamp(0, 3000).toInt(),
        );
  }

  static void _guardResponse(http.Response response) {
    if (response.bodyBytes.length > maxResponseBytes)
      throw StateError('AI response is too large.');
    final contentType = response.headers['content-type']?.toLowerCase() ?? '';
    if (!contentType.startsWith('application/json'))
      throw StateError('AI response must be JSON.');
  }

  void close() => client.close();
}

/// Composition-root factory for the optional cloud AI adapter.
final class AiGatewayFactory {
  const AiGatewayFactory._();

  static AiGateway fromRuntimeConfig(AiRuntimeConfig config) {
    if (!config.isConfigured) return const OfflineAiGateway();

import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

import '../models/secure_session_credentials.dart';
import 'secure_session_storage.dart';

/// Android implementation backed by the platform Keystore boundary.
///
/// Only the opaque credential value crosses the platform channel transiently.
/// The Dart layer never handles keys, ciphertext, or storage files.
final class AndroidSecureSessionStorage implements SecureSessionStorage {
  AndroidSecureSessionStorage({MethodChannel? channel})
      : _channel = channel ?? const MethodChannel(_channelName);

  static const String _channelName =
      'com.deutschbilarabi.app/secure_session_storage';
  static const String _saveMethod = 'save';
  static const String _readMethod = 'read';
  static const String _clearMethod = 'clear';

  final MethodChannel _channel;

  @override
  Future<void> save(SecureSessionCredentials credentials) async {
    await _invoke<void>(_saveMethod, <String, Object?>{
      'value': credentials.value,
    });
  }

  @override
  Future<SecureSessionCredentials?> read() async {
    final value = await _invoke<String?>(_readMethod);
    return value == null ? null : SecureSessionCredentials(value);
  }

  @override
  Future<void> clear() async {
    await _invoke<void>(_clearMethod);
  }

  @override
  Future<void> replace(SecureSessionCredentials credentials) =>
      save(credentials);

  Future<T?> _invoke<T>(
    String method, [
    Map<String, Object?>? arguments,
  ]) async {
    try {
      return await _channel.invokeMethod<T>(method, arguments);
    } on PlatformException catch (error) {
      throw SecureSessionStorageFailure(_mapFailure(error.code));
    } on MissingPluginException {
      throw const SecureSessionStorageFailure(
        SecureSessionStorageFailureCode.unavailable,
      );
    }
  }

  static SecureSessionStorageFailureCode _mapFailure(String code) {
    switch (code) {
      case 'corrupted':
        return SecureSessionStorageFailureCode.corrupted;
      case 'unreadable':
        return SecureSessionStorageFailureCode.unreadable;
      default:
        return SecureSessionStorageFailureCode.unavailable;
    }
  }
}

import '../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../language/language_exercise_strategy.dart';
import '../models/assessment.dart';
import '../models/learner.dart';

class AssessmentEngine {
  static const skills = ['recall', 'listening', 'production', 'transfer'];

  static List<AssessmentQuestion> build<T extends LearningContent>(
    List<T> items,
    LearnerState state, {
    required LanguageExerciseStrategy exerciseStrategy,
    DateTime? now,
    int questionCount = 10,
    int seed = 0,
    required bool Function(T item) isLearnable,
  }) {
    final eligible = items.where(isLearnable).toList();
    if (eligible.isEmpty || questionCount <= 0) return const [];
    final weak = _weakSkill(state);
    final ranked = [...eligible]..sort((a, b) {
        final sa = _priority(a, state, weak, seed);
        final sb = _priority(b, state, weak, seed);
        return sb.compareTo(sa);
      });
    final selected = <T>[];
    final seen = <String>{};
    for (final item in ranked) {
      if (seen.add(item.id)) selected.add(item);
      if (selected.length >= questionCount.clamp(1, 20)) break;
    }
    return List.generate(
      selected.length,
      (i) => exerciseStrategy.assessmentQuestion(selected[i], i, seed),
    );
  }

  static AssessmentResult score<T extends LearningContent>(
    List<AssessmentResponse> responses,
    List<T> items, {
    DateTime? now,
    String? id,
    required LanguageExerciseStrategy exerciseStrategy,
  }) {
    final at = now ?? DateTime.now();
    final valid = responses
        .take(50)
        .where((r) => _findItem(items, r.itemId) != null)
        .toList();
    final scores = <String, List<double>>{};
    var correct = 0, clean = 0;
    final next = <String>[];
    for (final response in valid) {
      final item = _findItem(items, response.itemId);
      if (item == null) continue;
      final ok = response.correct;
      final value = !ok ? 0.0 : (response.hinted ? .7 : 1.0);
      final skill = _skillForQuestionId(
        item,
        response.questionId,
        exerciseStrategy,
      );
      scores.putIfAbsent(skill, () => []).add(value);
      if (ok) {
        correct++;
        if (!response.hinted) clean++;
      } else {
        next.add(item.id);
      }
    }
    final skillScores = <String, double>{
      for (final e in scores.entries)
        e.key: e.value.reduce((a, b) => a + b) / e.value.length,
    };
    final weak = skillScores.entries
        .where((e) => e.value < .7)
        .map((e) => e.key)
        .toList()
      ..sort(
        (a, b) => (skillScores[a] ?? 0).compareTo(skillScores[b] ?? 0),
      );
    final score = valid.isEmpty
        ? 0.0
        : ((valid.fold<double>(0, (sum, r) {
                  final item = _findItem(items, r.itemId);
                  return sum +
                      (item == null || !r.correct ? 0 : (r.hinted ? .7 : 1));
                }) /
                valid.length *
                100)
            .clamp(0, 100));
    return AssessmentResult(
      id: id ?? 't_${at.microsecondsSinceEpoch}',
      at: at,
      answered: valid.length,
      correct: correct,
      cleanCorrect: clean,
      score: score.toDouble(),
      skillScores: skillScores,
      weakSkills: weak,
      nextReviewItemIds: next.toSet().take(20).toList(),
    );
  }

  static T? _findItem<T extends LearningContent>(List<T> items, String id) {
    for (final item in items) {
      if (item.id == id) return item;
    }
    return null;
  }

  static AssessmentQuestion questionFor<T extends LearningContent>(
    T item,
    String questionId,
    LanguageExerciseStrategy exerciseStrategy,
  ) {
    for (var i = 0; i < AssessmentQuestionType.values.length; i++) {
      final q = exerciseStrategy.assessmentQuestion(item, i, 0);
      if (q.id == questionId) return q;
    }
    return exerciseStrategy.assessmentQuestion(item, 0, 0);
  }

  static String _skillForQuestionId<T extends LearningContent>(
    T item,
    String questionId,
    LanguageExerciseStrategy exerciseStrategy,
  ) =>
      questionFor(item, questionId, exerciseStrategy).skill;

  static double _priority(
    LearningContent x,
    LearnerState s,
    String weak,
    int seed,
  ) {
    final attempts = s.attempts.where((a) => a.itemId == x.id).toList();
    final errors = attempts.where((a) => !a.correct).length;
    final weakBoost = x.skill == weak ? 100 : 0;
    final unseen = attempts.isEmpty ? 30 : 0;
    return (weakBoost + errors * 15 + unseen + ((seed + x.id.hashCode) & 7))
        .toDouble();
  }

  static String _weakSkill(LearnerState s) {
    final keys = <String>{...skills, ...s.attempts.map((x) => x.skill)};
    final values = <String, double>{};
    for (final k in keys) {
      final a = s.attempts.where((x) => x.skill == k).toList();
      final recent = a.reversed.take(10).toList();
      if (recent.isNotEmpty) {
        final recentCorrect = recent.where((x) => x.correct).length;
        values[k] = recentCorrect / recent.length;
      }
    }
    if (values.isEmpty) return 'recall';
    return values.entries.reduce((a, b) => a.value <= b.value ? a : b).key;
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../models/account_session.dart';
import 'authentication.dart';

/// Application-facing session state.
///
/// This controller owns only transient authentication state. It never reads
/// or mutates learner data and never persists credentials.
final class AuthSessionController extends ChangeNotifier {
  AuthSessionController(this._authenticationService);

  final AuthenticationService _authenticationService;
  AccountSession _session = const AccountSession.unauthenticated();
  bool _isInitialized = false;
  AuthenticationFailure? _lastFailure;
  int _operationGeneration = 0;

  AccountSession get session => _session;
  bool get isInitialized => _isInitialized;
  AuthenticationFailure? get lastFailure => _lastFailure;

  Future<void> initialize() async {
    final operationGeneration = ++_operationGeneration;
    try {
      final session = await _authenticationService.currentSession;
      if (operationGeneration != _operationGeneration) return;
      _setSession(session);
      _lastFailure = null;
    } on AuthenticationFailure catch (error) {
      if (operationGeneration != _operationGeneration) return;
      _setFailure(error);
      _setSession(const AccountSession.unauthenticated());
    } catch (_) {
      if (operationGeneration != _operationGeneration) return;
      _setFailure(
        const AuthenticationFailure(AuthenticationFailureCode.unavailable),
      );
      _setSession(const AccountSession.unauthenticated());
    } finally {
      _isInitialized = true;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  Future<void> requestEmailOtp({required String email}) async {
    final operationGeneration = ++_operationGeneration;
    try {
      await _authenticationService.requestEmailOtp(email: email);
      if (operationGeneration != _operationGeneration) return;
      _lastFailure = null;
    } on AuthenticationFailure catch (error) {
      if (operationGeneration != _operationGeneration) return;
      _setFailure(error);
    } catch (_) {
      if (operationGeneration != _operationGeneration) return;
      _setFailure(
        const AuthenticationFailure(AuthenticationFailureCode.unavailable),
      );
    }
    if (operationGeneration == _operationGeneration) notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> signInWithEmailOtp({
    required String email,
    required String otp,
  }) async {
    await _runAuthentication(() {
      return _authenticationService.signInWithEmailOtp(email: email, otp: otp);
    });
  }

  Future<void> signInWithGoogle() async {
    await _runAuthentication(_authenticationService.signInWithGoogle);
  }

  Future<void> signInWithApple() async {
    await _runAuthentication(_authenticationService.signInWithApple);
  }

  Future<void> renewSession() async {
    final operationGeneration = ++_operationGeneration;
    try {
      final session = await _authenticationService.renewSession();
      if (operationGeneration != _operationGeneration) return;
      _setSession(session);
      _lastFailure = null;
    } on AuthenticationFailure catch (error) {
      if (operationGeneration != _operationGeneration) return;
      _setFailure(error);
      _setSession(const AccountSession.unauthenticated());
    } catch (_) {
      if (operationGeneration != _operationGeneration) return;
      _setFailure(
        const AuthenticationFailure(AuthenticationFailureCode.unavailable),
      );
      _setSession(const AccountSession.unauthenticated());
    }
    if (operationGeneration == _operationGeneration) notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> signOut() async {
    final operationGeneration = ++_operationGeneration;
    try {
      await _authenticationService.signOut();
      if (operationGeneration != _operationGeneration) return;
      _setSession(const AccountSession.unauthenticated());
      _lastFailure = null;
    } on AuthenticationFailure catch (error) {
      if (operationGeneration != _operationGeneration) return;
      _setFailure(error);
      _setSession(const AccountSession.unauthenticated());
    } catch (_) {
      if (operationGeneration != _operationGeneration) return;
      _setFailure(
        const AuthenticationFailure(AuthenticationFailureCode.unavailable),
      );
      _setSession(const AccountSession.unauthenticated());
    }
    if (operationGeneration == _operationGeneration) notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> _runAuthentication(
    Future<AccountSession> Function() operation,
  ) async {
    final operationGeneration = ++_operationGeneration;
    try {
      final session = await operation();
      if (operationGeneration != _operationGeneration) return;
      _setSession(session);
      _lastFailure = null;
    } on AuthenticationFailure catch (error) {
      if (operationGeneration != _operationGeneration) return;
      _setFailure(error);
      _setSession(const AccountSession.unauthenticated());
    } catch (_) {
      if (operationGeneration != _operationGeneration) return;
      _setFailure(
        const AuthenticationFailure(AuthenticationFailureCode.unavailable),
      );
      _setSession(const AccountSession.unauthenticated());
    }
    if (operationGeneration == _operationGeneration) notifyListeners();
  }

  void _setSession(AccountSession session) {
    _session = session.isAuthenticated &&
            session.identity != null &&
            !session.requiresReauthentication
        ? session
        : const AccountSession.unauthenticated();
  }

  void _setFailure(AuthenticationFailure failure) {
    _lastFailure = failure;
  }
}

import '../models/account_session.dart';
import '../models/backend_authentication_contract.dart';
import '../models/backend_transport.dart';
import '../models/secure_session_credentials.dart';
import 'authentication_contract.dart';
import 'authentication_failures.dart';
import 'backend_transport.dart';
import 'secure_session_storage.dart';

final class TransportBackendAuthenticationGateway
    implements BackendAuthenticationGateway {
  TransportBackendAuthenticationGateway(
    this.transport, {
    SecureSessionStorage? secureSessionStorage,
  }) : _secureSessionStorage =
            secureSessionStorage ?? const UnavailableSecureSessionStorage();

  final BackendTransport transport;
  final SecureSessionStorage _secureSessionStorage;
  int _credentialOperationGeneration = 0;
  Future<void> _credentialMutationQueue = Future<void>.value();

  @override
  Future<void> requestEmailOtp(EmailOtpRequest request) async {
    await _send(BackendTransportRequest.requestEmailOtp(email: request.email));
  }

  @override
  Future<AccountSession> verifyEmailOtp(EmailOtpVerification request) async {
    final operationGeneration = ++_credentialOperationGeneration;
    final response = await _send(
      BackendTransportRequest.verifyEmailOtp(
        email: request.email,
        otp: request.otp,
      ),
    );
    final session = _sessionFromResponse(response);
    if (operationGeneration != _credentialOperationGeneration) {
      throw const AuthenticationFailure(
        AuthenticationFailureCode.invalidSession,
      );
    }
    await _storeCredential(response.credentials, operationGeneration);
    return session;
  }

  @override
  Future<AccountSession> authenticateProvider(
    ProviderAuthenticationAssertion assertion,
  ) async {
    final operationGeneration = ++_credentialOperationGeneration;
    final response = await _send(
      BackendTransportRequest.authenticateProvider(assertion: assertion),
    );
    final session = _sessionFromResponse(response);
    if (operationGeneration != _credentialOperationGeneration) {
      throw const AuthenticationFailure(
        AuthenticationFailureCode.invalidSession,
      );
    }
    await _storeCredential(response.credentials, operationGeneration);
    return session;
  }

  @override
  Future<AccountSession> renewSession(
    SecureSessionCredentials credentials,
  ) async {
    final operationGeneration = ++_credentialOperationGeneration;
    try {
      final response = await _send(
        BackendTransportRequest.renewSession(credentials: credentials),
      );
      final session = _sessionFromResponse(response);
      if (response.credentials == null) {
        if (operationGeneration == _credentialOperationGeneration) {
          await _clearCredential(operationGeneration);
        }
        throw const AuthenticationFailure(
          AuthenticationFailureCode.invalidSession,
        );
      }
      if (operationGeneration != _credentialOperationGeneration) {
        throw const AuthenticationFailure(
          AuthenticationFailureCode.invalidSession,
        );
      }
      await _storeCredential(response.credentials, operationGeneration);
      return session;
    } on AuthenticationFailure catch (error) {
      if (error.code == AuthenticationFailureCode.invalidSession &&
          operationGeneration == _credentialOperationGeneration) {
        await _clearCredential(operationGeneration);
      }
      rethrow;
    } catch (_) {
      await _clearCredential(operationGeneration);
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> revokeSession(SecureSessionCredentials? credentials) async {
    final operationGeneration = ++_credentialOperationGeneration;
    try {
      await _send(
        BackendTransportRequest.revokeSession(credentials: credentials),
      );
    } finally {
      if (operationGeneration == _credentialOperationGeneration) {
        await _clearCredential(operationGeneration);
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<AccountSession> getCurrentSession() async {
    final operationGeneration = ++_credentialOperationGeneration;
    try {
      final credential = await _secureSessionStorage.read();
      if (credential == null) {
        return const AccountSession.unauthenticated();
      }
      final response = await _send(
        BackendTransportRequest.currentSession(credentials: credential),
      );
      if (operationGeneration != _credentialOperationGeneration) {
        throw const AuthenticationFailure(
          AuthenticationFailureCode.invalidSession,
        );
      }
      final session = _sessionFromResponse(response);
      if (!session.isAuthenticated || session.identity == null) {
        if (operationGeneration == _credentialOperationGeneration) {
          await _clearCredential(operationGeneration);
        }
        throw const AuthenticationFailure(
          AuthenticationFailureCode.invalidSession,
        );
      }
      return session;
    } on AuthenticationFailure catch (error) {
      if (error.code == AuthenticationFailureCode.invalidSession) {
        if (operationGeneration == _credentialOperationGeneration) {
          await _clearCredential(operationGeneration);
        }
      }
      rethrow;
    } on SecureSessionStorageFailure catch (_) {
      throw const AuthenticationFailure(
        AuthenticationFailureCode.invalidSession,
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> signOut() async {
    await _send(const BackendTransportRequest.signOut());
  }

  Future<BackendTransportResponse> _send(
    BackendTransportRequest request,
  ) async {
    try {
      return await transport.send(request);
    } on BackendTransportFailure catch (error) {
      throw _mapFailure(error.code);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _storeCredential(
    SecureSessionCredentials? credentials,
    int operationGeneration,
  ) async {
    if (credentials == null) {
      throw const AuthenticationFailure(
        AuthenticationFailureCode.invalidSession,
      );
    }
    final applied = await _withCredentialMutationLock(
      operationGeneration,
      () => _secureSessionStorage.save(credentials),
    );
    if (!applied) {
      throw const AuthenticationFailure(
        AuthenticationFailureCode.invalidSession,
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _clearCredential(int operationGeneration) async {
    await _withCredentialMutationLock(
      operationGeneration,
      _secureSessionStorage.clear,
    );
  }

  Future<bool> _withCredentialMutationLock(
    int operationGeneration,
    Future<void> Function() mutation,
  ) async {
    final previous = _credentialMutationQueue;
    final current = previous.then((_) async {
      if (operationGeneration != _credentialOperationGeneration) return false;
      await mutation();
      return true;
    });
    _credentialMutationQueue = current.then<void>((_) {}).catchError((_) {});
    return current;
  }

  static AccountSession _sessionFromResponse(
    BackendTransportResponse response,
  ) {
    final session = response.session;
    if (session == null ||
        !session.isAuthenticated ||
        session.identity == null ||
        session.identity!.userId.trim().isEmpty ||
        session.requiresReauthentication) {
      throw const AuthenticationFailure(
        AuthenticationFailureCode.invalidSession,
      );
    }
    return session;
  }

  static AuthenticationFailure _mapFailure(BackendTransportFailureCode code) {
    return AuthenticationFailure(switch (code) {
      BackendTransportFailureCode.invalidAuthentication =>
        AuthenticationFailureCode.invalidCredential,
      BackendTransportFailureCode.rateLimited =>
        AuthenticationFailureCode.rateLimited,
      BackendTransportFailureCode.providerRejected =>
        AuthenticationFailureCode.providerRejected,
      BackendTransportFailureCode.unavailable =>
        AuthenticationFailureCode.unavailable,
      BackendTransportFailureCode.invalidSession =>
        AuthenticationFailureCode.invalidSession,
      BackendTransportFailureCode.retryable =>
        AuthenticationFailureCode.retryable,
    });
  }
}

final class UnavailableBackendAuthenticationGateway
    implements BackendAuthenticationGateway {
  const UnavailableBackendAuthenticationGateway();

  @override
  Future<void> requestEmailOtp(EmailOtpRequest request) async {
    throw const AuthenticationFailure(AuthenticationFailureCode.unavailable);
  }

  @override
  Future<AccountSession> verifyEmailOtp(EmailOtpVerification request) async {
    throw const AuthenticationFailure(AuthenticationFailureCode.unavailable);
  }

  @override
  Future<AccountSession> authenticateProvider(
    ProviderAuthenticationAssertion assertion,
  ) async {
    throw const AuthenticationFailure(AuthenticationFailureCode.unavailable);
  }

  @override
  Future<AccountSession> renewSession(
    SecureSessionCredentials credentials,
  ) async {
    return const AccountSession.unauthenticated();
  }

  @override
  Future<void> revokeSession(SecureSessionCredentials? credentials) async {}

  @override
  Future<AccountSession> getCurrentSession() async {
    return const AccountSession.unauthenticated();
  }

  @override
  Future<void> signOut() async {}
}

import '../models/account_session.dart';
import '../models/backend_authentication_contract.dart';
import '../models/secure_session_credentials.dart';

/// Email OTP adapter. It owns no persistent credential state.
abstract interface class EmailOtpProvider {
  Future<void> requestCode({required String email});

  Future<AccountSession> verifyCode({
    required String email,
    required String otp,
  });
}

/// Social provider adapter for Google or Apple.
abstract interface class SocialAuthenticationProvider {
  AccountProvider get provider;

  Future<ProviderAuthenticationAssertion> authenticate();
}

/// Provider-neutral authentication boundary.
abstract interface class BackendAuthenticationGateway {
  Future<void> requestEmailOtp(EmailOtpRequest request);

  Future<AccountSession> verifyEmailOtp(EmailOtpVerification request);

  Future<AccountSession> authenticateProvider(
    ProviderAuthenticationAssertion assertion,
  );

  Future<AccountSession> renewSession(SecureSessionCredentials credentials);

  Future<void> revokeSession(SecureSessionCredentials? credentials);

  Future<AccountSession> getCurrentSession();

  Future<void> signOut();
}

abstract interface class AuthenticationService {
  Future<AccountSession> get currentSession;

  Future<void> requestEmailOtp({required String email});

  Future<AccountSession> signInWithEmailOtp({
    required String email,
    required String otp,
  });

  Future<AccountSession> signInWithGoogle();

  Future<AccountSession> signInWithApple();

  Future<AccountSession> renewSession();

  Future<void> signOut();
}

/// Authentication failures are deliberately explicit and never fabricate an
/// authenticated session.
enum AuthenticationFailureCode {
  cancelled,
  invalidCredential,
  expiredCredential,
  unavailable,
  invalidSession,
  rateLimited,
  providerRejected,
  retryable,
}

final class AuthenticationFailure implements Exception {
  const AuthenticationFailure(this.code);

  final AuthenticationFailureCode code;

  @override
  String toString() => 'AuthenticationFailure($code)';
}

  }

  @override
  Future<AccountSession> verifyCode({
    required String email,
    required String otp,
  }) async {
    throw const AuthenticationFailure(AuthenticationFailureCode.unavailable);
  }

  @override

  @override
