import '../models/account_session.dart';
import '../models/backend_authentication_contract.dart';
import '../models/secure_session_credentials.dart';
import 'authentication_contract.dart';
import 'authentication_failures.dart';
import 'authentication_backend_gateway.dart';
import 'secure_session_storage.dart';

/// Small orchestration layer that keeps provider adapters independent.
final class ProviderAuthenticationService implements AuthenticationService {
  ProviderAuthenticationService({
    required EmailOtpProvider emailOtpProvider,
    required SocialAuthenticationProvider googleProvider,
    required SocialAuthenticationProvider appleProvider,
    BackendAuthenticationGateway? backendGateway,
    SecureSessionStorage? secureSessionStorage,
  })  : _emailOtpProvider = emailOtpProvider,
        _backendGateway =
            backendGateway ?? const UnavailableBackendAuthenticationGateway(),
        _secureSessionStorage =
            secureSessionStorage ?? const UnavailableSecureSessionStorage(),
        _googleProvider = _requireProvider(
          googleProvider,
          AccountProvider.google,
        ),
        _appleProvider = _requireProvider(appleProvider, AccountProvider.apple);

  final EmailOtpProvider _emailOtpProvider;
  final BackendAuthenticationGateway _backendGateway;
  final SecureSessionStorage _secureSessionStorage;
  final SocialAuthenticationProvider _googleProvider;
  final SocialAuthenticationProvider _appleProvider;
  AccountSession _session = const AccountSession.unauthenticated();
  int _storageOperationGeneration = 0;

  @override
  Future<AccountSession> get currentSession async {
    final operationGeneration = ++_storageOperationGeneration;
    try {
      final session = await _backendGateway.getCurrentSession();
      if (operationGeneration != _storageOperationGeneration) {
        throw const AuthenticationFailure(
          AuthenticationFailureCode.invalidSession,
        );
      }
      _session = _canonicalSession(session);
    } on AuthenticationFailure {
      rethrow;
    } catch (_) {
      if (operationGeneration == _storageOperationGeneration) {
        _session = const AccountSession.unauthenticated();
      }
    }
    if (operationGeneration == _storageOperationGeneration &&
        _session.requiresReauthentication) {
      _session = const AccountSession.unauthenticated();
    }
    if (operationGeneration != _storageOperationGeneration) {
      throw const AuthenticationFailure(
        AuthenticationFailureCode.invalidSession,
      );
    }
    return _session;
  }

  @override
  Future<void> requestEmailOtp({required String email}) =>
      _emailOtpProvider.requestCode(email: email);

  @override
  Future<AccountSession> signInWithEmailOtp({
    required String email,
    required String otp,
  }) async {
    return _authenticate(
      () => _backendGateway.verifyEmailOtp(
        EmailOtpVerification(email: email, otp: otp),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Future<AccountSession> signInWithGoogle() async {
    return _authenticate(() async {
      final assertion = await _googleProvider.authenticate();
      return _backendGateway.authenticateProvider(assertion);
    });
  }

  @override
  Future<AccountSession> signInWithApple() async {
    return _authenticate(() async {
      final assertion = await _appleProvider.authenticate();
      return _backendGateway.authenticateProvider(assertion);
    });
  }

  @override
  Future<AccountSession> renewSession() async {
    final operationGeneration = ++_storageOperationGeneration;
    SecureSessionCredentials? credentials;
    try {
      credentials = await _secureSessionStorage.read();
    } on SecureSessionStorageFailure catch (_) {
      if (operationGeneration == _storageOperationGeneration) {
        _session = const AccountSession.unauthenticated();
      }
      throw const AuthenticationFailure(
        AuthenticationFailureCode.invalidSession,
      );
    }
    if (credentials == null) {
      if (operationGeneration == _storageOperationGeneration) {
        _session = const AccountSession.unauthenticated();
      }
      throw const AuthenticationFailure(
        AuthenticationFailureCode.invalidSession,
      );
    }
    try {
      final renewed = await _backendGateway.renewSession(credentials);
      final canonical = _canonicalSession(renewed);
      if (!canonical.isAuthenticated || canonical.identity == null) {
        if (operationGeneration == _storageOperationGeneration) {
          _session = const AccountSession.unauthenticated();
        }
        throw const AuthenticationFailure(
          AuthenticationFailureCode.invalidSession,
        );
      }
      if (_session.isAuthenticated &&
          _session.identity != null &&
          canonical.identity!.userId != _session.identity!.userId) {
        throw const AuthenticationFailure(
          AuthenticationFailureCode.invalidSession,
        );
      }
      final replacement = await _secureSessionStorage.read();
      if (replacement == null) {
        if (operationGeneration == _storageOperationGeneration) {
          _session = const AccountSession.unauthenticated();
        }
        throw const AuthenticationFailure(
          AuthenticationFailureCode.invalidSession,
        );
      }
      if (operationGeneration != _storageOperationGeneration) {
        throw const AuthenticationFailure(
          AuthenticationFailureCode.invalidSession,
        );
      }
      _session = canonical;
      return canonical;
    } on AuthenticationFailure catch (_) {
      if (operationGeneration == _storageOperationGeneration) {
        _session = const AccountSession.unauthenticated();
      }
      rethrow;
    } catch (_) {
      if (operationGeneration == _storageOperationGeneration) {
        _session = const AccountSession.unauthenticated();
      }
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> signOut() async {
    final operationGeneration = ++_storageOperationGeneration;
    try {
      SecureSessionCredentials? credentials;
      try {
        credentials = await _secureSessionStorage.read();
      } on SecureSessionStorageFailure {
        credentials = null;
      }
      await _backendGateway.revokeSession(credentials);
    } finally {
      if (operationGeneration == _storageOperationGeneration) {
        _session = const AccountSession.unauthenticated();
      }
    }
  }

  Future<AccountSession> _authenticate(
    Future<AccountSession> Function() operation,
  ) async {
    final operationGeneration = ++_storageOperationGeneration;
    final result = await operation();
    if (operationGeneration != _storageOperationGeneration) {
      throw const AuthenticationFailure(
        AuthenticationFailureCode.invalidSession,
      );
    }
    final canonical = _canonicalSession(result);
    _session = canonical;
    return canonical;
  }

  static AccountSession _canonicalSession(AccountSession result) {
    if (!result.isAuthenticated ||
        result.identity == null ||
        result.identity!.userId.trim().isEmpty ||
        result.requiresReauthentication) {
      return const AccountSession.unauthenticated();
    }
    return result;
  }

  static SocialAuthenticationProvider _requireProvider(
    SocialAuthenticationProvider provider,
    AccountProvider expected,
  ) {
    if (provider.provider != expected) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        provider.provider,
        'provider',
        'Expected $expected adapter.',
      );
    }
    return provider;
  }
}

import '../models/backend_authentication_api.dart';
import '../models/backend_transport.dart';
import 'backend_transport.dart';

/// Maps semantic authentication API operations onto the provider-neutral
/// transport contract. It introduces no network implementation.
final class BackendAuthenticationApi {
  const BackendAuthenticationApi(this.transport);

  final BackendTransport transport;

  Future<BackendAuthenticationApiResponse> send(
    BackendAuthenticationApiRequest request,
  ) async {
    final response = await transport.send(_toTransportRequest(request));
    return BackendAuthenticationApiResponse(
      session: response.session,
      credentials: response.credentials,
    );
  }

  static T _require<T>(T? value, String field) {
    final result = value;
    if (result == null) {
      throw ArgumentError('Missing $field for authentication operation');
    }
    return result;
  }

  static BackendTransportRequest _toTransportRequest(
    BackendAuthenticationApiRequest request,
  ) {
    return switch (request.operation) {
      BackendAuthenticationOperation.requestEmailOtp =>
        BackendTransportRequest.requestEmailOtp(
          email: _require(request.email, 'email'),
        ),
      BackendAuthenticationOperation.verifyEmailOtp =>
        BackendTransportRequest.verifyEmailOtp(
          email: _require(request.email, 'email'),
          otp: _require(request.otp, 'otp'),
        ),
      BackendAuthenticationOperation.authenticateProvider =>
        BackendTransportRequest.authenticateProvider(
          assertion: _require(request.assertion, 'assertion'),
        ),
      BackendAuthenticationOperation.currentSession =>
        BackendTransportRequest.currentSession(
          credentials: request.credentials,
        ),
      BackendAuthenticationOperation.renewSession =>
        BackendTransportRequest.renewSession(
          credentials: _require(request.credentials, 'credentials'),
        ),
      BackendAuthenticationOperation.revokeSession =>
        BackendTransportRequest.revokeSession(credentials: request.credentials),
      BackendAuthenticationOperation.signOut =>
        const BackendTransportRequest.signOut(),
    };
  }
}

FILE: lib/services/backend_http_transport.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';

import '../models/account_session.dart';
import '../models/backend_transport.dart';
import '../models/secure_session_credentials.dart';
import 'backend_transport.dart';

/// HTTPS transport implementation for the provider-neutral backend contract.
///
/// This class owns only transient wire encoding/decoding and network I/O. It
/// never persists credentials, interprets credential contents, or decides
/// authentication/entitlement policy.
final class HttpBackendTransport implements BackendTransport {
  HttpBackendTransport(
    this.baseUri, {
    Duration timeout = const Duration(seconds: 15),
  }) : timeout = _validateTimeout(timeout);

  static const int MAX_REQUEST_BYTES = 32 * 1024;
  static const int MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES = 64 * 1024;
  static const Duration MIN_TIMEOUT = Duration(seconds: 1);
  static const Duration MAX_TIMEOUT = Duration(seconds: 30);

  final Uri baseUri;
  final Duration timeout;

  @override
  Future<BackendTransportResponse> send(BackendTransportRequest request) async {
    _validateBaseUri(baseUri);

    final body = utf8.encode(jsonEncode(_requestJson(request)));
    if (body.length > MAX_REQUEST_BYTES) {
      throw const BackendTransportFailure(
        BackendTransportFailureCode.unavailable,
      );
    }

    final client = HttpClient()..connectionTimeout = timeout;
    try {
      final uri = baseUri.resolve('v1/auth/${request.operation.name}');
      final requestMessage = await client.postUrl(uri).timeout(timeout);
      requestMessage.headers.contentType = ContentType.json;
      requestMessage.headers.contentLength = body.length;
      requestMessage.add(body);

      final response = await requestMessage.close().timeout(timeout);
      if (response.statusCode < 200 || response.statusCode >= 300) {
        throw _failureForStatus(response.statusCode, request.operation);
      }

      final responseDeadline = DateTime.now().add(timeout);
      final responseBytes = await _readResponseBytes(
        response,
        responseDeadline,
      );

      if (responseBytes.isEmpty) {
        return const BackendTransportResponse();
      }

      final decoded = jsonDecode(utf8.decode(responseBytes));
      if (decoded is! Map<String, dynamic>) {
        throw const BackendTransportFailure(
          BackendTransportFailureCode.unavailable,
        );
      }
      final parsedResponse = _responseFromJson(decoded);
      _validateResponseForOperation(parsedResponse, request.operation);
      return parsedResponse;
    } on BackendTransportFailure {
      rethrow;
    } on TimeoutException {
      throw const BackendTransportFailure(
        BackendTransportFailureCode.unavailable,
      );
    } on SocketException {
      throw const BackendTransportFailure(
        BackendTransportFailureCode.unavailable,
      );
    } on FormatException {
      throw const BackendTransportFailure(
        BackendTransportFailureCode.unavailable,
      );
    } finally {
      client.close(force: true);
    }
  }

  static Future<List<int>> _readResponseBytes(
    HttpClientResponse response,
    DateTime responseDeadline,
  ) async {
    final responseBytes = <int>[];
    final iterator = StreamIterator<List<int>>(response);
    try {
      while (await iterator.moveNext().timeout(
            _remainingUntil(responseDeadline),
          )) {
        responseBytes.addAll(iterator.current);
        if (responseBytes.length > MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES) {
          throw const BackendTransportFailure(
            BackendTransportFailureCode.unavailable,
          );
        }
      }
      return responseBytes;
    } finally {
      await iterator.cancel();
    }
  }

  static Duration _remainingUntil(DateTime deadline) {
    final remaining = deadline.difference(DateTime.now());
    if (remaining <= Duration.zero) {
      throw TimeoutException('Backend response deadline exceeded');
    }
    return remaining;
  }

  static Map<String, dynamic> _requestJson(BackendTransportRequest request) {
    final result = <String, dynamic>{'operation': request.operation.name};
    if (request.email != null) result['email'] = request.email;
    if (request.otp != null) result['otp'] = request.otp;
    final assertion = request.assertion;
    if (assertion != null) {
      result['provider'] = assertion.provider.name;
      result['assertion'] = assertion.assertion;
    }
    final credentials = request.credentials;
    if (credentials != null) {
      result['credential'] = credentials.value;
    }
    return result;
  }

  static BackendTransportResponse _responseFromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    SecureSessionCredentials? credentials;
    final credential = json['credential'];
    if (credential != null) {
      if (credential is! String) {
        throw const BackendTransportFailure(
          BackendTransportFailureCode.unavailable,
        );
      }
      try {
        credentials = SecureSessionCredentials(credential);
      } on ArgumentError {
        throw const BackendTransportFailure(
          BackendTransportFailureCode.invalidSession,
        );
      }
    }

    AccountSession? session;
    final rawSession = json['session'];
    if (rawSession != null) {
      if (rawSession is! Map<String, dynamic>) {
        throw const BackendTransportFailure(
          BackendTransportFailureCode.unavailable,
        );
      }
      session = _sessionFromJson(rawSession);
    }

    return BackendTransportResponse(session: session, credentials: credentials);
  }

  static void _validateResponseForOperation(
    BackendTransportResponse response,
    BackendTransportOperation operation,
  ) {
    switch (operation) {
      case BackendTransportOperation.verifyEmailOtp:
      case BackendTransportOperation.authenticateProvider:
        if (response.session == null || response.credentials == null) {
          throw const BackendTransportFailure(
            BackendTransportFailureCode.invalidSession,
          );
        }
      case BackendTransportOperation.currentSession:
        if (response.session == null) {
          throw const BackendTransportFailure(
            BackendTransportFailureCode.invalidSession,
          );
        }
      case BackendTransportOperation.renewSession:
        if (response.session == null || response.credentials == null) {
          throw const BackendTransportFailure(
            BackendTransportFailureCode.invalidSession,
          );
        }
      case BackendTransportOperation.requestEmailOtp:
      case BackendTransportOperation.revokeSession:
      case BackendTransportOperation.signOut:
        break;
    }
  }

  static AccountSession _sessionFromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    final isAuthenticated = json['isAuthenticated'];
    if (isAuthenticated is! bool) {
      throw const BackendTransportFailure(
        BackendTransportFailureCode.unavailable,
      );
    }
    if (!isAuthenticated) {
      return const AccountSession.unauthenticated();
    }

    final rawUserId = json['userId'];
    if (rawUserId is! String || rawUserId.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw const BackendTransportFailure(
        BackendTransportFailureCode.invalidSession,
      );
    }

    final rawExpiresAt = json['expiresAt'];
    if (rawExpiresAt == null || rawExpiresAt is! String) {
      throw const BackendTransportFailure(
        BackendTransportFailureCode.invalidSession,
      );
    }

    late final DateTime expiresAt;
    try {
      expiresAt = DateTime.parse(rawExpiresAt).toUtc();
    } on FormatException {
      throw const BackendTransportFailure(
        BackendTransportFailureCode.invalidSession,
      );
    }
    if (!DateTime.now().toUtc().isBefore(expiresAt)) {
      throw const BackendTransportFailure(
        BackendTransportFailureCode.invalidSession,
      );
    }

    return AccountSession.authenticated(
      identity: AccountIdentity(userId: rawUserId),
      expiresAt: expiresAt,
    );
  }

  static BackendTransportFailure _failureForStatus(
    int statusCode,
    BackendTransportOperation operation,
  ) {
    if (statusCode == 429) {
      return const BackendTransportFailure(
        BackendTransportFailureCode.rateLimited,
      );
    }
    if (statusCode == 408 || statusCode >= 500) {
      return const BackendTransportFailure(
        BackendTransportFailureCode.retryable,
      );
    }
    if (statusCode == 401 || statusCode == 403) {
      final sessionOperation =
          operation == BackendTransportOperation.currentSession ||
              operation == BackendTransportOperation.renewSession ||
              operation == BackendTransportOperation.revokeSession;
      return BackendTransportFailure(
        sessionOperation
            ? BackendTransportFailureCode.invalidSession
            : BackendTransportFailureCode.invalidAuthentication,
      );
    }
    return const BackendTransportFailure(
      BackendTransportFailureCode.invalidAuthentication,
    );
  }

  static Duration _validateTimeout(Duration value) {
    if (value < MIN_TIMEOUT || value > MAX_TIMEOUT) {
      throw ArgumentError(
        'Backend transport timeout must be between 1 and 30 seconds',
      );
    }
    return value;
  }

  static void _validateBaseUri(Uri uri) {
    if (uri.scheme != 'https' || uri.host.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError('Backend transport requires an HTTPS base URI');
    }
  }
}

import '../models/backend_transport.dart';

final class BackendTransportFailure implements Exception {
  const BackendTransportFailure(this.code);

  final BackendTransportFailureCode code;

  @override
  String toString() => 'BackendTransportFailure($code)';
}

/// Platform-neutral backend transport. It does not know about learner state,
/// subscriptions, provider SDKs, or persistence.
abstract interface class BackendTransport {
  Future<BackendTransportResponse> send(BackendTransportRequest request);
}

/// Safe default until a real backend transport is deliberately selected.
final class UnavailableBackendTransport implements BackendTransport {
  const UnavailableBackendTransport();

  @override
  Future<BackendTransportResponse> send(BackendTransportRequest request) async {
    throw const BackendTransportFailure(
      BackendTransportFailureCode.unavailable,
    );
  }
}

import '../models/backend_runtime_config.dart';
import 'backend_http_transport.dart';
import 'backend_transport.dart';

/// Composes the authentication backend transport from non-secret runtime configuration.
final class BackendTransportFactory {
  const BackendTransportFactory._();

  static BackendTransport fromRuntimeConfig(BackendRuntimeConfig config) {
    if (!config.isConfigured) {
      return const UnavailableBackendTransport();
    }
    return HttpBackendTransport(config.baseUri!);
  }
}

import '../core/content_contract.dart';

/// Neutral runtime boundary between learning logic and a physical content source.
/// Language-specific source selection belongs to the selected language pack.
abstract interface class ContentSource<T extends LearningContent> {
  Iterable<T> get items;
}

class ContentEngine<T extends LearningContent> {
  const ContentEngine(this._source);

  final ContentSource<T> _source;

  Iterable<T> get items => _source.items;

  T? byId(String id) {
    final target = id.trim();
    if (target.isEmpty) return null;
    for (final item in _source.items) {
      if (item.id == target) return item;
    }
    return null;
  }
}

/// Shared service facade. Language heuristics live behind the injected
/// LanguageContentIntelligence implementation.
final class ContentIntelligence {
  final LanguageContentIntelligence delegate;
  List<LearningContent>? _cachedCorpus;
  ContentIntelligenceReport? _cachedReport;

  ContentIntelligence(this.delegate);

  ContentProfile profile(LearningContent item) => delegate.profile(item);

  ContentIntelligenceReport analyze(List<LearningContent> items) =>
      delegate.analyze(items);

  ContentIntelligenceReport cachedReport(List<LearningContent> items) {
    if (identical(_cachedCorpus, items) && _cachedReport != null)
      return _cachedReport!;
    _cachedCorpus = items;
    _cachedReport = delegate.analyze(items);
    return _cachedReport!;
  }

  Map<ContentLevel, List<LearningContent>> curriculum(
    List<LearningContent> items,
  ) =>
      delegate.curriculum(items);
}

import '../language/language_exercise_strategy.dart';
import '../language/language_text_normalizer.dart';
import '../models/conversation.dart';

class ConversationEngine {
  final LanguageExerciseStrategy exerciseStrategy;
  final LanguageTextNormalizer textNormalizer;
  const ConversationEngine({
    required this.exerciseStrategy,
    required this.textNormalizer,
  });

  List<ConversationScenario> get scenarios =>
      exerciseStrategy.conversationScenarios;

  ConversationScore score(ConversationTurn turn, String transcript) {
    final answer = textNormalizer.answer(transcript);
    final accepted = turn.expected.map(textNormalizer.answer).toSet();
    if (answer.isEmpty)
      return ConversationScore(
        value: 0,
        correct: false,
        matchedKeywords: const [],
        missingKeywords: turn.keywords
            .map(textNormalizer.answer)
            .where((x) => x.isNotEmpty)
            .toList(),
      );
    if (accepted.contains(answer))
      return ConversationScore(
        value: 100,
        correct: true,
        matchedKeywords: turn.keywords.map(textNormalizer.answer).toList(),
        missingKeywords: const [],
      );
    final matched = <String>[];
    final missing = <String>[];
    final normalizedKeys = turn.keywords
        .map(textNormalizer.answer)
        .where((x) => x.isNotEmpty)
        .toList();
    for (final key in normalizedKeys) {
      if (_tokensContainSimilar(answer, key))
        matched.add(key);
      else
        missing.add(key);
    }
    final coverage =
        normalizedKeys.isEmpty ? 0.0 : matched.length / normalizedKeys.length;
    final order = _orderScore(answer, matched);
    final value = (coverage * 80 + order * 20).round().clamp(0, 99);
    return ConversationScore(
      value: value,
      correct: coverage >= .67 && order >= .50,
      matchedKeywords: matched,
      missingKeywords: missing,
    );
  }

  static bool _tokensContainSimilar(String text, String token) {
    final tokens = text.split(' ').where((x) => x.isNotEmpty);
    for (final candidate in tokens) {
      if (_tokenSimilarity(candidate, token) >= .80) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  static double _tokenSimilarity(String a, String b) {
    if (a == b) return 1;
    if (a.length < 4 || b.length < 4) return 0;
    final limit = a.length < b.length ? a.length : b.length;
    var common = 0;
    while (common < limit && a[common] == b[common]) common++;
    return common / (a.length > b.length ? a.length : b.length);
  }

  static double _orderScore(String text, List<String> matched) {
    if (matched.length <= 1) return 1;
    final tokens = text.split(' ').where((x) => x.isNotEmpty).toList();
    var cursor = -1;
    var ordered = 0;
    for (final key in matched) {
      var found = -1;
      for (var i = cursor + 1; i < tokens.length; i++) {
        if (_tokenSimilarity(tokens[i], key) >= .80) {
          found = i;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (found >= 0) {
        ordered++;
        cursor = found;
      }
    }
    return ordered / matched.length;
  }
}

import '../models/learner.dart';
import 'adaptive_teacher.dart';

class DailyPlan {
  final int total, review, repair, newContent, listening, production;
  final String focusSkill;
  const DailyPlan({
    required this.total,
    required this.review,
    required this.repair,
    required this.newContent,
    required this.listening,
    required this.production,
    required this.focusSkill,
  });

  factory DailyPlan.from(LearnerState state, {DateTime? now, int goal = 10}) {
    final boundedGoal = goal.clamp(5, 20).toInt();
    final due = state.meaningReviewCards
        .where((c) => !c.dueAt.isAfter(now ?? DateTime.now()))
        .length;
    final action = AdaptiveTeacher.next(state, now: now);
    final review = due.clamp(0, (boundedGoal * .5).round()).toInt();
    final repair = action.type == TeacherActionType.repair
        ? ((boundedGoal - review) * .45).round()
        : ((boundedGoal - review) * .25).round();
    final newContent =
        (boundedGoal - review - repair).clamp(0, boundedGoal).toInt();
    final listening = (boundedGoal * .15).round();
    final production = (boundedGoal * .25).round();
    return DailyPlan(
      total: boundedGoal,
      review: review,
      repair: repair,
      newContent: newContent,
      listening: listening,
      production: production,
      focusSkill: action.skill,
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:io';

import 'package:sqflite_common/sqlite_api.dart';
import 'package:path/path.dart' as p;

import 'sqlite_policy.dart';

class DatabaseMigrationHelper {
  /// Opens the database, handling backups and migrations automatically.
  ///
  /// [path] The database file path.
  /// [version] The target database version.
  /// [onCreate] The callback invoked if the database is created for the first time.
  /// [migrationScripts] A map where the key is the target version and the value is a list of SQL queries to execute to reach that version from the previous version.
  /// [factory] Optional DatabaseFactory for testing or specialized environments.
  static Future<Database> open({
    required String path,
    required int version,
    required OnDatabaseCreateFn onCreate,
    required Map<int, List<String>> migrationScripts,
    DatabaseFactory? factory,
  }) async {
    final options = OpenDatabaseOptions(
      version: version,
      onCreate: onCreate,
      onUpgrade: (db, oldVersion, newVersion) async {
        // Perform backup before any migrations run
        await _backupDatabase(path, oldVersion);

        // Execute migrations sequentially
        for (int v = oldVersion + 1; v <= newVersion; v++) {
          final scripts = migrationScripts[v];
          if (scripts != null) {
            for (final script in scripts) {
              await db.execute(script);
            }
          }
        }
      },
    );

    return AppSqlitePolicy(factory: factory).openWritable(
      path: path,
      version: options.version ?? version,
      onCreate: options.onCreate,
      onUpgrade: options.onUpgrade,
    );
  }

  /// Creates a backup of the main `.db` file as well as `-wal` and `-shm` files if they exist.
  static Future<void> _backupDatabase(String dbPath, int currentVersion) async {
    try {
      final dbFile = File(dbPath);
      if (!await dbFile.exists()) return; // Nothing to backup

      final directory = p.dirname(dbPath);
      final basename = p.basenameWithoutExtension(dbPath);
      final extension = p.extension(dbPath);
      final timestamp = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;

      final backupPrefix = p.join(directory, 'backups');
      final backupDir = Directory(backupPrefix);
      if (!await backupDir.exists()) {
        await backupDir.create(recursive: true);
      }

      final backupBaseName = '${basename}_v${currentVersion}_$timestamp';
      final backupPath = p.join(backupPrefix, '$backupBaseName$extension');

      // Copy main database file
      await dbFile.copy(backupPath);

      // Copy WAL and SHM files if they exist
      final walFile = File('$dbPath-wal');
      if (await walFile.exists()) {
        await walFile.copy('$backupPath-wal');
      }

      final shmFile = File('$dbPath-shm');
      if (await shmFile.exists()) {
        await shmFile.copy('$backupPath-shm');
      }
    } on Object {
      // Backup is best-effort. Do not emit exception details into production
      // logs; migration continuity is intentionally preserved.
    }
  }

  static Future<T> executeAtomic<T>(
    Database db,
    Future<T> Function(Transaction txn) action,
  ) async {
    return await db.transaction((txn) async => await action(txn));
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:sqflite_common/sqlite_api.dart';

import 'sqlite_policy.dart';

import 'dart:math';

class DynamicUiVariationsEngine {
  static const String _tableName = 'ui_variations';
  static const String _columnId = 'id';
  static const String _columnDate = 'last_date';
  static const String _columnSeed = 'current_seed';

  static final DynamicUiVariationsEngine instance =
      DynamicUiVariationsEngine._init();
  static Database? _database;
  static const AppSqlitePolicy _sqlitePolicy = AppSqlitePolicy();

  DynamicUiVariationsEngine._init();

  Future<Database> get database async {
    if (_database != null) return _database!;
    _database = await _initDB('dynamic_ui.db');
    return _database!;
  }

  Future<Database> _initDB(String filePath) async {
    final path = await _sqlitePolicy.resolvePath(fileName: filePath);
    return _sqlitePolicy.openWritable(
      path: path,
      version: 1,
      onCreate: _createDB,
    );
  }

  Future _createDB(Database db, int version) async {
    await db.execute('''
      CREATE TABLE $_tableName (
        $_columnId TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        $_columnDate TEXT NOT NULL,
        $_columnSeed INTEGER NOT NULL
      )
    ''');
  }

  Future<int> getDailySeed() async {
    final db = await instance.database;
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final today =
        "${now.year}-${now.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${now.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}";

    final maps = await db.query(
      _tableName,
      where: '$_columnId = ?',
      whereArgs: ['daily_variation'],
    );

    if (maps.isEmpty) {
      final newSeed = Random().nextInt(360);
      await db.insert(_tableName, {
        _columnId: 'daily_variation',
        _columnDate: today,
        _columnSeed: newSeed,
      });
      return newSeed;
    } else {
      final lastDate = maps.first[_columnDate] as String;
      if (lastDate != today) {
        final newSeed = Random().nextInt(360);
        await db.update(
          _tableName,
          {_columnDate: today, _columnSeed: newSeed},
          where: '$_columnId = ?',
          whereArgs: ['daily_variation'],
        );
        return newSeed;
      } else {
        return maps.first[_columnSeed] as int;
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    if (_database != null) {
      await _database!.close();
      _database = null;
    }
  }
}

class DynamicUiVariationHelpers {
  static Color getRotatedSeedColor(int seed) {
    const baseColor = Colors.indigo; // Base theme seed color
    final hsl = HSLColor.fromColor(baseColor);
    final rotatedHsl = hsl.withHue((hsl.hue + (seed % 30) - 15) % 360);
    return rotatedHsl.toColor();
  }

  static List<Color> getGradientColors(int seed, bool isDark) {
    final base = getRotatedSeedColor(seed);
    final hsl = HSLColor.fromColor(base);

    final lightnessAdjustment = isDark ? -0.05 : 0.05;

    final color1 = hsl
        .withLightness((hsl.lightness + lightnessAdjustment).clamp(0.0, 1.0))
        .withAlpha(0.05)
        .toColor();
    final color2 = hsl
        .withHue((hsl.hue + 10) % 360)
        .withLightness((hsl.lightness - lightnessAdjustment).clamp(0.0, 1.0))
        .withAlpha(0.02)
        .toColor();

    return [color1, color2];
  }

  static Alignment getGradientBegin(int seed) {
    final values = [Alignment.topLeft, Alignment.topRight, Alignment.topCenter];
    return values[seed % values.length];
  }

  static Alignment getGradientEnd(int seed) {
    final values = [
      Alignment.bottomRight,
      Alignment.bottomLeft,
      Alignment.bottomCenter,
    ];
    return values[seed % values.length];
  }

  static Duration getMicroAnimationDuration(int seed) {
    // Variations between 300ms and 800ms
    final milliseconds = 300 + (seed % 500);
    return Duration(milliseconds: milliseconds);
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:sqflite_common/sqlite_api.dart';

import '../models/grammar_microscope.dart';
import 'canonical_grammar_compiler.dart';
import 'sqlite_policy.dart';

class GrammarTopic {
  final String id;
  final String level;
  final String titleDe;
  final String titleAr;
  final String explanationMarkdown;
  final String? formulaPattern;
  final int orderIndex;
  final bool isMastered;

  GrammarTopic({
    required this.id,
    required this.level,
    required this.titleDe,
    required this.titleAr,
    required this.explanationMarkdown,
    this.formulaPattern,
    required this.orderIndex,
    this.isMastered = false,
  });

  factory GrammarTopic.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    return GrammarTopic(
      id: map['id'] as String,
      level: map['level'] as String,
      titleDe: map['title_de'] as String,
      titleAr: map['title_ar'] as String,
      explanationMarkdown: map['explanation_markdown'] as String,
      formulaPattern: map['formula_pattern'] as String?,
      orderIndex: map['order_index'] as int,
      isMastered: (map['is_mastered'] as int? ?? 0) == 1,
    );
  }
}

class GrammarQuiz {
  final int? id;
  final String topicId;
  final String question;
  final List<String> options;
  final int correctIndex;
  final String explanation;

  GrammarQuiz({
    this.id,
    required this.topicId,
    required this.question,
    required this.options,
    required this.correctIndex,
    required this.explanation,
  });

  factory GrammarQuiz.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    return GrammarQuiz(
      id: map['id'] as int?,
      topicId: map['topic_id'] as String,
      question: map['question'] as String,
      options: List<String>.from(json.decode(map['options_json'] as String)),
      correctIndex: map['correct_index'] as int,
      explanation: map['explanation'] as String,
    );
  }
}

abstract interface class GrammarHubRepository {
  Future<List<GrammarTopic>> getTopicsByLevel(String level);
  Future<GrammarTopic?> getTopicDetail(String topicId);
  Future<List<GrammarQuiz>> getQuizzesForTopic(String topicId);
  Future<void> saveTopicMastery(String topicId, bool mastered);
  Future<void> close();
}

/// Optional detailed grammar capability used by the Phase 13 microscope.
/// Keeping this separate preserves compatibility with lightweight hub fakes.
abstract interface class GrammarMicroscopeRepository {
  Future<List<GrammarRuleDetail>> getRulesForTopic(String topicId);
}

class GrammarHubService
    implements GrammarHubRepository, GrammarMicroscopeRepository {
  static const String _dbName = 'grammar_hub.db';
  Database? _db;
  final AppSqlitePolicy _sqlitePolicy;
  final String? _inMemoryPath;

  GrammarHubService({DatabaseFactory? factory, String? path})
      : _sqlitePolicy = AppSqlitePolicy(factory: factory),
        _inMemoryPath = path;

  Future<Database> get database async {
    if (_db != null) return _db!;
    _db = await _initDB();
    return _db!;
  }

  Future<Database> _initDB() async {
    final path = await _sqlitePolicy.resolvePath(
      fileName: _dbName,
      overridePath: _inMemoryPath,
    );
    return _sqlitePolicy.openWritable(
      path: path,
      version: CanonicalGrammarCompiler.databaseVersion,
      onCreate: _createDB,
      onUpgrade: _upgradeDB,
    );
  }

  Future _createDB(Database db, int version) async {
    await CanonicalGrammarCompiler.rebuild(db);
  }

  Future<void> _upgradeDB(Database db, int oldVersion, int newVersion) async {
    if (oldVersion < CanonicalGrammarCompiler.databaseVersion) {
      await CanonicalGrammarCompiler.rebuild(db);
    }
  }

  Future<List<GrammarTopic>> getTopicsByLevel(String level) async {
    final db = await database;
    final maps = await db.query(
      'grammar_topic_runtime',
      where: 'level = ?',
      whereArgs: [level],
      orderBy: 'order_index ASC',
    );
    return maps.map((e) => GrammarTopic.fromMap(e)).toList();
  }

  Future<GrammarTopic?> getTopicDetail(String topicId) async {
    final db = await database;
    final maps = await db.query(
      'grammar_topic_runtime',
      where: 'id = ?',
      whereArgs: [topicId],
    );
    if (maps.isNotEmpty) {
      return GrammarTopic.fromMap(maps.first);
    }
    return null;
  }

  Future<List<GrammarQuiz>> getQuizzesForTopic(String topicId) async {
    final db = await database;
    final maps = await db.query(
      'grammar_quizzes',
      where: 'topic_id = ?',
      whereArgs: [topicId],
    );
    return maps.map((e) => GrammarQuiz.fromMap(e)).toList();
  }

  @override
  Future<List<GrammarRuleDetail>> getRulesForTopic(String topicId) async {
    final safeTopicId = topicId.trim();
    if (safeTopicId.isEmpty || safeTopicId.length > 160) {
      return const <GrammarRuleDetail>[];
    }

    final db = await database;
    final ruleRows = await db.query(
      'grammar_rules',
      where: 'topic_id = ?',
      whereArgs: <Object?>[safeTopicId],
      orderBy: 'order_index ASC',
      limit: 100,
    );
    final result = <GrammarRuleDetail>[];

    for (final row in ruleRows) {
      final ruleId = _boundedText(row['id'], maxLength: 160);
      if (ruleId.isEmpty) continue;
      final tableRows = await db.query(
        'grammar_rule_rows',
        where: 'rule_id = ?',
        whereArgs: <Object?>[ruleId],
        orderBy: 'row_index ASC',
        limit: 100,
      );
      final exampleRows = await db.query(
        'grammar_examples',
        where: 'rule_id = ?',
        whereArgs: <Object?>[ruleId],
        orderBy: 'example_index ASC',
        limit: 100,
      );

      result.add(
        GrammarRuleDetail(
          id: ruleId,
          topicId: safeTopicId,
          title: _boundedText(row['title']),
          explanationAr: _boundedText(row['explanation_ar']),
          orderIndex: _safeInt(row['order_index']),
          table: tableRows
              .map((entry) => _decodeCells(entry['cells_json']))
              .where((cells) => cells.isNotEmpty)
              .toList(growable: false),
          examples: exampleRows
              .map(
                (entry) => GrammarExampleDetail(
                  german: _boundedText(entry['german']),
                  arabic: _boundedText(entry['arabic']),
                ),
              )
              .where(
                (example) =>
                    example.german.isNotEmpty || example.arabic.isNotEmpty,
              )
              .toList(growable: false),
        ),
      );
    }
    return List<GrammarRuleDetail>.unmodifiable(result);
  }

  static List<String> _decodeCells(Object? raw) {
    if (raw is! String || raw.length > 64 * 1024) {
      return const <String>[];
    }
    try {
      final decoded = json.decode(raw);
      if (decoded is! List) return const <String>[];
      return decoded
          .map((value) => _boundedText(value))
          .where((value) => value.isNotEmpty)
          .take(16)
          .toList(growable: false);
    } on Object {
      return const <String>[];
    }
  }

  static String _boundedText(Object? raw, {int maxLength = 4000}) {
    final value = raw?.toString().trim() ?? '';
    if (value.isEmpty) return '';
    return value.length <= maxLength ? value : value.substring(0, maxLength);
  }

  static int _safeInt(Object? raw) =>
      raw is num ? raw.toInt() : int.tryParse(raw?.toString() ?? '') ?? 0;

  Future<void> saveTopicMastery(String topicId, bool mastered) async {
    final db = await database;
    await db.update(
      'grammar_topics',
      {'is_mastered': mastered ? 1 : 0},
      where: 'id = ?',
      whereArgs: [topicId],
    );
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    if (_db != null) {
      await _db!.close();
      _db = null;
    }
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';

enum LearnerPersistenceFailureCode { payloadTooLarge, writeFailed }

final class LearnerPersistenceFailure implements Exception {
  const LearnerPersistenceFailure(this.code);

  final LearnerPersistenceFailureCode code;

  @override
  String toString() => 'LearnerPersistenceFailure($code)';
}

enum ReviewAttemptApplyStatus {
  applied,
  alreadyApplied,
}

final class ReviewAttemptApplyResult {
  const ReviewAttemptApplyResult({
    required this.status,
    required this.state,
  });

  final ReviewAttemptApplyStatus status;
  final LearnerState state;

  bool get alreadyApplied =>
      status == ReviewAttemptApplyStatus.alreadyApplied;
}

final class ReviewAttemptApplyException implements Exception {
  const ReviewAttemptApplyException(this.code);

  final String code;

  @override
  String toString() => 'ReviewAttemptApplyException($code)';
}

final class LegacyGamificationSeed {
  const LegacyGamificationSeed({
    required this.xp,
    required this.streak,
  });

  final int xp;
  final int streak;
}

/// Owns the physical representation and migration of persisted learner state.
/// It contains no learner-domain orchestration and no UI/authentication logic.
class LearnerPersistence {
  LearnerPersistence(this.prefs, this.storageKey, this.legacyFavoriteKey);

  final PreferencesService prefs;
  final String storageKey;
  final String legacyFavoriteKey;

  LearnerStateDatabase? _sqliteDatabase;
  LearnerMigrationRecord? _cutoverRecord;
  LearnerSqliteSnapshot? _sqliteSnapshot;
  LearnerState? _legacyStateCache;
  bool _closed = false;
  static const maxAttempts = 2000;
  static const maxCollectionItems = 20000;
  static const maxReviewStorageKeyLength = 1024;
  static const maxXp = 10000000;
  static const maxStreak = 10000;
  static const maxMistakeProgress = 5000;
  static const maxPayloadBytes = 4 * 1024 * 1024;

  bool get hasVerifiedSqliteAuthority =>
      _sqliteDatabase != null &&
      _cutoverRecord != null &&
      _sqliteSnapshot != null;

  Future<void> bindVerifiedSqliteAuthority({
    required LearnerStateDatabase database,
    required LearnerMigrationRecord migrationRecord,
  }) async {
    if (_closed) {
      throw const LearnerPersistenceSqliteException(
        'learner_persistence_closed',
      );
    }

    final revision = await database.loadRevision();
    if (revision < migrationRecord.cutoverRevision) {
      throw const LearnerPersistenceSqliteException(
        'learner_store_revision_regressed',
      );
    }

    final snapshot = await database.readSnapshot();
    if (revision == migrationRecord.cutoverRevision) {
      final hash =
          await LegacyLearnerSnapshotReader.canonicalSnapshotSha256(
        snapshot,
      );
      if (hash != migrationRecord.importedSnapshotSha256 ||
          snapshot.attempts.length != migrationRecord.attemptCount ||
          snapshot.assessmentHistory.length !=
              migrationRecord.assessmentCount ||
          snapshot.placementHistory.length !=
              migrationRecord.placementCount ||
          snapshot.favoriteVerbs.length !=
              migrationRecord.favoriteCount) {
        throw const LearnerPersistenceSqliteException(
          'verified_learner_sqlite_snapshot_mismatch',
        );
      }
    }

    _sqliteDatabase = database;
    _cutoverRecord = migrationRecord;
    _sqliteSnapshot = snapshot;
    _legacyStateCache = _loadLegacy();
  }

  Future<bool> canUseLegacyRollbackBuffer() async {
    final database = _sqliteDatabase;
    final record = _cutoverRecord;
    if (database == null || record == null) return true;
    try {
      final revision = await database.loadRevision();
      return revision <= record.cutoverRevision;
    } on Object {
      return false;
    }
  }

  LegacyGamificationSeed loadLegacyGamificationSeed() {
    final legacy = _legacyStateCache ?? _loadLegacy();
    return LegacyGamificationSeed(
      xp: legacy.xp,
      streak: legacy.streak,
    );
  }

  LearnerState load() {
    final legacy = _legacyStateCache ?? _loadLegacy();
    final snapshot = _sqliteSnapshot;
    if (!hasVerifiedSqliteAuthority || snapshot == null) {
      return LearnerState(
        xp: 0,
        streak: 0,
        learned: legacy.learned,
        review: legacy.review,
        favoriteVerbs: legacy.favoriteVerbs,
        reviewCards: legacy.reviewCards,
        attempts: legacy.attempts,
        assessmentHistory: legacy.assessmentHistory,
        placementHistory: legacy.placementHistory,
        updatedAt: legacy.updatedAt,
      );
    }
    return LearnerState(
      xp: 0,
      streak: 0,
      learned: legacy.learned,
      review: legacy.review,
      favoriteVerbs: snapshot.favoriteVerbs,
      reviewCards: legacy.reviewCards,
      attempts: snapshot.attempts,
      assessmentHistory: snapshot.assessmentHistory,
      placementHistory: snapshot.placementHistory,
      updatedAt: legacy.updatedAt,
    );
  }

  LearnerState _loadLegacy() {
    try {
      final raw = prefs.getString(storageKey);
      if (raw == null || raw.length > 4 * 1024 * 1024)
        return LearnerState(updatedAt: DateTime.now());
      final decoded = jsonDecode(raw);
      if (decoded is! Map) return LearnerState(updatedAt: DateTime.now());
      final j = <String, dynamic>{};
      for (final entry in decoded.entries) {
        if (entry.key is String) j[entry.key as String] = entry.value;
      }
      final attempts = <Attempt>[];
      final attemptsRaw = j['attempts'];
      if (attemptsRaw is List) {
        for (final value in attemptsRaw.take(maxAttempts)) {
          if (value is! Map) continue;
          try {
            final normalized = _normalizeAttempt(
              Attempt.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>.from(value)),
            );
            if (normalized.id.isNotEmpty && normalized.itemId.isNotEmpty)
              attempts.add(
                  normalized); // Ignore one corrupt record rather than discarding all progress.
          } catch (_) {}
        }
      }
      final now = DateTime.now();
      var updatedAt =
          DateTime.tryParse(j['updatedAt']?.toString() ?? '') ?? now;
      if (updatedAt.isAfter(now.add(const Duration(days: 1)))) updatedAt = now;
      final reviewCards = <String, ReviewCard>{};
      final cardsRaw = j['reviewCards'];
      if (cardsRaw is Map) {
        for (final entry in cardsRaw.entries.take(maxCollectionItems)) {
          final key = entry.key.toString().trim();
          if (key.isEmpty ||
              key.length > maxReviewStorageKeyLength ||
              entry.value is! Map) {
            continue;
          }
          try {
            final card = ReviewCard.fromJson(
              Map<String, dynamic>.from(entry.value as Map),
            );
            if (card.facetKey.isValid && card.storageKey == key) {
              reviewCards[key] = card;
            }
          } catch (_) {}
        }
      }
      final history = <AssessmentHistory>[];
      final historyRaw = j['assessmentHistory'];
      if (historyRaw is List) {
        for (final value in historyRaw.take(100)) {
          if (value is Map) {
            try {
              final normalized = AssessmentHistory.fromJson(
                Map<String, dynamic>.from(value),
              );
              if (normalized.id.isNotEmpty) history.add(normalized);
            } catch (_) {}
          }
        }
      }
      final placementHistory = <PlacementDiagnosticRecord>[];
      final placementRaw = j['placementHistory'];
      if (placementRaw is List) {
        for (final value in placementRaw.take(20)) {
          if (value is! Map) continue;
          try {
            final record = PlacementDiagnosticRecord.fromJson(
              Map<String, dynamic>.from(value),
            );
            if (record.id.isNotEmpty) placementHistory.add(record);
          } catch (_) {}
        }
      }
      final legacyReview = _boundedStrings(j['review']);
      final migratedCards = {...reviewCards};
      for (final id in legacyReview)
        migratedCards.putIfAbsent(id, () => ReviewCard(itemId: id, dueAt: now));
      return LearnerState(
        xp: _boundedInt(j['xp'], 0, maxXp),
        streak: _boundedInt(j['streak'], 0, maxStreak),
        learned: _boundedStrings(j['learned']),
        favoriteVerbs: _boundedStrings(j['favoriteVerbs']),
        reviewCards: migratedCards,
        review: legacyReview,
        attempts: attempts,
        assessmentHistory: history,
        placementHistory: placementHistory,
        updatedAt: updatedAt,
      );
    } catch (_) {
      return LearnerState(updatedAt: DateTime.now());
    }
  }

  Future<void> save(LearnerState state) async {
    final normalized = normalize(state);
    final rollback = _legacyStateCache ?? _loadLegacy();

    if (!hasVerifiedSqliteAuthority) {
      final legacyOnly = LearnerState(
        xp: rollback.xp,
        streak: rollback.streak,
        learned: normalized.learned,
        review: normalized.review,
        favoriteVerbs: normalized.favoriteVerbs,
        reviewCards: normalized.reviewCards,
        attempts: normalized.attempts,
        assessmentHistory: normalized.assessmentHistory,
        placementHistory: normalized.placementHistory,
        updatedAt: normalized.updatedAt,
      );
      await _writeLegacy(legacyOnly);
      return;
    }

    final legacyOnly = LearnerState(
      xp: rollback.xp,
      streak: rollback.streak,
      learned: normalized.learned,
      review: normalized.review,
      favoriteVerbs: rollback.favoriteVerbs,
      reviewCards: normalized.reviewCards,
      attempts: rollback.attempts,
      assessmentHistory: rollback.assessmentHistory,
      placementHistory: rollback.placementHistory,
      updatedAt: normalized.updatedAt,
    );
    await _writeLegacy(legacyOnly);
    _legacyStateCache = legacyOnly;
  }

  Future<void> _writeLegacy(LearnerState state) async {
    final payload = jsonEncode(_toJson(state));
    final encodedPayloadBytes = utf8.encode(payload);
    if (encodedPayloadBytes.length > maxPayloadBytes) {
      throw const LearnerPersistenceFailure(
        LearnerPersistenceFailureCode.payloadTooLarge,
      );
    }
    if (!await prefs.setString(storageKey, payload)) {
      throw const LearnerPersistenceFailure(
        LearnerPersistenceFailureCode.writeFailed,
      );
    }
    if (hasVerifiedSqliteAuthority) {
      _legacyStateCache = state;
    }
  }

  Future<ReviewAttemptApplyResult> applyReviewAttemptOnce({
    required String reviewEventId,
    required Attempt attempt,
  }) async {
    final normalizedReviewEventId = reviewEventId.trim();
    if (normalizedReviewEventId.isEmpty ||
        normalizedReviewEventId.length > 160) {
      throw const ReviewAttemptApplyException(
        'invalid_review_event_id',
      );
    }
    if (attempt.id.trim() != normalizedReviewEventId) {
      throw const ReviewAttemptApplyException(
        'review_attempt_event_id_mismatch',
      );
    }

    final normalizedAttempt = _normalizeAttempt(attempt);
    if (normalizedAttempt.id != normalizedReviewEventId ||
        normalizedAttempt.itemId.isEmpty) {
      throw const ReviewAttemptApplyException(
        'invalid_review_attempt_identity',
      );
    }

    final database = _sqliteDatabase;
    if (hasVerifiedSqliteAuthority && database != null) {
      final result = await database.applyAttemptOnce(normalizedAttempt);
      if (!result.alreadyApplied) {
        await _refreshSqliteSnapshot();
      }
      return ReviewAttemptApplyResult(
        status: result.alreadyApplied
            ? ReviewAttemptApplyStatus.alreadyApplied
            : ReviewAttemptApplyStatus.applied,
        state: load(),
      );
    }

    final current = load();
    final existing = current.attempts
        .where((candidate) => candidate.id == normalizedReviewEventId)
        .toList(growable: false);
    if (existing.isNotEmpty) {
      final allMatch = existing.every(
        (candidate) => _attemptsEquivalent(
          _normalizeAttempt(candidate),
          normalizedAttempt,
        ),
      );
      if (!allMatch) {
        throw const ReviewAttemptApplyException(
          'review_attempt_payload_mismatch',
        );
      }
      return ReviewAttemptApplyResult(
        status: ReviewAttemptApplyStatus.alreadyApplied,
        state: current,
      );
    }

    final attempts = <Attempt>[
      ...current.attempts,
      normalizedAttempt,
    ];
    final boundedAttempts = attempts.length > maxAttempts
        ? attempts.sublist(attempts.length - maxAttempts)
        : attempts;
    final next = normalize(
      current.copyWith(attempts: boundedAttempts),
    );
    await save(next);
    return ReviewAttemptApplyResult(
      status: ReviewAttemptApplyStatus.applied,
      state: load(),
    );
  }

  Future<LearnerState> recordAssessmentOnce(
    AssessmentHistory assessment,
  ) async {
    final database = _sqliteDatabase;
    if (hasVerifiedSqliteAuthority && database != null) {
      final result = await database.recordAssessmentOnce(
        _normalizeAssessmentHistory(assessment),
      );
      if (!result.alreadyApplied) {
        await _refreshSqliteSnapshot();
      }
      return load();
    }

    final current = load();
    final existing = current.assessmentHistory
        .where((item) => item.id == assessment.id)
        .toList(growable: false);
    if (existing.isNotEmpty) {
      if (!existing.every(
        (item) => _assessmentsEquivalent(item, assessment),
      )) {
        throw const LearnerPersistenceSqliteException(
          'assessment_payload_mismatch',
        );
      }
      return current;
    }
    final history = <AssessmentHistory>[
      _normalizeAssessmentHistory(assessment),
      ...current.assessmentHistory,
    ].take(100).toList(growable: false);
    final next = normalize(
      current.copyWith(assessmentHistory: history),
    );
    await save(next);
    return next;
  }

  Future<LearnerState> recordPlacementOnce(
    PlacementDiagnosticRecord placement,
  ) async {
    final database = _sqliteDatabase;
    if (hasVerifiedSqliteAuthority && database != null) {
      final result = await database.recordPlacementOnce(placement);
      if (!result.alreadyApplied) {
        await _refreshSqliteSnapshot();
      }
      return load();
    }

    final current = load();
    final existing = current.placementHistory
        .where((item) => item.id == placement.id)
        .toList(growable: false);
    if (existing.isNotEmpty) {
      if (!existing.every(
        (item) => _placementsEquivalent(item, placement),
      )) {
        throw const LearnerPersistenceSqliteException(
          'placement_payload_mismatch',
        );
      }
      return current;
    }
    final history = <PlacementDiagnosticRecord>[
      placement,
      ...current.placementHistory,
    ].take(20).toList(growable: false);
    final next = normalize(
      current.copyWith(placementHistory: history),
    );
    await save(next);
    return next;
  }

  Future<LearnerState> setFavoriteMembership(
    String verb, {
    required bool isFavorite,
  }) async {
    final value = verb.trim();
    if (value.isEmpty || value.length > 160) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        verb,
        'verb',
        'must be 1..160 characters',
      );
    }

    final database = _sqliteDatabase;
    if (hasVerifiedSqliteAuthority && database != null) {
      final result = await database.setFavoriteMembership(
        verb: value,
        isFavorite: isFavorite,
      );
      if (!result.alreadyApplied) {
        await _refreshSqliteSnapshot();
      }
      return load();
    }

    final current = load();
    final favorites = <String>{...current.favoriteVerbs};
    if (isFavorite) {
      if (favorites.length >= maxCollectionItems &&
          !favorites.contains(value)) {
        throw const LearnerPersistenceSqliteException(
          'favorite_row_bound_exceeded',
        );
      }
      favorites.add(value);
    } else {
      favorites.remove(value);
    }
    final next = normalize(
      current.copyWith(favoriteVerbs: favorites),
    );
    await save(next);
    return next;
  }

  Future<void> _refreshSqliteSnapshot() async {
    final database = _sqliteDatabase;
    final record = _cutoverRecord;
    if (database == null || record == null) {
      throw const LearnerPersistenceSqliteException(
        'sqlite_authority_not_bound',
      );
    }
    try {
      _sqliteSnapshot = await database.readSnapshot();
    } on Object {
      final revision = await database.loadRevision();
      if (revision > record.cutoverRevision) {
        throw const LearnerPersistenceSqliteException(
          'stale_legacy_fallback_forbidden',
        );
      }
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<LearnerState> loadAndMigrateFavoriteVerbs(
    LearnerState current,
  ) async {
    if (hasVerifiedSqliteAuthority) {
      return load();
    }
    final legacy = prefs.getStringList(legacyFavoriteKey) ?? const <String>[];
    if (legacy.isEmpty) return current;
    final merged = {...current.favoriteVerbs, ..._boundedStrings(legacy)};
    final persisted = normalize(current.copyWith(favoriteVerbs: merged));
    await save(persisted);
    return persisted;
  }

  Future<bool> clearLocalData() async {
    var success = true;
    try {
      final database = _sqliteDatabase;
      if (database != null) {
        await database.clearAuthoritativeStateForUserReset();
        await database.close();
        _sqliteDatabase = null;
        _cutoverRecord = null;
        _sqliteSnapshot = null;
        _legacyStateCache = null;
      }
      final hadPrimary = prefs.getString(storageKey) != null;
      final hadLegacy = prefs.getStringList(legacyFavoriteKey) != null;
      if (hadPrimary && !await prefs.remove(storageKey)) success = false;
      if (hadLegacy && !await prefs.remove(legacyFavoriteKey)) success = false;
      return success;
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    _closed = true;
    final database = _sqliteDatabase;
    _sqliteDatabase = null;
    _cutoverRecord = null;
    _sqliteSnapshot = null;
    if (database != null) {
      await database.close();
    }
  }

  LearnerState normalize(LearnerState s) => _normalizeForPersistence(s);

  LearnerState _normalizeForPersistence(LearnerState s) {
    final normalizedCards = _normalizeReviewCards(s.reviewCards);
    final normalizedLearned = _boundedStringSet(s.learned);
    final normalizedReview = _boundedStringSet(s.review);
    final normalizedFavorites = _boundedStringSet(s.favoriteVerbs);
    final now = DateTime.now();
    var normalizedUpdatedAt = s.updatedAt.isBefore(now) ? now : s.updatedAt;
    if (normalizedUpdatedAt.isAfter(now.add(const Duration(days: 1))))
      normalizedUpdatedAt = now;
    for (final id in normalizedReview)
      normalizedCards.putIfAbsent(id, () => ReviewCard(itemId: id, dueAt: now));
    return LearnerState(
      xp: s.xp.clamp(0, maxXp),
      streak: s.streak.clamp(0, maxStreak),
      learned: normalizedLearned,
      review: normalizedReview,
      favoriteVerbs: normalizedFavorites,
      reviewCards: normalizedCards,
      attempts: (s.attempts.length > maxAttempts
              ? s.attempts.sublist(s.attempts.length - maxAttempts)
              : List<Attempt>.from(s.attempts))
          .map(_normalizeAttempt)
          .where(
            (a) => a.id.trim().isNotEmpty && a.itemId.trim().isNotEmpty,
          )
          .toList(),
      assessmentHistory: s.assessmentHistory
          .take(100)
          .map(_normalizeAssessmentHistory)
          .where((h) => h.id.trim().isNotEmpty)
          .toList(),
      placementHistory: s.placementHistory
          .take(20)
          .map((record) => PlacementDiagnosticRecord.fromJson(record.toJson()))
          .where((record) => record.id.trim().isNotEmpty)
          .toList(),
      updatedAt: normalizedUpdatedAt,
    );
  }

  static Attempt _normalizeAttempt(Attempt a) {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final safeAt = a.at.isAfter(now.add(const Duration(days: 1))) ? now : a.at;
    return Attempt(
      id: a.id.toString().trim().length > 160
          ? a.id.toString().trim().substring(0, 160)
          : a.id.toString().trim(),
      itemId: a.itemId.toString().trim().length > 160
          ? a.itemId.toString().trim().substring(0, 160)
          : a.itemId.toString().trim(),
      skill: a.skill.toString().trim().length > 160
          ? a.skill.toString().trim().substring(0, 160)
          : a.skill.toString().trim(),
      answer: a.answer.length > 1000 ? a.answer.substring(0, 1000) : a.answer,
      correct: a.correct,
      hinted: a.hinted,
      seconds: a.seconds.clamp(0, 3600),
      at: safeAt,
      facetType: a.facetType,
      variantKey: ReviewFacetKey.normalizeVariant(a.variantKey),
    );
  }

  static bool _attemptsEquivalent(Attempt left, Attempt right) =>
      left.id == right.id &&
      left.itemId == right.itemId &&
      left.skill == right.skill &&
      left.answer == right.answer &&
      left.correct == right.correct &&
      left.hinted == right.hinted &&
      left.seconds == right.seconds &&
      left.at.toUtc().microsecondsSinceEpoch ==
          right.at.toUtc().microsecondsSinceEpoch &&
      left.facetType == right.facetType &&
      ReviewFacetKey.normalizeVariant(left.variantKey) ==
          ReviewFacetKey.normalizeVariant(right.variantKey);

  static bool _assessmentsEquivalent(
    AssessmentHistory left,
    AssessmentHistory right,
  ) =>
      left.id == right.id &&
      left.at.toUtc().microsecondsSinceEpoch ==
          right.at.toUtc().microsecondsSinceEpoch &&
      left.score == right.score &&
      left.answered == right.answered &&
      _orderedStringsEqual(left.weakSkills, right.weakSkills);

  static bool _placementsEquivalent(
    PlacementDiagnosticRecord left,
    PlacementDiagnosticRecord right,
  ) {
    if (left.id != right.id ||
        left.at.toUtc().microsecondsSinceEpoch !=
            right.at.toUtc().microsecondsSinceEpoch ||
        left.answered != right.answered ||
        left.scoredAnswers != right.scoredAnswers ||
        left.score != right.score ||
        left.confidence != right.confidence ||
        left.band != right.band ||
        left.curriculumStartLevel != right.curriculumStartLevel ||
        left.recommendedStartTaskOrder !=
            right.recommendedStartTaskOrder ||
        left.learningGoal != right.learningGoal ||
        !_orderedStringsEqual(left.reviewItemIds, right.reviewItemIds) ||
        left.weakDimensions.length != right.weakDimensions.length ||
        left.dimensionScores.length != right.dimensionScores.length) {
      return false;
    }
    for (var index = 0;
        index < left.weakDimensions.length;
        index += 1) {
      if (left.weakDimensions[index] != right.weakDimensions[index]) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    for (final entry in left.dimensionScores.entries) {
      if (right.dimensionScores[entry.key] != entry.value) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  static bool _orderedStringsEqual(
    List<String> left,
    List<String> right,
  ) {
    if (left.length != right.length) return false;
    for (var index = 0; index < left.length; index += 1) {
      if (left[index] != right[index]) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  static Map<String, ReviewCard> _normalizeReviewCards(
    Map<String, ReviewCard> source,
  ) {
    final result = <String, ReviewCard>{};
    for (final entry in source.entries.take(maxCollectionItems)) {
      final id = entry.key.trim();
      if (id.isEmpty || id.length > maxReviewStorageKeyLength) continue;
      final card = _normalizeReviewCard(id, entry.value);
      if (card != null) result[id] = card;
    }
    return result;
  }

  static ReviewCard? _normalizeReviewCard(String key, ReviewCard card) {
    final normalized = ReviewCard.fromJson(card.toJson());
    if (!normalized.facetKey.isValid) return null;
    return normalized.storageKey == key ? normalized : null;
  }

  static AssessmentHistory _normalizeAssessmentHistory(AssessmentHistory h) =>
      AssessmentHistory.fromJson(h.toJson());
  static Map<String, dynamic> _toJson(LearnerState s) => {
        'xp': s.xp,
        'streak': s.streak,
        'learned': s.learned.toList(),
        'review': s.review.toList(),
        'favoriteVerbs': s.favoriteVerbs.toList(),
        'reviewCards': Map.fromEntries(
          s.reviewCards.entries.map((e) => MapEntry(e.key, e.value.toJson())),
        ),
        'assessmentHistory':
            s.assessmentHistory.map((x) => x.toJson()).toList(),
        'placementHistory': s.placementHistory.map((x) => x.toJson()).toList(),
        'attempts': s.attempts.map((x) => x.toJson()).toList(),
        'updatedAt': s.updatedAt.toIso8601String(),
      };
  static int _boundedInt(Object? value, int min, int max) =>
      ((value is num ? value.toInt() : int.tryParse(value?.toString() ?? '')) ??
              min)
          .clamp(min, max);
  static Set<String> _boundedStringSet(Iterable<String> values) => values
      .map((x) => x.trim())
      .where((x) => x.isNotEmpty && x.length <= 160)
      .take(maxCollectionItems)
      .toSet();
  static Set<String> _boundedStrings(Object? value) => value is List
      ? value
          .whereType<String>()
          .map((x) => x.trim())
          .where((x) => x.isNotEmpty && x.length <= 160)
          .take(maxCollectionItems)
          .toSet()
      : <String>{};
}


final class LearnerPersistenceSqliteException implements Exception {
  const LearnerPersistenceSqliteException(this.code);

  final String code;

  @override
  String toString() => 'LearnerPersistenceSqliteException($code)';
}

import '../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../language/language_exercise_strategy.dart';
import '../language/language_content_quality.dart';
import '../language/language_content_intelligence.dart';
import '../models/learner.dart';
import '../models/learning_path.dart';
import 'adaptive_teacher.dart';
import 'memory.dart';
import 'mistake_engine.dart';
import '../models/mistake.dart';
import 'vocabulary_coach.dart';
import 'mastery.dart';
import 'adaptive_focus.dart';
import 'learning_intelligence.dart';
import 'production_engine.dart';

class LearningEngine {
  static LearningPath buildPlan(
    List<LearningContent> items,
    LearnerState state, {
    required LanguageExerciseStrategy exerciseStrategy,
    required LanguageContentQuality contentQuality,
    required LanguageContentIntelligence contentIntelligence,
    DateTime? now,
    int dailyGoal = 10,
  }) {
    final at = now ?? DateTime.now();
    final goal = dailyGoal.clamp(5, 20).toInt();
    final eligible =
        items.where((x) => contentQuality.issues(x).isEmpty).toList();
    final eligibleById = <String, LearningContent>{
      for (final item in eligible) item.id: item,
    };
    final meaningAttempts = state.meaningAttempts.toList(growable: false);
    final attemptsByItem = <String, List<Attempt>>{};
    for (final attempt in meaningAttempts) {
      (attemptsByItem[attempt.itemId] ??= <Attempt>[]).add(attempt);
    }
    final teacher = AdaptiveTeacher.next(state, now: at);
    final weak = teacher.skill;
    final mistakes = MistakeEngine.from(
      meaningAttempts,
      eligible,
      now: at,
    ).items;
    final due = MemoryQueue.rank(
      state.meaningReviewCards,
      now: at,
      limit: goal,
    );
    final teacherBudget = teacher.itemCount.clamp(1, goal).toInt();
    final reviewBoost = (teacher.reviewPressure * 12).round();
    var selected = <LearningPathItem>[];
    final seen = <String>{};
    void add(String id, String mode, String reason, int priority) {
      if (!seen.add(id) || selected.length >= goal) return;
      final item = eligibleById[id];
      if (item != null)
        selected.add(
          LearningPathItem(
            item: item,
            mode: mode,
            reason: reason,
            priority: priority,
          ),
        );
    }

    for (final card in due)
      add(
        card.itemId,
        'review',
        MemoryQueue.reason(card, now: at).name,
        120 + MemoryQueue.priority(card, at).round() + reviewBoost,
      );
    for (final m in mistakes) {
      if (selected.length >= goal) break;
      add(
        m.itemId,
        _modeForMistake(m.category),
        '${m.diagnosis} • ${m.errorCount} أخطاء من ${m.attemptCount} محاولات',
        90 + m.severity,
      );
    }
    final coached = VocabularyCoach.recommend(
      eligible,
      state,
      contentQuality: contentQuality,
      limit: eligible.length,
      now: at,
    );
    final priorityById = <String, int>{
      for (final item in coached)
        item.id: _itemPriority(item, attemptsByItem, weak),
    };
    final remaining = [...coached];
    final intelligenceLimit =
        (goal * 3).clamp(20, 120).clamp(1, remaining.length).toInt();
    final intelligenceCandidates =
        remaining.take(intelligenceLimit).toList(growable: false);
    final intelligence = LearningIntelligence.rankSession(
      intelligenceCandidates,
      state,
      contentIntelligence: contentIntelligence,
      now: at,
      limit: intelligenceLimit,
    );
    final intelligenceById = {for (final d in intelligence) d.itemId: d};
    while (selected.length < goal && remaining.isNotEmpty) {
      var bestIndex = 0;
      var bestScore = double.negativeInfinity;
      for (var i = 0; i < remaining.length; i++) {
        final candidate = remaining[i];
        final score = (priorityById[candidate.id] ?? 0) -
            _topicPenalty(candidate, selected) +
            (intelligenceById[candidate.id]?.priority ?? 0) * .35;
        if (score > bestScore) {
          bestScore = score;
          bestIndex = i;
        }
      }
      final item = remaining.removeAt(bestIndex);
      const _topicCap = 2;
      if (_topicCount(selected, item.topic) >= _topicCap &&
          _hasTopicAlternative(remaining, selected)) continue;
      final decision = intelligenceById[item.id];
      final itemAttempts = attemptsByItem[item.id] ?? const <Attempt>[];
      final adaptiveMode = AdaptiveFocus.modeForRows(
        item.id,
        itemAttempts,
        reviewCard: state.reviewCards[item.id],
        now: at,
      );
      final selectedMode = decision?.recommendedMode ?? adaptiveMode;
      final hasHistory = itemAttempts.isNotEmpty;
      if (!hasHistory &&
          teacher.newContentReadiness < .5 &&
          selected.length >= teacherBudget) continue;
      final mastery = Mastery.forItemRows(
        item.id,
        itemAttempts,
        reviewCard: state.reviewCards[item.id],
        now: at,
      );
      final isWeak = item.skill == weak || hasHistory;
      final contentProfile = contentIntelligence.profile(item);
      final curriculumPenalty = !hasHistory &&
              teacher.newContentReadiness < .70 &&
              contentProfile.inferredLevel == ContentLevel.b1
          ? 30
          : 0;
      final productionTask =
          (selectedMode == 'production' || item.skill == 'production')
              ? ProductionEngine.buildFor(
                  item,
                  exerciseStrategy: exerciseStrategy,
                  isLearnable: contentQuality.isLearnable,
                )
              : null;
      final productionHint =
          productionTask == null ? '' : ' • ${productionTask.prompt}';
      add(
        item.id,
        hasHistory ? selectedMode : 'new',
        hasHistory
            ? '${decision?.reason ?? 'تدريب موجّه: ${mastery.nextAction}'} • المراجعة التالية خلال ${mastery.nextReviewDays} يوم.$productionHint'
            : (teacher.newContentReadiness < .75
                ? 'محتوى جديد بجرعة محسوبة حسب جاهزيتك.$productionHint'
                : 'اختيار ذكي من مفردات مناسبة لمسارك.$productionHint'),
        isWeak
            ? 70
            : ((30 + (teacher.newContentReadiness * 10).round()) -
                curriculumPenalty),
      );
    }
    selected = _interleave(selected);
    final reviewCount = selected.where((x) => x.mode == 'review').length;
    final repairCount = selected.where((x) => x.mode == 'repair').length;
    final newCount = selected.where((x) => x.mode == 'new').length;
    return LearningPath(
      items: selected,
      focusSkill: weak,
      reviewCount: reviewCount,
      repairCount: repairCount,
      newCount: newCount,
      listeningCount: _balancedCount(selected, 'listening'),
      productionCount: _balancedCount(selected, 'production'),
    );
  }

  static String _modeForMistake(MistakeCategory category) {
    switch (category) {
      case MistakeCategory.listening:
        return 'listening';
      case MistakeCategory.production:
      case MistakeCategory.writing:
        return 'production';
      case MistakeCategory.translation:
      case MistakeCategory.grammar:
      case MistakeCategory.wordOrder:
        return 'transfer';
      case MistakeCategory.article:
      case MistakeCategory.vocabulary:
        return 'recall';
    }
  }

  static int _itemPriority(
    LearningContent item,
    Map<String, List<Attempt>> attemptsByItem,
    String weak,
  ) {
    final a = attemptsByItem[item.id] ?? const <Attempt>[];
    final e = a.where((x) => !x.correct).length;
    return (item.skill == weak ? 80 : 0) +
        e * 8 +
        (a.isEmpty ? 25 : 0) +
        item.id.hashCode.abs() % 7;
  }

  static int _balancedCount(List<LearningPathItem> items, String mode) => items
      .where((x) => _sessionMode(x) == mode)
      .length
      .clamp(0, items.length)
      .toInt();
  static String _sessionMode(LearningPathItem item) {
    if (item.item.skill == 'listening') return 'listening';
    if (item.item.skill == 'production' || item.mode == 'consolidate')
      return 'production';
    if (item.item.skill == 'transfer') return 'production';
    return 'recall';
  }

  static List<LearningPathItem> _interleave(List<LearningPathItem> source) {
    if (source.length < 3) return source;
    final remaining = [...source];
    final output = <LearningPathItem>[];
    final usedModes = <String>{};
    final usedTopics = <String>{};
    while (remaining.isNotEmpty) {
      remaining.sort((a, b) => b.priority.compareTo(a.priority));
      var index = remaining.indexWhere(
        (x) =>
            !usedModes.contains(x.mode) && !usedTopics.contains(x.item.topic),
      );
      if (index < 0)
        index = remaining.indexWhere((x) => !usedTopics.contains(x.item.topic));
      if (index < 0)
        index = remaining.indexWhere((x) => !usedModes.contains(x.mode));
      if (index < 0) index = 0;
      final item = remaining.removeAt(index);
      output.add(item);
      usedModes.add(item.mode);
      usedTopics.add(item.item.topic);
    }
    return output;
  }

  static int _topicCount(List<LearningPathItem> selected, String topic) =>
      selected.where((x) => x.item.topic == topic).length;
  static bool _hasTopicAlternative(
    List<dynamic> remaining,
    List<LearningPathItem> selected,
  ) {
    final topics = {for (final x in selected) x.item.topic};
    return remaining.any((x) => !topics.contains(x.item.topic));
  }

  static int _topicPenalty(
    LearningContent item,
    List<LearningPathItem> selected,
  ) {
    final same = selected.where((x) => x.item.topic == item.topic).length;
    return same * 18;
  }
}
