import '../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../models/learner.dart';
import '../language/language_content_intelligence.dart';
import '../models/mistake.dart';
import 'adaptive_teacher.dart';
import 'mastery.dart';
import 'memory.dart';
import 'mistake_engine.dart';
import 'srs.dart';

/// V126: one bounded decision layer for the learning engines.
/// It does not replace SRS, mastery or mistake analysis; it reconciles them
/// into one actionable recommendation for a content item.
class LearningDecision {
  final String itemId;
  final String recommendedMode;
  final double priority;
  final String reason;
  final bool newContentAllowed;
  final double mastery;
  final double retrievability;
  final double mistakePressure;

  const LearningDecision({
    required this.itemId,
    required this.recommendedMode,
    required this.priority,
    required this.reason,
    required this.newContentAllowed,
    required this.mastery,
    required this.retrievability,
    required this.mistakePressure,
  });
}

class LearningIntelligence {
  static List<LearningDecision> rankSession(
    List<LearningContent> items,
    LearnerState state, {
    required LanguageContentIntelligence contentIntelligence,
    DateTime? now,
    int limit = 20,
  }) {
    final at = now ?? DateTime.now();
    final teacher = AdaptiveTeacher.next(state, now: at);
    final meaningAttempts = state.meaningAttempts.toList(growable: false);
    final mistakes = MistakeEngine.from(meaningAttempts, items, now: at).items;
    final mistakeById = {for (final m in mistakes) m.itemId: m};
    final dueIds = {
      for (final card in MemoryQueue.rank(
        state.meaningReviewCards,
        now: at,
        limit: 100,
      ))
        card.itemId,
    };
    final attemptsByItem = <String, List<Attempt>>{};
    for (final attempt in meaningAttempts) {
      (attemptsByItem[attempt.itemId] ??= <Attempt>[]).add(attempt);
    }
    final ranked = <LearningDecision>[];
    final cap = limit.clamp(1, 100).toInt();
    for (final item in items) {
      final decision = decide(
        item: item,
        state: state,
        attempts: attemptsByItem[item.id] ?? const <Attempt>[],
        teacher: teacher,
        mistake: mistakeById[item.id],
        contentIntelligence: contentIntelligence,
        now: at,
      );
      final adjusted = dueIds.contains(item.id)
          ? LearningDecision(
              itemId: decision.itemId,
              recommendedMode: 'review',
              priority: (decision.priority + 20).clamp(0.0, 200.0).toDouble(),
              reason: decision.reason,
              newContentAllowed: decision.newContentAllowed,
              mastery: decision.mastery,
              retrievability: decision.retrievability,
              mistakePressure: decision.mistakePressure,
            )
          : decision;
      ranked.add(adjusted);
      if (ranked.length > cap * 2) {
        ranked.sort((a, b) => b.priority.compareTo(a.priority));
        ranked.removeRange(cap, ranked.length);
      }
    }
    ranked.sort((a, b) => b.priority.compareTo(a.priority));
    return ranked.take(cap).toList(growable: false);
  }

  static LearningDecision decide({
    required LearningContent item,
    required LearnerState state,
    required List<Attempt> attempts,
    required TeacherAction teacher,
    MistakeRecord? mistake,
    required LanguageContentIntelligence contentIntelligence,
    DateTime? now,
  }) {
    final at = now ?? DateTime.now();
    final card = state.reviewCards[item.id];
    final evidence = Mastery.forItemRows(
      item.id,
      attempts,
      reviewCard: card,
      now: at,
    );
    final profile = contentIntelligence.profile(item);
    final retrievability = card == null ? 0.0 : _safeRetrievability(card, at);
    final mistakePressure = mistake == null
        ? 0.0
        : ((mistake.severity / 100) * .55 + mistake.recentFailureRate * .45)
            .clamp(0.0, 1.0)
            .toDouble();
    final newAllowed = teacher.newContentReadiness >= .55 &&
        teacher.reviewPressure < .75 &&
        teacher.recentFailureRate < .45;

    var mode = 'new';
    var priority = 25.0;
    var reason = 'محتوى جديد مناسب لجاهزية التعلم الحالية.';
    if (card != null && !card.dueAt.isAfter(at)) {
      mode = 'review';
      priority = 120 + MemoryQueue.priority(card, at);
      reason = 'مراجعة مستحقة؛ نحمي الذاكرة قبل إضافة حمل جديد.';
    } else if (mistake != null && mistakePressure >= .38) {
      mode = _modeForMistake(mistake.category);
      if (mistake.recentFailureRate >= .60) mode = 'repair';
      priority = 85 + mistake.severity * .65 + mistake.recentFailureRate * 30;
      reason = mistake.diagnosis;
    } else if (evidence.skillScores.isNotEmpty &&
        evidence.nextAction != 'consolidate') {
      mode = evidence.nextAction;
      priority = 65 + (1 - evidence.overall) * 45;
      reason = 'الإتقان غير مكتمل؛ نركز على ${evidence.nextAction} بدل التوسع.';
    } else if (!newAllowed && attempts.isEmpty) {
      mode = 'consolidate';
      priority = 48 + teacher.reviewPressure * 20;
      reason = 'نؤجل المحتوى الجديد لأن ضغط المراجعة أو الأخطاء الحديثة مرتفع.';
    } else if (profile.inferredLevel == ContentLevel.b1 &&
        teacher.newContentReadiness < .75) {
      mode = 'consolidate';
      priority = 42;
      reason = 'محتوى أعلى صعوبة؛ نؤجله حتى ترتفع جاهزية المحتوى الجديد.';
    } else if (evidence.isMastered) {
      mode = 'consolidate';
      priority = 40 + (1 - retrievability) * 30;
      reason = 'العنصر متقن؛ نستخدمه للتثبيت والسياق بدل التكرار الخام.';
    }

    return LearningDecision(
      itemId: item.id,
      recommendedMode: mode,
      priority: priority.clamp(0.0, 200.0).toDouble(),
      reason: reason,
      newContentAllowed: newAllowed,
      mastery: evidence.overall,
      retrievability: retrievability,
      mistakePressure: mistakePressure,
    );
  }

  static double _safeRetrievability(ReviewCard card, DateTime now) =>
      SrsAdapter.retrievability(card, now);

  static String _modeForMistake(MistakeCategory category) {
    switch (category) {
      case MistakeCategory.article:
      case MistakeCategory.vocabulary:
        return 'recall';
      case MistakeCategory.listening:
        return 'listening';
      case MistakeCategory.production:
      case MistakeCategory.writing:
        return 'production';
      case MistakeCategory.translation:
      case MistakeCategory.grammar:
      case MistakeCategory.wordOrder:
        return 'transfer';
    }
  }
}

/// Tiny adapter keeps the decision layer independent of SRS implementation
/// details and gives us one seam for future retention-model upgrades.
class SrsAdapter {
  static double retrievability(ReviewCard card, DateTime now) =>
      Srs.retrievability(card, now: now);
}

import 'package:sqflite/sqflite.dart';
import 'package:path/path.dart';

import 'database_migration_helper.dart';

class LocalHeatmapStore {
  static const String _tableName = 'study_activity';
  static const String _columnDate = 'date';
  static const String _columnCount = 'count';

  static final LocalHeatmapStore instance = LocalHeatmapStore._init();
  static Database? _database;

  LocalHeatmapStore._init();

  Future<Database> get database async {
    if (_database != null) return _database!;
    _database = await _initDB('heatmap.db');
    return _database!;
  }

  Future<Database> _initDB(String filePath) async {
    final dbPath = await getDatabasesPath();
    final path = join(dbPath, filePath);

    return await DatabaseMigrationHelper.open(
      path: path,
      version: 1,
      onCreate: _createDB,
      migrationScripts: {},
    );
  }

  Future _createDB(Database db, int version) async {
    await db.execute('''
      CREATE TABLE $_tableName (
        $_columnDate TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        $_columnCount INTEGER NOT NULL
      )
    ''');
  }

  Future<void> logActivity(DateTime date, {int count = 1}) async {
    final db = await instance.database;
    final dateString = _formatDate(date);

    // Using compatible SQLite approach (without UPSERT which needs SQLite 3.24.0+)
    await DatabaseMigrationHelper.executeAtomic(db, (txn) async {
      final maps = await txn.query(
        _tableName,
        where: '$_columnDate = ?',
        whereArgs: [dateString],
      );

      if (maps.isEmpty) {
        await txn.insert(_tableName, {
          _columnDate: dateString,
          _columnCount: count,
        });
      } else {
        final currentCount = maps.first[_columnCount] as int;
        await txn.update(
          _tableName,
          {_columnCount: currentCount + count},
          where: '$_columnDate = ?',
          whereArgs: [dateString],
        );
      }
    });
  }

  Future<Map<DateTime, int>> getYearlyActivity(int year) async {
    final db = await instance.database;
    final yearString = year.toString();

    final maps = await db.query(
      _tableName,
      where: '$_columnDate LIKE ?',
      whereArgs: ['$yearString-%'],
    );

    final result = <DateTime, int>{};
    for (var map in maps) {
      final date = DateTime.parse(map[_columnDate] as String);
      final count = map[_columnCount] as int;
      result[date] = count;
    }

    return result;
  }

  String _formatDate(DateTime date) {
    return '${date.year}-${date.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${date.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    final db = await instance.database;
    db.close();
  }
}

import '../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../language/language_content_intelligence.dart';
import '../models/learner.dart';
import 'mastery.dart';
import 'srs.dart';

/// V124: a decision-oriented mastery snapshot, not a cosmetic progress meter.
class MasteryDashboardSnapshot {
  final double readiness;
  final double retentionRisk;
  final double retrievability;
  final double evidenceStrength;
  final String weakestSkill;
  final String nextAction;
  final int nextReviewDays;
  final int masteredItems;
  final int measuredItems;
  final int dueItems;
  final int overdueItems;
  final int activeErrorItems;
  final List<String> priorityItemIds;
  final ContentIntelligenceReport contentReport;

  const MasteryDashboardSnapshot({
    required this.readiness,
    required this.retentionRisk,
    required this.retrievability,
    required this.evidenceStrength,
    required this.weakestSkill,
    required this.nextAction,
    required this.nextReviewDays,
    required this.masteredItems,
    required this.measuredItems,
    required this.dueItems,
    required this.overdueItems,
    required this.activeErrorItems,
    required this.priorityItemIds,
    required this.contentReport,
  });

  String get readinessLabel => readiness >= .85
      ? 'جاهز'
      : readiness >= .65
          ? 'قريب'
          : readiness >= .45
              ? 'يحتاج تثبيتًا'
              : 'يحتاج علاجًا';
  String get actionLabel =>
      const {
        'review': 'راجع العناصر المعرضة للنسيان',
        'learn': 'ابدأ بناء الدليل',
        'recall': 'قوِّ التعرّف',
        'listening': 'قوِّ الاستماع',
        'production': 'قوِّ الإنتاج',
        'transfer': 'قوِّ النقل إلى سياقات جديدة',
        'consolidate': 'ثبّت ما تعلمته قبل التوسع',
      }[nextAction] ??
      nextAction;
}

class MasteryDashboard {
  static MasteryDashboardSnapshot build(
    LearnerState state, {
    required List<LearningContent> corpus,
    required LanguageContentIntelligence contentIntelligence,
    DateTime? now,
  }) {
    final at = now ?? DateTime.now();
    final items = corpus;
    final report = contentIntelligence.analyze(items);
    final cards = state.meaningReviewCards.toList(growable: false);
    final due = cards.where((c) => !c.dueAt.isAfter(at)).length;
    final overdue = cards.where((c) => c.dueAt.isBefore(at)).length;

    var retrievabilitySum = 0.0;
    var retentionSum = 0.0;
    var measured = 0;
    var mastered = 0;
    var activeErrors = 0;
    final skillTotals = <String, double>{};
    final skillCounts = <String, int>{};
    final priorities = <String, double>{};
    final attemptsByItem = <String, List<Attempt>>{};
    for (final attempt in state.meaningAttempts) {
      (attemptsByItem[attempt.itemId] ??= <Attempt>[]).add(attempt);
    }

    final activeItemIds = <String>{
      ...attemptsByItem.keys,
      ...state.meaningReviewCards.map((card) => card.itemId),
    };
    for (final itemId in activeItemIds) {
      final itemAttempts = attemptsByItem[itemId] ?? const <Attempt>[];
      final card = state.reviewCards[itemId];
      final evidence = Mastery.forItemRows(
        itemId,
        itemAttempts,
        reviewCard: card,
        now: at,
      );
      if (evidence.skillScores.isNotEmpty) {
        measured++;
        if (evidence.isMastered) mastered++;
        for (final entry in evidence.skillScores.entries) {
          skillTotals[entry.key] = (skillTotals[entry.key] ?? 0) + entry.value;
          skillCounts[entry.key] = (skillCounts[entry.key] ?? 0) + 1;
        }
      }
      final recentStart = itemAttempts.length > 6 ? itemAttempts.length - 6 : 0;
      var recentErrors = 0;
      for (var i = recentStart; i < itemAttempts.length; i++) {
        if (!itemAttempts[i].correct) recentErrors++;
      }
      if (recentErrors >= 2) activeErrors++;
      if (card != null) {
        retrievabilitySum += Srs.retrievability(card, now: at);
        retentionSum += Mastery.retentionForCard(card);
        priorities[itemId] = Srs.reviewPriority(card, now: at);
      }
    }

    final cardCount = cards.length;
    final retrievability = cardCount == 0
        ? (state.learned.isEmpty ? 0.0 : .82)
        : retrievabilitySum / cardCount;
    final retention = cardCount == 0
        ? (state.learned.isEmpty ? 0.0 : .55)
        : retentionSum / cardCount;
    final skillScores = <String, double>{};
    for (final skill in const [
      'recall',
      'listening',
      'production',
      'transfer',
    ]) {
      final n = skillCounts[skill] ?? 0;
      if (n > 0) skillScores[skill] = (skillTotals[skill] ?? 0) / n;
    }
    final weakest = _weakest(skillScores);
    final evidenceStrength = _evidenceStrength(state, measured);
    final readiness = (skillScores.isEmpty
            ? evidenceStrength * .55 + retrievability * .45
            : skillScores.values.reduce((a, b) => a + b) /
                    skillScores.length *
                    .55 +
                retrievability * .25 +
                retention * .20)
        .clamp(0.0, 1.0)
        .toDouble();
    final retentionRisk = (1 - retrievability) * .72 +
        (due == 0 ? 0 : (due / (cardCount == 0 ? due : cardCount)) * .28);
    final nextAction = _nextAction(
      skillScores,
      retrievability,
      retention,
      state.meaningAttempts.toList(growable: false),
    );
    final nextReviewDays = retrievability <= 0
        ? 0
        : retrievability < .45
            ? 0
            : retrievability < .60
                ? 1
                : retrievability < .75
                    ? 2
                    : retrievability < .85
                        ? 4
                        : 7;
    final ordered = priorities.entries.toList()
      ..sort((a, b) => b.value.compareTo(a.value));

    return MasteryDashboardSnapshot(
      readiness: readiness,
      retentionRisk: retentionRisk.clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble(),
      retrievability: retrievability.clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble(),
      evidenceStrength: evidenceStrength,
      weakestSkill: weakest,
      nextAction: nextAction,
      nextReviewDays: nextReviewDays,
      masteredItems: mastered,
      measuredItems: measured,
      dueItems: due,
      overdueItems: overdue,
      activeErrorItems: activeErrors,
      priorityItemIds:
          ordered.take(8).map((x) => x.key).toList(growable: false),
      contentReport: report,
    );
  }

  static double _evidenceStrength(LearnerState state, int measuredItems) {
    final attempts = state.meaningAttempts.length;
    return ((attempts / 60) * .55 + (measuredItems / 40) * .45)
        .clamp(0.0, 1.0)
        .toDouble();
  }

  static String _weakest(Map<String, double> scores) {
    if (scores.isEmpty) return 'recall';
    return scores.entries.reduce((a, b) => a.value <= b.value ? a : b).key;
  }

  static String _nextAction(
    Map<String, double> scores,
    double retrievability,
    double retention,
    List<Attempt> attempts,
  ) {
    if (retrievability < .45) return 'review';
    if (scores.isEmpty) return attempts.isEmpty ? 'learn' : 'recall';
    final weak = _weakest(scores);
    if ((scores[weak] ?? 0) < .65) return weak;
    if (retention < .65) return 'review';
    return 'consolidate';
  }
}

FILE: lib/services/mistake_analysis.dart

import '../models/learner.dart';

class MistakeBucket {
  final String skill;
  final int errors, attempts;
  const MistakeBucket({
    required this.skill,
    required this.errors,
    required this.attempts,
  });
  double get errorRate => attempts == 0 ? 0 : errors / attempts;
}

class MistakeReport {
  final List<MistakeBucket> bySkill;
  final List<String> weakItems;
  const MistakeReport({required this.bySkill, required this.weakItems});
}

class MistakeAnalysis {
  static MistakeReport from(List<Attempt> attempts) {
    final grouped = <String, List<Attempt>>{};
    for (final a in attempts) grouped.putIfAbsent(a.skill, () => []).add(a);
    final buckets = grouped.entries
        .map(
          (e) => MistakeBucket(
            skill: e.key,
            errors: e.value.where((a) => !a.correct).length,
            attempts: e.value.length,
          ),
        )
        .toList()
      ..sort((a, b) => (b.errorRate).compareTo(a.errorRate));
    final itemErrors = <String, int>{};
    for (final a in attempts.where((a) => !a.correct))
      itemErrors[a.itemId] = (itemErrors[a.itemId] ?? 0) + 1;
    final weakItems = itemErrors.entries.toList()
      ..sort((a, b) => b.value.compareTo(a.value));
    return MistakeReport(
      bySkill: buckets,
      weakItems: weakItems.take(12).map((e) => e.key).toList(),
    );
  }
}

import '../models/learner.dart';

class MistakeCoachingItem {
  final String itemId, skill, action;
  final int errorCount, attemptCount;
  const MistakeCoachingItem({
    required this.itemId,
    required this.skill,
    required this.action,
    required this.errorCount,
    required this.attemptCount,
  });
}

class MistakeCoachReport {
  final List<MistakeCoachingItem> items;
  final String headline;
  const MistakeCoachReport({required this.items, required this.headline});
}

class MistakeCoach {
  static MistakeCoachReport from(List<Attempt> attempts) {
    final grouped = <String, List<Attempt>>{};
    for (final a in attempts) grouped.putIfAbsent(a.itemId, () => []).add(a);
    final rows = <MistakeCoachingItem>[];
    for (final e in grouped.entries) {
      final errors = e.value.where((a) => !a.correct).length;
      if (errors == 0) continue;
      final skill = e.value.last.skill;
      final action = skill == 'listening'
          ? 'استمع ثم أعد الجملة بصوتك في تدريب قصير.'
          : skill == 'production'
              ? 'اكتب جملة جديدة ثم قارنها بالنموذج.'
              : skill == 'transfer'
                  ? 'درّب الترجمة من العربية إلى الألمانية دون تلميح.'
                  : 'أعد القاعدة في 3 أسئلة متدرجة قبل الانتقال.';
      rows.add(
        MistakeCoachingItem(
          itemId: e.key,
          skill: skill,
          action: action,
          errorCount: errors,
          attemptCount: e.value.length,
        ),
      );
    }
    rows.sort(
      (a, b) => (b.errorCount * 3 + b.attemptCount).compareTo(
        a.errorCount * 3 + a.attemptCount,
      ),
    );
    return MistakeCoachReport(
      items: rows.take(12).toList(),
      headline: rows.isEmpty
          ? 'لا توجد أخطاء متكررة تحتاج علاجًا الآن.'
          : 'لدينا نقاط متكررة سنحوّلها إلى تدريبات قصيرة.',
    );
  }
}

FILE: lib/services/mistake_engine.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import '../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../models/mistake.dart';
import '../models/learner.dart';
import '../core/date_utils.dart';

class MistakeEngine {
  static MistakeReport from(
    List<Attempt> attempts,
    List<LearningContent> content, {
    DateTime? now,
  }) {
    final at = now ?? DateTime.now();
    final grouped = <String, List<Attempt>>{};
    for (final a in attempts) {
      if (a.itemId.trim().isEmpty) continue;
      grouped.putIfAbsent(a.itemId, () => []).add(a);
    }
    final contentById = <String, LearningContent>{
      for (final item in content) item.id: item,
    };
    final rows = <MistakeRecord>[];
    for (final entry in grouped.entries) {
      final all = entry.value;
      final errors = all.where((a) => !a.correct).toList();
      if (errors.isEmpty) continue;
      final item = contentById[entry.key];
      final latest = all.reduce((a, b) => a.at.isAfter(b.at) ? a : b);
      final category = _classify(all, item);
      final streak = _correctiveStreak(all);
      final recency = _recency(at, latest.at);
      final failureRate = errors.length / all.length;
      final recentFailureRate = _recentFailureRate(all, at);
      final recurrent = errors.length >= 2 || failureRate >= .40;
      final recurrence = errors.length * 18 + (errors.length >= 2 ? 22 : 0);
      final unresolved = (errors.length - streak).clamp(0, errors.length);
      if (streak >= 3 && unresolved == 0) continue;
      final severity = (recurrence +
              unresolved * 10 +
              recency +
              (recentFailureRate * 25).round())
          .clamp(1, 100)
          .toInt();
      rows.add(
        MistakeRecord(
          itemId: entry.key,
          category: category,
          source: _source(entry.key),
          errorCount: errors.length,
          attemptCount: all.length,
          correctiveStreak: streak,
          lastSeenAt: latest.at,
          severity: severity,
          normalizedKey: '${category.name}:${entry.key}',
          failureRate: failureRate,
          recentFailureRate: recentFailureRate,
          diagnosis: _diagnosis(category, recurrent, recentFailureRate),
        ),
      );
    }
    rows.sort((a, b) => b.severity.compareTo(a.severity));
    return MistakeReport(
      items: rows.take(20).toList(),
      headline: rows.isEmpty
          ? 'لا توجد أخطاء تحتاج علاجًا الآن.'
          : 'هذه أكثر الأخطاء تكرارًا؛ سنعالجها بتدريبات قصيرة ثم نعيد قياسها.',
    );
  }

  static MistakeRecord fromWriting({
    required String itemId,
    required String issue,
    DateTime? at,
  }) =>
      MistakeRecord(
        itemId: itemId,
        category: MistakeCategory.writing,
        source: MistakeSource.writing,
        errorCount: 1,
        attemptCount: 1,
        correctiveStreak: 0,
        lastSeenAt: at ?? DateTime.now(),
        severity: 55,
        normalizedKey: 'writing:${issue.trim().toLowerCase()}',
      );

  static MistakeCategory _classify(List<Attempt> all, LearningContent? item) {
    final skill = all.last.skill.toLowerCase();
    if (skill == 'listening') return MistakeCategory.listening;
    if (skill == 'production') return MistakeCategory.production;
    if (skill == 'transfer') return MistakeCategory.translation;
    if (skill == 'writing') return MistakeCategory.writing;
    if (skill == 'grammar') return MistakeCategory.grammar;
    if (item != null && item.grammaticalMarker.isNotEmpty) {
      final expected = item.grammaticalMarker.toLowerCase();
      final wrong = all.any(
        (a) =>
            !a.correct &&
            a.answer.toLowerCase().contains(
                  RegExp(r'^(der|die|das|ein|eine)\b'),
                ) &&
            !a.answer.toLowerCase().startsWith(expected),
      );
      if (wrong) return MistakeCategory.article;
    }
    return MistakeCategory.vocabulary;
  }

  static int _correctiveStreak(List<Attempt> all) {
    var n = 0;
    for (final a in all.reversed) {
      if (!a.correct) break;
      n++;
    }
    return n;
  }

  static int _recency(DateTime now, DateTime seen) {
    final d =
        now.toUtcMidnight.difference(seen.toUtcMidnight).inDays.clamp(0, 30);
    return 30 - d;
  }

  static double _recentFailureRate(List<Attempt> all, DateTime now) {
    var total = 0;
    var failures = 0;
    for (final a in all) {
      if (now.toUtcMidnight.difference(a.at.toUtcMidnight).inDays > 14)
        continue;
      total++;
      if (!a.correct) failures++;
    }
    if (total == 0) return 0;
    return failures / total;
  }

  static String _diagnosis(
    MistakeCategory category,
    bool recurrent,
    double recentRate,
  ) {
    if (recentRate >= .60)
      return 'خطأ نشط ومتكرر؛ نحتاج إصلاحه الآن بتدريب قصير ومتدرّج.';
    if (recurrent)
      return 'خطأ متكرر؛ المشكلة تحتاج تثبيتًا إضافيًا بدل إعادة السؤال نفسه.';
    switch (category) {
      case MistakeCategory.article:
        return 'تشخيص: Artikel؛ ركّز على جنس الاسم ثم استخدمه داخل جملة.';
      case MistakeCategory.grammar:
        return 'تشخيص: قاعدة؛ صحّح النمط ثم طبّقه في سياق جديد.';
      case MistakeCategory.translation:
        return 'تشخيص: نقل المعنى؛ اربط المعنى العربي بالبنية الألمانية.';
      case MistakeCategory.wordOrder:
        return 'تشخيص: ترتيب الجملة؛ ثبّت موقع الفعل ثم أعد بناء الجملة.';
      case MistakeCategory.production:
        return 'تشخيص: إنتاج؛ انتقل من التعرّف إلى الاستعمال الحر.';
      case MistakeCategory.listening:
        return 'تشخيص: استماع؛ أعد ربط الصوت بالشكل المكتوب والمعنى.';
      case MistakeCategory.writing:
        return 'تشخيص: كتابة؛ صحّح البنية ثم اكتب مثالًا جديدًا.';
      case MistakeCategory.vocabulary:
        return 'تشخيص: مفردات؛ ثبّت الكلمة عبر الاسترجاع ثم السياق.';
    }
  }

  static MistakeSource _source(String id) {
    if (id.startsWith('restaurant_') ||
        id.startsWith('station_') ||
        id.startsWith('market_') ||
        id.startsWith('work_') ||
        id.startsWith('doctor_')) return MistakeSource.conversation;
    if (id.startsWith('writing:')) return MistakeSource.writing;
    if (id.startsWith('assessment_')) return MistakeSource.assessment;
    return MistakeSource.practice;
  }
}

FILE: lib/services/offline_backup_system.dart

import 'dart:io';

import 'package:path/path.dart';
import 'package:sqflite/sqflite.dart';

class OfflineBackupSystem {
  static const List<String> _targetDatabases = [
    'heatmap.db',
    'user_vocabulary.db',
    'milestones.db',
    'reverse_quiz.db',
  ];

  Future<void> exportDatabases(String backupDirectoryPath) async {
    final dbPath = await getDatabasesPath();
    final backupDir = Directory(backupDirectoryPath);

    if (!await backupDir.exists()) {
      await backupDir.create(recursive: true);
    }

    for (final dbName in _targetDatabases) {
      final sourceFile = File(join(dbPath, dbName));
      if (await sourceFile.exists()) {
        final destFile = File(join(backupDirectoryPath, dbName));
        await sourceFile.copy(destFile.path);
      }
      final walFile = File(join(dbPath, '$dbName-wal'));
      if (await walFile.exists()) {
        final destWal = File(join(backupDirectoryPath, '$dbName-wal'));
        await walFile.copy(destWal.path);
      }
      final shmFile = File(join(dbPath, '$dbName-shm'));
      if (await shmFile.exists()) {
        final destShm = File(join(backupDirectoryPath, '$dbName-shm'));
        await shmFile.copy(destShm.path);
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> restoreDatabases(String backupDirectoryPath) async {
    final dbPath = await getDatabasesPath();
    final backupDir = Directory(backupDirectoryPath);

    if (!await backupDir.exists()) {
      throw FileSystemException(
        'Backup directory does not exist',
        backupDirectoryPath,
      );
    }

    final databasesDir = Directory(dbPath);
    if (!await databasesDir.exists()) {
      await databasesDir.create(recursive: true);
    }

    for (final dbName in _targetDatabases) {
      final sourceFile = File(join(backupDirectoryPath, dbName));
      if (await sourceFile.exists()) {
        // Delete existing auxiliary files before restoring main db to prevent corruption
        final existingWal = File(join(dbPath, '$dbName-wal'));
        if (await existingWal.exists()) {
          await existingWal.delete();
        }
        final existingShm = File(join(dbPath, '$dbName-shm'));
        if (await existingShm.exists()) {
          await existingShm.delete();
        }

        final destFile = File(join(dbPath, dbName));
        await sourceFile.copy(destFile.path);
      }

      final sourceWal = File(join(backupDirectoryPath, '$dbName-wal'));
      if (await sourceWal.exists()) {
        final destWal = File(join(dbPath, '$dbName-wal'));
        await sourceWal.copy(destWal.path);
      }
      final sourceShm = File(join(backupDirectoryPath, '$dbName-shm'));
      if (await sourceShm.exists()) {
        final destShm = File(join(dbPath, '$dbName-shm'));
        await sourceShm.copy(destShm.path);
      }
    }
  }
}

/// Single adapter boundary for the shared_preferences plugin.
/// Application/UI code depends on this service instead of the plugin API.
class PreferencesService implements LocalPreferencesStore {
  static const String systemMemoryAgentKey = 'sys_memory_agent_v1';

  final SharedPreferences _prefs;
  const PreferencesService._(this._prefs);

  static Future<PreferencesService> instance() async =>
      PreferencesService._(await SharedPreferences.getInstance());

  @override
  String? getString(String key) => _prefs.getString(key);
  List<String>? getStringList(String key) => _prefs.getStringList(key);
  bool getBool(String key) => _prefs.getBool(key) ?? false;
  int? getInt(String key) => _prefs.getInt(key);

  @override
  Future<bool> setString(String key, String value) =>
      _prefs.setString(key, value);
  Future<bool> setStringList(String key, List<String> value) =>
      _prefs.setStringList(key, value);
  Future<bool> setBool(String key, bool value) => _prefs.setBool(key, value);
  Future<bool> setInt(String key, int value) => _prefs.setInt(key, value);
  Future<bool> remove(String key) => _prefs.remove(key);

  String? readSystemMemoryAgentState() =>
      _prefs.getString(systemMemoryAgentKey);

  Future<bool> writeSystemMemoryAgentState(String value) =>
      _prefs.setString(systemMemoryAgentKey, value);
}

  String? readText(String storageKey) => getString(storageKey);

  List<String>? readTextList(String storageKey) => getStringList(storageKey);

      setString(storageKey, value);

  Future<bool> writeTextList(String storageKey, List<String> value) =>
      setStringList(storageKey, value);

  Future<bool> deleteValue(String storageKey) => remove(storageKey);
}

import 'preferences_service.dart';

/// Provider-neutral privacy preferences boundary.
///
/// UI and feature code receive this contract from the composition root rather
/// than reaching into global storage singletons.
abstract interface class PrivacySettingsStore {
  Future<bool> cloudAiEnabled();
  Future<bool> speechEnabled();
  Future<bool> setCloudAi(bool value);
  Future<bool> setSpeech(bool value);
}

final class LocalPrivacySettingsStore implements PrivacySettingsStore {
  const LocalPrivacySettingsStore(this._preferences);

  final PreferencesService _preferences;

  static const cloudKey = 'privacy_cloud_ai_v1';
  static const speechKey = 'privacy_speech_v1';

  @override
  Future<bool> cloudAiEnabled() async => _readBool(cloudKey);

  @override
  Future<bool> speechEnabled() async => _readBool(speechKey);

  @override
  Future<bool> setCloudAi(bool value) async => _writeBool(cloudKey, value);

  @override
  Future<bool> setSpeech(bool value) async => _writeBool(speechKey, value);

  Future<bool> _readBool(String key) async {
    try {
      return _preferences.getBool(key);
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  Future<bool> _writeBool(String key, bool value) async {
    try {
      return await _preferences.setBool(key, value);
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  }
}

/// Compatibility facade for staged callers outside the UI dependency graph.
/// New code should receive [PrivacySettingsStore] from composition.
final class PrivacySettings {
  PrivacySettings._();

  static Future<bool> cloudAiEnabled() async {
    try {
      return (await PreferencesService.instance()).getBool(
        LocalPrivacySettingsStore.cloudKey,
      );
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  static Future<bool> speechEnabled() async {
    try {
      return (await PreferencesService.instance()).getBool(
        LocalPrivacySettingsStore.speechKey,
      );
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  static Future<bool> setCloudAi(bool value) async {
    try {
      return await (await PreferencesService.instance()).setBool(
        LocalPrivacySettingsStore.cloudKey,
        value,
      );
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  static Future<bool> setSpeech(bool value) async {
    try {
      return await (await PreferencesService.instance()).setBool(
        LocalPrivacySettingsStore.speechKey,
        value,
      );
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  }
}

import '../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../language/language_exercise_strategy.dart';
import '../language/language_text_normalizer.dart';
import '../models/mistake.dart';
import '../models/production.dart';

class ProductionEngine {
  static ProductionTask? buildFor(
    LearningContent item, {
    required LanguageExerciseStrategy exerciseStrategy,
    MistakeRecord? mistake,
    ProductionMode? mode,
    bool Function(LearningContent item)? isLearnable,
  }) {
    if (!(isLearnable?.call(item) ?? item.exampleText.trim().isNotEmpty))
      return null;
    return exerciseStrategy.productionTask(item, mistake: mistake, mode: mode);
  }

  static bool matches(
    String answer,
    ProductionTask task, {
    required LanguageTextNormalizer textNormalizer,
  }) {
    final normalized = textNormalizer.answer(answer);
    if (normalized.isEmpty) return false;
    return task.accepted.any((x) => textNormalizer.answer(x) == normalized);
  }
}

import '../models/learner.dart';
import '../models/progress_snapshot.dart';

class ProgressSnapshotService {
  static ProgressSnapshot build(
    List<Attempt> attempts,
    List<AssessmentHistory> history,
  ) {
    final keys = <String>{
      'recall',
      'listening',
      'production',
      'transfer',
      ...attempts.map((a) => a.skill),
    };
    final scores = <String, double>{};
    for (final skill in keys) {
      final rows = attempts.where((a) => a.skill == skill).toList();
      if (rows.isEmpty) {
        scores[skill] = 0;
        continue;
      }
      final recent = rows.length > 12 ? rows.sublist(rows.length - 12) : rows;
      var total = 0.0;
      var weight = 1.0;
      for (final a in recent.reversed) {
        total += (a.correct ? 1.0 : 0.0) * (a.hinted ? .85 : 1.0) * weight;
        weight *= .94;
      }
      scores[skill] = total / _weightSum(recent.length);
    }
    final considered = scores.entries
        .where((e) => attempts.any((a) => a.skill == e.key))
        .toList();
    final overall = considered.isEmpty
        ? (history.isEmpty ? 0.0 : history.first.score / 100)
        : considered.map((e) => e.value).reduce((a, b) => a + b) /
            considered.length;
    final weakest = considered.isEmpty
        ? 'recall'
        : (List.of(
            considered,
          )..sort((a, b) => a.value.compareTo(b.value)))
            .first
            .key;
    return ProgressSnapshot(
      skillScores: scores,
      levelLabel: _level(overall),
      weakestSkill: weakest,
      assessedCount: history.length,
      overall: overall.clamp(0, 1).toDouble(),
    );
  }

  static double _weightSum(int n) {
    var weight = 1.0;
    var sum = 0.0;
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      sum += weight;
      weight *= .94;
    }
    return sum == 0 ? 1 : sum;
  }

  static String _level(double score) => score >= .90
      ? 'B2 قوي'
      : score >= .78
          ? 'B1 متقدم'
          : score >= .64
              ? 'A2 متقدم'
              : score >= .48
                  ? 'A2'
                  : score >= .30
                      ? 'A1 متقدم'
                      : 'A1 بداية';
}

import '../models/content.dart';
import '../language/german/german_content_quality.dart';

/// Compatibility facade for legacy service callers.
///
/// New code should receive LanguageContentQuality from the selected LanguagePack.
final class ContentQuality {
  static final GermanContentQuality _delegate = const GermanContentQuality();
  static final Expando<List<String>> _validationCache = Expando<List<String>>(
    'contentQualityIssues',
  );

  static List<String> issues(ContentItem item) {
    final cached = _validationCache[item];
    if (cached != null) return cached;
    final computed = _delegate.issues(item);
    _validationCache[item] = computed;
    return computed;
  }

  static List<String> validate(ContentItem item) => issues(item);
  static bool isLearnable(ContentItem item) => issues(item).isEmpty;

  static bool uniqueGerman(List<ContentItem> xs) =>
      xs.map((x) => x.german.trim().toLowerCase()).toSet().length == xs.length;

  static bool uniqueIds(List<ContentItem> xs) =>
      xs.map((x) => x.id.trim()).toSet().length == xs.length;

  static List<String> collectionErrors(List<ContentItem> xs) {
    final errors = <String>[];
    final ids = <String>{};
    final german = <String>{};
    for (final x in xs) {
      final id = x.id.trim();
      final de = x.german.trim().toLowerCase();
      if (id.isNotEmpty && !ids.add(id)) errors.add('duplicate id: $id');
      if (de.isNotEmpty && !german.add(de)) errors.add('duplicate german: $de');
    }
    return errors;
  }

  static bool question(String value) => value.trim().endsWith('?');
}

import '../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../language/language_content_quality.dart';

class ReadingPassage {
  final List<LearningContent> sentences;
  final List<String> targetWords;
  final String title;
  const ReadingPassage({
    required this.sentences,
    required this.targetWords,
    required this.title,
  });
}

class ReadingPractice {
  static ReadingPassage build(
    List<LearningContent> items, {
    required LanguageContentQuality contentQuality,
    String? focusSkill,
    int targetWords = 6,
    int maxSentences = 5,
  }) {
    final eligible = items
        .where(
          (x) =>
              contentQuality.issues(x).isEmpty &&
              (focusSkill == null || x.skill == focusSkill),
        )
        .toList();
    final source = eligible.isEmpty
        ? items.where((x) => contentQuality.issues(x).isEmpty).toList()
        : eligible;
    final selected = <LearningContent>[];
    final words = <String>[];
    final seen = <String>{};
    for (final x in source) {
      if (selected.length >= maxSentences) break;
      if (!seen.add(x.exampleText)) continue;
      selected.add(x);
      if (words.length < targetWords) words.add(x.sourceText);
    }
    return ReadingPassage(
      sentences: selected,
      targetWords: words,
      title: focusSkill == null ? 'قراءة اليوم' : 'قراءة مركزة على $focusSkill',
    );
  }
}

const releaseGates = <ReleaseGate>[

import '../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../language/language_exercise_strategy.dart';
import '../models/mistake.dart';

class RepairEngine {
  static RepairDrill? build<T extends LearningContent>(
    MistakeRecord mistake,
    List<T> items, {
    required LanguageExerciseStrategy exerciseStrategy,
    bool Function(T item)? isLearnable,
  }) {
    T? item;
    for (final x in items) {
      if (x.id == mistake.itemId) {
        item = x;
        break;
      }
    }
    final allowed = item != null && (isLearnable?.call(item) ?? true);
    return exerciseStrategy.repairDrill(allowed ? item : null, mistake);
  }
}

FILE: lib/services/repository.dart

import '../core/content_contract.dart';
import 'preferences_service.dart';
import 'learner_persistence.dart';
import '../models/learner.dart';
import '../core/srs_facets.dart';
import '../core/srs_scheduler.dart';
import '../core/models/language_catalog_models.dart';
import '../core/progress/offline_pair_progress_engine.dart';
import '../core/progress/pair_progress_models.dart';
import '../core/progress/review_transaction_envelope.dart';
import '../models/assessment.dart';
import '../models/diagnostic_placement.dart';
import '../features/gamification/domain/gamification_models.dart';
import '../features/gamification/domain/gamification_review_sink.dart';
import '../features/gamification/gamification_repository.dart';
import '../features/error_pattern_agent/domain/error_diagnostic_repository.dart';
import '../features/error_pattern_agent/domain/error_pattern_models.dart';

/// Local learner-state storage. This app deliberately has no network trust boundary.
/// Persisted values are treated as untrusted input and are bounded before use.
class LearnerRepository {
  final PreferencesService prefs;
  LearnerRepository(
    this.prefs, {
    required this.persistence,
    this.gamificationReviewSink = const NoopGamificationReviewSink(),
    this.errorDiagnosticSink = const NoopErrorDiagnosticSink(),
  });

  final LearnerPersistence persistence;
  final GamificationReviewSink gamificationReviewSink;
  final ErrorDiagnosticSink errorDiagnosticSink;

  OfflinePairProgressEngine? _pairProgressEngine;
  ResolvedLanguagePair? _activeResolvedPair;
  static const key = 'v34_state';
  static const legacyFavoriteKey = 'verb_favorites_v1';
  static const maxXp = LearnerPersistence.maxXp;
  Future<void> _writeQueue = Future<void>.value();
  LearnerState? _cachedState;

  Future<T> _enqueue<T>(Future<T> Function() action) {
    final next = _writeQueue.then((_) => action());
    _writeQueue = next.then<void>((_) {}).catchError((_) {});
    return next;
  }


  LearnerState load() {
    final cached = _cachedState;
    if (cached != null) return cached;
    final loaded = _loadFromPrefs();
    _cachedState = loaded;
    return loaded;
  }

  /// Reloads the persisted state when another persistence actor may have changed it.
  /// Normal reads stay cached; callers that explicitly need storage truth use this boundary.
  LearnerState reload() {
    _cachedState = null;
    return load();
  }

  /// Reloads persisted state after all writes already queued by this repository finish.
  /// This prevents a synchronous storage read from observing a pre-write snapshot.
  Future<LearnerState> reloadPersisted() async {
    await _writeQueue;
    _cachedState = null;
    return load();
  }

  LearnerState _loadFromPrefs() => persistence.load();

  Future<GamificationSnapshot> loadGamificationSnapshot() {
    final sink = gamificationReviewSink;
    if (sink is GamificationRepository) {
      return sink.loadSnapshot();
    }
    return Future<GamificationSnapshot>.value(
      const GamificationSnapshot(
        profile: GamificationProfile(),
        unlocked: <UnlockedMilestone>[],
        badges: GamificationMilestones.defaults,
      ),
    );
  }

  bool get hasPairProgressAuthority =>
      _pairProgressEngine != null && _activeResolvedPair != null;

  OfflinePairProgressEngine get boundPairProgressEngine =>
      _requirePairProgressAuthority().engine;

  Future<void> bindPairProgressAuthority({
    required OfflinePairProgressEngine engine,
    required ResolvedLanguagePair pair,
    bool migrateLegacy = false,
    int migratedAchievementPoints = 0,
  }) =>
      _enqueue(() async {
        if (migratedAchievementPoints < 0 ||
            migratedAchievementPoints > LearnerRepository.maxXp) {
          throw ArgumentError.value(
            migratedAchievementPoints,
            'migratedAchievementPoints',
            'must be 0..${LearnerRepository.maxXp}',
          );
        }

        final state = load();
        final hasLegacyProgress = state.reviewCards.isNotEmpty ||
            state.learned.isNotEmpty ||
            state.review.isNotEmpty;
        if (hasLegacyProgress && !migrateLegacy) {
          throw StateError(
            'legacy_pair_progress_requires_explicit_migration',
          );
        }

        if (migrateLegacy && hasLegacyProgress) {
          await _migrateLegacyProgress(
            state,
            engine: engine,
            pair: pair,
            migratedAchievementPoints:
                migratedAchievementPoints,
          );
        }

        _pairProgressEngine = engine;
        _activeResolvedPair = pair;

        if (migrateLegacy && hasLegacyProgress) {
          await _saveNow(
            state.copyWith(
              learned: <String>{},
              review: <String>{},
              reviewCards: <String, ReviewCard>{},
            ),
          );
        }
      });

  Future<PairProgressSnapshot> loadPairProgress() async {
    final authority = _requirePairProgressAuthority();
    return authority.engine.loadPair(authority.pair);
  }

  Future<ReviewCard?> loadPairReviewCard(
    String conceptId, {
    ReviewFacetType facetType = ReviewFacetType.meaningRecall,
    String? variantKey,
  }) {
    final authority = _requirePairProgressAuthority();
    return authority.engine.loadReviewCard(
      authority.pair,
      conceptId: conceptId,
      facetType: facetType,
      variantKey: variantKey,
    );
  }

  Future<void> _migrateLegacyProgress(
    LearnerState state, {
    required OfflinePairProgressEngine engine,
    required ResolvedLanguagePair pair,
    required int migratedAchievementPoints,
  }) async {
    final cards = <String, ReviewCard>{...state.reviewCards};
    final now = DateTime.now();

    for (final id in <String>{...state.learned, ...state.review}) {
      final normalized = id.trim();
      if (normalized.isEmpty || normalized.length > 160) {
        continue;
      }
      cards.putIfAbsent(
        normalized,
        () => ReviewCard(
          itemId: normalized,
          dueAt: now,
        ),
      );
    }

    await engine.migrateLegacySnapshot(
      pair: pair,
      reviewCards: cards.values,
      learnedConceptIds: state.learned,
      achievementPoints: migratedAchievementPoints,
    );
  }

  _PairProgressAuthority _requirePairProgressAuthority() {
    final engine = _pairProgressEngine;
    final pair = _activeResolvedPair;
    if (engine == null || pair == null) {
      throw StateError('pair_progress_authority_not_bound');
    }
    return _PairProgressAuthority(engine: engine, pair: pair);
  }

  LearnerState _withoutLegacyPairProgress(LearnerState state) {
    if (!hasPairProgressAuthority) return state;
    return state.copyWith(
      learned: <String>{},
      review: <String>{},
      reviewCards: <String, ReviewCard>{},
    );
  }

  Future<void> save(LearnerState s) => _enqueue(() async {
        final persisted = persistence.normalize(
          _withoutLegacyPairProgress(s),
        );
        await persistence.save(persisted);
        _cachedState = persistence.load();
      });

  Future<Set<String>> loadAndMigrateFavoriteVerbs() => _enqueue(() async {
        final result = await persistence.loadAndMigrateFavoriteVerbs(load());
        _cachedState = result;
        return result.favoriteVerbs;
      });

  Future<bool> clearLocalData() => _enqueue<bool>(() async {
        try {
          final authority = hasPairProgressAuthority
              ? _requirePairProgressAuthority()
              : null;
          if (authority != null) {
            await authority.engine.clearAll();
          }
          final learnerCleared = await persistence.clearLocalData();
          await gamificationReviewSink.clearGamification();
          return learnerCleared;
        } finally {
          _cachedState = null;
        }
      });

  Future<void> recordAssessment(AssessmentResult result) => _enqueue(() async {
        final persisted = await persistence.recordAssessmentOnce(
          AssessmentHistory(
            id: result.id,
            at: result.at,
            score: result.score,
            weakSkills: result.weakSkills,
            answered: result.answered,
          ),
        );
        _cachedState = persisted;
      });

  Future<void> recordWritingMistake({required String issue, DateTime? at}) =>
      _enqueue(() async {
        final key = 'writing:${issue.trim().toLowerCase()}';
        final now = at ?? DateTime.now();
        final attempt = Attempt(
          id: 'w_${now.microsecondsSinceEpoch}',
          itemId: key,
          skill: 'writing',
          answer: issue.trim(),
          correct: false,
          hinted: false,
          seconds: 5,
          at: now,
        );
        final result = await persistence.applyReviewAttemptOnce(
          reviewEventId: attempt.id,
          attempt: attempt,
        );
        _cachedState = result.state;
      });

  Future<void> toggleFavoriteVerb(String infinitive) => _enqueue(() async {
        final value = infinitive.trim();
        if (value.isEmpty || value.length > 120) return;
        final current = load();
        final shouldFavorite = !current.favoriteVerbs.contains(value);
        final persisted = await persistence.setFavoriteMembership(
          value,
          isFavorite: shouldFavorite,
        );
        _cachedState = persisted;
      });

  Future<void> _saveNow(LearnerState s) async {
    final persisted = persistence.normalize(
      _withoutLegacyPairProgress(s),
    );
    await persistence.save(persisted);
    _cachedState = persistence.load();
  }

  Future<void> _reconcileAcceptedReviewBestEffort({
    required _PairProgressAuthority authority,
    required ReviewTransactionEnvelope envelope,
    required String payloadHash,
  }) async {
    try {
      final result = await persistence.applyReviewAttemptOnce(
        reviewEventId: envelope.reviewEventId,
        attempt: Attempt(
          id: envelope.reviewEventId,
          itemId: envelope.conceptId,
          skill: envelope.skill,
          answer: envelope.answer,
          correct: envelope.correct,
          hinted: envelope.hinted,
          seconds: envelope.seconds,
          at: envelope.occurredAtUtc,
          facetType: envelope.facetType,
          variantKey: envelope.variantKey,
        ),
      );
      _cachedState = result.state;
      await authority.engine.acknowledgeReviewTransaction(
        reviewEventId: envelope.reviewEventId,
        payloadHash: payloadHash,
        sink: ReviewTransactionSink.attempt,
      );
    } on Object {
      // The PairProgress transaction is already the durable acceptance point.
      // Leave the attempt stage pending for bounded reconciliation.
    }

    if (gamificationReviewSink is NoopGamificationReviewSink) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      await gamificationReviewSink.recordReview(
        GamificationReviewEvent(
          reviewId: envelope.reviewEventId,
          facetType: envelope.facetType,
          correct: envelope.correct,
          hinted: envelope.hinted,
          requestedXp: envelope.requestedXp,
          occurredAtUtc: envelope.occurredAtUtc,
          timezoneOffsetMinutes: envelope.timezoneOffsetMinutes,
        ),
      );
      await authority.engine.acknowledgeReviewTransaction(
        reviewEventId: envelope.reviewEventId,
        payloadHash: payloadHash,
        sink: ReviewTransactionSink.gamification,
      );
    } on Object {
      // Keep the accepted event pending. Replay is idempotent at the sink.
    }
  }

  static String _reviewEventId({
    required String kind,
    required DateTime occurredAt,
    String? supplied,
  }) {
    final explicit = supplied?.trim();
    if (explicit != null && explicit.isNotEmpty) return explicit;
    return ReviewTransactionEnvelope.generateReviewEventId(
      kind: kind,
      occurredAt: occurredAt,
    );
  }

  Future<void> _recordDiagnosticFailure({
    required LearningContent item,
    required String answer,
    required DateTime at,
  }) async {
    try {
      await errorDiagnosticSink.recordFailure(
        LearningFailureSignal(
          source: ErrorEventSource.flashcard,
          skillTag: item.skill,
          expected: item.grammaticalMarker.trim().isNotEmpty
              ? item.grammaticalMarker
              : item.sourceText,
          actual: answer,
          focus: item.sourceText,
          occurredAt: at,
        ),
      );
    } on Object {
      // Diagnostic telemetry is secondary to durable learner progress.
    }
  }

  Future<void> record({
    required LearningContent item,
    required String answer,
    required bool correct,
    required int seconds,
    required bool hinted,
    String? skillOverride,
    DateTime? at,
    String? reviewEventId,
  }) =>
      _enqueue(() async {
        final authority = _requirePairProgressAuthority();
        final now = at ?? DateTime.now();
        final safeAnswer = answer.length > 1000
            ? answer.substring(0, 1000)
            : answer;
        final safeSeconds = seconds.clamp(0, 3600).toInt();
        final xpReward = unifiedSrsScheduler.xpRewardForReview(
          correct: correct,
          hinted: hinted,
        );
        final stableReviewEventId = LearnerRepository._reviewEventId(
          kind: 'meaning',
          occurredAt: now,
          supplied: reviewEventId,
        );
        final envelope = ReviewTransactionEnvelope(
          reviewEventId: stableReviewEventId,
          sourceLanguageId: authority.pair.source.id,
          targetLanguageId: authority.pair.target.id,
          conceptId: item.id,
          skill: skillOverride ?? item.skill,
          answer: safeAnswer,
          correct: correct,
          hinted: hinted,
          seconds: safeSeconds,
          occurredAt: now,
          timezoneOffsetMinutes: now.timeZoneOffset.inMinutes,
          requestedXp: xpReward,
        );

        final pairSnapshot =
            await authority.engine.loadPair(authority.pair);
        final currentCard =
            await authority.engine.loadReviewCard(
                  authority.pair,
                  conceptId: item.id,
                ) ??
                ReviewCard(
                  itemId: item.id,
                  dueAt: now,
                );
        final updatedCard =
            await unifiedSrsScheduler.schedule(
          currentCard,
          correct: correct,
          hinted: hinted,
          now: now,
        );
        final acceptance = await authority.engine.persistReviewEnvelope(
          pair: authority.pair,
          envelope: envelope,
          reviewCard: updatedCard,
          learned: correct,
          level: pairSnapshot.level,
        );

        await _reconcileAcceptedReviewBestEffort(
          authority: authority,
          envelope: envelope,
          payloadHash: acceptance.payloadHash,
        );
        if (!acceptance.alreadyAccepted && !correct) {
          await _recordDiagnosticFailure(
            item: item,
            answer: answer,
            at: now,
          );
        }
      });

  Future<void> recordConversationAttempt({
    required String itemId,
    required String skill,
    required String answer,
    required bool correct,
    required int seconds,
    required bool hinted,
    DateTime? at,
    String? reviewEventId,
  }) =>
      _enqueue(() async {
        final authority = _requirePairProgressAuthority();
        final now = at ?? DateTime.now();
        final safeId = itemId.trim();
        if (safeId.isEmpty || safeId.length > 160) return;
        final safeSkill =
            skill.trim().isEmpty ? 'production' : skill.trim();
        final safeAnswer =
            answer.length > 1000 ? answer.substring(0, 1000) : answer;
        final safeSeconds = seconds.clamp(0, 3600).toInt();
        final stableReviewEventId = LearnerRepository._reviewEventId(
          kind: 'conversation',
          occurredAt: now,
          supplied: reviewEventId,
        );
        final envelope = ReviewTransactionEnvelope(
          reviewEventId: stableReviewEventId,
          sourceLanguageId: authority.pair.source.id,
          targetLanguageId: authority.pair.target.id,
          conceptId: safeId,
          facetType: ReviewFacetType.production,
          skill: safeSkill,
          answer: safeAnswer,
          correct: correct,
          hinted: hinted,
          seconds: safeSeconds,
          occurredAt: now,
          timezoneOffsetMinutes: now.timeZoneOffset.inMinutes,
          requestedXp: correct ? 10 : 2,
        );
        final acceptance =
            await authority.engine.persistReviewDeliveryEnvelope(
          pair: authority.pair,
          envelope: envelope,
        );
        await _reconcileAcceptedReviewBestEffort(
          authority: authority,
          envelope: envelope,
          payloadHash: acceptance.payloadHash,
        );
      });
}

extension FacetReviewRepository on LearnerRepository {
  Future<void> recordFacet({
    required LearningContent item,
    required ReviewFacetType facetType,
    String? variantKey,
    required String answer,
    required bool correct,
    required int seconds,
    required bool hinted,
    DateTime? at,
    String? reviewEventId,
  }) {
    final key = ReviewFacetKey(
      conceptId: item.id,
      facetType: facetType,
      variantKey: variantKey,
    );
    if (!key.isValid) return Future<void>.value();

    if (key.isLegacyMeaningKey) {
      return record(
        item: item,
        answer: answer,
        correct: correct,
        seconds: seconds,
        hinted: hinted,
        at: at,
        reviewEventId: reviewEventId,
      );
    }

    return _enqueue(() async {
      final authority = _requirePairProgressAuthority();
      final now = at ?? DateTime.now();
      final safeAnswer = answer.length > 1000
          ? answer.substring(0, 1000)
          : answer;
      final safeSeconds = seconds.clamp(0, 3600).toInt();
      final xpReward = unifiedSrsScheduler.xpRewardForReview(
        correct: correct,
        hinted: hinted,
      );
      final stableReviewEventId = LearnerRepository._reviewEventId(
        kind: 'facet',
        occurredAt: now,
        supplied: reviewEventId,
      );
      final envelope = ReviewTransactionEnvelope(
        reviewEventId: stableReviewEventId,
        sourceLanguageId: authority.pair.source.id,
        targetLanguageId: authority.pair.target.id,
        conceptId: item.id,
        facetType: facetType,
        variantKey: key.normalizedVariantKey,
        skill: item.skill,
        answer: safeAnswer,
        correct: correct,
        hinted: hinted,
        seconds: safeSeconds,
        occurredAt: now,
        timezoneOffsetMinutes: now.timeZoneOffset.inMinutes,
        requestedXp: xpReward,
      );

      final pairSnapshot =
          await authority.engine.loadPair(authority.pair);
      final currentCard =
          await authority.engine.loadReviewCard(
                authority.pair,
                conceptId: item.id,
                facetType: facetType,
                variantKey: key.normalizedVariantKey,
              ) ??
              ReviewCard(
                itemId: item.id,
                facetType: facetType,
                variantKey: key.normalizedVariantKey,
                dueAt: now,
              );
      final updatedCard =
          await unifiedSrsScheduler.schedule(
        currentCard,
        correct: correct,
        hinted: hinted,
        now: now,
      );
      final acceptance = await authority.engine.persistReviewEnvelope(
        pair: authority.pair,
        envelope: envelope,
        reviewCard: updatedCard,
        learned: correct,
        level: pairSnapshot.level,
      );

      await _reconcileAcceptedReviewBestEffort(
        authority: authority,
        envelope: envelope,
        payloadHash: acceptance.payloadHash,
      );
      if (!acceptance.alreadyAccepted && !correct) {
        await _recordDiagnosticFailure(
          item: item,
          answer: answer,
          at: now,
        );
      }
    });
  }
}

final class _PairProgressAuthority {
  const _PairProgressAuthority({
    required this.engine,
    required this.pair,
  });

  final OfflinePairProgressEngine engine;
  final ResolvedLanguagePair pair;
}

extension PlacementDiagnosticRepository on LearnerRepository {
  Future<void> recordPlacementDiagnostic(PlacementDiagnosticRecord record) =>
      _enqueue(() async {
        final persisted = await persistence.recordPlacementOnce(record);
        _cachedState = persisted;
      });
}

import '../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../language/language_text_normalizer.dart';
import 'verb_index.dart';

/// V122 search intelligence: exact, semantic-ish token, morphology and fuzzy lookup.
class SearchIndex<T extends LearningContent> {
  final List<T> _items;
  final VerbIndex _verbIndex;
  final LanguageTextNormalizer _textNormalizer;

  late final Map<String, List<T>> _sourceExact = _buildExact(
    _items,
    (x) => x.sourceText,
  );
  late final Map<String, List<T>> _translationExact = _buildExact(
    _items,
    (x) => x.translationText,
  );
  late final Map<String, List<T>> _tokenIndex = _buildTokens(_items);
  late final Map<String, List<T>> _topicGroups = _buildGroups(
    _items,
    (x) => x.topic,
  );
  late final Map<String, List<T>> _skillGroups = _buildGroups(
    _items,
    (x) => x.skill,
  );
  final Map<String, _Entry<T>> _entryCache = <String, _Entry<T>>{};
  late final Map<String, List<_Entry<T>>> _trigramIndex = _buildTrigrams(
    _items
        .map((item) => _Entry<T>(item, _textNormalizer))
        .toList(growable: false),
  );

  SearchIndex(this._items, this._verbIndex, this._textNormalizer);

  List<T> search(String query, {int limit = 60, String? skill}) =>
      searchDetailed(
        query,
        limit: limit,
        skill: skill,
      ).map((x) => x.item).toList(growable: false);

  List<SearchResult<T>> searchDetailed(
    String query, {
    int limit = 60,
    String? skill,
  }) {
    final q = _textNormalizer.answer(query);
    final cap = limit.clamp(1, 200).toInt();
    final eligible = (T x) => skill == null || x.skill == skill;
    if (q.isEmpty) {
      return _items
          .where(eligible)
          .take(cap)
          .map((item) => SearchResult(item, 1, 'browse', 'عرض المحتوى'))
          .toList(growable: false);
    }

    final scored = <String, SearchResult<T>>{};
    void add(T item, int score, String type, String label) {
      if (!eligible(item)) return;
      final existing = scored[item.id];
      if (existing == null || score > existing.score) {
        scored[item.id] = SearchResult(item, score, type, label);
      }
    }

    final exactResults = <SearchResult<T>>[];
    for (final item in _sourceExact[q] ?? <T>[]) {
      if (eligible(item))
        exactResults.add(
          SearchResult(item, 1000, 'exactGerman', 'مطابقة ألمانية كاملة'),
        );
    }
    for (final item in _translationExact[q] ?? <T>[]) {
      if (eligible(item))
        exactResults.add(
          SearchResult(item, 940, 'exactArabic', 'مطابقة عربية كاملة'),
        );
    }
    if (exactResults.length >= cap)
      return exactResults.take(cap).toList(growable: false);

    for (final item in exactResults) {
      add(item.item, item.score, item.matchType, item.label);
    }

    final verbInfinitives = _verbIndex.infinitivesFor(q);
    for (final infinitive in verbInfinitives) {
      for (final item
          in _sourceExact[_textNormalizer.answer(infinitive)] ?? <T>[]) {
        add(item, 920, 'verbForm', 'صيغة فعل → المصدر');
      }
    }

    if (scored.length >= cap) {
      final result = scored.values.toList(growable: false);
      return result.take(cap).toList(growable: false);
    }

    final queryTokens = _tokens(q);
    final candidates = <T>{};
    for (final token in queryTokens) {
      candidates.addAll(_tokenIndex[token] ?? <T>[]);
    }
    // Do not fall back to the full corpus here: a miss should move to the
    // bounded fuzzy stage instead of materializing thousands of _Entry objects.
    for (final item in candidates) {
      if (!eligible(item)) continue;
      final entry = _entryCache[item.id] ??= _Entry<T>(item, _textNormalizer);
      final scoredEntry = entry.scoreDetailed(q);
      if (scoredEntry.score > 0)
        add(item, scoredEntry.score, scoredEntry.type, scoredEntry.label);
    }

    // Fuzzy fallback is intentionally bounded to avoid O(N²) behavior for ordinary searches.
    if (scored.length < cap) {
      for (final entry in _fuzzyCandidates(q)) {
        if (!eligible(entry.item) || scored.containsKey(entry.item.id))
          continue;
        final distance = _bestFuzzyDistance(q, entry.searchTerms);
        if (distance <= _fuzzyLimit(q)) {
          final score = 320 - distance * 55 + _lengthProximity(q, entry.source);
          add(entry.item, score, 'fuzzy', 'اقتراح تهجئة قريب');
        }
      }
    }

    final result = scored.values.toList(growable: false)
      ..sort((a, b) {
        final score = b.score.compareTo(a.score);
        if (score != 0) return score;
        return a.item.sourceText.compareTo(b.item.sourceText);
      });
    return result.take(cap).toList(growable: false);
  }

  List<String> suggestions(String query, {int limit = 5}) {
    final q = _textNormalizer.answer(query);
    if (q.isEmpty) return const <String>[];
    return searchDetailed(q, limit: limit * 2)
        .where((r) => r.matchType == 'fuzzy')
        .map((r) => r.item.sourceText)
        .toSet()
        .take(limit.clamp(1, 20).toInt())
        .toList(growable: false);
  }

  Map<String, List<T>> get topicGroups => _topicGroups;
  Map<String, List<T>> get skillGroups => _skillGroups;

  static Map<String, List<E>> _buildGroups<E extends LearningContent>(
    List<E> items,
    String Function(E) key,
  ) {
    final map = <String, List<E>>{};
    for (final item in items) {
      (map[key(item)] ??= <E>[]).add(item);
    }
    return map;
  }

  Map<String, List<E>> _buildExact<E extends LearningContent>(
    List<E> items,
    String Function(E) key,
  ) {
    final map = <String, List<E>>{};
    for (final item in items) {
      final value = _textNormalizer.answer(key(item));
      if (value.isNotEmpty) (map[value] ??= <E>[]).add(item);
    }
    return map;
  }

  Iterable<_Entry<T>> _fuzzyCandidates(String q) {
    const maxCandidates = 160;
    final grams = trigramsFor(q);
    if (grams.isEmpty) {
      final maxDistance = _fuzzyLimit(q);
      final first = q.isEmpty ? '' : q[0];
      final candidates = <_Entry<T>>[];
      for (final item in _items) {
        if (first.isNotEmpty &&
            !_textNormalizer.answer(item.sourceText).startsWith(first))
          continue;
        if ((_textNormalizer.answer(item.sourceText).length - q.length).abs() >
            maxDistance + 1) continue;
        candidates.add(
          _entryCache[item.id] ??= _Entry<T>(item, _textNormalizer),
        );
        if (candidates.length >= _fuzzyCandidateCap(q)) break;
      }
      return candidates;
    }

    final candidates = <_Entry<T>>{};
    for (final gram in grams) {
      for (final entry in _trigramIndex[gram] ?? <_Entry<T>>[]) {
        candidates.add(entry);
        if (candidates.length >= maxCandidates) break;
      }
      if (candidates.length >= maxCandidates) break;
    }
    return candidates;
  }

  int _fuzzyCandidateCap(String q) => q.length <= 4 ? 80 : 160;

  static Map<String, List<_Entry<E>>> _buildTrigrams<E extends LearningContent>(
    List<_Entry<E>> entries,
  ) {
    final map = <String, List<_Entry<E>>>{};
    for (final entry in entries) {
      for (final term in entry.searchTerms) {
        for (final gram in trigramsFor(term)) {
          (map[gram] ??= <_Entry<E>>[]).add(entry);
        }
      }
    }
    return map;
  }

  Map<String, List<E>> _buildTokens<E extends LearningContent>(List<E> items) {
    final map = <String, List<E>>{};
    for (final item in items) {
      final german = _tokens(_textNormalizer.answer(item.sourceText));
      final arabic = _tokens(_textNormalizer.answer(item.translationText));
      final plural = _tokens(_textNormalizer.answer(item.pluralForm));
      for (final token in {...german, ...arabic, ...plural}) {
        (map[token] ??= <E>[]).add(item);
      }
    }
    return map;
  }
}

class SearchResult<T extends LearningContent> {
  final T item;
  final int score;
  final String matchType;
  final String label;
  const SearchResult(this.item, this.score, this.matchType, this.label);

  String get level => score >= 900
      ? 'high'
      : score >= 500
          ? 'medium'
          : 'low';
}

class _EntryScore {
  final int score;
  final String type;
  final String label;
  const _EntryScore(this.score, this.type, this.label);
}

class _Entry<T extends LearningContent> {
  final T item;
  final String source,
      translation,
      sentence,
      sentenceAr,
      topic,
      grammaticalMarker,
      plural;
  final LanguageTextNormalizer _textNormalizer;
  final Set<String> sourceTokens, translationTokens;
  final Set<String> searchTerms;

  _Entry(this.item, this._textNormalizer)
      : source = _textNormalizer.answer(item.sourceText),
        translation = _textNormalizer.answer(item.translationText),
        sentence = _textNormalizer.answer(item.exampleText),
        sentenceAr = _textNormalizer.answer(item.exampleTranslationText),
        topic = _textNormalizer.answer(item.topic),
        grammaticalMarker = _textNormalizer.answer(item.grammaticalMarker),
        plural = _textNormalizer.answer(item.pluralForm),
        sourceTokens = _tokens(_textNormalizer.answer(item.sourceText)),
        translationTokens =
            _tokens(_textNormalizer.answer(item.translationText)),
        searchTerms = {
          _textNormalizer.answer(item.sourceText),
          _textNormalizer.answer(item.translationText),
          _textNormalizer.answer(item.pluralForm),
          ...item.acceptedForms.map(_textNormalizer.answer),
        }..removeWhere((x) => x.isEmpty);

  int tokenScore(String q) => scoreDetailed(q).score;

  _EntryScore scoreDetailed(String q) {
    if (source == q)
      return const _EntryScore(1000, 'exactGerman', 'مطابقة ألمانية كاملة');
    if ('$grammaticalMarker $source' == q)
      return const _EntryScore(980, 'article', 'مطابقة Artikel + كلمة');
    if ('$source $plural' == q && plural.isNotEmpty)
      return const _EntryScore(970, 'plural', 'مطابقة المفرد + الجمع');
    if (plural == q)
      return const _EntryScore(900, 'plural', 'مطابقة صيغة الجمع');
    if (item.acceptedForms.any((x) => _textNormalizer.answer(x) == q))
      return const _EntryScore(890, 'accepted', 'إجابة بديلة معتمدة');
    if (source.startsWith(q))
      return const _EntryScore(850, 'prefix', 'مطابقة بداية الكلمة');
    if (source.contains(q))
      return const _EntryScore(720, 'containsGerman', 'الكلمة تحتوي البحث');
    if (translation == q)
      return const _EntryScore(940, 'exactArabic', 'مطابقة عربية كاملة');
    if (translation.contains(q))
      return const _EntryScore(610, 'containsArabic', 'العربية تحتوي البحث');
    if (plural.contains(q))
      return const _EntryScore(520, 'containsPlural', 'البحث داخل الجمع');
    if (sentence.contains(q) || sentenceAr.contains(q))
      return const _EntryScore(410, 'example', 'مطابقة داخل المثال');
    if (topic.contains(q))
      return const _EntryScore(250, 'topic', 'مطابقة الموضوع');
    final queryTokens = _tokens(q);
    if (queryTokens.isEmpty) return const _EntryScore(0, 'none', '');
    final germanHits = queryTokens.where(sourceTokens.contains).length;
    final arabicHits = queryTokens.where(translationTokens.contains).length;
    final hits = germanHits + arabicHits;
    if (hits == 0) return const _EntryScore(0, 'none', '');
    final coverage = hits / queryTokens.length;
    if (coverage == 1 && germanHits == queryTokens.length)
      return const _EntryScore(560, 'tokenGerman', 'مطابقة كلمات ألمانية');
    if (coverage >= .5 && germanHits > 0)
      return const _EntryScore(
        360,
        'tokenMixed',
        'مطابقة جزئية متعددة الكلمات',
      );
    return const _EntryScore(180, 'tokenArabic', 'مطابقة كلمات عربية');
  }
}

int _bestFuzzyDistance(String q, Iterable<String> terms) {
  var best = 999;
  for (final term in terms) {
    final d = _editDistance(q, term);
    if (d < best) best = d;
    if (best == 0) break;
  }
  return best;
}

int _fuzzyLimit(String q) => q.length <= 4
    ? 1
    : q.length <= 8
        ? 2
        : 3;

int _lengthProximity(String a, String b) =>
    (10 - (a.length - b.length).abs()).clamp(0, 10).toInt();

int _editDistance(String a, String b) {
  if (a == b) return 0;
  if (a.isEmpty) return b.length;
  if (b.isEmpty) return a.length;
  if (a.length < b.length) return _editDistance(b, a);
  var previous = List<int>.generate(b.length + 1, (i) => i);
  for (var i = 1; i <= a.length; i++) {
    final current = List<int>.filled(b.length + 1, 0);
    current[0] = i;
    for (var j = 1; j <= b.length; j++) {
      final cost = a.codeUnitAt(i - 1) == b.codeUnitAt(j - 1) ? 0 : 1;
      current[j] = [
        current[j - 1] + 1,
        previous[j] + 1,
        previous[j - 1] + cost,
      ].reduce((x, y) => x < y ? x : y);
    }
    previous = current;
  }
  return previous[b.length];
}

Set<String> _tokens(String value) => value
    .split(RegExp(r'[^\p{L}\p{N}]+', unicode: true))
    .where((x) => x.isNotEmpty)
    .toSet();

Set<String> trigramsFor(String value) {
  if (value.length < 3) return const <String>{};
  final grams = <String>{};
  for (var i = 0; i <= value.length - 3; i++) {
    grams.add(value.substring(i, i + 3));
  }
  return grams;
}
