import '../core/storage/local_db/learner_state_database.dart';
import 'legacy_learner_snapshot_reader.dart';

enum LearnerStateMigrationStatus {
  migrated,
  alreadyVerified,
}

final class LearnerStateMigrationResult {
  const LearnerStateMigrationResult({
    required this.status,
    required this.record,
  });

  final LearnerStateMigrationStatus status;
  final LearnerMigrationRecord record;
}

final class LearnerStateMigration {
  LearnerStateMigration({
    required this.database,
    required this.legacyReader,
    DateTime Function()? now,
  }) : _now = now ?? DateTime.now;

  static const String migrationId =
      'shared_preferences_v34_to_learner_sqlite_v1';
  static const int migrationVersion = 1;

  final LearnerStateDatabase database;
  final LegacyLearnerSnapshotReader legacyReader;
  final DateTime Function() _now;

  Future<LearnerStateMigrationResult> migrateAndVerify() async {
    final existing = await database.loadMigrationRecord(migrationId);
    if (existing != null) {
      await _verifyCommittedRecord(existing);
      return LearnerStateMigrationResult(
        status: LearnerStateMigrationStatus.alreadyVerified,
        record: existing,
      );
    }

    if (await database.hasDomainRows()) {
      throw const LearnerStateMigrationException(
        'unverified_learner_sqlite_state',
      );
    }

    final source = await legacyReader.readStrict();

    final record = await database.transaction((txn) async {
      final existingInside = await database.loadMigrationRecord(
        migrationId,
        executor: txn,
      );
      if (existingInside != null) {
        await _verifyRecordAgainstSnapshot(
          existingInside,
          await database.readSnapshot(executor: txn),
        );
        return existingInside;
      }

      final unexpectedMarkers = await txn.query(
        LearnerStateDatabase.migrationTable,
        columns: const <String>['migration_id'],
        limit: 1,
      );
      if (unexpectedMarkers.isNotEmpty) {
        throw const LearnerStateMigrationException(
          'unexpected_learner_migration_record',
        );
      }

      if (await database.hasDomainRows(executor: txn)) {
        throw const LearnerStateMigrationException(
          'unverified_learner_sqlite_state',
        );
      }

      final revision = await database.loadRevision(executor: txn);
      if (revision != 0) {
        throw const LearnerStateMigrationException(
          'learner_store_revision_not_pristine',
        );
      }

      await database.importSnapshot(txn, source.sqliteSnapshot);

      final imported = await database.readSnapshot(executor: txn);
      final importedHash =
          await LegacyLearnerSnapshotReader.canonicalSnapshotSha256(
        imported,
      );
      _verifyImportedSnapshot(
        source: source,
        imported: imported,
        importedHash: importedHash,
      );

      final completedAt = _now().toUtc();
      final verified = LearnerMigrationRecord(
        migrationId: migrationId,
        migrationVersion: migrationVersion,
        sourceStorageKey: legacyReader.storageKey,
        sourcePayloadSha256: source.sourcePayloadSha256,
        sourceLegacyFavoritesSha256:
            source.sourceLegacyFavoritesSha256,
        importedSnapshotSha256: importedHash,
        attemptCount: imported.attempts.length,
        assessmentCount: imported.assessmentHistory.length,
        placementCount: imported.placementHistory.length,
        favoriteCount: imported.favoriteVerbs.length,
        completedAtUtc: completedAt,
        cutoverRevision: revision,
      );
      await database.insertVerifiedMigrationRecord(txn, verified);
      return verified;
    });

    await _verifyCommittedRecord(record);
    return LearnerStateMigrationResult(
      status: LearnerStateMigrationStatus.migrated,
      record: record,
    );
  }

  Future<void> _verifyCommittedRecord(
    LearnerMigrationRecord record,
  ) async {
    if (record.migrationId != migrationId ||
        record.migrationVersion != migrationVersion ||
        record.sourceStorageKey != legacyReader.storageKey) {
      throw const LearnerStateMigrationException(
        'migration_record_identity_mismatch',
      );
    }

    final persisted = await database.loadMigrationRecord(migrationId);
    if (persisted == null) {
      throw const LearnerStateMigrationException(
        'migration_record_missing_after_commit',
      );
    }
    _verifyRecordIdentity(record, persisted);

    final revision = await database.loadRevision();
    if (revision < persisted.cutoverRevision) {
      throw const LearnerStateMigrationException(
        'learner_store_revision_regressed',
      );
    }

    final snapshot = await database.readSnapshot();
    if (revision == persisted.cutoverRevision) {
      await _verifyRecordAgainstSnapshot(persisted, snapshot);
    }
  }

  Future<bool> canFallbackToLegacy() async {
    try {
      final revision = await database.loadRevision();
      if (revision != 0) return false;
      final marker = await database.loadMigrationRecord(migrationId);
      if (marker != null) return false;
      return !await database.hasDomainRows();
    } on Object {
      return false;
    }
  }

  static Future<void> _verifyRecordAgainstSnapshot(
    LearnerMigrationRecord record,
    LearnerSqliteSnapshot snapshot,
  ) async {
    final hash =
        await LegacyLearnerSnapshotReader.canonicalSnapshotSha256(snapshot);
    if (hash != record.importedSnapshotSha256 ||
        snapshot.attempts.length != record.attemptCount ||
        snapshot.assessmentHistory.length != record.assessmentCount ||
        snapshot.placementHistory.length != record.placementCount ||
        snapshot.favoriteVerbs.length != record.favoriteCount) {
      throw const LearnerStateMigrationException(
        'learner_sqlite_readback_mismatch',
      );
    }
  }

  static void _verifyImportedSnapshot({
    required LegacyLearnerMigrationSnapshot source,
    required LearnerSqliteSnapshot imported,
    required String importedHash,
  }) {
    if (importedHash != source.canonicalSnapshotSha256 ||
        imported.attempts.length != source.attemptCount ||
        imported.assessmentHistory.length != source.assessmentCount ||
        imported.placementHistory.length != source.placementCount ||
        imported.favoriteVerbs.length != source.favoriteCount) {
      throw const LearnerStateMigrationException(
        'learner_sqlite_import_verification_failed',
      );
    }
  }

  static void _verifyRecordIdentity(
    LearnerMigrationRecord expected,
    LearnerMigrationRecord actual,
  ) {
    if (expected.migrationId != actual.migrationId ||
        expected.migrationVersion != actual.migrationVersion ||
        expected.sourceStorageKey != actual.sourceStorageKey ||
        expected.sourcePayloadSha256 != actual.sourcePayloadSha256 ||
        expected.sourceLegacyFavoritesSha256 !=
            actual.sourceLegacyFavoritesSha256 ||
        expected.importedSnapshotSha256 !=
            actual.importedSnapshotSha256 ||
        expected.attemptCount != actual.attemptCount ||
        expected.assessmentCount != actual.assessmentCount ||
        expected.placementCount != actual.placementCount ||
        expected.favoriteCount != actual.favoriteCount ||
        expected.completedAtUtc.toUtc().microsecondsSinceEpoch !=
            actual.completedAtUtc.toUtc().microsecondsSinceEpoch ||
        expected.cutoverRevision != actual.cutoverRevision) {
      throw const LearnerStateMigrationException(
        'migration_record_readback_mismatch',
      );
    }
  }
}

final class LearnerStateMigrationException implements Exception {
  const LearnerStateMigrationException(this.code);

  final String code;

  @override
  String toString() => 'LearnerStateMigrationException($code)';
}

import '../models/secure_session_credentials.dart';

/// Storage failures are deliberately non-semantic: callers must fail closed
/// rather than inspect or recover credential contents.
enum SecureSessionStorageFailureCode { unavailable, corrupted, unreadable }

final class SecureSessionStorageFailure implements Exception {
  const SecureSessionStorageFailure(this.code);

  final SecureSessionStorageFailureCode code;

  @override
  String toString() => 'SecureSessionStorageFailure($code)';
}

/// Platform-secure storage boundary for authenticated session credentials.
///
/// A future Android implementation must use platform-secure primitives. This
/// contract intentionally selects no package or concrete storage mechanism.
/// Replacement means the new credential is the only credential reported by a
/// successful operation; an implementation must not report success after a
/// failed write.
abstract interface class SecureSessionStorage {
  Future<void> save(SecureSessionCredentials credentials);

  Future<SecureSessionCredentials?> read();

  Future<void> clear();

  Future<void> replace(SecureSessionCredentials credentials) =>
      save(credentials);
}

/// Safe default while no real platform-secure implementation exists.
/// Nothing is persisted.
final class UnavailableSecureSessionStorage implements SecureSessionStorage {
  const UnavailableSecureSessionStorage();

  @override
  Future<void> save(SecureSessionCredentials credentials) async {
    throw const SecureSessionStorageFailure(
      SecureSessionStorageFailureCode.unavailable,
    );
  }

  @override
  Future<SecureSessionCredentials?> read() async => null;

  @override
  Future<void> clear() async {}

  @override
  Future<void> replace(SecureSessionCredentials credentials) async {
    throw const SecureSessionStorageFailure(
      SecureSessionStorageFailureCode.unavailable,
    );
  }
}

import 'package:sqflite_common/sqlite_api.dart';

import 'sqlite_policy.dart';

class SmartMistakesLedger {
  static const String _tableName = 'smart_mistakes';
  static const String _columnWordId = 'word_id';
  static const String _columnRating = 'rating';
  static const String _columnTimestamp = 'timestamp';
  static const String _columnCount = 'mistake_count';

  static final SmartMistakesLedger instance = SmartMistakesLedger._init();
  static Database? _database;
  static const AppSqlitePolicy _sqlitePolicy = AppSqlitePolicy();

  SmartMistakesLedger._init();

  Future<Database> get database async {
    if (_database != null) return _database!;
    _database = await _initDB('smart_mistakes.db');
    return _database!;
  }

  Future<Database> _initDB(String filePath) async {
    final path = await _sqlitePolicy.resolvePath(fileName: filePath);
    return _sqlitePolicy.openWritable(
      path: path,
      version: 1,
      onCreate: _createDB,
    );
  }

  Future _createDB(Database db, int version) async {
    await db.execute('''
      CREATE TABLE $_tableName (
        $_columnWordId TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        $_columnRating TEXT NOT NULL,
        $_columnTimestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
        $_columnCount INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
      )
    ''');
  }

  Future<void> logMistake(
    String wordId,
    String rating,
    DateTime timestamp,
  ) async {
    final db = await instance.database;
    final timestampString = timestamp.toIso8601String();

    await db.transaction((txn) async {
      final maps = await txn.query(
        _tableName,
        where: '$_columnWordId = ?',
        whereArgs: [wordId],
      );

      if (maps.isEmpty) {
        await txn.insert(_tableName, {
          _columnWordId: wordId,
          _columnRating: rating,
          _columnTimestamp: timestampString,
          _columnCount: 1,
        });
      } else {
        final currentCount = maps.first[_columnCount] as int;
        await txn.update(
          _tableName,
          {
            _columnCount: currentCount + 1,
            _columnRating: rating,
            _columnTimestamp: timestampString,
          },
          where: '$_columnWordId = ?',
          whereArgs: [wordId],
        );
      }
    });
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> getDifficultWords({int limit = 50}) async {
    final db = await instance.database;

    final maps = await db.query(
      _tableName,
      orderBy: '$_columnCount DESC, $_columnTimestamp DESC',
      limit: limit,
    );

    return maps;
  }

  Future<void> clear() async {
    final db = await instance.database;
    await db.delete(_tableName);
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    if (_database != null) {
      await _database!.close();
      _database = null;
    }
  }
}

import '../models/learner.dart';

class Stats {
  static double score(LearnerState s, String skill) {
    final a = s.attempts.where((x) => x.skill == skill).toList();
    if (a.isEmpty) return 0;
    return a.where((x) => x.correct).length / a.length;
  }

  static int avgSeconds(LearnerState s) {
    if (s.attempts.isEmpty) return 0;
    return (s.attempts.map((x) => x.seconds).reduce((a, b) => a + b) /
            s.attempts.length)
        .round();
  }

  static int completedTopics(LearnerState s) => s.learned.length;
}

import 'package:sqflite/sqflite.dart';
import 'package:path/path.dart';

import 'database_migration_helper.dart';

class MilestoneBadge {
  final String id;
  final String title;
  final String description;
  final int requiredStreak;

  const MilestoneBadge({
    required this.id,
    required this.title,
    required this.description,
    required this.requiredStreak,
  });
}

class StreakMilestonesEngine {
  static const String _tableName = 'streak_milestones';
  static const String _columnId = 'id';
  static const String _columnUnlockedAt = 'unlocked_at';

  static final StreakMilestonesEngine instance = StreakMilestonesEngine._init();
  static StreakMilestonesEngine getInstance() => instance;
  static Database? _database;

  static const List<MilestoneBadge> availableBadges = [
    MilestoneBadge(
      id: 'streak_3',
      title: 'بداية موفقة',
      description: 'دراسة لمدة 3 أيام متتالية',
      requiredStreak: 3,
    ),
    MilestoneBadge(
      id: 'streak_7',
      title: 'أسبوع من الالتزام',
      description: 'دراسة لمدة 7 أيام متتالية',
      requiredStreak: 7,
    ),
    MilestoneBadge(
      id: 'streak_30',
      title: 'شهر كامل',
      description: 'دراسة لمدة 30 يوم متتالية',
      requiredStreak: 30,
    ),
    MilestoneBadge(
      id: 'streak_100',
      title: 'مئة يوم من النجاح',
      description: 'دراسة لمدة 100 يوم متتالية',
      requiredStreak: 100,
    ),
    MilestoneBadge(
      id: 'streak_365',
      title: 'سنة من التفوق',
      description: 'دراسة لمدة 365 يوم متتالية',
      requiredStreak: 365,
    ),
  ];

  StreakMilestonesEngine._init();

  Future<Database> get database async {
    if (_database != null) return _database!;
    _database = await _initDB('milestones.db');
    return _database!;
  }

  Future<Database> _initDB(String filePath) async {
    final dbPath = await getDatabasesPath();
    final path = join(dbPath, filePath);

    return await DatabaseMigrationHelper.open(
      path: path,
      version: 1,
      onCreate: _createDB,
      migrationScripts: {},
    );
  }

  Future _createDB(Database db, int version) async {
    await db.execute('''
      CREATE TABLE $_tableName (
        $_columnId TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        $_columnUnlockedAt TEXT NOT NULL
      )
    ''');
  }

  Future<List<String>> checkAndUnlockMilestones(int currentStreak) async {
    final db = await instance.database;
    final now = DateTime.now().toIso8601String();
    List<String> newlyUnlocked = [];

    await DatabaseMigrationHelper.executeAtomic(db, (txn) async {
      for (final badge in availableBadges) {
        if (currentStreak >= badge.requiredStreak) {
          final maps = await txn.query(
            _tableName,
            where: '$_columnId = ?',
            whereArgs: [badge.id],
          );

          if (maps.isEmpty) {
            await txn.insert(_tableName, {
              _columnId: badge.id,
              _columnUnlockedAt: now,
            });
            newlyUnlocked.add(badge.id);
          }
        }
      }
    });

    return newlyUnlocked;
  }

  Future<Set<String>> getUnlockedMilestones() async {
    final db = await instance.database;
    final maps = await db.query(_tableName);

    return maps.map((map) => map[_columnId] as String).toSet();
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    final db = await instance.database;
    db.close();
  }
}

import '../models/learner.dart';

class TeacherDecision {
  final String skill, title, reason;
  final List<String> proof;
  const TeacherDecision(this.skill, this.title, this.reason, this.proof);
}

class Teacher {
  static TeacherDecision decide(LearnerState s) {
    if (s.attempts.isEmpty)
      return const TeacherDecision(
        'baseline',
        'ابدأ اختبار البداية',
        'لا توجد بيانات كافية؛ سنقيسك أولًا عبر مهارات مختلفة.',
        ['Recognize', 'Understand', 'Listen', 'Produce', 'Transfer', 'Retain'],
      );
    if (s.review.isNotEmpty)
      return const TeacherDecision(
        'review',
        'راجع الأخطاء أولًا',
        'لديك عناصر تحتاج مراجعة قبل إضافة محتوى جديد.',
        ['Recognize', 'Understand', 'Retain'],
      );
    final m = <String, List<double>>{};
    for (final a in s.attempts) {
      m.putIfAbsent(a.skill, () => []).add(a.correct ? 1 : 0);
    }
    String weak = 'recall';
    double score = 1;
    for (final e in m.entries) {
      final x = e.value.reduce((a, b) => a + b) / e.value.length;
      if (x < score) {
        score = x;
        weak = e.key;
      }
    }
    const n = {
      'recall': 'التعرّف',
      'listening': 'الاستماع',
      'production': 'الإنتاج',
      'transfer': 'النقل',
    };
    return TeacherDecision(
      weak,
      'درّب ${n[weak] ?? weak}',
      'أداءك الحالي في هذه المهارة هو ${(score * 100).round()}%، لذلك هي الأولوية.',
      ['Recognize', 'Understand', 'Listen', 'Produce', 'Transfer', 'Retain'],
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter_tts/flutter_tts.dart';

class FlutterOfflineTtsEngine {
  final FlutterTts _flutterTts = FlutterTts();

  Future<void> speak(String text, {String lang = 'de-DE', double? rate}) async {
    if (text.trim().isEmpty) return;
    try {
      if (rate != null) await _flutterTts.setSpeechRate(rate);
      await _flutterTts.setLanguage(lang);
      await _flutterTts.speak(text);
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> stop() async {
    await _flutterTts.stop();
  }

  void dispose() {
    _flutterTts.stop();
  }
}

class SafeTtsController {
  static final SafeTtsController _instance = SafeTtsController._internal();
  factory SafeTtsController() => _instance;
  SafeTtsController._internal();

  final FlutterTts _tts = FlutterTts();

  Future<void> speak(String text, {String? languageCode, double? rate}) async {
    if (text.trim().isEmpty) return;
    try {
      if (rate != null) await _tts.setSpeechRate(rate);
      await _tts.setLanguage(languageCode ?? 'de-DE');
      await _tts.speak(text);
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> stop() async {
    await _tts.stop();
  }

  void dispose() {
    _tts.stop();
  }
}

class TtsService {
  static final TtsService _instance = TtsService._internal();
  factory TtsService() => _instance;
  TtsService._internal() {
    _initTts();
  }

  final FlutterTts _flutterTts = FlutterTts();

  void _initTts() async {
    await _flutterTts.setSpeechRate(0.45);
    await _flutterTts.setVolume(1.0);
    await _flutterTts.setPitch(1.0);
  }

  String _mapLanguageCode(String code) {
    switch (code.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'de':
        return 'de-DE';
      case 'en':
        return 'en-US';
      case 'fr':
        return 'fr-FR';
      case 'es':
        return 'es-ES';
      case 'tr':
        return 'tr-TR';
      default:
        return 'de-DE';
    }
  }

  Future<void> speak(String text, {String langCode = 'de'}) async {
    if (text.trim().isEmpty) return;
    try {
      final locale = _mapLanguageCode(langCode);
      await _flutterTts.setLanguage(locale);
      await _flutterTts.speak(text);
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> stop() async {
    await _flutterTts.stop();
  }

  void dispose() {
    _flutterTts.stop();
  }
}

import 'preferences_service.dart';
import '../core/view_mode.dart';

class UiPreferences {
  static const viewModeKey = 'vocabulary_view_mode';
  static const dailyStudyTimeKey = 'daily_study_time_minutes';
  static const pomodoroTimerKey = 'pomodoro_timer_minutes';
  static const dailyNewCardsQuotaKey = 'daily_new_cards_quota';
  static const dailyReviewLimitKey = 'daily_review_limit';

  final PreferencesService _prefs;

  const UiPreferences(this._prefs);

  ViewMode? get viewMode {
    final stored = _prefs.getString(viewModeKey);
    if (stored == null || stored.isEmpty) return null;
    final normalized = stored.startsWith('ViewMode.')
        ? stored.substring('ViewMode.'.length)
        : stored;
    for (final mode in ViewMode.values) {
      if (mode.name == normalized) return mode;
    }
    return null;
  }

  Future<bool> setViewMode(ViewMode mode) {
    return _prefs.setString(viewModeKey, mode.name);
  }

  Future<bool> setDailyStudyProfile({
    required int minutes,
    required int newCardsQuota,
    required int reviewLimit,
  }) async {
    final results = await Future.wait<bool>([
      _prefs.setInt(dailyStudyTimeKey, minutes),
      _prefs.setInt(pomodoroTimerKey, minutes),
      _prefs.setInt(dailyNewCardsQuotaKey, newCardsQuota),
      _prefs.setInt(dailyReviewLimitKey, reviewLimit),
    ]);
    return results.every((value) => value);
  }
}

import 'sqlite_policy.dart';

class CustomExample {

class UserCustomization {
  final String wordId;
  final String? customArabicTranslation;
  final String? customNotes;
  final DateTime updatedAt;

  UserCustomization({
    required this.wordId,
    this.customArabicTranslation,
    this.customNotes,
    required this.updatedAt,
  });
}

class UserCustomizationService {
  UserCustomizationService({DatabaseFactory? factory, String? path})
      : _sqlitePolicy = AppSqlitePolicy(factory: factory),
        _overridePath = path;

  final AppSqlitePolicy _sqlitePolicy;
  final String? _overridePath;
  Database? _db;

  Future<Database> get db async {
    if (_db != null) return _db!;
    _db = await _initDb();
    return _db!;
  }

  Future<Database> _initDb() async {
    final path = await _sqlitePolicy.resolvePath(
      fileName: 'user_customizations.db',
      overridePath: _overridePath,
    );
    return _sqlitePolicy.openWritable(
      path: path,
      version: 1,
      onCreate: (database, version) async {
        await database.execute('''
          CREATE TABLE user_vocab_customizations (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            word_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
            custom_arabic_translation TEXT,
            custom_notes TEXT,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
          )
        ''');
        await database.execute('''
          CREATE TABLE user_custom_examples (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            word_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            german_sentence TEXT NOT NULL,
            arabic_sentence TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL
          )
        ''');
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> saveTranslationOverride(
    String wordId,
    String customArabic,
    String? notes,
  ) async {
    final database = await db;
    await database.insert(
        'user_vocab_customizations',
        {
          'word_id': wordId,
          'custom_arabic_translation': customArabic,
          'custom_notes': notes,
          'updated_at': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
        },
        conflictAlgorithm: ConflictAlgorithm.replace);
  }

  Future<void> resetTranslationOverride(String wordId) async {
    final database = await db;
    await database.delete(
      'user_vocab_customizations',
      where: 'word_id = ?',
      whereArgs: [wordId],
    );
  }

  Future<void> addCustomExample(
    String wordId,
    String germanSentence,
    String arabicSentence,
  ) async {
    final database = await db;
    await database.insert('user_custom_examples', {
      'word_id': wordId,
      'german_sentence': germanSentence,
      'arabic_sentence': arabicSentence,
      'created_at': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
    });
  }

  Future<void> deleteCustomExample(int exampleId) async {
    final database = await db;
    await database.delete(
      'user_custom_examples',
      where: 'id = ?',
      whereArgs: [exampleId],
    );
  }

  Future<List<CustomExample>> getCustomExamples(String wordId) async {
    final database = await db;
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> maps = await database.query(
      'user_custom_examples',
      where: 'word_id = ?',
      whereArgs: [wordId],
    );
    return List.generate(maps.length, (i) {
      return CustomExample(
        id: maps[i]['id'] as int,
        wordId: maps[i]['word_id'] as String,
        germanSentence: maps[i]['german_sentence'] as String,
        arabicSentence: maps[i]['arabic_sentence'] as String,
        createdAt: DateTime.parse(maps[i]['created_at'] as String),
      );
    });
  }

  Future<UserCustomization?> getCustomization(String wordId) async {
    final database = await db;
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> maps = await database.query(
      'user_vocab_customizations',
      where: 'word_id = ?',
      whereArgs: [wordId],
    );
    if (maps.isEmpty) {
      return null;
    }
    return UserCustomization(
      wordId: maps[0]['word_id'] as String,
      customArabicTranslation: maps[0]['custom_arabic_translation'] as String?,
      customNotes: maps[0]['custom_notes'] as String?,
      updatedAt: DateTime.parse(maps[0]['updated_at'] as String),
    );
  }
}

class UserVocabularyService {

      migrationScripts: {},
    );

    await DatabaseMigrationHelper.executeAtomic(db, (txn) async {
      await txn.insert(
        'user_vocabulary',

        conflictAlgorithm: ConflictAlgorithm.replace,
      );
    });
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> getCustomEntries({

      return await db.query(
        'user_vocabulary',

        orderBy: 'created_at DESC',
      );
    }
    return await db.query('user_vocabulary', orderBy: 'created_at DESC');
  }

  Future<void> deleteCustomEntry(String id) async {
    final db = await instance.database;
    await DatabaseMigrationHelper.executeAtomic(db, (txn) async {
      await txn.delete('user_vocabulary', where: 'id = ?', whereArgs: [id]);
    });
  }

    if (_database != null) {
      await _database!.close();
      _database = null;
    }
  }

  Future _createDB(Database db, int version) async {
    await db.execute('''
      CREATE TABLE vocabulary_favorites (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        is_favorite INTEGER NOT NULL
      )
    ''');

    await db.execute('''
      CREATE TABLE user_vocabulary (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        german_text TEXT NOT NULL,
        arabic_translation TEXT NOT NULL,
        article TEXT,
        notes TEXT,
        example_sentence TEXT,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        is_custom INTEGER NOT NULL
      )
    ''');
  }
}

class FavoritesRepository {
  static final FavoritesRepository instance = FavoritesRepository._init();
  FavoritesRepository._init();

  Future<void> toggleFavorite(String id) async {
    final db = await UserVocabularyService.instance.database;

    await DatabaseMigrationHelper.executeAtomic(db, (txn) async {
      final maps = await txn.query(
        'vocabulary_favorites',
        where: 'id = ?',
        whereArgs: [id],
      );

      if (maps.isEmpty) {
        await txn.insert('vocabulary_favorites', {'id': id, 'is_favorite': 1});
      } else {
        final current = maps.first['is_favorite'] as int;
        await txn.update(
          'vocabulary_favorites',
          {'is_favorite': current == 1 ? 0 : 1},
          where: 'id = ?',
          whereArgs: [id],
        );
      }
    });
  }

  Future<bool> isFavorite(String id) async {
    final db = await UserVocabularyService.instance.database;
    final maps = await db.query(
      'vocabulary_favorites',
      where: 'id = ?',
      whereArgs: [id],
    );

    if (maps.isEmpty) return false;
    return (maps.first['is_favorite'] as int) == 1;
  }

  Future<Set<String>> getFavorites() async {
    final db = await UserVocabularyService.instance.database;
    final maps = await db.query(
      'vocabulary_favorites',
      where: 'is_favorite = 1',
    );

    return maps.map((e) => e['id'] as String).toSet();
  }
}

import '../language/language_text_normalizer.dart';
import '../models/verb_conjugation.dart';

/// Language-neutral verb lookup over an explicitly supplied row set.
///
/// Production callers must source rows from an admitted runtime repository.
/// This engine deliberately owns no embedded/generated corpus fallback.
final class VerbIndex {
  VerbIndex.fromRows({
    required LanguageTextNormalizer textNormalizer,
    required Iterable<VerbConjugation> rows,
  }) : _textNormalizer = textNormalizer {
    for (final row in rows) {
      _byForm
          .putIfAbsent(
            _textNormalizer.answer(row.form),
            () => <VerbConjugation>[],
          )
          .add(row);
      _byInfinitive
          .putIfAbsent(
            _textNormalizer.answer(row.infinitive),
            () => <VerbConjugation>[],
          )
          .add(row);
      _byGroup.putIfAbsent(row.group, () => <String>{}).add(row.infinitive);
    }
    _infinitives = _byInfinitive.values
        .expand((items) => items)
        .map((row) => row.infinitive)
        .toSet()
        .toList(growable: false);
  }

  final LanguageTextNormalizer _textNormalizer;
  final Map<String, List<VerbConjugation>> _byForm =
      <String, List<VerbConjugation>>{};
  final Map<String, List<VerbConjugation>> _byInfinitive =
      <String, List<VerbConjugation>>{};
  final Map<String, Set<String>> _byGroup = <String, Set<String>>{};
  late final List<String> _infinitives;
  late final Map<String, List<String>> _groups = <String, List<String>>{
    for (final entry in _byGroup.entries)
      entry.key: entry.value.toList(growable: false),
  };

  List<VerbConjugation> lookup(String query) =>
      _byForm[_textNormalizer.answer(query)] ?? const <VerbConjugation>[];

  List<String> infinitivesFor(String query) =>
      lookup(query).map((row) => row.infinitive).toSet().toList(growable: false);

  List<VerbConjugation> rowsFor(String infinitive) =>
      _byInfinitive[_textNormalizer.answer(infinitive)] ??
      const <VerbConjugation>[];

  List<String> get infinitives => _infinitives;

  Map<String, List<String>> get groups => _groups;

  bool containsForm(String query) => lookup(query).isNotEmpty;
}

import '../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../models/learner.dart';
import '../language/language_content_quality.dart';

class VocabularyCoach {
  static List<LearningContent> recommend(
    List<LearningContent> items,
    LearnerState state, {
    required LanguageContentQuality contentQuality,
    int limit = 8,
    DateTime? now,
  }) {
    final at = now ?? DateTime.now();
    final attempts = <String, List<Attempt>>{};
    for (final attempt in state.meaningAttempts) {
      attempts.putIfAbsent(attempt.itemId, () => []).add(attempt);
    }
    final due = state.meaningReviewCards
        .where((c) => !c.dueAt.isAfter(at))
        .map((c) => c.itemId)
        .toSet();
    const maxRanked = 120;
    final ranked = <LearningContent>[];
    final rankedScores = <int>[];
    for (final item in items) {
      if (!contentQuality.isLearnable(item) || item.sourceText.trim().isEmpty)
        continue;
      final score = _priority(
        item,
        attempts[item.id] ?? const [],
        due.contains(item.id),
      );
      var insertAt = 0;
      while (insertAt < rankedScores.length && rankedScores[insertAt] >= score)
        insertAt++;
      if (ranked.length < maxRanked) {
        ranked.insert(insertAt, item);
        rankedScores.insert(insertAt, score);
      } else if (insertAt < maxRanked) {
        ranked.insert(insertAt, item);
        rankedScores.insert(insertAt, score);
        ranked.removeLast();
        rankedScores.removeLast();
      }
    }
    return ranked.take(limit.clamp(1, 120)).toList(growable: false);
  }

  static int _priority(LearningContent item, List<Attempt> attempts, bool due) {
    if (due) return 1000;
    if (attempts.isEmpty) return 700;
    final errors = attempts.where((a) => !a.correct).length;
    final recent =
        attempts.length > 6 ? attempts.sublist(attempts.length - 6) : attempts;
    final recentErrors = recent.where((a) => !a.correct).length;
    final hintCount = attempts.where((a) => a.hinted).length;
    return 500 +
        errors * 30 +
        recentErrors * 45 +
        hintCount * 8 +
        item.skill.length;
  }
}

FILE: lib/services/word_profile_service.dart

import '../core/content_contract.dart';
import 'search_index.dart';
import 'verb_index.dart';
import '../models/learner.dart';
import '../models/word_profile.dart';
import '../language/language_text_normalizer.dart';
import 'mastery.dart';

class WordProfileService {
  static WordProfile<T> build<T extends LearningContent>(
    T item,
    LearnerState state, {
    required SearchIndex<T> searchIndex,
    required VerbIndex verbIndex,
    required LanguageTextNormalizer textNormalizer,
    List<T>? corpus,
    List<Attempt>? itemAttempts,
    DateTime? now,
  }) {
    final at = now ?? DateTime.now();
    final attempts = (itemAttempts ??
            state.meaningAttempts
                .where((x) => x.itemId == item.id)
                .toList(growable: false))
        .where((attempt) => attempt.isMeaningFacet)
        .toList(growable: false);
    final due = state.reviewCards[item.id]?.dueAt.isBefore(at) ?? false;
    final evidence = Mastery.forItemRows(
      item.id,
      attempts,
      reviewCard: state.reviewCards[item.id],
    );
    final mastery = evidence.skillScores.isEmpty
        ? 0.0
        : (evidence.overall * .70 + evidence.retention * .30)
            .clamp(0.0, 1.0)
            .toDouble();
    final forms = <String>{};
    final words = <String>{};
    final examples = <String>{};
    final key = textNormalizer.answer(item.sourceText);
    for (final v in verbIndex.rowsFor(item.sourceText)) {
      forms.add(v.form);
      forms.add(v.past);
      examples.add(v.example);
      examples.add(v.pastExample);
    }
    final topicItems = searchIndex.topicGroups[item.topic] ?? <T>[];
    for (final x in topicItems) {
      if (x.id != item.id && words.length < 8) words.add(x.sourceText);
    }
    final sameSkillItems = searchIndex.skillGroups[item.skill] ?? <T>[];
    for (final x in sameSkillItems) {
      if (x.id == item.id || examples.length >= 8) continue;
      if (textNormalizer.answer(x.exampleText).contains(key))
        examples.add(x.exampleText);
    }
    return WordProfile(
      item: item,
      relatedForms: forms.take(10).toList(growable: false),
      relatedWords: words.take(8).toList(growable: false),
      relatedExamples: examples.take(6).toList(growable: false),
      attempts: attempts.length,
      errors: attempts.where((x) => !x.correct).length,
      due: due,
      masteryScore: mastery,
    );
  }
}

import '../language/language_text_normalizer.dart';

class WritingIssue {
  final String code;
  final String message;
  const WritingIssue(this.code, this.message);
}

/// Conservative offline German writing checks. It reports structural hints,
/// never claims full grammatical correctness.
class WritingAnalyzer {
  static List<WritingIssue> analyze(
    String input, {
    required LanguageTextNormalizer textNormalizer,
  }) {
    final text = input.trim();
    if (text.isEmpty) return const [WritingIssue('empty', 'اكتب جملة أولًا.')];
    final issues = <WritingIssue>[];
    if (!RegExp(r'[.!?]$').hasMatch(text)) {
      issues.add(
        const WritingIssue('punctuation', 'أضف علامة ترقيم في نهاية الجملة.'),
      );
    }
    if (text[0] != text[0].toUpperCase()) {
      issues.add(
        const WritingIssue('capital', 'ابدأ الجملة الألمانية بحرف كبير.'),
      );
    }
    final tokens = textNormalizer
        .answer(text)
        .split(' ')
        .where((x) => x.isNotEmpty)
        .toList();
    if (tokens.length >= 2) {
      const subjects = {'ich', 'du', 'er', 'sie', 'es', 'wir', 'ihr'};
      if (subjects.contains(tokens.first)) {
        final second = tokens[1];
        const commonVerbs = {
          'bin',
          'bist',
          'ist',
          'sind',
          'seid',
          'habe',
          'hast',
          'hat',
          'lernen',
          'lerne',
          'lernst',
          'lernt',
          'wohne',
          'wohnst',
          'wohnt',
          'gehe',
          'gehst',
          'geht',
          'komme',
          'kommst',
          'kommt',
          'mache',
          'machst',
          'macht',
          'arbeite',
          'arbeitest',
          'arbeitet',
          'spreche',
          'sprichst',
          'spricht',
          'esse',
          'isst',
          'trinke',
          'trinkst',
          'kauft',
          'kaufe',
          'fahre',
          'fährst',
          'fahrt',
          'kann',
          'kannst',
          'können',
          'möchte',
          'mochte',
        };
        if (!commonVerbs.contains(second)) {
          issues.add(
            const WritingIssue(
              'verb_position',
              'بعد الفاعل في الجملة الرئيسية راجع وجود الفعل المصرف في الموضع الثاني.',
            ),
          );
        }
      }
    }
    final repeated = <String>{};
    for (var i = 1; i < tokens.length; i++) {
      if (tokens[i] == tokens[i - 1] && tokens[i].length > 2)
        repeated.add(tokens[i]);
    }
    if (repeated.isNotEmpty) {
      issues.add(
        WritingIssue(
          'repetition',
          'تكرار كلمة متتالٍ: ${repeated.join(', ')}.',
        ),
      );
    }
    return issues;
  }
}

FILE: lib/services/active_pack_runtime_provider.dart

import 'dart:io';

import 'package:path/path.dart' as p;
import 'package:sqflite/sqflite.dart' as sqflite;
import 'package:sqflite_common/sqlite_api.dart'
    show Database, DatabaseFactory, OpenDatabaseOptions;
import 'package:sqflite_sqlcipher/sqflite.dart' as sqlcipher;

import '../features/srs/corpus_sqlite_contract.dart';
import '../features/srs/corpus_sqlite_migrator.dart';
import '../features/srs/corpus_sqlite_repository.dart';
import '../language/language_pack.dart';
import '../language/german/german_word_family_repository.dart';
import 'grammar_hub_service.dart';
import 'pack_grammar_hub_repository.dart';
import 'pack_german_word_family_repository.dart';
import 'pack_manager_service.dart';
import 'pack_database_key_store.dart';
import 'pack_database_security.dart';

enum RuntimeContentOrigin { activePack, embeddedFallback }

final class RuntimePackState {
  const RuntimePackState({
    required this.origin,
    this.activePackId,
    this.fallbackReason,
  });

  const RuntimePackState.embeddedFallback({
    this.activePackId,
    this.fallbackReason,
  }) : origin = RuntimeContentOrigin.embeddedFallback;

  final RuntimeContentOrigin origin;
  final String? activePackId;
  final String? fallbackReason;

  bool get isActivePack => origin == RuntimeContentOrigin.activePack;
}

final class RuntimePackResolution {
  const RuntimePackResolution({
    required this.languagePack,
    required this.grammarHubService,
    required this.state,
    this.wordFamilyRepository = const EmptyGermanWordFamilyRepository(),
    this.corpusRepository,
    Database? corpusDatabase,
  }) : _corpusDatabase = corpusDatabase;

  final LanguagePack languagePack;
  final GrammarHubRepository grammarHubService;
  final GermanWordFamilyRepository wordFamilyRepository;
  final RuntimePackState state;

  /// Indexed SQLite corpus. Null means no admitted local corpus is active.
  final IndexedSrsCorpusRepository? corpusRepository;
  final Database? _corpusDatabase;

  bool get hasIndexedCorpus => corpusRepository != null;

  Future<void> closeCorpus() async {
    final database = _corpusDatabase;
    if (database != null) {
      await database.close();
    }
  }
}

/// Admission boundary for authenticity/integrity decisions before the SQLite
/// database is trusted.
abstract interface class RuntimePackAdmissionGate {
  Future<void> verify({
    required InstalledLanguagePack pack,
    required String sqlitePath,
  });
}

final class RegisteredRuntimePackAdmissionGate
    implements RuntimePackAdmissionGate {
  const RegisteredRuntimePackAdmissionGate();

  @override
  Future<void> verify({
    required InstalledLanguagePack pack,
    required String sqlitePath,
  }) async {
    if (sqlitePath.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw const RuntimePackAdmissionException('pack_sqlite_missing');
    }
    if (pack.contractVersion.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw const RuntimePackAdmissionException('pack_contract_missing');
    }
    if (!pack.hasSignedProvenance) {
      throw const RuntimePackAdmissionException('pack_provenance_missing');
    }
    if (!pack.databaseEncrypted) {
      throw const RuntimePackAdmissionException('pack_database_unencrypted');
    }
  }
}

final class RuntimePackAdmissionException implements Exception {
  const RuntimePackAdmissionException(this.code);

  final String code;

  @override
  String toString() => 'RuntimePackAdmissionException($code)';
}

/// Resolves an admitted language pack to indexed local SQLite.
///
/// The signed/encrypted pack database remains immutable. Its legacy lexicon is
/// migrated in bounded pages into a derived indexed SRS database. Production
/// callers read content through [corpusRepository]; no full lexicon is
/// materialized into Dart objects here.
final class ActivePackRuntimeProvider {
  ActivePackRuntimeProvider({
    required this.packManager,
    required LanguagePack languagePack,
    required this.embeddedGrammar,
    this.databaseFactory,
    PackDatabaseKeyStore? databaseKeyStore,
    PackDatabaseOpener? databaseOpener,
    this.admissionGate = const RegisteredRuntimePackAdmissionGate(),
  })  : embeddedLanguagePack = languagePack,
        _databaseKeyStore =
            databaseKeyStore ?? const UnavailablePackDatabaseKeyStore(),
        _databaseOpener = databaseOpener ??
            (databaseFactory == null
                ? const SqlCipherPackDatabaseSecurity()
                : FactoryBackedPackDatabaseOpener(databaseFactory));

  static const String derivedCorpusFilePrefix = 'srs-corpus-v1-';

  final PackManagerService packManager;
  final LanguagePack embeddedLanguagePack;
  final GrammarHubRepository embeddedGrammar;
  final DatabaseFactory? databaseFactory;
  final PackDatabaseKeyStore _databaseKeyStore;
  final PackDatabaseOpener _databaseOpener;
  final RuntimePackAdmissionGate admissionGate;

  Future<RuntimePackResolution> resolve() async {
    final activeId = packManager.activePackId;
    if (activeId == null) {
      return _fallback('no_active_pack');
    }

    final installed = packManager.installedFor(activeId);
    if (installed == null) {
      return _fallback('active_pack_not_registered', activeId);
    }
    if (installed.languageCode.toLowerCase() !=
        embeddedLanguagePack.languageCode.toLowerCase()) {
      return _fallback('active_pack_language_mismatch', activeId);
    }

    final sqlitePath = p.join(
      packManager.rootDirectory.path,
      'packs',
      activeId,
      'content',
      'content.sqlite',
    );

    Database? source;
    Database? corpusDatabase;
    try {
      await admissionGate.verify(
        pack: installed,
        sqlitePath: sqlitePath,
      );
      if (!await _databaseExists(sqlitePath)) {
        throw const RuntimePackAdmissionException('pack_sqlite_missing');
      }

      final databaseKey = await _databaseKeyStore.readKey();
      if (databaseKey == null || databaseKey.trim().isEmpty) {
        throw const RuntimePackAdmissionException(
          'pack_database_key_missing',
        );
      }

      source = await _databaseOpener.openReadOnly(
        sqlitePath,
        password: databaseKey,
      );
      final expectedCardinality = await _validateMetadata(
        source,
        installed,
      );

      final prepared = await _openOrBuildCorpus(
        source: source,
        installed: installed,
        databaseKey: databaseKey,
        expectedCardinality: expectedCardinality,
      );
      corpusDatabase = prepared.database;

      await source.close();
      source = null;

      return RuntimePackResolution(
        languagePack: embeddedLanguagePack,
        grammarHubService: PackGrammarHubRepository(
          databasePath: sqlitePath,
          packId: activeId,
          fallback: embeddedGrammar,
          databaseOpener: _databaseOpener,
          databasePassword: databaseKey,
        ),
        wordFamilyRepository: PackGermanWordFamilyRepository(
          databasePath: sqlitePath,
          databaseOpener: _databaseOpener,
          databasePassword: databaseKey,
        ),
        corpusRepository: prepared.repository,
        corpusDatabase: corpusDatabase,
        state: RuntimePackState(
          origin: RuntimeContentOrigin.activePack,
          activePackId: activeId,
        ),
      );
    } on RuntimePackAdmissionException catch (error) {
      if (corpusDatabase != null) {
        await corpusDatabase.close();
      }
      return _fallback(error.code, activeId);
    } on Object {
      if (corpusDatabase != null) {
        await corpusDatabase.close();
      }
      return _fallback('active_pack_runtime_invalid', activeId);
    } finally {
      if (source != null) {
        try {
          await source.close();
        } on Object {
          // Cleanup must not replace the original failure reason.
        }
      }
    }
  }

  Future<_PreparedCorpus> _openOrBuildCorpus({
    required Database source,
    required InstalledLanguagePack installed,
    required String databaseKey,
    required SrsCorpusCardinality expectedCardinality,
  }) async {
    final runtimeDirectory = Directory(
      p.join(
        packManager.rootDirectory.path,
        'packs',
        installed.id,
        'runtime',
      ),
    );
    await runtimeDirectory.create(recursive: true);

    final contentIdentity = installed.contentSha256.toLowerCase();
    if (!RegExp(r'^[a-f0-9]{64}$').hasMatch(contentIdentity)) {
      throw const RuntimePackAdmissionException(
        'pack_content_sha256_invalid',
      );
    }
    final finalFile = File(
      p.join(
        runtimeDirectory.path,
        '$derivedCorpusFilePrefix$contentIdentity.sqlite',
      ),
    );
    final buildingFile = File(finalFile.path + '.building');

    if (await buildingFile.exists()) {
      await buildingFile.delete();
    }

    if (await finalFile.exists()) {
      final existing = await _tryOpenVerifiedCorpus(
        path: finalFile.path,
        databaseKey: databaseKey,
        expectedCardinality: expectedCardinality,
        sourceContentSha256: contentIdentity,
      );
      if (existing != null) {
        return existing;
      }
      await finalFile.delete();
    }

    Database? target;
    try {
      target = await _openWritableDerivedDatabase(
        path: buildingFile.path,
        databaseKey: databaseKey,
      );
      final report = await const SrsCorpusSqliteMigrator().migrate(
        source: source,
        target: target,
        expectedCardinality: expectedCardinality,
        sourceContentSha256: contentIdentity,
      );
      if (!report.matches(expectedCardinality)) {
        throw const RuntimePackAdmissionException(
          'srs_corpus_migration_incomplete',
        );
      }
      await target.close();
      target = null;

      if (await finalFile.exists()) {
        await finalFile.delete();
      }
      await buildingFile.rename(finalFile.path);

      final prepared = await _tryOpenVerifiedCorpus(
        path: finalFile.path,
        databaseKey: databaseKey,
        expectedCardinality: expectedCardinality,
        sourceContentSha256: contentIdentity,
      );
      if (prepared == null) {
        throw const RuntimePackAdmissionException(
          'srs_corpus_verification_failed',
        );
      }
      return prepared;
    } on RuntimePackAdmissionException {
      rethrow;
    } on Object {
      throw const RuntimePackAdmissionException(
        'srs_corpus_migration_failed',
      );
    } finally {
      if (target != null) {
        try {
          await target.close();
        } on Object {
          // Cleanup boundary only.
        }
      }
      if (await buildingFile.exists()) {
        await buildingFile.delete();
      }
    }
  }

  Future<_PreparedCorpus?> _tryOpenVerifiedCorpus({
    required String path,
    required String databaseKey,
    required SrsCorpusCardinality expectedCardinality,
    required String sourceContentSha256,
  }) async {
    Database? database;
    try {
      database = await _openDerivedReadOnly(
        path: path,
        databaseKey: databaseKey,
      );
      final repository = await IndexedSrsCorpusRepository.open(
        database,
        expectedCardinality: expectedCardinality,
        sourceContentSha256: sourceContentSha256,
      );
      return _PreparedCorpus(
        database: database,
        repository: repository,
      );
    } on Object {
      if (database != null) {
        try {
          await database.close();
        } on Object {
          // Invalid derived corpus is discarded by the caller.
        }
      }
      return null;
    }
  }

  Future<Database> _openWritableDerivedDatabase({
    required String path,
    required String databaseKey,
  }) {
    final factory = databaseFactory;
    if (factory != null) {
      return factory.openDatabase(
        path,
        options: OpenDatabaseOptions(
          singleInstance: false,
        ),
      );
    }
    return sqlcipher.openDatabase(
      path,
      password: databaseKey,
      singleInstance: false,
    );
  }

  Future<Database> _openDerivedReadOnly({
    required String path,
    required String databaseKey,
  }) {
    final factory = databaseFactory;
    if (factory != null) {
      return factory.openDatabase(
        path,
        options: OpenDatabaseOptions(
          readOnly: true,
          singleInstance: false,
        ),
      );
    }
    return sqlcipher.openDatabase(
      path,
      password: databaseKey,
      readOnly: true,
      singleInstance: false,
    );
  }

  Future<bool> _databaseExists(String path) {
    final factory = databaseFactory;
    return factory == null
        ? sqflite.databaseExists(path)
        : factory.databaseExists(path);
  }

  Future<SrsCorpusCardinality> _validateMetadata(
    Database database,
    InstalledLanguagePack installed,
  ) async {
    if (!await _hasTable(database, 'metadata') ||
        !await _hasTable(database, 'lexicon')) {
      throw const RuntimePackAdmissionException('pack_schema_missing');
    }

    final rows = await database.query('metadata', limit: 64);
    final metadata = <String, String>{
      for (final row in rows)
        if (row['key'] != null && row['value'] != null)
          row['key'].toString(): row['value'].toString(),
    };

    if (metadata['packId'] != installed.id ||
        metadata['languageCode']?.toLowerCase() !=
            installed.languageCode.toLowerCase() ||
        metadata['version'] != installed.version ||
        metadata['contractVersion'] != installed.contractVersion) {
      throw const RuntimePackAdmissionException(
        'pack_metadata_mismatch',
      );
    }

    final contentRows = _requiredMetadataInt(
      metadata,
      'contentRows',
      allowZero: false,
    );
    final verbRows = _requiredMetadataInt(
      metadata,
      'verbRows',
      allowZero: true,
    );

    final countRows = await database.rawQuery(
      'SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM lexicon',
    );
    final rawCount =
        countRows.length == 1 ? countRows.single['count'] : null;
    final actualContentRows = rawCount is int
        ? rawCount
        : int.tryParse(rawCount?.toString() ?? '');
    if (actualContentRows != contentRows) {
      throw const RuntimePackAdmissionException(
        'pack_content_cardinality_mismatch',
      );
    }

    return SrsCorpusCardinality(
      contentRows: contentRows,
      verbRows: verbRows,
    );
  }

  int _requiredMetadataInt(
    Map<String, String> metadata,
    String key, {
    required bool allowZero,
  }) {
    final value = int.tryParse(metadata[key] ?? '');
    final minimum = allowZero ? 0 : 1;
    if (value == null || value < minimum) {
      throw const RuntimePackAdmissionException(
        'pack_cardinality_metadata_invalid',
      );
    }
    return value;
  }

  Future<bool> _hasTable(Database database, String name) async {
    final rows = await database.rawQuery(
      'SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = ? AND name = ?',
      <Object?>['table', name],
    );
    return rows.isNotEmpty;
  }

  RuntimePackResolution _fallback(
    String reason, [
    String? attemptedPackId,
  ]) =>
      RuntimePackResolution(
        languagePack: embeddedLanguagePack,
        grammarHubService: embeddedGrammar,
        state: RuntimePackState.embeddedFallback(
          activePackId: attemptedPackId,
          fallbackReason: reason,
        ),
      );
}

final class _PreparedCorpus {
  const _PreparedCorpus({
    required this.database,
    required this.repository,
  });

  final Database database;
  final IndexedSrsCorpusRepository repository;
}

FILE: lib/services/adaptive_placement_engine.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'dart:math' as math;

import '../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../core/srs_facets.dart';
import '../language/language_exercise_strategy.dart';
import '../models/assessment.dart';
import '../models/diagnostic_placement.dart';
import '../models/learner.dart';

final class AdaptivePlacementEngine {
  const AdaptivePlacementEngine._();

  static const int defaultMaxQuestions = 10;
  static const int minQuestionsBeforeAdaptiveStop = 7;
  static const List<DiagnosticDimension> _dimensionOrder =
      <DiagnosticDimension>[
    DiagnosticDimension.meaning,
    DiagnosticDimension.grammar,
    DiagnosticDimension.transfer,
    DiagnosticDimension.listening,
  ];

  static DiagnosticQuestion? nextQuestion<T extends LearningContent>({
    required List<T> items,
    required LearnerState state,
    required List<DiagnosticResponse> responses,
    required LanguageExerciseStrategy exerciseStrategy,
    required bool Function(T item) isLearnable,
    int seed = 0,
    int maxQuestions = defaultMaxQuestions,
  }) {
    final boundedMax = maxQuestions.clamp(1, 20).toInt();
    if (shouldStop(responses, maxQuestions: boundedMax)) return null;

    final usedIds = <String>{for (final response in responses) response.itemId};
    final eligible = items
        .where(isLearnable)
        .where(
          (item) =>
              item.id.trim().isNotEmpty &&
              item.sourceText.trim().isNotEmpty &&
              item.translationText.trim().isNotEmpty &&
              !usedIds.contains(item.id),
        )
        .toList(growable: false);
    if (eligible.isEmpty) return null;

    final dimension = _targetDimension(responses, state);
    final difficulty = _targetDifficulty(responses);
    final priorAttempts = <String, int>{};
    for (final attempt in state.meaningAttempts) {
      priorAttempts[attempt.itemId] = (priorAttempts[attempt.itemId] ?? 0) + 1;
    }

    T? selected;
    AssessmentQuestion? selectedQuestion;
    var selectedScore = 1 << 30;
    for (final item in eligible) {
      final question = _questionForDimension(
        item,
        dimension,
        exerciseStrategy,
        seed,
      );
      if (question == null) continue;
      final complexityDistance =
          (_contentComplexity(item) - difficulty).abs() * 100;
      final priorPenalty =
          (priorAttempts[item.id] ?? 0).clamp(0, 20).toInt() * 7;
      final tie = _stableHash('$seed|${item.id}|${dimension.wireName}') % 29;
      final dimensionPenalty = dimension == DiagnosticDimension.grammar &&
              item.grammaticalMarker.trim().isEmpty
          ? 400
          : 0;
      final score = complexityDistance + priorPenalty + dimensionPenalty + tie;
      if (selected == null || score < selectedScore) {
        selected = item;
        selectedQuestion = question;
        selectedScore = score;
      }
    }
    if (selected == null || selectedQuestion == null) return null;

    return DiagnosticQuestion(
      question: selectedQuestion,
      dimension: dimension,
      difficultyBand: difficulty,
    );
  }

  static bool shouldStop(
    List<DiagnosticResponse> responses, {
    int maxQuestions = defaultMaxQuestions,
  }) {
    final boundedMax = maxQuestions.clamp(1, 20).toInt();
    if (responses.length >= boundedMax) return true;
    final scored = responses.where((response) => !response.skipped).toList();
    if (scored.length < minQuestionsBeforeAdaptiveStop) return false;

    final unavailable = <DiagnosticDimension>{
      for (final response in responses)
        if (response.skipped) response.dimension,
    };
    final available = _dimensionOrder
        .where((dimension) => !unavailable.contains(dimension))
        .toSet();
    final measured = <DiagnosticDimension>{
      for (final response in scored) response.dimension,
    };
    return available.isNotEmpty && measured.containsAll(available);
  }

  static PlacementDiagnosticResult score(
    List<DiagnosticResponse> responses, {
    int maxQuestions = defaultMaxQuestions,
  }) {
    final boundedMax = maxQuestions.clamp(1, 20).toInt();
    final bounded = responses.take(boundedMax).toList();
    final scored = bounded.where((response) => !response.skipped).toList();
    final buckets = <DiagnosticDimension, List<double>>{};
    var cleanCorrect = 0;
    var evidence = 0.0;
    final reviewIds = <String>[];

    for (final response in scored) {
      final value = response.evidenceValue;
      evidence += value;
      (buckets[response.dimension] ??= <double>[]).add(value);
      if (response.correct && !response.hinted) cleanCorrect++;
      if (!response.correct && !reviewIds.contains(response.itemId)) {
        reviewIds.add(response.itemId);
      }
    }

    final dimensionScores = <DiagnosticDimension, double>{
      for (final entry in buckets.entries)
        entry.key: entry.value.reduce((a, b) => a + b) / entry.value.length,
    };
    final score = scored.isEmpty
        ? 0.0
        : (evidence / scored.length * 100).clamp(0.0, 100.0).toDouble();
    final weak = dimensionScores.entries
        .where((entry) => entry.value < .65)
        .toList()
      ..sort((a, b) => a.value.compareTo(b.value));

    final skippedDimensions = <DiagnosticDimension>{
      for (final response in bounded)
        if (response.skipped) response.dimension,
    };
    final availableCount = math.max(
      1,
      _dimensionOrder.length - skippedDimensions.length,
    );
    final coverage =
        (dimensionScores.length / availableCount).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
    final sample = (scored.length / boundedMax).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
    final confidence = (coverage * sample).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();

    return PlacementDiagnosticResult(
      answered: bounded.length,
      scoredAnswers: scored.length,
      cleanCorrect: cleanCorrect,
      score: score,
      confidence: confidence,
      band: _bandFor(score),
      dimensionScores: Map<DiagnosticDimension, double>.unmodifiable(
        dimensionScores,
      ),
      weakDimensions: weak.map((entry) => entry.key).toList(growable: false),
      reviewItemIds: List<String>.unmodifiable(reviewIds.take(20)),
    );
  }

  static DiagnosticDimension _targetDimension(
    List<DiagnosticResponse> responses,
    LearnerState state,
  ) {
    final skipped = <DiagnosticDimension>{
      for (final response in responses)
        if (response.skipped) response.dimension,
    };
    final scored = responses.where((response) => !response.skipped).toList();
    if (scored.isEmpty) {
      final prior = _priorWeakDimension(state);
      if (prior != null && !skipped.contains(prior)) return prior;
    }
    if (scored.isNotEmpty) {
      final last = scored.last;
      final sameDimensionCount = scored
          .where((response) => response.dimension == last.dimension)
          .length;
      if (!last.correct &&
          sameDimensionCount < 2 &&
          !skipped.contains(last.dimension)) {
        return last.dimension;
      }
    }

    DiagnosticDimension? selected;
    var lowest = 1 << 30;
    for (final dimension in _dimensionOrder) {
      if (skipped.contains(dimension)) continue;
      final count =
          scored.where((response) => response.dimension == dimension).length;
      if (selected == null || count < lowest) {
        selected = dimension;
        lowest = count;
      }
    }
    return selected ?? DiagnosticDimension.meaning;
  }

  static int _targetDifficulty(List<DiagnosticResponse> responses) {
    final scored = responses.where((response) => !response.skipped).toList();
    if (scored.isEmpty) return 1;
    final last = scored.last;
    if (!last.correct) {
      return math.max(0, last.difficultyBand - 1).toInt();
    }
    if (last.hinted) return last.difficultyBand.clamp(0, 3).toInt();
    return math.min(3, last.difficultyBand + 1).toInt();
  }

  static int _contentComplexity(LearningContent item) {
    var score = 0;
    if (item.grammaticalMarker.trim().isNotEmpty) score++;
    if (item.exampleText.trim().split(RegExp(r'\s+')).length >= 6) score++;
    if (item.acceptedForms.length > 1) score++;
    return score.clamp(0, 3).toInt();
  }

  static DiagnosticDimension? _priorWeakDimension(LearnerState state) {
    final pressure = <DiagnosticDimension, int>{};
    for (final card in state.reviewCards.values) {
      final dimension = _dimensionForFacet(card.facetType);
      if (dimension == null) continue;
      final value = card.failures * 2 + card.lapses;
      if (value <= 0) continue;
      pressure[dimension] = (pressure[dimension] ?? 0) + value;
    }
    if (pressure.isEmpty) return null;

    DiagnosticDimension? selected;
    var highest = -1;
    for (final dimension in _dimensionOrder) {
      final value = pressure[dimension] ?? 0;
      if (value > highest) {
        selected = dimension;
        highest = value;
      }
    }
    return selected;
  }

  static DiagnosticDimension? _dimensionForFacet(ReviewFacetType facet) {
    switch (facet) {
      case ReviewFacetType.meaningRecall:
      case ReviewFacetType.spelling:
        return DiagnosticDimension.meaning;
      case ReviewFacetType.gender:
      case ReviewFacetType.plural:
      case ReviewFacetType.caseForm:
      case ReviewFacetType.verbValency:
      case ReviewFacetType.prepositionCase:
      case ReviewFacetType.separablePrefix:
      case ReviewFacetType.auxiliary:
        return DiagnosticDimension.grammar;
      case ReviewFacetType.listening:
      case ReviewFacetType.pronunciation:
        return DiagnosticDimension.listening;
      case ReviewFacetType.collocation:
      case ReviewFacetType.production:
        return DiagnosticDimension.production;
      case ReviewFacetType.unknown:
        return null;
    }
  }

  static AssessmentQuestion? _questionForDimension<T extends LearningContent>(
    T item,
    DiagnosticDimension dimension,
    LanguageExerciseStrategy strategy,
    int seed,
  ) {
    final desired = switch (dimension) {
      DiagnosticDimension.meaning => AssessmentQuestionType.recall,
      DiagnosticDimension.grammar => AssessmentQuestionType.grammar,
      DiagnosticDimension.listening => AssessmentQuestionType.listening,
      DiagnosticDimension.transfer => AssessmentQuestionType.translation,
      DiagnosticDimension.production => AssessmentQuestionType.production,
    };
    for (var index = 0; index < AssessmentQuestionType.values.length; index++) {
      final question = strategy.assessmentQuestion(item, index, seed);
      if (question.type != desired) continue;
      if (dimension == DiagnosticDimension.meaning) return question;
      return AssessmentQuestion(
        id: question.id,
        itemId: question.itemId,
        prompt: question.prompt,
        expected: question.expected,
        type: question.type,
        accepted: const <String>[],
        skill: question.skill,
      );
    }
    return null;
  }

  static DiagnosticPlacementBand _bandFor(double score) {
    if (score < 35) return DiagnosticPlacementBand.foundation;
    if (score < 55) return DiagnosticPlacementBand.basic;
    if (score < 75) return DiagnosticPlacementBand.developing;
    return DiagnosticPlacementBand.strong;
  }

  static int _stableHash(String value) {
    var hash = 17;
    for (final codeUnit in value.codeUnits) {
      hash = ((hash * 31) + codeUnit) & 0x7fffffff;
    }
    return hash;
  }
}

FILE: lib/services/canonical_grammar_compiler.dart

import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:sqflite/sqflite.dart';

import '../data/canonical_grammar_catalog.dart';
import '../models/grammar.dart' as canonical;
import 'linguistics/german_linguistic_validator.dart';

/// Compiles the single authored grammar catalog into the runtime SQLite model.
///
/// Rebuilds preserve mastery for stable topic IDs while removing stale seed
/// rows, so SQLite never becomes a second independently authored source.
abstract final class CanonicalGrammarCompiler {
  static const int databaseVersion = 2;

  static const List<String> createStatements = <String>[
    '''
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS grammar_topics (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  level TEXT NOT NULL,
  title_de TEXT NOT NULL,
  title_ar TEXT NOT NULL,
  explanation_markdown TEXT NOT NULL,
  formula_pattern TEXT,
  order_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
  is_mastered INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_mastered IN (0, 1))
)
''',
    '''
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS grammar_rules (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  topic_id TEXT NOT NULL
    REFERENCES grammar_topics(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  explanation_ar TEXT NOT NULL,
  order_index INTEGER NOT NULL
)
''',
    '''
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS grammar_rule_rows (
  rule_id TEXT NOT NULL
    REFERENCES grammar_rules(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  row_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
  cells_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (rule_id, row_index)
)
''',
    '''
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS grammar_examples (
  rule_id TEXT NOT NULL
    REFERENCES grammar_rules(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  example_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
  german TEXT NOT NULL,
  arabic TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (rule_id, example_index)
)
''',
    '''
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS grammar_quizzes (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  canonical_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  topic_id TEXT NOT NULL
    REFERENCES grammar_topics(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  question TEXT NOT NULL,
  options_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  correct_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
  explanation TEXT NOT NULL
)
''',
    'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_grammar_topics_level '
        'ON grammar_topics(level, order_index)',
    'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_grammar_rules_topic '
        'ON grammar_rules(topic_id, order_index)',
    'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_grammar_quizzes_topic '
        'ON grammar_quizzes(topic_id, id)',
    '''
CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS grammar_topic_runtime AS
SELECT
  id,
  level,
  title_de,
  title_ar,
  explanation_markdown,
  formula_pattern,
  order_index,
  is_mastered
FROM grammar_topics
''',
  ];

  static Future<void> rebuild(Database db) async {
    const GermanLinguisticValidator().validateCanonicalGrammar().throwIfInvalid(
          context: 'canonical grammar catalog',
        );
    await db.execute('PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON');
    final mastered = await _existingMastery(db);

    await db.transaction((txn) async {
      // Old v1 grammar_quizzes lacks canonical_id. Recreate child tables
      // instead of mutating a partially compatible schema in place.
      await txn.execute('DROP VIEW IF EXISTS grammar_topic_runtime');
      await txn.execute('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS grammar_examples');
      await txn.execute('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS grammar_rule_rows');
      await txn.execute('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS grammar_rules');
      await txn.execute('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS grammar_quizzes');

      for (final statement in createStatements) {
        await txn.execute(statement);
      }
      await txn.delete('grammar_topics');

      final orderByLevel = <String, int>{};
      for (final topic in CanonicalGrammarCatalog.allTopics) {
        final nextOrder = (orderByLevel[topic.level] ?? 0) + 1;
        orderByLevel[topic.level] = nextOrder;
        await _insertTopic(
          txn,
          topic,
          orderIndex: nextOrder,
          mastered: mastered.contains(topic.id),
        );
      }
    });
  }

  static Future<Set<String>> _existingMastery(Database db) async {
    final tables = await db.rawQuery(
      'SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = ? AND name = ?',
      <Object?>['table', 'grammar_topics'],
    );
    if (tables.isEmpty) return <String>{};
    final rows = await db.query(
      'grammar_topics',
      columns: const <String>['id'],
      where: 'is_mastered = ?',
      whereArgs: const <Object?>[1],
    );
    return rows.map((row) => row['id'].toString()).toSet();
  }

  static Future<void> _insertTopic(
    DatabaseExecutor db,
    canonical.GrammarTopic topic, {
    required int orderIndex,
    required bool mastered,
  }) async {
    await db.insert('grammar_topics', <String, Object?>{
      'id': topic.id,
      'level': topic.level,
      'title_de': topic.titleDe,
      'title_ar': topic.titleAr,
      'explanation_markdown': topic.summaryAr,
      'formula_pattern': _formula(topic),
      'order_index': orderIndex,
      'is_mastered': mastered ? 1 : 0,
    });

    for (var ruleIndex = 0; ruleIndex < topic.rules.length; ruleIndex++) {
      final rule = topic.rules[ruleIndex];
      await db.insert('grammar_rules', <String, Object?>{
        'id': rule.id,
        'topic_id': topic.id,
        'title': rule.title,
        'explanation_ar': rule.explanationAr,
        'order_index': ruleIndex + 1,
      });

      for (var rowIndex = 0; rowIndex < rule.table.length; rowIndex++) {
        await db.insert('grammar_rule_rows', <String, Object?>{
          'rule_id': rule.id,
          'row_index': rowIndex,
          'cells_json': jsonEncode(rule.table[rowIndex]),
        });
      }

      for (var exampleIndex = 0;
          exampleIndex < rule.examples.length;
          exampleIndex++) {
        final example = rule.examples[exampleIndex];
        await db.insert('grammar_examples', <String, Object?>{
          'rule_id': rule.id,
          'example_index': exampleIndex,
          'german': example.german,
          'arabic': example.arabic,
        });
      }
    }

    for (final quiz in topic.miniChecks) {
      await db.insert('grammar_quizzes', <String, Object?>{
        'canonical_id': quiz.id,
        'topic_id': topic.id,
        'question': quiz.questionText,
        'options_json': jsonEncode(quiz.options),
        'correct_index': quiz.correctAnswerIndex,
        'explanation': quiz.explanationAr,
      });
    }
  }

  static String? _formula(canonical.GrammarTopic topic) {
    if (topic.rules.isEmpty || topic.rules.first.table.isEmpty) return null;
    final firstRow = topic.rules.first.table.first;
    if (firstRow.isEmpty) return null;
    return firstRow.join(' · ');
  }
}
