FILE: lib/services/canonical_linguistic_schema.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'package:sqflite/sqflite.dart';

/// Relational schema for canonical linguistic data.
///
/// SQLite user_version 3 is additive: the legacy lexicon table is deliberately
/// preserved so Phase-1 runtime readers continue working during migration.
abstract final class CanonicalLinguisticSchema {
  static const int sqliteUserVersion = 3;
  static const int canonicalSchemaVersion = 2;

  static const String conceptsTable = 'concepts';
  static const String nounsTable = 'german_nouns';
  static const String verbsTable = 'german_verbs';
  static const String valencyTable = 'verb_valency_frames';
  static const String verbFormsTable = 'german_verb_forms';
  static const String wordFamiliesTable = 'german_word_families';
  static const String wordFamilyMembersTable = 'german_word_family_members';

  static const List<String> createStatements = <String>[
    '''
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS concepts (
  concept_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  sense_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  lemma TEXT NOT NULL,
  part_of_speech TEXT NOT NULL,
  register TEXT NOT NULL,
  cefr TEXT NOT NULL,
  surface TEXT NOT NULL,
  direction TEXT NOT NULL,
  semantic_tags_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  legacy_fields_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
)
''',
    '''
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS german_nouns (
  concept_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
    REFERENCES concepts(concept_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  gender TEXT NOT NULL,
  plural TEXT,
  declension_class TEXT NOT NULL,
  nominative_singular TEXT NOT NULL,
  accusative_singular TEXT NOT NULL,
  dative_singular TEXT NOT NULL,
  genitive_singular TEXT NOT NULL,
  nominative_plural TEXT,
  accusative_plural TEXT,
  dative_plural TEXT,
  genitive_plural TEXT
)
''',
    '''
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS german_verbs (
  concept_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
    REFERENCES concepts(concept_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  infinitive TEXT NOT NULL,
  separable_prefix TEXT,
  inseparable_prefix TEXT,
  reflexivity TEXT NOT NULL,
  auxiliary TEXT NOT NULL,
  participle_ii TEXT,
  preterite TEXT,
  imperative TEXT
)
''',
    '''
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS verb_valency_frames (
  concept_id TEXT NOT NULL
    REFERENCES german_verbs(concept_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  frame_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  governed_case TEXT,
  preposition TEXT,
  preposition_case TEXT,
  semantic_role TEXT NOT NULL,
  object_required INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (object_required IN (0, 1)),
  PRIMARY KEY (concept_id, frame_id)
)
''',
    '''
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS german_verb_forms (
  concept_id TEXT NOT NULL
    REFERENCES german_verbs(concept_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  tense TEXT NOT NULL,
  person_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  form TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (concept_id, tense, person_key)
)
''',
    '''
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS german_word_families (
  family_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  base_concept_id TEXT NOT NULL
    REFERENCES concepts(concept_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
''',
    '''
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS german_word_family_members (
  family_id TEXT NOT NULL
    REFERENCES german_word_families(family_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  concept_id TEXT NOT NULL
    REFERENCES concepts(concept_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  relation_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  prefix TEXT,
  suffix TEXT,
  semantic_distance TEXT NOT NULL,
  pedagogical_level TEXT NOT NULL,
  interference_risk INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK (interference_risk IN (0, 1)),
  PRIMARY KEY (family_id, concept_id)
)
''',
    'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_concepts_lemma ON concepts(lemma)',
    'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_concepts_sense ON concepts(sense_id)',
    'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_valency_prep '
        'ON verb_valency_frames(preposition, preposition_case)',
    'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_word_family_member_concept '
        'ON german_word_family_members(concept_id)',
    'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_word_family_distance '
        'ON german_word_family_members(family_id, semantic_distance)',
  ];

  static const String selectConceptById =
      'SELECT * FROM concepts WHERE concept_id = ? LIMIT 1';
  static const String selectLegacyConceptById =
      'SELECT id, surface, part_of_speech, direction, fields_json '
      'FROM lexicon WHERE id = ? LIMIT 1';
  static const String selectNounById =
      'SELECT * FROM german_nouns WHERE concept_id = ? LIMIT 1';
  static const String selectVerbById =
      'SELECT * FROM german_verbs WHERE concept_id = ? LIMIT 1';
  static const String selectValencyByVerb =
      'SELECT * FROM verb_valency_frames WHERE concept_id = ? '
      'ORDER BY frame_id ASC';
  static const String selectFormsByVerb =
      'SELECT * FROM german_verb_forms WHERE concept_id = ? '
      'ORDER BY tense ASC, person_key ASC';
  static const String selectWordFamilyIds =
      'SELECT family_id FROM german_word_families ORDER BY family_id ASC LIMIT ?';
  static const String selectWordFamily =
      'SELECT f.family_id, f.base_concept_id, '
      'm.relation_type, m.prefix, m.suffix, m.semantic_distance, '
      'm.pedagogical_level, m.interference_risk, '
      'c.concept_id, c.sense_id, c.lemma, c.part_of_speech, '
      'c.register, c.cefr, c.surface, c.direction, '
      'c.semantic_tags_json, c.legacy_fields_json '
      'FROM german_word_families f '
      'JOIN german_word_family_members m ON m.family_id = f.family_id '
      'JOIN concepts c ON c.concept_id = m.concept_id '
      'WHERE f.family_id = ? '
      "ORDER BY CASE m.relation_type WHEN 'base' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, "
      'm.semantic_distance ASC, c.lemma COLLATE NOCASE ASC';

  static Future<void> migrateLegacyFlatSchema(Database database) async {
    await database.execute('PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON');
    await database.transaction((txn) async {
      for (final statement in createStatements) {
        await txn.execute(statement);
      }
      if (await _hasTable(txn, 'lexicon')) {
        // Backfill only language-neutral concept identity. No noun/verb
        // morphology is guessed from flat legacy strings.
        await txn.execute('''
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO concepts(
  concept_id,
  sense_id,
  lemma,
  part_of_speech,
  register,
  cefr,
  surface,
  direction,
  semantic_tags_json,
  legacy_fields_json
)
SELECT
  id,
  id,
  surface,
  LOWER(part_of_speech),
  'neutral',
  'unknown',
  surface,
  direction,
  '[]',
  fields_json
FROM lexicon
''');
      }
      await txn.execute('PRAGMA user_version = $sqliteUserVersion');
    });
  }

  static Future<bool> _hasTable(DatabaseExecutor db, String table) async {
    final rows = await db.rawQuery(
      'SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = ? AND name = ?',
      <Object?>['table', table],
    );
    return rows.isNotEmpty;
  }
}


--------------------------------------------------
FILE: lib/services/canonical_linguistic_store.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:sqflite/sqflite.dart';

import '../models/linguistics/german_grammar_types.dart';
import '../models/linguistics/german_noun.dart';
import '../models/linguistics/german_noun_forms.dart';
import '../models/linguistics/german_verb.dart';
import '../models/linguistics/german_word_family.dart';
import '../models/linguistics/linguistic_concept.dart';
import '../models/linguistics/verb_valency_frame.dart';
import 'canonical_linguistic_schema.dart';

/// Read-only query adapter for canonical linguistic tables.
///
/// If an older pack has only the Phase-1 flat lexicon table, concept identity
/// can still be projected safely. Morphology is never fabricated.
final class CanonicalLinguisticStore {
  const CanonicalLinguisticStore(this.db);

  final DatabaseExecutor db;

  Future<LinguisticConcept?> readConcept(String conceptId) async {
    if (await _hasTable(CanonicalLinguisticSchema.conceptsTable)) {
      final rows = await db.rawQuery(
        CanonicalLinguisticSchema.selectConceptById,
        <Object?>[conceptId],
      );
      return rows.isEmpty ? null : _concept(rows.first);
    }
    if (!await _hasTable('lexicon')) return null;
    final rows = await db.rawQuery(
      CanonicalLinguisticSchema.selectLegacyConceptById,
      <Object?>[conceptId],
    );
    if (rows.isEmpty) return null;
    final row = rows.first;
    return LinguisticConcept(
      id: row['id'].toString(),
      senseId: row['id'].toString(),
      lemma: row['surface'].toString(),
      partOfSpeech: LinguisticPartOfSpeech.fromWire(
        row['part_of_speech']?.toString(),
      ),
      register: LanguageRegister.neutral,
      cefr: CefrLevel.unknown,
    );
  }

  Future<GermanNoun?> readGermanNoun(String conceptId) async {
    if (!await _hasTable(CanonicalLinguisticSchema.nounsTable)) return null;
    final concept = await readConcept(conceptId);
    if (concept == null) return null;
    final rows = await db.rawQuery(
      CanonicalLinguisticSchema.selectNounById,
      <Object?>[conceptId],
    );
    if (rows.isEmpty) return null;
    final row = rows.first;
    return GermanNoun(
      concept: concept,
      gender: GermanGender.fromWire(row['gender']?.toString()),
      plural: _nullableText(row['plural']),
      declensionClass: GermanNounDeclensionClass.fromWire(
        row['declension_class']?.toString(),
      ),
      caseForms: GermanNounCaseForms(
        nominativeSingular: row['nominative_singular'].toString(),
        accusativeSingular: row['accusative_singular'].toString(),
        dativeSingular: row['dative_singular'].toString(),
        genitiveSingular: row['genitive_singular'].toString(),
        nominativePlural: _nullableText(row['nominative_plural']),
        accusativePlural: _nullableText(row['accusative_plural']),
        dativePlural: _nullableText(row['dative_plural']),
        genitivePlural: _nullableText(row['genitive_plural']),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<GermanVerb?> readGermanVerb(String conceptId) async {
    if (!await _hasTable(CanonicalLinguisticSchema.verbsTable)) return null;
    final concept = await readConcept(conceptId);
    if (concept == null) return null;
    final rows = await db.rawQuery(
      CanonicalLinguisticSchema.selectVerbById,
      <Object?>[conceptId],
    );
    if (rows.isEmpty) return null;
    final row = rows.first;

    final valencyRows = await db.rawQuery(
      CanonicalLinguisticSchema.selectValencyByVerb,
      <Object?>[conceptId],
    );
    final formRows = await db.rawQuery(
      CanonicalLinguisticSchema.selectFormsByVerb,
      <Object?>[conceptId],
    );

    return GermanVerb(
      concept: concept,
      infinitive: row['infinitive'].toString(),
      separablePrefix: _nullableText(row['separable_prefix']),
      inseparablePrefix: _nullableText(row['inseparable_prefix']),
      reflexivity: GermanReflexivity.fromWire(row['reflexivity']?.toString()),
      auxiliary: GermanAuxiliary.fromWire(row['auxiliary']?.toString()),
      participleII: _nullableText(row['participle_ii']),
      preterite: _nullableText(row['preterite']),
      imperative: _nullableText(row['imperative']),
      valencyFrames: valencyRows
          .map(
            (item) => VerbValencyFrame(
              frameId: item['frame_id'].toString(),
              governedCase: GermanCase.fromWire(
                item['governed_case']?.toString(),
              ),
              preposition: _nullableText(item['preposition']),
              prepositionCase: GermanCase.fromWire(
                item['preposition_case']?.toString(),
              ),
              semanticRole: item['semantic_role'].toString(),
              objectRequired: item['object_required'] == 1,
            ),
          )
          .toList(growable: false),
      forms: formRows
          .map(
            (item) => GermanVerbForm(
              tense: item['tense'].toString(),
              personKey: item['person_key'].toString(),
              form: item['form'].toString(),
            ),
          )
          .toList(growable: false),
    );
  }

  Future<List<String>> listGermanWordFamilyIds({int limit = 200}) async {
    if (limit <= 0 ||
        !await _hasTable(CanonicalLinguisticSchema.wordFamiliesTable)) {
      return const <String>[];
    }
    final rows = await db.rawQuery(
      CanonicalLinguisticSchema.selectWordFamilyIds,
      <Object?>[limit.clamp(1, 500)],
    );
    return rows
        .map((row) => row['family_id']?.toString() ?? '')
        .where((value) => value.isNotEmpty)
        .toList(growable: false);
  }

  Future<GermanWordFamily?> readGermanWordFamily(String familyId) async {
    if (familyId.trim().isEmpty ||
        !await _hasTable(CanonicalLinguisticSchema.wordFamiliesTable) ||
        !await _hasTable(CanonicalLinguisticSchema.wordFamilyMembersTable)) {
      return null;
    }
    final rows = await db.rawQuery(
      CanonicalLinguisticSchema.selectWordFamily,
      <Object?>[familyId],
    );
    if (rows.isEmpty) return null;
    final baseConceptId = rows.first['base_concept_id']?.toString() ?? '';
    if (baseConceptId.isEmpty) return null;

    final members = rows
        .map(
          (row) => GermanWordFamilyMember(
            concept: _concept(row),
            relationType: GermanWordFamilyRelationType.fromWire(
              row['relation_type']?.toString(),
            ),
            prefix: _nullableText(row['prefix']),
            suffix: _nullableText(row['suffix']),
            semanticDistance: GermanSemanticDistance.fromWire(
              row['semantic_distance']?.toString(),
            ),
            pedagogicalLevel: CefrLevel.fromWire(
              row['pedagogical_level']?.toString(),
            ),
            interferenceRisk: row['interference_risk'] == 1,
          ),
        )
        .toList(growable: false);

    final family = GermanWordFamily(
      familyId: familyId,
      baseConceptId: baseConceptId,
      members: List<GermanWordFamilyMember>.unmodifiable(members),
    );
    return family.baseMember == null ? null : family;
  }

  LinguisticConcept _concept(Map<String, Object?> row) {
    final tagsRaw = row['semantic_tags_json']?.toString() ?? '[]';
    final decoded = jsonDecode(tagsRaw);
    final tags = decoded is List
        ? decoded.whereType<String>().toList(growable: false)
        : const <String>[];
    return LinguisticConcept(
      id: row['concept_id'].toString(),
      senseId: row['sense_id'].toString(),
      lemma: row['lemma'].toString(),
      partOfSpeech: LinguisticPartOfSpeech.fromWire(
        row['part_of_speech']?.toString(),
      ),
      register: LanguageRegister.fromWire(row['register']?.toString()),
      cefr: CefrLevel.fromWire(row['cefr']?.toString()),
      semanticTags: tags,
    );
  }

  Future<bool> _hasTable(String table) async {
    final rows = await db.rawQuery(
      'SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = ? AND name = ?',
      <Object?>['table', table],
    );
    return rows.isNotEmpty;
  }

  String? _nullableText(Object? value) {
    if (value == null) return null;
    final text = value.toString();
    return text.isEmpty ? null : text;
  }
}

FILE: lib/services/grammar_microscope_service.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import '../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../core/srs_facets.dart';
import '../models/grammar_microscope.dart';
import '../models/learner.dart';
import 'grammar_hub_service.dart';

final class GrammarMicroscopeSnapshot {
  const GrammarMicroscopeSnapshot({
    required this.topic,
    required this.rules,
    required this.linkedFacets,
    required this.facetEvidence,
    required this.weakItems,
  });

  final GrammarTopic topic;
  final List<GrammarRuleDetail> rules;
  final List<ReviewFacetType> linkedFacets;
  final List<GrammarFacetEvidence> facetEvidence;
  final List<GrammarEvidenceItem> weakItems;

  bool get hasPersonalEvidence => facetEvidence.isNotEmpty;
}

final class GrammarMicroscopeService {
  const GrammarMicroscopeService(this.repository);

  final GrammarHubRepository repository;

  Future<GrammarMicroscopeSnapshot?> load({
    required String topicId,
    required LearnerState state,
    required Iterable<LearningContent> corpus,
  }) async {
    final safeTopicId = topicId.trim();
    if (safeTopicId.isEmpty || safeTopicId.length > 160) return null;

    final topic = await repository.getTopicDetail(safeTopicId);
    if (topic == null) return null;

    List<GrammarRuleDetail> rules = const <GrammarRuleDetail>[];
    final source = repository;
    if (source is GrammarMicroscopeRepository) {
      rules = await (source as GrammarMicroscopeRepository).getRulesForTopic(
        safeTopicId,
      );
    }

    final linkedFacets = _linkedFacets(topic, rules);
    final evidence = _facetEvidence(state, linkedFacets);
    final weakItems = _weakItems(
      state: state,
      linkedFacets: linkedFacets,
      corpus: corpus,
    );

    return GrammarMicroscopeSnapshot(
      topic: topic,
      rules: List<GrammarRuleDetail>.unmodifiable(rules),
      linkedFacets: List<ReviewFacetType>.unmodifiable(linkedFacets),
      facetEvidence: List<GrammarFacetEvidence>.unmodifiable(evidence),
      weakItems: List<GrammarEvidenceItem>.unmodifiable(weakItems),
    );
  }

  static List<ReviewFacetType> _linkedFacets(
    GrammarTopic topic,
    List<GrammarRuleDetail> rules,
  ) {
    final haystack = <String>[
      topic.id,
      topic.titleDe,
      for (final rule in rules) rule.id,
      for (final rule in rules) rule.title,
    ].join(' ').toLowerCase();

    final facets = <ReviewFacetType>{};

    if (haystack.contains('nominativ') || haystack.contains('artikel')) {
      facets
        ..add(ReviewFacetType.gender)
        ..add(ReviewFacetType.caseForm);
    }
    if (haystack.contains('akkusativ') ||
        haystack.contains('dativ') ||
        haystack.contains('genitiv') ||
        haystack.contains('relativ') ||
        haystack.contains('pronoun')) {
      facets.add(ReviewFacetType.caseForm);
    }
    if (haystack.contains('plural')) {
      facets.add(ReviewFacetType.plural);
    }
    if (haystack.contains('präposition') || haystack.contains('preposition')) {
      facets.add(ReviewFacetType.prepositionCase);
    }
    if (haystack.contains('valenz') || haystack.contains('valency')) {
      facets.add(ReviewFacetType.verbValency);
    }
    if (haystack.contains('trenn') || haystack.contains('separable')) {
      facets.add(ReviewFacetType.separablePrefix);
    }
    if (haystack.contains('perfekt') || haystack.contains('passiv')) {
      facets.add(ReviewFacetType.auxiliary);
    }
    if (haystack.contains('nomen_verb') ||
        haystack.contains('nomen-verb') ||
        haystack.contains('kollok') ||
        haystack.contains('colloc')) {
      facets.add(ReviewFacetType.collocation);
    }
    if (haystack.contains('konjunktiv') ||
        haystack.contains('nominal') ||
        haystack.contains('partizip')) {
      facets.add(ReviewFacetType.production);
    }

    return facets.toList(growable: false);
  }

  static List<GrammarFacetEvidence> _facetEvidence(
    LearnerState state,
    List<ReviewFacetType> linkedFacets,
  ) {
    final result = <GrammarFacetEvidence>[];
    for (final facet in linkedFacets) {
      var cardCount = 0;
      var failures = 0;
      var lapses = 0;
      for (final card in state.reviewCards.values) {
        if (card.facetType != facet) continue;
        final pressure = card.failures * 2 + card.lapses;
        if (pressure <= 0) continue;
        cardCount++;
        failures += card.failures;
        lapses += card.lapses;
      }
      final pressure = failures * 2 + lapses;
      if (pressure <= 0) continue;
      result.add(
        GrammarFacetEvidence(
          facetType: facet,
          cardCount: cardCount,
          failures: failures,
          lapses: lapses,
          pressure: pressure,
        ),
      );
    }
    result.sort((a, b) => b.pressure.compareTo(a.pressure));
    return result;
  }

  static List<GrammarEvidenceItem> _weakItems({
    required LearnerState state,
    required List<ReviewFacetType> linkedFacets,
    required Iterable<LearningContent> corpus,
  }) {
    if (linkedFacets.isEmpty) return const <GrammarEvidenceItem>[];

    final contentById = <String, LearningContent>{
      for (final item in corpus)
        if (item.id.trim().isNotEmpty) item.id: item,
    };
    final items = <GrammarEvidenceItem>[];

    for (final card in state.reviewCards.values) {
      if (!linkedFacets.contains(card.facetType)) continue;
      final pressure = card.failures * 2 + card.lapses;
      if (pressure <= 0) continue;
      final content = contentById[card.itemId];
      if (content == null) continue;
      items.add(
        GrammarEvidenceItem(
          itemId: card.itemId,
          sourceText: content.sourceText,
          translationText: content.translationText,
          facetType: card.facetType,
          failures: card.failures,
          lapses: card.lapses,
          pressure: pressure,
        ),
      );
    }

    items.sort((a, b) {
      final pressure = b.pressure.compareTo(a.pressure);
      if (pressure != 0) return pressure;
      return a.itemId.compareTo(b.itemId);
    });
    return items.take(8).toList(growable: false);
  }
}


--------------------------------------------------
FILE: lib/services/linguistics/german_linguistic_validator.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import '../../data/canonical_grammar_catalog.dart';
import '../../models/grammar.dart';
import '../../models/linguistics/german_grammar_types.dart';
import '../../models/linguistics/german_noun.dart';
import '../../models/linguistics/german_verb.dart';
import '../../models/linguistics/linguistic_concept.dart';
import '../../models/linguistics/verb_valency_frame.dart';

enum LinguisticQaSeverity { error, warning }

final class LinguisticQaIssue {
  const LinguisticQaIssue({
    required this.code,
    required this.path,
    required this.message,
    this.severity = LinguisticQaSeverity.error,
  });

  final String code;
  final String path;
  final String message;
  final LinguisticQaSeverity severity;
}

final class LinguisticQaReport {
  LinguisticQaReport(Iterable<LinguisticQaIssue> issues)
      : issues = List<LinguisticQaIssue>.unmodifiable(issues);

  final List<LinguisticQaIssue> issues;

  List<LinguisticQaIssue> get errors => issues
      .where((issue) => issue.severity == LinguisticQaSeverity.error)
      .toList(growable: false);

  List<LinguisticQaIssue> get warnings => issues
      .where((issue) => issue.severity == LinguisticQaSeverity.warning)
      .toList(growable: false);

  bool get isValid => errors.isEmpty;

  void throwIfInvalid({String context = 'German linguistic QA'}) {
    if (isValid) return;
    final first = errors.first;
    throw LinguisticQaException(
      context + ': ' + first.code + ' at ' + first.path + ': ' + first.message,
    );
  }
}

final class LinguisticQaException implements Exception {
  const LinguisticQaException(this.message);

  final String message;

  @override
  String toString() => 'LinguisticQaException: ' + message;
}

/// Deterministic structural/semantic QA for canonical German data.
///
/// This validator deliberately avoids heuristic claims that are not universal
/// German rules. It validates relationships explicitly represented by the
/// canonical schema and reports incomplete metadata separately.
final class GermanLinguisticValidator {
  const GermanLinguisticValidator();

  LinguisticQaReport validateNoun(GermanNoun noun) {
    final issues = <LinguisticQaIssue>[];
    _validateConcept(
      noun.concept,
      expectedPartOfSpeech: LinguisticPartOfSpeech.noun,
      path: 'noun.' + noun.concept.id,
      issues: issues,
    );

    if (noun.gender == GermanGender.unknown ||
        noun.gender == GermanGender.none) {
      issues.add(
        LinguisticQaIssue(
          code: 'noun.gender_unresolved',
          path: 'noun.' + noun.concept.id + '.gender',
          message: 'Canonical German noun requires an explicit gender.',
        ),
      );
    }
    if (noun.declensionClass == GermanNounDeclensionClass.unknown) {
      issues.add(
        LinguisticQaIssue(
          code: 'noun.declension_unresolved',
          path: 'noun.' + noun.concept.id + '.declensionClass',
          message: 'Canonical German noun requires a declension class.',
        ),
      );
    }

    final forms = noun.caseForms;
    final singular = <String, String>{
      'nominativeSingular': forms.nominativeSingular,
      'accusativeSingular': forms.accusativeSingular,
      'dativeSingular': forms.dativeSingular,
      'genitiveSingular': forms.genitiveSingular,
    };
    for (final entry in singular.entries) {
      _requireText(
        entry.value,
        'noun.' + noun.concept.id + '.caseForms.' + entry.key,
        'noun.case_form_blank',
        issues,
      );
    }

    if (forms.nominativeSingular.trim() != noun.concept.lemma.trim()) {
      issues.add(
        LinguisticQaIssue(
          code: 'noun.lemma_nominative_mismatch',
          path: 'noun.' + noun.concept.id + '.caseForms.nominativeSingular',
          message: 'Lemma must equal nominative singular in this schema.',
        ),
      );
    }

    final pluralForms = <String, String?>{
      'nominativePlural': forms.nominativePlural,
      'accusativePlural': forms.accusativePlural,
      'dativePlural': forms.dativePlural,
      'genitivePlural': forms.genitivePlural,
    };
    final plural = _clean(noun.plural);
    if (plural == null) {
      if (pluralForms.values.any((value) => _clean(value) != null)) {
        issues.add(
          LinguisticQaIssue(
            code: 'noun.plural_forms_without_plural',
            path: 'noun.' + noun.concept.id + '.caseForms',
            message: 'Plural case forms require an explicit canonical plural.',
          ),
        );
      }
    } else {
      if (_clean(forms.nominativePlural) != plural) {
        issues.add(
          LinguisticQaIssue(
            code: 'noun.plural_mismatch',
            path: 'noun.' + noun.concept.id + '.caseForms.nominativePlural',
            message: 'Canonical plural must equal nominative plural.',
          ),
        );
      }
      for (final entry in pluralForms.entries) {
        if (_clean(entry.value) == null) {
          issues.add(
            LinguisticQaIssue(
              code: 'noun.plural_case_missing',
              path: 'noun.' + noun.concept.id + '.caseForms.' + entry.key,
              message: 'Declared plural requires all plural case forms.',
            ),
          );
        }
      }
    }

    return LinguisticQaReport(issues);
  }

  LinguisticQaReport validateVerb(GermanVerb verb) {
    final issues = <LinguisticQaIssue>[];
    _validateConcept(
      verb.concept,
      expectedPartOfSpeech: LinguisticPartOfSpeech.verb,
      path: 'verb.' + verb.concept.id,
      issues: issues,
    );

    _requireText(
      verb.infinitive,
      'verb.' + verb.concept.id + '.infinitive',
      'verb.infinitive_blank',
      issues,
    );
    if (verb.infinitive.trim() != verb.concept.lemma.trim()) {
      issues.add(
        LinguisticQaIssue(
          code: 'verb.lemma_infinitive_mismatch',
          path: 'verb.' + verb.concept.id + '.infinitive',
          message: 'Verb lemma must equal canonical infinitive.',
        ),
      );
    }
    if (verb.auxiliary == GermanAuxiliary.unknown) {
      issues.add(
        LinguisticQaIssue(
          code: 'verb.auxiliary_unresolved',
          path: 'verb.' + verb.concept.id + '.auxiliary',
          message: 'Canonical verb requires haben/sein classification.',
        ),
      );
    }
    if (verb.reflexivity == GermanReflexivity.unknown) {
      issues.add(
        LinguisticQaIssue(
          code: 'verb.reflexivity_unresolved',
          path: 'verb.' + verb.concept.id + '.reflexivity',
          message: 'Canonical verb requires explicit reflexivity metadata.',
        ),
      );
    }

    final separable = _clean(verb.separablePrefix);
    final inseparable = _clean(verb.inseparablePrefix);
    if (separable != null && inseparable != null) {
      issues.add(
        LinguisticQaIssue(
          code: 'verb.prefix_conflict',
          path: 'verb.' + verb.concept.id,
          message: 'Verb cannot declare separable and inseparable prefixes.',
        ),
      );
    }
    if (separable != null && !verb.infinitive.startsWith(separable)) {
      issues.add(
        LinguisticQaIssue(
          code: 'verb.separable_prefix_mismatch',
          path: 'verb.' + verb.concept.id + '.separablePrefix',
          message: 'Separable prefix must be a prefix of the infinitive.',
        ),
      );
    }
    if (inseparable != null && !verb.infinitive.startsWith(inseparable)) {
      issues.add(
        LinguisticQaIssue(
          code: 'verb.inseparable_prefix_mismatch',
          path: 'verb.' + verb.concept.id + '.inseparablePrefix',
          message: 'Inseparable prefix must be a prefix of the infinitive.',
        ),
      );
    }

    final frameIds = <String>{};
    for (final frame in verb.valencyFrames) {
      _validateValency(
        frame,
        'verb.' + verb.concept.id + '.valency.' + frame.frameId,
        issues,
      );
      if (!frameIds.add(frame.frameId.trim())) {
        issues.add(
          LinguisticQaIssue(
            code: 'valency.duplicate_frame_id',
            path: 'verb.' + verb.concept.id + '.valency',
            message: 'Valency frame IDs must be unique per verb.',
          ),
        );
      }
    }

    final formKeys = <String>{};
    for (final form in verb.forms) {
      _requireText(
        form.tense,
        'verb.' + verb.concept.id + '.forms.tense',
        'verb.form_field_blank',
        issues,
      );
      _requireText(
        form.personKey,
        'verb.' + verb.concept.id + '.forms.personKey',
        'verb.form_field_blank',
        issues,
      );
      _requireText(
        form.form,
        'verb.' + verb.concept.id + '.forms.form',
        'verb.form_field_blank',
        issues,
      );
      final key = form.tense.trim() + '|' + form.personKey.trim();
      if (!formKeys.add(key)) {
        issues.add(
          LinguisticQaIssue(
            code: 'verb.duplicate_form_key',
            path: 'verb.' + verb.concept.id + '.forms',
            message: 'Verb tense/person keys must be unique.',
          ),
        );
      }
    }

    return LinguisticQaReport(issues);
  }

  LinguisticQaReport validateGrammarCatalog(Iterable<GrammarTopic> topics) {
    final issues = <LinguisticQaIssue>[];
    final topicIds = <String>{};
    final ruleIds = <String>{};
    final quizIds = <String>{};
    const levels = <String>{'A1', 'A2', 'B1', 'B2', 'C1', 'C2'};

    for (final topic in topics) {
      final path = 'grammar.' + topic.id;
      if (!topicIds.add(topic.id.trim())) {
        issues.add(
          LinguisticQaIssue(
            code: 'grammar.duplicate_topic_id',
            path: path,
            message: 'Grammar topic IDs must be globally unique.',
          ),
        );
      }
      if (!levels.contains(topic.level)) {
        issues.add(
          LinguisticQaIssue(
            code: 'grammar.invalid_level',
            path: path + '.level',
            message: 'Grammar topic level must be A1 through C2.',
          ),
        );
      }
      _requireText(topic.id, path + '.id', 'grammar.blank_field', issues);
      _requireText(
        topic.titleDe,
        path + '.titleDe',
        'grammar.blank_field',
        issues,
      );
      _requireText(
        topic.titleAr,
        path + '.titleAr',
        'grammar.blank_field',
        issues,
      );
      _requireText(
        topic.summaryAr,
        path + '.summaryAr',
        'grammar.blank_field',
        issues,
      );

      if (topic.rules.isEmpty) {
        issues.add(
          LinguisticQaIssue(
            code: 'grammar.topic_without_rules',
            path: path + '.rules',
            message:
                'Canonical grammar topic should include at least one rule.',
            severity: LinguisticQaSeverity.warning,
          ),
        );
      }
      for (final rule in topic.rules) {
        final rulePath = path + '.rules.' + rule.id;
        if (!ruleIds.add(rule.id.trim())) {
          issues.add(
            LinguisticQaIssue(
              code: 'grammar.duplicate_rule_id',
              path: rulePath,
              message: 'Grammar rule IDs must be globally unique.',
            ),
          );
        }
        _requireText(rule.id, rulePath + '.id', 'grammar.blank_field', issues);
        _requireText(
          rule.title,
          rulePath + '.title',
          'grammar.blank_field',
          issues,
        );
        _requireText(
          rule.explanationAr,
          rulePath + '.explanationAr',
          'grammar.blank_field',
          issues,
        );
        for (var rowIndex = 0; rowIndex < rule.table.length; rowIndex++) {
          final row = rule.table[rowIndex];
          if (row.isEmpty || row.any((cell) => cell.trim().isEmpty)) {
            issues.add(
              LinguisticQaIssue(
                code: 'grammar.table_blank_cell',
                path: rulePath + '.table.' + rowIndex.toString(),
                message: 'Grammar table rows cannot contain blank cells.',
              ),
            );
          }
        }
        for (var exampleIndex = 0;
            exampleIndex < rule.examples.length;
            exampleIndex++) {
          final example = rule.examples[exampleIndex];
          _requireText(
            example.german,
            rulePath + '.examples.' + exampleIndex.toString() + '.german',
            'grammar.example_blank',
            issues,
          );
          _requireText(
            example.arabic,
            rulePath + '.examples.' + exampleIndex.toString() + '.arabic',
            'grammar.example_blank',
            issues,
          );
        }
      }

      for (final quiz in topic.miniChecks) {
        final quizPath = path + '.quiz.' + quiz.id;
        if (!quizIds.add(quiz.id.trim())) {
          issues.add(
            LinguisticQaIssue(
              code: 'grammar.duplicate_quiz_id',
              path: quizPath,
              message: 'Grammar quiz IDs must be globally unique.',
            ),
          );
        }
        _requireText(quiz.id, quizPath + '.id', 'grammar.blank_field', issues);
        _requireText(
          quiz.questionText,
          quizPath + '.questionText',
          'grammar.blank_field',
          issues,
        );
        _requireText(
          quiz.explanationAr,
          quizPath + '.explanationAr',
          'grammar.blank_field',
          issues,
        );
        if (quiz.options.length < 2) {
          issues.add(
            LinguisticQaIssue(
              code: 'grammar.quiz_too_few_options',
              path: quizPath + '.options',
              message: 'Grammar quiz requires at least two options.',
            ),
          );
        }
        if (quiz.correctAnswerIndex < 0 ||
            quiz.correctAnswerIndex >= quiz.options.length) {
          issues.add(
            LinguisticQaIssue(
              code: 'grammar.quiz_index_out_of_range',
              path: quizPath + '.correctAnswerIndex',
              message: 'Correct answer index must reference an option.',
            ),
          );
        }
        final normalizedOptions =
            quiz.options.map((option) => option.trim()).toList(growable: false);
        if (normalizedOptions.any((option) => option.isEmpty)) {
          issues.add(
            LinguisticQaIssue(
              code: 'grammar.quiz_blank_option',
              path: quizPath + '.options',
              message: 'Grammar quiz options cannot be blank.',
            ),
          );
        }
        if (normalizedOptions.toSet().length != normalizedOptions.length) {
          issues.add(
            LinguisticQaIssue(
              code: 'grammar.quiz_duplicate_option',
              path: quizPath + '.options',
              message: 'Grammar quiz options must be distinct.',
            ),
          );
        }
      }
    }

    return LinguisticQaReport(issues);
  }

  LinguisticQaReport validateCanonicalGrammar() =>
      validateGrammarCatalog(CanonicalGrammarCatalog.allTopics);

  void _validateConcept(
    LinguisticConcept concept, {
    required LinguisticPartOfSpeech expectedPartOfSpeech,
    required String path,
    required List<LinguisticQaIssue> issues,
  }) {
    _requireText(concept.id, path + '.id', 'concept.blank_id', issues);
    _requireText(
      concept.senseId,
      path + '.senseId',
      'concept.blank_sense_id',
      issues,
    );
    _requireText(concept.lemma, path + '.lemma', 'concept.blank_lemma', issues);
    if (concept.partOfSpeech != expectedPartOfSpeech) {
      issues.add(
        LinguisticQaIssue(
          code: 'concept.part_of_speech_mismatch',
          path: path + '.partOfSpeech',
          message: 'Concept part of speech does not match German model.',
        ),
      );
    }
    if (concept.semanticTags.map((tag) => tag.trim()).toSet().length !=
        concept.semanticTags.length) {
      issues.add(
        LinguisticQaIssue(
          code: 'concept.duplicate_semantic_tag',
          path: path + '.semanticTags',
          message: 'Semantic tags must be unique.',
        ),
      );
    }
    if (concept.cefr == CefrLevel.unknown) {
      issues.add(
        LinguisticQaIssue(
          code: 'concept.cefr_unresolved',
          path: path + '.cefr',
          message: 'CEFR is not resolved yet.',
          severity: LinguisticQaSeverity.warning,
        ),
      );
    }
    if (concept.register == LanguageRegister.unknown) {
      issues.add(
        LinguisticQaIssue(
          code: 'concept.register_unresolved',
          path: path + '.register',
          message: 'Register is not resolved yet.',
          severity: LinguisticQaSeverity.warning,
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  void _validateValency(
    VerbValencyFrame frame,
    String path,
    List<LinguisticQaIssue> issues,
  ) {
    _requireText(
      frame.frameId,
      path + '.frameId',
      'valency.blank_frame_id',
      issues,
    );
    _requireText(
      frame.semanticRole,
      path + '.semanticRole',
      'valency.blank_semantic_role',
      issues,
    );
    final preposition = _clean(frame.preposition);
    final hasPrepositionCase = frame.prepositionCase != null;
    if ((preposition == null) != (!hasPrepositionCase)) {
      issues.add(
        LinguisticQaIssue(
          code: 'valency.preposition_case_pair',
          path: path,
          message:
              'Preposition and preposition case must be declared together.',
        ),
      );
    }
    if (frame.governedCase == null &&
        !(preposition != null && hasPrepositionCase)) {
      issues.add(
        LinguisticQaIssue(
          code: 'valency.missing_government',
          path: path,
          message: 'Valency frame requires case or preposition government.',
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  void _requireText(
    String value,
    String path,
    String code,
    List<LinguisticQaIssue> issues,
  ) {
    if (value.trim().isEmpty) {
      issues.add(
        LinguisticQaIssue(
          code: code,
          path: path,
          message: 'Required canonical text is blank.',
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  String? _clean(String? value) {
    final clean = value?.trim();
    return clean == null || clean.isEmpty ? null : clean;
  }
}

abstract final class PackChecksum {
  static String sha256Hex(List<int> input) {
    final bytes = <int>[...input, 0x80];
    while (bytes.length % 64 != 56) {
      bytes.add(0);
    }
    final bitLength = input.length * 8;
    for (var shift = 56; shift >= 0; shift -= 8) {
      bytes.add((bitLength >> shift) & 0xff);
    }

    var h0 = 0x6a09e667;
    var h1 = 0xbb67ae85;
    var h2 = 0x3c6ef372;
    var h3 = 0xa54ff53a;
    var h4 = 0x510e527f;
    var h5 = 0x9b05688c;
    var h6 = 0x1f83d9ab;
    var h7 = 0x5be0cd19;

    for (var offset = 0; offset < bytes.length; offset += 64) {
      final words = List<int>.filled(64, 0);
      for (var index = 0; index < 16; index++) {
        final base = offset + index * 4;
        words[index] = (bytes[base] << 24) |
            (bytes[base + 1] << 16) |
            (bytes[base + 2] << 8) |
            bytes[base + 3];
      }
      for (var index = 16; index < 64; index++) {
        final s0 = _rotateRight(words[index - 15], 7) ^
            _rotateRight(words[index - 15], 18) ^
            (words[index - 15] >> 3);
        final s1 = _rotateRight(words[index - 2], 17) ^
            _rotateRight(words[index - 2], 19) ^
            (words[index - 2] >> 10);
        words[index] =
            (words[index - 16] + s0 + words[index - 7] + s1) & 0xffffffff;
      }

      var a = h0;
      var b = h1;
      var c = h2;
      var d = h3;
      var e = h4;
      var f = h5;
      var g = h6;
      var h = h7;

      for (var index = 0; index < 64; index++) {
        final s1 =
            _rotateRight(e, 6) ^ _rotateRight(e, 11) ^ _rotateRight(e, 25);
        final choose = (e & f) ^ ((~e) & g);
        final temp1 =
            (h + s1 + choose + _roundConstants[index] + words[index]) &
                0xffffffff;
        final s0 =
            _rotateRight(a, 2) ^ _rotateRight(a, 13) ^ _rotateRight(a, 22);
        final majority = (a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c);
        final temp2 = (s0 + majority) & 0xffffffff;

        h = g;
        g = f;
        f = e;
        e = (d + temp1) & 0xffffffff;
        d = c;
        c = b;
        b = a;
        a = (temp1 + temp2) & 0xffffffff;
      }

      h0 = (h0 + a) & 0xffffffff;
      h1 = (h1 + b) & 0xffffffff;
      h2 = (h2 + c) & 0xffffffff;
      h3 = (h3 + d) & 0xffffffff;
      h4 = (h4 + e) & 0xffffffff;
      h5 = (h5 + f) & 0xffffffff;
      h6 = (h6 + g) & 0xffffffff;
      h7 = (h7 + h) & 0xffffffff;
    }

    return <int>[
      h0,
      h1,
      h2,
      h3,
      h4,
      h5,
      h6,
      h7,
    ].map((value) => value.toRadixString(16).padLeft(8, '0')).join();
  }

  static int _rotateRight(int value, int bits) =>
      ((value >> bits) | (value << (32 - bits))) & 0xffffffff;

  static const List<int> _roundConstants = <int>[
    0x428a2f98,
    0x71374491,
    0xb5c0fbcf,
    0xe9b5dba5,
    0x3956c25b,
    0x59f111f1,
    0x923f82a4,
    0xab1c5ed5,
    0xd807aa98,
    0x12835b01,
    0x243185be,
    0x550c7dc3,
    0x72be5d74,
    0x80deb1fe,
    0x9bdc06a7,
    0xc19bf174,
    0xe49b69c1,
    0xefbe4786,
    0x0fc19dc6,
    0x240ca1cc,
    0x2de92c6f,
    0x4a7484aa,
    0x5cb0a9dc,
    0x76f988da,
    0x983e5152,
    0xa831c66d,
    0xb00327c8,
    0xbf597fc7,
    0xc6e00bf3,
    0xd5a79147,
    0x06ca6351,
    0x14292967,
    0x27b70a85,
    0x2e1b2138,
    0x4d2c6dfc,
    0x53380d13,
    0x650a7354,
    0x766a0abb,
    0x81c2c92e,
    0x92722c85,
    0xa2bfe8a1,
    0xa81a664b,
    0xc24b8b70,
    0xc76c51a3,
    0xd192e819,
    0xd6990624,
    0xf40e3585,
    0x106aa070,
    0x19a4c116,
    0x1e376c08,
    0x2748774c,
    0x34b0bcb5,
    0x391c0cb3,
    0x4ed8aa4a,
    0x5b9cca4f,
    0x682e6ff3,
    0x748f82ee,
    0x78a5636f,
    0x84c87814,
    0x8cc70208,
    0x90befffa,
    0xa4506ceb,
    0xbef9a3f7,
    0xc67178f2,
  ];
}

FILE: lib/services/pack_database_key_store.dart

import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

abstract interface class PackDatabaseKeyStore {
  Future<String> getOrCreateKey();
  Future<String?> readKey();
}

final class UnavailablePackDatabaseKeyStore implements PackDatabaseKeyStore {
  const UnavailablePackDatabaseKeyStore();

  @override
  Future<String> getOrCreateKey() {
    throw const PackDatabaseKeyStoreException('pack_key_store_unavailable');
  }

  @override
  Future<String?> readKey() async => null;
}

final class AndroidKeystorePackDatabaseKeyStore
    implements PackDatabaseKeyStore {
  AndroidKeystorePackDatabaseKeyStore({MethodChannel? channel})
      : _channel = channel ?? const MethodChannel(_channelName);

  static const String _channelName =
      'com.deutschbilarabi.app/pack_database_key_store';
  static const String _getOrCreateMethod = 'getOrCreate';
  static const String _readMethod = 'read';

  final MethodChannel _channel;

  @override
  Future<String> getOrCreateKey() async {
    final value = await _invoke<String>(_getOrCreateMethod);
    return _validate(value, required: true)!;
  }

  @override
  Future<String?> readKey() async {
    final value = await _invoke<String?>(_readMethod);
    return _validate(value, required: false);
  }

  Future<T?> _invoke<T>(String method) async {
    try {
      return await _channel.invokeMethod<T>(method);
    } on PlatformException catch (error) {
      throw PackDatabaseKeyStoreException('pack_key_store_' + error.code);
    } on MissingPluginException {
      throw const PackDatabaseKeyStoreException('pack_key_store_unavailable');
    }
  }

  String? _validate(String? encoded, {required bool required}) {
    if (encoded == null || encoded.isEmpty) {
      if (!required) return null;
      throw const PackDatabaseKeyStoreException('pack_key_missing');
    }
    try {
      final bytes = base64Decode(encoded);
      if (bytes.length != 32) {
        throw const FormatException();
      }
      return encoded;
    } on Object {
      throw const PackDatabaseKeyStoreException('pack_key_corrupted');
    }
  }
}

final class PackDatabaseKeyStoreException implements Exception {
  const PackDatabaseKeyStoreException(this.code);

  final String code;

  @override
  String toString() => 'PackDatabaseKeyStoreException(' + code + ')';
}

FILE: lib/services/pack_database_security.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:sqflite_common/sqlite_api.dart';
import 'package:sqflite_sqlcipher/sqflite.dart' as sqlcipher;

abstract interface class PackDatabaseCipher {
  Future<void> encryptPlaintextInPlace(
    File plaintextDatabase, {
    required String password,
  });
}

abstract interface class PackDatabaseOpener {
  Future<Database> openReadOnly(String path, {required String password});
}

final class UnavailablePackDatabaseCipher implements PackDatabaseCipher {
  const UnavailablePackDatabaseCipher();

  @override
  Future<void> encryptPlaintextInPlace(
    File plaintextDatabase, {
    required String password,
  }) {
    throw const PackDatabaseSecurityException(
      'pack_database_cipher_unavailable',
    );
  }
}

final class FactoryBackedPackDatabaseOpener implements PackDatabaseOpener {
  const FactoryBackedPackDatabaseOpener(this.factory);

  final DatabaseFactory factory;

  @override
  Future<Database> openReadOnly(String path, {required String password}) =>
      factory.openDatabase(
        path,
        options: OpenDatabaseOptions(readOnly: true, singleInstance: false),
      );
}

final class SqlCipherPackDatabaseSecurity
    implements PackDatabaseCipher, PackDatabaseOpener {
  const SqlCipherPackDatabaseSecurity();

  static const List<int> _plainSqliteHeader = <int>[
    0x53,
    0x51,
    0x4c,
    0x69,
    0x74,
    0x65,
    0x20,
    0x66,
    0x6f,
    0x72,
    0x6d,
    0x61,
    0x74,
    0x20,
    0x33,
    0x00,
  ];

  @override
  Future<void> encryptPlaintextInPlace(
    File plaintextDatabase, {
    required String password,
  }) async {
    _requirePassword(password);
    if (!await plaintextDatabase.exists() ||
        await plaintextDatabase.length() <= _plainSqliteHeader.length) {
      throw const PackDatabaseSecurityException(
        'pack_plaintext_database_missing',
      );
    }

    final encrypted = File(plaintextDatabase.path + '.phase7-encrypted');
    final backup = File(plaintextDatabase.path + '.phase7-plaintext');
    if (await encrypted.exists()) await encrypted.delete();
    if (await backup.exists()) await backup.delete();

    Database? source;
    var attached = false;
    try {
      source = await sqlcipher.openDatabase(
        plaintextDatabase.path,
        singleInstance: false,
      );
      await _assertCipherEngine(source);
      final versionRows = await source.rawQuery('PRAGMA user_version');
      final userVersion = versionRows.isEmpty
          ? 0
          : ((versionRows.first.values.first as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0);

      await source.execute(
        "ATTACH DATABASE '" +
            _sqlLiteral(encrypted.path) +
            "' AS encrypted KEY '" +
            _sqlLiteral(password) +
            "'",
      );
      attached = true;
      await source.rawQuery("SELECT sqlcipher_export('encrypted')");
      await source.execute(
        'PRAGMA encrypted.user_version = ' + userVersion.toString(),
      );
      final cipherErrors = await source.rawQuery(
        'PRAGMA encrypted.cipher_integrity_check',
      );
      if (cipherErrors.isNotEmpty) {
        throw const PackDatabaseSecurityException(
          'pack_cipher_integrity_failed',
        );
      }
      await source.execute('DETACH DATABASE encrypted');
      attached = false;
      await source.close();
      source = null;

      await plaintextDatabase.rename(backup.path);
      try {
        await encrypted.rename(plaintextDatabase.path);
        await _assertEncryptedFile(plaintextDatabase, password: password);
        await backup.delete();
      } on Object {
        if (await plaintextDatabase.exists()) {
          await plaintextDatabase.delete();
        }
        if (await backup.exists()) {
          await backup.rename(plaintextDatabase.path);
        }
        rethrow;
      }
    } on PackDatabaseSecurityException {
      rethrow;
    } on Object {
      throw const PackDatabaseSecurityException(
        'pack_database_encryption_failed',
      );
    } finally {
      if (attached && source != null) {
        try {
          await source.execute('DETACH DATABASE encrypted');
        } on Object {
          // Closing the connection is the final cleanup boundary.
        }
      }
      if (source != null) {
        try {
          await source.close();
        } on Object {
          // Do not replace the original encryption error.
        }
      }
      if (await encrypted.exists()) {
        await encrypted.delete();
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<Database> openReadOnly(String path, {required String password}) async {
    _requirePassword(password);
    Database? database;
    try {
      database = await sqlcipher.openDatabase(
        path,
        password: password,
        readOnly: true,
        singleInstance: false,
      );
      await _assertCipherEngine(database);
      await _assertIntegrity(database);
      return database;
    } on PackDatabaseSecurityException {
      if (database != null) await database.close();
      rethrow;
    } on Object {
      if (database != null) await database.close();
      throw const PackDatabaseSecurityException('pack_database_open_failed');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _assertEncryptedFile(
    File databaseFile, {
    required String password,
  }) async {
    final header = await databaseFile
        .openRead(0, _plainSqliteHeader.length)
        .fold<List<int>>(<int>[], (bytes, chunk) => bytes..addAll(chunk));
    if (_sameBytes(header, _plainSqliteHeader)) {
      throw const PackDatabaseSecurityException(
        'pack_database_plaintext_header_detected',
      );
    }
    final database = await openReadOnly(databaseFile.path, password: password);
    await database.close();
  }

  Future<void> _assertCipherEngine(Database database) async {
    final rows = await database.rawQuery('PRAGMA cipher_version');
    if (rows.isEmpty ||
        rows.first.values.isEmpty ||
        rows.first.values.first.toString().trim().isEmpty) {
      throw const PackDatabaseSecurityException(
        'pack_cipher_engine_unavailable',
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _assertIntegrity(Database database) async {
    final cipherErrors = await database.rawQuery(
      'PRAGMA cipher_integrity_check',
    );
    if (cipherErrors.isNotEmpty) {
      throw const PackDatabaseSecurityException('pack_cipher_integrity_failed');
    }
    final logical = await database.rawQuery('PRAGMA integrity_check');
    if (logical.isEmpty ||
        logical.first.values.isEmpty ||
        logical.first.values.first.toString().toLowerCase() != 'ok') {
      throw const PackDatabaseSecurityException('pack_sqlite_integrity_failed');
    }
  }

  static void _requirePassword(String password) {
    if (password.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw const PackDatabaseSecurityException('pack_database_key_missing');
    }
  }

  static String _sqlLiteral(String value) => value.replaceAll("'", "''");

  static bool _sameBytes(List<int> left, List<int> right) {
    if (left.length != right.length) return false;
    for (var index = 0; index < left.length; index++) {
      if (left[index] != right[index]) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }
}

final class PackDatabaseSecurityException implements Exception {
  const PackDatabaseSecurityException(this.code);

  final String code;

  @override
  String toString() => 'PackDatabaseSecurityException(' + code + ')';
}

import '../language/german/german_word_family_repository.dart';
import '../models/linguistics/german_word_family.dart';
import 'canonical_linguistic_store.dart';
import 'pack_database_security.dart';

final class PackGermanWordFamilyRepository
    implements GermanWordFamilyRepository {
  const PackGermanWordFamilyRepository({
    required this.databasePath,
    required this.databaseOpener,
    required this.databasePassword,
  });

  final String databasePath;
  final PackDatabaseOpener databaseOpener;
  final String databasePassword;

  @override
  Future<List<GermanWordFamily>> listFamilies({int limit = 100}) async {
    final boundedLimit = limit.clamp(1, 200);
    final database = await databaseOpener.openReadOnly(
      databasePath,
      password: databasePassword,
    );
    try {
      final store = CanonicalLinguisticStore(database);
      final ids = await store.listGermanWordFamilyIds(limit: boundedLimit);
      final families = <GermanWordFamily>[];
      for (final id in ids) {
        final family = await store.readGermanWordFamily(id);
        if (family != null) {
          families.add(family);
        }
      }
      return List<GermanWordFamily>.unmodifiable(families);
    } finally {
      await database.close();
    }
  }
}

FILE: lib/services/pack_grammar_hub_repository.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:sqflite_common/sqlite_api.dart';

import '../models/grammar_microscope.dart';
import 'grammar_hub_service.dart';
import 'pack_database_security.dart';

/// Reads grammar from an admitted active-pack SQLite database when that
/// database exposes the Phase-1 compatibility tables. Until Phase 2 compiles
/// canonical grammar into those tables, embedded grammar is the fail-safe.
final class PackGrammarHubRepository
    implements GrammarHubRepository, GrammarMicroscopeRepository {
  PackGrammarHubRepository({
    required this.databasePath,
    required this.packId,
    required GrammarHubRepository fallback,
    required PackDatabaseOpener databaseOpener,
    required String databasePassword,
  })  : _fallback = fallback,
        _databaseOpener = databaseOpener,
        _databasePassword = databasePassword;

  final String databasePath;
  final String packId;
  final GrammarHubRepository _fallback;
  final PackDatabaseOpener _databaseOpener;
  final String _databasePassword;
  final Set<String> _mastered = <String>{};

  Database? _database;
  bool? _compatibleSchema;
  bool? _microscopeCompatibleSchema;

  Future<Database> get _db async {
    final current = _database;
    if (current != null) return current;
    _database = await _databaseOpener.openReadOnly(
      databasePath,
      password: _databasePassword,
    );
    return _database!;
  }

  Future<bool> _hasCompatibleSchema() async {
    final cached = _compatibleSchema;
    if (cached != null) return cached;
    try {
      final db = await _db;
      final topicColumns = await db.rawQuery(
        'PRAGMA table_info(grammar_topics)',
      );
      final quizColumns = await db.rawQuery(
        'PRAGMA table_info(grammar_quizzes)',
      );
      final topicNames =
          topicColumns.map((row) => row['name']?.toString() ?? '').toSet();
      final quizNames =
          quizColumns.map((row) => row['name']?.toString() ?? '').toSet();
      const requiredTopics = <String>{
        'id',
        'level',
        'title_de',
        'title_ar',
        'explanation_markdown',
        'formula_pattern',
        'order_index',
      };
      const requiredQuizzes = <String>{
        'id',
        'topic_id',
        'question',
        'options_json',
        'correct_index',
        'explanation',
      };
      _compatibleSchema = topicNames.containsAll(requiredTopics) &&
          quizNames.containsAll(requiredQuizzes);
    } on Object {
      _compatibleSchema = false;
    }
    return _compatibleSchema!;
  }

  Future<bool> _hasMicroscopeSchema() async {
    final cached = _microscopeCompatibleSchema;
    if (cached != null) return cached;
    if (!await _hasCompatibleSchema()) {
      _microscopeCompatibleSchema = false;
      return false;
    }
    try {
      final db = await _db;
      final ruleColumns = await _columnNames(db, 'grammar_rules');
      final rowColumns = await _columnNames(db, 'grammar_rule_rows');
      final exampleColumns = await _columnNames(db, 'grammar_examples');
      _microscopeCompatibleSchema = ruleColumns.containsAll(const <String>{
            'id',
            'topic_id',
            'title',
            'explanation_ar',
            'order_index',
          }) &&
          rowColumns.containsAll(const <String>{
            'rule_id',
            'row_index',
            'cells_json',
          }) &&
          exampleColumns.containsAll(const <String>{
            'rule_id',
            'example_index',
            'german',
            'arabic',
          });
    } on Object {
      _microscopeCompatibleSchema = false;
    }
    return _microscopeCompatibleSchema!;
  }

  Future<Set<String>> _columnNames(Database db, String table) async {
    final rows = await db.rawQuery('PRAGMA table_info($table)');
    return rows.map((row) => row['name']?.toString() ?? '').toSet();
  }

  GrammarTopic _topic(Map<String, Object?> row) =>
      GrammarTopic.fromMap(<String, dynamic>{
        ...row,
        'is_mastered': _mastered.contains(row['id']?.toString()) ? 1 : 0,
      });

  @override
  Future<List<GrammarTopic>> getTopicsByLevel(String level) async {
    if (!await _hasCompatibleSchema()) {
      return _fallback.getTopicsByLevel(level);
    }
    try {
      final rows = await (await _db).query(
        'grammar_topics',
        where: 'level = ?',
        whereArgs: <Object?>[level],
        orderBy: 'order_index ASC',
        limit: 200,
      );
      return rows.map(_topic).toList(growable: false);
    } on Object {
      return _fallback.getTopicsByLevel(level);
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<GrammarTopic?> getTopicDetail(String topicId) async {
    if (!await _hasCompatibleSchema()) {
      return _fallback.getTopicDetail(topicId);
    }
    try {
      final rows = await (await _db).query(
        'grammar_topics',
        where: 'id = ?',
        whereArgs: <Object?>[topicId],
        limit: 1,
      );
      return rows.isEmpty ? null : _topic(rows.first);
    } on Object {
      return _fallback.getTopicDetail(topicId);
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<List<GrammarQuiz>> getQuizzesForTopic(String topicId) async {
    if (!await _hasCompatibleSchema()) {
      return _fallback.getQuizzesForTopic(topicId);
    }
    try {
      final rows = await (await _db).query(
        'grammar_quizzes',
        where: 'topic_id = ?',
        whereArgs: <Object?>[topicId],
        orderBy: 'id ASC',
        limit: 200,
      );
      return rows
          .map((row) => GrammarQuiz.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic>.from(row)))
          .toList(growable: false);
    } on Object {
      return _fallback.getQuizzesForTopic(topicId);
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<List<GrammarRuleDetail>> getRulesForTopic(String topicId) async {
    final safeTopicId = topicId.trim();
    if (safeTopicId.isEmpty || safeTopicId.length > 160) {
      return const <GrammarRuleDetail>[];
    }
    if (!await _hasMicroscopeSchema()) {
      final fallback = _fallback;
      if (fallback is GrammarMicroscopeRepository) {
        return (fallback as GrammarMicroscopeRepository).getRulesForTopic(
          safeTopicId,
        );
      }
      return const <GrammarRuleDetail>[];
    }

    try {
      final db = await _db;
      final rules = await db.query(
        'grammar_rules',
        where: 'topic_id = ?',
        whereArgs: <Object?>[safeTopicId],
        orderBy: 'order_index ASC',
        limit: 100,
      );
      final result = <GrammarRuleDetail>[];
      for (final row in rules) {
        final ruleId = _boundedText(row['id'], maxLength: 160);
        if (ruleId.isEmpty) continue;
        final tableRows = await db.query(
          'grammar_rule_rows',
          where: 'rule_id = ?',
          whereArgs: <Object?>[ruleId],
          orderBy: 'row_index ASC',
          limit: 100,
        );
        final examples = await db.query(
          'grammar_examples',
          where: 'rule_id = ?',
          whereArgs: <Object?>[ruleId],
          orderBy: 'example_index ASC',
          limit: 100,
        );
        result.add(
          GrammarRuleDetail(
            id: ruleId,
            topicId: safeTopicId,
            title: _boundedText(row['title']),
            explanationAr: _boundedText(row['explanation_ar']),
            orderIndex: _safeInt(row['order_index']),
            table: tableRows
                .map((entry) => _decodeCells(entry['cells_json']))
                .where((cells) => cells.isNotEmpty)
                .toList(growable: false),
            examples: examples
                .map(
                  (entry) => GrammarExampleDetail(
                    german: _boundedText(entry['german']),
                    arabic: _boundedText(entry['arabic']),
                  ),
                )
                .where(
                  (example) =>
                      example.german.isNotEmpty || example.arabic.isNotEmpty,
                )
                .toList(growable: false),
          ),
        );
      }
      return List<GrammarRuleDetail>.unmodifiable(result);
    } on Object {
      final fallback = _fallback;
      if (fallback is GrammarMicroscopeRepository) {
        return (fallback as GrammarMicroscopeRepository).getRulesForTopic(
          safeTopicId,
        );
      }
      return const <GrammarRuleDetail>[];
    }
  }

  static List<String> _decodeCells(Object? raw) {
    if (raw is! String || raw.length > 64 * 1024) {
      return const <String>[];
    }
    try {
      final decoded = json.decode(raw);
      if (decoded is! List) return const <String>[];
      return decoded
          .map((value) => _boundedText(value))
          .where((value) => value.isNotEmpty)
          .take(16)
          .toList(growable: false);
    } on Object {
      return const <String>[];
    }
  }

  static String _boundedText(Object? raw, {int maxLength = 4000}) {
    final value = raw?.toString().trim() ?? '';
    if (value.isEmpty) return '';
    return value.length <= maxLength ? value : value.substring(0, maxLength);
  }

  static int _safeInt(Object? raw) =>
      raw is num ? raw.toInt() : int.tryParse(raw?.toString() ?? '') ?? 0;

  @override
  Future<void> saveTopicMastery(String topicId, bool mastered) async {
    if (!await _hasCompatibleSchema()) {
      await _fallback.saveTopicMastery(topicId, mastered);
      return;
    }
    if (mastered) {
      _mastered.add(topicId);
    } else {
      _mastered.remove(topicId);
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> close() async {
    final db = _database;
    _database = null;
    if (db != null) {
      await db.close();
    }
    await _fallback.close();
  }
}
