import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:path/path.dart' as p;

import 'pack_checksum.dart';
import 'pack_manifest.dart';
import 'pack_database_key_store.dart';
import 'pack_database_security.dart';
import 'preferences_service.dart';

export 'pack_checksum.dart';
export 'pack_manifest.dart';

enum PackLifecycleStage {
  idle,
  downloading,
  verifying,
  extracting,
  installed,
  deleting,
  failed,
}

class PackOperationState {
  const PackOperationState({
    required this.stage,
    this.progress = 0,
    this.message,
  });

  const PackOperationState.idle()
      : stage = PackLifecycleStage.idle,
        progress = 0,
        message = null;

  final PackLifecycleStage stage;
  final double progress;
  final String? message;

  bool get isBusy =>
      stage == PackLifecycleStage.downloading ||
      stage == PackLifecycleStage.verifying ||
      stage == PackLifecycleStage.extracting ||
      stage == PackLifecycleStage.deleting;
}

class PackIntegrityException implements Exception {
  const PackIntegrityException(this.message);

  final String message;

  @override
  String toString() => 'PackIntegrityException: $message';
}

abstract interface class PackDownloader {
  Future<int> download(
    Uri source,
    File destination, {
    required int expectedBytes,
    required ValueChanged<double> onProgress,
  });
}

class HttpPackDownloader implements PackDownloader {
  HttpPackDownloader({http.Client? client})
      : _client = client ?? http.Client(),
        _ownsClient = client == null;

  final http.Client _client;
  final bool _ownsClient;

  @override
  Future<int> download(
    Uri source,
    File destination, {
    required int expectedBytes,
    required ValueChanged<double> onProgress,
  }) async {
    if (source.scheme != 'https') {
      throw const FormatException('Only HTTPS pack downloads are allowed.');
    }

    await destination.parent.create(recursive: true);
    final response = await _client.send(http.Request('GET', source));
    if (response.statusCode < 200 || response.statusCode >= 300) {
      throw HttpException(
        'Pack download failed with HTTP ${response.statusCode}.',
        uri: source,
      );
    }

    final sink = destination.openWrite();
    var received = 0;
    try {
      await for (final chunk in response.stream) {
        received += chunk.length;
        if (received > expectedBytes) {
          throw const PackIntegrityException(
            'Downloaded pack exceeds manifest archive size.',
          );
        }
        sink.add(chunk);
        final progress = expectedBytes == 0
            ? 0.0
            : (received / expectedBytes).clamp(0, 1).toDouble();
        onProgress(progress);
      }
      await sink.flush();
    } finally {
      await sink.close();
    }
    return received;
  }

  void dispose() {
    if (_ownsClient) _client.close();
  }
}

abstract interface class PackArchiveExtractor {
  Future<void> extract(
    File archiveFile,
    Directory destination,
    LanguagePackDescriptor descriptor,
  );
}

/// Language-neutral pack bundle:
/// gzip(JSON({packId, version, contractVersion, files:[{path, contentBase64}]})).
class JsonGzipPackExtractor implements PackArchiveExtractor {
  const JsonGzipPackExtractor();

  static const String supportedFormat = 'json-gzip-v1';

  @override
  Future<void> extract(
    File archiveFile,
    Directory destination,
    LanguagePackDescriptor descriptor,
  ) async {
    final compressed = await archiveFile.readAsBytes();
    final decodedBytes = <int>[];
    final envelopeLimit = (descriptor.installedSizeBytes * 2 + 1024 * 1024)
        .clamp(1024 * 1024, 128 * 1024 * 1024)
        .toInt();
    try {
      final decoder = gzip.decoder.startChunkedConversion(
        _BoundedByteSink(decodedBytes, envelopeLimit),
      );
      decoder.add(compressed);
      decoder.close();
    } on PackIntegrityException {
      rethrow;
    } on Object {
      throw const PackIntegrityException('Pack gzip payload is invalid.');
    }

    late final Object? decoded;
    try {
      decoded = jsonDecode(utf8.decode(decodedBytes));
    } on Object {
      throw const PackIntegrityException('Pack JSON payload is invalid.');
    }
    if (decoded is! Map<String, dynamic>) {
      throw const PackIntegrityException('Pack payload must be a JSON object.');
    }

    if (decoded['packId'] != descriptor.id ||
        decoded['version'] != descriptor.version ||
        decoded['contractVersion'] != descriptor.contractVersion) {
      throw const PackIntegrityException(
        'Pack payload identity does not match its manifest.',
      );
    }

    final files = decoded['files'];
    if (files is! List || files.isEmpty || files.length > 256) {
      throw const PackIntegrityException(
        'Pack files must contain between 1 and 256 entries.',
      );
    }

    await destination.create(recursive: true);
    final root = p.normalize(destination.absolute.path);
    final seenPaths = <String>{};
    var expandedBytes = 0;

    for (final rawFile in files) {
      if (rawFile is! Map) {
        throw const PackIntegrityException('Invalid pack file entry.');
      }
      final file = rawFile.cast<String, dynamic>();
      final safePath = _safeRelativePath((file['path'] ?? '').toString());
      if (!seenPaths.add(safePath)) {
        throw PackIntegrityException('Duplicate pack file: $safePath');
      }

      late final List<int> content;
      try {
        content = base64Decode((file['contentBase64'] ?? '').toString());
      } on Object {
        throw PackIntegrityException(
          'Invalid base64 content for pack file: $safePath',
        );
      }

      expandedBytes += content.length;
      if (expandedBytes > descriptor.installedSizeBytes) {
        throw const PackIntegrityException(
          'Expanded pack exceeds manifest installed size.',
        );
      }

      final outputPath = p.normalize(p.join(root, safePath));
      if (!p.isWithin(root, outputPath)) {
        throw const PackIntegrityException(
          'Pack file attempts to escape its destination.',
        );
      }
      final output = File(outputPath);
      await output.parent.create(recursive: true);
      await output.writeAsBytes(content, flush: true);
    }

    if (expandedBytes != descriptor.installedSizeBytes) {
      throw PackIntegrityException(
        'Expanded size mismatch: expected '
        '${descriptor.installedSizeBytes}, got $expandedBytes.',
      );
    }
  }

  static String _safeRelativePath(String rawPath) {
    final normalized = p.posix.normalize(rawPath.replaceAll('\\', '/'));
    if (normalized.isEmpty ||
        normalized == '.' ||
        normalized == '..' ||
        normalized.startsWith('../') ||
        p.posix.isAbsolute(normalized) ||
        normalized.length > 240) {
      throw const PackIntegrityException('Unsafe pack file path.');
    }
    return p.joinAll(p.posix.split(normalized));
  }
}

final class _BoundedByteSink implements ChunkedConversionSink<List<int>> {
  _BoundedByteSink(this.target, this.maxBytes);

  final List<int> target;
  final int maxBytes;
  int _received = 0;

  @override
  void add(List<int> chunk) {
    _received += chunk.length;
    if (_received > maxBytes) {
      throw const PackIntegrityException(
        'Expanded gzip envelope exceeds safety limit.',
      );
    }
    target.addAll(chunk);
  }

  @override
  void close() {}
}

final class _ManifestAcceptance {
  const _ManifestAcceptance({
    required this.revision,
    required this.signature,
    required this.keyId,
  });

  const _ManifestAcceptance.empty()
      : revision = 0,
        signature = '',
        keyId = '';

  final int revision;
  final String signature;
  final String keyId;
}

class PackManagerService extends ChangeNotifier {
  PackManagerService(
    this._prefs, {
    required this.rootDirectory,
    PackManifestVerifier? manifestVerifier,
    PackDatabaseKeyStore databaseKeyStore =
        const UnavailablePackDatabaseKeyStore(),
    PackDatabaseCipher databaseCipher = const UnavailablePackDatabaseCipher(),
    PackDownloader? downloader,
    PackArchiveExtractor extractor = const JsonGzipPackExtractor(),
    DateTime Function()? clock,
  })  : _manifestVerifier =
            manifestVerifier ?? const RejectingPackManifestVerifier(),
        _databaseKeyStore = databaseKeyStore,
        _databaseCipher = databaseCipher,
        _downloader = downloader ?? HttpPackDownloader(),
        _extractor = extractor,
        _clock = clock ?? DateTime.now {
    _loadInstalledRegistry();
  }

  static const String installedRegistryKey = 'offline_pack_registry_v1';
  static const String activePackKey = 'offline_active_pack_v1';
  static const String manifestRevisionKey = 'offline_manifest_revision_v1';
  static const String manifestAcceptanceKey = 'offline_manifest_acceptance_v2';

  final PreferencesService _prefs;
  final Directory rootDirectory;
  final PackManifestVerifier _manifestVerifier;
  final PackDatabaseKeyStore _databaseKeyStore;
  final PackDatabaseCipher _databaseCipher;
  final PackDownloader _downloader;
  final PackArchiveExtractor _extractor;
  final DateTime Function() _clock;

  PackManifest _manifest = PackManifest.empty();
  final Map<String, InstalledLanguagePack> _installed =
      <String, InstalledLanguagePack>{};
  final Map<String, PackOperationState> _operations =
      <String, PackOperationState>{};
  String? _activePackId;

  PackManifest get manifest => _manifest;
  List<LanguagePackDescriptor> get availablePacks => _manifest.packs;
  List<InstalledLanguagePack> get installedPacks =>
      List.unmodifiable(_installed.values);
  String? get activePackId => _activePackId;
  int get totalStorageBytes => _installed.values.fold<int>(
        0,
        (total, pack) => total + pack.storageBytes,
      );

  InstalledLanguagePack? installedFor(String packId) => _installed[packId];

  PackOperationState operationFor(String packId) =>
      _operations[packId] ?? const PackOperationState.idle();

  Future<PackManifest> loadManifestJson(String rawJson) async {
    final parsed = await _manifestVerifier.verifyAndParse(rawJson);
    final acceptance = _readManifestAcceptance();
    final legacyRevision = _prefs.getInt(manifestRevisionKey) ?? 0;
    final acceptedRevision = acceptance.revision > legacyRevision
        ? acceptance.revision
        : legacyRevision;
    if (parsed.manifestRevision < acceptedRevision) {
      throw StateError(
        'Manifest rollback rejected: ' +
            parsed.manifestRevision.toString() +
            ' < ' +
            acceptedRevision.toString() +
            '.',
      );
    }
    if (parsed.manifestRevision == acceptance.revision &&
        acceptance.signature.isNotEmpty &&
        (parsed.signature != acceptance.signature ||
            parsed.keyId != acceptance.keyId)) {
      throw StateError(
        'Manifest replay conflict: revision was already accepted with '
        'different signed content.',
      );
    }
    if (parsed.manifestRevision > acceptance.revision ||
        acceptance.signature.isEmpty) {
      final state = jsonEncode(<String, Object>{
        'revision': parsed.manifestRevision,
        'signature': parsed.signature,
        'keyId': parsed.keyId,
      });
      if (!await _prefs.writeText(manifestAcceptanceKey, state)) {
        throw StateError('Manifest acceptance state could not be persisted.');
      }
      await _prefs.setInt(manifestRevisionKey, parsed.manifestRevision);
    }
    _manifest = parsed;
    notifyListeners();
    return parsed;
  }

  Future<InstalledLanguagePack> install(
    LanguagePackDescriptor descriptor,
  ) async {
    _assertDescriptorAdmitted(descriptor);
    _assertNotBusy(descriptor.id);
    await rootDirectory.create(recursive: true);

    final downloadDir = Directory(p.join(rootDirectory.path, '.downloads'));
    final stagingRoot = Directory(p.join(rootDirectory.path, '.staging'));
    await downloadDir.create(recursive: true);
    await stagingRoot.create(recursive: true);

    final stamp = _clock().toUtc().microsecondsSinceEpoch;
    final archiveFile = File(
      p.join(downloadDir.path, '${descriptor.id}_$stamp.pack.gz'),
    );
    final staging = Directory(
      p.join(stagingRoot.path, '${descriptor.id}_$stamp'),
    );

    try {
      _setOperation(
        descriptor.id,
        const PackOperationState(
          stage: PackLifecycleStage.downloading,
          progress: 0,
        ),
      );
      final downloaded = await _downloader.download(
        descriptor.archiveUrl,
        archiveFile,
        expectedBytes: descriptor.archiveSizeBytes,
        onProgress: (progress) => _setOperation(
          descriptor.id,
          PackOperationState(
            stage: PackLifecycleStage.downloading,
            progress: progress,
          ),
        ),
      );
      if (downloaded != descriptor.archiveSizeBytes) {
        throw PackIntegrityException(
          'Archive size mismatch: expected '
          '${descriptor.archiveSizeBytes}, got $downloaded.',
        );
      }

      _setOperation(
        descriptor.id,
        const PackOperationState(
          stage: PackLifecycleStage.verifying,
          progress: 1,
        ),
      );
      final checksum = PackChecksum.sha256Hex(await archiveFile.readAsBytes());
      if (checksum.toLowerCase() != descriptor.sha256.toLowerCase()) {
        throw const PackIntegrityException(
          'SHA-256 checksum verification failed.',
        );
      }

      _setOperation(
        descriptor.id,
        const PackOperationState(
          stage: PackLifecycleStage.extracting,
          progress: 1,
        ),
      );
      await staging.create(recursive: true);
      await _extractor.extract(archiveFile, staging, descriptor);
      final sqliteFile = File(
        p.join(staging.path, 'content', 'content.sqlite'),
      );
      if (!await sqliteFile.exists()) {
        throw const PackIntegrityException(
          'Pack is missing required content/content.sqlite.',
        );
      }
      final contentChecksum = PackChecksum.sha256Hex(
        await sqliteFile.readAsBytes(),
      );
      if (contentChecksum.toLowerCase() !=
          descriptor.contentSha256.toLowerCase()) {
        throw const PackIntegrityException(
          'Content SQLite SHA-256 verification failed.',
        );
      }
      final plaintextStorageBytes = await _directorySize(staging);
      if (plaintextStorageBytes != descriptor.installedSizeBytes) {
        throw PackIntegrityException(
          'Installed size mismatch: expected ' +
              descriptor.installedSizeBytes.toString() +
              ', got ' +
              plaintextStorageBytes.toString() +
              '.',
        );
      }

      final databaseKey = await _databaseKeyStore.getOrCreateKey();
      await _databaseCipher.encryptPlaintextInPlace(
        sqliteFile,
        password: databaseKey,
      );
      final storageBytes = await _directorySize(staging);

      final destination = _packDirectory(descriptor.id);
      await _replaceAtomically(staging, destination);

      final installed = InstalledLanguagePack(
        id: descriptor.id,
        languageCode: descriptor.languageCode,
        displayName: descriptor.displayName,
        version: descriptor.version,
        contractVersion: descriptor.contractVersion,
        sha256: descriptor.sha256,
        contentSha256: descriptor.contentSha256,
        storageBytes: storageBytes,
        installedAt: _clock().toUtc(),
        manifestRevision: _manifest.manifestRevision,
        manifestKeyId: _manifest.keyId,
        manifestSignature: _manifest.signature,
        databaseEncrypted: true,
      );
      _installed[descriptor.id] = installed;
      await _persistInstalledRegistry();

      if (_activePackId == null) {
        await _persistActivePack(descriptor.id);
      }

      _setOperation(
        descriptor.id,
        const PackOperationState(
          stage: PackLifecycleStage.installed,
          progress: 1,
        ),
      );
      return installed;
    } on Object catch (error) {
      _setOperation(
        descriptor.id,
        PackOperationState(
          stage: PackLifecycleStage.failed,
          message: error.toString(),
        ),
      );
      rethrow;
    } finally {
      if (await archiveFile.exists()) {
        await archiveFile.delete();
      }
      if (await staging.exists()) {
        await staging.delete(recursive: true);
      }
    }
  }

  Future<InstalledLanguagePack> reinstall(LanguagePackDescriptor descriptor) =>
      install(descriptor);

  Future<void> deletePack(String packId) async {
    _assertPackId(packId);
    _assertNotBusy(packId);
    _setOperation(
      packId,
      const PackOperationState(stage: PackLifecycleStage.deleting),
    );
    try {
      final directory = _packDirectory(packId);
      if (await directory.exists()) {
        await directory.delete(recursive: true);
      }
      _installed.remove(packId);
      await _persistInstalledRegistry();
      if (_activePackId == packId) {
        _activePackId = null;
        if (!await _prefs.deleteValue(activePackKey)) {
          throw StateError('Active pack registration could not be cleared.');
        }
      }
      _setOperation(packId, const PackOperationState.idle());
    } on Object catch (error) {
      _setOperation(
        packId,
        PackOperationState(
          stage: PackLifecycleStage.failed,
          message: error.toString(),
        ),
      );
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<void> setActivePack(String packId) async {
    _assertPackId(packId);
    final installed = _installed[packId];
    if (installed == null) {
      throw StateError('Cannot activate a pack that is not installed.');
    }
    if (!installed.hasSignedProvenance) {
      throw StateError('Cannot activate a pack without signed provenance.');
    }
    if (!installed.databaseEncrypted) {
      throw StateError('Cannot activate an unencrypted pack.');
    }
    await _persistActivePack(packId);
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<int> storageBytesFor(String packId) async {
    _assertPackId(packId);
    return _directorySize(_packDirectory(packId));
  }

  Future<void> refreshStorage() async {
    var changed = false;
    final stale = <String>[];

    for (final entry in _installed.entries.toList(growable: false)) {
      final directory = _packDirectory(entry.key);
      if (!await directory.exists()) {
        stale.add(entry.key);
        continue;
      }
      final bytes = await _directorySize(directory);
      if (bytes != entry.value.storageBytes) {
        _installed[entry.key] = entry.value.copyWith(storageBytes: bytes);
        changed = true;
      }
    }

    for (final id in stale) {
      _installed.remove(id);
      changed = true;
    }
    if (_activePackId != null && !_installed.containsKey(_activePackId)) {
      _activePackId = null;
      await _prefs.deleteValue(activePackKey);
      changed = true;
    }

    if (changed) {
      await _persistInstalledRegistry();
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  Directory _packDirectory(String packId) =>
      Directory(p.join(rootDirectory.path, 'packs', packId));

  void _loadInstalledRegistry() {
    final raw = _prefs.readTextList(installedRegistryKey) ?? const <String>[];
    for (final entry in raw) {
      try {
        final decoded = jsonDecode(entry);
        if (decoded is! Map) continue;
        final installed = InstalledLanguagePack.fromJson(
          decoded.cast<String, dynamic>(),
        );
        _installed[installed.id] = installed;
      } on Object {
        // Corrupt local registration is ignored rather than trusted.
      }
    }
    final active = _prefs.readText(activePackKey);
    _activePackId =
        active != null && _installed.containsKey(active) ? active : null;
  }

  Future<void> _persistInstalledRegistry() async {
    final rows = _installed.values
        .map((pack) => jsonEncode(pack.toJson()))
        .toList(growable: false);
    if (!await _prefs.writeTextList(installedRegistryKey, rows)) {
      throw StateError('Installed pack registry could not be persisted.');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _persistActivePack(String packId) async {
    if (!await _prefs.writeText(activePackKey, packId)) {
      throw StateError('Active pack registration could not be persisted.');
    }
    _activePackId = packId;
  }

  Future<void> _replaceAtomically(
    Directory staging,
    Directory destination,
  ) async {
    await destination.parent.create(recursive: true);
    final backup = Directory('${destination.path}.backup');
    if (await backup.exists()) {
      await backup.delete(recursive: true);
    }

    var movedExisting = false;
    if (await destination.exists()) {
      await destination.rename(backup.path);
      movedExisting = true;
    }

    try {
      await staging.rename(destination.path);
      if (movedExisting && await backup.exists()) {
        await backup.delete(recursive: true);
      }
    } on Object {
      if (await destination.exists()) {
        await destination.delete(recursive: true);
      }
      if (movedExisting && await backup.exists()) {
        await backup.rename(destination.path);
      }
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<int> _directorySize(Directory directory) async {
    if (!await directory.exists()) return 0;
    var total = 0;
    await for (final entity in directory.list(recursive: true)) {
      if (entity is File) {
        total += await entity.length();
      }
    }
    return total;
  }

  _ManifestAcceptance _readManifestAcceptance() {
    final raw = _prefs.readText(manifestAcceptanceKey);
    if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty) return const _ManifestAcceptance.empty();
    try {
      final decoded = jsonDecode(raw);
      if (decoded is! Map) {
        throw StateError('Manifest acceptance state is corrupt.');
      }
      final map = decoded.cast<String, dynamic>();
      final revision = (map['revision'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
      final signature = (map['signature'] ?? '').toString();
      final keyId = (map['keyId'] ?? '').toString();
      if (revision <= 0 || signature.isEmpty || keyId.isEmpty) {
        throw StateError('Manifest acceptance state is corrupt.');
      }
      return _ManifestAcceptance(
        revision: revision,
        signature: signature,
        keyId: keyId,
      );
    } on StateError {
      rethrow;
    } on Object {
      throw StateError('Manifest acceptance state is corrupt.');
    }
  }

  void _assertDescriptorAdmitted(LanguagePackDescriptor descriptor) {
    final admitted = _manifest.packById(descriptor.id);
    if (admitted == null || !admitted.sameAs(descriptor)) {
      throw const PackIntegrityException(
        'Pack descriptor is not admitted by the verified manifest.',
      );
    }
  }

  void _setOperation(String packId, PackOperationState state) {
    _operations[packId] = state;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void _assertNotBusy(String packId) {
    if (operationFor(packId).isBusy) {
      throw StateError('Pack operation already in progress: $packId');
    }
  }

  static void _assertPackId(String packId) {
    if (!RegExp(r'^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{1,63}$').hasMatch(packId)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(packId, 'packId', 'Invalid pack id.');
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    final downloader = _downloader;
    if (downloader is HttpPackDownloader) {
      downloader.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:cryptography/cryptography.dart';

final class LanguagePackDescriptor {
  const LanguagePackDescriptor({
    required this.id,
    required this.languageCode,
    required this.displayName,
    required this.version,
    required this.contractVersion,
    required this.bundleFormat,
    required this.archiveUrl,
    required this.sha256,
    required this.contentSha256,
    required this.archiveSizeBytes,
    required this.installedSizeBytes,
  });

  static const int maxArchiveSizeBytes = 64 * 1024 * 1024;
  static const int maxInstalledSizeBytes = 96 * 1024 * 1024;

  final String id;
  final String languageCode;
  final String displayName;
  final String version;
  final String contractVersion;
  final String bundleFormat;
  final Uri archiveUrl;
  final String sha256;
  final String contentSha256;
  final int archiveSizeBytes;
  final int installedSizeBytes;

  factory LanguagePackDescriptor.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    _rejectUnknownKeys(
        json,
        const <String>{
          'id',
          'languageCode',
          'displayName',
          'version',
          'contractVersion',
          'bundleFormat',
          'archiveUrl',
          'sha256',
          'contentSha256',
          'archiveSizeBytes',
          'installedSizeBytes',
        },
        'pack descriptor');
    final id = _requiredString(json, 'id');
    if (!RegExp(r'^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{1,63}$').hasMatch(id)) {
      throw const FormatException('Invalid pack id.');
    }
    final languageCode = _requiredString(json, 'languageCode');
    if (!RegExp(r'^[A-Za-z]{2,8}(?:-[A-Za-z0-9]{1,8})*$')
        .hasMatch(languageCode)) {
      throw const FormatException('Invalid language code.');
    }
    final archiveUrl = Uri.tryParse(_requiredString(json, 'archiveUrl'));
    if (archiveUrl == null ||
        archiveUrl.scheme != 'https' ||
        archiveUrl.host.isEmpty) {
      throw const FormatException('Pack archiveUrl must use HTTPS.');
    }
    final bundleFormat = _requiredString(json, 'bundleFormat');
    if (bundleFormat != 'json-gzip-v1') {
      throw const FormatException('Unsupported pack bundle format.');
    }
    final checksum = _requiredSha256(json, 'sha256');
    final contentChecksum = _requiredSha256(json, 'contentSha256');
    final archiveSize = _requiredPositiveInt(json, 'archiveSizeBytes');
    final installedSize = _requiredPositiveInt(json, 'installedSizeBytes');
    if (archiveSize > maxArchiveSizeBytes) {
      throw const FormatException('Pack archive exceeds mobile safety limit.');
    }
    if (installedSize > maxInstalledSizeBytes) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Installed pack exceeds mobile safety limit.',
      );
    }
    return LanguagePackDescriptor(
      id: id,
      languageCode: languageCode,
      displayName: _requiredString(json, 'displayName'),
      version: _requiredString(json, 'version'),
      contractVersion: _requiredString(json, 'contractVersion'),
      bundleFormat: bundleFormat,
      archiveUrl: archiveUrl,
      sha256: checksum,
      contentSha256: contentChecksum,
      archiveSizeBytes: archiveSize,
      installedSizeBytes: installedSize,
    );
  }

  Map<String, Object> toJson() => <String, Object>{
        'id': id,
        'languageCode': languageCode,
        'displayName': displayName,
        'version': version,
        'contractVersion': contractVersion,
        'bundleFormat': bundleFormat,
        'archiveUrl': archiveUrl.toString(),
        'sha256': sha256,
        'contentSha256': contentSha256,
        'archiveSizeBytes': archiveSizeBytes,
        'installedSizeBytes': installedSizeBytes,
      };

  bool sameAs(LanguagePackDescriptor other) =>
      id == other.id &&
      languageCode == other.languageCode &&
      displayName == other.displayName &&
      version == other.version &&
      contractVersion == other.contractVersion &&
      bundleFormat == other.bundleFormat &&
      archiveUrl == other.archiveUrl &&
      sha256 == other.sha256 &&
      contentSha256 == other.contentSha256 &&
      archiveSizeBytes == other.archiveSizeBytes &&
      installedSizeBytes == other.installedSizeBytes;
}

final class PackManifest {
  const PackManifest({
    required this.schemaVersion,
    required this.manifestRevision,
    required this.algorithm,
    required this.keyId,
    required this.signature,
    required this.packs,
  });

  static const int supportedSchemaVersion = 2;
  static const String supportedAlgorithm = 'Ed25519';

  final int schemaVersion;
  final int manifestRevision;
  final String algorithm;
  final String keyId;
  final String signature;
  final List<LanguagePackDescriptor> packs;

  static PackManifest empty() => const PackManifest(
        schemaVersion: supportedSchemaVersion,
        manifestRevision: 0,
        algorithm: supportedAlgorithm,
        keyId: '',
        signature: '',
        packs: <LanguagePackDescriptor>[],
      );

  factory PackManifest.parse(String rawJson) {
    final decoded = jsonDecode(rawJson);
    if (decoded is! Map) {
      throw const FormatException('Pack manifest must be a JSON object.');
    }
    final json = decoded.cast<String, dynamic>();
    _rejectUnknownKeys(
        json,
        const <String>{
          'schemaVersion',
          'manifestRevision',
          'algorithm',
          'keyId',
          'packs',
          'signature',
        },
        'manifest');
    final schemaVersion = _requiredPositiveInt(json, 'schemaVersion');
    if (schemaVersion != supportedSchemaVersion) {
      throw FormatException(
        'Unsupported manifest schema version: ' + schemaVersion.toString(),
      );
    }
    final algorithm = _requiredString(json, 'algorithm');
    if (algorithm != supportedAlgorithm) {
      throw const FormatException('Unsupported manifest signature algorithm.');
    }
    final keyId = _requiredString(json, 'keyId');
    if (!RegExp(r'^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}$').hasMatch(keyId)) {
      throw const FormatException('Invalid manifest key id.');
    }
    final signature = _requiredString(json, 'signature');
    late final List<int> signatureBytes;
    try {
      signatureBytes = base64Decode(signature);
    } on Object {
      throw const FormatException('Manifest signature is not valid base64.');
    }
    if (signatureBytes.length != 64) {
      throw const FormatException('Ed25519 signature must be 64 bytes.');
    }
    final rawPacks = json['packs'];
    if (rawPacks is! List) {
      throw const FormatException('Manifest packs must be a list.');
    }
    final seen = <String>{};
    final packs = <LanguagePackDescriptor>[];
    for (final rawPack in rawPacks) {
      if (rawPack is! Map) {
        throw const FormatException('Invalid pack manifest entry.');
      }
      final descriptor = LanguagePackDescriptor.fromJson(
        rawPack.cast<String, dynamic>(),
      );
      if (!seen.add(descriptor.id)) {
        throw FormatException('Duplicate pack id: ' + descriptor.id);
      }
      packs.add(descriptor);
    }
    return PackManifest(
      schemaVersion: schemaVersion,
      manifestRevision: _requiredPositiveInt(json, 'manifestRevision'),
      algorithm: algorithm,
      keyId: keyId,
      signature: signature,
      packs: List<LanguagePackDescriptor>.unmodifiable(packs),
    );
  }

  LanguagePackDescriptor? packById(String packId) {
    for (final pack in packs) {
      if (pack.id == packId) return pack;
    }
    return null;
  }
}

final class InstalledLanguagePack {
  const InstalledLanguagePack({
    required this.id,
    required this.languageCode,
    required this.displayName,
    required this.version,
    required this.contractVersion,
    required this.sha256,
    required this.contentSha256,
    required this.storageBytes,
    required this.installedAt,
    required this.manifestRevision,
    required this.manifestKeyId,
    required this.manifestSignature,
    required this.databaseEncrypted,
  });

  final String id;
  final String languageCode;
  final String displayName;
  final String version;
  final String contractVersion;
  final String sha256;
  final String contentSha256;
  final int storageBytes;
  final DateTime installedAt;
  final int manifestRevision;
  final String manifestKeyId;
  final String manifestSignature;
  final bool databaseEncrypted;

  bool get hasSignedProvenance =>
      manifestRevision > 0 &&
      manifestKeyId.isNotEmpty &&
      RegExp(r'^[a-f0-9]{64}$').hasMatch(contentSha256) &&
      _validSignature(manifestSignature);

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => <String, dynamic>{
        'id': id,
        'languageCode': languageCode,
        'displayName': displayName,
        'version': version,
        'contractVersion': contractVersion,
        'sha256': sha256,
        'contentSha256': contentSha256,
        'storageBytes': storageBytes,
        'installedAt': installedAt.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
        'manifestRevision': manifestRevision,
        'manifestKeyId': manifestKeyId,
        'manifestSignature': manifestSignature,
        'databaseEncrypted': databaseEncrypted,
      };

  factory InstalledLanguagePack.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    final id = (json['id'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    if (!RegExp(r'^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{1,63}$').hasMatch(id)) {
      throw const FormatException('Invalid installed pack id.');
    }
    final installedAt = DateTime.tryParse(
      (json['installedAt'] ?? '').toString(),
    );
    if (installedAt == null) {
      throw const FormatException('Invalid installedAt timestamp.');
    }
    return InstalledLanguagePack(
      id: id,
      languageCode: (json['languageCode'] ?? '').toString(),
      displayName: (json['displayName'] ?? '').toString(),
      version: (json['version'] ?? '').toString(),
      contractVersion: (json['contractVersion'] ?? '').toString(),
      sha256: (json['sha256'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase(),
      contentSha256: (json['contentSha256'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase(),
      storageBytes: ((json['storageBytes'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0)
          .clamp(0, 1 << 50)
          .toInt(),
      installedAt: installedAt.toUtc(),
      manifestRevision:
          ((json['manifestRevision'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0).clamp(0, 1 << 31),
      manifestKeyId: (json['manifestKeyId'] ?? '').toString(),
      manifestSignature: (json['manifestSignature'] ?? '').toString(),
      databaseEncrypted: json['databaseEncrypted'] == true,
    );
  }

  InstalledLanguagePack copyWith({int? storageBytes}) => InstalledLanguagePack(
        id: id,
        languageCode: languageCode,
        displayName: displayName,
        version: version,
        contractVersion: contractVersion,
        sha256: sha256,
        contentSha256: contentSha256,
        storageBytes: storageBytes ?? this.storageBytes,
        installedAt: installedAt,
        manifestRevision: manifestRevision,
        manifestKeyId: manifestKeyId,
        manifestSignature: manifestSignature,
        databaseEncrypted: databaseEncrypted,
      );
}

abstract interface class PackManifestVerifier {
  Future<PackManifest> verifyAndParse(String rawJson);
}

final class RejectingPackManifestVerifier implements PackManifestVerifier {
  const RejectingPackManifestVerifier();

  @override
  Future<PackManifest> verifyAndParse(String rawJson) {
    throw const PackManifestAuthenticityException(
      'No trusted manifest public key is configured.',
    );
  }
}

final class Ed25519PackManifestVerifier implements PackManifestVerifier {
  Ed25519PackManifestVerifier({
    required Map<String, List<int>> trustedPublicKeys,
  }) : _trustedPublicKeys = Map<String, List<int>>.unmodifiable(
          trustedPublicKeys.map(
            (key, value) => MapEntry(key, List<int>.unmodifiable(value)),
          ),
        );

  final Map<String, List<int>> _trustedPublicKeys;
  final Ed25519 _algorithm = Ed25519();

  @override
  Future<PackManifest> verifyAndParse(String rawJson) async {
    final manifest = PackManifest.parse(rawJson);
    final publicKeyBytes = _trustedPublicKeys[manifest.keyId];
    if (publicKeyBytes == null || publicKeyBytes.length != 32) {
      throw const PackManifestAuthenticityException(
        'Manifest key id is not trusted.',
      );
    }
    final signatureBytes = base64Decode(manifest.signature);
    final payload = PackManifestCanonicalJson.signingBytes(rawJson);
    final valid = await _algorithm.verify(
      payload,
      signature: Signature(
        signatureBytes,
        publicKey: SimplePublicKey(publicKeyBytes, type: KeyPairType.ed25519),
      ),
    );
    if (!valid) {
      throw const PackManifestAuthenticityException(
        'Manifest Ed25519 signature verification failed.',
      );
    }
    return manifest;
  }
}

abstract final class PackManifestVerifiers {
  static PackManifestVerifier fromSingleBase64Key({
    required String keyId,
    required String publicKeyBase64,
  }) {
    if (keyId.trim().isEmpty || publicKeyBase64.trim().isEmpty) {
      return const RejectingPackManifestVerifier();
    }
    try {
      final bytes = base64Decode(publicKeyBase64.trim());
      if (bytes.length != 32) {
        return const RejectingPackManifestVerifier();
      }
      return Ed25519PackManifestVerifier(
        trustedPublicKeys: <String, List<int>>{keyId.trim(): bytes},
      );
    } on Object {
      return const RejectingPackManifestVerifier();
    }
  }
}

final class PackManifestAuthenticityException implements Exception {
  const PackManifestAuthenticityException(this.message);
  final String message;

  @override
  String toString() => 'PackManifestAuthenticityException: ' + message;
}

abstract final class PackManifestCanonicalJson {
  static List<int> signingBytes(String rawJson) {
    final decoded = jsonDecode(rawJson);
    if (decoded is! Map) {
      throw const FormatException('Manifest must be an object.');
    }
    final unsigned = Map<String, dynamic>.from(decoded.cast<String, dynamic>())
      ..remove('signature');
    return utf8.encode(_encode(unsigned) + '\n');
  }

  static String _encode(Object? value) {
    if (value is Map) {
      final keys = value.keys.map((key) => key.toString()).toList()..sort();
      final parts = <String>[];
      for (final key in keys) {
        parts.add(jsonEncode(key) + ':' + _encode(value[key]));
      }
      return '{' + parts.join(',') + '}';
    }
    if (value is List) {
      return '[' + value.map(_encode).join(',') + ']';
    }
    return jsonEncode(value);
  }
}

bool _validSignature(String encoded) {
  try {
    return base64Decode(encoded).length == 64;
  } on Object {
    return false;
  }
}

void _rejectUnknownKeys(
  Map<String, dynamic> json,
  Set<String> allowed,
  String path,
) {
  final unknown = json.keys.where((key) => !allowed.contains(key)).toList();
  if (unknown.isNotEmpty) {
    throw FormatException(path + ' contains unknown keys.');
  }
}

String _requiredString(Map<String, dynamic> json, String key) {
  final value = (json[key] ?? '').toString().trim();
  if (value.isEmpty || value.length > 500) {
    throw FormatException('Invalid ' + key + '.');
  }
  return value;
}

String _requiredSha256(Map<String, dynamic> json, String key) {
  final value = _requiredString(json, key).toLowerCase();
  if (!RegExp(r'^[a-f0-9]{64}$').hasMatch(value)) {
    throw FormatException('Invalid ' + key + '.');
  }
  return value;
}

int _requiredPositiveInt(Map<String, dynamic> json, String key) {
  final value = (json[key] as num?)?.toInt();
  if (value == null || value <= 0) {
    throw FormatException('Invalid ' + key + '.');
  }
  return value;
}

import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:path/path.dart' as p;
import 'package:sqflite/sqflite.dart';

import '../core/srs_facets.dart';
import '../models/learner.dart';
import 'database_migration_helper.dart';
import 'spaced_repetition_service.dart';

class ProgressTrackerService {
  static const String _tableNameCompletedLessons = 'completed_lessons';
  static const String _tableNameStreaks = 'daily_streaks';
  static const String _tableNameReviewScores = 'review_scores';
  static const String _tableNameSpacedRepetition = 'spaced_repetition';

  static final ProgressTrackerService instance = ProgressTrackerService._init();
  Database? _database;
  DatabaseFactory? _factory;

  ProgressTrackerService._init();

  factory ProgressTrackerService.withFactory(DatabaseFactory factory) {
    final service = ProgressTrackerService._init();
    service._factory = factory;
    return service;
  }

  Future<Database> get database async {
    if (_database != null) return _database!;
    _database = await _initDB('progress_tracker.db');
    return _database!;
  }

  Future<Database> _initDB(String filePath) async {
    final path = _factory != null
        ? filePath
        : p.join(await getDatabasesPath(), filePath);

    return DatabaseMigrationHelper.open(
      path: path,
      version: 3,
      onCreate: _createDB,
      migrationScripts: <int, List<String>>{
        2: <String>[
          '''
          CREATE TABLE $_tableNameSpacedRepetition (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            ef REAL NOT NULL,
            repetitions INTEGER NOT NULL,
            intervalDays INTEGER NOT NULL,
            nextReviewAt TEXT NOT NULL
          )
          ''',
        ],
        3: <String>[
          "ALTER TABLE $_tableNameSpacedRepetition "
              "ADD COLUMN conceptId TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''",
          "ALTER TABLE $_tableNameSpacedRepetition "
              "ADD COLUMN facetType TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'meaning_recall'",
          "ALTER TABLE $_tableNameSpacedRepetition "
              "ADD COLUMN variantKey TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''",
          "ALTER TABLE $_tableNameSpacedRepetition "
              "ADD COLUMN lapses INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0",
          "ALTER TABLE $_tableNameSpacedRepetition "
              "ADD COLUMN successes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0",
          "ALTER TABLE $_tableNameSpacedRepetition "
              "ADD COLUMN failures INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0",
          "ALTER TABLE $_tableNameSpacedRepetition "
              "ADD COLUMN difficulty REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.3",
          "ALTER TABLE $_tableNameSpacedRepetition "
              "ADD COLUMN stabilityDays REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0",
          "ALTER TABLE $_tableNameSpacedRepetition "
              "ADD COLUMN lastReviewedAt TEXT",
          "UPDATE $_tableNameSpacedRepetition SET conceptId = id "
              "WHERE conceptId = ''",
          "UPDATE $_tableNameSpacedRepetition SET successes = repetitions "
              "WHERE successes = 0 AND repetitions > 0",
          "UPDATE $_tableNameSpacedRepetition SET stabilityDays = intervalDays "
              "WHERE stabilityDays = 0 AND intervalDays > 0",
          "CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_spaced_repetition_facet "
              "ON $_tableNameSpacedRepetition(conceptId, facetType, variantKey)",
        ],
      },
      factory: _factory,
    );
  }

  Future<void> _createDB(Database db, int version) async {
    await db.execute('''
      CREATE TABLE $_tableNameCompletedLessons (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        completedAt TEXT NOT NULL
      )
    ''');
    await db.execute('''
      CREATE TABLE $_tableNameStreaks (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        date TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        count INTEGER NOT NULL
      )
    ''');
    await db.execute('''
      CREATE TABLE $_tableNameReviewScores (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        lessonId TEXT NOT NULL,
        score REAL NOT NULL,
        reviewedAt TEXT NOT NULL
      )
    ''');
    await db.execute('''
      CREATE TABLE $_tableNameSpacedRepetition (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        conceptId TEXT NOT NULL,
        facetType TEXT NOT NULL,
        variantKey TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        ef REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 2.5,
        repetitions INTEGER NOT NULL,
        intervalDays INTEGER NOT NULL,
        lapses INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        successes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        failures INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        difficulty REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.3,
        stabilityDays REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        nextReviewAt TEXT NOT NULL,
        lastReviewedAt TEXT
      )
    ''');
    await db.execute(
      'CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_spaced_repetition_facet '
      'ON $_tableNameSpacedRepetition(conceptId, facetType, variantKey)',
    );
  }

  Future<void> markLessonCompleted(String lessonId) async {
    final db = await database;
    await DatabaseMigrationHelper.executeAtomic(db, (txn) async {
      await txn.insert(
          _tableNameCompletedLessons,
          <String, Object>{
            'id': lessonId,
            'completedAt': DateTime.now().toUtc().toIso8601String(),
          },
          conflictAlgorithm: ConflictAlgorithm.replace);
    });
  }

  Future<void> updateStreak(String date, int count) async {
    final db = await database;
    await DatabaseMigrationHelper.executeAtomic(db, (txn) async {
      await txn.insert(
          _tableNameStreaks,
          <String, Object>{
            'date': date,
            'count': count,
          },
          conflictAlgorithm: ConflictAlgorithm.replace);
    });
  }

  Future<void> updateReviewScore(String lessonId, double score) async {
    final db = await database;
    await DatabaseMigrationHelper.executeAtomic(db, (txn) async {
      await txn.insert(
          _tableNameReviewScores,
          <String, Object>{
            'lessonId': lessonId,
            'score': score,
            'reviewedAt': DateTime.now().toUtc().toIso8601String(),
          },
          conflictAlgorithm: ConflictAlgorithm.replace);
    });
  }

  Future<ReviewCard?> getFacetReviewCard({
    required String conceptId,
    ReviewFacetType facetType = ReviewFacetType.meaningRecall,
    String? variantKey,
  }) async {
    final key = ReviewFacetKey(
      conceptId: conceptId,
      facetType: facetType,
      variantKey: variantKey,
    );
    if (!key.isValid) return null;
    final db = await database;
    final rows = await db.query(
      _tableNameSpacedRepetition,
      where: 'conceptId = ? AND facetType = ? AND variantKey = ?',
      whereArgs: <Object?>[
        key.conceptId.trim(),
        key.facetType.wireName,
        key.normalizedVariantKey ?? '',
      ],
      limit: 1,
    );
    if (rows.isEmpty) return null;
    return _reviewCardFromRow(rows.first);
  }

  Future<SpacedRepetitionItem?> getSpacedRepetitionItem(String id) async {
    final key = ReviewFacetKey(conceptId: id);
    if (!key.isValid) return null;
    final db = await database;
    final rows = await db.query(
      _tableNameSpacedRepetition,
      where: 'conceptId = ? AND facetType = ? AND variantKey = ?',
      whereArgs: <Object?>[
        key.conceptId.trim(),
        ReviewFacetType.meaningRecall.wireName,
        '',
      ],
      limit: 1,
    );
    if (rows.isEmpty) return null;
    final row = rows.first;
    return SpacedRepetitionItem(
      id: key.conceptId.trim(),
      ef: (row['ef'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 2.5,
      repetitions: (row['repetitions'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
      intervalDays: (row['intervalDays'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
      nextReviewAt:
          DateTime.tryParse(row['nextReviewAt']?.toString() ?? '')?.toUtc() ??
              DateTime.now().toUtc(),
    );
  }

  Future<void> processFacetReview({
    required String conceptId,
    required ReviewFacetType facetType,
    String? variantKey,
    required bool correct,
    required bool hinted,
    DateTime? at,
  }) async {
    final key = ReviewFacetKey(
      conceptId: conceptId,
      facetType: facetType,
      variantKey: variantKey,
    );
    if (!key.isValid) {
      throw ArgumentError('Invalid facet review key.');
    }
    throw StateError(
      'legacy_srs_store_retired_use_pair_progress',
    );
  }

  Future<void> processSpacedRepetitionReview({
    required String itemId,
    required int quality,
  }) async {
    if (quality < 0 || quality > 5) {
      throw ArgumentError('Quality must be between 0 and 5.');
    }
    throw StateError(
      'legacy_srs_store_retired_use_pair_progress',
    );
  }

  Future<String> exportProgressState() async {
    final db = await database;
    final state = <String, Object?>{
      'completed_lessons': await db.query(_tableNameCompletedLessons),
      'daily_streaks': await db.query(_tableNameStreaks),
      'review_scores': await db.query(_tableNameReviewScores),
      'spaced_repetition': await db.query(_tableNameSpacedRepetition),
    };
    return jsonEncode(state);
  }

  Future<void> importProgressState(String jsonState) async {
    final decoded = jsonDecode(jsonState);
    if (decoded is! Map) {
      throw const FormatException('progress_state_invalid');
    }
    final state = Map<String, dynamic>.from(decoded);
    final db = await database;

    await DatabaseMigrationHelper.executeAtomic(db, (txn) async {
      await txn.delete(_tableNameCompletedLessons);
      await txn.delete(_tableNameStreaks);
      await txn.delete(_tableNameReviewScores);
      await txn.delete(_tableNameSpacedRepetition);

      await _restoreRows(
        txn,
        _tableNameCompletedLessons,
        state['completed_lessons'],
      );
      await _restoreRows(txn, _tableNameStreaks, state['daily_streaks']);
      await _restoreRows(txn, _tableNameReviewScores, state['review_scores']);

      final spaced = state['spaced_repetition'];
      if (spaced is List) {
        for (final raw in spaced.take(20000)) {
          if (raw is! Map) continue;
          final normalized = _normalizeImportedSrsRow(
            Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw),
          );
          if (normalized == null) continue;
          await txn.insert(
            _tableNameSpacedRepetition,
            normalized,
            conflictAlgorithm: ConflictAlgorithm.replace,
          );
        }
      }
    });
  }

  Future<void> _restoreRows(
    Transaction txn,
    String table,
    Object? rawRows,
  ) async {
    if (rawRows is! List) return;
    for (final raw in rawRows.take(20000)) {
      if (raw is! Map) continue;
      await txn.insert(table, Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw));
    }
  }

  Map<String, Object?>? _normalizeImportedSrsRow(Map<String, dynamic> row) {
    final conceptId = (row['conceptId'] ?? row['id'])?.toString().trim() ?? '';
    final facetType = ReviewFacetType.fromWire(row['facetType']?.toString());
    final variantKey = ReviewFacetKey.normalizeVariant(
      row['variantKey']?.toString(),
    );
    final key = ReviewFacetKey(
      conceptId: conceptId,
      facetType: facetType,
      variantKey: variantKey,
    );
    if (!key.isValid) return null;

    final card = ReviewCard.fromJson(<String, dynamic>{
      'itemId': conceptId,
      'facetType': facetType.wireName,
      if (variantKey != null) 'variantKey': variantKey,
      'repetitions': row['repetitions'],
      'intervalDays': row['intervalDays'],
      'lapses': row['lapses'],
      'successes': row['successes'] ?? row['repetitions'],
      'failures': row['failures'],
      'difficulty': row['difficulty'],
      'stabilityDays': row['stabilityDays'] ?? row['intervalDays'],
      'dueAt': row['nextReviewAt'],
      'lastReviewedAt': row['lastReviewedAt'],
    });
    return _rowForCard(
      card,
      legacyEase: (row['ef'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 2.5,
    );
  }

  Map<String, Object?> _rowForCard(
    ReviewCard card, {
    double legacyEase = 2.5,
  }) =>
      <String, Object?>{
        'id': card.storageKey,
        'conceptId': card.itemId,
        'facetType': card.facetType.wireName,
        'variantKey': card.facetKey.normalizedVariantKey ?? '',
        'ef': legacyEase.clamp(1.3, 5.0),
        'repetitions': card.repetitions,
        'intervalDays': card.intervalDays,
        'lapses': card.lapses,
        'successes': card.successes,
        'failures': card.failures,
        'difficulty': card.difficulty,
        'stabilityDays': card.stabilityDays,
        'nextReviewAt': card.dueAt.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
        'lastReviewedAt': card.lastReviewedAt?.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
      };

  ReviewCard _reviewCardFromRow(Map<String, Object?> row) =>
      ReviewCard.fromJson(<String, dynamic>{
        'itemId': row['conceptId'] ?? row['id'],
        'facetType': row['facetType'],
        'variantKey': row['variantKey'],
        'repetitions': row['repetitions'],
        'intervalDays': row['intervalDays'],
        'lapses': row['lapses'],
        'successes': row['successes'],
        'failures': row['failures'],
        'difficulty': row['difficulty'],
        'stabilityDays': row['stabilityDays'],
        'dueAt': row['nextReviewAt'],
        'lastReviewedAt': row['lastReviewedAt'],
      });

  Future<void> close() async {
    final db = _database;
    if (db != null) {
      await db.close();
      _database = null;
    }
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

/// Release-safe crash reporting boundary.
///
/// Phase 17 intentionally ships with a no-op implementation. A future
/// first-party/approved reporter can implement this contract without changing
/// global Flutter error handling or exposing exception details to release logs.
abstract interface class RuntimeFailureReporter {
  void recordFlutterError(FlutterErrorDetails details);

  void record(
    Object error,
    StackTrace stackTrace, {
    required bool fatal,
    required String context,
  });
}

final class NoopRuntimeFailureReporter implements RuntimeFailureReporter {
  const NoopRuntimeFailureReporter();

  @override
  void recordFlutterError(FlutterErrorDetails details) {}

  @override
  void record(
    Object error,
    StackTrace stackTrace, {
    required bool fatal,
    required String context,
  }) {}
}

class SpacedRepetitionItem {
  final String id;
  final double ef;
  final int repetitions;
  final int intervalDays;
  final DateTime nextReviewAt;

  const SpacedRepetitionItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.ef,
    required this.repetitions,
    required this.intervalDays,
    required this.nextReviewAt,
  });

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() {
    return {
      'id': id,
      'ef': ef,
      'repetitions': repetitions,
      'intervalDays': intervalDays,
      'nextReviewAt': nextReviewAt.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
    };
  }

  factory SpacedRepetitionItem.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    return SpacedRepetitionItem(
      id: map['id'] as String,
      ef: map['ef'] as double,
      repetitions: map['repetitions'] as int,
      intervalDays: map['intervalDays'] as int,
      nextReviewAt: DateTime.parse(map['nextReviewAt'] as String).toUtc(),
    );
  }
}

class SpacedRepetitionService {
  /// Calculates the next review parameters using the SuperMemo-2 (SM-2) algorithm.
  ///
  /// [item] The current SpacedRepetitionItem, or null if this is the first review.
  /// [itemId] The ID of the item being reviewed.
  /// [quality] User rating from 0 to 5.
  ///   0 - Complete blackout.
  ///   1 - Incorrect response; the correct one remembered.
  ///   2 - Incorrect response; where the correct one seemed easy to recall.
  ///   3 - Correct response recalled with serious difficulty.
  ///   4 - Correct response after a hesitation.
  ///   5 - Perfect response.
  static SpacedRepetitionItem calculateNextReview({
    SpacedRepetitionItem? item,
    required String itemId,
    required int quality,
  }) {
    if (quality < 0 || quality > 5) {
      throw ArgumentError('Quality must be between 0 and 5.');
    }

    int repetitions = item?.repetitions ?? 0;
    double ef = item?.ef ?? 2.5;
    int intervalDays = item?.intervalDays ?? 0;

    if (quality >= 3) {
      if (repetitions == 0) {
        intervalDays = 1;
      } else if (repetitions == 1) {
        intervalDays = 6;
      } else {
        intervalDays = (intervalDays * ef).round();
      }
      repetitions++;
    } else {
      repetitions = 0;
      intervalDays = 1;
    }

    ef = ef + (0.1 - (5 - quality) * (0.08 + (5 - quality) * 0.02));
    if (ef < 1.3) {
      ef = 1.3;
    }

    final nextReviewAt = DateTime.now().toUtc().add(
          Duration(days: intervalDays),
        );

    return SpacedRepetitionItem(
      id: itemId,
      ef: ef,
      repetitions: repetitions,
      intervalDays: intervalDays,
      nextReviewAt: nextReviewAt,
    );
  }
}

FILE: lib/services/sqlite_policy.dart

import 'package:path/path.dart' as p;
import 'package:sqflite/sqflite.dart' as sqflite;
import 'package:sqflite_common/sqlite_api.dart';

/// Single policy boundary for ordinary application SQLite databases.
///
/// Active content packs are intentionally excluded: Phase 7 routes those
/// encrypted databases through PackDatabaseOpener/SQLCipher.
final class AppSqlitePolicy {
  const AppSqlitePolicy({this.factory});

  static const int busyTimeoutMilliseconds = 5000;

  final DatabaseFactory? factory;

  Future<String> resolvePath({
    required String fileName,
    String? overridePath,
  }) async {
    final explicit = overridePath?.trim();
    if (explicit != null && explicit.isNotEmpty) {
      return explicit;
    }
    if (p.basename(fileName) != fileName || fileName.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw const SqlitePolicyException('invalid_database_file_name');
    }
    if (factory != null) {
      return fileName;
    }
    final root = await sqflite.getDatabasesPath();
    return p.join(root, fileName);
  }

  Future<Database> openWritable({
    required String path,
    required int version,
    OnDatabaseCreateFn? onCreate,
    OnDatabaseVersionChangeFn? onUpgrade,
    OnDatabaseVersionChangeFn? onDowngrade,
    OnDatabaseOpenFn? onOpen,
    OnDatabaseConfigureFn? onConfigure,
    bool foreignKeys = true,
  }) async {
    if (path.trim().isEmpty || version <= 0) {
      throw const SqlitePolicyException('invalid_database_open_request');
    }

    final options = OpenDatabaseOptions(
      version: version,
      onConfigure: (database) async {
        await _configureConnection(database, foreignKeys: foreignKeys);
        if (onConfigure != null) {
          await onConfigure(database);
        }
      },
      onCreate: onCreate,
      onUpgrade: onUpgrade,
      onDowngrade: onDowngrade,
      onOpen: onOpen,
    );

    return (factory ?? sqflite.databaseFactory).openDatabase(
      path,
      options: options,
    );
  }

  Future<Database> openReadOnly({
    required String path,
    OnDatabaseOpenFn? onOpen,
  }) async {
    if (path.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw const SqlitePolicyException('invalid_database_open_request');
    }
    return (factory ?? sqflite.databaseFactory).openDatabase(
      path,
      options: OpenDatabaseOptions(
        readOnly: true,
        singleInstance: false,
        onOpen: onOpen,
      ),
    );
  }

  static Future<void> _configureConnection(
    Database database, {
    required bool foreignKeys,
  }) async {
    await database.execute(
      'PRAGMA foreign_keys = ' + (foreignKeys ? 'ON' : 'OFF'),
    );
    await database.execute(
      'PRAGMA busy_timeout = ' + busyTimeoutMilliseconds.toString(),
    );

    final foreignKeyRows = await database.rawQuery('PRAGMA foreign_keys');
    final foreignKeyValue =
        foreignKeyRows.isEmpty ? null : foreignKeyRows.first.values.first;
    final expected = foreignKeys ? 1 : 0;
    if (foreignKeyValue != expected) {
      throw const SqlitePolicyException('foreign_key_policy_not_applied');
    }
  }
}

final class SqlitePolicyException implements Exception {
  const SqlitePolicyException(this.code);

  final String code;

  @override
  String toString() => 'SqlitePolicyException(' + code + ')';
}

FILE: lib/services/review_transaction_reconciler.dart

import '../core/progress/offline_pair_progress_engine.dart';
import '../core/progress/review_transaction_envelope.dart';
import '../features/gamification/domain/gamification_models.dart';
import '../features/gamification/gamification_repository.dart';
import '../models/learner.dart';
import 'learner_persistence.dart';

final class ReviewTransactionReconciler {
  const ReviewTransactionReconciler({
    required this.pairProgressEngine,
    required this.learnerPersistence,
    required this.gamificationRepository,
  });

  static const int maxBatchSize = 128;

  final OfflinePairProgressEngine pairProgressEngine;
  final LearnerPersistence learnerPersistence;
  final GamificationRepository gamificationRepository;

  Future<ReviewReconciliationReport> reconcilePendingReviewTransactions({
    int limit = maxBatchSize,
  }) async {
    final boundedLimit = limit.clamp(1, maxBatchSize).toInt();
    final pending = await pairProgressEngine.loadPendingReviewTransactions(
      limit: boundedLimit,
    );

    var attemptsAcknowledged = 0;
    var gamificationAcknowledged = 0;
    var completed = 0;

    for (final entry in pending) {
      if (!entry.attemptApplied) {
        await _reconcileAttempt(entry);
        await pairProgressEngine.acknowledgeReviewTransaction(
          reviewEventId: entry.envelope.reviewEventId,
          payloadHash: entry.payloadHash,
          sink: ReviewTransactionSink.attempt,
        );
        attemptsAcknowledged += 1;
      }

      if (!entry.gamificationApplied) {
        await _reconcileGamification(entry);
        await pairProgressEngine.acknowledgeReviewTransaction(
          reviewEventId: entry.envelope.reviewEventId,
          payloadHash: entry.payloadHash,
          sink: ReviewTransactionSink.gamification,
        );
        gamificationAcknowledged += 1;
      }

      completed += 1;
    }

    return ReviewReconciliationReport(
      inspected: pending.length,
      attemptsAcknowledged: attemptsAcknowledged,
      gamificationAcknowledged: gamificationAcknowledged,
      completed: completed,
    );
  }

  Future<ReviewReconciliationReport> reconcilePending({
    int limit = maxBatchSize,
  }) =>
      reconcilePendingReviewTransactions(limit: limit);

  Future<void> _reconcileAttempt(
    ReviewTransactionJournalEntry entry,
  ) async {
    final envelope = entry.envelope;
    await learnerPersistence.applyReviewAttemptOnce(
      reviewEventId: envelope.reviewEventId,
      attempt: Attempt(
        id: envelope.reviewEventId,
        itemId: envelope.conceptId,
        skill: envelope.skill,
        answer: envelope.answer,
        correct: envelope.correct,
        hinted: envelope.hinted,
        seconds: envelope.seconds,
        at: envelope.occurredAtUtc,
        facetType: envelope.facetType,
        variantKey: envelope.variantKey,
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _reconcileGamification(
    ReviewTransactionJournalEntry entry,
  ) async {
    final envelope = entry.envelope;
    await gamificationRepository.recordReview(
      GamificationReviewEvent(
        reviewId: envelope.reviewEventId,
        facetType: envelope.facetType,
        correct: envelope.correct,
        hinted: envelope.hinted,
        requestedXp: envelope.requestedXp,
        occurredAtUtc: envelope.occurredAtUtc,
        timezoneOffsetMinutes: envelope.timezoneOffsetMinutes,
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class ReviewReconciliationReport {
  const ReviewReconciliationReport({
    required this.inspected,
    required this.attemptsAcknowledged,
    required this.gamificationAcknowledged,
    required this.completed,
  });

  final int inspected;
  final int attemptsAcknowledged;
  final int gamificationAcknowledged;
  final int completed;
}
