FILE: lib/services/legacy_learner_snapshot_reader.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:cryptography/cryptography.dart';

import '../core/srs_facets.dart';
import '../core/storage/local_db/learner_state_database.dart';
import '../models/diagnostic_placement.dart';
import '../models/learner.dart';
import 'preferences_service.dart';

final class LegacyLearnerSnapshotReader {
  const LegacyLearnerSnapshotReader({
    required this.prefs,
    required this.storageKey,
    required this.legacyFavoriteKey,
  });

  final PreferencesService prefs;
  final String storageKey;
  final String legacyFavoriteKey;

  static const int maxPayloadBytes = 4 * 1024 * 1024;

  Future<LegacyLearnerMigrationSnapshot> readStrict() async {
    final rawPayload = prefs.getString(storageKey);
    final sourcePayload = rawPayload ?? '{}';
    if (utf8.encode(sourcePayload).length > maxPayloadBytes) {
      throw const LegacyLearnerSnapshotException(
        'legacy_payload_too_large',
      );
    }

    final decoded = _decodeTopLevel(sourcePayload);
    final attempts = _parseAttempts(decoded['attempts']);
    final assessments = _parseAssessments(decoded['assessmentHistory']);
    final placements = _parsePlacements(decoded['placementHistory']);
    final primaryFavorites = _parseFavoriteList(
      decoded['favoriteVerbs'],
      field: 'favoriteVerbs',
    );

    final rawLegacyFavorites =
        prefs.getStringList(legacyFavoriteKey) ?? const <String>[];
    if (rawLegacyFavorites.length > LearnerStateDatabase.maxFavorites) {
      throw const LegacyLearnerSnapshotException(
        'legacy_favorite_bound_exceeded',
      );
    }
    final legacyFavorites = <String>{};
    for (final raw in rawLegacyFavorites) {
      legacyFavorites.add(
        _strictIdentifier(raw, field: 'legacy_favorite_verb'),
      );
    }

    final mergedFavorites = <String>{
      ...primaryFavorites,
      ...legacyFavorites,
    };
    if (mergedFavorites.length > LearnerStateDatabase.maxFavorites) {
      throw const LegacyLearnerSnapshotException(
        'merged_favorite_bound_exceeded',
      );
    }

    final sqliteSnapshot = LearnerSqliteSnapshot(
      attempts: List<Attempt>.unmodifiable(attempts),
      assessmentHistory:
          List<AssessmentHistory>.unmodifiable(assessments),
      placementHistory:
          List<PlacementDiagnosticRecord>.unmodifiable(placements),
      favoriteVerbs: Set<String>.unmodifiable(mergedFavorites),
    );

    return LegacyLearnerMigrationSnapshot(
      sqliteSnapshot: sqliteSnapshot,
      sourcePayloadSha256: await _sha256Utf8(rawPayload ?? ''),
      sourceLegacyFavoritesSha256:
          await _sha256Utf8(jsonEncode(rawLegacyFavorites)),
      canonicalSnapshotSha256:
          await canonicalSnapshotSha256(sqliteSnapshot),
    );
  }

  static Future<String> canonicalSnapshotSha256(
    LearnerSqliteSnapshot snapshot,
  ) =>
      _sha256Utf8(canonicalSnapshotJson(snapshot));

  static String canonicalSnapshotJson(
    LearnerSqliteSnapshot snapshot,
  ) {
    final favorites = snapshot.favoriteVerbs.toList()..sort();

    return jsonEncode(<String, Object?>{
      'attempts': snapshot.attempts.map(_canonicalAttempt).toList(),
      'assessmentHistory':
          snapshot.assessmentHistory.map(_canonicalAssessment).toList(),
      'placementHistory':
          snapshot.placementHistory.map(_canonicalPlacement).toList(),
      'favoriteVerbs': favorites,
    });
  }

  static Map<String, Object?> _canonicalAttempt(Attempt value) =>
      <String, Object?>{
        'id': value.id,
        'itemId': value.itemId,
        'skill': value.skill,
        'answer': value.answer,
        'correct': value.correct,
        'hinted': value.hinted,
        'seconds': value.seconds,
        'at': value.at.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
        'facetType': value.facetType.wireName,
        'variantKey':
            ReviewFacetKey.normalizeVariant(value.variantKey) ?? '',
      };

  static Map<String, Object?> _canonicalAssessment(
    AssessmentHistory value,
  ) =>
      <String, Object?>{
        'id': value.id,
        'at': value.at.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
        'score': value.score,
        'weakSkills': List<String>.from(value.weakSkills),
        'answered': value.answered,
      };

  static Map<String, Object?> _canonicalPlacement(
    PlacementDiagnosticRecord value,
  ) {
    final dimensions = value.dimensionScores.entries.toList()
      ..sort((a, b) => a.key.wireName.compareTo(b.key.wireName));
    return <String, Object?>{
      'id': value.id,
      'at': value.at.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
      'answered': value.answered,
      'scoredAnswers': value.scoredAnswers,
      'score': value.score,
      'confidence': value.confidence,
      'band': value.band.wireName,
      'dimensionScores': <String, double>{
        for (final entry in dimensions)
          entry.key.wireName: entry.value,
      },
      'weakDimensions':
          value.weakDimensions.map((item) => item.wireName).toList(),
      'reviewItemIds': List<String>.from(value.reviewItemIds),
      'curriculumStartLevel': value.curriculumStartLevel,
      'recommendedStartTaskOrder': value.recommendedStartTaskOrder,
      'learningGoal': value.learningGoal,
    };
  }

  static Map<String, dynamic> _decodeTopLevel(String raw) {
    Object? decoded;
    try {
      decoded = jsonDecode(raw);
    } on Object {
      throw const LegacyLearnerSnapshotException(
        'legacy_payload_invalid_json',
      );
    }
    if (decoded is! Map) {
      throw const LegacyLearnerSnapshotException(
        'legacy_payload_not_object',
      );
    }

    final result = <String, dynamic>{};
    for (final entry in decoded.entries) {
      if (entry.key is! String) {
        throw const LegacyLearnerSnapshotException(
          'legacy_payload_non_string_key',
        );
      }
      result[entry.key as String] = entry.value;
    }
    return result;
  }

  static List<Attempt> _parseAttempts(Object? raw) {
    if (raw == null) return const <Attempt>[];
    if (raw is! List) {
      throw const LegacyLearnerSnapshotException(
        'legacy_attempts_not_list',
      );
    }
    if (raw.length > LearnerStateDatabase.maxAttempts) {
      throw const LegacyLearnerSnapshotException(
        'legacy_attempt_bound_exceeded',
      );
    }

    final result = <Attempt>[];
    final ids = <String>{};
    for (final value in raw) {
      final row = _strictMap(value, field: 'attempt');
      final id = _strictIdentifier(row['id'], field: 'attempt_id');
      if (!ids.add(id)) {
        throw const LegacyLearnerSnapshotException(
          'duplicate_attempt_id',
        );
      }
      final facet = ReviewFacetType.fromWire(
        _strictString(
          row['facetType'],
          field: 'facet_type',
          maxLength: 64,
        ),
      );
      if (facet == ReviewFacetType.unknown) {
        throw const LegacyLearnerSnapshotException(
          'invalid_attempt_facet_type',
        );
      }
      final variant = _optionalString(
        row['variantKey'],
        field: 'variant_key',
        maxLength: LearnerStateDatabase.maxIdentifierLength,
      );
      result.add(
        Attempt(
          id: id,
          itemId: _strictIdentifier(row['itemId'], field: 'item_id'),
          skill: _strictIdentifier(row['skill'], field: 'skill'),
          answer: _strictString(
            row['answer'],
            field: 'answer',
            maxLength: LearnerStateDatabase.maxAnswerLength,
            allowEmpty: true,
            trim: false,
          ),
          correct: _strictBool(row['correct'], field: 'correct'),
          hinted: _strictBool(row['hinted'], field: 'hinted'),
          seconds: _strictInteger(
            row['seconds'],
            field: 'seconds',
            min: 0,
            max: 3600,
          ),
          at: _strictDateTime(row['at'], field: 'attempt_at'),
          facetType: facet,
          variantKey: variant,
        ),
      );
    }
    return result;
  }

  static List<AssessmentHistory> _parseAssessments(Object? raw) {
    if (raw == null) return const <AssessmentHistory>[];
    if (raw is! List) {
      throw const LegacyLearnerSnapshotException(
        'legacy_assessments_not_list',
      );
    }
    if (raw.length > LearnerStateDatabase.maxAssessments) {
      throw const LegacyLearnerSnapshotException(
        'legacy_assessment_bound_exceeded',
      );
    }

    final result = <AssessmentHistory>[];
    final ids = <String>{};
    for (final value in raw) {
      final row = _strictMap(value, field: 'assessment');
      final id = _strictIdentifier(
        row['id'],
        field: 'assessment_id',
      );
      if (!ids.add(id)) {
        throw const LegacyLearnerSnapshotException(
          'duplicate_assessment_id',
        );
      }

      final rawWeak = row['weakSkills'];
      if (rawWeak is! List ||
          rawWeak.length > LearnerStateDatabase.maxWeakSkills) {
        throw const LegacyLearnerSnapshotException(
          'invalid_assessment_weak_skills',
        );
      }
      final weak = <String>[];
      for (final item in rawWeak) {
        weak.add(_strictIdentifier(item, field: 'weak_skill'));
      }

      result.add(
        AssessmentHistory(
          id: id,
          at: _strictDateTime(row['at'], field: 'assessment_at'),
          score: _strictDouble(
            row['score'],
            field: 'assessment_score',
            min: 0,
            max: 100,
          ),
          weakSkills: List<String>.unmodifiable(weak),
          answered: _strictInteger(
            row['answered'],
            field: 'assessment_answered',
            min: 0,
            max: 100,
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
    return result;
  }

  static List<PlacementDiagnosticRecord> _parsePlacements(Object? raw) {
    if (raw == null) return const <PlacementDiagnosticRecord>[];
    if (raw is! List) {
      throw const LegacyLearnerSnapshotException(
        'legacy_placements_not_list',
      );
    }
    if (raw.length > LearnerStateDatabase.maxPlacements) {
      throw const LegacyLearnerSnapshotException(
        'legacy_placement_bound_exceeded',
      );
    }

    final result = <PlacementDiagnosticRecord>[];
    final ids = <String>{};
    for (final value in raw) {
      final row = _strictMap(value, field: 'placement');
      final id = _strictIdentifier(
        row['id'],
        field: 'placement_id',
      );
      if (!ids.add(id)) {
        throw const LegacyLearnerSnapshotException(
          'duplicate_placement_id',
        );
      }

      final bandRaw = _strictString(
        row['band'],
        field: 'placement_band',
        maxLength: 32,
      );
      final band = DiagnosticPlacementBand.values
          .where((candidate) => candidate.wireName == bandRaw)
          .toList(growable: false);
      if (band.length != 1) {
        throw const LegacyLearnerSnapshotException(
          'invalid_placement_band',
        );
      }

      final rawScores = row['dimensionScores'];
      if (rawScores is! Map ||
          rawScores.length > DiagnosticDimension.values.length) {
        throw const LegacyLearnerSnapshotException(
          'invalid_placement_dimension_scores',
        );
      }
      final scores = <DiagnosticDimension, double>{};
      for (final entry in rawScores.entries) {
        if (entry.key is! String) {
          throw const LegacyLearnerSnapshotException(
            'invalid_placement_dimension_key',
          );
        }
        final dimension = DiagnosticDimension.fromWire(entry.key as String);
        if (dimension == null || scores.containsKey(dimension)) {
          throw const LegacyLearnerSnapshotException(
            'invalid_placement_dimension',
          );
        }
        scores[dimension] = _strictDouble(
          entry.value,
          field: 'placement_dimension_score',
          min: 0,
          max: 1,
        );
      }

      final weak = _parsePlacementWeakDimensions(row['weakDimensions']);
      final reviewItems = _parsePlacementReviewItems(row['reviewItemIds']);
      final level = _optionalEnum(
        row['curriculumStartLevel'],
        field: 'curriculum_start_level',
        allowed: const <String>{'A1', 'A2', 'B1', 'B2'},
      );
      final goal = _optionalEnum(
        row['learningGoal'],
        field: 'learning_goal',
        allowed: const <String>{
          'general',
          'dailyLife',
          'work',
          'studyExam',
          'travel',
        },
      );

      final taskOrder = row.containsKey('recommendedStartTaskOrder')
          ? _strictInteger(
              row['recommendedStartTaskOrder'],
              field: 'recommended_start_task_order',
              min: 1,
              max: 50,
            )
          : 1;

      result.add(
        PlacementDiagnosticRecord(
          id: id,
          at: _strictDateTime(row['at'], field: 'placement_at'),
          answered: _strictInteger(
            row['answered'],
            field: 'placement_answered',
            min: 0,
            max: 20,
          ),
          scoredAnswers: _strictInteger(
            row['scoredAnswers'],
            field: 'placement_scored_answers',
            min: 0,
            max: 20,
          ),
          score: _strictDouble(
            row['score'],
            field: 'placement_score',
            min: 0,
            max: 100,
          ),
          confidence: _strictDouble(
            row['confidence'],
            field: 'placement_confidence',
            min: 0,
            max: 1,
          ),
          band: band.single,
          dimensionScores:
              Map<DiagnosticDimension, double>.unmodifiable(scores),
          weakDimensions:
              List<DiagnosticDimension>.unmodifiable(weak),
          reviewItemIds: List<String>.unmodifiable(reviewItems),
          curriculumStartLevel: level,
          recommendedStartTaskOrder: taskOrder,
          learningGoal: goal,
        ),
      );
    }
    return result;
  }

  static List<DiagnosticDimension> _parsePlacementWeakDimensions(
    Object? raw,
  ) {
    if (raw is! List ||
        raw.length > DiagnosticDimension.values.length) {
      throw const LegacyLearnerSnapshotException(
        'invalid_placement_weak_dimensions',
      );
    }
    final result = <DiagnosticDimension>[];
    for (final item in raw) {
      if (item is! String) {
        throw const LegacyLearnerSnapshotException(
          'invalid_placement_weak_dimension',
        );
      }
      final dimension = DiagnosticDimension.fromWire(item);
      if (dimension == null || result.contains(dimension)) {
        throw const LegacyLearnerSnapshotException(
          'invalid_placement_weak_dimension',
        );
      }
      result.add(dimension);
    }
    return result;
  }

  static List<String> _parsePlacementReviewItems(Object? raw) {
    if (raw is! List ||
        raw.length > LearnerStateDatabase.maxPlacementReviewItems) {
      throw const LegacyLearnerSnapshotException(
        'invalid_placement_review_items',
      );
    }
    final result = <String>[];
    for (final item in raw) {
      final id = _strictIdentifier(
        item,
        field: 'placement_review_item_id',
      );
      if (result.contains(id)) {
        throw const LegacyLearnerSnapshotException(
          'duplicate_placement_review_item',
        );
      }
      result.add(id);
    }
    return result;
  }

  static Set<String> _parseFavoriteList(
    Object? raw, {
    required String field,
  }) {
    if (raw == null) return <String>{};
    if (raw is! List ||
        raw.length > LearnerStateDatabase.maxFavorites) {
      throw LegacyLearnerSnapshotException('invalid_$field');
    }
    final result = <String>{};
    for (final item in raw) {
      result.add(_strictIdentifier(item, field: 'favorite_verb'));
    }
    return result;
  }

  static Map<String, dynamic> _strictMap(
    Object? raw, {
    required String field,
  }) {
    if (raw is! Map) {
      throw LegacyLearnerSnapshotException('invalid_$field');
    }
    final result = <String, dynamic>{};
    for (final entry in raw.entries) {
      if (entry.key is! String) {
        throw LegacyLearnerSnapshotException('invalid_$field');
      }
      result[entry.key as String] = entry.value;
    }
    return result;
  }

  static String _strictIdentifier(
    Object? raw, {
    required String field,
  }) =>
      _strictString(
        raw,
        field: field,
        maxLength: LearnerStateDatabase.maxIdentifierLength,
      );

  static String _strictString(
    Object? raw, {
    required String field,
    required int maxLength,
    bool allowEmpty = false,
    bool trim = true,
  }) {
    if (raw is! String) {
      throw LegacyLearnerSnapshotException('invalid_$field');
    }
    final normalized = trim ? raw.trim() : raw;
    if ((!allowEmpty && normalized.isEmpty) ||
        normalized.length > maxLength) {
      throw LegacyLearnerSnapshotException('invalid_$field');
    }
    return normalized;
  }

  static String? _optionalString(
    Object? raw, {
    required String field,
    required int maxLength,
  }) {
    if (raw == null) return null;
    if (raw is! String) {
      throw LegacyLearnerSnapshotException('invalid_$field');
    }
    final value = raw.trim();
    if (value.isEmpty) return null;
    if (value.length > maxLength) {
      throw LegacyLearnerSnapshotException('invalid_$field');
    }
    return ReviewFacetKey.normalizeVariant(value);
  }

  static bool _strictBool(Object? raw, {required String field}) {
    if (raw is! bool) {
      throw LegacyLearnerSnapshotException('invalid_$field');
    }
    return raw;
  }

  static int _strictInteger(
    Object? raw, {
    required String field,
    required int min,
    required int max,
  }) {
    if (raw is! num || raw.toInt() != raw) {
      throw LegacyLearnerSnapshotException('invalid_$field');
    }
    final value = raw.toInt();
    if (value < min || value > max) {
      throw LegacyLearnerSnapshotException('invalid_$field');
    }
    return value;
  }

  static double _strictDouble(
    Object? raw, {
    required String field,
    required double min,
    required double max,
  }) {
    if (raw is! num) {
      throw LegacyLearnerSnapshotException('invalid_$field');
    }
    final value = raw.toDouble();
    if (!value.isFinite || value < min || value > max) {
      throw LegacyLearnerSnapshotException('invalid_$field');
    }
    return value;
  }

  static DateTime _strictDateTime(
    Object? raw, {
    required String field,
  }) {
    if (raw is! String) {
      throw LegacyLearnerSnapshotException('invalid_$field');
    }
    final value = DateTime.tryParse(raw)?.toUtc();
    if (value == null ||
        value.isBefore(DateTime.utc(2000)) ||
        value.isAfter(DateTime.now().toUtc().add(const Duration(days: 1)))) {
      throw LegacyLearnerSnapshotException('invalid_$field');
    }
    return value;
  }

  static String? _optionalEnum(
    Object? raw, {
    required String field,
    required Set<String> allowed,
  }) {
    if (raw == null) return null;
    if (raw is! String) {
      throw LegacyLearnerSnapshotException('invalid_$field');
    }
    final value = raw.trim();
    if (value.isEmpty) return null;
    if (!allowed.contains(value)) {
      throw LegacyLearnerSnapshotException('invalid_$field');
    }
    return value;
  }

  static Future<String> _sha256Utf8(String value) async {
    final digest = await Sha256().hash(utf8.encode(value));
    final buffer = StringBuffer();
    for (final byte in digest.bytes) {
      buffer.write(byte.toRadixString(16).padLeft(2, '0'));
    }
    return buffer.toString();
  }
}

final class LegacyLearnerMigrationSnapshot {
  const LegacyLearnerMigrationSnapshot({
    required this.sqliteSnapshot,
    required this.sourcePayloadSha256,
    required this.sourceLegacyFavoritesSha256,
    required this.canonicalSnapshotSha256,
  });

  final LearnerSqliteSnapshot sqliteSnapshot;
  final String sourcePayloadSha256;
  final String sourceLegacyFavoritesSha256;
  final String canonicalSnapshotSha256;

  int get attemptCount => sqliteSnapshot.attempts.length;
  int get assessmentCount => sqliteSnapshot.assessmentHistory.length;
  int get placementCount => sqliteSnapshot.placementHistory.length;
  int get favoriteCount => sqliteSnapshot.favoriteVerbs.length;
}

final class LegacyLearnerSnapshotException implements Exception {
  const LegacyLearnerSnapshotException(this.code);

  final String code;

  @override
  String toString() => 'LegacyLearnerSnapshotException($code)';
}

import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

class MultilingualService {
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> loadLanguagePack(String langCode) async {
    try {
      final String response = await rootBundle.loadString('content/multilingual/generated/$langCode.json');
      final dynamic decoded = json.decode(response);

      if (decoded is Map<String, dynamic>) {
        final List<dynamic> vocabulary = decoded['contentItems'] ??
            decoded['vocabulary'] ??
            decoded['words'] ??
            decoded['terms'] ??
            [];

        final List<dynamic> verbs = decoded['verbConjugations'] ??
            decoded['verbs'] ??
            decoded['conjugations'] ??
            [];

        final List<dynamic> grammar = decoded['grammarRules'] ??
            decoded['grammar'] ??
            decoded['rules'] ??
            [];

        return {
          'contentItems': vocabulary,
          'verbConjugations': verbs,
          'grammarRules': grammar,
          ...decoded,
        };
      } else if (decoded is List) {
        return {
          'contentItems': decoded,
          'verbConjugations': [],
          'grammarRules': [],
        };
      }
      return {};
    } catch (e) {
      return {
        'contentItems': [],
        'verbConjugations': [],
        'grammarRules': [],
      };
    }
  }
}

import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

class ProgressStorageService {
  static const String _keyLangCode = 'user_selected_language';
  static const String _keyStreak = 'user_streak_days';
  static const String _keyPoints = 'user_total_points';
  static const String _keyAccuracy = 'user_accuracy_percent';
  static const String _keyFavorites = 'user_favorite_words';

  static Future<void> saveSelectedLanguage(String langCode) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setString(_keyLangCode, langCode);
  }

  static Future<String> getSelectedLanguage({String defaultLang = 'de'}) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    return prefs.getString(_keyLangCode) ?? defaultLang;
  }

  static Future<void> addPoints(int points) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final current = prefs.getInt(_keyPoints) ?? 1450;
    await prefs.setInt(_keyPoints, current + points);
  }

  static Future<Map<String, dynamic>> getUserStats() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    return {
      'streak': prefs.getInt(_keyStreak) ?? 14,
      'points': prefs.getInt(_keyPoints) ?? 1450,
      'accuracy': prefs.getInt(_keyAccuracy) ?? 98,
      'langCode': prefs.getString(_keyLangCode) ?? 'de',
    };
  }

  static Future<List<String>> getFavorites() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    return prefs.getStringList(_keyFavorites) ?? [];
  }

  static Future<bool> toggleFavorite(String wordJsonStr) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    List<String> favs = prefs.getStringList(_keyFavorites) ?? [];
    bool isAdded;
    if (favs.contains(wordJsonStr)) {
      favs.remove(wordJsonStr);
      isAdded = false;
    } else {
      favs.add(wordJsonStr);
      isAdded = true;
    }
    await prefs.setStringList(_keyFavorites, favs);
    return isAdded;
  }
}

class LearningSession extends StatefulWidget {
  final LearnerRepository repo;
  final AppDependencies<ContentItem> dependencies;
  final VoidCallback onDone;

  const LearningSession({
    super.key,
    required this.repo,
    required this.dependencies,
    required this.onDone,
  });

  @override
  State<LearningSession> createState() => _SessionState();
}

class _SessionState extends State<LearningSession> {
  int i = 0;
  String answer = '';
  bool submitted = false;
  bool correct = false;
  late DateTime started;
  late List<int> order;
  late final List<ContentItem> content;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    content = widget.dependencies.corpus;
    started = DateTime.now();
    final learned = widget.repo.load().learned;
    order = List.generate(
      content.length,
      (x) => x,
    ).where((x) => !learned.contains(content[x].id)).toList();
    if (order.isEmpty) {
      order = List.generate(content.length, (x) => x);
    }
    order = order.take(8).toList();
  }

  ContentItem get item => content[order[i % order.length]];

  Future<void> submit() async {
    if (submitted) return;
    String norm(String value) =>
        value.toLowerCase().replaceAll(RegExp(r'[.!?]'), '').trim();
    correct = item.acceptedForms.isEmpty
        ? norm(answer) == norm(item.sourceText)
        : item.acceptedForms.map(norm).contains(norm(answer));
    await widget.repo.record(
      item: item,
      answer: answer,
      correct: correct,
      seconds:
          DateTime.now().difference(started).inSeconds.clamp(1, 999).toInt(),
      hinted: false,
    );
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => submitted = true);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(title: Text('جلسة ${i + 1}/${order.length}')),
        body: ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
          children: [
            Text(item.topic, style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.labelLarge),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Text(
              item.translationText,
              style: Theme.of(context)
                  .textTheme
                  .headlineMedium
                  ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Text(item.exampleText,
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge),
            Text(item.exampleTranslationText),
            const SizedBox(height: 18),
            TextField(
              enabled: !submitted,
              onChanged: (x) => answer = x,
              textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                labelText:
                    'اكتب بـ${widget.dependencies.languagePack.presentation.targetLanguageName}',
                border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            if (!submitted)
              FilledButton(onPressed: submit, child: const Text('تحقق'))
            else
              Card(
                child: ListTile(
                  leading: Icon(correct ? Icons.check_circle : Icons.close),
                  title: Text(correct ? 'أحسنت!' : 'ليس بعد'),
                  subtitle: Text(
                    correct
                        ? 'إجابة صحيحة.'
                        : 'الإجابة المستهدفة: ${item.sourceText}',
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            if (submitted)
              FilledButton(
                onPressed: () {
                  if (i + 1 >= order.length) {
                    widget.onDone();
                    Navigator.pop(context);
                  } else {
                    setState(() {
                      i++;
                      submitted = false;
                      answer = '';
                      started = DateTime.now();
                    });
                  }
                },
                child: Text(i + 1 >= order.length ? 'إنهاء الجلسة' : 'التالي'),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

class VocabularyPage extends StatefulWidget {
  final LearnerRepository repo;
  final AppDependencies<ContentItem> dependencies;
  final VoidCallback onDone;

  const VocabularyPage({
    super.key,
    required this.repo,
    required this.dependencies,
    required this.onDone,
  });

}

class _VocabState extends State<VocabularyPage> {
  final SafeTtsController tts = SafeTtsController();
  late final List<ContentItem> content;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    content = widget.dependencies.corpus;
  }

  Future<void> speak(String text) => tts.speak(text);

  @override
  void dispose() {
    tts.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(title: Text('A1 • ${content.length} مدخلًا')),
        body: ListView.builder(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
          itemCount: content.length,
          itemBuilder: (context, i) {
            final item = content[i];
            final issues =
                widget.dependencies.languagePack.contentQuality.issues(
              item,

  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    state = LearnerState(updatedAt: DateTime.now());
    _repoFuture = PreferencesService.instance().then(
      (prefs) => LearnerRepository(
        prefs,
        persistence: LearnerPersistence(
          prefs,
          LearnerRepository.key,
          LearnerRepository.legacyFavoriteKey,
        ),
      ),
    );
    _stateFuture = _repoFuture.then((repo) => repo.load());

    final repo = await _repoFuture;
    await repo.toggleFavoriteVerb(infinitive);
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => state = repo.load());
    if (close && mounted) Navigator.pop(context);

FILE: lib/ui/bridge/agent_ui_bridge.dart

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';

import '../../core/agents/polyglot_agent_models.dart';
import '../../core/agents/sys_error_recovery_fallback.dart';
import '../../core/agents/system_agent_runtime.dart';
import '../../core/storage/offline_progress_service.dart';

final class EpochUIValue<T> {
  const EpochUIValue({
    required this.epoch,
    required this.value,
  });

  final int epoch;
  final T value;
}

abstract interface class AgentUIRuntimePort {
  int get pairEpoch;
  OfflineProgressSnapshot get progressSnapshot;
  PolyglotMatrixState? get matrixState;

  Stream<EpochUIValue<OfflineProgressSnapshot>> get progressSignals;
  Stream<EpochUIValue<PolyglotMatrixState>> get matrixSignals;
  Stream<EpochUIValue<RecoveryDirective>> get recoverySignals;

  void requestLearningPair({
    required String sourceLanguageTag,
    required String targetLanguageTag,
  });
}

final class AgentUIState {
  const AgentUIState({
    required this.pairEpoch,
    required this.progress,
    required this.matrix,
    required this.recovery,
  });

  final int pairEpoch;
  final OfflineProgressSnapshot progress;
  final PolyglotMatrixState? matrix;
  final RecoveryDirective? recovery;

  AgentUIState copyWith({
    int? pairEpoch,
    OfflineProgressSnapshot? progress,
    PolyglotMatrixState? matrix,
    bool clearMatrix = false,
    RecoveryDirective? recovery,
    bool clearRecovery = false,
  }) =>
      AgentUIState(
        pairEpoch: pairEpoch ?? this.pairEpoch,
        progress: progress ?? this.progress,
        matrix: clearMatrix ? null : matrix ?? this.matrix,
        recovery: clearRecovery ? null : recovery ?? this.recovery,
      );
}

typedef AgentUIStateWidgetBuilder = Widget Function(
  BuildContext context,
  AgentUIState state,
);

final class AgentUIBridgeBuilder extends StatelessWidget {
  const AgentUIBridgeBuilder({
    required this.bridge,
    required this.builder,
    super.key,
  });

  final AgentUIBridge bridge;
  final AgentUIStateWidgetBuilder builder;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => RepaintBoundary(
        child: ValueListenableBuilder<AgentUIState>(
          valueListenable: bridge.state,
          builder: (context, value, _) => builder(context, value),
        ),
      );
}

final class AgentUIBridge {
  AgentUIBridge._(this._runtime)
      : state = ValueNotifier<AgentUIState>(
          AgentUIState(
            pairEpoch: _runtime.pairEpoch,
            progress: _runtime.progressSnapshot,
            matrix: _runtime.matrixState,
            recovery: null,
          ),
        ) {
    _progressSubscription =
        _runtime.progressSignals.listen(_onProgressSignal);
    _matrixSubscription =
        _runtime.matrixSignals.listen(_onMatrixSignal);
    _recoverySubscription =
        _runtime.recoverySignals.listen(_onRecoverySignal);
  }

  factory AgentUIBridge.attach(SystemAgentRuntime runtime) =>
      AgentUIBridge._(_SystemAgentRuntimePort(runtime));

  @visibleForTesting
  factory AgentUIBridge.attachPort(AgentUIRuntimePort runtime) =>
      AgentUIBridge._(runtime);

  final AgentUIRuntimePort _runtime;
  final ValueNotifier<AgentUIState> state;

  late final StreamSubscription<EpochUIValue<OfflineProgressSnapshot>>
      _progressSubscription;
  late final StreamSubscription<EpochUIValue<PolyglotMatrixState>>
      _matrixSubscription;
  late final StreamSubscription<EpochUIValue<RecoveryDirective>>
      _recoverySubscription;

  AgentUIState? _pendingState;
  int? _pendingEpoch;
  bool _flushScheduled = false;
  bool _closed = false;
  int _droppedStaleUpdates = 0;

  bool get isClosed => _closed;
  int get droppedStaleUpdates => _droppedStaleUpdates;
  int get pairEpoch => _runtime.pairEpoch;

  void switchPair({
    required String sourceLanguageTag,
    required String targetLanguageTag,
  }) {
    _ensureOpen();
    _discardPendingIfEpochChanged();
    _runtime.requestLearningPair(
      sourceLanguageTag: sourceLanguageTag,
      targetLanguageTag: targetLanguageTag,
    );
  }

  Future<T?> guardAsyncResult<T>(
    Future<T?> Function() operation,
  ) async {
    _ensureOpen();
    final submittedEpoch = _runtime.pairEpoch;
    final result = await operation();
    if (_closed || submittedEpoch != _runtime.pairEpoch) {
      _droppedStaleUpdates += 1;
      return null;
    }
    return result;
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    _closed = true;
    _pendingState = null;
    _pendingEpoch = null;
    await _progressSubscription.cancel();
    await _matrixSubscription.cancel();
    await _recoverySubscription.cancel();
    state.dispose();
  }

  void _onProgressSignal(
    EpochUIValue<OfflineProgressSnapshot> signal,
  ) {
    _enqueue(
      signal.epoch,
      (current) => current.copyWith(progress: signal.value),
    );
  }

  void _onMatrixSignal(EpochUIValue<PolyglotMatrixState> signal) {
    _enqueue(
      signal.epoch,
      (current) => current.copyWith(matrix: signal.value),
    );
  }

  void _onRecoverySignal(EpochUIValue<RecoveryDirective> signal) {
    _enqueue(
      signal.epoch,
      (current) => current.copyWith(recovery: signal.value),
    );
  }

  void _enqueue(
    int epoch,
    AgentUIState Function(AgentUIState current) reduce,
  ) {
    if (_closed) return;
    if (epoch != _runtime.pairEpoch) {
      _droppedStaleUpdates += 1;
      return;
    }

    final base = _pendingEpoch == epoch && _pendingState != null
        ? _pendingState!
        : state.value.copyWith(pairEpoch: epoch);
    _pendingEpoch = epoch;
    _pendingState = reduce(base).copyWith(pairEpoch: epoch);

    if (_flushScheduled) return;
    _flushScheduled = true;
    scheduleMicrotask(_flushPending);
  }

  void _flushPending() {
    _flushScheduled = false;
    if (_closed) {
      _pendingState = null;
      _pendingEpoch = null;
      return;
    }

    final epoch = _pendingEpoch;
    final next = _pendingState;
    _pendingState = null;
    _pendingEpoch = null;
    if (epoch == null || next == null) return;

    if (epoch != _runtime.pairEpoch) {
      _droppedStaleUpdates += 1;
      return;
    }

    state.value = next.copyWith(pairEpoch: epoch);
  }

  void _discardPendingIfEpochChanged() {
    final epoch = _pendingEpoch;
    if (epoch == null || epoch == _runtime.pairEpoch) return;
    _pendingState = null;
    _pendingEpoch = null;
    _droppedStaleUpdates += 1;
  }

  void _ensureOpen() {
    if (_closed) {
      throw StateError('AgentUIBridge is closed.');
    }
  }
}

final class _SystemAgentRuntimePort implements AgentUIRuntimePort {
  const _SystemAgentRuntimePort(this.runtime);

  final SystemAgentRuntime runtime;

  @override
  int get pairEpoch => runtime.pairEpoch;

  @override
  OfflineProgressSnapshot get progressSnapshot =>
      runtime.progressSnapshot;

  @override
  PolyglotMatrixState? get matrixState => runtime.polyglotMatrixState;

  @override
  Stream<EpochUIValue<OfflineProgressSnapshot>> get progressSignals =>
      runtime.progressChanges.map(
        (value) => EpochUIValue<OfflineProgressSnapshot>(
          epoch: runtime.pairEpoch,
          value: value,
        ),
      );

  @override
  Stream<EpochUIValue<PolyglotMatrixState>> get matrixSignals =>
      runtime.polyglotMatrixChanges.map(
        (value) => EpochUIValue<PolyglotMatrixState>(
          epoch: runtime.pairEpoch,
          value: value,
        ),
      );

  @override
  Stream<EpochUIValue<RecoveryDirective>> get recoverySignals =>
      runtime.recoveryDirectives.map(
        (value) => EpochUIValue<RecoveryDirective>(
          epoch: runtime.pairEpoch,
          value: value,
        ),
      );

  @override
  void requestLearningPair({
    required String sourceLanguageTag,
    required String targetLanguageTag,
  }) {
    runtime.requestLearningPair(
      sourceLanguageTag: sourceLanguageTag,
      targetLanguageTag: targetLanguageTag,
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

enum FlipCardFace { front, back }

enum FlipCardSwipeDirection { left, right, up, down }

typedef FlipCardFaceChanged = void Function(FlipCardFace face);
typedef FlipCardSwipeChanged = void Function(FlipCardSwipeDirection direction);

final class FlipCardWidget extends StatefulWidget {
  const FlipCardWidget({
    required this.front,
    required this.back,
    required this.semanticLabel,
    this.duration = const Duration(milliseconds: 320),
    this.perspective = 0.0012,
    this.onFaceChanged,
    this.onSwipe,
    this.initiallyFlipped = false,
    super.key,
  });

  final Widget front;
  final Widget back;
  final String semanticLabel;
  final Duration duration;
  final double perspective;
  final FlipCardFaceChanged? onFaceChanged;
  final FlipCardSwipeChanged? onSwipe;
  final bool initiallyFlipped;

  @override
  State<FlipCardWidget> createState() => _FlipCardWidgetState();
}

final class _FlipCardWidgetState extends State<FlipCardWidget>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late final AnimationController _controller;
  final ValueNotifier<Offset> _dragOffset = ValueNotifier<Offset>(Offset.zero);

  bool get _isBack => _controller.value >= 0.5;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _controller = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: widget.duration,
      value: widget.initiallyFlipped ? 1 : 0,
    );
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant FlipCardWidget oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.duration != widget.duration) {
      _controller.duration = widget.duration;
    }
    if (oldWidget.initiallyFlipped != widget.initiallyFlipped) {
      _animateTo(widget.initiallyFlipped);
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _dragOffset.dispose();
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _toggle() async {
    final toBack = !_isBack;
    await HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
    await _animateTo(toBack);
  }

  Future<void> _animateTo(bool back) async {
    if (!mounted) return;
    await _controller.animateTo(
      back ? 1 : 0,
      duration: widget.duration,
      curve: Curves.easeInOutCubic,
    );
    if (!mounted) return;
    widget.onFaceChanged?.call(
      back ? FlipCardFace.back : FlipCardFace.front,
    );
  }

  void _onPanStart(DragStartDetails details) {
    _dragOffset.value = Offset.zero;
  }

  void _onPanUpdate(DragUpdateDetails details) {
    _dragOffset.value += details.delta;
  }

  void _onPanCancel() {
    _dragOffset.value = Offset.zero;
  }

  void _onPanEnd(DragEndDetails details) {
    final offset = _dragOffset.value;
    _dragOffset.value = Offset.zero;

    final velocity = details.velocity.pixelsPerSecond;
    final horizontal = offset.dx.abs() >= offset.dy.abs();
    const displacementThreshold = 42.0;
    const velocityThreshold = 420.0;

    FlipCardSwipeDirection? direction;
    if (horizontal &&
        (offset.dx.abs() >= displacementThreshold ||
            velocity.dx.abs() >= velocityThreshold)) {
      direction = (offset.dx + velocity.dx * 0.04) >= 0
          ? FlipCardSwipeDirection.right
          : FlipCardSwipeDirection.left;
    } else if (!horizontal &&
        (offset.dy.abs() >= displacementThreshold ||
            velocity.dy.abs() >= velocityThreshold)) {
      direction = (offset.dy + velocity.dy * 0.04) >= 0
          ? FlipCardSwipeDirection.down
          : FlipCardSwipeDirection.up;
    }

    if (direction == null) return;
    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
    widget.onSwipe?.call(direction);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Semantics(
      button: true,
      label: widget.semanticLabel,
      hint: 'Tap to flip. Swipe to record a learning action.',
      child: GestureDetector(
        key: const ValueKey<String>('phase10-flip-card'),
        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
        onTap: _toggle,
        onPanStart: _onPanStart,
        onPanUpdate: _onPanUpdate,
        onPanCancel: _onPanCancel,
        onPanEnd: _onPanEnd,
        child: RepaintBoundary(
          child: AnimatedBuilder(
            animation: Listenable.merge(<Listenable>[
              _controller,
              _dragOffset,
            ]),
            builder: (context, child) {
              final progress = _controller.value;
              final rotation = progress * math.pi;
              final drag = _dragOffset.value;
              final dragRotation =
                  (drag.dx / 900).clamp(-0.08, 0.08).toDouble();
              final visibleBack = progress > 0.5;

              final matrix = Matrix4.identity()
                ..setEntry(3, 2, widget.perspective)
                ..rotateY(rotation + dragRotation);

              final face = visibleBack
                  ? Transform(
                      alignment: Alignment.center,
                      transform: Matrix4.identity()..rotateY(math.pi),
                      child: widget.back,
                    )
                  : widget.front;

              return Transform(
                alignment: Alignment.center,
                transform: matrix,
                child: face,
              );
            },
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../core/curriculum/omni_directional_matrix.dart';
import 'phase6_l10n_controller.dart';

final class LanguageSelectionScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const LanguageSelectionScreen({
    required this.controller,
    super.key,
  });

  final Phase6L10nController controller;

  @override
  State<LanguageSelectionScreen> createState() =>
      _LanguageSelectionScreenState();
}

final class _LanguageSelectionScreenState
    extends State<LanguageSelectionScreen> {
  late String _uiLanguage;
  late String _sourceLanguage;
  late String _targetLanguage;

  Phase6L10nController get controller => widget.controller;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _uiLanguage = controller.snapshot.userLocale.languageCode;
    _sourceLanguage = controller.pair.source.id;
    _targetLanguage = controller.pair.target.id;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AnimatedBuilder(
        animation: controller,
        builder: (context, _) => Directionality(
          textDirection: controller.textDirection,
          child: Scaffold(
            appBar: AppBar(
              title: Text(controller.text('language.screen.title')),
            ),
            body: SafeArea(
              child: ListView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 32),
                children: <Widget>[
                  _LanguageField(
                    label: controller.text('language.ui'),
                    value: _uiLanguage,
                    languages: controller.languages,
                    onChanged: (value) {
                      if (value == null) return;
                      setState(() => _uiLanguage = value);
                    },
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  _LanguageField(
                    label: controller.text('language.source'),
                    value: _sourceLanguage,
                    languages: controller.languages,
                    onChanged: (value) {
                      if (value == null) return;
                      setState(() {
                        _sourceLanguage = value;
                        if (_targetLanguage == value) {
                          _targetLanguage = _firstDifferent(value);
                        }
                      });
                    },
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  _LanguageField(
                    label: controller.text('language.target'),
                    value: _targetLanguage,
                    languages: controller.languages
                        .where((item) => item.id != _sourceLanguage)
                        .toList(growable: false),
                    onChanged: (value) {
                      if (value == null) return;
                      setState(() => _targetLanguage = value);
                    },
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 20),
                  Card(
                    child: Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                        children: <Widget>[
                          Text(
                            controller.text(
                              'language.matrix',
                              arguments: <String, Object?>{
                                'source':
                                    controller.languageLabel(_sourceLanguage),
                                'target':
                                    controller.languageLabel(_targetLanguage),
                              },
                            ),
                            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 8),
                          Text(
                            controller.text(
                              'language.directions',
                              arguments: <String, Object?>{
                                'count': controller.matrix.directedPairCount,
                                'languages': controller.matrix.languages.length,
                              },
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 8),
                          Text(controller.text('language.ui_fallback')),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 20),
                  FilledButton.icon(
                    onPressed: _apply,
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.check_rounded),
                    label: Text(controller.text('language.apply')),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );

  void _apply() {
    if (_sourceLanguage == _targetLanguage) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text(controller.text('language.same_error'))),
      );
      return;
    }

    try {
      controller.requestSelection(
        userLanguageId: _uiLanguage,
        sourceLanguageId: _sourceLanguage,
        targetLanguageId: _targetLanguage,
      );
      Navigator.of(context).pop();
    } on Object catch (error) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text(
            controller.text(
              'language.apply_error',
              arguments: <String, Object?>{'error': error.toString()},
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  String _firstDifferent(String sourceId) =>
      controller.languages.firstWhere((item) => item.id != sourceId).id;
}

final class _LanguageField extends StatelessWidget {
  const _LanguageField({
    required this.label,
    required this.value,
    required this.languages,
    required this.onChanged,
  });

  final String label;
  final String value;
  final List<LearningLanguageIdentity> languages;
  final ValueChanged<String?> onChanged;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
        initialValue: value,
        decoration: InputDecoration(
          labelText: label,
          border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
        ),
        isExpanded: true,
        items: <DropdownMenuItem<String>>[
          for (final language in languages)
            DropdownMenuItem<String>(
              value: language.id,
              child: Text(
                '${language.nativeName} · ${language.englishName}',
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
              ),
            ),
        ],
        onChanged: onChanged,
      );
}

final class LifeTaskRouteRegistry {
  LifeTaskRouteRegistry({
    LifeCurriculumCatalog? catalog,
    this.localizationController,
  })  : catalog = catalog ?? LifeCurriculumCatalog.standard(),
        _builders = _createBuilders() {
    final catalogKeys = this.catalog.links
        .map((link) => link.featureKey)
        .toSet();
    final routeKeys = _builders.keys.toSet();
    if (catalogKeys.length != 50 ||
        routeKeys.length != 50 ||
        !catalogKeys.containsAll(routeKeys) ||
        !routeKeys.containsAll(catalogKeys)) {
      throw StateError(
        'Life route registry must match the 50-entry curriculum catalog.',
      );
    }
  }

  final LifeCurriculumCatalog catalog;
  final Phase6L10nController? localizationController;
  final Map<String, WidgetBuilder> _builders;

  Set<String> get featureKeys => Set<String>.unmodifiable(_builders.keys);

  WidgetBuilder builderFor(String featureKey) {
    final builder = _builders[featureKey.trim()];
    if (builder == null) {
      throw StateError('No UI route registered for $featureKey.');
    }
    final controller = localizationController;
    if (controller == null) return builder;
    return (context) => LocalizedTaskRouteHost(
          controller: controller,
          childBuilder: builder,
        );
  }

  bool canOpen(String featureKey) =>
      _builders.containsKey(featureKey.trim());

final class _OwnedNotifierPage<T extends ChangeNotifier>
    extends StatefulWidget {
  const _OwnedNotifierPage({
    required this.create,
    required this.builder,
  });

  final T Function() create;
  final Widget Function(T notifier) builder;

  @override
  State<_OwnedNotifierPage<T>> createState() =>
      _OwnedNotifierPageState<T>();
}

final class _OwnedNotifierPageState<T extends ChangeNotifier>
    extends State<_OwnedNotifierPage<T>> {
  late final T _notifier;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _notifier = widget.create();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _notifier.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => widget.builder(_notifier);
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';

import '../../core/agents/memory_models.dart';
import '../../core/design/flashcards_3d/flashcard_3d_models.dart';
import '../../core/orchestration/orchestration.dart';
import '../../core/storage/offline_progress_service.dart';
import '../../core/storage/runtime_local_state_container.dart';
import '../../core/storage/validation_hash_cache.dart';
import '../../services/preferences_service.dart';

final class Phase10PresentationBridge {
  Phase10PresentationBridge._({
    required AgentEventBus eventBus,
    required OrchestrationKernel kernel,
    required AgentEndpoint endpoint,
    required AgentEventBatchDispatcher batchDispatcher,
    required ValidationHashCache validationCache,
    required OfflineProgressSnapshot initialSnapshot,
  })  : _eventBus = eventBus,
        _kernel = kernel,
        _batchDispatcher = batchDispatcher,
        _validationCache = validationCache,
        _snapshot = initialSnapshot {
    _subscription = endpoint.allEvents.listen(_handleEvent);
  }

  static const String _uiValidationKey = 'phase10_validation_cache_v1';

  static Future<Phase10PresentationBridge> start() async {
    final eventBus = AgentEventBus();
    final kernel = OrchestrationKernel(
      eventBus: eventBus,
      services: ServiceContainer(),
    );
    final endpoint = _connect(kernel, 'phase10.presentation-ui');

    OfflineProgressSnapshot initial = OfflineProgressSnapshot.empty();
    MemoryAgentStore validationStore = _InMemoryStore();

    try {
      final preferences = await PreferencesService.instance();
      initial = await _readPersistedProgress(
        _PreferencesSystemMemoryStore(preferences),
      );
      validationStore = _PreferencesTextStore(
        preferences,
        _uiValidationKey,
      );
    } on Object {
      initial = OfflineProgressSnapshot.empty();
    }

    final cache = await ValidationHashCache.open(validationStore);
    final batchDispatcher = endpoint.createBatchDispatcher(
      maxBatchSize: 8,
      maxPending: 64,
      flushDelay: const Duration(milliseconds: 2),
    );
    return Phase10PresentationBridge._(
      eventBus: eventBus,
      kernel: kernel,
      endpoint: endpoint,
      batchDispatcher: batchDispatcher,
      validationCache: cache,
      initialSnapshot: initial,
    );
  }

  static Future<Phase10PresentationBridge> isolated({
    required AgentEventBus eventBus,
    required MemoryAgentStore validationStore,
    required OfflineProgressSnapshot initialSnapshot,
  }) async {
    final kernel = OrchestrationKernel(
      eventBus: eventBus,
      services: ServiceContainer(),
    );
    final endpoint = _connect(kernel, 'phase10.presentation-isolated');
    final cache = await ValidationHashCache.open(validationStore);
    final batchDispatcher = endpoint.createBatchDispatcher(
      maxBatchSize: 8,
      maxPending: 64,
      flushDelay: Duration.zero,
    );
    return Phase10PresentationBridge._(
      eventBus: eventBus,
      kernel: kernel,
      endpoint: endpoint,
      batchDispatcher: batchDispatcher,
      validationCache: cache,
      initialSnapshot: initialSnapshot,
    );
  }

  final AgentEventBus _eventBus;
  final OrchestrationKernel _kernel;
  final AgentEventBatchDispatcher _batchDispatcher;
  final ValidationHashCache _validationCache;
  final StreamController<OfflineProgressSnapshot> _progressController =
      StreamController<OfflineProgressSnapshot>.broadcast();

  late final StreamSubscription<AgentEvent> _subscription;
  OfflineProgressSnapshot _snapshot;
  int _sequence = 0;
  bool _closed = false;

  OfflineProgressSnapshot get progressSnapshot => _snapshot;
  Stream<OfflineProgressSnapshot> get progressStream =>
      _progressController.stream;
  bool get isClosed => _closed;

  int get validationCacheHits => _validationCache.hits;
  int get validationCacheMisses => _validationCache.misses;
  AgentBatchQueueStats get batchStats => _batchDispatcher.stats;

  Future<ValidationCacheResult> validateCard(Flashcard3DData card) {
    _ensureOpen();
    final source = _snapshot.sourceLanguageTag ?? card.backLanguageCode;
    final target = _snapshot.targetLanguageTag ?? card.frontLanguageCode;
    final content = <String>[
      card.frontText,
      card.backText,
      card.article ?? '',
      card.frontSupportingText ?? '',
      card.backSupportingText ?? '',
    ].join('\u0000');

    return _validationCache.validateOnce(
      scopeKey:
          '${source.toLowerCase()}->${target.toLowerCase()}'
          '|flashcard|${card.id}',
      content: content,
      validatorVersion: 'phase10.card.v1',
      validator: () async => _isStructurallyValid(card),
    );
  }

  void recordCardInteraction({
    required String cardId,
    required double score,
    required int points,
    String taskId = 'task-46',
    bool completed = false,
  }) {
    _ensureOpen();
    final normalizedTask = taskId.trim();
    if (!_isCanonicalTaskId(normalizedTask)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(
        taskId,
        'taskId',
        'must be one of task-01..task-50',
      );
    }

    final now = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;
    final payload = <String, Object?>{
      'taskId': normalizedTask,
      'score': score.clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble(),
      'completed': completed,
      'attempts': 1,
      'points': points.clamp(0, 1000).toInt(),
      'occurredAtEpochMs': now,
      'source': 'phase10.flashcard',
      'cardId': cardId.trim(),
    };

    _applyProgressPayload(payload);
    final correlationId = _nextCorrelation('progress');
    unawaited(
      _batchDispatcher
          .submit(
            AgentBatchEvent(
              dedupeKey: correlationId,
              topic: AgentTopics.learningProgress,
              targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.memory},
              context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty(correlationId),
              payload: payload,
            ),
          )
          .catchError((Object _) {}),
    );
  }

  Future<void> flush() async {
    _ensureOpen();
    await _batchDispatcher.flush();
    await _validationCache.flush();
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    _closed = true;
    await _batchDispatcher.close();
    await _subscription.cancel();
    await _validationCache.close();
    await _kernel.close();
    await _progressController.close();
  }

  void _handleEvent(AgentEvent event) {
    if (_closed) return;
    switch (event.topic) {
      case AgentTopics.learningProgress:
        _applyProgressPayload(event.payload);
        return;
      case AgentTopics.polyglotMatrixChanged:
        _applyPairPayload(event.payload);
        return;
    }
  }

  void _applyProgressPayload(Map<String, Object?> payload) {
    final taskId = payload['taskId'];
    if (taskId is! String || !_isCanonicalTaskId(taskId)) return;

    final rawScore = payload['score'];
    final score = rawScore is num
        ? rawScore.toDouble().clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble()
        : 0.0;
    final rawPoints = payload['points'];
    final pointsDelta = rawPoints is num
        ? rawPoints.toInt().clamp(0, 1000).toInt()
        : _defaultPoints(score, payload['completed'] == true);
    final completed = payload['completed'] == true;
    final rawTimestamp = payload['occurredAtEpochMs'];
    final timestamp = rawTimestamp is num
        ? rawTimestamp.toInt().clamp(0, 4102444800000).toInt()
        : DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;

    final tasks = <String, Map<String, Object?>>{
      for (final entry in _snapshot.tasks.entries)
        entry.key: entry.value.toJson(),
    };
    final current = _snapshot.tasks[taskId];
    final currentPoints = current?.points ?? 0;
    final currentScore = current?.bestScore ?? 0;
    final nextScore = score > currentScore ? score : currentScore;
    final nextCompleted = (current?.completed ?? false) || completed;
    final nextPoints =
        (currentPoints + pointsDelta).clamp(0, 1000000000).toInt();

    tasks[taskId] = <String, Object?>{
      'taskId': taskId,
      'points': nextPoints,
      'bestScore': nextScore,
      'completed': nextCompleted,
      'mastery': nextCompleted
          ? TaskMasteryStatus.mastered.name
          : (nextPoints > 0 || nextScore > 0)
              ? TaskMasteryStatus.learning.name
              : TaskMasteryStatus.notStarted.name,
      'updatedAtEpochMs': timestamp,
    };

    _snapshot = _decodeSnapshot(
      source: _snapshot.sourceLanguageTag,
      target: _snapshot.targetLanguageTag,
      tasks: tasks.values,
      updatedAtEpochMs: timestamp,
    );
    _emit();
  }

  void _applyPairPayload(Map<String, Object?> payload) {
    final source = _language(
      payload['sourceLanguage'] ?? payload['sourceLocale'],
    );
    final target = _language(
      payload['targetLanguage'] ?? payload['targetLocale'],
    );
    if (source == null || target == null) return;

    _snapshot = _decodeSnapshot(
      source: source,
      target: target,
      tasks: _snapshot.tasks.values.map((task) => task.toJson()),
      updatedAtEpochMs: DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch,
    );
    _emit();
  }

  void _emit() {
    if (!_closed && !_progressController.isClosed) {
      _progressController.add(_snapshot);
    }
  }

  String _nextCorrelation(String purpose) {
    _sequence += 1;
    return 'phase10.$purpose.$_sequence';
  }

  void _ensureOpen() {
    if (_closed || _eventBus.isClosed) {
      throw StateError('Phase10PresentationBridge is closed.');
    }
  }

  static AgentEndpoint _connect(
    OrchestrationKernel kernel,
    String id,
  ) =>
      kernel.connect(
        AgentDescriptor(
          id: id,
          role: AgentRole.task,
          subscriptions: const <String>{
            AgentTopics.learningProgress,
            AgentTopics.polyglotMatrixChanged,
          },
          observesTargetedEvents: true,
        ),
      );

  static Future<OfflineProgressSnapshot> _readPersistedProgress(
    MemoryAgentStore physicalStore,
  ) async {
    final container = await RuntimeLocalStateContainer.open(physicalStore);
    try {
      final encoded = await container.namespace('progress').read();
      return OfflineProgressSnapshot.decode(encoded);
    } on Object {
      return OfflineProgressSnapshot.empty();
    } finally {
      await container.close();
    }
  }

  static OfflineProgressSnapshot _decodeSnapshot({
    required String? source,
    required String? target,
    required Iterable<Map<String, Object?>> tasks,
    required int updatedAtEpochMs,
  }) =>
      OfflineProgressSnapshot.decode(
        jsonEncode(
          <String, Object?>{
            'schemaVersion': OfflineProgressSnapshot.schemaVersion,
            'sourceLanguageTag': source,
            'targetLanguageTag': target,
            'updatedAtEpochMs': updatedAtEpochMs,
            'tasks': tasks.toList(growable: false),
          },
        ),
      );

  static String? _language(Object? value) {
    if (value is! String || value.trim().isEmpty) return null;
    final normalized = value.trim().replaceAll('_', '-');
    return RegExp(
      r'^[A-Za-z]{2,8}(?:-[A-Za-z0-9]{1,8})*$',
    ).hasMatch(normalized)
        ? normalized
        : null;
  }

  static bool _isCanonicalTaskId(String value) {
    final match = RegExp(r'^task-(\d{2})$').firstMatch(value.trim());
    if (match == null) return false;
    final number = int.tryParse(match.group(1) ?? '');
    return number != null && number >= 1 && number <= 50;
  }

  static int _defaultPoints(double score, bool completed) {
    final base = (score.clamp(0.0, 1.0) * 100).round();
    final bonus = completed ? 25 : 0;
    return (base + bonus).clamp(0, 125).toInt();
  }

  static bool _isStructurallyValid(Flashcard3DData card) {
    if (card.id.trim().isEmpty ||
        card.frontText.trim().isEmpty ||
        card.backText.trim().isEmpty) {
      return false;
    }
    return _language(card.frontLanguageCode) != null &&
        _language(card.backLanguageCode) != null;
  }
}

final class _PreferencesSystemMemoryStore implements MemoryAgentStore {
  const _PreferencesSystemMemoryStore(this.preferences);

  final PreferencesService preferences;

  @override
  Future<String?> read() async =>
      preferences.readSystemMemoryAgentState();

  @override
  Future<void> write(String encoded) async {
    final written =
        await preferences.writeSystemMemoryAgentState(encoded);
    if (!written) {
      throw StateError('System memory storage write failed.');
    }
  }
}

final class _PreferencesTextStore implements MemoryAgentStore {
  const _PreferencesTextStore(this.preferences, this.key);

  final PreferencesService preferences;
  final String key;

  @override
  Future<String?> read() async => preferences.getString(key);

  @override
  Future<void> write(String encoded) async {
    final written = await preferences.setString(key, encoded);
    if (!written) {
      throw StateError('Local phase10 storage write failed.');
    }
  }
}

final class _InMemoryStore implements MemoryAgentStore {
  String? _value;

  @override
  Future<String?> read() async => _value;

  @override
  Future<void> write(String encoded) async {
    _value = encoded;
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

typedef Phase10TaskTap = void Function(CurriculumTask task);

final class Phase10TasksTrackView extends StatelessWidget {
  const Phase10TasksTrackView({
    required this.initialSnapshot,
    required this.progressStream,
    this.onTaskTap,
    this.tasks = const <CurriculumTask>[],
    this.fallbackSourceLanguageTag,
    this.fallbackTargetLanguageTag,
    super.key,
  });

  final OfflineProgressSnapshot initialSnapshot;
  final Stream<OfflineProgressSnapshot> progressStream;
  final Phase10TaskTap? onTaskTap;
  final List<CurriculumTask> tasks;
  final String? fallbackSourceLanguageTag;
  final String? fallbackTargetLanguageTag;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return StreamBuilder<OfflineProgressSnapshot>(
      stream: progressStream,
      initialData: initialSnapshot,
      builder: (context, snapshot) {
        final progress = snapshot.data ?? initialSnapshot;
        return _TrackBody(
          progress: progress,
          tasks: tasks.isEmpty ? CanonicalCurriculum50.tasks : tasks,
          onTaskTap: onTaskTap,
          fallbackSourceLanguageTag: fallbackSourceLanguageTag,
          fallbackTargetLanguageTag: fallbackTargetLanguageTag,
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

final class _TrackBody extends StatelessWidget {
  const _TrackBody({
    required this.progress,
    required this.tasks,
    required this.onTaskTap,
    required this.fallbackSourceLanguageTag,
    required this.fallbackTargetLanguageTag,
  });

  final OfflineProgressSnapshot progress;
  final List<CurriculumTask> tasks;
  final Phase10TaskTap? onTaskTap;
  final String? fallbackSourceLanguageTag;
  final String? fallbackTargetLanguageTag;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final rtl = Directionality.of(context) == TextDirection.rtl;
    return ListView.separated(
      key: const ValueKey<String>('phase10-tasks-track'),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 12, 12, 28),
      itemCount: tasks.length + 1,
      separatorBuilder: (_, __) => const SizedBox(height: 8),
      itemBuilder: (context, index) {
        if (index == 0) {
          return _ProgressHeader(
            progress: progress,
            rtl: rtl,
            fallbackSourceLanguageTag: fallbackSourceLanguageTag,
            fallbackTargetLanguageTag: fallbackTargetLanguageTag,
          );
        }

        final task = tasks[index - 1];
        return _TaskProgressCard(
          task: task,
          progress: progress.tasks[task.id],
          rtl: rtl,
          onTap: onTaskTap == null ? null : () => onTaskTap!(task),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

final class _ProgressHeader extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ProgressHeader({
    required this.progress,
    required this.rtl,
    required this.fallbackSourceLanguageTag,
    required this.fallbackTargetLanguageTag,
  });

  final OfflineProgressSnapshot progress;
  final bool rtl;
  final String? fallbackSourceLanguageTag;
  final String? fallbackTargetLanguageTag;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final storedPair = progress.activePair?.replaceAll('->', ' → ');
    final fallbackSource = fallbackSourceLanguageTag?.trim();
    final fallbackTarget = fallbackTargetLanguageTag?.trim();
    final fallbackPair = fallbackSource != null &&
            fallbackSource.isNotEmpty &&
            fallbackTarget != null &&
            fallbackTarget.isNotEmpty
        ? '$fallbackSource → $fallbackTarget'
        : '— → —';
    final pair = storedPair ?? fallbackPair;
    final title = rtl ? 'مسار التعلّم' : 'Learning Track';
    final completedLabel = rtl ? 'مكتمل' : 'completed';
    final masteredLabel = rtl ? 'متقن' : 'mastered';

    return AppGlassCard(
      key: const ValueKey<String>('phase10-track-header'),
      glowColor: AppColors.primary,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          Text(
            title,
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          Text(
            pair,
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall?.copyWith(
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Wrap(
            spacing: 8,
            runSpacing: 8,
            children: <Widget>[
              _MetricChip(
                icon: Icons.task_alt_rounded,
                label: '${progress.completedTasks}/50 $completedLabel',
              ),
              _MetricChip(
                icon: Icons.workspace_premium_rounded,
                label: '${progress.masteredTasks}/50 $masteredLabel',
              ),
              _MetricChip(
                icon: Icons.bolt_rounded,
                label: '${progress.totalPoints} pts',
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../../core/curriculum/advanced_vocabulary.dart';
import '../../core/design/flashcards_3d/flashcard_3d_models.dart';

import '../../design_system/app_glass_card.dart';
import '../../design_system/app_typography.dart';
