abstract final class VocabularyProjectionFactory {
  static VocabularyFlashcardProjection fromContent(LearningContent item) {
    final marker = item.grammaticalMarker.trim();
    final normalizedMarker = marker.toLowerCase();
    final article = const <String>{'der', 'die', 'das', 'plural'}
            .contains(normalizedMarker)
        ? normalizedMarker
        : null;
    final supporting = <String>[
      if (marker.isNotEmpty) marker,
      if (item.pluralForm.trim().isNotEmpty)
        'Plural: ${item.pluralForm.trim()}',
    ].join(' • ');

    return VocabularyFlashcardProjection(
      id: item.id,
      frontText: item.sourceText,
      backText: item.translationText,
      frontLanguageCode: 'de',
      backLanguageCode: 'ar',
      article: article,
      frontSupportingText:
          supporting.isEmpty ? item.exampleText : supporting,
      backSupportingText: item.exampleTranslationText,
      semanticLabel: '${item.topic}: ${item.sourceText}',
    );
  }

  static List<VocabularyFlashcardProjection> fromContentList(
    Iterable<LearningContent> items,
  ) =>
      List<VocabularyFlashcardProjection>.unmodifiable(
        items.map(fromContent),
      );
}

abstract final class VocabularyFlashcard3DAdapter {
  static Flashcard3DData fromProjection(
    VocabularyFlashcardProjection projection,
  ) =>
      Flashcard3DData(
        id: projection.id,
        frontText: projection.frontText,
        backText: projection.backText,
        frontLanguageCode: projection.frontLanguageCode,
        backLanguageCode: projection.backLanguageCode,
        article: projection.article,
        frontSupportingText: projection.frontSupportingText,
        backSupportingText: projection.backSupportingText,
        semanticLabel: projection.semanticLabel,
      );

  static List<Flashcard3DData> deck(
    Iterable<VocabularyFlashcardProjection> projections,
  ) =>
      List<Flashcard3DData>.unmodifiable(
        projections.map(fromProjection),
      );
}

final class Phase3FlashcardDeckPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const Phase3FlashcardDeckPage({
    required this.title,
    required this.emptyText,
    required this.projections,
    this.onAudio,
    this.presentationBridge,
    super.key,
  });

  final String title;
  final String emptyText;
  final List<VocabularyFlashcardProjection> projections;
  final FlashcardAudioCallback? onAudio;
  final Phase10PresentationBridge? presentationBridge;

  @override
  State<Phase3FlashcardDeckPage> createState() =>
      _Phase3FlashcardDeckPageState();
}

final class _Phase3FlashcardDeckPageState
    extends State<Phase3FlashcardDeckPage> {
  late final List<Flashcard3DData> _cards;
  late final Future<Phase10PresentationBridge> _bridgeFuture;
  late final bool _ownsBridge;

  final Set<String> _validatedCards = <String>{};
  final Set<String> _revealedCards = <String>{};
  int _index = 0;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _cards = VocabularyFlashcard3DAdapter.deck(widget.projections);
    _ownsBridge = widget.presentationBridge == null;
    _bridgeFuture = widget.presentationBridge == null
        ? Phase10PresentationBridge.start()
        : Future<Phase10PresentationBridge>.value(
            widget.presentationBridge,
          );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    if (_ownsBridge) {
      unawaited(
        _bridgeFuture.then((bridge) => bridge.close()).catchError((_) {}),
      );
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  Flashcard3DData get _activeCard => _cards[_index];

  void _moveBy(int delta) {
    if (_cards.isEmpty) return;
    final next = ((_index + delta) % _cards.length + _cards.length) %
        _cards.length;
    if (next == _index) return;
    setState(() => _index = next);
  }

  void _onFaceChanged(FlipCardFace face) {
    if (face != FlipCardFace.back || _cards.isEmpty) return;
    final card = _activeCard;
    if (!_revealedCards.add(card.id)) return;

    unawaited(
      _bridgeFuture.then((bridge) async {
        final result = await bridge.validateCard(card);
        if (!mounted) return;
        if (result.validated) {
          setState(() => _validatedCards.add(card.id));
          bridge.recordCardInteraction(
            cardId: card.id,
            score: 0.5,
            points: 1,
          );
        }
      }).catchError((_) {}),
    );
  }

  void _onSwipe(FlipCardSwipeDirection direction) {
    if (_cards.isEmpty) return;
    final card = _activeCard;

    final interaction = switch (direction) {
      FlipCardSwipeDirection.right => (score: 1.0, points: 3),
      FlipCardSwipeDirection.left => (score: 0.0, points: 0),
      FlipCardSwipeDirection.up => (score: 0.75, points: 2),
      FlipCardSwipeDirection.down => (score: 0.25, points: 0),
    };

    unawaited(
      _bridgeFuture.then((bridge) async {
        final validation = await bridge.validateCard(card);
        if (!validation.validated) return;
        bridge.recordCardInteraction(
          cardId: card.id,
          score: interaction.score,
          points: interaction.points,
        );
      }).catchError((_) {}),
    );

    switch (direction) {
      case FlipCardSwipeDirection.left:
        _moveBy(1);
        return;
      case FlipCardSwipeDirection.right:
        _moveBy(-1);
        return;
      case FlipCardSwipeDirection.up:
      case FlipCardSwipeDirection.down:
        return;
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_cards.isEmpty) {
      return Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(title: Text(widget.title)),
        body: Center(child: Text(widget.emptyText)),
      );
    }

    final card = _activeCard;
    final dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface = dark ? AppColors.darkSurface : AppColors.lightSurface;
    final border =
        dark ? AppColors.glassBorderDark : AppColors.glassBorderLight;

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: Text(widget.title)),
      body: SafeArea(
        child: LayoutBuilder(
          builder: (context, constraints) {
            final width = (constraints.maxWidth - 32)
                .clamp(260.0, 560.0)
                .toDouble();
            final height = (width * 1.2).clamp(340.0, 620.0).toDouble();

            return SingleChildScrollView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              child: Center(
                child: ConstrainedBox(
                  constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 560),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      _DeckHeader(
                        index: _index,
                        total: _cards.length,
                        validated: _validatedCards.contains(card.id),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 14),
                      SizedBox(
                        width: width,
                        height: height,
                        child: FlipCardWidget(
                          key: ValueKey<String>(
                            'phase10-flip-${card.id}',
                          ),
                          semanticLabel:
                              card.semanticLabel ?? 'Interactive flashcard',
                          onFaceChanged: _onFaceChanged,
                          onSwipe: _onSwipe,
                          front: _CardFace(
                            card: card,
                            face: Flashcard3DFace.front,
                            surface: surface,
                            border: border,
                            validated: _validatedCards.contains(card.id),
                            onAudio: widget.onAudio ?? _requestTargetSpeech,
                          ),
                          back: _CardFace(
                            card: card,
                            face: Flashcard3DFace.back,
                            surface: surface,
                            border: border,
                            validated: _validatedCards.contains(card.id),
                            onAudio: widget.onAudio ?? _requestTargetSpeech,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 14),
                      _DeckControls(
                        onPrevious: () => _moveBy(-1),
                        onNext: () => _moveBy(1),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            );
          },
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _requestTargetSpeech(
    Flashcard3DData card,
    Flashcard3DFace face,
  ) {
    final runtime = LifeFeatureRuntime.shared;
    final target = runtime.snapshot.targetLocale;
    final language = face == Flashcard3DFace.front
        ? card.frontLanguageCode
        : card.backLanguageCode;
    if (!runtime.isTargetLanguage(language)) return;

    final text = face == Flashcard3DFace.front
        ? card.frontText
        : card.backText;
    if (text.trim().isEmpty) return;

    unawaited(
      _speakSafely(
        runtime: runtime,
        text: text,
        targetLanguageTag: target.languageTag,
      ),
    );
  }

  static Future<void> _speakSafely({
    required LifeFeatureRuntime runtime,
    required String text,
    required String targetLanguageTag,
  }) async {
    try {
      await runtime.requestSpeech(
        text: text,
        languageTag: targetLanguageTag,
      );
    } on Object {
      return;
    }
  }
}

final class _DeckHeader extends StatelessWidget {
  const _DeckHeader({
    required this.index,
    required this.total,
    required this.validated,
  });

  final int index;
  final int total;
  final bool validated;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Row(
        children: <Widget>[
          Expanded(
            child: Text(
              '${index + 1} / $total',
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
            ),
          ),
          AnimatedSwitcher(
            duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
            child: validated
                ? const Chip(
                    key: ValueKey<String>('phase10-card-validated'),
                    avatar: Icon(Icons.verified_rounded, size: 18),
                    label: Text('Offline verified'),
                  )
                : const Chip(
                    key: ValueKey<String>('phase10-card-pending'),
                    avatar: Icon(Icons.offline_bolt_rounded, size: 18),
                    label: Text('Offline first'),
                  ),
          ),
        ],
      );
}

final class _CardFace extends StatelessWidget {
  const _CardFace({
    required this.card,
    required this.face,
    required this.surface,
    required this.border,
    required this.validated,
    required this.onAudio,
  });

  final Flashcard3DData card;
  final Flashcard3DFace face;
  final Color surface;
  final Color border;
  final bool validated;
  final FlashcardAudioCallback onAudio;

  bool get _front => face == Flashcard3DFace.front;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final text = _front ? card.frontText : card.backText;
    final language =
        _front ? card.frontLanguageCode : card.backLanguageCode;
    final supporting = _front
        ? card.frontSupportingText
        : card.backSupportingText;
    final grammar = <String>[
      if (card.article != null && card.article!.trim().isNotEmpty)
        'Artikel: ${card.article}',
      if (card.frontSupportingText != null &&
          card.frontSupportingText!.trim().isNotEmpty)
        card.frontSupportingText!.trim(),
    ].join(' • ');

    return AppGlassCard(
      backgroundColor: surface,
      borderColor: _front ? AppColors.primary.withAlpha(130) : border,
      glowColor: _front ? AppColors.primary : AppColors.secondary,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(22),
      child: Stack(
        children: <Widget>[
          Center(
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: <Widget>[
                AppDirectionalText(
                  text,
                  languageCode: language,
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  style: AppTypography.display,
                ),
                if (supporting != null &&
                    supporting.trim().isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  AppDirectionalText(
                    supporting,
                    languageCode: language,
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: AppTypography.body,
                  ),
                ],
                if (!_front && grammar.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  Divider(color: border),
                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                  AppDirectionalText(
                    grammar,
                    languageCode: card.frontLanguageCode,
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
                      color: AppColors.primary,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Text(
                    validated
                        ? 'Validated locally • no network'
                        : 'Validation runs on first reveal',
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.labelSmall,
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
          PositionedDirectional(
            end: 0,
            bottom: 0,
            child: AppAudioButton(
              onPressed: () => onAudio(card, face),
              semanticLabel: _front
                  ? 'Listen to card text'
                  : 'Listen to translation when it is the target language',
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class _DeckControls extends StatelessWidget {
  const _DeckControls({
    required this.onPrevious,
    required this.onNext,
  });

  final VoidCallback onPrevious;
  final VoidCallback onNext;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Row(
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
        children: <Widget>[
          IconButton.filledTonal(
            onPressed: onPrevious,
            tooltip: 'Previous card',
            icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 18),
          Text(
            'Tap: flip • Swipe: learn',
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.labelLarge,
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 18),
          IconButton.filledTonal(
            onPressed: onNext,
            tooltip: 'Next card',
            icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_forward_rounded),
          ),
        ],
      );
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../features/audio/domain/services/i_audio_runtime.dart';
import '../../features/audio/hybrid_pronunciation_service.dart';
import '../../features/daily_drill/data/universal_session_drill_review_sink.dart';

final class Phase3ProductionShell extends StatefulWidget {
  const Phase3ProductionShell({
    required this.corpus,
    required this.audioRuntime,
    required this.learnerRepository,
    required this.gamificationRepository,
    required this.quickReviewService,
    required this.explainerService,
    required this.reviewSourceLanguageCode,
    required this.reviewTranslationLanguageCode,
    this.routeRegistry,
    this.localizationController,
    this.deckId = 'main-vocabulary',
    this.startTaskOrder = 1,
    super.key,
  }) : assert(startTaskOrder >= 1 && startTaskOrder <= 50);

  final List<LearningContent> corpus;
  final IAudioRuntime audioRuntime;
  final LearnerRepository learnerRepository;
  final GamificationRepository gamificationRepository;
  final QuickReviewService quickReviewService;
  final ExplainerService explainerService;
  final String reviewSourceLanguageCode;
  final String reviewTranslationLanguageCode;
  final LifeTaskRouteRegistry? routeRegistry;
  final Phase6L10nController? localizationController;
  final String deckId;
  final int startTaskOrder;

  @override
  State<Phase3ProductionShell> createState() =>
      _Phase3ProductionShellState();
}

final class _Phase3ProductionShellState extends State<Phase3ProductionShell> {
  late final Phase6L10nController _l10n;
  late final bool _ownsL10n;
  late final LifeTaskRouteRegistry _routes;
  late final LifeCurriculumCatalog _catalog;
  late final List<VocabularyFlashcardProjection> _projections;
  late final Phase3AgentRuntime _runtime;
  late final HybridPronunciationService _pronunciationAudio;
  late final UniversalSessionOrchestrator _quickReviewOrchestrator;
  late final DailyDrillReviewSink _quickReviewSink;
  late final Future<Phase10PresentationBridge> _phase10BridgeFuture;
  late final List<CurriculumTask> _routedTasks;

  Phase3DesignProfile? _design;
  int _index = 0;
  bool _busy = false;
  String? _lastError;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _ownsL10n = widget.localizationController == null;
    _l10n = widget.localizationController ?? Phase6L10nController.standard();
    _routes = widget.routeRegistry ??
        LifeTaskRouteRegistry(localizationController: _l10n);
    _catalog = _routes.catalog;
    final routableTaskIds = _catalog.links
        .map((link) => link.curriculumTaskId)
        .toSet();
    _routedTasks = List<CurriculumTask>.unmodifiable(
      CanonicalCurriculum50.tasks.where(
        (task) =>
            task.order >= widget.startTaskOrder &&
            routableTaskIds.contains(task.id),
      ),
    );
    if (_routedTasks.isEmpty) {
      throw StateError(
        'No routable curriculum task exists at or after '
        'startTaskOrder=${widget.startTaskOrder}.',
      );
    }
    _index = widget.startTaskOrder > 1 ? 1 : 0;
    _projections = VocabularyProjectionFactory.fromContentList(widget.corpus);
    _runtime = Phase3AgentRuntime.start(
      catalog: _catalog,
      decks: VocabularyProjectionDeckRegistry(
        <String, List<VocabularyFlashcardProjection>>{
          widget.deckId: _projections,
        },
      ),
    );
    _pronunciationAudio = HybridPronunciationService(
      audioRuntime: widget.audioRuntime,
    );
    _quickReviewOrchestrator = UniversalSessionOrchestrator(
      repository: widget.learnerRepository,
    );
    _quickReviewSink = UniversalSessionDrillReviewSink(
      orchestrator: _quickReviewOrchestrator,
      gamificationRepository: widget.gamificationRepository,
    );
    _phase10BridgeFuture = Phase10PresentationBridge.start();
    unawaited(_loadDesign());
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _quickReviewOrchestrator.dispose();
    unawaited(_runtime.close());
    unawaited(
      _phase10BridgeFuture
          .then((bridge) => bridge.close())
          .catchError((_) {}),
    );
    if (_ownsL10n) {
      _l10n.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _loadDesign() async {
    try {
      final design = await _runtime.requestDesign();
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() => _design = design);
    } on Object catch (error) {
      _setError('error.design', error);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _openLifeTask(LifeCurriculumLink link) async {
    if (_busy) return;
    setState(() {
      _busy = true;
      _lastError = null;
    });
    try {
      final route = await _runtime.requestRoute(link.featureKey);
      if (!mounted) return;
      final builder = _routes.builderFor(route.featureKey);
      await Navigator.of(context).push<void>(
        MaterialPageRoute<void>(builder: builder),
      );
    } on Object catch (error) {
      _setError('error.task', error);
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _busy = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _openCards() async {
    if (_busy) return;
    setState(() {
      _busy = true;
      _lastError = null;
    });
    try {
      final ready = await _runtime.requestCards(widget.deckId);
      final presentationBridge = await _phase10BridgeFuture;
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (ready.cardCount != _projections.length) {
        throw StateError('Card deck count mismatch.');
      }
      await Navigator.of(context).push<void>(
        MaterialPageRoute<void>(
          builder: (_) => Directionality(
            textDirection: _l10n.textDirection,
            child: Phase3FlashcardDeckPage(
              title: _l10n.text('cards.title'),
              emptyText: _l10n.text('cards.empty'),
              projections: _projections,
              presentationBridge: presentationBridge,
              onAudio: (card, face) {
                final language = face == Flashcard3DFace.front
                    ? card.frontLanguageCode
                    : card.backLanguageCode;
                final targetLanguage = _l10n
                    .snapshot.targetLocale.languageCode
                    .toLowerCase()
                    .split(RegExp('[-_]'))
                    .first;
                final cardLanguage = language
                    .toLowerCase()
                    .split(RegExp('[-_]'))
                    .first;
                if (targetLanguage != cardLanguage) return;
                final text = face == Flashcard3DFace.front
                    ? card.frontText
                    : card.backText;
                unawaited(
                  _pronunciationAudio.play(
                    conceptId: card.id,
                    text: text,
                    languageCode: language,
                  ),
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
    } on Object catch (error) {
      _setError('error.cards', error);
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _busy = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _openQuickReview() async {
    if (_busy) return;
    setState(() {
      _busy = true;
      _lastError = null;
    });
    try {
      final learner = await widget.learnerRepository.reloadPersisted();
      final session = await widget.quickReviewService.buildSession(
        reviewCards: learner.reviewCards.values,
        now: DateTime.now(),
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      _quickReviewOrchestrator.resetSession();
      await Navigator.of(context).push<void>(
        MaterialPageRoute<void>(
          builder: (_) => SrsReviewHubScreen(
            session: session,
            reviewSink: _quickReviewSink,
            pronunciationAudio: _pronunciationAudio,
            explainerService: widget.explainerService,
            sourceLanguageCode: widget.reviewSourceLanguageCode,
            translationLanguageCode: widget.reviewTranslationLanguageCode,
          ),
        ),
      );
    } on Object catch (error) {
      _setError('error.cards', error);
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _busy = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _openLanguageSelection() => Navigator.of(context).push<void>(
        MaterialPageRoute<void>(
          builder: (_) => LanguageSelectionScreen(controller: _l10n),
        ),
      );

  void _setError(String key, Object error) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    final message = _l10n.text(
      key,
      arguments: <String, Object?>{'error': error.toString()},
    );
    setState(() => _lastError = message);
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(content: Text(message)),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AnimatedBuilder(
        animation: _l10n,
        builder: (context, _) {
          final tabs = <Widget>[
            _overviewTab(context),
            _curriculumTab(context),
            _lifeTab(context),
            _cardsTab(context),
          ];

          return Directionality(
            textDirection: _l10n.textDirection,
            child: Scaffold(
              appBar: AppBar(
                title: Text(_titleForIndex(_index)),
                actions: <Widget>[
                  IconButton(
                    tooltip: _l10n.text('action.languages'),
                    onPressed: _openLanguageSelection,
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.translate_rounded),
                  ),
                  if (_busy)
                    const Padding(
                      padding: EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(end: 16),
                      child: Center(
                        child: SizedBox.square(
                          dimension: 20,
                          child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
              body: IndexedStack(
                index: _index,
                children: tabs,
              ),
              bottomNavigationBar:
                  _design == null || _design!.navigation == 'bottom'
                      ? NavigationBar(
                          selectedIndex: _index,
                          onDestinationSelected: (value) =>
                              setState(() => _index = value),
                          destinations: <NavigationDestination>[
                            NavigationDestination(
                              icon: const Icon(Icons.home_outlined),
                              selectedIcon:
                                  const Icon(Icons.home_rounded),
                              label: _l10n.text('nav.home'),
                            ),
                            NavigationDestination(
                              icon: const Icon(Icons.route_outlined),
                              selectedIcon:
                                  const Icon(Icons.route_rounded),
                              label: _l10n.text('nav.curriculum'),
                            ),
                            NavigationDestination(
                              icon: const Icon(Icons.apps_outlined),
                              selectedIcon:
                                  const Icon(Icons.apps_rounded),
                              label: _l10n.text('nav.life'),
                            ),
                            NavigationDestination(
                              icon: const Icon(Icons.view_in_ar_outlined),
                              selectedIcon:
                                  const Icon(Icons.view_in_ar_rounded),
                              label: _l10n.text('nav.cards'),
                            ),
                          ],
                        )
                      : null,
            ),
          );
        },
      );

  Widget _overviewTab(BuildContext context) {
    final design = _design;
    return ListView(

  }

  Widget _curriculumTab(BuildContext context) =>
      FutureBuilder<Phase10PresentationBridge>(
        future: _phase10BridgeFuture,
        builder: (context, snapshot) {
          final bridge = snapshot.data;
          if (bridge == null) {
            return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
          }
          return Phase10TasksTrackView(
            initialSnapshot: bridge.progressSnapshot,
            progressStream: bridge.progressStream,
            fallbackSourceLanguageTag: _l10n.pair.source.id,
            fallbackTargetLanguageTag: _l10n.pair.target.id,
            tasks: _routedTasks,
            onTaskTap: _openCurriculumTask,
          );
        },
      );

  void _openCurriculumTask(CurriculumTask task) {
    final links = _catalog.links
        .where((link) => link.curriculumTaskId == task.id)
        .toList(growable: false);
    if (links.isEmpty || _busy) return;
    unawaited(_openLifeTask(links.first));
  }

  Widget _lifeTab(BuildContext context) => ListView.separated(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 12, 12, 24),
        itemCount: _catalog.links.length,
        separatorBuilder: (_, __) => const SizedBox(height: 8),
        itemBuilder: (context, index) {
          final link = _catalog.links[index];
          final directed = _l10n.curriculumPlan
              .taskByCanonicalId(link.curriculumTaskId);
          return Card(
            child: ListTile(
              leading: CircleAvatar(child: Text('${link.ordinal}')),
              title: Text(_lifeTitle(link)),
              subtitle: Text(
                _l10n.text(
                  'life.linked_lesson',
                  arguments: <String, Object?>{
                    'order': directed.task.order,
                    'title': _taskTitle(directed.task),
                  },
                ),
              ),
              trailing:
                  const Icon(Icons.arrow_forward_ios_rounded, size: 18),
              onTap: _busy ? null : () => _openLifeTask(link),
            ),
          );
        },
      );

  Widget _cardsTab(BuildContext context) => ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        children: <Widget>[
          Card(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  const Icon(Icons.view_in_ar_rounded, size: 56),

                  ),
                ],

                    languageCode: 'ar',
                    style: AppTypography.label,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      );

  String _taskTitle(CurriculumTask task) {
    final locale = _l10n.snapshot.userLocale.languageCode;
    return locale == 'ar' ? task.titleAr : task.titleDe;
  }

  String _lifeTitle(LifeCurriculumLink link) {
    final locale = _l10n.snapshot.userLocale.languageCode;
    return locale == 'ar' ? link.titleAr : link.titleDe;
  }

  String _titleForIndex(int index) => switch (index) {
        1 => _l10n.text('nav.curriculum'),
        2 => _l10n.text('nav.life'),
        3 => _l10n.text('nav.cards'),
        _ => _l10n.text('app.title'),
      };
}

final class _StatusCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _StatusCard({
    required this.icon,
    required this.title,
    required this.value,
    required this.detail,
  });

  final IconData icon;
  final String title;
  final String value;
  final String detail;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Card(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
          child: Row(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: <Widget>[
              Icon(icon, size: 32),
              const SizedBox(width: 14),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    Text(
                      title,
                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                    Text(
                      value,
                      style: Theme.of(context)
                          .textTheme
                          .headlineSmall
                          ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                    Text(detail),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
}

FILE: lib/ui/phase3/phase6_l10n_controller.dart

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../core/curriculum/canonical_curriculum_50.dart';
import '../../core/curriculum/omni_directional_matrix.dart';
import '../../core/l10n/l10n.dart';
import '../../core/orchestration/orchestration.dart';
import 'phase3_ui_dictionaries.dart';

final class Phase6L10nController extends ChangeNotifier {
  Phase6L10nController._({
    required this.matrix,
    required DynamicL10nEngine engine,
    required AgentEventBus eventBus,
    required OrchestrationKernel kernel,
    required AgentEndpoint requester,
    required L10nEventBridge bridge,
    required LocalizationDesignRoutingObservers observers,
  })  : _engine = engine,
        _eventBus = eventBus,
        _kernel = kernel,
        _requester = requester,
        _bridge = bridge,
        _observers = observers,
        _pair = matrix.requirePair(
          engine.snapshot.sourceLocale.languageCode,
          engine.snapshot.targetLocale.languageCode,
        ),
        _plan = PairAwareCurriculumPlan.build(
          pair: matrix.requirePair(
            engine.snapshot.sourceLocale.languageCode,
            engine.snapshot.targetLocale.languageCode,
          ),
          tasks: CanonicalCurriculum50.tasks,
        ) {
    _designSubscription = _observers.designChanges.listen(_onDesignChange);
    _routingSubscription = _observers.routingChanges.listen(_onRoutingChange);
  }

  factory Phase6L10nController.standard() {
    final matrix = OmniDirectionalLearningMatrix.standard20();
    final engine = DynamicL10nEngine(
      initialState: LocalizationState.fromLanguageTags(
        userLanguageTag: 'ar',
        sourceLanguageTag: 'ar',
        targetLanguageTag: 'de',
      ),
      fallbackLanguageTag: 'en',
      dictionaries: Phase3UiDictionaries.build(),
    );
    final eventBus = AgentEventBus();
    final kernel = OrchestrationKernel(
      eventBus: eventBus,
      services: ServiceContainer(),
    );
    final localizationEndpoint = kernel.connect(
      AgentDescriptor(
        id: 'phase6.localization-runtime',
        role: AgentRole.localization,
        subscriptions: const <String>{
          AgentTopics.localizationChangeRequested,
        },
      ),
    );
    final observers = LocalizationDesignRoutingObservers.connect(kernel);
    final requester = kernel.connect(
      AgentDescriptor(
        id: 'phase6.ui-language-selector',
        role: AgentRole.task,
        subscriptions: const <String>{AgentTopics.contextUpdated},
      ),
    );
    final bridge = L10nEventBridge(
      engine: engine,
      endpoint: localizationEndpoint,
    );

    return Phase6L10nController._(
      matrix: matrix,
      engine: engine,
      eventBus: eventBus,
      kernel: kernel,
      requester: requester,
      bridge: bridge,
      observers: observers,
    );
  }

  final OmniDirectionalLearningMatrix matrix;
  final DynamicL10nEngine _engine;
  final AgentEventBus _eventBus;
  final OrchestrationKernel _kernel;
  final AgentEndpoint _requester;
  final L10nEventBridge _bridge;
  final LocalizationDesignRoutingObservers _observers;

  late final StreamSubscription<AgentLocalizationState> _designSubscription;
  late final StreamSubscription<AgentLocalizationState> _routingSubscription;

  DirectedLanguagePair _pair;
  PairAwareCurriculumPlan _plan;
  AgentLocalizationState? _designState;
  AgentLocalizationState? _routingState;
  int _requestSequence = 0;
  bool _closed = false;

  L10nRuntimeSnapshot get snapshot => _engine.snapshot;
  DirectedLanguagePair get pair => _pair;
  PairAwareCurriculumPlan get curriculumPlan => _plan;
  AgentLocalizationState? get designState => _designState;
  AgentLocalizationState? get routingState => _routingState;
  bool get isClosed => _closed;

  TextDirection get textDirection =>
      snapshot.isRtl ? TextDirection.rtl : TextDirection.ltr;

  List<LearningLanguageIdentity> get languages => matrix.languages;

  String text(
    String key, {
    Map<String, Object?> arguments = const <String, Object?>{},
  }) =>
      _engine.uiText(key, arguments: arguments);

  LearningLanguageIdentity language(String id) =>
      matrix.requireLanguage(id);

  String languageLabel(String id) {
    final item = language(id);
    return '${item.nativeName} · ${item.englishName}';
  }

  void requestSelection({
    required String userLanguageId,
    required String sourceLanguageId,
    required String targetLanguageId,
  }) {
    _ensureOpen();

    final user = matrix.requireLanguage(userLanguageId);
    final pair = matrix.requirePair(
      sourceLanguageId,
      targetLanguageId,
    );

    _requestSequence += 1;
    _requester.publish(
      topic: AgentTopics.localizationChangeRequested,
      targetRoles: const <AgentRole>{AgentRole.localization},
      context: AgentContextSnapshot.empty(
        'phase6.language-selection.$_requestSequence',
      ),
      payload: <String, Object?>{
        'userLocale': user.id,
        'sourceLocale': pair.source.id,
        'targetLocale': pair.target.id,
      },
    );
  }

  void _onDesignChange(AgentLocalizationState state) {
    if (_closed) return;
    _designState = state;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void _onRoutingChange(AgentLocalizationState state) {
    if (_closed) return;
    _routingState = state;
    try {
      final nextPair = matrix.requirePair(
        state.sourceLocale,
        state.targetLocale,
      );
      _pair = nextPair;
      _plan = PairAwareCurriculumPlan.build(
        pair: nextPair,
        tasks: CanonicalCurriculum50.tasks,
      );
    } on ArgumentError {
      return;
    }
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> close() async {
    if (_closed) return;
    _closed = true;
    await _designSubscription.cancel();
    await _routingSubscription.cancel();
    await _observers.close();
    await _bridge.close();
    await _kernel.close();
    await _engine.close();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    unawaited(close());
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _ensureOpen() {
    if (_closed) {
      throw StateError('Phase6L10nController is closed.');
    }
    if (_eventBus.isClosed) {
      throw StateError('Phase6 localization EventBus facade is closed.');
    }
  }
}

FILE: lib/ui_v35/account_auth_page.dart
--------------------------------------------------

import '../design_system/design_system.dart';
import '../models/account_session.dart';
import '../services/authentication.dart';
import '../services/auth_session_controller.dart';

/// Account/authentication UI boundary.
///
/// This page intentionally depends only on transient authentication state.
/// Learner data, subscriptions, credentials, and network transports remain
/// outside the presentation layer.
class AccountPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const AccountPage({super.key, required this.auth});

  final AuthSessionController auth;

  @override
  State<AccountPage> createState() => _AccountPageState();
}

class _AccountPageState extends State<AccountPage> {
  final _emailController = TextEditingController();
  final _otpController = TextEditingController();
  bool _busy = false;
  bool _otpRequested = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    widget.auth.addListener(_onAuthChanged);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    widget.auth.removeListener(_onAuthChanged);
    _emailController.dispose();
    _otpController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onAuthChanged() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  Future<void> _requestOtp() async {
    final email = _emailController.text.trim();
    if (!_validEmail(email)) {
      _showMessage('أدخل بريدًا إلكترونيًا صالحًا.');
      return;
    }
    await _runBusy(() => widget.auth.requestEmailOtp(email: email));
    if (mounted && widget.auth.lastFailure == null) {
      setState(() => _otpRequested = true);
      _showMessage('تم طلب رمز التحقق.');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _verifyOtp() async {
    final email = _emailController.text.trim();
    final otp = _otpController.text.trim();
    if (!_validEmail(email)) {
      _showMessage('أدخل بريدًا إلكترونيًا صالحًا.');
      return;
    }
    if (otp.isEmpty) {
      _showMessage('أدخل رمز التحقق.');
      return;
    }
    await _runBusy(
      () => widget.auth.signInWithEmailOtp(email: email, otp: otp),
    );
    if (mounted && widget.auth.session.isAuthenticated) {
      _otpController.clear();
      setState(() => _otpRequested = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _runBusy(Future<void> Function() operation) async {
    if (_busy) return;
    setState(() => _busy = true);
    try {
      await operation();
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _busy = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _renewSession() async {
    await _runBusy(widget.auth.renewSession);
  }

  Future<void> _signOut() async {
    await _runBusy(widget.auth.signOut);
  }

  bool _validEmail(String value) {
    return value.contains('@') &&
        value.indexOf('@') > 0 &&
        value.indexOf('@') < value.length - 1;
  }

  void _showMessage(String message) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: AppDirectionalText(
          message,
          languageCode: 'ar',
          style: AppTypography.body,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final session = widget.auth.session;
    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: AppDirectionalText(
            'الملف الشخصي والحساب',
            languageCode: 'ar',
            style: AppTypography.title,
          ),
        ),
        body: ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
          children: <Widget>[
            _profileSummary(session),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            if (!widget.auth.isInitialized)
              AppGlassCard(
                glowColor: AppColors.primary,
                child: Row(
                  children: <Widget>[
                    const CircularProgressIndicator(),
                    const SizedBox(width: 14),
                    Expanded(
                      child: AppDirectionalText(
                        'جارٍ التحقق من حالة الحساب...',
                        languageCode: 'ar',
                        style: AppTypography.body,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              )
            else if (session.isAuthenticated)
              _authenticatedView(context, session)
            else
              _signInView(context),
            if (widget.auth.lastFailure != null) ...<Widget>[
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              AppGlassCard(
                glowColor: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error,
                child: Row(

  }

    return Column(
      children: <Widget>[
        AppGlassCard(
          glowColor: AppColors.primary,
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,

                'تسجيل الدخول',
                languageCode: 'ar',
                style: AppTypography.title,

                keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress,
                textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                style: AppTypography.body,
                autofillHints: const <String>[AutofillHints.email],
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  label: AppDirectionalText(
                    'البريد الإلكتروني',
                    languageCode: 'ar',
                    style: AppTypography.label,
                  ),
                  border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              FilledButton.icon(
                onPressed: _busy ? null : _requestOtp,
                icon: const Icon(Icons.mark_email_read_outlined),
                label: AppDirectionalText(
                  'إرسال رمز التحقق',
                  languageCode: 'ar',
                  style: AppTypography.label,
                ),
              ),
              if (_otpRequested) ...<Widget>[
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                TextField(
                  controller: _otpController,
                  keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                  textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                  style: AppTypography.body,
                  obscureText: true,
                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                    label: AppDirectionalText(
                      'رمز التحقق',
                      languageCode: 'ar',
                      style: AppTypography.label,
                    ),
                    border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                FilledButton(
                  onPressed: _busy ? null : _verifyOtp,
                  child: AppDirectionalText(
                    'تأكيد وتسجيل الدخول',
                    languageCode: 'ar',
                    style: AppTypography.label,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ],
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        AppGlassCard(

                style: AppTypography.title,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              OutlinedButton.icon(
                onPressed:
                    _busy ? null : () => _runBusy(widget.auth.signInWithGoogle),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.g_mobiledata),
                label: AppDirectionalText(
                  'المتابعة باستخدام Google',
                  languageCode: 'ar',
                  style: AppTypography.label,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              OutlinedButton.icon(
                onPressed:
                    _busy ? null : () => _runBusy(widget.auth.signInWithApple),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.apple),
                label: AppDirectionalText(
                  'المتابعة باستخدام Apple',
                  languageCode: 'ar',
                  style: AppTypography.label,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  String _failureMessage(AuthenticationFailureCode code) {
    switch (code) {
      case AuthenticationFailureCode.cancelled:
        return 'تم إلغاء العملية.';
      case AuthenticationFailureCode.invalidCredential:
        return 'بيانات التحقق غير صالحة.';
      case AuthenticationFailureCode.expiredCredential:
        return 'انتهت صلاحية بيانات التحقق. أعد المحاولة.';
      case AuthenticationFailureCode.invalidSession:
        return 'انتهت صلاحية الجلسة. سجّل الدخول مرة أخرى.';
      case AuthenticationFailureCode.rateLimited:
        return 'تم تجاوز عدد المحاولات المسموح به. حاول لاحقًا.';
      case AuthenticationFailureCode.providerRejected:
        return 'رفض مزود تسجيل الدخول العملية.';
      case AuthenticationFailureCode.retryable:
        return 'تعذر إتمام العملية مؤقتًا. حاول مرة أخرى.';
      case AuthenticationFailureCode.unavailable:
        return 'خدمة تسجيل الدخول غير متاحة في هذه النسخة.';
    }
  }
}

class SettingsV35 extends StatelessWidget {
  final LearnerRepository repo;
  final PrivacySettingsStore privacySettings;
  final NeuroAccessibilitySettings? neuroSettings;
  final VoidCallback? onCleared;
  const SettingsV35({
    super.key,
    required this.repo,
    required this.privacySettings,
    this.neuroSettings,
    this.onCleared,
  });
  Future<void> _reset(BuildContext context) async {
    final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (d) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('مسح التقدم؟'),
        content: const Text(
          'سيتم حذف XP والمراجعات والمحاولات والمفضلة من هذا الجهاز فقط. لا يمكن التراجع عن العملية.',
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(d, false),
            child: const Text('إلغاء'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(d, true),
            child: const Text('مسح'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (ok == true) {
      final cleared = await repo.clearLocalData();
      if (cleared) {
        onCleared?.call();
        if (context.mounted)
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            const SnackBar(content: Text('تم حذف بيانات التعلم المحلية.')),
          );
      } else if (context.mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text('تعذر حذف بيانات التعلم المحلية بالكامل.'),
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext c) => Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('الإعدادات والخصوصية')),
        body: ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
          children: [
            Card(
              child: ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(Icons.language),
                title: const Text('Target Language'),
                trailing: DropdownButton<AppTargetLanguage>(
                  value: AppTargetLanguage.german,
                  underline: const SizedBox(),
                  items: AppTargetLanguage.values.map((lang) {
                    return DropdownMenuItem(
                      value: lang,
                      child: Text(lang.name.toUpperCase()),
                    );
                  }).toList(),
                  onChanged: (newLang) {},
                ),
              ),
            ),
            if (neuroSettings != null)
              Card(
                child: ListenableBuilder(
                  listenable: neuroSettings!,
                  builder: (context, _) => SwitchListTile(
                    title: const Text('وضعية التيسير المعرفي'),
                    subtitle: const Text(
                      'تحسين تباعد الأحرف وتبسيط الواجهة لتقليل الإجهاد البصري.',
                    ),
                    value: neuroSettings!.isEnabled,
                    onChanged: (val) => neuroSettings!.setEnabled(val),
                    secondary: const Icon(Icons.accessibility_new_outlined),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            const Card(
              child: ListTile(
                leading: Icon(Icons.lock_outline),
                title: Text('الخصوصية'),
                subtitle: Text(
                  'التقدم والمحاولات محفوظة محليًا. لا توجد مزامنة سحابية ولا اتصال شبكي للتطبيق.',
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const Card(
              child: ListTile(
                leading: Icon(Icons.offline_bolt_outlined),
                title: Text('Offline'),
                subtitle: Text('المحتوى والجلسات والتقدم وTTS تعمل محليًا.'),
              ),
            ),
            Card(
              child: ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(Icons.description_outlined),
                title: const Text('تراخيص المصادر المفتوحة'),
                subtitle: const Text(
                  'اعرض تراخيص وملاحظات المكونات مفتوحة المصدر المستخدمة في التطبيق.',
                ),
                onTap: () => showLicensePage(
                  context: c,
                  applicationName: 'Deutsch بالعربي',
                  applicationVersion: '3.3.10',
                ),
              ),
            ),
            Card(
              child: ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(Icons.auto_awesome),
                title: const Text('AI Teacher'),
                subtitle: Text(AiTeacherContract.rules.join('\\n')),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            OutlinedButton.icon(
              onPressed: () => _reset(c),
              icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline),
              label: const Text('مسح بيانات التعلم من الجهاز'),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            if (adminToolsEnabled)
              FilledButton.icon(
                onPressed: () => Navigator.push(
                  c,
                  MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const QualityV35()),
                ),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.admin_panel_settings_outlined),
                label: const Text('مركز الجودة'),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

Widget rtlAppBuilder(BuildContext context, Widget? child) => Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: child ?? const SizedBox.shrink(),
    );

final class _PreferenceTextScaler extends TextScaler {
  const _PreferenceTextScaler(this.base, this.factor);

  final TextScaler base;
  final double factor;

  @override
  double scale(double fontSize) => base.scale(fontSize) * factor;

  @override
  double get textScaleFactor => scale(14) / 14;

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      identical(this, other) ||
      other is _PreferenceTextScaler &&
          other.base == base &&
          other.factor == factor;

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(base, factor);
}

class DeutschAppV35 extends StatefulWidget {
  final LearnerRepository repo;
  final AuthSessionController auth;
  final AppDependencies<ContentItem> dependencies;
  const DeutschAppV35(
    this.repo, {
    required this.auth,
    required this.dependencies,
    super.key,
  });
  @override
  State<DeutschAppV35> createState() => _AppState();
}

class _AppState extends State<DeutschAppV35> {
  bool dark = false;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    widget.dependencies.audioRuntime.shutdown();
    widget.dependencies.sourceAudioRuntime.shutdown();
    widget.dependencies.gamificationRepository.close();
    widget.dependencies.errorPatternAgent?.dispose();
    widget.dependencies.settingsController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext c) => ListenableBuilder(
        listenable: Listenable.merge(<Listenable>[
          widget.dependencies.neuroSettings,
          widget.dependencies.settingsController,
        ]),
        builder: (context, child) {
          final isNeuroMode = widget.dependencies.neuroSettings.isEnabled;

          ThemeData lightTheme = AppDesignSystem.light();
          ThemeData darkTheme = AppDesignSystem.dark();

          if (isNeuroMode) {
            lightTheme = lightTheme.applyNeuroAccessibility();
            darkTheme = darkTheme.applyNeuroAccessibility();
          }

          return NeuroAccessibilityMode(
            isEnabled: isNeuroMode,
            child: MaterialApp(
              debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
              title: 'Deutsch بالعربي',
              themeMode: dark ? ThemeMode.dark : ThemeMode.light,
              theme: lightTheme,
              darkTheme: darkTheme,
              builder: (builderContext, child) {
                final media = MediaQuery.of(builderContext);
                final scale = widget
                    .dependencies.settingsController.preferences.textScaleFactor;
                return Directionality(
                  textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                  child: MediaQuery(
                    data: media.copyWith(
                      textScaler: _PreferenceTextScaler(media.textScaler, scale),
                    ),
                    child: child ?? const SizedBox.shrink(),
                  ),
                );
              },
              routes: <String, WidgetBuilder>{
                FurnitureHomeSetupModule.routeName: (_) =>
                    FurnitureHomeMasterScreen(
                  module: widget.dependencies.furnitureHomeSetupModule,
                ),
                PostalDeliveryModule.routeName: (_) => PostalDeliveryMasterHub(
                      orchestrator: widget.dependencies.postalDeliveryModule
                          .createOrchestrator(),
                    ),
                HaircutBarbershopModule.routeName: (_) =>
                    HaircutMasterScreen(
                  module: widget.dependencies.haircutBarbershopModule,
                ),
              },
              home: HomeV35(
                repo: widget.repo,
                auth: widget.auth,
                dependencies: widget.dependencies,
                onTheme: () => setState(() => dark = !dark),
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      );
}

  final LearnerRepository repo;

    super.key,

class _HomeState extends State<HomeV35> {
  late LearnerState state;
  late Future<GamificationSnapshot> _homeGamification;
  int tab = 0;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    state = widget.repo.load();
    _homeGamification =
        widget.dependencies.gamificationRepository.loadSnapshot();
  }

  void refresh() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      state = widget.repo.load();
      _homeGamification =
          widget.dependencies.gamificationRepository.loadSnapshot();
    });
  }

  Widget _tabForIndex(BuildContext c, int index) {
    switch (index) {
      case 1:
        return _learnTab(c);
      case 2:
        return _practiceTab(c);
      case 3:
        return this._progressTab(c);
      case 4:
        return _practiceTab(c);
      case 0:
      default:
        return _homeTab(c);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext c) {
    return Scaffold(
      extendBody: true,
      appBar: tab == 0
          ? null
          : AppBar(
              title: const Text('Deutsch بالعربي'),
              actions: [
                IconButton(
                  tooltip: 'تغيير المظهر',
                  onPressed: widget.onTheme,
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.dark_mode_outlined),
                ),
                IconButton(
                  tooltip: 'الحساب',
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.push(
                    c,
                    MaterialPageRoute(
                      builder: (_) => AccountPage(auth: widget.auth),
                    ),
                  ),
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.account_circle_outlined),
                ),
                IconButton(
                  tooltip: 'الاشتراك والباقات',
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.push(
                    c,
                    MaterialPageRoute(
                      builder: (_) => SubscriptionPage(repo: widget.repo),
                    ),
                  ),
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.workspace_premium_outlined),
                ),
                IconButton(
                  tooltip: 'الإعدادات',
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.push(
                    c,
                    MaterialPageRoute(
                      builder: (_) => AppSettingsScreen(
                        notifier: widget.dependencies.settingsController,
                        accessibilityListenable: widget.dependencies.neuroSettings,
                        cognitiveAccessibilityEnabled:
                            () => widget.dependencies.neuroSettings.isEnabled,
                        onCognitiveAccessibilityChanged:
                            widget.dependencies.neuroSettings.setEnabled,
                        onProgressReset: refresh,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.settings_outlined),
                ),
              ],
            ),
      body: Semantics(
        label: 'محتوى الصفحة الرئيسية',
        child: ColoredBox(
          color: Theme.of(c).scaffoldBackgroundColor,
          child: _tabForIndex(c, tab),
        ),
      ),
      bottomNavigationBar: ReferenceFloatingNavigationBar(
        selectedIndex: tab,
        onSelected: (i) {

            );
            return;

    );
  }

      state.attempts,
      state.assessmentHistory,

        future: _homeGamification,

              snapshot.data?.profile ?? const GamificationProfile();

          return ListView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 18, 18, 112),

            children: <Widget>[
              HomeProgressHero(

      ),

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class ContextualExamplesDrawer extends StatelessWidget {
  final List<String> examples;

  const ContextualExamplesDrawer({super.key, required this.examples});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Drawer(
      child: Directionality(
        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
        child: SafeArea(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text(
                  'أمثلة سياقية',
                  style: Theme.of(context)
                      .textTheme
                      .titleLarge
                      ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                if (examples.isEmpty)
                  const Text('لا توجد أمثلة متاحة.')
                else
                  ...examples.map(
                    (ex) => Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12.0),
                      child: Text(
                        ex,
                        style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16),
                        textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

/// A responsive wrapper layout enforcing neuro-ergonomic constraints.
///
/// It utilizes [SafeArea] to prevent UI clipping from notches/system UI.
/// It wraps its content in a [ConstrainedBox] to apply max-width constraints
/// (to maintain comfortable reading line lengths on tablets/landscape).
/// The inner content is placed within a scrollable thumb-zone container
/// ([SingleChildScrollView] by default, though content can dictate otherwise)
/// to prevent overflow issues on small devices.
class ResponsiveNeuroLayout extends StatelessWidget {
  final Widget child;
  final double maxWidth;
  final bool scrollable;

  /// Creates a [ResponsiveNeuroLayout].
  ///
  /// [maxWidth] defaults to 600.0, which is an optimal reading width for neuro-ergonomic design.
  /// If [scrollable] is true (the default), the layout injects a [SingleChildScrollView].
  const ResponsiveNeuroLayout({
    super.key,
    required this.child,
    this.maxWidth = 600.0,
    this.scrollable = true,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    Widget content = scrollable
        ? SingleChildScrollView(
            child: Padding(
              // Ensure thumb-zone padding at the bottom (ergonomic reach).
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 80.0),
              child: child,
            ),
          )
        : child;

    return SafeArea(
      child: Center(
        child: ConstrainedBox(
          constraints: BoxConstraints(maxWidth: maxWidth),
          child: content,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class WritingCoachPage extends StatefulWidget {
  final LearnerRepository repo;
  final VoidCallback onDone;
  final LanguageTextNormalizer textNormalizer;
  final AiGateway aiGateway;
  final PrivacySettingsStore privacySettings;
  const WritingCoachPage({
    super.key,
    required this.repo,
    required this.onDone,
    required this.textNormalizer,
    required this.aiGateway,
    required this.privacySettings,
  });
  @override
  State<WritingCoachPage> createState() => _WritingCoachState();
}

class _WritingCoachState extends State<WritingCoachPage> {
  String text = '';
  String feedback = '';
  bool checked = false, loading = false;
  Future<void> check() async {
    final t = text.trim();
    final issues = <String>[
      for (final issue in WritingAnalyzer.analyze(
        t,
        textNormalizer: widget.textNormalizer,
      ))
        issue.message,
    ];
    if (issues.isEmpty) {
      final cloud = await widget.privacySettings.cloudAiEnabled();
      if (cloud && widget.aiGateway.enabled) {
        setState(() => loading = true);
        try {
          final result = await widget.aiGateway.reviewWriting(t);
          if (!mounted) return;
          setState(
            () => feedback = (result.corrected.isEmpty
                    ? ''
                    : 'التصحيح المقترح: ${result.corrected}\n') +
                (result.issues.isEmpty
                    ? 'لا توجد مشكلات واضحة.'
                    : result.issues.join('\n')) +
                '\n' +
                result.explanation,
          );
          return;
        } catch (_) {
          issues.add('تعذر الوصول إلى المراجعة السحابية؛ عُدنا للفحص المحلي.');
        } finally {
          if (mounted) setState(() => loading = false);
        }
      }
    }
    if (!mounted) return;
    for (final issue in issues.where((x) => !x.startsWith('اكتب جملة'))) {
      await widget.repo.recordWritingMistake(issue: issue);
    }
    setState(() {
      checked = true;
      feedback = issues.isEmpty
          ? 'الجملة تبدو سليمة مبدئيًا. يمكنك تفعيل AI السحابي اختياريًا للحصول على شرح أعمق.'
          : issues.join('\n');
      loading = false;
    });
    widget.onDone();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext c) => Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('تصحيح الكتابة')),
        body: ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
          children: [
            const Text(
              'فحص محلي أولًا. أخطاء الكتابة تدخل الآن في مدرب الأخطاء حتى تتحول إلى تدريب علاجي.',
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            TextField(
              onChanged: (v) => text = v,
              textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
              minLines: 3,
              maxLines: 6,
              decoration: const InputDecoration(
                border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                labelText: 'الجملة بالألمانية',
                hintText: 'Ich lerne Deutsch.',
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            FilledButton.icon(
              onPressed: loading ? null : check,
              icon: Icon(loading ? Icons.hourglass_top : Icons.check),
              label: Text(loading ? 'جارٍ الفحص' : 'افحص الجملة'),
            ),
            if (checked || feedback.isNotEmpty)
              Card(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
                  child: Text(feedback),
                ),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

class ConversationPage extends StatefulWidget {
