class _ConversationPageState extends State<ConversationPage> {
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext c) => Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('المحادثة')),
        body: Builder(
          builder: (BuildContext context) {
            final scenarios = ConversationEngine(
              exerciseStrategy: widget.exerciseStrategy,
              textNormalizer: widget.textNormalizer,
            ).scenarios;
            return ListView.builder(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
              itemCount: scenarios.length + 3,
              itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                if (index == 0) {
                  return Card(
                    child: ListTile(
                      leading: const Icon(Icons.record_voice_over_outlined),
                      title: const Text('محادثة صوتية واقعية'),
                      subtitle: Text(
                        widget.presentation.conversation
                            .targetLanguageInstruction,
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                }
                if (index == 1) {
                  return const SizedBox(height: 8);
                }
                if (index == scenarios.length + 2) {
                  return Column(
                    children: [
                      const SizedBox(height: 8),
                      OutlinedButton.icon(
                        onPressed: () => Navigator.push(
                          c,
                          MaterialPageRoute(
                            builder: (_) => AiConversationPage(
                              scenario: 'محادثة عامة',
                              aiGateway: widget.aiGateway,
                              privacySettings: widget.privacySettings,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.auto_awesome_outlined),
                        label: const Text('المحادثة النصية مع AI الاختياري'),
                      ),
                    ],
                  );
                }
                final scenarioIndex = index - 2;
                final x = scenarios[scenarioIndex];
                return Card(
                  child: ListTile(
                    leading: const Icon(Icons.forum_outlined),
                    title: Text(x.title),
                    subtitle: Text('${x.situation}\n${x.turns.length} جولات'),
                    isThreeLine: true,
                    onTap: () => Navigator.push(
                      c,
                      MaterialPageRoute(
                        builder: (_) => VoiceConversationPage(
                          repo: widget.repo,
                          onDone: widget.onDone,
                          scenario: x,
                          exerciseStrategy: widget.exerciseStrategy,
                          presentation: widget.presentation,
                          textNormalizer: widget.textNormalizer,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                );
              },
            );
          },
        ),
      );
}

class VoiceConversationPage extends StatefulWidget {
  final LearnerRepository repo;
  final VoidCallback onDone;
  final ConversationScenario? scenario;
  final LanguageExerciseStrategy exerciseStrategy;
  final LanguagePresentation presentation;
  final LanguageTextNormalizer textNormalizer;
  const VoiceConversationPage({
    super.key,
    required this.repo,
    required this.onDone,
    required this.exerciseStrategy,
    required this.presentation,
    required this.textNormalizer,
    this.scenario,
  });
  @override
  State<VoiceConversationPage> createState() => _VoiceConversationState();
}

class _VoiceConversationState extends State<VoiceConversationPage> {
  final SpeechService speech = SpeechService();
  final SafeTtsController tts = SafeTtsController();
  late ConversationScenario scenario;
  int turnIndex = 0;
  String heard = '';
  String status = '';
  bool listening = false, scored = false;
  bool saving = false;
  bool speechBusy = false;
  ConversationScore? score;
  final scores = <ConversationScore>[];

  ConversationTurn get turn => scenario.turns.isEmpty
      ? widget.presentation.conversation.fallbackScenario.turns.first
      : scenario.turns[turnIndex.clamp(0, scenario.turns.length - 1)];

  ConversationScenario _safeScenario(ConversationScenario? candidate) {
    if (candidate != null && candidate.turns.isNotEmpty) return candidate;
    for (final item in ConversationEngine(
      exerciseStrategy: widget.exerciseStrategy,
      textNormalizer: widget.textNormalizer,
    ).scenarios) {
      if (item.turns.isNotEmpty) return item;
    }
    return widget.presentation.conversation.fallbackScenario;
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    scenario = _safeScenario(widget.scenario);
    status = widget.presentation.conversation.defaultSpeechStatus;
    _speakPrompt();
  }

  Future<void> _speakPrompt() => tts.speak(turn.promptGerman, rate: .43);

  Future<void> _toggleListening() async {
    if (speechBusy) return;
    if (scored || saving) return;
    speechBusy = true;
    try {
      if (listening) {
        await speech.stop();
        if (mounted) setState(() => listening = false);
        return;
      }
      if (mounted) setState(() => status = 'أستمع... تحدث بجملة كاملة.');
      final ok = await speech.listen(
        onResult: (r) {
          if (!mounted) return;
          setState(() => heard = r.recognizedWords);
          if (r.finalResult) {
            speech.stop();
            if (mounted) setState(() => listening = false);
          }
        },
      );
      if (mounted) setState(() => listening = ok);
      if (!ok && mounted)
        setState(
          () => status = widget.presentation.conversation.speechPermissionError,
        );
    } finally {
      speechBusy = false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _score() async {
    if (scored || saving) return;
    if (listening) {
      await speech.stop();
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() => listening = false);
    }
    final value = ConversationEngine(
      exerciseStrategy: widget.exerciseStrategy,
      textNormalizer: widget.textNormalizer,
    ).score(turn, heard);
    setState(() {
      score = value;
      scored = true;
      status = value.correct
          ? 'إجابة جيدة. انتقل للجولة التالية.'
          : 'اقتربت. راجع الكلمات الناقصة ثم أعد المحاولة أو تابع.';
    });
    await widget.repo.recordConversationAttempt(
      itemId: turn.id,
      skill: turn.skill,
      answer: heard,
      correct: value.correct,
      seconds: 20,
      hinted: false,
    );
    if (!mounted) return;
    widget.onDone();
  }

  void _retry() {
    setState(() {
      heard = '';
      score = null;
      scored = false;
      status = 'استمع للسؤال ثم أجب من جديد.';
    });
    _speakPrompt();
  }

  void _next() {
    final currentScore = score;
    if (!scored || currentScore == null || saving || !mounted) return;
    if (turnIndex + 1 >= scenario.turns.length) {
      Navigator.pushReplacement(
        context,
        MaterialPageRoute(
          builder: (_) => VoiceConversationResultPage(
            scenario: scenario,
            scores: List.of(scores)..add(currentScore),
            onDone: widget.onDone,
          ),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }
    setState(() {
      scores.add(currentScore);
      turnIndex++;
      heard = '';
      score = null;
      scored = false;
      status = widget.presentation.conversation.defaultSpeechStatus;
    });
    _speakPrompt();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    speech.dispose();
    tts.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext c) {
    final currentScore = score;
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(
          '${scenario.title} • ${turnIndex + 1}/${scenario.turns.length}',
        ),
      ),
      body: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
        children: [
          LinearProgressIndicator(
            value: (turnIndex + 1) / scenario.turns.length,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 18),
          Text('الموقف', style: Theme.of(c).textTheme.labelLarge),
          Text(
            scenario.situation,
            style: Theme.of(c)
                .textTheme
                .titleMedium
                ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 18),
          Card(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text('الطرف الآخر', style: Theme.of(c).textTheme.labelLarge),
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  Text(
                    turn.promptGerman,
                    textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                    style: Theme.of(c)
                        .textTheme
                        .headlineSmall
                        ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 5),
                  Text(turn.promptArabic),
                  Align(
                    alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
                    child: IconButton(
                      tooltip: 'استمع للجملة',
                      onPressed: _speakPrompt,
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.volume_up_outlined),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          Card(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    heard.isEmpty ? 'لم يتم التقاط كلامك بعد.' : heard,
                    textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 19,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 7),
                  Text(status),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  FilledButton.icon(
                    onPressed: scored ? null : _toggleListening,
                    icon: Icon(listening ? Icons.stop : Icons.mic),
                    label: Text(
                      listening
                          ? 'إيقاف التسجيل'
                          : 'تحدث ${widget.presentation.conversation.targetLanguageName}',
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  OutlinedButton.icon(
                    onPressed: (!listening &&
                            heard.trim().isNotEmpty &&
                            !scored &&
                            !saving)
                        ? _score
                        : null,
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.check_circle_outline),
                    label: const Text('قيّم الإجابة'),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          if (scored && currentScore != null) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            Card(
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      '${currentScore.value}%',
                      style: Theme.of(c)
                          .textTheme
                          .displaySmall
                          ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                    ),
                    Text(
                      currentScore.correct
                          ? 'المعنى الأساسي وصل بشكل جيد.'
                          : 'المعنى لم يكتمل بعد.',
                    ),
                    if (currentScore.matchedKeywords.isNotEmpty)
                      Text(
                        'تم التقاط: ${currentScore.matchedKeywords.join(' • ')}',
                      ),
                    if (currentScore.missingKeywords.isNotEmpty)
                      Text(
                        'تحتاج: ${currentScore.missingKeywords.join(' • ')}',
                      ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    Text(
                      'النموذج: ${safeFirst(turn.expected) ?? 'لا يوجد نموذج متاح'}',
                      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: OutlinedButton(
                    onPressed: _retry,
                    child: const Text('أعد المحاولة'),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                Expanded(
                  child: FilledButton(
                    onPressed: _next,
                    child: Text(
                      turnIndex + 1 >= scenario.turns.length
                          ? 'النتيجة'
                          : 'التالي',
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          const Text(
            'التقييم محلي: لا يتم إرسال تسجيلك أو النص إلى خادم AI. جودة التعرف تعتمد على محرك الكلام في الجهاز.',
            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class VoiceConversationResultPage extends StatelessWidget {
  final ConversationScenario scenario;
  final List<ConversationScore> scores;
  final VoidCallback onDone;
  const VoiceConversationResultPage({
    super.key,
    required this.scenario,
    required this.scores,
    required this.onDone,
  });
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext c) {
    final total = scores.fold<int>(0, (a, b) => a + b.value);
    final average = scores.isEmpty ? 0 : (total / scores.length).round();
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('نتيجة المحادثة')),
      body: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
        children: [
          Card(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(22),
              child: Column(
                children: [
                  Text(
                    '$average%',
                    style: Theme.of(c)
                        .textTheme
                        .displaySmall
                        ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  Text(
                    '${scores.where((x) => x.correct).length}/${scores.length} جولات ناجحة',
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  Text(
                    average >= 85
                        ? 'ممتاز. يمكنك رفع صعوبة الموقف.'
                        : average >= 67
                            ? 'جيد. أعد الجولات الضعيفة مرة أخرى.'
                            : 'سنحوّل الكلمات الناقصة إلى تدريب علاجي.',
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          ...scores.asMap().entries.map(
                (e) => Card(
                  child: ListTile(
                    leading: CircleAvatar(child: Text('${e.key + 1}')),
                    title: Text('${e.value.value}%'),
                    subtitle: Text(
                      e.value.missingKeywords.isEmpty
                          ? 'لا توجد كلمات ناقصة.'
                          : 'تحتاج: ${e.value.missingKeywords.join(' • ')}',
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          FilledButton.icon(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(c),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.mic),
            label: const Text('العودة إلى المحادثات'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class AiConversationPage extends StatefulWidget {
  final String scenario;
  final AiGateway aiGateway;
  final PrivacySettingsStore privacySettings;
  const AiConversationPage({
    super.key,
    required this.scenario,
    required this.aiGateway,
    required this.privacySettings,
  });
  @override
  State<AiConversationPage> createState() => _AiConversationState();
}

class _AiConversationState extends State<AiConversationPage> {
  final input = TextEditingController();
  final messages = <String>[];
  bool loading = false;
  Future<void> send() async {
    final text = input.text.trim();
    if (text.isEmpty || loading) return;
    setState(() {
      messages.add('أنت: $text');
      input.clear();
      loading = true;
    });
    try {
      final enabled = await widget.privacySettings.cloudAiEnabled();
      if (enabled && widget.aiGateway.enabled) {
        try {
          final reply = await widget.aiGateway.continueConversation(
            scenario: widget.scenario,
            message: text,
          );
          if (mounted) setState(() => messages.add('المدرس: $reply'));
        } catch (_) {
          if (mounted)
            setState(
              () => messages.add(
                'المدرس: تعذر الاتصال الآن. أكمل بالمحتوى المحلي أو حاول لاحقًا.',
              ),
            );
        }
      } else {
        if (mounted)
          setState(
            () => messages.add(
              'المدرس: الوضع المحلي لا يحتاج إنترنت. اختر جملة من أمثلة الموقف وجرّب إعادة صياغتها.',
            ),
          );
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted)
        setState(
          () => messages.add('المدرس: تعذر قراءة إعدادات الاتصال الآن.'),
        );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => loading = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    input.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext c) => Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(title: Text(widget.scenario)),
        body: Column(
          children: [
            Expanded(
              child: ListView.builder(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
                itemCount: messages.length,
                itemBuilder: (_, i) => Card(
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                    child: Text(messages[i], textDirection: TextDirection.ltr),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: TextField(
                      controller: input,
                      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(
                        border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                        labelText: 'ردك بالألمانية',
                        hintText: 'اكتب ردك بالألمانية',
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  IconButton(
                    tooltip: 'إرسال الرسالة إلى المدرس',
                    onPressed: loading ? null : send,
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.send),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

import 'dart:math';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class FlashcardWidget extends StatefulWidget {
  final String frontText;
  final String backText;
  final String? article;
  final VoidCallback onAudio;
  final Widget? trailing;

  const FlashcardWidget({
    super.key,
    required this.frontText,
    required this.backText,
    this.article,
    required this.onAudio,
    this.trailing,
  });

  @override
  State<FlashcardWidget> createState() => _FlashcardWidgetState();
}

class _FlashcardWidgetState extends State<FlashcardWidget>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late AnimationController _controller;
  bool _isFront = true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _controller = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _flip() {
    if (_isFront) {
      _controller.forward();
    } else {
      _controller.reverse();
    }
    _isFront = !_isFront;
  }

  Color _getArticleColor() {
    switch (widget.article?.toLowerCase() ?? "") {
      case 'der':
        return const Color(0xFF2563EB); // Slate Blue
      case 'die':
        return const Color(0xFFE11D48); // Soft Crimson
      case 'das':
        return const Color(0xFF0D9488); // Deep Teal
      case 'plural':
        return const Color(0xFF7C3AED); // Muted Violet
      default:
        return Colors.grey;
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: _flip,
      child: AnimatedBuilder(
        animation: _controller,
        builder: (context, child) {
          final angle = _controller.value * pi;
          final transform = Matrix4.identity()
            ..setEntry(3, 2, 0.001)
            ..rotateY(angle);

          final isFrontVisible = angle <= pi / 2;

          return Transform(
            transform: transform,
            alignment: Alignment.center,
            child: isFrontVisible
                ? _buildFront()
                : Transform(
                    transform: Matrix4.identity()..rotateY(pi),
                    alignment: Alignment.center,
                    child: _buildBack(),
                  ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildFront() {
    final articleColor = widget.article != null && widget.article!.isNotEmpty
        ? _getArticleColor()
        : Colors.transparent;

    return Card(
      color: Colors.blue.withValues(alpha: 0.05),
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        side: BorderSide(color: articleColor.withValues(alpha: 0.5), width: 2),
      ),
      child: Stack(
        children: [
          Center(
            child: Column(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
              children: [
                Text(
                  widget.frontText,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 28,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  ),
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                ),
                if (widget.article != null && widget.article!.isNotEmpty)
                  Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8.0),
                    child: Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                        horizontal: 12,
                        vertical: 4,
                      ),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: articleColor,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                      ),
                      child: Text(
                        widget.article ?? "",
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          color: Colors.white,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          Positioned(
            top: 8,
            right: 8,
            child: widget.trailing ?? const SizedBox.shrink(),
          ),
          Positioned(
            bottom: 8,
            right: 8,
            child: IconButton(
              icon: const Icon(Icons.volume_up),
              onPressed: () {
                widget.onAudio();
              },
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildBack() {
    return Card(
      color: Colors.green.withValues(alpha: 0.05),
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16)),
      child: Center(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
          child: Text(
            widget.backText,
            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 24, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart' show rootBundle;

import '../../features/audio/domain/entities/audio_request.dart';
import '../../models/content.dart';
import '../../models/learner.dart';
import '../../services/grammar_hub_service.dart';
import '../../services/app_dependencies.dart';
import '../../design_system/app_audio_button.dart';
import '../../design_system/app_colors.dart';
import '../../design_system/app_glass_card.dart';
import '../../design_system/app_typography.dart';
import '../../features/grammar/data/ar_de_grammar_explain_why.dart';
import '../../features/grammar/data/local_grammar_drill_repository.dart';
import '../../features/grammar/domain/grammar_drill_models.dart';
import '../../features/grammar/presentation/screens/grammar_drill_screen.dart';
import 'grammar_topic_detail_page.dart';

class GrammarHubPage extends StatefulWidget {
  final AppDependencies<ContentItem> dependencies;
  final LearnerState? learnerState;

  const GrammarHubPage({
    Key? key,
    required this.dependencies,
    this.learnerState,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<GrammarHubPage> createState() => _GrammarHubPageState();
}

class _GrammarHubPageState extends State<GrammarHubPage> {
  String _selectedLevel = 'A1';
  final List<String> _levels = <String>['A1', 'A2', 'B1', 'B2', 'C1', 'C2'];
  List<GrammarTopic> _topics = <GrammarTopic>[];
  bool _isLoading = true;
  bool _isDrillRepositoryLoading = true;
  GrammarDrillRepository? _activeDrillRepository;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    unawaited(_loadTopics());
    unawaited(_loadDrillRepository());
  }

  Future<void> _loadTopics() async {
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() => _isLoading = true);
    }
    final topics = await widget.dependencies.grammarHubService.getTopicsByLevel(
      _selectedLevel,
    );
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _topics = topics;
      _isLoading = false;
    });
  }

  void _onLevelSelected(String level) {
    if (_selectedLevel == level) return;
    setState(() => _selectedLevel = level);
    unawaited(_loadTopics());
  }

  GrammarLevel? get _drillLevel => switch (_selectedLevel) {
        'A1' => GrammarLevel.a1,
        'A2' => GrammarLevel.a2,
        'B1' => GrammarLevel.b1,
        _ => null,
      };

  Future<void> _loadDrillRepository() async {
    final sourceLocale = widget.dependencies.languagePack.sourceLocale;
    final targetLocale = widget.dependencies.languagePack.targetLocale;
    final source = sourceLocale.trim().toLowerCase().split(RegExp('[-_]')).first;
    final target = targetLocale.trim().toLowerCase().split(RegExp('[-_]')).first;

    if (source != 'ar' || target != 'de') {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _activeDrillRepository = null;
        _isDrillRepositoryLoading = false;
      });
      return;
    }

    try {
      final explainWhyEngine = await ArDeGrammarExplainWhyCatalog.load(
        readText: rootBundle.loadString,
      );
      final repository = LocalGrammarDrillRepository.forDirectedPair(
        sourceLocale: sourceLocale,
        targetLocale: targetLocale,
        explainWhyEngine: explainWhyEngine,
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _activeDrillRepository = repository;
        _isDrillRepositoryLoading = false;
      });
    } on Object {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _activeDrillRepository = null;
        _isDrillRepositoryLoading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  void _speakGerman(String text, String conceptId) {
    final value = text.trim();
    if (value.isEmpty) return;
    unawaited(
      widget.dependencies.audioRuntime
          .play(
            AudioRequest(
              text: value,
              languageCode: widget.dependencies.languagePack.targetLocale,
              conceptId: conceptId,
              variant: AudioVariant.sentence,
            ),
          )
          .then<void>((_) {}),
    );
  }

  void _openInteractiveDrills() {
    final level = _drillLevel;
    final repository = _activeDrillRepository;
    if (level == null || repository == null) return;
    final exercises = repository.forLevel(level);
    if (exercises.isEmpty) return;
    Navigator.push(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute<void>(
        builder: (_) => GrammarDrillScreen(
          exercises: exercises,
          levelLabel: level.code,
          explainWhyEngine: repository.explainWhyEngine,
          errorDiagnosticSink: widget.dependencies.errorPatternAgent,
          targetLanguageCode: widget.dependencies.languagePack.targetLocale,
          onSpeakGerman: _speakGerman,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  double _glassOpacity(BuildContext context) =>
      Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark ? .38 : .72;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    return Directionality(
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      child: Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: AppDirectionalText(
            'القواعد والتمارين',
            languageCode: 'ar',
            style: AppTypography.title,
          ),
          centerTitle: true,
        ),
        body: Column(
          children: <Widget>[
            SingleChildScrollView(
              scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: 16,
                vertical: 8,
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: _levels.map((level) {
                  return Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4),
                    child: ChoiceChip(
                      label: AppDirectionalText(
                        level,
                        languageCode: 'de',
                        style: AppTypography.label,
                      ),
                      selected: _selectedLevel == level,
                      onSelected: (_) => _onLevelSelected(level),
                    ),
                  );
                }).toList(growable: false),
              ),
            ),
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 16, 12),
              child: AppGlassCard(
                backgroundColor: scheme.surface,
                opacity: _glassOpacity(context),
                glowColor: AppColors.primary,
                child: Row(
                  children: <Widget>[
                    const Icon(
                      Icons.extension_rounded,
                      color: AppColors.primary,
                      size: 30,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 12),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: <Widget>[
                          AppDirectionalText(
                            'تدريب القواعد التفاعلي',
                            languageCode: 'ar',
                            style: AppTypography.title,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 4),
                          AppDirectionalText(
                            _isDrillRepositoryLoading
                                ? 'جاري تجهيز شرح القواعد المحلي.'
                                : _activeDrillRepository == null
                                    ? 'لا توجد حزمة تمارين معتمدة لزوج اللغة النشط.'
                                    : _drillLevel == null
                                        ? 'بنك التمارين متاح حاليًا من A1 إلى B1.'
                                        : 'رتّب الجمل، صرّف الأفعال، وتدرّب على الحالات الإعرابية.',
                            languageCode: 'ar',
                            style: AppTypography.body,
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 10),
                    FilledButton(
                      onPressed: _isDrillRepositoryLoading ||
                              _activeDrillRepository == null ||
                              _drillLevel == null
                          ? null
                          : _openInteractiveDrills,
                      child: AppDirectionalText(
                        'ابدأ',
                        languageCode: 'ar',
                        style: AppTypography.label,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
            Expanded(
              child: _isLoading
                  ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
                  : _topics.isEmpty
                      ? Center(
                          child: AppDirectionalText(
                            'لا توجد مواضيع متاحة لهذا المستوى.',
                            languageCode: 'ar',
                            style: AppTypography.body,
                          ),
                        )
                      : ListView.separated(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 4, 16, 28),
                          itemCount: _topics.length,
                          separatorBuilder: (_, __) =>
                              const SizedBox(height: 12),
                          itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                            final topic = _topics[index];
                            final accent = topic.isMastered
                                ? AppColors.mastery
                                : AppColors.primary;
                            return AppGlassCard(
                              onTap: () async {
                                await Navigator.push<void>(
                                  context,
                                  MaterialPageRoute<void>(
                                    builder: (context) =>
                                        GrammarTopicDetailPage(
                                      topic: topic,
                                      dependencies: widget.dependencies,
                                      learnerState: widget.learnerState,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                );
                                await _loadTopics();
                              },
                              backgroundColor: scheme.surface,
                              opacity: _glassOpacity(context),
                              borderColor: accent.withAlpha(120),
                              glowColor: topic.isMastered ? accent : null,
                              child: Row(
                                children: <Widget>[
                                  Expanded(
                                    child: Column(
                                      crossAxisAlignment:
                                          CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                                      children: <Widget>[
                                        AppDirectionalText(
                                          topic.titleDe,
                                          languageCode: 'de',
                                          style: AppTypography.title,
                                        ),
                                        const SizedBox(height: 4),
                                        AppDirectionalText(
                                          topic.titleAr,
                                          languageCode: 'ar',
                                          style: AppTypography.body,
                                        ),
                                      ],
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                                  AppAudioButton(
                                    onPressed: () => _speakGerman(
                                      topic.titleDe,
                                      'grammar.topic.${topic.id}',
                                    ),
                                    semanticLabel:
                                        'استمع إلى ${topic.titleDe}',
                                    activeColor: accent,
                                  ),
                                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                                  Icon(
                                    topic.isMastered
                                        ? Icons.check_circle_rounded
                                        : Icons.chevron_left_rounded,
                                    color: accent,
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            );
                          },
                        ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../design_system/app_audio_button.dart';
import '../../design_system/app_colors.dart';
import '../../design_system/app_glass_card.dart';
import '../../design_system/app_typography.dart';
import '../../features/audio/domain/entities/audio_request.dart';
import '../../services/app_dependencies.dart';
import '../../services/grammar_hub_service.dart';

class GrammarQuizPage extends StatefulWidget {
  final String topicId;
  final AppDependencies dependencies;

  const GrammarQuizPage({
    Key? key,
    required this.topicId,
    required this.dependencies,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<GrammarQuizPage> createState() => _GrammarQuizPageState();
}

class _GrammarQuizPageState extends State<GrammarQuizPage> {
  List<GrammarQuiz> _quizzes = <GrammarQuiz>[];
  int _currentIndex = 0;
  bool _isLoading = true;
  bool _isAnswered = false;
  int? _selectedIndex;
  int _correctCount = 0;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    unawaited(_loadQuizzes());
  }

  Future<void> _loadQuizzes() async {
    final quizzes = await widget.dependencies.grammarHubService
        .getQuizzesForTopic(widget.topicId);
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _quizzes = quizzes;
      _isLoading = false;
    });
  }

  void _submitAnswer(int index) {
    if (_isAnswered) return;
    setState(() {
      _selectedIndex = index;
      _isAnswered = true;
      if (index == _quizzes[_currentIndex].correctIndex) {
        _correctCount++;
      }
    });
  }

  Future<void> _nextQuestion() async {
    if (_currentIndex < _quizzes.length - 1) {
      setState(() {
        _currentIndex++;
        _isAnswered = false;
        _selectedIndex = null;
      });
      return;
    }

    if (_correctCount == _quizzes.length && _quizzes.isNotEmpty) {
      await widget.dependencies.grammarHubService.saveTopicMastery(
        widget.topicId,
        true,
      );
    }
    if (mounted) {
      Navigator.pop(context);
    }
  }

  String _languageCodeFor(String text) =>
      RegExp(r'[\u0600-\u06FF]').hasMatch(text) ? 'ar' : 'de';

  void _speakQuestion(String text) {
    final value = text.trim();
    if (value.isEmpty || _languageCodeFor(value) != 'de') return;
    unawaited(
      widget.dependencies.audioRuntime
          .play(
            AudioRequest(
              text: value,
              languageCode: widget.dependencies.languagePack.targetLocale,
              conceptId: 'grammar.quiz.${widget.topicId}.${_currentIndex + 1}',
              variant: AudioVariant.sentence,
            ),
          )
          .then<void>((_) {}),
    );
  }

  double _glassOpacity(BuildContext context) =>
      Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark ? .38 : .72;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Directionality(
        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
        child: Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(
            title: AppDirectionalText(
              'اختبار القواعد',
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
            centerTitle: true,
          ),
          body: _isLoading
              ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
              : _quizzes.isEmpty
                  ? Center(
                      child: AppDirectionalText(
                        'لا توجد أسئلة متاحة لهذا الموضوع.',
                        languageCode: 'ar',
                        style: AppTypography.body,
                      ),
                    )
                  : _buildQuizContent(context),
        ),
      );

  Widget _buildQuizContent(BuildContext context) {
    final quiz = _quizzes[_currentIndex];
    final questionLanguage = _languageCodeFor(quiz.question);
    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    return SingleChildScrollView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 32),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: <Widget>[
          AppDirectionalText(
            'السؤال ${_currentIndex + 1} من ${_quizzes.length}',
            languageCode: 'ar',
            style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
              color: scheme.onSurfaceVariant,
            ),
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          AppGlassCard(
            backgroundColor: scheme.surface,
            opacity: _glassOpacity(context),
            glowColor: AppColors.primary,
            child: Row(
              children: <Widget>[
                Expanded(
                  child: AppDirectionalText(
                    quiz.question,
                    languageCode: questionLanguage,
                    style: AppTypography.title,
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  ),
                ),
                if (questionLanguage == 'de') ...<Widget>[
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  AppAudioButton(
                    onPressed: () => _speakQuestion(quiz.question),
                    semanticLabel: 'استمع إلى السؤال',
                    activeColor: AppColors.primary,
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 18),
          ...List<Widget>.generate(quiz.options.length, (index) {
            final option = quiz.options[index];
            final isCorrect = index == quiz.correctIndex;
            final isSelected = index == _selectedIndex;
            final accent = !_isAnswered
                ? scheme.outlineVariant
                : isCorrect
                    ? AppColors.mastery
                    : isSelected
                        ? AppColors.tertiary
                        : scheme.outlineVariant;
            return Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
              child: AppGlassCard(
                onTap: _isAnswered ? null : () => _submitAnswer(index),
                backgroundColor: scheme.surface,
                opacity: _glassOpacity(context),
                borderColor: accent.withAlpha(_isAnswered ? 170 : 95),
                glowColor: _isAnswered && (isCorrect || isSelected)
                    ? accent
                    : null,
                child: AppDirectionalText(
                  option,
                  languageCode: _languageCodeFor(option),
                  style: AppTypography.body.copyWith(
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                  ),
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                ),
              ),
            );
          }),
          if (_isAnswered) ...<Widget>[
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            AppGlassCard(
              backgroundColor: scheme.surface,
              opacity: _glassOpacity(context),
              glowColor: _selectedIndex == quiz.correctIndex
                  ? AppColors.mastery
                  : AppColors.tertiary,
              child: AppDirectionalText(
                quiz.explanation,
                languageCode: 'ar',
                style: AppTypography.body,
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            FilledButton(
              onPressed: () => unawaited(_nextQuestion()),
              child: AppDirectionalText(
                _currentIndex < _quizzes.length - 1
                    ? 'السؤال التالي'
                    : 'إنهاء',
                languageCode: 'ar',
                style: AppTypography.label,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

              ),
              if (learnerState != null) ...<Widget>[
                const SizedBox(height: 18),
                OutlinedButton.icon(
                  onPressed: () {
                    Navigator.push<void>(
                      context,
                      MaterialPageRoute<void>(
                        builder: (context) => GrammarMicroscopePage(
                          topicId: topic.id,
                          state: learnerState!,
                          dependencies: dependencies,
                        ),
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.biotech_outlined),
                  label: AppDirectionalText(
                    'مجهر القواعد',
                    languageCode: 'ar',
                    style: AppTypography.label,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              FilledButton.icon(
                onPressed: () {
                  Navigator.push<void>(
                    context,
                    MaterialPageRoute<void>(
                      builder: (context) => GrammarQuizPage(
                        topicId: topic.id,
                        dependencies: dependencies,
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                },
                icon: const Icon(Icons.quiz_outlined),
                label: AppDirectionalText(
                  'ابدأ الاختبار القصير',
                  languageCode: 'ar',
                  style: AppTypography.label,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../core/text/directional_text.dart';
import '../../design_system/app_colors.dart';
import '../../design_system/app_glass_card.dart';
import '../../design_system/app_typography.dart';
import '../../features/audio/domain/entities/audio_request.dart';
import '../../models/content.dart';
import '../../models/learner.dart';
import '../../services/app_dependencies.dart';
import '../../services/grammar_microscope_service.dart';
import '../shared/text/bidi_text.dart';
import 'grammar_microscope_sections.dart';

class GrammarMicroscopePage extends StatefulWidget {
  const GrammarMicroscopePage({
    super.key,
    required this.topicId,
    required this.state,
    required this.dependencies,
  });

  final String topicId;
  final LearnerState state;
  final AppDependencies<ContentItem> dependencies;

  @override
  State<GrammarMicroscopePage> createState() => _GrammarMicroscopePageState();
}

class _GrammarMicroscopePageState extends State<GrammarMicroscopePage> {
  late final Future<GrammarMicroscopeSnapshot?> _snapshot;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _snapshot =
        GrammarMicroscopeService(widget.dependencies.grammarHubService).load(
      topicId: widget.topicId,
      state: widget.state,
      corpus: widget.dependencies.corpus,
    );
  }

  void _speakGerman(String text, String conceptId) {
    final value = text.trim();
    if (value.isEmpty) return;
    unawaited(
      widget.dependencies.audioRuntime
          .play(
            AudioRequest(
              text: value,
              languageCode: widget.dependencies.languagePack.targetLocale,
              conceptId: conceptId,
              variant: AudioVariant.sentence,
            ),
          )
          .then<void>((_) {}),
    );
  }

  double _glassOpacity(BuildContext context) =>
      Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark ? .38 : .72;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Directionality(
        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
        child: Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(
            title: AppDirectionalText(
              'مجهر القواعد',
              languageCode: 'ar',
              style: AppTypography.title,
            ),
          ),
          body: FutureBuilder<GrammarMicroscopeSnapshot?>(
            future: _snapshot,
            builder: (context, asyncSnapshot) {
              if (asyncSnapshot.connectionState != ConnectionState.done) {
                return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
              }
              if (asyncSnapshot.hasError) {
                return Center(
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                    child: AppDirectionalText(
                      'تعذر تحميل تفاصيل القاعدة بأمان.',
                      languageCode: 'ar',
                      style: AppTypography.body,
                    ),
                  ),
                );
              }

              final snapshot = asyncSnapshot.data;
              if (snapshot == null) {
                return Center(
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                    child: AppDirectionalText(
                      'موضوع القاعدة غير متاح في المصدر النشط.',
                      languageCode: 'ar',
                      style: AppTypography.body,
                    ),
                  ),
                );
              }

              final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
              return ListView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 32),
                children: <Widget>[
                  AppGlassCard(
                    backgroundColor: scheme.surface,
                    opacity: _glassOpacity(context),
                    glowColor: AppColors.primary,
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                      children: <Widget>[
                        BidiText(
                          DirectionalText.german(
                            snapshot.topic.titleDe,
                            semanticRole:
                                LinguisticSemanticRole.grammarLabel,
                          ),
                          style: AppTypography.title,
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 4),
                        BidiText(
                          DirectionalText.arabic(
                            snapshot.topic.titleAr,
                            semanticRole:
                                LinguisticSemanticRole.translation,
                          ),
                          style: AppTypography.body,
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 12),
                        BidiText(
                          DirectionalText.arabic(
                            snapshot.topic.explanationMarkdown,
                            semanticRole:
                                LinguisticSemanticRole.explanation,
                          ),
                          style: AppTypography.body,
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 20),
                  GrammarMicroscopeEvidenceSection(snapshot: snapshot),
                  const SizedBox(height: 20),
                  GrammarMicroscopeRulesSection(
                    snapshot: snapshot,
                    onSpeakGerman: _speakGerman,
                  ),
                ],
              );
            },
          ),
        ),
      );
}

                              _directional(
                                cell,
                                semanticRole:
                                    LinguisticSemanticRole.grammarLabel,
                              ),
                              style: AppTypography.label,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
            ],
            if (rule.examples.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              AppDirectionalText(
                'أمثلة',
                languageCode: 'ar',
                style: AppTypography.label,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 6),
              for (var index = 0; index < rule.examples.length; index++)
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
                  child: AppGlassCard(

                    opacity: .18,
                    borderColor: scheme.outlineVariant.withAlpha(90),

                      children: <Widget>[

                        AppAudioButton(

                            rule.examples[index].german,
                            'grammar.rule.${rule.id}.example.$index',
                          ),
                          semanticLabel: 'استمع إلى المثال الألماني',
                          activeColor: AppColors.primary,
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

DirectionalText _directional(
  String text, {
  required LinguisticSemanticRole semanticRole,
}) =>
    DirectionalText.forLanguage(
      text,
      languageCode: RegExp(r'[\u0600-\u06FF]').hasMatch(text) ? 'ar' : 'de',
      semanticRole: semanticRole,
    );

String _facetLabel(Object facet) {
  final wire = facet.toString().split('.').last;
  return switch (wire) {
    'gender' => 'الجنس وأداة الاسم',
    'plural' => 'الجمع',
    'caseForm' => 'الحالة الإعرابية',
    'verbValency' => 'تعدية الفعل',
    'prepositionCase' => 'حرف الجر والحالة',
    'separablePrefix' => 'الفعل المنفصل',
    'auxiliary' => 'الفعل المساعد',
    'collocation' => 'التركيب الثابت',
    'production' => 'الإنتاج',
    _ => 'مهارة نحوية',
  };
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../services/streak_milestones_engine.dart';

class MilestoneBadgesPage extends StatefulWidget {
  final int currentStreak;
  final StreakMilestonesEngine engine;

  const MilestoneBadgesPage({
    super.key,
    required this.currentStreak,
    required this.engine,
  });

  @override
  State<MilestoneBadgesPage> createState() => _MilestoneBadgesPageState();
}

class _MilestoneBadgesPageState extends State<MilestoneBadgesPage> {
  Set<String> unlockedBadges = {};
  bool loading = true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    await widget.engine.checkAndUnlockMilestones(widget.currentStreak);
    final unlocked = await widget.engine.getUnlockedMilestones();
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        unlockedBadges = unlocked;
        loading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (loading) {
      return const Scaffold(body: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()));
    }

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('إنجازات الاستمرارية')),
      body: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
        children: [
          Card(
            color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primaryContainer,
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
              child: Column(
                children: [
                  const Icon(
                    Icons.local_fire_department,
                    size: 48,
                    color: Colors.orange,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Text(
                    'الاستمرارية الحالية: ${widget.currentStreak} أيام',
                    style: Theme.of(context)
                        .textTheme
                        .titleLarge
                        ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 20),
          Text(
            'الشارات',
            style: Theme.of(context)
                .textTheme
                .titleMedium
                ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          ...StreakMilestonesEngine.availableBadges.map((badge) {
            final isUnlocked = unlockedBadges.contains(badge.id);
            return Card(
              color: isUnlocked
                  ? null
                  : Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
              child: ListTile(
                leading: Icon(
                  isUnlocked ? Icons.stars : Icons.lock_outline,
                  color: isUnlocked ? Colors.amber : Colors.grey,
                  size: 32,
                ),
                title: Text(
                  badge.title,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontWeight:
                        isUnlocked ? FontWeight.w800 : FontWeight.normal,
                    color: isUnlocked ? null : Colors.grey,
                  ),
                ),
                subtitle: Text(
                  badge.description,
                  style: TextStyle(color: isUnlocked ? null : Colors.grey),
                ),
                trailing: isUnlocked
                    ? const Icon(Icons.check_circle, color: Colors.green)
                    : null,
              ),
            );
          }),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../services/preferences_service.dart';
import '../../services/ui_preferences.dart';

class CalmOnboardingSetupScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final VoidCallback? onComplete;
  final PreferencesService prefs;

  const CalmOnboardingSetupScreen({
    super.key,
    this.onComplete,
    required this.prefs,
  });

  @override
  State<CalmOnboardingSetupScreen> createState() =>
      _CalmOnboardingSetupScreenState();
}

class _CalmOnboardingSetupScreenState extends State<CalmOnboardingSetupScreen> {
  bool _isSaving = false;
  int? _selectedMinutes;

  Future<void> _savePreferences(int minutes) async {
    if (_isSaving) return;
    setState(() {
      _isSaving = true;
      _selectedMinutes = minutes;
    });

    try {
      final prefs = widget.prefs;

      int newCardsQuota;
      int reviewLimit;

      switch (minutes) {
        case 5:
          newCardsQuota = 5;
          reviewLimit = 25;
          break;
        case 15:
          newCardsQuota = 15;
          reviewLimit = 75;
          break;
        case 10:
        default:
          newCardsQuota = 10;
          reviewLimit = 50;
          break;
      }

      final saved = await UiPreferences(prefs).setDailyStudyProfile(
        minutes: minutes,
        newCardsQuota: newCardsQuota,
        reviewLimit: reviewLimit,
      );
      if (!saved) {
        throw StateError('Study preferences could not be persisted.');
      }

      if (mounted) {
        if (widget.onComplete != null) {
          widget.onComplete!();
        } else {
          Navigator.of(context).pop();
        }
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _isSaving = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  Widget _buildTimeOption(
    BuildContext context,
    int minutes,
    String description,
  ) {
    final isSelected = _selectedMinutes == minutes;

    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8.0),
      child: Material(
        color: isSelected
            ? Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primaryContainer
            : Theme.of(context)
                .colorScheme
                .surfaceContainerHighest
                .withValues(alpha: 0.5),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24.0),
        child: InkWell(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24.0),
          onTap: _isSaving ? null : () => _savePreferences(minutes),
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
              horizontal: 24.0,
              vertical: 24.0,
            ),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                Container(
                  width: 48,
                  height: 48,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                    color: isSelected
                        ? Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary
                        : Theme.of(context)
                            .colorScheme
                            .primary
                            .withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                  ),
                  child: Center(
                    child: Text(
                      '$minutes',
                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge?.copyWith(
                            color: isSelected
                                ? Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onPrimary
                                : Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 24),
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        '$minutes دقائق يومياً',
                        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                        style:
                            Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                  color: isSelected
                                      ? Theme.of(context)
                                          .colorScheme
                                          .onPrimaryContainer
                                      : Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurface,
                                ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 4),
                      Text(
                        description,
                        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                              color: isSelected
                                  ? Theme.of(context)
                                      .colorScheme
                                      .onPrimaryContainer
                                      .withValues(alpha: 0.8)
                                  : Theme.of(context)
                                      .colorScheme
                                      .onSurfaceVariant,
                            ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                if (isSelected && _isSaving)

class RealityPractice extends StatefulWidget {
  final LearnerRepository repo;
  final String title;
  final String targetText;
  final String sourceText;
  final VoidCallback onDone;
  final LanguagePresentation presentation;

  const RealityPractice({
    super.key,
    required this.repo,
    required this.title,
    required this.targetText,
    required this.sourceText,
    required this.onDone,
    required this.presentation,
  });

  @override
  State<RealityPractice> createState() => _RealityState();
}

class _RealityState extends State<RealityPractice> {
  String answer = '';
  bool done = false;
  bool correct = false;
  late DateTime start;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    start = DateTime.now();
  }

  Future<void> submit() async {
    String norm(String value) => value
        .toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[.!?,]'), '')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ')
        .trim();
    correct = norm(answer) == norm(widget.targetText);
    await widget.repo.record(
      item: ContentItem(
        id: 'reality_${widget.title}',
        german: widget.targetText,
        arabic: widget.sourceText,
        sentence: widget.targetText,
        sentenceAr: widget.sourceText,
        topic: widget.title,
        skill: 'transfer',
        accepted: [widget.targetText],
      ),
      answer: answer,
      correct: correct,
      seconds: DateTime.now().difference(start).inSeconds.clamp(1, 999).toInt(),
      hinted: false,
      skillOverride: 'transfer',
    );
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => done = true);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(title: Text(widget.title)),
        body: ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
          children: [
            Text(
              widget.sourceText,
              style: Theme.of(context)
                  .textTheme
                  .headlineSmall
                  ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Text(widget.presentation.realWorld.targetLanguageInstruction),
            const SizedBox(height: 15),
            TextField(
              enabled: !done,
              onChanged: (value) => answer = value,
              textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
                labelText: widget.presentation.realWorld.title,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            if (!done)
              FilledButton(onPressed: submit, child: const Text('تحقق'))
            else
              Card(
                child: ListTile(
                  title: Text(correct ? 'صحيح' : 'راجع الصياغة'),
                  subtitle: Text(widget.targetText),
                ),
              ),
            if (done)
              FilledButton(
                onPressed: () {
                  widget.onDone();
                  Navigator.pop(context);
                },
                child: const Text('إنهاء'),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

class CategoriesPage extends StatelessWidget {

  @override

    return Scaffold(

              leading: const Icon(Icons.folder_outlined),
              title: Text(
                k,
                style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
              ),

              onTap: () => Navigator.push(
                c,

                  builder: (_) => CategoryWordsPage(
                    title: k,
                    items: xs,
                    repo: repo,
                    presentation: presentation,

            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

class SearchDictionaryPage extends StatefulWidget {
  final LearnerRepository repo;
  final SearchIndex<ContentItem> searchIndex;
  final VerbIndex verbIndex;
  final LanguagePresentation presentation;
  final LanguageTextNormalizer textNormalizer;
  const SearchDictionaryPage({
    super.key,
    required this.repo,
    required this.searchIndex,
    required this.verbIndex,
    required this.presentation,
    required this.textNormalizer,
  });
  @override
  State<SearchDictionaryPage> createState() => _SearchDictionaryState();
}

class _SearchDictionaryState extends State<SearchDictionaryPage> {
  String q = '';
  late final LearnerState state = widget.repo.load();
  final Map<String, WordProfile<ContentItem>> _profiles =
      <String, WordProfile<ContentItem>>{};
  late final Map<String, List<Attempt>> _attemptsByItem = _groupAttempts(
    state.attempts,
  );
  static Map<String, List<Attempt>> _groupAttempts(List<Attempt> attempts) {
    final grouped = <String, List<Attempt>>{};
    for (final attempt in attempts) {
      (grouped[attempt.itemId] ??= <Attempt>[]).add(attempt);
    }
    return grouped;
  }

  final SafeTtsController _tts = SafeTtsController();
  Future<void> _speak(String text) => _tts.speak(text);
  WordProfile<ContentItem> _profileFor(ContentItem item) =>
      _profiles[item.id] ??= WordProfileService.build(
        item,
        state,
        searchIndex: widget.searchIndex,
        verbIndex: widget.verbIndex,
        textNormalizer: widget.textNormalizer,
        itemAttempts: _attemptsByItem[item.id] ?? const <Attempt>[],
      );
  @override
  void dispose() {
    _tts.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext c) {
    final query = widget.textNormalizer.answer(q);
    final results = widget.searchIndex.search(query, limit: 60);
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('البحث والقاموس')),
      body: Column(
        children: [
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
            child: TextField(
              onChanged: (v) => setState(() => q = v),
              textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
              decoration: const InputDecoration(
                prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.search),
                labelText: 'البحث',
                hintText: 'ابحث بالألمانية أو العربية',
                border: OutlineInputBorder(),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          Expanded(
            child: results.isEmpty && q.trim().isNotEmpty
                ? Center(
                    child: Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                      child: Column(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          const Icon(Icons.search_off, size: 48),
                          const SizedBox(height: 10),
                          const Text(
                            'لا توجد نتيجة مطابقة',
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 18,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 6),
                          const Text(
                            'جرّب الكلمة الألمانية، ترجمتها العربية، صيغة الجمع، أو جزءًا من الجملة.',
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  )
                : ListView.builder(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12),
                    itemCount: results.length,
                    itemBuilder: (c, i) {
                      final x = results[i];
                      return _DictionaryWordCard(
                        item: x,
                        profile: _profileFor(x),
                        speak: _speak,
                        presentation: widget.presentation,
                      );
                    },
                  ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _GrammarHubPageState extends State<GrammarHubPage>

  final List<String> _levels = ['A1', 'A2', 'B1', 'B2', 'C1', 'C2'];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _tabController = TabController(length: _levels.length, vsync: this);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _tabController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text(
          'مركز القواعد',
          style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
        ),
        bottom: TabBar(
          controller: _tabController,
          isScrollable: true,
          tabs: _levels.map((level) => Tab(text: level)).toList(),
        ),
      ),
      body: TabBarView(
        controller: _tabController,
        children: _levels.map((level) {
          final topicsForLevel = CanonicalGrammarCatalog.allTopics
              .where((topic) => topic.level == level)
              .toList();
          return _buildTopicsList(topicsForLevel);
        }).toList(),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildTopicsList(List<GrammarTopic> topics) {
    if (topics.isEmpty) {
      return const Center(child: Text('لا توجد مواضيع في هذا المستوى حالياً.'));
    }

    return ListView.builder(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
      itemCount: topics.length,
      itemBuilder: (context, index) {
        final topic = topics[index];
        return Card(
          elevation: 2,
          margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16.0),
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
          ),
          child: InkWell(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
            onTap: () {
              Navigator.push(
                context,
                MaterialPageRoute(
                  builder: (context) => GrammarTopicDetailPage(topic: topic),
                ),
              );
            },
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: 12,
                          vertical: 4,
                        ),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primaryContainer,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                        ),
                        child: Text(
                          topic.level,
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            color: Theme.of(context)
                                .colorScheme
                                .onPrimaryContainer,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 12),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Text(
                          topic.titleDe,
                          style:
                              Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge?.copyWith(
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                    fontFamily: 'Inter',
                                  ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Text(
                    topic.titleAr,
                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                          fontFamily: 'Tajawal',
                        ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Text(
                    topic.summaryAr,
                    style: Theme.of(context)
                        .textTheme
                        .bodyMedium
                        ?.copyWith(fontFamily: 'Tajawal'),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}
