import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../models/grammar.dart';

class GrammarTopicDetailPage extends StatefulWidget {
  final GrammarTopic topic;

  const GrammarTopicDetailPage({Key? key, required this.topic})
      : super(key: key);

  @override
  _GrammarTopicDetailPageState createState() => _GrammarTopicDetailPageState();
}

class _GrammarTopicDetailPageState extends State<GrammarTopicDetailPage> {
  final Map<String, int?> _selectedAnswers = {};
  final Map<String, bool> _showExplanations = {};

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(
          widget.topic.titleDe,
          style: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Inter'),
        ),
      ),
      body: SingleChildScrollView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            _buildHeader(context),
            const SizedBox(height: 24),
            ...widget.topic.rules
                .map((rule) => _buildRuleCard(context, rule))
                .toList(),
            if (widget.topic.miniChecks.isNotEmpty) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 32),
              const Divider(),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              Text(
                'اختبر فهمك',
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall?.copyWith(
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      fontFamily: 'Tajawal',
                    ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              ...widget.topic.miniChecks
                  .map((check) => _buildMiniCheck(context, check))
                  .toList(),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildHeader(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Row(
          children: [
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 4),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primaryContainer,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              ),
              child: Text(
                widget.topic.level,
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onPrimaryContainer,
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Expanded(
              child: Text(
                widget.topic.titleAr,
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall?.copyWith(
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      fontFamily: 'Tajawal',
                    ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 16),
        Text(
          widget.topic.summaryAr,
          style: Theme.of(context)
              .textTheme
              .bodyLarge
              ?.copyWith(fontFamily: 'Tajawal'),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildRuleCard(BuildContext context, GrammarRule rule) {
    return Card(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 24.0),
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16)),
      elevation: 2,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Row(
              children: [
                const Icon(Icons.rule_outlined, color: Colors.blueAccent),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    rule.title,
                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          fontFamily: 'Tajawal',
                        ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Text(
              rule.explanationAr,
              style: Theme.of(context)
                  .textTheme
                  .bodyMedium
                  ?.copyWith(fontFamily: 'Tajawal'),
            ),
            if (rule.table.isNotEmpty) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              _buildSyntaxTable(context, rule.table),
            ],
            if (rule.examples.isNotEmpty) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              const Text(
                'أمثلة:',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  fontFamily: 'Tajawal',
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              ...rule.examples
                  .map((ex) => _buildExampleRow(context, ex))
                  .toList(),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSyntaxTable(BuildContext context, List<List<String>> table) {
    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        border: Border.all(color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.outlineVariant),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
      ),
      child: Table(
        border: TableBorder.symmetric(
          inside: BorderSide(
            color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.outlineVariant,
          ),
        ),
        children: table.map((row) {
          final isHeader = table.indexOf(row) == 0;
          return TableRow(
            decoration: isHeader
                ? BoxDecoration(
                    color:
                        Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
                  )
                : null,
            children: row.map((cell) {
              return Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8.0),
                child: Text(
                  cell,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontWeight: isHeader ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.normal,
                    fontFamily: 'Inter',
                  ),
                ),
              );
            }).toList(),
          );
        }).toList(),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildExampleRow(BuildContext context, GrammarExample example) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8.0),
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surfaceContainerLowest,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
          border: Border.all(
            color: Theme.of(context)
                .colorScheme
                .outlineVariant
                .withValues(alpha: 0.5),
          ),
        ),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text(
              example.german,
              style: const TextStyle(
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                fontFamily: 'Inter',
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text(
              example.arabic,
              style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.grey, fontFamily: 'Tajawal'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildMiniCheck(BuildContext context, MiniCheckQuestion check) {
    final selectedOption = _selectedAnswers[check.id];
    final isAnswered = selectedOption != null;
    final isCorrect = isAnswered && selectedOption == check.correctAnswerIndex;
    final showExplanation = _showExplanations[check.id] ?? false;

    return Card(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16.0),
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16)),
      color: Theme.of(context)
          .colorScheme
          .surfaceContainerHighest
          .withValues(alpha: 0.3),
      elevation: 0,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text(
              check.questionText,
              style: const TextStyle(
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                fontFamily: 'Inter',
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            ...check.options.asMap().entries.map((entry) {
              final idx = entry.key;
              final option = entry.value;

              Color? tileColor;
              if (isAnswered) {
                if (idx == check.correctAnswerIndex) {
                  tileColor = Colors.green.withValues(alpha: 0.2);
                } else if (idx == selectedOption) {
                  tileColor = Colors.red.withValues(alpha: 0.2);
                }
              }

              return Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8.0),
                child: InkWell(
                  onTap: isAnswered
                      ? null
                      : () {
                          setState(() {
                            _selectedAnswers[check.id] = idx;
                            _showExplanations[check.id] = true;
                          });
                        },
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                  child: Container(
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: tileColor ?? Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                      border: Border.all(
                        color: isAnswered && idx == selectedOption
                            ? (isCorrect ? Colors.green : Colors.red)
                            : Theme.of(context).colorScheme.outlineVariant,
                      ),
                    ),
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                    child: Row(
                      children: [
                        if (isAnswered && idx == check.correctAnswerIndex)
                          const Icon(
                            Icons.check_circle,
                            color: Colors.green,
                            size: 20,
                          )
                        else if (isAnswered && idx == selectedOption)
                          const Icon(Icons.cancel, color: Colors.red, size: 20)
                        else
                          const Icon(Icons.radio_button_unchecked, size: 20),
                        const SizedBox(width: 8),
                        Expanded(
                          child: Text(
                            option,
                            style: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Inter'),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              );
            }).toList(),
            if (showExplanation) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: isCorrect
                      ? Colors.green.withValues(alpha: 0.1)
                      : Colors.red.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                  border: Border.all(
                    color: isCorrect
                        ? Colors.green.withValues(alpha: 0.5)
                        : Colors.red.withValues(alpha: 0.5),
                  ),
                ),
                child: Row(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Icon(
                      isCorrect ? Icons.lightbulb_outline : Icons.info_outline,
                      color: isCorrect ? Colors.green : Colors.red,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Text(
                        check.explanationAr,
                        style: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Tajawal'),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

enum BreathingPhase { inhale, holdIn, exhale, holdOut }

class MicroBreaksScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final VoidCallback? onComplete;

  const MicroBreaksScreen({super.key, this.onComplete});

  @override
  State<MicroBreaksScreen> createState() => _MicroBreaksScreenState();
}

class _MicroBreaksScreenState extends State<MicroBreaksScreen>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late AnimationController _controller;
  BreathingPhase _currentPhase = BreathingPhase.inhale;
  int _cycleCount = 0;
  final int _maxCycles = 3;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _controller = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(seconds: 4), // 4 seconds for inhale
    );

    _controller.addStatusListener(_handleAnimationStatus);
    _controller.forward();
  }

  Timer? _timer;

  void _handleAnimationStatus(AnimationStatus status) {
    if (status == AnimationStatus.completed) {
      if (_currentPhase == BreathingPhase.inhale) {
        setState(() => _currentPhase = BreathingPhase.holdIn);
        _timer = Timer(const Duration(seconds: 4), () {
          if (!mounted) return;
          setState(() => _currentPhase = BreathingPhase.exhale);
          _controller.duration = const Duration(
            seconds: 4,
          ); // 4 seconds for exhale
          _controller.reverse();
        });
      }
    } else if (status == AnimationStatus.dismissed) {
      if (_currentPhase == BreathingPhase.exhale) {
        setState(() => _currentPhase = BreathingPhase.holdOut);
        _timer = Timer(const Duration(seconds: 4), () {
          if (!mounted) return;
          _cycleCount++;
          if (_cycleCount >= _maxCycles) {
            if (widget.onComplete != null) {
              widget.onComplete!();
            } else {
              Navigator.of(context).pop();
            }
          } else {
            setState(() => _currentPhase = BreathingPhase.inhale);
            _controller.duration = const Duration(
              seconds: 4,
            ); // 4 seconds for inhale
            _controller.forward();
          }
        });
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    _controller.removeStatusListener(_handleAnimationStatus);
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  String get _promptText {
    switch (_currentPhase) {
      case BreathingPhase.inhale:
        return 'Breathe In...';
      case BreathingPhase.holdIn:
        return 'Hold...';
      case BreathingPhase.exhale:
        return 'Breathe Out...';
      case BreathingPhase.holdOut:
        return 'Relax...';
    }
  }

  IconData get _phaseIcon {
    switch (_currentPhase) {
      case BreathingPhase.inhale:
        return Icons.air;
      case BreathingPhase.holdIn:
        return Icons.pause_circle_outline;
      case BreathingPhase.exhale:
        return Icons.water_drop_outlined;
      case BreathingPhase.holdOut:
        return Icons.self_improvement;
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Center(
          child: Column(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
              Text(
                'Micro-Break',
                style: Theme.of(context)
                    .textTheme
                    .headlineSmall
                    ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w300, letterSpacing: 2.0),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              Text(
                'Relax your eyes. Follow the rhythm.',
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                      color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                    ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 64),
              AnimatedBuilder(
                animation: _controller,
                builder: (context, child) {
                  // _controller.value goes from 0.0 to 1.0 on forward (inhale)
                  // and 1.0 to 0.0 on reverse (exhale).
                  // Hold states maintain the value (1.0 or 0.0).
                  final scale = 0.5 + (_controller.value * 0.5);
                  final opacity = 0.3 + (_controller.value * 0.7);

                  return Container(
                    width: 200,
                    height: 200,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      shape: BoxShape.circle,
                      color: Theme.of(context)
                          .colorScheme
                          .primary
                          .withValues(alpha: opacity * 0.2),
                      border: Border.all(
                        color: Theme.of(context)
                            .colorScheme
                            .primary
                            .withValues(alpha: opacity),
                        width: 2.0,
                      ),
                    ),
                    child: Center(
                      child: Transform.scale(
                        scale: scale,
                        child: Container(
                          width: 160,
                          height: 160,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            shape: BoxShape.circle,
                            color: Theme.of(context)
                                .colorScheme
                                .primary
                                .withValues(alpha: opacity * 0.5),
                          ),
                          child: Center(
                            child: Icon(
                              _phaseIcon,
                              size: 48,
                              color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                },
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 64),
              AnimatedSwitcher(
                duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 500),
                child: Text(
                  _promptText,
                  key: ValueKey<BreathingPhase>(_currentPhase),
                  style: Theme.of(context)
                      .textTheme
                      .titleLarge
                      ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w500),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 32),
              Text(
                'Cycle ${_cycleCount + 1} of $_maxCycles',
                style: Theme.of(context)
                    .textTheme
                    .labelLarge
                    ?.copyWith(color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.outline),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 48),
              TextButton(
                onPressed: () {
                  if (widget.onComplete != null) {
                    widget.onComplete!();
                  } else {
                    Navigator.of(context).pop();
                  }
                },
                style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                    horizontal: 24,
                    vertical: 16,
                  ),
                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                  ),
                ),
                child: const Text('Skip Break'),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../models/content.dart';
import '../../models/learner.dart';
import '../../services/repository.dart';
import '../../services/search_index.dart';
import '../../language/language_text_normalizer.dart';
import '../../services/verb_index.dart';
import '../../services/word_profile_service.dart';
import '../../language/language_presentation.dart';
import '../../models/word_profile.dart';
import '../safe_ui.dart';

class OfflineLexiconHub extends StatefulWidget {
  final LearnerRepository repo;
  final List<ContentItem> corpus;
  final SearchIndex<ContentItem> searchIndex;
  final VerbIndex verbIndex;
  final LanguagePresentation presentation;
  final LanguageTextNormalizer textNormalizer;

  const OfflineLexiconHub({
    super.key,
    required this.repo,
    required this.corpus,
    required this.searchIndex,
    required this.verbIndex,
    required this.presentation,
    required this.textNormalizer,
  });

  @override
  State<OfflineLexiconHub> createState() => _OfflineLexiconHubState();
}

class _OfflineLexiconHubState extends State<OfflineLexiconHub> {
  String q = '';
  late final LearnerState state = widget.repo.load();
  late final Set<String> _learnedIds = state.learned;
  late final List<ContentItem> _learnedItems = widget.corpus
      .where((x) => _learnedIds.contains(x.id))
      .toList(growable: false);

  final Map<String, WordProfile<ContentItem>> _profiles =
      <String, WordProfile<ContentItem>>{};
  late final Map<String, List<Attempt>> _attemptsByItem = _groupAttempts(
    state.attempts,
  );

  static Map<String, List<Attempt>> _groupAttempts(List<Attempt> attempts) {
    final grouped = <String, List<Attempt>>{};
    for (final attempt in attempts) {
      (grouped[attempt.itemId] ??= <Attempt>[]).add(attempt);
    }
    return grouped;
  }

  final SafeTtsController _tts = SafeTtsController();

  Future<void> _speak(String text) => _tts.speak(text);

  WordProfile<ContentItem> _profileFor(ContentItem item) =>
      _profiles[item.id] ??= WordProfileService.build(
        item,
        state,
        searchIndex: widget.searchIndex,
        verbIndex: widget.verbIndex,
        textNormalizer: widget.textNormalizer,
        itemAttempts: _attemptsByItem[item.id] ?? const <Attempt>[],
      );

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _tts.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final query = widget.textNormalizer.answer(q);
    List<ContentItem> results;

    if (query.isEmpty) {
      results = _learnedItems;
    } else {
      final searchResults = widget.searchIndex
          .searchDetailed(query, limit: 200)
          .map((x) => x.item);
      results =
          searchResults.where((item) => _learnedIds.contains(item.id)).toList();
    }

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('مكتبة المفردات')),
      body: Column(
        children: [
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
            child: TextField(
              onChanged: (v) => setState(() => q = v),
              textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
              decoration: const InputDecoration(
                prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.search),
                labelText: 'البحث في المفردات المكتسبة',
                hintText: 'ابحث بالألمانية أو العربية',
                border: OutlineInputBorder(),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          Expanded(
            child: results.isEmpty
                ? Center(
                    child: Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                      child: Column(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          const Icon(Icons.search_off, size: 48),
                          const SizedBox(height: 10),
                          Text(
                            _learnedItems.isEmpty
                                ? 'لم تكتسب أي مفردات بعد'
                                : 'لا توجد نتيجة مطابقة في مفرداتك المكتسبة',
                            style: const TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 18,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                            ),
                            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                          ),
                          if (_learnedItems.isNotEmpty) ...[
                            const SizedBox(height: 6),
                            const Text(
                              'جرّب الكلمة الألمانية أو ترجمتها العربية.',
                              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                            ),
                          ],
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  )
                : ListView.builder(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12),
                    itemCount: results.length,
                    itemBuilder: (c, i) {
                      final x = results[i];
                      return _LexiconWordCard(
                        item: x,
                        profile: _profileFor(x),
                        speak: _speak,
                        presentation: widget.presentation,
                      );
                    },
                  ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _LexiconWordCard extends StatelessWidget {
  final ContentItem item;
  final WordProfile<ContentItem> profile;
  final Future<void> Function(String) speak;
  final LanguagePresentation presentation;

  const _LexiconWordCard({

FILE: lib/ui_v35/pages/silent_bubble_popper.dart

import 'dart:math';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class BubbleItem {
  final String id;
  final String text;
  final bool isGerman;
  final String matchingId;

  BubbleItem({
    required this.id,
    required this.text,
    required this.isGerman,
    required this.matchingId,
  });
}

class BubbleState {
  final BubbleItem item;
  double x;
  double y;
  double phase;
  bool isMatched;
  bool isSelected;

  BubbleState({
    required this.item,
    required this.x,
    required this.y,
    required this.phase,
    this.isMatched = false,
    this.isSelected = false,
  });
}

class SilentBubblePopper extends StatefulWidget {
  final Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> Function() fetchVocabulary;
  final VoidCallback? onComplete;

  const SilentBubblePopper({
    super.key,
    required this.fetchVocabulary,
    this.onComplete,
  });

  @override
  State<SilentBubblePopper> createState() => _SilentBubblePopperState();
}

class _SilentBubblePopperState extends State<SilentBubblePopper>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late AnimationController _floatController;
  List<BubbleState> _bubbles = [];
  BubbleState? _selectedBubble;
  bool _isLoading = true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _floatController = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(seconds: 10),
    )..repeat();

    _loadVocabulary();
  }

  Future<void> _loadVocabulary() async {
    try {
      final entries = await widget.fetchVocabulary();
      List<Map<String, dynamic>> selectedEntries = [];

      if (entries.isEmpty || entries.length < 3) {
        // Fallback
        selectedEntries = [
          {'id': 'f1', 'german_text': 'Apfel', 'arabic_translation': 'تفاحة'},
          {'id': 'f2', 'german_text': 'Buch', 'arabic_translation': 'كتاب'},
          {'id': 'f3', 'german_text': 'Wasser', 'arabic_translation': 'ماء'},
          {'id': 'f4', 'german_text': 'Haus', 'arabic_translation': 'منزل'},
        ];
      } else {
        selectedEntries = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(entries)..shuffle();
        selectedEntries = selectedEntries.take(4).toList();
      }

      _generateBubbles(selectedEntries);
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _isLoading = false;
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // Fallback on error
      final selectedEntries = [
        {'id': 'e1', 'german_text': 'Apfel', 'arabic_translation': 'تفاحة'},
        {'id': 'e2', 'german_text': 'Buch', 'arabic_translation': 'كتاب'},
        {'id': 'e3', 'german_text': 'Wasser', 'arabic_translation': 'ماء'},
      ];
      _generateBubbles(selectedEntries);
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _isLoading = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  void _generateBubbles(List<Map<String, dynamic>> entries) {
    final random = Random();
    List<BubbleState> newBubbles = [];

    for (var entry in entries) {
      final id = entry['id'] as String;

      newBubbles.add(
        BubbleState(
          item: BubbleItem(
            id: '${id}_de',
            text: entry['german_text'] as String,
            isGerman: true,
            matchingId: '${id}_ar',
          ),
          x: random.nextDouble(),
          y: random.nextDouble(),
          phase: random.nextDouble() * 2 * pi,
        ),
      );

      newBubbles.add(
        BubbleState(
          item: BubbleItem(
            id: '${id}_ar',
            text: entry['arabic_translation'] as String,
            isGerman: false,
            matchingId: '${id}_de',
          ),
          x: random.nextDouble(),
          y: random.nextDouble(),
          phase: random.nextDouble() * 2 * pi,
        ),
      );
    }

    newBubbles.shuffle();
    _bubbles = newBubbles;
  }

  void _handleBubbleTap(BubbleState tapped) {
    if (tapped.isMatched) return;

    setState(() {
      if (_selectedBubble == null) {
        tapped.isSelected = true;
        _selectedBubble = tapped;
      } else {
        if (_selectedBubble == tapped) {
          tapped.isSelected = false;
          _selectedBubble = null;
        } else if (_selectedBubble!.item.matchingId == tapped.item.id) {
          // Match found
          tapped.isMatched = true;
          _selectedBubble!.isMatched = true;
          _selectedBubble!.isSelected = false;
          _selectedBubble = null;

          _checkCompletion();
        } else {
          // Mismatch
          _selectedBubble!.isSelected = false;
          tapped.isSelected = true;
          _selectedBubble = tapped;
        }
      }
    });
  }

  void _checkCompletion() {
    if (_bubbles.every((b) => b.isMatched)) {
      Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 500), () {
        if (mounted) {
          if (widget.onComplete != null) {
            widget.onComplete!();
          } else {
            Navigator.of(context).pop();
          }
        }
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _floatController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_isLoading) {
      return Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
        body: const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
      );
    }

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Column(
          children: [
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
              child: Text(
                'Silent Popper',
                style: Theme.of(context)
                    .textTheme
                    .headlineSmall
                    ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w300, letterSpacing: 1.5),
              ),
            ),
            Text(
              'Match the words to pop the bubbles.',
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                    color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                  ),
            ),
            Expanded(
              child: LayoutBuilder(
                builder: (context, constraints) {
                  return AnimatedBuilder(
                    animation: _floatController,
                    builder: (context, child) {
                      return Stack(
                        children: _bubbles.where((b) => !b.isMatched).map((
                          bubble,
                        ) {
                          // Calculate position with float
                          final floatOffset = sin(
                                bubble.phase + _floatController.value * 2 * pi,
                              ) *
                              20;
                          final xPos = bubble.x * (constraints.maxWidth - 100);
                          final yPos =
                              bubble.y * (constraints.maxHeight - 100) +
                                  floatOffset;

                          return Positioned(
                            left: xPos.clamp(0.0, constraints.maxWidth - 100),
                            top: yPos.clamp(0.0, constraints.maxHeight - 100),
                            child: GestureDetector(
                              onTap: () => _handleBubbleTap(bubble),
                              child: Container(
                                width: 100,
                                height: 100,
                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                                  color: bubble.isSelected
                                      ? Theme.of(context)
                                          .colorScheme
                                          .primaryContainer
                                      : Theme.of(context)
                                          .colorScheme
                                          .surfaceContainerHighest
                                          .withValues(alpha: 0.8),
                                  border: Border.all(
                                    color: bubble.isSelected
                                        ? Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary
                                        : Theme.of(context)
                                            .colorScheme
                                            .outline
                                            .withValues(alpha: 0.3),
                                    width: bubble.isSelected ? 2.0 : 1.0,
                                  ),
                                  boxShadow: [
                                    BoxShadow(
                                      color: Theme.of(context)
                                          .colorScheme
                                          .shadow
                                          .withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                                      blurRadius: 10,
                                      offset: const Offset(0, 4),
                                    ),
                                  ],
                                ),
                                child: Center(
                                  child: Padding(
                                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8.0),
                                    child: Directionality(
                                      textDirection: bubble.item.isGerman
                                          ? TextDirection.ltr
                                          : TextDirection.rtl,
                                      child: Text(
                                        bubble.item.text,
                                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                                        style: TextStyle(
                                          color: bubble.isSelected
                                              ? Theme.of(context)
                                                  .colorScheme
                                                  .onPrimaryContainer
                                              : Theme.of(context)
                                                  .colorScheme
                                                  .onSurface,
                                          fontWeight: bubble.isSelected
                                              ? FontWeight.bold
                                              : FontWeight.normal,
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          );
                        }).toList(),
                      );
                    },
                  );
                },
              ),
            ),
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
              child: TextButton(
                onPressed: () {
                  if (widget.onComplete != null) {
                    widget.onComplete!();
                  } else {
                    Navigator.of(context).pop();
                  }
                },
                child: const Text('Skip'),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class LearningCardViewModel {
  final String sourceText;
  final String targetText;
  final String prompt;
  final double progress;

  const LearningCardViewModel({
    required this.sourceText,
    required this.targetText,
    required this.prompt,
    required this.progress,
  });

  factory LearningCardViewModel.fromNeutralMap(Map<String, Object?> map) {
    final sourceText = _requiredText(map, 'sourceText');
    final targetText = _requiredText(map, 'targetText');
    final prompt = (map['prompt'] as String?) ?? '';
    final rawProgress = map['progress'];

    return LearningCardViewModel(
      sourceText: sourceText,
      targetText: targetText,
      prompt: prompt,
      progress:
          rawProgress is num ? rawProgress.toDouble().clamp(0.0, 1.0) : 0.0,
    );
  }
}

  final String targetText;

    required this.id,
    required this.sourceText,
    required this.targetText,
    required this.dueLabel,
  });

  const ReviewQueueViewModel({required this.items});

String _requiredText(Map<String, Object?> map, String key) {
  final value = map[key];
  if (value is! String || value.trim().isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(value, key, 'must be a non-empty string');
  }
  return value;
}

class _PersonalPathCardState extends State<PersonalPathCard> {
  late LearnerState _state;
  late LearningPath _path;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _rebuildPlan();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant PersonalPathCard oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.revision != widget.revision) _rebuildPlan();
  }

  void _rebuildPlan() {
    _state = widget.repo.load();
    _path = LearningEngine.buildPlan(
      widget.corpus,
      _state,
      exerciseStrategy: widget.exerciseStrategy,
      contentQuality: widget.contentQuality,
      contentIntelligence: widget.contentIntelligence,
      dailyGoal: 8,
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext c) {
    final first = _path.items.isEmpty ? null : _path.items.first;
    return Card(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Row(
              children: [
                const Icon(Icons.route_outlined),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    'المسار الشخصي اليومي',
                    style: Theme.of(c)
                        .textTheme
                        .titleLarge
                        ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                  ),
                ),
                Text('${_path.items.length}'),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 7),
            Text(
              first == null
                  ? 'لا توجد عناصر صالحة الآن.'
                  : 'ابدأ بـ ${first.item.sourceText} — ${first.reason}',
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Text(
              'مراجعة ${_path.reviewCount} • علاج ${_path.repairCount} • جديد ${_path.newCount} • التركيز: ${_path.focusSkill}',
              style: Theme.of(c).textTheme.bodySmall,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            SizedBox(

                  c,
                  MaterialPageRoute(
                    builder: (_) => PersonalizedPathPage(
                      repo: widget.repo,
                      corpus: widget.corpus,

                      onDone: widget.onDone,
                      exerciseStrategy: widget.exerciseStrategy,
                      presentation: widget.presentation,
                      contentQuality: widget.contentQuality,

                      contentIntelligence: widget.contentIntelligence,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),

              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

class PersonalizedPathPage extends StatelessWidget {
  final LearnerRepository repo;
  final List<ContentItem> corpus;
  final SearchIndex searchIndex;
  final VerbIndex verbIndex;
  final VoidCallback onDone;
  final LanguageExerciseStrategy exerciseStrategy;
  final LanguagePresentation presentation;
  final LanguageContentQuality contentQuality;
  final LanguageTextNormalizer textNormalizer;
  final LanguageContentIntelligence contentIntelligence;
  const PersonalizedPathPage({
    super.key,
    required this.repo,
    required this.corpus,
    required this.searchIndex,
    required this.verbIndex,
    required this.onDone,
    required this.exerciseStrategy,
    required this.presentation,
    required this.contentQuality,
    required this.textNormalizer,
    required this.contentIntelligence,
  });
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext c) {
    final state = repo.load();
    final path = LearningEngine.buildPlan(
      corpus,
      state,
      exerciseStrategy: exerciseStrategy,
      contentQuality: contentQuality,
      contentIntelligence: contentIntelligence,
      dailyGoal: 10,
    );
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('مسارك الشخصي')),
      body: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
        children: [
          Card(
            child: ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(Icons.flag_outlined),
              title: Text('تركيز اليوم: ${path.focusSkill}'),
              subtitle: Text(
                'الخطة: ${path.reviewCount} مراجعة • ${path.repairCount} علاج • ${path.newCount} جديد',
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          ...path.items.asMap().entries.map((e) {
            final x = e.value;
            return Card(
              child: ListTile(
                leading: CircleAvatar(child: Text('${e.key + 1}')),
                title: Text(
                  x.item.sourceText,
                  textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                ),
                subtitle: Text('${x.item.translationText}\n${x.reason}'),
                isThreeLine: true,
                trailing: Text(x.mode),
              ),
            );
          }),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          FilledButton.icon(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.push(
              c,
              MaterialPageRoute(
                builder: (_) => CoreSession(
                  repo: repo,
                  corpus: corpus,
                  onDone: onDone,
                  exerciseStrategy: exerciseStrategy,
                  presentation: presentation,
                  contentQuality: contentQuality,
                  textNormalizer: textNormalizer,
                  contentIntelligence: contentIntelligence,
                ),
              ),
            ),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.play_arrow),
            label: const Text('ابدأ جلسة التدريب'),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          OutlinedButton.icon(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.push(
              c,
              MaterialPageRoute(
                builder: (_) => ReadingPracticePage(
                  repo: repo,
                  corpus: corpus,
                  searchIndex: searchIndex,
                  verbIndex: verbIndex,
                  contentQuality: contentQuality,
                ),
              ),
            ),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.menu_book_outlined),
            label: const Text('تابع بقراءة تفاعلية'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class ReadingPracticePage extends StatelessWidget {
  final LearnerRepository repo;
  final List<ContentItem> corpus;
  final SearchIndex searchIndex;
  final VerbIndex verbIndex;
  final LanguageContentQuality contentQuality;
  const ReadingPracticePage({
    super.key,
    required this.repo,
    required this.corpus,
    required this.searchIndex,
    required this.verbIndex,
    required this.contentQuality,
  });
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext c) {
    final state = repo.load();
    final p = ProgressSnapshotService.build(
      state.attempts,
      state.assessmentHistory,
    );
    final passage = ReadingPractice.build(
      corpus,
      contentQuality: contentQuality,
      focusSkill: p.weakestSkill,
      targetWords: 6,
      maxSentences: 5,
    );
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('القراءة التفاعلية')),
      body: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
        children: [
          Card(
            child: ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(Icons.menu_book_outlined),
              title: Text(passage.title),
              subtitle: const Text(
                'اقرأ، اضغط على الكلمات، ثم تدرب على الجمل التي ظهرت لك.',
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          ...passage.sentences.map(
            (x) => Card(
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      x.exampleText,
                      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                      style: Theme.of(c)
                          .textTheme
                          .titleLarge
                          ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 5),
                    Text(x.exampleTranslationText),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    Wrap(
                      spacing: 6,
                      runSpacing: 6,
                      children: x.exampleText
                          .split(RegExp(r'\s+'))
                          .map(
                            (word) => ActionChip(
                              label: Text(
                                word,
                                textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                              ),
                              onPressed: () => _showWord(c, word, x),
                            ),
                          )
                          .toList(),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text(
            'كلمات التركيز: ${passage.targetWords.join(' • ')}',
            textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showWord(BuildContext c, String raw, LearningContent source) {
    final word = raw.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^A-Za-zÄÖÜäöüß-]'), '').toLowerCase();
    final matches = searchIndex.search(word, limit: 3);
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: c,
      builder: (_) => Directionality(
        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
        child: SafeArea(
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text(
                  raw,
                  textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 22,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                  ),
                ),
                Text(
                  matches.isEmpty
                      ? 'من الجملة: ${source.translationText}'
                      : matches
                          .map(
                            (x) =>
                                '${x.sourceText} — ${x.translationText}${x.grammaticalMarker.isEmpty ? '' : ' • ${x.grammaticalMarker}'}',
                          )
                          .join('\n'),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                const Text('استخدم هذه الكلمة في جملة جديدة لتثبيتها.'),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class LearningDashboardPage extends StatelessWidget {

    required this.verbIndex,
    required this.exerciseStrategy,

    required this.contentIntelligence,
  });

              trailing: Text('${action.itemCount}'),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          _NextStepCard(
            repo: repo,
            corpus: corpus,
            focusSkill: action.skill,
            searchIndex: searchIndex,
            verbIndex: verbIndex,
            contentQuality: contentQuality,
            textNormalizer: textNormalizer,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Card(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    'خطة اليوم',
                    style: Theme.of(c)
                        .textTheme
                        .titleLarge
                        ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                  Text(
                    'المجموع: ${plan.total} • مراجعة: ${plan.review} • علاج: ${plan.repair} • جديد: ${plan.newContent}',
                  ),
                  Text(
                    'استماع: ${plan.listening} • إنتاج: ${plan.production} • التركيز: ${plan.focusSkill}',
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          ...scores.entries.map(
            (e) => ListTile(
              title: Text(_skillName(e.key)),
              subtitle: LinearProgressIndicator(value: e.value),
              trailing: Text('${(e.value * 100).round()}%'),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          FilledButton.icon(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.push(
              c,
              MaterialPageRoute(
                builder: (_) => CoreSession(
                  repo: repo,
                  corpus: corpus,
                  onDone: () => Navigator.pop(c),
                  exerciseStrategy: exerciseStrategy,
                  presentation: presentation,
                  contentQuality: contentQuality,
                  textNormalizer: textNormalizer,
                  contentIntelligence: contentIntelligence,
                ),
              ),
            ),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.play_arrow),
            label: const Text('ابدأ الخطة الآن'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  static String _skillName(String s) =>
      const {
        'recall': 'التعرّف',
        'listening': 'الاستماع',
        'production': 'الإنتاج',
        'transfer': 'النقل',
      }[s] ??
      s;
}

class _NextStepCard extends StatelessWidget {

                  fontSize: 17,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,

          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class SpeechPracticePage extends StatefulWidget {
  final LearnerRepository repo;
  const SpeechPracticePage({super.key, required this.repo});
  @override
  State<SpeechPracticePage> createState() => _SpeechPracticeState();
}

class _SpeechPracticeState extends State<SpeechPracticePage> {
  final SpeechService speech = SpeechService();
  final SafeTtsController tts = SafeTtsController();
  String heard = '',
      status = 'اضغط على الميكروفون ثم انطق جملة قصيرة بالألمانية.';
  bool listening = false;
  bool speechBusy = false;
  final target = 'Ich lerne Deutsch.';
  Future<void> speakTarget() => tts.speak(target, rate: .43);
  Future<void> toggle() async {
    if (speechBusy) return;
    if (listening) {
      speechBusy = true;
      try {
        await speech.stop();
        if (!mounted) return;
        setState(() => listening = false);
      } finally {
        speechBusy = false;
      }
      return;
    }
    speechBusy = true;
    try {
      final ok = await speech.listen(
        onResult: (SpeechResult r) {
          if (!mounted) return;
          setState(() {
            heard = r.recognizedWords;
            status = r.finalResult ? 'تم التقاط العبارة.' : 'أستمع...';
          });
        },
      );
      if (mounted)
        setState(() {
          listening = ok;
          if (!ok)
            status =
                'تعذر تشغيل التعرف الصوتي. تحقق من إذن الميكروفون وإعداد اللغة الألمانية.';
        });
    } finally {
      speechBusy = false;
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    speech.dispose();
    tts.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext c) => Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('مختبر النطق')),
        body: ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
          children: [
            const Text(
                'Shadowing: اسمع، كرر، ثم قارن النص الذي التقطه الجهاز.'),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Card(
              child: ListTile(
                title: const Text('الجملة المستهدفة'),
                subtitle: Text(target, textDirection: TextDirection.ltr),
                trailing: IconButton(
                  tooltip: 'استمع للجملة المستهدفة',
                  onPressed: speakTarget,
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.volume_up_outlined),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Card(
              child: ListTile(
                title: Text(
                  heard.isEmpty ? 'لم يتم التعرف بعد' : heard,
                  textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                ),
                subtitle: Text(status),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            FilledButton.icon(
              onPressed: toggle,
              icon: Icon(listening ? Icons.stop : Icons.mic),
              label: Text(listening ? 'إيقاف' : 'ابدأ النطق'),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            const Text(
              'ملاحظة: التعرف الصوتي يعتمد على خدمة/محرك الجهاز وقد يحتاج اتصالًا بالإنترنت حسب إعدادات Android.',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

class PrivacyCenterPage extends StatefulWidget {
  final PrivacySettingsStore privacySettings;
  const PrivacyCenterPage({super.key, required this.privacySettings});
  @override
  State<PrivacyCenterPage> createState() => _PrivacyCenterState();
}

class _PrivacyCenterState extends State<PrivacyCenterPage> {
  bool cloud = false, speech = false, loading = true;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    cloud = await widget.privacySettings.cloudAiEnabled();
    speech = await widget.privacySettings.speechEnabled();
    if (mounted) setState(() => loading = false);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext c) => Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('الخصوصية')),
        body: loading
            ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
            : ListView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
                children: [
                  const Card(
                    child: ListTile(
                      leading: Icon(Icons.offline_bolt_outlined),
                      title: Text('الأساس المحلي'),
                      subtitle: Text('المحتوى والتقدم وSRS لا تحتاج إلى خادم.'),
                    ),
                  ),
                  SwitchListTile(
                    title: const Text('ميزات AI السحابية'),
                    subtitle: const Text(
                      'تسمح بإرسال النص الذي تختاره فقط إلى خادم AI آمن عند ربطه. مغلقة افتراضيًا.',
                    ),
                    value: cloud,
                    onChanged: (v) async {
                      final saved = await widget.privacySettings.setCloudAi(v);
                      if (saved && mounted) setState(() => cloud = v);
                    },
                  ),
                  SwitchListTile(
                    title: const Text('التعرف الصوتي'),
                    subtitle: const Text(
                      'يسمح باستخدام ميكروفون الجهاز لتدريب النطق.',
                    ),
                    value: speech,
                    onChanged: (v) async {
                      final saved = await widget.privacySettings.setSpeech(v);
                      if (saved && mounted) setState(() => speech = v);
                    },
                  ),
                  const Divider(height: 28),
                  const Text(
                    'لا توجد مفاتيح API سرية داخل التطبيق. أي تكامل سحابي يجب أن يمر عبر طبقة آمنة ويستخدم HTTPS فقط.',
                  ),
                ],
              ),
      );
}

class MasteryDashboardPage extends StatelessWidget {

                  leading: const Icon(Icons.schedule),

                  subtitle: Text(
                    '${snapshot.overdueItems} متأخرة • المراجعة التالية المتوقعة: ${snapshot.nextReviewDays} يوم',

                ListTile(

          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Card(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    'تغطية المحتوى',
                    style: Theme.of(c)
                        .textTheme
                        .titleLarge
                        ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Text(
                    'A1: ${snapshot.contentReport.a1Count} • A2: ${snapshot.contentReport.a2Count} • B1: ${snapshot.contentReport.b1Count}',
                  ),
                  Text(
                    'Word families: ${snapshot.contentReport.wordFamilyCount} • Near duplicates: ${snapshot.contentReport.nearDuplicatePairCount}',

            Text(
              'أولوية المراجعة',
              style: Theme.of(c)
                  .textTheme

            ),

              (id) => ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(Icons.priority_high),
                title: Text(id),
                subtitle: const Text('اختاره SRS كعنصر ذي أولوية أعلى.'),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _metric(BuildContext c, String title, double value) => Card(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),

            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [

              LinearProgressIndicator(value: value),
              const SizedBox(height: 5),
              Text('${(value * 100).round()}%'),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class NeuroAccessibilityMode extends InheritedWidget {
  final bool isEnabled;

  const NeuroAccessibilityMode({
    super.key,
    required this.isEnabled,
    required super.child,
  });

  static NeuroAccessibilityMode? maybeOf(BuildContext context) {
    return context.dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType<NeuroAccessibilityMode>();
  }

  static bool of(BuildContext context) {
    final result = maybeOf(context);
    return result?.isEnabled ?? false;
  }

  @override
  bool updateShouldNotify(NeuroAccessibilityMode oldWidget) =>
      isEnabled != oldWidget.isEnabled;
}

extension NeuroAccessibilityThemeExtension on ThemeData {
  ThemeData applyNeuroAccessibility() {
    return copyWith(
      textTheme: textTheme.copyWith(
        bodyLarge: textTheme.bodyLarge?.copyWith(
          letterSpacing: 1.5,
          height: 1.8,
          // Optional: use a dyslexia-friendly font family if available,
          // or fallback to a clean sans-serif.
        ),
        bodyMedium: textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
          letterSpacing: 1.5,
          height: 1.8,
        ),
        titleLarge: textTheme.titleLarge?.copyWith(letterSpacing: 1.2),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../design_system/app_colors.dart';

abstract final class AppPalette {
  static const Color primary = AppColors.primary;
  static const Color primaryDark = AppColors.primaryDark;
  static const Color secondary = AppColors.secondary;
  static const Color secondaryDark = AppColors.secondaryDark;
  static const Color tertiary = AppColors.tertiary;
  static const Color tertiaryDark = AppColors.tertiaryDark;

  static const Color lightBackground = AppColors.lightBackground;
  static const Color lightSurface = AppColors.lightSurface;
  static const Color darkBackground = AppColors.darkBackground;
  static const Color darkSurface = AppColors.darkSurface;

  static const Color articleDer = AppColors.articleDer;
  static const Color articleDie = AppColors.articleDie;
  static const Color articleDas = AppColors.articleDas;
  static const Color articleOther = AppColors.articleOther;

  static const Color streak = AppColors.streak;
  static const Color xp = AppColors.xp;
  static const Color achievement = AppColors.achievement;
  static const Color mastery = AppColors.mastery;
}

abstract final class AppDesignSystem {
  static ThemeData light() => _build(Brightness.light);
  static ThemeData dark() => _build(Brightness.dark);

  static ThemeData _build(Brightness brightness) {
    final isDark = brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final background =
        isDark ? AppPalette.darkBackground : AppPalette.lightBackground;
    final surface = isDark ? AppPalette.darkSurface : AppPalette.lightSurface;

    final generated = ColorScheme.fromSeed(
      seedColor: AppPalette.primary,
      brightness: brightness,
    );
    final scheme = generated.copyWith(
      primary: isDark ? AppPalette.primaryDark : AppPalette.primary,
      secondary: isDark ? AppPalette.secondaryDark : AppPalette.secondary,
      tertiary: isDark ? AppPalette.tertiaryDark : AppPalette.tertiary,
      surface: surface,
    );

    final base = ThemeData(
      useMaterial3: true,
      brightness: brightness,
      colorScheme: scheme,
      scaffoldBackgroundColor: background,
      visualDensity: VisualDensity.standard,
    );

    final textTheme = base.textTheme.copyWith(
      headlineMedium: base.textTheme.headlineMedium?.copyWith(
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
        height: 1.18,
      ),
      headlineSmall: base.textTheme.headlineSmall?.copyWith(
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
        height: 1.20,
      ),
      titleLarge: base.textTheme.titleLarge?.copyWith(
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
        height: 1.25,
      ),
      titleMedium: base.textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
        height: 1.28,
      ),
      bodyLarge: base.textTheme.bodyLarge?.copyWith(height: 1.48),
      bodyMedium: base.textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(height: 1.45),
      labelLarge: base.textTheme.labelLarge?.copyWith(
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
      ),
    );

    final cardBorder = scheme.outlineVariant.withValues(
      alpha: isDark ? 0.42 : 0.55,
    );

    return base.copyWith(
      textTheme: textTheme,
      appBarTheme: AppBarThemeData(
        backgroundColor: background,
        foregroundColor: scheme.onSurface,
        surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
        elevation: 0,
        scrolledUnderElevation: 0,
        centerTitle: false,
        titleTextStyle: textTheme.titleLarge?.copyWith(color: scheme.onSurface),
      ),
      cardTheme: CardThemeData(
        color: surface,
        surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
        elevation: 1,
        shadowColor: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.30 : 0.07),
        margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 6),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
          side: BorderSide(color: cardBorder),
        ),
      ),
      navigationBarTheme: NavigationBarThemeData(
        height: 70,
        elevation: 0,
        backgroundColor: surface,
        indicatorColor: scheme.primaryContainer,
        indicatorShape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        ),
        labelTextStyle: const WidgetStatePropertyAll(
          TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
        ),
      ),
      filledButtonTheme: FilledButtonThemeData(
        style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
          minimumSize: const Size(48, 48),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18, vertical: 13),
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(15),
          ),
          textStyle: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
        ),
      ),
      outlinedButtonTheme: OutlinedButtonThemeData(
        style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
          minimumSize: const Size(48, 48),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18, vertical: 13),
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(15),
          ),
        ),
      ),
      floatingActionButtonTheme: FloatingActionButtonThemeData(
        backgroundColor: scheme.primaryContainer,
        foregroundColor: scheme.onPrimaryContainer,
        elevation: 2,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18)),
      ),
      inputDecorationTheme: InputDecorationThemeData(
        filled: true,
        fillColor: isDark ? const Color(0xFF22262D) : const Color(0xFFFFFDF9),
        contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
          horizontal: 16,
          vertical: 14,
        ),
        border: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(15),
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: cardBorder),
        ),
        enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(15),
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: cardBorder),
        ),
        focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(15),
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: scheme.primary, width: 1.5),
        ),
      ),
      progressIndicatorTheme: ProgressIndicatorThemeData(
        color: scheme.primary,
        linearTrackColor: scheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
        linearMinHeight: 8,
      ),
      chipTheme: base.chipTheme.copyWith(
        side: BorderSide(color: cardBorder),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999)),
        labelStyle: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
      ),
      dividerTheme: DividerThemeData(
        color: scheme.outlineVariant.withValues(alpha: 0.55),
        thickness: 1,
        space: 1,
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class AppTheme {
  // الألوان الأساسية للتطبيق
  static const Color primaryColor = Color(0xFF1E88E5);
  static const Color accentColor = Color(0xFFFFB300);
  static const Color backgroundColor = Color(0xFFF8F9FA);
  static const Color darkTextColor = Color(0xFF212121);

  // النمط العام للواجهات (ThemeData)
  static ThemeData get lightTheme {
    return ThemeData(
      useMaterial3: true,
      primaryColor: primaryColor,
      scaffoldBackgroundColor: backgroundColor,
      appBarTheme: const AppBarTheme(
        backgroundColor: primaryColor,
        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
        elevation: 0,
        centerTitle: true,
      ),
      elevatedButtonTheme: ElevatedButtonThemeData(
        style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
          backgroundColor: primaryColor,
          foregroundColor: Colors.white,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          ),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24, vertical: 12),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../models/verb_conjugation.dart';
import '../services/repository.dart';
import '../services/verb_index.dart';
import 'safe_ui.dart';

class VerbConjugationPage extends StatefulWidget {
  final LearnerRepository repo;
  final VerbIndex verbIndex;
  const VerbConjugationPage({
    super.key,
    required this.repo,
    required this.verbIndex,
  });
  @override
  State<VerbConjugationPage> createState() => _VerbConjugationPageState();
}

class _VerbConjugationPageState extends State<VerbConjugationPage> {
  final SafeTtsController _tts = SafeTtsController();
  final Set<String> _favorites = <String>{};

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadFavorites();
  }

  Future<void> _loadFavorites() async {
    try {
      final saved = await widget.repo.loadAndMigrateFavoriteVerbs();
      if (mounted)
        setState(() {
          _favorites.addAll(saved);
        });
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> _toggleFavorite(String infinitive) async {
    try {
      await widget.repo.toggleFavoriteVerb(infinitive);
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        if (_favorites.contains(infinitive)) {
          _favorites.remove(infinitive);
        } else {
          _favorites.add(infinitive);
        }
      });
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) setState(() {});
    }
  }

  Future<void> _speak(String text) => _tts.speak(text);

  Widget _audioButton(String text) => IconButton(
        tooltip: 'استمع للنطق الألماني',
        onPressed: () => _speak(text),
        icon: const Icon(Icons.volume_up_outlined),
      );

  Widget _verbCard(BuildContext c, VerbConjugation v) {
    final key = '${v.infinitive}|${v.person}';
    final isFav = _favorites.contains(v.infinitive);
    return Card(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 12, 14, 14),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    v.infinitive,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 20,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                    ),
                    textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                  ),
                ),
                IconButton(
                  tooltip: isFav
                      ? 'إزالة الفعل من المفضلة'
                      : 'إضافة الفعل إلى قائمة الأفعال الدراسية',
                  onPressed: () => _toggleFavorite(v.infinitive),
                  icon: Icon(isFav ? Icons.star : Icons.star_border),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            Text(v.arabic, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16)),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 8),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Theme.of(c).colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      '${v.person} — ${v.personAr}',
                      style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
                    ),
                  ),
                  _audioButton(v.form),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Text(
              'الحاضر: ${v.form}',
              style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
              textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
            ),
            Text('المعنى: ${v.personAr} ${v.arabic}'),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Text(
              'الماضي (Perfekt): ${v.past}',
              style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
              textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
            ),
            Text('ترجمة الماضي: ${v.pastArabic}'),
            const Divider(height: 20),
            Text('مثال الحاضر', style: Theme.of(c).textTheme.labelLarge),
            Row(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    v.example,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 16,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                    ),
                    textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                  ),
                ),
                _audioButton(v.example),
              ],
            ),
            Text(v.exampleAr),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Text('مثال الماضي', style: Theme.of(c).textTheme.labelLarge),
            Row(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    v.pastExample,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 16,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                    ),
                    textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                  ),
                ),
                _audioButton(v.pastExample),
              ],
            ),
            Text(v.pastExampleAr),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            Text('معرّف الدراسة: $key', style: Theme.of(c).textTheme.bodySmall),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext c) {
    final groups = widget.verbIndex.groups;
    final ks = groups.keys.toList()..sort();
    final uniqueVerbs = widget.verbIndex.infinitives.length;
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('الأفعال والتصريف'),
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            tooltip: 'قائمة الأفعال المفضلة',
            onPressed: () => Navigator.push(
              c,
              MaterialPageRoute(
                builder: (_) => VerbFavoritesPage(
                  favorites: _favorites.toList(),
                  speak: _speak,
                  verbIndex: widget.verbIndex,
                ),
              ),
            ),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.star),
          ),
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12),
            child: Center(child: Text('المفضلة: ${_favorites.length}')),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 10, 12, 24),
        children: [
          Card(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
              child: Text(
                'كل ضمير مستقل: ich، du، er، sie (هي)، es، wir، ihr، sie (هم)، Sie. لكل تصريف نطق مستقل، ماضٍ، ومثال حاضر ومثال ماضٍ مع الترجمة. عدد الأفعال: $uniqueVerbs',
              ),
            ),
          ),
          for (final g in ks) ...[
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(4, 14, 4, 8),
              child: Text(
                g,
                style: Theme.of(c)
                    .textTheme
                    .titleLarge
                    ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
              ),
            ),
            for (final infinitive in groups[g] ?? const <String>[])
              ...widget.verbIndex
                  .rowsFor(infinitive)
                  .map((v) => _verbCard(c, v)),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _tts.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }
}

class VerbFavoritesPage extends StatelessWidget {
  final List<String> favorites;
  final Future<void> Function(String) speak;
  final VerbIndex verbIndex;
  const VerbFavoritesPage({
    super.key,
    required this.favorites,
    required this.speak,
    required this.verbIndex,
  });
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext c) {
    final selected = <VerbConjugation>[];
    for (final favorite in favorites) {
      selected.addAll(verbIndex.rowsFor(favorite));
    }
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: Text('أفعال للدراسة (${favorites.length})')),
      body: favorites.isEmpty
          ? const Center(
              child: Text(
                'لم تضف أفعالًا للمفضلة بعد. اضغط ⭐ بجانب الفعل لإضافته.',
              ),
            )
          : ListView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
              children: [
                for (final v in selected)
                  Card(
                    child: Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                        children: [
                          Row(
                            children: [
                              Expanded(
                                child: Text(
                                  v.infinitive,
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 20,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                                  ),
                                  textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                                ),
                              ),
                              IconButton(
                                tooltip: 'نطق الفعل',
                                onPressed: () => speak(v.infinitive),
                                icon: const Icon(Icons.volume_up_outlined),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                          Text(v.arabic),
                          const SizedBox(height: 8),
                          Text(
                            '${v.person} — ${v.form}',
                            style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
                            textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                          ),
                          Text(v.personAr),
                          const SizedBox(height: 6),
                          Text(
                            'الماضي: ${v.past}',
                            textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                          ),
                          Text(v.pastArabic),
                          const SizedBox(height: 8),
                          Text(
                            v.example,
                            style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                            textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                          ),
                          Text(v.exampleAr),
                          const SizedBox(height: 6),
                          Text(
                            v.pastExample,
                            style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                            textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                          ),
                          Text(v.pastExampleAr),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
    );
  }
}
