import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../services/repository.dart';
import '../../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../../services/app_dependencies.dart';

class ZenContextReader extends StatefulWidget {
  final LearnerRepository repo;
  final AppDependencies<LearningContent> dependencies;

  const ZenContextReader({
    super.key,
    required this.repo,
    required this.dependencies,
  });

  @override
  State<ZenContextReader> createState() => _ZenContextReaderState();
}

class _ZenContextReaderState extends State<ZenContextReader> {
  List<String> _paragraphs = [];
  bool _isLoading = true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadMasteredVocabulary();
  }

  Future<void> _loadMasteredVocabulary() async {
    setState(() => _isLoading = true);

    try {
      final state = widget.repo.load();
      final learnedIds = state.learned;

      if (learnedIds.isEmpty) {
        setState(() {
          _paragraphs = [
            'Keine Vokabeln gemeistert.',
            'Bitte lernen Sie mehr Wörter, um Texte zu lesen.',
          ];
          _isLoading = false;
        });
        return;
      }

      final learnedContent = widget.dependencies.corpus
          .where((c) => learnedIds.contains(c.id))
          .toList();
      final sentences = learnedContent
          .map((c) => c.exampleText)
          .where((s) => s.isNotEmpty)
          .toList();

      if (sentences.isEmpty) {
        setState(() {
          _paragraphs = ['Nicht genug Vokabeln für einen Text.'];
          _isLoading = false;
        });
        return;
      }

      // Group sentences into short paragraphs for coherent contextual reading
      final paragraphs = <String>[];
      for (int i = 0; i < sentences.length; i += 3) {
        final end = (i + 3 < sentences.length) ? i + 3 : sentences.length;
        paragraphs.add(sentences.sublist(i, end).join(' '));
      }

      setState(() {
        _paragraphs = paragraphs;
        _isLoading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      setState(() {
        _paragraphs = ['Fehler beim Laden des Textes.'];
        _isLoading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('Zen Kontext Leser'),
        backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
        elevation: 0,
      ),
      body: _isLoading
          ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
          : Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24.0),
              child: ListView.builder(
                itemCount: _paragraphs.length,
                itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                  return Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 24.0),
                    child: Text(
                      _paragraphs[index],
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontFamily: 'Inter',
                        fontSize: 20,
                        height: 1.6,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                },
              ),
            ),
    );
  }
}

class CommutePlaybackControls extends StatelessWidget {
  const CommutePlaybackControls({
    super.key,
    required this.playing,
    required this.busy,
    required this.onPlay,
    required this.onPause,
    required this.onKnown,
    required this.onUnknown,
  });

  final bool playing;
  final bool busy;
  final VoidCallback onPlay;
  final VoidCallback onPause;
  final VoidCallback onKnown;
  final VoidCallback onUnknown;

  static const double _controlHeight = 72;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              Expanded(
                child: SizedBox(
                  height: _controlHeight,
                  child: FilledButton.icon(
                    onPressed: busy || playing ? null : onPlay,
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.play_arrow, size: 34),
                    label: const Text(
                      'تشغيل',
                      style:
                          TextStyle(fontSize: 20, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 12),
              Expanded(
                child: SizedBox(
                  height: _controlHeight,
                  child: FilledButton.tonalIcon(
                    onPressed: playing ? onPause : null,
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.pause, size: 34),
                    label: const Text(
                      'إيقاف مؤقت',
                      style:
                          TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          SizedBox(
            height: _controlHeight,
            child: FilledButton.icon(
              onPressed: busy ? null : onKnown,
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF0B6E3C),
                foregroundColor: Colors.white,
              ),
              icon: const Icon(Icons.check_circle_outline, size: 32),
              label: const Text(
                'أعرفها',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 21, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          SizedBox(
            height: _controlHeight,
            child: FilledButton.icon(
              onPressed: busy ? null : onUnknown,
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF9B1C1C),
                foregroundColor: Colors.white,
              ),
              icon: const Icon(Icons.replay_outlined, size: 32),
              label: const Text(
                'لا أعرفها',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 21, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../features/commute/domain/commute_models.dart';
import '../../features/commute/hands_free_commute_service.dart';
import '../../models/content.dart';
import '../../services/app_dependencies.dart';
import '../../services/repository.dart';
import 'commute_controls.dart';

class HandsFreeCommutePage extends StatefulWidget {
  const HandsFreeCommutePage({
    super.key,
    required this.repo,
    required this.dependencies,
    required this.onDone,
  });

  final LearnerRepository repo;
  final AppDependencies<ContentItem> dependencies;
  final VoidCallback onDone;

  @override
  State<HandsFreeCommutePage> createState() => _HandsFreeCommutePageState();
}

class _HandsFreeCommutePageState extends State<HandsFreeCommutePage> {
  late final HandsFreeCommuteService<ContentItem> _service;
  List<CommuteReviewItem<ContentItem>> _queue =
      const <CommuteReviewItem<ContentItem>>[];

  bool _playing = false;
  bool _busy = false;
  int _reviewStartedMs = 0;
  String _status =
      'اضغط تشغيل: ألماني → وقفة → المعنى بالعربية → المثال بالألمانية.';

  CommuteReviewItem<ContentItem>? get _current =>
      _queue.isEmpty ? null : _queue.first;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _service = HandsFreeCommuteService<ContentItem>(
      repository: widget.repo,
      targetAudioRuntime: widget.dependencies.audioRuntime,
      sourceAudioRuntime: widget.dependencies.sourceAudioRuntime,
      targetLanguageCode: widget.dependencies.languagePack.languageCode,
      sourceLanguageCode: widget.dependencies.languagePack.sourceLocale,
      corpus: widget.dependencies.corpus,
    );
    _reloadQueue();
  }

  void _reloadQueue() {
    _queue = _service.pendingQueue(state: widget.repo.load(), limit: 50);
    _reviewStartedMs = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;
  }

  Future<void> _play() async {
    final current = _current;
    if (current == null || _playing || _busy) return;
    setState(() {
      _playing = true;
      _status = 'التسلسل الصوتي يعمل الآن. يمكنك الإيقاف المؤقت في أي وقت.';
    });

    final report = await _service.play(current);
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _playing = false;
      if (report.completed) {
        _status = 'اكتمل التسلسل. اختر أعرفها أو لا أعرفها.';
      } else if (report.stage == CommutePlaybackStage.cancelled) {
        _status = 'تم الإيقاف المؤقت. التشغيل التالي يبدأ العنصر من أوله.';
      } else {
        _status = 'تعذر الصوت عند ${_stageLabel(report.stage)}: '
            '${report.reason ?? 'audio_runtime_unavailable'}.';
      }
    });
  }

  Future<void> _pause() async {
    if (!_playing) return;
    await _service.pause();
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _playing = false;
      _status = 'تم الإيقاف المؤقت. التشغيل التالي يبدأ العنصر من أوله.';
    });
  }

  Future<void> _grade(bool known) async {
    final current = _current;
    if (current == null || _busy) return;
    setState(() => _busy = true);
    if (_playing) {
      await _service.pause();
    }
    final elapsed = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch - _reviewStartedMs;
    await _service.recordReview(
      current,
      known: known,
      seconds: (elapsed ~/ 1000).clamp(1, 3600).toInt(),
    );
    if (!mounted) return;

    setState(() {
      _playing = false;
      _busy = false;
      _reloadQueue();
      _status = known
          ? 'سُجلت كمعلومة معروفة في SRS.'
          : 'سُجلت للمراجعة الإضافية في SRS.';
    });
    widget.onDone();

    if (_queue.isNotEmpty) {
      await _play();
    }
  }

  String _stageLabel(CommutePlaybackStage stage) => switch (stage) {
        CommutePlaybackStage.targetTerm => 'الكلمة الألمانية',
        CommutePlaybackStage.sourceMeaning => 'المعنى العربي',
        CommutePlaybackStage.targetExample => 'المثال الألماني',
        CommutePlaybackStage.completed => 'الاكتمال',
        CommutePlaybackStage.cancelled => 'الإيقاف',
      };

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _service.pause();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final current = _current;
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: Colors.black,
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor: Colors.black,
        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
        title: const Text('وضع التنقل'),
      ),
      body: current == null
          ? const CommuteEmptyState()
          : SafeArea(
              child: ListView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 18, 16, 28),
                children: [
                  const Text(
                    'Audio-first SRS • لا تحتاج للنظر إلى الشاشة أثناء التشغيل.',
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: Colors.white70,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  CommuteNowPlayingCard(
                    review: current,
                    targetLanguageCode:
                        widget.dependencies.languagePack.languageCode,
                    sourceLanguageCode:
                        widget.dependencies.languagePack.sourceLocale,
                    position: 1,
                    total: _queue.length,
                    status: _status,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  CommutePlaybackControls(
                    playing: _playing,
                    busy: _busy,
                    onPlay: _play,
                    onPause: _pause,
                    onKnown: () => _grade(true),
                    onUnknown: () => _grade(false),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 18),
                  const Text(
                    'إذا لم يكن الصوت المحلي متاحًا، يتوقف التسلسل ويعرض السبب '
                    'بدل تخطي المقطع أو استخدام خدمة سحابية بديلة.',
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white60),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class GamificationDashboardPage extends StatefulWidget {

  final GamificationRepository repository;

  @override
  State<GamificationDashboardPage> createState() =>
      _GamificationDashboardPageState();
}

class _GamificationDashboardPageState extends State<GamificationDashboardPage> {
  late Future<GamificationSnapshot> _snapshot;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _snapshot = widget.repository.loadSnapshot();
  }

  void _refresh() {
    setState(() {
      _snapshot = widget.repository.loadSnapshot();
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: const Text('الإنجازات و XP'),
          actions: [
            IconButton(
              tooltip: 'تحديث',
              onPressed: _refresh,
              icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        body: Directionality(
          textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
          child: FutureBuilder<GamificationSnapshot>(
            future: _snapshot,
            builder: (context, state) {
              if (state.connectionState != ConnectionState.done) {
                return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
              }
              if (state.hasError || state.data == null) {
                return const Center(
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: EdgeInsets.all(24),
                    child: Text(
                      'تعذر قراءة بيانات الإنجازات المحلية. '
                      'لن يتم عرض أرقام تقديرية أو جلب بيانات من خادم.',
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    ),
                  ),
                );
              }

              final snapshot = state.data!;
              return ListView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 32),
                children: [
                  const Text(
                    'يتم احتساب XP والسلسلة من مراجعات SRS المكتملة وتخزينها '
                    'محليًا في SQLite على الجهاز.',
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  if (snapshot.profile.clockAnomalyDetected) ...[
                    const GamificationClockWarning(),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  ],
                  GamificationSummaryGrid(snapshot: snapshot),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  GamificationNextMilestoneCard(snapshot: snapshot),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  GamificationBadgeList(snapshot: snapshot),
                ],
              );
            },
          ),
        ),
      );
}

class GamificationNextMilestoneCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const GamificationNextMilestoneCard({super.key, required this.snapshot});

  final GamificationSnapshot snapshot;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final badge = snapshot.nextMilestone;
    if (badge == null) {
      return const Card(
        child: ListTile(
          leading: Icon(Icons.verified_outlined),
          title: Text('كل المعالم الحالية مكتملة'),
          subtitle: Text('سيتم إظهار معالم جديدة عند إضافتها إلى المحرك.'),
        ),
      );
    }

    final profile = snapshot.profile;
    final threshold = badge.xpThreshold ?? badge.streakThreshold ?? 1;
    final current =
        badge.xpThreshold != null ? profile.totalXp : profile.currentStreak;
    final progress = (current / threshold).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
    final unit = badge.xpThreshold != null ? 'XP' : 'يوم';

    return Card(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            const Row(
              children: [
                Icon(Icons.flag_outlined),
                SizedBox(width: 8),
                Text(
                  'المعلم التالي',
                  style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Text(
              badge.titleAr,
              style: Theme.of(context)
                  .textTheme
                  .titleMedium
                  ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            Text(badge.descriptionAr),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            LinearProgressIndicator(value: progress),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            BidiText(
              DirectionalText.forLanguage(
                '$current / $threshold $unit',
                languageCode: unit == 'XP' ? 'en' : 'ar',
                semanticRole: LinguisticSemanticRole.number,
              ),
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class ProgressPage extends StatelessWidget {
  final LearnerRepository repo;
  final List<ContentItem> corpus;
  final LanguageExerciseStrategy exerciseStrategy;
  final LanguagePresentation presentation;
  final LanguageContentQuality contentQuality;
  final LanguageTextNormalizer textNormalizer;
  final LanguageContentIntelligence contentIntelligence;
  const ProgressPage({
    super.key,
    required this.repo,
    required this.corpus,
    required this.exerciseStrategy,
    required this.presentation,
    required this.contentQuality,
    required this.textNormalizer,
    required this.contentIntelligence,
  });
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext c) {
    final state = repo.load();
    final p = ProgressSnapshotService.build(
      state.attempts,
      state.assessmentHistory,
    );
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('تطوري ومستواي')),
      body: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
        children: [
          Card(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
              child: Column(
                children: [
                  Text(
                    p.levelLabel,
                    style: Theme.of(c)
                        .textTheme
                        .displaySmall
                        ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  Text('المؤشر الحالي ${(p.overall * 100).round()}%'),
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  Text('أضعف مهارة: ${_skillName(p.weakestSkill)}'),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          ...p.skillScores.entries.map(
            (e) => ListTile(
              title: Text(_skillName(e.key)),
              subtitle: LinearProgressIndicator(value: e.value),
              trailing: Text('${(e.value * 100).round()}%'),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text('عدد الاختبارات المحفوظة: ${p.assessedCount}'),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          FilledButton.icon(
            onPressed: () async {
              final gamification = await repo.loadGamificationSnapshot();
              if (!c.mounted) return;
              await Navigator.push(
                c,
                MaterialPageRoute(
                  builder: (_) => MilestoneBadgesPage(
                    currentStreak:
                        gamification.profile.currentStreak,
                    engine: StreakMilestonesEngine.getInstance(),
                  ),
                ),
              );
            },
            icon: const Icon(Icons.stars_outlined),
            label: const Text('إنجازات الاستمرارية'),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          FilledButton.icon(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.push(
              c,
              MaterialPageRoute(
                builder: (_) => SmartAssessmentPage(
                  repo: repo,
                  corpus: corpus,
                  exerciseStrategy: exerciseStrategy,
                  presentation: presentation,
                  contentQuality: contentQuality,
                  textNormalizer: textNormalizer,
                  contentIntelligence: contentIntelligence,
                ),
              ),
            ),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.quiz_outlined),
            label: const Text('اختبار جديد'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  static String _skillName(String s) =>
      const {
        'recall': 'التعرّف',
        'listening': 'الاستماع',
        'production': 'الإنتاج',
        'transfer': 'النقل',
        'grammar': 'القواعد',
        'vocabulary': 'المفردات',
      }[s] ??
      s;
}

                      MaterialPageRoute(
                        builder: (_) => MistakeRepairPage(

                ),
              ),

      ),
    );
  }

class MistakeRepairPage extends StatefulWidget {
  final LearnerRepository repo;
  final MistakeRecord mistake;
  final List<ContentItem> corpus;
  final LanguageExerciseStrategy exerciseStrategy;
  final LanguageContentQuality contentQuality;
  const MistakeRepairPage({
    super.key,
    required this.repo,
    required this.mistake,
    required this.corpus,
    required this.exerciseStrategy,
    required this.contentQuality,
  });
  @override
  State<MistakeRepairPage> createState() => _MistakeRepairState();
}

class _MistakeRepairState extends State<MistakeRepairPage> {
  late final RepairDrill? drill;
  int step = 0;
  String answer = '';
  bool checked = false, correct = false;
  late DateTime started;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    drill = RepairEngine.build(
      widget.mistake,
      widget.corpus,
      exerciseStrategy: widget.exerciseStrategy,
      isLearnable: widget.contentQuality.isLearnable,
    );
    started = DateTime.now();
  }

  Future<void> submit() async {
    if (drill == null || checked || safeIndex(step, drill!.steps.length) < 0)
      return;
    final s = drill!.steps[safeIndex(step, drill!.steps.length)];
    String norm(String x) => x
        .toLowerCase()
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[.!?,]'), '')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ')
        .trim();
    correct = repairStepAccepts(s, answer, norm);
    setState(() => checked = true);
    if (widget.mistake.itemId.startsWith('writing:')) {
      if (!correct)
        await widget.repo.recordWritingMistake(
          issue: widget.mistake.normalizedKey,
          at: DateTime.now(),
        );
    } else {
      ContentItem? item;
      for (final x in widget.corpus) {
        if (x.id == widget.mistake.itemId) {
          item = x;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (item != null)
        await widget.repo.record(
          item: item,
          answer: answer,
          correct: correct,
          seconds: DateTime.now()
              .difference(started)
              .inSeconds
              .clamp(1, 999)
              .toInt(),
          hinted: false,
          skillOverride: item.skill,
        );
    }
    if (!mounted) return;
  }

  void next() {
    if (drill == null || safeIndex(step, drill!.steps.length) < 0) return;
    if (!correct) {
      setState(() {
        answer = '';
        checked = false;
        started = DateTime.now();
      });
      return;
    }
    if (step + 1 >= drill!.steps.length) {
      Navigator.pop(context);
    } else {
      setState(() {
        step++;
        answer = '';
        checked = false;
        started = DateTime.now();
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext c) {
    if (drill == null || drill!.steps.isEmpty)
      return const Scaffold(
        body: Center(child: Text('لا يوجد تدريب آمن لهذا الخطأ.')),
      );
    final safeStep = safeIndex(step, drill!.steps.length);
    if (safeStep < 0)
      return const Scaffold(
        body: Center(child: Text('انتهى هذا التدريب بأمان.')),
      );
    final s = drill!.steps[safeStep];
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('علاج الخطأ')),
      body: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
        children: [
          LinearProgressIndicator(value: (step + 1) / 3),
          const SizedBox(height: 18),
          Text(
            'الخطوة ${step + 1} من 3',
            style: Theme.of(c).textTheme.labelLarge,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text(
            mistakeCategoryLabel(widget.mistake.category),
            style: Theme.of(c)
                .textTheme
                .headlineSmall
                ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          Card(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              child: Text(s.prompt, style: Theme.of(c).textTheme.titleLarge),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          TextField(
            enabled: !checked,
            onChanged: (v) => answer = v,
            textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
            decoration: const InputDecoration(
              border: OutlineInputBorder(),
              labelText: 'إجابتك بالألمانية',
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          if (!checked)
            FilledButton(onPressed: submit, child: const Text('تحقق'))
          else
            Card(
              child: ListTile(
                leading: Icon(correct ? Icons.check_circle : Icons.refresh),
                title: Text(
                  correct
                      ? 'إجابة صحيحة — نرفع الإتقان تدريجيًا'
                      : 'ما زالت تحتاج تدريبًا',
                ),
                subtitle: Text(s.expected),
              ),
            ),
          if (checked)
            FilledButton(
              onPressed: next,
              child: Text(
                correct
                    ? (step + 1 >= 3 ? 'إنهاء' : 'الخطوة التالية')
                    : 'أعد المحاولة',
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../core/text/directional_text.dart';
import '../../features/audio/domain/entities/audio_request.dart';
import '../../features/audio/domain/services/i_audio_runtime.dart';
import '../../language/language_content_quality.dart';
import '../../language/language_exercise_strategy.dart';
import '../../language/language_presentation.dart';
import '../../models/assessment.dart';
import '../../models/content.dart';
import '../../models/diagnostic_placement.dart';
import '../../models/learner.dart';
import '../../services/adaptive_placement_engine.dart';
import '../../services/adaptive_placement_service.dart';
import '../../services/repository.dart';
import '../shared/text/bidi_text.dart';
import 'placement_result_panel.dart';

class AdaptivePlacementPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const AdaptivePlacementPage({
    super.key,
    required this.repo,
    required this.corpus,
    required this.exerciseStrategy,
    required this.contentQuality,
    required this.placementPresentation,
    required this.targetLanguageName,
    required this.languageCode,
    required this.sourceLanguageCode,
    required this.audioRuntime,
    required this.onDone,
  });

  final LearnerRepository repo;
  final List<ContentItem> corpus;
  final LanguageExerciseStrategy exerciseStrategy;
  final LanguageContentQuality contentQuality;
  final PlacementPresentation placementPresentation;
  final String targetLanguageName;
  final String languageCode;
  final String sourceLanguageCode;
  final IAudioRuntime audioRuntime;
  final VoidCallback onDone;

  @override
  State<AdaptivePlacementPage> createState() => _AdaptivePlacementPageState();
}

class _AdaptivePlacementPageState extends State<AdaptivePlacementPage> {
  final TextEditingController _answer = TextEditingController();
  final List<DiagnosticResponse> _responses = <DiagnosticResponse>[];
  late LearnerState _baseline;
  late int _seed;
  DiagnosticQuestion? _current;
  PlacementDiagnosticResult? _result;
  bool _submitted = false;
  bool _correct = false;
  bool _saving = false;
  bool _listeningUnavailable = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _baseline = widget.repo.load();
    final now = DateTime.now();
    _seed = now.year * 10000 + now.month * 100 + now.day;
    _current = _nextQuestion();
  }

  DiagnosticQuestion? _nextQuestion() => AdaptivePlacementEngine.nextQuestion(
        items: widget.corpus,
        state: _baseline,
        responses: _responses,
        exerciseStrategy: widget.exerciseStrategy,
        isLearnable: widget.contentQuality.isLearnable,
        seed: _seed,
      );

  Future<void> _submit() async {
    final current = _current;
    if (current == null || _submitted || _saving) return;
    final answer = _answer.text;
    final q = current.question;
    _correct = assessmentAnswerMatches(
      AssessmentResponse(
        questionId: q.id,
        itemId: q.itemId,
        answer: answer,
        correct: true,
        hinted: false,
      ),
      q,
    );
    _responses.add(
      DiagnosticResponse(
        questionId: q.id,
        itemId: q.itemId,
        dimension: current.dimension,
        correct: _correct,
        hinted: false,
        skipped: false,
        difficultyBand: current.difficultyBand,
      ),
    );
    if (mounted) setState(() => _submitted = true);
  }

  Future<void> _playListening() async {
    final current = _current;
    if (current == null || current.dimension != DiagnosticDimension.listening) {
      return;
    }
    final result = await widget.audioRuntime.play(
      AudioRequest(
        text: current.question.expected,
        languageCode: widget.languageCode,
        conceptId: current.question.itemId,
        variant: AudioVariant.sentence,
      ),
    );
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => _listeningUnavailable = !result.played);
  }

  Future<void> _skipUnavailableListening() async {
    final current = _current;
    if (current == null ||
        current.dimension != DiagnosticDimension.listening ||
        !_listeningUnavailable ||
        _saving) {
      return;
    }
    _responses.add(
      DiagnosticResponse(
        questionId: current.question.id,
        itemId: current.question.itemId,
        dimension: current.dimension,
        correct: false,
        hinted: false,
        skipped: true,
        difficultyBand: current.difficultyBand,
      ),
    );
    await _advance();
  }

  Future<void> _advance() async {
    if (_saving) return;
    final next = _nextQuestion();
    if (next == null) {
      await _finish();
      return;
    }
    setState(() {
      _current = next;
      _submitted = false;
      _correct = false;
      _listeningUnavailable = false;
      _answer.clear();
    });
  }

  Future<void> _finish() async {
    if (_saving) return;
    setState(() => _saving = true);
    try {
      final result = AdaptivePlacementEngine.score(_responses);
      await AdaptivePlacementService(widget.repo).recordResult(result);
      widget.onDone();
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _result = result;
        _current = null;
      });
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _saving = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final result = _result;
    if (result != null) {
      return Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(title: Text(widget.placementPresentation.resultTitle)),
        body: PlacementResultPanel(
          result: result,
          onClose: () => Navigator.maybePop(context),
        ),
      );
    }

    final current = _current;
    if (current == null) {
      return Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(title: Text(widget.placementPresentation.title)),
        body: const Center(
          child: Text('لا توجد عينة محتوى صالحة للتشخيص حاليًا.'),
        ),
      );
    }

    final question = current.question;
    final progress =
        (_responses.length + 1) / AdaptivePlacementEngine.defaultMaxQuestions;

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: Text(widget.placementPresentation.title)),
      body: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
        children: [
          LinearProgressIndicator(value: progress.clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble()),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Row(
            children: [
              Chip(label: Text(_dimensionLabel(current.dimension))),
              const Spacer(),
              Text('السؤال ${_responses.length + 1}'),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          BidiText(
            DirectionalText.forLanguage(
              question.prompt,
              languageCode: widget.sourceLanguageCode,
              semanticRole: LinguisticSemanticRole.explanation,
            ),
            style: Theme.of(context)
                .textTheme
                .headlineSmall
                ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
          ),
          if (current.dimension == DiagnosticDimension.listening) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            FilledButton.icon(
              onPressed: _playListening,
              icon: const Icon(Icons.volume_up_outlined),
              label: const Text('تشغيل الصوت المحلي'),
            ),
            if (_listeningUnavailable) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              const Text(
                'الصوت الألماني المحلي غير متاح؛ لن يُحتسب هذا السؤال.',
              ),
              TextButton(
                onPressed: _skipUnavailableListening,
                child: const Text('تجاوز دون احتساب'),
              ),
            ],
          ],
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          TextField(
            controller: _answer,
            enabled: !_submitted && !_saving,
            textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
            minLines: 1,
            maxLines: 3,
            decoration: InputDecoration(
              border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
              labelText:
                  '${widget.placementPresentation.answerLabel} بـ${widget.targetLanguageName}',
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          if (!_submitted)
            FilledButton(
              onPressed: _saving ? null : _submit,
              child: const Text('تحقق'),
            )
          else ...[
            Card(
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      _correct ? '✓ صحيح' : '✗ يحتاج مراجعة',
                      style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    const Text('الإجابة المستهدفة:'),
                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                    BidiText(
                      DirectionalText.forLanguage(
                        question.expected,
                        languageCode: widget.languageCode,
                        semanticRole: LinguisticSemanticRole.example,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            FilledButton(
              onPressed: _saving ? null : _advance,
              child: Text(
                AdaptivePlacementEngine.shouldStop(_responses)
                    ? widget.placementPresentation.finishLabel
                    : widget.placementPresentation.nextLabel,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _answer.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  static String _dimensionLabel(DiagnosticDimension dimension) =>
      switch (dimension) {
        DiagnosticDimension.meaning => 'المعنى',
        DiagnosticDimension.grammar => 'القواعد',
        DiagnosticDimension.listening => 'الاستماع',
        DiagnosticDimension.transfer => 'النقل',
        DiagnosticDimension.production => 'الإنتاج',
      };
}

class PlacementResultPanel extends StatelessWidget {

    required this.result,
    required this.onClose,

  final VoidCallback onClose;

  Widget build(BuildContext context) => ListView(

            Icons.assessment_outlined,

            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: Theme.of(context)

                .titleLarge
                ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),

              context, 'ثقة التشخيص', '${(result.confidence * 100).round()}%'),
          _metric(
            context,
            'إجابات محسوبة',
            '${result.scoredAnswers}/${result.answered}',

                .titleMedium

          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          ...DiagnosticDimension.values
              .where(result.dimensionScores.containsKey)
              .map(
                (dimension) => Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                  child: Row(
                    children: [
                      Expanded(child: Text(_dimensionLabel(dimension))),
                      Text(
                        '${((result.dimensionScores[dimension] ?? 0) * 100).round()}%',
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
          if (result.weakDimensions.isNotEmpty) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Text(
              'الأولوية التالية: ${result.weakDimensions.map(_dimensionLabel).join(' • ')}',
            ),
          ],
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          const Card(
            child: Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.all(14),
              child: Text(
                'هذه نقطة بداية تعليمية مبنية على عينة محلية متكيّفة، وليست شهادة CEFR.',
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          FilledButton(onPressed: onClose, child: const Text('متابعة التعلم')),
        ],
      );

  Widget _metric(BuildContext context, String label, String value) => Card(
        child: ListTile(

          trailing: Text(
            value,
            style: Theme.of(context)
                .textTheme
                .titleMedium
                ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
          ),
        ),
      );

        DiagnosticPlacementBand.strong => 'قاعدة قوية للتقدم',

part of '../learning_pages.dart';

class CoreSession extends StatefulWidget {
  final LearnerRepository repo;
  final List<ContentItem> corpus;
  final VoidCallback onDone;
  final LanguageExerciseStrategy exerciseStrategy;
  final LanguagePresentation presentation;
  final LanguageContentQuality contentQuality;
  final LanguageTextNormalizer textNormalizer;
  final LanguageContentIntelligence contentIntelligence;
  const CoreSession({
    super.key,
    required this.repo,
    required this.corpus,
    required this.onDone,
    required this.exerciseStrategy,
    required this.presentation,
    required this.contentQuality,
    required this.textNormalizer,
    required this.contentIntelligence,
  });
  @override
  State<CoreSession> createState() => _CoreState();
}

class _CoreState extends State<CoreSession> {
  final SafeTtsController tts = SafeTtsController();
  late final UniversalSessionOrchestrator session;
  late LearnerState sessionState;
  late List<LearningContent> items;
  late List<LearningPathItem> plannedItems;
  int pos = 0;
  String answer = '';
  bool submitted = false, correct = false;
  late DateTime started;
  String mode = 'production';
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    session = UniversalSessionOrchestrator(repository: widget.repo);
    sessionState = widget.repo.load();
    final corpus = widget.corpus;
    final plan = LearningEngine.buildPlan(
      corpus,
      sessionState,
      exerciseStrategy: widget.exerciseStrategy,
      contentQuality: widget.contentQuality,
      contentIntelligence: widget.contentIntelligence,
      dailyGoal: 6,
    );
    plannedItems = plan.items;
    items = plannedItems.map((x) => x.item).toList();
    if (items.isEmpty) items = corpus.take(6).toList();
    started = DateTime.now();
    mode = plannedItems.isEmpty
        ? _fallbackMode(0, sessionState)
        : _modeForPlanItem(plannedItems[0]);
  }

  LearningContent get item => items[pos];
  String _modeForPlanItem(LearningPathItem planned) {
    const valid = {'recall', 'listening', 'production', 'transfer'};
    if (valid.contains(planned.mode)) return planned.mode;
    if (valid.contains(planned.item.skill)) return planned.item.skill;
    if (planned.mode == 'repair' || planned.mode == 'review') return 'recall';
    if (planned.mode == 'consolidate') return 'production';
    return _fallbackMode(pos, sessionState);
  }

  String _fallbackMode(int index, LearnerState s) {
    const modes = ['recall', 'listening', 'production', 'transfer'];
    final weak = LearningCore.weakestSkill(s);
    if (index == 0) return weak;
    return modes[index % modes.length];
  }

  String get prompt {
    final d = depthFor(item);
    switch (mode) {
      case 'recall':
        return 'ما الكلمة بـ${widget.presentation.targetLanguageName}؟ ${item.translationText}';
      case 'listening':
        return 'استمع ثم اكتب الجملة التي تسمعها.';
      case 'transfer':
        return d.transferPrompt.isNotEmpty
            ? d.transferPrompt
            : item.exampleTranslationText;
      default:
        return d.transferPrompt.isNotEmpty
            ? d.transferPrompt
            : item.exampleTranslationText;
    }
  }

  String get expected {
    final d = depthFor(item);
    switch (mode) {
      case 'recall':
        return item.sourceText;
      case 'listening':
        return item.exampleText;
      case 'transfer':
        return d.transferAnswer.isNotEmpty
            ? d.transferAnswer
            : item.exampleText;
      default:
        return d.transferAnswer.isNotEmpty
            ? d.transferAnswer
            : (item.acceptedForms.isNotEmpty
                ? item.acceptedForms.first
                : item.sourceText);
    }
  }

  Future<void> submit() async {
    if (submitted) return;
    final a = widget.textNormalizer.answer(answer);
    final e = widget.textNormalizer.answer(expected);
    correct = a == e ||
        item.acceptedForms.any(
          (value) => widget.textNormalizer.answer(value) == a,
        );
    await session.record(
      SessionReviewInput(
        item: item,
        answer: answer,
        correct: correct,
        seconds:
            DateTime.now().difference(started).inSeconds.clamp(1, 999).toInt(),
        hinted: false,
        facetType: switch (mode) {
          'listening' => ReviewFacetType.listening,
          'production' => ReviewFacetType.production,
          _ => ReviewFacetType.meaningRecall,
        },
        variantKey: switch (mode) {
          'listening' => 'session',
          'production' => 'session',
          _ => null,
        },
        skillOverride: mode,
      ),
    );
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => submitted = true);
  }

  Future<void> speak() => tts.speak(item.exampleText, rate: .42);
  @override
  void dispose() {
    session.dispose();
    tts.stop();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext c) => Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(title: Text('جلسة ${pos + 1}/${items.length}')),
        body: ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
          children: [
            Chip(
              label: Text(
                mode == 'listening'
                    ? 'Listening'
                    : mode == 'transfer'
                        ? 'Transfer'
                        : mode == 'recall'
                            ? 'Recognition'
                            : 'Production',
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Text(item.topic, style: Theme.of(c).textTheme.labelLarge),
            const SizedBox(height: 7),
            Text(
              prompt,
              style: Theme.of(c)
                  .textTheme
                  .headlineSmall
                  ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
            ),
            if (mode == 'listening')
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 14),
                child: FilledButton.icon(
                  onPressed: speak,
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.volume_up),
                  label: const Text('استمع'),
                ),
              ),
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            TextField(
              enabled: !submitted,
              onChanged: (x) => answer = x,
              textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
              minLines: 1,
              maxLines: 3,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                labelText: 'إجابتك بـ${widget.presentation.targetLanguageName}',
                border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            if (!submitted)
              FilledButton(onPressed: submit, child: const Text('تحقق'))
            else
              Card(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(15),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        correct ? '✓ إجابة صحيحة' : '✗ نحتاج تدريبًا إضافيًا',
                        style: Theme.of(c)
                            .textTheme
                            .titleMedium
                            ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 5),
                      Text('الإجابة المستهدفة: $expected'),
                      if (depthFor(item).grammar.isNotEmpty)
                        Padding(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
                          child: Text('قاعدة: ${depthFor(item).grammar}'),
                        ),
                      if (depthFor(item).collocation.isNotEmpty)
                        Padding(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 4),
                          child:
                              Text('تركيب مهم: ${depthFor(item).collocation}'),
                        ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            if (submitted)
              FilledButton(
                onPressed: () {
                  if (pos + 1 >= items.length) {
                    widget.onDone();
                    Navigator.pop(c);
                  } else {
                    setState(() {
                      pos++;
                      submitted = false;
                      answer = '';
                      started = DateTime.now();
                      mode = plannedItems.isEmpty
                          ? _fallbackMode(pos, sessionState)
                          : _modeForPlanItem(plannedItems[pos]);
                    });
                  }
                },
                child:
                    Text(pos + 1 >= items.length ? 'إنهاء الجلسة' : 'التالي'),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

class SingleItemSession extends StatefulWidget {
  final LearnerRepository repo;
  final ContentItem item;
  final VoidCallback onDone;
  final LanguagePresentation presentation;
  final LanguageTextNormalizer textNormalizer;
  const SingleItemSession({
    super.key,
    required this.repo,
    required this.item,
    required this.onDone,
    required this.presentation,
    required this.textNormalizer,
  });
  @override
  State<SingleItemSession> createState() => _SingleState();
}

class _SingleState extends State<SingleItemSession> {
  final SafeTtsController tts = SafeTtsController();
  int step = 0;
  String answer = '';
  bool done = false, correct = false;
  late DateTime start;
  final labels = const [
    'Recognize',
    'Understand',
    'Listen',
    'Produce',
    'Transfer',
    'Retain',
  ];
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    start = DateTime.now();
  }

  String get expected {
    final d = depthFor(widget.item);
    if (step == 0) return widget.item.sourceText;
    if (step == 2) return widget.item.exampleText;
    if (step == 4 && d.transferAnswer.isNotEmpty) return d.transferAnswer;
    return widget.item.exampleText;
  }

  String get question {
    final d = depthFor(widget.item);
    switch (step) {
      case 0:
        return 'ما الكلمة بـ${widget.presentation.targetLanguageName}؟ ${widget.item.translationText}';
      case 1:
        return 'اربط الكلمة بمعناها ثم اكتبها بـ${widget.presentation.targetLanguageName}.';
      case 2:
        return 'استمع ثم اكتب الجملة.';
      case 3:
        return d.transferPrompt.isNotEmpty
            ? d.transferPrompt
            : widget.item.exampleTranslationText;
      case 4:
        return d.transferPrompt.isNotEmpty
            ? d.transferPrompt
            : 'استخدم الكلمة في موقف جديد.';
      default:
        return 'مراجعة متأخرة: اكتب ما تتذكره.';
    }
  }

  Future<void> submit() async {
    final a = widget.textNormalizer.answer(answer);
    final e = widget.textNormalizer.answer(expected);
    correct = a == e ||
        widget.item.acceptedForms.any(
          (value) => widget.textNormalizer.answer(value) == a,
        );
    final skills = [
      'recall',
      'recall',
      'listening',
      'production',
      'transfer',
      'recall',
    ];
    await widget.repo.record(
      item: widget.item,
      answer: answer,
      correct: correct,
      seconds: DateTime.now().difference(start).inSeconds.clamp(1, 999).toInt(),
      hinted: false,
      skillOverride: skills[step],
    );
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => done = true);
  }

  Future<void> speak() => tts.speak(widget.item.exampleText);
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext c) => Scaffold(
        appBar:
            AppBar(title: Text('${labels[step]} • ${widget.item.sourceText}')),
        body: ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
          children: [
            LinearProgressIndicator(value: (step + 1) / labels.length),
            const SizedBox(height: 22),
            Text(
              question,
              style: Theme.of(c)
                  .textTheme
                  .headlineSmall
                  ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
            ),
            if (step == 2)
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 12),
                child: FilledButton.icon(
                  onPressed: speak,
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.volume_up),
                  label: const Text('استمع'),
                ),
              ),
            if (step == 1)
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 12),
                child: Text('المعنى: ${widget.item.translationText}'),
              ),
            const SizedBox(height: 15),
            TextField(
              enabled: !done,
              onChanged: (x) => answer = x,
              textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                labelText: 'اكتب بـ${widget.presentation.targetLanguageName}',
                border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            if (!done)
              FilledButton(onPressed: submit, child: const Text('تحقق'))
            else
              Card(
                child: ListTile(
                  leading: Icon(correct ? Icons.check_circle : Icons.close),
                  title: Text(correct ? 'أحسنت' : 'نحتاج دليلًا إضافيًا'),
                  subtitle: Text('الإجابة: $expected'),
                ),
              ),
            if (done)
              FilledButton(
                onPressed: () {
                  if (step + 1 >= labels.length) {
                    widget.onDone();
                    Navigator.pop(c);
                  } else {
                    setState(() {
                      step++;
                      done = false;
                      answer = '';
                      start = DateTime.now();
                    });
                  }
                },
                child: Text(step + 1 >= labels.length ? 'إنهاء' : 'التالي'),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}

class SmartAssessmentPage extends StatefulWidget {
  final LearnerRepository repo;
  final List<ContentItem> corpus;
  final LanguageExerciseStrategy exerciseStrategy;
  final LanguagePresentation presentation;
  final LanguageContentQuality contentQuality;
  final LanguageTextNormalizer textNormalizer;
  final LanguageContentIntelligence contentIntelligence;
  const SmartAssessmentPage({
    super.key,
    required this.repo,
    required this.corpus,
    required this.exerciseStrategy,
    required this.presentation,
    required this.contentQuality,
    required this.textNormalizer,
    required this.contentIntelligence,
  });
  @override
  State<SmartAssessmentPage> createState() => _SmartAssessmentState();
}

class _SmartAssessmentState extends State<SmartAssessmentPage> {
  final SafeTtsController tts = SafeTtsController();
  late LearnerState assessmentState;
  late List<AssessmentQuestion> questions;
  final answers = <String, String>{};
  final responses = <AssessmentResponse>[];
  int index = 0;
  bool submitted = false;
  bool correct = false;
  bool saving = false;
  late DateTime started;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _build();
  }

  void _build() {
    assessmentState = widget.repo.load();
    final corpus = widget.corpus;
    questions = AssessmentEngine.build(
      corpus,
      assessmentState,
      exerciseStrategy: widget.exerciseStrategy,
      isLearnable: widget.contentQuality.isLearnable,
      questionCount: 8,
      seed: DateTime.now().day + DateTime.now().month,
    );
    if (questions.isEmpty) questions = const [];
    started = DateTime.now();
  }

  AssessmentQuestion get q => questions[index];
  String get _expected => q.expected;
  bool _matches(String value) {
    final a = assessmentNormalize(value);
    if (a.isEmpty) return false;
    return assessmentAnswerMatches(
      AssessmentResponse(
        questionId: q.id,
        itemId: q.itemId,
        answer: value,
        correct: true,
        hinted: false,
      ),
      q,
    );
  }

  Future<void> _speak() => tts.speak(q.expected, rate: .42);

  Future<void> _submit() async {
    if (submitted) return;
    final answer = answers[q.id] ?? '';
    correct = _matches(answer);
    responses.add(
      AssessmentResponse(
        questionId: q.id,
        itemId: q.itemId,
        answer: answer,
        correct: correct,
        hinted: false,
      ),
    );
    setState(() => submitted = true);
  }

  Future<void> _next() async {
    if (saving) return;
    if (saving || !mounted) return;
    if (index + 1 >= questions.length) {
      setState(() => saving = true);
      try {
        final corpus = widget.corpus;
        final result = AssessmentEngine.score(
          responses,
          corpus,
          exerciseStrategy: widget.exerciseStrategy,
        );
        for (final response in responses) {
          final item = assessmentFindItem(corpus, response.itemId);
          if (item == null) continue;
          final question = AssessmentEngine.questionFor(
            item,
            response.questionId,
            widget.exerciseStrategy,
          );
          await widget.repo.record(
            item: item,
            answer: response.answer,
            correct: response.correct,
            seconds: DateTime.now()
                .difference(started)
                .inSeconds
                .clamp(1, 999)
                .toInt(),
            hinted: response.hinted,
            skillOverride: question.skill,
          );
        }
        await widget.repo.recordAssessment(result);
        if (!mounted) return;
        await Navigator.pushReplacement(
          context,
          MaterialPageRoute(
            builder: (_) => AssessmentResultPage(
              result: result,
              history: assessmentState.assessmentHistory,
            ),
          ),
        );
      } finally {
        if (mounted) setState(() => saving = false);
      }
      return;
    }
    setState(() {
      index++;
      submitted = false;
      correct = false;
      started = DateTime.now();
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext c) {
    if (questions.isEmpty)
      return Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('الاختبار الذكي')),
        body: const Center(child: Text('لا توجد أسئلة صالحة للاختبار حاليًا.')),
      );
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text('الاختبار الذكي ${index + 1}/${questions.length}'),
      ),
      body: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
        children: [
          LinearProgressIndicator(value: (index + 1) / questions.length),
          const SizedBox(height: 18),
          Chip(label: Text(_typeLabel(q.type))),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Text(
            q.prompt,
            style: Theme.of(c)
                .textTheme
                .headlineSmall
                ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
          ),
          if (q.type == AssessmentQuestionType.listening)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 12),
              child: FilledButton.icon(
                onPressed: _speak,
                icon: const Icon(Icons.volume_up),
                label: const Text('استمع'),
              ),
            ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          TextField(
            enabled: !submitted,
            onChanged: (v) => answers[q.id] = v,
            textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
            minLines: 1,
            maxLines: 3,
            decoration: InputDecoration(
              border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
              labelText: 'إجابتك بـ${widget.presentation.targetLanguageName}',
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          if (!submitted)
            FilledButton(onPressed: _submit, child: const Text('تحقق'))
          else
            Card(
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(15),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      correct ? '✓ إجابة صحيحة' : '✗ تحتاج مراجعة',
                      style: Theme.of(c)
                          .textTheme
                          .titleMedium
                          ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 5),
                    Text('الإجابة المستهدفة: $_expected'),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          if (submitted)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 12),
              child: FilledButton(
                onPressed: _next,
                child: Text(
                  index + 1 >= questions.length ? 'عرض النتيجة' : 'التالي',
                ),
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    tts.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  static String _typeLabel(AssessmentQuestionType t) =>
      const {
        AssessmentQuestionType.recall: 'التعرّف',
        AssessmentQuestionType.grammar: 'القواعد',
        AssessmentQuestionType.translation: 'الترجمة',
        AssessmentQuestionType.listening: 'الاستماع',
        AssessmentQuestionType.production: 'الإنتاج',
      }[t] ??
      'غير معروف';
}

class AssessmentResultPage extends StatelessWidget {
  final AssessmentResult result;
  final List<AssessmentHistory> history;
  const AssessmentResultPage({
    super.key,
    required this.result,
    required this.history,
  });
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext c) => Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('نتيجة الاختبار')),
        body: ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
          children: [
            Card(
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
                child: Column(
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      '${result.score.round()}%',
                      style: Theme.of(c)
                          .textTheme
                          .displaySmall
                          ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    Text(
                      '${result.correct}/${result.answered} إجابات صحيحة • ${result.cleanCorrect} دون تلميح',
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    Text(_message(result.score)),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            Text(
              'خريطة المهارات',
              style: Theme.of(c)
                  .textTheme
                  .titleLarge
                  ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
            ),
            ...result.skillScores.entries.map(
              (e) => ListTile(
                title: Text(e.key),
                subtitle: LinearProgressIndicator(value: e.value),
                trailing: Text('${(e.value * 100).round()}%'),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            if (result.weakSkills.isNotEmpty)
              Card(
                child: ListTile(
                  leading: const Icon(Icons.warning_amber_outlined),
                  title: const Text('ما الذي نركز عليه؟'),
                  subtitle: Text(result.weakSkills.join(' • ')),
                ),
              ),
            if (result.nextReviewItemIds.isNotEmpty)
              Card(
                child: ListTile(
                  leading: const Icon(Icons.replay_outlined),
                  title: const Text('بطاقات تستحق المراجعة'),
                  subtitle: Text(
                    '${result.nextReviewItemIds.length} عناصر ستعود إلى خطة المراجعة.',
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Text(
              'آخر الاختبارات',
              style: Theme.of(c)
                  .textTheme
                  .titleLarge
                  ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
            ),
            ...history.take(5).map(
                  (h) => ListTile(
                    title: Text('${h.score.round()}%'),
                    subtitle: Text(
                      '${h.at.toLocal()} • ${h.weakSkills.isEmpty ? 'لا توجد نقاط ضعف محددة' : h.weakSkills.join('، ')}',
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
          ],
        ),
      );
  static String _message(double score) => score >= 85
      ? 'ممتاز. سنرفع التحدي ونركز على الاحتفاظ.'
      : score >= 70
          ? 'جيد. هناك مهارات تحتاج تثبيتًا إضافيًا.'
          : 'النتيجة تكشف نقاطًا تحتاج علاجًا؛ سنحوّلها إلى مراجعات مستهدفة.';
}

class VocabularyV35 extends StatefulWidget {
  final LearnerRepository repo;
  final List<ContentItem> corpus;
  final VoidCallback onDone;
  final LanguagePresentation presentation;
  final LanguageContentQuality contentQuality;
  final LanguageTextNormalizer textNormalizer;
  final AppDependencies dependencies;
  const VocabularyV35({
    super.key,
    required this.repo,
    required this.corpus,
    required this.onDone,
    required this.presentation,
    required this.contentQuality,
    required this.textNormalizer,
    required this.dependencies,
  });
  @override
  State<VocabularyV35> createState() => _VocabularyV35State();
}
class _VocabularyV35State extends State<VocabularyV35> {
  Set<String> _favorites = {};
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _customEntries = [];
  String _filter = 'all';
  ViewMode _viewMode = ViewMode.list;
  final PageController _pageController = PageController();
  String get _targetLanguageCode {
    final locale = widget.dependencies.languagePack.targetLocale.trim();
    return locale.isEmpty ? 'de' : locale;
  }
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    // // _loadViewMode();
    _loadData();
  }
  @override
  void dispose() {
    _pageController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }
  Future<void> _loadData() async {
    _viewMode =
        UiPreferences(widget.dependencies.preferencesService).viewMode ??
            ViewMode.list;
    final favs = await widget.dependencies.favoritesRepository.getFavorites();
    final langCode =
        widget.presentation.targetLanguageName.contains("لمان") ? "de" : "en";
    final custom = await widget.dependencies.userVocabularyService
        .getCustomEntries(targetLanguage: langCode);
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _favorites = favs;
        _customEntries = custom;
      });
    }
  }
  Future<void> _setViewMode(ViewMode mode) async {
    setState(() => _viewMode = mode);
    await UiPreferences(
      widget.dependencies.preferencesService,
    ).setViewMode(mode);
  }
  void _speakSource(ContentItem item) {
    unawaited(
      widget.dependencies.audioRuntime
          .play(
            AudioRequest(
              text: item.sourceText,
              languageCode: widget.dependencies.languagePack.targetLocale,
              conceptId: item.id,
            ),
          )
          .then<void>((_) {}),
    );
  }
  void _speakCustomEntry(Map<String, dynamic> entry) {
    final text = entry['german_text']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
    final id = entry['id']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
    if (text.isEmpty || id.isEmpty) return;
    unawaited(
      widget.dependencies.audioRuntime
          .play(
            AudioRequest(
              text: text,
              languageCode: widget.dependencies.languagePack.targetLocale,
              conceptId: id,
            ),
          )
          .then<void>((_) {}),
    );
  }
  Future<void> _openLearningSession(
    BuildContext context,
    ContentItem item,
  ) async {
    await Navigator.of(context).push<void>(
      MaterialPageRoute<void>(
        builder: (_) => SingleItemSession(
          repo: widget.repo,
          item: item,
          onDone: widget.onDone,
          presentation: widget.presentation,
          textNormalizer: widget.textNormalizer,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
  void _showAddCustomDialog() {
    final germanController = TextEditingController();
    final arabicController = TextEditingController();
    final articleController = TextEditingController();
    final notesController = TextEditingController();
    final exampleController = TextEditingController();
    final formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      builder: (c) => Directionality(
        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
        child: Padding(
          padding: EdgeInsets.only(
            bottom: MediaQuery.of(c).viewInsets.bottom,
            left: 16,
            right: 16,
            top: 24,
          ),
          child: Form(
            key: formKey,
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                Text(
                  'إضافة مفردة مخصصة',
                  style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                TextFormField(
                  controller: germanController,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'الكلمة بالألمانية',
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                  ),
                  validator: (v) => v == null || v.isEmpty ? 'مطلوب' : null,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                TextFormField(
                  controller: arabicController,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'الترجمة العربية',
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                  ),
                  validator: (v) => v == null || v.isEmpty ? 'مطلوب' : null,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                  initialValue: 'none',
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'الأداة (اختياري)',
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                  ),
                  items: const [
                    DropdownMenuItem(value: 'none', child: Text('بدون أداة')),
                    DropdownMenuItem(value: 'der', child: Text('der')),
                    DropdownMenuItem(value: 'die', child: Text('die')),
                    DropdownMenuItem(value: 'das', child: Text('das')),
                  ],
                  onChanged: (v) =>
                      articleController.text = v == 'none' ? '' : v!,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                TextFormField(
                  controller: exampleController,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'مثال (اختياري)',
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                TextFormField(
                  controller: notesController,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'ملاحظات (اختياري)',
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 24),
                FilledButton(
                  onPressed: () async {
                    if (formKey.currentState!.validate()) {
                      await widget.dependencies.userVocabularyService
                          .addCustomEntry({
                        'id': 'custom_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}',
                        'german_text': germanController.text,
                        'arabic_translation': arabicController.text,
                        'article': articleController.text,
                        'notes': notesController.text,
                        'example_sentence': exampleController.text,
                        'created_at': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
                        'is_custom': 1,
                      });
                      if (mounted) {
                        Navigator.pop(c);
                        _loadData();
                      }
                    }
                  },
                  child: const Text('حفظ'),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 24),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
  Color _getArticleColor(String article) {
    switch (article.trim().toLowerCase()) {
      case 'der':
        return const Color(0xFF2563EB);
      case 'die':
        return const Color(0xFFDC2626);
      case 'das':
        return const Color(0xFF16A34A);
      default:
        return const Color(0xFF7C3AED);
    }
  }
  double _glassOpacity(BuildContext context) =>
      Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark ? .38 : .72;

class _FlashcardWidget extends StatefulWidget {
  final ContentItem item;
  final bool isFav;
  final VoidCallback onToggleFav;
  final VoidCallback onSpeak;
  final VoidCallback onLearn;
  final Color articleColor;
  final String targetLanguageCode;
  const _FlashcardWidget({
    required this.item,
    required this.isFav,
    required this.onToggleFav,
    required this.onSpeak,
    required this.onLearn,
    required this.articleColor,
    required this.targetLanguageCode,
  });
  @override
  State<_FlashcardWidget> createState() => _FlashcardWidgetState();
}
class _FlashcardWidgetState extends State<_FlashcardWidget>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late final AnimationController _controller;
  late final Animation<double> _animation;
  bool _isFront = true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _controller = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 320),
    );
    _animation = CurvedAnimation(
      parent: _controller,
      curve: Curves.easeInOutCubic,
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _flip() {
    if (_isFront) {
      unawaited(_controller.forward());
    } else {
      unawaited(_controller.reverse());
    }
    setState(() => _isFront = !_isFront);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: _flip,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
        child: AnimatedBuilder(
          animation: _animation,
          builder: (context, _) {
            final angle = _animation.value * math.pi;
            final isBackVisible = angle > math.pi / 2;
            return Transform(
              transform: Matrix4.identity()
                ..setEntry(3, 2, .0012)
                ..rotateY(angle),
              alignment: Alignment.center,
              child: isBackVisible
                  ? Transform(
                      transform: Matrix4.identity()..rotateY(math.pi),
                      alignment: Alignment.center,
                      child: _buildCardBack(context),
                    )
                  : _buildCardFront(context),
            );
          },
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildCardFront(BuildContext context) {
    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final hasArticle = widget.item.grammaticalMarker.trim().isNotEmpty;
    return AppGlassCard(
      backgroundColor: scheme.surface,
      opacity: Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark ? .38 : .72,
      borderColor: hasArticle
          ? widget.articleColor.withAlpha(150)
          : scheme.outlineVariant.withAlpha(90),
      glowColor: hasArticle ? widget.articleColor : null,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
      child: Column(
        children: <Widget>[
          Row(
            children: <Widget>[
              IconButton(
                tooltip:
                    widget.isFav ? 'إزالة من المفضلة' : 'إضافة للمفضلة',
                icon: Icon(
                  widget.isFav
                      ? Icons.favorite_rounded
                      : Icons.favorite_border_rounded,
                  color: widget.isFav ? const Color(0xFFE11D48) : null,
                ),
                onPressed: widget.onToggleFav,
              ),
              const Spacer(),
              AppAudioButton(
                onPressed: widget.onSpeak,
                semanticLabel: 'استمع إلى ${widget.item.sourceText}',
                activeColor: widget.articleColor,
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const Spacer(),
          if (hasArticle) ...<Widget>[
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 5),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: widget.articleColor.withAlpha(24),
                border: Border.all(
                  color: widget.articleColor.withAlpha(160),
                  width: 1.4,
                ),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
              ),
              child: Text(
                widget.item.grammaticalMarker,
                textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                style: AppTypography.title.copyWith(
                  color: widget.articleColor,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
          ],
          AppDirectionalText(
            widget.item.sourceText,
            languageCode: widget.targetLanguageCode,
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: AppTypography.display.copyWith(fontSize: 36),
          ),
          const Spacer(),
          AppDirectionalText(
            'اضغط لقلب البطاقة',
            languageCode: 'ar',
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: AppTypography.label.copyWith(
              color: scheme.onSurfaceVariant,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildCardBack(BuildContext context) {
    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    return AppGlassCard(
      backgroundColor: scheme.surface,
      opacity: Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark ? .38 : .72,
      borderColor: scheme.outlineVariant.withAlpha(105),
      glowColor: scheme.secondary,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
      child: Column(
        children: <Widget>[
          const Spacer(),
          AppDirectionalText(
            widget.item.translationText,
            languageCode: 'ar',
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: AppTypography.display.copyWith(fontSize: 28),
          ),
          if (widget.item.pluralForm.trim().isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            AppDirectionalText(
              widget.item.pluralForm,
              languageCode: widget.targetLanguageCode,
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: AppTypography.body.copyWith(
                color: scheme.onSurfaceVariant,
              ),
            ),
          ],
          if (widget.item.exampleText.trim().isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
            const SizedBox(height: 28),
            AppDirectionalText(
              widget.item.exampleText,

            if (widget.item.exampleTranslationText.trim().isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[

            ],

          SizedBox(
