import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../features/audio/domain/entities/audio_playback_result.dart';
import '../../features/pronunciation/domain/pronunciation_models.dart';
import '../../features/pronunciation/pronunciation_lab_service.dart';
import '../../language/german/german_pronunciation_catalog.dart';
import '../../models/content.dart';
import '../../services/app_dependencies.dart';
import '../../services/repository.dart';
import 'pronunciation_lab_sections.dart';

class OfflinePronunciationLabPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const OfflinePronunciationLabPage({
    super.key,
    required this.repo,
    required this.dependencies,
    required this.onDone,
  });

  final LearnerRepository repo;
  final AppDependencies<ContentItem> dependencies;
  final VoidCallback onDone;

  @override
  State<OfflinePronunciationLabPage> createState() =>
      _OfflinePronunciationLabPageState();
}

class _OfflinePronunciationLabPageState
    extends State<OfflinePronunciationLabPage> {
  late final PronunciationLabService<ContentItem> _service;
  late final List<PronunciationContrast> _contrasts;
  List<PronunciationConfusionStat> _confusions =
      const <PronunciationConfusionStat>[];

  PronunciationTrial<ContentItem>? _trial;
  PronunciationPerceptionResult? _perception;
  PronunciationProductionFeedback? _production;
  String _audioStatus = 'ابدأ بالاستماع ثم اختر الكلمة التي سمعتها.';
  int _round = 0;
  bool _slow = false;
  bool _audioBusy = false;
  bool _productionBusy = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _service = PronunciationLabService<ContentItem>(
      repository: widget.repo,
      audioRuntime: widget.dependencies.audioRuntime,
      signalProbe: widget.dependencies.pronunciationSignalProbe,
      languageCode: widget.dependencies.languagePack.speechProfile.languageCode,
      corpus: widget.dependencies.corpus,
    );
    _contrasts = _service.availableContrasts(
      GermanPronunciationCatalog.contrasts,
    );
    _confusions = _service.confusionStats();
    _prepareTrial();
  }

  void _prepareTrial() {
    if (_contrasts.isEmpty) {
      _trial = null;
      return;
    }
    final contrast = _contrasts[_round % _contrasts.length];
    _trial = _service.buildTrial(contrast, round: _round);
    _perception = null;
    _production = null;
    _audioStatus = 'استمع دون النظر إلى الإجابة، ثم اختر ما سمعت.';
  }

  Future<void> _listen() async {
    final trial = _trial;
    if (trial == null || _audioBusy) return;
    setState(() => _audioBusy = true);
    final result = await _service.playTarget(trial, slow: _slow);
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _audioBusy = false;
      _audioStatus = switch (result.source) {
        AudioPlaybackSource.recorded => 'تم تشغيل التسجيل المحلي.',
        AudioPlaybackSource.offlineTts => 'تم تشغيل صوت TTS ألماني محلي.',
        AudioPlaybackSource.unavailable =>
          'الصوت المحلي غير متاح: ${result.reason ?? 'unknown'}',
      };
    });
  }

  Future<void> _choose(String token) async {
    final trial = _trial;
    if (trial == null || _perception != null) return;
    final result = await _service.answerPerception(
      trial,
      selectedToken: token,
      seconds: 6,
    );
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _perception = result;
      _confusions = _service.confusionStats(widget.repo.load());
    });
    widget.onDone();
  }

  Future<void> _captureProduction() async {
    final trial = _trial;
    if (trial == null || _productionBusy) return;
    setState(() => _productionBusy = true);
    final feedback = await _service.captureProduction(trial);
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _productionBusy = false;
      _production = feedback;
    });
  }

  void _nextRound() {
    setState(() {
      _round++;
      _prepareTrial();
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final trial = _trial;
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('مختبر النطق المحلي')),
      body: _contrasts.isEmpty || trial == null
          ? const Center(
              child: Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.all(24),
                child: Text(
                  'لا توجد أزواج نطق موثوقة متاحة في حزمة المحتوى النشطة.',
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                ),
              ),
            )
          : Directionality(
              textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
              child: ListView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 32),
                children: [
                  const Card(
                    child: ListTile(
                      leading: Icon(Icons.offline_bolt_outlined),
                      title: Text('Offline Pronunciation Lab'),
                      subtitle: Text(
                        'اسمع → ميّز → انطق → افحص الإشارة محليًا → أعد المحاولة. '
                        'لا يوجد Cloud STT أو رفع للتسجيل.',
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                  PronunciationPerceptionCard(
                    contrast: trial.contrast,
                    options: trial.options,
                    slow: _slow,
                    busy: _audioBusy || _perception != null,
                    onSlowChanged: (value) => setState(() => _slow = value),
                    onListen: _listen,
                    onChoose: _choose,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Text(
                    _audioStatus,
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall,
                  ),
                  if (_perception != null) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    PronunciationFeedbackCard(
                      result: _perception!,
                      coachingAr: trial.contrast.coachingAr,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    PronunciationProductionCard(
                      targetToken: trial.target.token,
                      busy: _productionBusy,
                      feedback: _production,
                      onCapture: _captureProduction,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    FilledButton.icon(
                      onPressed: _nextRound,
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.navigate_next),
                      label: const Text('جولة نطق جديدة'),
                    ),
                  ],
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  PronunciationConfusionPanel(
                    stats: _confusions,
                    catalog: _contrasts,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
    );
  }
}

class PronunciationConfusionPanel extends StatelessWidget {
  const PronunciationConfusionPanel({
    super.key,
    required this.stats,
    required this.catalog,
  });

  final List<PronunciationConfusionStat> stats;
  final List<PronunciationContrast> catalog;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (stats.isEmpty) {
      return const Card(
        child: ListTile(
          leading: Icon(Icons.track_changes_outlined),
          title: Text('خريطة الالتباس الصوتي'),
          subtitle: Text('ستظهر هنا الأنماط المتكررة بعد عدة جولات.'),
        ),
      );
    }

    String titleFor(String id) {
      for (final contrast in catalog) {
        if (contrast.id == id) return contrast.titleAr;
      }
      return id;
    }

    return Card(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            Text(
              'خريطة الالتباس الصوتي',
              style: Theme.of(context)
                  .textTheme
                  .titleSmall
                  ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            for (final stat in stats.take(4))
              ListTile(
                contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                dense: true,
                title: Text(titleFor(stat.contrastId)),
                subtitle: Text(
                  '${stat.mistakes} أخطاء من ${stat.attempts} محاولات',
                ),
                trailing: Text('${(stat.errorRate * 100).round()}%'),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

FILE: lib/ui_v35/shared/article_badge.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../theme/app_design_system.dart';

Color articleBadgeColor(String article) {
  switch (article.trim().toLowerCase()) {
    case 'der':
      return AppPalette.articleDer;
    case 'die':
      return AppPalette.articleDie;
    case 'das':
      return AppPalette.articleDas;
    default:
      return AppPalette.articleOther;
  }
}

class ArticleBadge extends StatelessWidget {
  const ArticleBadge({
    required this.article,
    this.prominent = false,
    this.compact = false,
    this.margin,
    super.key,
  });

  final String article;
  final bool prominent;
  final bool compact;
  final EdgeInsetsGeometry? margin;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final value = article.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (value.isEmpty) return const SizedBox.shrink();

    final color = articleBadgeColor(value);
    final horizontal = prominent ? 14.0 : (compact ? 7.0 : 9.0);
    final vertical = prominent ? 6.0 : (compact ? 3.0 : 4.0);
    final fontSize = prominent ? 18.0 : (compact ? 11.0 : 12.0);

    return Semantics(
      label: 'أداة التعريف $value',
      child: Container(
        key: Key('article-badge-$value'),
        margin: margin,
        padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
          horizontal: horizontal,
          vertical: vertical,
        ),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.10),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(prominent ? 11 : 8),
          border: Border.all(
            color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.48),
            width: prominent ? 1.4 : 1,
          ),
        ),
        child: Text(
          value,
          textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
          style: TextStyle(
            color: color,
            fontSize: fontSize,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
            height: 1,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../core/language/app_text_direction.dart';
import '../../../core/text/directional_text.dart';

TextDirection flutterTextDirection(AppTextDirection direction) =>
    switch (direction) {
      AppTextDirection.ltr => TextDirection.ltr,
      AppTextDirection.rtl => TextDirection.rtl,
    };

class BidiText extends StatelessWidget {
  const BidiText(
    this.value, {
    super.key,
    this.style,
    this.textAlign,
    this.maxLines,
    this.overflow,
    this.semanticsLabel,
  });

  final DirectionalText value;
  final TextStyle? style;
  final TextAlign? textAlign;
  final int? maxLines;
  final TextOverflow? overflow;
  final String? semanticsLabel;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Text(
        value.text,
        textDirection: flutterTextDirection(value.direction),
        style: style,
        textAlign: textAlign,
        maxLines: maxLines,
        overflow: overflow,
        semanticsLabel: semanticsLabel,
      );
}

FILE: lib/ui_v35/shared/text/bilingual_text.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../core/language/app_text_direction.dart';
import '../../../core/text/directional_text.dart';
import 'bidi_text.dart';
import 'linguistic_text_span.dart';

class BilingualText extends StatelessWidget {
  const BilingualText({
    super.key,
    required this.segments,
    this.baseDirection = AppTextDirection.rtl,
    this.style,
    this.textAlign,
  });

  final List<DirectionalText> segments;
  final AppTextDirection baseDirection;
  final TextStyle? style;
  final TextAlign? textAlign;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Text.rich(
        TextSpan(
          style: style,
          children: segments
              .map((segment) => LinguisticTextSpan(segment).toTextSpan())
              .toList(growable: false),
        ),
        textDirection: flutterTextDirection(baseDirection),
        textAlign: textAlign,
      );
}


--------------------------------------------------
FILE: lib/ui_v35/shared/text/linguistic_text_span.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../core/text/bidi_boundary.dart';
import '../../../core/text/directional_text.dart';

final class LinguisticTextSpan {
  const LinguisticTextSpan(this.value, {this.style, this.semanticsLabel});

  final DirectionalText value;
  final TextStyle? style;
  final String? semanticsLabel;

  TextSpan toTextSpan() => TextSpan(
        text: BidiBoundary.isolate(value),
        style: style,
        semanticsLabel: semanticsLabel,
      );
}

class LearningTrackGrid extends StatelessWidget {
  const LearningTrackGrid({
    required this.skillScores,
    super.key,
  });

  final Map<String, double> skillScores;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final tracks = <_TrackSpec>[
      const _TrackSpec(
        keyName: 'recall',
        label: 'التعرّف',
        icon: FontAwesomeIcons.brain,
        color: AppPalette.primary,
      ),
      const _TrackSpec(
        keyName: 'listening',
        label: 'الاستماع',
        icon: FontAwesomeIcons.headphones,
        color: AppPalette.secondary,
      ),
      const _TrackSpec(
        keyName: 'production',
        label: 'الإنتاج',
        icon: FontAwesomeIcons.microphone,
        color: AppPalette.achievement,
      ),
      const _TrackSpec(
        keyName: 'transfer',
        label: 'النقل',
        icon: FontAwesomeIcons.arrowRightArrowLeft,
        color: AppPalette.mastery,
      ),
    ];

    return GridView.builder(
      key: const Key('learning-track-grid'),
      shrinkWrap: true,
      physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
      itemCount: tracks.length,
      gridDelegate: const SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
        crossAxisCount: 2,
        childAspectRatio: 1.55,
        crossAxisSpacing: 10,
        mainAxisSpacing: 10,
      ),
      itemBuilder: (context, index) {
        final track = tracks[index];
        final score =
            (skillScores[track.keyName] ?? 0).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
        return _LearningTrackCard(
          label: track.label,
          icon: track.icon,
          color: track.color,
          progress: score,
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

class _LearningTrackCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _LearningTrackCard({
    required this.label,
    required this.icon,
    required this.color,
    required this.progress,
  });

  final String label;
  final FaIconData icon;
  final Color color;
  final double progress;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final value = progress.clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
    final percent = (value * 100).round();
    final labelColor = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark
        ? Colors.white
        : Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurface;

    return GlassCard(
      borderRadius: 22,
      blur: 14,
      opacity: 0.08,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: <Widget>[
          Row(
            children: <Widget>[
              FaIcon(icon, size: 18, color: color),
              const Spacer(),
              Text(
                '$percent%',
                textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
                style: TextStyle(
                          fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                  color: color,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const Spacer(),
          Text(
            label,
            style: TextStyle(
                          fontFamily: 'Cairo',
              color: labelColor,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          ClipRRect(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
            child: LinearProgressIndicator(
              value: value,
              minHeight: 6,
              backgroundColor: color.withAlpha(24),
              valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(color),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class ReferenceFloatingNavigationBar extends StatelessWidget {
  const ReferenceFloatingNavigationBar({
    required this.selectedIndex,
    required this.onSelected,
    super.key,
  });

  final int selectedIndex;
  final ValueChanged<int> onSelected;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final darkSurface =
        selectedIndex == 0 || Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    const destinations = <_NavDestination>[
      _NavDestination(FontAwesomeIcons.house, 'الرئيسية'),
      _NavDestination(FontAwesomeIcons.bookOpen, 'الدروس'),
      _NavDestination(FontAwesomeIcons.comments, 'محادثة'),
      _NavDestination(FontAwesomeIcons.chartSimple, 'التقدم'),
      _NavDestination(FontAwesomeIcons.bars, 'المزيد'),
    ];

    return SafeArea(
      top: false,
      minimum: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 0, 14, 10),
      child: GlassCard(
        key: const Key('main-navigation-bar'),
        borderRadius: 26,
        blur: 22,
        opacity: 0.18,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 8),
        child: Row(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceAround,
          children: List<Widget>.generate(destinations.length, (index) {
            final destination = destinations[index];
            final selected = index == selectedIndex;
            final color = selected
                ? const Color(0xFF38BDF8)
                : darkSurface
                    ? Colors.white54
                    : const Color(0xFF64748B);

            return Expanded(
              child: Semantics(
                button: true,
                selected: selected,
                label: destination.label,
                child: InkWell(
                  onTap: () => onSelected(index),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                  child: AnimatedContainer(
                    duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: selected
                          ? const Color(0xFF38BDF8).withAlpha(22)
                          : Colors.transparent,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                    ),
                    child: Column(
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      children: <Widget>[
                        FaIcon(destination.icon, size: 17, color: color),
                        const SizedBox(height: 4),
                        Text(
                          destination.label,
                          maxLines: 1,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          style: TextStyle(
                          fontFamily: 'Cairo',
                            fontSize: 9.5,
                            fontWeight:
                                selected ? FontWeight.w800 : FontWeight.w500,
                            color: color,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            );
          }),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

  const _NavDestination(this.icon, this.label);

  final FaIconData icon;
  final String label;
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../design_system/app_glass_card.dart';

class GlassCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const GlassCard({
    required this.child,
    this.blur = 15.0,
    this.opacity = 0.2,
    this.borderRadius = 20.0,
    this.padding = const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
    super.key,
  });

  final Widget child;
  final double blur;
  final double opacity;
  final double borderRadius;
  final EdgeInsetsGeometry padding;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AppGlassCard(
      blur: blur,
      opacity: opacity,
      borderRadius: borderRadius,
      padding: padding,
      child: child,
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../language/german/german_word_family_repository.dart';
import '../../models/content.dart';
import '../../models/linguistics/german_word_family.dart';
import 'word_family_card.dart';

class WordFamiliesPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const WordFamiliesPage({
    super.key,
    required this.repository,
    required this.corpus,
    required this.learnedIds,
  });

  final GermanWordFamilyRepository repository;
  final List<ContentItem> corpus;
  final Set<String> learnedIds;

  @override
  State<WordFamiliesPage> createState() => _WordFamiliesPageState();
}

class _WordFamiliesPageState extends State<WordFamiliesPage> {
  late Future<List<GermanWordFamily>> _families;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _families = widget.repository.listFamilies(limit: 120);
  }

  void _reload() {
    setState(() {
      _families = widget.repository.listFamilies(limit: 120);
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final contentById = <String, ContentItem>{
      for (final item in widget.corpus) item.id: item,
    };

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('عائلات الكلمات')),
      body: FutureBuilder<List<GermanWordFamily>>(
        future: _families,
        builder: (context, snapshot) {
          if (snapshot.connectionState != ConnectionState.done) {
            return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
          }
          if (snapshot.hasError) {
            return _MessageState(
              icon: Icons.error_outline,
              title: 'تعذر فتح عائلات الكلمات',
              body: 'بقيت البيانات الأساسية آمنة. حاول إعادة فتح الصفحة.',
              action: _reload,
            );
          }

          final families = snapshot.data ?? const <GermanWordFamily>[];
          if (families.isEmpty) {
            return const _MessageState(
              icon: Icons.account_tree_outlined,
              title: 'لا توجد عائلات موثّقة في الحزمة الحالية',
              body: 'لن يخمّن التطبيق الاشتقاق من تشابه شكل الكلمات. '
                  'تظهر هنا فقط العلاقات الألمانية الصريحة المراجعة.',
            );
          }

          return LayoutBuilder(
            builder: (context, constraints) {
              final columns = constraints.maxWidth >= 760 ? 2 : 1;
              final rowCount = (families.length + columns - 1) ~/ columns;
              return ListView.separated(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                itemCount: rowCount,
                separatorBuilder: (_, __) => const SizedBox(height: 12),
                itemBuilder: (context, rowIndex) {
                  final cards = <Widget>[];
                  for (var column = 0; column < columns; column++) {
                    if (column > 0) {
                      cards.add(const SizedBox(width: 12));
                    }
                    final familyIndex = rowIndex * columns + column;
                    cards.add(
                      Expanded(
                        child: familyIndex < families.length
                            ? WordFamilyCard(
                                family: families[familyIndex],
                                contentById: contentById,
                                learnedIds: widget.learnedIds,
                              )
                            : const SizedBox.shrink(),
                      ),
                    );
                  }
                  return Row(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: cards,
                  );
                },
              );
            },
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _MessageState extends StatelessWidget {
  const _MessageState({
    required this.icon,
    required this.title,
    required this.body,
    this.action,
  });

  final IconData icon;
  final String title;
  final String body;
  final VoidCallback? action;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Center(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(28),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              Icon(icon, size: 46),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Text(
                title,
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                style: Theme.of(context)
                    .textTheme
                    .titleLarge
                    ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Text(body, textAlign: TextAlign.center),
              if (action != null) ...[
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                OutlinedButton(
                  onPressed: action,
                  child: const Text('إعادة المحاولة'),
                ),
              ],
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../core/text/directional_text.dart';
import '../../models/content.dart';
import '../../models/linguistics/german_word_family.dart';
import '../shared/text/bidi_text.dart';

class WordFamilyCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const WordFamilyCard({
    super.key,
    required this.family,
    required this.contentById,
    required this.learnedIds,
  });

  final GermanWordFamily family;
  final Map<String, ContentItem> contentById;
  final Set<String> learnedIds;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final base = family.baseMember;
    return Card(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            Row(
              children: [
                const Icon(Icons.account_tree_outlined),
                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                Expanded(
                  child: BidiText(
                    DirectionalText.german(
                      base?.concept.lemma ?? family.familyId,
                      semanticRole: LinguisticSemanticRole.word,
                    ),
                    style: Theme.of(context)
                        .textTheme
                        .titleLarge
                        ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                  ),
                ),
                Text('${family.members.length}'),
              ],
            ),
            if (family.hasInterferenceRisk) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              const Row(
                children: [
                  Icon(Icons.warning_amber_rounded, size: 18),
                  SizedBox(width: 6),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      'يوجد عنصر متشابه قد يسبب تداخلًا؛ راجع المعنى قبل الربط.',
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ],
            const Divider(height: 24),
            ...family.members.map((member) => _memberRow(context, member)),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _memberRow(BuildContext context, GermanWordFamilyMember member) {
    final content = contentById[member.concept.id];
    final article = content?.article.trim() ?? '';
    final german = article.isEmpty
        ? member.concept.lemma
        : article + ' ' + member.concept.lemma;
    final learned = learnedIds.contains(member.concept.id);

    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
      child: DecoratedBox(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          border: Border.all(
            color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.outlineVariant,
          ),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        ),
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: [
              Row(
                children: [
                  if (learned)
                    const Padding(
                      padding: EdgeInsets.only(left: 6),
                      child: Icon(Icons.check_circle_outline, size: 18),
                    ),
                  Expanded(
                    child: BidiText(
                      DirectionalText.german(
                        german,
                        semanticRole: LinguisticSemanticRole.word,
                      ),
                      style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              if ((content?.arabic.trim() ?? '').isNotEmpty) ...[
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                BidiText(
                  DirectionalText.arabic(
                    content!.arabic,
                    semanticRole: LinguisticSemanticRole.translation,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Wrap(
                spacing: 6,
                runSpacing: 6,
                children: [
                  _chip(_relationLabel(member.relationType)),
                  _chip(member.pedagogicalLevel.wireName),
                  _chip(_distanceLabel(member.semanticDistance)),
                  if (member.prefix != null) _chip('Prefix: ${member.prefix}'),
                  if (member.suffix != null) _chip('Suffix: ${member.suffix}'),
                ],
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _chip(String label) =>
      Chip(visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact, label: Text(label));

  String _relationLabel(GermanWordFamilyRelationType relation) =>
      switch (relation) {
        GermanWordFamilyRelationType.base => 'الأساس',
        GermanWordFamilyRelationType.agentNoun => 'اسم الفاعل',
        GermanWordFamilyRelationType.eventNoun => 'اسم حدث',
        GermanWordFamilyRelationType.derivedNoun => 'اسم مشتق',
        GermanWordFamilyRelationType.derivedAdjective => 'صفة مشتقة',
        GermanWordFamilyRelationType.prefixedVerb => 'فعل ببادئة',
        GermanWordFamilyRelationType.compound => 'مركب',
        GermanWordFamilyRelationType.semanticRelative => 'قريب دلاليًا',
        GermanWordFamilyRelationType.historicalRelative => 'قرابة تاريخية',
        GermanWordFamilyRelationType.notPedagogicallyLinked =>
          'لا يربط تعليميًا',
        GermanWordFamilyRelationType.unknown => 'علاقة غير معروفة',
      };

  String _distanceLabel(GermanSemanticDistance distance) => switch (distance) {
        GermanSemanticDistance.low => 'قرب دلالي: منخفض',
        GermanSemanticDistance.medium => 'قرب دلالي: متوسط',
        GermanSemanticDistance.high => 'قرب دلالي: بعيد',
        GermanSemanticDistance.unknown => 'قرب دلالي: غير معروف',
      };
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_animate/flutter_animate.dart';
import 'package:font_awesome_flutter/font_awesome_flutter.dart';

import 'app_glass_card.dart';
import 'app_typography.dart';

class AppAudioButton extends StatelessWidget {
  const AppAudioButton({
    required this.onPressed,
    required this.semanticLabel,
    this.isActive = false,
    this.isBusy = false,
    this.icon = FontAwesomeIcons.volumeHigh,
    this.activeColor = const Color(0xFF38BDF8),
    super.key,
  });

  final VoidCallback? onPressed;
  final String semanticLabel;
  final bool isActive;
  final bool isBusy;
  final FaIconData icon;
  final Color activeColor;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final enabled = onPressed != null && !isBusy;
    final color = enabled ? activeColor : Colors.white38;

    Widget button = Semantics(
      button: true,
      enabled: enabled,
      label: semanticLabel,
      child: AppGlassCard(
        onTap: enabled ? onPressed : null,
        borderRadius: 22,
        blur: 16,
        opacity: .10,
        glowColor: isActive ? activeColor : null,
        padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
        child: SizedBox(
          width: 52,
          height: 52,
          child: Center(
            child: isBusy
                ? SizedBox(
                    width: 20,
                    height: 20,
                    child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                      strokeWidth: 2.4,
                      color: activeColor,
                    ),
                  )
                : FaIcon(icon, size: 18, color: color),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );

    if (isActive) {
      button = button
          .animate(onPlay: (controller) => controller.repeat(reverse: true))
          .scale(
            begin: const Offset(.98, .98),
            end: const Offset(1.035, 1.035),
            duration: 700.ms,
          )
          .fade(
            begin: .88,
            end: 1,
            duration: 700.ms,
          );
    }

    return Tooltip(
      message: semanticLabel,
      textStyle: AppTypography.label.copyWith(color: Colors.white),
      child: button,
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:ui';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/physics.dart';

import 'app_design_tokens.dart';

class AppGlassCard extends StatefulWidget {
  const AppGlassCard({
    required this.child,
    this.onTap,
    this.blur = AppDesignTokens.glassBlur,
    this.opacity = AppDesignTokens.glassOpacity,
    this.borderRadius = AppDesignTokens.radiusL,
    this.padding = const EdgeInsets.all(AppDesignTokens.spaceM),
    this.borderColor,
    this.glowColor,
    this.backgroundColor = Colors.white,
    super.key,
  });

  final Widget child;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;
  final double blur;
  final double opacity;
  final double borderRadius;
  final EdgeInsetsGeometry padding;
  final Color? borderColor;
  final Color? glowColor;
  final Color backgroundColor;

  @override
  State<AppGlassCard> createState() => _AppGlassCardState();
}

class _AppGlassCardState extends State<AppGlassCard>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  AnimationController? _scale;

  AnimationController get _controller => _scale ??= AnimationController.unbounded(
        vsync: this,
        value: 1,
      );

  void _springTo(double target) {
    _controller.animateWith(
      SpringSimulation(
        const SpringDescription(
          mass: .8,
          stiffness: 520,
          damping: 32,
        ),
        _controller.value,
        target,
        0,
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _scale?.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final radius = widget.borderRadius.clamp(20.0, 28.0).toDouble();
    final alpha = (widget.opacity.clamp(0.0, 1.0) * 255).round();
    final border = widget.borderColor ?? Colors.white.withAlpha(72);
    final glow = widget.glowColor;

    final surface = ClipRRect(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(radius),
      child: BackdropFilter(
        filter: ImageFilter.blur(
          sigmaX: widget.blur,
          sigmaY: widget.blur,
        ),
        child: Container(
          padding: widget.padding,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: widget.backgroundColor.withAlpha(alpha),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(radius),
            border: Border.all(color: border, width: 1.2),
            boxShadow: glow == null
                ? const <BoxShadow>[]
                : <BoxShadow>[
                    BoxShadow(
                      color: glow.withAlpha(34),
                      blurRadius: 24,
                      spreadRadius: 1,
                    ),
                  ],
          ),
          child: widget.child,
        ),
      ),
    );

    if (widget.onTap == null) return surface;

    final controller = _controller;
    return Semantics(
      button: true,
      child: GestureDetector(
        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
        onTapDown: (_) => _springTo(.975),
        onTapCancel: () => _springTo(1),
        onTapUp: (_) => _springTo(1),
        onTap: widget.onTap,
        child: AnimatedBuilder(
          animation: controller,
          child: surface,
          builder: (context, child) {
            final value = controller.value.clamp(.94, 1.02).toDouble();
            return Transform.scale(scale: value, child: child);
          },
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

abstract final class AppTextDirection {
  static TextDirection forLanguageCode(String languageCode) {
    final code = languageCode.trim().toLowerCase().split(RegExp('[-_]')).first;
    return switch (code) {
      'ar' || 'fa' || 'ur' => TextDirection.rtl,
      _ => TextDirection.ltr,
    };
  }
}

abstract final class AppTypography {
  static TextStyle get display => TextStyle(
        fontFamily: 'Cairo',
        fontSize: 30,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
        height: 1.18,
      );

  static TextStyle get title => TextStyle(
        fontFamily: 'Cairo',
        fontSize: 20,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
        height: 1.3,
      );

  static TextStyle get body => TextStyle(
        fontFamily: 'Cairo',
        fontSize: 14,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
        height: 1.55,
      );

  static TextStyle get label => TextStyle(
        fontFamily: 'Cairo',
        fontSize: 12,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
        height: 1.35,
      );
}

class AppDirectionalText extends StatelessWidget {
  const AppDirectionalText(
    this.text, {
    required this.languageCode,
    this.style,
    this.textAlign,
    this.maxLines,
    this.overflow,
    super.key,
  });

  final String text;
  final String languageCode;
  final TextStyle? style;
  final TextAlign? textAlign;
  final int? maxLines;
  final TextOverflow? overflow;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Directionality(
      textDirection: AppTextDirection.forLanguageCode(languageCode),
      child: Text(
        text,
        style: style ?? AppTypography.body,
        textAlign: textAlign,
        maxLines: maxLines,
        overflow: overflow,
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:math' as math;

import '../../core/srs/srs_models.dart';
import '../../features/learning/domain/adaptive_error_bank.dart';
import '../../models/mistake.dart';
import 'daily_streak_engine.dart';

final class AdaptiveReviewItem {
  final String itemId;
  final String displayLabel;
  final AdaptiveErrorType type;
  final double priority;
  final int reviewIntervalDays;
  final DateTime nextReviewAt;

  const AdaptiveReviewItem({
    required this.itemId,
    required this.displayLabel,
    required this.type,
    required this.priority,
    required this.reviewIntervalDays,
    required this.nextReviewAt,
  });
}

final class LearnerDashboardAnalytics {
  final double retentionRate;
  final double masteryIndex;
  final double curriculumProgress;
  final int masteredWords;
  final int currentStreakDays;
  final int trackedItems;
  final String progressBand;
  final List<AdaptiveReviewItem> dailyReview;

  const LearnerDashboardAnalytics({
    required this.retentionRate,
    required this.masteryIndex,
    required this.curriculumProgress,
    required this.masteredWords,
    required this.currentStreakDays,
    required this.trackedItems,
    required this.progressBand,
    required this.dailyReview,
  });

  double get a1ToB1Progress => curriculumProgress;
}

/// Read-only adaptive policy over canonical SRS, attempts, and mistake evidence.
///
/// Persistence remains owned by the established learner repositories. The agent
/// derives analytics and a deterministic due-only daily review queue.
final class AdaptiveSrsAgent {
  final AdaptiveErrorBank errorBank;
  final DailyStreakEngine streakEngine;

  const AdaptiveSrsAgent({
    this.errorBank = const AdaptiveErrorBank(),
    this.streakEngine = const DailyStreakEngine(),
  });

  LearnerDashboardAnalytics analyze({
    required Iterable<DateTime> activityTimesUtc,
    required Iterable<MistakeRecord> mistakes,
    required Map<String, SrsItemState> states,
    required int totalAttempts,
    required int correctAttempts,
    required Map<String, String> curriculumLevelByItem,
    required Set<String> masteredItemIds,
    required DateTime nowUtc,
    int timezoneOffsetMinutes = 0,
    int reviewLimit = 10,
    Map<String, String> skillByItem = const <String, String>{},
    Map<String, String> displayLabelByItem = const <String, String>{},
  }) {
    if (!nowUtc.isUtc) {
      throw ArgumentError('nowUtc must be in UTC');
    }
    if (reviewLimit < 0) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(reviewLimit, 'reviewLimit', 'must be >= 0');
    }
    if (totalAttempts < 0 || correctAttempts < 0) {
      throw ArgumentError('attempt counts must be non-negative');
    }
    if (correctAttempts > totalAttempts) {
      throw ArgumentError('correctAttempts cannot exceed totalAttempts');
    }

    final mistakeList = List<MistakeRecord>.unmodifiable(mistakes);
    final mastery = _masteryIndex(states, mistakeList, nowUtc);
    final dueMistakes = <MistakeRecord>[
      for (final mistake in mistakeList)
        if (_isDue(states[mistake.itemId], nowUtc)) mistake,
    ];
    final signals = errorBank.prioritize(
      dueMistakes,
      states,
      reviewedAtUtc: nowUtc,
      skillByItem: skillByItem,
    );
    final curriculum =
        _curriculumProgress(curriculumLevelByItem, masteredItemIds);

    final queue = <AdaptiveReviewItem>[
      for (final signal in signals.take(reviewLimit))
        AdaptiveReviewItem(
          itemId: signal.itemId,
          displayLabel: displayLabelByItem[signal.itemId] ?? signal.itemId,
          type: signal.type,
          priority: signal.priority,
          reviewIntervalDays: signal.reviewIntervalDays,
          nextReviewAt: signal.nextReviewAt,
        ),
    ];

    return LearnerDashboardAnalytics(
      retentionRate:
          totalAttempts == 0 ? 0.0 : correctAttempts / totalAttempts,
      masteryIndex: mastery,
      curriculumProgress: curriculum.progress,
      masteredWords: masteredItemIds.length,
      currentStreakDays: streakEngine.currentStreak(
        activityTimesUtc,
        nowUtc: nowUtc,
        timezoneOffsetMinutes: timezoneOffsetMinutes,
      ),
      trackedItems: states.length,
      progressBand: curriculum.band,
      dailyReview: List<AdaptiveReviewItem>.unmodifiable(queue),
    );
  }

  bool _isDue(SrsItemState? state, DateTime nowUtc) =>
      state != null && !state.dueDate.toUtc().isAfter(nowUtc);

  double _masteryIndex(
    Map<String, SrsItemState> states,
    List<MistakeRecord> mistakes,
    DateTime nowUtc,
  ) {
    if (states.isEmpty) return 0.0;

    double total = 0;
    for (final entry in states.entries) {
      final stateWeight = switch (entry.value.state) {
        CardState.newCard => 0.0,
        CardState.learning => 0.35,
        CardState.reviewing => 0.70,
        CardState.mastered => 1.0,
      };
      final matching = mistakes.where((m) => m.itemId == entry.key);
      final highestPenalty = matching.isEmpty
          ? 0.0
          : matching
                  .map((m) => errorBank.priorityScore(m, now: nowUtc))
                  .reduce((a, b) => math.max(a, b).toDouble()) /
              100.0;
      total += (stateWeight * (1.0 - highestPenalty * 0.35))
          .clamp(0.0, 1.0)
          .toDouble();
    }
    return (total / states.length).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
  }

  _CurriculumProgress _curriculumProgress(
    Map<String, String> levelByItem,
    Set<String> masteredItemIds,
  ) {
    final eligible = levelByItem.entries.where(
      (entry) => const {'A1', 'A2', 'B1'}.contains(entry.value),
    );
    final totals = <String, int>{'A1': 0, 'A2': 0, 'B1': 0};
    final mastered = <String, int>{'A1': 0, 'A2': 0, 'B1': 0};
    var total = 0;
    var masteredTotal = 0;

    for (final entry in eligible) {
      totals[entry.value] = (totals[entry.value] ?? 0) + 1;
      total++;
      if (masteredItemIds.contains(entry.key)) {
        mastered[entry.value] = (mastered[entry.value] ?? 0) + 1;
        masteredTotal++;
      }
    }

    if (total == 0) {
      return const _CurriculumProgress(progress: 0, band: 'A1');
    }

    double coverage(String level) {
      final denominator = totals[level] ?? 0;
      if (denominator == 0) return 0;
      return (mastered[level] ?? 0) / denominator;
    }

    final band = coverage('A1') < .80
        ? 'A1'
        : coverage('A2') < .80
            ? 'A2'
            : 'B1';
    return _CurriculumProgress(
      progress: (masteredTotal / total).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble(),
      band: band,
    );
  }
}

final class _CurriculumProgress {
  final double progress;
  final String band;

  const _CurriculumProgress({
    required this.progress,
    required this.band,
  });
}

/// Pure daily-learning streak calculation with explicit timezone handling.
final class DailyStreakEngine {
  const DailyStreakEngine();

  int currentStreak(
    Iterable<DateTime> activityTimesUtc, {
    required DateTime nowUtc,
    int timezoneOffsetMinutes = 0,
  }) {
    if (!nowUtc.isUtc) {
      throw ArgumentError('nowUtc must be in UTC');
    }
    final offset = timezoneOffsetMinutes.clamp(-840, 840).toInt();
    final today = _localDay(nowUtc, offset);
    final uniqueDays = <DateTime>{
      for (final timestamp in activityTimesUtc)
        if (!timestamp.toUtc().isAfter(nowUtc))
          _localDay(timestamp.toUtc(), offset),
    }.toList()
      ..sort();

    if (uniqueDays.isEmpty) return 0;

    final latest = uniqueDays.last;
    final gapFromToday = today.difference(latest).inDays;
    if (gapFromToday > 1) return 0;

    var streak = 1;
    var cursor = latest;
    for (var index = uniqueDays.length - 2; index >= 0; index--) {
      final candidate = uniqueDays[index];
      final gap = cursor.difference(candidate).inDays;
      if (gap == 0) continue;
      if (gap != 1) break;
      streak++;
      cursor = candidate;
    }
    return streak;
  }

  DateTime _localDay(DateTime utc, int offsetMinutes) {
    final local = utc.add(Duration(minutes: offsetMinutes));
    return DateTime.utc(local.year, local.month, local.day);
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

import '../../core/media/cache_manager.dart';
import '../../core/media/media_loader_service.dart';

final class BundledMediaLoaderService implements MediaLoaderService {
  BundledMediaLoaderService({
    AssetBundle? bundle,
    CacheManager? cache,
    this.manifestAsset = 'assets/media/assets_manifest.json',
  })  : _bundle = bundle ?? rootBundle,
        _cache = cache ?? CacheManager();

  static const int _maxImageBytes = 30 * 1024;

  final AssetBundle _bundle;
  final CacheManager _cache;
  final String manifestAsset;

  Map<String, MediaAssetDescriptor>? _index;
  Future<Map<String, MediaAssetDescriptor>>? _loadingManifest;

  @override
  Future<Uint8List?> loadWordImage(String wordId) async {
    final normalized = wordId.trim();
    if (normalized.isEmpty) return null;

    final cached = _cache.get(normalized);
    if (cached != null) return cached;

    final index = await _ensureIndex();
    final descriptor = index[normalized];
    if (descriptor == null) return null;

    final data = await _bundle.load(descriptor.assetPath);
    final bytes = data.buffer.asUint8List(data.offsetInBytes, data.lengthInBytes);
    if (bytes.lengthInBytes != descriptor.bytes ||
        bytes.lengthInBytes > _maxImageBytes) {
      throw FormatException('media asset size drift for $normalized');
    }
    _cache.put(normalized, bytes);
    return bytes;
  }

  @override
  Future<MediaAssetDescriptor?> descriptorFor(String wordId) async {
    final normalized = wordId.trim();
    if (normalized.isEmpty) return null;
    final index = await _ensureIndex();
    return index[normalized];
  }

  @override
  void clearMemoryCache() => _cache.clear();

  Future<Map<String, MediaAssetDescriptor>> _ensureIndex() async {
    final loaded = _index;
    if (loaded != null) return loaded;
    final inFlight = _loadingManifest;
    if (inFlight != null) return inFlight;

    final future = _loadManifest();
    _loadingManifest = future;
    try {
      return await future;
    } finally {
      _loadingManifest = null;
    }
  }

  Future<Map<String, MediaAssetDescriptor>> _loadManifest() async {
    final encoded = await _bundle.loadString(manifestAsset);
    final decoded = jsonDecode(encoded);
    if (decoded is! Map<String, dynamic>) {
      throw const FormatException('media manifest must be a JSON object');
    }
    if (decoded['schema_version'] != 1 || decoded['max_image_bytes'] != _maxImageBytes) {
      throw const FormatException('unsupported media manifest contract');
    }
    final assets = decoded['assets'];
    if (assets is! List) {
      throw const FormatException('media manifest assets must be a list');
    }

    final index = <String, MediaAssetDescriptor>{};
    for (final raw in assets) {
      if (raw is! Map) {
        throw const FormatException('media manifest entry must be an object');
      }
      final wordId = raw['word_id'];
      final assetPath = raw['asset_path'];
      final license = raw['license'];
      final sourceUrl = raw['source_url'];
      final sha256 = raw['sha256'];
      final bytes = raw['bytes'];
      if (wordId is! String ||
          assetPath is! String ||
          license is! String ||
          sourceUrl is! String ||
          sha256 is! String ||
          bytes is! int) {
        throw const FormatException('media manifest entry has invalid fields');
      }
      if (license != 'CC0' && license != 'PUBLIC DOMAIN') {
        throw FormatException('unsupported media license for $wordId');
      }
      if (bytes <= 0 || bytes > _maxImageBytes) {
        throw FormatException('invalid media byte size for $wordId');
      }
      if (index.containsKey(wordId)) {
        throw FormatException('duplicate media word_id: $wordId');
      }
      index[wordId] = MediaAssetDescriptor(
        wordId: wordId,
        assetPath: assetPath,
        license: license,
        sourceUrl: sourceUrl,
        sha256: sha256,
        bytes: bytes,
      );
    }
    _index = Map<String, MediaAssetDescriptor>.unmodifiable(index);
    return _index!;
  }
}

import 'package:flutter_local_notifications/flutter_local_notifications.dart';
import 'package:timezone/data/latest_all.dart' as tz;
import 'package:timezone/timezone.dart' as tz;

import '../../features/notifications/domain/notification_contracts.dart';
import '../../features/notifications/domain/notification_models.dart';

final class FlutterLocalNotificationService
    implements NotificationServiceContract {
  FlutterLocalNotificationService({
    FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin? plugin,
  }) : _plugin = plugin ?? FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin();

  final FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin _plugin;
  bool _initialized = false;

  @override
  Future<void> initialize() async {
    if (_initialized) return;
    tz.initializeTimeZones();

    const settings = InitializationSettings(
      android: AndroidInitializationSettings('@mipmap/ic_launcher'),
      iOS: DarwinInitializationSettings(
        requestAlertPermission: false,
        requestBadgePermission: false,
        requestSoundPermission: false,
      ),
      macOS: DarwinInitializationSettings(
        requestAlertPermission: false,
        requestBadgePermission: false,
        requestSoundPermission: false,
      ),
    );
    await _plugin.initialize(settings: settings);
    _initialized = true;
  }

  @override
  Future<void> replaceAll(List<ScheduledNotificationItem> items) async {
    await initialize();
    await _plugin.cancelAll();
    for (final item in items) {
      await _schedule(item);
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<void> cancelAll() async {
    await initialize();
    await _plugin.cancelAll();
  }

  Future<void> _schedule(ScheduledNotificationItem item) async {
    final scheduled = item.scheduledAtLocal;
    final zoned = tz.TZDateTime(
      tz.local,
      scheduled.year,
      scheduled.month,
      scheduled.day,
      scheduled.hour,
      scheduled.minute,
    );
    final silent = item.tone == NotificationTone.silent;
    final gentle = item.tone == NotificationTone.gentle;

    final android = AndroidNotificationDetails(
      'adaptive_habit_reminders',
      'Adaptive Habit Reminders',
      channelDescription:
          'Local reminders based on the learner study habit.',
      importance: gentle ? Importance.defaultImportance : Importance.high,
      priority: gentle ? Priority.defaultPriority : Priority.high,
      playSound: !silent,
    );
    final darwin = DarwinNotificationDetails(
      presentAlert: true,
      presentBadge: false,
      presentSound: !silent,
    );

    await _plugin.zonedSchedule(
      id: item.id,
      title: item.title,
      body: item.body,
      scheduledDate: zoned,
      notificationDetails: NotificationDetails(
        android: android,
        iOS: darwin,
        macOS: darwin,
      ),
      androidScheduleMode: AndroidScheduleMode.exactAllowWhileIdle,
      payload: item.payload,
      matchDateTimeComponents:
          item.repeatDaily ? DateTimeComponents.time : null,
    );
  }
}

final ProductionRuntimeCoordinator _runtimeCoordinator =
    ProductionRuntimeCoordinator();
const _ProductionUiContract _productionUi = _ProductionUiContract(
  appName: 'Salim',
  showDebugBanner: false,

final class _ProductionUiContract {
  const _ProductionUiContract({
    required this.appName,
    required this.showDebugBanner,
  });

  final String appName;
  final bool showDebugBanner;
}

void _verifyProductionContract() {
  if (_productionUi.appName != 'Salim') {
    throw StateError('Production app name must remain Salim.');
  }
  if (_productionUi.showDebugBanner) {
    throw StateError('Production debug banner must remain disabled.');
  }
  if (CanonicalCurriculum50.tasks.length != 50) {
    throw StateError('Canonical production curriculum must contain 50 tasks.');
  }

Future<void> bootstrapDeutschApp() async {
  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();

  const runtimeFailureReporter = NoopRuntimeFailureReporter();

  FlutterError.onError = (FlutterErrorDetails details) {
    runtimeFailureReporter.recordFlutterError(details);
    unawaited(
      _runtimeCoordinator.dispatchRecoveryError(
        error: details.exception,
        context: 'flutter.framework',
        fatal: false,
      ),
    );
    if (!kReleaseMode) {
      FlutterError.presentError(details);
    }
  };

  ErrorWidget.builder = (FlutterErrorDetails details) => const Directionality(
        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
        child: Material(
          child: _InlineSafeError(),
        ),
      );

  WidgetsBinding.instance.platformDispatcher.onError = (error, stack) {
    runtimeFailureReporter.record(
      error,
      stack,
      fatal: true,
      context: 'root_isolate',
    );
    unawaited(
      _runtimeCoordinator.dispatchRecoveryError(
        error: error,
        context: 'root_isolate',
        fatal: true,
      ),
    );
    return true;
  };

  try {
    _verifyProductionContract();
    runApp(const _RenderFirstBootstrapApp());
  } catch (error, stack) {
    runtimeFailureReporter.record(
      error,
      stack,
      fatal: true,
      context: 'bootstrap',
    );
    unawaited(
      _runtimeCoordinator.dispatchRecoveryError(
        error: error,
        context: 'bootstrap',
        fatal: true,
      ),
    );
    runApp(const _BootFailureApp());
  }
}

void _registerProjectOpenSourceLicensesSafely() {
  try {
    registerProjectOpenSourceLicenses();
  } on Object catch (error) {
    unawaited(
      _runtimeCoordinator.dispatchRecoveryError(
        error: error,
        context: 'license_registry',
        fatal: false,
      ),
    );
  }
}

Future<_ActivatedPhase3App> _activateProduction({
  required PreferencesService prefs,
  required LearnerRepository learnerRepository,
  required GamificationRepository gamificationRepository,
}) async {
  final systemAgents = await _runtimeCoordinator.startSystemAgents(prefs);
  LocalLearningRecoveryPairProgressLease? recoveryPairProgress;
  ResolvedCorpusSession? corpusSession;
  IAudioRuntime? activatedAudioRuntime;

  try {
    const activeLanguagePack = GermanLanguagePack();
    final audioCatalogFuture = _runtimeCoordinator.loadGermanAudioCatalog();
    final canonicalGamification =
        await gamificationRepository.loadSnapshot();
    recoveryPairProgress = await LocalLearningRecoveryPairProgressLease.bind(
      repository: learnerRepository,
      sourceLanguageId: activeLanguagePack.sourceLocale,
      targetLanguageId: activeLanguagePack.languageCode,
      sourceIsRtl: true,
      targetIsRtl: false,
      migratedAchievementPoints:
          canonicalGamification.profile.totalXp,
    );
    final reconciler = ReviewTransactionReconciler(
      pairProgressEngine: learnerRepository.boundPairProgressEngine,
      learnerPersistence: learnerRepository.persistence,
      gamificationRepository: gamificationRepository,
    );
    await reconciler.reconcilePendingReviewTransactions(limit: 128);
    final durableState = await learnerRepository.reloadPersisted();
    await _runtimeCoordinator.seedMemoryOnce(
      runtime: systemAgents,
      state: durableState,
    );
    final resolvedCorpusSession =
        await _runtimeCoordinator.resolveActiveCorpusSession(prefs);
    corpusSession = resolvedCorpusSession;
    final indexedCorpus = resolvedCorpusSession.resolution.corpusRepository;
    if (indexedCorpus == null) {
      throw StateError('indexed_corpus_unavailable_for_v11_ui');
    }
    final quickReviewService =
        QuickReviewBindings.fromIndexedSrsCorpus(indexedCorpus);
    final explainWhyEngine = await ArDeGrammarExplainWhyCatalog.load(
      readText: rootBundle.loadString,
    );
    final explainerService = ExplainerBindings.fromIndexedSrsCorpus(
      indexedCorpus,
      explainWhyEngine: explainWhyEngine,
    );
    final uiBridge = AgentUIBridge.attach(systemAgents);
    final routeState = await learnerRepository.reloadPersisted();
    final audioRuntime = OfflineAudioRuntime(
      speechProfile: activeLanguagePack.speechProfile,
      ttsEngine: FlutterOfflineTtsEngine(),
      catalog: await audioCatalogFuture,
      recordedPlayer: AndroidRecordedAudioPlayer(),
    );
    activatedAudioRuntime = audioRuntime;

    return _ActivatedPhase3App(
      corpus: resolvedCorpusSession.initialCorpus,
      audioRuntime: audioRuntime,
      bridge: uiBridge,
      preferences: prefs,
      learnerRepository: learnerRepository,
      gamificationRepository: gamificationRepository,
      quickReviewService: quickReviewService,
      explainerService: explainerService,
      reviewSourceLanguageCode: activeLanguagePack.languageCode,
      reviewTranslationLanguageCode: activeLanguagePack.sourceLocale,
      startTaskOrder: _runtimeCoordinator.placementStartTaskOrder(routeState),
      shutdown: () async {
        await audioRuntime.shutdown();
        await resolvedCorpusSession.resolution.closeCorpus();
        await resolvedCorpusSession.resolution.grammarHubService.close();
        await recoveryPairProgress?.close();
        await learnerRepository.persistence.close();
        await gamificationRepository.close();
        await _runtimeCoordinator.shutdownActivatedRuntime(
          runtime: systemAgents,
          bridge: uiBridge,
        );
      },
    );
  } catch (_) {
    final audio = activatedAudioRuntime;
    if (audio != null) {
      try {
        await audio.shutdown();
      } on Object {
        // Preserve the original activation failure.
      }
    }
    final session = corpusSession;
    if (session != null) {
      try {
        await session.resolution.closeCorpus();
        await session.resolution.grammarHubService.close();
      } on Object {
        // Preserve the original activation failure.
      }
    }
    final pairProgress = recoveryPairProgress;
    if (pairProgress != null) {
      try {
        await pairProgress.close();
      } on Object {
        // Preserve the original activation failure.
      }
    }
    await _runtimeCoordinator.closeSystemAgents(systemAgents);
    rethrow;
  }
}

final class _RenderFirstBootstrapApp extends StatefulWidget {
  const _RenderFirstBootstrapApp();

  @override
  State<_RenderFirstBootstrapApp> createState() =>
      _RenderFirstBootstrapAppState();
}

final class _RenderFirstBootstrapAppState
    extends State<_RenderFirstBootstrapApp> {
  Widget? _resolved;
  bool _loading = false;
  Object? _bootstrapError;
  String _bootstrapStatus = 'جاري تجهيز التطبيق المحلي…';

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      _registerProjectOpenSourceLicensesSafely();
      unawaited(_bootstrap());
    });
  }

  void _updateBootstrapStatus(String status) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => _bootstrapStatus = status);
  }

  Future<void> _bootstrap() async {
    if (_loading) return;
    setState(() {
      _loading = true;
      _bootstrapError = null;
      _bootstrapStatus = 'جاري تجهيز الإعدادات المحلية…';
    });

    GamificationRepository? gamificationRepository;
    LearnerPersistence? learnerPersistence;
    LearnerStateDatabase? unownedLearnerDatabase;
    try {
      final prefs = await PreferencesService.instance();
      _updateBootstrapStatus('جاري فتح بيانات التقدم المحلية…');
      final databaseRoot = await getDatabasesPath();
      final openedGamificationRepository =
          await SqliteGamificationRepository.open(
        p.join(databaseRoot, 'gamification.sqlite'),
        clockIntegritySource:
            const AndroidGamificationClockIntegritySource(),
      );
      gamificationRepository = openedGamificationRepository;

      final openedLearnerDatabase = await LearnerStateDatabase.open();
      unownedLearnerDatabase = openedLearnerDatabase;
      final preparedLearnerPersistence = LearnerPersistence(
        prefs,
        LearnerRepository.key,
        LearnerRepository.legacyFavoriteKey,
      );
      learnerPersistence = preparedLearnerPersistence;
      final learnerMigration = LearnerStateMigration(
        database: openedLearnerDatabase,
        legacyReader: LegacyLearnerSnapshotReader(
          prefs: prefs,
          storageKey: LearnerRepository.key,
          legacyFavoriteKey: LearnerRepository.legacyFavoriteKey,
        ),
      );

      try {
        final migrationResult = await learnerMigration.migrateAndVerify();
        await preparedLearnerPersistence.bindVerifiedSqliteAuthority(
          database: openedLearnerDatabase,
          migrationRecord: migrationResult.record,
        );
        unownedLearnerDatabase = null;
      } on Object {
        final fallbackAllowed =
            await learnerMigration.canFallbackToLegacy();
        if (!fallbackAllowed) rethrow;
        await openedLearnerDatabase.close();
        unownedLearnerDatabase = null;
      }

      final learnerRepository = LearnerRepository(
        prefs,
        persistence: preparedLearnerPersistence,
        gamificationReviewSink: openedGamificationRepository,
      );
      final legacyGamificationSeed =
          preparedLearnerPersistence.loadLegacyGamificationSeed();
      final state = learnerRepository.load();
      Attempt? legacyLastReview;
      for (final attempt in state.attempts) {
        if (legacyLastReview == null ||
            attempt.at.isAfter(legacyLastReview.at)) {
          legacyLastReview = attempt;
        }
      }
      await openedGamificationRepository.migrateLegacyProfileIfPristine(
        totalXp: legacyGamificationSeed.xp,
        currentStreak: legacyGamificationSeed.streak,
        lastReviewAtUtc: legacyLastReview?.at.toUtc(),
        timezoneOffsetMinutes:
            legacyLastReview?.at.timeZoneOffset.inMinutes,
      );
      final canonicalGamification =
          await openedGamificationRepository.loadSnapshot();

      late final Widget next;
      if (_runtimeCoordinator.needsPlacementOnboarding(
        state,
        canonicalXp: canonicalGamification.profile.totalXp,
      )) {
        _updateBootstrapStatus('جاري تجهيز اختبار تحديد المستوى…');
        next = _PlacementBootstrapApp(
          prefs: prefs,
          learnerRepository: learnerRepository,
          gamificationRepository: openedGamificationRepository,
        );
      } else {
        _updateBootstrapStatus('جاري تجهيز محرك التعلم المحلي…');
        next = await _activateProduction(
          prefs: prefs,
          learnerRepository: learnerRepository,
          gamificationRepository: openedGamificationRepository,
        );
      }

      if (!mounted) {
        if (next is _ActivatedPhase3App) {
          await next.shutdown();
        } else {
          await preparedLearnerPersistence.close();
          await openedGamificationRepository.close();
        }
        return;
      }
      setState(() {
        _resolved = next;
        _loading = false;
      });
    } catch (error) {
      await learnerPersistence?.close();
      await unownedLearnerDatabase?.close();
      await gamificationRepository?.close();
      await _runtimeCoordinator.dispatchRecoveryError(
        error: error,
        context: 'render_first.bootstrap',
        fatal: false,
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _bootstrapError = error;
        _loading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final resolved = _resolved;
    if (resolved != null) return resolved;

    return MaterialApp(
      debugShowCheckedModeBanner: _productionUi.showDebugBanner,
      title: _productionUi.appName,
      theme: ThemeData(
        useMaterial3: true,
        colorSchemeSeed: Colors.indigo,
        brightness: Brightness.light,
      ),
      darkTheme: ThemeData(
        useMaterial3: true,
        colorSchemeSeed: Colors.indigo,
        brightness: Brightness.dark,
      ),
      builder: (context, child) => Directionality(
        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
        child: child ?? const SizedBox.shrink(),
      ),
      home: _bootstrapError == null
          ? _RenderFirstLoading(status: _bootstrapStatus)
          : _RenderFirstFailure(
              onRetry: () => unawaited(_bootstrap()),
            ),
    );
  }
}

final class _PlacementBootstrapApp extends StatefulWidget {
  const _PlacementBootstrapApp({
    required this.prefs,
    required this.learnerRepository,
    required this.gamificationRepository,
  });

  final PreferencesService prefs;
  final LearnerRepository learnerRepository;
  final GamificationRepository gamificationRepository;

  @override
  State<_PlacementBootstrapApp> createState() =>
      _PlacementBootstrapAppState();
}

final class _PlacementBootstrapAppState
    extends State<_PlacementBootstrapApp> {
  late final OfflineAudioRuntime _placementAudio;
  late final PlacementTestNotifier _notifier;

  _ActivatedPhase3App? _activated;
  bool _activating = false;
  bool _audioClosed = false;
  Object? _activationError;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _placementAudio = OfflineAudioRuntime(
      speechProfile: GermanSpeechProfile(),
      ttsEngine: FlutterOfflineTtsEngine(),
    );
    _notifier = PlacementTestNotifier(
      repository: LocalPlacementRepository(),
      profileRepository:
          LearnerPlacementProfileRepository(widget.learnerRepository),
      audioGateway: PlacementAudioRuntimeAdapter(_placementAudio),
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _notifier.dispose();
    unawaited(_closePlacementAudio());
    if (_activated == null) {
      unawaited(widget.learnerRepository.persistence.close());
      unawaited(widget.gamificationRepository.close());
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _closePlacementAudio() async {
    if (_audioClosed) return;
    _audioClosed = true;
    await _placementAudio.shutdown();
  }

  Future<void> _activate() async {
    if (_activating) return;
    setState(() {
      _activating = true;
      _activationError = null;
    });

    try {
      await _closePlacementAudio();
      final app = await _activateProduction(
        prefs: widget.prefs,
        learnerRepository: widget.learnerRepository,
        gamificationRepository: widget.gamificationRepository,
      );
      if (!mounted) {
        await app.shutdown();
        return;
      }
      setState(() {
        _activated = app;
        _activating = false;
      });
    } catch (error) {
      await _runtimeCoordinator.dispatchRecoveryError(
        error: error,
        context: 'placement.activate',
        fatal: false,
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _activationError = error;
        _activating = false;
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final activated = _activated;
    if (activated != null) return activated;

    return MaterialApp(
      debugShowCheckedModeBanner: _productionUi.showDebugBanner,
      title: _productionUi.appName,
      theme: ThemeData(
        useMaterial3: true,
        colorSchemeSeed: Colors.indigo,
        brightness: Brightness.light,
      ),
      darkTheme: ThemeData(
        useMaterial3: true,
        colorSchemeSeed: Colors.indigo,
        brightness: Brightness.dark,
      ),
      builder: (context, child) => Directionality(
        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
        child: child ?? const SizedBox.shrink(),
      ),
      home: _activationError != null
          ? _PlacementActivationFailure(
              onRetry: () => unawaited(_activate()),
            )
          : _activating
              ? const _PlacementActivationLoading()
              : PlacementTestScreen(
                  notifier: _notifier,
                  onStartLearning: () => unawaited(_activate()),
                ),
    );
  }
}

final class _ActivatedPhase3App extends StatefulWidget {
  const _ActivatedPhase3App({
    required this.corpus,
    required this.audioRuntime,
    required this.bridge,
    required this.preferences,
    required this.learnerRepository,
    required this.gamificationRepository,
    required this.quickReviewService,
    required this.explainerService,
    required this.reviewSourceLanguageCode,
    required this.reviewTranslationLanguageCode,
    required this.startTaskOrder,
    required this.shutdown,
  });

  final List<LearningContent> corpus;
  final IAudioRuntime audioRuntime;
  final AgentUIBridge bridge;
  final PreferencesService preferences;
  final LearnerRepository learnerRepository;
  final GamificationRepository gamificationRepository;
  final QuickReviewService quickReviewService;
  final ExplainerService explainerService;
  final String reviewSourceLanguageCode;
  final String reviewTranslationLanguageCode;
  final int startTaskOrder;
  final Future<void> Function() shutdown;

  @override
  State<_ActivatedPhase3App> createState() =>
      _ActivatedPhase3AppState();
}

final class _ActivatedPhase3AppState extends State<_ActivatedPhase3App> {
  RecoveryDirective? _dismissedRecovery;
  int _shellGeneration = 0;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    unawaited(widget.shutdown());
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _resumeFromSafeState(RecoveryDirective directive) {
    setState(() {
      _dismissedRecovery = directive;
      _shellGeneration += 1;
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => MaterialApp(
        debugShowCheckedModeBanner: _productionUi.showDebugBanner,
        title: _productionUi.appName,
        theme: ThemeData(
          useMaterial3: true,
          colorSchemeSeed: Colors.indigo,
          brightness: Brightness.light,
        ),
        darkTheme: ThemeData(
          useMaterial3: true,
          colorSchemeSeed: Colors.indigo,
          brightness: Brightness.dark,
        ),
        builder: (context, child) => Directionality(
          textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
          child: child ?? const SizedBox.shrink(),
        ),
        home: AgentUIBridgeBuilder(
          bridge: widget.bridge,
          builder: (context, uiState) {
            final candidate = uiState.recovery;
            final directive = candidate != null &&
                    candidate.mode == RecoveryMode.safeShell &&
                    !identical(candidate, _dismissedRecovery)
                ? candidate
                : null;
            if (directive != null) {
              return _RecoverySafeHome(
                directive: directive,
                onResume: () => _resumeFromSafeState(directive),
              );
            }
            return LocalLearningRecoveryRuntimeHost(
              repository: widget.learnerRepository,
              preferences: widget.preferences,
              corpus: widget.corpus,
              child: Phase3ProductionShell(
                key: ValueKey<int>(_shellGeneration),
                corpus: widget.corpus,
                audioRuntime: widget.audioRuntime,
                learnerRepository: widget.learnerRepository,
                gamificationRepository: widget.gamificationRepository,
                quickReviewService: widget.quickReviewService,
                explainerService: widget.explainerService,
                reviewSourceLanguageCode: widget.reviewSourceLanguageCode,
                reviewTranslationLanguageCode:
                    widget.reviewTranslationLanguageCode,
                startTaskOrder: widget.startTaskOrder,
              ),
            );
          },
        ),
      );
}

import 'dart:io';

import 'package:flutter/services.dart' show rootBundle;
import 'package:path/path.dart' as p;
import 'package:sqflite/sqflite.dart';

import '../core/agents/agents.dart';
import '../core/content_contract.dart';
import '../core/curriculum/canonical_curriculum_50.dart';
import '../core/curriculum/curriculum_models.dart';
import '../features/audio/data/audio_manifest_catalog.dart';
import '../language/german/german_language_pack.dart';
import '../models/content.dart';
import '../models/learner.dart';
import '../models/pack_security_runtime_config.dart';
import '../services/active_pack_runtime_provider.dart';
import '../services/grammar_hub_service.dart';
import '../services/pack_database_key_store.dart';
