import '../services/pack_manager_service.dart';
import '../services/preferences_service.dart';
import '../ui/bridge/agent_ui_bridge.dart';

final class ProductionRuntimeCoordinator {
  SystemAgentRuntime? _systemAgentRuntime;

  Future<SystemAgentRuntime> startSystemAgents(
    PreferencesService preferences,
  ) async {
    final runtime = await SystemAgentRuntime.start(
      memoryStore: _PreferencesMemoryAgentStore(preferences),
    );
    _systemAgentRuntime = runtime;
    return runtime;
  }

  Future<AudioManifestCatalog> loadGermanAudioCatalog() =>
      _loadGermanAudioCatalog();

  bool needsPlacementOnboarding(
    LearnerState state, {
    required int canonicalXp,
  }) =>
      _needsPlacementOnboarding(
        state,
        canonicalXp: canonicalXp,
      );

  int placementStartTaskOrder(LearnerState state) =>
      _placementStartTaskOrder(state);

  Future<ResolvedCorpusSession> resolveActiveCorpusSession(
    PreferencesService preferences,
  ) =>
      _resolveActiveCorpusSession(preferences);

  Future<void> seedMemoryOnce({
    required SystemAgentRuntime runtime,
    required LearnerState state,
  }) =>
      _seedMemoryOnce(runtime: runtime, state: state);

  Future<void> dispatchRecoveryError({
    required Object error,
    required String context,
    required bool fatal,
  }) async {
    final runtime = _systemAgentRuntime;
    if (runtime == null || runtime.isClosed) return;
    try {
      await runtime.reportError(
        context: context,
        errorType: error.runtimeType.toString(),
        message: error.toString(),
        fatal: fatal,
      );
    } on Object {
      return;
    }
  }

  Future<void> shutdownActivatedRuntime({
    required SystemAgentRuntime runtime,
    required AgentUIBridge bridge,
  }) async {
    await bridge.close();
    await runtime.close();
    if (identical(_systemAgentRuntime, runtime)) {
      _systemAgentRuntime = null;
    }
  }

  Future<void> closeSystemAgents(SystemAgentRuntime runtime) async {
    await runtime.close().catchError((_) {});
    if (identical(_systemAgentRuntime, runtime)) {
      _systemAgentRuntime = null;
    }
  }
}

Future<AudioManifestCatalog> _loadGermanAudioCatalog() async {
  try {
    final raw = await rootBundle.loadString(
      'content/german/audio_manifest.json',
    );
    return AudioManifestCatalog.parse(raw);
  } on Object {
    return AudioManifestCatalog.empty();
  }
}

bool _needsPlacementOnboarding(
  LearnerState state, {
  required int canonicalXp,
}) =>
    state.placementHistory.isEmpty &&
    state.attempts.isEmpty &&
    state.assessmentHistory.isEmpty &&
    state.learned.isEmpty &&
    state.reviewCards.isEmpty &&
    canonicalXp == 0;

int _placementStartTaskOrder(LearnerState state) {
  for (final record in state.placementHistory) {
    if (record.curriculumStartLevel == null) continue;
    return record.recommendedStartTaskOrder.clamp(1, 50).toInt();
  }
  return 1;
}

final class ResolvedCorpusSession {
  const ResolvedCorpusSession({
    required this.resolution,
    required this.initialCorpus,
  });

  final RuntimePackResolution resolution;
  final List<LearningContent> initialCorpus;
}

Future<ResolvedCorpusSession> _resolveActiveCorpusSession(
  PreferencesService prefs,
) async {
  const initialWindowSize = 128;

  final databaseRoot = await getDatabasesPath();
  final languagePack = const GermanLanguagePack();
  final packSecurity = PackSecurityRuntimeConfig.fromEnvironment();
  final manifestVerifier = PackManifestVerifiers.fromSingleBase64Key(
    keyId: packSecurity.manifestKeyId,
    publicKeyBase64: packSecurity.manifestPublicKeyBase64,
  );
  final packDatabaseKeyStore = AndroidKeystorePackDatabaseKeyStore();
  const packDatabaseSecurity = SqlCipherPackDatabaseSecurity();

  final packManager = PackManagerService(
    prefs,
    manifestVerifier: manifestVerifier,
    databaseKeyStore: packDatabaseKeyStore,
    databaseCipher: packDatabaseSecurity,
    rootDirectory: Directory(
      p.join(databaseRoot, 'offline_language_packs'),
    ),
  );

  final resolution = await ActivePackRuntimeProvider(
    packManager: packManager,
    languagePack: languagePack,
    embeddedGrammar: GrammarHubService(),
    databaseKeyStore: packDatabaseKeyStore,
    databaseOpener: packDatabaseSecurity,
  ).resolve();

  final repository = resolution.corpusRepository;
  if (repository == null) {
    await resolution.grammarHubService.close();
    throw StateError(
      'indexed_corpus_unavailable:'
      '${resolution.state.fallbackReason ?? 'unknown'}',
    );
  }

  final verification = repository.verification;
  if (!verification.hasExpectedCardinality) {
    await resolution.closeCorpus();
    await resolution.grammarHubService.close();
    throw StateError('indexed_corpus_cardinality_mismatch');
  }

  final page = await repository.fetchPage(
    limit: initialWindowSize,
  );
  if (page.isEmpty) {
    await resolution.closeCorpus();
    await resolution.grammarHubService.close();
    throw StateError('indexed_corpus_initial_window_empty');
  }

  final initialCorpus = page
      .map(
        (item) => ContentItem(
          id: item.id,
          german: item.german,
          arabic: item.arabic,
          sentence: item.sentence,
          sentenceAr: item.sentenceAr,
          topic: item.topic,
          skill: item.skill,
          article: item.article,
          plural: item.plural,
          accepted: item.accepted,
        ),
      )
      .cast<LearningContent>()
      .toList(growable: false);

  return ResolvedCorpusSession(
    resolution: resolution,
    initialCorpus: List<LearningContent>.unmodifiable(initialCorpus),
  );
}

Future<void> _seedMemoryOnce({
  required SystemAgentRuntime runtime,
  required LearnerState state,
}) async {
  if (runtime.memorySnapshot.tasks.isNotEmpty ||
      runtime.memorySnapshot.weaknesses.isNotEmpty ||
      state.attempts.isEmpty) {
    return;
  }

  final recentAttempts = state.attempts.length <= 300
      ? state.attempts
      : state.attempts.sublist(state.attempts.length - 300);
  final aggregates = <String, _SeedTaskAggregate>{};

  for (final attempt in recentAttempts) {
    final task = _taskForSkill(attempt.skill);
    final aggregate = aggregates.putIfAbsent(
      task.id,
      () => _SeedTaskAggregate(task),
    );
    aggregate.record(attempt);

    if (!attempt.correct) {
      runtime.recordMistake(
        taskId: task.id,
        weaknessKey: _weaknessKey(attempt),
        weight: attempt.hinted ? 2 : 1,
        occurredAtEpochMs: attempt.at.millisecondsSinceEpoch,
      );
    }
  }

  for (final aggregate in aggregates.values) {
    final score = aggregate.total == 0
        ? 0.0
        : aggregate.correct / aggregate.total;
    runtime.recordProgress(
      taskId: aggregate.task.id,
      score: score,
      completed:
          aggregate.total >= 2 && score >= aggregate.task.masteryThreshold,
      attempts: aggregate.total,
      occurredAtEpochMs: aggregate.latestEpochMs,
    );
  }

  for (final assessment in state.assessmentHistory.take(20)) {
    for (final weakSkill in assessment.weakSkills) {
      final task = _taskForSkill(weakSkill);
      runtime.recordMistake(
        taskId: task.id,
        weaknessKey: 'assessment:${weakSkill.trim().toLowerCase()}',
        weight: 2,
        occurredAtEpochMs: assessment.at.millisecondsSinceEpoch,
      );
    }
  }

  await runtime.flushMemory();
}

CurriculumTask _taskForSkill(String rawSkill) {
  final skill = rawSkill.trim().toLowerCase();

  for (final task in CanonicalCurriculum50.tasks) {
    if (task.skill.toLowerCase() == skill) return task;
  }

  if (skill.contains('listen')) {
    return CanonicalCurriculum50.tasks
        .firstWhere((task) => task.skill == 'listening');
  }
  if (skill.contains('speak') || skill.contains('production')) {
    return CanonicalCurriculum50.tasks
        .firstWhere((task) => task.skill == 'speaking');
  }
  if (skill.contains('writ')) {
    return CanonicalCurriculum50.tasks
        .firstWhere((task) => task.skill == 'writing');
  }
  if (skill.contains('gram')) {
    return CanonicalCurriculum50.tasks
        .firstWhere((task) => task.skill == 'grammar');
  }
  if (skill.contains('read')) {
    return CanonicalCurriculum50.tasks
        .firstWhere((task) => task.skill == 'reading');
  }
  if (skill.contains('vocab') || skill.contains('recall')) {
    return CanonicalCurriculum50.tasks
        .firstWhere((task) => task.skill == 'vocabulary');
  }

  return CanonicalCurriculum50.tasks[47];
}

String _weaknessKey(Attempt attempt) {
  final skill = attempt.skill.trim().toLowerCase();
  final item = attempt.itemId.trim().toLowerCase();
  final facet = attempt.facetType.name;
  final raw = '$skill:$item:$facet';
  return raw.length <= 160 ? raw : raw.substring(0, 160);
}

final class _PreferencesMemoryAgentStore implements MemoryAgentStore {
  const _PreferencesMemoryAgentStore(this.preferences);

  final PreferencesService preferences;

  @override
  Future<String?> read() async =>
      preferences.readSystemMemoryAgentState();

  @override
  Future<void> write(String encoded) async {
    final written =
        await preferences.writeSystemMemoryAgentState(encoded);
    if (!written) {
      throw StateError('Memory agent storage write failed.');
    }
  }
}

final class _SeedTaskAggregate {
  _SeedTaskAggregate(this.task);

  final CurriculumTask task;
  int total = 0;
  int correct = 0;
  int latestEpochMs = 0;

  void record(Attempt attempt) {
    total += 1;
    if (attempt.correct) correct += 1;
    final occurredAt = attempt.at.millisecondsSinceEpoch;
    if (occurredAt > latestEpochMs) {
      latestEpochMs = occurredAt;
    }
  }
}

class LanguageRecord {

  final String nativeName;
  final String englishName;

    required this.code,
    required this.nativeName,
    required this.englishName,
  });

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
    'code': code,
    'nativeName': nativeName,
    'englishName': englishName,
  };

  factory LanguageRecord.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) => LanguageRecord(
    code: json['code'] ?? '',
    nativeName: json['nativeName'] ?? '',
    englishName: json['englishName'] ?? '',
  );
}

class LanguageRegistry {
  static const List<LanguageRecord> supportedLanguages = [
    LanguageRecord(code: 'de', nativeName: 'Deutsch', englishName: 'German'),
    LanguageRecord(code: 'ar', nativeName: 'العربية', englishName: 'Arabic'),
    LanguageRecord(code: 'en', nativeName: 'English', englishName: 'English'),
  ];

  static List<LanguageRecord> getSupportedLanguages() {
    return supportedLanguages;
  }

  static bool isSupported(String code) {
    return supportedLanguages.any((lang) => lang.code == code);
  }
}

import 'hundred_languages_registry.dart';

class GrammarRuleModel {
  const GrammarRuleModel({
    required this.ruleName,
    required this.description,
    required this.examples,
  });

  final String ruleName;
  final String description;
  final List<String> examples;

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
        'ruleName': ruleName,
        'description': description,
        'examples': examples,
      };
}

class AdvancedGrammarEngine {
  static List<GrammarRuleModel> getRulesForLanguage(String languageCode) {
    final language = HundredLanguagesRegistry.getLanguage(languageCode);

    if (language.hasGenderCases) {
      return [
        const GrammarRuleModel(
          ruleName: 'Gender and Cases',
          description: 'This language incorporates grammatical gender and case declensions.',
          examples: ['Nominative', 'Accusative', 'Dative'],
        ),
      ];
    } else {
      return [
        const GrammarRuleModel(
          ruleName: 'Standard Structure',
          description: 'Direct structural flow without complex noun case declensions.',
          examples: ['Subject-Verb-Object'],
        ),
      ];
    }
  }
}

class LanguageProvider {
  String _currentLanguageCode = 'de';

  String get currentLanguageCode => _currentLanguageCode;

  LanguageDefinition get currentLanguage =>
      HundredLanguagesRegistry.getLanguage(_currentLanguageCode);

  Future<void> changeLanguage(String code) async {
    if (LanguagePackLoader.isLanguageSupported(code)) {
      _currentLanguageCode = code;
      await LanguagePackLoader.loadPack(code);
    } else {
      throw Exception('Unsupported language code: $code');
    }
  }

  List<LanguageDefinition> getAvailableLanguages() {
    return HundredLanguagesRegistry.supportedLanguages;
  }
}

import 'hundred_languages_registry.dart';
import 'pack_compiler.dart';

class LanguagePackLoader {
  static Future<Map<String, dynamic>> loadPack(String languageCode) async {
    // محاكاة جلب الحزمة المعمارية للغة المطلوبة محلياً أو من الذاكرة المؤقتة
    final language = HundredLanguagesRegistry.getLanguage(languageCode);

    if (language.code.isEmpty) {
      throw Exception('Language pack not found for code: $languageCode');
    }

    return PackCompiler.compileLanguagePack(languageCode);
  }

  static bool isLanguageSupported(String languageCode) {
    return HundredLanguagesRegistry.supportedLanguages
        .any((lang) => lang.code == languageCode);
  }
}


--------------------------------------------------
FILE: lib/content/contract/advanced_verb_conjugator.dart
--------------------------------------------------
import 'language_intelligence_contract.dart';

class AdvancedVerbConjugator {
  static List<VerbConjugationRule> getConjugationsForLanguage(String languageCode) {
    return LanguageIntelligenceContract.getStandardConjugations(languageCode);
  }

  static String conjugate(String verb, String tense, String pronoun, String languageCode) {
    final rules = getConjugationsForLanguage(languageCode);
    final rule = rules.firstWhere(
      (r) => r.tense == tense,
      orElse: () => const VerbConjugationRule(tense: '', pronounSuffixes: {}),
    );

    final suffix = rule.pronounSuffixes[pronoun] ?? '';
    return '$verb$suffix';
  }
}

// Language Pack Manager - Post-V1 Expansion
// Coordinates pack lifecycle, installation state, and runtime availability

import 'content_contracts.dart';

class LanguagePackManager {
  final Map<String, PackLoader> _loaders = {};

  void registerPack(String packId) {
    if (!_loaders.containsKey(packId)) {
      _loaders[packId] = PackLoader(packId: packId);
    }
  }

  Future<bool> activatePack(String packId) async {
    final loader = _loaders[packId];
    if (loader == null) return false;
    return await loader.installPack();
  }

  bool isPackActive(String packId) {
    return _loaders[packId]?.isInstalled ?? false;
  }
}

    this.hasComplexVerbConjugation = true,

  final bool hasComplexVerbConjugation;

        'code': code,
        'name': name,
        'nativeName': nativeName,
        'family': family,
        'hasGenderCases': hasGenderCases,
        'hasComplexVerbConjugation': hasComplexVerbConjugation,
      };

class HundredLanguagesRegistry {
  static final List<LanguageDefinition> supportedLanguages = [
    const LanguageDefinition(
      code: 'de',
      name: 'German',
      nativeName: 'Deutsch',
      family: 'Germanic',
      hasGenderCases: true,
    ),
    const LanguageDefinition(
      code: 'ar',
      name: 'Arabic',
      nativeName: 'العربية',
      family: 'Semitic',
      hasGenderCases: true,
    ),
    const LanguageDefinition(

      nativeName: 'English',
      family: 'Germanic',
      hasGenderCases: false,
    ),
    const LanguageDefinition(

      family: 'Romance',
      hasGenderCases: true,
    ),
    const LanguageDefinition(
      code: 'es',
      name: 'Spanish',
      nativeName: 'Español',
      family: 'Romance',
      hasGenderCases: true,
    ),
  ];

  static LanguageDefinition getLanguage(String code) {
    return supportedLanguages.firstWhere(
      (lang) => lang.code == code,
      orElse: () => supportedLanguages.first,
    );
  }
}

class VerbConjugationRule {
  const VerbConjugationRule({
    required this.tense,
    required this.pronounSuffixes,
  });

  final String tense;
  final Map<String, String> pronounSuffixes;

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
        'tense': tense,
        'pronounSuffixes': pronounSuffixes,
      };
}

class LanguageIntelligenceContract {
  static List<VerbConjugationRule> getStandardConjugations(String languageCode) {
    switch (languageCode) {
      case 'de':
        return [
          const VerbConjugationRule(
            tense: 'Present',
            pronounSuffixes: {'ich': '-e', 'du': '-st', 'er/sie/es': '-t'},
          ),
        ];
      case 'ar':
        return [
          const VerbConjugationRule(
            tense: 'Past',
            pronounSuffixes: {'هو': 'َ', 'هي': 'َت', 'أنا': 'ْتُ'},
          ),
        ];
      default:
        return [];
    }
  }
}

import 'hundred_languages_registry.dart';
import 'language_intelligence_contract.dart';

class PackCompiler {
  static Map<String, dynamic> compileLanguagePack(String languageCode) {
    final language = HundredLanguagesRegistry.getLanguage(languageCode);
    final conjugations = LanguageIntelligenceContract.getStandardConjugations(languageCode);

    return {
      'metadata': language.toJson(),
      'conjugations': conjugations.map((rule) => rule.toJson()).toList(),
      'compiledAt': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
    };
  }
}

  }

class ContentDashboardScreen extends StatefulWidget {

  const ContentDashboardScreen({super.key, required this.activeLanguageCode});

  @override
  State<ContentDashboardScreen> createState() => _ContentDashboardScreenState();
}

class _ContentDashboardScreenState extends State<ContentDashboardScreen> {
  late final ExpandedDictionaryDatabase _db;
  final TextEditingController _searchController = TextEditingController();
  bool _searchResult = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _db = ExpandedDictionaryDatabase(languageCode: widget.activeLanguageCode);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: Text('Content Hub (${widget.activeLanguageCode})')),
      body: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
        child: Column(
          children: [
            TextField(
              controller: _searchController,
              decoration: const InputDecoration(
                labelText: 'Search Dictionary Term',
                border: OutlineInputBorder(),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: () {
                setState(() {
                  _searchResult = _db.queryIndex(_searchController.text);
                });
              },
              child: const Text('Query Index'),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 20),
            Text(
              _searchResult ? 'Term Found in Registry!' : 'No Result / Enter Term',
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 16,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                color: _searchResult ? Colors.green : Colors.grey,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _LanguagesScreenState extends State<LanguagesScreen> {
  final MultilingualService _service = MultilingualService();

  final List<Map<String, String>> _languages = [
    {'code': 'de', 'name': 'Deutsch', 'sub': 'الألمانية'},
    {'code': 'en', 'name': 'English', 'sub': 'الإنجليزية'},
    {'code': 'fr', 'name': 'Français', 'sub': 'الفرنسية'},

    {'code': 'nl', 'name': 'Nederlands', 'sub': 'الهولندية'},
    {'code': 'pt', 'name': 'Português', 'sub': 'البرتغالية'},
    {'code': 'sv', 'name': 'Svenska', 'sub': 'السويدية'},
    {'code': 'pl', 'name': 'Polski', 'sub': 'البولندية'},
    {'code': 'da', 'name': 'Dansk', 'sub': 'الدانماركية'},
    {'code': 'fi', 'name': 'Suomi', 'sub': 'الفنلندية'},
    {'code': 'el', 'name': 'Ελληνικά', 'sub': 'اليونانية'},
    {'code': 'ja', 'name': '日本語', 'sub': 'اليابانية'},
    {'code': 'ko', 'name': '한국어', 'sub': 'الكورية'},
    {'code': 'zh', 'name': '中文', 'sub': 'الصينية'},
    {'code': 'hi', 'name': 'हिन्दी', 'sub': 'الهندية'},
    {'code': 'fa', 'name': 'فارسی', 'sub': 'الفارسية'},
    {'code': 'ar', 'name': 'العربية', 'sub': 'العربية'},
  ];

  String _currentLangCode = 'de';
  String _currentLangName = 'Deutsch (الألمانية)';
  Map<String, dynamic>? _currentData;
  bool _isLoading = false;
  int _navIndex = 0;

  int _streak = 14;
  int _points = 1450;
  int _accuracy = 98;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadUserProgressAndLanguage();
  }

  void _loadUserProgressAndLanguage() async {
    final stats = await ProgressStorageService.getUserStats();
    final savedCode = stats['langCode'] as String;
    final match = _languages.firstWhere(
      (l) => l['code'] == savedCode,
      orElse: () => _languages[0],
    );

    setState(() {
      _streak = stats['streak'] as int;
      _points = stats['points'] as int;
      _accuracy = stats['accuracy'] as int;
    });

    _loadData(match['code']!, '${match['name']} (${match['sub']})');
  }

  void _loadData(String code, String name) async {
    setState(() => _isLoading = true);
    await ProgressStorageService.saveSelectedLanguage(code);
    final data = await _service.loadLanguagePack(code);
    setState(() {
      _currentData = data;
      _currentLangCode = code;
      _currentLangName = name;
      _isLoading = false;
    });
  }

  void _openVocabularyScreen() {
    final items = (_currentData?['contentItems'] as List?) ?? [];
    Navigator.push(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (context) => VocabularyDetailScreen(
          languageCode: _currentLangCode,
          languageName: _currentLangName,
          items: items,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _openVerbsScreen() {
    final verbs = (_currentData?['verbConjugations'] as List?) ?? [];
    Navigator.push(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (context) => VerbsScreen(
          languageName: _currentLangName,
          languageCode: _currentLangCode,
          verbs: verbs,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _openGrammarScreen() {
    final rules = (_currentData?['grammarRules'] as List?) ?? [];
    Navigator.push(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (context) => GrammarScreen(
          languageName: _currentLangName,
          rules: rules,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _onBottomNavTapped(int index) {
    if (index == 1) {
      _openLessonsScreen();
    } else if (index == 2) {
      _openConversationScreen();
    } else if (index == 3) {
      Navigator.push(
        context,
        MaterialPageRoute(builder: (context) => const AnalyticsScreen()),
      );
    } else {
      setState(() => _navIndex = index);
    }
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _getArticlesForLang(String code) {
    switch (code) {
      case 'de':
        return [
          {'article': 'der', 'label': 'Masculine / مذكر', 'color': const Color(0xFF2563EB)},
          {'article': 'die', 'label': 'Feminine / مؤنث', 'color': const Color(0xFFEC4899)},
          {'article': 'das', 'label': 'Neutral / محايد', 'color': const Color(0xFF10B981)},
        ];
      case 'en':
        return [
          {'article': 'the', 'label': 'Definite / معرفة', 'color': const Color(0xFF2563EB)},
          {'article': 'a', 'label': 'Indefinite / نكرة', 'color': const Color(0xFF10B981)},
          {'article': 'an', 'label': 'Vowel / علة', 'color': const Color(0xFFF59E0B)},
        ];
      case 'fr':
        return [
          {'article': 'le', 'label': 'Masculin / مذكر', 'color': const Color(0xFF2563EB)},
          {'article': 'la', 'label': 'Féminin / مؤنث', 'color': const Color(0xFFEC4899)},
          {'article': 'les', 'label': 'Pluriel / جمع', 'color': const Color(0xFF8B5CF6)},
        ];
      case 'es':
        return [
          {'article': 'el', 'label': 'Masculino / مذكر', 'color': const Color(0xFF2563EB)},
          {'article': 'la', 'label': 'Femenino / مؤنث', 'color': const Color(0xFFEC4899)},
          {'article': 'los', 'label': 'Plural / جمع', 'color': const Color(0xFF10B981)},
        ];
      case 'it':
        return [
          {'article': 'il / lo', 'label': 'Maschile / مذكر', 'color': const Color(0xFF2563EB)},
          {'article': 'la', 'label': 'Femminile / مؤنث', 'color': const Color(0xFFEC4899)},
          {'article': 'i / gli', 'label': 'Plurale / جمع', 'color': const Color(0xFF10B981)},
        ];
      case 'tr':
        return [
          {'article': '-i', 'label': 'Belirtme / مفعول', 'color': const Color(0xFF2563EB)},
          {'article': '-e', 'label': 'Yönelme / إلى', 'color': const Color(0xFF10B981)},
          {'article': '-de', 'label': 'Bulunma / في', 'color': const Color(0xFFF59E0B)},
        ];
      default:
        return [
          {'article': 'Definite', 'label': 'أداة تعريف', 'color': const Color(0xFF2563EB)},
          {'article': 'Indefinite', 'label': 'أداة نكرة', 'color': const Color(0xFF10B981)},
        ];
    }
  }

import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../services/tts_service.dart';
import '../services/progress_storage_service.dart';
import 'favorites_screen.dart';

class VocabularyDetailScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final String languageCode;
  final String languageName;
  final List<dynamic> items;

  const VocabularyDetailScreen({
    Key? key,
    required this.languageCode,
    required this.languageName,
    required this.items,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<VocabularyDetailScreen> createState() => _VocabularyDetailScreenState();
}

class _VocabularyDetailScreenState extends State<VocabularyDetailScreen> {
  final TtsService _tts = TtsService();
  String _selectedLevel = 'ALL';
  String _searchQuery = '';
  Set<String> _favTerms = {};

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadFavs();
  }

  void _loadFavs() async {
    final list = await ProgressStorageService.getFavorites();
    final terms = <String>{};
    for (var s in list) {
      try {
        final decoded = json.decode(s);
        if (decoded['term'] != null) terms.add(decoded['term'].toString());
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    setState(() => _favTerms = terms);
  }

  void _toggleFav(Map<String, dynamic> item) async {
    final payload = {
      'term': item['term'] ?? item['word'] ?? '',
      'meaning': item['translation'] ?? item['meaning'] ?? '',
      'lang': widget.languageCode,
    };
    final isAdded = await ProgressStorageService.toggleFavorite(json.encode(payload));
    setState(() {
      final t = payload['term'].toString();
      if (isAdded) {
        _favTerms.add(t);
      } else {
        _favTerms.remove(t);
      }
    });
    if (mounted) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text(isAdded ? 'تمت إضافة الكلمة إلى المفضلة 🔖' : 'تمت الإزالة من المفضلة'),
          duration: const Duration(seconds: 1),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final filteredItems = widget.items.where((it) {
      final lvl = it['cefr_level'] ?? 'A1';
      final matchesLevel = _selectedLevel == 'ALL' || lvl == _selectedLevel;
      final term = (it['term'] ?? it['word'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
      final trans = (it['translation'] ?? it['meaning'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
      final q = _searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      final matchesSearch = _searchQuery.isEmpty || term.contains(q) || trans.contains(q);
      return matchesLevel && matchesSearch;
    }).toList();

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF8FAFC),
      appBar: AppBar(
        elevation: 0,
        backgroundColor: Colors.white,
        iconTheme: const IconThemeData(color: Color(0xFF0F172A)),
        title: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text('Vocabulary / مفردات ${widget.languageName}', style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF0F172A), fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
            Text('${filteredItems.length} كلمة متاحة', style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF64748B), fontSize: 11)),
          ],
        ),
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.bookmarks_rounded, color: Color(0xFF2563EB)),
            onPressed: () async {
              await Navigator.push(
                context,
                MaterialPageRoute(builder: (context) => const FavoritesScreen()),
              );
              _loadFavs();
            },
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: Column(
        children: [
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
            child: TextField(
              onChanged: (val) => setState(() => _searchQuery = val),
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                hintText: 'ابحث عن أي كلمة أو معنى...',
                prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search_rounded, color: Color(0xFF64748B)),
                filled: true,
                fillColor: Colors.white,
                contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 0, horizontal: 16),
                border: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16), borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFE2E8F0))),
                enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16), borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFE2E8F0))),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          SizedBox(
            height: 40,
            child: ListView(
              scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
              children: ['ALL', 'A1', 'A2', 'B1', 'B2'].map((lvl) {
                final isSel = _selectedLevel == lvl;
                return Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 8.0),
                  child: FilterChip(
                    label: Text(lvl == 'ALL' ? 'الكل' : lvl),
                    selected: isSel,
                    onSelected: (_) => setState(() => _selectedLevel = lvl),
                    selectedColor: const Color(0xFF2563EB),
                    labelStyle: TextStyle(color: isSel ? Colors.white : const Color(0xFF475569), fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 12),
                    backgroundColor: Colors.white,
                    shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20), side: BorderSide(color: isSel ? const Color(0xFF2563EB) : const Color(0xFFCBD5E1))),
                  ),
                );
              }).toList(),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Expanded(
            child: filteredItems.isEmpty
                ? const Center(child: Text('لا توجد كلمات مطابقة', style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF64748B))))
                : ListView.builder(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 8),
                    itemCount: filteredItems.length > 200 ? 200 : filteredItems.length,
                    itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                      final item = filteredItems[index];
                      final term = (item['term'] ?? item['word'] ?? '').toString();
                      final translation = (item['translation'] ?? item['meaning'] ?? '').toString();
                      final example = (item['example'] ?? '').toString();
                      final level = (item['cefr_level'] ?? 'A1').toString();
                      final isFav = _favTerms.contains(term);

                      return Container(
                        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: Colors.white,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                          border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFE2E8F0)),
                          boxShadow: const [
                            BoxShadow(color: Color(0x04000000), blurRadius: 8, offset: Offset(0, 4)),
                          ],
                        ),
                        child: Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            Row(
                              children: [
                                Container(
                                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
                                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                    color: const Color(0xFFEFF6FF),
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                                  ),
                                  child: Text(level, style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF2563EB), fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 11)),
                                ),
                                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                                Expanded(
                                  child: Text(term, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Color(0xFF0F172A))),
                                ),
                                IconButton(
                                  icon: const Icon(Icons.volume_up_rounded, color: Color(0xFF2563EB)),
                                  onPressed: () => _tts.speak(term, langCode: widget.languageCode),
                                ),
                                IconButton(
                                  icon: Icon(isFav ? Icons.bookmark_rounded : Icons.bookmark_border_rounded, color: isFav ? const Color(0xFF2563EB) : const Color(0xFF64748B)),
                                  onPressed: () => _toggleFav(Map<String, dynamic>.from(item)),
                                ),
                              ],
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(height: 6),
                            Text(translation, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: Color(0xFF334155), fontWeight: FontWeight.w500)),
                            if (example.isNotEmpty) ...[
                              const SizedBox(height: 8),
                              Container(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  color: const Color(0xFFF8FAFC),
                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                                ),
                                child: Row(
                                  children: [
                                    Expanded(
                                      child: Text(example, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Color(0xFF64748B), fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
                                    ),
                                    IconButton(
                                      constraints: const BoxConstraints(),
                                      padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                                      icon: const Icon(Icons.volume_down_rounded, size: 18, color: Color(0xFF64748B)),
                                      onPressed: () => _tts.speak(example, langCode: widget.languageCode),
                                    ),
                                  ],
                                ),
                              ),
                            ]
                          ],
                        ),
                      );
                    },
                  ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../services/progress_storage_service.dart';

class ArticlesQuizScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ArticlesQuizScreen({Key? key}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<ArticlesQuizScreen> createState() => _ArticlesQuizScreenState();
}

class _ArticlesQuizScreenState extends State<ArticlesQuizScreen> {
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> _questions = const [
    {'word': 'Tisch', 'meaning': 'طاولة', 'correct': 'der'},
    {'word': 'Sonne', 'meaning': 'شمس', 'correct': 'die'},
    {'word': 'Buch', 'meaning': 'كتاب', 'correct': 'das'},
    {'word': 'Stuhl', 'meaning': 'كرسي', 'correct': 'der'},
    {'word': 'Lampe', 'meaning': 'مصباح', 'correct': 'die'},
    {'word': 'Auto', 'meaning': 'سيارة', 'correct': 'das'},
    {'word': 'Apfel', 'meaning': 'تفاحة', 'correct': 'der'},
    {'word': 'Katze', 'meaning': 'قطة', 'correct': 'die'},
    {'word': 'Haus', 'meaning': 'منزل', 'correct': 'das'},
  ];

  int _currentIndex = 0;
  int _score = 0;
  String? _selectedAnswer;
  bool _answered = false;

  void _submitAnswer(String article) async {
    if (_answered) return;
    final isCorrect = article == _questions[_currentIndex]['correct'];
    setState(() {
      _selectedAnswer = article;
      _answered = true;
      if (isCorrect) {
        _score += 10;
      }
    });

    if (isCorrect) {
      await ProgressStorageService.addPoints(10);
    }

    Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 1200), () {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          if (_currentIndex < _questions.length - 1) {
            _currentIndex++;
            _selectedAnswer = null;
            _answered = false;
          } else {
            _showFinishDialog();
          }
        });
      }
    });
  }

  void _showFinishDialog() {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: false,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
        title: const Text('أحسنت! إنجاز رائع 🏆', textAlign: TextAlign.center, style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
        content: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            Text('لقد جمعت $_score نقطة جديدة تمت إضافتها إلى رصيدك الإجمالي!', textAlign: TextAlign.center, style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF475569))),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            const Icon(Icons.stars_rounded, color: Colors.amber, size: 48),
          ],
        ),
        actions: [
          Center(
            child: ElevatedButton(
              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF2563EB),
                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16)),
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24, vertical: 12),
              ),
              onPressed: () {
                Navigator.pop(ctx);
                Navigator.pop(context);
              },
              child: const Text('العودة للرئيسية', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
            ),
          )
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final q = _questions[_currentIndex];

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF8FAFC),
      appBar: AppBar(
        elevation: 0,
        backgroundColor: Colors.white,
        iconTheme: const IconThemeData(color: Color(0xFF0F172A)),
        title: const Text('Articles Challenge / تحدي الأدوات', style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF0F172A), fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
        actions: [
          Container(
            margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 4),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: const Color(0xFFEFF6FF),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            ),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                const Icon(Icons.star_rounded, color: Colors.amber, size: 18),
                const SizedBox(width: 4),
                Text('+$_score Pts', style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF2563EB), fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 13)),
              ],
            ),
          )
        ],
      ),
      body: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20.0),
        child: Column(
          children: [
            ClipRRect(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
              child: LinearProgressIndicator(
                value: (_currentIndex + 1) / _questions.length,
                minHeight: 8,
                backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFE2E8F0),
                valueColor: const AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(Color(0xFF2563EB)),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Align(
              alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
              child: Text('السؤال ${_currentIndex + 1} من ${_questions.length}', style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF64748B), fontSize: 12)),
            ),
            const Spacer(),
            Container(
              width: double.infinity,
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 40, horizontal: 20),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.white,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(28),
                border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFE2E8F0)),
                boxShadow: const [
                  BoxShadow(color: Color(0x06000000), blurRadius: 16, offset: Offset(0, 8)),
                ],
              ),
              child: Column(
                children: [
                  const Text('اختر أداة التعريف المناسبة:', style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF64748B), fontSize: 14)),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  Text(
                    q['word'],
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 34, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Color(0xFF0F172A), letterSpacing: 1.2),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  Text(
                    q['meaning'],
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16, color: Color(0xFF334155), fontWeight: FontWeight.w500),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const Spacer(),
            Row(
              children: [
                _buildArticleButton('der', const Color(0xFF2563EB), q['correct']),
                const SizedBox(width: 12),
                _buildArticleButton('die', const Color(0xFFEC4899), q['correct']),
                const SizedBox(width: 12),
                _buildArticleButton('das', const Color(0xFF10B981), q['correct']),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 20),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildArticleButton(String article, Color defaultColor, String correct) {
    Color bg = Colors.white;
    Color border = defaultColor.withValues(alpha: 0.3);
    Color textCol = defaultColor;

    if (_answered) {
      if (article == correct) {
        bg = const Color(0xFF10B981);
        border = const Color(0xFF10B981);
        textCol = Colors.white;
      } else if (article == _selectedAnswer) {
        bg = const Color(0xFFEF4444);
        border = const Color(0xFFEF4444);
        textCol = Colors.white;
      }
    }

    return Expanded(
      child: GestureDetector(
        onTap: () => _submitAnswer(article),
        child: AnimatedContainer(
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 18),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: bg,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
            border: Border.all(color: border, width: 2),
            boxShadow: [
              BoxShadow(color: defaultColor.withValues(alpha: 0.08), blurRadius: 10, offset: const Offset(0, 4)),
            ],
          ),
          child: Center(
            child: Text(
              article,
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 22, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: textCol),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../services/tts_service.dart';
import '../services/progress_storage_service.dart';
import 'favorites_screen.dart';

class VerbsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final String languageName;
  final String languageCode;
  final List<dynamic> verbs;

  const VerbsScreen({
    Key? key,
    required this.languageName,
    this.languageCode = 'de',
    required this.verbs,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<VerbsScreen> createState() => _VerbsScreenState();
}

class _VerbsScreenState extends State<VerbsScreen> {
  final TtsService _tts = TtsService();
  String _selectedLevel = 'ALL';
  String _searchQuery = '';
  Set<String> _favVerbs = {};

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadFavorites();
  }

  void _loadFavorites() async {
    final list = await ProgressStorageService.getFavorites();
    final verbsSet = <String>{};
    for (var s in list) {
      try {
        final decoded = json.decode(s);
        if (decoded['term'] != null) verbsSet.add(decoded['term'].toString());
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    setState(() => _favVerbs = verbsSet);
  }

  void _toggleFav(Map<String, dynamic> v) async {
    final infinitive = (v['infinitive'] ?? v['verb'] ?? v['term'] ?? '').toString();
    final meaning = (v['meaning'] ?? v['translation'] ?? '').toString();
    final payload = {
      'term': infinitive,
      'meaning': meaning,
      'type': 'verb',
      'lang': widget.languageCode,
    };

    final isAdded = await ProgressStorageService.toggleFavorite(json.encode(payload));
    setState(() {
      if (isAdded) {
        _favVerbs.add(infinitive);
      } else {
        _favVerbs.remove(infinitive);
      }
    });

    if (mounted) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text(isAdded ? 'تمت إضافة الفعل إلى المفضلة 🔖' : 'تمت الإزالة من المفضلة'),
          duration: const Duration(seconds: 1),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final filteredVerbs = widget.verbs.where((v) {
      final lvl = v['cefr_level'] ?? 'A1';
      final matchesLevel = _selectedLevel == 'ALL' || lvl == _selectedLevel;
      final infinitive = (v['infinitive'] ?? v['verb'] ?? v['term'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
      final meaning = (v['meaning'] ?? v['translation'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
      final q = _searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      final matchesSearch = _searchQuery.isEmpty || infinitive.contains(q) || meaning.contains(q);
      return matchesLevel && matchesSearch;
    }).toList();

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF8FAFC),
      appBar: AppBar(
        elevation: 0,
        backgroundColor: Colors.white,
        iconTheme: const IconThemeData(color: Color(0xFF0F172A)),
        title: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text('Verbs / أفعال ${widget.languageName}', style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF0F172A), fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
            Text('${filteredVerbs.length} أفعال وتصريفات', style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF64748B), fontSize: 11)),
          ],
        ),
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.bookmarks_rounded, color: Color(0xFF10B981)),
            onPressed: () async {
              await Navigator.push(
                context,
                MaterialPageRoute(builder: (context) => const FavoritesScreen()),
              );
              _loadFavorites();
            },
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: Column(
        children: [
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
            child: TextField(
              onChanged: (val) => setState(() => _searchQuery = val),
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                hintText: 'ابحث عن أي فعل أو تصريف...',
                prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search_rounded, color: Color(0xFF64748B)),
                filled: true,
                fillColor: Colors.white,
                contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 0, horizontal: 16),
                border: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16), borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFE2E8F0))),
                enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16), borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFE2E8F0))),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          SizedBox(
            height: 40,
            child: ListView(
              scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
              children: ['ALL', 'A1', 'A2', 'B1', 'B2'].map((lvl) {
                final isSel = _selectedLevel == lvl;
                return Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 8.0),
                  child: FilterChip(
                    label: Text(lvl == 'ALL' ? 'الكل' : lvl),
                    selected: isSel,
                    onSelected: (_) => setState(() => _selectedLevel = lvl),
                    selectedColor: const Color(0xFF10B981),
                    labelStyle: TextStyle(color: isSel ? Colors.white : const Color(0xFF475569), fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 12),
                    backgroundColor: Colors.white,
                    shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20), side: BorderSide(color: isSel ? const Color(0xFF10B981) : const Color(0xFFCBD5E1))),
                  ),
                );
              }).toList(),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Expanded(
            child: filteredVerbs.isEmpty
                ? const Center(child: Text('لا توجد أفعال مطابقة للبحث', style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF64748B))))
                : ListView.builder(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 8),
                    itemCount: filteredVerbs.length > 150 ? 150 : filteredVerbs.length,
                    itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                      final v = filteredVerbs[index];
                      final infinitive = (v['infinitive'] ?? v['verb'] ?? v['term'] ?? '').toString();
                      final meaning = (v['meaning'] ?? v['translation'] ?? '').toString();
                      final level = (v['cefr_level'] ?? 'A1').toString();
                      final isFav = _favVerbs.contains(infinitive);

                      return Container(
                        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: Colors.white,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                          border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFE2E8F0)),
                          boxShadow: const [
                            BoxShadow(color: Color(0x04000000), blurRadius: 8, offset: Offset(0, 4)),
                          ],
                        ),
                        child: Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            Row(
                              children: [
                                Container(
                                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
                                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                    color: const Color(0xFFECFDF5),
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                                  ),
                                  child: Text(level, style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF10B981), fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 11)),
                                ),
                                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                                Expanded(
                                  child: Text(infinitive, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Color(0xFF0F172A))),
                                ),
                                IconButton(
                                  icon: const Icon(Icons.volume_up_rounded, color: Color(0xFF10B981)),
                                  onPressed: () => _tts.speak(infinitive, langCode: widget.languageCode),
                                ),
                                IconButton(
                                  icon: Icon(isFav ? Icons.bookmark_rounded : Icons.bookmark_border_rounded, color: isFav ? const Color(0xFF10B981) : const Color(0xFF64748B)),
                                  onPressed: () => _toggleFav(Map<String, dynamic>.from(v)),
                                ),
                              ],
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(height: 4),
                            Text(meaning, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: Color(0xFF334155), fontWeight: FontWeight.w500)),
                            if (v['present'] != null || v['past'] != null) ...[
                              const SizedBox(height: 10),
                              Container(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  color: const Color(0xFFF8FAFC),
                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                                ),
                                child: Row(
                                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceAround,
                                  children: [
                                    if (v['present'] != null)
                                      Text('المضارع: ${v['present']}', style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Color(0xFF475569))),
                                    if (v['past'] != null)
                                      Text('الماضي: ${v['past']}', style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Color(0xFF475569))),
                                  ],
                                ),
                              ),
                            ]
                          ],
                        ),
                      );
                    },
                  ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../services/progress_storage_service.dart';

class AnalyticsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const AnalyticsScreen({Key? key}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<AnalyticsScreen> createState() => _AnalyticsScreenState();
}

class _AnalyticsScreenState extends State<AnalyticsScreen> {
  int _streak = 14;
  int _points = 1450;
  int _accuracy = 98;
  bool _loading = true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _fetchStats();
  }

  void _fetchStats() async {
    final stats = await ProgressStorageService.getUserStats();
    setState(() {
      _streak = stats['streak'] as int;
      _points = stats['points'] as int;
      _accuracy = stats['accuracy'] as int;
      _loading = false;
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF8FAFC),
      appBar: AppBar(
        elevation: 0,
        backgroundColor: Colors.white,
        iconTheme: const IconThemeData(color: Color(0xFF0F172A)),
        title: const Text('Analytics & Progress / لوحة التحليلات', style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF0F172A), fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
      ),
      body: _loading
          ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
          : ListView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              children: [
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    gradient: const LinearGradient(
                      colors: [Color(0xFF0F172A), Color(0xFF1E293B)],
                      begin: Alignment.topRight,
                      end: Alignment.bottomLeft,
                    ),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
                    boxShadow: const [

                    color: Colors.white,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),

                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildHeaderMetric(String value, String label, IconData icon, Color iconColor) {
    return Column(
      children: [
        Icon(icon, color: iconColor, size: 20),
        const SizedBox(height: 4),
        Text(value, style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 14)),
        Text(label, style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white60, fontSize: 10)),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildDayBar(String day, double heightFactor, bool isDone) {
    return Column(
      children: [
        Container(
          width: 22,
          height: 100 * (heightFactor > 0 ? heightFactor : 0.08),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: isDone ? const Color(0xFF2563EB) : const Color(0xFFE2E8F0),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        Text(day.substring(0, 2), style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Color(0xFF64748B), fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSkillProgress(String skill, double progress, Color color) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Row(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
          children: [
            Text(skill, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, color: Color(0xFF334155))),
            Text('${(progress * 100).toInt()}%', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: color)),
          ],
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 6),
        ClipRRect(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
          child: LinearProgressIndicator(
            value: progress,
            minHeight: 6,
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF1F5F9),
            valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(color),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'lesson_session_screen.dart';

class LessonsPathScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final String languageName;

  const LessonsPathScreen({Key? key, required this.languageName}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<LessonsPathScreen> createState() => _LessonsPathScreenState();
}

class _LessonsPathScreenState extends State<LessonsPathScreen> {
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> _units = [
    {
      'unit': '1',
      'title': 'الأساسيات والتحيات / Greetings & Basics',
      'level': 'A1.1',
      'lessons': 6,
      'completed': 4,
      'isLocked': false,
      'color': const Color(0xFF2563EB),
    },
    {
      'unit': '2',
      'title': 'المطعم والتسوق / Shopping & Dining',
      'level': 'A1.2',
      'lessons': 8,
      'completed': 2,
      'isLocked': false,
      'color': const Color(0xFF10B981),
    },
    {
      'unit': '3',
      'title': 'الروتين اليومي والوقت / Daily Life & Time',
      'level': 'A2.1',
      'lessons': 8,
      'completed': 0,
      'isLocked': false,
      'color': const Color(0xFFF59E0B),
    },
    {
      'unit': '4',
      'title': 'العمل والمهن / Career & Profession',
      'level': 'A2.2',
      'lessons': 10,
      'completed': 0,
      'isLocked': true,
      'color': const Color(0xFF8B5CF6),
    },
    {
      'unit': '5',
      'title': 'السفر واستكشاف المدينة / Travel & City Life',
      'level': 'B1.1',
      'lessons': 12,
      'completed': 0,
      'isLocked': true,
      'color': const Color(0xFFEC4899),
    },
  ];

  void _startLesson(int index) async {
    final u = _units[index];
    if (u['isLocked'] == true) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(content: Text('هذه الوحدة مقفلة حالياً. أكمل الوحدات السابقة لفتحها! 🔒')),
      );
      return;
    }

    final finished = await Navigator.push(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (context) => LessonSessionScreen(
          unitTitle: u['title'],
          level: u['level'],
        ),
      ),
    );

    if (finished == true && mounted) {
      setState(() {
        if (u['completed'] < u['lessons']) {
          u['completed'] += 1;
        }
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF8FAFC),
      appBar: AppBar(
        elevation: 0,
        backgroundColor: Colors.white,
        iconTheme: const IconThemeData(color: Color(0xFF0F172A)),
        title: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text('Learning Path / مسار ${widget.languageName}', style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF0F172A), fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
            const Text('انقر على أي وحدة لبدء الدرس التفاعلي', style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF64748B), fontSize: 11)),
          ],
        ),
      ),
      body: ListView.builder(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 20),
        itemCount: _units.length,
        itemBuilder: (context, index) {
          final u = _units[index];
          final isLocked = u['isLocked'] as bool;
          final total = u['lessons'] as int;
          final done = u['completed'] as int;
          final progress = done / total;
          final unitColor = u['color'] as Color;

          return Column(
            children: [
              InkWell(
                onTap: () => _startLesson(index),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
                child: Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: isLocked ? const Color(0xFFF1F5F9) : Colors.white,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
                    border: Border.all(color: isLocked ? const Color(0xFFE2E8F0) : unitColor.withValues(alpha: 0.3)),
                    boxShadow: isLocked
                        ? []
                        : [BoxShadow(color: unitColor.withValues(alpha: 0.08), blurRadius: 12, offset: const Offset(0, 4))],
                  ),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          CircleAvatar(
                            radius: 18,
                            backgroundColor: isLocked ? const Color(0xFFCBD5E1) : unitColor,
                            child: Icon(
                              isLocked ? Icons.lock_outline_rounded : (done == total ? Icons.check_rounded : Icons.play_arrow_rounded),
                              color: Colors.white,
                              size: 18,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 12),
                          Expanded(
                            child: Column(
                              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                              children: [
                                Text(
                                  'الوحدة ${u['unit']} • ${u['level']}',
                                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: isLocked ? const Color(0xFF94A3B8) : unitColor),
                                ),
                                const SizedBox(height: 2),
                                Text(
                                  u['title'] as String,
                                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 15, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: isLocked ? const Color(0xFF64748B) : const Color(0xFF0F172A)),
                                ),
                              ],
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 14),
                      ClipRRect(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                        child: LinearProgressIndicator(
                          value: progress,
                          minHeight: 6,
                          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFE2E8F0),
                          valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(unitColor),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 8),
                      Row(
                        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                        children: [
                          Text('$done من $total دروس مكتملة', style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Color(0xFF64748B))),
                          Text('${(progress * 100).toInt()}%', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: isLocked ? const Color(0xFF94A3B8) : unitColor)),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              if (index < _units.length - 1)
                Container(
                  width: 3,
                  height: 28,
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: const Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
                  ),
                ),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../services/progress_storage_service.dart';
import '../services/tts_service.dart';

class FavoritesScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const FavoritesScreen({Key? key}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<FavoritesScreen> createState() => _FavoritesScreenState();
}

class _FavoritesScreenState extends State<FavoritesScreen> {
  final TtsService _tts = TtsService();
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _favorites = [];
  bool _loading = true;
  String _filter = 'ALL';

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadFavorites();
  }

  void _loadFavorites() async {
    final rawList = await ProgressStorageService.getFavorites();
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> parsed = [];
    for (var str in rawList) {
      try {
        parsed.add(Map<String, dynamic>.from(json.decode(str)));
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    setState(() {
      _favorites = parsed;
      _loading = false;
    });
  }

  void _removeFavorite(int index) async {
    final item = _favorites[index];
    await ProgressStorageService.toggleFavorite(json.encode(item));
    setState(() {
      _favorites.removeAt(index);
    });
    if (mounted) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(content: Text('تمت الإزالة من المفضلة')),
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final displayed = _favorites.where((it) {
      if (_filter == 'VERBS') return it['type'] == 'verb';
      if (_filter == 'WORDS') return it['type'] != 'verb';
      return true;
    }).toList();

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF8FAFC),
      appBar: AppBar(
        elevation: 0,
        backgroundColor: Colors.white,
        iconTheme: const IconThemeData(color: Color(0xFF0F172A)),
        title: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            const Text('Saved Terms / كلماتي المحفوظة', style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF0F172A), fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
            Text('${displayed.length} عنصر محفوظ', style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF64748B), fontSize: 11)),
          ],
        ),
      ),
      body: _loading
          ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
          : Column(
              children: [
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 8),
                  color: Colors.white,
                  child: Row(
                    children: [
                      _buildFilterChip('ALL', 'الكل (${_favorites.length})'),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      _buildFilterChip('WORDS', 'مفردات'),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      _buildFilterChip('VERBS', 'أفعال'),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                Expanded(
                  child: displayed.isEmpty
                      ? Center(
                          child: Column(
                            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                            children: [
                              Container(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                                decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                                  color: Color(0xFFEFF6FF),
                                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                                ),
                                child: const Icon(Icons.bookmark_border_rounded, size: 48, color: Color(0xFF2563EB)),
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(height: 16),
                              const Text('لا توجد عناصر محفوظة', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Color(0xFF0F172A))),
                              const SizedBox(height: 6),
                              const Text('احفظ الكلمات أو الأفعال الصعبة للرجوع إليها في أي وقت', style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF64748B), fontSize: 12)),
                            ],
                          ),
                        )
                      : ListView.builder(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                          itemCount: displayed.length,
                          itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                            final item = displayed[index];
                            final term = item['term'] ?? item['word'] ?? '';
                            final meaning = item['meaning'] ?? item['translation'] ?? '';
                            final lang = item['lang'] ?? 'de';
                            final isVerb = item['type'] == 'verb';

                            return Container(
                              margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: Colors.white,
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                                border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFE2E8F0)),
                                boxShadow: const [
                                  BoxShadow(color: Color(0x04000000), blurRadius: 8, offset: Offset(0, 4)),
                                ],
                              ),
                              child: Row(
                                children: [
                                  IconButton(
                                    icon: Icon(Icons.volume_up_rounded, color: isVerb ? const Color(0xFF10B981) : const Color(0xFF2563EB)),
                                    onPressed: () => _tts.speak(term, langCode: lang),
                                  ),
                                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                                  Expanded(
                                    child: Column(
                                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                      children: [
                                        Row(
                                          children: [
                                            Text(term, style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 16, color: Color(0xFF0F172A))),
                                            const SizedBox(width: 8),
                                            Container(
                                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
                                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                                color: isVerb ? const Color(0xFFECFDF5) : const Color(0xFFEFF6FF),
                                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                                              ),
                                              child: Text(
                                                isVerb ? 'فعل' : 'مفردة',
                                                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 10, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: isVerb ? const Color(0xFF10B981) : const Color(0xFF2563EB)),
                                              ),
                                            ),
                                          ],
                                        ),
                                        const SizedBox(height: 2),
                                        Text(meaning, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: Color(0xFF64748B))),
                                      ],
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  IconButton(
                                    icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline_rounded, color: Colors.redAccent),
                                    onPressed: () => _removeFavorite(index),
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            );
                          },
                        ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildFilterChip(String val, String label) {
    final isSel = _filter == val;
    return FilterChip(
      label: Text(label),
      selected: isSel,
      onSelected: (_) => setState(() => _filter = val),
      selectedColor: const Color(0xFF2563EB),
      labelStyle: TextStyle(color: isSel ? Colors.white : const Color(0xFF475569), fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 12),
      backgroundColor: Colors.white,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16), side: BorderSide(color: isSel ? const Color(0xFF2563EB) : const Color(0xFFCBD5E1))),
    );
  }
}
