import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../services/progress_storage_service.dart';
import '../services/tts_service.dart';

class LessonSessionScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final String unitTitle;
  final String level;
  final String languageCode;

  const LessonSessionScreen({
    Key? key,
    required this.unitTitle,
    required this.level,
    this.languageCode = 'de',
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<LessonSessionScreen> createState() => _LessonSessionScreenState();
}

class _LessonSessionScreenState extends State<LessonSessionScreen> {
  final TtsService _tts = TtsService();

  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> _quizData = const [
    {
      'question': 'كيف تقول "صباح الخير" باللغة الألمانية؟',
      'phrase': 'Guten Morgen',
      'options': ['Guten Abend', 'Guten Morgen', 'Auf Wiedersehen', 'Gute Nacht'],
      'correct': 'Guten Morgen',
    },
    {
      'question': 'ما معنى عبارة "Danke schön"؟',
      'phrase': 'Danke schön',
      'options': ['عفواً', 'أهلاً وسهلاً', 'شكراً جزيلاً', 'مع السلامة'],
      'correct': 'شكراً جزيلاً',
    },
    {
      'question': 'اختر العبارة الصحيحة لـ "أنا بخير، شكراً":',
      'phrase': 'Mir geht es gut, danke',
      'options': ['Mir geht es gut, danke', 'Wie geht es dir?', 'Ich heiße Max', 'Bitte sehr'],
      'correct': 'Mir geht es gut, danke',
    },
    {
      'question': 'كيف تسأل شخصاً عن اسمه؟',
      'phrase': 'Wie heißen Sie?',
      'options': ['Woher kommen Sie?', 'Wie alt sind Sie?', 'Wie heißen Sie?', 'Was machen Sie?'],
      'correct': 'Wie heißen Sie?',
    },
  ];

  int _currentIndex = 0;
  String? _selectedOption;
  bool _isAnswered = false;
  int _earnedPoints = 0;

  void _checkAnswer(String option) async {
    if (_isAnswered) return;
    final current = _quizData[_currentIndex];
    final isCorrect = option == current['correct'];

    setState(() {
      _selectedOption = option;
      _isAnswered = true;
      if (isCorrect) {
        _earnedPoints += 15;
      }
    });

    if (isCorrect) {
      await ProgressStorageService.addPoints(15);
    }

    Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 1100), () {
      if (mounted) {
        if (_currentIndex < _quizData.length - 1) {
          setState(() {
            _currentIndex++;
            _selectedOption = null;
            _isAnswered = false;
          });
        } else {
          _showCompletionSheet();
        }
      }
    });
  }

  void _showCompletionSheet() {
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isDismissible: false,
      enableDrag: false,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(28)),
      ),
      builder: (ctx) => Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                color: Color(0xFFEFF6FF),
                shape: BoxShape.circle,
              ),
              child: const Icon(Icons.emoji_events_rounded, size: 48, color: Color(0xFF2563EB)),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            const Text(
              'أحسنت! أكملت الدرس بنجاح 🎉',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Color(0xFF0F172A)),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Text(
              'حصلت على +$_earnedPoints نقطة وأحرزت تقدماً في المسار!',
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: Color(0xFF64748B)),
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 24),
            SizedBox(
              width: double.infinity,
              height: 50,
              child: ElevatedButton(
                style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF2563EB),
                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16)),
                ),
                onPressed: () {
                  Navigator.pop(ctx);
                  Navigator.pop(context, true);
                },
                child: const Text('متابعة المسار التعليمي', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final current = _quizData[_currentIndex];
    final progress = (_currentIndex + 1) / _quizData.length;

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF8FAFC),
      appBar: AppBar(
        elevation: 0,
        backgroundColor: Colors.white,
        iconTheme: const IconThemeData(color: Color(0xFF0F172A)),
        title: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text(widget.unitTitle, style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF0F172A), fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
            Text('مستوى ${widget.level} • تدريب تفاعلي', style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF64748B), fontSize: 11)),
          ],
        ),
        actions: [
          Container(
            margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: const Color(0xFFEFF6FF),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            ),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                const Icon(Icons.star_rounded, color: Colors.amber, size: 16),
                const SizedBox(width: 4),
                Text('+$_earnedPoints Pts', style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF2563EB), fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 12)),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            ClipRRect(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
              child: LinearProgressIndicator(
                value: progress,
                minHeight: 6,
                backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFE2E8F0),
                valueColor: const AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(Color(0xFF2563EB)),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Text('السؤال ${_currentIndex + 1} من ${_quizData.length}', style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF64748B), fontSize: 12)),
            const SizedBox(height: 20),
            Container(
              width: double.infinity,
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.white,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
                border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFE2E8F0)),
              ),
              child: Column(
                children: [
                  Text(
                    current['question'],
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Color(0xFF0F172A)),
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  Row(
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        current['phrase'],
                        style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 20, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Color(0xFF2563EB)),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      IconButton(
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.volume_up_rounded, color: Color(0xFF2563EB)),
                        onPressed: () => _tts.speak(current['phrase'], langCode: widget.languageCode),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 24),
            Expanded(
              child: ListView.separated(
                itemCount: (current['options'] as List).length,
                separatorBuilder: (_, __) => const SizedBox(height: 12),
                itemBuilder: (context, idx) {
                  final opt = (current['options'] as List)[idx];
                  Color bg = Colors.white;
                  Color border = const Color(0xFFE2E8F0);
                  Color textCol = const Color(0xFF0F172A);

                  if (_isAnswered) {
                    if (opt == current['correct']) {
                      bg = const Color(0xFFECFDF5);
                      border = const Color(0xFF10B981);
                      textCol = const Color(0xFF059669);
                    } else if (opt == _selectedOption) {
                      bg = const Color(0xFFFEF2F2);
                      border = const Color(0xFFEF4444);
                      textCol = const Color(0xFFDC2626);
                    }
                  }

                  return InkWell(
                    onTap: () => _checkAnswer(opt),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                    child: Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: bg,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                        border: Border.all(color: border, width: 1.5),
                      ),
                      child: Row(
                        children: [
                          CircleAvatar(
                            radius: 12,
                            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF1F5F9),
                            child: Text('${idx + 1}', style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Color(0xFF64748B), fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 12),
                          Expanded(
                            child: Text(
                              opt,
                              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 15, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: textCol),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                },
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class SafeErrorBoundary extends StatelessWidget {
  final Widget child;
  const SafeErrorBoundary({super.key, required this.child});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    ErrorWidget.builder = (FlutterErrorDetails details) {
      return Material(
        color: Colors.transparent,
        child: Center(
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                const Icon(Icons.refresh_rounded, size: 48, color: Colors.blueAccent),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                const Text(
                  'حدث خطأ غير متوقع في هذا الجزء',
                  style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                ),
                TextButton(
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).maybePop(),
                  child: const Text('العودة للواجهة السابقة'),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
    };
    return child;
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class GermanArticleCard extends StatelessWidget {
  final String german;
  final String arabic;
  final VoidCallback? onSpeak;

  const GermanArticleCard({
    super.key,
    required this.german,
    required this.arabic,
    this.onSpeak,
  });

  Color _getArticleColor(String text) {
    final lower = text.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (lower.startsWith('der ')) return Colors.blue.shade700;
    if (lower.startsWith('die ')) return Colors.red.shade600;
    if (lower.startsWith('das ')) return Colors.green.shade700;
    return Colors.teal.shade700;
  }

  String _extractArticle(String text) {
    final parts = text.trim().split(' ');
    if (parts.length > 1 && ['der', 'die', 'das'].contains(parts.first.toLowerCase())) {
      return parts.first;
    }
    return '';
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final article = _extractArticle(german);
    final accentColor = _getArticleColor(german);

    return Card(
      elevation: 2,
      margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 6),
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        side: BorderSide(color: accentColor.withValues(alpha: 0.3), width: 1.5),
      ),
      child: ListTile(
        leading: article.isNotEmpty
            ? Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: accentColor,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                ),
                child: Text(
                  article,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    color: Colors.white,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  ),
                ),
              )
            : Icon(Icons.translate, color: accentColor),
        title: Text(
          german,
          style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 18),
        ),
        subtitle: Text(
          arabic,
          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16, color: Colors.black87),
        ),
        trailing: onSpeak != null
            ? IconButton(
                icon: const Icon(Icons.volume_up_rounded, color: Colors.blueAccent),
                onPressed: onSpeak,
              )
            : null,
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_tts/flutter_tts.dart';

class InteractiveAudioController extends StatefulWidget {
  final String primaryText;
  final String primaryLocale; // e.g. 'de-DE', 'en-US', 'fr-FR'
  final String? translatedText;
  final String translatedLocale; // e.g. 'ar-SA'

  const InteractiveAudioController({
    super.key,
    required this.primaryText,
    this.primaryLocale = 'de-DE',
    this.translatedText,
    this.translatedLocale = 'ar-SA',
  });

  @override
  State<InteractiveAudioController> createState() => _InteractiveAudioControllerState();
}

class _InteractiveAudioControllerState extends State<InteractiveAudioController> {
  final FlutterTts _tts = FlutterTts();

  int _repeatTarget = 1;
  int _currentIteration = 0;
  double _speechRate = 0.5; // السرعة الافتراضية المناسبة للتعلم
  bool _isPlaying = false;
  bool _isCancelled = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _initTts();
  }

  Future<void> _initTts() async {
    await _tts.setVolume(1.0);
    await _tts.setPitch(1.0);
  }

  Future<void> _speakLoop({required String text, required String locale}) async {
    if (text.trim().isEmpty) return;

    setState(() {
      _isPlaying = true;
      _isCancelled = false;
      _currentIteration = 0;
    });

    await _tts.setLanguage(locale);
    await _tts.setSpeechRate(_speechRate);

    for (int i = 1; i <= _repeatTarget; i++) {
      if (_isCancelled || !mounted) break;

      setState(() => _currentIteration = i);
      await _tts.speak(text);

      // انتظار انتهاء نطق الكلمة ثم فاصل مريح قبل التكرار التالي
      await Future.delayed(Duration(milliseconds: (1200 / _speechRate).round()));

      if (_isCancelled || !mounted) break;
    }

    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _isPlaying = false;
        _currentIteration = 0;
      });
    }
  }

  void _stop() {
    _isCancelled = true;
    _tts.stop();
    setState(() {
      _isPlaying = false;
      _currentIteration = 0;
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _isCancelled = true;
    _tts.stop();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Theme.of(context).cardColor,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.06),
            blurRadius: 12,
            offset: const Offset(0, 4),
          ),
        ],
        border: Border.all(color: Colors.blueAccent.withValues(alpha: 0.15)),
      ),
      child: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          // عداد التكرارات من 1 إلى 9
          Row(
            children: [
              const Icon(Icons.repeat_rounded, size: 20, color: Colors.blueAccent),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              const Text(
                'مرات التكرار:',
                style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 14),
              ),
              const Spacer(),
              Wrap(
                spacing: 4,
                children: List.generate(9, (index) {
                  final val = index + 1;
                  final isSelected = _repeatTarget == val;
                  return InkWell(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                    onTap: _isPlaying ? null : () => setState(() => _repeatTarget = val),
                    child: Container(
                      width: 28,
                      height: 28,
                      alignment: Alignment.center,
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: isSelected ? Colors.blueAccent : Colors.grey.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                      ),
                      child: Text(
                        '$val',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          color: isSelected ? Colors.white : Colors.black87,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          fontSize: 12,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                }),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),

          // مؤشر سرعة النطق
          Row(
            children: [
              const Icon(Icons.speed_rounded, size: 20, color: Colors.teal),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Text(
                'السرعة: ${_speechRate.toStringAsFixed(2)}x',
                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
              ),
              Expanded(
                child: Slider(
                  value: _speechRate,
                  min: 0.25,
                  max: 1.0,
                  divisions: 6,
                  label: '${_speechRate.toStringAsFixed(2)}x',
                  onChanged: _isPlaying
                      ? null
                      : (val) => setState(() => _speechRate = val),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const Divider(height: 16),

          // أزرار التشغيل والتحكم التفاعلي
          Row(
            children: [
              // زر نطق اللغة الأساسية
              Expanded(
                child: ElevatedButton.icon(
                  style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                    backgroundColor: Colors.blueAccent,
                    foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                    shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10),
                  ),
                  icon: Icon(_isPlaying ? Icons.stop_rounded : Icons.volume_up_rounded),
                  label: Text(
                    _isPlaying
                        ? 'إيقاف ($_currentIteration/$_repeatTarget)'
                        : 'نطق الأصل',
                    style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                  ),
                  onPressed: () {
                    if (_isPlaying) {
                      _stop();
                    } else {
                      _speakLoop(
                        text: widget.primaryText,
                        locale: widget.primaryLocale,
                      );
                    }
                  },
                ),
              ),

              // زر نطق الترجمة (إن وجدت)
              if (widget.translatedText != null && widget.translatedText!.isNotEmpty) ...[
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                IconButton.filledTonal(
                  tooltip: 'نطق الترجمة',
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.translate_rounded),
                  onPressed: _isPlaying
                      ? null
                      : () {
                          _speakLoop(
                            text: widget.translatedText!,
                            locale: widget.translatedLocale,
                          );
                        },
                ),
              ],
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

class SmartCopyButton extends StatefulWidget {
  final String textToCopy;
  final String? label; // عنوان الكلمة ليظهر في التنبيه مثل "تم نسخ الكلمة"
  final Color? iconColor;
  final double iconSize;

  const SmartCopyButton({
    super.key,
    required this.textToCopy,
    this.label,
    this.iconColor,
    this.iconSize = 22.0,
  });

  @override
  State<SmartCopyButton> createState() => _SmartCopyButtonState();
}

class _SmartCopyButtonState extends State<SmartCopyButton> {
  bool _copied = false;

  Future<void> _handleCopy() async {
    if (widget.textToCopy.trim().isEmpty) return;

    // نسخ النص إلى الحافظة
    await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: widget.textToCopy.trim()));

    // اهتزاز لمسي خفيف للتأكيد
    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();

    if (!mounted) return;

    setState(() => _copied = true);

    // إظهار تنبيه أنيق أسفل الشاشة
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).clearSnackBars();
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Row(
          children: [
            const Icon(Icons.check_circle_rounded, color: Colors.greenAccent, size: 20),
            const SizedBox(width: 10),
            Expanded(
              child: Text(
                widget.label != null
                    ? 'تم نسخ: "${widget.label}"'
                    : 'تم نسخ النص إلى الحافظة',
                style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                maxLines: 1,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        duration: const Duration(seconds: 2),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
        margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 16),
      ),
    );

    // إعادة الأيقونة لحالتها الطبيعية بعد ثانية ونصف
    await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 1500));
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() => _copied = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedSwitcher(
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 250),
      transitionBuilder: (child, anim) => ScaleTransition(scale: anim, child: child),
      child: IconButton(
        key: ValueKey<bool>(_copied),
        tooltip: 'نسخ إلى الحافظة',
        iconSize: widget.iconSize,
        icon: Icon(
          _copied ? Icons.check_circle_rounded : Icons.copy_rounded,
          color: _copied ? Colors.green : (widget.iconColor ?? Colors.grey.shade700),
        ),
        onPressed: _copied ? null : _handleCopy,
      ),
    );
  }
}
